This paper introduces a symmetry-aware heterogeneous graph neural network (Sym-HGNN) that infers contact states directly from proprioceptive measurements, including IMU and cable-length histories, without dedicated contact sensors. The network incorporates the robot's dihedral symmetry $D_3$ into the message-passing process to enhance sample efficiency and generalization. The predicted contacts are integrated into a state-of-the-art contact-aided invariant extended Kalman filter (InEKF) for improved pose estimation. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves up to 15% higher accuracy and 5% higher F1-score using only 20% of the training data compared to the CNN and MI-HGNN baselines, while maintaining low-drift and physically consistent state estimation results comparable to ground truth contacts. This work highlights the potential of fully proprioceptive sensing for accurate and robust state estimation in tensegrity robots. Code available at: https://github.com/Jonathan-Twz/Tensegrity-Sym-HGNN
summary_zh: 张拉整体机器人因其轻量化和弹性的结构而著称，但由于其柔顺和分布式的地面接触，给状态估计带来了重大挑战。本文提出了一种对称性感知的异构图神经网络（Sym-HGNN），该网络可以直接从本体感受测量值（包括IMU和缆绳长度历史记录）推断接触状态，而无需专门的接触传感器。该网络将机器人的二面体对称性$D_3$融入到消息传递过程中，从而提高样本效率和泛化能力。预测的接触状态被集成到最先进的接触辅助不变扩展卡尔曼滤波器（InEKF）中，以改善姿态估计。仿真结果表明，与CNN和MI-HGNN基线相比，所提出的方法仅使用20%的训练数据，即可实现高达15%的精度提升和5%的F1分数提升，同时保持与真实接触状态相当的低漂移和物理一致的状态估计结果。这项工作突显了完全本体感受传感在张拉整体机器人中实现精确且鲁棒的状态估计的潜力。代码可在此处获取：https://github.com/Jonathan-Twz/Tensegrity-Sym-HGNN
tldr: This paper introduces a symmetry-aware heterogeneous graph neural network (Sym-HGNN) for contact state estimation in tensegrity robots, using only proprioceptive sensors, achieving improved pose estimation accuracy compared to baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种对称感知异构图神经网络（Sym-HGNN），用于张拉整体机器人的接触状态估计，仅使用本体感受传感器，与基线方法相比，实现了更高的姿态估计精度。

title: A Robust Simulation Framework for Verification and Validation of Autonomous Maritime Navigation in Adverse Weather and Constrained Environments
summary: Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships (MASS) have emerged as a promising solution to enhance navigational safety, operational efficiency, and long-term cost effectiveness. However, their reliable deployment requires rigorous verification and validation (V\&V) under various environmental conditions, including extreme and safety-critical scenarios. This paper presents an enhanced virtual simulation framework to support the V\&V of MASS in realistic maritime environments, with particular emphasis on the influence of weather and bathymetry on autonomous navigation performance. The framework incorporates a high-fidelity environmental modeling suite capable of simulating adverse weather conditions such as rain, fog, and wave dynamics. The key factors that affect weather, such as rain and visibility, are parameterized to affect sea-state characteristics, perception, and sensing systems, resulting in position and velocity uncertainty, reduced visibility, and degraded situational awareness. Furthermore, high-resolution bathymetric data from major U.S. ports are integrated to enable depth-aware navigation, grounding prevention capabilities, and evaluation of vessel controllability in shallow or confined waterways. The proposed framework offers extensive configurability, enabling systematic testing in a wide spectrum of maritime conditions, including scenarios that are impractical or unsafe to replicate in real-world trials, thus supporting the V\&V of MASS.
summary_zh: 水面自主航行船舶（MASS）已成为提高航行安全、运行效率和长期成本效益的一种有前景的解决方案。然而，其可靠部署需要在各种环境条件下进行严格的验证和确认（V\&V），包括极端和安全攸关的场景。本文提出了一种增强型虚拟仿真框架，以支持MASS在真实海事环境中的V\&V，特别强调天气和水深地形对自主导航性能的影响。该框架包含一个高保真环境建模套件，能够模拟诸如雨、雾和波浪动力学等不利天气条件。影响天气的关键因素，如降雨和能见度，被参数化以影响海况特征、感知和传感系统，从而导致位置和速度不确定性、能见度降低以及情境感知能力下降。此外，集成了美国主要港口的高分辨率水深数据，以实现深度感知导航、预防搁浅能力以及评估船舶在浅水或限制水道中的可控性。所提出的框架提供了广泛的可配置性，能够在各种海事条件下进行系统测试，包括在现实世界试验中不切实际或不安全的场景，从而支持MASS的验证和确认。
tldr: This paper introduces a simulation framework for the verification and validation of Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships (MASS) under adverse weather and constrained environments using high-fidelity environmental modeling and bathymetric data.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个仿真框架，用于在恶劣天气和受限环境下验证和确认海上自主水面舰艇 (MASS)，该框架使用高保真环境建模和测深数据。

title: COLREGs Compliant Collision Avoidance and Grounding Prevention for Autonomous Marine Navigation
summary: Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships (MASS) are increasingly regarded as a promising solution to address crew shortages, improve navigational safety, and improve operational efficiency in the maritime industry. Nevertheless, the reliable deployment of MASS in real-world environments remains a significant challenge, particularly in congested waters where the majority of maritime accidents occur. This emphasizes the need for safe and regulation-aware motion planning strategies for MASS that are capable of operating under dynamic maritime conditions. This paper presents a unified motion planning method for MASS that achieves real time collision avoidance, compliance with International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea (COLREGs), and grounding prevention. The proposed work introduces a convex optimization method that integrates velocity obstacle-based (VO) collision constraints, COLREGs-based directional constraints, and bathymetry-based grounding constraints to generate computationally efficient, rule-compliant optimal velocity selection. To enhance robustness, the classical VO method is extended to consider uncertainty in the position and velocity estimates of the target vessel. Unnavigable shallow water regions obtained from bathymetric data, which are inherently nonconvex, are approximated via convex geometries using a integer linear programming (ILP), allowing grounding constraints to be incorporated into the motion planning. The resulting optimization generates optimal and dynamically feasible input velocities that meet collision avoidance, regulatory compliance, kinodynamic limits, and grounding prevention requirements. Simulation results involving multi-vessel encounters demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in producing safe and regulation-compliant maneuvers, highlighting the suitability of the proposed approach for real time autonomous maritime navigation.
summary_zh: 无人自主水面船舶(MASS)日益被认为是解决海员短缺、提高航行安全和提高海运业运营效率的有前景的方案。然而，在真实环境中可靠地部署MASS仍然是一个重大挑战，尤其是在海上事故发生频率最高的拥挤水域。这突显了对MASS安全且符合法规的运动规划策略的需求，这些策略能够在动态的海上条件下运行。本文提出了一种统一的MASS运动规划方法，该方法能够实现实时避碰、遵守《国际海上避碰规则》(COLREGs)以及防止搁浅。所提出的工作引入了一种凸优化方法，该方法集成了基于速度障碍(VO)的碰撞约束、基于COLREGs的方向约束和基于测深数据的搁浅约束，以生成计算高效、符合规则的最优速度选择。为了增强鲁棒性，传统的VO方法被扩展，以考虑目标船舶的位置和速度估计中的不确定性。利用整数线性规划(ILP)将从测深数据中获得的不可航行的浅水区域（本质上是非凸的）近似为凸几何体，从而可以将搁浅约束纳入运动规划中。由此产生的优化生成最优且动态可行的输入速度，满足避碰、法规遵从性、运动学约束和防止搁浅的要求。涉及多船相遇的仿真结果表明，所提出的方法在产生安全且符合规则的操纵方面是有效的，突出了所提出的方法适用于实时自主海上导航。
tldr: This paper proposes a convex optimization method for autonomous marine navigation that achieves real-time collision avoidance, COLREGs compliance, and grounding prevention by integrating velocity obstacle constraints, directional constraints, and bathymetry-based grounding constraints.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于自主船舶导航的凸优化方法，通过整合速度障碍约束、方向约束和基于测深法的接地约束，实现了实时避碰、COLREGs 合规和防搁浅。

title: A Novel Modular Cable-Driven Soft Robotic Arm with Multi-Segment Reconfigurability
summary: This paper presents a novel, modular, cable-driven soft robotic arm featuring multi-segment reconfigurability. The proposed architecture enables a stackable system with independent segment control, allowing scalable adaptation to diverse structural and application requirements. The system is fabricated from soft silicone material and incorporates embedded tendon-routing channels with a protective dual-helical tendon structure. Experimental results showed that modular stacking substantially expanded the reachable workspace: relative to the single-segment arm, the three-segment configuration achieved up to a 13-fold increase in planar workspace area and a 38.9-fold increase in workspace volume. Furthermore, this study investigated the effect of silicone stiffness on actuator performance. The results revealed a clear trade-off between compliance and stiffness: softer silicone improved bending flexibility, while stiffer silicone improved structural rigidity and load-bearing stability. These results highlight the potential of stiffness tuning to balance compliance and strength for configuring scalable, reconfigurable soft robotic arms.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新型的、模块化的、绳索驱动的软体机械臂，其特点是具有多段可重构性。所提出的架构实现了一种可堆叠系统，具有独立的段控制，从而能够根据不同的结构和应用需求进行可扩展的适应。该系统由柔软的硅胶材料制成，并包含嵌入式肌腱布线通道和保护性的双螺旋肌腱结构。实验结果表明，模块化堆叠显著扩大了可达工作空间：相对于单段机械臂，三段配置将平面工作区面积最大扩展了13倍，工作区体积扩展了38.9倍。此外，本研究还探讨了硅胶刚度对执行器性能的影响。结果揭示了顺应性和刚度之间存在明显的权衡：较软的硅胶提高了弯曲灵活性，而较硬的硅胶提高了结构刚度和承载稳定性。这些结果突出了刚度调节在平衡顺应性和强度方面的潜力，可用于配置可扩展的、可重构的软体机械臂。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel modular, cable-driven soft robotic arm with multi-segment reconfigurability, demonstrating significant workspace expansion and exploring the trade-off between silicone stiffness and actuator performance. The arm is designed for scalable adaptation to diverse applications.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新型的模块化、缆绳驱动的软体机器人手臂，具有多段可重构性，展示了显著的工作空间扩展，并探讨了硅胶刚度和执行器性能之间的权衡。该手臂旨在以可扩展的方式适应各种应用。

title: Learning Therapist Policy from Therapist-Exoskeleton-Patient Interaction
summary: Post-stroke rehabilitation is often necessary for patients to regain proper walking gait. However, the typical therapy process can be exhausting and physically demanding for therapists, potentially reducing therapy intensity, duration, and consistency over time. We propose a Patient-Therapist Force Field (PTFF) to visualize therapist responses to patient kinematics and a Synthetic Therapist (ST) machine learning model to support the therapist in dyadic robot-mediated physical interaction therapy. The first encodes patient and therapist stride kinematics into a shared low-dimensional latent manifold using a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) and models their interaction through a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), which learns a probabilistic vector field mapping patient latent states to therapist responses. This representation visualizes patient-therapist interaction dynamics to inform therapy strategies and robot controller design. The latter is implemented as a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network trained on patient-therapist interaction data to predict therapist-applied joint torques from patient kinematics. Trained and validated using leave-one-out cross-validation across eight post-stroke patients, the model was integrated into a ROS-based exoskeleton controller to generate real-time torque assistance based on predicted therapist responses. Offline results and preliminary testing indicate the potential of their use as an alternative approach to post-stroke exoskeleton therapy. The PTFF provides understanding of the therapist's actions while the ST frees the human therapist from the exoskeleton, allowing them to continuously monitor the patient's nuanced condition.
summary_zh: 卒中后患者通常需要进行康复治疗以恢复正常的步态。然而，典型的治疗过程对于治疗师来说通常会非常疲惫和耗费体力，这可能会随着时间的推移降低治疗强度、持续时间和一致性。我们提出一种患者-治疗师力场（PTFF）来可视化治疗师对患者运动学响应，以及一种合成治疗师（ST）机器学习模型，以支持治疗师在二元机器人辅助物理互动治疗中的工作。前者使用变分自编码器(VAE)将患者和治疗师的步态运动学编码到共享的低维潜在流形中，并通过高斯混合模型(GMM)对他们的互动进行建模，该模型学习一种概率向量场，将患者潜在状态映射到治疗师的响应。这种表示方法可视化了患者-治疗师的互动动态，从而为制定治疗策略和机器人控制器设计提供信息。后者被实现为一个长短期记忆(LSTM)网络，该网络在患者-治疗师互动数据上进行训练，从而从患者运动学数据中预测治疗师施加的关节扭矩。该模型通过对八名卒中后患者进行留一法交叉验证进行训练和验证，并被集成到基于ROS的外骨骼控制器中，以基于预测的治疗师响应生成实时扭矩辅助。离线结果和初步测试表明，它们有潜力作为卒中后外骨骼治疗的替代方法。PTFF提供了对治疗师行为的理解，而ST将人类治疗师从外骨骼中解放出来，使其能够持续监测患者的细微状况。
tldr: This paper introduces a Patient-Therapist Force Field (PTFF) and a Synthetic Therapist (ST) using VAE, GMM, and LSTM to model therapist-patient interaction during post-stroke rehabilitation, aiming to provide robotic exoskeleton assistance and free the therapist for continuous patient monitoring.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种患者-治疗师力场 (PTFF) 和一个合成治疗师 (ST)，它们使用 VAE、GMM 和 LSTM 来建模中风后康复期间治疗师与患者的互动，旨在提供机器人外骨骼辅助并使治疗师能够持续监测患者。

title: Learning Memory-Enhanced Improvement Heuristics for Flexible Job Shop Scheduling
summary: The rise of smart manufacturing under Industry 4.0 introduces mass customization and dynamic production, demanding more advanced and flexible scheduling techniques. The flexible job-shop scheduling problem (FJSP) has attracted significant attention due to its complex constraints and strong alignment with real-world production scenarios. Current deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based approaches to FJSP predominantly employ constructive methods. While effective, they often fall short of reaching (near-)optimal solutions. In contrast, improvement-based methods iteratively explore the neighborhood of initial solutions and are more effective in approaching optimality. However, the flexible machine allocation in FJSP poses significant challenges to the application of this framework, including accurate state representation, effective policy learning, and efficient search strategies. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a Memory-enhanced Improvement Search framework with heterogeneous graph representation--MIStar. It employs a novel heterogeneous disjunctive graph that explicitly models the operation sequences on machines to accurately represent scheduling solutions. Moreover, a memoryenhanced heterogeneous graph neural network (MHGNN) is designed for feature extraction, leveraging historical trajectories to enhance the decision-making capability of the policy network. Finally, a parallel greedy search strategy is adopted to explore the solution space, enabling superior solutions with fewer iterations. Extensive experiments on synthetic data and public benchmarks demonstrate that MIStar significantly outperforms both traditional handcrafted improvement heuristics and state-of-the-art DRL-based constructive methods.
summary_zh: 工业4.0背景下智能制造的兴起带来了大规模定制和动态生产，对更先进和灵活的调度技术提出了需求。柔性作业车间调度问题(FJSP)因其复杂的约束和与实际生产场景的高度一致性而备受关注。目前基于深度强化学习(DRL)的FJSP方法主要采用构造性方法。虽然有效，但通常难以达到(近)最优解。相比之下，改进型方法迭代地探索初始解的邻域，在逼近最优性方面更有效。然而，FJSP中灵活的机器分配对该框架的应用提出了重大挑战，包括准确的状态表示、有效的策略学习和高效的搜索策略。为了应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种基于异构图表示的、具有记忆增强的改进搜索框架——MIStar。它采用了一种新颖的异构析取图，显式地建模机器上的工序序列，以准确地表示调度方案。此外，设计了一种记忆增强的异构图神经网络(MHGNN)用于特征提取，利用历史轨迹来增强策略网络的决策能力。最后，采用并行贪婪搜索策略来探索解空间，从而能够以更少的迭代次数获得更优的解。在合成数据和公共基准测试上的大量实验表明，MIStar显著优于传统的手工改进启发式算法和最先进的基于DRL的构造性方法。
tldr: This paper introduces MIStar, a memory-enhanced improvement search framework using heterogeneous graph representation and a graph neural network, to solve flexible job shop scheduling problems, outperforming existing DRL and heuristic methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为MIStar的内存增强改进搜索框架，它使用异构图表示和图神经网络来解决柔性作业车间调度问题，其性能优于现有的DRL和启发式方法。

title: Enhancing User Throughput in Multi-panel mmWave Radio Access Networks for Beam-based MU-MIMO Using a DRL Method
summary: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) communication systems, particularly those leveraging multi-user multiple-input and multiple-output (MU-MIMO) with hybrid beamforming, face challenges in optimizing user throughput and minimizing latency due to the high complexity of dynamic beam selection and management. This paper introduces a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approach for enhancing user throughput in multi-panel mmWave radio access networks in a practical network setup. Our DRL-based formulation utilizes an adaptive beam management strategy that models the interaction between the communication agent and its environment as a Markov decision process (MDP), optimizing beam selection based on real-time observations. The proposed framework exploits spatial domain (SD) characteristics by incorporating the cross-correlation between the beams in different antenna panels, the measured reference signal received power (RSRP), and the beam usage statistics to dynamically adjust beamforming decisions. As a result, the spectral efficiency is improved and end-to-end latency is reduced. The numerical results demonstrate an increase in throughput of up to 16% and a reduction in latency by factors 3-7x compared to baseline (legacy beam management).
summary_zh: 毫米波（mmWave）通信系统，特别是那些利用混合波束成形的 multi-user multiple-input and multiple-output (MU-MIMO) 的系统，由于动态波束选择和管理的高度复杂性，在优化用户吞吐量和最小化延迟方面面临挑战。本文提出了一种基于深度强化学习（DRL）的方法，用于在实际网络设置中增强多面板毫米波无线接入网络中的用户吞吐量。我们的基于 DRL 的公式利用了一种自适应波束管理策略，该策略将通信代理与其环境之间的交互建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），并基于实时观测优化波束选择。该提出的框架通过结合不同天线面板中波束之间的互相关、测量的参考信号接收功率（RSRP）以及波束使用统计信息来利用空间域（SD）特性，从而动态调整波束赋形决策。结果表明，频谱效率得到提高，端到端延迟得以降低。数值结果表明，与基线（传统波束管理）相比，吞吐量提高了高达 16%，延迟降低了 3-7 倍。
tldr: This paper proposes a DRL-based adaptive beam management strategy for mmWave MU-MIMO systems, achieving significant throughput increase and latency reduction compared to legacy methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于DRL (深度强化学习) 的自适应波束管理策略，用于毫米波多用户多输入多输出 (MU-MIMO) 系统，与传统方法相比，实现了显著的吞吐量增加和延迟降低。

title: RADAR: Learning to Route with Asymmetry-aware DistAnce Representations
summary: Recent neural solvers have achieved strong performance on vehicle routing problems (VRPs), yet they mainly assume symmetric Euclidean distances, restricting applicability to real-world scenarios. A core challenge is encoding the relational features in asymmetric distance matrices of VRPs. Early attempts directly encoded these matrices but often failed to produce compact embeddings and generalized poorly at scale. In this paper, we propose RADAR, a scalable neural framework that augments existing neural VRP solvers with the ability to handle asymmetric inputs. RADAR addresses asymmetry from both static and dynamic perspectives. It leverages Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) on the asymmetric distance matrix to initialize compact and generalizable embeddings that inherently encode the static asymmetry in the inbound and outbound costs of each node. To further model dynamic asymmetry in embedding interactions during encoding, it replaces the standard softmax with Sinkhorn normalization that imposes joint row and column distance awareness in attention weights. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks across various VRPs show that RADAR outperforms strong baselines on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution instances, demonstrating robust generalization and superior performance in solving asymmetric VRPs.
summary_zh: 最近的神经求解器在车辆路径问题（VRP）上取得了显著的性能，然而它们主要假设对称欧几里得距离，限制了在真实世界场景中的适用性。一个核心挑战是在VRP的不对称距离矩阵中编码关系特征。早期的尝试直接编码这些矩阵，但通常未能产生紧凑的嵌入，并且在规模上泛化能力较差。在本文中，我们提出RADAR，一个可扩展的神经框架，通过增强现有的神经VRP求解器使其能够处理不对称输入。RADAR从静态和动态两个角度解决不对称性。它利用不对称距离矩阵的奇异值分解（SVD）来初始化紧凑且可泛化的嵌入，这些嵌入固有地编码了每个节点的流入和流出成本中的静态不对称性。为了进一步建模编码过程中嵌入交互中的动态不对称性，它用Sinkhorn归一化取代了标准softmax，Sinkhorn归一化在注意力权重中施加了联合行和列的距离感知。在各种VRP上的合成和真实世界基准上的大量实验表明，RADAR在同分布和异分布实例上均优于强大的基线，证明了其在解决不对称VRP中的鲁棒泛化能力和卓越性能。
tldr: The paper introduces RADAR, a neural framework that enhances VRP solvers to handle asymmetric distance matrices by using SVD for static asymmetry and Sinkhorn normalization for dynamic asymmetry, achieving better generalization in complex routing problems.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为RADAR的神经网络框架，它通过使用奇异值分解（SVD）处理静态不对称性，并使用Sinkhorn归一化处理动态不对称性，从而增强车辆路径问题（VRP）求解器处理非对称距离矩阵的能力，并在复杂的路径问题中实现了更好的泛化。

title: COOL-MC: Verifying and Explaining RL Policies for Platelet Inventory Management
summary: Platelets expire within five days. Blood banks face uncertain daily demand and must balance ordering decisions between costly wastage from overstocking and life-threatening shortages from understocking. Reinforcement learning (RL) can learn effective ordering policies for this Markov decision process (MDP), but the resulting neural policies remain black boxes, hindering trust and adoption in safety-critical domains. We apply COOL-MC, a tool that combines RL with probabilistic model checking and explainable RL, to verify and explain a trained policy for the MDP on platelet inventory management inspired by Haijema et al. By constructing a policy-induced discrete-time Markov chain (which includes only the reachable states under the trained policy to reduce memory usage), we verify PCTL properties and provide feature-level explanations. Results show that the trained policy achieves a 2.9% stockout probability and a 1.1% inventory-full (potential wastage) probability within a 200-step horizon, primarily attends to the age distribution of inventory rather than other features such as day of week or pending orders. Action reachability analysis reveals that the policy employs a diverse replenishment strategy, with most order quantities reached quickly, while several are never selected. Counterfactual analysis shows that replacing medium-large orders with smaller ones leaves both safety probabilities nearly unchanged, indicating that these orders are placed in well-buffered inventory states. This first formal verification and explanation of an RL platelet inventory management policy demonstrates COOL-MC's value for transparent, auditable decision-making in safety-critical healthcare supply chain domains.
summary_zh: 血小板的有效期为五天。血库面临着不确定的每日需求，必须在过度库存导致的高昂浪费和库存不足导致的危及生命的短缺之间权衡订购决策。强化学习 (RL) 可以为该马尔可夫决策过程 (MDP) 学习有效的订购策略，但由此产生的神经策略仍然是黑盒，阻碍了在安全关键领域的信任和采用。我们应用 COOL-MC，一种结合了 RL、概率模型检验和可解释 RL 的工具，来验证和解释基于 Haijema 等人提出的血小板库存管理 MDP 训练策略。通过构建策略诱导的离散时间马尔可夫链（仅包含训练策略下的可达状态，以减少内存使用），我们验证了 PCTL 属性并提供了特征级别的解释。结果表明，训练后的策略在 200 步范围内实现了 2.9% 的缺货概率和 1.1% 的库存满溢（潜在浪费）概率，主要关注库存的年龄分布，而不是一周中的哪一天或待处理订单等其他特征。行动可达性分析表明，该策略采用多样化的补货策略，大多数订购数量都能快速达到，而有几个数量则从未被选择。反事实分析表明，用较小的订单替换中等大小的订单几乎不会改变两种安全概率，表明这些订单是在缓冲良好的库存状态下下的。对 RL 血小板库存管理策略的首次正式验证和解释证明了 COOL-MC 在安全关键的医疗保健供应链领域中透明、可审核的决策制定的价值。
tldr: The paper presents COOL-MC, a tool for verifying and explaining RL policies, and applies it to platelet inventory management, a safety-critical healthcare domain, to enhance trust and adoption.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了COOL-MC，一个用于验证和解释强化学习策略的工具，并将其应用于血小板库存管理这一安全攸关的医疗领域，以增强信任和采用。

title: Towards an Incremental Unified Multimodal Anomaly Detection: Augmenting Multimodal Denoising From an Information Bottleneck Perspective
summary: The quest for incremental unified multimodal anomaly detection seeks to empower a single model with the ability to systematically detect anomalies across all categories and support incremental learning to accommodate emerging objects/categories. Central to this pursuit is resolving the catastrophic forgetting dilemma, which involves acquiring new knowledge while preserving prior learned knowledge. Despite some efforts to address this dilemma, a key oversight persists: ignoring the potential impact of spurious and redundant features on catastrophic forgetting. In this paper, we delve into the negative effect of spurious and redundant features on this dilemma in incremental unified frameworks, and reveal that under similar conditions, the multimodal framework developed by naive aggregation of unimodal architectures is more prone to forgetting. To address this issue, we introduce a novel denoising framework called IB-IUMAD, which exploits the complementary benefits of the Mamba decoder and information bottleneck fusion module: the former dedicated to disentangle inter-object feature coupling, preventing spurious feature interference between objects; the latter serves to filter out redundant features from the fused features, thus explicitly preserving discriminative information. A series of theoretical analyses and experiments on MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies datasets demonstrates the effectiveness and competitive performance of IB-IUMAD.
summary_zh: 针对增量统一多模态异常检测的研究旨在赋予单个模型系统性地检测所有类别的异常，并支持增量学习以适应新兴对象/类别。该研究的核心是解决灾难性遗忘困境，即在获取新知识的同时保留先前习得的知识。尽管已有一些工作致力于解决这一困境，但一个关键的疏忽仍然存在：忽略了虚假和冗余特征对灾难性遗忘的潜在影响。在本文中，我们深入研究了虚假和冗余特征对增量统一框架中该困境的负面影响，并揭示了在相似条件下，通过简单聚合单模态架构开发的多模态框架更容易发生遗忘。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的去噪框架，称为 IB-IUMAD，它利用了 Mamba 解码器和信息瓶颈融合模块的互补优势：前者专门用于解开对象间的特征耦合，防止对象间的虚假特征干扰；后者用于过滤掉融合特征中的冗余特征，从而显式地保留判别性信息。在 MVTec 3D-AD 和 Eyecandies 数据集上进行的一系列理论分析和实验证明了 IB-IUMAD 的有效性和竞争性能。
tldr: This paper presents a novel multimodal anomaly detection framework, IB-IUMAD, that addresses catastrophic forgetting by disentangling inter-object feature coupling and filtering out redundant features, achieving competitive performance on MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的多模态异常检测框架IB-IUMAD，通过解耦对象间的特征耦合和过滤冗余特征来解决灾难性遗忘问题，并在MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies数据集上取得了有竞争力的性能。

title: Synthetic-Child: An AIGC-Based Synthetic Data Pipeline for Privacy-Preserving Child Posture Estimation
summary: Accurate child posture estimation is critical for AI-powered study companion devices, yet collecting large-scale annotated datasets of children is both expensive and ethically prohibitive due to privacy concerns. We present Synthetic-Child, an AIGC-based synthetic data pipeline that produces photorealistic child posture training images with ground-truth-projected keypoint annotations, requiring zero real child photographs. The pipeline comprises four stages: (1) a programmable 3D child body model (SMPL-X) in Blender generates diverse desk-study poses with IK-constrained anatomical plausibility and automatic COCO-format ground-truth export; (2) a custom PoseInjectorNode feeds 3D-derived skeletons into a dual ControlNet (pose + depth) conditioned on FLUX-1 Dev, synthesizing 12,000 photorealistic images across 10 posture categories with low annotation drift; (3) ViTPose-based confidence filtering and targeted augmentation remove generation failures and improve robustness; (4) RTMPose-M (13.6M params) is fine-tuned on the synthetic data and paired with geometric feature engineering and a lightweight MLP for posture classification, then quantized to INT8 for real-time edge deployment. On a real-child test set (n~300), the FP16 model achieves 71.2 AP -- a +12.5 AP improvement over the COCO-pretrained adult-data baseline at identical model capacity. After INT8 quantization the model retains 70.4 AP while running at 22 FPS on a 0.8-TOPS Rockchip RK3568 NPU. In a single-subject controlled comparison with a commercial posture corrector, our system achieves substantially higher recognition rates across most tested categories and responds ~1.8x faster on average. These results demonstrate that carefully designed AIGC pipelines can substantially reduce dependence on real child imagery while achieving deployment-ready accuracy, with potential applications to other privacy-sensitive domains.
summary_zh: 准确的儿童姿态估计对于人工智能助学设备至关重要，然而，由于隐私问题，收集大规模带标注的儿童数据集既昂贵又在伦理上受到限制。我们提出 Synthetic-Child，一个基于AIGC的合成数据流水线，能够生成具有真实感且带有ground-truth投影关键点标注的儿童姿态训练图像，且无需任何真实的儿童照片。该流水线包含四个阶段：（1）Blender中可编程的3D儿童身体模型（SMPL-X）生成多样化的桌面学习姿势，使用IK约束保证解剖学上的合理性，并自动导出COCO格式的ground-truth标注；（2）一个定制的 PoseInjectorNode 将3D衍生的骨骼输入到基于 FLUX-1 Dev 条件的双 ControlNet(姿势 + 深度) 中，合成 12,000 张跨越 10 种姿势类别的、具有低标注漂移的真实感图像；（3）基于 ViTPose 的置信度过滤和有针对性的增强去除生成失败的图像并提高鲁棒性；（4）RTMPose-M（1360万参数）在合成数据上进行微调，并与几何特征工程和一个轻量级的 MLP 相结合进行姿势分类，然后量化为 INT8 以用于实时边缘部署。在一个真实的儿童测试集（n~300）上，FP16模型实现了 71.2 AP，相比于相同模型容量下 COCO 预训练的成人数据基线，提升了 +12.5 AP。在 INT8 量化后，该模型在 0.8-TOPS Rockchip RK3568 NPU 上以 22 FPS 的速度运行，同时保持了 70.4 AP。在与商业姿势矫正器的单对象受控比较中，我们的系统在大多数测试类别中实现了明显更高的识别率，并且平均响应速度快约 1.8 倍。这些结果表明，精心设计的 AIGC 流水线可以显著减少对真实儿童图像的依赖，同时实现可部署级别的精度，并有可能应用于其他隐私敏感领域。
tldr: This paper presents Synthetic-Child, an AIGC-based pipeline for generating synthetic child posture data to train posture estimation models, achieving comparable performance to models trained on real data while addressing privacy concerns.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Synthetic-Child，一个基于AIGC的生成合成儿童姿势数据的流程，用于训练姿势估计模型，在解决隐私问题的同时，实现了与在真实数据上训练的模型相当的性能。

title: CAWM-Mamba: A unified model for infrared-visible image fusion and compound adverse weather restoration
summary: Multimodal Image Fusion (MMIF) integrates complementary information from various modalities to produce clearer and more informative fused images. MMIF under adverse weather is particularly crucial in autonomous driving and UAV monitoring applications. However, existing adverse weather fusion methods generally only tackle single types of degradation such as haze, rain, or snow, and fail when multiple degradations coexist (e.g., haze+rain, rain+snow). To address this challenge, we propose Compound Adverse Weather Mamba (CAWM-Mamba), the first end-to-end framework that jointly performs image fusion and compound weather restoration with unified shared weights. Our network contains three key components: (1) a Weather-Aware Preprocess Module (WAPM) to enhance degraded visible features and extracts global weather embeddings; (2) a Cross-modal Feature Interaction Module (CFIM) to facilitate the alignment of heterogeneous modalities and exchange of complementary features across modalities; and (3) a Wavelet Space State Block (WSSB) that leverages wavelet-domain decomposition to decouple multi-frequency degradations. WSSB includes Freq-SSM, a module that models anisotropic high-frequency degradation without redundancy, and a unified degradation representation mechanism to further improve generalization across complex compound weather conditions. Extensive experiments on the AWMM-100K benchmark and three standard fusion datasets demonstrate that CAWM-Mamba consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both compound and single-weather scenarios. In addition, our fusion results excel in downstream tasks covering semantic segmentation and object detection, confirming the practical value in real-world adverse weather perception. The source code will be available at https://github.com/Feecuin/CAWM-Mamba.
summary_zh: 多模态图像融合（MMIF）整合来自不同模态的互补信息，从而生成更清晰、信息量更丰富的融合图像。在恶劣天气下的MMIF在自动驾驶和无人机监控应用中尤为关键。然而，现有的恶劣天气融合方法通常只处理单一类型的退化，如雾霾、雨或雪，并且在多种退化共存时（例如，雾霾+雨，雨+雪）失效。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了复合恶劣天气Mamba (CAWM-Mamba)，这是第一个端到端框架，它利用统一的共享权重联合执行图像融合和复合天气恢复。我们的网络包含三个关键组成部分：（1）一个感知天气预处理模块（WAPM)，用于增强退化的可见特征并提取全局天气嵌入；（2）一个跨模态特征交互模块（CFIM），用于促进异构模态的对齐以及跨模态的互补特征交换；以及（3）一个利用小波域分解来解耦多频退化的小波空间状态块（WSSB）。WSSB包括Freq-SSM，这是一个对各向异性高频退化进行无冗余建模的模块，以及一个统一的退化表示机制，以进一步提高在复杂复合天气条件下的泛化能力。在AWMM-100K基准数据集和三个标准融合数据集上的大量实验表明，CAWM-Mamba在复合和单一天气场景中均始终优于最先进的方法。此外，我们的融合结果在涵盖语义分割和目标检测的下游任务中表现出色，证实了其在现实世界恶劣天气感知中的实际价值。源代码可在https://github.com/Feecuin/CAWM-Mamba获取。
tldr: The paper introduces CAWM-Mamba, a novel end-to-end framework for infrared-visible image fusion and compound adverse weather restoration using shared weights and a wavelet-domain Mamba architecture, demonstrating superior performance on compound and single-weather scenarios, also proving practical value in downstream tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CAWM-Mamba，一种新颖的端到端框架，用于红外-可见光图像融合和复合恶劣天气恢复，采用共享权重和基于小波域的Mamba架构，在复合和单一天气场景下均表现出卓越的性能，并在下游任务中证明了实际应用价值。

title: ForestPersons: A Large-Scale Dataset for Under-Canopy Missing Person Detection
summary: Detecting missing persons in forest environments remains a challenge, as dense canopy cover often conceals individuals from detection in top-down or oblique aerial imagery typically captured by Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). While UAVs are effective for covering large, inaccessible areas, their aerial perspectives often miss critical visual cues beneath the forest canopy. This limitation underscores the need for under-canopy perspectives better suited for detecting missing persons in such environments. To address this gap, we introduce ForestPersons, a novel large-scale dataset specifically designed for under-canopy person detection. ForestPersons contains 96,482 images and 204,078 annotations collected under diverse environmental and temporal conditions. Each annotation includes a bounding box, pose, and visibility label for occlusion-aware analysis. ForestPersons provides ground-level and low-altitude perspectives that closely reflect the visual conditions encountered by Micro Aerial Vehicles (MAVs) during forest Search and Rescue (SAR) missions. Our baseline evaluations reveal that standard object detection models, trained on prior large-scale object detection datasets or SAR-oriented datasets, show limited performance on ForestPersons. This indicates that prior benchmarks are not well aligned with the challenges of missing person detection under the forest canopy. We offer this benchmark to support advanced person detection capabilities in real-world SAR scenarios. The dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/etri/ForestPersons.
summary_zh: 在森林环境中检测失踪人员仍然是一个挑战，因为茂密的树冠覆盖经常会遮蔽个体，使其无法在无人机（UAV）通常采集的自上而下或倾斜的航空影像中被检测到。尽管无人机在覆盖大面积、难以到达的区域方面很有效，但它们的航拍视角经常会错过森林树冠下方的关键视觉线索。这一局限性突显了需要更适合于在这些环境中检测失踪人员的树冠下视角。为了弥补这一差距，我们推出了ForestPersons，这是一个专门为树冠下人员检测设计的新型大规模数据集。ForestPersons包含96,482张图像和204,078个标注，这些数据是在不同的环境和时间条件下收集的。每个标注都包括边界框、姿势和可见性标签，用于进行遮挡感知分析。ForestPersons提供了地面和低空视角，这些视角能够紧密地反映微型飞行器（MAV）在森林搜救（SAR）任务中遇到的视觉条件。我们的基线评估表明，在先前的大规模目标检测数据集或面向搜救的数据集上训练的标准目标检测模型，在ForestPersons上的表现有限。这表明先前的基准测试与森林树冠下失踪人员检测的挑战并不完全一致。我们提供此基准测试，以支持现实世界搜救场景中的高级人员检测能力。该数据集可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/etri/ForestPersons公开获取。
tldr: The paper introduces ForestPersons, a large-scale dataset designed for under-canopy missing person detection using low-altitude imagery. It highlights the limitations of existing datasets and detection models in addressing this specific challenge and provides a new benchmark for SAR applications.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ForestPersons，一个大规模数据集，旨在利用低空图像进行林下失踪人员检测。它强调了现有数据集和检测模型在解决这一特定挑战方面的局限性，并为搜救应用提供了一个新的基准。

title: Biomechanically Accurate Gait Analysis: A 3d Human Reconstruction Framework for Markerless Estimation of Gait Parameters
summary: This paper presents a biomechanically interpretable framework for gait analysis using 3D human reconstruction from video data. Unlike conventional keypoint based approaches, the proposed method extracts biomechanically meaningful markers analogous to motion capture systems and integrates them within OpenSim for joint kinematic estimation. To evaluate performance, both spatiotemporal and kinematic gait parameters were analysed against reference marker-based data. Results indicate strong agreement with marker-based measurements, with considerable improvements when compared with pose-estimation methods alone. The proposed framework offers a scalable, markerless, and interpretable approach for accurate gait assessment, supporting broader clinical and real world deployment of vision based biomechanics
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种生物力学可解释的步态分析框架，该框架利用视频数据重建3D人体。与传统的基于关键点的方法不同，该方法提取与动作捕捉系统类似的、具有生物力学意义的标记点，并将其集成到OpenSim中用于关节运动学估计。为了评估性能，我们针对参考的、基于标记点的步态数据分析了时空步态参数和运动学步态参数。结果表明，该方法与基于标记点的测量结果高度一致，并且与仅使用姿态估计方法相比，有显著提升。所提出的框架为精确的步态评估提供了一种可扩展的、无标记的、且可解释的方法，支持基于视觉的生物力学在更广泛的临床和真实世界中的应用。
tldr: This paper introduces a markerless gait analysis framework using 3D human reconstruction from video, achieving biomechanically accurate gait parameter estimation comparable to marker-based systems and surpassing pose-estimation alone.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于视频的三维人体重建的无标记步态分析框架，该框架实现了与基于标记的系统相当的生物力学精确步态参数估计，并且优于单独的姿态估计。

title: ModalPatch: A Plug-and-Play Module for Robust Multi-Modal 3D Object Detection under Modality Drop
summary: Multi-modal 3D object detection is pivotal for autonomous driving, integrating complementary sensors like LiDAR and cameras. However, its real-world reliability is challenged by transient data interruptions and missing, where modalities can momentarily drop due to hardware glitches, adverse weather, or occlusions. This poses a critical risk, especially during a simultaneous modality drop, where the vehicle is momentarily blind. To address this problem, we introduce ModalPatch, the first plug-and-play module designed to enable robust detection under arbitrary modality-drop scenarios. Without requiring architectural changes or retraining, ModalPatch can be seamlessly integrated into diverse detection frameworks. Technically, ModalPatch leverages the temporal nature of sensor data for perceptual continuity, using a history-based module to predict and compensate for transiently unavailable features. To improve the fidelity of the predicted features, we further introduce an uncertainty-guided cross-modality fusion strategy that dynamically estimates the reliability of compensated features, suppressing biased signals while reinforcing informative ones. Extensive experiments show that ModalPatch consistently enhances both robustness and accuracy of state-of-the-art 3D object detectors under diverse modality-drop conditions.
summary_zh: 多模态3D目标检测对于自动驾驶至关重要，它整合了诸如激光雷达和相机等互补传感器。然而，其在真实世界中的可靠性受到瞬态数据中断和缺失的挑战，其中模态可能因硬件故障、恶劣天气或遮挡而暂时失效。这构成了一个严重的风险，尤其是在同时发生模态失效时，车辆会暂时“失明”。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了ModalPatch，这是首个即插即用模块，旨在实现任意模态失效场景下的稳健检测。无需架构变更或重新训练，ModalPatch即可无缝集成到各种检测框架中。在技术层面上，ModalPatch利用传感器数据的时间特性来实现感知上的连续性，使用一个基于历史的模块来预测和补偿瞬时不可用的特征。为了提高预测特征的保真度，我们进一步引入了一种不确定性引导的跨模态融合策略，该策略动态估计补偿特征的可靠性，抑制有偏置的信号，同时增强信息丰富的信号。大量的实验表明，ModalPatch始终如一地增强了最先进的3D目标检测器在各种模态失效条件下的鲁棒性和准确性。
tldr: The paper introduces ModalPatch, a plug-and-play module that enhances the robustness of multi-modal 3D object detectors under various modality-drop scenarios by predicting and compensating for missing features using temporal information and an uncertainty-guided fusion strategy, without requiring retraining of the base detector.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为ModalPatch的即插即用模块，通过利用时间信息和不确定性引导的融合策略来预测和补偿缺失的特征，从而增强多模态3D目标检测器在各种模态缺失场景下的鲁棒性，而无需对基础检测器进行重新训练。

title: Using the SEKF to Transfer NN Models of Dynamical Systems with Limited Data
summary: Data-driven models of dynamical systems require extensive amounts of training data. For many practical applications, gathering sufficient data is not feasible due to cost or safety concerns. This work uses the Subset Extended Kalman Filter (SEKF) to adapt pre-trained neural network models to new, similar systems with limited data available. Experimental validation across damped spring and continuous stirred-tank reactor systems demonstrates that small parameter perturbations to the initial model capture target system dynamics while requiring as little as 1% of original training data. In addition, finetuning requires less computational cost and reduces generalization error.
summary_zh: 动态系统的数据驱动模型需要大量的训练数据。对于许多实际应用来说，由于成本或安全方面的考虑，收集足够的数据是不可行的。本文采用子集扩展卡尔曼滤波（SEKF）来使预训练的神经网络模型适应具有有限数据可用的新的、相似的系统。在阻尼弹簧和连续搅拌釜反应器系统上的实验验证表明，对初始模型的小参数扰动可以在仅需原始训练数据1%的情况下捕获目标系统的动态特性。此外，微调需要的计算成本更低，并能减少泛化误差。
tldr: This paper presents a method using the Subset Extended Kalman Filter (SEKF) to adapt pre-trained neural network models of dynamical systems to new systems with very limited data, showing reduced data needs, lower computational cost, and improved generalization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用子集扩展卡尔曼滤波器 (SEKF) 的方法，以非常有限的数据将动态系统的预训练神经网络模型适应到新系统，显示出减少的数据需求、更低的计算成本和改进的泛化。

title: Design, Modeling and Direction Control of a Wire-Driven Robotic Fish Based on a 2-DoF Crank-Slider Mechanism
summary: Robotic fish have attracted growing attention in recent years owing to their biomimetic design and potential applications in environmental monitoring and biological surveys. Among robotic fish employing the Body-Caudal Fin (BCF) locomotion pattern, motor-driven actuation is widely adopted. Some approaches utilize multiple servo motors to achieve precise body curvature control, while others employ a brushless motor to drive the tail via wire or rod, enabling higher oscillation and swimming speeds. However, the former approaches typically result in limited swimming speed, whereas the latter suffer from poor maneuverability, with few capable of smooth turning. To address this trade-off, we develop a wire-driven robotic fish equipped with a 2-degree-of-freedom (DoF) crank-slider mechanism that decouples propulsion from steering, enabling both high swimming speed and agile maneuvering. In this paper, we first present the design of the robotic fish, including the elastic skeleton, waterproof structure, and the actuation mechanism that realizes the decoupling. We then establish the actuation modeling and body dynamics to analyze the locomotion behavior. Furthermore, we propose a combined feedforward-feedback control strategy to achieve independent regulation of propulsion and steering. Finally, we validate the feasibility of the design, modeling, and control through a series of prototype experiments, demonstrating swimming, turning, and directional control.
summary_zh: 近年来，仿生设计及其在环境监测和生物调查中的潜在应用使得仿生鱼受到了越来越多的关注。在采用躯干尾鳍（BCF）运动模式的仿生鱼中，电机驱动被广泛采用。一些方法使用多个舵机来实现精确的身体弯曲控制，而另一些方法则采用无刷电机通过线或杆驱动尾部，从而实现更高的振荡和游泳速度。然而，前一种方法通常导致游泳速度受限，而后一种方法则存在机动性差的问题，能够平稳转向的很少。为了解决这种权衡，我们开发了一种线驱动仿生鱼，配备了具有2自由度（DoF）的曲柄滑块机构，该机构将推进与转向分离，从而实现高速游泳和敏捷机动。在本文中，我们首先介绍了仿生鱼的设计，包括弹性骨架、防水结构和实现解耦的驱动机构。然后，我们建立了驱动模型和身体动力学模型来分析运动行为。此外，我们提出了一种结合前馈-反馈的控制策略，以实现推进和转向的独立调节。最后，我们通过一系列原型实验验证了设计、建模和控制的可行性，展示了游泳、转弯和方向控制。
tldr: This paper presents the design, modeling, and control of a wire-driven robotic fish with a 2-DoF crank-slider mechanism for decoupled propulsion and steering, aiming for both high speed and agile maneuvering.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于2自由度曲柄滑块机构的线驱动机器鱼的设计、建模和控制，该机构将推进和转向解耦，旨在实现高速和灵活的操控。

title: Scalar-Measurement Attitude Estimation on $\mathbf{SO}(3)$ with Bias Compensation
summary: Attitude estimation methods typically rely on full vector measurements from inertial sensors such as accelerometers and magnetometers. This paper shows that reliable estimation can also be achieved using only scalar measurements, which naturally arise either as components of vector readings or as independent constraints from other sensing modalities. We propose nonlinear deterministic observers on $\mathbf{SO}(3)$ that incorporate gyroscope bias compensation and guarantee uniform local exponential stability under suitable observability conditions. A key feature of the framework is its robustness to partial sensing: accurate estimation is maintained even when only a subset of vector components is available. Experimental validation on the BROAD dataset confirms consistent performance across progressively reduced measurement configurations, with estimation errors remaining small even under severe information loss. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to establish fundamental observability results showing that two scalar measurements under suitable excitation suffice for attitude estimation, and that three are enough in the static case. These results position scalar-measurement-based observers as a practical and reliable alternative to conventional vector-based approaches.
summary_zh: 通常，姿态估计方法依赖于来自惯性传感器的完整向量测量，例如加速度计和磁力计。本文表明，仅使用标量测量也可实现可靠的估计，这些测量天然地来源于向量读数的组成部分或来自其他传感方式的独立约束。我们提出了$\mathbf{SO}(3)$上的非线性确定性观测器，该观测器包含了陀螺仪偏差补偿，并在适当的可观测性条件下保证了一致局部指数稳定性。该框架的一个关键特征是其对部分感知的鲁棒性：即使仅有向量分量的一个子集可用，也能保持精确的估计。在BROAD数据集上的实验验证证实了在逐渐减少的测量配置中性能的一致性，即使在严重的信息丢失下，估计误差仍然很小。据我们所知，这是第一个建立基本可观测性结果的工作，表明在适当的激励下，两个标量测量足以进行姿态估计，而三个标量测量在静态情况下就足够了。这些结果将基于标量测量的观测器定位为传统基于向量方法的实用且可靠的替代方案。
tldr: This paper presents nonlinear deterministic observers on SO(3) using scalar measurements for attitude estimation with gyroscope bias compensation, demonstrating robustness to partial sensing and establishing fundamental observability results.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于SO(3)的非线性确定性观测器，使用标量测量进行姿态估计，并进行陀螺仪偏差补偿。该方法对部分传感具有鲁棒性，并建立了基本的观测性结果。

title: TinyIceNet: Low-Power SAR Sea Ice Segmentation for On-Board FPGA Inference
summary: Accurate sea ice mapping is essential for safe maritime navigation in polar regions, where rapidly changing ice conditions require timely and reliable information. While Sentinel-1 Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) provides high-resolution, all-weather observations of sea ice, conventional ground-based processing is limited by downlink bandwidth, latency, and energy costs associated with transmitting large volumes of raw data. On-board processing, enabled by dedicated inference chips integrated directly within the satellite payload, offers a transformative alternative by generating actionable sea ice products in orbit. In this context, we present TinyIceNet, a compact semantic segmentation network co-designed for on-board Stage of Development (SOD) mapping from dual-polarized Sentinel-1 SAR imagery under strict hardware and power constraints. Trained on the AI4Arctic dataset, TinyIceNet combines SAR-aware architectural simplifications with low-precision quantization to balance accuracy and efficiency. The model is synthesized using High-Level Synthesis and deployed on a Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA platform, demonstrating near-real-time inference with significantly reduced energy consumption. Experimental results show that TinyIceNet achieves 75.216% F1 score on SOD segmentation while reducing energy consumption by 2x compared to full-precision GPU baselines, underscoring the potential of chip-level hardware-algorithm co-design for future spaceborne and edge AI systems.
summary_zh: 准确的海冰测绘对于极地地区安全的海上导航至关重要，该区域快速变化的海冰状况需要及时和可靠的信息。尽管 Sentinel-1 合成孔径雷达 (SAR) 提供了高分辨率、全天候的海冰观测数据，但传统的地面处理受到下行链路带宽、延迟以及与传输大量原始数据相关的能源成本的限制。机载处理通过集成在卫星有效载荷内的专用推理芯片来实现，它通过在轨道上生成可操作的海冰产品，提供了一种变革性的替代方案。在此背景下，我们提出了 TinyIceNet，这是一个紧凑的语义分割网络，它经过协同设计，可在严格的硬件和功耗约束下，从双极化 Sentinel-1 SAR 图像中进行机载海冰发育阶段 (SOD) 测绘。TinyIceNet 基于 AI4Arctic 数据集训练，将 SAR 感知的架构简化与低精度量化相结合，以平衡准确性和效率。该模型使用高级综合工具进行综合，并部署在 Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ FPGA 平台上，展示了近乎实时的推理，并显著降低了能耗。实验结果表明，TinyIceNet 在 SOD 分割上实现了 75.216% 的 F1 分数，同时与全精度 GPU 基线相比，能耗降低了 2 倍，突出了芯片级硬件-算法协同设计对于未来星载和边缘 AI 系统的潜力。
tldr: The paper presents TinyIceNet, a compact deep learning model for on-board sea ice segmentation from SAR imagery on FPGAs, achieving near-real-time inference with reduced energy consumption, important for polar navigation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TinyIceNet，一个紧凑型深度学习模型，用于在FPGA上进行SAR图像的海冰分割，实现了近实时的推理并降低了能耗，这对极地导航非常重要。

title: Safe and Robust Domains of Attraction for Discrete-Time Systems: A Set-Based Characterization and Certifiable Neural Network Estimation
summary: Analyzing nonlinear systems with attracting robust invariant sets (RISs) requires estimating their domains of attraction (DOAs). Despite extensive research, accurately characterizing DOAs for general nonlinear systems remains challenging due to both theoretical and computational limitations, particularly in the presence of uncertainties and state constraints. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for the accurate estimation of safe (state-constrained) and robust DOAs for discrete-time nonlinear uncertain systems with continuous dynamics, open safe sets, compact disturbance sets, and uniformly locally $\ell_p$-stable compact RISs. The notion of uniform $\ell_p$ stability is quite general and encompasses, as special cases, uniform exponential and polynomial stability. The DOAs are characterized via newly introduced value functions defined on metric spaces of compact sets. We establish their fundamental mathematical properties and derive the associated Bellman-type (Zubov-type) functional equations. Building on this characterization, we develop a physics-informed neural network (NN) framework to learn the corresponding value functions by embedding the derived Bellman-type equations directly into the training process. To obtain certifiable estimates of the safe robust DOAs from the learned neural approximations, we further introduce a verification procedure that leverages existing formal verification tools. The effectiveness and applicability of the proposed methodology are demonstrated through four numerical examples involving nonlinear uncertain systems subject to state constraints, and its performance is compared with existing methods from the literature.
summary_zh: 分析具有吸引的鲁棒不变集 (RIS) 的非线性系统需要估计其吸引域 (DOA)。尽管已经进行了广泛的研究，但由于理论和计算上的限制，特别是存在不确定性和状态约束的情况下，准确表征一般非线性系统的 DOA 仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的框架，用于准确估计具有连续动力学、开放安全集、紧扰动集和一致局部 $\ell_p$ 稳定紧 RIS 的离散时间非线性不确定系统的安全（状态约束）且鲁棒的 DOA。一致 $\ell_p$ 稳定性的概念非常普遍，并且作为特例包含了均匀指数稳定性和多项式稳定性。通过在紧集度量空间上新引入的值函数来表征 DOA。我们建立了它们的基本数学性质，并推导了相关的贝尔曼型（祖博夫型）泛函方程。在此表征的基础上，我们开发了一个 physics-informed 神经网络 (NN) 框架，通过将导出的贝尔曼型方程直接嵌入到训练过程中来学习相应的值函数。为了从学习到的神经近似中获得安全鲁棒 DOA 的可验证估计，我们进一步引入了一个验证程序，该程序利用了现有的形式化验证工具。通过四个涉及受状态约束的非线性不确定系统的数值例子证明了所提出方法的有效性和适用性，并将其性能与文献中现有的方法进行了比较。
tldr: This paper introduces a physics-informed neural network (NN) framework for estimating safe and robust Domains of Attraction (DOAs) for discrete-time nonlinear uncertain systems, using Bellman-type equations and formal verification to obtain certifiable estimates. The proposed methodology's effectiveness is validated through numerical examples.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于物理信息的神经网络 (NN) 框架，用于估计离散时间非线性不确定系统的安全和鲁棒吸引域 (DOA)，使用 Bellman 型方程和形式验证来获得可验证的估计。 通过数值例子验证了该方法的效果。

title: IROSA: Interactive Robot Skill Adaptation using Natural Language
summary: Foundation models have demonstrated impressive capabilities across diverse domains, while imitation learning provides principled methods for robot skill adaptation from limited data. Combining these approaches holds significant promise for direct application to robotics, yet this combination has received limited attention, particularly for industrial deployment. We present a novel framework that enables open-vocabulary skill adaptation through a tool-based architecture, maintaining a protective abstraction layer between the language model and robot hardware. Our approach leverages pre-trained LLMs to select and parameterize specific tools for adapting robot skills without requiring fine-tuning or direct model-to-robot interaction. We demonstrate the framework on a 7-DoF torque-controlled robot performing an industrial bearing ring insertion task, showing successful skill adaptation through natural language commands for speed adjustment, trajectory correction, and obstacle avoidance while maintaining safety, transparency, and interpretability.
summary_zh: 基础模型已在各个领域展现出令人印象深刻的能力，而模仿学习为机器人技能从有限数据中进行适应提供了有原则的方法。结合这两种方法对于直接应用于机器人技术具有重大希望，但这种结合受到的关注有限，尤其是在工业部署方面。我们提出了一种新颖的框架，该框架通过基于工具的架构实现开放词汇表的技能适应，从而在语言模型和机器人硬件之间维护一个保护性的抽象层。我们的方法利用预训练的LLM来选择和参数化特定工具，以适应机器人技能，而无需进行微调或直接的模型-机器人交互。我们在执行工业轴承环插入任务的7自由度扭矩控制机器人上演示了该框架，展示了通过自然语言命令成功进行的技能适应，包括速度调整、轨迹校正和避障，同时保持安全性、透明性和可解释性。
tldr: The paper introduces IROSA, a framework leveraging LLMs for interactive robot skill adaptation in industrial settings using natural language commands, focusing on safety and interpretability without fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了IROSA，一个利用大型语言模型通过自然语言命令进行交互式机器人技能调整的框架，应用于工业环境，侧重于安全性和可解释性，且无需微调。

title: Pretrained Vision-Language-Action Models are Surprisingly Resistant to Forgetting in Continual Learning
summary: Continual learning is a long-standing challenge in robot policy learning, where a policy must acquire new skills over time without catastrophically forgetting previously learned ones. While prior work has extensively studied continual learning in relatively small behavior cloning (BC) policy models trained from scratch, its behavior in modern large-scale pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remains underexplored. In this work, we found that pretrained VLAs are remarkably resistant to forgetting compared with smaller policy models trained from scratch. Simple Experience Replay (ER) works surprisingly well on VLAs, sometimes achieving zero forgetting even with a small replay data size. Our analysis reveals that pretraining plays a critical role in downstream continual learning performance: large pretrained models mitigate forgetting with a small replay buffer size while maintaining strong forward learning capabilities. Furthermore, we found that VLAs can retain relevant knowledge from prior tasks despite performance degradation during learning new tasks. This knowledge retention enables rapid recovery of seemingly forgotten skills through finetuning. Together, these insights imply that large-scale pretraining fundamentally changes the dynamics of continual learning, enabling models to continually acquire new skills over time with simple replay. Code and more information can be found at https://ut-austin-rpl.github.io/continual-vla
summary_zh: 持续学习是机器人策略学习中一个长期存在的挑战，策略必须随着时间的推移学习新技能，而不会灾难性地遗忘以前学习过的技能。虽然先前的工作已经广泛研究了在从头开始训练的相对较小的行为克隆（BC）策略模型中的持续学习，但它在现代大规模预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的表现仍然未被充分探索。在这项工作中，我们发现与从头开始训练的较小策略模型相比，预训练的VLA模型对遗忘具有显著的抵抗力。简单的经验回放（ER）在VLA模型上表现出乎意料地好，有时甚至可以在较小的回放数据规模下实现零遗忘。我们的分析表明，预训练在下游持续学习性能中起着关键作用：大型预训练模型可以通过较小的回放缓冲区大小来减轻遗忘，同时保持强大的前向学习能力。此外，我们发现VLA模型可以保留来自先前任务的相关知识，即使在新任务学习期间性能下降。这种知识保留使得可以通过微调快速恢复看似被遗忘的技能。综上所述，这些见解表明，大规模预训练从根本上改变了持续学习的动态，使模型能够通过简单的回放随着时间的推移不断学习新技能。代码和更多信息请访问https://ut-austin-rpl.github.io/continual-vla
tldr: The paper explores continual learning with large pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, finding they are surprisingly resistant to forgetting and benefit significantly from simple experience replay compared to smaller models trained from scratch.
tldr_zh: 该论文探索了大型预训练视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型中的持续学习，发现与从头开始训练的小型模型相比，它们对遗忘具有惊人的抵抗力，并且从简单的经验回放中获益匪浅。

title: Act-Observe-Rewrite: Multimodal Coding Agents as In-Context Policy Learners for Robot Manipulation
summary: Can a multimodal language model learn to manipulate physical objects by reasoning about its own failures-without gradient updates, demonstrations, or reward engineering? We argue the answer is yes, under conditions we characterise precisely. We present Act-Observe-Rewrite (AOR), a framework in which an LLM agent improves a robot manipulation policy by synthesising entirely new executable Python controller code between trials, guided by visual observations and structured episode outcomes. Unlike prior work that grounds LLMs in pre-defined skill libraries or uses code generation for one-shot plan synthesis, AOR makes the full low-level motor control implementation the unit of LLM reasoning, enabling the agent to change not just what the robot does, but how it does it. The central claim is that interpretable code as the policy representation creates a qualitatively different kind of in-context learning from opaque neural policies: the agent can diagnose systematic failures and rewrite their causes. We validate this across three robosuite manipulation tasks and report promising results, with the agent achieving high success rates without demonstrations, reward engineering, or gradient updates.
summary_zh: 多模态语言模型能否通过推理自身失败的原因来学习操纵物体，而无需梯度更新、演示或奖励工程？我们认为答案是肯定的，但需满足我们精确描述的条件。我们提出了一种名为Act-Observe-Rewrite（AOR）的框架，在该框架中，LLM智能体通过在试验之间合成全新的可执行Python控制器代码来改进机器人操纵策略，并以视觉观察和结构化的情节结果作为指导。与以往将LLM植根于预定义技能库或使用代码生成进行一次性计划合成的工作不同，AOR将完整的低级电机控制实现作为LLM推理的单元，使智能体不仅可以改变机器人*做什么*，还可以改变机器人*如何做*。核心论点是，可解释的代码作为策略表示，与不透明的神经策略相比，创建了一种本质上不同的上下文学习：智能体可以诊断系统性失败并重新编写其原因。我们在三个robosuite操纵任务中验证了这一点，并报告了有前景的结果，智能体无需演示、奖励工程或梯度更新即可实现高成功率。
tldr: The paper introduces Act-Observe-Rewrite (AOR), a framework allowing LLMs to improve robot manipulation policies by iteratively generating and refining Python controller code based on visual observations and structured episode outcomes, achieving high success rates without demonstrations, reward engineering, or gradient updates.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了Act-Observe-Rewrite (AOR)框架，该框架允许LLM通过迭代生成和改进Python控制器代码，并基于视觉观察和结构化的episode结果来改进机器人操作策略，无需演示、奖励工程或梯度更新即可实现高成功率。

title: PROSPECT: Unified Streaming Vision-Language Navigation via Semantic--Spatial Fusion and Latent Predictive Representation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced zero-shot end-to-end Vision-Language Navigation (VLN), yet robust navigation requires not only semantic understanding but also predictive modeling of environment dynamics and spatial structure. We propose PROSPECT, a unified streaming navigation agent that couples a streaming Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy with latent predictive representation learning. PROSPECT uses CUT3R as a streaming 3D foundation spatial encoder to produce long-context, absolute-scale spatial features, and fuses them with SigLIP semantic features via cross-attention. During training, we introduce learnable stream query tokens that query the streaming context and predict next-step 2D and 3D latent features (rather than pixels or explicit modalities), supervised in the latent spaces of frozen SigLIP and CUT3R teachers. The predictive branch shapes internal representations without inference overhead. Experiments on VLN-CE benchmarks and real-robot deployment demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and improved long-horizon robustness under diverse lighting. We will release code for the community soon.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）极大地促进了零样本端到端视觉语言导航（VLN）的发展，然而，稳健的导航不仅需要语义理解，还需要对环境动态和空间结构的预测建模。我们提出了PROSPECT，一个统一的流式导航智能体，它将流式视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略与潜在预测表示学习相结合。PROSPECT使用CUT3R作为流式3D基础空间编码器，生成长上下文、绝对尺度的空间特征，并通过交叉注意力将其与SigLIP语义特征融合。在训练过程中，我们引入可学习的流查询令牌，用于查询流式上下文并预测下一步的2D和3D潜在特征（而非像素或显式模态），并在冻结的SigLIP和CUT3R教师模型的潜在空间中进行监督。预测分支塑造了内部表示，且不增加推理开销。在VLN-CE基准测试和真实机器人部署上的实验表明，该方法具有最先进的性能，并在不同光照条件下提高了长期导航的稳健性。我们将很快向社区发布代码。
tldr: PROSPECT is a novel VLN agent that fuses semantic and spatial features from SigLIP and CUT3R with latent predictive representation learning, achieving state-of-the-art performance on VLN benchmarks and real robot deployment.
tldr_zh: PROSPECT 是一种新颖的 VLN 代理，它融合了来自 SigLIP 和 CUT3R 的语义和空间特征，并结合了潜在的预测表示学习，在 VLN 基准测试和真实机器人部署中实现了最先进的性能。

title: Proact-VL: A Proactive VideoLLM for Real-Time AI Companions
summary: Proactive and real-time interactive experiences are essential for human-like AI companions, yet face three key challenges: (1) achieving low-latency inference under continuous streaming inputs, (2) autonomously deciding when to respond, and (3) controlling both quality and quantity of generated content to meet real-time constraints. In this work, we instantiate AI companions through two gaming scenarios, commentator and guide, selected for their suitability for automatic evaluation. We introduce the Live Gaming Benchmark, a large-scale dataset with three representative scenarios: solo commentary, co-commentary, and user guidance, and present Proact-VL, a general framework that shapes multimodal language models into proactive, real-time interactive agents capable of human-like environment perception and interaction. Extensive experiments show Proact-VL achieves superior response latency and quality while maintaining strong video understanding capabilities, demonstrating its practicality for real-time interactive applications.
summary_zh: 主动且实时的互动体验对于类人AI伴侣至关重要，但面临三个关键挑战：（1）在连续流输入下实现低延迟推理，（2）自主决定何时响应，以及（3）控制生成内容的质量和数量以满足实时约束。 在这项工作中，我们通过两种游戏场景（解说员和引导员）实例化AI伴侣，选择它们是因为它们适合自动评估。我们引入了Live Gaming Benchmark，这是一个大规模数据集，包含三个代表性场景：单人解说、合作解说和用户引导，并提出了Proact-VL，这是一个通用框架，将多模态语言模型塑造成主动、实时的交互式代理，能够进行类人环境感知和交互。 大量实验表明，Proact-VL实现了卓越的响应延迟和质量，同时保持了强大的视频理解能力，证明了其在实时交互应用中的实用性。
tldr: The paper introduces Proact-VL, a framework using multimodal language models for creating proactive, real-time AI companions, and evaluates it on a new Live Gaming Benchmark with promising results in latency, quality, and video understanding.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Proact-VL，一个使用多模态语言模型创建主动式、实时AI伴侣的框架，并在一个新的Live Gaming Benchmark上对其进行了评估，在延迟、质量和视频理解方面取得了可喜的成果。

title: Beyond Language Modeling: An Exploration of Multimodal Pretraining
summary: The visual world offers a critical axis for advancing foundation models beyond language. Despite growing interest in this direction, the design space for native multimodal models remains opaque. We provide empirical clarity through controlled, from-scratch pretraining experiments, isolating the factors that govern multimodal pretraining without interference from language pretraining. We adopt the Transfusion framework, using next-token prediction for language and diffusion for vision, to train on diverse data including text, video, image-text pairs, and even action-conditioned video. Our experiments yield four key insights: (i) Representation Autoencoder (RAE) provides an optimal unified visual representation by excelling at both visual understanding and generation; (ii) visual and language data are complementary and yield synergy for downstream capabilities; (iii) unified multimodal pretraining leads naturally to world modeling, with capabilities emerging from general training; and (iv) Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) enables efficient and effective multimodal scaling while naturally inducing modality specialization. Through IsoFLOP analysis, we compute scaling laws for both modalities and uncover a scaling asymmetry: vision is significantly more data-hungry than language. We demonstrate that the MoE architecture harmonizes this scaling asymmetry by providing the high model capacity required by language while accommodating the data-intensive nature of vision, paving the way for truly unified multimodal models.
summary_zh: 视觉世界为推动基础模型超越语言提供了一个关键维度。尽管对这一方向的兴趣日益增长，但原生多模态模型的设计空间仍然不明朗。我们通过受控的、从头开始的预训练实验，分离出控制多模态预训练的因素，避免语言预训练的干扰，从而提供经验上的清晰性。我们采用 Transfusion 框架，使用下一词预测进行语言建模，扩散模型进行视觉建模，并在包含文本、视频、图像-文本对，甚至是以动作为条件的视频等多样化数据上进行训练。我们的实验产生了四个关键见解：（i）表征自编码器（RAE）通过在视觉理解和生成方面表现出色，提供了一种最佳的统一视觉表征；（ii）视觉和语言数据相互补充，并为下游能力产生协同效应；（iii）统一的多模态预训练自然而然地导致世界建模，其能力从通用训练中涌现；（iv）混合专家（MoE）实现了高效且有效的多模态扩展，同时自然地引发模态专业化。通过 IsoFLOP 分析，我们计算了两种模态的缩放法则，并发现了一种缩放不对称性：视觉对数据的需求明显高于语言。我们证明了 MoE 架构通过提供语言所需的高模型容量，同时适应视觉的数据密集型特性，从而调和了这种缩放不对称性，为真正统一的多模态模型铺平了道路。
tldr: This paper explores multimodal pretraining from scratch, identifying key insights on visual representations, modality synergy, world modeling emergence, and MoE-based efficient scaling, highlighting a significant data-hungry nature of vision compared to language.
tldr_zh: 该论文从零开始探索多模态预训练，重点研究了视觉表示、模态协同作用、世界建模涌现以及基于MoE的有效缩放等关键见解，表明视觉相比语言更需要大量数据。

title: OmniPlanner: Universal Exploration and Inspection Path Planning across Robot Morphologies
summary: Autonomous robotic systems are increasingly deployed for mapping, monitoring, and inspection in complex and unstructured environments. However, most existing path planning approaches remain domain-specific (i.e., either on air, land, or sea), limiting their scalability and cross-platform applicability. This article presents OmniPlanner, a unified planning framework for autonomous exploration and inspection across aerial, ground, and underwater robots. The method integrates volumetric exploration and viewpoint-based inspection, alongside target reach behaviors within a single modular architecture, complemented by a platform abstraction layer that captures morphology-specific sensing, traversability and motion constraints. This enables the same planning strategy to generalize across distinct mobility domains with minimal retuning. The framework is validated through extensive simulation studies and field deployments in underground mines, industrial facilities, forests, submarine bunkers, and structured outdoor environments. Across these diverse scenarios, OmniPlanner demonstrates robust performance, consistent cross-domain generalization, and improved exploration and inspection efficiency compared to representative state-of-the-art baselines.
summary_zh: 自主机器人系统正越来越多地部署于复杂且非结构化环境中的地图绘制、监控和检查任务。然而，当前大多数路径规划方法仍然是领域特定的（即，空中、陆地或水下），限制了其可扩展性和跨平台适用性。本文提出了一种统一的规划框架OmniPlanner，用于空中、地面和水下机器人的自主探索和检查。该方法在一个模块化架构中集成了体积探索和基于视点的检查，并结合了目标到达行为，同时辅以平台抽象层，该抽象层捕获了形态特定的传感、 traversability 和运动约束。这使得相同的规划策略能够以最小的调整推广到不同的移动领域。通过大量的模拟研究和在地下矿井、工业设施、森林、潜艇掩体和结构化户外环境中的现场部署验证了该框架。在这些不同的场景中，OmniPlanner展现了稳健的性能、一致的跨领域泛化能力，以及相较于代表性的最先进基线而言的更优的探索和检查效率。
tldr: OmniPlanner is a unified path planning framework for autonomous exploration and inspection across aerial, ground, and underwater robots, demonstrating robust performance and improved efficiency in diverse environments.
tldr_zh: OmniPlanner是一个统一的路径规划框架，用于在空中、地面和水下机器人之间进行自主探索和检查，在各种环境中都表现出强大的性能并提高了效率。

title: VANGUARD: Vehicle-Anchored Ground Sample Distance Estimation for UAVs in GPS-Denied Environments
summary: Autonomous aerial robots operating in GPS-denied or communication-degraded environments frequently lose access to camera metadata and telemetry, leaving onboard perception systems unable to recover the absolute metric scale of the scene. As LLM/VLM-based planners are increasingly adopted as high-level agents for embodied systems, their ability to reason about physical dimensions becomes safety-critical -- yet our experiments show that five state-of-the-art VLMs suffer from spatial scale hallucinations, with median area estimation errors exceeding 50%. We propose VANGUARD, a lightweight, deterministic Geometric Perception Skill designed as a callable tool that any LLM-based agent can invoke to recover Ground Sample Distance (GSD) from ubiquitous environmental anchors: small vehicles detected via oriented bounding boxes, whose modal pixel length is robustly estimated through kernel density estimation and converted to GSD using a pre-calibrated reference length. The tool returns both a GSD estimate and a composite confidence score, enabling the calling agent to autonomously decide whether to trust the measurement or fall back to alternative strategies. On the DOTA~v1.5 benchmark, VANGUARD achieves 6.87% median GSD error on 306~images. Integrated with SAM-based segmentation for downstream area measurement, the pipeline yields 19.7% median error on a 100-entry benchmark -- with 2.6x lower category dependence and 4x fewer catastrophic failures than the best VLM baseline -- demonstrating that equipping agents with deterministic geometric tools is essential for safe autonomous spatial reasoning.
summary_zh: 在GPS拒止或通信降级环境中运行的自主飞行机器人，经常会失去对相机元数据和遥测信息的访问，导致机载感知系统无法恢复场景的绝对尺度。由于基于LLM/VLM的规划器正日益被采纳为具身系统的高级代理，它们对物理维度的推理能力变得至关重要，然而我们的实验表明，五种最先进的VLM存在空间尺度幻觉，面积估计的中位数误差超过50%。我们提出了VANGUARD，一种轻量级、确定性的几何感知技能，设计成可调用的工具，任何基于LLM的代理都可以调用它，以便从普遍存在的环境锚点（通过有向边界框检测到的小型车辆）恢复地面采样距离(GSD)。这些车辆的模态像素长度通过核密度估计得到稳健估计，并使用预先校准的参考长度转换为GSD。该工具返回GSD估计值和一个综合置信度评分，使调用代理能够自主决定是否信任该测量值或回退到替代策略。在DOTA~v1.5基准测试中，VANGUARD在306张图像上实现了6.87%的中位数GSD误差。与基于SAM的分割集成用于下游面积测量后，该流程在100个条目的基准测试中产生19.7%的中位数误差，其类别依赖性降低了2.6倍，灾难性故障减少了4倍，优于最佳VLM基线，证明了为代理配备确定性几何工具对于安全的自主空间推理至关重要。
tldr: The paper introduces VANGUARD, a geometric perception skill for UAVs in GPS-denied environments that estimates Ground Sample Distance (GSD) using vehicle detection, helping LLM/VLM-based agents improve spatial reasoning and reducing scale hallucinations.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 VANGUARD，一种用于 GPS 受限环境中无人机的几何感知技能，通过车辆检测估计地面采样距离 (GSD)，帮助基于 LLM/VLM 的智能体提高空间推理能力，减少尺度幻觉。

title: RoboLight: A Dataset with Linearly Composable Illumination for Robotic Manipulation
summary: In this paper, we introduce RoboLight, the first real-world robotic manipulation dataset capturing synchronized episodes under systematically varied lighting conditions. RoboLight consists of two components. (a) RoboLight-Real contains 2,800 real-world episodes collected in our custom Light Cube setup, a calibrated system equipped with eight programmable RGB LED lights. It includes structured illumination variation along three independently controlled dimensions: color, direction, and intensity. Each dimension is paired with a dedicated task featuring objects of diverse geometries and materials to induce perceptual challenges. All image data are recorded in high-dynamic-range (HDR) format to preserve radiometric accuracy. Leveraging the linearity of light transport, we introduce (b) RoboLight-Synthetic, comprising 196,000 episodes synthesized through interpolation in the HDR image space of RoboLight-Real. In principle, RoboLight-Synthetic can be arbitrarily expanded by refining the interpolation granularity. We further verify the dataset quality through qualitative analysis and real-world policy roll-outs, analyzing task difficulty, distributional diversity, and the effectiveness of synthesized data. We additionally demonstrate three representative use cases of the proposed dataset. The full dataset, along with the system software and hardware design, will be released as open-source to support continued research.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了RoboLight，这是首个真实世界的机器人操作数据集，它捕捉了在系统性变化的照明条件下同步的 episodes。RoboLight 由两部分组成。(a) RoboLight-Real 包含 2,800 个真实世界 episodes，这些 episodes 在我们定制的 Light Cube 设置中收集，该设置是一个配备八个可编程 RGB LED 灯的校准系统。它包括沿着三个独立控制的维度（颜色、方向和强度）的结构化照明变化。每个维度都与一个专门的任务配对，该任务以具有不同几何形状和材料的物体为特征，以引发感知挑战。所有图像数据均以高动态范围 (HDR) 格式记录，以保持辐射测量的准确性。利用光传输的线性特性，我们引入了 (b) RoboLight-Synthetic，它包含通过在 RoboLight-Real 的 HDR 图像空间中进行插值而合成的 196,000 个 episodes。原则上，可以通过细化插值粒度来任意扩展 RoboLight-Synthetic。我们通过定性分析和真实世界策略部署进一步验证数据集质量，分析任务难度、分布多样性和合成数据的有效性。此外，我们还展示了所提出的数据集的三个代表性用例。完整的数据集，连同系统软件和硬件设计，将以开源形式发布，以支持持续的研究。
tldr: The paper introduces RoboLight, a new real-world and synthetic dataset for robotic manipulation under systematically varied lighting conditions, featuring a custom-built Light Cube and HDR image capture.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RoboLight，这是一个新的真实和合成数据集，用于在系统变化的光照条件下进行机器人操作，其特点是定制的Light Cube和HDR图像捕获。

title: PRAM-R: A Perception-Reasoning-Action-Memory Framework with LLM-Guided Modality Routing for Adaptive Autonomous Driving
summary: Multimodal perception enables robust autonomous driving but incurs unnecessary computational cost when all sensors remain active. This paper presents PRAM-R, a unified Perception-Reasoning-Action-Memory framework with LLM-Guided Modality Routing for adaptive autonomous driving. PRAM-R adopts an asynchronous dual-loop design: a fast reactive loop for perception and control, and a slow deliberative loop for reasoning-driven modality selection and memory updates. An LLM router selects and weights modalities using environmental context and sensor diagnostics, while a hierarchical memory module preserves temporal consistency and supports long-term adaptation. We conduct a two-stage evaluation: (1) synthetic stress tests for stability analysis and (2) real-world validation on the nuScenes dataset. Synthetic stress tests confirm 87.2% reduction in routing oscillations via hysteresis-based stabilization. Real-world validation on nuScenes shows 6.22% modality reduction with 20% memory recall while maintaining comparable trajectory accuracy to full-modality baselines in complex urban scenarios. Our work demonstrates that LLM-augmented architectures with hierarchical memory achieve efficient, adaptive multimodal perception in autonomous driving.
summary_zh: 多模态感知技术能够实现稳健的自动驾驶，但当所有传感器保持激活状态时，会产生不必要的计算成本。 本文提出了一种统一的感知-推理-行动-记忆框架PRAM-R，利用LLM引导的模态路由实现自适应自动驾驶。PRAM-R采用异步双环设计：一个用于感知和控制的快速反应环，以及一个用于推理驱动的模态选择和记忆更新的慢速深思熟虑环。一个LLM路由器使用环境上下文和传感器诊断来选择和加权模态，而一个分层记忆模块则保持时间一致性并支持长期适应。 我们进行了两阶段评估：（1）用于稳定性分析的合成压力测试；（2）在nuScenes数据集上的真实世界验证。合成压力测试证实，通过基于滞后的稳定化，路由振荡减少了87.2%。在nuScenes上的真实世界验证表明，在复杂的城市环境中，在保持与全模态基线相当的轨迹精度情况下，模态减少了6.22%，同时记忆召回率为20%。 我们的工作证明，具有分层记忆的LLM增强架构能够在自动驾驶中实现高效、自适应的多模态感知。
tldr: This paper introduces PRAM-R, an LLM-guided framework for adaptive autonomous driving that intelligently routes and weights multimodal sensor data, reducing computation while maintaining performance through a hierarchical memory system.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了PRAM-R，一个由LLM引导的自适应自动驾驶框架，它能智能地路由和权衡多模态传感器数据，通过分层记忆系统在减少计算的同时保持性能。

title: GarmentPile++: Affordance-Driven Cluttered Garments Retrieval with Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Garment manipulation has attracted increasing attention due to its critical role in home-assistant robotics. However, the majority of existing garment manipulation works assume an initial state consisting of only one garment, while piled garments are far more common in real-world settings. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel garment retrieval pipeline that can not only follow language instruction to execute safe and clean retrieval but also guarantee exactly one garment is retrieved per attempt, establishing a robust foundation for the execution of downstream tasks (e.g., folding, hanging, wearing). Our pipeline seamlessly integrates vision-language reasoning with visual affordance perception, fully leveraging the high-level reasoning and planning capabilities of VLMs alongside the generalization power of visual affordance for low-level actions. To enhance the VLM's comprehensive awareness of each garment's state within a garment pile, we employ visual segmentation model (SAM2) to execute object segmentation on the garment pile for aiding VLM-based reasoning with sufficient visual cues. A mask fine-tuning mechanism is further integrated to address scenarios where the initial segmentation results are suboptimal. In addition, a dual-arm cooperation framework is deployed to address cases involving large or long garments, as well as excessive garment sagging caused by incorrect grasping point determination, both of which are strenuous for a single arm to handle. The effectiveness of our pipeline are consistently demonstrated across diverse tasks and varying scenarios in both real-world and simulation environments. Project page: https://garmentpile2.github.io/.
summary_zh: 服装操控由于其在家庭助手机器人中的关键作用而日益受到关注。然而，现有的大多数服装操控工作都假设一个初始状态，其中仅包含一件服装，而在现实世界中，堆叠的服装更为常见。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种新颖的服装检索流程，该流程不仅可以遵循语言指令执行安全且干净的检索，而且可以保证每次尝试仅检索一件服装，为下游任务（例如，折叠、悬挂、穿着）的执行建立稳固的基础。我们的流程无缝地集成了视觉-语言推理与视觉可供性感知，充分利用了视觉语言模型（VLM）的高级推理和规划能力，以及视觉可供性在低级动作上的泛化能力。为了增强VLM对服装堆中每件服装状态的全面感知，我们采用视觉分割模型（SAM2）对服装堆执行目标分割，从而为基于VLM的推理提供充分的视觉线索。进一步集成了一种掩码微调机制，以解决初始分割结果次优的情况。此外，还部署了一个双臂协作框架来处理涉及大型或长型服装，以及因抓取点确定不正确而导致服装过度下垂的情况，这些情况对于单臂来说都非常吃力。我们的流程的有效性在真实世界和仿真环境中的各种任务和不同场景中都得到了持续的证明。项目主页：https://garmentpile2.github.io/。
tldr: This paper introduces a vision-language reasoning pipeline for robotic garment retrieval from a pile, using segmentation, affordance perception, and dual-arm cooperation to handle complex scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于从衣物堆中进行机器人衣物检索的视觉-语言推理流程，使用分割、可供性感知和双臂协作来处理复杂场景。

title: SaFeR: Safety-Critical Scenario Generation for Autonomous Driving Test via Feasibility-Constrained Token Resampling
summary: Safety-critical scenario generation is crucial for evaluating autonomous driving systems. However, existing approaches often struggle to balance three conflicting objectives: adversarial criticality, physical feasibility, and behavioral realism. To bridge this gap, we propose SaFeR: safety-critical scenario generation for autonomous driving test via feasibility-constrained token resampling. We first formulate traffic generation as a discrete next token prediction problem, employing a Transformer-based model as a realism prior to capture naturalistic driving distributions. To capture complex interactions while effectively mitigating attention noise, we propose a novel differential attention mechanism within the realism prior. Building on this prior, SaFeR implements a novel resampling strategy that induces adversarial behaviors within a high-probability trust region to maintain naturalism, while enforcing a feasibility constraint derived from the Largest Feasible Region (LFR). By approximating the LFR via offline reinforcement learning, SaFeR effectively prevents the generation of theoretically inevitable collisions. Closed-loop experiments on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset and nuPlan demonstrate that SaFeR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a higher solution rate and superior kinematic realism while maintaining strong adversarial effectiveness.
summary_zh: 安全关键场景生成对于评估自动驾驶系统至关重要。然而，现有方法通常难以平衡三个相互冲突的目标：对抗性临界性、物理可行性以及行为真实性。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了 SaFeR：通过可行性约束的令牌重采样实现的自动驾驶测试安全关键场景生成。我们首先将交通生成形式化为一种离散的下一个令牌预测问题，采用基于Transformer的模型作为真实性先验，以捕捉自然驾驶分布。为了捕捉复杂的交互，同时有效缓解注意力噪声，我们在真实性先验中提出了一种新颖的差分注意力机制。在此先验的基础上，SaFeR实施了一种新颖的重采样策略，该策略在高概率信任区域内诱导对抗行为以保持自然性，同时强制执行源自最大可行区域 (LFR) 的可行性约束。通过离线强化学习逼近 LFR，SaFeR 有效地阻止了理论上不可避免的碰撞的生成。在 Waymo Open Motion Dataset 和 nuPlan 上的闭环实验表明，SaFeR 显著优于最先进的基线，在保持强大的对抗有效性的同时，实现了更高的求解率和卓越的运动学真实性。
tldr: The paper introduces SaFeR, a novel scenario generation method for autonomous driving testing that balances adversarial criticality, physical feasibility, and behavioral realism through a feasibility-constrained token resampling strategy.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为SaFeR的新型自动驾驶测试场景生成方法，该方法通过可行性约束的令牌重采样策略，平衡了对抗性临界性、物理可行性和行为真实性。

title: Force-Aware Residual DAgger via Trajectory Editing for Precision Insertion with Impedance Control
summary: Imitation learning (IL) has shown strong potential for contact-rich precision insertion tasks. However, its practical deployment is often hindered by covariate shift and the need for continuous expert monitoring to recover from failures during execution. In this paper, we propose Trajectory Editing Residual Dataset Aggregation (TER-DAgger), a scalable and force-aware human-in-the-loop imitation learning framework that mitigates covariate shift by learning residual policies through optimization-based trajectory editing. This approach smoothly fuses policy rollouts with human corrective trajectories, providing consistent and stable supervision. Second, we introduce a force-aware failure anticipation mechanism that triggers human intervention only when discrepancies arise between predicted and measured end-effector forces, significantly reducing the requirement for continuous expert monitoring. Third, all learned policies are executed within a Cartesian impedance control framework, ensuring compliant and safe behavior during contact-rich interactions. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world precision insertion tasks show that TER-DAgger improves the average success rate by over 37\% compared to behavior cloning, human-guided correction, retraining, and fine-tuning baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness in mitigating covariate shift and enabling scalable deployment in contact-rich manipulation.
summary_zh: 模仿学习（IL）已展现出在富接触精密插入任务中的强大潜力。然而，其实际部署常因协变量偏移问题以及在执行过程中需要专家持续监控以从失败中恢复而受阻。在本文中，我们提出了一种可扩展且具有力感知的闭环模仿学习框架——轨迹编辑残差数据集聚合（TER-DAgger），该框架通过基于优化的轨迹编辑学习残差策略来缓解协变量偏移问题。该方法平滑地融合了策略展开与人工校正轨迹，提供了持续且稳定的监督。其次，我们引入了一种力感知型故障预测机制，该机制仅在预测和测量的末端执行器力之间出现差异时才触发人工干预，从而显著降低了对专家持续监控的需求。第三，所有学习到的策略都在笛卡尔阻抗控制框架内执行，从而确保在富接触交互过程中的顺从性和安全性。在仿真和真实世界精密插入任务中的大量实验表明，TER-DAgger相较于行为克隆、人工引导校正、重训练和微调等基线方法，平均成功率提高了37\%以上，证明了其在缓解协变量偏移和实现富接触操作中可扩展部署方面的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces TER-DAgger, a force-aware imitation learning framework that combines trajectory editing, force-aware failure anticipation, and impedance control for improving the success rate and reducing human monitoring in precision insertion tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TER-DAgger，一种力感知的模仿学习框架，结合轨迹编辑、力感知的故障预测和阻抗控制，以提高精密插入任务的成功率并减少人工监控。

title: Self-adapting Robotic Agents through Online Continual Reinforcement Learning with World Model Feedback
summary: As learning-based robotic controllers are typically trained offline and deployed with fixed parameters, their ability to cope with unforeseen changes during operation is limited. Biologically inspired, this work presents a framework for online Continual Reinforcement Learning that enables automated adaptation during deployment. Building on DreamerV3, a model-based Reinforcement Learning algorithm, the proposed method leverages world model prediction residuals to detect out-of-distribution events and automatically trigger finetuning. Adaptation progress is monitored using both task-level performance signals and internal training metrics, allowing convergence to be assessed without external supervision and domain knowledge. The approach is validated on a variety of contemporary continuous control problems, including a quadruped robot in high-fidelity simulation, and a real-world model vehicle. Relevant metrics and their interpretation are presented and discussed, as well as resulting trade-offs described. The results sketch out how autonomous robotic agents could once move beyond static training regimes toward adaptive systems capable of self-reflection and -improvement during operation, just like their biological counterparts.
summary_zh: 基于学习的机器人控制器通常离线训练并以固定参数部署，因此应对运行期间意外变化的能力有限。受生物学启发，本文提出了一种在线持续强化学习框架，能够在部署期间实现自动适应。该方法基于DreamerV3（一种基于模型的强化学习算法），利用世界模型预测残差来检测分布外事件，并自动触发微调。适应过程的进展通过任务级性能信号和内部训练指标进行监控，从而可以在没有外部监督和领域知识的情况下评估收敛性。该方法在一系列当代连续控制问题上进行了验证，包括高保真仿真中的四足机器人和真实世界的模型车辆。文中呈现并讨论了相关的指标及其解释，以及由此产生的权衡。结果表明，自主机器人代理如何能摆脱静态训练模式，转变为能够在运行期间进行自我反思和自我改进的自适应系统，就像它们的生物学对应物一样。
tldr: This paper introduces a continual reinforcement learning framework that allows robots to adapt online using world model prediction residuals to trigger finetuning, demonstrating it on simulated and real-world robotic platforms.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个持续强化学习框架，该框架允许机器人使用世界模型预测残差来触发微调，从而在线适应，并在模拟和现实世界的机器人平台上进行了演示。

title: Structural Action Transformer for 3D Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Achieving human-level dexterity in robots via imitation learning from heterogeneous datasets is hindered by the challenge of cross-embodiment skill transfer, particularly for high-DoF robotic hands. Existing methods, often relying on 2D observations and temporal-centric action representation, struggle to capture 3D spatial relations and fail to handle embodiment heterogeneity. This paper proposes the Structural Action Transformer (SAT), a new 3D dexterous manipulation policy that challenges this paradigm by introducing a structural-centric perspective. We reframe each action chunk not as a temporal sequence, but as a variable-length, unordered sequence of joint-wise trajectories. This structural formulation allows a Transformer to natively handle heterogeneous embodiments, treating the joint count as a variable sequence length.
