The inability of conventional binary clustering to represent subtle feature distributions leads to the degradation of visual words, a problem that is compounded as errors accumulate and propagate through the hierarchical tree structure. To address these structural deficiencies, this paper proposes hierarchical binary-to-real-and-back (HBRB)-BoW, a refined hierarchical binary vocabulary training algorithm. By integrating a global real-valued flow within the hierarchical clustering process, our method preserves high-fidelity descriptor information until the final binarization at the leaf nodes. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach yields a more discriminative and well-structured vocabulary than traditional methods, significantly enhancing the representational integrity of the visual dictionary in complex environments. Furthermore, replacing the default ORB-SLAM vocabulary file with our HBRB-BoW file is expected to improve performance in loop closing and relocalization tasks.
summary_zh: 在视觉同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）中，视觉词汇表的质量对于系统表示环境和识别位置的能力至关重要。虽然ORB-SLAM是一个广泛使用的框架，但其通过基于k-众数的词袋（BoW）方法训练的二元词汇表存在固有的精度损失。传统二元聚类无法表示细微的特征分布会导致视觉词退化，而这种问题会随着误差在分层树结构中累积和传播而加剧。为了解决这些结构性缺陷，本文提出了一种精细化的分层二元词汇表训练算法，即分层二元-到实数-再到二元（HBRB）-BoW。通过在分层聚类过程中集成全局实值流，我们的方法可以保持高保真的描述符信息，直到叶子节点的最终二元化。实验结果表明，该方法比传统方法产生了更具区分性和结构良好的词汇表，显著提高了视觉词典在复杂环境中的表征完整性。此外，用我们的HBRB-BoW文件替换默认的ORB-SLAM词汇表文件预计可以提高回环检测和重定位任务的性能。
tldr: This paper introduces HBRB-BoW, a novel hierarchical vocabulary training algorithm for ORB-SLAM that improves visual dictionary representation and loop closing by preserving descriptor information during binarization.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为HBRB-BoW的新型分层词汇训练算法，用于ORB-SLAM， 通过在二值化过程中保留描述符信息，改进了视觉词典的表示和闭环。

title: Lambdas at the Far Edge: a Tale of Flying Lambdas and Lambdas on Wheels
summary: Aggregate Programming (AP) is a paradigm for programming the collective behaviour of sets of distributed devices, possibly situated at the network far edge, by relying on asynchronous proximity-based interactions. The eXchange Calculus (XC), a recently proposed foundational model for AP, is essentially a typed lambda calculus extended with an operator (the exchange operator) providing an implicit communication mechanism between neighbour devices. This paper provides a gentle introduction to XC and to its implementation as a C++ library, called FCPP. The FCPP library and toolchain has been mainly developed at the Department of Computer Science of the University of Turin, where Stefano Berardi spent most of his academic career conducting outstanding research about logical foundation of computer science and transmitting his passion for research to students and young researchers, often exploiting typed lambda calculi. An FCCP program is essentially a typed lambda term, and FCPP has been used to write code that has been deployed on devices at the far edge of the network, including rovers and (soon) Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs); hence the title of the paper.
summary_zh: 聚合编程(AP)是一种编程范式，旨在通过依赖于基于异步邻近度的交互来编程分布式设备集合的集体行为，这些设备可能位于网络边缘。交换演算(XC)是最近提出的AP的基础模型，本质上是一种类型化的λ演算，扩展了一个算子(交换算子)，该算子提供了相邻设备之间的隐式通信机制。本文简要介绍了XC及其作为C++库的实现，该库名为FCPP。FCPP库和工具链主要在都灵大学计算机科学系开发，Stefano Berardi 大部分学术生涯都致力于此，他对计算机科学的逻辑基础进行了杰出的研究，并将他对研究的热情传递给学生和年轻的研究人员，经常利用类型化的λ演算。一个FCPP程序本质上是一个类型化的λ项，而FCPP已被用于编写部署在网络远端边缘的设备（包括漫游车和（即将）无人机(UAV)）上的代码；因此本文以此为题。
tldr: This paper introduces the eXchange Calculus (XC) and its C++ implementation (FCPP) for aggregate programming at the network edge, specifically targeting distributed devices like rovers and UAVs.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为 eXchange Calculus (XC) 的计算模型及其 C++ 实现 (FCPP)，用于网络边缘的聚合编程，专门针对分布式设备（如漫游车和无人机）。

title: Characterization and Correlation of Robotic Snake Scale Friction and Locomotion Speed
summary: Snake robots are inspired by the ability of biological snakes to move over rock, grass, leaves, soil, up trees, along pavement and more. Their ability to move in multiple distinct environments is due to their legless locomotion strategy, which combines distinct gaits with a skin that exhibits frictional anisotropy. Designing soft robotic snakes with similar capabilities requires an understanding of how this underlying frictional anisotropy should be created in engineered systems, and how variances in the frictional anisotropy ratio affect locomotion speed and direction on different surfaces. While forward and backward frictional ratios have been characterized for previous scale designs, lateral friction and the associated ratios are often overlooked. In this paper, our contributions include: (i) the development of a novel articulated pseudo-skin design that is modular, easy to construct and has removable or replaceable scales; (ii) experimental measurement of the frictional characteristics of otherwise-identical scales at varying angles of attack (15°, 25°, 35°, 45°) on different surfaces of interest (grass, bark, smooth surface, carpet);(iii) separate measurements of locomotion speed for each angle and surface. Consequently, while we observed some consistent trends between frictional coefficients and scale angle, aligning with literature and intuition, we were not able to consistently identify expected correlations between frictional ratios and locomotion speed. We conclude that either frictional ratios alone are not sufficient to predict the observed speed of a snake robot, or that specific measurement approaches are required to accurately capture these ratios.
summary_zh: 蛇形机器人的设计灵感来源于生物蛇类在岩石、草地、落叶、土壤、树木、路面等多种表面上的移动能力。它们能在多种不同环境中移动的能力归功于其无腿运动策略，该策略将不同的步态与具有摩擦各向异性的表皮相结合。设计具有类似能力的软体蛇形机器人，需要理解如何在工程系统中创建这种底层的摩擦各向异性，以及摩擦各向异性比率的变化如何影响在不同表面上的运动速度和方向。虽然先前尺度设计的前向和后向摩擦比率已被表征，但横向摩擦和相关的比率通常被忽略。在本文中，我们的贡献包括：（i）开发了一种新型铰接式伪表皮设计，该设计模块化、易于构建，并具有可移除或可更换的鳞片；（ii）在不同的感兴趣表面（草地、树皮、光滑表面、地毯）上，实验测量了角度可变（15°、25°、35°、45°）的相同鳞片的摩擦特性；（iii）分别测量了每个角度和表面上的运动速度。因此，虽然我们观察到摩擦系数和鳞片角度之间存在一致的趋势，与文献和直觉相符，但我们无法始终如一地确定摩擦比率和运动速度之间的预期相关性。我们得出结论，要么仅凭摩擦比率不足以预测蛇形机器人的观察到的速度，要么需要特定的测量方法才能准确捕捉这些比率。
tldr: This paper investigates the relationship between scale friction anisotropy and locomotion speed in a snake robot with a novel scale design, finding no consistent correlation between friction ratios and speed across different surfaces.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了一种新型蛇形机器人鳞片摩擦各向异性与运动速度之间的关系，发现摩擦比与不同表面上的速度之间没有一致的关联。

title: Soft Semi-active Back Support Device with Adaptive Force Profiles using Variable-elastic Actuation and Weight Feedback
summary: Portable active back support devices (BSDs) offer tunable assistance but are often bulky and heavy, limiting their usability. In contrast, passive BSDs are lightweight and compact but lack the ability to adapt their assistance to different back movements. We present a soft, lightweight, and compact BSD that combines a variable-stiffness passive element and an active element (an artificial muscle) in parallel. The device provides tunable assistance through discrete changes in stiffness values and active force levels. We validate the device's tuning capabilities through bench testing and on-body characterization. Further, we use the device's tuning capabilities to provide weight-adaptive object lifting and lowering assistance. We detect the weight handled by the user based on forearm force myography and upper-back inertial measurement unit data. Furthermore, electromyography analyses in five participants performing symmetric object lifting and lowering tasks showed reductions in back extensor activity. Preliminary results in one participant also indicated reduced muscle activity during asymmetric lifting.
summary_zh: 便携式主动式背部支撑装置（BSDs）提供可调节的辅助，但通常体积大且笨重，限制了其可用性。相比之下，被动式BSDs轻便且紧凑，但缺乏根据不同的背部运动调整辅助的能力。我们提出了一种柔软、轻便且紧凑的BSD，它将一个可变刚度的被动元件和一个主动元件（人工肌肉）并联结合在一起。该装置通过刚度值和主动力水平的离散变化提供可调节的辅助。我们通过台架测试和本体特征分析验证了该装置的调节能力。此外，我们利用该装置的调节能力来提供重量自适应的物体提举和降低辅助。我们基于前臂力肌电图和上背部惯性测量单元数据来检测用户处理的重量。此外，在五名参与者执行对称物体提举和降低任务的肌电图分析表明，背部伸肌活动减少。一名参与者的初步结果还表明，在非对称提举过程中，肌肉活动减少。
tldr: The paper presents a soft, lightweight back support device with variable-stiffness and active elements, demonstrating weight-adaptive lifting assistance and reduced back extensor activity.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种轻量级、柔软的背部支撑设备，该设备具有可变刚度和主动元件，能够提供重量自适应的抬举辅助并减少背部伸肌的活动。

title: TreeLoc++: Robust 6-DoF LiDAR Localization in Forests with a Compact Digital Forest Inventory
summary: Reliable localization is essential for sustainable forest management, as it allows robots or sensor systems to revisit and monitor the status of individual trees over long periods. In modern forestry, this management is structured around Digital Forest Inventories (DFIs), which encode stems using compact geometric attributes rather than raw data. Despite their central role, DFIs have been overlooked in localization research, and most methods still rely on dense gigabyte-sized point clouds that are costly to store and maintain. To improve upon this, we propose TreeLoc++, a global localization framework that operates directly on DFIs as a discriminative representation, eliminating the need to use the raw point clouds. TreeLoc++ reduces false matches in structurally ambiguous forests and improves the reliability of full 6-DoF pose estimation. It augments coarse retrieval with a pairwise distance histogram that encodes local tree-layout context, subsequently refining candidates via DBH-based filtering and yaw-consistent inlier selection to further reduce mismatches. Furthermore, a constrained optimization leveraging tree geometry jointly estimates roll, pitch, and height, enhancing pose stability and enabling accurate localization without reliance on dense 3D point cloud data. Evaluations on 27 sequences recorded in forests across three datasets and four countries show that TreeLoc++ achieves precise localization with centimeter-level accuracy. We further demonstrate robustness to long-term change by localizing data recorded in 2025 against inventories built from 2023 data, spanning a two-year interval. The system represents 15 sessions spanning 7.98 km of trajectories using only 250KB of map data and outperforms both hand-crafted and learning-based baselines that rely on point cloud maps. This demonstrates the scalability of TreeLoc++ for long-term deployment.
summary_zh: 可靠的定位对于可持续森林管理至关重要，因为它允许机器人或传感器系统在长期时间内复访和监测单个树木的状态。在现代林业中，这种管理围绕数字森林清查（DFIs）构建，后者使用紧凑的几何属性而非原始数据来编码树干。尽管DFIs具有核心作用，但在定位研究中却被忽视，大多数方法仍然依赖于存储和维护成本高昂的千兆字节级密集点云。为了改进这一点，我们提出了TreeLoc++，一种直接在DFIs上作为判别性表示运行的全局定位框架，消除了使用原始点云的需求。TreeLoc++减少了结构模糊森林中的错误匹配，并提高了完整6自由度位姿估计的可靠性。它通过编码局部树木布局上下文的成对距离直方图来增强粗略检索，随后通过基于胸径（DBH）的过滤和偏航角一致的内点选择来细化候选对象，从而进一步减少不匹配。此外，利用树木几何形状的约束优化可以联合估计横滚角、俯仰角和高度，从而提高位姿稳定性，并实现无需依赖密集3D点云数据的精确本地化。在跨三个数据集和四个国家的森林中记录的27个序列上的评估表明，TreeLoc++实现了厘米级精度的精确本地化。我们进一步证明了对长期变化的鲁棒性，通过将2025年记录的数据与基于2023年数据构建的清查进行定位，跨越了两年的间隔。该系统仅使用250KB的地图数据即可表示跨越7.98公里轨迹的15个会话，并优于依赖点云地图的手工制作和基于学习的基线。这证明了TreeLoc++对于长期部署的可扩展性。
tldr: The paper presents TreeLoc++, a LiDAR localization framework for forests that uses compact digital forest inventories, achieving centimeter-level accuracy and robustness to long-term changes, outperforming point cloud-based methods with significantly smaller map sizes.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了TreeLoc++，一个用于森林的激光雷达定位框架，它使用紧凑的数字森林清单，实现了厘米级的精度和对长期变化的鲁棒性，并且优于基于点云的方法，地图尺寸也大大缩小。

title: Real-time loosely coupled GNSS and IMU integration via Factor Graph Optimization
summary: Accurate positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) is fundamental to the operation of modern technologies and a key enabler of autonomous systems. A very important component of PNT is the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) which ensures outdoor positioning. Modern research directions have pushed the performance of GNSS localization to new heights by fusing GNSS measurements with other sensory information, mainly measurements from Inertial Measurement Units (IMU). In this paper, we propose a loosely coupled architecture to integrate GNSS and IMU measurements using a Factor Graph Optimization (FGO) framework. Because the FGO method can be computationally challenging and often used as a post-processing method, our focus is on assessing its localization accuracy and service availability while operating in real-time in challenging environments (urban canyons). Experimental results on the UrbanNav-HK-MediumUrban-1 dataset show that the proposed approach achieves real-time operation and increased service availability compared to batch FGO methods. While this improvement comes at the cost of reduced positioning accuracy, the paper provides a detailed analysis of the trade-offs between accuracy, availability, and computational efficiency that characterize real-time FGO-based GNSS/IMU fusion.
summary_zh: 精确的定位、导航和授时（PNT）是现代技术运行的基础，也是自主系统的关键推动力。全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）是PNT的一个非常重要的组成部分，它确保了室外定位。现代研究方向已通过融合GNSS测量值与其他传感器信息（主要是来自惯性测量单元（IMU）的测量值）将GNSS定位的性能推向了新的高度。在本文中，我们提出了一种松耦合架构，利用因子图优化（FGO）框架来集成GNSS和IMU的测量值。由于FGO方法可能在计算上具有挑战性，并且通常用作后处理方法，因此我们的重点是评估其在具有挑战性的环境（城市峡谷）中实时运行时的定位精度和服务可用性。在UrbanNav-HK-MediumUrban-1数据集上的实验结果表明，与批处理FGO方法相比，所提出的方法实现了实时运行，并提高了服务可用性。虽然这种改进是以降低定位精度为代价的，但本文详细分析了基于实时FGO的GNSS/IMU融合的精度、可用性和计算效率之间的权衡。
tldr: This paper presents a real-time, loosely coupled GNSS/IMU integration method using Factor Graph Optimization, analyzing the trade-offs between accuracy, availability, and computational efficiency in challenging urban environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于因子图优化的实时、松耦合的GNSS/IMU集成方法，分析了在具有挑战性的城市环境中，精度、可用性和计算效率之间的权衡。

title: Towards Explainable Deep Learning for Ship Trajectory Prediction in Inland Waterways
summary: Accurate predictions of ship trajectories in crowded environments are essential to ensure safety in inland waterways traffic. Recent advances in deep learning promise increased accuracy even for complex scenarios. While the challenge of ship-to-ship awareness is being addressed with growing success, the explainability of these models is often overlooked, potentially obscuring an inaccurate logic and undermining the confidence in their reliability. This study examines an LSTM-based vessel trajectory prediction model by incorporating trained ship domain parameters that provide insight into the attention-based fusion of the interacting vessels' hidden states. This approach has previously been explored in the field of maritime shipping, yet the variety and complexity of encounters in inland waterways allow for a more profound analysis of the model's interpretability. The prediction performance of the proposed model variants are evaluated using standard displacement error statistics. Additionally, the plausibility of the generated ship domain values is analyzed. With an final displacement error of around 40 meters in a 5-minute prediction horizon, the model performs comparably to similar studies. Though the ship-to-ship attention architecture enhances prediction accuracy, the weights assigned to vessels in encounters using the learnt ship domain values deviate from the expectation. The observed accuracy improvements are thus not entirely driven by a causal relationship between a predicted trajectory and the trajectories of nearby ships. This finding underscores the model's explanatory capabilities through its intrinsically interpretable design. Future work will focus on utilizing the architecture for counterfactual analysis and on the incorporation of more sophisticated attention mechanisms.
summary_zh: 在拥挤环境中准确预测船舶轨迹对于确保内河航运安全至关重要。 近期深度学习的进展有望提高预测精度，即使在复杂场景下也是如此。 船舶间的感知挑战正日益成功地得到解决，但这些模型的可解释性往往被忽视，这可能掩盖了不准确的逻辑并削弱了对其可靠性的信心。 本研究通过结合训练过的船舶领域参数，来检查一个基于LSTM的船舶轨迹预测模型，这些参数提供了对交互船舶隐藏状态基于注意力机制融合的深入理解。 这种方法之前已经在海运领域被探索过，但内河航道中航行相遇的多样性和复杂性使得对模型可解释性进行更深入的分析成为可能。 使用标准位移误差统计量评估了所提出的模型变体的预测性能。 此外，还分析了生成的船舶领域值的合理性。 在5分钟的预测范围内，最终位移误差约为40米，该模型性能与类似研究相当。 尽管船间注意力架构提高了预测精度，但使用学习到的船舶领域值分配给相遇船舶的权重与预期不符。 因此，观察到的精度改进并非完全由预测轨迹与附近船舶轨迹之间的因果关系驱动。 这一发现通过模型固有的可解释性设计，强调了模型的解释能力。 未来的工作将侧重于利用该架构进行反事实分析，以及整合更为复杂的注意力机制。
tldr: This paper explores explainable LSTM-based ship trajectory prediction in inland waterways by incorporating ship domain parameters into attention mechanisms. While achieving comparable prediction accuracy, the study reveals discrepancies between attention weights and expected ship domain influences, highlighting the model's explanatory capabilities and areas for improvement.
tldr_zh: 本文通过将船舶领域参数融入注意力机制，探索了内河航道中基于LSTM的可解释的船舶轨迹预测。虽然实现了相当的预测精度，但研究揭示了注意力权重与预期船舶领域影响之间的差异，突出了模型的可解释性能力和需要改进的领域。

title: LeafInst - Unified Instance Segmentation Network for Fine-Grained Forestry Leaf Phenotype Analysis: A New UAV based Benchmark
summary: Intelligent forest tree breeding has advanced plant phenotyping, yet existing research largely focuses on large-leaf agricultural crops, with limited attention to fine-grained leaf analysis of sapling trees in open-field environments. Natural scenes introduce challenges including scale variation, illumination changes, and irregular leaf morphology. To address these issues, we collected UAV RGB imagery of field-grown saplings and constructed the Poplar-leaf dataset, containing 1,202 branches and 19,876 pixel-level annotated leaf instances. To our knowledge, this is the first instance segmentation dataset specifically designed for forestry leaves in open-field conditions. We propose LeafInst, a novel segmentation framework tailored for irregular and multi-scale leaf structures. The model integrates an Asymptotic Feature Pyramid Network (AFPN) for multi-scale perception, a Dynamic Asymmetric Spatial Perception (DASP) module for irregular shape modeling, and a dual-residual Dynamic Anomalous Regression Head (DARH) with Top-down Concatenation decoder Feature Fusion (TCFU) to improve detection and segmentation performance. On Poplar-leaf, LeafInst achieves 68.4 mAP, outperforming YOLOv11 by 7.1 percent and MaskDINO by 6.5 percent. On the public PhenoBench benchmark, it reaches 52.7 box mAP, exceeding MaskDINO by 3.4 percent. Additional experiments demonstrate strong generalization and practical utility for large-scale leaf phenotyping.
summary_zh: 智能林木育种促进了植物表型分析的发展，然而，现有研究主要集中于大叶农作物，对露天环境中幼树的精细叶片分析关注较少。自然场景带来了尺度变化、光照变化和不规则叶片形态等挑战。为了解决这些问题，我们采集了田间种植幼树的无人机RGB图像，并构建了杨树叶片数据集，其中包含1202个枝条和19876个像素级标注的叶片实例。据我们所知，这是第一个专门为露天条件下林业叶片设计的实例分割数据集。我们提出了LeafInst，一种为不规则和多尺度叶片结构量身定制的新型分割框架。该模型集成了用于多尺度感知的渐近特征金字塔网络(AFPN)、用于不规则形状建模的动态非对称空间感知(DASP)模块，以及具有自顶向下级联解码器特征融合(TCFU)的双残差动态异常回归头(DARH)，以提高检测和分割性能。在杨树叶片数据集上，LeafInst达到了68.4 mAP，超越YOLOv11 7.1个百分点，超越MaskDINO 6.5个百分点。在公共PhenoBench基准测试中，它达到了52.7 box mAP，超过MaskDINO 3.4个百分点。其他实验证明了其强大的泛化能力和大规模叶片表型分析的实用性。
tldr: The paper introduces LeafInst, a novel instance segmentation framework and associated Poplar-leaf dataset for fine-grained forestry leaf phenotyping using UAV imagery, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了LeafInst，一种新颖的实例分割框架以及相关的Poplar-leaf数据集，用于使用无人机图像进行细粒度的林业叶片表型分析，并实现了最先进的性能。

title: Tracking Feral Horses in Aerial Video Using Oriented Bounding Boxes
summary: The social structures of group-living animals such as feral horses are diverse and remain insufficiently understood, even within a single species. To investigate group dynamics, aerial videos are often utilized to track individuals and analyze their movement trajectories, which are essential for evaluating inter-individual interactions and comparing social behaviors. Accurate individual tracking is therefore crucial. In multi-animal tracking, axis-aligned bounding boxes (bboxes) are widely used; however, for aerial top-view footage of entire groups, their performance degrades due to complex backgrounds, small target sizes, high animal density, and varying body orientations. To address this issue, we employ oriented bounding boxes (OBBs), which include rotation angles and reduce unnecessary background. Nevertheless, current OBB detectors such as YOLO-OBB restrict angles within a 180$^{\circ}$ range, making it impossible to distinguish head from tail and often causing sudden 180$^{\circ}$ flips across frames, which severely disrupts continuous tracking. To overcome this limitation, we propose a head-orientation estimation method that crops OBB-centered patches, applies three detectors (head, tail, and head-tail), and determines the final label through IoU-based majority voting. Experiments using 299 test images show that our method achieves 99.3% accuracy, outperforming individual models, demonstrating its effectiveness for robust OBB-based tracking.
summary_zh: 群居动物（如野马）的社会结构具有多样性，即使在同一物种内也未被充分理解。为了研究群体动态，常利用航拍视频来追踪个体并分析其运动轨迹，这对于评估个体间交互作用和比较社会行为至关重要。因此，准确的个体追踪至关重要。在多动物追踪中，轴对齐边界框（bboxes）被广泛使用；然而，对于整个群体的航拍俯视镜头，由于复杂的背景、小目标尺寸、高动物密度和变化的身体朝向，其性能会下降。为了解决这个问题，我们采用了包含旋转角度并能够减少不必要背景的旋转边界框（OBBs）。然而，当前的OBB检测器（如YOLO-OBB）将角度限制在180°范围内，这使得区分头部和尾部变得不可能，并且经常导致跨帧的突然180°翻转，严重扰乱了连续追踪。为了克服这个限制，我们提出了一种头部朝向估计方法，该方法裁剪以OBB为中心的图像块，应用三个检测器（头部、尾部和头部-尾部），并通过基于IoU的多数投票确定最终标签。使用299张测试图像的实验表明，我们的方法达到了99.3%的准确率，优于单个模型，证明了其对于鲁棒的基于OBB的追踪的有效性。
tldr: The paper presents a method for tracking feral horses in aerial videos using oriented bounding boxes (OBBs) and a novel head-orientation estimation technique to improve tracking accuracy by preventing identity flips.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种使用定向边界框（OBB）在空中视频中跟踪野生马匹的方法，以及一种新的头部方向估计技术，通过防止身份翻转来提高跟踪精度。

title: Confidence-aware Monocular Depth Estimation for Minimally Invasive Surgery
summary: Purpose: Monocular depth estimation (MDE) is vital for scene understanding in minimally invasive surgery (MIS). However, endoscopic video sequences are often contaminated by smoke, specular reflections, blur, and occlusions, limiting the accuracy of MDE models. In addition, current MDE models do not output depth confidence, which could be a valuable tool for improving their clinical reliability. Methods: We propose a novel confidence-aware MDE framework featuring three significant contributions: (i) Calibrated confidence targets: an ensemble of fine-tuned stereo matching models is used to capture disparity variance into pixel-wise confidence probabilities; (ii) Confidence-aware loss: Baseline MDE models are optimized with confidence-aware loss functions, utilizing pixel-wise confidence probabilities such that reliable pixels dominate training; and (iii) Inference-time confidence: a confidence estimation head is proposed with two convolution layers to predict per-pixel confidence at inference, enabling assessment of depth reliability. Results: Comprehensive experimental validation across internal and public datasets demonstrates that our framework improves depth estimation accuracy and can robustly quantify the prediction's confidence. On the internal clinical endoscopic dataset (StereoKP), we improve dense depth estimation accuracy by ~8% as compared to the baseline model. Conclusion: Our confidence-aware framework enables improved accuracy of MDE models in MIS, addressing challenges posed by noise and artifacts in pre-clinical and clinical data, and allows MDE models to provide confidence maps that may be used to improve their reliability for clinical applications.
summary_zh: 目的：单目深度估计(MDE)对于微创手术(MIS)中的场景理解至关重要。然而，内窥镜视频序列经常受到烟雾、镜面反射、模糊和遮挡的干扰，限制了MDE模型的准确性。此外，当前的MDE模型不输出深度置信度，而深度置信度可能成为提高其临床可靠性的宝贵工具。方法：我们提出了一种新型的置信度感知MDE框架，其主要贡献在于三点：(i) 校准的置信度目标：采用微调的立体匹配模型集合，将视差方差捕获为像素级的置信度概率；(ii) 置信度感知损失：基准MDE模型通过置信度感知损失函数进行优化，利用像素级的置信度概率，使可靠像素在训练中占据主导地位；(iii) 推理时置信度：提出了一个置信度估计头，包含两个卷积层，用于预测推理时每个像素的置信度，从而评估深度可靠性。结果：在内部和公共数据集上进行的全面实验验证表明，我们的框架提高了深度估计的准确性，并且可以稳健地量化预测的置信度。在内部临床内窥镜数据集(StereoKP)上，与基准模型相比，我们提高了约8%的密集深度估计精度。结论：我们的置信度感知框架提高了MDE模型在MIS中的准确性，解决了临床前和临床数据中噪声和伪影带来的挑战，并使MDE模型能够提供置信度图，从而提高其在临床应用中的可靠性。
tldr: The paper presents a confidence-aware monocular depth estimation framework for minimally invasive surgery, improving accuracy and providing confidence estimates for clinical reliability.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个置信度感知的单目深度估计框架，用于微创手术，提高了准确性，并为临床可靠性提供了置信度估计。

title: Fixed-Budget Constrained Best Arm Identification in Grouped Bandits
summary: We study fixed budget constrained best-arm identification in grouped bandits, where each arm consists of multiple independent attributes with stochastic rewards. An arm is considered feasible only if all its attributes' means are above a given threshold. The aim is to find the feasible arm with the largest overall mean. We first derive a lower bound on the error probability for any algorithm on this setting. We then propose Feasibility Constrained Successive Rejects (FCSR), a novel algorithm that identifies the best arm while ensuring feasibility. We show it attains optimal dependence on problem parameters up to constant factors in the exponent. Empirically, FCSR outperforms natural baselines while preserving feasibility guarantees.
summary_zh: 我们研究了分组老虎机中的固定预算约束最优臂识别问题，其中每个臂由多个具有随机回报的独立属性组成。只有在其所有属性的均值都高于给定阈值时，该臂才被认为是可行的。目标是找到具有最大总体均值的可行臂。我们首先推导了适用于此设置下任何算法的错误概率下界。然后，我们提出了一种新算法，即可行性约束连续拒绝算法（FCSR），该算法在确保可行性的前提下识别最佳臂。我们证明了它在指数上达到了对问题参数的最佳依赖性，直至常数因子。在实验上，FCSR优于自然基线，同时保留了可行性保证。
tldr: This paper introduces a new algorithm, FCSR, for best-arm identification in grouped bandits with feasibility constraints, proving its optimality and demonstrating its effectiveness empirically.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的算法FCSR，用于在具有可行性约束的分组bandit中进行最佳臂识别，证明了其最优性并通过实验证明了其有效性。

title: Real-time tightly coupled GNSS and IMU integration via Factor Graph Optimization
summary: Reliable positioning in dense urban environments remains challenging due to frequent GNSS signal blockage, multipath, and rapidly varying satellite geometry. While factor graph optimization (FGO)-based GNSS-IMU fusion has demonstrated strong robustness and accuracy, most formulations remain offline. In this work, we present a real-time tightly coupled GNSS-IMU FGO method that enables causal state estimation via incremental optimization with fixed-lag marginalization, and we evaluate its performance in a highly urbanized GNSS-degraded environment using the UrbanNav dataset.
summary_zh: 在密集的城市环境中，由于频繁的GNSS信号遮挡、多径效应和快速变化的卫星几何结构，实现可靠的定位仍然具有挑战性。尽管基于因子图优化(FGO)的GNSS-IMU融合已经展现出强大的鲁棒性和精度，但大多数公式仍然是离线的。 在这项工作中，我们提出了一种实时的紧耦合GNSS-IMU FGO方法，该方法通过具有固定延迟边缘化的增量优化来实现因果状态估计。我们使用UrbanNav数据集，在一个高度城市化的GNSS退化环境中评估了其性能。
tldr: This paper presents a real-time tightly coupled GNSS-IMU integration method using factor graph optimization for robust positioning in urban environments, addressing GNSS signal degradation issues.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于因子图优化的实时紧耦合GNSS-IMU集成方法，用于在城市环境中实现鲁棒定位，解决了GNSS信号退化问题。

title: Activity Recognition from Smart Insole Sensor Data Using a Circular Dilated CNN
summary: Smart insoles equipped with pressure sensors, accelerometers, and gyroscopes offer a non-intrusive means of monitoring human gait and posture. We present an activity classification system based on a circular dilated convolutional neural network (CDCNN) that processes multi-modal time-series data from such insoles. The model operates on 160-frame windows with 24 channels (18 pressure, 3 accelerometer, 3 gyroscope axes), achieving 86.42% test accuracy in a subject-independent evaluation on a four-class task (Standing, Walking, Sitting, Tandem), compared with 87.83% for an extreme gradient-boosted tree (XGBoost) model trained on flattened data. Permutation feature importance reveals that inertial sensors (accelerometer and gyroscope) contribute substantially to discrimination. The approach is suitable for embedded deployment and real-time inference.
summary_zh: 配备压力传感器、加速度计和陀螺仪的智能鞋垫提供了一种非侵入式监测人体步态和姿势的手段。我们提出了一种基于圆形膨胀卷积神经网络 (CDCNN) 的活动分类系统，该系统处理来自此类鞋垫的多模态时间序列数据。该模型在具有 24 个通道（18 个压力通道、3 个加速度计轴和 3 个陀螺仪轴）的 160 帧窗口上运行，在四类任务（站立、行走、坐立、并步）的受试者独立评估中，实现了 86.42% 的测试准确率，而基于扁平化数据训练的极端梯度提升树 (XGBoost) 模型的准确率为 87.83%。排列特征重要性表明，惯性传感器（加速度计和陀螺仪）对区分度有显著贡献。该方法适用于嵌入式部署和实时推理。
tldr: This paper introduces a circular dilated CNN (CDCNN) for activity recognition from smart insole sensor data, achieving comparable accuracy to XGBoost in a subject-independent evaluation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于环形扩张卷积神经网络（CDCNN）的智能鞋垫传感器数据活动识别方法，在主体独立的评估中获得了与XGBoost相当的准确性。

title: Detection and Identification of Penguins Using Appearance and Motion Features
summary: In animal facilities, continuous surveillance of penguins is essential yet technically challenging due to their homogeneous visual characteristics, rapid and frequent posture changes, and substantial environmental noise such as water reflections. In this study, we propose a framework that enhances both detection and identification performance by integrating appearance and motion features. For detection, we adapted YOLO11 to process consecutive frames to overcome the lack of temporal consistency in single-frame detectors. This approach leverages motion cues to detect targets even when distinct visual features are obscured. Our evaluation shows that fine-tuning the model with two-frame inputs improves mAP@0.5 from 0.922 to 0.933, outperforming the baseline, and successfully recovers individuals that are indistinguishable in static images. For identification, we introduce a tracklet-based contrastive learning approach applied after tracking. Through qualitative visualization, we demonstrate that the method produces coherent feature embeddings, bringing samples from the same individual closer in the feature space, suggesting the potential for mitigating ID switching.
summary_zh: 在动物设施中，对企鹅进行持续监测至关重要，但由于其视觉特征同质化、姿势变化迅速且频繁以及大量环境噪声（如水面反射），在技术上极具挑战性。本研究提出了一种通过整合外观和运动特征来提高检测和识别性能的框架。在检测方面，我们改进了YOLO11以处理连续帧，从而克服单帧检测器在时间一致性上的不足。该方法利用运动线索来检测目标，即使当独特的视觉特征被遮挡时也能发挥作用。评估结果表明，使用双帧输入微调模型可将mAP@0.5从0.922提高到0.933，优于基线模型，并成功恢复了在静态图像中无法区分的个体。在识别方面，我们引入了一种在跟踪后应用的基于轨迹片段的对比学习方法。通过定性可视化，我们证明该方法生成了连贯的特征嵌入，将来自同一主体的样本在特征空间中拉得更近，表明其具有减轻ID切换的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents a framework for penguin detection and identification using appearance and motion features, improving performance via a modified YOLO and tracklet-based contrastive learning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个利用外观和运动特征进行企鹅检测和识别的框架，通过改进的YOLO和基于轨迹的对比学习来提高性能。

title: OpenFrontier: General Navigation with Visual-Language Grounded Frontiers
summary: Open-world navigation requires robots to make decisions in complex everyday environments while adapting to flexible task requirements. Conventional navigation approaches often rely on dense 3D reconstruction and hand-crafted goal metrics, which limits their generalization across tasks and environments. Recent advances in vision--language navigation (VLN) and vision--language--action (VLA) models enable end-to-end policies conditioned on natural language, but typically require interactive training, large-scale data collection, or task-specific fine-tuning with a mobile agent. We formulate navigation as a sparse subgoal identification and reaching problem and observe that providing visual anchoring targets for high-level semantic priors enables highly efficient goal-conditioned navigation. Based on this insight, we select navigation frontiers as semantic anchors and propose OpenFrontier, a training-free navigation framework that seamlessly integrates diverse vision--language prior models. OpenFrontier enables efficient navigation with a lightweight system design, without dense 3D mapping, policy training, or model fine-tuning. We evaluate OpenFrontier across multiple navigation benchmarks and demonstrate strong zero-shot performance, as well as effective real-world deployment on a mobile robot.
summary_zh: 开放世界导航要求机器人在复杂的日常环境中做出决策，同时适应灵活的任务需求。传统的导航方法通常依赖于密集的3D重建和手工设计的目标指标，这限制了它们在不同任务和环境中的泛化能力。视觉-语言导航（VLN）和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的最新进展使得能够实现以自然语言为条件的端到端策略，但通常需要交互式训练、大规模数据收集，或者使用移动代理进行特定于任务的微调。我们把导航描述为稀疏子目标识别和到达问题，并观察到为高级语义先验提供视觉锚定目标能够实现高效的目标条件导航。基于这一洞察，我们选择导航前沿作为语义锚，并提出OpenFrontier，一个无需训练的导航框架，能够无缝集成各种视觉-语言先验模型。 OpenFrontier能够以轻量级的系统设计实现高效导航，无需密集的3D地图、策略训练或模型微调。我们在多个导航基准上评估了OpenFrontier，并展示了强大的零样本性能，以及在移动机器人上的有效真实世界部署。
tldr: OpenFrontier is a training-free navigation framework that uses visual-language grounded frontiers as semantic anchors for efficient, zero-shot navigation, enabling deployment on real-world mobile robots without dense 3D mapping or policy training.
tldr_zh: OpenFrontier是一个无需训练的导航框架，它使用视觉-语言接地的边界作为语义锚点，实现高效的零样本导航，无需密集的3D地图构建或策略训练即可部署在现实世界的移动机器人上。

title: Critic in the Loop: A Tri-System VLA Framework for Robust Long-Horizon Manipulation
summary: Balancing high-level semantic reasoning with low-level reactive control remains a core challenge in visual robotic manipulation. While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at cognitive planning, their inference latency precludes real-time execution. Conversely, fast Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often lack the semantic depth required for complex, long-horizon tasks. To bridge this gap, we introduce Critic in the Loop, an adaptive hierarchical framework driven by dynamic VLM-Expert scheduling. At its core is a bionic Tri-System architecture comprising a VLM brain for global reasoning, a VLA cerebellum for reactive execution, and a lightweight visual Critic. By continuously monitoring the workspace, the Critic dynamically routes control authority. It sustains rapid closed-loop execution via the VLA for routine subtasks, and adaptively triggers the VLM for replanning upon detecting execution anomalies such as task stagnation or failures. Furthermore, our architecture seamlessly integrates human-inspired rules to intuitively break infinite retry loops. This visually-grounded scheduling minimizes expensive VLM queries, while substantially enhancing system robustness and autonomy in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. Comprehensive experiments on challenging, long-horizon manipulation benchmarks reveal that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance.
summary_zh: 在视觉机器人操作中，如何平衡高层语义推理与底层反应式控制仍然是一个核心挑战。尽管视觉-语言模型（VLM）擅长认知规划，但其推理延迟阻碍了实时执行。相反，快速的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常缺乏复杂、长时序任务所需的语义深度。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了循环内的评论家，一个由动态VLM-专家调度驱动的自适应分层框架。其核心是一个仿生三系统架构，包含一个用于全局推理的VLM大脑，一个用于反应式执行的VLA小脑，以及一个轻量级的视觉评论家。通过持续监控工作空间，评论家动态地路由控制权限。对于常规子任务，它通过VLA维持快速闭环执行，并在检测到任务停滞或失败等执行异常时，自适应地触发VLM进行重新规划。此外，我们的架构无缝地集成了受人类启发式规则，以直观地打破无限重试循环。这种视觉驱动的调度最大限度地减少了昂贵的VLM查询，同时显著提高了系统在分布外（OOD）场景中的鲁棒性和自主性。在具有挑战性的长时序操作基准测试上的综合实验表明，我们的方法实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: This paper presents a "Critic in the Loop" framework using a VLM, VLA, and a visual critic to improve long-horizon robotic manipulation by adaptively switching between high-level planning and low-level reactive control, achieving SOTA results.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文提出了一个“循环中的批评者”框架，使用VLM、VLA和一个视觉评论家，通过自适应地切换高级规划和低级反应控制来改进长距离机器人操作，并实现了SOTA结果。

title: RoboMME: Benchmarking and Understanding Memory for Robotic Generalist Policies
summary: Memory is critical for long-horizon and history-dependent robotic manipulation. Such tasks often involve counting repeated actions or manipulating objects that become temporarily occluded. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models have begun to incorporate memory mechanisms; however, their evaluations remain confined to narrow, non-standardized settings. This limits their systematic understanding, comparison, and progress measurement. To address these challenges, we introduce RoboMME: a large-scale standardized benchmark for evaluating and advancing VLA models in long-horizon, history-dependent scenarios. Our benchmark comprises 16 manipulation tasks constructed under a carefully designed taxonomy that evaluates temporal, spatial, object, and procedural memory. We further develop a suite of 14 memory-augmented VLA variants built on the π0.5 backbone to systematically explore different memory representations across multiple integration strategies. Experimental results show that the effectiveness of memory representations is highly task-dependent, with each design offering distinct advantages and limitations across different tasks. Videos and code can be found at our website https://robomme.github.io.
summary_zh: 记忆对于长时程和历史依赖型机器人操作至关重要。这类任务通常涉及重复动作的计数或对临时遮挡物体的操作。近期的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已经开始结合记忆机制；然而，它们的评估仍然局限于狭窄的、非标准化的环境中。这限制了它们的系统性理解、比较和进度衡量。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入RoboMME：一个大规模标准化基准，用于评估和推进VLA模型在长时程、历史依赖型情景中的性能。我们的基准包含16个操作任务，这些任务是在一个精心设计的分类法下构建的，该分类法评估了时间、空间、物体以及程序性记忆。我们进一步开发了一套基于π0.5主干的14种记忆增强型VLA变体，以系统地探索跨多种集成策略的不同记忆表征。实验结果表明，记忆表征的有效性高度依赖于任务，每种设计在不同任务中都表现出独特的优势和局限性。视频和代码可在我们的网站https://robomme.github.io找到。
tldr: The paper introduces RoboMME, a standardized benchmark for evaluating memory in vision-language-action models for long-horizon robotic manipulation, and explores the effectiveness of different memory representations across various tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 RoboMME，一个用于评估视觉-语言-动作模型在长程机器人操作中记忆能力的标准化基准，并探讨了不同记忆表征在各种任务中的有效性。

title: RoboCasa365: A Large-Scale Simulation Framework for Training and Benchmarking Generalist Robots
summary: Recent advances in robot learning have accelerated progress toward generalist robots that can perform everyday tasks in human environments. Yet it remains difficult to gauge how close we are to this vision. The field lacks a reproducible, large-scale benchmark for systematic evaluation. To fill this gap, we present RoboCasa365, a comprehensive simulation benchmark for household mobile manipulation. Built on the RoboCasa platform, RoboCasa365 introduces 365 everyday tasks across 2,500 diverse kitchen environments, with over 600 hours of human demonstration data and over 1600 hours of synthetically generated demonstration data -- making it one of the most diverse and large-scale resources for studying generalist policies. RoboCasa365 is designed to support systematic evaluations for different problem settings, including multi-task learning, robot foundation model training, and lifelong learning. We conduct extensive experiments on this benchmark with state-of-the-art methods and analyze the impacts of task diversity, dataset scale, and environment variation on generalization. Our results provide new insights into what factors most strongly affect the performance of generalist robots and inform strategies for future progress in the field.
summary_zh: 机器人学习的最新进展加速了通用机器人方向的发展，这种机器人能够在人类环境中执行日常任务。然而，衡量我们离这个愿景有多近仍然很困难。该领域缺乏一个可复现的大规模基准，用于系统性评估。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了RoboCasa365，这是一个用于家庭移动操作的综合模拟基准。RoboCasa365建立在RoboCasa平台之上，引入了2,500个不同厨房环境下的365个日常任务，包含超过600小时的人类演示数据和超过1600小时的合成生成演示数据——使其成为研究通用策略的最多样化和大规模的资源之一。RoboCasa365旨在支持对不同问题设置的系统性评估，包括多任务学习、机器人基础模型训练和终身学习。我们使用最先进的方法，在这个基准上进行了广泛的实验，并分析了任务多样性、数据集规模和环境变化对泛化的影响。我们的结果为哪些因素对通用机器人的性能影响最大提供了新的见解，并为该领域未来的发展战略提供了信息。
tldr: The paper introduces RoboCasa365, a large-scale simulation benchmark for training and evaluating generalist robots in realistic household environments, featuring diverse tasks, environments, and demonstration data.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RoboCasa365，一个大规模模拟基准，用于在真实的家庭环境中训练和评估通用机器人，具有多样化的任务、环境和演示数据。

title: WebChain: A Large-Scale Human-Annotated Dataset of Real-World Web Interaction Traces
summary: We introduce WebChain, the largest open-source dataset of human-annotated trajectories on real-world websites, designed to accelerate reproducible research in web agents. It contains 31,725 trajectories and 318k steps, featuring a core Triple Alignment of visual, structural, and action data to provide rich, multi-modal supervision. The data is collected via a scalable pipeline that ensures coverage of complex, high-value tasks often missed by synthetic methods. Leveraging this dataset, we propose a Dual Mid-Training recipe that decouples spatial grounding from planning, achieving state-of-the-art performance on our proposed WebChainBench and other public GUI benchmarks. Our work provides the data and insights necessary to build and rigorously evaluate the next generation of scalable web agents.
summary_zh: 我们推出了WebChain，这是最大的开源人类标注的真实网站轨迹数据集，旨在加速Web代理中可复现的研究。它包含31,725条轨迹和31.8万个步骤，具有视觉、结构和行动数据的核心三重对齐，以提供丰富的多模态监督。该数据是通过可扩展的流水线收集的，确保了对合成方法经常遗漏的复杂、高价值任务的覆盖。利用该数据集，我们提出了一种双重中间训练策略，将空间定位与规划分离，从而在我们的WebChainBench以及其他公共GUI基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。我们的工作提供了构建和严格评估下一代可扩展Web代理所需的数据和见解。
tldr: The paper introduces WebChain, a large-scale, human-annotated web interaction dataset with visual, structural, and action data, and proposes a dual mid-training recipe achieving SOTA performance on web agent benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了WebChain，一个大规模的人工标注网络交互数据集，包含视觉、结构和动作数据，并提出了一种双重中间训练方法，在网络代理基准测试中实现了SOTA性能。

title: EvoTool: Self-Evolving Tool-Use Policy Optimization in LLM Agents via Blame-Aware Mutation and Diversity-Aware Selection
summary: LLM-based agents depend on effective tool-use policies to solve complex tasks, yet optimizing these policies remains challenging due to delayed supervision and the difficulty of credit assignment in long-horizon trajectories. Existing optimization approaches tend to be either monolithic, which are prone to entangling behaviors, or single-aspect, which ignore cross-module error propagation. To address these limitations, we propose EvoTool, a self-evolving framework that optimizes a modular tool-use policy via a gradient-free evolutionary paradigm. EvoTool decomposes agent's tool-use policy into four modules, including Planner, Selector, Caller, and Synthesizer, and iteratively improves them in a self-improving loop through three novel mechanisms. Trajectory-Grounded Blame Attribution uses diagnostic traces to localize failures to a specific module. Feedback-Guided Targeted Mutation then edits only that module via natural-language critique. Diversity-Aware Population Selection preserves complementary candidates to ensure solution diversity. Across four benchmarks, EvoTool outperforms strong baselines by over 5 points on both GPT-4.1 and Qwen3-8B, while achieving superior efficiency and transferability. The code will be released once paper is accepted.
summary_zh: 基于LLM的智能体依赖于有效的工具使用策略来解决复杂任务，然而，由于监督延迟和长程轨迹中信用分配的困难，优化这些策略仍然具有挑战性。现有的优化方法往往是单片的，容易纠缠行为，或者是单方面的，忽略了跨模块的误差传播。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了EvoTool，一个自演化框架，通过无梯度演化范式优化模块化的工具使用策略。EvoTool将智能体的工具使用策略分解为四个模块，包括规划器（Planner）、选择器（Selector）、调用器（Caller）和合成器（Synthesizer），并通过三种新颖机制在自改进循环中迭代改进它们。轨迹溯源故障归因使用诊断追踪将故障定位到特定模块。然后，反馈引导的目标突变仅通过自然语言评判来编辑该模块。多样性感知种群选择保留互补候选方案，以确保解决方案的多样性。在四个基准测试中，EvoTool在GPT-4.1和Qwen3-8B上都优于强大的基线超过5个点，同时实现了卓越的效率和可迁移性。代码将在论文被接收后发布。
tldr: EvoTool is a self-evolving framework that optimizes modular tool-use policies in LLM agents using blame attribution, targeted mutation, and diversity-aware selection, outperforming strong baselines in several benchmarks.
tldr_zh: EvoTool是一个自进化框架，它通过归因、针对性突变和多样性选择来优化LLM代理中模块化的工具使用策略，并在多个基准测试中优于现有方法。

title: Latent Particle World Models: Self-supervised Object-centric Stochastic Dynamics Modeling
summary: We introduce Latent Particle World Model (LPWM), a self-supervised object-centric world model scaled to real-world multi-object datasets and applicable in decision-making. LPWM autonomously discovers keypoints, bounding boxes, and object masks directly from video data, enabling it to learn rich scene decompositions without supervision. Our architecture is trained end-to-end purely from videos and supports flexible conditioning on actions, language, and image goals. LPWM models stochastic particle dynamics via a novel latent action module and achieves state-of-the-art results on diverse real-world and synthetic datasets. Beyond stochastic video modeling, LPWM is readily applicable to decision-making, including goal-conditioned imitation learning, as we demonstrate in the paper. Code, data, pre-trained models and video rollouts are available: https://taldatech.github.io/lpwm-web
summary_zh: 我们提出了潜在粒子世界模型（LPWM），一种自监督的、以对象为中心的世界模型，可扩展到真实世界的多对象数据集并适用于决策。 LPWM能够直接从视频数据中自主发现关键点、边界框和对象掩码，从而无需监督即可学习丰富的场景分解。 我们的架构完全从视频中进行端到端训练，并支持基于动作、语言和图像目标的灵活条件控制。 LPWM通过一种新颖的潜在动作模块对随机粒子动力学进行建模，并在各种真实世界和合成数据集上取得了最先进的结果。 除了随机视频建模之外，LPWM还可轻松应用于决策，包括目标条件模仿学习，正如我们在本文中所展示的那样。代码、数据、预训练模型和视频回滚可在此处获得：https://taldatech.github.io/lpwm-web
tldr: The paper introduces Latent Particle World Model (LPWM), a self-supervised object-centric world model that learns scene decompositions and stochastic particle dynamics from video data, achieving state-of-the-art results and enabling goal-conditioned imitation learning.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了潜粒子世界模型（LPWM），这是一种自我监督的以对象为中心的世界模型，可以从视频数据中学习场景分解和随机粒子动力学，实现了最先进的结果，并实现了目标条件模仿学习。

title: PhysiFlow: Physics-Aware Humanoid Whole-Body VLA via Multi-Brain Latent Flow Matching and Robust Tracking
summary: In the domain of humanoid robot control, the fusion of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) with whole-body control is essential for semantically guided execution of real-world tasks. However, existing methods encounter challenges in terms of low VLA inference efficiency or an absence of effective semantic guidance for whole-body control, resulting in instability in dynamic limb-coordinated tasks. To bridge this gap, we present a semantic-motion intent guided, physics-aware multi-brain VLA framework for humanoid whole-body control. A series of experiments was conducted to evaluate the performance of the proposed framework. The experimental results demonstrated that the framework enabled reliable vision-language-guided full-body coordination for humanoid robots.
summary_zh: 在人形机器人控制领域，视觉-语言-动作(VLA)与全身控制的融合对于语义引导的现实世界任务执行至关重要。然而，现有方法在VLA推理效率低下或缺乏对全身控制的有效语义引导方面面临挑战，导致动态肢体协调任务的不稳定性。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了一种语义-运动意图引导的、具备物理感知的多脑VLA框架，用于人形机器人全身控制。 一系列实验被用来评估所提框架的性能。实验结果表明，该框架能够实现可靠的视觉-语言引导的人形机器人全身协调。
tldr: The paper introduces a physics-aware multi-brain VLA framework called PhysiFlow for humanoid robot whole-body control, addressing limitations in efficiency and semantic guidance of existing VLA methods for dynamic tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为PhysiFlow的物理感知多脑VLA框架，用于人形机器人全身控制，解决了现有VLA方法在动态任务中的效率和语义指导方面的局限性。

title: UltraDexGrasp: Learning Universal Dexterous Grasping for Bimanual Robots with Synthetic Data
summary: Grasping is a fundamental capability for robots to interact with the physical world. Humans, equipped with two hands, autonomously select appropriate grasp strategies based on the shape, size, and weight of objects, enabling robust grasping and subsequent manipulation. In contrast, current robotic grasping remains limited, particularly in multi-strategy settings. Although substantial efforts have targeted parallel-gripper and single-hand grasping, dexterous grasping for bimanual robots remains underexplored, with data being a primary bottleneck. Achieving physically plausible and geometrically conforming grasps that can withstand external wrenches poses significant challenges. To address these issues, we introduce UltraDexGrasp, a framework for universal dexterous grasping with bimanual robots. The proposed data-generation pipeline integrates optimization-based grasp synthesis with planning-based demonstration generation, yielding high-quality and diverse trajectories across multiple grasp strategies. With this framework, we curate UltraDexGrasp-20M, a large-scale, multi-strategy grasp dataset comprising 20 million frames across 1,000 objects. Based on UltraDexGrasp-20M, we further develop a simple yet effective grasp policy that takes point clouds as input, aggregates scene features via unidirectional attention, and predicts control commands. Trained exclusively on synthetic data, the policy achieves robust zero-shot sim-to-real transfer and consistently succeeds on novel objects with varied shapes, sizes, and weights, attaining an average success rate of 81.2% in real-world universal dexterous grasping. To facilitate future research on grasping with bimanual robots, we open-source the data generation pipeline at https://github.com/InternRobotics/UltraDexGrasp.
summary_zh: 抓取是机器人与物理世界交互的一项基础能力。人类凭借双手，能够根据物体的形状、大小和重量自主选择合适的抓取策略，从而实现稳健的抓取和后续操作。相比之下，当前的机器人抓取仍然受到限制，尤其是在多策略的场景下。尽管大量的研究工作集中于平行夹爪和单手抓取，但针对双臂机器人的灵巧抓取仍然未被充分探索，数据是主要的瓶颈。实现物理上合理且几何上符合的、能够承受外部扳手的抓取姿态带来了巨大的挑战。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了UltraDexGrasp，一个用于双臂机器人通用灵巧抓取的框架。所提出的数据生成流程集成了基于优化的抓取合成和基于规划的示教生成，从而产生了高质量且多样化的、跨多种抓取策略的轨迹。基于此框架，我们整理了 UltraDexGrasp-20M，一个大规模、多策略的抓取数据集，包含 1000 个物体的 2000 万帧数据。基于 UltraDexGrasp-20M，我们进一步开发了一种简单而有效的抓取策略，该策略以点云作为输入，通过单向注意力聚合场景特征，并预测控制指令。该策略完全在合成数据上训练，实现了鲁棒的零样本 Sim-to-Real 迁移，并在各种形状、大小和重量的新物体上持续成功，在真实世界通用灵巧抓取中达到了 81.2% 的平均成功率。为了促进未来对双臂机器人抓取的研究，我们开源了数据生成流程，地址为 https://github.com/InternRobotics/UltraDexGrasp。
tldr: The paper introduces UltraDexGrasp, a framework and large-scale synthetic dataset for learning universal dexterous grasping with bimanual robots, demonstrating robust zero-shot sim-to-real transfer with a simple grasp policy.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了UltraDexGrasp，一个用于学习双臂机器人通用灵巧抓取的框架和大规模合成数据集，并通过简单的抓取策略展示了强大的零样本模拟到真实的迁移能力。

title: Latent Policy Steering through One-Step Flow Policies
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) allows robots to learn from offline datasets without risky exploration. Yet, offline RL's performance often hinges on a brittle trade-off between (1) return maximization, which can push policies outside the dataset support, and (2) behavioral constraints, which typically require sensitive hyperparameter tuning. Latent steering offers a structural way to stay within the dataset support during RL, but existing offline adaptations commonly approximate action values using latent-space critics learned via indirect distillation, which can lose information and hinder convergence. We propose Latent Policy Steering (LPS), which enables high-fidelity latent policy improvement by backpropagating original-action-space Q-gradients through a differentiable one-step MeanFlow policy to update a latent-action-space actor. By eliminating proxy latent critics, LPS allows an original-action-space critic to guide end-to-end latent-space optimization, while the one-step MeanFlow policy serves as a behavior-constrained generative prior. This decoupling yields a robust method that works out-of-the-box with minimal tuning. Across OGBench and real-world robotic tasks, LPS achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently outperforms behavioral cloning and strong latent steering baselines.
summary_zh: 离线强化学习 (RL) 允许机器人从离线数据集中学习，而无需进行有风险的探索。然而，离线 RL 的性能通常取决于 (1) 回报最大化与 (2) 行为约束之间脆弱的权衡，前者可能会将策略推到数据集支持之外，而后者通常需要灵敏的超参数调整。潜在空间操纵提供了一种在 RL 期间保持在数据集支持范围内的结构化方法，但现有的离线适配通常使用通过间接蒸馏学习的潜在空间评论家来近似行动价值，这可能会丢失信息并阻碍收敛。我们提出了潜在策略操纵 (LPS)，它通过将原始动作空间的 Q-梯度反向传播到可微分的单步 MeanFlow 策略，来更新潜在动作空间中的策略，从而实现高保真的潜在策略提升。通过消除代理潜在空间评论家，LPS 允许原始动作空间的评论家指导端到端的潜在空间优化，而单步 MeanFlow 策略则充当行为约束的生成先验。这种解耦产生了一种鲁棒的方法，可以开箱即用，且只需最少的调整。在 OGBench 和真实世界的机器人任务中，LPS 实现了最先进的性能，并始终优于行为克隆和强大的潜在空间操纵基线。
tldr: The paper introduces Latent Policy Steering (LPS), a novel offline RL method that leverages a differentiable one-step MeanFlow policy for high-fidelity latent policy improvement, achieving state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的离线强化学习方法，称为潜在策略引导（LPS），它利用可微的单步 MeanFlow 策略来实现高保真潜在策略的改进，并在多个基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

title: Iterative On-Policy Refinement of Hierarchical Diffusion Policies for Language-Conditioned Manipulation
summary: Hierarchical policies for language-conditioned manipulation decompose tasks into subgoals, where a high-level planner guides a low-level controller. However, these hierarchical agents often fail because the planner generates subgoals without considering the actual limitations of the controller. Existing solutions attempt to bridge this gap via intermediate modules or shared representations, but they remain limited by their reliance on fixed offline datasets. We propose HD-ExpIt, a framework for iterative fine-tuning of hierarchical diffusion policies via environment feedback. HD-ExpIt organizes training into a self-reinforcing cycle: it utilizes diffusion-based planning to autonomously discover successful behaviors, which are then distilled back into the hierarchical policy. This loop enables both components to improve while implicitly grounding the planner in the controller's actual capabilities without requiring explicit proxy models. Empirically, HD-ExpIt significantly improves hierarchical policies trained solely on offline data, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the long-horizon CALVIN benchmark among methods trained from scratch.
summary_zh: 语言条件操纵的分层策略将任务分解为子目标，其中高层规划器指导低层控制器。然而，这些分层智能体常常失败，因为规划器在生成子目标时没有考虑控制器的实际限制。现有的解决方案试图通过中间模块或共享表示来弥合这一差距，但它们仍然受到其对固定离线数据集的依赖的限制。我们提出HD-ExpIt，一个通过环境反馈迭代精调分层扩散策略的框架。HD-ExpIt将训练组织成一个自我增强的循环：它利用基于扩散的规划自主发现成功的行为，然后将其提炼回分层策略中。这个循环使得两个组件都能得到改进，同时隐式地将规划器建立在控制器的实际能力上，而无需显式的代理模型。在实验上，HD-ExpIt显著改进了完全在离线数据上训练的分层策略，在从头开始训练的方法中，在长时程CALVIN基准测试上实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces HD-ExpIt, a framework for iteratively refining hierarchical diffusion policies via environment feedback for language-conditioned manipulation, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the CALVIN benchmark from scratch.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了HD-ExpIt，一个通过环境反馈迭代改进分层扩散策略的框架，用于语言条件下的操作任务，并在CALVIN基准测试中从头开始训练时实现了最先进的性能。

title: Digital Twin Driven Textile Classification and Foreign Object Recognition in Automated Sorting Systems
summary: The increasing demand for sustainable textile recycling requires robust automation solutions capable of handling deformable garments and detecting foreign objects in cluttered environments. This work presents a digital twin driven robotic sorting system that integrates grasp prediction, multi modal perception, and semantic reasoning for real world textile classification. A dual arm robotic cell equipped with RGBD sensing, capacitive tactile feedback, and collision-aware motion planning autonomously separates garments from an unsorted basket, transfers them to an inspection zone, and classifies them using state of the art Visual Language Models (VLMs). We benchmark nine VLM s from five model families on a dataset of 223 inspection scenarios comprising shirts, socks, trousers, underwear, foreign objects (including garments outside of the aforementioned classes), and empty scenes. The evaluation assesses per class accuracy, hallucination behavior, and computational performance under practical hardware constraints. Results show that the Qwen model family achieves the highest overall accuracy (up to 87.9 %), with strong foreign object detection performance, while lighter models such as Gemma3 offer competitive speed accuracy trade offs for edge deployment. A digital twin combined with MoveIt enables collision aware path planning and integrates segmented 3D point clouds of inspected garments into the virtual environment for improved manipulation reliability. The presented system demonstrates the feasibility of combining semantic VLM reasoning with conventional grasp detection and digital twin technology for scalable, autonomous textile sorting in realistic industrial settings.
summary_zh: 对可持续纺织品回收日益增长的需求促使人们寻求能够处理可变形衣物并检测杂乱环境中异物的强大自动化解决方案。本研究提出了一种数字孪生驱动的机器人分拣系统，该系统集成了抓取预测、多模态感知和语义推理，用于现实世界的纺织品分类。一个配备RGBD传感、电容式触觉反馈和防碰撞运动规划的双臂机器人单元，能够自主地从一个未分类的篮子中分离衣物，并将它们转移到检查区域，然后使用最先进的视觉语言模型（VLMs）对它们进行分类。我们在一个包含衬衫、袜子、裤子、内衣、异物（包括上述类别之外的衣物）和空场景的223个检查场景的数据集上，对来自五个模型系列的九个VLMs进行了基准测试。评估内容包括各类别的准确率、幻觉行为以及在实际硬件约束下的计算性能。结果表明，Qwen模型系列实现了最高的总体准确率（高达 87.9%），并具有强大的异物检测性能，而像Gemma3这样的更轻量级模型则为边缘部署提供了具有竞争力的速度-准确率权衡。数字孪生结合MoveIt实现了防碰撞路径规划，并将被检查衣物的分割3D点云集成到虚拟环境中，以提高操纵的可靠性。所提出的系统证明了将语义VLMs推理与传统抓取检测和数字孪生技术相结合，用于在现实工业环境中实现可扩展的自主纺织品分拣的可行性。
tldr: This paper presents a digital twin-driven robotic system for automated textile sorting, using VLMs for classification and foreign object detection, demonstrating promising results with the Qwen model family. The system also uses MoveIt for collision-aware path planning and updates the digital twin with segmented garment point clouds.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种数字孪生驱动的机器人系统，用于自动纺织品分类，使用视觉语言模型（VLM）进行分类和异物检测，并展示了Qwen模型家族的良好性能。该系统还使用MoveIt进行避碰路径规划，并使用分割后的服装点云更新数字孪生。

title: Lifelong Language-Conditioned Robotic Manipulation Learning
summary: Traditional language-conditioned manipulation agent sequential adaptation to new manipulation skills leads to catastrophic forgetting of old skills, limiting dynamic scene practical deployment. In this paper, we propose SkillsCrafter, a novel robotic manipulation framework designed to continually learn multiple skills while reducing catastrophic forgetting of old skills. Specifically, we propose a Manipulation Skills Adaptation to retain the old skills knowledge while inheriting the shared knowledge between new and old skills to facilitate learning of new skills. Meanwhile, we perform the singular value decomposition on the diverse skill instructions to obtain common skill semantic subspace projection matrices, thereby recording the essential semantic space of skills. To achieve forget-less and generalization manipulation, we propose a Skills Specialization Aggregation to compute inter-skills similarity in skill semantic subspaces, achieving aggregation of the previously learned skill knowledge for any new or unknown skill. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of our proposed SkillsCrafter.
summary_zh: 传统语言条件下的操控智能体在顺序适应新操控技能时，会导致旧技能的灾难性遗忘，从而限制了动态场景的实际部署。在本文中，我们提出了 SkillsCrafter，一种新型的机器人操控框架，旨在持续学习多种技能，同时减少旧技能的灾难性遗忘。具体来说，我们提出了一种操控技能适应方法，以保留旧技能知识，同时继承新旧技能之间的共享知识，从而促进新技能的学习。同时，我们对多样的技能指令进行奇异值分解，以获得通用的技能语义子空间投影矩阵，从而记录技能的基本语义空间。为了实现无遗忘和泛化的操控，我们提出了一种技能专业化聚合方法，以计算技能语义子空间中的技能间相似度，从而实现对任何新的或未知的技能的先前学习的技能知识的聚合。大量的实验证明了我们提出的 SkillsCrafter 的有效性和优越性。
tldr: The paper introduces SkillsCrafter, a new robotic manipulation framework using language-conditioned learning to mitigate catastrophic forgetting in sequential skill adaptation, leveraging semantic subspace projection and skill similarity aggregation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为SkillsCrafter的新的机器人操纵框架，该框架使用语言条件学习来减轻顺序技能适应中的灾难性遗忘，利用语义子空间投影和技能相似性聚合。

title: Act, Think or Abstain: Complexity-Aware Adaptive Inference for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Current research on Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models predominantly focuses on enhancing generalization through established reasoning techniques. While effective, these improvements invariably increase computational complexity and inference latency. Furthermore, these mechanisms are typically applied indiscriminately, resulting in the inefficient allocation of resources for trivial tasks while simultaneously failing to provide the uncertainty estimation necessary to prevent catastrophic failure on out-of-distribution tasks. Inspired by human cognition, we propose an adaptive framework that dynamically routes VLA execution based on the complexity of the perceived state. Our approach transforms the VLA's vision-language backbone into an active detection tool by projecting latent embeddings into an ensemble of parametric and non-parametric estimators. This allows the system to execute known tasks immediately (Act), reason about ambiguous scenarios (Think), and preemptively halt execution when encountering significant physical or semantic anomalies (Abstain). In our empirical analysis, we observe a phenomenon where visual embeddings alone are superior for inferring task complexity due to the semantic invariance of language. Evaluated on the LIBERO and LIBERO-PRO benchmarks as well as on a real robot, our vision-only configuration achieves 80% F1-Score using as little as 5% of training data, establishing itself as a reliable and efficient task complexity detector.
summary_zh: 当前视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型的研究主要集中在使用成熟的推理技术来增强泛化能力。尽管这些方法有效，但它们总是会增加计算复杂性和推理延迟。此外，这些机制通常被无差别地应用，导致对简单任务的资源分配效率低下，同时又未能提供必要的不确定性估计，从而无法防止在分布外任务上发生灾难性故障。受人类认知启发，我们提出了一种自适应框架，该框架根据感知状态的复杂性动态路由 VLA 的执行过程。我们的方法将 VLA 的视觉-语言主干转变为一种主动检测工具，通过将潜在嵌入投影到参数和非参数估计器的集成中来实现。这使得系统能够立即执行已知任务（Act），推理模糊场景（Think），以及在遇到显著的物理或语义异常时提前停止执行（Abstain）。在我们的实证分析中，我们观察到一种现象，即仅使用视觉嵌入在推断任务复杂性方面更胜一筹，因为语言具有语义不变性。在 LIBERO 和 LIBERO-PRO 基准以及真实机器人上的评估表明，我们仅使用视觉的配置能够使用少至 5% 的训练数据达到 80% 的 F1 分数，从而确立了其作为可靠且高效的任务复杂性检测器的地位。
tldr: This paper proposes an adaptive inference framework for VLA models that dynamically routes execution based on task complexity, using a vision-only configuration for efficient task complexity detection, showing promising results on robot navigation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种VLA模型的自适应推理框架，该框架根据任务的复杂性动态地路由执行，使用纯视觉配置进行高效的任务复杂性检测，并在机器人导航基准测试中显示出有希望的结果。

title: SeedPolicy: Horizon Scaling via Self-Evolving Diffusion Policy for Robot Manipulation
summary: Imitation Learning (IL) enables robots to acquire manipulation skills from expert demonstrations. Diffusion Policy (DP) models multi-modal expert behaviors but suffers performance degradation as observation horizons increase, limiting long-horizon manipulation. We propose Self-Evolving Gated Attention (SEGA), a temporal module that maintains a time-evolving latent state via gated attention, enabling efficient recurrent updates that compress long-horizon observations into a fixed-size representation while filtering irrelevant temporal information. Integrating SEGA into DP yields Self-Evolving Diffusion Policy (SeedPolicy), which resolves the temporal modeling bottleneck and enables scalable horizon extension with moderate overhead. On the RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark with 50 manipulation tasks, SeedPolicy outperforms DP and other IL baselines. Averaged across both CNN and Transformer backbones, SeedPolicy achieves 36.8% relative improvement in clean settings and 169% relative improvement in randomized challenging settings over the DP. Compared to vision-language-action models such as RDT with 1.2B parameters, SeedPolicy achieves competitive performance with one to two orders of magnitude fewer parameters, demonstrating strong efficiency and scalability. These results establish SeedPolicy as a state-of-the-art imitation learning method for long-horizon robotic manipulation. Code is available at: https://github.com/Youqiang-Gui/SeedPolicy.
summary_zh: 模仿学习 (IL) 使机器人能够从专家演示中获得操作技能。扩散策略 (DP) 能够对多模态专家行为进行建模，但随着观察时间范围的增加，其性能会下降，从而限制了长程操作。我们提出了一种自演化门控注意力 (SEGA)，这是一种时间模块，通过门控注意力维护一个随时间演化的潜在状态，从而实现高效的循环更新，将长程观察压缩成固定大小的表示，同时过滤掉不相关的时间信息。将 SEGA 集成到 DP 中，产生自演化扩散策略 (SeedPolicy)，从而解决了时间建模瓶颈，并能够以适中的开销扩展时间范围。在包含 50 个操作任务的 RoboTwin 2.0 基准上，SeedPolicy 优于 DP 和其他 IL 基线。在使用 CNN 和 Transformer 作为主干网络的平均情况下，SeedPolicy 在干净设置下实现了 36.8% 的相对改进，在随机化的挑战性设置下实现了 169% 的相对改进，优于 DP。与具有 12 亿参数的视觉-语言-动作模型（例如 RDT）相比，SeedPolicy 在参数数量减少一到两个数量级的情况下实现了具有竞争力的性能，证明了其强大的效率和可扩展性。这些结果证明了 SeedPolicy 作为长程机器人操作最先进的模仿学习方法。代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/Youqiang-Gui/SeedPolicy。
tldr: The paper introduces SeedPolicy, a Diffusion Policy variant that uses a Self-Evolving Gated Attention mechanism to improve performance in long-horizon robotic manipulation tasks. SeedPolicy achieves state-of-the-art results on the RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark while using significantly fewer parameters than vision-language-action models.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为SeedPolicy的扩散策略变体，该变体使用自演化门控注意力机制来提高长程机器人操作任务的性能。SeedPolicy在RoboTwin 2.0基准测试中取得了最先进的结果，同时使用的参数明显少于视觉-语言-动作模型。

title: Decoupling Task and Behavior: A Two-Stage Reward Curriculum in Reinforcement Learning for Robotics
summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning is a promising tool for robotic control, yet practical application is often hindered by the difficulty of designing effective reward functions. Real-world tasks typically require optimizing multiple objectives simultaneously, necessitating precise tuning of their weights to learn a policy with the desired characteristics. To address this, we propose a two-stage reward curriculum where we decouple task-specific objectives from behavioral terms. In our method, we first train the agent on a simplified task-only reward function to ensure effective exploration before introducing the full reward that includes auxiliary behavior-related terms such as energy efficiency. Further, we analyze various transition strategies and demonstrate that reusing samples between phases is critical for training stability. We validate our approach on the DeepMind Control Suite, ManiSkill3, and a mobile robot environment, modified to include auxiliary behavioral objectives. Our method proves to be simple yet effective, substantially outperforming baselines trained directly on the full reward while exhibiting higher robustness to specific reward weightings.
summary_zh: 深度强化学习是机器人控制领域一种很有前景的工具，然而，实际应用往往受到难以设计有效的奖励函数的阻碍。现实世界的任务通常需要同时优化多个目标，因此需要精确调整它们的权重，才能学习到具有所需特征的策略。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种两阶段奖励课程，在该课程中，我们将特定任务目标与行为项解耦。在我们的方法中，我们首先在简化的仅任务奖励函数上训练智能体，以确保有效的探索，然后再引入包含辅助行为相关项（如能源效率）的完整奖励。此外，我们分析了各种转移策略，并证明在阶段之间重用样本对于训练稳定性至关重要。我们在 DeepMind Control Suite、ManiSkill3 和一个移动机器人环境（修改后包含辅助行为目标）上验证了我们的方法。我们的方法证明了其简单而有效，显著优于直接在完整奖励上训练的基线方法，同时对特定奖励权重的鲁棒性更高。
tldr: This paper introduces a two-stage reward curriculum for robotic reinforcement learning that decouples task-specific objectives from behavioral terms, leading to improved performance and robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于机器人强化学习的两阶段奖励课程，将任务特定目标与行为项分离，从而提高了性能和鲁棒性。

title: SPIRIT: Perceptive Shared Autonomy for Robust Robotic Manipulation under Deep Learning Uncertainty
summary: Deep learning (DL) has enabled impressive advances in robotic perception, yet its limited robustness and lack of interpretability hinder reliable deployment in safety critical applications. We propose a concept termed perceptive shared autonomy, in which uncertainty estimates from DL based perception are used to regulate the level of autonomy. Specifically, when the robot's perception is confident, semi-autonomous manipulation is enabled to improve performance; when uncertainty increases, control transitions to haptic teleoperation for maintaining robustness. In this way, high-performing but uninterpretable DL methods can be integrated safely into robotic systems. A key technical enabler is an uncertainty aware DL based point cloud registration approach based on the so called Neural Tangent Kernels (NTK). We evaluate perceptive shared autonomy on challenging aerial manipulation tasks through a user study of 15 participants and realization of mock-up industrial scenarios, demonstrating reliable robotic manipulation despite failures in DL based perception. The resulting system, named SPIRIT, improves both manipulation performance and system reliability. SPIRIT was selected as a finalist of a major industrial innovation award.
summary_zh: 深度学习(DL)已在机器人感知领域取得了显著进展，但其有限的鲁棒性和缺乏可解释性阻碍了其在安全关键型应用中的可靠部署。我们提出了一种名为感知共享自主的概念，其中来自基于DL的感知的置信度估计被用于调节自主水平。具体来说，当机器人的感知具有高度置信度时，启用半自主操作以提高性能；当置信度降低时，控制过渡到触觉遥操作以保持鲁棒性。通过这种方式，高性能但不可解释的DL方法可以安全地集成到机器人系统中。一个关键的技术推动因素是基于所谓的神经正切核(NTK)的、基于DL的、具有置信度意识的点云配准方法。我们通过一项包含15名参与者的用户研究以及模拟的工业场景，在具有挑战性的空中操作任务中评估了感知共享自主，验证了即使基于DL的感知出现故障，也能实现可靠的机器人操作。由此产生的系统，名为SPIRIT，提高了操作性能和系统可靠性。SPIRIT入围了一项重要的工业创新奖的决赛。
tldr: The paper introduces SPIRIT, a perceptive shared autonomy system that leverages uncertainty estimates from deep learning-based perception to switch between semi-autonomous manipulation and haptic teleoperation, enhancing robustness in robotic manipulation, especially in aerial scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SPIRIT，一种感知共享自主系统，它利用深度学习感知的不确定性估计，在半自主操作和触觉遥操作之间切换，从而增强了机器人操作的鲁棒性，特别是在空中场景中。

title: GaussTwin: Unified Simulation and Correction with Gaussian Splatting for Robotic Digital Twins
summary: Digital twins promise to enhance robotic manipulation by maintaining a consistent link between real-world perception and simulation. However, most existing systems struggle with the lack of a unified model, complex dynamic interactions, and the real-to-sim gap, which limits downstream applications such as model predictive control. Thus, we propose GaussTwin, a real-time digital twin that combines position-based dynamics with discrete Cosserat rod formulations for physically grounded simulation, and Gaussian splatting for efficient rendering and visual correction. By anchoring Gaussians to physical primitives and enforcing coherent SE(3) updates driven by photometric error and segmentation masks, GaussTwin achieves stable prediction-correction while preserving physical fidelity. Through experiments in both simulation and on a Franka Research 3 platform, we show that GaussTwin consistently improves tracking accuracy and robustness compared to shape-matching and rigid-only baselines, while also enabling downstream tasks such as push-based planning. These results highlight GaussTwin as a step toward unified, physically meaningful digital twins that can support closed-loop robotic interaction and learning.
summary_zh: 数字孪生有望通过维持真实世界感知和仿真之间的一致性联系来增强机器人操作。然而，现有的大多数系统都面临着缺乏统一模型、复杂的动态交互以及真实到仿真（real-to-sim）的鸿沟等问题，这些问题限制了诸如模型预测控制之类的下游应用。因此，我们提出了GaussTwin，一种实时数字孪生，它结合了基于位置的动力学和离散Cosserat杆公式用于物理上的仿真，并结合高斯溅射用于高效渲染和视觉校正。通过将高斯分布锚定到物理原语，并强制执行由光度误差和分割掩码驱动的连贯SE(3)更新，GaussTwin实现了稳定的预测-校正，同时保持了物理保真度。通过在仿真和Franka Research 3平台上进行的实验，我们表明，与形状匹配和仅刚体基线相比，GaussTwin始终如一地提高了跟踪精度和鲁棒性，同时还支持了诸如基于推送的规划等下游任务。这些结果表明，GaussTwin是朝着统一的、具有物理意义的数字孪生迈出的一步，它可以支持闭环机器人交互和学习。
tldr: GaussTwin introduces a real-time digital twin system for robotic manipulation using Gaussian splatting and physically grounded simulation to improve tracking accuracy and enable downstream tasks like push-based planning.
tldr_zh: GaussTwin 提出了一个用于机器人操作的实时数字孪生系统，该系统使用高斯溅射和基于物理的仿真，从而提高跟踪精度并实现诸如基于推动的规划等下游任务。

title: Direct Contact-Tolerant Motion Planning With Vision Language Models
summary: Navigation in cluttered environments often requires robots to tolerate contact with movable or deformable objects to maintain efficiency. Existing contact-tolerant motion planning (CTMP) methods rely on indirect spatial representations (e.g., prebuilt map, obstacle set), resulting in inaccuracies and a lack of adaptiveness to environmental uncertainties. To address this issue, we propose a direct contact-tolerant (DCT) planner, which integrates vision-language models (VLMs) into direct point perception and navigation, including two key components. The first one is VLM point cloud partitioner (VPP), which performs contact-tolerance reasoning in image space using VLM, caches inference masks, propagates them across frames using odometry, and projects them onto the current scan to generate a contact-aware point cloud. The second innovation is VPP guided navigation (VGN), which formulates CTMP as a perception-to-control optimization problem under direct contact-aware point cloud constraints, which is further solved by a specialized deep neural network (DNN). We implement DCT in Isaac Sim and a real car-like robot, demonstrating that DCT achieves robust and efficient navigation in cluttered environments with movable obstacles, outperforming representative baselines across diverse metrics. The code is available at: https://github.com/ChrisLeeUM/DCT.
summary_zh: 在杂乱环境中导航通常需要机器人能够容忍与可移动或可变形物体的接触，以保持效率。现有的容许接触运动规划(CTMP)方法依赖于间接的空间表示（例如，预先构建的地图、障碍物集合），导致不准确和缺乏对环境不确定性的适应性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种直接容许接触(DCT)规划器，它将视觉-语言模型(VLM)集成到直接点云感知和导航中，包括两个关键组件。第一个是VLM点云分割器(VPP)，它使用VLM在图像空间中执行容许接触推理，缓存推理掩码，使用里程计在帧之间传播它们，并将它们投影到当前扫描上，以生成一个具有接触感知的点云。第二个创新是VPP引导的导航(VGN)，它将CTMP形式化为一个在直接接触感知点云约束下的感知到控制的优化问题，并通过一个专门的深度神经网络(DNN)进一步求解。我们在Isaac Sim和一个真实的类车机器人上实现了DCT，结果表明，DCT在充满可移动障碍物的杂乱环境中实现了稳健和高效的导航，在各种指标上优于代表性的基线方法。代码可在以下网址获得：https://github.com/ChrisLeeUM/DCT。
tldr: This paper introduces a direct contact-tolerant motion planning (DCT) method that uses Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to navigate cluttered environments by reasoning about contact-tolerance from image space and optimizing navigation based on contact-aware point clouds.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种直接接触容错运动规划（DCT）方法，该方法利用视觉语言模型（VLM）通过推理图像空间中的接触容错来导航拥挤环境，并基于接触感知点云优化导航。

title: VPWEM: Non-Markovian Visuomotor Policy with Working and Episodic Memory
summary: Imitation learning from human demonstrations has achieved significant success in robotic control, yet most visuomotor policies still condition on single-step observations or short-context histories, making them struggle with non-Markovian tasks that require long-term memory. Simply enlarging the context window incurs substantial computational and memory costs and encourages overfitting to spurious correlations, leading to catastrophic failures under distribution shift and violating real-time constraints in robotic systems. By contrast, humans can compress important past experiences into long-term memories and exploit them to solve tasks throughout their lifetime. In this paper, we propose VPWEM, a non-Markovian visuomotor policy equipped with working and episodic memories. VPWEM retains a sliding window of recent observation tokens as short-term working memory, and introduces a Transformer-based contextual memory compressor that recursively converts out-of-window observations into a fixed number of episodic memory tokens. The compressor uses self-attention over a cache of past summary tokens and cross-attention over a cache of historical observations, and is trained jointly with the policy. We instantiate VPWEM on diffusion policies to exploit both short-term and episode-wide information for action generation with nearly constant memory and computation per step. Experiments demonstrate that VPWEM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines including diffusion policies and vision-language-action (VLA) models by more than 20% on the memory-intensive manipulation tasks in MIKASA and achieves an average 5% improvement on the mobile manipulation benchmark MoMaRT. Code is available at https://github.com/HarryLui98/code_vpwem.
summary_zh: 从人类演示中进行模仿学习已在机器人控制领域取得了显著成功，然而，大多数视觉运动策略仍然依赖于单步观测或短上下文历史，这使得它们难以应对需要长期记忆的非马尔可夫任务。简单地扩大上下文窗口会导致大量的计算和内存成本，并容易过度拟合虚假相关性，从而在分布偏移下导致灾难性失败，并且违背机器人系统中的实时约束。相比之下，人类可以将重要的过往经验压缩成长时记忆，并利用这些记忆来解决其一生中的任务。在本文中，我们提出了一种配备工作记忆和情景记忆的非马尔可夫视觉运动策略VPWEM。VPWEM保留了一个滑动窗口，用于存储最近的观测令牌作为短期工作记忆，并引入了一个基于Transformer的上下文记忆压缩器，该压缩器递归地将窗口外的观测转换为固定数量的情景记忆令牌。该压缩器使用对过去摘要令牌缓存的自注意力，以及对历史观测缓存的交叉注意力，并与策略联合训练。我们实例化了基于扩散策略的VPWEM，以利用短期和情景级别的全部信息来生成动作，同时保持近乎恒定的每步内存和计算量。实验表明，VPWEM在MIKASA中对内存密集型操作任务的表现优于包括扩散策略和视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型在内的最先进基线20%以上，并在移动操作基准测试MoMaRT上平均提高了5%。代码可在https://github.com/HarryLui98/code_vpwem 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces VPWEM, a non-Markovian visuomotor policy with working and episodic memory for imitation learning, showing significant improvement on long-horizon manipulation tasks compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了VPWEM，一种具有工作记忆和情景记忆的非马尔可夫视觉运动策略，用于模仿学习，与最先进的基线相比，在长时程操作任务上表现出显著改进。

title: Causally Robust Reward Learning from Reason-Augmented Preference Feedback
summary: Preference-based reward learning is widely used for shaping agent behavior to match a user's preference, yet its sparse binary feedback makes it especially vulnerable to causal confusion. The learned reward often latches onto spurious features that merely co-occur with preferred trajectories during training, collapsing when those correlations disappear or reverse at test time. We introduce ReCouPLe, a lightweight framework that uses natural language rationales to provide the missing causal signal. Each rationale is treated as a guiding projection axis in an embedding space, training the model to score trajectories based on features aligned with that axis while de-emphasizing context that is unrelated to the stated reason. Because the same rationales (e.g., "avoids collisions", "completes the task faster") can appear across multiple tasks, ReCouPLe naturally reuses the same causal direction whenever tasks share semantics, and transfers preference knowledge to novel tasks without extra data or language-model fine-tuning. Our learned reward model can ground preferences on the articulated reason, aligning better with user intent and generalizing beyond spurious features. ReCouPLe outperforms baselines by up to 1.5x in reward accuracy under distribution shifts, and 2x in downstream policy performance in novel tasks. We have released our code at https://github.com/mj-hwang/ReCouPLe
summary_zh: 基于偏好的奖励学习被广泛用于塑造智能体的行为以匹配用户的偏好，但其稀疏的二元反馈使其特别容易受到因果混淆的影响。学习到的奖励往往会锁定在虚假特征上，这些特征仅仅在训练期间与偏好轨迹共同出现，当这些相关性在测试时消失或反转时，奖励就会失效。我们引入了ReCouPLe，一个轻量级框架，利用自然语言理由来提供缺失的因果信号。每个理由都被视为嵌入空间中的一个引导投影轴，训练模型根据与该轴对齐的特征来对轨迹进行评分，同时淡化与所述理由无关的上下文。由于相同的理由（例如，“避免碰撞”，“更快地完成任务”）可以出现在多个任务中，因此ReCouPLe会在任务共享语义时自然地重用相同的因果方向，并将偏好知识转移到新的任务，而无需额外的数据或语言模型的微调。我们学习到的奖励模型可以将偏好建立在明确表达的理由之上，更好地与用户意图对齐，并推广到虚假特征之外。在分布偏移下，ReCouPLe在奖励准确性方面比基线方法高出1.5倍，在新任务中的下游策略性能方面高出2倍。我们已在https://github.com/mj-hwang/ReCouPLe发布了我们的代码。
tldr: The paper introduces ReCouPLe, a framework for causally robust reward learning using natural language rationales to guide preference learning and improve generalization in reinforcement learning tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ReCouPLe，一个利用自然语言推理增强因果鲁棒性奖励学习的框架，通过自然语言推理指导偏好学习，并提升强化学习任务中的泛化能力。

title: Hyperbolic Multiview Pretraining for Robotic Manipulation
summary: 3D-aware visual pretraining has proven effective in improving the performance of downstream robotic manipulation tasks. However, existing methods are constrained to Euclidean embedding spaces, whose flat geometry limits their ability to model structural relations among embeddings. As a result, they struggle to learn structured embeddings that are essential for robust spatial perception in robotic applications. To this end, we propose HyperMVP, a self-supervised framework for \underline{Hyper}bolic \underline{M}ulti\underline{V}iew \underline{P}retraining. Hyperbolic space offers geometric properties well suited for capturing structural relations. Methodologically, we extend the masked autoencoder paradigm and design a GeoLink encoder to learn multiview hyperbolic representations. The pretrained encoder is then finetuned with visuomotor policies on manipulation tasks. In addition, we introduce 3D-MOV, a large-scale dataset comprising multiple types of 3D point clouds to support pretraining. We evaluate HyperMVP on COLOSSEUM, RLBench, and real-world scenarios, where it consistently outperforms strong baselines across diverse tasks and perturbation settings. Our results highlight the potential of 3D-aware pretraining in a non-Euclidean space for learning robust and generalizable robotic manipulation policies.
summary_zh: 3D 感知视觉预训练已被证明能够有效提升下游机器人操作任务的性能。然而，现有方法受限于欧几里得嵌入空间，其扁平几何结构限制了建模嵌入之间结构关系的能力。因此，它们难以学习结构化嵌入，而结构化嵌入对于机器人应用中稳健的空间感知至关重要。为此，我们提出 HyperMVP，一种用于双曲多视图预训练的自监督框架。双曲空间提供了非常适合捕捉结构关系的几何属性。在方法论上，我们扩展了掩码自编码器范式，并设计了一个 GeoLink 编码器来学习多视图双曲表示。然后，使用视觉运动策略在操作任务上对预训练编码器进行微调。此外，我们引入了 3D-MOV，一个包含多种 3D 点云类型的大规模数据集，以支持预训练。我们在 COLOSSEUM、RLBench 和真实世界场景中评估了 HyperMVP，在各种任务和扰动设置下，它始终优于强大的基线方法。我们的结果突出了在非欧几里得空间进行 3D 感知预训练，以学习稳健且可泛化的机器人操作策略的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces HyperMVP, a self-supervised framework for pretraining robotic manipulation policies in hyperbolic space, leveraging a new dataset (3D-MOV) and demonstrating improved performance on various benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了HyperMVP，一个在双曲空间中预训练机器人操作策略的自监督框架，利用了一个新的数据集（3D-MOV），并在多个基准测试中表现出改进的性能。

title: On the Strengths and Weaknesses of Data for Open-set Embodied Assistance
summary: Embodied foundation models are increasingly performant in real-world domains such as robotics or autonomous driving. These models are often deployed in interactive or assistive settings, where it is important that these assistive models generalize to new users and new tasks. Diverse interactive data generation offers a promising avenue for providing data-efficient generalization capabilities for interactive embodied foundation models. In this paper, we investigate the generalization capabilities of a multimodal foundation model fine-tuned on diverse interactive assistance data in a synthetic domain. We explore generalization along two axes: a) assistance with unseen categories of user behavior and b) providing guidance in new configurations not encountered during training. We study a broad capability called \textbf{Open-Set Corrective Assistance}, in which the model needs to inspect lengthy user behavior and provide assistance through either corrective actions or language-based feedback. This task remains unsolved in prior work, which typically assumes closed corrective categories or relies on external planners, making it a challenging testbed for evaluating the limits of assistive data. To support this task, we generate synthetic assistive datasets in Overcooked and fine-tune a LLaMA-based model to evaluate generalization to novel tasks and user behaviors. Our approach provides key insights into the nature of assistive datasets required to enable open-set assistive intelligence. In particular, we show that performant models benefit from datasets that cover different aspects of assistance, including multimodal grounding, defect inference, and exposure to diverse scenarios.
summary_zh: 具身基础模型在机器人或自动驾驶等现实世界领域中的性能日益提升。这些模型通常部署在交互式或辅助性环境中，因此辅助模型能泛化到新的用户和新的任务至关重要。多样化的交互数据生成为交互式具身基础模型提供数据高效的泛化能力提供了一个有前景的途径。在本文中，我们研究了一个在合成领域中基于多样化交互辅助数据微调的多模态基础模型的泛化能力。我们沿着两个维度探索泛化：a) 对未见类别的用户行为的辅助，以及 b) 在训练期间未遇到的新配置中提供指导。我们研究了一种称为\textbf{开放集纠正性辅助}的广泛能力，其中模型需要检查冗长的用户行为，并通过纠正性动作或基于语言的反馈来提供辅助。这项任务在先前的工作中仍未解决，这些工作通常假设封闭的纠正类别或依赖于外部规划器，因此它成为了评估辅助数据限制的一个具有挑战性的试验平台。为了支持这项任务，我们在 Overcooked 中生成合成辅助数据集，并微调一个基于 LLaMA 的模型，以评估其对新任务和用户行为的泛化能力。我们的方法为实现开放集辅助智能所需的辅助数据集的性质提供了关键见解。特别是，我们表明性能优越的模型受益于涵盖辅助不同方面的数据集，包括多模态基础、缺陷推断和暴露于各种场景。
tldr: This paper explores using diverse, interactive data to improve the generalization capabilities of multimodal foundation models for open-set corrective assistance in embodied environments, specifically in a synthetic Overcooked environment using a LLaMA-based model.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了使用多样化、交互式数据来提高多模态基础模型在具身环境中进行开放式纠正辅助的泛化能力，具体来说是在一个合成的 Overcooked 环境中使用基于 LLaMA 的模型。
