title: Diffusion Policy through Conditional Proximal Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has been extensively employed in a wide range of decision-making problems, such as games and robotics. Recently, diffusion policies have shown strong potential in modeling multi-modal behaviors, enabling more diverse and flexible action generation compared to the conventional Gaussian policy. Despite various attempts to combine RL with diffusion, a key challenge is the difficulty of computing action log-likelihood under the diffusion model. This greatly hinders the direct application of diffusion policies in on-policy reinforcement learning. Most existing methods calculate or approximate the log-likelihood through the entire denoising process in the diffusion model, which can be memory- and computationally inefficient. To overcome this challenge, we propose a novel and efficient method to train a diffusion policy in an on-policy setting that requires only evaluating a simple Gaussian probability. This is achieved by aligning the policy iteration with the diffusion process, which is a distinct paradigm compared to previous work. Moreover, our formulation can naturally handle entropy regularization, which is often difficult to incorporate into diffusion policies. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method produces multimodal policy behaviors and achieves superior performance on a variety of benchmark tasks in both IsaacLab and MuJoCo Playground.
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）已被广泛应用于各种决策问题中，如游戏和机器人学。最近，扩散策略在建模多模态行为方面展现出强大的潜力，与传统的 Gaussian 策略相比，能够实现更多样化和灵活的动作生成。尽管已经尝试将强化学习与扩散相结合，但一个关键挑战在于难以计算扩散模型下的动作对数似然。这极大地阻碍了扩散策略在同策略强化学习中的直接应用。现有的大多数方法通过扩散模型中的整个去噪过程来计算或近似对数似然，这可能会导致内存和计算效率低下。为了克服这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖且高效的方法，在同策略设置下训练扩散策略，而只需要评估一个简单的 Gaussian 概率。这通过将策略迭代与扩散过程对齐来实现，这是一种与先前工作截然不同的范式。此外，我们的公式可以自然地处理熵正则化，这通常难以融入到扩散策略中。实验表明，所提出的方法可以产生多模态的策略行为，并在 IsaacLab 和 MuJoCo Playground 中的各种基准任务上实现卓越的性能。
tldr: This paper presents a novel on-policy reinforcement learning method using diffusion policies, addressing the computational inefficiency of log-likelihood calculation through a new alignment strategy requiring only Gaussian probability evaluation. The method handles entropy regularization naturally and demonstrates superior performance on benchmark tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的基于扩散策略的on-policy强化学习方法，通过一种新的对齐策略解决了计算对数似然时的计算效率问题，该策略仅需评估高斯概率。该方法可以自然地处理熵正则化，并在基准任务上表现出卓越的性能。

title: LLM-Guided Decentralized Exploration with Self-Organizing Robot Teams
summary: When individual robots have limited sensing capabilities or insufficient fault tolerance, it becomes necessary for multiple robots to form teams during exploration, thereby increasing the collective observation range and reliability. Traditionally, swarm formation has often been managed by a central controller; however, from the perspectives of robustness and flexibility, it is preferable for the swarm to operate autonomously even in the absence of centralized control. In addition, the determination of exploration targets for each team is crucial for efficient exploration in such multi-team exploration scenarios. This study therefore proposes an exploration method that combines (1) an algorithm for self-organization, enabling the autonomous and dynamic formation of multiple teams, and (2) an algorithm that allows each team to autonomously determine its next exploration target (destination). In particular, for (2), this study explores a novel strategy based on large language models (LLMs), while classical frontier-based methods and deep reinforcement learning approaches have been widely studied. The effectiveness of the proposed method was validated through simulations involving tens to hundreds of robots.
summary_zh: 当单个机器人感知能力有限或容错性不足时，有必要由多个机器人组队进行探索，从而扩大整体观测范围并提高可靠性。传统上，群体队形通常由中央控制器管理；然而，从鲁棒性和灵活性的角度来看，群体最好在没有集中控制的情况下也能自主运行。此外，在这样的多团队探索场景中，确定每个团队的探索目标对于高效探索至关重要。因此，本研究提出了一种结合以下两种算法的探索方法：（1）一种实现自主和动态组建多个团队的自组织算法，以及（2）一种允许每个团队自主确定其下一个探索目标（目的地）的算法。特别地，对于（2），本研究探索了一种基于大型语言模型（LLM）的新策略，而经典的基于边界的方法和深度强化学习方法已被广泛研究。通过涉及数十到数百个机器人的仿真验证了所提出方法的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces a decentralized multi-robot exploration method guided by LLMs for target selection, enabling autonomous team formation and efficient exploration without centralized control.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种由LLM引导的去中心化多机器人探索方法，该方法通过LLM进行目标选择，能够实现自主组队和高效探索，无需中央控制。

title: Design, Mapping, and Contact Anticipation with 3D-printed Whole-Body Tactile and Proximity Sensors
summary: Robots operating in dynamic and shared environments benefit from anticipating contact before it occurs. We present GenTact-Prox, a fully 3D-printed artificial skin that integrates tactile and proximity sensing for contact detection and anticipation. The artificial skin platform is modular in design, procedurally generated to fit any robot morphology, and can cover the whole body of a robot. The skin achieved detection ranges of up to 18 cm during evaluation. To characterize how robots perceive nearby space through this skin, we introduce a data-driven framework for mapping the Perisensory Space -- the body-centric volume of space around the robot where sensors provide actionable information for contact anticipation. We demonstrate this approach on a Franka Research 3 robot equipped with five GenTact-Prox units, enabling online object-aware operation and contact prediction.
summary_zh: 在动态和共享环境中运行的机器人受益于提前预测接触的发生。我们提出GenTact-Prox，一种完全3D打印的人工皮肤，集成了触觉和接近觉传感，用于接触检测和预测。该人工皮肤平台采用模块化设计，可程序化生成以适应任何机器人形态，并可覆盖机器人的整个身体。在评估过程中，该皮肤实现了高达18厘米的检测范围。为了表征机器人如何通过该皮肤感知周围空间，我们引入了一个数据驱动框架，用于映射周身感知空间（Perisensory Space）-- 以机器人为中心的体积空间，其中传感器提供可操作的信息以进行接触预测。我们在一台配备五个GenTact-Prox单元的Franka Research 3机器人上演示了这种方法，实现了在线、对象感知的操作和接触预测。
tldr: This paper introduces GenTact-Prox, a 3D-printed artificial skin with tactile and proximity sensing for whole-body robot coverage, enabling contact anticipation and object-aware operation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍GenTact-Prox，一种具有触觉和接近觉传感功能的3D打印人工皮肤，可覆盖整个机器人身体，从而实现接触预测和目标感知操作。

title: LEGS-POMDP: Language and Gesture-Guided Object Search in Partially Observable Environments
summary: To assist humans in open-world environments, robots must interpret ambiguous instructions to locate desired objects. Foundation model-based approaches excel at multimodal grounding, but they lack a principled mechanism for modeling uncertainty in long-horizon tasks. In contrast, Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) provide a systematic framework for planning under uncertainty but are often limited in supported modalities and rely on restrictive environment assumptions. We introduce LanguagE and Gesture-Guided Object Search in Partially Observable Environments (LEGS-POMDP), a modular POMDP system that integrates language, gesture, and visual observations for open-world object search. Unlike prior work, LEGS-POMDP explicitly models two sources of partial observability: uncertainty over the target object's identity and its spatial location. In simulation, multimodal fusion significantly outperforms unimodal baselines, achieving an average success rate of 89\% across challenging environments and object categories. Finally, we demonstrate the full system on a quadruped mobile manipulator, where real-world experiments qualitatively validate robust multimodal perception and uncertainty reduction under ambiguous instructions.
summary_zh: 为了辅助人类在开放世界环境中工作，机器人必须能够解读含糊的指令以定位期望的目标物体。基于通用模型的方案在多模态信息关联方面表现出色，但缺乏在长时程任务中对不确定性进行建模的有效机制。相比之下，部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDPs）为不确定性下的规划提供了一个系统的框架，但其支持的模态类型通常有限，且依赖于严格的环境假设。我们引入了基于语言和手势引导的部分可观测环境下的物体搜索（LEGS-POMDP），这是一个模块化的POMDP系统，集成了语言、手势和视觉观测，用于开放世界中的物体搜索。与以往工作不同，LEGS-POMDP显式地对两种部分可观测性的来源进行建模：目标物体身份的不确定性和其空间位置的不确定性。在仿真环境中，多模态融合显著优于单模态基线，在具有挑战性的环境和物体类别中，平均成功率达到89%。最后，我们在一个四足移动机械臂上演示了完整的系统，真实世界的实验定性验证了在含糊指令下稳健的多模态感知和不确定性降低。
tldr: The paper introduces LEGS-POMDP, a POMDP-based system that integrates language, gesture, and visual observations for object search in partially observable environments, demonstrating its effectiveness in simulation and on a quadruped robot.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了LEGS-POMDP，一个基于POMDP的系统，集成了语言、手势和视觉观察，用于在部分可观察的环境中进行物体搜索，并在模拟和四足机器人上证明了其有效性。

title: Risk-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Mobile Manipulation
summary: For robots to successfully transition from lab settings to everyday environments, they must begin to reason about the risks associated with their actions and make informed, risk-aware decisions. This is particularly true for robots performing mobile manipulation tasks, which involve both interacting with and navigating within dynamic, unstructured spaces. However, existing whole-body controllers for mobile manipulators typically lack explicit mechanisms for risk-sensitive decision-making under uncertainty. To our knowledge, we are the first to (i) learn risk-aware visuomotor policies for mobile manipulation conditioned on egocentric depth observations with runtime-adjustable risk sensitivity, and (ii) show risk-aware behaviours can be transferred through Imitation Learning (IL) to a visuomotor policy conditioned on egocentric depth observations. Our method achieves this by first training a privileged teacher policy using Distributional Reinforcement Learning (DRL), with a risk-neutral distributional critic. Distortion risk-metrics are then applied to the critic's predicted return distribution to calculate risk-adjusted advantage estimates used in policy updates to achieve a range of risk-aware behaviours. We then distil teacher policies with IL to obtain risk-aware student policies conditioned on egocentric depth observations. We perform extensive evaluations demonstrating that our trained visuomotor policies exhibit risk-aware behaviour (specifically achieving better worst-case performance) while performing reactive whole-body motions in unmapped environments, leveraging live depth observations for perception.
summary_zh: 为了使机器人能够成功地从实验室环境过渡到日常环境，它们必须开始推理其行动相关的风险，并做出知情的、具有风险意识的决策。对于执行移动操作任务的机器人来说尤其如此，这些任务既涉及与动态、非结构化空间交互，又涉及在其中导航。然而，现有的移动操作器全身控制器通常缺乏在不确定性下进行风险敏感决策的显式机制。据我们所知，我们是第一个 (i) 学习基于以自我为中心的深度观测，并具有运行时可调的风险敏感性的移动操作风险感知视觉运动策略的，以及 (ii) 展示风险感知行为可以通过模仿学习 (IL) 迁移到基于以自我为中心的深度观测的视觉运动策略的。我们的方法首先使用具有风险中性的分布评论家的分布强化学习 (DRL) 训练一个特权教师策略。然后，将失真风险度量应用于评论家预测的回报分布，以计算风险调整优势估计，用于策略更新，从而实现一系列风险感知行为。接下来，我们通过模仿学习将教师策略提炼，以获得基于以自我为中心的深度观测的风险感知学生策略。我们进行了广泛的评估，证明我们训练的视觉运动策略展现出风险感知行为（特别是实现了更好的最坏情况性能），同时在未映射环境中执行反应式全身运动，利用实时深度观测进行感知。
tldr: This paper introduces a risk-aware reinforcement learning method for mobile manipulation, using distributional RL and imitation learning to train visuomotor policies that perform well in unmapped environments, especially in worst-case scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于移动操作的风险感知强化学习方法，使用分布强化学习和模仿学习来训练视觉运动策略，该策略在未映射的环境中表现良好，尤其是在最坏情况下。

title: From Local Corrections to Generalized Skills: Improving Neuro-Symbolic Policies with MEMO
summary: Recent works use a neuro-symbolic framework for general manipulation policies. The advantage of this framework is that -- by applying off-the-shelf vision and language models -- the robot can break complex tasks down into semantic subtasks. However, the fundamental bottleneck is that the robot needs skills to ground these subtasks into embodied motions. Skills can take many forms (e.g., trajectory snippets, motion primitives, coded functions), but regardless of their form skills act as a constraint. The high-level policy can only ground its language reasoning through the available skills; if the robot cannot generate the right skill for the current task, its policy will fail. We propose to address this limitation -- and dynamically expand the robot's skills -- by leveraging user feedback. When a robot fails, humans can intuitively explain what went wrong (e.g., ``no, go higher''). While a simple approach is to recall this exact text the next time the robot faces a similar situation, we hypothesize that by collecting, clustering, and re-phrasing natural language corrections across multiple users and tasks, we can synthesize more general text guidance and coded skill templates. Applying this hypothesis we develop Memory Enhanced Manipulation (MEMO). MEMO builds and maintains a retrieval-augmented skillbook gathered from human feedback and task successes. At run time, MEMO retrieves relevant text and code from this skillbook, enabling the robot's policy to generate new skills while reasoning over multi-task human feedback. Our experiments demonstrate that using MEMO to aggregate local feedback into general skill templates enables generalization to novel tasks where existing baselines fall short. See supplemental material here: https://collab.me.vt.edu/memo
summary_zh: 近期工作采用神经符号框架来实现通用操作策略。该框架的优势在于——通过应用现成的视觉和语言模型——机器人可以将复杂任务分解为语义子任务。然而，根本瓶颈在于机器人需要技能来将这些子任务转化为具身运动。技能可以采取多种形式（例如，轨迹片段、运动原语、编码函数），但无论其形式如何，技能都作为一种约束。高层策略只能通过现有技能来实现其语言推理；如果机器人无法为当前任务生成正确的技能，其策略将失败。我们提出通过利用用户反馈来解决此限制——并动态扩展机器人的技能。当机器人失败时，人类可以直观地解释出错的原因（例如，“不，再高一点”）。虽然一种简单的方法是在下次机器人遇到类似情况时回忆起这段确切的文本，但我们假设，通过收集、聚类和改写多个用户和任务的自然语言更正，我们可以合成更通用的文本指导和编码技能模板。应用这一假设，我们开发了记忆增强操作(MEMO)。MEMO构建并维护一个从人类反馈和任务成功中收集的检索增强技能书。在运行时，MEMO从该技能书中检索相关的文本和代码，使得机器人的策略能够在推理多任务人类反馈的同时生成新的技能。我们的实验表明，使用MEMO将局部反馈聚合到通用技能模板中能够推广到现有基线方法无法胜任的新任务。 请参见辅助材料：https://collab.me.vt.edu/memo
tldr: The paper introduces MEMO, a neuro-symbolic framework that leverages human feedback to dynamically expand robot skills by collecting, clustering, and re-phrasing natural language corrections to synthesize generalized skill templates, enabling better generalization to novel manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MEMO，一种神经符号框架，通过收集、聚类和改述自然语言修正，利用人类反馈动态扩展机器人技能，合成通用技能模板，从而更好地泛化到新的操作任务。

title: ManipulationNet: An Infrastructure for Benchmarking Real-World Robot Manipulation with Physical Skill Challenges and Embodied Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Dexterous manipulation enables robots to purposefully alter the physical world, transforming them from passive observers into active agents in unstructured environments. This capability is the cornerstone of physical artificial intelligence. Despite decades of advances in hardware, perception, control, and learning, progress toward general manipulation systems remains fragmented due to the absence of widely adopted standard benchmarks. The central challenge lies in reconciling the variability of the real world with the reproducibility and authenticity required for rigorous scientific evaluation. To address this, we introduce ManipulationNet, a global infrastructure that hosts real-world benchmark tasks for robotic manipulation. ManipulationNet delivers reproducible task setups through standardized hardware kits, and enables distributed performance evaluation via a unified software client that delivers real-time task instructions and collects benchmarking results. As a persistent and scalable infrastructure, ManipulationNet organizes benchmark tasks into two complementary tracks: 1) the Physical Skills Track, which evaluates low-level physical interaction skills, and 2) the Embodied Reasoning Track, which tests high-level reasoning and multimodal grounding abilities. This design fosters the systematic growth of an interconnected network of real-world abilities and skills, paving the path toward general robotic manipulation. By enabling comparable manipulation research in the real world at scale, this infrastructure establishes a sustainable foundation for measuring long-term scientific progress and identifying capabilities ready for real-world deployment.
summary_zh: 灵巧操作使机器人能够有目的地改变物理世界，将其从被动观察者转变为非结构化环境中的主动代理，而这正是物理人工智能的基石。尽管在硬件、感知、控制和学习方面取得了数十年的进步，但由于缺乏广泛采用的标准基准，通用操作系统的进展仍然分散。核心挑战在于如何将现实世界的变异性与严格科学评估所需的重现性和真实性相协调。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了ManipulationNet，一个托管机器人操作的真实世界基准任务的全球基础设施。ManipulationNet通过标准化的硬件套件提供可重复的任务设置，并通过统一的软件客户端实现分布式性能评估，该客户端提供实时的任务指令并收集基准测试结果。作为一个持久且可扩展的基础设施，ManipulationNet将基准任务组织成两个互补的轨道：1) 物理技能轨道，评估低级别的物理交互技能；2) 具身推理轨道，测试高级别的推理和多模态语境能力。这种设计促进了一个相互关联的真实世界能力和技能网络的系统性增长，为通用机器人操作铺平了道路。通过实现大规模的真实世界可比操作研究，该基础设施为衡量长期科学进展并识别适合真实世界部署的能力奠定了可持续的基础。
tldr: The paper introduces ManipulationNet, a standardized real-world robotics manipulation benchmark with two tracks: Physical Skills and Embodied Reasoning, aiming to foster comparable research and measure long-term progress in the field.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了ManipulationNet，一个标准化的真实机器人操作基准，包含物理技能和具身推理两个方向，旨在促进可比较的研究，并衡量该领域的长期进展。

title: Tendon Force Modeling for Sim2Real Transfer of Reinforcement Learning Policies for Tendon-Driven Robots
summary: Robots which make use of soft or compliant inter- actions often leverage tendon-driven actuation which enables actuators to be placed more flexibly, and compliance to be maintained. However, controlling complex tendon systems is challenging. Simulation paired with reinforcement learning (RL) could be enable more complex behaviors to be generated. Such methods rely on torque and force-based simulation roll- outs which are limited by the sim-to-real gap, stemming from the actuator and system dynamics, resulting in poor transfer of RL policies onto real robots. To address this, we propose a method to model the tendon forces produced by typical servo motors, focusing specifically on the transfer of RL policies for a tendon driven finger. Our approach extends existing data- driven techniques by leveraging contextual history and a novel data collection test-bench. This test-bench allows us to capture tendon forces undergo contact-rich interactions typical of real- world manipulation. We then utilize our force estimation model in a GPU-accelerated tendon force-driven rigid body simulation to train RL-based controllers. Our transformer-based model is capable of predicting tendon forces within 3% of the maximum motor force and is robot-agnostic. By integrating our learned model into simulation, we reduce the sim-to-real gap for test trajectories by 41%. RL-based controller trained with our model achieves a 50% improvement in fingertip pose tracking tasks on real tendon-driven robotic fingers. This approach is generalizable to different actuators and robot systems, and can enable RL policies to be used widely across tendon systems, advancing capabilities of dexterous manipulators and soft robots.
summary_zh: 利用柔性或顺应交互的机器人通常采用腱驱动方式，这使得驱动器可以更灵活地放置并保持顺应性。然而，控制复杂的腱系统具有挑战性。与强化学习（RL）相结合的仿真可以生成更复杂的行为。这类方法依赖于基于扭矩和力的仿真推演，但受限于仿真到真实（sim-to-real）的差距，该差距源于驱动器和系统动力学，导致RL策略在真实机器人上的迁移效果不佳。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种方法来模拟典型伺服电机产生的腱力，特别关注腱驱动手指的RL策略迁移。我们的方法通过利用上下文历史信息和一种新颖的数据采集测试平台来扩展现有的数据驱动技术。该测试平台使我们能够捕获经历富含接触的交互的腱力，这在真实世界的操纵中很常见。然后，我们利用力估计模型在GPU加速的腱力驱动刚体仿真中训练基于RL的控制器。我们的基于Transformer的模型能够预测最大电机力3%范围内的腱力，并且与机器人无关。通过将我们学习的模型集成到仿真中，我们将测试轨迹的仿真到真实差距减少了41%。使用我们的模型训练的基于RL的控制器在真实腱驱动机器人手指上，于指尖姿态跟踪任务中实现了50%的改进。这种方法可以推广到不同的驱动器和机器人系统，并能够使RL策略广泛应用于腱系统，从而提高灵巧机械臂和软体机器人的能力。
tldr: This paper presents a method to model tendon forces for improved sim-to-real transfer of RL policies in tendon-driven robots, achieving significant performance gains in real-world tasks. It leverages a transformer-based model for force prediction and a data-driven method in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种建模肌腱力的方法，以改善肌腱驱动机器人中强化学习策略的模拟到真实的迁移，并在现实世界任务中实现了显著的性能提升。 它利用基于 Transformer 的模型进行力预测，并在模拟中使用数据驱动的方法。

title: STRUCTUREDAGENT: Planning with AND/OR Trees for Long-Horizon Web Tasks
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agentic systems for sequential decision-making. Such agents must perceive their environment, reason across multiple time steps, and take actions that optimize long-term objectives. However, existing web agents struggle on complex, long-horizon tasks due to limited in-context memory for tracking history, weak planning abilities, and greedy behaviors that lead to premature termination. To address these challenges, we propose STRUCTUREDAGENT, a hierarchical planning framework with two core components: (1) an online hierarchical planner that uses dynamic AND/OR trees for efficient search and (2) a structured memory module that tracks and maintains candidate solutions to improve constraint satisfaction in information-seeking tasks. The framework also produces interpretable hierarchical plans, enabling easier debugging and facilitating human intervention when needed. Our results on WebVoyager, WebArena, and custom shopping benchmarks show that STRUCTUREDAGENT improves performance on long-horizon web-browsing tasks compared to standard LLM-based agents.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展推动了用于序列决策的主体系统的发展。此类主体必须感知其环境，在多个时间步长上进行推理，并采取行动以优化长期目标。然而，现有的Web主体在复杂、长时程任务中表现不佳，原因在于其有限的上下文记忆用于追踪历史、较弱的规划能力以及导致过早终止的贪婪行为。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了STRUCTUREDAGENT，一个分层规划框架，包含两个核心组件：（1）一个在线分层规划器，利用动态与/或树进行高效搜索，以及（2）一个结构化记忆模块，用于跟踪和维护候选解决方案，从而提高信息搜索任务中的约束满足度。该框架还生成可解释的分层计划，简化调试并促进必要时的人工干预。我们在WebVoyager、WebArena和自定义购物基准测试上的结果表明，与标准的基于LLM的主体相比，STRUCTUREDAGENT提高了长时程Web浏览任务的性能。
tldr: STRUCTUREDAGENT is a hierarchical planning framework using AND/OR trees and structured memory to improve LLM-based web agents on long-horizon tasks, demonstrating better performance on web-browsing benchmarks.
tldr_zh: STRUCTUREDAGENT是一个分层规划框架，使用AND/OR树和结构化内存来改进基于LLM的Web代理在长时程任务上的表现，并在Web浏览基准测试中显示出更好的性能。

title: KARL: Knowledge Agents via Reinforcement Learning
summary: We present a system for training enterprise search agents via reinforcement learning that achieves state-of-the-art performance across a diverse suite of hard-to-verify agentic search tasks. Our work makes four core contributions. First, we introduce KARLBench, a multi-capability evaluation suite spanning six distinct search regimes, including constraint-driven entity search, cross-document report synthesis, tabular numerical reasoning, exhaustive entity retrieval, procedural reasoning over technical documentation, and fact aggregation over internal enterprise notes. Second, we show that models trained across heterogeneous search behaviors generalize substantially better than those optimized for any single benchmark. Third, we develop an agentic synthesis pipeline that employs long-horizon reasoning and tool use to generate diverse, grounded, and high-quality training data, with iterative bootstrapping from increasingly capable models. Fourth, we propose a new post-training paradigm based on iterative large-batch off-policy RL that is sample efficient, robust to train-inference engine discrepancies, and naturally extends to multi-task training with out-of-distribution generalization. Compared to Claude 4.6 and GPT 5.2, KARL is Pareto-optimal on KARLBench across cost-quality and latency-quality trade-offs, including tasks that were out-of-distribution during training. With sufficient test-time compute, it surpasses the strongest closed models. These results show that tailored synthetic data in combination with multi-task reinforcement learning enables cost-efficient and high-performing knowledge agents for grounded reasoning.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种通过强化学习训练企业搜索代理的系统，该系统在一套多样化的、难以验证的代理搜索任务中实现了最先进的性能。我们的工作主要有四个方面的贡献。首先，我们引入了KARLBench，一个多功能评估套件，涵盖六个不同的搜索模式，包括约束驱动的实体搜索、跨文档报告合成、表格数值推理、穷举式实体检索、技术文档上的程序推理以及对内部企业注释的事实聚合。其次，我们表明，在异构搜索行为上训练的模型比针对任何单一基准优化过的模型具有更好的泛化能力。第三，我们开发了一个代理合成流水线，该流水线采用长程推理和工具使用来生成多样化、有依据且高质量的训练数据，并通过能力越来越强的模型进行迭代引导。第四，我们提出了一种新的后训练范例，该范例基于迭代的大批量离策略强化学习，该方法具有样本效率高、对训练-推理引擎差异的鲁棒性好，并且自然地扩展到具有分布外泛化的多任务训练。与Claude 4.6和GPT 5.2相比，KARL在KARLBench上实现了帕累托最优，在成本-质量和延迟-质量的权衡中表现出色，包括训练期间属于分布外的任务。在有足够的测试时计算资源的情况下，它可以超越最强大的封闭模型。这些结果表明，定制的合成数据与多任务强化学习相结合，可以为基于知识的推理提供经济高效且高性能的知识代理。
tldr: The paper introduces KARL, a reinforcement learning system for training enterprise search agents, achieving state-of-the-art performance on a new benchmark (KARLBench) and demonstrating strong generalization capabilities through tailored synthetic data and multi-task RL.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 KARL，一个用于训练企业搜索代理的强化学习系统，在新的基准测试 (KARLBench) 上实现了最先进的性能，并通过定制的合成数据和多任务 RL 展示了强大的泛化能力。

title: WebFactory: Automated Compression of Foundational Language Intelligence into Grounded Web Agents
summary: Current paradigms for training GUI agents are fundamentally limited by a reliance on either unsafe, non-reproducible live web interactions or costly, scarce human-crafted data and environments. We argue this focus on data volume overlooks a more critical factor: the efficiency of compressing a large language model's (LLM) latent knowledge into actionable agent behavior. We introduce WebFactory, a novel, fully automated closed-loop reinforcement learning pipeline for GUI agents, systematically compressing LLM-encoded internet intelligence into efficient, grounded actions. Our pipeline features a process of scalable environment synthesis, knowledge-aware task generation, LLM-powered trajectory collection, decomposed reward RL training, and systematic agent evaluation. Remarkably, our agent demonstrates exceptional data efficiency and generalization. Trained on synthetic data from only 10 websites within WebFactory, it achieves performance comparable to GUI agents trained on the same amount of human-annotated data from a much larger set of environments. This superior performance is consistent across our internal offline and online transfer benchmarks, where our agent also significantly outperforms the base foundation model. We further provide critical insights into the "embodiment potential" of different LLM foundations, offering a new axis for model evaluation. This work presents a scalable and cost-effective paradigm for transforming passive internet knowledge into active, grounded intelligence, marking a critical step towards general-purpose interactive agents.
summary_zh: 目前GUI代理的训练范式从根本上受到依赖不安全、不可复现的实时网络交互或代价高昂、稀缺的人工数据和环境的限制。我们认为，这种对数据量的关注忽略了一个更关键的因素：将大型语言模型（LLM）的潜在知识压缩为可操作的代理行为的效率。我们引入了WebFactory，一种新颖的、完全自动化的闭环强化学习流水线，用于GUI代理，该流水线系统地将LLM编码的互联网智能压缩为高效、基于上下文的行为。我们的流水线包含可扩展的环境合成、知识感知的任务生成、LLM驱动的轨迹收集、分解式奖励的强化学习训练以及系统性的代理评估流程。值得注意的是，我们的代理展现出了卓越的数据效率和泛化能力。仅使用WebFactory中来自10个网站的合成数据进行训练，即可达到与使用来自更大集合环境的相同数量的人工标注数据训练的GUI代理相当的性能。这种卓越的性能在我们内部的离线和在线迁移基准测试中是一致的，在这些测试中，我们的代理也显著优于基础模型。我们进一步提供了关于不同LLM基础模型的“具身潜力”的关键见解，为模型评估提供了一个新的维度。这项工作提出了一种可扩展且经济高效的范式，将被动互联网知识转化为主动、基于上下文的智能，标志着朝着通用交互式代理迈出了关键一步。
tldr: The paper introduces WebFactory, an automated reinforcement learning pipeline that efficiently compresses LLM knowledge into grounded web agent actions, achieving comparable performance to human-annotated data with significantly less training data and highlighting a new axis for LLM evaluation: embodiment potential.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 WebFactory，一个自动强化学习流程，有效地将 LLM 知识压缩为基于 Web agent 的行动，以远少于人工标注数据训练的数据量实现了与人工标注数据相当的性能，并强调了一个 LLM 评估的新维度：具身潜力。

title: 3D-RFT: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Video-based 3D Scene Understanding
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards ( RLVR ) has emerged as a transformative paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models ( LLMs), yet its potential in 3D scene understanding remains under-explored. Existing approaches largely rely on Supervised Fine-Tuning ( SFT), where the token-level cross-entropy loss acts as an indirect proxy for optimization, leading to a misalignment between training objectives and task performances. To bridge this gap, we present Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Video-based 3D Scene Understanding (3D-RFT ), the first framework to extend RLVR to video-based 3D perception and reasoning. 3D-RFT shifts the paradigm by directly optimizing the model towards evaluation metrics. 3D-RFT first activates 3D-aware Multi-modal Large Language Models ( MLLM s) via SFT, followed by reinforcement fine-tuning using Group Relative Policy Optimization ( GRPO) with strictly verifiable reward functions. We design task-specific reward functions directly from metrics like 3D IoU and F1-Score to provide more effective signals to guide model training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that 3D-RFT-4B achieves state-of-the-art performance on various video-based 3D scene understanding tasks. Notably, 3D-RFT-4B significantly outperforms larger models (e.g., VG LLM-8B) on 3D video detection, 3D visual grounding, and spatial reasoning benchmarks. We further reveal good properties of 3D-RFT such as robust efficacy, and valuable insights into training strategies and data impact. We hope 3D-RFT can serve as a robust and promising paradigm for future development of 3D scene understanding.
summary_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已经成为一种变革性的范例，旨在增强大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，但其在3D场景理解中的潜力仍未得到充分探索。现有方法主要依赖于监督微调（SFT），其中token级别的交叉熵损失充当优化的间接代理，导致训练目标与任务性能之间的不匹配。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了基于视频的3D场景理解的强化微调（3D-RFT），这是第一个将RLVR扩展到基于视频的3D感知和推理的框架。3D-RFT通过直接针对评估指标优化模型来转变范例。3D-RFT首先通过SFT激活3D感知的多模态大型语言模型（MLLM），然后使用具有严格可验证奖励函数的组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行强化微调。我们从诸如3D IoU和F1-Score等指标中直接设计任务特定的奖励函数，以提供更有效的信号来指导模型训练。大量实验表明，3D-RFT-4B在各种基于视频的3D场景理解任务上实现了最先进的性能。值得注意的是，3D-RFT-4B在3D视频检测、3D视觉定位和空间推理基准测试中显著优于更大的模型（例如，VG LLM-8B）。我们进一步揭示了3D-RFT的良好特性，例如强大的功效，以及对训练策略和数据影响的宝贵见解。我们希望3D-RFT能够成为未来3D场景理解发展的一个稳健且有前景的范例。
tldr: The paper introduces 3D-RFT, a novel framework that extends Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to video-based 3D scene understanding, achieving state-of-the-art performance by directly optimizing for evaluation metrics using reinforcement fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 3D-RFT，一种新颖的框架，将具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）扩展到基于视频的 3D 场景理解，通过使用强化微调直接针对评估指标进行优化，实现了最先进的性能。

title: TimeWarp: Evaluating Web Agents by Revisiting the Past
summary: The improvement of web agents on current benchmarks raises the question: Do today's agents perform just as well when the web changes? We introduce TimeWarp, a benchmark that emulates the evolving web using containerized environments that vary in UI, design, and layout. TimeWarp consists of three web environments, each with six UI versions spanning different eras of the internet, paired with a set of complex, realistic tasks requiring different forms of web navigation. Our experiments reveal web agents' vulnerability to changes and the limitations of behavior cloning (BC) on single-version trajectories. To address this, we propose TimeTraj, a simple yet effective algorithm that uses plan distillation to collect trajectories across multiple versions. By training agents on teacher rollouts using our BC-variant, we achieve substantial performance gains: $20.4\%\rightarrow37.7\%$ for Qwen-3 4B and $0\%\rightarrow27.0\%$ for Llama-3.1 8B models. We hope our work helps researchers study generalization across web designs and unlock a new paradigm for collecting plans rather than trajectories, thereby improving the robustness of web agents.
summary_zh: 目前网页代理在基准测试上的性能提升引发了一个问题：当网页发生变化时，现在的代理表现是否依旧出色？我们引入了 TimeWarp，一个使用容器化环境模拟不断演进的网页的基准测试，这些环境在用户界面、设计和布局上各不相同。TimeWarp 包含三个网页环境，每个环境有六个用户界面版本，跨越互联网的不同时代，并配有一系列需要不同形式网页导航的复杂、真实的任务。我们的实验揭示了网页代理对变化的脆弱性，以及在单版本轨迹上行为克隆（BC）的局限性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 TimeTraj，一种简单而有效的算法，它使用计划蒸馏来收集跨多个版本的轨迹。通过使用我们的 BC 变体在教师展开上训练代理，我们取得了显著的性能提升：Qwen-3 4B 模型从 $20.4\%$ 提升到 $37.7\%$，Llama-3.1 8B 模型从 $0\%$ 提升到 $27.0\%$。我们希望我们的工作能够帮助研究人员研究跨网页设计的泛化能力，并开启一种新的范式，即收集计划而非轨迹，从而提高网页代理的鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces TimeWarp, a benchmark to evaluate web agents' robustness to UI changes over time, and proposes TimeTraj, an algorithm to improve generalization by training on trajectories collected across multiple web versions, demonstrably improving performance on specific models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 TimeWarp，一个用于评估 Web 代理对随时间变化的 UI 变化的鲁棒性的基准测试，并提出了 TimeTraj 算法，通过训练在多个 Web 版本中收集的轨迹来提高泛化能力，从而显著提高了特定模型的性能。

title: BandPO: Bridging Trust Regions and Ratio Clipping via Probability-Aware Bounds for LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Proximal constraints are fundamental to the stability of the Large Language Model reinforcement learning. While the canonical clipping mechanism in PPO serves as an efficient surrogate for trust regions, we identify a critical bottleneck: fixed bounds strictly constrain the upward update margin of low-probability actions, disproportionately suppressing high-advantage tail strategies and inducing rapid entropy collapse. To address this, we introduce Band-constrained Policy Optimization (BandPO). BandPO replaces canonical clipping with Band, a unified theoretical operator that projects trust regions defined by f-divergences into dynamic, probability-aware clipping intervals. Theoretical analysis confirms that Band effectively resolves this exploration bottleneck. We formulate this mapping as a convex optimization problem, guaranteeing a globally optimal numerical solution while deriving closed-form solutions for specific divergences. Extensive experiments across diverse models and datasets demonstrate that BandPO consistently outperforms canonical clipping and Clip-Higher, while robustly mitigating entropy collapse.
summary_zh: 近端约束对于大型语言模型强化学习的稳定性至关重要。虽然PPO中经典的裁剪机制可以作为信任区域的有效替代，但我们发现了一个关键瓶颈：固定的边界严格地约束了低概率动作的向上更新幅度，不成比例地抑制了高优势尾部策略，并导致快速的熵崩溃。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了带约束策略优化（BandPO）。BandPO用带（Band）替换了经典裁剪，带是一种统一的理论算子，可以将由f-散度定义的信任区域投影到动态的、概率感知的裁剪区间中。理论分析证实，带有效地解决了这个探索瓶颈。我们将此映射公式化为一个凸优化问题，保证了全局最优的数值解，同时推导出了特定散度的闭式解。在各种模型和数据集上的大量实验表明，BandPO始终优于经典裁剪和Clip-Higher，同时稳健地缓解了熵崩溃。
tldr: BandPO introduces a probability-aware clipping mechanism to address the entropy collapse issue in PPO for LLM reinforcement learning, outperforming canonical clipping methods.
tldr_zh: BandPO提出了一种概率感知剪切机制，旨在解决LLM强化学习中PPO的熵崩溃问题，并且性能优于标准的剪切方法。

title: K-Gen: A Multimodal Language-Conditioned Approach for Interpretable Keypoint-Guided Trajectory Generation
summary: Generating realistic and diverse trajectories is a critical challenge in autonomous driving simulation. While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise, existing methods often rely on structured data like vectorized maps, which fail to capture the rich, unstructured visual context of a scene. To address this, we propose K-Gen, an interpretable keypoint-guided multimodal framework that leverages Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to unify rasterized BEV map inputs with textual scene descriptions. Instead of directly predicting full trajectories, K-Gen generates interpretable keypoints along with reasoning that reflects agent intentions, which are subsequently refined into accurate trajectories by a refinement module. To further enhance keypoint generation, we apply T-DAPO, a trajectory-aware reinforcement fine-tuning algorithm. Experiments on WOMD and nuPlan demonstrate that K-Gen outperforms existing baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of combining multimodal reasoning with keypoint-guided trajectory generation.
summary_zh: 在自动驾驶仿真中，生成逼真且多样的轨迹是一个关键挑战。虽然大型语言模型（LLMs）展现出潜力，但现有方法通常依赖于向量化地图等结构化数据，无法捕捉场景中丰富的、非结构化的视觉上下文。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了K-Gen，一个可解释的关键点引导的多模态框架，利用多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）将栅格化的BEV地图输入与文本场景描述相结合。K-Gen并非直接预测完整轨迹，而是生成可解释的关键点及其反映智能体意图的推理过程，随后通过一个精细化模块将这些关键点细化为精确的轨迹。为了进一步提升关键点的生成质量，我们应用了一种轨迹感知强化微调算法T-DAPO。在WOMD和nuPlan上的实验表明，K-Gen优于现有基线，突显了将多模态推理与关键点引导的轨迹生成相结合的有效性。
tldr: K-Gen is a multimodal LLM framework that generates interpretable keypoints and reasoning for trajectory generation, outperforming existing methods on autonomous driving datasets.
tldr_zh: K-Gen是一个多模态LLM框架，它生成可解释的关键点和推理，用于轨迹生成，并在自动驾驶数据集上优于现有方法。

title: Breaking Contextual Inertia: Reinforcement Learning with Single-Turn Anchors for Stable Multi-Turn Interaction
summary: While LLMs demonstrate strong reasoning capabilities when provided with full information in a single turn, they exhibit substantial vulnerability in multi-turn interactions. Specifically, when information is revealed incrementally or requires updates, models frequently fail to integrate new constraints, leading to a collapse in performance compared to their single-turn baselines. We term the root cause as \emph{Contextual Inertia}: a phenomenon where models rigidly adhere to previous reasoning traces. Even when users explicitly provide corrections or new data in later turns, the model ignores them, preferring to maintain consistency with its previous (incorrect) reasoning path. To address this, we introduce \textbf{R}einforcement \textbf{L}earning with \textbf{S}ingle-\textbf{T}urn \textbf{A}nchors (\textbf{RLSTA}), a generalizable training approach designed to stabilize multi-turn interaction across diverse scenarios and domains. RLSTA leverages the model's superior single-turn capabilities as stable internal anchors to provide reward signals. By aligning multi-turn responses with these anchors, RLSTA empowers models to break contextual inertia and self-calibrate their reasoning based on the latest information. Experiments show that RLSTA significantly outperforms standard fine-tuning and abstention-based methods. Notably, our method exhibits strong cross-domain generalization (e.g., math to code) and proves effective even without external verifiers, highlighting its potential for general-domain applications.
summary_zh: 虽然大型语言模型在单轮交互中提供完整信息时表现出强大的推理能力，但它们在多轮交互中表现出显著的脆弱性。具体而言，当信息以增量方式揭示或需要更新时，模型经常无法整合新的约束条件，导致性能相比单轮基线崩塌。我们将根本原因称为\emph{上下文惰性}：一种模型僵化地坚持先前推理轨迹的现象。即使在之后的轮次中用户明确提供更正或新数据，模型也会忽略这些信息，转而保持与其先前（不正确的）推理路径的一致性。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了\textbf{基}于\textbf{单}轮\textbf{锚点}的\textbf{强}化\textbf{学}习（\textbf{RLSTA}），这是一种通用化的训练方法，旨在稳定跨不同场景和领域的多轮交互。RLSTA利用模型优秀的单轮能力作为稳定的内部锚点来提供奖励信号。通过将多轮响应与这些锚点对齐，RLSTA使模型能够消除上下文惰性，并基于最新信息进行自我校准推理。实验表明，RLSTA显著优于标准的微调和基于弃权的方法。值得注意的是，我们的方法表现出很强的跨领域泛化能力（例如，数学到代码），并且即使没有外部验证器也能证明其有效性，突显了其在通用领域应用中的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces Reinforcement Learning with Single-Turn Anchors (RLSTA) to address the problem of 'contextual inertia' in LLMs during multi-turn interactions, improving their ability to integrate new information and self-calibrate reasoning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了使用单轮锚点的强化学习 (RLSTA) 方法，旨在解决LLM在多轮交互中存在的“上下文惯性”问题，提升模型整合新信息和自我校准推理的能力。

title: Are Multimodal LLMs Ready for Surveillance? A Reality Check on Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection in the Wild
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive general competence in video understanding, yet their reliability for real-world Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) remains largely unexplored. Unlike conventional pipelines relying on reconstruction or pose-based cues, MLLMs enable a paradigm shift: treating anomaly detection as a language-guided reasoning task. In this work, we systematically evaluate state-of-the-art MLLMs on the ShanghaiTech and CHAD benchmarks by reformulating VAD as a binary classification task under weak temporal supervision. We investigate how prompt specificity and temporal window lengths (1s--3s) influence performance, focusing on the precision--recall trade-off. Our findings reveal a pronounced conservative bias in zero-shot settings; while models exhibit high confidence, they disproportionately favor the 'normal' class, resulting in high precision but a recall collapse that limits practical utility. We demonstrate that class-specific instructions can significantly shift this decision boundary, improving the peak F1-score on ShanghaiTech from 0.09 to 0.64, yet recall remains a critical bottleneck. These results highlight a significant performance gap for MLLMs in noisy environments and provide a foundation for future work in recall-oriented prompting and model calibration for open-world surveillance, which demands complex video understanding and reasoning.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型(MLLMs)在视频理解方面展现了令人印象深刻的通用能力，但它们在现实世界视频异常检测(VAD)中的可靠性在很大程度上仍未被探索。与依赖于重构或基于姿态的线索的传统流程不同，MLLMs实现了一种范式转变：将异常检测视为一种语言引导的推理任务。 在这项工作中，我们通过在弱时间监督下将VAD重新定义为二元分类任务，从而系统地评估了最先进的MLLMs在ShanghaiTech和CHAD基准上的表现。我们研究了提示词的具体性和时间窗口长度(1秒-3秒)如何影响性能，重点关注精确率-召回率的权衡。我们的发现揭示了零样本设置中存在显著的保守偏见；虽然模型表现出很高的置信度，但它们不成比例地倾向于“正常”类别，导致高精确率但召回率崩溃，从而限制了实际应用。我们证明了特定类别的指令可以显著改变这个决策边界，将ShanghaiTech上的峰值F1分数从0.09提高到0.64，但召回率仍然是一个关键瓶颈。这些结果突出了MLLMs在嘈杂环境中的显著性能差距，并为未来在面向召回的提示工程和模型校准方面的工作奠定了基础，以适应需要复杂视频理解和推理的开放世界监控。
tldr: This paper evaluates the performance of zero-shot MLLMs for video anomaly detection, revealing a conservative bias towards 'normal' classification and highlighting the need for recall-oriented prompting strategies to improve practical utility in surveillance applications.
tldr_zh: 该论文评估了零样本多模态大型语言模型在视频异常检测中的性能，揭示了一种趋向于'正常'分类的保守偏差，并强调需要面向召回的提示策略，以提高其在监控应用中的实用性。

title: Probabilistic Dreaming for World Models
summary: "Dreaming" enables agents to learn from imagined experiences, enabling more robust and sample-efficient learning of world models. In this work, we consider innovations to the state-of-the-art Dreamer model using probabilistic methods that enable: (1) the parallel exploration of many latent states; and (2) maintaining distinct hypotheses for mutually exclusive futures while retaining the desirable gradient properties of continuous latents. Evaluating on the MPE SimpleTag domain, our method outperforms standard Dreamer with a 4.5% score improvement and 28% lower variance in episode returns. We also discuss limitations and directions for future work, including how optimal hyperparameters (e.g. particle count K) scale with environmental complexity, and methods to capture epistemic uncertainty in world models.
summary_zh: “梦境”使智能体能够从想象的经验中学习，从而更稳健、更具样本效率地学习世界模型。在这项工作中，我们考虑使用概率方法对最先进的Dreamer模型进行创新，以实现：（1）并行探索多个潜在状态；以及（2）在保持连续潜在变量理想梯度属性的同时，维持对互斥未来的不同假设。 在MPE SimpleTag 域上进行评估，我们的方法优于标准的 Dreamer，分数提高了 4.5%，且单幕回报的方差降低了 28%。 我们还讨论了局限性以及未来工作的方向，包括最佳超参数（例如，粒子数量 K）如何随环境复杂性而变化，以及在世界模型中捕获认知不确定性的方法。
tldr: This paper introduces a probabilistic extension to the Dreamer world model, enabling parallel exploration of latent states and improved performance on the SimpleTag domain.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种 Dreamer 世界模型的概率扩展，能够并行探索潜在状态，并在 SimpleTag 领域上提高了性能。

title: When Sensors Fail: Temporal Sequence Models for Robust PPO under Sensor Drift
summary: Real-world reinforcement learning systems must operate under distributional drift in their observation streams, yet most policy architectures implicitly assume fully observed and noise-free states. We study robustness of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) under temporally persistent sensor failures that induce partial observability and representation shift. To respond to this drift, we augment PPO with temporal sequence models, including Transformers and State Space Models (SSMs), to enable policies to infer missing information from history and maintain performance. Under a stochastic sensor failure process, we prove a high-probability bound on infinite-horizon reward degradation that quantifies how robustness depends on policy smoothness and failure persistence. Empirically, on MuJoCo continuous-control benchmarks with severe sensor dropout, we show Transformer-based sequence policies substantially outperform MLP, RNN, and SSM baselines in robustness, maintaining high returns even when large fractions of sensors are unavailable. These results demonstrate that temporal sequence reasoning provides a principled and practical mechanism for reliable operation under observation drift caused by sensor unreliability.
summary_zh: 真实世界的强化学习系统必须在观测流中的分布漂移下运行，然而大多数策略架构隐式地假设完全观测且无噪声的状态。 我们研究了近端策略优化（PPO）在诱导部分可观测性和表征偏移的持续性传感器故障下的鲁棒性。为了应对这种漂移，我们利用时间序列模型（包括 Transformers 和状态空间模型 (SSM)）来增强 PPO，以使策略能够从历史中推断缺失信息并维持性能。 在随机传感器故障过程下，我们证明了无限视界回报退化的高概率界限，该界限量化了鲁棒性如何依赖于策略平滑度和故障持久性。通过实验，在具有严重传感器丢失的 MuJoCo 连续控制基准上，我们证明了基于 Transformer 的序列策略在鲁棒性方面大大优于 MLP、RNN 和 SSM 基线，即使在大部分传感器不可用时也能保持高回报。这些结果表明，时间序列推理为在由传感器不可靠性引起的观测漂移下实现可靠操作提供了一种有原则且实用的机制。
tldr: The paper enhances PPO with temporal sequence models (Transformers, SSMs) to improve robustness against sensor failures, demonstrating superior performance on MuJoCo benchmarks with sensor dropout.
tldr_zh: 该论文通过将时间序列模型（Transformers，SSMs）加入 PPO，提高了其在传感器故障下的鲁棒性，并在 MuJoCo 基准测试中展示了卓越的性能，尤其是在传感器失灵的情况下。

title: Bootstrapping Exploration with Group-Level Natural Language Feedback in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) typically receive diverse natural language (NL) feedback through interaction with the environment. However, current reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms rely solely on scalar rewards, leaving the rich information in NL feedback underutilized and leading to inefficient exploration. In this work, we propose GOLF, an RL framework that explicitly exploits group-level language feedback to guide targeted exploration through actionable refinements. GOLF aggregates two complementary feedback sources: (i) external critiques that pinpoint errors or propose targeted fixes, and (ii) intra-group attempts that supply alternative partial ideas and diverse failure patterns. These group-level feedbacks are aggregated to produce high-quality refinements, which are adaptively injected into training as off-policy scaffolds to provide targeted guidance in sparse-reward regions. Meanwhile, GOLF jointly optimizes generation and refinement within a unified RL loop, creating a virtuous cycle that continuously improves both capabilities. Experiments on both verifiable and non-verifiable benchmarks show that GOLF achieves superior performance and exploration efficiency, achieving 2.2$\times$ improvements in sample efficiency compared to RL methods trained solely on scalar rewards. Code is available at https://github.com/LuckyyySTA/GOLF.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）通常通过与环境交互接收到多种多样的自然语言（NL）反馈。然而，当前的强化学习（RL）算法仅仅依赖于标量奖励，使得自然语言反馈中蕴含的丰富信息未被充分利用，导致探索效率低下。在这项工作中，我们提出了GOLF，一种强化学习框架，它显式地利用群体层面的语言反馈，通过可执行的改进来指导目标明确的探索。GOLF聚合了两种互补的反馈来源：（i）外部评论，它精准地指出错误或提出有针对性的修复建议，以及（ii）组内尝试，它提供替代性的局部想法和多样化的失败模式。这些群体层面的反馈被聚合以产生高质量的改进，这些改进被自适应地注入到训练中作为离策略支架，从而在稀疏奖励区域提供有针对性的指导。同时，GOLF在一个统一的强化学习循环中联合优化生成和改进，创造一个不断改进两种能力的良性循环。在可验证和不可验证的基准测试上的实验表明，GOLF实现了卓越的性能和探索效率，与仅通过标量奖励训练的强化学习方法相比，样本效率提高了2.2倍。代码可在https://github.com/LuckyyySTA/GOLF获取。
tldr: The paper introduces GOLF, a reinforcement learning framework that leverages group-level natural language feedback to guide exploration and improve sample efficiency in sparse-reward environments by adaptively injecting off-policy scaffolds.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GOLF, 一种强化学习框架，它利用群体层面的自然语言反馈来指导探索，并通过自适应地注入 off-policy scaffolds 来提高稀疏奖励环境中的样本效率。

title: Self-Attribution Bias: When AI Monitors Go Easy on Themselves
summary: Agentic systems increasingly rely on language models to monitor their own behavior. For example, coding agents may self critique generated code for pull request approval or assess the safety of tool-use actions. We show that this design pattern can fail when the action is presented in a previous or in the same assistant turn instead of being presented by the user in a user turn. We define self-attribution bias as the tendency of a model to evaluate an action as more correct or less risky when the action is implicitly framed as its own, compared to when the same action is evaluated under off-policy attribution. Across four coding and tool-use datasets, we find that monitors fail to report high-risk or low-correctness actions more often when evaluation follows a previous assistant turn in which the action was generated, compared to when the same action is evaluated in a new context presented in a user turn. In contrast, explicitly stating that the action comes from the monitor does not by itself induce self-attribution bias. Because monitors are often evaluated on fixed examples rather than on their own generated actions, these evaluations can make monitors appear more reliable than they actually are in deployment, leading developers to unknowingly deploy inadequate monitors in agentic systems.
summary_zh: 代理系统越来越依赖于语言模型来监控自身的行为。例如，编码代理可能会自我批判其生成的代码，以便批准拉取请求，或者评估工具使用行为的安全性。我们发现，当动作在之前或相同的助手轮次中呈现，而不是由用户在用户轮次中呈现时，这种设计模式可能会失效。我们定义“自我归因偏差”为：当一个动作被隐含地视为模型自身的动作时，与在离策略归因下评估同一动作相比，模型倾向于将该动作评估为更正确或风险更低。在四个编码和工具使用数据集上，我们发现，与在用户轮次中呈现的新上下文中评估同一动作相比，当评估跟随生成该动作的上一个助手轮次之后时，监控器更频繁地未能报告高风险或低正确性的动作。相反，明确声明该动作来自监控器本身并不会诱发自我归因偏差。由于监控器通常在固定的示例上进行评估，而不是基于它们自己生成的动作，因此这些评估可能会使监控器在部署时显得比实际更可靠，导致开发者在不知情的情况下在代理系统中部署不充分的监控器。
tldr: The paper identifies a 'self-attribution bias' in AI monitors, where they are less likely to flag errors in their own actions compared to those presented by users, leading to potentially unreliable agentic systems. The bias does not appear when explicitly stating the action comes from the monitor.
tldr_zh: 该论文指出AI监控器存在“自我归因偏见”，与用户提出的行为相比，它们不太可能标记自己行为中的错误，这可能导致代理系统不可靠。 当明确声明动作来自监控器时，不会出现这种偏差。

title: Dual-Modality Multi-Stage Adversarial Safety Training: Robustifying Multimodal Web Agents Against Cross-Modal Attacks
summary: Multimodal web agents that process both screenshots and accessibility trees are increasingly deployed to interact with web interfaces, yet their dual-stream architecture opens an underexplored attack surface: an adversary who injects content into the webpage DOM simultaneously corrupts both observation channels with a consistent deceptive narrative. Our vulnerability analysis on MiniWob++ reveals that attacks including a visual component far outperform text-only injections, exposing critical gaps in text-centric VLM safety training. Motivated by this finding, we propose Dual-Modality Multi-Stage Adversarial Safety Training (DMAST), a framework that formalizes the agent-attacker interaction as a two-player zero-sum Markov game and co-trains both players through a three-stage pipeline: (1) imitation learning from a strong teacher model, (2) oracle-guided supervised fine-tuning that uses a novel zero-acknowledgment strategy to instill task-focused reasoning under adversarial noise, and (3) adversarial reinforcement learning via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) self-play. On out-of-distribution tasks, DMAST substantially mitigates adversarial risks while simultaneously doubling task completion efficiency. Our approach significantly outperforms established training-based and prompt-based defenses, demonstrating genuine co-evolutionary progress and robust generalization to complex, unseen environments.
summary_zh: 处理屏幕截图和可访问性树的多模态网络代理正越来越多地被部署以与网页界面交互，但其双流架构开启了一个尚未充分探索的攻击面：攻击者通过将内容注入网页DOM，同时以一致的欺骗性叙事破坏两个观察通道。我们对MiniWob++的漏洞分析表明，包含视觉成分的攻击远胜于仅文本注入，暴露了以文本为中心的视觉语言模型（VLM）安全训练中的关键缺陷。受此发现的启发，我们提出了双模态多阶段对抗安全训练（DMAST），该框架将代理-攻击者交互形式化为一个双人零和马尔可夫博弈，并通过一个三阶段流程共同训练这两个玩家：（1）从强大的教师模型进行模仿学习；（2）使用一种新颖的零确认策略，在对抗噪声下灌输以任务为中心的推理的、具有指导意义的监督微调；（3）通过群体相对策略优化（GRPO）自博弈进行对抗强化学习。在分布外任务中，DMAST显著降低了对抗风险，同时使任务完成效率提高了一倍。我们的方法显著优于已建立的基于训练和基于提示的防御，展示了真正的协同进化进展以及对复杂、未见环境的强大泛化能力。
tldr: The paper introduces Dual-Modality Multi-Stage Adversarial Safety Training (DMAST) to improve the robustness of multimodal web agents against cross-modal attacks by co-training an agent and attacker through a three-stage pipeline, achieving significant improvements in adversarial risk mitigation and task completion efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种双模态多阶段对抗安全训练 (DMAST) 方法，旨在通过三阶段流水线共同训练智能体和攻击者，从而提高多模态 Web 智能体对跨模态攻击的鲁棒性，并在降低对抗风险和提高任务完成效率方面取得了显著进展。

title: SGR3 Model: Scene Graph Retrieval-Reasoning Model in 3D
summary: 3D scene graphs provide a structured representation of object entities and their relationships, enabling high-level interpretation and reasoning for robots while remaining intuitively understandable to humans. Existing approaches for 3D scene graph generation typically combine scene reconstruction with graph neural networks (GNNs). However, such pipelines require multi-modal data that may not always be available, and their reliance on heuristic graph construction can constrain the prediction of relationship triplets. In this work, we introduce a Scene Graph Retrieval-Reasoning Model in 3D (SGR3 Model), a training-free framework that leverages multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for semantic scene graph generation. SGR3 Model bypasses the need for explicit 3D reconstruction. Instead, it enhances relational reasoning by incorporating semantically aligned scene graphs retrieved via a ColPali-style cross-modal framework. To improve retrieval robustness, we further introduce a weighted patch-level similarity selection mechanism that mitigates the negative impact of blurry or semantically uninformative regions. Experiments demonstrate that SGR3 Model achieves competitive performance compared to training-free baselines and on par with GNN-based expert models. Moreover, an ablation study on the retrieval module and knowledge base scale reveals that retrieved external information is explicitly integrated into the token generation process, rather than being implicitly internalized through abstraction.
summary_zh: 3D场景图提供了对象实体及其关系的结构化表示，从而使机器人可以进行高级别的解释和推理，同时保持对人类的直观可理解性。现有的3D场景图生成方法通常将场景重建与图神经网络(GNN)相结合。然而，这种流程需要多模态数据，而这些数据并不总是可用的，并且它们对启发式图构建的依赖可能会限制关系三元组的预测。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个3D场景图检索-推理模型(SGR3模型)，这是一个无需训练的框架，它利用带有检索增强生成(RAG)的多模态大型语言模型(MLLM)进行语义场景图生成。SGR3模型绕过了对显式3D重建的需求。相反，它通过结合经由ColPali式跨模态框架检索到的语义对齐的场景图来增强关系推理。为了提高检索的鲁棒性，我们进一步引入了一种加权的patch级别相似性选择机制，以减轻模糊或语义信息不足区域的负面影响。实验表明，与无需训练的基线相比，SGR3模型实现了有竞争力的性能，并且与基于GNN的专家模型相当。此外，对检索模块和知识库规模的消融研究表明，检索到的外部信息被显式地集成到token生成过程中，而不是通过抽象隐式地内化。
tldr: The paper introduces SGR3, a training-free framework for 3D scene graph generation using MLLMs and retrieval-augmented generation, bypassing 3D reconstruction and achieving competitive performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SGR3，一个使用多模态大语言模型和检索增强生成的三维场景图生成框架，无需三维重建并达到了有竞争力的性能。

title: TaxonRL: Reinforcement Learning with Intermediate Rewards for Interpretable Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning
summary: Traditional vision-language models struggle with contrastive fine-grained taxonomic reasoning, particularly when distinguishing between visually similar species within the same genus or family. We introduce TaxonRL, a reinforcement learning approach using Group Relative Policy Optimization with intermediate rewards that decomposes the reasoning process into hierarchical taxonomic predictions. Our method incentivizes models to explicitly reason about species-level, genus-level, and family-level features before making final classifications. This structured approach is designed not only to boost accuracy but also to yield a transparent, verifiable decision-making process. On the challenging Birds-to-Words dataset, TaxonRL achieves 91.7\% average accuracy, exceeding human performance (77.3\%) while generating interpretable reasoning traces. We demonstrate strong cross-domain generalization, showing substantial gains in primate and marine species verification. Our results establish that enforcing structured, hierarchical reasoning provides a powerful and transferable framework for fine-grained visual discrimination.
summary_zh: 传统视觉-语言模型在对比细粒度分类推理方面表现不佳，尤其是在区分同一属或科内视觉相似的物种时。我们提出 TaxonRL，一种使用带中间奖励的群相对策略优化的强化学习方法，将推理过程分解为分层分类预测。我们的方法激励模型在做出最终分类之前，显式地推理物种级别、属级别和科级别的特征。这种结构化方法旨在不仅提高准确性，而且产生透明、可验证的决策过程。在具有挑战性的 Birds-to-Words 数据集上，TaxonRL 实现了 91.7% 的平均准确率，超过了人类的表现（77.3%），同时生成了可解释的推理轨迹。我们展示了强大的跨域泛化能力，在灵长类动物和海洋物种验证方面取得了显著提升。我们的结果表明，强制执行结构化的分层推理为细粒度视觉辨别提供了一个强大且可迁移的框架。
tldr: TaxonRL uses reinforcement learning with hierarchical taxonomic prediction and intermediate rewards to improve fine-grained visual reasoning, surpassing human accuracy on the Birds-to-Words dataset and demonstrating strong cross-domain generalization.
tldr_zh: TaxonRL利用强化学习和分层分类预测以及中间奖励来提升细粒度视觉推理能力，超越了在Birds-to-Words数据集上的人类准确率，并展示了强大的跨领域泛化能力。

title: FocusGraph: Graph-Structured Frame Selection for Embodied Long Video Question Answering
summary:
The ability to understand long videos is vital for embodied intelligent agents, because their effectiveness depends on how well they can accumulate, organize, and leverage long-horizon perceptual memories. Recently, multimodal LLMs have been gaining popularity for solving the long video understanding task due to their general ability to understand natural language and to leverage world knowledge. However, as the number of frames provided to an MLLM increases, the quality of its responses tends to degrade, and inference time grows. Therefore, when using MLLMs for long video understanding, a crucial step is selecting key frames from the video to answer user queries.
  In this work, we develop FocusGraph, a framework for keyframe selection for question answering over long egocentric videos. It leverages a lightweight trainable Scene-Caption LLM Selector that selects query-relevant clips based on their graph-based captions, and a training-free method for selecting keyframes from these clips. Unlike existing methods, the proposed Scene-Caption LLM Selector does not rely on the original sequence of low-resolution frames; instead, it operates on a compact textual representation of the scene. We then design a training-free Patch-wise Sparse-Flow Retention (PSFR) method to select keyframes from the resulting sequence of clips, which are fed into an MLLM to produce the final answer. Together, these components enable FocusGraph to achieve state-of-the-art results on challenging egocentric long-video question answering benchmarks, including FindingDory and HourVideo, while significantly reducing inference time relative to baseline approaches.
summary_zh:
理解长视频对于具身智能体至关重要，因为它们的有效性取决于它们积累、组织和利用长时域感知记忆的能力。 近年来，多模态LLM (MLLM) 因其理解自然语言和利用世界知识的通用能力，在解决长视频理解任务方面越来越受欢迎。然而，随着提供给MLLM的帧数增加，其响应质量往往会下降，并且推理时间会增长。因此，在使用MLLM进行长视频理解时，一个关键步骤是从视频中选择关键帧来回答用户查询。

在这项工作中，我们开发了FocusGraph，这是一个用于长第一人称视角视频问答的关键帧选择框架。 它利用一个轻量级的可训练场景描述LLM选择器，该选择器基于其基于图的描述来选择与查询相关的片段，以及一种无训练方法来从这些片段中选择关键帧。 与现有方法不同，所提出的场景描述LLM选择器不依赖于原始的低分辨率帧序列，而是基于场景的紧凑文本表示进行操作。 然后，我们设计了一种无训练的逐块稀疏流保留 (PSFR) 方法，从生成的片段序列中选择关键帧，这些关键帧被馈送到MLLM以生成最终答案。 总而言之，这些组件使FocusGraph能够在具有挑战性的第一人称视角长视频问答基准测试（包括FindingDory和HourVideo）上实现最先进的结果，同时相对于基线方法显著减少推理时间。
tldr: The paper introduces FocusGraph, a keyframe selection framework for long egocentric video question answering that uses a lightweight LLM selector and patch-wise sparse-flow retention to improve accuracy and reduce inference time when using Multimodal LLMs. It achieves state-of-the-art results on FindingDory and HourVideo datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了FocusGraph，一个用于长时自中心视频问答的关键帧选择框架，它使用轻量级的LLM选择器和逐块稀疏流保持来提高在使用多模态LLM时的准确性并减少推理时间。该方法在FindingDory和HourVideo数据集上取得了最先进的结果。

title: Reward-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: RL agents are typically trained under a single, fixed reward function, which makes them brittle to reward misspecification and limits their ability to adapt to changing task preferences. We introduce Reward-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning (RCRL), a framework that trains a single agent to optimize a family of reward specifications while collecting experience under only one nominal objective. RCRL conditions the agent on reward parameterizations and learns multiple reward objectives from a shared replay data entirely off-policy, enabling a single policy to represent reward-specific behaviors. Across single-task, multi-task, and vision-based benchmarks, we show that RCRL not only improves performance under the nominal reward parameterization, but also enables efficient adaptation to new parameterizations. Our results demonstrate that RCRL provides a scalable mechanism for learning robust, steerable policies without sacrificing the simplicity of single-task training.
summary_zh: 强化学习智能体通常在单一、固定的奖励函数下进行训练，这使得它们对奖励指定错误非常敏感，并限制了其适应变化的任务偏好的能力。我们引入了奖励条件强化学习(RCRL)，该框架训练单个智能体来优化一系列奖励规范，同时仅在一个标称目标下收集经验。RCRL 以奖励参数化为条件，并从完全离线的共享回放数据中学习多个奖励目标，从而使单个策略能够代表特定于奖励的行为。在单任务、多任务和基于视觉的基准测试中，我们表明 RCRL 不仅提高了标称奖励参数化下的性能，而且能够高效地适应新的参数化。我们的结果表明，RCRL 提供了一种可扩展机制，用于学习鲁棒、可操纵的策略，而不会牺牲单任务训练的简易性。
tldr: The paper introduces Reward-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning (RCRL) which trains an RL agent to optimize a family of reward specifications from a shared replay buffer, enabling adaptation to new reward parameterizations and improving performance under the nominal reward.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了奖励条件强化学习 (RCRL)，它训练一个强化学习智能体从共享的重放缓冲区中优化一系列奖励规范，从而能够适应新的奖励参数化并提高标称奖励下的性能。

title: Accelerating Sampling-Based Control via Learned Linear Koopman Dynamics
summary: This paper presents an efficient model predictive path integral (MPPI) control framework for systems with complex nonlinear dynamics. To improve the computational efficiency of classic MPPI while preserving control performance, we replace the nonlinear dynamics used for trajectory propagation with a learned linear deep Koopman operator (DKO) model, enabling faster rollout and more efficient trajectory sampling. The DKO dynamics are learned directly from interaction data, eliminating the need for analytical system models. The resulting controller, termed MPPI-DK, is evaluated in simulation on pendulum balancing and surface vehicle navigation tasks, and validated on hardware through reference-tracking experiments on a quadruped robot. Experimental results demonstrate that MPPI-DK achieves control performance close to MPPI with true dynamics while substantially reducing computational cost, enabling efficient real-time control on robotic platforms.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种高效的模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制框架，用于具有复杂非线性动力学的系统。为了在保持控制性能的同时提高经典MPPI的计算效率，我们用一个学习到的线性深度Koopman算子（DKO）模型来替代用于轨迹传播的非线性动力学，从而实现更快的展开和更有效的轨迹采样。DKO动力学直接从交互数据中学习，无需解析系统模型。由此产生的控制器，命名为MPPI-DK，在钟摆平衡和水面车辆导航任务的仿真中进行了评估，并通过四足机器人的参考跟踪实验在硬件上进行了验证。实验结果表明，MPPI-DK在计算成本大幅降低的同时，实现了接近于使用真实动力学的MPPI的控制性能，从而能够在机器人平台上实现高效的实时控制。
tldr: This paper presents a computationally efficient Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control framework using a learned linear Deep Koopman Operator (DKO) model, validated on simulated and real robotic systems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种计算高效的模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制框架，该框架使用学习到的线性深度 Koopman 算子（DKO）模型，并在模拟和真实机器人系统上进行了验证。

title: Omni-Manip: Beyond-FOV Large-Workspace Humanoid Manipulation with Omnidirectional 3D Perception
summary: The deployment of humanoid robots for dexterous manipulation in unstructured environments remains challenging due to perceptual limitations that constrain the effective workspace. In scenarios where physical constraints prevent the robot from repositioning itself, maintaining omnidirectional awareness becomes far more critical than color or semantic information. While recent advances in visuomotor policy learning have improved manipulation capabilities, conventional RGB-D solutions suffer from narrow fields of view (FOV) and self-occlusion, requiring frequent base movements that introduce motion uncertainty and safety risks. Existing approaches to expanding perception, including active vision systems and third-view cameras, introduce mechanical complexity, calibration dependencies, and latency that hinder reliable real-time performance. In this work, We propose Omni-Manip, an end-to-end LiDAR-driven 3D visuomotor policy that enables robust manipulation in large workspaces. Our method processes panoramic point clouds through a Time-Aware Attention Pooling mechanism, efficiently encoding sparse 3D data while capturing temporal dependencies. This 360° perception allows the robot to interact with objects across wide areas without frequent repositioning. To support policy learning, we develop a whole-body teleoperation system for efficient data collection on full-body coordination. Extensive experiments in simulation and real-world environments show that Omni-Manip achieves robust performance in large-workspace and cluttered scenarios, outperforming baselines that rely on egocentric depth cameras.
summary_zh: 在非结构化环境中部署具有灵巧操作能力的人形机器人仍然面临挑战，这主要是由于感知限制约束了有效的工作空间。当物理约束阻止机器人重新定位自身时，保持全向感知变得比颜色或语义信息更为关键。尽管视觉运动策略学习的最新进展提高了操作能力，但传统的RGB-D解决方案受到狭窄视野(FOV)和自遮挡的限制，需要频繁的基础移动，这引入了运动不确定性和安全风险。现有的扩展感知方法，包括主动视觉系统和第三视角相机，引入了机械复杂性、标定依赖性和延迟，阻碍了可靠的实时性能。在这项工作中，我们提出了Omni-Manip，一种端到端的激光雷达驱动的3D视觉运动策略，能够在大型工作空间中实现鲁棒的操作。我们的方法通过一种时序感知注意力池化机制处理全景点云，高效地编码稀疏的3D数据，同时捕获时间依赖性。这种360°感知允许机器人与大范围内的物体交互，而无需频繁的重新定位。为了支持策略学习，我们开发了一个全身遥操作系统，用于在全身协调上高效地收集数据。在模拟和真实环境中的大量实验表明，Omni-Manip在大型工作空间和拥挤场景中实现了强大的性能，优于依赖以自我为中心的深度相机的基线方法。
tldr: The paper introduces Omni-Manip, a LiDAR-driven 3D visuomotor policy for humanoid robots that overcomes the limitations of narrow FOV vision by using 360° perception, allowing for robust manipulation in large workspaces without frequent repositioning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Omni-Manip，一种基于激光雷达驱动的三维视觉运动策略，用于人形机器人，通过使用360°感知克服了窄视野视觉的局限性，从而能够在大型工作空间中进行稳健的操作，而无需频繁重新定位。

title: AIM-SLAM: Dense Monocular SLAM via Adaptive and Informative Multi-View Keyframe Prioritization with Foundation Model
summary: Recent advances in geometric foundation models have emerged as a promising alternative for addressing the challenge of dense reconstruction in monocular visual simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). Although geometric foundation models enable SLAM to leverage variable input views, the previous methods remain confined to two-view pairs or fixed-length inputs without sufficient deliberation of geometric context for view selection. To tackle this problem, we propose AIM-SLAM, a dense monocular SLAM framework that exploits an adaptive and informative multi-view keyframe prioritization with dense pointmap predictions from visual geometry grounded transformer (VGGT). Specifically, we introduce the selective information- and geometric-aware multi-view adaptation (SIGMA) module, which employs voxel overlap and information gain to retrieve a candidate set of keyframes and adaptively determine its size. Furthermore, we formulate a joint multi-view Sim(3) optimization that enforces consistent alignment across selected views, substantially improving pose estimation accuracy. The effectiveness of AIM-SLAM is demonstrated on real-world datasets, where it achieves state-of-the-art performance in both pose estimation and dense reconstruction. Our system supports ROS integration, with code is available at https://aimslam.github.io/.
summary_zh: 单目视觉同步定位与地图构建(SLAM)中，几何基础模型的最新进展为应对稠密重建的挑战提供了一种有希望的替代方案。尽管几何基础模型使SLAM能够利用可变的输入视图，但先前的方法仍然局限于双视图配对或固定长度的输入，而没有充分考虑视图选择的几何上下文。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了AIM-SLAM，一个稠密单目SLAM框架，它利用自适应和信息丰富的多视图关键帧优先级排序，以及来自基于视觉几何的Transformer (VGGT)的稠密点云地图预测。具体而言，我们引入了选择性的信息与几何感知多视图自适应(SIGMA)模块，该模块采用体素重叠和信息增益来检索候选的关键帧集并自适应地确定其大小。此外，我们构建了一个联合多视图Sim(3)优化，它强制在所选视图之间保持一致的对齐，从而显著提高位姿估计的准确性。AIM-SLAM的有效性在真实世界的数据集上得到了验证，在位姿估计和稠密重建方面都实现了最先进的性能。我们的系统支持ROS集成，代码可在https://aimslam.github.io/上获取。
tldr: AIM-SLAM introduces a monocular SLAM framework leveraging geometric foundation models and adaptive multi-view keyframe prioritization for improved pose estimation and dense reconstruction, achieving state-of-the-art results.
tldr_zh: AIM-SLAM提出了一个单目SLAM框架，利用几何基础模型和自适应多视角关键帧优先级排序，以提高姿态估计和密集重建的性能，并实现了最先进的结果。

title: CoIn3D: Revisiting Configuration-Invariant Multi-Camera 3D Object Detection
summary: Multi-camera 3D object detection (MC3D) has attracted increasing attention with the growing deployment of multi-sensor physical agents, such as robots and autonomous vehicles. However, MC3D models still struggle to generalize to unseen platforms with new multi-camera configurations. Current solutions simply employ a meta-camera for unified representation but lack comprehensive consideration. In this paper, we revisit this issue and identify that the devil lies in spatial prior discrepancies across source and target configurations, including different intrinsics, extrinsics, and array layouts. To address this, we propose CoIn3D, a generalizable MC3D framework that enables strong transferability from source configurations to unseen target ones. CoIn3D explicitly incorporates all identified spatial priors into both feature embedding and image observation through spatial-aware feature modulation (SFM) and camera-aware data augmentation (CDA), respectively. SFM enriches feature space by integrating four spatial representations, such as focal length, ground depth, ground gradient, and Plücker coordinate. CDA improves observation diversity under various configurations via a training-free dynamic novel-view image synthesis scheme. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CoIn3D achieves strong cross-configuration performance on landmark datasets such as NuScenes, Waymo, and Lyft, under three dominant MC3D paradigms represented by BEVDepth, BEVFormer, and PETR.
summary_zh: 多相机3D目标检测（MC3D）随着机器人和自动驾驶车辆等多传感器物理代理的日益普及而备受关注。然而，MC3D模型仍然难以泛化到具有全新多相机配置的未知平台。目前的解决方案仅采用元相机进行统一表示，但缺乏全面的考虑。在本文中，我们重新审视这个问题，并发现问题在于源配置和目标配置之间的空间先验差异，包括不同的内参、外参和阵列布局。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了CoIn3D，一种可泛化的MC3D框架，能够实现从源配置到未知目标配置的强大迁移能力。CoIn3D通过空间感知特征调制（SFM）和相机感知数据增强（CDA），将所有已识别的空间先验显式地融入到特征嵌入和图像观测中。SFM通过整合焦距、地面深度、地面梯度和普吕克坐标等四种空间表示来丰富特征空间。CDA通过一种免训练的动态新视角图像合成方案，提高了不同配置下的观测多样性。 大量实验表明，在以BEVDepth、BEVFormer和PETR为代表的三种主流MC3D范例下，CoIn3D在NuScenes、Waymo和Lyft等标志性数据集上实现了强大的跨配置性能。
tldr: The paper introduces CoIn3D, a framework for multi-camera 3D object detection designed to generalize across different camera configurations by explicitly incorporating spatial priors into feature embedding and image observation. It achieves state-of-the-art cross-configuration performance on major datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了CoIn3D，一个多摄像头3D目标检测框架，旨在通过将空间先验显式地融入特征嵌入和图像观察中，从而推广到不同的摄像头配置。它在主要数据集上实现了最先进的跨配置性能。

title: U-OBCA: Uncertainty-Aware Optimization-Based Collision Avoidance via Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Chance Constraints
summary: Uncertainties arising from localization error, trajectory prediction errors of the moving obstacles and environmental disturbances pose significant challenges to robot's safe navigation. Existing uncertainty-aware planners often approximate polygon-shaped robots and obstacles using simple geometric primitives such as circles or ellipses. Though computationally convenient, these approximations substantially shrink the feasible space, leading to overly conservative trajectories and even planning failure in narrow environments. In addition, many such methods rely on specific assumptions about noise distributions, which may not hold in practice and thus limit their performance guarantees. To address these limitations, we extend the Optimization-Based Collision Avoidance (OBCA) framework to an uncertainty-aware formulation, termed \emph{U-OBCA}. The proposed method explicitly accounts for the collision risk between polygon-shaped robots and obstacles by formulating OBCA-based chance constraints, and hence avoiding geometric simplifications and reducing unnecessary conservatism. These probabilistic constraints are further tightened into deterministic nonlinear constraints under mild distributional assumptions, which can be solved efficiently by standard numerical optimization solvers. The proposed approach is validated through theoretical analysis, numerical simulations and real-world experiments. The results demonstrate that U-OBCA significantly mitigates the conservatism in trajectory planning and achieves higher navigation efficiency compared to existing baseline methods, particularly in narrow and cluttered environments.
summary_zh: 由定位误差、移动障碍物轨迹预测误差和环境干扰引起的不确定性给机器人的安全导航带来了重大挑战。现有的不确定性感知规划器通常使用简单的几何基元（如圆形或椭圆形）来近似多边形机器人和障碍物。虽然在计算上很方便，但这些近似会大大缩小可行空间，导致过度保守的轨迹，甚至在狭窄环境中出现规划失败。此外，许多此类方法依赖于对噪声分布的特定假设，这些假设在实践中可能不成立，从而限制了它们的性能保证。为了解决这些局限性，我们将基于优化的避碰（OBCA）框架扩展到不确定性感知公式，称为\emph{U-OBCA}。所提出的方法通过制定基于OBCA的概率约束，明确考虑多边形机器人和障碍物之间的碰撞风险，从而避免了几何简化并减少了不必要的保守性。在温和的分布假设下，这些概率约束进一步收紧为确定性的非线性约束，这些约束可以通过标准数值优化求解器有效地求解。所提出的方法通过理论分析、数值模拟和实际实验进行了验证。结果表明，与现有的基线方法相比，U-OBCA显著降低了轨迹规划中的保守性，并实现了更高的导航效率，尤其是在狭窄和拥挤的环境中。
tldr: The paper introduces U-OBCA, an uncertainty-aware optimization-based collision avoidance method that improves robot navigation efficiency by explicitly considering collision risks between polygon-shaped robots and obstacles, avoiding overly conservative trajectories.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了U-OBCA，一种不确定性感知的基于优化的避障方法，通过显式考虑多边形机器人和障碍物之间的碰撞风险，避免过于保守的轨迹，从而提高机器人导航效率。

title: Beyond the Patch: Exploring Vulnerabilities of Visuomotor Policies via Viewpoint-Consistent 3D Adversarial Object
summary: Neural network-based visuomotor policies enable robots to perform manipulation tasks but remain susceptible to perceptual attacks. For example, conventional 2D adversarial patches are effective under fixed-camera setups, where appearance is relatively consistent; however, their efficacy often diminishes under dynamic viewpoints from moving cameras, such as wrist-mounted setups, due to perspective distortions. To proactively investigate potential vulnerabilities beyond 2D patches, this work proposes a viewpoint-consistent adversarial texture optimization method for 3D objects through differentiable rendering. As optimization strategies, we employ Expectation over Transformation (EOT) with a Coarse-to-Fine (C2F) curriculum, exploiting distance-dependent frequency characteristics to induce textures effective across varying camera-object distances. We further integrate saliency-guided perturbations to redirect policy attention and design a targeted loss that persistently drives robots toward adversarial objects. Our comprehensive experiments show that the proposed method is effective under various environmental conditions, while confirming its black-box transferability and real-world applicability.
summary_zh: 基于神经网络的视觉运动策略使机器人能够执行操作任务，但仍然容易受到感知攻击。例如，传统的2D对抗补丁在固定摄像头设置下是有效的，在这些设置中，外观相对一致；然而，由于透视畸变，它们在来自移动摄像头的动态视角（例如，腕部安装设置）下的效力通常会降低。为了主动研究超越2D补丁的潜在漏洞，本文提出了一种基于可微渲染的3D物体的视角一致性对抗纹理优化方法。作为优化策略，我们采用带有粗到细（C2F）课程的学习预期转换（EOT），利用距离相关的频率特性来诱导在不同相机-物体距离下有效的纹理。我们进一步整合了显著性引导的扰动来重定向策略注意力，并设计了一个目标损失，以持续地将机器人推向对抗性物体。我们全面的实验表明，所提出的方法在各种环境条件下都是有效的，同时证实了其黑盒可迁移性和现实世界的适用性。
tldr: This paper introduces a method for generating viewpoint-consistent 3D adversarial textures on objects to attack visuomotor policies, demonstrating its effectiveness in both simulated and real-world scenarios with black-box transferability.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种生成视角一致的3D对抗纹理的方法，用于攻击视觉运动策略。实验表明，该方法在模拟和现实环境中都有效，并具有黑盒可迁移性。

title: Task-Relevant and Irrelevant Region-Aware Augmentation for Generalizable Vision-Based Imitation Learning in Agricultural Manipulation
summary: Vision-based imitation learning has shown promise for robotic manipulation; however, its generalization remains limited in practical agricultural tasks. This limitation stems from scarce demonstration data and substantial visual domain gaps caused by i) crop-specific appearance diversity and ii) background variations. To address this limitation, we propose Dual-Region Augmentation for Imitation Learning (DRAIL), a region-aware augmentation framework designed for generalizable vision-based imitation learning in agricultural manipulation. DRAIL explicitly separates visual observations into task-relevant and task-irrelevant regions. The task-relevant region is augmented in a domain-knowledge-driven manner to preserve essential visual characteristics, while the task-irrelevant region is aggressively randomized to suppress spurious background correlations. By jointly handling both sources of visual variation, DRAIL promotes learning policies that rely on task-essential features rather than incidental visual cues. We evaluate DRAIL on diffusion policy-based visuomotor controllers through robot experiments on artificial vegetable harvesting and real lettuce defective leaf picking preparation tasks. The results show consistent improvements in success rates under unseen visual conditions compared to baseline methods. Further attention analysis and representation generalization metrics indicate that the learned policies rely more on task-essential visual features, resulting in enhanced robustness and generalization.
summary_zh: 基于视觉的模仿学习在机器人操作领域展现了潜力，但其泛化能力在实际农业任务中仍然有限。这种局限性源于稀缺的示范数据以及由i)作物特定的外观多样性和ii)背景变化造成的显著视觉领域差异。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种用于模仿学习的双区域增强方法（DRAIL），这是一种区域感知增强框架，专为农业操作中可泛化的基于视觉的模仿学习而设计。DRAIL显式地将视觉观察结果分为任务相关区域和任务无关区域。任务相关区域以领域知识驱动的方式进行增强，以保留必要的视觉特征，而任务无关区域则被积极地随机化，以抑制虚假的背景相关性。通过联合处理两种视觉变化来源，DRAIL促进了依赖于任务必要特征而非偶然视觉线索的学习策略。我们通过在人工蔬菜收获和真实生菜残叶采摘准备任务中的机器人实验，在基于扩散策略的视觉运动控制器上评估了DRAIL。结果表明，与基线方法相比，在未见过的视觉条件下，成功率得到了持续提高。进一步的注意力分析和表征泛化指标表明，学习策略更多地依赖于任务必要的视觉特征，从而提高了鲁棒性和泛化能力。
tldr: The paper introduces DRAIL, a region-aware augmentation framework for vision-based imitation learning in agricultural robotics, improving generalization by augmenting task-relevant and irrelevant regions differently. It shows improved performance on vegetable harvesting and lettuce preparation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DRAIL，一种用于农业机器人视觉模仿学习的区域感知增强框架，通过以不同方式增强任务相关和不相关区域来提高泛化能力。实验表明，在蔬菜收获和生菜准备任务中性能有所提升。

title: Data-Driven Control of a Magnetically Actuated Fish-Like Robot
summary: Magnetically actuated fish-like robots offer promising solutions for underwater exploration due to their miniaturization and agility; however, precise control remains a significant challenge because of nonlinear fluid dynamics, flexible fin hysteresis, and the variable-duration control steps inherent to the actuation mechanism. This paper proposes a comprehensive data-driven control framework to address these complexities without relying on analytical modeling. Our methodology comprises three core components: 1) developing a forward dynamics model (FDM) using a neural network trained on real-world experimental data to capture state transitions under varying time steps; 2) integrating this FDM into a gradient-based model predictive control (G-MPC) architecture to optimize control inputs for path following; and 3) applying imitation learning to approximate the G-MPC policy, thereby reducing the computational cost for real-time implementation. We validate the approach through simulations utilizing the identified dynamics model. The results demonstrate that the G-MPC framework achieves accurate path convergence with minimal root mean square error (RMSE), and the imitation learning controller (ILC) effectively replicates this performance. This study highlights the potential of data-driven control strategies for the precise navigation of miniature, fish-like soft robots.
summary_zh: 磁驱动鱼形机器人因其小型化和敏捷性，为水下探索提供了极具前景的解决方案；然而，由于非线性流体动力学、柔性鳍迟滞以及驱动机制固有的可变时长控制步长，精确控制仍然是一个重大挑战。本文提出了一种全面的数据驱动控制框架，以解决这些复杂性，而无需依赖解析建模。我们的方法包含三个核心组成部分：1）开发一个前向动力学模型 (FDM)，利用在真实世界实验数据上训练的神经网络来捕获不同时间步长下的状态转换；2）将此 FDM 集成到基于梯度的模型预测控制 (G-MPC) 架构中，以优化用于路径跟踪的控制输入；3）应用模仿学习来近似 G-MPC 策略，从而降低实时实现的计算成本。我们通过利用已识别动力学模型的仿真验证了该方法。结果表明，G-MPC 框架实现了精确的路径收敛，具有最小的均方根误差 (RMSE)，并且模仿学习控制器 (ILC) 有效地复制了这种性能。这项研究突出了数据驱动控制策略在微型、鱼形软机器人的精确导航中的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents a data-driven control framework using neural networks, gradient-based model predictive control (G-MPC), and imitation learning for precise navigation of magnetically actuated fish-like robots in underwater environments, validated through simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的控制框架，使用神经网络、基于梯度的模型预测控制（G-MPC）和模仿学习，来实现磁驱动鱼形机器人在水下环境中的精确导航，并通过仿真进行了验证。

title: Adaptive Policy Switching of Two-Wheeled Differential Robots for Traversing over Diverse Terrains
summary: Exploring lunar lava tubes requires robots to traverse without human intervention. Because pre-trained policies cannot fully cover all possible terrain conditions, our goal is to enable adaptive policy switching, where the robot selects an appropriate terrain-specialized model based on its current terrain features. This study investigates whether terrain types can be estimated effectively using posture-related observations collected during navigation. We fine-tuned a pre-trained policy using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), and then collected the robot's 3D orientation data as it moved across flat and rough terrain in a simulated lava-tube environment. Our analysis revealed that the standard deviation of the robot's pitch data shows a clear difference between these two terrain types. Using Gaussian mixture models (GMM), we evaluated terrain classification across various window sizes. An accuracy of more than 98% was achieved when using a 70-step window. The result suggests that short-term orientation data are sufficient for reliable terrain estimation, providing a foundation for adaptive policy switching.
summary_zh: 探索月球熔岩管需要机器人能够在无人干预的情况下进行穿越。由于预训练策略无法完全覆盖所有可能的地形条件，我们的目标是实现自适应策略切换，即机器人根据其当前的地形特征选择合适的地形专业模型。本研究探讨了是否可以利用导航过程中收集的姿态相关观测数据来有效地估计地形类型。我们使用近端策略优化（PPO）对预训练策略进行了微调，然后收集了机器人在模拟熔岩管环境中跨越平坦和粗糙地形时产生的3D姿态数据。我们的分析表明，机器人俯仰角数据的标准差在这两种地形类型之间表现出明显的差异。我们采用高斯混合模型（GMM）评估了不同窗口大小下的地形分类效果。使用70步窗口时，准确率超过98%。结果表明，短期姿态数据足以进行可靠的地形估计，为自适应策略切换奠定了基础。
tldr: This paper explores using robot pitch data during navigation to classify terrain types in a simulated lunar lava tube environment, achieving high accuracy with Gaussian Mixture Models, which could enable adaptive policy switching for robots.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用机器人导航过程中的俯仰数据来分类模拟月球熔岩管环境中的地形类型，使用高斯混合模型获得了高精度，这可以实现机器人的自适应策略切换。

title: Python Bindings for a Large C++ Robotics Library: The Case of OMPL
summary: Python bindings are a critical bridge between high-performance C++ libraries and the flexibility of Python, enabling rapid prototyping, reproducible experiments, and integration with simulation and learning frameworks in robotics research. Yet, generating bindings for large codebases is a tedious process that creates a heavy burden for a small group of maintainers. In this work, we investigate the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) to assist in generating nanobind wrappers, with human experts kept in the loop. Our workflow mirrors the structure of the C++ codebase, scaffolds empty wrapper files, and employs LLMs to fill in binding definitions. Experts then review and refine the generated code to ensure correctness, compatibility, and performance.
