Through a case study on a large C++ motion planning library, we document common failure modes, including mismanaging shared pointers, overloads, and trampolines, and show how in-context examples and careful prompt design improve reliability. Experiments demonstrate that the resulting bindings achieve runtime performance comparable to legacy solutions. Beyond this case study, our results provide general lessons for applying LLMs to binding generation in large-scale C++ projects.
summary_zh: Python绑定是高性能C++库和Python灵活性之间的关键桥梁，能够在机器人研究中实现快速原型设计、可复现实验，以及与仿真和学习框架的集成。然而，为大型代码库生成绑定是一个繁琐的过程，给一小部分维护人员带来沉重负担。在这项工作中，我们研究了使用大型语言模型（LLMs）来辅助生成nanobind包装器，并保持人类专家参与其中。我们的工作流程模仿C++代码库的结构，搭建空的包装器文件，并利用LLM填充绑定定义。然后，专家审查并完善生成的代码，以确保正确性、兼容性和性能。通过对一个大型C++运动规划库的案例研究，我们记录了常见的失败模式，包括共享指针、重载和跳转表管理不当，并展示了上下文示例和仔细的提示设计如何提高可靠性。实验表明，由此产生的绑定实现了与传统解决方案相当的运行时性能。除了这个案例研究，我们的结果为将LLM应用于大规模C++项目中的绑定生成提供了通用经验。
tldr: This paper explores using Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate the generation of Python bindings for large C++ robotics libraries, specifically OMPL, achieving comparable runtime performance to existing solutions and providing general lessons for similar projects.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用大型语言模型（LLM）自动生成大型 C++ 机器人库（特别是 OMPL）的 Python 绑定，实现了与现有解决方案相当的运行时性能，并为类似的项目提供了通用经验。

title: GIANT - Global Path Integration and Attentive Graph Networks for Multi-Agent Trajectory Planning
summary: This paper presents a novel approach to multi-robot collision avoidance that integrates global path planning with local navigation strategies, utilizing attentive graph neural networks to manage dynamic interactions among agents. We introduce a local navigation model that leverages pre-planned global paths, allowing robots to adhere to optimal routes while dynamically adjusting to environmental changes. The models robustness is enhanced through the introduction of noise during training, resulting in superior performance in complex, dynamic environments. Our approach is evaluated against established baselines, including NH-ORCA, DRL-NAV, and GA3C-CADRL, across various structurally diverse simulated scenarios. The results demonstrate that our model achieves consistently higher success rates, lower collision rates, and more efficient navigation, particularly in challenging scenarios where baseline models struggle. This work offers an advancement in multi-robot navigation, with implications for robust performance in complex, dynamic environments with varying degrees of complexity, such as those encountered in logistics, where adaptability is essential for accommodating unforeseen obstacles and unpredictable changes.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的多机器人避撞方法，该方法集成了全局路径规划和局部导航策略，并利用注意力图神经网络来管理智能体之间的动态交互。我们引入了一个局部导航模型，该模型利用预先规划的全局路径，使机器人能够在遵守最佳路线的同时动态适应环境变化。通过在训练过程中引入噪声，提高了模型的鲁棒性，从而在复杂的动态环境中获得了卓越的性能。我们通过各种结构多样的模拟场景，将我们的方法与已建立的基线方法进行评估，包括 NH-ORCA、DRL-NAV 和 GA3C-CADRL。结果表明，我们的模型在具有挑战性的场景中，即基线模型表现不佳的情况下，始终能够实现更高的成功率、更低的碰撞率和更高效的导航。这项工作为多机器人导航提供了一项进步，对于在复杂的、动态的、且具有不同复杂程度环境中实现稳健的性能具有重要意义，例如在物流中遇到的情况，其中适应性对于适应无法预见的障碍和不可预测的变化至关重要。
tldr: The paper introduces GIANT, a novel approach for multi-robot collision avoidance using attentive graph neural networks and global path integration, achieving superior performance compared to baselines in complex environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为GIANT的新型多机器人避撞方法，该方法使用注意力图神经网络和全局路径积分，与现有方法相比，在复杂环境中实现了更优越的性能。

title: Autonomous Aerial Non-Destructive Testing: Ultrasound Inspection with a Commercial Quadrotor in an Unstructured Environment
summary: This work presents an integrated control and software architecture that enables arguably the first fully autonomous, contact-based non-destructive testing (NDT) using a commercial multirotor originally restricted to remotely-piloted operations. To allow autonomous operation with an off-the-shelf platform, we developed a real-time framework that interfaces directly with its onboard sensor suite. The architecture features a multi-rate control scheme: low-level control is executed at 200 Hz, force estimation at 100 Hz, while an admittance filter and trajectory planner operate at 50 Hz, ultimately supplying acceleration and yaw rate commands to the internal flight controller. We validate the system through physical experiments on a Flyability Elios 3 quadrotor equipped with an ultrasound payload. Relying exclusively on onboard sensing, the vehicle successfully performs autonomous NDT measurements within an unstructured, industrial-like environment. This work demonstrates the viability of retrofitting off-the-shelf platforms for autonomous physical interaction, paving the way for safe, contact-based inspection of hazardous and confined infrastructure.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种集成的控制和软件架构，该架构使得首个完全自主的、基于接触式的无损检测(NDT)成为可能，所使用的平台原本是仅限遥控操作的商用多旋翼飞行器。为了实现基于现有平台的自主操作，我们开发了一个实时框架，该框架直接与机载传感器套件交互。该架构的特点是一种多速率控制方案：底层控制以200赫兹的频率执行，力估计以100赫兹的频率执行，而导纳滤波器和轨迹规划器以50赫兹的频率运行，最终为内置飞行控制器提供加速度和偏航率指令。我们通过在配备超声波载荷的Flyability Elios 3四旋翼飞行器上进行的物理实验来验证该系统。仅依赖机载传感，该飞行器便能在非结构化的、类似工业的环境中成功执行自主NDT测量。这项工作证明了对现有平台进行改造以实现自主物理交互的可行性，为危险和受限基础设施的安全、基于接触的检测铺平了道路。
tldr: This paper presents a system for autonomous non-destructive testing using a commercial quadrotor fitted with an ultrasound payload, demonstrating its capability in unstructured industrial environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种使用配备超声波载荷的商用四旋翼飞行器进行自主无损检测的系统，展示了其在非结构化工业环境中的能力。

title: Risk-Aware Rulebooks for Multi-Objective Trajectory Evaluation under Uncertainty
summary: We present a risk-aware formalism for evaluating system trajectories in the presence of uncertain interactions between the system and its environment. The proposed formalism supports reasoning under uncertainty and systematically handles complex relationships among requirements and objectives, including hierarchical priorities and non-comparability. Rather than treating the environment as exogenous noise, we explicitly model how each system trajectory influences the environment and evaluate trajectories under the resulting distribution of environment responses. We prove that the formalism induces a preorder on the set of system trajectories, ensuring consistency and preventing cyclic preferences. Finally, we illustrate the approach with an autonomous driving example that demonstrates how the formalism enhances explainability by clarifying the rationale behind trajectory selection.
summary_zh: 我们提出一种风险感知的形式化方法，用于在系统与其环境之间存在不确定性交互的情况下评估系统轨迹。所提出的形式化方法支持不确定性推理，并系统地处理需求和目标之间的复杂关系，包括分层优先级和不可比性。我们并非将环境视为外生噪声，而是显式地建模每个系统轨迹如何影响环境，并在由此产生的环境响应分布下评估轨迹。我们证明该形式化方法在系统轨迹集合上诱导出一个预序关系，从而确保一致性并防止循环偏好。最后，我们通过一个自动驾驶示例来展示该方法，该示例表明该形式化方法通过阐明轨迹选择背后的基本原理来增强可解释性。
tldr: This paper introduces a risk-aware formalism for trajectory evaluation under uncertainty, particularly within complex environments like autonomous driving, emphasizing explainability and consistent preferences.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种风险感知的形式化方法，用于在不确定性下评估轨迹，特别是在自动驾驶等复杂环境中，强调可解释性和一致的偏好。

title: ELLIPSE: Evidential Learning for Robust Waypoints and Uncertainties
summary: Robust waypoint prediction is crucial for mobile robots operating in open-world, safety-critical settings. While Imitation Learning (IL) methods have demonstrated great success in practice, they are susceptible to distribution shifts: the policy can become dangerously overconfident in unfamiliar states. In this paper, we present \textit{ELLIPSE}, a method building on multivariate deep evidential regression to output waypoints and multivariate Student-t predictive distributions in a single forward pass. To reduce covariate-shift-induced overconfidence under viewpoint and pose perturbations near expert trajectories, we introduce a lightweight domain augmentation procedure that synthesizes plausible viewpoint/pose variations without collecting additional demonstrations. To improve uncertainty reliability under environment/domain shift (e.g., unseen staircases), we apply a post-hoc isotonic recalibration on probability integral transform (PIT) values so that prediction sets remain plausible during deployment. We ground the discussion and experiments in staircase waypoint prediction, where obtaining robust waypoint and uncertainty is pivotal. Extensive real world evaluations show that \textit{ELLIPSE} improves both task success rate and uncertainty coverage compared to baselines.
summary_zh: 在开放世界和安全关键的环境中运行的移动机器人，鲁棒的路点预测至关重要。虽然模仿学习（IL）方法在实践中已表现出巨大的成功，但它们容易受到分布偏移的影响：策略在不熟悉的状态下可能会变得危险地过于自信。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为\textit{ELLIPSE}的方法，该方法基于多元深度证据回归，可以在一次前向传递中输出路点和多元Student-t预测分布。为了减少专家轨迹附近视角和姿态扰动所引起的协变量偏移导致的过度自信，我们引入了一种轻量级的领域增强程序，该程序在不收集额外演示的情况下合成合理的视角/姿态变化。为了提高环境/领域偏移（例如，未见过的楼梯）下的不确定性可靠性，我们对概率积分变换（PIT）值应用事后等张重校准，以保证预测集在部署期间保持合理。我们以楼梯路点预测为基础进行讨论和实验，其中获得鲁棒的路点和不确定性至关重要。大量的真实世界评估表明，与基线方法相比，\textit{ELLIPSE}提高了任务成功率和不确定性覆盖率。
tldr: The paper introduces ELLIPSE, a method for robust waypoint prediction with calibrated uncertainty estimates using evidential learning, domain augmentation, and isotonic recalibration, demonstrating improved performance in real-world staircase navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了ELLIPSE，一种使用证据学习、领域增强和等渗再校准的鲁棒路径点预测方法，该方法具有校准的不确定性估计，并在现实世界的楼梯导航中表现出改进的性能。

title: Many-RRT*: Robust Joint-Space Trajectory Planning for Serial Manipulators
summary: The rapid advancement of high degree-of-freedom (DoF) serial manipulators necessitates the use of swift, sampling-based motion planners for high-dimensional spaces. While sampling-based planners like the Rapidly-Exploring Random Tree (RRT) are widely used, planning in the manipulator's joint space presents significant challenges due to non-invertible forward kinematics. A single task-space end-effector pose can correspond to multiple configuration-space states, creating a multi-arm bandit problem for the planner. In complex environments, simply choosing the wrong joint space goal can result in suboptimal trajectories or even failure to find a viable plan. To address this planning problem, we propose Many-RRT*: an extension of RRT*-Connect that plans to multiple goals in parallel. By generating multiple IK solutions and growing independent trees from these goal configurations simultaneously alongside a single start tree, Many-RRT* ensures that computational effort is not wasted on suboptimal IK solutions. This approach maintains robust convergence and asymptotic optimality. Experimental evaluations across robot morphologies and diverse obstacle environments demonstrate that Many-RRT* provides higher quality trajectories (44.5% lower cost in the same runtime) with a significantly higher success rate (100% vs. the next best of 1.6%) than previous RRT iterations without compromising on runtime performance.
summary_zh: 高自由度串联机械臂的快速发展，促使人们在高维空间中使用快速的基于采样的运动规划器。虽然像快速探索随机树(RRT)这样的基于采样的规划器被广泛使用，但由于不可逆的正向运动学，在机械臂关节空间中进行规划面临着重大挑战。单个任务空间末端执行器姿态可能对应于多个配置空间状态，从而为规划器创建了一个多臂老虎机问题。在复杂环境中，仅仅选择错误的关节空间目标就可能导致次优轨迹，甚至无法找到可行的规划。为了解决这个规划问题，我们提出了Many-RRT*: 它是RRT*-Connect的扩展，能够并行地规划到多个目标。通过生成多个逆运动学(IK)解，并与单个起始树同时从这些目标配置中增长独立的树，Many-RRT*确保计算资源不会浪费在次优的IK解上。这种方法保持了鲁棒的收敛性和渐近最优性。在不同的机器人形态和各种障碍环境中的实验评估表明，与之前的RRT迭代算法相比，Many-RRT*提供了更高质量的轨迹（在相同的运行时间内成本降低了44.5%），并且具有明显更高的成功率（100% vs. 次优的1.6% ），而且不以牺牲运行时间性能为代价。
tldr: The paper introduces Many-RRT*, an extension of RRT*-Connect for robotic trajectory planning, which simultaneously explores multiple inverse kinematics solutions to significantly improve trajectory quality and success rate in complex environments without compromising runtime.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Many-RRT*，这是 RRT*-Connect 的扩展，用于机器人轨迹规划，它同时探索多个逆运动学解决方案，从而在不影响运行时间的情况下显著提高复杂环境中轨迹的质量和成功率。

title: PTLD: Sim-to-real Privileged Tactile Latent Distillation for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Tactile dexterous manipulation is essential to automating complex household tasks, yet learning effective control policies remains a challenge. While recent work has relied on imitation learning, obtaining high quality demonstrations for multi-fingered hands via robot teleoperation or kinesthetic teaching is prohibitive. Alternatively, with reinforcement we can learn skills in simulation, but fast and realistic simulation of tactile observations is challenging. To bridge this gap, we introduce PTLD: sim-to-real Privileged Tactile Latent Distillation, a novel approach to learning tactile manipulation skills without requiring tactile simulation. Instead of simulating tactile sensors or relying purely on proprioceptive policies to transfer zero-shot sim-to-real, our key idea is to leverage privileged sensors in the real world to collect real-world tactile policy data. This data is then used to distill a robust state estimator that operates on tactile input. We demonstrate from our experiments that PTLD can be used to improve proprioceptive manipulation policies trained in simulation significantly by incorporating tactile sensing. On the benchmark in-hand rotation task, PTLD achieves a 182% improvement over a proprioception only policy. We also show that PTLD enables learning the challenging task of tactile in-hand reorientation where we see a 57% improvement in the number of goals reached over using proprioception alone. Website: https://akashsharma02.github.io/ptld-website/.
summary_zh: 触觉灵巧操作对于自动化复杂的家务任务至关重要，但学习有效的控制策略仍然是一个挑战。虽然最近的工作依赖于模仿学习，但通过机器人遥操作或动觉示教来获得多指手的优质演示是难以实现的。 或者，通过强化学习我们可以在仿真环境中学习技能，但快速且真实的触觉观察仿真具有挑战性。 为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了PTLD：sim-to-real 特权触觉潜在蒸馏，这是一种新颖的方法，可以在不需要触觉仿真的情况下学习触觉操作技能。我们的主要思想不是模拟触觉传感器或仅仅依赖本体感受策略来实现零样本sim-to-real迁移，而是利用现实世界中的特权传感器来收集现实世界的触觉策略数据。 这些数据随后被用于提炼一个在触觉输入上运行的鲁棒的状态估计器。 我们的实验表明，PTLD可以通过整合触觉感应，显著改善在仿真环境中训练的本体感受操作策略。 在基准的掌内旋转任务中，PTLD比仅使用本体感受的策略实现了182%的改进。 我们还表明，PTLD能够学习具有挑战性的触觉掌内重定向任务，在该任务中，我们观察到与单独使用本体感受相比，目标到达数量增加了57%。 项目网站：https://akashsharma02.github.io/ptld-website/。
tldr: The paper introduces PTLD, a novel sim-to-real approach for tactile dexterous manipulation that uses privileged real-world tactile sensors to distill a robust state estimator, improving proprioceptive manipulation policies trained in simulation without relying on tactile simulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PTLD，一种新颖的触觉灵巧操作的模拟到真实的方法，它使用特权的真实世界触觉传感器来提炼一个强大的状态估计器，在不依赖触觉模拟的情况下，显著改善了模拟中训练的本体感受操作策略。

title: Logi-PAR: Logic-Infused Patient Activity Recognition via Differentiable Rule
summary: Patient Activity Recognition (PAR) in clinical settings uses activity data to improve safety and quality of care. Although significant progress has been made, current models mainly identify which activity is occurring. They often spatially compose sub-sparse visual cues using global and local attention mechanisms, yet only learn logically implicit patterns due to their neural-pipeline. Advancing clinical safety requires methods that can infer why a set of visual cues implies a risk, and how these can be compositionally reasoned through explicit logic beyond mere classification. To address this, we proposed Logi-PAR, the first Logic-Infused Patient Activity Recognition Framework that integrates contextual fact fusion as a multi-view primitive extractor and injects neural-guided differentiable rules. Our method automatically learns rules from visual cues, optimizing them end-to-end while enabling the implicit emergence patterns to be explicitly labelled during training. To the best of our knowledge, Logi-PAR is the first framework to recognize patient activity by applying learnable logic rules to symbolic mappings. It produces auditable why explanations as rule traces and supports counterfactual interventions (e.g., risk would decrease by 65% if assistance were present). Extensive evaluation on clinical benchmarks (VAST and OmniFall) demonstrates state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming Vision-Language Models and transformer baselines. The code is available via: https://github.com/zararkhan985/Logi-PAR.git}
summary_zh: 临床环境下的患者活动识别 (PAR) 利用活动数据来提高安全性和护理质量。尽管已经取得了显著进展，但目前的模型主要识别正在发生的活动。它们通常使用全局和局部注意力机制在空间上组合稀疏的视觉线索，但由于其神经管道的特性，只能学习到逻辑上隐式的模式。提升临床安全性需要能够推断出一组视觉线索为何暗示风险，以及如何通过显式逻辑进行组合推理的方法，而不仅仅是单纯的分类。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 Logi-PAR，这是第一个逻辑注入的患者活动识别框架，它集成了上下文事实融合作为多视图原始特征提取器，并注入了神经引导的可微规则。我们的方法自动地从视觉线索中学习规则，对其进行端到端优化，同时使得在训练期间能够显式地标记隐式涌现的模式。据我们所知，Logi-PAR 是第一个通过应用可学习的逻辑规则到符号映射来识别患者活动的框架。它产生可审计的因果解释作为规则追踪，并支持反事实干预（例如，如果提供协助，风险将降低 65%）。在临床基准数据集（VAST 和 OmniFall）上的广泛评估表明，该方法实现了最先进的性能，显著优于视觉-语言模型和 Transformer 基线。代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/zararkhan985/Logi-PAR.git
tldr: The paper introduces Logi-PAR, a novel framework for patient activity recognition that integrates contextual information and learns differentiable logic rules from visual cues for explainable and improved performance, outperforming existing vision-language models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Logi-PAR，一种用于患者活动识别的新型框架，集成了上下文信息并从视觉线索中学习可微分的逻辑规则，以实现可解释和改进的性能，优于现有的视觉-语言模型。

title: BioLLMAgent: A Hybrid Framework with Enhanced Structural Interpretability for Simulating Human Decision-Making in Computational Psychiatry
summary: Computational psychiatry faces a fundamental trade-off: traditional reinforcement learning (RL) models offer interpretability but lack behavioral realism, while large language model (LLM) agents generate realistic behaviors but lack structural interpretability. We introduce BioLLMAgent, a novel hybrid framework that combines validated cognitive models with the generative capabilities of LLMs. The framework comprises three core components: (i) an Internal RL Engine for experience-driven value learning; (ii) an External LLM Shell for high-level cognitive strategies and therapeutic interventions; and (iii) a Decision Fusion Mechanism for integrating components via weighted utility. Comprehensive experiments on the Iowa Gambling Task (IGT) across six clinical and healthy datasets demonstrate that BioLLMAgent accurately reproduces human behavioral patterns while maintaining excellent parameter identifiability (correlations $>0.67$). Furthermore, the framework successfully simulates cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) principles and reveals, through multi-agent dynamics, that community-wide educational interventions may outperform individual treatments. Validated across reward-punishment learning and temporal discounting tasks, BioLLMAgent provides a structurally interpretable "computational sandbox" for testing mechanistic hypotheses and intervention strategies in psychiatric research.
summary_zh: 计算精神病学面临着一个根本性的权衡：传统的强化学习（RL）模型具有可解释性，但缺乏行为的真实性，而大型语言模型（LLM）代理能够生成逼真的行为，但缺乏结构性的可解释性。我们提出了BioLLMAgent，一种新颖的混合框架，它将经过验证的认知模型与LLM的生成能力相结合。该框架包含三个核心组成部分：（i）用于经验驱动价值学习的内部RL引擎；（ii）用于高级认知策略和治疗干预的外部LLM外壳；以及（iii）用于通过加权效用整合各个组成部分的决策融合机制。在六个临床和健康数据集上进行的艾奥瓦赌博任务（IGT）的全面实验表明，BioLLMAgent能够准确地重现人类的行为模式，同时保持出色的参数可识别性（相关性>0.67）。此外，该框架成功地模拟了认知行为疗法（CBT）的原则，并通过多主体动态揭示了社区范围内的教育干预可能优于个体治疗。经过奖励-惩罚学习和时间折扣任务的验证，BioLLMAgent提供了一个结构上可解释的“计算沙盒”，用于在精神病学研究中测试机制性假设和干预策略。
tldr: The paper introduces BioLLMAgent, a hybrid framework combining reinforcement learning and large language models for simulating human decision-making in computational psychiatry, achieving both behavioral realism and structural interpretability.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了BioLLMAgent，一个结合了强化学习和大型语言模型的混合框架，用于模拟计算精神病学中的人类决策，实现了行为真实性和结构可解释性。

title: SCoUT: Scalable Communication via Utility-Guided Temporal Grouping in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Communication can improve coordination in partially observed multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), but learning \emph{when} and \emph{who} to communicate with requires choosing among many possible sender-recipient pairs, and the effect of any single message on future reward is hard to isolate. We introduce \textbf{SCoUT} (\textbf{S}calable \textbf{Co}mmunication via \textbf{U}tility-guided \textbf{T}emporal grouping), which addresses both these challenges via temporal and agent abstraction within traditional MARL. During training, SCoUT resamples \textit{soft} agent groups every \(K\) environment steps (macro-steps) via Gumbel-Softmax; these groups are latent clusters that induce an affinity used as a differentiable prior over recipients. Using the same assignments, a group-aware critic predicts values for each agent group and maps them to per-agent baselines through the same soft assignments, reducing critic complexity and variance. Each agent is trained with a three-headed policy: environment action, send decision, and recipient selection. To obtain precise communication learning signals, we derive counterfactual communication advantages by analytically removing each sender's contribution from the recipient's aggregated messages. This counterfactual computation enables precise credit assignment for both send and recipient-selection decisions. At execution time, all centralized training components are discarded and only the per-agent policy is run, preserving decentralized execution. Project website, videos and code: \hyperlink{https://scout-comm.github.io/}{https://scout-comm.github.io/}
summary_zh: 通信能够提升部分可观测多智能体强化学习 (MARL) 中的协作，但学习与 \emph{何时} 以及与 \emph{哪些} 智能体通信，需要在众多可能的发送者-接收者对中进行选择，且任何单条消息对未来奖励的影响都难以隔离。我们提出了 \textbf{SCoUT} (\textbf{S}calable \textbf{Co}mmunication via \textbf{U}tility-guided \textbf{T}emporal grouping，基于效用引导的时间分组的可\textbf{S}伸缩\textbf{Co}mmunication)，其通过传统 MARL 内的时间和智能体抽象来应对上述两个挑战。在训练期间，SCoUT 通过 Gumbel-Softmax 每 \(K\) 个环境步骤（宏步）重新采样 \textit{软} 智能体组；这些组是潜在的聚类，其诱导一种亲和力，用作接收者的可微先验。使用相同的分配，一个组感知的评论家预测每个智能体组的值，并通过相同的软分配将它们映射到各个智能体的基线，从而降低评论家的复杂性和方差。每个智能体都使用一个三头策略进行训练：环境动作、发送决策和接收者选择。为了获得精确的通信学习信号，我们通过从接收者的聚合消息中解析地去除每个发送者的贡献，从而导出反事实通信优势。这种反事实计算能够为发送和接收者选择决策提供精确的信用分配。在执行时，所有中心化训练组件都被丢弃，仅运行每个智能体的策略，从而保留了去中心化的执行。项目网站、视频和代码：\hyperlink{https://scout-comm.github.io/}{https://scout-comm.github.io/}
tldr: The paper introduces SCoUT, a MARL method that uses utility-guided temporal grouping with counterfactual advantages for scalable and precise communication learning, enabling decentralized execution.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了SCoUT，一种MARL方法，它采用效用引导的时间分组和反事实优势来实现可扩展和精确的通信学习，从而实现分散式执行。

title: HiMAP-Travel: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Planning for Long-Horizon Constrained Travel
summary: Sequential LLM agents fail on long-horizon planning with hard constraints like budgets and diversity requirements. As planning progresses and context grows, these agents drift from global constraints. We propose HiMAP-Travel, a hierarchical multi-agent framework that splits planning into strategic coordination and parallel day-level execution. A Coordinator allocates resources across days, while Day Executors plan independently in parallel. Three key mechanisms enable this: a transactional monitor enforcing budget and uniqueness constraints across parallel agents, a bargaining protocol allowing agents to reject infeasible sub-goals and trigger re-planning, and a single policy trained with GRPO that powers all agents through role conditioning. On TravelPlanner, HiMAP-Travel with Qwen3-8B achieves 52.78% validation and 52.65% test Final Pass Rate (FPR). In a controlled comparison with identical model, training, and tools, it outperforms the sequential DeepTravel baseline by +8.67~pp. It also surpasses ATLAS by +17.65~pp and MTP by +10.0~pp. On FlexTravelBench multi-turn scenarios, it achieves 44.34% (2-turn) and 37.42% (3-turn) FPR while reducing latency 2.5x through parallelization.
summary_zh: 顺序LLM智能体在具有预算和多样性要求等硬约束的长期规划中表现不佳。随着规划的进行和上下文的增长，这些智能体逐渐偏离全局约束。我们提出了HiMAP-Travel，一个分层多智能体框架，将规划分解为战略协调和并行的日级执行。一个协调器在不同日期之间分配资源，而日级执行器并行地独立规划。三个关键机制实现了这一点：一个事务性监视器，用于跨并行智能体强制执行预算和唯一性约束；一个允许智能体拒绝不可行的子目标并触发重新规划的协商协议；以及一个用GRPO训练的单一策略，通过角色条件化为所有智能体提供支持。在 TravelPlanner 上，使用 Qwen3-8B 的 HiMAP-Travel 实现了 52.78% 的验证集和 52.65% 的测试集最终通过率 (FPR)。在与使用相同模型、训练和工具的受控实验中，它比顺序 DeepTravel 基线高出 +8.67 个百分点。它也超过了 ATLAS +17.65 个百分点， MTP +10.0 个百分点。在 FlexTravelBench 多轮场景中，它实现了 44.34%（2 轮）和 37.42%（3 轮）的 FPR，同时通过并行化将延迟降低了 2.5 倍。
tldr: HiMAP-Travel introduces a hierarchical multi-agent planning framework using a coordinator and parallel day-level executors, achieving state-of-the-art performance on long-horizon travel planning with constraints by using Qwen3-8B and a new training paradigm called GRPO.
tldr_zh: HiMAP-Travel 提出了一种分层多代理规划框架，使用协调器和并行的天级执行器，通过使用 Qwen3-8B 和一种名为 GRPO 的新训练范式，在具有约束的远程旅行规划中实现了最先进的性能。

title: Visioning Human-Agentic AI Teaming: Continuity, Tension, and Future Research
summary: Artificial intelligence is undergoing a structural transformation marked by the rise of agentic systems capable of open-ended action trajectories, generative representations and outputs, and evolving objectives. These properties introduce structural uncertainty into human-AI teaming (HAT), including uncertainty about behavior trajectories, epistemic grounding, and the stability of governing logics over time. Under such conditions, alignment cannot be secured through agreement on bounded outputs; it must be continuously sustained as plans unfold and priorities shift. We advance Team Situation Awareness (Team SA) theory, grounded in shared perception, comprehension, and projection, as an integrative anchor for this transition. While Team SA remains analytically foundational, its stabilizing logic presumes that shared awareness, once achieved, will support coordinated action through iterative updating. Agentic AI challenges this presumption. Our argument unfolds in two stages: first, we extend Team SA to reconceptualize both human and AI awareness under open-ended agency, including the sensemaking of projection congruence across heterogeneous systems. Second, we interrogate whether the dynamic processes traditionally assumed to stabilize teaming in relational interaction, cognitive learning, and coordination and control continue to function under adaptive autonomy. By distinguishing continuity from tension, we clarify where foundational insights hold and where structural uncertainty introduces strain, and articulate a forward-looking research agenda for HAT. The central challenge of HAT is not whether humans and AI can agree in the moment, but whether they can remain aligned as futures are continuously generated, revised, enacted, and governed over time.
summary_zh: 人工智能正在经历一场结构性转型，其标志是涌现出具有开放式行动轨迹、生成式表征与输出以及不断演化目标的主动系统。这些特性给人类-人工智能团队协作（HAT）带来了结构性不确定性，包括行为轨迹、认知基础和控制逻辑随时间推移的稳定性等方面的不确定性。在这种情况下，对齐无法通过对有限输出的共识来确保，而必须在计划展开和优先级转移的过程中持续维持。我们以共享感知、理解和预测为基础，推进团队情境意识（Team SA）理论，将其作为这一转变的整合锚点。虽然团队情境意识在分析上仍然具有基础性，但其稳定逻辑假定，一旦达成共享意识，它将通过迭代更新来支持协调行动。主动型人工智能挑战了这一假设。我们的论证分两个阶段进行：首先，我们扩展团队情境意识，以重新概念化开放式主动性下的人和人工智能的意识，包括对异构系统间预测一致性的理解。其次，我们探讨传统上认为能在关系互动、认知学习以及协调和控制中稳定团队协作的动态过程，在自适应自主性下是否继续发挥作用。通过区分连续性和张力，我们阐明了基础性见解在何处适用，以及结构性不确定性在何处引入压力，并阐述了一个面向未来的HAT研究议程。HAT的核心挑战不是人类和人工智能是否能在当下达成一致，而是它们在未来不断生成、修订、实施和管理的过程中，能否保持对齐。
tldr: This paper examines the challenges that agentic AI systems (capable of open-ended actions and evolving objectives) pose for human-AI teaming, proposing to adapt Team Situation Awareness theory to handle uncertainty and maintain alignment over time. It identifies areas of continuity and tension in traditional teaming approaches, suggesting a forward-looking research agenda.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了具有开放式行动和不断变化目标的智能AI系统对人机协作带来的挑战，并提出调整团队情境意识理论以应对不确定性并维持长期对齐。它确定了传统协作方法中的连续性和紧张性领域，并提出了前瞻性的研究议程。

title: Robustness of Agentic AI Systems via Adversarially-Aligned Jacobian Regularization
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) transition into autonomous multi-agent ecosystems, robust minimax training becomes essential yet remains prone to instability when highly non-linear policies induce extreme local curvature in the inner maximization. Standard remedies that enforce global Jacobian bounds are overly conservative, suppressing sensitivity in all directions and inducing a large Price of Robustness. We introduce Adversarially-Aligned Jacobian Regularization (AAJR), a trajectory-aligned approach that controls sensitivity strictly along adversarial ascent directions. We prove that AAJR yields a strictly larger admissible policy class than global constraints under mild conditions, implying a weakly smaller approximation gap and reduced nominal performance degradation. Furthermore, we derive step-size conditions under which AAJR controls effective smoothness along optimization trajectories and ensures inner-loop stability. These results provide a structural theory for agentic robustness that decouples minimax stability from global expressivity restrictions.
summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）过渡到自主多智能体生态系统，稳健的极小极大训练变得至关重要，但当高度非线性策略在内部最大化中引起极端的局部曲率时，仍然容易出现不稳定。强制全局雅可比矩阵边界的标准方法过于保守，抑制了所有方向上的敏感性，并导致了巨大的稳健性代价。我们引入了对抗对齐的雅可比矩阵正则化（AAJR），这是一种轨迹对齐的方法，严格控制了沿对抗性上升方向的敏感性。我们证明，在温和条件下，AAJR 相比于全局约束，会产生严格更大的容许策略类，这意味着近似差距的减小和标称性能退化的降低。此外，我们推导出步长条件，在该条件下，AAJR 控制了沿优化轨迹的有效平滑性，并确保了内循环的稳定性。这些结果为智能体稳健性提供了一个结构性理论，将极小极大稳定性与全局表达性限制解耦。
tldr: The paper introduces Adversarially-Aligned Jacobian Regularization (AAJR) to improve the robustness of agentic AI systems, specifically LLMs in multi-agent settings, by addressing minimax training instability without sacrificing nominal performance through excessive global Jacobian constraints. They provide theoretical guarantees for AAJR's improved policy class and optimization stability.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种对抗对齐雅可比正则化（AAJR）方法，旨在提高智能体AI系统的鲁棒性，特别是多智能体环境中的LLM，并通过解决minimax训练的不稳定性，同时避免牺牲全局雅可比约束带来的标称性能下降。他们为AAJR更好的策略类和优化稳定性提供了理论保证。

title: CATNet: Collaborative Alignment and Transformation Network for Cooperative Perception
summary: Cooperative perception significantly enhances scene understanding by integrating complementary information from diverse agents. However, existing research often overlooks critical challenges inherent in real-world multi-source data integration, specifically high temporal latency and multi-source noise. To address these practical limitations, we propose Collaborative Alignment and Transformation Network (CATNet), an adaptive compensation framework that resolves temporal latency and noise interference in multi-agent systems. Our key innovations can be summarized in three aspects. First, we introduce a Spatio-Temporal Recurrent Synchronization (STSync) that aligns asynchronous feature streams via adjacent-frame differential modeling, establishing a temporal-spatially unified representation space. Second, we design a Dual-Branch Wavelet Enhanced Denoiser (WTDen) that suppresses global noise and reconstructs localized feature distortions within aligned representations. Third, we construct an Adaptive Feature Selector (AdpSel) that dynamically focuses on critical perceptual features for robust fusion. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that CATNet consistently outperforms existing methods under complex traffic conditions, proving its superior robustness and adaptability.
summary_zh: 合作感知通过整合来自不同智能体的互补信息，显著增强对场景的理解。然而，现有的研究往往忽略了真实世界多源数据集成中固有的关键挑战，特别是高时间延迟和多源噪声。为了解决这些实际限制，我们提出了一种协作对齐与转换网络（CATNet），一个自适应补偿框架，用于解决多智能体系统中的时间延迟和噪声干扰。我们的主要创新可以概括为三个方面。首先，我们引入了一种时空循环同步（STSync），通过相邻帧差分建模对齐异步特征流，从而建立一个时空统一的表示空间。其次，我们设计了一种双分支小波增强去噪器（WTDen），它抑制全局噪声并重建对齐表示中的局部特征失真。第三，我们构建了一个自适应特征选择器（AdpSel），它动态地关注关键感知特征以实现稳健的融合。在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，在复杂的交通状况下，CATNet始终优于现有方法，证明了其卓越的鲁棒性和适应性。
tldr: CATNet is a novel cooperative perception framework that handles temporal latency and multi-source noise through spatio-temporal synchronization, wavelet-enhanced denoising, and adaptive feature selection, demonstrating superior performance in complex traffic conditions.
tldr_zh: CATNet是一个新型的协同感知框架，通过时空同步、小波增强去噪和自适应特征选择来处理时间延迟和多源噪声，并在复杂的交通条件下表现出卓越的性能。

title: TAPFormer: Robust Arbitrary Point Tracking via Transient Asynchronous Fusion of Frames and Events
summary: Tracking any point (TAP) is a fundamental yet challenging task in computer vision, requiring high precision and long-term motion reasoning. Recent attempts to combine RGB frames and event streams have shown promise, yet they typically rely on synchronous or non-adaptive fusion, leading to temporal misalignment and severe degradation when one modality fails. We introduce TAPFormer, a transformer-based framework that performs asynchronous temporal-consistent fusion of frames and events for robust and high-frequency arbitrary point tracking. Our key innovation is a Transient Asynchronous Fusion (TAF) mechanism, which explicitly models the temporal evolution between discrete frames through continuous event updates, bridging the gap between low-rate frames and high-rate events. In addition, a Cross-modal Locally Weighted Fusion (CLWF) module adaptively adjusts spatial attention according to modality reliability, yielding stable and discriminative features even under blur or low light. To evaluate our approach under realistic conditions, we construct a novel real-world frame-event TAP dataset under diverse illumination and motion conditions. Our method outperforms existing point trackers, achieving a 28.2% improvement in average pixel error within threshold. Moreover, on standard point tracking benchmarks, our tracker consistently achieves the best performance. Project website: tapformer.github.io
summary_zh: 跟踪任意点（TAP）是计算机视觉中一项基础但具有挑战性的任务，它需要高精度和长期的运动推理。最近结合RGB帧和事件流的尝试显示出前景，但它们通常依赖于同步或非自适应融合，当一种模态失效时，会导致时间上的错位和严重的性能下降。我们提出了 TAPFormer，一个基于 Transformer 的框架，用于对帧和事件进行异步的、时间一致性的融合，以实现鲁棒和高频率的任意点跟踪。我们的关键创新是一种瞬态异步融合（TAF）机制，该机制通过连续的事件更新显式地对离散帧之间的时间演化进行建模，从而弥合了低帧率帧和高帧率事件之间的差距。此外，跨模态局部加权融合（CLWF）模块根据模态的可靠性自适应地调整空间注意力，即使在模糊或低光照条件下也能产生稳定且具有区分性的特征。为了在真实条件下评估我们的方法，我们构建了一个新的真实世界帧-事件 TAP 数据集，该数据集涵盖了各种光照和运动条件。我们的方法优于现有的点跟踪器，在阈值范围内平均像素误差提高了 28.2%。此外，在标准点跟踪基准测试中，我们的跟踪器始终取得最佳性能。项目网站：tapformer.github.io
tldr: The paper introduces TAPFormer, a transformer-based framework for robust point tracking using asynchronous fusion of frames and event streams, achieving state-of-the-art performance on various datasets, including a novel real-world frame-event TAP dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为TAPFormer的基于Transformer的框架，用于通过异步融合帧和事件流来实现鲁棒的点跟踪。该方法在各种数据集上取得了最先进的性能，包括一个新的真实世界的帧-事件TAP数据集。

title: SURE: Semi-dense Uncertainty-REfined Feature Matching
summary: Establishing reliable image correspondences is essential for many robotic vision problems. However, existing methods often struggle in challenging scenarios with large viewpoint changes or textureless regions, where incorrect cor- respondences may still receive high similarity scores. This is mainly because conventional models rely solely on fea- ture similarity, lacking an explicit mechanism to estimate the reliability of predicted matches, leading to overconfident errors. To address this issue, we propose SURE, a Semi- dense Uncertainty-REfined matching framework that jointly predicts correspondences and their confidence by modeling both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties. Our approach in- troduces a novel evidential head for trustworthy coordinate regression, along with a lightweight spatial fusion module that enhances local feature precision with minimal overhead. We evaluated our method on multiple standard benchmarks, where it consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art semi-dense matching models in both accuracy and efficiency. our code will be available on https://github.com/LSC-ALAN/SURE.
summary_zh: 建立可靠的图像对应关系对于许多机器人视觉问题至关重要。 然而，现有方法在具有大视点变化或无纹理区域的具有挑战性的场景中经常遇到困难，在这些场景中，不正确的对应关系仍然可能获得高相似度评分。 这主要是因为传统模型仅依赖于特征相似性，缺乏显式机制来估计预测匹配的可靠性，从而导致过度自信的错误。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SURE，一种半稠密不确定性精炼匹配框架，通过对偶然不确定性和认知不确定性建模，联合预测对应关系及其置信度。 我们的方法引入了一种用于可信坐标回归的新型证据头，以及一个轻量级的空间融合模块，该模块以最小的开销增强了局部特征的精度。 我们在多个标准基准上评估了我们的方法，结果表明，在准确性和效率方面，该方法始终优于现有的最先进的半稠密匹配模型。 我们的代码将在https://github.com/LSC-ALAN/SURE上提供。
tldr: The paper introduces SURE, a semi-dense feature matching framework that jointly predicts correspondences and their confidence by modeling both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties to improve robustness in challenging visual scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SURE，一种半稠密特征匹配框架，通过对偶然和认知不确定性进行建模，联合预测对应关系及其置信度，从而提高在具有挑战性的视觉场景中的鲁棒性。

title: Replaying pre-training data improves fine-tuning
summary: To obtain a language model for a target domain (e.g. math), the current paradigm is to pre-train on a vast amount of generic web text and then fine-tune on the relatively limited amount of target data. Typically, generic data is only mixed in during fine-tuning to prevent catastrophic forgetting of the generic domain. We surprisingly find that replaying the generic data during fine-tuning can actually improve performance on the (less related) target task. Concretely, in a controlled pre-training environment with 4M target tokens, 4B total tokens, and 150M parameter models, generic replay increases target data efficiency by up to $1.87\times$ for fine-tuning and $2.06\times$ for mid-training. We further analyze data schedules that introduce target data during pre-training and find that replay helps more when there is less target data present in pre-training. We demonstrate the success of replay in practice for fine-tuning 8B parameter models, improving agentic web navigation success by $4.5\%$ and Basque question-answering accuracy by $2\%$.
summary_zh: 为了获得目标领域（如数学）的语言模型，目前的范式是在大量通用网络文本上进行预训练，然后在相对有限的目标数据上进行微调。通常，仅在微调期间混合通用数据以防止通用领域的灾难性遗忘。我们惊人地发现，在微调期间重放通用数据实际上可以提高在（关联度较低的）目标任务上的性能。具体来说，在一个受控的预训练环境中，拥有 400 万个目标 token，总共 40 亿个 token 和 1.5 亿参数的模型，通用数据重放将微调的目标数据效率提高了高达 1.87 倍，将中间训练的目标数据效率提高了高达 2.06 倍。我们进一步分析了在预训练期间引入目标数据的数据调度策略，发现当预训练中存在的目标数据较少时，重放的帮助更大。我们通过微调 80 亿参数的模型，在实践中展示了重放的成功之处，将智能体网络导航成功率提高了 4.5%，并将巴斯克语问答准确率提高了 2%。
tldr: This paper surprisingly finds that replaying generic pre-training data during fine-tuning actually improves performance on target tasks, especially when the pre-training data contains limited target data. They demonstrate improvements in web navigation and question-answering.
tldr_zh: 该论文发现，在微调期间重放通用预训练数据实际上可以提高目标任务的性能，尤其是在预训练数据包含的目标数据有限的情况下。他们展示了在网络导航和问答方面的改进。

title: U-Parking: Distributed UWB-Assisted Autonomous Parking System with Robust Localization and Intelligent Planning
summary: This demonstration presents U-Parking, a distributed Ultra-Wideband (UWB)-assisted autonomous parking system. By integrating Large Language Models (LLMs)-assisted planning with robust fusion localization and trajectory tracking, it enables reliable automated parking in challenging indoor environments, as validated through real-vehicle demonstrations.
summary_zh: 此演示展示了U-Parking，一个基于分布式超宽带（UWB）辅助的自动泊车系统。通过将大型语言模型（LLM）辅助的规划与鲁棒的融合定位和轨迹跟踪相结合，它能够在具有挑战性的室内环境中实现可靠的自动泊车，这已通过实车演示验证。
tldr: The paper demonstrates U-Parking, an autonomous parking system utilizing UWB, LLM-assisted planning, robust localization and trajectory tracking for reliable automated parking in indoor environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文展示了U-Parking，一个利用UWB，LLM辅助规划，鲁棒定位和轨迹跟踪的自动泊车系统，可在室内环境中实现可靠的自动泊车。

title: Loop Closure via Maximal Cliques in 3D LiDAR-Based SLAM
summary: Reliable loop closure detection remains a critical challenge in 3D LiDAR-based SLAM, especially under sensor noise, environmental ambiguity, and viewpoint variation conditions. RANSAC is often used in the context of loop closures for geometric model fitting in the presence of outliers. However, this approach may fail, leading to map inconsistency. We introduce a novel deterministic algorithm, CliReg, for loop closure validation that replaces RANSAC verification with a maximal clique search over a compatibility graph of feature correspondences. This formulation avoids random sampling and increases robustness in the presence of noise and outliers. We integrated our approach into a real- time pipeline employing binary 3D descriptors and a Hamming distance embedding binary search tree-based matching. We evaluated it on multiple real-world datasets featuring diverse LiDAR sensors. The results demonstrate that our proposed technique consistently achieves a lower pose error and more reliable loop closures than RANSAC, especially in sparse or ambiguous conditions. Additional experiments on 2D projection-based maps confirm its generality across spatial domains, making our approach a robust and efficient alternative for loop closure detection.
summary_zh: 在基于3D激光雷达的SLAM中，可靠的回环检测仍然是一个关键挑战，尤其是在传感器噪声、环境模糊和视点变化条件下。RANSAC常用于回环检测中，用于在存在异常值的情况下进行几何模型拟合。然而，这种方法可能会失败，导致地图不一致。我们引入了一种新的确定性算法CliReg，用于回环验证，它用最大团搜索特征对应关系的兼容性图来代替RANSAC验证。这种公式避免了随机抽样，并提高了在存在噪声和异常值时的鲁棒性。我们将我们的方法集成到一个实时流水线中，该流水线采用二进制3D描述符和一个基于哈明距离嵌入的二叉搜索树匹配。我们对多个具有不同激光雷达传感器的真实世界数据集进行了评估。结果表明，与RANSAC相比，我们提出的技术始终能够实现更低的位姿误差和更可靠的回环，尤其是在稀疏或模糊的条件下。在基于2D投影的地图上进行的额外实验证实了其在空间域的通用性，使我们的方法成为回环检测一个鲁棒且高效的替代方案。
tldr: This paper introduces CliReg, a novel deterministic loop closure validation algorithm for 3D LiDAR SLAM that replaces RANSAC with maximal clique search, demonstrating improved robustness and accuracy, especially in challenging environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为CliReg的新型确定性回环闭合验证算法，用于3D激光雷达SLAM。该算法通过寻找最大团来替代RANSAC，从而在具有挑战性的环境中表现出更高的鲁棒性和准确性。

title: Curve-Induced Dynamical Systems on Riemannian Manifolds and Lie Groups
summary: Deploying robots in household environments requires safe, adaptable, and interpretable behaviors that respect the geometric structure of tasks. Often represented on Lie groups and Riemannian manifolds, this includes poses on SE(3) or symmetric positive definite matrices encoding stiffness or damping matrices. In this context, dynamical system-based approaches offer a natural framework for generating such behavior, providing stability and convergence while remaining responsive to changes in the environment. We introduce Curve-induced Dynamical systems on Smooth Manifolds (CDSM), a real-time framework for constructing dynamical systems directly on Riemannian manifolds and Lie groups. The proposed approach constructs a nominal curve on the manifold, and generates a dynamical system which combines a tangential component that drives motion along the curve and a normal component that attracts the state toward the curve. We provide a stability analysis of the resulting dynamical system and validate the method quantitatively. On an S2 benchmark, CDSM demonstrates improved trajectory accuracy, reduced path deviation, and faster generation and query times compared to state-of-the-art methods. Finally, we demonstrate the practical applicability of the framework on both a robotic manipulator, where poses on SE(3) and damping matrices on SPD(n) are adapted online, and a mobile manipulator.
summary_zh: 在家庭环境中部署机器人需要安全、适应性强且可解释的行为，这些行为要符合任务的几何结构。这些结构通常用李群和黎曼流形表示，包括SE(3)上的姿态，或编码刚度或阻尼矩阵的对称正定矩阵。在这种背景下，基于动力系统的方案为生成这种行为提供了一个自然的框架，在保持对环境变化响应的同时，提供了稳定性和收敛性。我们引入了光滑流形上的曲线诱导动力系统(CDSM)，这是一个用于直接在黎曼流形和李群上构建动力系统的实时框架。所提出的方法在流形上构建一条标称曲线，并生成一个动力系统，该系统结合了一个驱动沿曲线运动的切向分量和一个将状态吸引到曲线的法向分量。我们提供了所得动力系统的稳定性分析，并对该方法进行了定量验证。在S2基准测试中，与最先进的方法相比，CDSM展示了更高的轨迹精度、更小的路径偏差以及更快的生成和查询时间。最后，我们展示了该框架在机器人操纵臂和移动操纵臂上的实际应用，其中SE(3)上的姿态和SPD(n)上的阻尼矩阵都得到了在线调整。
tldr: The paper introduces Curve-induced Dynamical systems on Smooth Manifolds (CDSM), a real-time framework for generating stable and adaptable robot behaviors on Riemannian manifolds and Lie groups, demonstrating improved performance in trajectory accuracy and reduced path deviation compared to state-of-the-art methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种曲线诱导光滑流形上的动力系统（CDSM），这是一个用于在黎曼流形和李群上生成稳定且适应性强的机器人行为的实时框架，与最先进的方法相比，在轨迹精度和路径偏差方面表现出更高的性能。

title: Gait Generation Balancing Joint Load and Mobility for Legged Modular Robots with Easily Detachable Joints
summary: While modular robots offer versatility, excessive joint torque during locomotion poses a significant risk of mechanical failure, especially for detachable joints. To address this, we propose an optimization framework using the NSGA-III algorithm. Unlike conventional approaches that prioritize mobility alone, our method derives Pareto optimal solutions to minimize joint load while maintaining necessary locomotion speed and stability. Simulations and physical experiments demonstrate that our approach successfully generates gait motions for diverse environments, such as slopes and steps, ensuring structural integrity without compromising overall mobility.
summary_zh: 模块化机器人在提供多功能性的同时，运动过程中过大的关节力矩会对机械故障构成重大风险，尤其是对于可拆卸关节。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个采用NSGA-III算法的优化框架。与仅关注移动性的传统方法不同，我们的方法推导出帕累托最优解，在保持必要的运动速度和稳定性的同时，最小化关节负载。仿真和物理实验表明，我们的方法成功地为各种环境（例如斜坡和台阶）生成了步态运动，确保了结构完整性，而不会影响整体移动性。
tldr: This paper introduces an optimization framework using NSGA-III to generate gait motions for modular robots, minimizing joint load while maintaining mobility to prevent mechanical failure, particularly in robots with detachable joints. They validated this with simulations and physical experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种使用NSGA-III的优化框架，为模块化机器人生成步态运动，旨在最小化关节负荷并保持移动性，以防止机械故障，尤其是在具有可拆卸关节的机器人中。并通过仿真和物理实验验证了该方法。

title: Selecting Spots by Explicitly Predicting Intention from Motion History Improves Performance in Autonomous Parking
summary: In many applications of social navigation, existing works have shown that predicting and reasoning about human intentions can help robotic agents make safer and more socially acceptable decisions. In this work, we study this problem for autonomous valet parking (AVP), where an autonomous vehicle ego agent must drop off its passengers, explore the parking lot, find a parking spot, negotiate for the spot with other vehicles, and park in the spot without human supervision. Specifically, we propose an AVP pipeline that selects parking spots by explicitly predicting where other agents are going to park from their motion history using learned models and probabilistic belief maps. To test this pipeline, we build a simulation environment with reactive agents and realistic modeling assumptions on the ego agent, such as occlusion-aware observations, and imperfect trajectory prediction. Simulation experiments show that our proposed method outperforms existing works that infer intentions from future predicted motion or embed them implicitly in end-to-end models, yielding better results in prediction accuracy, social acceptance, and task completion. Our key insight is that, in parking, where driving regulations are more lax, explicit intention prediction is crucial for reasoning about diverse and ambiguous long-term goals, which cannot be reliably inferred from short-term motion prediction alone, but can be effectively learned from motion history.
summary_zh: 在社交导航的许多应用中，现有研究表明，预测和推理人类意图可以帮助机器人代理做出更安全和更符合社会规范的决策。在这项工作中，我们研究了自动代客泊车（AVP）中的这个问题，其中自动驾驶车辆主体必须放下乘客，探索停车场，找到停车位，与其他车辆协商该停车位，并在没有人为监督的情况下停入该车位。具体来说，我们提出了一种AVP流程，该流程通过显式预测其他代理将要停车的位置（基于它们使用学习模型和概率置信图的运动历史）来选择停车位。为了测试这个流程，我们构建了一个包含反应式代理的仿真环境，并对自动驾驶车辆主体进行了现实建模假设，例如感知遮挡的观测和不完美的轨迹预测。仿真实验表明，我们提出的方法优于从未来预测运动推断意图或将意图隐式嵌入到端到端模型中的现有工作，在预测准确性、社会接受度和任务完成度方面取得了更好的结果。我们的关键见解是，在停车场景中，驾驶规则较为宽松，显式意图预测对于推理多样化和模糊的长期目标至关重要，这些目标无法仅从短期运动预测中可靠推断出来，但可以有效地从运动历史中学习得到。
tldr: The paper presents an autonomous valet parking (AVP) pipeline that improves performance by explicitly predicting other agents' parking intentions from their motion history, outperforming methods that rely on future motion prediction or end-to-end learning in simulations.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个自动代客泊车 (AVP) 流程，通过明确预测其他车辆基于其运动历史的停车意图来提高性能，在模拟中优于依赖未来运动预测或端到端学习的方法。

title: EVMbench: Evaluating AI Agents on Smart Contract Security
summary: Smart contracts on public blockchains now manage large amounts of value, and vulnerabilities in these systems can lead to substantial losses. As AI agents become more capable at reading, writing, and running code, it is natural to ask how well they can already navigate this landscape, both in ways that improve security and in ways that might increase risk. We introduce EVMbench, an evaluation that measures the ability of agents to detect, patch, and exploit smart contract vulnerabilities. EVMbench draws on 117 curated vulnerabilities from 40 repositories and, in the most realistic setting, uses programmatic grading based on tests and blockchain state under a local Ethereum execution environment. We evaluate a range of frontier agents and find that they are capable of discovering and exploiting vulnerabilities end-to-end against live blockchain instances. We release code, tasks, and tooling to support continued measurement of these capabilities and future work on security.
summary_zh: 公共区块链上的智能合约目前管理着大量的价值，而这些系统中的漏洞可能导致重大损失。随着人工智能代理在读取、编写和运行代码方面的能力增强，很自然会提出一个问题：它们在多大程度上已经能够驾驭这一领域，无论是在提高安全性的方面，还是在可能增加风险的方面。我们介绍了EVMbench，一种评估代理检测、修补和利用智能合约漏洞能力的基准。EVMbench借鉴了来自40个代码仓库的117个精心策划的漏洞，并且在最真实的设置下，使用基于测试和本地以太坊执行环境下的区块链状态的程序化评分。我们评估了一系列前沿代理，发现它们有能力针对实时区块链实例端到端地发现和利用漏洞。我们发布代码、任务和工具，以支持对这些能力的持续测量和未来的安全工作。
tldr: EVMbench is introduced to evaluate AI agents' ability to detect, patch, and exploit smart contract vulnerabilities, revealing that current frontier agents can successfully find and exploit vulnerabilities in live blockchain instances.
tldr_zh: EVMbench被提出用于评估AI代理检测、修补和利用智能合约漏洞的能力，结果显示当前的先进代理能够成功地在实时的区块链实例中发现和利用漏洞。

title: DARE: Aligning LLM Agents with the R Statistical Ecosystem via Distribution-Aware Retrieval
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can automate data-science workflows, but many rigorous statistical methods implemented in R remain underused because LLMs struggle with statistical knowledge and tool retrieval. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches focus on function-level semantics and ignore data distribution, producing suboptimal matches. We propose DARE (Distribution-Aware Retrieval Embedding), a lightweight, plug-and-play retrieval model that incorporates data distribution information into function representations for R package retrieval. Our main contributions are: (i) RPKB, a curated R Package Knowledge Base derived from 8,191 high-quality CRAN packages; (ii) DARE, an embedding model that fuses distributional features with function metadata to improve retrieval relevance; and (iii) RCodingAgent, an R-oriented LLM agent for reliable R code generation and a suite of statistical analysis tasks for systematically evaluating LLM agents in realistic analytical scenarios. Empirically, DARE achieves an NDCG at 10 of 93.47%, outperforming state-of-the-art open-source embedding models by up to 17% on package retrieval while using substantially fewer parameters. Integrating DARE into RCodingAgent yields significant gains on downstream analysis tasks. This work helps narrow the gap between LLM automation and the mature R statistical ecosystem.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 代理可以自动化数据科学工作流，但许多在 R 中实现的严谨统计方法仍未得到充分利用，因为 LLM 在统计知识和工具检索方面存在困难。 现有的检索增强方法侧重于函数级别的语义，忽略了数据分布，导致次优匹配。 我们提出了 DARE（分布感知检索嵌入），这是一种轻量级的、即插即用的检索模型，它将数据分布信息融入到函数表示中，用于 R 包检索。 我们的主要贡献是：(i) RPKB，一个从 8,191 个高质量 CRAN 包中提取的精选 R 包知识库；(ii) DARE，一个融合了分布特征和函数元数据以提高检索相关性的嵌入模型；以及 (iii) RCodingAgent，一个面向 R 的 LLM 代理，用于可靠的 R 代码生成，以及一套统计分析任务，用于在真实的分析场景中系统地评估 LLM 代理。 经验表明，DARE 在包检索方面实现了 93.47% 的 NDCG@10，优于最先进的开源嵌入模型高达 17%，同时使用的参数明显更少。 将 DARE 集成到 RCodingAgent 中可以显著提高下游分析任务的性能。 这项工作有助于缩小 LLM 自动化和成熟的 R 统计生态系统之间的差距。
tldr: The paper introduces DARE, a retrieval model for R packages that incorporates data distribution information to improve the performance of LLM agents in data science workflows, demonstrating significant gains in package retrieval and downstream analysis tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DARE，一种将数据分布信息纳入R软件包检索的检索模型，旨在提升LLM agent在数据科学工作流程中的性能，并在软件包检索和下游分析任务中表现出显著提升。

title: ZipMap: Linear-Time Stateful 3D Reconstruction with Test-Time Training
summary: Feed-forward transformer models have driven rapid progress in 3D vision, but state-of-the-art methods such as VGGT and $π^3$ have a computational cost that scales quadratically with the number of input images, making them inefficient when applied to large image collections. Sequential-reconstruction approaches reduce this cost but sacrifice reconstruction quality. We introduce ZipMap, a stateful feed-forward model that achieves linear-time, bidirectional 3D reconstruction while matching or surpassing the accuracy of quadratic-time methods. ZipMap employs test-time training layers to zip an entire image collection into a compact hidden scene state in a single forward pass, enabling reconstruction of over 700 frames in under 10 seconds on a single H100 GPU, more than $20\times$ faster than state-of-the-art methods such as VGGT. Moreover, we demonstrate the benefits of having a stateful representation in real-time scene-state querying and its extension to sequential streaming reconstruction.
summary_zh: 前馈Transformer模型极大地推动了3D视觉的快速发展，但诸如VGGT和$π^3$等最先进的方法的计算成本随输入图像数量呈二次方增长，这使得它们在应用于大型图像集时效率低下。顺序重建方法降低了这种成本，但牺牲了重建质量。我们提出了ZipMap，一种有状态的前馈模型，它实现了线性时间、双向3D重建，同时达到或超过了二次时间方法的精度。ZipMap采用测试时训练层，在一次前向传递中将整个图像集压缩成一个紧凑的隐藏场景状态，从而能够在单个H100 GPU上于10秒内重建超过700帧，比诸如VGGT等最先进的方法快20倍以上。此外，我们还展示了有状态表示在实时场景状态查询以及将其扩展到顺序流式重建中的优势。
tldr: ZipMap introduces a linear-time stateful feed-forward model for 3D reconstruction that achieves comparable accuracy to quadratic-time methods with significantly improved speed and efficiency via test-time training, also enabling real-time scene querying and streaming reconstruction.
tldr_zh: ZipMap 提出了一种线性时间的状态前馈模型，用于 3D 重建。通过测试时训练，该模型在显著提高速度和效率的同时，实现了与二次时间方法相当的精度，并且支持实时场景查询和流式重建。

title: Dark3R: Learning Structure from Motion in the Dark
summary: We introduce Dark3R, a framework for structure from motion in the dark that operates directly on raw images with signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) below $-4$ dB -- a regime where conventional feature- and learning-based methods break down. Our key insight is to adapt large-scale 3D foundation models to extreme low-light conditions through a teacher--student distillation process, enabling robust feature matching and camera pose estimation in low light. Dark3R requires no 3D supervision; it is trained solely on noisy--clean raw image pairs, which can be either captured directly or synthesized using a simple Poisson--Gaussian noise model applied to well-exposed raw images. To train and evaluate our approach, we introduce a new, exposure-bracketed dataset that includes $\sim$42,000 multi-view raw images with ground-truth 3D annotations, and we demonstrate that Dark3R achieves state-of-the-art structure from motion in the low-SNR regime. Further, we demonstrate state-of-the-art novel view synthesis in the dark using Dark3R's predicted poses and a coarse-to-fine radiance field optimization procedure.
summary_zh: 我们提出了Dark3R，一个用于黑暗环境下的运动结构恢复框架，它直接作用于信噪比(SNR)低于$-4$分贝的原始图像上——在这个条件下，传统的基于特征和学习的方法会失效。我们的核心思想是通过教师-学生蒸馏过程，将大规模3D基础模型适应于极端的低光照环境，以实现低光照下的鲁棒特征匹配和相机位姿估计。Dark3R不需要3D监督；它仅在噪声-干净的原始图像对上进行训练，这些图像对可以直接捕获，也可以使用应用于良好曝光原始图像的简单泊松-高斯噪声模型合成。为了训练和评估我们的方法，我们引入了一个新的、包含$\sim$42,000张多视点原始图像的曝光包围数据集，该数据集带有真实3D标注，我们证明了Dark3R在低信噪比状态下实现了最先进的运动结构恢复效果。此外，我们还展示了使用Dark3R预测的位姿以及由粗到精的辐射场优化程序，在黑暗环境下实现了最先进的新视角合成效果。
tldr: Dark3R enables structure from motion in extremely low-light conditions by adapting large-scale 3D foundation models using teacher-student distillation and requiring only noisy-clean raw image pairs for training, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: Dark3R通过教师-学生蒸馏调整大型3D基础模型，实现了在极低光照条件下的运动结构重建，仅需噪声-干净原始图像对用于训练，并达到最先进的性能。

title: Distributional Reinforcement Learning with Information Bottleneck for Uncertainty-Aware DRAM Equalization
summary: Equalizer parameter optimization is critical for signal integrity in high-speed memory systems operating at multi-gigabit data rates. However, existing methods suffer from computationally expensive eye diagram evaluation, optimization of expected rather than worst-case performance, and absence of uncertainty quantification for deployment decisions. In this paper, we propose a distributional risk-sensitive reinforcement learning framework integrating Information Bottleneck latent representations with Conditional Value-at-Risk optimization. We introduce rate-distortion optimal signal compression achieving 51 times speedup over eye diagrams while quantifying epistemic uncertainty through Monte Carlo dropout. Distributional reinforcement learning with quantile regression enables explicit worst-case optimization, while PAC-Bayesian regularization certifies generalization bounds. Experimental validation on 2.4 million waveforms from eight memory units demonstrated mean improvements of 37.1\% and 41.5\% for 4-tap and 8-tap equalizer configurations with worst-case guarantees of 33.8\% and 38.2\%, representing 80.7\% and 89.1\% improvements over Q-learning baselines. The framework achieved 62.5\% high-reliability classification eliminating manual validation for most configurations. These results suggest the proposed framework provides a practical solution for production-scale equalizer optimization with certified worst-case guarantees.
summary_zh: 均衡器参数优化对于以多千兆位数据速率运行的高速存储系统中信号完整性至关重要。然而，现有方法存在计算代价高昂的眼图评估、对期望性能而非最坏情况性能的优化，以及缺乏对部署决策的不确定性量化等问题。在本文中，我们提出了一种分布式的风险敏感强化学习框架，将信息瓶颈潜在表示与条件风险价值(Conditional Value-at-Risk)优化相结合。我们引入了速率失真最优的信号压缩，在量化认知不确定性的同时，实现了相对于眼图51倍的速度提升（通过蒙特卡洛dropout）。使用分位数回归的分布式强化学习能够实现显式的最坏情况优化，而PAC-Bayes正则化则证明了泛化边界。对来自八个存储单元的240万个波形的实验验证表明，对于四阶和八阶均衡器配置，平均改进分别达到37.1%和41.5%，最坏情况保证分别达到33.8%和38.2%，分别代表了相对于Q-learning基线80.7%和89.1%的改进。该框架实现了62.5%的高可靠性分类，消除了大多数配置的手动验证。这些结果表明，所提出的框架为具有认证的最坏情况保证的生产规模均衡器优化提供了一种实用的解决方案。
tldr: The paper introduces a distributional reinforcement learning framework with an information bottleneck for uncertainty-aware DRAM equalization, achieving significant performance improvements and worst-case guarantees compared to traditional methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于信息瓶颈的分布强化学习框架，用于具有不确定性感知的DRAM均衡，与传统方法相比，实现了显著的性能提升和最坏情况保证。

title: A Constrained RL Approach for Cost-Efficient Delivery of Latency-Sensitive Applications
summary: Next-generation networks aim to provide performance guarantees to real-time interactive services that require timely and cost-efficient packet delivery. In this context, the goal is to reliably deliver packets with strict deadlines imposed by the application while minimizing overall resource allocation cost. A large body of work has leveraged stochastic optimization techniques to design efficient dynamic routing and scheduling solutions under average delay constraints; however, these methods fall short when faced with strict per-packet delay requirements. We formulate the minimum-cost delay-constrained network control problem as a constrained Markov decision process and utilize constrained deep reinforcement learning (CDRL) techniques to effectively minimize total resource allocation cost while maintaining timely throughput above a target reliability level. Results indicate that the proposed CDRL-based solution can ensure timely packet delivery even when existing baselines fall short, and it achieves lower cost compared to other throughput-maximizing methods.
summary_zh: 下一代网络旨在为需要及时且经济高效地交付数据包的实时交互服务提供性能保障。在此背景下，目标是在最小化总体资源分配成本的同时，可靠地交付具有应用所施加严格截止期限的数据包。大量研究利用随机优化技术来设计在平均延迟约束下的高效动态路由和调度方案；然而，这些方法在面对严格的逐包延迟要求时表现不足。我们将最小成本延迟约束网络控制问题表述为约束马尔可夫决策过程，并利用约束深度强化学习（CDRL）技术来有效地最小化总资源分配成本，同时保持及时吞吐量高于目标可靠性水平。结果表明，所提出的基于CDRL的解决方案可以确保及时的数据包交付，即使在现有基线表现不佳时也能如此，并且与其它最大化吞吐量的方法相比，它可以实现更低的成本。
tldr: This paper introduces a constrained deep reinforcement learning (CDRL) approach to minimize resource allocation costs while ensuring timely packet delivery in latency-sensitive networks, outperforming existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种约束深度强化学习（CDRL）方法，旨在最小化资源分配成本，同时确保延迟敏感网络中及时的数据包交付，并优于现有方法。

title: ROScopter: A Multirotor Autopilot based on ROSflight 2.0
summary: ROScopter is a lean multirotor autopilot built for researchers. ROScopter seeks to accelerate simulation and hardware testing of research code with an architecture that is both easy to understand and simple to modify. ROScopter is designed to interface with ROSflight 2.0 and runs entirely on an onboard flight computer, leveraging the features of ROS 2 to improve modularity. This work describes the architecture of ROScopter and how it can be used to test application code in both simulated and hardware environments. Hardware results of the default ROScopter behavior are presented, showing that ROScopter achieves similar performance to another state-of-the-art autopilot for basic waypoint-following maneuvers, but with a significantly reduced and more modular code-base.
summary_zh: ROScopter是一个专为研究人员设计的精简型多旋翼飞行器自动驾驶仪。ROScopter旨在通过易于理解和易于修改的架构，加速研究代码的仿真和硬件测试。ROScopter设计为与ROSflight 2.0接口，并完全在板载飞行计算机上运行，利用ROS 2的特性来提高模块化程度。本文介绍了ROScopter的架构，以及如何在仿真和硬件环境中测试应用程序代码。展示了默认ROScopter行为的硬件结果，表明ROScopter在基本的航点跟踪机动中，实现了与另一种最先进的自动驾驶仪类似的性能，但代码库显著减少且更模块化。
tldr: ROScopter is a modular and lightweight autopilot built on ROSflight 2.0, designed to accelerate research in multirotor control by providing an easily modifiable and understandable codebase. It demonstrates comparable performance to existing autopilots with a simpler architecture.
tldr_zh: ROScopter是一个基于ROSflight 2.0的模块化且轻量级的自动驾驶仪，旨在通过提供一个易于修改和理解的代码库来加速多旋翼飞行器控制领域的研究。它证明了在更简单的架构下可与现有的自动驾驶仪相媲美的性能。

title: CT-Enabled Patient-Specific Simulation and Contact-Aware Robotic Planning for Cochlear Implantation
summary: Robotic cochlear-implant (CI) insertion requires precise prediction and regulation of contact forces to minimize intracochlear trauma and prevent failure modes such as locking and buckling. Aligned with the integration of advanced medical imaging and robotics for autonomous, precision interventions, this paper presents a unified CT-to-simulation pipeline for contact-aware insertion planning and validation. We develop a low-dimensional, differentiable Cosserat-rod model of the electrode array coupled with frictional contact and pseudo-dynamics regularization to ensure continuous stick-slip transitions. Patient-specific cochlear anatomy is reconstructed from CT imaging and encoded via an analytic parametrization of the scala-tympani lumen, enabling efficient and differentiable contact queries through closest-point projection. Based on a differentiated equilibrium-constraint formulation, we derive an online direction-update law under an RCM-like constraint that suppresses lateral insertion forces while maintaining axial advancement. Simulations and benchtop experiments validate deformation and force trends, demonstrating reduced locking/buckling risk and improved insertion depth. The study highlights how CT-based imaging enhances modeling, planning, and safety capabilities in robot-assisted inner-ear procedures.
summary_zh: 机器人人工耳蜗植入需要精确预测和调节接触力，以最大程度地减少耳蜗内创伤，并防止诸如锁定和屈曲等失效模式。为了与将先进医学影像和机器人技术结合应用于自主、精准干预相一致，本文提出了一种统一的CT到模拟的流程，用于接触感知的植入规划和验证。我们开发了一个低维、可微的Cosserat杆模型，该模型与电极阵列耦合，并结合了摩擦接触和伪动力学正则化，以确保连续的黏滑过渡。从CT影像中重建患者特异性的耳蜗解剖结构，并通过鼓阶腔的解析参数化进行编码，从而通过最近点投影实现高效且可微的接触查询。基于微分平衡约束公式，我们推导出一个RCM类约束下的在线方向更新律，该约束抑制了横向植入力，同时保持了轴向推进。仿真和台式实验验证了变形和力趋势，表明降低了锁定/屈曲风险并提高了植入深度。该研究强调了基于CT的成像如何增强机器人辅助内耳手术中的建模、规划和安全能力。
tldr: This paper presents a CT-to-simulation pipeline for contact-aware robotic cochlear implantation, using a differentiable Cosserat-rod model and patient-specific CT data for improved insertion planning and safety.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于接触感知机器人耳蜗植入的CT到模拟的流程，使用可微的Cosserat杆模型和患者特定的CT数据，以改进植入规划和安全性。

title: From Code to Road: A Vehicle-in-the-Loop and Digital Twin-Based Framework for Central Car Server Testing in Autonomous Driving
summary: Simulation is one of the most essential parts in the development stage of automotive software. However, purely virtual simulations often struggle to accurately capture all real-world factors due to limitations in modeling. To address this challenge, this work presents a test framework for automotive software on the centralized E/E architecture, which is a central car server in our case, based on Vehicle-in-the-Loop (ViL) and digital twin technology. The framework couples a physical test vehicle on a dynamometer test bench with its synchronized virtual counterpart in a simulation environment. Our approach provides a safe, reproducible, realistic, and cost-effective platform for validating autonomous driving algorithms with a centralized architecture. This test method eliminates the need to test individual physical ECUs and their communication protocols separately. In contrast to traditional ViL methods, the proposed framework runs the full autonomous driving software directly on the vehicle hardware after the simulation process, eliminating flashing and intermediate layers while enabling seamless virtual-physical integration and accurately reflecting centralized E/E behavior. In addition, incorporating mixed testing in both simulated and physical environments reduces the need for full hardware integration during the early stages of automotive development. Experimental case studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the framework in different test scenarios. These findings highlight the potential to reduce development and integration efforts for testing autonomous driving pipelines in the future.
summary_zh: 仿真在汽车软件的开发阶段至关重要。然而，纯虚拟仿真由于建模的局限性，通常难以准确捕捉所有真实世界的因素。为了应对这一挑战，本文提出了一种基于车在环 (ViL) 和数字孪生技术的汽车软件测试框架，该软件运行于集中式电子电气 (E/E) 架构之上，在我们的案例中体现为一个中央车载服务器。该框架将置于测功机试验台上的物理测试车辆与其在仿真环境中同步的虚拟副本耦合。我们的方法为验证采用集中式架构的自动驾驶算法提供了一个安全、可复现、逼真且具有成本效益的平台。该测试方法无需单独测试各个物理 ECU 及其通信协议。与传统的 ViL 方法不同，所提出的框架在仿真过程之后直接在车辆硬件上运行完整的自动驾驶软件，消除了刷写和中间层，同时实现了无缝的虚实融合，并准确地反映了集中式 E/E 的行为。此外，在仿真和物理环境中引入混合测试，降低了在汽车开发早期阶段对完整硬件集成的需求。实验案例研究表明了该框架在不同测试场景中的有效性。这些发现突显了在未来减少自动驾驶流水线测试的开发和集成工作量的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents a Vehicle-in-the-Loop and Digital Twin-based framework for testing autonomous driving software on a centralized car server, improving simulation realism and reducing development efforts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于车辆在环和数字孪生的框架，用于测试集中式车载服务器上的自动驾驶软件，提高了模拟的真实性并减少了开发工作。

title: Rethinking the Role of Collaborative Robots in Rehabilitation
summary: Current research on collaborative robots (cobots) in physical rehabilitation largely focuses on repeated motion training for people undergoing physical therapy (PuPT), even though these sessions include phases that could benefit from robotic collaboration and assistance. Meanwhile, access to physical therapy remains limited for people with disabilities and chronic illnesses. Cobots could support both PuPT and therapists, and improve access to therapy, yet their broader potential remains underexplored. We propose extending the scope of cobots by imagining their role in assisting therapists and PuPT before, during, and after a therapy session. We discuss how cobot assistance may lift access barriers by promoting ability-based therapy design and helping therapists manage their time and effort. Finally, we highlight challenges to realizing these roles, including advancing user-state understanding, ensuring safety, and integrating cobots into therapists' workflow. This view opens new research questions and opportunities to draw from the HRI community's advances in assistive robotics.
summary_zh: 目前，关于物理康复中协作机器人（cobot）的研究主要集中在针对接受物理治疗者（PuPT）的重复运动训练上，即使这些疗程包含一些可能受益于机器人协作和辅助的阶段。与此同时，残疾人和慢性病患者获得物理治疗的机会仍然有限。协作机器人可以同时支持接受物理治疗者和治疗师，并改善获得治疗的机会，但其更广泛的潜力仍未得到充分探索。我们提出通过设想协作机器人在治疗会话之前、期间和之后辅助治疗师和接受物理治疗者的作用，来扩展协作机器人的应用范围。我们讨论了协作机器人辅助如何通过促进基于能力的治疗设计，以及帮助治疗师管理时间和精力来消除获取障碍。最后，我们强调了实现这些角色所面临的挑战，包括提升用户状态理解、确保安全性，以及将协作机器人集成到治疗师的工作流程中。这种观点开启了新的研究问题和机遇，可以借鉴人机交互（HRI）社区在辅助机器人方面的进展。
tldr: This paper proposes broadening the role of collaborative robots in physical rehabilitation beyond repetitive motion training to include assisting therapists and patients before, during, and after therapy sessions, with the aim of improving access and efficiency. It identifies key challenges and opportunities for HRI research.
tldr_zh: 本文提出扩展协作机器人在物理康复中的作用，超越重复运动训练，包括在治疗前后协助治疗师和患者，旨在提高可及性和效率。它确定了人机交互研究的关键挑战和机遇。

title: VinePT-Map: Pole-Trunk Semantic Mapping for Resilient Autonomous Robotics in Vineyards
summary: Reliable long-term deployment of autonomous robots in agricultural environments remains challenging due to perceptual aliasing, seasonal variability, and the dynamic nature of crop canopies. Vineyards, characterized by repetitive row structures and significant visual changes across phenological stages, represent a pivotal field challenge, limiting the robustness of conventional feature-based localization and mapping approaches. This paper introduces VinePT-Map, a semantic mapping framework that leverages vine trunks and support poles as persistent structural landmarks to enable season-agnostic and resilient robot localization. The proposed method formulates the mapping problem as a factor graph, integrating GPS, IMU, and RGB-D observations through robust geometrical constraints that exploit vineyard structure. An efficient perception pipeline based on instance segmentation and tracking, combined with a clustering filter for outlier rejection and pose refinement, enables accurate landmark detection using low-cost sensors and onboard computation. To validate the pipeline, we present a multi-season dataset for trunk and pole segmentation and tracking. Extensive field experiments conducted across diverse seasons demonstrate the robustness and accuracy of the proposed approach, highlighting its suitability for long-term autonomous operation in agricultural environments.
summary_zh: 由于感知混淆、季节性变化以及作物树冠的动态特性，自主机器人在农业环境中可靠的长期部署仍然面临挑战。葡萄园以重复的行结构和跨物候期的显著视觉变化为特征，代表着一个关键的领域挑战，限制了传统基于特征的定位和建图方法的鲁棒性。本文提出 VinePT-Map，一种语义建图框架，该框架利用葡萄树干和支撑杆作为持久的结构地标，以实现与季节无关且具有弹性的机器人定位。所提出的方法将建图问题公式化为一个因子图，通过利用葡萄园结构的鲁棒几何约束，整合GPS、IMU和RGB-D观测。一个基于实例分割和跟踪的高效感知流水线，结合用于异常值剔除和姿态优化的聚类滤波器，使用低成本传感器和板载计算实现精确的地标检测。为了验证该流水线，我们提出了一个用于树干和杆分割及跟踪的多季节数据集。在不同季节进行的广泛田间实验证明了所提出方法的鲁棒性和准确性，突出了其在农业环境中长期自主运行的适用性。
tldr: The paper introduces VinePT-Map, a semantic mapping framework using persistent landmarks (vine trunks and poles) for resilient robot localization in vineyards, demonstrated with a multi-season dataset and field experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了VinePT-Map，一个利用持久性地标（葡萄树干和杆）的语义地图框架，用于葡萄园中具有弹性的机器人定位，并通过多季节数据集和实地实验进行了演示。

title: Person Detection and Tracking from an Overhead Crane LiDAR
summary: This paper investigates person detection and tracking in an industrial indoor workspace using a LiDAR mounted on an overhead crane. The overhead viewpoint introduces a strong domain shift from common vehicle-centric LiDAR benchmarks, and limited availability of suitable public training data. Henceforth, we curate a site-specific overhead LiDAR dataset with 3D human bounding-box annotations and adapt selected candidate 3D detectors under a unified training and evaluation protocol. We further integrate lightweight tracking-by-detection using AB3DMOT and SimpleTrack to maintain person identities over time. Detection performance is reported with distance-sliced evaluation to quantify the practical operating envelope of the sensing setup. The best adapted detector configurations achieve average precision (AP) up to 0.84 within a 5.0 m horizontal radius, increasing to 0.97 at 1.0 m, with VoxelNeXt and SECOND emerging as the most reliable backbones across this range. The acquired results contribute in bridging the domain gap between standard driving datasets and overhead sensing for person detection and tracking. We also report latency measurements, highlighting practical real-time feasibility. Finally, we release our dataset and implementations in GitHub to support further research
summary_zh: 本文研究了使用安装在桥式起重机上的激光雷达在工业室内工作空间中进行人员检测和跟踪的问题。俯视视角引入了与常见的车辆中心激光雷达基准的强烈领域偏移，并且合适的公开训练数据有限。因此，我们整理了一个特定地点的俯视激光雷达数据集，其中包含3D人体边界框注释，并在统一的训练和评估协议下调整了选定的候选3D检测器。我们进一步集成了使用AB3DMOT和SimpleTrack的轻量级检测跟踪（tracking-by-detection）方法，以保持随时间推移的人员身份。检测性能通过距离分片评估进行报告，以量化传感设置的实际工作范围。最佳调整的检测器配置在 5.0 米水平半径内可达到高达 0.84 的平均精度（AP），并在 1.0 米处提高到 0.97，其中 VoxelNeXt 和 SECOND 成为该范围内最可靠的主干网络。获得的结果有助于弥合标准驾驶数据集与用于人员检测和跟踪的俯视感知之间的领域差距。我们还报告了延迟测量结果，突出了实际的实时可行性。最后，我们在 GitHub 上发布我们的数据集和实现，以支持进一步的研究。
tldr: This paper presents a new overhead LiDAR dataset for person detection and tracking in industrial environments, evaluates several 3D detectors, and releases the dataset and code, which may help bridge the gap between standard driving datasets and overhead sensing applications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个新的用于工业环境中人员检测和跟踪的顶置激光雷达数据集，评估了几种3D检测器，并发布了数据集和代码，这可能有助于弥合标准驾驶数据集和顶置传感应用之间的差距。

title: Integrated cooperative localization of heterogeneous measurement swarm: A unified data-driven method
summary: The cooperative localization (CL) problem in heterogeneous robotic systems with different measurement capabilities is investigated in this work. In practice, heterogeneous sensors lead to directed and sparse measurement topologies, whereas most existing CL approaches rely on multilateral localization with restrictive multi-neighbor geometric requirements. To overcome this limitation, we enable pairwise relative localization (RL) between neighboring robots using only mutual measurement and odometry information. A unified data-driven adaptive RL estimator is first developed to handle heterogeneous and unidirectional measurements. Based on the convergent RL estimates, a distributed pose-coupling CL strategy is then designed, which guarantees CL under a weakly connected directed measurement topology, representing the least restrictive condition among existing results. The proposed method is independent of specific control tasks and is validated through a formation control application and real-world experiments.
summary_zh: 本文研究了具有不同测量能力的异构机器人系统中的协同定位（CL）问题。 实际上，异构传感器会导致有向且稀疏的测量拓扑，而大多数现有的协同定位方法依赖于具有严格的多邻居几何要求的多边定位。 为了克服这一限制，我们仅使用相互测量和里程计信息来实现相邻机器人之间的成对相对定位（RL）。 首先，开发了一种统一的数据驱动自适应相对定位估计器，以处理异构和单向测量。 然后，基于收敛的相对定位估计，设计了一种分布式位姿耦合协同定位策略，该策略保证在弱连通的有向测量拓扑下进行协同定位，这代表了现有结果中最宽松的条件。 提出的方法与特定的控制任务无关，并通过编队控制应用和实际实验进行了验证。
tldr: This paper presents a data-driven cooperative localization method for heterogeneous robotic swarms that addresses sparse and directed measurement topologies using pairwise relative localization and a distributed pose-coupling strategy, validated with formation control and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对异构机器人集群的数据驱动协同定位方法。该方法通过成对相对定位和分布式姿态耦合策略来解决稀疏和定向的测量拓扑结构问题，并通过编队控制和实际实验进行了验证。

title: Distributed State Estimation for Vision-Based Cooperative Slung Load Transportation in GPS-Denied Environments
summary: Transporting heavy or oversized slung loads using rotorcraft has traditionally relied on single-aircraft systems, which limits both payload capacity and control authority. Cooperative multilift using teams of rotorcraft offers a scalable and efficient alternative, especially for infrequent but challenging "long-tail" payloads without the need of building larger and larger rotorcraft. Most prior multilift research assumes GPS availability, uses centralized estimation architectures, or relies on controlled laboratory motion-capture setups. As a result, these methods lack robustness to sensor loss and are not viable in GPS-denied or operationally constrained environments. This paper addresses this limitation by presenting a distributed and decentralized payload state estimation framework for vision-based multilift operations. Using onboard monocular cameras, each UAV detects a fiducial marker on the payload and estimates its relative pose. These measurements are fused via a Distributed and Decentralized Extended Information Filter (DDEIF), enabling robust and scalable estimation that is resilient to individual sensor dropouts. This payload state estimate is then used for closed-loop trajectory tracking control. Monte Carlo simulation results in Gazebo show the effectiveness of the proposed approach, including the effect of communication loss during flight.
summary_zh: 使用旋翼飞行器运输重型或超大吊挂载荷传统上依赖于单机系统，这限制了有效载荷能力和控制权限。使用旋翼飞行器团队进行协同多举升提供了一个可扩展且高效的替代方案，特别是对于不常见但具有挑战性的“长尾”有效载荷，而无需建造越来越大的旋翼飞行器。大多数先前的多举升研究假设GPS可用，使用中心化估计架构，或依赖于受控的实验室运动捕捉设置。因此，这些方法缺乏对传感器丢失的鲁棒性，并且在GPS拒止或操作受限环境中不可行。本文通过提出一种用于基于视觉的多举升操作的分布式和去中心化载荷状态估计框架来解决这一局限性。利用机载单目相机，每个无人机检测载荷上的标志板并估计其相对姿态。这些测量通过分布式和去中心化扩展信息滤波器（DDEIF）进行融合，实现鲁棒且可扩展的估计，能够应对单个传感器掉线的情况。然后，该载荷状态估计用于闭环轨迹跟踪控制。在Gazebo中的蒙特卡洛仿真结果表明了所提出方法的有效性，包括飞行期间通信丢失的影响。
tldr: This paper presents a distributed state estimation framework for vision-based cooperative slung load transportation using multiple UAVs in GPS-denied environments, employing onboard monocular cameras and a Distributed and Decentralized Extended Information Filter (DDEIF). The method demonstrates robustness to sensor and communication loss through Gazebo simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于视觉的多无人机协同吊运的分布式状态估计框架，用于GPS受限环境。该框架利用机载单目相机和分布式去中心化扩展信息滤波器（DDEIF）进行估计，并通过Gazebo仿真展示了对传感器和通信丢失的鲁棒性。

title: The Spatial and Temporal Resolution of Motor Intention in Multi-Target Prediction
summary:
Reaching for grasping, and manipulating objects are essential motor functions in everyday life. Decoding human motor intentions is a central challenge for rehabilitation and assistive technologies. This study focuses on predicting intentions by inferring movement direction and target location from multichannel electromyography (EMG) signals, and investigating how spatially and temporally accurate such information can be detected relative to movement onset. We present a computational pipeline that combines data-driven temporal segmentation with classical and deep learning classifiers in order to analyse EMG data recorded during the planning, early execution, and target contact phases of a delayed reaching task.
  Early intention prediction enables devices to anticipate user actions, improving responsiveness and supporting active motor recovery in adaptive rehabilitation systems. Random Forest achieves $80\%$ accuracy and Convolutional Neural Network $75\%$ accuracy across $25$ spatial targets, each separated by $14^\circ$ azimuth/altitude. Furthermore, a systematic evaluation of EMG channels, feature sets, and temporal windows demonstrates that motor intention can be efficiently decoded even with drastically reduced data. This work sheds light on the temporal and spatial evolution of motor intention, paving the way for anticipatory control in adaptive rehabilitation systems and driving advancements in computational approaches to motor neuroscience.
summary_zh:
抓握、操控物体是日常生活中至关重要的运动功能。解码人类运动意图是康复和辅助技术面临的核心挑战。本研究着重于通过多通道肌电图(EMG)信号推断运动方向和目标位置来预测意图，并探究此类信息相对于运动起始点的时空精度如何被检测。我们提出了一个计算流程，它结合了数据驱动的时序分割与经典和深度学习分类器，从而分析在延迟抓取任务的计划、早期执行和目标接触阶段记录的EMG数据。
  早期意图预测使设备能够预期用户行为，提高响应速度，并支持自适应康复系统中积极的运动恢复。随机森林在25个空间目标（每个目标相隔14°方位角/仰角）上实现了80%的准确率，卷积神经网络实现了75%的准确率。此外，对EMG通道、特征集和时间窗口的系统评估表明，即使在大幅减少数据的情况下，也能有效地解码运动意图。 这项工作阐明了运动意图的时空演变，为自适应康复系统中的预测性控制铺平了道路，并推动了运动神经科学计算方法的进步。
tldr: This paper investigates the accuracy and timing of motor intention decoding from EMG signals during a reaching task, achieving reasonable accuracy in predicting target location using machine learning models. Early intention prediction enables devices to anticipate user actions, improving responsiveness and supporting active motor recovery in adaptive rehabilitation systems.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了在抓取任务中，从肌电（EMG）信号中解码运动意图的准确性和时间，使用机器学习模型在预测目标位置方面实现了合理的准确性。早期意图预测使设备能够预测用户行为，提高响应能力并支持自适应康复系统中的主动运动恢复。

title: Visual-Informed Speech Enhancement Using Attention-Based Beamforming
summary: Recent studies have demonstrated that incorporating auxiliary information, such as speaker voiceprint or visual cues, can substantially improve Speech Enhancement (SE) performance. However, single-channel methods often yield suboptimal results in low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions, when there is high reverberation, or in complex scenarios involving dynamic speakers, overlapping speech, or non-stationary noise. To address these issues, we propose a novel Visual-Informed Neural Beamforming Network (VI-NBFNet), which integrates microphone array signal processing and deep neural networks (DNNs) using multimodal input features. The proposed network leverages a pretrained visual speech recognition model to extract lip movements as input features, which serve for voice activity detection (VAD) and target speaker identification. The system is intended to handle both static and moving speakers by introducing a supervised end-to-end beamforming framework equipped with an attention mechanism. The experimental results demonstrated that the proposed audiovisual system has achieved better SE performance and robustness for both stationary and dynamic speaker scenarios, compared to several baseline methods.
summary_zh: 近期研究表明，整合辅助信息，例如说话人声纹或视觉线索，能够显著提升语音增强(SE)性能。然而，单通道方法在低信噪比(SNR)条件、高混响环境或涉及动态说话人、重叠语音或非平稳噪声的复杂场景中，通常产生次优结果。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的视觉信息神经波束成形网络(VI-NBFNet)，该网络利用多模态输入特征，整合了麦克风阵列信号处理和深度神经网络(DNN)。所提出的网络利用预训练的视觉语音识别模型来提取唇动作为输入特征，用于语音活动检测(VAD)和目标说话人识别。该系统旨在通过引入配备注意力机制的监督端到端波束成形框架来处理静态和移动的说话人。实验结果表明，与几种基线方法相比，所提出的视听系统在静态和动态说话人场景中均实现了更好的语音增强性能和鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces a Visual-Informed Neural Beamforming Network (VI-NBFNet) for speech enhancement that uses lip movements to improve performance in challenging acoustic environments, especially with dynamic speakers.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种用于语音增强的视觉信息神经波束成形网络（VI-NBFNet），该网络利用唇部运动来提高在复杂声学环境下的性能，特别是在动态扬声器场景下。

title: Not All Trust is the Same: Effects of Decision Workflow and Explanations in Human-AI Decision Making
summary: A central challenge in AI-assisted decision making is achieving warranted, well-calibrated trust. Both overtrust (accepting incorrect AI recommendations) and undertrust (rejecting correct advice) should be prevented.
