Prior studies differ in the design of the decision workflow - whether users see the AI suggestion immediately (1-step setup) or have to submit a first decision beforehand (2-step setup) -, and in how trust is measured - through self-reports or as behavioral trust, that is, reliance. We examined the effects and interactions of (a) the type of decision workflow, (b) the presence of explanations, and (c) users' domain knowledge and prior AI experience. We compared reported trust, reliance (agreement rate and switch rate), and overreliance. Results showed no evidence that a 2-step setup reduces overreliance. The decision workflow also did not directly affect self-reported trust, but there was a crossover interaction effect with domain knowledge and explanations, suggesting that the effects of explanations alone may not generalize across workflow setups. Finally, our findings confirm that reported trust and reliance behavior are distinct constructs that should be evaluated separately in AI-assisted decision making.
summary_zh: 人工智能辅助决策的核心挑战是实现有保证的、良好校准的信任。应当避免过度信任（接受不正确的AI建议）和不信任（拒绝正确的建议）。以往的研究在决策流程的设计上有所不同——即用户是立即看到AI建议（一步设置）还是需要事先提交一个初步决策（两步设置）——以及信任的衡量方式上有所不同——通过自我报告或作为行为信任，即依赖度。我们研究了（a）决策流程类型、（b）解释的存在、（c）用户的领域知识和先前的AI经验的影响和交互作用。我们比较了报告的信任度、依赖度（一致率和转换率）以及过度依赖。结果表明，没有证据表明两步设置能减少过度依赖。决策流程也没有直接影响自我报告的信任度，但与领域知识和解释之间存在交叉交互效应，表明解释的单独作用可能无法推广到不同的流程设置中。最后，我们的研究结果证实，在人工智能辅助决策中，报告的信任度和依赖行为是不同的结构，应该分别进行评估。
tldr: This paper investigates how different decision workflows and explanations affect trust and reliance in human-AI decision-making, highlighting the distinct nature of reported trust versus reliance behavior.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了不同决策流程和解释如何影响人机决策中的信任和依赖，强调了报告的信任与依赖行为的本质区别。

title: A 360-degree Multi-camera System for Blue Emergency Light Detection Using Color Attention RT-DETR and the ABLDataset
summary: This study presents an advanced system for detecting blue lights on emergency vehicles, developed using ABLDataset, a curated dataset that includes images of European emergency vehicles under various climatic and geographic conditions. The system employs a configuration of four fisheye cameras, each with a 180-degree horizontal field of view, mounted on the sides of the vehicle. A calibration process enables the azimuthal localization of the detections. Additionally, a comparative analysis of major deep neural network algorithms was conducted, including YOLO (v5, v8, and v10), RetinaNet, Faster R-CNN, and RT-DETR. RT-DETR was selected as the base model and enhanced through the incorporation of a color attention block, achieving an accuracy of 94.7 percent and a recall of 94.1 percent on the test set, with field test detections reaching up to 70 meters. Furthermore, the system estimates the approach angle of the emergency vehicle relative to the center of the car using geometric transformations. Designed for integration into a multimodal system that combines visual and acoustic data, this system has demonstrated high efficiency, offering a promising approach to enhancing Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) and road safety.
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种先进的紧急车辆蓝色警示灯检测系统，该系统基于 ABLDataset 开发，这是一个经过精心整理的数据集，包含欧洲紧急车辆在各种气候和地理条件下的图像。该系统采用了由四个鱼眼摄像头组成的配置，每个摄像头具有 180 度的水平视场角，安装在车辆侧面。通过标定过程，实现了对检测结果的方位角定位。此外，还对主要的深度神经网络算法进行了比较分析，包括 YOLO (v5、v8 和 v10)、RetinaNet、Faster R-CNN 和 RT-DETR。选择 RT-DETR 作为基础模型，并通过整合颜色注意力模块进行了增强，在测试集上实现了 94.7% 的准确率和 94.1% 的召回率，现场测试检测距离可达 70 米。此外，该系统利用几何变换估计了紧急车辆相对于车辆中心的接近角。该系统的设计旨在集成到结合视觉和声学数据的多模态系统中，已展示出高效性，为增强高级驾驶辅助系统 (ADAS) 和道路安全提供了一种很有前景的方法。
tldr: The paper presents a multi-camera system using a color-attention enhanced RT-DETR model for detecting blue emergency lights, achieving high accuracy and recall on a curated dataset and field tests. It aims to improve ADAS and road safety by integrating visual and acoustic data.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种使用颜色注意力增强的RT-DETR模型的多摄像头系统，用于检测蓝色紧急灯，在整理的数据集和现场测试中实现了高精度和召回率。 它旨在通过整合视觉和声学数据来改进ADAS和道路安全。

title: S5-SHB Agent: Society 5.0 enabled Multi-model Agentic Blockchain Framework for Smart Home
summary: The smart home is a key application domain within the Society 5.0 vision for a human-centered society. As smart home ecosystems expand with heterogeneous IoT protocols, diverse devices, and evolving threats, autonomous systems must manage comfort, security, energy, and safety for residents. Such autonomous decision-making requires a trust anchor, making blockchain a preferred foundation for transparent and accountable smart home governance. However, realizing this vision requires blockchain-governed smart homes to simultaneously address adaptive consensus, intelligent multi-agent coordination, and resident-controlled governance aligned with the principles of Society 5.0. Existing frameworks rely solely on rigid smart contracts with fixed consensus protocols, employ at most a single AI model without multi-agent coordination, and offer no governance mechanism for residents to control automation behaviour. To address these limitations, this paper presents the Society 5.0-driven human-centered governance-enabled smart home blockchain agent (S5-SHB-Agent). The framework orchestrates ten specialized agents using interchangeable large language models to make decisions across the safety, security, comfort, energy, privacy, and health domains. An adaptive PoW blockchain adjusts mining difficulty based on transaction volume and emergency conditions, with digital signatures and Merkle tree anchoring to ensure tamper evident auditability. A four-tier governance model enables residents to control automation through tiered preferences from routine adjustments to immutable safety thresholds. Evaluation confirms that resident governance correctly separates adjustable comfort priorities from immutable safety thresholds across all tested configurations, while adaptive consensus commits emergency blocks.
summary_zh: 智能家居是人类社会5.0愿景中以人为本社会的一个关键应用领域。随着智能家居生态系统通过异构的物联网协议、多样化的设备以及不断演化的威胁扩展，自治系统必须管理居民的舒适度、安全性、能源和安全。这种自治决策需要一个信任根，使得区块链成为透明且可问责的智能家居治理的首选基础。然而，实现这一愿景需要区块链治理的智能家居同时解决自适应共识、智能多代理协同以及与人类社会5.0原则对齐的居民控制的治理。现有的框架仅依赖于具有固定共识协议的僵化智能合约，最多采用单个AI模型，而没有多代理协同，并且不提供居民控制自动化行为的治理机制。为了解决这些局限性，本文提出了一种由人类社会5.0驱动、以人为本的、支持治理的智能家居区块链代理（S5-SHB-Agent）。该框架编排了十个利用可互换的大型语言模型的专业代理，以便在安全、安保、舒适、能源、隐私和健康领域做出决策。一种自适应的工作量证明（PoW）区块链根据交易量和紧急情况调整挖矿难度，并采用数字签名和Merkle树锚定，以确保防篡改的可审计性。一个四层治理模型使居民能够通过从常规调整到不可变的安全性阈值等分层偏好来控制自动化。评估证实，在所有测试配置中，居民治理能够正确区分可调节的舒适度优先级和不可变的安全性阈值，而自适应共识能够提交紧急区块。
tldr: The paper introduces S5-SHB-Agent, a blockchain-based multi-agent framework for smart homes that incorporates adaptive consensus, AI-driven agent coordination, and resident-controlled governance aligned with Society 5.0 principles.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了S5-SHB-Agent，一个基于区块链的智能家居多智能体框架，它结合了自适应共识、AI驱动的智能体协调和符合Society 5.0原则的居民控制治理。

title: MOOSEnger -- a Domain-Specific AI Agent for the MOOSE Ecosystem
summary: MOOSEnger is a tool-enabled AI agent tailored to the Multiphysics Object-Oriented Simulation Environment (MOOSE). MOOSE cases are specified in HIT ".i" input files; the large object catalog and strict syntax make initial setup and debugging slow. MOOSEnger offers a conversational workflow that turns natural-language intent into runnable inputs by combining retrieval-augmented generation over curated docs/examples with deterministic, MOOSE-aware parsing, validation, and execution tools. A core-plus-domain architecture separates reusable agent infrastructure (configuration, registries, tool dispatch, retrieval services, persistence, and evaluation) from a MOOSE plugin that adds HIT-based parsing, syntax-preserving ingestion of input files, and domain-specific utilities for input repair and checking. An input precheck pipeline removes hidden formatting artifacts, fixes malformed HIT structure with a bounded grammar-constrained loop, and resolves invalid object types via similarity search over an application syntax registry. Inputs are then validated and optionally smoke-tested with the MOOSE runtime in the loop via an MCP-backed execution backend (with local fallback), translating solver diagnostics into iterative verify-and-correct updates. Built-in evaluation reports RAG metrics (faithfulness, relevancy, context precision/recall) and end-to-end success by actual execution. On a 125-prompt benchmark spanning diffusion, transient heat conduction, solid mechanics, porous flow, and incompressible Navier--Stokes, MOOSEnger achieves a 0.93 execution pass rate versus 0.08 for an LLM-only baseline.
summary_zh: MOOSEnger是一个工具使能的人工智能代理，专为多物理场面向对象模拟环境（MOOSE）量身定制。MOOSE案例在HIT ".i" 输入文件中指定；庞大的对象目录和严格的语法使得初始设置和调试过程缓慢。MOOSEnger提供了一种对话式工作流程，通过结合对精选文档/示例的检索增强生成以及确定性的、MOOSE感知的解析、验证和执行工具，将自然语言意图转化为可运行的输入。核心加领域架构将可重用的代理基础架构（配置、注册表、工具调度、检索服务、持久性和评估）与MOOSE插件分离，该插件增加了基于HIT的解析、输入文件的语法保留摄取以及用于输入修复和检查的特定于领域的实用程序。输入预检查管道消除隐藏的格式伪影，通过有界语法约束循环修复格式错误的HIT结构，并通过应用程序语法注册表上的相似性搜索来解决无效的对象类型。然后，通过MCP支持的执行后端（具有本地回退），在MOOSE运行时循环中验证输入并选择性地进行冒烟测试，将求解器诊断信息转换为迭代的验证和纠正更新。内置评估报告RAG指标（忠实性、相关性、上下文精确率/召回率）以及通过实际执行实现的端到端成功率。在一个涵盖扩散、瞬态热传导、固体力学、多孔介质流动和不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程的125个提示基准测试中，MOOSEnger达到了0.93的执行通过率，而仅使用LLM基线的执行通过率为0.08。
tldr: MOOSEnger is an AI agent that uses retrieval-augmented generation, domain-specific parsing, and validation tools to convert natural language into executable MOOSE input files, significantly improving the success rate compared to LLMs alone.
tldr_zh: MOOSEnger是一个AI agent，它使用检索增强生成、领域特定的解析和验证工具，将自然语言转换为可执行的MOOSE输入文件，与单独使用LLM相比，显著提高了成功率。

title: From Offline to Periodic Adaptation for Pose-Based Shoplifting Detection in Real-world Retail Security
summary: Shoplifting is a growing operational and economic challenge for retailers, with incidents rising and losses increasing despite extensive video surveillance. Continuous human monitoring is infeasible, motivating automated, privacy-preserving, and resource-aware detection solutions. In this paper, we cast shoplifting detection as a pose-based, unsupervised video anomaly detection problem and introduce a periodic adaptation framework designed for on-site Internet of Things (IoT) deployment. Our approach enables edge devices in smart retail environments to adapt from streaming, unlabeled data, supporting scalable and low-latency anomaly detection across distributed camera networks. To support reproducibility, we introduce RetailS, a new large-scale real-world shoplifting dataset collected from a retail store under multi-day, multi-camera conditions, capturing unbiased shoplifting behavior in realistic IoT settings. For deployable operation, thresholds are selected using both F1 and H_PRS scores, the harmonic mean of precision, recall, and specificity, during data filtering and training. In periodic adaptation experiments, our framework consistently outperformed offline baselines on AUC-ROC and AUC-PR in 91.6% of evaluations, with each training update completing in under 30 minutes on edge-grade hardware, demonstrating the feasibility and reliability of our solution for IoT-enabled smart retail deployment.
summary_zh: 扒窃是零售商面临的一个日益严重的运营和经济挑战，尽管广泛应用了视频监控，但扒窃事件和损失仍在增加。持续的人工监控是不可行的，这促使人们寻求自动化、保护隐私且感知资源的检测解决方案。在本文中，我们将扒窃检测定义为一个基于姿态的、无监督的视频异常检测问题，并引入了一个为现场物联网（IoT）部署设计的周期性自适应框架。我们的方法支持智能零售环境中的边缘设备从流式、未标记数据中进行自适应学习，从而支持在分布式摄像头网络中实现可扩展且低延迟的异常检测。为了支持可复现性，我们引入了RetailS，这是一个新的大规模真实世界扒窃数据集，该数据集是在零售店内，在多天、多摄像头条件下收集的，记录了真实的物联网环境中无偏差的扒窃行为。为了可部署运行，在数据过滤和训练过程中，使用F1得分和H_PRS得分（精度、召回率和特异性的调和平均值）选择阈值。在周期性自适应实验中，我们的框架在91.6%的评估中，在AUC-ROC和AUC-PR指标上始终优于离线基线，且每次训练更新在边缘级硬件上均在30分钟内完成，证明了我们的解决方案对于物联网赋能的智能零售部署的可行性和可靠性。
tldr: The paper introduces a pose-based, unsupervised video anomaly detection framework for shoplifting using periodic adaptation on IoT devices, validated by a new real-world dataset called RetailS. Their framework outperforms offline baselines while maintaining efficiency on edge hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于姿势的无监督视频异常检测框架，用于检测商店盗窃行为，该框架使用物联网设备上的周期性自适应，并通过名为 RetailS 的新真实世界数据集进行了验证。 他们的框架优于离线基线，同时保持了边缘硬件的效率。

title: A Dual-Helix Governance Approach Towards Reliable Agentic AI for WebGIS Development
summary: WebGIS development requires rigor, yet agentic AI frequently fails due to five large language model (LLM) limitations: context constraints, cross-session forgetting, stochasticity, instruction failure, and adaptation rigidity. We propose a dual-helix governance framework reframing these challenges as structural governance problems that model capacity alone cannot resolve. We implement the framework as a 3-track architecture (Knowledge, Behavior, Skills) that uses a knowledge graph substrate to stabilize execution by externalizing domain facts and enforcing executable protocols, complemented by a self-learning cycle for autonomous knowledge growth. Applying this to the FutureShorelines WebGIS tool, a governed agent refactored a 2,265-line monolithic codebase into modular ES6 components. Results demonstrated a 51\% reduction in cyclomatic complexity and a 7-point increase in maintainability index. A comparative experiment against a zero-shot LLM confirms that externalized governance, not just model capability, drives operational reliability in geospatial engineering. This approach is implemented in the open-source AgentLoom governance toolkit.
summary_zh: WebGIS开发需要严谨性，但自主AI（agentic AI）经常失败，原因在于五个大型语言模型(LLM)的局限性：上下文约束、跨会话遗忘、随机性、指令失败和适应刚性。我们提出了一种双螺旋治理框架，将这些挑战重新定义为结构性治理问题，而仅仅是模型能力无法解决这些问题。我们将该框架实现为一个三轨架构（知识、行为、技能），该架构使用知识图谱基底通过外化领域事实和强制执行可执行协议来稳定执行，并辅以自主知识增长的自学习循环。将其应用于FutureShorelines WebGIS工具，一个受治理的智能体将一个2265行代码的单体代码库重构为模块化的ES6组件。结果表明，循环复杂度降低了51％，可维护性指数提高了7点。与零样本LLM进行的一项对比实验证实，外化的治理而非仅仅是模型能力，驱动了地理空间工程中的运营可靠性。该方法已在开源的AgentLoom治理工具包中实现。
tldr: The paper presents a dual-helix governance framework (AgentLoom) using knowledge graphs and self-learning to improve the reliability of agentic AI for WebGIS development, demonstrating improved code maintainability through refactoring a monolithic codebase.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种双螺旋治理框架（AgentLoom），使用知识图谱和自学习来提高WebGIS开发中智能代理AI的可靠性，并通过重构单体代码库证明了代码可维护性的提高。

title: Fusion4CA: Boosting 3D Object Detection via Comprehensive Image Exploitation
summary: Nowadays, an increasing number of works fuse LiDAR and RGB data in the bird's-eye view (BEV) space for 3D object detection in autonomous driving systems. However, existing methods suffer from over-reliance on the LiDAR branch, with insufficient exploration of RGB information. To tackle this issue, we propose Fusion4CA, which is built upon the classic BEVFusion framework and dedicated to fully exploiting visual input with plug-and-play components. Specifically, a contrastive alignment module is designed to calibrate image features with 3D geometry, and a camera auxiliary branch is introduced to mine RGB information sufficiently during training. For further performance enhancement, we leverage an off-the-shelf cognitive adapter to make the most of pretrained image weights, and integrate a standard coordinate attention module into the fusion stage as a supplementary boost. Experiments on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate that our method achieves 69.7% mAP with only 6 training epochs and a mere 3.48% increase in inference parameters, yielding a 1.2% improvement over the baseline which is fully trained for 20 epochs. Extensive experiments in a simulated lunar environment further validate the effectiveness and generalization of our method. Our code will be released through Fusion4CA.
summary_zh: 如今，越来越多的工作将激光雷达和RGB数据融合在鸟瞰图 (BEV) 空间中，用于自动驾驶系统中的3D目标检测。然而，现有方法过度依赖激光雷达分支，对RGB信息的探索不足。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Fusion4CA，它构建在经典的BEVFusion框架之上，并致力于通过即插即用组件充分利用视觉输入。具体来说，设计了一个对比对齐模块来校准图像特征与3D几何，并引入一个相机辅助分支，以在训练期间充分挖掘RGB信息。为了进一步提升性能，我们利用现成的认知适配器来充分利用预训练的图像权重，并将标准的坐标注意力模块集成到融合阶段，作为补充增强。在nuScenes数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法仅用6个训练周期和仅3.48%的推理参数增量就实现了69.7%的mAP，相比完整训练20个周期的基线提高了1.2%。在模拟月球环境中的大量实验进一步验证了我们方法的有效性和泛化性。我们的代码将通过Fusion4CA发布。
tldr: The paper proposes Fusion4CA, a method to improve 3D object detection by better utilizing RGB information in LiDAR-RGB fusion, achieving improved mAP on the nuScenes dataset with minimal increase in parameters and training epochs.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了Fusion4CA，一种通过更好地利用LiDAR-RGB融合中的RGB信息来改进3D目标检测的方法，在nuScenes数据集上实现了改进的mAP，同时参数和训练epoch的增加也很小。

title: MoRe: Motion-aware Feed-forward 4D Reconstruction Transformer
summary: Reconstructing dynamic 4D scenes remains challenging due to the presence of moving objects that corrupt camera pose estimation. Existing optimization methods alleviate this issue with additional supervision, but they are mostly computationally expensive and impractical in real-time applications. To address these limitations, we propose MoRe, a feedforward 4D reconstruction network that efficiently recovers dynamic 3D scenes from monocular videos. Built upon a strong static reconstruction backbone, MoRe employs an attention-forcing strategy to disentangle dynamic motion from static structure. To further enhance robustness, we fine-tune the model on large-scale, diverse datasets encompassing both dynamic and static scenes. Moreover, our grouped causal attention captures temporal dependencies and adapts to varying token lengths across frames, ensuring temporally coherent geometry reconstruction. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that MoRe achieves high-quality dynamic reconstructions with exceptional efficiency.
summary_zh: 由于运动物体的存在会干扰相机位姿估计，重建动态4D场景仍然具有挑战性。现有的优化方法通过额外的监督来缓解这个问题，但它们大多计算成本高昂，在实时应用中不切实际。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出MoRe，一种前馈4D重建网络，可以有效地从单目视频中恢复动态3D场景。MoRe建立在强大的静态重建骨干网络之上，采用了一种注意力强制策略，将动态运动从静态结构中解耦。为了进一步增强鲁棒性，我们在包含动态和静态场景的大规模多样化数据集上对模型进行微调。此外，我们采用的分组因果注意力可以捕获时间依赖性，并适应跨帧变化的不同token长度，从而确保时间上连贯的几何重建。在多个基准测试上的大量实验表明，MoRe以卓越的效率实现了高质量的动态重建。
tldr: The paper introduces MoRe, a feed-forward transformer network for efficient dynamic 4D scene reconstruction from monocular video, utilizing attention mechanisms to disentangle motion and structure.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为MoRe的前馈Transformer网络，用于从单目视频中高效地重建动态4D场景，利用注意力机制来分离运动和结构。

title: MI-DETR: A Strong Baseline for Moving Infrared Small Target Detection with Bio-Inspired Motion Integration
summary: Infrared small target detection (ISTD) is challenging because tiny, low-contrast targets are easily obscured by complex and dynamic backgrounds. Conventional multi-frame approaches typically learn motion implicitly through deep neural networks, often requiring additional motion supervision or explicit alignment modules. We propose Motion Integration DETR (MI-DETR), a bio-inspired dual-pathway detector that processes one infrared frame per time step while explicitly modeling motion. First, a retina-inspired cellular automaton (RCA) converts raw frame sequences into a motion map defined on the same pixel grid as the appearance image, enabling parvocellular-like appearance and magnocellular-like motion pathways to be supervised by a single set of bounding boxes without extra motion labels or alignment operations. Second, a Parvocellular-Magnocellular Interconnection (PMI) Block facilitates bidirectional feature interaction between the two pathways, providing a biologically motivated intermediate interconnection mechanism. Finally, a RT-DETR decoder operates on features from the two pathways to produce detection results. Surprisingly, our proposed simple yet effective approach yields strong performance on three commonly used ISTD benchmarks. MI-DETR achieves 70.3% mAP@50 and 72.7% F1 on IRDST-H (+26.35 mAP@50 over the best multi-frame baseline), 98.0% mAP@50 on DAUB-R, and 88.3% mAP@50 on ITSDT-15K, demonstrating the effectiveness of biologically inspired motion-appearance integration. Code is available at https://github.com/nliu-25/MI-DETR.
summary_zh: 红外小目标检测（ISTD）极具挑战性，因为微小、低对比度的目标很容易被复杂且动态的背景所掩盖。传统的基于多帧的方法通常通过深度神经网络隐式地学习运动，这通常需要额外的运动监督或显式的对齐模块。我们提出了一种运动集成DETR（MI-DETR），这是一种受生物启发的双通路检测器，它处理每个时间步的一帧红外图像，同时显式地建模运动。首先，一个受视网膜启发的细胞自动机（RCA）将原始帧序列转换为一个运动图，该运动图定义在与外观图像相同的像素网格上，使得类似于小细胞的（parvocellular-like）外观通路和类似于大细胞的（magnocellular-like）运动通路可以在没有额外运动标签或对齐操作的情况下，被同一组边界框监督。其次，一个小细胞-大细胞互连（PMI）块促进了这两个通路之间双向的特征交互，提供了一种受生物学启发的中间互连机制。最后，一个RT-DETR解码器对来自这两个通路的特征进行操作，从而产生检测结果。令人惊讶的是，我们提出的简单而有效的方法在三个常用的ISTD基准测试中产生了强大的性能。MI-DETR在IRDST-H上实现了70.3%的mAP@50和72.7%的F1（比最好的多帧基线高出+26.35 mAP@50），在DAUB-R上实现了98.0%的mAP@50，在ITSDT-15K上实现了88.3%的mAP@50，证明了受生物启发的外观-运动集成的有效性。代码可在https://github.com/nliu-25/MI-DETR获取。
tldr: The paper introduces MI-DETR, a bio-inspired dual-pathway detector for infrared small target detection that explicitly models motion using a retina-inspired cellular automaton and demonstrates strong performance on standard benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MI-DETR，一种受生物学启发的双通路红外小目标检测器，它使用视网膜启发的细胞自动机显式建模运动，并在标准基准测试中表现出强大的性能。

title: MultiGO++: Monocular 3D Clothed Human Reconstruction via Geometry-Texture Collaboration
summary: Monocular 3D clothed human reconstruction aims to generate a complete and realistic textured 3D avatar from a single image. Existing methods are commonly trained under multi-view supervision with annotated geometric priors, and during inference, these priors are estimated by the pre-trained network from the monocular input. These methods are constrained by three key limitations: texturally by unavailability of training data, geometrically by inaccurate external priors, and systematically by biased single-modality supervision, all leading to suboptimal reconstruction. To address these issues, we propose a novel reconstruction framework, named MultiGO++, which achieves effective systematic geometry-texture collaboration. It consists of three core parts: (1) A multi-source texture synthesis strategy that constructs 15,000+ 3D textured human scans to improve the performance on texture quality estimation in challenge scenarios; (2) A region-aware shape extraction module that extracts and interacts features of each body region to obtain geometry information and a Fourier geometry encoder that mitigates the modality gap to achieve effective geometry learning; (3) A dual reconstruction U-Net that leverages geometry-texture collaborative features to refine and generate high-fidelity textured 3D human meshes. Extensive experiments on two benchmarks and many in-the-wild cases show the superiority of our method over state-of-the-art approaches.
summary_zh: 单目3D服装人体重建旨在从单张图像生成完整且逼真的纹理化3D化身。现有方法通常在带有标注几何先验的多视角监督下进行训练，并且在推理过程中，这些先验由预训练网络从单目输入中估计。这些方法受到三个关键因素的限制：在纹理上受限于训练数据的不可用性，在几何上受限于不准确的外部先验，以及在系统上受限于有偏差的单模态监督，所有这些都导致次优的重建效果。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的重建框架，名为MultiGO++，它实现了有效的系统性几何-纹理协作。它由三个核心部分组成：（1）一种多源纹理合成策略，构建了15000+个3D纹理化人体扫描，以提高在挑战场景中纹理质量估计的性能；（2）一个区域感知形状提取模块，提取并交互每个身体区域的特征以获得几何信息，以及一个傅里叶几何编码器，用于缓解模态差距以实现有效的几何学习；（3）一个双重重建U-Net，利用几何-纹理协作特征来细化和生成高保真度的纹理化3D人体网格。在两个基准数据集和许多真实场景下的广泛实验表明，我们的方法优于最先进的方法。
tldr: The paper presents MultiGO++, a novel framework for monocular 3D clothed human reconstruction that addresses limitations in texture quality, geometric accuracy, and single-modality supervision through geometry-texture collaboration.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了MultiGO++，一种用于单目3D服装人体重建的新框架，通过几何-纹理协作解决纹理质量、几何精度和单模态监督方面的局限性。

title: Scalable Injury-Risk Screening in Baseball Pitching From Broadcast Video
summary: Injury prediction in pitching depends on precise biomechanical signals, yet gold-standard measurements come from expensive, stadium-installed multi-camera systems that are unavailable outside professional venues. We present a monocular video pipeline that recovers 18 clinically relevant biomechanics metrics from broadcast footage, positioning pose-derived kinematics as a scalable source for injury-risk modeling. Built on DreamPose3D, our approach introduces a drift-controlled global lifting module that recovers pelvis trajectory via velocity-based parameterization and sliding-window inference, lifting pelvis-rooted poses into global space. To address motion blur, compression artifacts, and extreme pitching poses, we incorporate a kinematics refinement pipeline with bone-length constraints, joint-limited inverse kinematics, smoothing, and symmetry constraints to ensure temporally stable and physically plausible kinematics. On 13 professional pitchers (156 paired pitches), 16/18 metrics achieve sub-degree agreement (MAE $< 1^{\circ}$). Using these metrics for injury prediction, an automated screening model achieves AUC 0.811 for Tommy John surgery and 0.825 for significant arm injuries on 7,348 pitchers. The resulting pose-derived metrics support scalable injury-risk screening, establishing monocular broadcast video as a viable alternative to stadium-scale motion capture for biomechanics.
summary_zh: 在投球中，损伤预测依赖于精确的生物力学信号，但金标准测量来自昂贵的、安装在体育场内的多摄像头系统，这些系统在专业场地之外无法使用。我们提出了一种单目视频流程，可从广播镜头中恢复 18 个临床相关的生物力学指标，将姿态导出的运动学作为损伤风险建模的可扩展来源。我们的方法建立在 DreamPose3D 之上，引入了一种漂移控制的全局提升模块，该模块通过基于速度的参数化和滑动窗口推理来恢复骨盆轨迹，将以骨盆为根的姿势提升到全局空间。为了解决运动模糊、压缩伪影和极端的投球姿势，我们纳入了一个运动学精炼流程，该流程包括骨骼长度约束、关节限制的反向运动学、平滑和对称性约束，以确保时间上的稳定性和物理上合理的运动学。在 13 名专业投手（156 次配对投球）上，16/18 个指标达到了亚度协议（MAE $< 1^{\circ}$）。使用这些指标进行损伤预测，一个自动筛选模型在 7,348 名投手身上，对 Tommy John 手术实现了 0.811 的 AUC，对重大手臂损伤实现了 0.825 的 AUC。由此产生的姿态导出的指标支持可扩展的损伤风险筛查，确立了单目广播视频作为体育场规模运动捕捉的生物力学可行替代方案。
tldr: This paper introduces a monocular video pipeline, called DreamPose3D, for extracting clinically relevant biomechanical metrics from baseball broadcast footage to enable scalable injury-risk screening, achieving promising results in predicting Tommy John surgery and other arm injuries.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为DreamPose3D的单目视频管道，用于从棒球广播视频中提取临床相关的生物力学指标，从而实现可扩展的损伤风险筛查，并在预测Tommy John手术和其他手臂损伤方面取得了可喜的成果。

title: Revisiting Shape from Polarization in the Era of Vision Foundation Models
summary: We show that, with polarization cues, a lightweight model trained on a small dataset can outperform RGB-only vision foundation models (VFMs) in single-shot object-level surface normal estimation. Shape from polarization (SfP) has long been studied due to the strong physical relationship between polarization and surface geometry. Meanwhile, driven by scaling laws, RGB-only VFMs trained on large datasets have recently achieved impressive performance and surpassed existing SfP methods. This situation raises questions about the necessity of polarization cues, which require specialized hardware and have limited training data. We argue that the weaker performance of prior SfP methods does not come from the polarization modality itself, but from domain gaps. These domain gaps mainly arise from two sources. First, existing synthetic datasets use limited and unrealistic 3D objects, with simple geometry and random texture maps that do not match the underlying shapes. Second, real-world polarization signals are often affected by sensor noise, which is not well modeled during training. To address the first issue, we render a high-quality polarization dataset using 1,954 3D-scanned real-world objects. We further incorporate pretrained DINOv3 priors to improve generalization to unseen objects. To address the second issue, we introduce polarization sensor-aware data augmentation that better reflects real-world conditions. With only 40K training scenes, our method significantly outperforms both state-of-the-art SfP approaches and RGB-only VFMs. Extensive experiments show that polarization cues enable a 33x reduction in training data or an 8x reduction in model parameters, while still achieving better performance than RGB-only counterparts.
summary_zh: 我们证明，凭借偏振线索，在小数据集上训练的轻量级模型可以超越仅使用RGB的视觉基础模型（VFMs），在单次对象级表面法线估计方面表现更优。偏振重构形状（SfP）因偏振与表面几何形状之间强大的物理关系而备受关注。与此同时，受缩放定律驱动，在大型数据集上训练的仅使用RGB的VFMs最近取得了令人印象深刻的性能，并超越了现有的SfP方法。这种情况引发了关于偏振线索必要性的疑问，因为偏振需要专用硬件且训练数据有限。我们认为，先前SfP方法性能较弱并非来自偏振模态本身，而是来自领域差异。这些领域差异主要来自两个方面。首先，现有的合成数据集使用有限且不真实的 3D 对象，其几何形状简单，纹理贴图随机，与底层形状不匹配。其次，真实世界的偏振信号通常受到传感器噪声的影响，而在训练过程中没有对其进行很好的建模。为了解决第一个问题，我们使用 1,954 个 3D 扫描的真实世界对象渲染了一个高质量的偏振数据集。我们进一步结合了预训练的 DINOv3 先验知识，以提高对未见对象的泛化能力。为了解决第二个问题，我们引入了偏振传感器感知的数据增强，以更好地反映真实世界的条件。仅需 4 万个训练场景，我们的方法就显著优于最先进的 SfP 方法和仅使用 RGB 的 VFMs。大量实验表明，偏振线索能够将训练数据减少 33 倍或将模型参数减少 8 倍，同时仍能实现比仅使用 RGB 的同类方法更好的性能。
tldr: This paper demonstrates that shape from polarization, when trained with high-quality data and sensor-aware augmentation, can outperform RGB-only vision foundation models for surface normal estimation with significantly less data and parameters.
tldr_zh: 该论文表明，通过高质量数据和传感器感知增强训练的偏振形状恢复方法，在表面法线估计方面能够以更少的数据和参数优于仅使用 RGB 的视觉基础模型。

title: Recognition of Daily Activities through Multi-Modal Deep Learning: A Video, Pose, and Object-Aware Approach for Ambient Assisted Living
summary: Recognition of daily activities is a critical element for effective Ambient Assisted Living (AAL) systems, particularly to monitor the well-being and support the independence of older adults in indoor environments. However, developing robust activity recognition systems faces significant challenges, including intra-class variability, inter-class similarity, environmental variability, camera perspectives, and scene complexity. This paper presents a multi-modal approach for the recognition of activities of daily living tailored for older adults within AAL settings. The proposed system integrates visual information processed by a 3D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with 3D human pose data analyzed by a Graph Convolutional Network. Contextual information, derived from an object detection module, is fused with the 3D CNN features using a cross-attention mechanism to enhance recognition accuracy. This method is evaluated using the Toyota SmartHome dataset, which consists of real-world indoor activities. The results indicate that the proposed system achieves competitive classification accuracy for a range of daily activities, highlighting its potential as an essential component for advanced AAL monitoring solutions. This advancement supports the broader goal of developing intelligent systems that promote safety and autonomy among older adults.
summary_zh: 日常生活活动识别是有效的环境辅助生活(AAL)系统中的关键要素，特别是为了监测老年人在室内环境中的福祉并支持其独立性。然而，开发稳健的活动识别系统面临着重大挑战，包括类内变异性、类间相似性、环境变异性、相机视角和场景复杂性。本文提出了一种多模态方法，用于识别专为AAL环境中的老年人设计的日常生活活动。所提出的系统集成了由3D卷积神经网络（CNN）处理的视觉信息和由图卷积网络分析的3D人体姿态数据。从目标检测模块导出的上下文信息，通过交叉注意力机制与3D CNN特征融合，以提高识别精度。该方法使用Toyota SmartHome数据集进行评估，该数据集包含真实的室内活动。结果表明，所提出的系统在一系列日常活动中实现了具有竞争力的分类精度，突显了其作为先进AAL监测解决方案重要组成部分的潜力。这一进展支持了开发智能系统的更广泛目标，这些系统旨在提高老年人的安全性和自主性。
tldr: This paper proposes a multi-modal deep learning approach using video, pose, and object information for recognizing daily activities in Ambient Assisted Living, demonstrating competitive accuracy on the Toyota SmartHome dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种多模态深度学习方法，利用视频、姿势和物体信息来识别环境辅助生活中的日常活动，并在Toyota SmartHome数据集上展示了具有竞争力的准确性。

title: SimpliHuMoN: Simplifying Human Motion Prediction
summary: Human motion prediction combines the tasks of trajectory forecasting and human pose prediction. For each of the two tasks, specialized models have been developed. Combining these models for holistic human motion prediction is non-trivial, and recent methods have struggled to compete on established benchmarks for individual tasks. To address this, we propose a simple yet effective transformer-based model for human motion prediction. The model employs a stack of self-attention modules to effectively capture both spatial dependencies within a pose and temporal relationships across a motion sequence. This simple, streamlined, end-to-end model is sufficiently versatile to handle pose-only, trajectory-only, and combined prediction tasks without task-specific modifications. We demonstrate that this approach achieves state-of-the-art results across all tasks through extensive experiments on a wide range of benchmark datasets, including Human3.6M, AMASS, ETH-UCY, and 3DPW.
summary_zh: 人体运动预测结合了轨迹预测和人体姿态预测的任务。对于这两个任务，都已开发出专门的模型。将这些模型结合起来进行整体人体运动预测并非易事，并且最近的方法在既定基准上难以与针对单个任务的模型竞争。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种简单而有效的基于Transformer的人体运动预测模型。该模型采用一系列自注意力模块，以有效地捕获姿态内的空间依赖性和运动序列中的时间关系。这种简单、精简的端到端模型具有足够的通用性，可以处理仅姿态、仅轨迹以及组合预测任务，而无需进行特定于任务的修改。通过对包括Human3.6M、AMASS、ETH-UCY和3DPW在内的各种基准数据集进行的大量实验，我们证明了这种方法在所有任务上都取得了最先进的结果。
tldr: The paper introduces SimpliHuMoN, a simple transformer-based model for human motion prediction that achieves state-of-the-art results on various benchmarks without task-specific modifications, handling pose-only, trajectory-only, and combined prediction.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍SimpliHuMoN，一个简单的基于transformer的人体运动预测模型，在各种基准测试中取得了最先进的结果，无需针对特定任务的修改，即可处理仅姿势、仅轨迹以及组合预测。

title: Competitive Multi-Operator Reinforcement Learning for Joint Pricing and Fleet Rebalancing in AMoD Systems
summary: Autonomous Mobility-on-Demand (AMoD) systems promise to revolutionize urban transportation by providing affordable on-demand services to meet growing travel demand. However, realistic AMoD markets will be competitive, with multiple operators competing for passengers through strategic pricing and fleet deployment. While reinforcement learning has shown promise in optimizing single-operator AMoD control, existing work fails to capture competitive market dynamics. We investigate the impact of competition on policy learning by introducing a multi-operator reinforcement learning framework where two operators simultaneously learn pricing and fleet rebalancing policies. By integrating discrete choice theory, we enable passenger allocation and demand competition to emerge endogenously from utility-maximizing decisions. Experiments using real-world data from multiple cities demonstrate that competition fundamentally alters learned behaviors, leading to lower prices and distinct fleet positioning patterns compared to monopolistic settings. Notably, we demonstrate that learning-based approaches are robust to the additional stochasticity of competition, with competitive agents successfully converging to effective policies while accounting for partially unobserved competitor strategies.
summary_zh: 自主按需出行（AMoD）系统有望通过提供经济实惠的按需服务来满足日益增长的出行需求，从而彻底改变城市交通。然而，现实的AMoD市场将是竞争性的，多个运营商将通过战略性定价和车队部署来争夺乘客。虽然强化学习已显示出在优化单运营商AMoD控制方面的潜力，但现有工作未能捕捉到竞争性市场动态。我们通过引入一个多运营商强化学习框架来研究竞争对策略学习的影响，其中两个运营商同时学习定价和车队重新平衡策略。通过整合离散选择理论，我们使乘客分配和需求竞争能够内生地从效用最大化决策中产生。使用来自多个城市的真实世界数据进行的实验表明，竞争从根本上改变了学习到的行为，与垄断环境相比，导致了更低的价格和不同的车队定位模式。值得注意的是，我们证明了基于学习的方法对竞争带来的额外随机性具有鲁棒性，竞争性代理能够成功地收敛到有效的策略，同时考虑到部分未观察到的竞争对手策略。
tldr: This paper introduces a multi-operator reinforcement learning framework for competitive AMoD systems, showing competition alters pricing and fleet positioning compared to monopoly settings and demonstrating robustness to stochasticity.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于竞争性按需出行系统的多运营商强化学习框架，表明竞争会改变定价和车队定位，与垄断环境相比，并展示了对随机性的鲁棒性。

title: Semantic Communication-Enhanced Split Federated Learning for Vehicular Networks: Architecture, Challenges, and Case Study
summary: Vehicular edge intelligence (VEI) is vital for future intelligent transportation systems. However, traditional centralized learning in dynamic vehicular networks faces significant communication overhead and privacy risks. Split federated learning (SFL) offers a distributed solution but is often hindered by substantial communication bottlenecks from transmitting high-dimensional intermediate features and can present label privacy concerns. Semantic communication offers a transformative approach to alleviate these communication challenges in SFL by focusing on transmitting only task-relevant information. This paper leverages the advantages of semantic communication in the design of SFL, and presents a case study the semantic communication-enhanced U-Shaped split federated learning (SC-USFL) framework that inherently enhances label privacy by localizing sensitive computations with reduced overhead. It features a dedicated semantic communication module (SCM), with pre-trained and parameter-frozen encoding/decoding units, to efficiently compress and transmit only the task-relevant semantic information over the critical uplink path from vehicular users to the edge server (ES). Furthermore, a network status monitor (NSM) module enables adaptive adjustment of the semantic compression rate in real-time response to fluctuating wireless channel conditions. The SC-USFL framework demonstrates a promising approach for efficiently balancing communication load, preserving privacy, and maintaining learning performance in resource-constrained vehicular environments. Finally, this paper highlights key open research directions to further advance the synergy between semantic communication and SFL in the vehicular network.
summary_zh: 车辆边缘智能（VEI）对于未来智能交通系统至关重要。然而，动态车辆网络中传统的集中式学习面临着显著的通信开销和隐私风险。拆分联邦学习（SFL）提供了一种分布式解决方案，但常常受到传输高维中间特征所带来的巨大通信瓶颈的阻碍，并且可能存在标签隐私问题。语义通信提供了一种变革性的方法，可以通过仅传输与任务相关的信息来缓解SFL中的这些通信挑战。本文利用语义通信在SFL设计中的优势，并提出了一个案例研究：语义通信增强的U型拆分联邦学习（SC-USFL）框架，该框架通过将敏感计算本地化，同时降低开销，从本质上增强了标签隐私。它配备了一个专门的语义通信模块（SCM），具有预训练且参数冻结的编码/解码单元，用于有效地压缩和传输仅与任务相关的语义信息，通过从车辆用户到边缘服务器（ES）的关键上行链路路径。此外，网络状态监控（NSM）模块能够实时响应波动的无线信道条件，自适应地调整语义压缩率。SC-USFL框架展示了一种有希望的方法，可以在资源受限的车辆环境中有效平衡通信负载、保护隐私并保持学习性能。最后，本文强调了关键的开放研究方向，以进一步推进车辆网络中语义通信与SFL之间的协同作用。
tldr: This paper proposes a semantic communication-enhanced split federated learning (SC-USFL) framework for vehicular networks, focusing on reducing communication overhead and enhancing privacy by transmitting only task-relevant information. It adapts compression rates based on network conditions and identifies future research directions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于车辆网络的语义通信增强型分离联邦学习 (SC-USFL) 框架，通过仅传输与任务相关的信息来减少通信开销并增强隐私。它根据网络状况调整压缩率，并确定未来的研究方向。

title: Robust Unscented Kalman Filtering via Recurrent Meta-Adaptation of Sigma-Point Weights
summary: The Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) is a ubiquitous tool for nonlinear state estimation; however, its performance is limited by the static parameterization of the Unscented Transform (UT). Conventional weighting schemes, governed by fixed scaling parameters, assume implicit Gaussianity and fail to adapt to time-varying dynamics or heavy-tailed measurement noise. This work introduces the Meta-Adaptive UKF (MA-UKF), a framework that reformulates sigma-point weight synthesis as a hyperparameter optimization problem addressed via memory-augmented meta-learning. Unlike standard adaptive filters that rely on instantaneous heuristic corrections, our approach employs a Recurrent Context Encoder to compress the history of measurement innovations into a compact latent embedding. This embedding informs a policy network that dynamically synthesizes the mean and covariance weights of the sigma points at each time step, effectively governing the filter's trust in the prediction versus the measurement. By optimizing the system end-to-end through the filter's recursive logic, the MA-UKF learns to maximize tracking accuracy while maintaining estimation consistency. Numerical benchmarks on maneuvering targets demonstrate that the MA-UKF significantly outperforms standard baselines, exhibiting superior robustness to non-Gaussian glint noise and effective generalization to out-of-distribution (OOD) dynamic regimes unseen during training.
summary_zh: 无迹卡尔曼滤波(UKF)是非线性状态估计中一种广泛使用的工具；然而，其性能受到无迹变换(UT)静态参数化的限制。传统的加权方案由固定的缩放参数控制，它隐含地假设了高斯性，并且无法适应时变的动态或重尾测量噪声。本文介绍了一种元自适应UKF(MA-UKF)框架，该框架将sigma点权重综合重构为通过记忆增强的元学习解决的超参数优化问题。与依赖于瞬时启发式校正的标准自适应滤波器不同，我们的方法采用循环上下文编码器将测量新息的历史压缩成紧凑的潜在嵌入。该嵌入驱动策略网络，在每个时间步动态合成sigma点的均值和协方差权重，从而有效地控制滤波器对预测和测量的置信度。通过端到端地优化系统的滤波器递归逻辑，MA-UKF学会最大化跟踪精度，同时保持估计一致性。对机动目标的数值基准测试表明，MA-UKF显著优于标准基线，在非高斯闪烁噪声下表现出卓越的鲁棒性，并能够有效地泛化到训练期间未见过的离群分布(OOD)动态状态。
tldr: The paper introduces Meta-Adaptive UKF (MA-UKF), a novel Kalman filter that uses meta-learning to dynamically adjust sigma-point weights, improving robustness against non-Gaussian noise and generalization to unseen dynamic regimes.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Meta-Adaptive UKF (MA-UKF)，一种新型卡尔曼滤波器，它使用元学习来动态调整sigma-point权重，从而提高对非高斯噪声的鲁棒性并泛化到未见的动态状态。

title: Constraint-Free Static Modeling of Continuum Parallel Robot
summary: Continuum parallel robots (CPR) combine rigid actuation mechanisms with multiple elastic rods in a closed-loop topology, making forward statics challenging when rigid--continuum junctions are enforced by explicit kinematic constraints. Such constraint-based formulations typically introduce additional algebraic variables and complicate both numerical solution and downstream control. This paper presents a geometric exact, configuration-based and constraint-free static model of CPR that remains valid under geometrically nonlinear, large-deformation and large-rotation conditions. Connectivity constraints are eliminated by kinematic embedding, yielding a reduced unconstrained problem. Each rod of CPR is discretized by nodal poses on SE(3), while the element-wise strain field is reconstructed through a linear strain parameterization. A fourth-order Magnus approximation yields an explicit and geometrically consistent mapping between element end poses and the strain. Rigid attachments at the motor-driven base and the end-effector platforms are handled through kinematic embeddings. Based on total potential energy and virtual work, we derive assembly-ready residuals and explicit Newton tangents, and solve the resulting nonlinear equilibrium equations using a Riemannian Newton iteration on the product manifold. Experiments on a three-servomotor, six-rod prototype validate the model by showing good agreement between simulation and measurements for both unloaded motions and externally loaded cases.
summary_zh: 连续体并联机器人 (CPR) 将刚性驱动机构与闭环拓扑结构中的多个弹性杆相结合，当刚性-连续体连接处通过显式运动学约束强制执行时，正向静力学分析极具挑战性。这种基于约束的公式通常会引入额外的代数变量，并使数值求解和下游控制变得复杂。本文提出了一种几何精确、基于构型且无约束的CPR静力学模型，该模型在几何非线性、大变形和大旋转条件下仍然有效。通过运动学嵌入消除了连接约束，从而产生了一个简化的无约束问题。CPR的每个杆都通过SE(3)上的节点位姿进行离散化，同时单元级的应变场通过线性应变参数化进行重构。一个四阶Magnus近似产生了单元端位姿与应变之间的显式且几何一致性映射。在电机驱动基座和末端执行器平台上的刚性连接通过运动学嵌入进行处理。基于总势能和虚功，我们推导出易于组装的残差和显式牛顿切线，并使用黎曼牛顿迭代法在乘积流形上求解得到的非线性平衡方程。在一个三伺服电机、六杆原型上的实验验证了该模型，结果表明，无论是空载运动还是外部加载的情况下，仿真和测量之间都具有良好的一致性。
tldr: This paper presents a constraint-free static model for continuum parallel robots using geometric methods, validated through experiments on a prototype. It simplifies forward statics by eliminating kinematic constraints and uses a Riemannian Newton iteration for solving nonlinear equilibrium equations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于几何方法的连续体并联机器人无约束静态模型，并通过原型实验验证。它通过消除运动学约束简化了正向静态学，并使用黎曼牛顿迭代法求解非线性平衡方程。

title: Observer Design for Augmented Reality-based Teleoperation of Soft Robots
summary: Although virtual and augmented reality are gaining traction as teleoperation tools for various types of robots, including manipulators and mobile robots, they are not being used for soft robots. The inherent difficulties of modelling soft robots mean that combining accurate and computationally efficient representations is very challenging. This paper presents an augmented reality interface for teleoperating these devices. The developed system consists of Microsoft HoloLens 2 glasses and a central computer responsible for calculations. Validation is performed on PETER, a highly modular pneumatic manipulator. Using data collected from sensors, the computer estimates the robot's position based on the physics of the virtual reality programme. Errors obtained are on the order of 5% of the robot's length, demonstrating that augmented reality facilitates operator interaction with soft manipulators and can be integrated into the control loop.
summary_zh: 尽管虚拟现实和增强现实正日益成为各种类型机器人（包括机械臂和移动机器人）的遥操作工具，但它们尚未应用于软体机器人。对软体机器人进行建模的内在困难意味着，结合精确且计算高效的表示方式极具挑战性。本文提出了一种用于遥操作这些设备的增强现实界面。所开发的系统由微软HoloLens 2眼镜和负责计算的中央计算机组成。在高度模块化的气动机械臂PETER上进行了验证。通过使用从传感器收集的数据，计算机基于虚拟现实程序的物理特性来估计机器人的位置。获得的误差约为机器人长度的5%，这表明增强现实有助于操作员与软体机械臂进行交互，并且可以集成到控制回路中。
tldr: This paper introduces an augmented reality interface using HoloLens 2 for teleoperating soft robots, specifically a pneumatic manipulator, achieving about 5% error in position estimation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种使用HoloLens 2的增强现实界面，用于遥控软体机器人，特别是气动机械臂，实现了约5%的位置估计误差。

title: Designing and Validating a Self-Aligning Tool Changer for Modular Reconfigurable Manipulation Robots
summary: Modular reconfigurable robots require reliable mechanisms for automated module exchange, but conventional rigid active couplings often fail due to inevitable positioning and orientational errors. To address this, we propose a misalignment-tolerant tool-changing system. The hardware features a motor-driven coupling utilizing passive self-alignment geometries, specifically chamfered receptacles and triangular lead-in guides, to robustly compensate for angular and lateral misalignments without complex force sensors. To make this autonomous exchange practically feasible, the mechanism is complemented by a compact rotating tool exchange station for efficient module storage. Real-world autonomous tool-picking experiments validate that the self-aligning features successfully absorb execution errors, enabling highly reliable robotic tool reconfiguration.
summary_zh: 模块化可重构机器人需要可靠的自动化模块交换机制，但传统的刚性主动耦合机构常因不可避免的定位和朝向误差而失效。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种具有容错能力的工具更换系统。该硬件采用电机驱动的耦合机构，利用被动自对准几何形状——特别是倒角插座和三角形引导槽——无需复杂的力传感器即可可靠地补偿角度和横向不对准。为了使这种自主交换在实践中可行，该机制辅以一个紧凑的旋转工具交换站，用于高效的模块存储。真实的自主工具拾取实验验证了自对准特性成功吸收了执行误差，从而实现了高度可靠的机器人工具重构。
tldr: This paper introduces a self-aligning tool changer for modular robots that uses passive mechanical features to overcome positioning errors during automated tool exchange, validated through autonomous experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于模块化机器人的自对准工具更换器，该更换器利用被动机械特性来克服自动工具更换过程中的定位误差，并通过自主实验进行了验证。

title: A Soft Robotic Demonstration in the Stratosphere
summary: Machines designed for operation in Space, as well as other extreme environments, need to be both resilient and adaptable when mission parameters change. Soft robots offer advantages in adaptability, but most lack resilience to the pressure and temperature extremes found as close as the Stratosphere. Dielectric elastomer actuators overcome some of those limitations when built as solid state compliant capacitors capable of converting electrical energy into mechanical work, but the elastomer resilience limits the device's operating window. Here we present a crosslinking mechanism for silicone elastomers under ultraviolet light using trimethyl(methylcyclopentadienyl)platinum(IV) as a catalyst to react hydrosilane to vinyl groups. The formation of carbon-carbon bonds enables fast processing under UV light and exceptional electro-mechanical performance in dielectric elastomer actuators. The material resilience advantage is demonstrated in controlled experiments at -40° and 120° C, as well as near vacuum, in comparison with state-of-the-art acrylic and silicone chemistries. Fully autonomous systems controlling grippers made with the novel silicone were integrated into payloads for high altitude balloon testing. Two stratospheric balloon missions were carried out and demonstrated DEAs as a viable soft robotic technology under space-like conditions (as high as 23.6 km elevation, at <0.05 atm and -55° C). The combinations of chemical building blocks and catalyst can be further expanded to address other challenges for silicones, including adhesion and additive manufacturing.
summary_zh: 为在太空和其他极端环境中运行而设计的机器，需要在任务参数变化时具备弹性和适应性。软体机器人在适应性方面具有优势，但大多数在平流层附近所发现的极端压力和温度下缺乏弹性。介电弹性体驱动器（DEA）克服了其中一些限制，它们被构建为能够将电能转化为机械功的固态柔性电容器，但弹性体的弹性限制了设备的工作窗口。在此，我们提出了一种在紫外光下以三甲基（甲基环戊二烯基）铂(IV)为催化剂，使硅烷与乙烯基反应的硅酮弹性体交联机制。碳-碳键的形成使得在紫外光下能够快速处理，并使介电弹性体驱动器具有卓越的电机械性能。通过在-40°和120° C以及近真空下的受控实验，并与最先进的丙烯酸和硅酮化学材料进行比较，证明了该材料的弹性优势。完全自主的系统控制着由新型硅酮制成的夹爪，这些夹爪被集成到用于高空探空气球测试的有效载荷中。我们进行了两次平流层探空气球任务，证明了 DEA 作为一种可行的软体机器人技术，能在类太空条件下（高达 23.6 公里海拔，<0.05 个大气压和 -55° C）运行。化学构件和催化剂的组合可以进一步扩展，以解决硅酮的其他挑战，包括粘合和增材制造。
tldr: The paper presents a novel silicone elastomer crosslinking mechanism for dielectric elastomer actuators (DEAs), demonstrating its resilience to extreme stratospheric conditions in soft robotic grippers during high-altitude balloon testing.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新型硅弹性体交联机制，用于介电弹性体驱动器(DEA)。并通过高空气球试验，验证了该机制在软机器人夹爪于极端平流层条件下具有的弹性。

title: SSR-GS: Separating Specular Reflection in Gaussian Splatting for Glossy Surface Reconstruction
summary:
In recent years, 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) has achieved remarkable progress in novel view synthesis. However, accurately reconstructing glossy surfaces under complex illumination remains challenging, particularly in scenes with strong specular reflections and multi-surface interreflections. To address this issue, we propose SSR-GS, a specular reflection modeling framework for glossy surface reconstruction. Specifically, we introduce a prefiltered Mip-Cubemap to model direct specular reflections efficiently, and propose an IndiASG module to capture indirect specular reflections.
  Furthermore, we design Visual Geometry Priors (VGP) that couple a reflection-aware visual prior via a reflection score (RS) to downweight the photometric loss contribution of reflection-dominated regions, with geometry priors derived from VGGT, including progressively decayed depth supervision and transformed normal constraints. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that SSR-GS achieves state-of-the-art performance in glossy surface reconstruction.
summary_zh: 近年来，3D高斯溅射(3DGS)在 Novel View Synthesis 领域取得了显著进展。然而，在复杂光照条件下精确重建光滑表面仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在具有强镜面反射和多表面间反射的场景中。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种用于光滑表面重建的镜面反射建模框架 SSR-GS。具体来说，我们引入了一个预滤波Mip-Cubemap来有效地模拟直接镜面反射，并提出了一个 IndiASG 模块来捕获间接镜面反射。此外，我们设计了视觉几何先验 (VGP)，它通过反射得分 (RS) 将反射感知的视觉先验耦合起来，以降低反射主导区域的光度损失贡献，并结合从 VGGT 导出的几何先验，包括逐步衰减的深度监督和变换后的法线约束。在合成和真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，SSR-GS 在光滑表面重建方面取得了最先进的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces SSR-GS, a method for improving glossy surface reconstruction in 3D Gaussian Splatting by modeling both direct and indirect specular reflections with specialized modules and visual geometry priors.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SSR-GS，一种通过建模直接和间接镜面反射以及使用专门的模块和视觉几何先验来改进3D高斯溅射中光泽表面重建的方法。

title: DSA-SRGS: Super-Resolution Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Sparse-View DSA Reconstruction
summary: Digital subtraction angiography (DSA) is a key imaging technique for the auxiliary diagnosis and treatment of cerebrovascular diseases. Recent advancements in gaussian splatting and dynamic neural representations have enabled robust 3D vessel reconstruction from sparse dynamic inputs. However, these methods are fundamentally constrained by the resolution of input projections, where performing naive upsampling to enhance rendering resolution inevitably results in severe blurring and aliasing artifacts. Such lack of super-resolution capability prevents the reconstructed 4D models from recovering fine-grained vascular details and intricate branching structures, which restricts their application in precision diagnosis and treatment. To solve this problem, this paper proposes DSA-SRGS, the first super-resolution gaussian splatting framework for dynamic sparse-view DSA reconstruction. Specifically, we introduce a Multi-Fidelity Texture Learning Module that integrates high-quality priors from a fine-tuned DSA-specific super-resolution model, into the 4D reconstruction optimization. To mitigate potential hallucination artifacts from pseudo-labels, this module employs a Confidence-Aware Strategy to adaptively weight supervision signals between the original low-resolution projections and the generated high-resolution pseudo-labels. Furthermore, we develop Radiative Sub-Pixel Densification, an adaptive strategy that leverages gradient accumulation from high-resolution sub-pixel sampling to refine the 4D radiative gaussian kernels. Extensive experiments on two clinical DSA datasets demonstrate that DSA-SRGS significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both quantitative metrics and qualitative visual fidelity.
summary_zh: 数字减影血管造影 (DSA) 是脑血管疾病辅助诊断和治疗的关键成像技术。高斯溅射和动态神经表示的最新进展已经能够从稀疏动态输入中实现稳健的血管三维重建。然而，这些方法从根本上受到输入投影分辨率的限制，对输入投影进行简单的上采样以提高渲染分辨率，不可避免地会导致严重的模糊和混叠伪影。这种缺乏超分辨率能力的情况阻碍了重建的四维模型恢复精细的血管细节和复杂的血管分支结构，从而限制了其在精确诊断和治疗中的应用。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了 DSA-SRGS，这是第一个用于动态稀疏视角 DSA 重建的超分辨率高斯溅射框架。具体而言，我们引入了一个多保真度纹理学习模块，该模块将来自微调的 DSA 特定超分辨率模型的高质量先验知识集成到四维重建优化中。为了减轻来自伪标签的潜在幻觉伪影，该模块采用一种置信度感知策略，以自适应地加权原始低分辨率投影和生成的高分辨率伪标签之间的监督信号。此外，我们开发了辐射子像素密集化，这是一种自适应策略，利用来自高分辨率子像素采样的梯度累积来细化四维辐射高斯核。在两个临床 DSA 数据集上进行的大量实验表明，DSA-SRGS 在定量指标和定性视觉保真度方面均显著优于最先进的方法。
tldr: The paper introduces DSA-SRGS, a super-resolution gaussian splatting framework for dynamic sparse-view DSA reconstruction, enhancing the resolution and detail of 4D vessel models using multi-fidelity texture learning and radiative sub-pixel densification.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DSA-SRGS，一个用于动态稀疏视角DSA重建的超分辨率高斯溅射框架，通过多保真纹理学习和辐射亚像素加密来增强4D血管模型的分辨率和细节。

title: Video-based Locomotion Analysis for Fish Health Monitoring
summary: Monitoring the health conditions of fish is essential, as it enables the early detection of disease, safeguards animal welfare, and contributes to sustainable aquaculture practices. Physiological and pathological conditions of cultivated fish can be inferred by analyzing locomotion activities. In this paper, we present a system that estimates the locomotion activities from videos using multi object tracking. The core of our approach is a YOLOv11 detector embedded in a tracking-by-detection framework. We investigate various configurations of the YOLOv11-architecture as well as extensions that incorporate multiple frames to improve detection accuracy. Our system is evaluated on a manually annotated dataset of Sulawesi ricefish recorded in a home-aquarium-like setup, demonstrating its ability to reliably measure swimming direction and speed for fish health monitoring. The dataset will be made publicly available upon publication.
summary_zh: 监测鱼类的健康状况至关重要，因为它有助于疾病的早期发现，保障动物福利，并促进可持续的水产养殖实践。通过分析运动行为可以推断养殖鱼类的生理和病理状况。在本文中，我们提出了一种利用多目标跟踪从视频中估计运动行为的系统。我们方法的核心是嵌入在检测跟踪框架中的YOLOv11检测器。我们研究了YOLOv11架构的各种配置，以及结合多帧以提高检测精度的扩展。我们的系统在一个手动标注的苏拉威西稻田鱼数据集上进行了评估，该数据集是在类似家庭水族箱的设置中记录的，证明了其可靠测量鱼类游泳方向和速度，用于鱼类健康监测的能力。该数据集将在发表后公开。
tldr: The paper presents a video-based system for analyzing fish locomotion using YOLOv11 and multi-object tracking to monitor fish health; a dataset of Sulawesi ricefish will be released.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个基于视频的系统，利用YOLOv11和多目标跟踪分析鱼类运动，以监测鱼类健康；Sulawesi ricefish的数据集将发布。

title: Embedded Inter-Subject Variability in Adversarial Learning for Inertial Sensor-Based Human Activity Recognition
summary: This paper addresses the problem of Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using data from wearable inertial sensors. An important challenge in HAR is the model's generalization capabilities to new unseen individuals due to inter-subject variability, i.e., the same activity is performed differently by different individuals. To address this problem, we propose a novel deep adversarial framework that integrates the concept of inter-subject variability in the adversarial task, thereby encouraging subject-invariant feature representations and enhancing the classification performance in the HAR problem. Our approach outperforms previous methods in three well-established HAR datasets using a leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) cross-validation. Further results indicate that our proposed adversarial task effectively reduces inter-subject variability among different users in the feature space, and it outperforms adversarial tasks from previous works when integrated into our framework. Code: https://github.com/FranciscoCalatrava/EmbeddedSubjectVariability.git
summary_zh: 本文探讨了使用可穿戴惯性传感器数据进行人体活动识别（HAR）的问题。HAR 的一个重要挑战是模型对未见过的新个体表现出的泛化能力，这源于个体差异，即不同个体执行同一活动的方式不同。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种新颖的深度对抗框架，该框架将个体差异的概念融入到对抗任务中，从而鼓励生成与个体无关的特征表示，并提高 HAR 问题的分类性能。通过留一受试者交叉验证 (LOSO)，我们的方法在三个公认的 HAR 数据集上优于以往的方法。进一步的结果表明，我们提出的对抗任务能有效减少特征空间中不同用户之间的个体差异，并且当集成到我们的框架中时，它优于以往对抗任务。代码：https://github.com/FranciscoCalatrava/EmbeddedSubjectVariability.git
tldr: This paper introduces a novel adversarial learning framework for Human Activity Recognition (HAR) that addresses inter-subject variability, achieving state-of-the-art results on benchmark datasets using leave-one-subject-out cross-validation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的对抗学习框架，用于人体活动识别（HAR），该框架解决了主体间差异性问题，并在基准数据集上使用留一法交叉验证获得了最先进的结果。

title: Interpretable Pre-Release Baseball Pitch Type Anticipation from Broadcast 3D Kinematics
summary: How much can a pitcher's body reveal about the upcoming pitch? We study this question at scale by classifying eight pitch types from monocular 3D pose sequences, without access to ball-flight data. Our pipeline chains a diffusion-based 3D pose backbone with automatic pitching-event detection, groundtruth-validated biomechanical feature extraction, and gradient-boosted classification over 229 kinematic features. Evaluated on 119,561 professional pitches, the largest such benchmark to date, we achieve 80.4\% accuracy using body kinematics alone. A systematic importance analysis reveals that upper-body mechanics contribute 64.9\% of the predictive signal versus 35.1\% for the lower body, with wrist position (14.8\%) and trunk lateral tilt emerging as the most informative joint group and biomechanical feature, respectively. We further show that grip-defined variants (four-seam vs.\ two-seam fastball) are not separable from pose, establishing an empirical ceiling near 80\% and delineating where kinematic information ends and ball-flight information begins.
summary_zh: 一位投手身体的姿态能揭示多少关于即将投出的球的信息？我们大规模地研究这个问题，通过仅使用单目3D姿态序列来分类八种投球类型，而无需访问球的飞行数据。我们的流程将基于扩散模型的3D姿态主干网络与自动投球事件检测、经过真实性验证的生物力学特征提取以及基于梯度提升的分类器串联起来，该分类器基于229个运动学特征进行训练。在 119,561 次专业投球的评估中，这是迄今为止最大的此类基准测试，我们仅使用身体运动学就达到了 80.4% 的准确率。一项系统的重要性分析表明，上肢力学贡献了 64.9% 的预测信号，而下肢贡献了 35.1%，其中手腕位置（14.8%）和躯干侧倾分别成为信息量最大的关节组和生物力学特征。我们进一步表明，由握法定义的变体（四缝线快速球与两缝线快速球）无法从姿势中区分，从而确定了一个接近 80% 的经验上限，并界定了运动学信息的终点以及球飞行信息的起点。
tldr: This paper classifies baseball pitch types from 3D pose using a diffusion-based pose backbone and gradient-boosted classification, achieving 80.4% accuracy by analyzing kinematic features and identifying key body mechanics.
tldr_zh: 本文利用基于扩散的3D姿态骨干网络和梯度提升分类，通过分析运动学特征并识别关键身体机制，从3D姿态中分类棒球投球类型，准确率达到80.4%。

title: RoboPocket: Improve Robot Policies Instantly with Your Phone
summary: Scaling imitation learning is fundamentally constrained by the efficiency of data collection. While handheld interfaces have emerged as a scalable solution for in-the-wild data acquisition, they predominantly operate in an open-loop manner: operators blindly collect demonstrations without knowing the underlying policy's weaknesses, leading to inefficient coverage of critical state distributions. Conversely, interactive methods like DAgger effectively address covariate shift but rely on physical robot execution, which is costly and difficult to scale. To reconcile this trade-off, we introduce RoboPocket, a portable system that enables Robot-Free Instant Policy Iteration using single consumer smartphones. Its core innovation is a Remote Inference framework that visualizes the policy's predicted trajectory via Augmented Reality (AR) Visual Foresight. This immersive feedback allows collectors to proactively identify potential failures and focus data collection on the policy's weak regions without requiring a physical robot. Furthermore, we implement an asynchronous Online Finetuning pipeline that continuously updates the policy with incoming data, effectively closing the learning loop in minutes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RoboPocket adheres to data scaling laws and doubles the data efficiency compared to offline scaling strategies, overcoming their long-standing efficiency bottleneck. Moreover, our instant iteration loop also boosts sample efficiency by up to 2$\times$ in distributed environments a small number of interactive corrections per person. Project page and videos: https://robo-pocket.github.io.
summary_zh: 模仿学习的规模化受限于数据收集的效率。手持界面作为一种可扩展的野外数据采集方案已崭露头角，但它们主要以开环方式运行：操作员盲目地收集演示数据，而不知道底层策略的弱点，导致对关键状态分布的覆盖效率低下。相反，像DAgger这样的交互式方法可以有效地解决协变量偏移问题，但依赖于物理机器人的执行，这成本高昂且难以规模化。为了协调这种权衡，我们引入了 RoboPocket，这是一种便携式系统，可以使用单个消费级智能手机实现无需机器人的即时策略迭代。其核心创新是一个远程推理框架，通过增强现实 (AR) 视觉预测可视化策略的预测轨迹。这种沉浸式反馈使数据采集者能够主动识别潜在的失败，并将数据收集集中在策略的薄弱区域，而无需物理机器人。此外，我们实现了一个异步在线微调流程，该流程使用传入的数据持续更新策略，从而有效地在几分钟内闭合学习循环。大量的实验表明，RoboPocket 遵循数据缩放定律，与离线缩放策略相比，数据效率提高了一倍，克服了它们长期存在的效率瓶颈。此外，我们的即时迭代循环还在分布式环境中将样本效率提高了高达 2 倍——每个人只需进行少量交互式校正。项目主页和视频：https://robo-pocket.github.io。
tldr: RoboPocket uses AR visual foresight on smartphones for robot-free policy iteration, enabling efficient data collection by focusing on policy weaknesses without needing a physical robot, surpassing offline scaling and boosting sample efficiency.
tldr_zh: RoboPocket利用智能手机上的AR视觉预测进行无机器人策略迭代，通过关注策略弱点来实现高效的数据收集，无需物理机器人即可超越离线缩放并提高样本效率。

title: cuRoboV2: Dynamics-Aware Motion Generation with Depth-Fused Distance Fields for High-DoF Robots
summary: Effective robot autonomy requires motion generation that is safe, feasible, and reactive. Current methods are fragmented: fast planners output physically unexecutable trajectories, reactive controllers struggle with high-fidelity perception, and existing solvers fail on high-DoF systems. We present cuRoboV2, a unified framework with three key innovations: (1) B-spline trajectory optimization that enforces smoothness and torque limits; (2) a GPU-native TSDF/ESDF perception pipeline that generates dense signed distance fields covering the full workspace, unlike existing methods that only provide distances within sparsely allocated blocks, up to 10x faster and in 8x less memory than the state-of-the-art at manipulation scale, with up to 99% collision recall; and (3) scalable GPU-native whole-body computation, namely topology-aware kinematics, differentiable inverse dynamics, and map-reduce self-collision, that achieves up to 61x speedup while also extending to high-DoF humanoids (where previous GPU implementations fail). On benchmarks, cuRoboV2 achieves 99.7% success under 3kg payload (where baselines achieve only 72--77%), 99.6% collision-free IK on a 48-DoF humanoid (where prior methods fail entirely), and 89.5% retargeting constraint satisfaction (vs. 61% for PyRoki); these collision-free motions yield locomotion policies with 21% lower tracking error than PyRoki and 12x lower cross-seed variance than mink. A ground-up codebase redesign for discoverability enabled LLM coding assistants to author up to 73% of new modules, including hand-optimized CUDA kernels, demonstrating that well-structured robotics code can unlock productive human--LLM collaboration. Together, these advances provide a unified, dynamics-aware motion generation stack that scales from single-arm manipulators to full humanoids.
summary_zh: 有效的机器人自主能力需要安全、可行且具有反应性的运动生成。目前的方法是分散的：快速规划器输出物理上无法执行的轨迹，反应式控制器在面对高保真感知时表现不佳，而现有的求解器在高自由度系统上失效。我们提出了cuRoboV2，这是一个统一的框架，具有三个关键创新：(1) B样条轨迹优化，可强制平滑性和扭矩限制；(2) GPU原生TSDF/ESDF感知管线，可生成覆盖整个工作空间的密集符号距离场，与现有方法不同，现有方法仅提供稀疏分配块内的距离，但该管线速度提升高达10倍，内存占用减少8倍（在操作尺度下），碰撞召回率高达99%；(3) 可扩展的GPU原生全身计算，即拓扑感知运动学、可微逆动力学和map-reduce自碰撞，速度提升高达61倍，同时还扩展到了高自由度人形机器人（之前的GPU实现失败）。在基准测试中，cuRoboV2在3kg有效载荷下成功率达到99.7%（基线仅达到72-77%），在48自由度人形机器人上实现99.6%的无碰撞逆运动学（之前的算法完全失败），并实现89.5%的重定向约束满足度（PyRoki为61%）；这些无碰撞运动产生的运动策略比PyRoki降低了21%的跟踪误差，比mink降低了12倍的跨种子方差。一个自底向上的代码库重新设计以实现可发现性，使得LLM编码助手能够编写高达73%的新模块，包括手工优化的CUDA内核，这表明结构良好的机器人代码可以释放生产力高的人-LLM协作。 这些进展共同提供了一个统一的、动力学感知的运动生成堆栈，可从单臂机械手扩展到完整的人形机器人。
tldr: cuRoboV2 presents a unified, GPU-accelerated framework for dynamics-aware motion generation for robots, from manipulators to humanoids, featuring fast and memory-efficient perception, scalable whole-body computation, and improved LLM-assisted code development.
tldr_zh: cuRoboV2提出了一个统一的、GPU加速的机器人动力学感知运动生成框架，适用于从机械臂到人形机器人的各种机器人。该框架具有快速高效的感知，可扩展的全身计算，以及改进的LLM辅助代码开发。

title: Planning in 8 Tokens: A Compact Discrete Tokenizer for Latent World Model
summary: World models provide a powerful framework for simulating environment dynamics conditioned on actions or instructions, enabling downstream tasks such as action planning or policy learning. Recent approaches leverage world models as learned simulators, but its application to decision-time planning remains computationally prohibitive for real-time control. A key bottleneck lies in latent representations: conventional tokenizers encode each observation into hundreds of tokens, making planning both slow and resource-intensive. To address this, we propose CompACT, a discrete tokenizer that compresses each observation into as few as 8 tokens, drastically reducing computational cost while preserving essential information for planning. An action-conditioned world model that occupies CompACT tokenizer achieves competitive planning performance with orders-of-magnitude faster planning, offering a practical step toward real-world deployment of world models.
summary_zh: 世界模型为模拟以动作或指令为条件的环境动力学提供了一个强大的框架，从而支持诸如动作规划或策略学习之类的下游任务。 近期的方法将世界模型作为学习到的模拟器加以利用，但其在决策时规划中的应用仍然受限于实时控制所需的计算量。 一个关键瓶颈在于潜在表征：传统的编码器将每个观测编码成数百个令牌，使得规划既缓慢又消耗资源。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了CompACT，一种离散编码器，可以将每个观测压缩成仅8个令牌，在大幅降低计算成本的同时，保留了规划所需的基本信息。 采用CompACT编码器的以动作为条件的世界模型实现了具有竞争力的规划性能，同时规划速度提升了数个数量级，为世界模型的实际部署迈出了切实的一步。
tldr: This paper introduces CompACT, a discrete tokenizer that compresses observations into a small number of tokens (8) for faster and more efficient planning within world models, potentially enabling real-time control.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为 CompACT 的离散分词器，它将观测压缩成少量 tokens (8)，从而在世界模型中实现更快、更高效的规划，有可能实现实时的控制。

title: Observing and Controlling Features in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) have shown remarkable progress towards embodied intelligence. While their architecture partially resembles that of Large Language Models (LLMs), VLAs exhibit higher complexity due to their multi-modal inputs/outputs and often hybrid nature of transformer and diffusion heads. This is part of the reason why insights from mechanistic interpretability in LLMs, which explain how the internal model representations relate to their output behavior, do not trivially transfer to VLA counterparts. In this work, we propose to close this gap by introducing and analyzing two main concepts: feature-observability and feature-controllability. In particular, we first study features that are linearly encoded in representation space, and show how they can be observed by means of a linear classifier. Then, we use a minimal linear intervention grounded in optimal control to accurately place internal representations and steer the VLA's output towards a desired region. Our results show that targeted, lightweight interventions can reliably steer a robot's behavior while preserving closed-loop capabilities. We demonstrate on different VLA architectures ($π_{0.5}$ and OpenVLA) through simulation experiments that VLAs possess interpretable internal structure amenable to online adaptation without fine-tuning, enabling real-time alignment with user preferences and task requirements.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）在具身智能方面展现出了显著的进展。尽管它们的架构与大型语言模型（LLMs）部分相似，但由于其多模态输入/输出以及Transformer和扩散头的混合本质，VLAs表现出更高的复杂性。这部分解释了为什么LLMs中机制可解释性的洞察，即解释内部模型表征如何与其输出行为相关联，无法直接转移到VLA对应物上。在这项工作中，我们建议通过引入和分析两个主要概念来弥合这一差距：特征-可观察性和特征-可控性。特别是，我们首先研究以线性方式编码在表征空间中的特征，并展示如何通过线性分类器观察它们。然后，我们使用基于最优控制的最小线性干预来精确放置内部表征，并将VLA的输出导向期望区域。我们的结果表明，有针对性的、轻量级的干预可以可靠地引导机器人的行为，同时保持闭环能力。我们通过仿真实验，在不同的VLA架构（$π_{0.5}$和OpenVLA）上证明，VLAs拥有可解释的内部结构，能够进行在线自适应而无需微调，从而实现与用户偏好和任务要求的实时对齐。
tldr: This paper introduces feature-observability and feature-controllability for Vision-Language-Action models, showing that lightweight linear interventions can reliably steer robot behavior in simulation without fine-tuning, allowing real-time alignment with user needs.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了视觉-语言-动作模型中的特征可观察性和特征可控性，表明轻量级的线性干预可以可靠地引导机器人行为，而无需微调，从而能够实时地与用户需求对齐。

title: RealWonder: Real-Time Physical Action-Conditioned Video Generation
summary: Current video generation models cannot simulate physical consequences of 3D actions like forces and robotic manipulations, as they lack structural understanding of how actions affect 3D scenes. We present RealWonder, the first real-time system for action-conditioned video generation from a single image. Our key insight is using physics simulation as an intermediate bridge: instead of directly encoding continuous actions, we translate them through physics simulation into visual representations (optical flow and RGB) that video models can process. RealWonder integrates three components: 3D reconstruction from single images, physics simulation, and a distilled video generator requiring only 4 diffusion steps. Our system achieves 13.2 FPS at 480x832 resolution, enabling interactive exploration of forces, robot actions, and camera controls on rigid objects, deformable bodies, fluids, and granular materials. We envision RealWonder opens new opportunities to apply video models in immersive experiences, AR/VR, and robot learning. Our code and model weights are publicly available in our project website: https://liuwei283.github.io/RealWonder/
summary_zh: 当前视频生成模型无法模拟3D动作的物理结果，例如力以及机器人操作，因为它们缺乏对动作如何影响3D场景的结构性理解。我们提出了RealWonder，这是第一个从单张图像生成动作条件视频的实时系统。我们的关键见解是使用物理模拟作为中间桥梁：我们没有直接编码连续动作，而是通过物理模拟将它们转化为视频模型可以处理的视觉表示（光流和RGB）。RealWonder集成了三个组件：从单张图像进行3D重建、物理模拟以及只需要4个扩散步骤的蒸馏视频生成器。我们的系统在480x832分辨率下实现了13.2 FPS，从而能够对刚性物体、可变形物体、流体和颗粒材料进行力的交互式探索、机器人动作和相机控制。我们设想RealWonder为在沉浸式体验、AR/VR和机器人学习中应用视频模型开辟了新的机会。我们的代码和模型权重在我们的项目网站上公开提供：https://liuwei283.github.io/RealWonder/
tldr: RealWonder is a real-time system for action-conditioned video generation that leverages physics simulation as an intermediate step to bridge the gap between actions and visual representations, achieving interactive frame rates.
tldr_zh: RealWonder是一个实时的动作条件视频生成系统，它利用物理模拟作为中间步骤来弥合动作和视觉表示之间的差距，从而实现交互式帧速率。

title: Towards Multimodal Lifelong Understanding: A Dataset and Agentic Baseline
summary: While datasets for video understanding have scaled to hour-long durations, they typically consist of densely concatenated clips that differ from natural, unscripted daily life. To bridge this gap, we introduce MM-Lifelong, a dataset designed for Multimodal Lifelong Understanding. Comprising 181.1 hours of footage, it is structured across Day, Week, and Month scales to capture varying temporal densities. Extensive evaluations reveal two critical failure modes in current paradigms: end-to-end MLLMs suffer from a Working Memory Bottleneck due to context saturation, while representative agentic baselines experience Global Localization Collapse when navigating sparse, month-long timelines. To address this, we propose the Recursive Multimodal Agent (ReMA), which employs dynamic memory management to iteratively update a recursive belief state, significantly outperforming existing methods. Finally, we establish dataset splits designed to isolate temporal and domain biases, providing a rigorous foundation for future research in supervised learning and out-of-distribution generalization.
summary_zh: 视频理解的数据集已经扩展到数小时的时长，但它们通常由密集串联的片段组成，这与自然的、无脚本的日常生活不同。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了MM-Lifelong，一个为多模态终身理解设计的数据集。它包含181.1小时的素材，在日、周和月的时间尺度上进行组织，以捕捉不同的时间密度。广泛的评估揭示了当前范式的两种关键失效模式：端到端多模态大型语言模型(MLLMs)由于上下文饱和而遭受工作记忆瓶颈，而具有代表性的智能体基线在导航稀疏的、长达一个月的的时间线时，会经历全局定位崩溃。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了递归多模态智能体 (ReMA)，它采用动态内存管理来迭代更新递归信念状态，显著优于现有方法。最后，我们建立了旨在隔离时间和领域偏差的数据集划分，为未来在监督学习和分布外泛化方面的研究提供了坚实的基础。
tldr: The paper introduces MM-Lifelong, a large-scale multimodal dataset for lifelong video understanding, highlighting limitations of current MLLMs and agentic baselines, and proposes ReMA, a recursive multimodal agent, to address these issues.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了用于终身视频理解的大规模多模态数据集 MM-Lifelong，强调了当前 MLLM 和代理基线的局限性，并提出了 ReMA，一种递归多模态代理，以解决这些问题。

title: Safe-SAGE: Social-Semantic Adaptive Guidance for Safe Engagement through Laplace-Modulated Poisson Safety Functions
summary: Traditional safety-critical control methods, such as control barrier functions, suffer from semantic blindness, exhibiting the same behavior around obstacles regardless of contextual significance. This limitation leads to the uniform treatment of all obstacles, despite their differing semantic meanings. We present Safe-SAGE (Social-Semantic Adaptive Guidance for Safe Engagement), a unified framework that bridges the gap between high-level semantic understanding and low-level safety-critical control through a Poisson safety function (PSF) modulated using a Laplace guidance field. Our approach perceives the environment by fusing multi-sensor point clouds with vision-based instance segmentation and persistent object tracking to maintain up-to-date semantics beyond the camera's field of view. A multi-layer safety filter is then used to modulate system inputs to achieve safe navigation using this semantic understanding of the environment. This safety filter consists of both a model predictive control layer and a control barrier function layer. Both layers utilize the PSF and flux modulation of the guidance field to introduce varying levels of conservatism and multi-agent passing norms for different obstacles in the environment. Our framework enables legged robots to navigate semantically rich, dynamic environments with context-dependent safety margins while maintaining rigorous safety guarantees.
summary_zh: 传统的安全关键控制方法，例如控制屏障函数，存在语义盲视问题，对障碍物的反应行为一致，忽略了其上下文重要性。这种局限性导致所有障碍物被同等对待，尽管它们的语义含义不同。我们提出 Safe-SAGE（用于安全交互的社交-语义自适应引导），一个统一框架，通过泊松安全函数（PSF）和使用拉普拉斯引导场进行调制，弥合了高层语义理解与底层安全关键控制之间的差距。我们的方法通过融合多传感器点云与基于视觉的实例分割和持久对象跟踪来感知环境，以保持相机视野之外的最新的语义信息。然后使用一个多层安全滤波器来调节系统输入，从而利用对环境的语义理解实现安全导航。该安全滤波器由模型预测控制层和控制屏障函数层组成。这两层都利用 PSF 和引导场的通量调制，针对环境中不同的障碍物引入不同程度的保守性和多智能体通行规范。我们的框架使具有腿的机器人在语义丰富的动态环境中能够进行导航，具有上下文相关的安全裕度，同时保持严格的安全保证。
tldr: Safe-SAGE introduces a novel safety-critical control framework for robots that incorporates semantic understanding to enable safer and more context-aware navigation in dynamic environments by using a Laplace-modulated Poisson safety function.
tldr_zh: Safe-SAGE 提出了一个新颖的安全关键控制框架，通过整合语义理解，利用拉普拉斯调制的泊松安全函数，使机器人能够在动态环境中实现更安全、更具上下文意识的导航。

title: Latent Wasserstein Adversarial Imitation Learning
summary: Imitation Learning (IL) enables agents to mimic expert behavior by learning from demonstrations. However, traditional IL methods require large amounts of medium-to-high-quality demonstrations as well as actions of expert demonstrations, both of which are often unavailable. To reduce this need, we propose Latent Wasserstein Adversarial Imitation Learning (LWAIL), a novel adversarial imitation learning framework that focuses on state-only distribution matching. It benefits from the Wasserstein distance computed in a dynamics-aware latent space. This dynamics-aware latent space differs from prior work and is obtained via a pre-training stage, where we train the Intention Conditioned Value Function (ICVF) to capture a dynamics-aware structure of the state space using a small set of randomly generated state-only data. We show that this enhances the policy's understanding of state transitions, enabling the learning process to use only one or a few state-only expert episodes to achieve expert-level performance. Through experiments on multiple MuJoCo environments, we demonstrate that our method outperforms prior Wasserstein-based IL methods and prior adversarial IL methods, achieving better results across various tasks.
summary_zh: 模仿学习（IL）使智能体能够通过从示范中学习来模仿专家行为。然而，传统的IL方法需要大量中等到高质量的示范，以及专家示范的行动，这两者通常都不可用。为了减少这种需求，我们提出了一种新颖的对抗模仿学习框架——潜在Wasserstein对抗模仿学习（LWAIL），它专注于仅状态（state-only）的分布匹配。它受益于在动力学感知的潜在空间中计算的Wasserstein距离。这种动力学感知的潜在空间与先前的工作不同，是通过一个预训练阶段获得的，在该阶段我们训练意图条件价值函数（ICVF），以使用少量随机生成的仅状态数据来捕获状态空间的动力学感知结构。我们表明，这增强了策略对状态转移的理解，使得学习过程能够仅使用一个或几个仅状态的专家片段来实现专家级别的性能。通过在多个MuJoCo环境中的实验，我们证明了我们的方法优于先前的基于Wasserstein的IL方法和先前的对抗IL方法，在各种任务中实现了更好的结果。
tldr: The paper introduces Latent Wasserstein Adversarial Imitation Learning (LWAIL), an imitation learning method which leverages a dynamics-aware latent space to achieve expert-level performance using only a few state-only expert demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了潜在Wasserstein对抗模仿学习（LWAIL），一种模仿学习方法，利用动态感知的潜在空间，仅使用少量仅状态的专家演示即可实现专家级性能。

title: Cheap Thrills: Effective Amortized Optimization Using Inexpensive Labels
summary: To scale the solution of optimization and simulation problems, prior work has explored machine-learning surrogates that inexpensively map problem parameters to corresponding solutions. Commonly used approaches, including supervised and self-supervised learning with either soft or hard feasibility enforcement, face inherent challenges such as reliance on expensive, high-quality labels or difficult optimization landscapes. To address their trade-offs, we propose a novel framework that first collects "cheap" imperfect labels, then performs supervised pretraining, and finally refines the model through self-supervised learning to improve overall performance. Our theoretical analysis and merit-based criterion show that labeled data need only place the model within a basin of attraction, confirming that only modest numbers of inexact labels and training epochs are required. We empirically validate our simple three-stage strategy across challenging domains, including nonconvex constrained optimization, power-grid operation, and stiff dynamical systems, and show that it yields faster convergence; improved accuracy, feasibility, and optimality; and up to 59x reductions in total offline cost.
summary_zh: 为了扩展优化和仿真问题的求解规模，先前的工作探索了机器学习代理模型，该模型能够以较低的成本将问题参数映射到相应的解。常用的方法，包括采用软约束或硬约束可行性执行的监督学习和自监督学习，都面临着固有的挑战，例如对昂贵的高质量标签的依赖，或者困难的优化空间。为了解决它们的权衡，我们提出了一种新的框架，该框架首先收集“廉价”的不完美标签，然后执行有监督的预训练，最后通过自监督学习细化模型以提高整体性能。我们的理论分析和基于价值的判据表明，带标签的数据只需要将模型放置在一个吸引盆地内，证实了只需要少量的不精确标签和训练周期。我们在具有挑战性的领域中，包括非凸约束优化、电力网运行和刚性动力系统，进行了实证验证，表明我们的简单三阶段策略能够实现更快的收敛速度；更高的准确性、可行性、最优性；并且总离线成本降低高达59倍。
tldr: The paper introduces a three-stage machine learning framework for optimization and simulation that uses cheap, imperfect labels for pretraining and then refines the model self-supervisedly, leading to faster convergence and improved performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个用于优化和仿真的三阶段机器学习框架，该框架使用廉价、不完美的标签进行预训练，然后以自监督方式改进模型，从而实现更快的收敛和更高的性能。

title: Residual RL--MPC for Robust Microrobotic Cell Pushing Under Time-Varying Flow
summary: Contact-rich micromanipulation in microfluidic flow is challenging because small disturbances can break pushing contact and induce large lateral drift. We study planar cell pushing with a magnetic rolling microrobot that tracks a waypoint-sampled reference curve under time-varying Poiseuille flow. We propose a hybrid controller that augments a nominal MPC with a learned residual policy trained by SAC. The policy outputs a bounded 2D velocity correction that is contact-gated, so residual actions are applied only during robot--cell contact, preserving reliable approach behavior and stabilizing learning. All methods share the same actuation interface and speed envelope for fair comparisons. Experiments show improved robustness and tracking accuracy over pure MPC and PID under nonstationary flow, with generalization from a clover training curve to unseen circle and square trajectories. A residual-bound sweep identifies an intermediate correction limit as the best trade-off, which we use in all benchmarks.
summary_zh: 微流体流动中富接触的微操作极具挑战性，因为微小的扰动就可能破坏推力接触并引起较大的横向漂移。我们研究了利用磁力滚动微型机器人进行平面细胞推动，该机器人会跟踪时变泊肃叶流下的航路点采样参考曲线。我们提出了一种混合控制器，它用SAC训练的学习残差策略来增强标称MPC。该策略输出一个有界的二维速度修正量，该修正量由接触门控，因此残差动作仅在机器人与细胞接触期间应用，从而保持可靠的接近行为并稳定学习。所有方法共享相同的驱动接口和速度包络以进行公平的比较。实验表明，在非平稳流下，相比纯MPC和PID，本文提出的方法在稳健性和跟踪精度方面都有所提高，并且从三叶草训练曲线推广到未见的圆形和正方形轨迹。 残差边界扫描确定了一个中间修正限制作为最佳权衡，我们在所有基准测试中使用该限制。
tldr: The paper presents a hybrid RL-MPC controller for robust microrobotic cell pushing under time-varying flow, demonstrating improved tracking accuracy and robustness compared to pure MPC and PID controllers.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种混合RL-MPC控制器，用于在时变流条件下实现鲁棒的微型机器人细胞推动，并证明了与纯MPC和PID控制器相比，其具有更高的跟踪精度和鲁棒性。

title: EdgeDAM: Real-time Object Tracking for Mobile Devices
summary: Single-object tracking (SOT) on edge devices is a critical computer vision task, requiring accurate and continuous target localization across video frames under occlusion, distractor interference, and fast motion. However, recent state-of-the-art distractor-aware memory mechanisms are largely built on segmentation-based trackers and rely on mask prediction and attention-driven memory updates, which introduce substantial computational overhead and limit real-time deployment on resource-constrained hardware; meanwhile, lightweight trackers sustain high throughput but are prone to drift when visually similar distractors appear. To address these challenges, we propose EdgeDAM, a lightweight detection-guided tracking framework that reformulates distractor-aware memory for bounding-box tracking under strict edge constraints.
