EdgeDAM introduces two key strategies: (1) Dual-Buffer Distractor-Aware Memory (DAM), which integrates a Recent-Aware Memory to preserve temporally consistent target hypotheses and a Distractor-Resolving Memory to explicitly store hard negative candidates and penalize their re-selection during recovery; and (2) Confidence-Driven Switching with Held-Box Stabilization, where tracker reliability and temporal consistency criteria adaptively activate detection and memory-guided re-identification during occlusion, while a held-box mechanism temporarily freezes and expands the estimate to suppress distractor contamination. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks, including the distractor-focused DiDi dataset, demonstrate improved robustness under occlusion and fast motion while maintaining real-time performance on mobile devices, achieving 88.2% accuracy on DiDi and 25 FPS on an iPhone 15. Code will be released.
summary_zh: 边缘设备上的单目标跟踪（SOT）是一项关键的计算机视觉任务，需要在遮挡、干扰物干扰和快速运动的情况下，对视频帧中的目标进行准确且连续的定位。然而，目前最先进的干扰物感知记忆机制主要构建于基于分割的跟踪器之上，并依赖于掩码预测和注意力驱动的记忆更新，这引入了大量的计算开销，限制了其在资源受限的硬件上的实时部署；与此同时，轻量级跟踪器保持了高吞吐量，但在视觉上相似的干扰物出现时容易发生漂移。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出 EdgeDAM，一种轻量级的检测引导跟踪框架，该框架在严格的边缘约束下重塑了用于边界框跟踪的干扰物感知记忆。EdgeDAM 引入了两个关键策略：（1）双缓冲干扰物感知记忆（DAM），它集成了一个近期感知记忆来保留时间上一致的目标假设，以及一个干扰物消解记忆来显式存储难负样本候选并惩罚其在恢复期间的重新选择；（2）置信度驱动的切换与保持框稳定，其中跟踪器可靠性和时间一致性标准自适应地激活遮挡期间的检测和记忆引导的重识别，而保持框机制暂时冻结并扩展估计，以抑制干扰物污染。在五个基准数据集（包括专注于干扰物的 DiDi 数据集）上的大量实验表明，在遮挡和快速运动下提高了鲁棒性，同时在移动设备上保持了实时性能，在 DiDi 上实现了 88.2% 的精度，在 iPhone 15 上实现了 25 FPS。 代码即将发布。
tldr: EdgeDAM proposes a lightweight detection-guided object tracking framework for edge devices with a novel dual-buffer memory system and confidence-driven switching to improve robustness and real-time performance, achieving 88.2% accuracy on DiDi and 25 FPS on iPhone 15.
tldr_zh: EdgeDAM提出了一种轻量级的检测引导目标跟踪框架，用于边缘设备。它采用了一种新颖的双缓冲内存系统和置信度驱动的切换机制，提高了鲁棒性和实时性能，在DiDi数据集上实现了88.2%的准确率，并在iPhone 15上达到了25 FPS。

title: Towards 3D Scene Understanding of Gas Plumes in LWIR Hyperspectral Images Using Neural Radiance Fields
summary: Hyperspectral images (HSI) have many applications, ranging from environmental monitoring to national security, and can be used for material detection and identification. Longwave infrared (LWIR) HSI can be used for gas plume detection and analysis. Oftentimes, only a few images of a scene of interest are available and are analyzed individually. The ability to combine information from multiple images into a single, cohesive representation could enhance analysis by providing more context on the scene's geometry and spectral properties. Neural radiance fields (NeRFs) create a latent neural representation of volumetric scene properties that enable novel-view rendering and geometry reconstruction, offering a promising avenue for hyperspectral 3D scene reconstruction. We explore the possibility of using NeRFs to create 3D scene reconstructions from LWIR HSI and demonstrate that the model can be used for the basic downstream analysis task of gas plume detection. The physics-based DIRSIG software suite was used to generate a synthetic multi-view LWIR HSI dataset of a simple facility with a strong sulfur hexafluoride gas plume. Our method, built on the standard Mip-NeRF architecture, combines state-of-the-art methods for hyperspectral NeRFs and sparse-view NeRFs, along with a novel adaptive weighted MSE loss. Our final NeRF method requires around 50% fewer training images than the standard Mip-NeRF and achieves an average PSNR of 39.8 dB with as few as 30 training images. Gas plume detection applied to NeRF-rendered test images using the adaptive coherence estimator achieves an average AUC of 0.821 when compared with detection masks generated from ground-truth test images.
summary_zh: 高光谱图像（HSI）具有广泛的应用，涵盖从环境监测到国家安全等领域，可用于材料检测和识别。长波红外（LWIR）HSI 可用于气体羽流检测和分析。通常，只有少量感兴趣场景的图像可用，并单独进行分析。将来自多个图像的信息组合成单一、连贯的表示，可以通过提供更多关于场景几何结构和光谱特性的上下文来增强分析能力。神经辐射场（NeRFs）创建了体积场景属性的潜在神经表示，从而实现新视角渲染和几何重建，为高光谱 3D 场景重建提供了一条有希望的途径。我们探索了使用 NeRFs 从 LWIR HSI 创建 3D 场景重建的可能性，并证明该模型可用于气体羽流检测等基本下游分析任务。基于物理的 DIRSIG 软件套件用于生成一个简单的设施合成多视角 LWIR HSI 数据集，其中包含强烈的六氟化硫气体羽流。我们的方法建立在标准的 Mip-NeRF 架构之上，结合了用于高光谱 NeRFs 和稀疏视角 NeRFs 的最先进方法，以及一种新的自适应加权 MSE 损失。最终的 NeRF 方法所需的训练图像比标准 Mip-NeRF 少大约 50%，并且仅使用 30 张训练图像即可实现平均 PSNR 为 39.8 dB。将自适应相干估计器应用于 NeRF 渲染的测试图像进行气体羽流检测，与从真实测试图像生成的检测掩模相比，实现了平均 AUC 为 0.821。
tldr: This paper explores using NeRFs for 3D reconstruction of LWIR hyperspectral images, specifically for gas plume detection, demonstrating good performance with a novel adaptive loss and fewer training images.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用NeRFs进行LWIR高光谱图像的三维重建，特别是用于气体羽流检测，并展示了使用一种新的自适应损失函数和更少的训练图像所获得的良好性能。

title: BEVLM: Distilling Semantic Knowledge from LLMs into Bird's-Eye View Representations
summary: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into autonomous driving has attracted growing interest for their strong reasoning and semantic understanding abilities, which are essential for handling complex decision-making and long-tail scenarios. However, existing methods typically feed LLMs with tokens from multi-view and multi-frame images independently, leading to redundant computation and limited spatial consistency. This separation in visual processing hinders accurate 3D spatial reasoning and fails to maintain geometric coherence across views. On the other hand, Bird's-Eye View (BEV) representations learned from geometrically annotated tasks (e.g., object detection) provide spatial structure but lack the semantic richness of foundation vision encoders. To bridge this gap, we propose BEVLM, a framework that connects a spatially consistent and semantically distilled BEV representation with LLMs. Through extensive experiments, we show that BEVLM enables LLMs to reason more effectively in cross-view driving scenes, improving accuracy by 46%, by leveraging BEV features as unified inputs. Furthermore, by distilling semantic knowledge from LLMs into BEV representations, BEVLM significantly improves closed-loop end-to-end driving performance by 29% in safety-critical scenarios.
summary_zh: 将大型语言模型（LLM）集成到自动驾驶中，因其强大的推理能力和语义理解能力而受到日益增长的关注，这对于处理复杂决策和长尾场景至关重要。然而，现有方法通常独立地将多视角和多帧图像中的tokens输入LLM，导致冗余计算和有限的空间一致性。这种视觉处理的分离阻碍了精确的3D空间推理，并且无法维持跨视角的几何连贯性。另一方面，从几何标注任务（例如，目标检测）中学习到的鸟瞰图（BEV）表示提供了空间结构，但缺乏基础视觉编码器的语义丰富性。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了BEVLM，一个将空间一致且语义精炼的BEV表示与LLM连接的框架。通过大量实验，我们表明BEVLM使LLM能够更有效地在跨视角驾驶场景中进行推理，通过利用BEV特征作为统一输入，将准确率提高了46%。此外，通过将来自LLM的语义知识提炼到BEV表示中，BEVLM在安全攸关的场景中显著提高了29%的闭环端到端驾驶性能。
tldr: The paper introduces BEVLM, a framework that combines Bird's-Eye View (BEV) representations with Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve reasoning and driving performance in autonomous vehicles by distilling semantic knowledge to BEV and leveraging BEV features as LLM input.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了BEVLM，一个将鸟瞰图（BEV）表示与大型语言模型（LLM）相结合的框架，通过将语义知识提炼到BEV并利用BEV特征作为LLM输入，从而提高自动驾驶汽车的推理和驾驶性能。

title: SUREON: A Benchmark and Vision-Language-Model for Surgical Reasoning
summary: Surgeons don't just see -- they interpret. When an expert observes a surgical scene, they understand not only what instrument is being used, but why it was chosen, what risk it poses, and what comes next. Current surgical AI cannot answer such questions, largely because training data that explicitly encodes surgical reasoning is immensely difficult to annotate at scale. Yet surgical video lectures already contain exactly this -- explanations of intent, rationale, and anticipation, narrated by experts for the purpose of teaching. Though inherently noisy and unstructured, these narrations encode the reasoning that surgical AI currently lacks. We introduce SUREON, a large-scale video QA dataset that systematically harvests this training signal from surgical academic videos. SUREON defines 12 question categories covering safety assessment, decision rationale, and forecasting, and uses a multi-agent pipeline to extract and structure supervision at scale. Across 134.7K clips and 170 procedure types, SUREON yields 206.8k QA pairs and an expert-validated benchmark of 354 examples. To evaluate the extent to which this supervision translates to surgical reasoning ability, we introduce two models: SureonVLM, a vision-language model adapted through supervised fine-tuning, and SureonVLM-R1, a reasoning model trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization. Both models can answer complex questions about surgery and substantially outperform larger general-domain models, exceeding 84% accuracy on the SUREON benchmark while outperforming general-domain models on standard surgical perception tasks. Qualitative analysis of SureonVLM-R1 reveals explicit reasoning behavior, such as inferring operative intent from visual context.
summary_zh: 外科医生不仅仅是观察，他们更是解读。当专家观察手术场景时，他们不仅能理解正在使用的器械，还能明白选择该器械的原因、它带来的风险以及下一步的操作。当前的 surgical AI 无法回答这类问题，主要是因为显式编码手术推理的训练数据难以大规模添加标注。然而，外科手术视频讲座已经包含这些内容 —— 对意图、原理和预判的解释，由专家为了教学目的进行讲解。尽管这些解说本质上是嘈杂且非结构化的，但它们编码了surgical AI 当前所欠缺的推理过程。我们介绍了 SUREON，这是一个大规模视频问答数据集，系统地从外科手术学术视频中获取这种训练信号。SUREON 定义了 12 个问题类别，涵盖安全评估、决策依据和预测，并使用多代理流水线来大规模提取和构建监督信息。 在包含 134.7K 个片段和 170 种手术类型的视频中，SUREON 产生了 206.8k 个问答对和一个包含 354 个示例的专家验证基准。为了评估这种监督信息在多大程度上转化为手术推理能力，我们引入了两个模型：SureonVLM，一个通过监督式微调调整的视觉-语言模型，以及 SureonVLM-R1，一个用群体相对策略优化训练的推理模型。这两个模型都能回答关于手术的复杂问题，并且大幅超越了更大的通用领域模型，在 SUREON 基准上超过 84% 的准确率，同时在标准手术感知任务上也优于通用领域模型。对 SureonVLM-R1 的定性分析揭示了明确的推理行为，例如从视觉背景中推断手术意图。
tldr: The paper introduces SUREON, a large-scale video QA dataset for surgical reasoning, along with vision-language models trained on it that demonstrate improved performance in surgical reasoning tasks compared to general-domain models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SUREON，一个用于外科推理的大规模视频问答数据集，以及基于该数据集训练的视觉语言模型，这些模型在外科推理任务中表现出比通用模型更好的性能。

title: Boosting deep Reinforcement Learning using pretraining with Logical Options
summary: Deep reinforcement learning agents are often misaligned, as they over-exploit early reward signals. Recently, several symbolic approaches have addressed these challenges by encoding sparse objectives along with aligned plans. However, purely symbolic architectures are complex to scale and difficult to apply to continuous settings. Hence, we propose a hybrid approach, inspired by humans' ability to acquire new skills. We use a two-stage framework that injects symbolic structure into neural-based reinforcement learning agents without sacrificing the expressivity of deep policies. Our method, called Hybrid Hierarchical RL (H^2RL), introduces a logical option-based pretraining strategy to steer the learning policy away from short-term reward loops and toward goal-directed behavior while allowing the final policy to be refined via standard environment interaction. Empirically, we show that this approach consistently improves long-horizon decision-making and yields agents that outperform strong neural, symbolic, and neuro-symbolic baselines.
summary_zh: 深度强化学习智能体经常出现目标错位问题，因为它们过度利用早期的奖励信号。最近，一些符号方法通过编码稀疏目标以及对齐的计划来解决这些挑战。然而，纯粹的符号架构难以扩展且难以应用于连续环境中。因此，我们提出了一种混合方法，其灵感来源于人类获取新技能的能力。我们使用一个两阶段框架，将符号结构注入到基于神经网络的强化学习智能体中，而不牺牲深度策略的表达能力。我们的方法，称为混合分层强化学习（H²RL），引入了一种基于逻辑选项的预训练策略，以引导学习策略远离短期奖励循环，并朝着目标导向的行为发展，同时允许通过标准环境交互来优化最终策略。在实验中，我们证明了该方法能够持续改进长时域决策，并生成优于强大的神经、符号和神经符号基线的智能体。
tldr: The paper introduces Hybrid Hierarchical RL (H^2RL), a neuro-symbolic approach that uses logical option-based pretraining to improve long-horizon decision-making in deep reinforcement learning by guiding policies towards goal-directed behavior and avoiding short-term reward loops.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了混合分层强化学习 (H^2RL)，这是一种神经符号方法，它使用基于逻辑选项的预训练来提高深度强化学习中长时决策的性能，通过引导策略朝着目标导向的行为并避免短期奖励循环。

title: Omni-Diffusion: Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation with Masked Discrete Diffusion
summary: While recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made impressive strides, they predominantly employ a conventional autoregressive architecture as their backbone, leaving significant room to explore effective and efficient alternatives in architectural design. Concurrently, recent studies have successfully applied discrete diffusion models to various domains, such as visual understanding and image generation, revealing their considerable potential as a promising backbone for multimodal systems. Drawing inspiration from these pioneering research, we introduce Omni-Diffusion, the first any-to-any multimodal language model built entirely on mask-based discrete diffusion models, which unifies understanding and generation across text, speech, and images. Omni-Diffusion employs a unified mask-based discrete diffusion model to directly capture the joint distribution over discrete multimodal tokens. This approach supports not only bimodal tasks but also more complex scenarios involving multiple modalities. On a diverse set of benchmarks, our method outperforms or performs on par with existing multimodal systems that process two or more modalities, highlighting the significant promise of diffusion models in powering the next generation of multimodal foundation models. Project webpage: https://omni-diffusion.github.io.
summary_zh: 尽管最近的多模态大型语言模型(MLLM)取得了令人瞩目的进展，但它们主要采用传统的自回归架构作为骨干，这在架构设计中留下了探索有效且高效替代方案的巨大空间。与此同时，最近的研究已成功将离散扩散模型应用于视觉理解和图像生成等各个领域，揭示了其作为多模态系统有前途的骨干的巨大潜力。受这些开创性研究的启发，我们推出了Omni-Diffusion，这是第一个完全基于掩码离散扩散模型的任意到任意多模态语言模型，它统一了文本、语音和图像的理解和生成。Omni-Diffusion采用统一的基于掩码的离散扩散模型，直接捕获离散多模态token的联合分布。这种方法不仅支持双模态任务，还支持涉及多种模态的更复杂场景。在一系列不同的基准测试中，我们的方法优于或媲美现有的处理两种或多种模态的多模态系统，突显了扩散模型在推动下一代多模态基础模型方面的巨大潜力。项目网页：https://omni-diffusion.github.io。
tldr: Omni-Diffusion introduces a novel any-to-any multimodal language model based on masked discrete diffusion, unifying understanding and generation across text, speech, and images, and demonstrating competitive performance on multimodal benchmarks. It presents a promising alternative to autoregressive architectures for multimodal foundation models.
tldr_zh: Omni-Diffusion 提出了一个基于掩码离散扩散的新型任意到任意多模态语言模型，统一了文本、语音和图像的理解和生成，并在多模态基准测试中表现出竞争力的性能。它为多模态基础模型提供了一种有前途的替代自回归架构方案。

title: Penguin-VL: Exploring the Efficiency Limits of VLM with LLM-based Vision Encoders
summary: Vision Language Model (VLM) development has largely relied on scaling model size, which hinders deployment on compute-constrained mobile and edge devices such as smartphones and robots. In this work, we explore the performance limits of compact (e.g., 2B and 8B) VLMs. We challenge the prevailing practice that state-of-the-art VLMs must rely on vision encoders initialized via massive contrastive pretraining (e.g., CLIP/SigLIP). We identify an objective mismatch: contrastive learning, optimized for discrimination, enforces coarse and category-level invariances that suppress fine-grained visual cues needed for dense captioning and complex VLM reasoning. To address this issue, we present Penguin-VL, whose vision encoder is initialized from a text-only LLM. Our experiments reveal that Penguin-Encoder serves as a superior alternative to traditional contrastive pretraining, unlocking a higher degree of visual fidelity and data efficiency for multimodal understanding. Across various image and video benchmarks, Penguin-VL achieves performance comparable to leading VLMs (e.g., Qwen3-VL) in mathematical reasoning and surpasses them in tasks such as document understanding, visual knowledge, and multi-perspective video understanding. Notably, these gains are achieved with a lightweight architecture, demonstrating that improved visual representation rather than model scaling is the primary driver of performance. Our ablations show that Penguin-Encoder consistently outperforms contrastive-pretrained encoders, preserving fine-grained spatial and temporal cues that are critical for dense perception and complex reasoning. This makes it a strong drop-in alternative for compute-efficient VLMs and enables high performance in resource-constrained settings. Code: https://github.com/tencent-ailab/Penguin-VL
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的发展很大程度上依赖于模型规模的扩展，这阻碍了其在算力受限的移动和边缘设备（如智能手机和机器人）上的部署。 在这项工作中，我们探索了紧凑型（例如，2B和8B）VLM的性能极限。 我们挑战了目前的主流做法，即最先进的VLM必须依赖于通过大规模对比预训练（例如，CLIP/SigLIP）初始化的视觉编码器。 我们发现了一个目标不匹配：针对判别进行优化的对比学习，强制执行粗略的类别级别不变性，这抑制了密集字幕和复杂 VLM 推理所需的细粒度视觉线索。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 Penguin-VL，其视觉编码器是从仅文本的 LLM 初始化。 我们的实验表明，Penguin-Encoder 是传统对比预训练的更好替代方案，可为多模态理解解锁更高程度的视觉保真度和数据效率。 在各种图像和视频基准测试中，Penguin-VL 在数学推理方面取得了与领先 VLM（例如，Qwen3-VL）相当的性能，并在文档理解、视觉知识和多视角视频理解等任务中超越了它们。 值得注意的是，这些优势是通过轻量级架构实现的，表明改进的视觉表示而不是模型缩放是性能的主要驱动因素。 我们的消融实验表明，Penguin-Encoder 始终优于对比预训练编码器，保留了对密集感知和复杂推理至关重要的细粒度空间和时间线索。 这使其成为算力高效VLM的强大替代方案，并能够在资源受限的环境中实现高性能。 代码：https://github.com/tencent-ailab/Penguin-VL
tldr: Penguin-VL presents a compute-efficient VLM that initializes its vision encoder from a text-only LLM instead of contrastive pretraining, achieving comparable or superior performance to larger VLMs in several tasks while preserving fine-grained visual cues.
tldr_zh: Penguin-VL 提出了一种计算效率高的 VLM，它使用纯文本 LLM 初始化其视觉编码器，而不是对比预训练，从而在多个任务中实现与更大规模 VLM 相当甚至更优越的性能，同时保留了细粒度的视觉线索。

title: EgoReasoner: Learning Egocentric 4D Reasoning via Task-Adaptive Structured Thinking
summary: Egocentric video understanding is inherently complex due to the dynamic 4D nature of the environment, where camera motion and object displacements necessitate a continuous re-evaluation of spatial relations. In this work, we target a suite of under-explored egocentric 4D reasoning tasks, including fixture interaction counting, viewpoint-relative fixture location, object movement itinerary tracking, and stationary object localization, that require fundamentally different cognitive operations: spatial anchoring, temporal tracking, and duration reasoning. We observe that these structural differences make task-agnostic approaches insufficient: generic Chain-of-Thought methods lack task-appropriate reasoning primitives, and uniform reinforcement learning actively destabilizes performance on spatial tasks. To address this, we propose EgoReasoner, a two-stage framework that aligns both the reasoning scaffold and the reward signal to each task's cognitive structure. In the first stage, Task-Adaptive Thinking Templates guide the synthesis of structured CoT traces that teach the model to reason adaptively across task types via supervised fine-tuning. In the second stage, task-aware reward functions verify entity grounding, temporal alignment, and task-adaptive logical consistency, selectively strengthening each reasoning pathway via reinforcement fine-tuning with GRPO. Our 3B-parameter model, trained on only 16K samples, achieves 37.5% average accuracy on the challenging HD-EPIC benchmark, surpassing Qwen2.5-VL-7B (25.7%) by over 10 points.
summary_zh: 由于环境的动态4D特性，自我中心视频理解本质上是复杂的，其中相机运动和物体位移需要连续地重新评估空间关系。在这项工作中，我们关注一系列未被充分探索的自我中心4D推理任务，包括固定装置交互计数、视点相关的固定装置定位、物体移动轨迹跟踪和静止物体定位，这些任务需要根本不同的认知操作：空间锚定、时间跟踪和持续时间推理。我们观察到这些结构性差异使得任务无关的方法不够有效：通用的思维链（Chain-of-Thought）方法缺乏适合任务的推理原语，而统一的强化学习会积极地破坏空间任务的性能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了EgoReasoner，一个两阶段框架，该框架将推理支架和奖励信号与每个任务的认知结构对齐。在第一阶段，任务自适应思维模板指导结构化CoT轨迹的合成，通过监督微调教导模型跨任务类型自适应地进行推理。在第二阶段，任务感知奖励函数验证实体定位、时间对齐和任务自适应逻辑一致性，通过GRPO强化微调选择性地加强每个推理路径。我们30亿参数的模型仅在1.6万个样本上训练，在具有挑战性的HD-EPIC基准测试中实现了37.5%的平均准确率，超过了Qwen2.5-VL-7B（25.7%）超过10个点。
tldr: The paper introduces EgoReasoner, a framework for egocentric 4D reasoning that uses task-adaptive thinking templates and reinforcement learning to improve performance on tasks requiring spatial anchoring, temporal tracking, and duration reasoning. Their 3B-parameter model outperforms Qwen2.5-VL-7B on the HD-EPIC benchmark.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EgoReasoner，一个用于以自我为中心的4D推理的框架，它使用任务自适应的思维模板和强化学习来提高在需要空间锚定、时间跟踪和持续时间推理的任务上的性能。他们30亿参数的模型在HD-EPIC基准测试中优于Qwen2.5-VL-7B。

title: Fly360: Omnidirectional Obstacle Avoidance within Drone View
summary: Obstacle avoidance in unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), as a fundamental capability, has gained increasing attention with the growing focus on spatial intelligence. However, current obstacle-avoidance methods mainly depend on limited field-of-view sensors and are ill-suited for UAV scenarios which require full-spatial awareness when the movement direction differs from the UAV's heading. This limitation motivates us to explore omnidirectional obstacle avoidance for panoramic drones with full-view perception. We first study an under explored problem setting in which a UAV must generate collision-free motion in environments with obstacles from arbitrary directions, and then construct a benchmark that consists of three representative flight tasks. Based on such settings, we propose Fly360, a two-stage perception-decision pipeline with a fixed random-yaw training strategy. At the perception stage, panoramic RGB observations are input and converted into depth maps as a robust intermediate representation. For the policy network, it is lightweight and used to output body-frame velocity commands from depth inputs. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that Fly360 achieves stable omnidirectional obstacle avoidance and outperforms forward-view baselines across all tasks. Our model is available at https://zxkai.github.io/fly360/
summary_zh: 无人驾驶飞行器(UAV)的避障作为一项基本能力，随着对空间智能的日益关注而受到越来越多的重视。然而，当前的避障方法主要依赖于有限视角的传感器，并且不适用于UAV场景，在这些场景中，当运动方向与UAV的航向不同时，需要完全的空间感知能力。这种局限性促使我们探索具有全景感知的全向无人机避障。我们首先研究了一个未充分探索的问题设置，即UAV必须在来自任意方向障碍物的环境中生成无碰撞运动，然后构建一个包含三个代表性飞行任务的基准测试。基于这样的设置，我们提出了Fly360，一个具有固定随机偏航训练策略的两阶段感知-决策流程。在感知阶段，输入全景RGB观测，并将其转换为深度图，作为一种鲁棒的中间表示。对于策略网络，它很轻量级，用于从深度输入输出机体坐标系速度指令。大量的仿真和真实世界实验表明，Fly360实现了稳定的全向避障，并在所有任务中优于前视基线。我们的模型可在https://zxkai.github.io/fly360/获取。
tldr: The paper introduces Fly360, a two-stage perception-decision pipeline for omnidirectional obstacle avoidance in drones using panoramic RGB and depth map inputs, demonstrating superior performance compared to forward-view methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Fly360，一个用于无人机全方位避障的两阶段感知-决策流程，它使用全景RGB和深度图输入，并且展示了比前视方法更优越的性能。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Adaptive Dynamics For Underwater Vehicle-Manipulator Robots
summary: Accurate and adaptive dynamic models are critical for underwater vehicle-manipulator systems where hydrodynamic effects induce time-varying parameters. This paper introduces a novel uncertainty-aware adaptive dynamics model framework that remains linear in lumped vehicle and manipulator parameters, and embeds convex physical consistency constraints during online estimation. Moving horizon estimation is used to stack horizon regressors, enforce realizable inertia, damping, friction, and hydrostatics, and quantify uncertainty from parameter evolution. Experiments on a BlueROV2 Heavy with a 4-DOF manipulator demonstrate rapid convergence and calibrated predictions. Manipulator fits achieve R2 = 0.88 to 0.98 with slopes near unity, while vehicle surge, heave, and roll are reproduced with good fidelity under stronger coupling and noise. Median solver time is approximately 0.023 s per update, confirming online feasibility. A comparison against a fixed parameter model shows consistent reductions in MAE and RMSE across degrees of freedom. Results indicate physically plausible parameters and confidence intervals with near 100% coverage, enabling reliable feedforward control and simulation in underwater environments.
summary_zh: 水下航行器-机械臂系统的精确自适应动力学模型至关重要，因为水动力效应会引起时变参数。本文提出了一种新颖的具有不确定性意识的自适应动力学模型框架，该框架对集总的航行器和机械臂参数保持线性，并在在线估计期间嵌入凸物理一致性约束。采用移动视界估计来堆叠视界回归量，强制实现惯性、阻尼、摩擦和静水力，并量化参数演变带来的不确定性。在配备4自由度机械臂的BlueROV2 Heavy上的实验表明，模型具有快速收敛性和校准的预测能力。机械臂拟合的R2范围为0.88到0.98，斜率接近1，而航行器的纵荡、垂荡和横滚在更强的耦合和噪声下也能以良好的保真度重现。中位求解器时间大约为每次更新0.023秒，证实了在线可行性。与固定参数模型的比较表明，各种自由度的平均绝对误差（MAE）和均方根误差（RMSE）均得到持续降低。结果表明，该模型能够产生物理上合理的参数和置信区间，置信区间覆盖率接近100%，从而能够在水下环境中实现可靠的前馈控制和仿真。
tldr: The paper introduces an uncertainty-aware adaptive dynamics model for underwater vehicle-manipulator systems, using moving horizon estimation with physical consistency constraints for parameter estimation and uncertainty quantification, demonstrating promising results in experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种针对水下机器人操作系统的，不确定性感知的自适应动力学模型。该模型利用移动地平线估计和物理一致性约束来进行参数估计和不确定性量化，并在实验中表现出良好的效果。

title: Unified Learning of Temporal Task Structure and Action Timing for Bimanual Robot Manipulation
summary: Temporal task structure is fundamental for bimanual manipulation: a robot must not only know that one action precedes or overlaps another, but also when each action should occur and how long it should take. While symbolic temporal relations enable high-level reasoning about task structure and alternative execution sequences, concrete timing parameters are equally essential for coordinating two hands at the execution level. Existing approaches address these two levels in isolation, leaving a gap between high-level task planning and low-level movement synchronization. This work presents an approach for learning both symbolic and subsymbolic temporal task constraints from human demonstrations and deriving executable, temporally parametrized plans for bimanual manipulation. Our contributions are (i) a 3-dimensional representation of timings between two actions with methods based on multivariate Gaussian Mixture Models to represent temporal relationships between actions on a subsymbolic level, (ii) a method based on the Davis-Putnam-Logemann-Loveland (DPLL) algorithm that finds and ranks all contradiction-free assignments of Allen relations to action pairs, representing different modes of a task, and (iii) an optimization-based planning system that combines the identified symbolic and subsymbolic temporal task constraints to derive temporally parametrized plans for robot execution. We evaluate our approach on several datasets, demonstrating that our method generates temporally parametrized plans closer to human demonstrations than the most characteristic demonstration baseline.
summary_zh: 时序任务结构对于双手操作至关重要：机器人不仅必须知道一个动作先于或重叠于另一个动作，还必须知道每个动作何时发生以及应该持续多久。虽然符号时序关系能够对任务结构和替代执行序列进行高级推理，但具体的时序参数对于在执行层协调双手同样重要。现有方法孤立地处理这两个层次，在高层次任务规划和低层次运动同步之间留下了空白。本工作提出了一种从人类演示中学习符号和亚符号时序任务约束，并推导出可执行的、时序参数化的双手操作计划的方法。我们的贡献包括：（i）基于多元高斯混合模型的三维双手动作时序关系表示方法，以亚符号层级表示动作之间的时序关系；（ii）一种基于Davis-Putnam-Logemann-Loveland（DPLL）算法的方法，用于寻找并排序所有无矛盾的Allen关系对动作对的分配情况，从而表示任务的不同模式；（iii）一个基于优化的规划系统，该系统结合了已识别的符号和亚符号时序任务约束，以推导出用于机器人执行的时序参数化计划。我们在多个数据集上评估了我们的方法，结果表明，与最具代表性的演示基线相比，我们的方法生成的时序参数化计划更接近于人类演示。
tldr: This paper proposes a method to learn both symbolic and subsymbolic temporal constraints for bimanual robot manipulation from human demonstrations, ultimately generating more human-like plans.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种从人类演示中学习双臂机器人操作的符号和亚符号时间约束的方法，最终生成更像人类的计划。

title: SCOPE: Scene-Contextualized Incremental Few-Shot 3D Segmentation
summary: Incremental Few-Shot (IFS) segmentation aims to learn new categories over time from only a few annotations. Although widely studied in 2D, it remains underexplored for 3D point clouds. Existing methods suffer from catastrophic forgetting or fail to learn discriminative prototypes under sparse supervision, and often overlook a key cue: novel categories frequently appear as unlabelled background in base-training scenes. We introduce SCOPE (Scene-COntextualised Prototype Enrichment), a plug-and-play background-guided prototype enrichment framework that integrates with any prototype-based 3D segmentation method. After base training, a class-agnostic segmentation model extracts high-confidence pseudo-instances from background regions to build a prototype pool. When novel classes arrive with few labelled samples, relevant background prototypes are retrieved and fused with few-shot prototypes to form enriched representations without retraining the backbone or adding parameters. Experiments on ScanNet and S3DIS show that SCOPE achieves SOTA performance, improving novel-class IoU by up to 6.98% and 3.61%, and mean IoU by 2.25% and 1.70%, respectively, while maintaining low forgetting. Code is available https://github.com/Surrey-UP-Lab/SCOPE.
summary_zh: 增量少样本(IFS)分割旨在随着时间的推移，仅从少量标注中学习新的类别。尽管在二维领域得到了广泛研究，但在三维点云领域仍未得到充分探索。现有方法存在灾难性遗忘问题，或者无法在稀疏监督下学习判别性原型，并且常常忽略一个关键线索：新类别经常作为未标注的背景出现在基础训练场景中。我们引入了SCOPE（场景上下文原型富集），这是一个即插即用型的背景引导原型富集框架，可与任何基于原型的三维分割方法集成。在基础训练之后，一个类别无关的分割模型从背景区域提取高置信度的伪实例以构建原型池。当新类别到来且只有少量标注样本时，检索相关的背景原型并将其与少样本原型融合，从而形成丰富的表示，而无需重新训练骨干网络或添加参数。在ScanNet和S3DIS上的实验表明，SCOPE实现了最先进的性能，将新类别IoU分别提高了高达6.98％和3.61％，并将平均IoU分别提高了2.25％和1.70％，同时保持了较低的遗忘率。代码可在https://github.com/Surrey-UP-Lab/SCOPE 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces SCOPE, a novel background-guided prototype enrichment framework for incremental few-shot 3D segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art performance by leveraging unlabelled background regions in base training scenes to improve novel class segmentation without retraining the backbone.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为SCOPE的新型背景引导原型增强框架，用于增量少样本3D分割。通过利用基础训练场景中未标记的背景区域，该框架实现了最先进的性能，并在不重新训练骨干网络的情况下改进了新类别分割。

title: Modeling and Measuring Redundancy in Multisource Multimodal Data for Autonomous Driving
summary: Next-generation autonomous vehicles (AVs) rely on large volumes of multisource and multimodal ($M^2$) data to support real-time decision-making. In practice, data quality (DQ) varies across sources and modalities due to environmental conditions and sensor limitations, yet AV research has largely prioritized algorithm design over DQ analysis. This work focuses on redundancy as a fundamental but underexplored DQ issue in AV datasets. Using the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 (AV2) datasets, we model and measure redundancy in multisource camera data and multimodal image-LiDAR data, and evaluate how removing redundant labels affects the YOLOv8 object detection task. Experimental results show that selectively removing redundant multisource image object labels from cameras with shared fields of view improves detection. In nuScenes, mAP${50}$ gains from $0.66$ to $0.70$, $0.64$ to $0.67$, and from $0.53$ to $0.55$, on three representative overlap regions, while detection on other overlapping camera pairs remains at the baseline even under stronger pruning. In AV2, $4.1$-$8.6\%$ of labels are removed, and mAP${50}$ stays near the $0.64$ baseline. Multimodal analysis also reveals substantial redundancy between image and LiDAR data. These findings demonstrate that redundancy is a measurable and actionable DQ factor with direct implications for AV performance. This work highlights the role of redundancy as a data quality factor in AV perception and motivates a data-centric perspective for evaluating and improving AV datasets. Code, data, and implementation details are publicly available at: https://github.com/yhZHOU515/RedundancyAD
summary_zh: 下一代自动驾驶汽车（AV）依赖大量的多源、多模态（$M^2$）数据来支持实时决策。实践中，由于环境条件和传感器限制，数据质量（DQ）在不同来源和模态之间存在差异，然而自动驾驶汽车研究主要侧重于算法设计，而忽视了数据质量分析。本工作重点关注冗余，将其作为自动驾驶汽车数据集中一个基础但未被充分探索的数据质量问题。我们使用nuScenes和Argoverse 2（AV2）数据集，对多源相机数据和多模态图像-激光雷达数据中的冗余进行建模和测量，并评估移除冗余标签对YOLOv8目标检测任务的影响。实验结果表明，选择性地移除来自具有共享视野的相机的冗余多源图像目标标签可以提高检测性能。在nuScenes中，在三个具有代表性的重叠区域，mAP${50}$分别从$0.66$提升至$0.70$，从$0.64$提升至$0.67$，以及从$0.53$提升至$0.55$，而其他重叠相机对上的检测性能即使在更强的剪枝下也保持在基准水平。在AV2中，移除了$4.1$-$8.6\%$的标签，且mAP${50}$保持在接近$0.64$的基准水平。多模态分析也揭示了图像和激光雷达数据之间存在大量冗余。这些发现表明，冗余是一个可测量且可操作的数据质量因素，对自动驾驶汽车性能具有直接影响。这项工作强调了冗余作为自动驾驶汽车感知中的一个数据质量因素的作用，并推动了一种以数据为中心的视角来评估和改进自动驾驶汽车数据集。代码、数据和实现细节可在以下网址公开获取：https://github.com/yhZHOU515/RedundancyAD
tldr: This paper investigates redundancy in multisource, multimodal autonomous driving datasets (nuScenes and Argoverse 2), showing that removing redundant labels can improve object detection performance, highlighting data quality's importance.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了多源、多模态自动驾驶数据集（nuScenes 和 Argoverse 2）中的冗余问题，表明删除冗余标签可以提高目标检测性能，强调了数据质量的重要性。

title: LiveSense: A Real-Time Wi-Fi Sensing Platform for Range-Doppler on COTS Laptop
summary: We present LiveSense - a cross-platform that transforms a commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) Wi-Fi Network Interface Card (NIC) on a laptop into a centimeter-level Range-Doppler sensor while preserving simultaneous communication capability. The laptops are equipped with COTS Intel AX211 (Wi-Fi 6E) or Intel BE201 (Wi-Fi 7) NICs. LiveSense can (i) Extract fully-synchronized channel state information (CSI) at >= 40 Hz, (ii) Perform time-phase alignment and self-interference cancellation on-device, and (iii) Provide a real-time stream of range, Doppler, subcarrier magnitude/phase and annotated video frames to a Python/Qt Graphical User Interface (GUI). The demo will showcase the ability to detect (i) Distance and radial velocity of attendees within a few meters of the device, (ii) Micro-motion (respiration), and (iii) Hand-gesture ranging. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first-ever demo to obtain accurate range information of targets from commercial Wi-Fi, despite the limited 160 MHz bandwidth.
summary_zh: 我们展示了LiveSense——一个跨平台系统，它将笔记本电脑上的商用现成（COTS）Wi-Fi网络接口卡（NIC）转换为厘米级测距-多普勒传感器，同时保留了同步通信能力。笔记本电脑配备了COTS Intel AX211 (Wi-Fi 6E) 或 Intel BE201 (Wi-Fi 7) NIC。LiveSense可以（i）以>= 40 Hz的速率提取完全同步的信道状态信息（CSI），（ii）在设备上执行时相校准和自干扰消除，以及（iii）向Python/Qt图形用户界面（GUI）提供范围、多普勒、子载波幅值/相位和带注释的视频帧的实时流。演示将展示检测（i）设备几米范围内与会者的距离和径向速度、（ii）微动（呼吸）以及（iii）手势测距的能力。据我们所知，这是有史以来第一个从商用Wi-Fi获得目标精确测距信息的演示，尽管带宽限制在160 MHz。
tldr: The paper presents LiveSense, a system that turns a COTS laptop with Wi-Fi 6E/7 into a real-time range-Doppler sensor for detecting distance, velocity, micro-motions, and hand gestures using Wi-Fi signals.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍LiveSense，该系统将配备Wi-Fi 6E/7的商用笔记本电脑转变为实时测距-多普勒传感器，能够利用Wi-Fi信号检测距离、速度、微动和手势。

title: SurgFormer: Scalable Learning of Organ Deformation with Resection Support and Real-Time Inference
summary: We introduce SurgFormer, a multiresolution gated transformer for data driven soft tissue simulation on volumetric meshes. High fidelity biomechanical solvers are often too costly for interactive use, so we train SurgFormer on solver generated data to predict nodewise displacement fields at near real time rates. SurgFormer builds a fixed mesh hierarchy and applies repeated multibranch blocks that combine local message passing, coarse global self attention, and pointwise feedforward updates, fused by learned per node, per channel gates to adaptively integrate local and long range information while remaining scalable on large meshes. For cut conditioned simulation, resection information is encoded as a learned cut embedding and provided as an additional input, enabling a unified model for both standard deformation prediction and topology altering cases. We also introduce two surgical simulation datasets generated under a unified protocol with XFEM based supervision: a cholecystectomy resection dataset and an appendectomy manipulation and resection dataset with cut and uncut cases. To our knowledge, this is the first learned volumetric surrogate setting to study XFEM supervised cut conditioned deformation within the same volumetric pipeline as standard deformation prediction. Across diverse baselines, SurgFormer achieves strong accuracy with favorable efficiency, making it a practical backbone for both tasks. {Code, data, and project page: \href{https://mint-vu.github.io/SurgFormer/}{available here}}
summary_zh: 我们提出了SurgFormer，一种用于体网格上数据驱动软组织模拟的多分辨率门控Transformer。高保真生物力学求解器通常计算成本过高，无法进行交互式使用，因此我们利用求解器生成的数据训练SurgFormer，以接近实时的速度预测节点位移场。SurgFormer构建一个固定的网格层次结构，并应用重复的多分支模块，这些模块结合了局部消息传递、粗粒度全局自注意力机制和逐点前馈更新，并通过学习到的每个节点、每个通道的门控进行融合，以自适应地整合局部和长程信息，同时保持在大网格上的可扩展性。对于切割条件下的模拟，切除信息被编码为学习到的切割嵌入，并作为附加输入提供，从而能够使用统一的模型进行标准形变预测和拓扑改变的情况。我们还引入了两个在统一协议下生成的基于XFEM监督的外科手术模拟数据集：一个胆囊切除术切除数据集和一个阑尾切除术操作和切除数据集，包含切割和未切割情况。据我们所知，这是第一个学习到的体积代理设置，用于研究与标准形变预测在同一体积管道内的XFEM监督的切割条件形变。在各种基准测试中，SurgFormer都能以良好的效率实现很高的准确度，使其成为两项任务的实用骨干模型。[代码、数据和项目页面：\href{https://mint-vu.github.io/SurgFormer/}{此处可用}]
tldr: SurgFormer is introduced as a multiresolution gated transformer trained on solver-generated data for near real-time soft tissue simulation, including resection, with accompanying surgical simulation datasets.
tldr_zh: SurgFormer是一个多分辨率门控Transformer，它在求解器生成的数据上进行训练，用于近乎实时的软组织模拟，包括切除，并附带手术模拟数据集。

title: Spatial Calibration of Diffuse LiDARs
summary: Diffuse direct time-of-flight LiDARs report per-pixel depth histograms formed by aggregating photon returns over a wide instantaneous field of view, violating the single-ray assumption behind standard LiDAR-RGB calibration. We present a simple spatial calibration procedure that estimates, for each diffuse LiDAR pixel, its footprint (effective support region) and relative spatial sensitivity in a co-located RGB image plane. Using a scanned retroreflective patch with background subtraction, we recover per-pixel response maps that provide an explicit LiDAR-to-RGB correspondence for cross-modal alignment and fusion. We demonstrate the method on the ams OSRAM TMF8828.
summary_zh: 漫反射直接飞行时间激光雷达报告每像素深度直方图，这些直方图是通过在宽瞬时视场上聚合光子返回形成的，这违反了标准激光雷达-RGB标定背后的单射线假设。我们提出了一种简单的空间标定程序，用于估计每个漫反射激光雷达像素的足迹（有效支撑区域）及其在共位RGB图像平面上的相对空间敏感度。通过扫描带有背景扣除的反光贴片，我们恢复了每像素响应图，该响应图为跨模态对齐和融合提供了显式的激光雷达-RGB对应关系。我们在ams OSRAM TMF8828上演示了该方法。
tldr: This paper presents a spatial calibration method for diffuse LiDARs, estimating the footprint and spatial sensitivity of each pixel in the corresponding RGB image plane. It uses a scanned retroreflective patch for LiDAR-to-RGB correspondence.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于漫反射激光雷达的空间标定方法，估计每个像素的足迹和在相应RGB图像平面中的空间灵敏度。它使用扫描的回射反射片来实现激光雷达到RGB的对应。

title: Underactuated multimodal jumping robot for extraterrestrial exploration
summary: We present a rolling and jumping underactuated monopedal robot designed to explore multimodal locomotion on low-gravity bodies. It uses only two reaction wheels to control its spatial orientation with two controllers: a balancing controller which can aim the robot's jump direction on the ground, and an aerial reorientation controller which can aim the robot's leg for landing after flight. We demonstrate rolling, targeted jumping and landing, and self-righting using only three actuators total, keeping system size to 0.33m and 1.25kg. Simple switching between locomotion modes enables the system to deal with differing landscapes and environmental conditions.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种欠驱动单足滚动跳跃机器人，旨在探索在低重力天体上的多模态运动。它仅使用两个反作用轮来控制其空间姿态，并包含两个控制器：一个平衡控制器，可以在地面上瞄准机器人的跳跃方向；以及一个空中重定向控制器，可以在飞行后瞄准机器人的腿部以进行着陆。我们演示了仅使用总共三个执行器即可实现滚动、目标跳跃和着陆以及自扶正，并将系统尺寸保持在0.33米，重量保持在1.25千克。在不同运动模式之间简单切换使得该系统能够应对不同的地形和环境条件。
tldr: This paper introduces a small, underactuated, monopedal robot capable of rolling, jumping, and self-righting, designed for multimodal locomotion on low-gravity bodies. It uses only two reaction wheels and simple controllers to achieve targeted jumps and landings.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种小型、欠驱动的单足机器人，该机器人能够滚动、跳跃和自扶正，专为低重力环境下的多模态运动而设计。它仅使用两个反作用轮和简单的控制器来实现有目标的跳跃和着陆。

title: AeroPlace-Flow: Language-Grounded Object Placement for Aerial Manipulators via Visual Foresight and Object Flow
summary: Precise object placement remains underexplored in aerial manipulation, where most systems rely on predefined target coordinates and focus primarily on grasping and control. Specifying exact placement poses, however, is cumbersome in real-world settings, where users naturally communicate goals through language. In this work, we present AeroPlace-Flow, a training-free framework for language-grounded aerial object placement that unifies visual foresight with explicit 3D geometric reasoning and object flow. Given RGB-D observations of the object and the placement scene, along with a natural language instruction, AeroPlace-Flow first synthesizes a task-complete goal image using image editing models. The imagined configuration is then grounded into metric 3D space through depth alignment and object-centric reasoning, enabling the inference of a collision-aware object flow that transports the grasped object to a language and contact-consistent placement configuration. The resulting motion is executed via standard trajectory tracking for an aerial manipulator. AeroPlace-Flow produces executable placement targets without requiring predefined poses or task-specific training. We validate our approach through extensive simulation and real-world experiments, demonstrating reliable language-conditioned placement across diverse aerial scenarios with an average success rate of 75% on hardware.
summary_zh:
摘要：
精确的目标物体放置在空中操作中仍未被充分探索，现有系统大多依赖于预定义的目标坐标，并主要关注抓取和控制。然而，在真实场景中指定精确的放置姿态非常繁琐，用户通常通过语言来表达目标。本文提出一种无需训练的语言引导空中物体放置框架AeroPlace-Flow，它统一了视觉前瞻、显式的3D几何推理和物体流。给定物体和放置场景的RGB-D观测以及自然语言指令，AeroPlace-Flow首先使用图像编辑模型合成一个任务完成的预期目标图像。然后，通过深度对齐和以物体为中心的推理，将想象的配置定位到度量3D空间中，从而能够推断出一个避碰的物体流，将抓取的物体传输到语言和接触一致的放置配置中。生成的运动通过空中机械臂的标准轨迹跟踪执行。AeroPlace-Flow能够生成可执行的放置目标，而无需预定义的姿态或特定于任务的训练。我们通过大量的模拟和真实实验验证了该方法，证明了其在各种空中场景中进行可靠的语言条件放置的能力，硬件平均成功率达到75%。
tldr: The paper presents AeroPlace-Flow, a training-free framework for language-grounded aerial object placement using visual foresight and object flow, achieving reliable performance in simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了AeroPlace-Flow，一个无需训练的语言引导的空中物体放置框架，它利用视觉预测和物体流，在模拟和真实实验中实现了可靠的性能。

title: RoboPCA: Pose-centered Affordance Learning from Human Demonstrations for Robot Manipulation
summary: Understanding spatial affordances -- comprising the contact regions of object interaction and the corresponding contact poses -- is essential for robots to effectively manipulate objects and accomplish diverse tasks. However, existing spatial affordance prediction methods mainly focus on locating the contact regions while delegating the pose to independent pose estimation approaches, which can lead to task failures due to inconsistencies between predicted contact regions and candidate poses. In this work, we propose RoboPCA, a pose-centered affordance prediction framework that jointly predicts task-appropriate contact regions and poses conditioned on instructions. To enable scalable data collection for pose-centered affordance learning, we devise Human2Afford, a data curation pipeline that automatically recovers scene-level 3D information and infers pose-centered affordance annotations from human demonstrations. With Human2Afford, scene depth and the interaction object's mask are extracted to provide 3D context and object localization, while pose-centered affordance annotations are obtained by tracking object points within the contact region and analyzing hand-object interaction patterns to establish a mapping from the 3D hand mesh to the robot end-effector orientation. By integrating geometry-appearance cues through an RGB-D encoder and incorporating mask-enhanced features to emphasize task-relevant object regions into the diffusion-based framework, RoboPCA outperforms baseline methods on image datasets, simulation, and real robots, and exhibits strong generalization across tasks and categories.
summary_zh: 理解空间可供性——包括物体交互的接触区域和相应的接触姿态——对于机器人有效地操作物体和完成多样化任务至关重要。然而，现有的空间可供性预测方法主要集中于定位接触区域，同时将姿态委派给独立的姿态估计方法，这可能由于预测的接触区域和候选姿态之间的不一致而导致任务失败。在这项工作中，我们提出了RoboPCA，这是一个以姿态为中心的可供性预测框架，可以根据指令联合预测适合任务的接触区域和姿态。为了实现以姿态为中心的可供性学习的可扩展数据收集，我们设计了Human2Afford，该数据整理流程可自动恢复场景级3D信息，并从人类演示中推断以姿态为中心的可供性标注。利用Human2Afford，提取场景深度和交互物体的掩码以提供3D上下文和物体定位，同时通过跟踪接触区域内的物体点并分析手-物体交互模式，以建立从3D手部网格到机器人末端执行器方向的映射，从而获得以姿态为中心的可供性标注。通过RGB-D编码器整合几何-外观线索，并将掩码增强的特征融入到基于扩散的模型中以强调与任务相关的物体区域，RoboPCA在图像数据集、模拟和真实机器人上均优于基线方法，并在任务和类别之间表现出强大的泛化能力。
tldr: RoboPCA is a pose-centered affordance learning framework that jointly predicts contact regions and poses from human demonstrations using a novel data curation pipeline and a diffusion-based model, demonstrating strong generalization in robot manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: RoboPCA是一个以姿态为中心的示能学习框架，它使用一种新的数据策展流程和一个基于扩散的模型，从人类演示中联合预测接触区域和姿态，并在机器人操作任务中表现出强大的泛化能力。

title: UniUncer: Unified Dynamic Static Uncertainty for End to End Driving
summary: End-to-end (E2E) driving has become a cornerstone of both industry deployment and academic research, offering a single learnable pipeline that maps multi-sensor inputs to actions while avoiding hand-engineered modules. However, the reliability of such pipelines strongly depends on how well they handle uncertainty: sensors are noisy, semantics can be ambiguous, and interaction with other road users is inherently stochastic. Uncertainty also appears in multiple forms: classification vs. localization, and, crucially, in both static map elements and dynamic agents. Existing E2E approaches model only static-map uncertainty, leaving planning vulnerable to overconfident and unreliable inputs. We present UniUncer, the first lightweight, unified uncertainty framework that jointly estimates and uses uncertainty for both static and dynamic scene elements inside an E2E planner. Concretely: (1) we convert deterministic heads to probabilistic Laplace regressors that output per-vertex location and scale for vectorized static and dynamic entities; (2) we introduce an uncertainty-fusion module that encodes these parameters and injects them into object/map queries to form uncertainty-aware queries; and (3) we design an uncertainty-aware gate that adaptively modulates reliance on historical inputs (ego status or temporal perception queries) based on current uncertainty levels. The design adds minimal overhead and drops throughput by only $\sim$0.5 FPS while remaining plug-and-play for common E2E backbones. On nuScenes (open-loop), UniUncer reduces average L2 trajectory error by 7\%. On NavsimV2 (pseudo closed-loop), it improves overall EPDMS by 10.8\% and notable stage two gains in challenging, interaction-heavy scenes. Ablations confirm that dynamic-agent uncertainty and the uncertainty-aware gate are both necessary.
summary_zh: 端到端（E2E）自动驾驶已成为工业部署和学术研究的基石，它提供了一个可学习的单一流程，将多传感器输入映射到行动，同时避免了手工设计的模块。然而，此类流程的可靠性在很大程度上取决于它们处理不确定性的能力：传感器具有噪声，语义可能模糊，与其他道路使用者的交互本质上是随机的。不确定性也以多种形式出现：分类与定位，以及最关键的，静态地图元素和动态智能体。现有的E2E方法仅对静态地图的不确定性进行建模，使得规划容易受到过度自信和不可靠的输入的影响。我们提出了UniUncer，这是第一个轻量级的、统一的不确定性框架，它在E2E规划器内部联合估计并使用静态和动态场景元素的不确定性。具体来说：（1）我们将确定性的头部转换为概率性的拉普拉斯回归器，为矢量化的静态和动态实体输出每个顶点的定位和尺度；（2）我们引入了一个不确定性融合模块，该模块对这些参数进行编码并将其注入到对象/地图查询中，以形成不确定性感知的查询；（3）我们设计了一个不确定性感知门，该门根据当前的不确定性水平自适应地调节对历史输入（自我状态或时间感知查询）的依赖程度。该设计增加了最小的开销，吞吐量仅下降约0.5FPS，同时保持了对常见E2E骨干网络的即插即用性。在nuScenes（开环）上，UniUncer将平均L2轨迹误差降低了7%。在NavsimV2（伪闭环）上，它将整体EPDMS提高了10.8%，并在具有挑战性的、交互密集的场景中实现了显著的第二阶段收益。消融实验证实，动态智能体的不确定性和不确定性感知门都是必要的。
tldr: The paper introduces UniUncer, a novel unified uncertainty framework for end-to-end driving that jointly estimates and uses uncertainty for both static and dynamic scene elements, improving driving performance in open and pseudo-closed loop scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了UniUncer，一种新颖的统一不确定性框架，用于端到端驾驶，可以联合估计和使用静态和动态场景元素的不确定性，从而提高在开放和伪闭环场景中的驾驶性能。

title: AtomicVLA: Unlocking the Potential of Atomic Skill Learning in Robots
summary: Recent advances in Visual-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising potential for robotic manipulation tasks. However, real-world robotic tasks often involve long-horizon, multi-step problem-solving and require generalization for continual skill acquisition, extending beyond single actions or skills. These challenges present significant barriers for existing VLA models, which use monolithic action decoders trained on aggregated data, resulting in poor scalability. To address these challenges, we propose AtomicVLA, a unified planning-and-execution framework that jointly generates task-level plans, atomic skill abstractions, and fine-grained actions. AtomicVLA constructs a scalable atomic skill library through a Skill-Guided Mixture-of-Experts (SG-MoE), where each expert specializes in mastering generic yet precise atomic skills. Furthermore, we introduce a flexible routing encoder that automatically assigns dedicated atomic experts to new skills, enabling continual learning. We validate our approach through extensive experiments. In simulation, AtomicVLA outperforms $π_{0}$ by 2.4\% on LIBERO, 10\% on LIBERO-LONG, and outperforms $π_{0}$ and $π_{0.5}$ by 0.22 and 0.25 in average task length on CALVIN. Additionally, our AtomicVLA consistently surpasses baselines by 18.3\% and 21\% in real-world long-horizon tasks and continual learning. These results highlight the effectiveness of atomic skill abstraction and dynamic expert composition for long-horizon and lifelong robotic tasks. The project page is \href{https://zhanglk9.github.io/atomicvla-web/}{here}.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的最新进展展现了在机器人操作任务中极具潜力的应用前景。然而，真实世界的机器人任务通常涉及长时程、多步骤的问题解决，并需要泛化能力以实现持续的技能获取，从而超越单一动作或技能的范畴。这些挑战给现有的VLA模型带来了重大障碍，这些模型使用基于聚合数据训练的单体式动作解码器，导致可扩展性较差。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 AtomicVLA，一个统一的规划-执行框架，它联合生成任务级别的计划、原子技能抽象以及细粒度的动作。AtomicVLA 通过技能引导的专家混合模型（SG-MoE）构建了一个可扩展的原子技能库，其中每个专家专注于掌握通用且精确的原子技能。此外，我们引入了一种灵活的路由编码器，它可以自动为新技能分配专门的原子专家，从而实现持续学习。我们通过大量的实验验证了我们的方法。在仿真环境中，AtomicVLA 在 LIBERO 上优于 $π_{0}$ 2.4%，在 LIBERO-LONG 上优于 $π_{0}$ 10%，在 CALVIN 上，平均任务长度优于 $π_{0}$ 和 $π_{0.5}$ 分别为 0.22 和 0.25。此外，我们的 AtomicVLA 在真实世界的长时程任务和持续学习中始终优于基线模型 18.3% 和 21%。这些结果突显了原子技能抽象和动态专家组合在长时程和终身机器人任务中的有效性。项目主页请访问\href{https://zhanglk9.github.io/atomicvla-web/}{here}。
tldr: AtomicVLA introduces a skill-guided mixture-of-experts framework for Visual-Language-Action models to address long-horizon and continual learning challenges in robotics by learning atomic skills and dynamically composing them for task completion.
tldr_zh: AtomicVLA 引入了一种技能引导的混合专家框架，用于视觉-语言-动作模型，旨在通过学习原子技能并动态组合它们来解决机器人技术中长程和持续学习的挑战。

title: TempoFit: Plug-and-Play Layer-Wise Temporal KV Memory for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
summary: Pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have achieved strong single-step manipulation, but their inference remains largely memoryless, which is brittle in non-Markovian long-horizon settings with occlusion, state aliasing, and subtle post-action changes. Prior approaches inject history either by stacking frames, which scales visual tokens and latency while adding near-duplicate pixels, or by learning additional temporal interfaces that require (re-)training and may break the original single-frame inference graph. We present TempoFit, a training-free temporal retrofit that upgrades frozen VLAs through state-level memory. Our key insight is that prefix attention K/V already form a model-native, content-addressable runtime state; reusing them across timesteps introduces history without new tokens or trainable modules. TempoFit stores layer-wise FIFO prefix K/V at selected intermediate layers, performs parameter-free K-to-K retrieval with Frame-Gap Temporal Bias (FGTB), a fixed recency bias inspired by positional biases in NLP, to keep decisions present-dominant, and injects the retrieved context via pre-attention residual loading with norm-preserving rescaling to avoid distribution shift under frozen weights. On LIBERO-LONG, TempoFit improves strong pretrained backbones by up to +4.0% average success rate while maintaining near-real-time latency, and it transfers consistently to CALVIN and real-robot long-horizon tasks.
summary_zh: 预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在单步操作中表现出色，但它们的推理在很大程度上是无记忆的，这在具有遮挡、状态混叠和细微动作后变化等非马尔可夫长时程环境中显得脆弱。以往的方法通过叠加帧来注入历史信息，但这会增加视觉token和延迟，同时添加近乎重复的像素；或者通过学习额外的时序接口，但这需要（重新）训练，并可能破坏原始的单帧推理图。我们提出了TempoFit，一种免训练的时序改造方法，通过状态级记忆来升级冻结的VLA。我们的关键洞察是，前缀注意力机制的K/V已经形成了一个模型原生的、内容可寻址的运行时状态；跨时间步骤重用它们引入了历史信息，而无需新的token或可训练模块。TempoFit在选定的中间层存储逐层FIFO前缀K/V，执行无参数的K-to-K检索，并使用帧间隙时序偏差（FGTB），这是一种受NLP位置偏差启发的固定近因偏差，以保持决策的当前主导地位，并通过预注意力残差加载注入检索到的上下文，并使用保持范数的重缩放，以避免在冻结权重下的分布偏移。在LIBERO-LONG上，TempoFit在保持接近实时延迟的同时，将强大的预训练骨干网络的平均成功率提高了高达+4.0％，并且它能够一致地迁移到CALVIN和真实机器人的长时程任务中。
tldr: TempoFit improves long-horizon Vision-Language-Action manipulation in frozen VLA policies by introducing a training-free temporal memory mechanism using layer-wise prefix K/V retrieval and a novel Frame-Gap Temporal Bias.
tldr_zh: TempoFit通过在冻结的VLA策略中引入一种无需训练的层级前缀K/V检索时序记忆机制，并结合新颖的帧间隙时序偏差，来改善长时程视觉-语言-动作操作。

title: PanoDP: Learning Collision-Free Navigation with Panoramic Depth and Differentiable Physics
summary: Autonomous collision-free navigation in cluttered environments requires safe decision-making under partial observability with both static structure and dynamic obstacles. We present \textbf{PanoDP}, a communication-free learning framework that combines four-view panoramic depth perception with differentiable-physics-based training signals. PanoDP encodes panoramic depth using a lightweight CNN and optimizes policies with dense differentiable collision and motion-feasibility terms, improving training stability beyond sparse terminal collisions. We evaluate PanoDP on a controlled ring-to-center benchmark with systematic sweeps over agent count, obstacle density/layout, and dynamic behaviors, and further test out-of-distribution generalization in an external simulator (e.g., AirSim). Across settings, PanoDP increases collision-free and completion rates over single-view and non-physics-guided baselines under matched training budgets, and ablations (view masking, rotation augmentation) confirm the policy leverages 360-degree information. Code will be open source upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 在杂乱环境中实现自主无碰撞导航需要在部分可观测性下，对静态结构和动态障碍物做出安全决策。我们提出了一种无需通信的学习框架 \textbf{PanoDP}，它结合了四视图全景深度感知和基于可微分物理的训练信号。PanoDP 使用轻量级 CNN 编码全景深度，并利用密集的、可微分的碰撞和运动可行性项来优化策略，从而提高训练稳定性，超越了稀疏的终端碰撞。我们在受控的环形到中心基准测试中评估了 PanoDP，系统地扫描了智能体数量、障碍物密度/布局和动态行为, 并在外部模拟器（例如 AirSim）中进一步测试了分布外泛化能力。在各种设置下，PanoDP 在匹配的训练预算下，相较于单视图和非物理引导的基线，提高了无碰撞率和完成率，消融实验（视图遮蔽、旋转增强）证实了该策略利用了 360 度信息。代码将在接收后开源。
tldr: The paper presents PanoDP, a communication-free learning framework for autonomous collision-free navigation that utilizes panoramic depth perception and differentiable physics for training, resulting in improved navigation performance in cluttered environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了PanoDP，一个用于自主无碰撞导航的无通信学习框架，该框架利用全景深度感知和可微物理进行训练，从而提高了在杂乱环境中导航的性能。

title: GeoLoco: Leveraging 3D Geometric Priors from Visual Foundation Model for Robust RGB-Only Humanoid Locomotion
summary: The prevailing paradigm of perceptive humanoid locomotion relies heavily on active depth sensors. However, this depth-centric approach fundamentally discards the rich semantic and dense appearance cues of the visual world, severing low-level control from the high-level reasoning essential for general embodied intelligence. While monocular RGB offers a ubiquitous, information-dense alternative, end-to-end reinforcement learning from raw 2D pixels suffers from extreme sample inefficiency and catastrophic sim-to-real collapse due to the inherent loss of geometric scale. To break this deadlock, we propose GeoLoco, a purely RGB-driven locomotion framework that conceptualizes monocular images as high-dimensional 3D latent representations by harnessing the powerful geometric priors of a frozen, scale-aware Visual Foundation Model (VFM). Rather than naive feature concatenation, we design a proprioceptive-query multi-head cross-attention mechanism that dynamically attends to task-critical topological features conditioned on the robot's real-time gait phase. Crucially, to prevent the policy from overfitting to superficial textures, we introduce a dual-head auxiliary learning scheme. This explicit regularization forces the high-dimensional latent space to strictly align with the physical terrain geometry, ensuring robust zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. Trained exclusively in simulation, GeoLoco achieves robust zero-shot transfer to the Unitree G1 humanoid and successfully negotiates challenging terrains.
summary_zh: 目前主流的感知人形机器人运动范例严重依赖于主动深度传感器。然而，这种以深度为中心的方案从根本上抛弃了视觉世界丰富的语义和密集的表观线索，将底层控制与通用具身智能所需的高层推理割裂开来。虽然单目RGB提供了一种普遍存在且信息密集的替代方案，但由于几何尺度的固有损失，从原始2D像素进行端到端强化学习会遭受极低的样本效率和灾难性的模拟到真实世界的崩塌。为了打破这一僵局，我们提出GeoLoco，一种纯粹由RGB驱动的运动框架，它通过利用冻结的、具有尺度感知能力的视觉基础模型（VFM）的强大几何先验，将单目图像概念化为高维3D潜在表示。我们没有采用简单的特征拼接，而是设计了一种本体感受查询多头交叉注意力机制，该机制根据机器人的实时步态相位动态地关注于任务关键的拓扑特征。至关重要的是，为了防止策略过度拟合表面纹理，我们引入了一种双头辅助学习方案。这种显式正则化强制高维潜在空间严格对齐物理地形几何结构，从而确保鲁棒的零样本模拟到真实世界的迁移。GeoLoco完全在模拟中训练，实现了到宇树G1人形机器人的鲁棒零样本迁移，并成功地在具有挑战性的地形上导航。
tldr: GeoLoco uses a Visual Foundation Model and a novel attention mechanism with auxiliary learning to achieve robust, RGB-only humanoid locomotion with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, addressing the limitations of depth-centric approaches.
tldr_zh: GeoLoco利用视觉基础模型和新型注意力机制以及辅助学习，实现了鲁棒的、仅使用RGB的人形机器人运动，并具有零样本sim-to-real迁移能力，解决了以深度为中心的方法的局限性。

title: ReconDrive: Fast Feed-Forward 4D Gaussian Splatting for Autonomous Driving Scene Reconstruction
summary: High-fidelity visual reconstruction and novel-view synthesis are essential for realistic closed-loop evaluation in autonomous driving. While 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) offers a promising balance of accuracy and efficiency, existing per-scene optimization methods require costly iterative refinement, rendering them unscalable for extensive urban environments. Conversely, current feed-forward approaches often suffer from degraded photometric quality. To address these limitations, we propose ReconDrive, a feed-forward framework that leverages and extends the 3D foundation model VGGT for rapid, high-fidelity 4DGS generation. Our architecture introduces two core adaptations to tailor the foundation model to dynamic driving scenes: (1) Hybrid Gaussian Prediction Heads, which decouple the regression of spatial coordinates and appearance attributes to overcome the photometric deficiencies inherent in generalized foundation features; and (2) a Static-Dynamic 4D Composition strategy that explicitly captures temporal motion via velocity modeling to represent complex dynamic environments. Benchmarked on nuScenes, ReconDrive significantly outperforms existing feed-forward baselines in reconstruction, novel-view synthesis, and 3D perception. It achieves performance competitive with per-scene optimization while being orders of magnitude faster, providing a scalable and practical solution for realistic driving simulation.
summary_zh: 高保真视觉重建和新视角合成对于自动驾驶中真实的闭环评估至关重要。虽然4D高斯溅射(4DGS)在精度和效率之间提供了有希望的平衡，但现有的每场景优化方法需要昂贵的迭代精细化，导致其无法扩展到广泛的城市环境。相反，当前的直接前馈方法通常会受到光度质量下降的影响。为了解决这些限制，我们提出ReconDrive，一个利用并扩展3D基础模型VGGT的直接前馈框架，用于快速、高保真地生成4DGS。我们的架构引入了两个核心适配来定制基础模型以适应动态驾驶场景：（1）混合高斯预测头，它解耦了空间坐标和外观属性的回归，以克服通用基础特征固有的光度缺陷；（2）静态-动态4D合成策略，它通过速度建模显式地捕捉时间运动，以表示复杂的动态环境。在nuScenes上进行基准测试，ReconDrive在重建、新视角合成和3D感知方面显著优于现有的直接前馈基线。它在速度上比每场景优化快几个数量级的同时，实现了与其性能相当的水平，为真实的驾驶模拟提供了一种可扩展且实用的解决方案。
tldr: ReconDrive is a fast, feed-forward framework for 4D Gaussian Splatting that leverages a 3D foundation model to efficiently reconstruct dynamic autonomous driving scenes, outperforming existing feed-forward methods and approaching per-scene optimization performance with significantly improved speed.
tldr_zh: ReconDrive 是一个快速的前馈 4D Gaussian Splatting 框架，它利用 3D 基础模型高效地重建动态自动驾驶场景。它在性能上优于现有的前馈方法，并且在速度得到显著提升的同时，性能接近于逐场景优化。

title: ICLR: In-Context Imitation Learning with Visual Reasoning
summary: In-context imitation learning enables robots to adapt to new tasks from a small number of demonstrations without additional training. However, existing approaches typically condition only on state-action trajectories and lack explicit representations of task intent. This limitation hinders performance in complex and ambiguous task settings where the same actions may be consistent with different objectives. To address this, we present In-Context Imitation Learning with Visual Reasoning (ICLR), a novel framework that augments demonstration prompts with structured visual reasoning traces representing anticipated future robot trajectories in image space. ICLR also jointly learns to generate reasoning traces and low-level actions within a unified autoregressive transformer, enabling the model to mimic not only action prediction but also the reasoning process that leads to those actions. We extensively evaluate ICLR in both simulation and real-world manipulation tasks and demonstrate consistent improvements in success rates and generalization to unseen tasks and novel object configurations compared to other in-context imitation learning methods. These results suggest that incorporating embodied visual reasoning represents a promising direction for enhancing the robustness and generalization of robotic in-context learning systems.
summary_zh:
以下为翻译结果：

上下文模仿学习使机器人能够从少量的演示中适应新的任务，而无需额外的训练。然而，现有的方法通常只以状态-动作轨迹为条件，缺乏对任务意图的显式表示。这种限制阻碍了在复杂和模糊的任务环境中的表现，因为相同的动作可能与不同的目标一致。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了基于视觉推理的上下文模仿学习 (ICLR)，这是一种新颖的框架，它通过结构化的视觉推理轨迹来扩充演示提示，这些轨迹代表图像空间中预期的未来机器人轨迹。ICLR还在统一的自回归Transformer中联合学习生成推理轨迹和底层动作，使模型不仅能够模仿动作预测，还能模仿导致这些动作的推理过程。我们对ICLR在模拟和真实世界的操纵任务中进行了广泛的评估，并证明与其他上下文模仿学习方法相比，在成功率和对未见任务及新颖物体配置的泛化能力方面都有持续的提高。这些结果表明，结合具身视觉推理代表了增强机器人上下文学习系统的稳健性和泛化能力的一个有希望的方向。
tldr: The paper introduces ICLR, a new in-context imitation learning framework for robots that incorporates visual reasoning through anticipated future trajectory generation within a transformer, leading to improved performance and generalization in manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为ICLR的新型机器人上下文模仿学习框架，该框架通过Transformer中预期未来轨迹的生成来结合视觉推理，从而提高了操作任务中的性能和泛化能力。

title: HSC-VLA: Hierarchical Scene-Clearing for Robust Bimanual Manipulation in Dense Clutter
summary: Modern Vision--Language--Action models often suffer from critical instruction-following failures in high-density manipulation environments, where task-irrelevant visual clutter dilutes attention, corrupts grounding, and substantially degrades performance in complex long-horizon scenarios. To overcome the representation bottleneck of monolithic end-to-end architectures, we propose HSC-VLA, a hierarchical framework that decouples high-level visual-semantic reasoning from low-level, high-frequency sensorimotor execution through an explicit scene-clearing abstraction. HSC-VLA employs a high-level Brain to decompose long-horizon tasks and to generate task-specific scene masks that preserve task-relevant geometry while suppressing distractors. The filtered observations are then passed to a low-level Cerebellum, a diffusion-based policy that performs bimanual manipulation using only mask-filtered vision and proprioception. Extensive experiments in densely cluttered supermarket shelves demonstrate that HSC-VLA achieves 86.7\% aggregate success under high-density clutter, surpassing the best monolithic baseline ($π_0$-Full FT at 34.3\%) by 52.4\%. HSC-VLA also exhibits strong long-horizon performance, reaching 72\% on clutter sorting and 66\% on restocking, demonstrating strong robustness and effective failure recovery in complex cluttered manipulation.
summary_zh: 现代视觉-语言-动作模型在高密度操作环境中常常出现严重的指令执行失败问题。在这种环境中，与任务无关的视觉杂乱会稀释注意力、破坏语义对齐，并显著降低复杂长时程场景中的性能。为了克服单体式端到端架构的表征瓶颈，我们提出了HSC-VLA，一种分层框架，它通过显式的场景清理抽象，将高层视觉-语义推理与低层、高频感觉运动执行解耦。HSC-VLA采用一个高层“大脑”来分解长时程任务，并生成任务特定的场景掩码，保留任务相关的几何信息，同时抑制干扰因素。过滤后的观测数据然后被传递到一个低层“小脑”，这是一个基于扩散模型的策略，仅使用掩码过滤后的视觉和本体感觉来执行双手动操作。在高度杂乱的超市货架上的大量实验表明，在高度杂乱的环境下，HSC-VLA实现了86.7%的总体成功率，超过了最佳单体式基线($π_0$-Full FT的34.3%) 52.4%。HSC-VLA还表现出强大的长时程性能，在杂乱分类任务中达到72%，在补货任务中达到66%，证明了其在复杂杂乱操作中的强大鲁棒性和有效的故障恢复能力。
tldr: The paper introduces HSC-VLA, a hierarchical vision-language-action framework that improves bimanual manipulation in cluttered environments by using a scene-clearing abstraction to filter out irrelevant visual information before execution.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 HSC-VLA，一种分层视觉-语言-动作框架，通过使用场景清理抽象来过滤掉无关视觉信息，从而改进在杂乱环境中的双手动操作。

title: LITHE: Bridging Best-Effort Python and Real-Time C++ for Hot-Swapping Robotic Control Laws on Commodity Linux
summary: Modern robotic systems rely on hierarchical control, where a high-level "Brain" (Python) directs a lower-level "Spine" (C++ real-time controller). Despite its necessity, this hierarchy makes it difficult for the Brain to completely rewrite the Spine's immutable control logic, consequently inhibiting fundamental adaptation for different tasks and environments. Conventional approaches require complex middleware, proprietary hardware, or sacrifice real-time performance. We present LITHE (Linux Isolated Threading for Hierarchical Execution), a lightweight software architecture that collapses the robot control hierarchy onto a commodity single-board computer (Raspberry Pi 4B with pi3hat), while maintaining safe frequency decoupling between the Brain and Spine. LITHE integrates strict CPU isolation (isolcpus), lock-free inter-process communication (IPC), and pipelined execution to meet high-frequency deadlines with minimal jitter. By adding multi-threaded dynamic linking, LITHE enables a Python-based Brain to dynamically evolve the logic of a 1kHz C++ Spine without interruption. We validate "functional real-time" system performance with worst-case execution time (WCET) < 100 $μ$s and maximum release jitter (MRJ) < 4 $μ$s under heavy load. We demonstrate a novel application where a large language model (LLM) supervisor performs online system identification to evolve a real-time controller on-the-fly, without interrupting the 1 kHz control loop. In essence, LITHE eliminates the "immutable compiled code" bottleneck for best-effort Brains to synthesize and inject completely new control laws into the real-time Spine. This bridges a critical gap between high-level AI and low-level real-time control to unlock continuous real-time evolution of embodied intelligence in safe, human-in-the-loop systems.
summary_zh: 现代机器人系统依赖于分层控制，其中高层“大脑”（Python）指导低层“脊髓”（C++实时控制器）。尽管这种分层结构是必需的，但它使得“大脑”难以完全重写“脊髓”不可变的控制逻辑，从而阻碍了针对不同任务和环境的基本适应。传统方法需要复杂中间件、专有硬件或牺牲实时性能。我们提出 LITHE (Linux Isolated Threading for Hierarchical Execution)，这是一种轻量级软件架构，可将机器人控制层次结构折叠到商用单板计算机（带有 pi3hat 的 Raspberry Pi 4B）上，同时保持“大脑”和“脊髓”之间的安全频率解耦。LITHE 集成了严格的 CPU 隔离 (isolcpus)、无锁进程间通信 (IPC) 和流水线执行，以最小的抖动满足高频截止时间。通过添加多线程动态链接，LITHE 使得基于 Python 的“大脑”能够在不中断的情况下动态演化 1kHz C++“脊髓”的逻辑。我们验证了“功能实时”系统性能，在重负载下，最坏情况执行时间 (WCET) < 100 $μ$s，最大释放抖动 (MRJ) < 4 $μ$s。我们展示了一种新颖的应用，其中大型语言模型 (LLM) 监督器执行在线系统辨识，从而动态演化实时控制器，无需中断 1 kHz 控制环路。本质上，LITHE 消除了“不可变的编译代码”瓶颈，从而使得尽力而为的“大脑”能够合成全新的控制律并将其注入到实时“脊髓”中。这弥合了高层 AI 和低层实时控制之间的关键差距，从而在安全的人在环系统中解锁了具身智能的连续实时演化。
tldr: The paper presents LITHE, a lightweight architecture that allows Python-based "Brains" to dynamically modify the C++ real-time control logic of a robot "Spine" on commodity hardware, enabling on-the-fly adaptation guided by LLMs.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了LITHE，一种轻量级架构，允许基于Python的“大脑”在通用硬件上动态修改机器人“脊柱”的C++实时控制逻辑，从而实现由LLM引导的实时自适应。

title: Adaptive Capacity Allocation for Vision Language Action Fine-tuning
summary: Vision language action models (VLAs) are increasingly used for Physical AI, but deploying a pre-trained VLA model to unseen environments, embodiments, or tasks still requires adaptation. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), especially LoRA, is common for VLA policies, yet the exposed capacity knob, the rank, does not transfer uniformly: robotics transfer exhibits a higher and task-varying intrinsic rank than language fine-tuning. Small ranks suffice for LLMs (e.g., $r \in \{4, 8\}$), while spectral analyses indicate VLAs may require much larger ranks (e.g., $r \approx 128$) or near-full rank, a mismatch that worsens in multi-task settings. We present LoRA-SP (Select-Prune), a rank-adaptive fine-tuning method that replaces fixed-rank updates with input- and layer-wise capacity. LoRA-SP uses an SVD-style parameterization with a small router whose nonnegative scores act as singular values over a shared vector bank. The active set is chosen by an energy target on the cumulative squared scores $E(k) \ge η$, providing a direct link to approximation error via our spectral analysis. During training, $η$ concentrates energy on a few directions and teaches the router to rely on fewer vectors while preserving accuracy. This yields compact adapters that reduce cross-task interference and improve generalization. On four real-robot manipulation tasks collected on an unseen AgileX PiPER arm, across two VLA backbones ($π_0$ and SmolVLA), LoRA-SP matches or exceeds full fine-tuning with far fewer trainable parameters, and improves multi-task success by up to 31.6% over standard LoRA while remaining robust to rank choice.
summary_zh: 视觉语言动作模型(VLAs)正被越来越多地应用于物理人工智能领域，但将预训练的VLA模型部署到未见过的环境、具身或任务中仍然需要进行适配。参数高效微调(PEFT)，特别是LoRA，在VLA策略中很常见，然而，作为可调控容量的参数--秩，其迁移性能并不一致：机器人迁移表现出比语言微调更高且任务相关的固有秩。小秩足以用于LLMs（例如，$r \in \{4, 8\}$），而谱分析表明VLAs可能需要更大的秩（例如，$r \approx 128$）甚至接近满秩，这种不匹配在多任务环境中会加剧。我们提出了LoRA-SP (Select-Prune)，一种秩自适应微调方法，它用输入和层相关的容量来代替固定秩的更新。LoRA-SP使用一种SVD风格的参数化，其中一个小型路由器与一个共享向量库配合，路由器输出的非负分数充当奇异值。通过累积平方得分上的能量目标$E(k) \ge η$来选择激活集，通过我们的谱分析，这提供了与近似误差的直接关联。在训练期间，$η$将能量集中在少数方向上，并教导路由器依赖更少的向量，同时保持准确性。这产生了紧凑的适配器，减少了跨任务的干扰并提高了泛化能力。在AgileX PiPER机械臂上收集的四个真实机器人操作任务中，针对两个VLA骨干网络（$π_0$和SmolVLA），LoRA-SP以更少的训练参数匹配或超过了全参数微调，并且在保证对秩的选择具有鲁棒性的前提下，多任务成功率比标准LoRA提高了高达31.6%。
tldr: The paper introduces LoRA-SP, a rank-adaptive fine-tuning method for Vision-Language-Action models that improves parameter efficiency and generalization in robotics tasks, demonstrating superior multi-task performance compared to standard LoRA.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为LoRA-SP的rank自适应微调方法，用于视觉-语言-动作模型，该方法提高了机器人任务中的参数效率和泛化能力，并展示了优于标准LoRA的多任务性能。

title: Memory for Autonomous LLM Agents:Mechanisms, Evaluation, and Emerging Frontiers
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in settings where a single context window is far too small to capture what has happened, what was learned, and what should not be repeated. Memory -- the ability to persist, organize, and selectively recall information across interactions -- is what turns a stateless text generator into a genuinely adaptive agent. This survey offers a structured account of how memory is designed, implemented, and evaluated in modern LLM-based agents, covering work from 2022 through early 2026. We formalize agent memory as a \emph{write--manage--read} loop tightly coupled with perception and action, then introduce a three-dimensional taxonomy spanning temporal scope, representational substrate, and control policy. Five mechanism families are examined in depth: context-resident compression, retrieval-augmented stores, reflective self-improvement, hierarchical virtual context, and policy-learned management. On the evaluation side, we trace the shift from static recall benchmarks to multi-session agentic tests that interleave memory with decision-making, analyzing four recent benchmarks that expose stubborn gaps in current systems. We also survey applications where memory is the differentiating factor -- personal assistants, coding agents, open-world games, scientific reasoning, and multi-agent teamwork -- and address the engineering realities of write-path filtering, contradiction handling, latency budgets, and privacy governance. The paper closes with open challenges: continual consolidation, causally grounded retrieval, trustworthy reflection, learned forgetting, and multimodal embodied memory.
summary_zh: 大规模语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地在单个上下文窗口远不足以捕捉已发生事件、已学习知识以及不应重复行为的环境中运作。记忆——跨交互持久化、组织和选择性地回忆信息的能力——是将无状态文本生成器转变为真正自适应智能体的关键。本综述对基于LLM的现代智能体中记忆的设计、实现和评估进行了结构化的阐述，涵盖了从2022年至2026年初的工作。我们将智能体的记忆形式化为一个与感知和行动紧密结合的\emph{写--管理--读}循环，然后引入了一个三维分类法，涵盖时间范围、表征基质和控制策略。我们深入探讨了五种机制家族：驻留上下文压缩、检索增强存储、反思性自我改进、分层虚拟上下文和策略学习管理。在评估方面，我们追踪了从静态召回基准测试到多会话智能体测试的转变，后者将记忆与决策相结合，并分析了揭示当前系统顽固差距的四个最新基准测试。我们还调研了以记忆为区分因素的应用——个人助理、编码智能体、开放世界游戏、科学推理和多智能体团队合作——并探讨了写入路径过滤、矛盾处理、延迟预算和隐私治理等工程现实。本文最后提出了开放性挑战：持续巩固、因果关系扎根的检索、可信的反思、学习遗忘以及多模态具身记忆。
tldr: This survey paper comprehensively examines memory mechanisms in LLM agents from 2022 to early 2026, covering design, implementation, evaluation, and applications while also identifying key open challenges.
tldr_zh: 该综述论文全面考察了 2022 年到 2026 年初 LLM 智能体中的记忆机制，涵盖设计、实现、评估和应用，并识别了关键的开放性挑战。

title: DreamSAC: Learning Hamiltonian World Models via Symmetry Exploration
summary: Learned world models excel at interpolative generalization but fail at extrapolative generalization to novel physical properties. This limitation arises because they learn statistical correlations rather than the environment's underlying generative rules, such as physical invariances and conservation laws. We argue that learning these invariances is key to robust extrapolation. To achieve this, we first introduce \textbf{Symmetry Exploration}, an unsupervised exploration strategy where an agent is intrinsically motivated by a Hamiltonian-based curiosity bonus to actively probe and challenge its understanding of conservation laws, thereby collecting physically informative data. Second, we design a Hamiltonian-based world model that learns from the collected data, using a novel self-supervised contrastive objective to identify the invariant physical state from raw, view-dependent pixel observations. Our framework, \textbf{DreamSAC}, trained on this actively curated data, significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in 3D physics simulations on tasks requiring extrapolation.
summary_zh: 学习得到的环境模型擅长插值泛化，但在外推泛化至新的物理属性时会失效。这种局限性源于它们学习的是统计相关性，而不是环境的底层生成规则，例如物理不变性和守恒定律。我们认为，学习这些不变性是实现鲁棒外推的关键。为了实现这一点，我们首先引入\textbf{对称性探索}，这是一种无监督探索策略，其中智能体受到基于哈密顿量的内在好奇心奖励的驱动，从而积极探测和挑战其对守恒定律的理解，进而收集具有物理信息的训练数据。其次，我们设计了一个基于哈密顿量的环境模型，该模型利用收集到的数据进行学习，并使用一种新颖的自监督对比目标，从原始、视角相关的像素观测中识别出不变的物理状态。我们的框架\textbf{DreamSAC}，在该主动管理的数据上进行训练，在需要外推的3D物理模拟任务中，显著优于最先进的基线方法。
tldr: DreamSAC learns Hamiltonian world models through Symmetry Exploration, an unsupervised strategy that actively probes conservation laws, enabling better extrapolation in physics simulations compared to state-of-the-art methods.
tldr_zh: DreamSAC 通过对称性探索学习 Hamiltonian 世界模型，这是一种主动探测守恒定律的无监督策略，与最先进的方法相比，能够在物理模拟中实现更好的外推。

title: AutoControl Arena: Synthesizing Executable Test Environments for Frontier AI Risk Evaluation
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents, existing safety evaluations face a fundamental trade-off: manual benchmarks are costly, while LLM-based simulators are scalable but suffer from logic hallucination. We present AutoControl Arena, an automated framework for frontier AI risk evaluation built on the principle of logic-narrative decoupling. By grounding deterministic state in executable code while delegating generative dynamics to LLMs, we mitigate hallucination while maintaining flexibility. This principle, instantiated through a three-agent framework, achieves over 98% end-to-end success and 60% human preference over existing simulators. To elicit latent risks, we vary environmental Stress and Temptation across X-Bench (70 scenarios, 7 risk categories). Evaluating 9 frontier models reveals: (1) Alignment Illusion: risk rates surge from 21.7% to 54.5% under pressure, with capable models showing disproportionately larger increases; (2) Scenario-Specific Safety Scaling: advanced reasoning improves robustness for direct harms but worsens it for gaming scenarios; and (3) Divergent Misalignment Patterns: weaker models cause non-malicious harm while stronger models develop strategic concealment.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）演进为自主智能体之际，现有的安全性评估面临着根本性的权衡：人工基准测试成本高昂，而基于LLM的模拟器虽然可扩展，但存在逻辑幻觉问题。我们提出了AutoControl Arena，一个基于逻辑-叙事解耦原则构建的用于前沿人工智能风险评估的自动化框架。通过将确定性状态植根于可执行代码，同时将生成式动态委托给LLM，我们在保持灵活性的同时减轻幻觉。这个原则通过一个三智能体框架得以实例化，实现了超过98%的端到端成功率和60%的人工偏好，优于现有的模拟器。为了引出潜在的风险，我们针对X-Bench（70个场景，7个风险类别）改变了环境压力和诱惑。对9个前沿模型的评估揭示：（1）对齐幻觉：在压力下，风险率从21.7%飙升至54.5%，能力强的模型表现出不成比例的更大增幅；（2）场景特定的安全缩放：高级推理提高了直接危害场景的稳健性，但降低了博弈场景的稳健性；（3）不同的未对齐模式：较弱的模型造成非恶意危害，而较强的模型则发展出策略性的隐瞒行为。
tldr: The paper introduces AutoControl Arena, a framework for evaluating risks associated with autonomous LLM agents by using executable environments combined with LLM-generated dynamics, revealing interesting insights on misalignment under stress.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AutoControl Arena，一个通过结合可执行环境和LLM生成的动态来评估自主LLM代理风险的系统，揭示了压力下不对齐的有趣见解。

title: The Yerkes-Dodson Curve for AI Agents: Emergent Cooperation Under Environmental Pressure in Multi-Agent LLM Simulations
summary: Designing environments that maximize the rate of emergent behavior development in AI agents remains an open problem. We present the first systematic study of stress-performance relationships in large language model (LLM) multi-agent systems, drawing an explicit parallel to the Yerkes-Dodson law from cognitive psychology. Using a grid-world survival arena, we conduct 22 experiments across four phases, varying environmental pressure through resource scarcity (upkeep cost) and reproductive competition (sexual selection). Our key finding is that cooperative behavior follows an inverted-U curve: trade interactions peak at 29 under medium pressure (upkeep=5), while both low and extreme pressure produce 8--12 trades. Under extreme pressure, behavioral repertoire collapses to movement-only within 5--12 turns. We further show that sexual selection -- a softer pressure mechanism where all agents survive but not all reproduce -- eliminates inter-agent aggression entirely and produces communicative behavior absent under survival pressure. These results suggest that environmental pressure calibration is a viable curriculum design strategy for LLM agent development, analogous to the inverted-U relationship between arousal and performance in biological systems.
summary_zh: 设计能够最大化人工智能体涌现行为发展速度的环境仍然是一个未解决的问题。我们首次对大型语言模型（LLM）多智能体系统中的压力-性能关系进行了系统研究，并明确地将其与认知心理学中的耶克斯-多德森定律进行了类比。在一个网格世界的生存竞技场中，我们进行了22项实验，涵盖四个阶段，通过资源稀缺性（维持成本）和繁殖竞争（性选择）来改变环境压力。我们的主要发现是合作行为遵循一个倒U型曲线：在适中压力（维持成本=5）下，贸易互动达到峰值29，而低压力和极端压力下，贸易互动仅产生8-12次。在极端压力下，行为库在5-12回合内崩溃为仅移动。我们进一步表明，性选择——一种较为缓和的压力机制，所有智能体都能生存但并非所有智能体都能繁殖——完全消除了智能体间的攻击性，并产生了在生存压力下不存在的沟通行为。这些结果表明，校准环境压力是LLM智能体开发的一种可行的课程设计策略，类似于生物系统中唤醒与性能之间的倒U型关系。
tldr: This paper investigates the impact of environmental pressure on emergent cooperative behavior in multi-agent LLM simulations, finding an inverted-U relationship similar to the Yerkes-Dodson law in psychology, suggesting calibrated environmental pressure is key for LLM agent development.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了环境压力对多智能体LLM模拟中涌现合作行为的影响，发现了一种类似于心理学中耶克斯-多德森定律的倒U型关系，表明校准的环境压力是LLM智能体开发的关键。

title: 3ViewSense: Spatial and Mental Perspective Reasoning from Orthographic Views in Vision-Language Models
summary: Current Large Language Models have achieved Olympiad-level logic, yet Vision-Language Models paradoxically falter on elementary spatial tasks like block counting. This capability mismatch reveals a critical ``spatial intelligence gap,'' where models fail to construct coherent 3D mental representations from 2D observations. We uncover this gap via diagnostic analyses showing the bottleneck is a missing view-consistent spatial interface rather than insufficient visual features or weak reasoning. To bridge this, we introduce \textbf{3ViewSense}, a framework that grounds spatial reasoning in Orthographic Views. Drawing on engineering cognition, we propose a ``Simulate-and-Reason'' mechanism that decomposes complex scenes into canonical orthographic projections to resolve geometric ambiguities. By aligning egocentric perceptions with these allocentric references, our method facilitates explicit mental rotation and reconstruction. Empirical results on spatial reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines, with consistent gains on occlusion-heavy counting and view-consistent spatial reasoning. The framework also improves the stability and consistency of spatial descriptions, offering a scalable path toward stronger spatial intelligence in multimodal systems.
summary_zh: 当前大型语言模型已经达到了奥林匹克竞赛级别的逻辑能力，但视觉-语言模型却反常地在诸如方块计数等基本的空间任务上表现不佳。这种能力不匹配揭示了一个关键的“空间智能鸿沟”，即模型无法从二维观测中构建连贯的三维心理表征。通过诊断性分析，我们发现瓶颈在于缺乏一个视角一致的空间接口，而非视觉特征不足或推理能力薄弱。为了弥合这一鸿沟，我们引入了 \textbf{3ViewSense}，这是一个将空间推理建立在正交视图上的框架。借鉴工程认知，我们提出了一种“模拟与推理”机制，该机制将复杂场景分解为规范的正交投影以消除几何歧义。通过将自我中心的感知与这些以自我为中心的参考信息对齐，我们的方法促进了显式的心理旋转和重建。在空间推理基准测试上的实证结果表明，我们的方法明显优于现有的基线，在遮挡严重的计数和视角一致的空间推理方面均获得了持续提升。该框架还提高了空间描述的稳定性和一致性，为多模态系统中更强的空间智能提供了可扩展的途径。
tldr: The paper introduces 3ViewSense, a framework leveraging orthographic views to improve spatial reasoning in Vision-Language Models, addressing the "spatial intelligence gap" and achieving significant performance gains on spatial reasoning benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了3ViewSense，一个利用正交视图来提升视觉-语言模型中空间推理能力的框架。该框架旨在解决“空间智能差距”，并在空间推理基准测试上取得了显著的性能提升。

title: Generalization in Online Reinforcement Learning for Mobile Agents
summary: Graphical user interface (GUI)-based mobile agents automate digital tasks on mobile devices by interpreting natural-language instructions and interacting with the screen. While recent methods apply reinforcement learning (RL) to train vision-language-model(VLM) agents in interactive environments with a primary focus on performance, generalization remains underexplored due to the lack of standardized benchmarks and open-source RL systems. In this work, we formalize the problem as a Contextual Markov Decision Process (CMDP) and introduce \textbf{AndroidWorld-Generalization}, a benchmark with three increasingly challenging regimes for evaluating zero-shot generalization to unseen task instances, templates, and applications. We further propose an RL training system that integrates Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a scalable rollout collection system, consisting of containerized infrastructure and asynchronous execution % , and error recovery to support reliable and efficient training.
