Experiments on AndroidWorld-Generalization show that RL enables a 7B-parameter VLM agent to surpass supervised fine-tuning baselines, yielding a 26.1\% improvement on unseen instances but only limited gains on unseen templates (15.7\%) and apps (8.3\%), underscoring the challenges of generalization. As a preliminary step, we demonstrate that few-shot adaptation at test-time improves performance on unseen apps, motivating future research in this direction. To support reproducibility and fair comparison, we open-source the full RL training system, including the environment, task suite, models, prompt configurations, and the underlying infrastructure \footnote{https://github.com/zihuanjiang/AndroidWorld-Generalization}.
summary_zh: 基于图形用户界面（GUI）的移动代理通过解析自然语言指令并与屏幕交互，从而在移动设备上自动执行数字任务。虽然最近的方法应用强化学习（RL）来训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）代理，并主要关注性能，但由于缺乏标准化的基准测试和开源RL系统，泛化能力仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们将该问题形式化为上下文马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），并引入\textbf{AndroidWorld-Generalization}，这是一个包含三个难度递增的机制的基准测试，用于评估对未见过的任务实例、模板和应用程序的零样本泛化能力。我们进一步提出了一个RL训练系统，该系统集成了分组相对策略优化（GRPO）和一个可扩展的 rollout 收集系统，该系统由容器化基础设施和异步执行组成，以及错误恢复，以支持可靠且高效的训练。在AndroidWorld-Generalization上的实验表明，RL使一个7B参数的VLM代理能够超越监督微调基线，在未见过的实例上产生26.1%的改进，但在未见过的模板（15.7%）和应用程序（8.3%）上收益有限，突显了泛化的挑战。作为初步步骤，我们证明了在测试时进行少量样本自适应可以提高在未见过的应用程序上的性能，从而激发了未来对该方向的研究。为了支持可复现性和公平比较，我们开源了完整的RL训练系统，包括环境、任务套件、模型、提示配置和底层基础设施\footnote{https://github.com/zihuanjiang/AndroidWorld-Generalization}。
tldr: This paper introduces AndroidWorld-Generalization, a new benchmark for evaluating zero-shot generalization in RL-trained GUI agents, and proposes an RL training system incorporating Group Relative Policy Optimization. Results show improvements on unseen instances but limited gains on unseen templates and apps, highlighting generalization challenges and motivating future research in few-shot adaptation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了AndroidWorld-Generalization，这是一个新的基准，用于评估强化学习训练的GUI代理中的零样本泛化能力。同时提出了一个结合了Group Relative Policy Optimization的强化学习训练系统。结果表明，在未见过的实例上有改进，但在未见过的模板和应用程序上的改进有限，这突出了泛化的挑战，并推动了未来在少样本自适应方面的研究。

title: Global Convergence of Average Reward Constrained MDPs with Neural Critic and General Policy Parameterization
summary: We study infinite-horizon Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs) with general policy parameterizations and multi-layer neural network critics. Existing theoretical analyses for constrained reinforcement learning largely rely on tabular policies or linear critics, which limits their applicability to high-dimensional and continuous control problems. We propose a primal-dual natural actor-critic algorithm that integrates neural critic estimation with natural policy gradient updates and leverages Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) theory to control function-approximation error under Markovian sampling, without requiring access to mixing-time oracles. We establish global convergence and cumulative constraint violation rates of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^-1/4)$ up to approximation errors induced by the policy and critic classes. Our results provide the first such guarantees for CMDPs with general policies and multi-layer neural critics, substantially extending the theoretical foundations of actor-critic methods beyond the linear-critic regime.
summary_zh: 我们研究具有一般策略参数化和多层神经网络评论家的无限视界约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）。 现有约束强化学习的理论分析在很大程度上依赖于表格策略或线性评论家，这限制了它们在高维和连续控制问题中的适用性。 我们提出了一种原始-对偶自然Actor-Critic算法，该算法将神经评论家估计与自然策略梯度更新相结合，并利用神经正切核（NTK）理论来控制马尔可夫采样下的函数逼近误差，而无需访问混合时间预言机。 我们建立了全局收敛和累积约束违反率，其量级可达到$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^-1/4)$，直至由策略和评论家类别引起的近似误差。 我们的结果首次为具有一般策略和多层神经网络评论家的CMDP提供了此类保证，从而大大扩展了Actor-Critic方法的理论基础，使其超越线性评论家体系。
tldr: This paper presents a primal-dual natural actor-critic algorithm for Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs) with neural network critics and general policy parameterizations, achieving global convergence with theoretical guarantees, thereby extending existing RL theory beyond linear critics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDPs）的原始对偶自然 Actor-Critic 算法，该算法使用神经网络评论家（critic）和通用策略参数化，实现了全局收敛并具有理论保证，从而将现有的强化学习理论扩展到线性评论家之外。

title: DualSpec: Accelerating Deep Research Agents via Dual-Process Action Speculation
summary: Large language model-based deep research agents have been increasingly popular for addressing long-horizon information-seeking tasks, but they often incur high end-to-end latency due to extensive reasoning and frequent tool use. Speculation frameworks aim to reduce latency by overlapping action execution with reasoning; however, existing approaches typically rely on uniform speculation strategies and strict action matching, which limits inference speedups and robustness. In this work, we revisit the speculate-verify paradigm for deep research agents through the lens of action heterogeneity. We show that \textit{Search} and \textit{Visit} actions exhibit fundamentally different reasoning and model capacity requirements: entropy-based analysis reveals that Search decisions have higher uncertainty and benefit significantly from explicit reasoning, whereas Visit decisions have lower entropy and depend primarily on model capacity. Motivated by this dual-process characteristic, we propose DualSpec, a heterogeneous speculation framework equipped with a lightweight, confidence-based semantic verifier. Experiments across multiple models and benchmarks demonstrate that DualSpec achieves up to 3.28$\times$ end-to-end speedup while maintaining accuracy comparable to fully reasoning agents.
summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型的深度研究型智能体在解决长时程信息检索任务中日益普及，但由于大量的推理和频繁的工具使用，它们通常会产生较高的端到端延迟。推测框架旨在通过将行动执行与推理重叠来减少延迟；然而，现有的方法通常依赖于统一的推测策略和严格的行动匹配，这限制了推理加速和鲁棒性。在这项工作中，我们从行动异质性的角度重新审视深度研究型智能体的推测-验证范式。我们表明，\textit{搜索}和\textit{访问}行动表现出根本不同的推理和模型容量需求：基于熵的分析表明，搜索决策具有更高的不确定性，并且显著受益于显式推理，而访问决策具有较低的熵并且主要依赖于模型容量。受这种双重过程特征的启发，我们提出了 DualSpec，一种配备了轻量级、基于置信度的语义验证器的异构推测框架。跨多个模型和基准的实验表明，DualSpec 实现了高达 3.28 倍的端到端加速，同时保持了与完全推理型智能体相当的准确性。
tldr: This paper introduces DualSpec, a framework that accelerates deep research agents by employing heterogeneous speculation strategies for different action types (Search vs. Visit), achieving significant speedups while maintaining accuracy.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DualSpec，一个通过为不同行动类型（搜索 vs. 访问）采用异构推测策略来加速深度研究代理的框架，从而在保持准确性的同时实现了显著的加速。

title: Learning to Reflect: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for CSI-Free mmWave Beam-Focusing
summary: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces promise to transform wireless environments, yet practical deployment is hindered by the prohibitive overhead of Channel State Information (CSI) estimation and the dimensionality explosion inherent in centralized optimization. This paper proposes a Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (HMARL) framework for the control of mechanically reconfigurable reflective surfaces in millimeter-wave (mmWave) systems. We introduce a "CSI-free" paradigm that substitutes pilot-based channel estimation with readily available user localization data. To manage the massive combinatorial action space, the proposed architecture utilizes Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO) under a Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE) paradigm. The proposed architecture decomposes the control problem into two abstraction levels: a high-level controller for user-to-reflector allocation and decentralized low-level controllers for low-level focal point optimization. Comprehensive ray-tracing evaluations demonstrate that the framework achieves 2.81-7.94 dB RSSI improvements over centralized baselines, with the performance advantage widening as system complexity increases. Scalability analysis reveals that the system maintains sustained efficiency, exhibiting minimal per-user performance degradation and stable total power utilization even when user density doubles. Furthermore, robustness validation confirms the framework's viability across varying reflector aperture sizes (45-99 tiles) and demonstrates graceful performance degradation under localization errors up to 0.5 m. By eliminating CSI overhead while maintaining high-fidelity beam-focusing, this work establishes HMARL as a practical solution for intelligent mmWave environments.
summary_zh: 可重构智能表面有望改变无线环境，但实际部署却因信道状态信息（CSI）估计的巨大开销以及集中式优化固有的维度爆炸而受阻。本文提出了一种分层多智能体强化学习（HMARL）框架，用于控制毫米波（mmWave）系统中机械可重构反射表面。我们引入了一种“无CSI”范例，用易于获取的用户定位数据替代基于导频的信道估计。为了管理巨大的组合动作空间，所提出的架构利用了在集中训练分散执行（CTDE）范例下的多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）。该架构将控制问题分解为两个抽象级别：用于用户到反射器分配的高级控制器，以及用于底层焦点优化分散式低级控制器。全面的射线追踪评估表明，该框架实现了比集中式基线2.81-7.94 dB的接收信号强度（RSSI）提升，并且随着系统复杂性的增加，性能优势不断扩大。可扩展性分析显示，该系统保持了持续的效率，即使在用户密度翻倍的情况下，也能表现出最小的单用户性能下降和稳定的总功率利用率。此外，鲁棒性验证证实了该框架在不同反射器孔径尺寸（45-99个单元）下的可行性，并展示了在高达0.5米的定位误差下的平稳性能下降。通过消除CSI开销，同时保持高保真波束聚焦，这项工作将 HMARL 确立为智能毫米波环境的实际解决方案。
tldr: This paper introduces a Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (HMARL) framework for CSI-free mmWave beam-focusing using user localization data, achieving significant RSSI improvements and demonstrating scalability and robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个分层多智能体强化学习（HMARL）框架，用于使用用户定位数据的无CSI毫米波波束聚焦，实现了显著的RSSI改进，并展示了可扩展性和鲁棒性。

title: Directing the Robot: Scaffolding Creative Human-AI-Robot Interaction
summary: Robots are moving beyond industrial settings into creative, educational, and public environments where interaction is open-ended and improvisational. Yet much of human-AI-robot interaction remains framed around performance and efficiency, positioning humans as supervisors rather than collaborators. We propose a re-framing of AI interaction with robots as scaffolding: infrastructure that enables humans to shape robotic behaviour over time while remaining meaningfully in control. Through scenarios from creative practice, learning-by-teaching, and embodied interaction, we illustrate how humans can act as executive directors, defining intent and steering revisions, while AI mediates between human expression and robotic execution. We outline design and evaluation implications that foreground creativity, agency, and flow. Finally, we discuss open challenges in social, scalable, and mission-critical contexts. We invite the community to rethink interacting with Robots and AI not as autonomy, but as sustained support for human creativity.
summary_zh: 机器人正从工业环境走向更具创造性、教育性和公共性的环境，在这些环境中，交互是开放且具有即兴性的。然而，目前很大一部分人机交互仍然围绕着性能和效率展开，将人类定位为管理者而非合作者。我们提出将AI与机器人的交互重新定位为脚手架：一种基础设施，使人类能够随着时间的推移塑造机器人的行为，同时保持有意义的控制权。通过来自创作实践、教学式学习和具身交互的场景，我们阐述了人类如何作为执行主任，定义意图并指导修改，而AI则在人类表达和机器人执行之间进行协调。我们概述了以创造力、能动性和流畅性为重点的设计和评估意义。最后，我们讨论了在社交、可扩展和关键任务环境中的开放性挑战。我们邀请社区重新思考与机器人和AI的交互，不将其看作是自主性，而是看作是对人类创造力的持续支持。
tldr: This paper proposes a new framework for human-AI-robot interaction, framing AI as a scaffolding to support human creativity and control in shaping robotic behavior in creative, educational, and public environments. The authors highlight design and evaluation implications for fostering creativity, agency, and flow.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了人-AI-机器人交互的新框架，将 AI 视为一种支架，以支持人类的创造力和控制，从而在创造性、教育和公共环境中塑造机器人的行为。作者强调了促进创造力、能动性和流畅性的设计和评估意义。

title: C$^2$-Explorer: Contiguity-Driven Task Allocation with Connectivity-Aware Task Representation for Decentralized Multi-UAV Exploration
summary: Efficient multi-UAV exploration under limited communication is severely bottlenecked by inadequate task representation and allocation. Previous task representations either impose heavy communication requirements for coordination or lack the flexibility to handle complex environments, often leading to inefficient traversal. Furthermore, short-horizon allocation strategies neglect spatiotemporal contiguity, causing non-contiguous assignments and frequent cross-region detours. To address this, we propose C$^2$-Explorer, a decentralized framework that constructs a connectivity graph to decompose disconnected unknown components into independent task units. We then introduce a contiguity-driven allocation formulation with a graph-based neighborhood penalty to discourage non-adjacent assignments, promoting more contiguous task sequences over time. Extensive simulation experiments show that C$^2$-Explorer consistently outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines, reducing average exploration time by 43.1\% and path length by 33.3\%. Real-world flights further demonstrate the system's feasibility. The code will be released at https://github.com/Robotics-STAR-Lab/C2-Explorer
summary_zh: 在有限通信条件下进行高效的多无人机探索，严重受限于不充分的任务表示和分配。以往的任务表示要么对协同提出很高的通信需求，要么缺乏处理复杂环境的灵活性，常常导致低效遍历。此外，短视的分配策略忽略了时空连续性，导致非连续的任务分配和频繁的跨区域绕行。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了C$^2$-Explorer，一种去中心化框架，它构建连通性图来将不连通的未知区域分解为独立的任务单元。然后，我们引入了一种基于连续性驱动的分配方式，采用基于图的邻域惩罚来抑制非邻近的任务分配，从而促进随时间推移更为连续的任务序列。大量的仿真实验表明，C$^2$-Explorer始终优于最先进（SOTA）的基线方法，平均探索时间减少了43.1%，路径长度减少了33.3%。真实飞行进一步证明了该系统的可行性。代码将在https://github.com/Robotics-STAR-Lab/C2-Explorer发布。
tldr: The paper introduces C$^2$-Explorer, a decentralized multi-UAV exploration framework that uses a connectivity graph and contiguity-driven task allocation to improve exploration efficiency and reduce travel distance compared to SOTA methods, as demonstrated in simulations and real-world flights.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了C$^2$-Explorer，一个去中心化的多无人机探索框架，它使用连接图和连续性驱动的任务分配，与最先进的方法相比，可以提高探索效率并缩短行程距离，这已在模拟和实际飞行中得到证明。

title: DAISS: Phase-Aware Imitation Learning for Dual-Arm Robotic Ultrasound-Guided Interventions
summary: Imitation learning has shown strong potential for automating complex robotic manipulation. In medical robotics, ultrasound-guided needle insertion demands precise bimanual coordination, as clinicians must simultaneously manipulate an ultrasound probe to maintain an optimal acoustic view while steering an interventional needle. Automating this asymmetric workflow -- and reliably transferring expert strategies to robots -- remains highly challenging. In this paper, we present the Dual-Arm Interventional Surgical System (DAISS), a teleoperated platform that collects high-fidelity dual-arm demonstrations and learns a phase-aware imitation policy for ultrasound-guided interventions. To avoid constraining the operator's natural behavior, DAISS uses a flexible NDI-based leader interface for teleoperating two coordinated follower arms. To support robust execution under real-time ultrasound feedback, we develop a lightweight, data-efficient imitation policy. Specifically, the policy incorporates a phase-aware architecture and a dynamic mask loss tailored to asymmetric bimanual control. Conditioned on a planned trajectory, the network fuses real-time ultrasound with external visual observations to generate smooth, coordinated dual-arm motions. Experimental results show that DAISS can learn personalized expert strategies from limited demonstrations. Overall, these findings highlight the promise of phase-aware imitation-learning-driven dual-arm robots for improving precision and reducing cognitive workload in image-guided interventions.
summary_zh: 模仿学习在自动化复杂机器人操作方面展现出强大的潜力。在医疗机器人领域，超声引导下穿刺术需要精准的双臂协调，因为临床医生必须同时操作超声探头以保持最佳声学视野，并引导穿刺针。自动化这种非对称的工作流程——并将专家策略可靠地转移到机器人身上——仍然极具挑战性。本文介绍了一种双臂介入手术系统(DAISS)，这是一个远程操作平台，用于收集高保真的双臂演示，并学习一种相位感知模仿策略，用于超声引导下的介入治疗。为了避免限制操作者自然的行为，DAISS使用基于NDI的灵活主端界面来远程操作两个协调的从端手臂。为了支持在实时超声反馈下的稳健执行，我们开发了一种轻量级、数据高效的模仿策略。具体来说，该策略融合了相位感知架构和针对非对称双臂控制定制的动态掩码损失。在规划轨迹的条件下，该网络融合了实时超声和外部视觉观测，以生成平滑、协调的双臂运动。实验结果表明，DAISS可以从有限的演示中学习个性化的专家策略。总的来说，这些发现突出了相位感知模仿学习驱动的双臂机器人在提高图像引导介入治疗的精度和降低认知负荷方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents DAISS, a teleoperated dual-arm robotic system using phase-aware imitation learning for ultrasound-guided needle insertion, demonstrating personalized expert strategy learning from limited demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DAISS，一个使用阶段感知模仿学习的遥操作双臂机器人系统，用于超声引导下的针插入，展示了从有限的演示中学习个性化专家策略的能力。

title: Multi-Agent Off-World Exploration for Sparse Evidence Discovery via Gaussian Belief Mapping and Dual-Domain Coverage
summary: Off-world multi-robot exploration is challenged by sparse targets, limited sensing, hazardous terrain, and restricted communication. Many scientifically valuable clues are visually ambiguous and often require close-range observations, making efficient and safe informative path planning essential. Existing methods often rely on predefined areas of interest (AOIs), which may be incomplete or biased, and typically handle terrain risk only through soft penalties, which are insufficient for avoiding non-recoverable regions. To address these issues, we propose a multi-agent informative path planning framework for sparse evidence discovery based on Gaussian belief mapping and dual-domain coverage. The method maintains Gaussian-process-based interest and risk beliefs and combines them with trajectory-intent representations to support coordinated sequential decision-making among multiple agents. It further prioritizes search inside the AOI while preserving limited exploration outside it, thereby improving robustness to AOI bias. In addition, the risk-aware design helps agents balance information gain and operational safety in hazardous environments. Experimental results in simulated lunar environments show that the proposed method consistently outperforms sampling-based and greedy baselines under different budgets and communication ranges. In particular, it achieves lower final uncertainty in risk-aware settings and remains robust under limited communication, demonstrating its effectiveness for cooperative off-world robotic exploration.
summary_zh: 针对稀疏目标、有限感知、危险地形和受限通信等挑战，星外多机器人探索面临诸多难题。许多具有科学价值的线索在视觉上具有歧义性，通常需要近距离观测，因此高效且安全的启发式路径规划至关重要。现有方法通常依赖于预定义的感兴趣区域（AOI），这些区域可能并不完整或存在偏差，并且通常仅通过软惩罚来处理地形风险，这不足以避免不可恢复区域。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种基于高斯置信度映射和双域覆盖的用于稀疏证据发现的多智能体启发式路径规划框架。该方法维护基于高斯过程的兴趣和风险置信度，并将其与轨迹意图表示相结合，以支持多个智能体之间的协调序列决策。它进一步优先在AOI内部进行搜索，同时保留在AOI外部进行有限的探索，从而提高对AOI偏差的鲁棒性。此外，风险感知设计有助于智能体在危险环境中平衡信息增益和作业安全。在模拟月球环境中的实验结果表明，在不同的预算和通信范围内，所提出的方法始终优于基于采样的基线方法和贪婪算法。特别是，它在风险感知设置中实现了更低的最终不确定性，并在有限通信条件下保持鲁棒性，证明了其在协同星外机器人探索中的有效性。
tldr: This paper presents a multi-agent informative path planning framework for off-world robotic exploration that utilizes Gaussian belief mapping and dual-domain coverage to improve robustness to AOI bias and balance information gain with safety in hazardous environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于异世界机器人探索的多智能体信息路径规划框架，该框架利用高斯置信度映射和双域覆盖来提高对AOI偏差的鲁棒性，并在高危环境中平衡信息增益与安全性。

title: Exoskeleton Control through Learning to Reduce Biological Joint Moments in Simulations
summary: Data-driven joint-moment predictors offer a scalable alternative to laboratory-based inverse-dynamics pipelines for biomechanics estimation and exoskeleton control. Meanwhile, physics-based reinforcement learning (RL) enables simulation-trained controllers to learn dynamics-aware assistance strategies without extensive human experimentation. However, quantitative verification of simulation-trained exoskeleton torque predictors, and their impact on human joint power injection, remains limited. This paper presents (1) an RL framework to learn exoskeleton assistance policies that reduce biological joint moments, and (2) a validation pipeline that verifies the trained control networks using an open-source gait dataset through inference and comparison with biological joint moments. Simulation-trained multilayer perceptron (MLP) controllers are developed for level-ground and ramp walking, mapping short-horizon histories of bilateral hip and knee kinematics to normalized assistance torques. Results show that predicted assistance preserves task-intensity trends across speeds and inclines. Agreement is particularly strong at the hip, with cross-correlation coefficients reaching 0.94 at 1.8 m/s and 0.98 during 5° decline walking, demonstrating near-matched temporal structure. Discrepancies increase at higher speeds and steeper inclines, especially at the knee, and are more pronounced in joint power comparisons. Delay tuning biases assistance toward greater positive power injection; modest timing shifts increase positive power and improve agreement in specific gait intervals. Together, these results establish a quantitative validation framework for simulation-trained exoskeleton controllers, demonstrate strong sim-to-data consistency at the torque level, and highlight both the promise and the remaining challenges for sim-to-real transfer.
summary_zh: 数据驱动的联合力矩预测器为生物力学估计和外骨骼控制提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，相比于基于实验室的反动力学流程。同时，基于物理的强化学习（RL）使仿真训练的控制器能够学习动力学感知的辅助策略，而无需进行大量的人体实验。然而，对于仿真训练外骨骼扭矩预测器的定量验证，以及它们对人体关节功率注入的影响，仍然存在局限性。本文提出（1）一种强化学习框架，用于学习能够减少生物关节力矩的外骨骼辅助策略，以及（2）一个验证流程，该流程通过推理以及与生物关节力矩的比较，利用开源步态数据集来验证训练后的控制网络。针对平地和坡道行走，开发了仿真训练的多层感知器（MLP）控制器，将双侧髋关节和膝关节运动学的短时历史映射到归一化的辅助扭矩。结果表明，预测的辅助能够保持跨速度和坡度的任务强度趋势。在髋关节处的一致性尤其强，在1.8 m/s速度下互相关系数达到0.94，在5°下坡行走期间达到0.98，表明时间结构几乎匹配。差异在高速度和更陡峭的坡度下增加，尤其是在膝关节处，并且在关节功率比较中更为明显。延迟调整使辅助更倾向于更大的正功率注入；适度的时序调整会增加正功率，并改善特定步态区间的匹配度。总而言之，这些结果建立了一个用于仿真训练外骨骼控制器的定量验证框架，证明了扭矩水平上强大的仿真-数据一致性，并强调了仿真到真实转移的希望和仍然存在的挑战。
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning framework for training exoskeleton controllers in simulation to reduce biological joint moments, and validates these controllers using real-world gait data, demonstrating strong sim-to-data consistency, particularly at the hip joint.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种强化学习框架，用于在模拟环境中训练外骨骼控制器以减少生物关节力矩，并通过真实步态数据验证这些控制器，结果表明模拟到数据的具有很强的一致性，尤其是在髋关节处。

title: SMAT: Staged Multi-Agent Training for Co-Adaptive Exoskeleton Control
summary: Effective exoskeleton assistance requires co-adaptation: as the device alters joint dynamics, the user reorganizes neuromuscular coordination, creating a non-stationary learning problem. Most learning-based approaches do not explicitly account for the sequential nature of human motor adaptation, leading to training instability and poorly timed assistance. We propose Staged Multi-Agent Training (SMAT), a four-stage curriculum designed to mirror how users naturally acclimate to a wearable device. In SMAT, a musculoskeletal human actor and a bilateral hip exoskeleton actor are trained progressively: the human first learns unassisted gait, then adapts to the added device mass; the exoskeleton subsequently learns a positive assistance pattern against a stabilized human policy, and finally both agents co-adapt with full torque capacity and bidirectional feedback. We implement SMAT in the MyoAssist simulation environment using a 26-muscle lower-limb model and an attached hip exoskeleton. Our musculoskeletal simulations demonstrate that the learned exoskeleton control policy produces an average 10.1% reduction in hip muscle activation relative to the no-assist condition. We validated the learned controller in an offline setting using open-source gait data, then deployed it to a physical hip exoskeleton for treadmill experiments with five subjects. The resulting policy delivers consistent assistance and predominantly positive mechanical power without the need for any explicitly imposed timing shift (mean positive power: 13.6 W at 6 Nm RMS torque to 23.8 W at 9.3 Nm RMS torque, with minimal negative power) consistently across all subjects without subject-specific retraining.
summary_zh: 有效的外骨骼辅助需要协同适应：由于设备改变了关节动力学，使用者会重新组织神经肌肉协调，从而产生一个非稳态学习问题。大多数基于学习的方法没有明确考虑人类运动适应的顺序性，导致训练不稳定和辅助时机不佳。我们提出了一种分阶段多智能体训练(SMAT)方法，这是一个四阶段的课程，旨在模拟用户自然适应可穿戴设备的过程。在SMAT中，一个骨骼肌肉人体参与者和一个双侧髋关节外骨骼参与者被逐步训练：人体首先学习无辅助步态，然后适应增加的设备质量；随后，外骨骼学习针对一个稳定的人体策略的积极辅助模式，最后两个智能体都以完全的扭矩能力和双向反馈进行协同适应。我们在MyoAssist模拟环境中，使用一个26块肌肉的下肢模型和一个附加的髋关节外骨骼来实现SMAT。我们的骨骼肌肉模拟表明，学习到的外骨骼控制策略相对于无辅助条件，平均降低了10.1%的髋关节肌肉激活。 我们使用开源步态数据在离线环境中验证了学习到的控制器，然后将其部署到物理髋关节外骨骼，对五名受试者进行了跑步机实验。 最终策略提供了持续的辅助和主要的正机械功率，而无需任何显式施加的时机调整（平均正功率：在6 Nm RMS扭矩下为13.6 W，在9.3 Nm RMS扭矩下为23.8 W，负功率极小），并且在所有受试者中保持一致，无需针对特定受试者进行重新训练。
tldr: The paper presents a Staged Multi-Agent Training (SMAT) approach for co-adaptive exoskeleton control, demonstrating improved exoskeleton assistance and reduced muscle activation in simulations and human experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于共适应外骨骼控制的分阶段多智能体训练（SMAT）方法，并在模拟和人体实验中展示了改进的外骨骼辅助和减少的肌肉激活。

title: FeasibleCap: Real-Time Embodiment Constraint Guidance for In-the-Wild Robot Demonstration Collection
summary: Gripper-in-hand data collection decouples demonstration acquisition from robot hardware, but whether a trajectory is executable on the target robot remains unknown until a separate replay-and-validate stage. Failed demonstrations therefore inflate the effective cost per usable trajectory through repeated collection, diagnosis, and validation. Existing collection-time feedback systems mitigate this issue but rely on head-worn AR/VR displays, robot-in-the-loop hardware, or learned dynamics models; real-time executability feedback has not yet been integrated into the gripper-in-hand data collection paradigm. We present \textbf{FeasibleCap}, a gripper-in-hand data collection system that brings real-time executability guidance into robot-free capture. At each frame, FeasibleCap checks reachability, joint-rate limits, and collisions against a target robot model and closes the loop through on-device visual overlays and haptic cues, allowing demonstrators to correct motions during collection without learned models, headsets, or robot hardware. On pick-and-place and tossing tasks, FeasibleCap improves replay success and reduces the fraction of infeasible frames, with the largest gains on tossing. Simulation experiments further indicate that enforcing executability constraints during collection does not sacrifice cross-embodiment transfer across robot platforms. Hardware designs and software are available at https://github.com/aod321/FeasibleCap.
summary_zh: 手持夹爪数据收集将演示获取与机器人硬件解耦，但轨迹是否可以在目标机器人上执行仍是未知的，直到进行单独的回放和验证阶段。因此，失败的演示会通过重复的收集、诊断和验证，增加每个可用轨迹的有效成本。现有的收集时反馈系统可以缓解这个问题，但依赖于头戴式 AR/VR 显示器、机器人环路硬件或学习到的动力学模型；实时可执行性反馈尚未集成到手持夹爪数据收集中。我们提出了 **FeasibleCap**，一个手持夹爪数据收集系统，它将实时可执行性指导引入到无机器人的采集过程中。在每一帧，FeasibleCap 都会检查针对目标机器人模型的可达性、关节速率限制和碰撞，并通过设备上的视觉叠加和触觉提示闭环，允许演示者在收集过程中纠正运动，而无需学习到的模型、头显或机器人硬件。在拾取放置和抛掷任务中，FeasibleCap 提高了回放成功率并减少了不可行帧的比例，并且在抛掷任务中增益最大。仿真实验进一步表明，在收集过程中执行可执行性约束不会牺牲跨机器人平台间的跨具身传递能力。硬件设计和软件可在 https://github.com/aod321/FeasibleCap 上获得。
tldr: The paper introduces FeasibleCap, a gripper-in-hand data collection system that provides real-time feedback on trajectory executability based on robot constraints, improving the success rate of demonstrations without requiring headsets, robot hardware, or learned models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为FeasibleCap的手持夹具数据收集系统，该系统基于机器人约束实时反馈轨迹的可执行性，提高了演示的成功率，且无需头显、机器人硬件或学习模型。

title: Approximate Imitation Learning for Event-based Quadrotor Flight in Cluttered Environments
summary: Event cameras offer high temporal resolution and low latency, making them ideal sensors for high-speed robotic applications where conventional cameras suffer from image degradations such as motion blur. In addition, their low power consumption can enhance endurance, which is critical for resource-constrained platforms. Motivated by these properties, we present a novel approach that enables a quadrotor to fly through cluttered environments at high speed by perceiving the environment with a single event camera. Our proposed method employs an end-to-end neural network trained to map event data directly to control commands, eliminating the reliance on standard cameras. To enable efficient training in simulation, where rendering synthetic event data is computationally expensive, we propose Approximate Imitation Learning, a novel imitation learning framework. Our approach leverages a large-scale offline dataset to learn a task-specific representation space. Subsequently, the policy is trained through online interactions that rely solely on lightweight, simulated state information, eliminating the need to render events during training. This enables the efficient training of event-based control policies for fast quadrotor flight, highlighting the potential of our framework for other modalities where data simulation is costly or impractical. Our approach outperforms standard imitation learning baselines in simulation and demonstrates robust performance in real-world flight tests, achieving speeds up to 9.8 ms-1 in cluttered environments.
summary_zh: 事件相机具有高时间分辨率和低延迟的特点，使其成为高速机器人应用的理想传感器，在这些应用中，传统相机容易出现运动模糊等图像退化现象。此外，其低功耗特性可以增强续航能力，这对资源受限的平台至关重要。受这些特性的启发，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，使四旋翼飞行器能够通过使用单个事件相机感知环境，从而高速穿梭于杂乱环境中。我们提出的方法采用端到端神经网络，该网络经过训练，可以直接将事件数据映射到控制指令，从而消除了对标准相机的依赖。为了在模拟环境中实现高效训练，因为渲染合成事件数据的计算成本很高，我们提出了一种名为近似模仿学习的新型模仿学习框架。我们的方法利用大规模离线数据集来学习特定于任务的表征空间。随后，策略通过仅依赖于轻量级模拟状态信息的在线交互进行训练，从而消除了训练期间渲染事件的需求。这使得能够高效训练基于事件的控制策略，以实现快速四旋翼飞行，突出了我们的框架在数据模拟成本高昂或不切实际的其他模式中的潜力。我们的方法在模拟中优于标准的模仿学习基线，并在真实世界飞行测试中表现出强大的性能，在杂乱环境中达到了高达 9.8 毫秒-1 的速度。
tldr: This paper presents a novel imitation learning framework called Approximate Imitation Learning to train a quadrotor to fly through cluttered environments at high speed using a single event camera, achieving robust real-world performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为近似模仿学习的新型模仿学习框架，训练四旋翼飞行器使用单个事件相机高速飞越杂乱环境，并在真实世界中实现了稳健的性能。

title: InterReal: A Unified Physics-Based Imitation Framework for Learning Human-Object Interaction Skills
summary: Interaction is one of the core abilities of humanoid robots. However, most existing frameworks focus on non-interactive whole-body control, which limits their practical applicability. In this work, we develop InterReal, a unified physics-based imitation learning framework for Real-world human-object Interaction (HOI) control. InterReal enables humanoid robots to track HOI reference motions, facilitating the learning of fine-grained interactive skills and their deployment in real-world settings. Within this framework, we first introduce a HOI motion data augmentation scheme with hand-object contact constraints, and utilize the augmented motions to improve policy stability under object perturbations. Second, we propose an automatic reward learner to address the challenge of large-scale reward shaping. A meta-policy guided by critical tracking error metrics explores and allocates reward signals to the low-level reinforcement learning objective, which enables more effective learning of interactive policies. Experiments on HOI tasks of box-picking and box-pushing demonstrate that InterReal achieves the best tracking accuracy and the highest task success rate compared to recent baselines. Furthermore, we validate the framework on the real-world robot Unitree G1, which demonstrates its practical effectiveness and robustness beyond simulation.
summary_zh: 交互是人形机器人核心能力之一。然而，现有的大部分框架专注于非交互式的全身控制，这限制了它们的实际应用性。在本工作中，我们开发了InterReal，一个统一的基于物理的模仿学习框架，用于真实世界人-物交互（HOI）控制。InterReal使人形机器人能够跟踪HOI参考运动，从而促进精细交互技能的学习及其在真实世界环境中的部署。在该框架中，我们首先引入了一个具有手-物接触约束的HOI运动数据增强方案，并利用增强后的运动来提高策略在物体扰动下的稳定性。其次，我们提出了一种自动奖励学习器，以应对大规模奖励塑造的挑战。一个由关键跟踪误差指标引导的元策略探索并将奖励信号分配给低层强化学习目标，从而更有效地进行交互策略的学习。在箱子抓取和箱子推动的HOI任务上的实验表明，与最新的基线相比，InterReal实现了最佳的跟踪精度和最高的任务成功率。此外，我们在真实世界的宇树 G1 机器人上验证了该框架，这证明了它在仿真之外的实际有效性和鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces InterReal, a physics-based imitation learning framework for humanoid robots to learn human-object interaction skills, featuring data augmentation and a meta-policy-guided reward learner, validated in simulation and on a real robot.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为 InterReal 的基于物理的模仿学习框架，用于帮助人形机器人学习人与物体的交互技能。该框架包含数据增强和一个元策略引导的奖励学习器，并在仿真和真实机器人上进行了验证。

title: GSAT: Geometric Traversability Estimation using Self-supervised Learning with Anomaly Detection for Diverse Terrains
summary: Safe autonomous navigation requires reliable estimation of environmental traversability. Traditional methods have relied on semantic or geometry-based approaches with human-defined thresholds, but these methods often yield unreliable predictions due to the inherent subjectivity of human supervision. While self-supervised approaches enable robots to learn from their own experience, they still face a fundamental challenge: the positive-only learning problem. To address these limitations, recent studies have employed Positive-Unlabeled (PU) learning, where the core challenge is identifying positive samples without explicit negative supervision. In this work, we propose GSAT, which addresses these limitations by constructing a positive hypersphere in latent space to classify traversable regions through anomaly detection without requiring additional prototypes (e.g., unlabeled or negative). Furthermore, our approach employs joint learning of anomaly classification and traversability prediction to more efficiently utilize robot experience. We comprehensively evaluate the proposed framework through ablation studies, validation on heterogeneous real-world robotic platforms, and autonomous navigation demonstrations in simulation environments.
summary_zh: 安全自主导航需要对环境可穿越性的可靠估计。传统方法依赖于基于语义或几何的方法，并使用人工定义的阈值，但由于人类监督固有的主观性，这些方法通常会产生不可靠的预测。虽然自监督方法使机器人能够从自身经验中学习，但它们仍然面临一个根本性的挑战：仅正样本学习问题。为了解决这些局限性，最近的研究采用了正样本-未标记样本（PU）学习，其核心挑战是在没有明确负监督的情况下识别正样本。在这项工作中，我们提出了GSAT，它通过在潜在空间中构建一个正超球来解决这些局限性，从而通过异常检测来分类可穿越区域，而无需额外的原型（例如，未标记或负样本）。此外，我们的方法采用异常分类和可穿越性预测的联合学习，以更有效地利用机器人经验。我们通过消融研究、在异构真实机器人平台上的验证以及在仿真环境中的自主导航演示，全面评估了所提出的框架。
tldr: This paper presents GSAT, a self-supervised learning method for geometric traversability estimation using anomaly detection in latent space, addressing the positive-only learning problem in robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种GSAT方法，该方法使用潜在空间中的异常检测进行几何可穿越性估计，采用自监督学习，解决了机器人技术中常见的仅有正样本学习问题。

title: Underwater Embodied Intelligence for Autonomous Robots: A Constraint-Coupled Perspective on Planning, Control, and Deployment
summary: Autonomous underwater robots are increasingly deployed for environmental monitoring, infrastructure inspection, subsea resource exploration, and long-horizon exploration. Yet, despite rapid advances in learning-based planning and control, reliable autonomy in real ocean environments remains fundamentally constrained by tightly coupled physical limits. Hydrodynamic uncertainty, partial observability, bandwidth-limited communication, and energy scarcity are not independent challenges; they interact within the closed perception-planning-control loop and often amplify one another over time. This Review develops a constraint-coupled perspective on underwater embodied intelligence, arguing that planning and control must be understood within tightly coupled sensing, communication, coordination, and resource constraints in real ocean environments. We synthesize recent progress in reinforcement learning, belief-aware planning, hybrid control, multi-robot coordination, and foundation-model integration through this embodied perspective. Across representative application domains, we show how environmental monitoring, inspection, exploration, and cooperative missions expose distinct stress profiles of cross-layer coupling. To unify these observations, we introduce a cross-layer failure taxonomy spanning epistemic, dynamic, and coordination breakdowns, and analyze how errors cascade across autonomy layers under uncertainty. Building on this structure, we outline research directions toward physics-grounded world models, certifiable learning-enabled control, communication-aware coordination, and deployment-aware system design. By internalizing constraint coupling rather than treating it as an external disturbance, underwater embodied intelligence may evolve from performance-driven adaptation toward resilient, scalable, and verifiable autonomy under real ocean conditions.
summary_zh: 自主水下机器人正日益广泛地应用于环境监测、基础设施检查、海底资源勘探和长航时探索。然而，尽管基于学习的规划和控制技术取得了快速进展，但在真实海洋环境中实现可靠自主性仍然受到紧密耦合的物理限制的根本约束。水动力不确定性、部分可观测性、带宽受限的通信以及能源匮乏并非独立的挑战；它们在闭环感知-规划-控制中相互作用，并经常随时间相互放大。本综述从约束耦合的视角出发，探讨水下具身智能，认为规划和控制必须在真实海洋环境中紧密耦合的感知、通信、协同和资源约束下理解。通过这种具身视角，我们综合了强化学习、信念感知规划、混合控制、多机器人协同和基础模型集成等方面的最新进展。在具有代表性的应用领域中，我们展示了环境监测、检查、探索和协同任务如何展现跨层耦合的不同应力剖面。为了统一这些观察结果，我们引入了一个跨层失效分类法，涵盖认知、动态和协同崩溃，并分析了在不确定性下误差如何在自主层之间级联。在此结构的基础上，我们概述了面向基于物理的先验世界模型、可认证的使能学习控制、通信感知协同和部署感知系统设计的研究方向。通过内化约束耦合而非将其视为外部扰动，水下具身智能可能会从性能驱动的适应演变为真实海洋条件下具有弹性、可扩展和可验证的自主性。
tldr: This review paper proposes a constraint-coupled perspective on underwater embodied intelligence, emphasizing the importance of considering tightly coupled sensing, communication, coordination, and resource constraints for reliable autonomous underwater robots.
tldr_zh: 这篇综述论文提出了关于水下具身智能的约束耦合视角，强调了考虑紧密耦合的感知、通信、协调和资源约束，对于实现可靠的水下自主机器人至关重要。

title: A Distributed Gaussian Process Model for Multi-Robot Mapping
summary: We propose DistGP: a multi-robot learning method for collaborative learning of a global function using only local experience and computation. We utilise a sparse Gaussian process (GP) model with a factorisation that mirrors the multi-robot structure of the task, and admits distributed training via Gaussian belief propagation (GBP). Our loopy model outperforms Tree-Structured GPs \cite{bui2014tree} and can be trained online and in settings with dynamic connectivity. We show that such distributed, asynchronous training can reach the same performance as a centralised, batch-trained model, albeit with slower convergence. Last, we compare to DiNNO \cite{yu2022dinno}, a distributed neural network (NN) optimiser, and find DistGP achieves superior accuracy, is more robust to sparse communication and is better able to learn continually.
summary_zh: 我们提出DistGP：一种多机器人学习方法，用于仅通过本地经验和计算协同学习全局函数。我们利用稀疏高斯过程（GP）模型，该模型使用反映任务多机器人结构的一种因子分解，并通过高斯信念传播（GBP）实现分布式训练。我们的循环模型优于树形结构GP \cite{bui2014tree}，并且可以进行在线训练和在动态连接环境中工作。我们证明了这种分布式、异步训练可以达到与集中式、批量训练模型相同的性能，尽管收敛速度较慢。最后，我们与分布式神经网络（NN）优化器DiNNO \cite{yu2022dinno}进行比较，发现DistGP获得了更高的准确性，对稀疏通信更具鲁棒性，并且能够更好地进行持续学习。
tldr: The paper introduces DistGP, a distributed Gaussian Process model for multi-robot collaborative learning, achieving comparable accuracy to centralized models but with distributed, asynchronous training, and outperforming distributed neural networks in accuracy and robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为DistGP的分布式高斯过程模型，用于多机器人协同学习。DistGP通过分布式异步训练，实现了与集中式模型相媲美的精度，并在精度和鲁棒性方面优于分布式神经网络。

title: Soft Rigid Hybrid Gripper with Inflatable Silicone Pockets for Tunable Frictional Grasping
summary: Grasping objects with diverse mechanical properties, such as heavy, slippery, or fragile items, remains a significant challenge in robotics. Conventional rigid grippers typically rely on increasing the normal forces to secure an object, however, this can cause damage to fragile objects due to excessive force. To address this limitation, we propose a soft rigid hybrid gripper finger that combines rigid structural shells with soft, inflatable silicone pockets, which could be integrated into a conventional gripper. The hybrid gripper can actively modulate its surface friction by varying the internal air pressure of the silicone pockets, enabling the gripper to securely grasp objects without increasing the gripping force. This is demonstrated by fundamental experimental results, in which an increase in internal pressure leads to a proportional increase in the effective coefficient of friction. The gripping experiments also show that the integrated gripper can stably lift heavy and slippery objects or fragile, deformable objects, such as eggs, tofu, fruits, and paper cups, with minimal damage by increasing friction rather than applying high force.
summary_zh: 对抓取具有不同机械特性的物体，如重物、易滑物体或易碎物品，仍然是机器人领域的一项重大挑战。传统的刚性夹爪通常依赖于增加正压力来固定物体，然而，这可能会因过大的力而损坏易碎物品。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了一种软硬混合型夹爪手指，它将刚性结构外壳与可充气的软硅胶口袋相结合，可以集成到传统的夹爪中。这种混合型夹爪可以通过改变硅胶口袋的内部气压来主动调节其表面摩擦力，从而使夹爪能够在不增加抓取力的情况下牢固地抓取物体。基础实验结果证明了这一点，其中内部压力的增加会导致有效摩擦系数成比例地增加。抓取实验还表明，这种集成夹爪可以通过增加摩擦力而不是施加高力，稳定地举起重物和易滑物体，或者易碎、可变形的物体，如鸡蛋、豆腐、水果和纸杯，并最大限度地减少损坏。
tldr: This paper presents a soft-rigid hybrid gripper that uses inflatable silicone pockets to modulate surface friction, enabling it to grasp slippery, heavy, or fragile objects without excessive force.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种软硬混合抓手，利用可充气的硅胶口袋来调节表面摩擦力，使其能够在不施加过大力量的情况下抓住滑溜、沉重或易碎的物体。

title: A Novel Multi-Agent Architecture to Reduce Hallucinations of Large Language Models in Multi-Step Structural Modeling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) such as GPT and Gemini have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in contextual understanding and reasoning. The strong performance of LLMs has sparked growing interest in leveraging them to automate tasks traditionally dependent on human expertise. Recently, LLMs have been integrated into intelligent agents capable of operating structural analysis software (e.g., OpenSees) to construct structural models and perform analyses. However, existing LLMs are limited in handling multi-step structural modeling due to frequent hallucinations and error accumulation during long-sequence operations. To this end, this study presents a novel multi-agent architecture to automate the structural modeling and analysis using OpenSeesPy. First, problem analysis and construction planning agents extract key parameters from user descriptions and formulate a stepwise modeling plan. Node and element agents then operate in parallel to assemble the frame geometry, followed by a load assignment agent. The resulting geometric and load information is translated into executable OpenSeesPy scripts by code translation agents. The proposed architecture is evaluated on a benchmark of 20 frame problems over ten repeated trials, achieving 100% accuracy in 18 cases and 90% in the remaining two. The architecture also significantly improves computational efficiency and demonstrates scalability to larger structural systems.
summary_zh:
摘要：
GPT和Gemini等大型语言模型（LLMs）在上下文理解和推理方面表现出了卓越的能力。LLMs的强大性能激发了人们对利用它们来自动化传统上依赖于人类专业知识的任务的日益增长的兴趣。最近，LLMs已被集成到能够操作结构分析软件（例如，OpenSees）来构建结构模型并执行分析的智能代理中。然而，由于在长序列操作期间频繁出现幻觉和误差累积，现有的LLMs在处理多步骤结构建模方面受到限制。为此，本研究提出了一种新颖的多代理架构，以使用OpenSeesPy自动化结构建模和分析。首先，问题分析和构建规划代理从用户描述中提取关键参数，并制定逐步建模计划。然后，节点和单元代理并行操作以组装框架几何形状，随后是荷载分配代理。生成的几何和荷载信息由代码翻译代理转换为可执行的OpenSeesPy脚本。所提出的架构在一个包含20个框架问题的基准上进行了评估，进行了十次重复试验，在18个案例中实现了100％的准确率，在其余两个案例中实现了90％的准确率。该架构还显着提高了计算效率，并展示了对更大规模结构系统的可扩展性。
tldr: The paper introduces a multi-agent architecture to reduce hallucinations and improve the accuracy and efficiency of LLMs in multi-step structural modeling tasks, demonstrating high accuracy and scalability on a benchmark of frame problems.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种多智能体架构，旨在减少大型语言模型在多步结构建模任务中的幻觉，提高准确性和效率。该架构在框架问题基准测试中表现出很高的准确性和可扩展性。

title: From Thinker to Society: Security in Hierarchical Autonomy Evolution of AI Agents
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents have evolved from passive predictive tools into active entities capable of autonomous decision-making and environmental interaction, driven by the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, this evolution has introduced critical security vulnerabilities that existing frameworks fail to address. The Hierarchical Autonomy Evolution (HAE) framework organizes agent security into three tiers: Cognitive Autonomy (L1) targets internal reasoning integrity; Execution Autonomy (L2) covers tool-mediated environmental interaction; Collective Autonomy (L3) addresses systemic risks in multi-agent ecosystems. We present a taxonomy of threats spanning cognitive manipulation, physical environment disruption, and multi-agent systemic failures, and evaluate existing defenses while identifying key research gaps. The findings aim to guide the development of multilayered, autonomy-aware defense architectures for trustworthy AI agent systems.
summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）代理已经从被动的预测工具演变为能够自主决策和环境交互的主动实体，这得益于大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。然而，这种演变引入了现有框架无法解决的关键安全漏洞。层级自主演化（HAE）框架将代理安全划分为三个层级：认知自主性（L1）针对内部推理完整性；执行自主性（L2）涵盖工具介导的环境交互；集体自主性（L3）解决多代理生态系统中的系统性风险。我们提出了一种威胁分类法，涵盖认知操纵、物理环境破坏和多代理系统性故障，并评估了现有防御措施，同时识别出关键的研究缺口。研究结果旨在指导开发多层、自主感知的防御架构，以实现可信赖的AI代理系统。
tldr: The paper proposes a hierarchical framework for securing AI agents, addressing vulnerabilities introduced by their increasing autonomy across cognitive, execution, and collective levels. It identifies threats and research gaps to guide the design of robust defense architectures.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于保护人工智能体的分层框架，旨在解决人工智能体在认知、执行和集体层面日益增长的自主性所引入的漏洞。它识别了威胁和研究差距，以指导开发强大的防御架构。

title: Adversarial Latent-State Training for Robust Policies in Partially Observable Domains
summary: Robustness under latent distribution shift remains challenging in partially observable reinforcement learning. We formalize a focused setting where an adversary selects a hidden initial latent distribution before the episode, termed an adversarial latent-initial-state POMDP. Theoretically, we prove a latent minimax principle, characterize worst-case defender distributions, and derive approximate best-response certificates with finite-sample guarantees, providing formal meaning to empirical training diagnostics. Empirically, using a Battleship benchmark, we demonstrate that targeted exposure to shifted latent distributions reduces average robustness gaps between Spread and Uniform distributions from 10.3 to 3.1 shots at equal budget. Furthermore, iterative best-response training exhibits budget-sensitive behavior entirely consistent with our approximate certificate theory. Ultimately, we show that for latent-initial-state problems, our framework yields precise diagnostic principles and confirms that structured adversarial exposure effectively mitigates worst-case vulnerabilities.
summary_zh: 部分可观察强化学习领域中，在潜在分布漂移下的鲁棒性仍然是一个挑战。我们形式化了一个聚焦的设定：在回合开始前，一个对抗者选择一个隐藏的初始潜在分布，称之为对抗性潜在-初始状态POMDP。理论上，我们证明了一个潜在极小极大原理，刻画了最坏情况下的防御者分布，并推导了具有有限样本保证的近似最优响应证书，为经验训练诊断提供了形式化的意义。在实验中，使用战舰基准测试，我们证明了有针对性地暴露于漂移后的潜在分布，可以将Spread分布和Uniform分布之间平均鲁棒性差距在相同预算下从10.3次射击减少到3.1次射击。此外，迭代最优响应训练表现出预算敏感的行为，完全符合我们的近似证书理论。最终，我们表明，对于潜在-初始状态问题，我们的框架产生了精确的诊断原则，并证实了结构化的对抗性暴露能够有效地减轻最坏情况下的脆弱性。
tldr: This paper introduces a framework for training robust RL policies in POMDPs with adversarial latent initial states. It provides theoretical analysis, certificates, and empirical validation on a Battleship benchmark, demonstrating improved robustness against latent distribution shifts.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个在具有对抗性潜在初始状态的POMDP中训练鲁棒RL策略的框架。它提供了理论分析、证书，并在Battleship基准上进行了实证验证，证明了针对潜在分布变化的鲁棒性得到了提高。

title: GLASS: Graph and Vision-Language Assisted Semantic Shape Correspondence
summary: Establishing dense correspondence across 3D shapes is crucial for fundamental downstream tasks, including texture transfer, shape interpolation, and robotic manipulation. However, learning these mappings without manual supervision remains a formidable challenge, particularly under severe non-isometric deformations and in inter-class settings where geometric cues are ambiguous. Conventional functional map methods, while elegant, typically struggle in these regimes due to their reliance on isometry. To address this, we present GLASS, a framework that bridges the gap by integrating geometric spectral analysis with rich semantic priors from vision-language foundation models. GLASS introduces three key innovations: (i) a view-consistent strategy that enables robust multi-view visual feature extraction from powerful vision foundation models; (ii) the injection of language embeddings into vertex descriptors via zero-shot 3D segmentation, capturing high-level part semantics; and (iii) a graph-assisted contrastive loss that enforces structural consistency between regions (e.g., source's head'' $\leftrightarrow$ target's head'') by leveraging geodesic and topological relationships between regions. This design allows GLASS to learn globally coherent and semantically consistent maps without ground-truth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GLASS achieves state-of-the-art performance across all regimes, maintaining high accuracy on standard near-isometric tasks while significantly advancing performance in challenging settings. Specifically, it achieves average geodesic errors of 0.21, 4.5, and 5.6 on the inter-class benchmark SNIS and non-isometric benchmarks SMAL and TOPKIDS, reducing errors from URSSM baselines of 0.49, 6.0, and 8.9 by 57%, 25%, and 37%, respectively.
summary_zh: 在三维形状之间建立稠密对应关系对于纹理传递、形状插值和机器人操作等下游基础任务至关重要。然而，在缺乏人工监督的情况下学习这些映射仍然是一个巨大的挑战，特别是在严重的非等距变形和几何线索模糊的跨类别场景中。传统的函数映射方法虽然优雅，但由于其对等距的依赖，通常在这些情况下表现不佳。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了GLASS，一个通过将几何谱分析与视觉-语言基础模型提供的丰富语义先验相结合来弥合差距的框架。GLASS引入了三个关键创新点：（i）一种视图一致性策略，能够从强大的视觉基础模型中提取鲁棒的多视图视觉特征；（ii）通过零样本三维分割将语言嵌入注入到顶点描述符中，从而捕获高层次的部件语义；以及（iii）一种图辅助对比损失，通过利用区域之间的测地线和拓扑关系来强制执行区域之间的结构一致性（例如，源对象的“头”$\leftrightarrow$目标对象的“头”）。这种设计使得GLASS能够在没有真值监督的情况下学习全局一致且语义连贯的映射。大量实验表明，GLASS在所有场景中都实现了最先进的性能，在标准近似等距任务上保持了高精度，同时显著提高了在具有挑战性场景中的性能。具体而言，它在跨类别基准SNIS以及非等距基准SMAL和TOPKIDS上实现了平均测地线误差分别为0.21、4.5和5.6，与URSSM基线（误差分别为0.49、6.0和8.9）相比，误差分别降低了57%、25%和37%。
tldr: The paper introduces GLASS, a novel unsupervised framework that leverages vision-language foundation models and graph-assisted contrastive learning to establish dense, semantically consistent 3D shape correspondence, even under significant non-isometric deformations and in inter-class scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GLASS，一种新颖的无监督框架，它利用视觉-语言基础模型和图辅助对比学习来建立密集的、语义一致的3D形状对应关系，即使在显著的非等距变形和跨类场景中也是如此。

title: Efficient RGB-D Scene Understanding via Multi-task Adaptive Learning and Cross-dimensional Feature Guidance
summary: Scene understanding plays a critical role in enabling intelligence and autonomy in robotic systems. Traditional approaches often face challenges, including occlusions, ambiguous boundaries, and the inability to adapt attention based on task-specific requirements and sample variations. To address these limitations, this paper presents an efficient RGB-D scene understanding model that performs a range of tasks, including semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, orientation estimation, panoptic segmentation, and scene classification. The proposed model incorporates an enhanced fusion encoder, which effectively leverages redundant information from both RGB and depth inputs. For semantic segmentation, we introduce normalized focus channel layers and a context feature interaction layer, designed to mitigate issues such as shallow feature misguidance and insufficient local-global feature representation. The instance segmentation task benefits from a non-bottleneck 1D structure, which achieves superior contour representation with fewer parameters. Additionally, we propose a multi-task adaptive loss function that dynamically adjusts the learning strategy for different tasks based on scene variations. Extensive experiments on the NYUv2, SUN RGB-D, and Cityscapes datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing methods in both segmentation accuracy and processing speed.
summary_zh: 场景理解在使能机器人系统的智能化和自主化方面起着至关重要的作用。传统方法常常面临诸多挑战，包括遮挡、模糊边界以及无法根据任务特定需求和样本变化来调整注意力。为了解决这些局限性，本文提出了一种高效的RGB-D场景理解模型，该模型能够执行一系列任务，包括语义分割、实例分割、方向估计、全景分割和场景分类。所提出的模型集成了一个增强的融合编码器，有效地利用了来自RGB和深度输入的冗余信息。对于语义分割，我们引入了归一化焦点通道层和上下文特征交互层，旨在缓解诸如浅层特征误导和局部-全局特征表示不足的问题。实例分割任务受益于一种非瓶颈1D结构，该结构以更少的参数实现了更优越的轮廓表示。此外，我们提出了一种多任务自适应损失函数，可以基于场景变化动态地调整不同任务的学习策略。在NYUv2、SUN RGB-D和Cityscapes数据集上进行的大量实验表明，我们的方法在分割精度和处理速度方面均优于现有方法。
tldr: This paper presents an efficient RGB-D scene understanding model with a multi-task adaptive loss, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multiple scene understanding datasets with improved speed and accuracy across tasks like semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, and scene classification.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种高效的RGB-D场景理解模型，采用多任务自适应损失函数，在多个场景理解数据集上实现了最先进的性能，并在语义分割、实例分割和场景分类等任务中提高了速度和准确性。

title: Data Agent: Learning to Select Data via End-to-End Dynamic Optimization
summary: Dynamic Data selection aims to accelerate training by prioritizing informative samples during online training. However, existing methods typically rely on task-specific handcrafted metrics or static/snapshot-based criteria to estimate sample importance, limiting scalability across learning paradigms and making it difficult to capture the evolving utility of data throughout training. To address this challenge, we propose Data Agent, an end-to-end dynamic data selection framework that formulates data selection as a training-aware sequential decision-making problem. The agent learns a sample-wise selection policy that co-evolves with model optimization, guided by a composite reward that integrates loss-based difficulty and confidence-based uncertainty signals. The reward signals capture complementary objectives of optimization impact and information gain, together with a tuning-free adaptive weighting mechanism that balances these signals over training. Extensive experiments across a wide range of datasets and architectures demonstrate that Data Agent consistently accelerates training while preserving or improving performance, e.g., reducing costs by over 50\% on ImageNet-1k and MMLU with lossless performance. Moreover, its dataset-agnostic formulation and modular reward make it plug-and-play across tasks and scenarios, e.g., robustness to noisy datasets, highlighting its potential in real-world scenarios.
summary_zh: 动态数据选择旨在通过在在线训练中优先考虑信息量大的样本来加速训练过程。然而，现有方法通常依赖于特定任务的手工设计的指标或静态/快照式标准来估计样本的重要性，这限制了跨学习范式的可扩展性，并且难以捕捉数据在整个训练过程中不断变化的效用。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了 Data Agent，一个端到端的动态数据选择框架，它将数据选择形式化为训练感知的序列决策问题。该Agent学习一种样本级的选择策略，该策略与模型优化共同演化，并由一个综合奖励引导，该奖励集成了基于损失的难度和基于置信度的不确定性信号。这些奖励信号捕获了优化影响和信息增益的互补目标， साथ ही 并采用了一种无需调优的自适应加权机制，以平衡这些信号在训练过程中的作用。在广泛的数据集和架构上的大量实验表明，Data Agent 可以始终如一地加速训练，同时保持或提高性能表现，例如，通过无损性能在 ImageNet-1k 和 MMLU 上降低成本超过 50%。此外，其数据集无关的公式化和模块化的奖励使其可以即插即用地应用于各种任务和场景，例如，对噪声数据集的鲁棒性，突出了其在现实世界场景中的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces Data Agent, a novel end-to-end framework for dynamic data selection that uses a reinforcement learning approach with composite rewards to prioritize informative samples during training, demonstrating significant cost reductions across various datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为Data Agent 的新型端到端动态数据选择框架，该框架采用强化学习方法，通过组合奖励来优先选择训练期间的信息性样本，并在各种数据集上展示了显著的成本降低。

title: QdaVPR: A novel query-based domain-agnostic model for visual place recognition
summary: Visual place recognition (VPR) aiming at predicting the location of an image based solely on its visual features is a fundamental task in robotics and autonomous systems. Domain variation remains one of the main challenges in VPR and is relatively unexplored. Existing VPR models attempt to achieve domain agnosticism either by training on large-scale datasets that inherently contain some domain variations, or by being specifically adapted to particular target domains. In practice, the former lacks explicit domain supervision, while the latter generalizes poorly to unseen domain shifts. This paper proposes a novel query-based domain-agnostic VPR model called QdaVPR. First, a dual-level adversarial learning framework is designed to encourage domain invariance for both the query features forming the global descriptor and the image features from which these query features are derived. Then, a triplet supervision based on query combinations is designed to enhance the discriminative power of the global descriptors. To support the learning process, we augment a large-scale VPR dataset using style transfer methods, generating various synthetic domains with corresponding domain labels as auxiliary supervision. Extensive experiments show that QdaVPR achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple VPR benchmarks with significant domain variations. Specifically, it attains the best Recall@1 and Recall@10 on nearly all test scenarios: 93.5%/98.6% on Nordland (seasonal changes), 97.5%/99.0% on Tokyo24/7 (day-night transitions), and the highest Recall@1 across almost all weather conditions on the SVOX dataset. Our code will be released at https://github.com/shuimushan/QdaVPR.
summary_zh: 视觉地点识别 (VPR) 旨在仅基于图像的视觉特征预测图像的位置，是机器人学和自主系统中的一项基础任务。领域差异仍然是 VPR 中的主要挑战之一，且相对未被充分探索。现有的 VPR 模型试图通过训练包含一些固有领域差异的大规模数据集，或者通过专门适配特定目标领域来实现领域无关性。实际上，前者缺乏显式的领域监督，而后者对于未见过的领域偏移泛化性能较差。本文提出了一种新颖的基于查询的领域无关VPR模型，称为QdaVPR。首先，设计了一个双层对抗学习框架来鼓励形成全局描述符的查询特征以及从中导出这些查询特征的图像特征的领域不变性。然后，设计了一种基于查询组合的三元组监督来增强全局描述符的判别能力。为了支持学习过程，我们使用风格迁移方法增强了一个大规模VPR数据集，生成具有相应领域标签的各种合成领域作为辅助监督。大量实验表明，QdaVPR在多个具有显著领域差异的VPR基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。具体而言，它在几乎所有测试场景中都获得了最佳的Recall@1和Recall@10：在Nordland（季节性变化）上为93.5%/98.6%，在Tokyo24/7（昼夜过渡）上为97.5%/99.0%，并且在SVOX数据集上几乎所有天气条件下都达到了最高的Recall@1。我们的代码将在https://github.com/shuimushan/QdaVPR上发布。
tldr: This paper introduces QdaVPR, a novel query-based domain-agnostic visual place recognition model that uses a dual-level adversarial learning framework and triplet supervision with style transfer data augmentation to achieve state-of-the-art performance on VPR benchmarks with domain variations.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的基于查询的领域无关视觉位置识别模型QdaVPR，该模型采用双层对抗学习框架和三重监督，结合风格迁移数据增强，在具有领域变化的VPR基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

title: Perceptive Variable-Timing Footstep Planning for Humanoid Locomotion on Disconnected Footholds
summary: Many real-world walking scenarios contain obstacles and unsafe ground patches (e.g., slippery or cluttered areas), leaving a disconnected set of admissible footholds that can be modeled as stepping-stone-like regions. We propose an onboard, perceptive mixed-integer model predictive control framework that jointly plans foot placement and step duration using step-to-step Divergent Component of Motion (DCM) dynamics. Ego-centric depth images are fused into a probabilistic local heightmap, from which we extract a union of convex steppable regions. Region membership is enforced with binary variables in a mixed-integer quadratic program (MIQP). To keep the optimization tractable while certifying safety, we embed capturability bounds in the DCM space: a lateral one-step condition (preventing leg crossing) and a sagittal infinite-step bound that limits unstable growth. We further re-plan within the step by back-propagating the measured instantaneous DCM to update the initial DCM, improving robustness to model mismatch and external disturbances. We evaluate the approach in simulation on Digit on randomized stepping-stone fields, including external pushes. The planner generates terrain-aware, dynamically consistent footstep sequences with adaptive timing and millisecond-level solve times.
summary_zh: 许多现实世界的行走场景都包含障碍物和不安全地面（例如，湿滑或杂乱区域），构成了一组不连通的可容许落脚点集合，可以建模为跳石状区域。我们提出了一种基于板载、具有感知能力的混合整数模型预测控制框架，该框架使用步至步运动发散分量（DCM）动力学联合规划落脚点位置和步态持续时间。以自我为中心的深度图像被融合为概率局部高度图，从中我们提取出凸可行走区域的并集。区域隶属关系通过混合整数二次规划（MIQP）中的二元变量来强制执行。为了保持优化的可追踪性并保证安全性，我们在DCM空间中嵌入了可捕获性边界：横向一步条件（防止腿部交叉）和限制不稳定增长的矢状无限步边界。我们通过反向传播测量的瞬时DCM以更新初始DCM，在步态期间进一步重新规划，从而提高对模型失配和外部干扰的鲁棒性。我们在Digit机器人上、在随机跳石场中对该方法进行了仿真评估，包括外力推搡。该规划器能够生成具有地形感知能力、动态一致的步态序列，并具有自适应时间控制和毫秒级的求解时间。
tldr: The paper presents a perceptive Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework for humanoid robots to navigate disconnected footholds by jointly planning foot placement and step duration, using depth images and capturability bounds for dynamic consistency and safety, demonstrating rapid solve times in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种感知型模型预测控制（MPC）框架，用于人形机器人在不连续的立足点上导航，通过联合规划足部放置和步长，利用深度图像和可捕获性边界来保证动态一致性和安全性，并在仿真中展示了快速的求解时间。

title: FrameVGGT: Frame Evidence Rolling Memory for streaming VGGT
summary: Streaming Visual Geometry Transformers such as StreamVGGT enable strong online 3D perception but suffer from unbounded KV-cache growth, which limits deployment over long streams. We revisit bounded-memory streaming from the perspective of geometric support. In geometry-driven reasoning, memory quality depends not only on how many tokens are retained, but also on whether the retained memory still preserves sufficiently coherent local support. This suggests that token-level retention may become less suitable under fixed budgets, as it can thin the evidence available within each contributing frame and make subsequent fusion more sensitive to weakly aligned history. Motivated by this observation, we propose FrameVGGT, a frame-driven rolling explicit-memory framework that treats each frame's incremental KV contribution as a coherent evidence block. FrameVGGT summarizes each block into a compact prototype and maintains a fixed-capacity mid-term bank of complementary frame blocks under strict budgets, with an optional lightweight anchor tier for rare prolonged degradation. Across long-sequence 3D reconstruction, video depth estimation, and camera pose benchmarks, FrameVGGT achieves favorable accuracy--memory trade-offs under bounded memory, while maintaining more stable geometry over long streams.
summary_zh: 流式视觉几何变换器（如StreamVGGT）实现了强大的在线3D感知，但面临着无界KV缓存增长的问题，这限制了其在长流上的部署。我们从几何支撑的角度重新审视有界内存的流式处理。在几何驱动的推理中，内存质量不仅取决于保留了多少token，还取决于保留的内存是否仍然保持足够连贯的局部支撑。这表明，在固定预算下，token级别的保留可能变得不太合适，因为它会稀释每个贡献帧内的可用证据，并使后续融合对弱对齐历史更加敏感。受此观察的启发，我们提出了FrameVGGT，一种帧驱动的滚动显式内存框架，将每个帧的增量KV贡献视为一个连贯的证据块。FrameVGGT将每个块总结为一个紧凑的原型，并在严格的预算下，维护一个固定容量的中期帧块库，其中包含互补的帧块，并可选地设置一个轻量级的锚定层，用于应对罕见的长期性能退化。在长序列3D重建、视频深度估计和相机姿态基准测试中，FrameVGGT在有界内存下实现了有利的精度-内存权衡，同时在长流上保持更稳定的几何形状。
tldr: FrameVGGT introduces a frame-driven memory management technique for streaming Visual Geometry Transformers to address the KV-cache growth problem, leading to improved accuracy and stability in long-sequence 3D perception tasks under memory constraints.
tldr_zh: FrameVGGT 引入了一种帧驱动的内存管理技术，用于流式视觉几何变换器，以解决 KV-cache 增长问题，从而在内存限制下，提高长序列 3D 感知任务的准确性和稳定性。

title: RayD3D: Distilling Depth Knowledge Along the Ray for Robust Multi-View 3D Object Detection
summary: Multi-view 3D detection with bird's eye view (BEV) is crucial for autonomous driving and robotics, but its robustness in real-world is limited as it struggles to predict accurate depth values. A mainstream solution, cross-modal distillation, transfers depth information from LiDAR to camera models but also unintentionally transfers depth-irrelevant information (e.g. LiDAR density). To mitigate this issue, we propose RayD3D, which transfers crucial depth knowledge along the ray: a line projecting from the camera to true location of an object. It is based on the fundamental imaging principle that predicted location of this object can only vary along this ray, which is finally determined by predicted depth value. Therefore, distilling along the ray enables more effective depth information transfer. More specifically, we design two ray-based distillation modules. Ray-based Contrastive Distillation (RCD) incorporates contrastive learning into distillation by sampling along the ray to learn how LiDAR accurately locates objects. Ray-based Weighted Distillation (RWD) adaptively adjusts distillation weight based on the ray to minimize the interference of depth-irrelevant information in LiDAR. For validation, we widely apply RayD3D into three representative types of BEV-based models, including BEVDet, BEVDepth4D, and BEVFormer. Our method is trained on clean NuScenes, and tested on both clean NuScenes and RoboBEV with a variety types of data corruptions. Our method significantly improves the robustness of all the three base models in all scenarios without increasing inference costs, and achieves the best when compared to recently released multi-view and distillation models.
summary_zh: 基于鸟瞰图（BEV）的多视角3D检测对于自动驾驶和机器人技术至关重要，但其在现实世界中的鲁棒性受到限制，因为它难以预测准确的深度值。一种主流的解决方案，跨模态蒸馏，将深度信息从LiDAR传递到相机模型，但同时也无意中传递了与深度无关的信息（例如LiDAR密度）。 为了缓解这个问题，我们提出了RayD3D，它沿着射线传递关键的深度知识：射线是指从相机投射到物体真实位置的直线。它基于一个基本的成像原理，即该物体的预测位置只能沿着这条射线变化，而这条射线最终由预测的深度值决定。因此，沿着射线进行蒸馏能够更有效地传递深度信息。更具体地说，我们设计了两个基于射线的蒸馏模块。基于射线的对比蒸馏（RCD）通过沿着射线采样，将对比学习融入蒸馏中，以学习LiDAR如何精确定位物体。基于射线的加权蒸馏（RWD）基于射线自适应地调整蒸馏权重，以最大限度地减少LiDAR中与深度无关的信息的干扰。 为了验证，我们将RayD3D广泛应用于三种具有代表性的基于BEV的模型，包括BEVDet、BEVDepth4D和BEVFormer。我们的方法在干净的NuScenes上进行训练，并在干净的NuScenes和具有各种数据损坏类型的RoboBEV上进行测试。 我们的方法在不增加推理成本的情况下，显著提高了所有三个基准模型在所有场景中的鲁棒性，并且与最近发布的多视角和蒸馏模型相比，实现了最佳效果。
tldr: RayD3D improves the robustness of multi-view 3D object detection by distilling depth knowledge along rays, mitigating the transfer of irrelevant LiDAR information and enhancing performance on corrupted datasets.
tldr_zh: RayD3D通过沿射线方向提取深度知识，提升了多视角3D目标检测的鲁棒性，减少了不相关的激光雷达信息的影响，并在损坏的数据集上提高了性能。

title: Multi-Modal Decouple and Recouple Network for Robust 3D Object Detection
summary: Multi-modal 3D object detection with bird's eye view (BEV) has achieved desired advances on benchmarks. Nonetheless, the accuracy may drop significantly in the real world due to data corruption such as sensor configurations for LiDAR and scene conditions for camera. One design bottleneck of previous models resides in the tightly coupling of multi-modal BEV features during fusion, which may degrade the overall system performance if one modality or both is corrupted. To mitigate, we propose a Multi-Modal Decouple and Recouple Network for robust 3D object detection under data corruption. Different modalities commonly share some high-level invariant features. We observe that these invariant features across modalities do not always fail simultaneously, because different types of data corruption affect each modality in distinct ways.These invariant features can be recovered across modalities for robust fusion under data corruption.To this end, we explicitly decouple Camera/LiDAR BEV features into modality-invariant and modality-specific parts. It allows invariant features to compensate each other while mitigates the negative impact of a corrupted modality on the other.We then recouple these features into three experts to handle different types of data corruption, respectively, i.e., LiDAR, camera, and both.For each expert, we use modality-invariant features as robust information, while modality-specific features serve as a complement.Finally, we adaptively fuse the three experts to exact robust features for 3D object detection. For validation, we collect a benchmark with a large quantity of data corruption for LiDAR, camera, and both based on nuScenes. Our model is trained on clean nuScenes and tested on all types of data corruption. Our model consistently achieves the best accuracy on both corrupted and clean data compared to recent models.
summary_zh: 基于鸟瞰图（BEV）的多模态3D目标检测技术在基准测试中取得了令人满意的进展。然而，在现实世界中，由于数据损坏，如激光雷达的传感器配置以及相机的场景条件等因素，其精度可能会显著下降。先前模型的一个设计瓶颈在于融合过程中多模态BEV特征的紧耦合，这可能在某一模态或两者都受损时降低整体系统性能。为了缓解这个问题，我们提出了一种多模态解耦和重组网络，用于在数据损坏情况下进行稳健的3D目标检测。不同的模态通常共享一些高层不变特征。我们观察到，这些跨模态的不变特征并非总是同时失效，因为不同类型的数据损坏会以不同的方式影响每种模态。这些不变特征可以跨模态进行恢复，以便在数据损坏的情况下进行稳健融合。为此，我们显式地将相机/激光雷达BEV特征解耦为模态不变和模态特定两部分。这使得不变特征能够相互补偿，同时减轻了受损模态对另一模态的负面影响。然后，我们将这些特征重组为三个专家模型，分别处理不同类型的数据损坏，即激光雷达、相机和两者皆有。对于每个专家模型，我们使用模态不变特征作为稳健信息，而模态特定特征作为补充。最后，我们自适应地融合这三个专家模型，从而提取稳健特征用于3D目标检测。为了验证，我们基于nuScenes收集了一个基准数据集，其中包含大量的激光雷达、相机以及两者皆有的数据损坏。我们的模型在干净的nuScenes数据集上进行训练，并在所有类型的数据损坏上进行测试。与最近的模型相比，我们的模型在损坏和干净数据上都始终实现了最佳精度。
tldr: This paper introduces a multi-modal 3D object detection network that decouples and recouples camera and LiDAR features to improve robustness against data corruption in real-world scenarios by using modality-invariant features.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种多模态3D目标检测网络，通过解耦和重耦相机与激光雷达的特征，利用模态不变特征来提高在现实场景中对抗数据损坏的鲁棒性。

title: Classifying Novel 3D-Printed Objects without Retraining: Towards Post-Production Automation in Additive Manufacturing
summary: Reliable classification of 3D-printed objects is essential for automating post-production workflows in industrial additive manufacturing. Despite extensive automation in other stages of the printing pipeline, this task still relies heavily on manual inspection, as the set of objects to be classified can change daily, making frequent model retraining impractical. Automating the identification step is therefore critical for improving operational efficiency. A vision model that could classify any set of objects by utilizing their corresponding CAD models and avoiding retraining would be highly beneficial in this setting. To enable systematic evaluation of vision models on this task, we introduce ThingiPrint, a new publicly available dataset that pairs CAD models with real photographs of their 3D-printed counterparts. Using ThingiPrint, we benchmark a range of existing vision models on the task of 3D-printed object classification. We additionally show that contrastive fine-tuning with a rotation-invariant objective allows effective prototype-based classification of previously unseen 3D-printed objects. By relying solely on the available CAD models, this avoids the need for retraining when new objects are introduced. Experiments show that this approach outperforms standard pretrained baselines, suggesting improved generalization and practical relevance for real-world use.
summary_zh: 三维打印物体的可靠分类对于工业增材制造中自动化后处理流程至关重要。尽管打印流程的其他阶段已经实现了广泛的自动化，但此项任务仍严重依赖于人工检查，因为待分类物体的集合每天都在变化，使得频繁的模型重训练不切实际。因此，自动化识别步骤对于提高运营效率至关重要。如果一种视觉模型能够利用对应CAD模型对任何一组物体进行分类，并避免重训练，那么在这种情况下将非常有益。为了能够系统地评估视觉模型在此任务上的性能，我们引入了ThingiPrint，这是一个新的公开数据集，它将CAD模型与其三维打印对应物的真实照片配对。通过使用ThingiPrint，我们对一系列现有的视觉模型在三维打印物体分类的任务上进行了基准测试。此外，我们还表明，使用旋转不变目标进行对比微调能够有效地对先前未见过的三维打印物体进行基于原型的分类。通过仅依赖可用的CAD模型，这种方法避免了引入新物体时进行重训练的需求。实验表明，该方法优于标准预训练基线，表明其具有更好的泛化能力和实际应用的相关性。
tldr: This paper introduces ThingiPrint, a dataset for classifying 3D-printed objects using CAD models, and proposes a contrastive fine-tuning approach that avoids retraining when classifying new objects, showing promising results for post-production automation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 ThingiPrint，一个使用 CAD 模型分类 3D 打印物体的数据库，并提出了一种对比微调方法，该方法在分类新物体时避免了重新训练。结果表明，该方法在增材制造的后处理自动化方面具有良好的应用前景。

title: Deep Incentive Design with Differentiable Equilibrium Blocks
summary: Automated design of multi-agent interactions with desirable equilibrium outcomes is inherently difficult due to the computational hardness, non-uniqueness, and instability of the resulting equilibria. In this work, we propose the use of game-agnostic differentiable equilibrium blocks (DEBs) as modules in a novel, differentiable framework to address a wide variety of incentive design problems from economics and computer science. We call this framework deep incentive design (DID). To validate our approach, we examine three diverse, challenging incentive design tasks: contract design, machine scheduling, and inverse equilibrium problems. For each task, we train a single neural network using a unified pipeline and DEB. This architecture solves the full distribution of problem instances, parameterized by a context, handling all games across a wide range of scales (from two to sixteen actions per player).
summary_zh: 由于计算上的困难、解的非唯一性和由此产生的均衡的不稳定性，自动设计具有理想均衡结果的多智能体交互本质上是困难的。 在这项工作中，我们提出使用与博弈无关的可微均衡块（DEB）作为一种新型可微框架中的模块，以解决来自经济学和计算机科学的各种激励设计问题。 我们称这个框架为深度激励设计（DID）。 为了验证我们的方法，我们研究了三个不同的、具有挑战性的激励设计任务：合约设计、机器调度和逆均衡问题。 对于每个任务，我们使用统一的流水线和DEB训练一个单独的神经网络。 该架构解决了由上下文参数化的完整问题实例分布，处理了各种规模（每个参与者从两个到十六个动作）的所有博弈。
tldr: This paper introduces Deep Incentive Design (DID), a differentiable framework using game-agnostic differentiable equilibrium blocks (DEBs) for automated multi-agent interaction design, demonstrating its effectiveness across contract design, machine scheduling, and inverse equilibrium problems.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了深度激励设计（DID），一个使用与博弈无关的可微均衡块（DEBs）的可微框架，用于自动多智能体交互设计，并在合同设计、机器调度和逆均衡问题中展示了其有效性。

title: Cost-Driven Representation Learning for Linear Quadratic Gaussian Control: Part II
summary: We study the problem of state representation learning for control from partial and potentially high-dimensional observations. We approach this problem via cost-driven state representation learning, in which we learn a dynamical model in a latent state space by predicting cumulative costs. In particular, we establish finite-sample guarantees on finding a near-optimal representation function and a near-optimal controller using the learned latent model for infinite-horizon time-invariant Linear Quadratic Gaussian (LQG) control. We study two approaches to cost-driven representation learning, which differ in whether the transition function of the latent state is learned explicitly or implicitly. The first approach has also been investigated in Part I of this work, for finite-horizon time-varying LQG control. The second approach closely resembles MuZero, a recent breakthrough in empirical reinforcement learning, in that it learns latent dynamics implicitly by predicting cumulative costs. A key technical contribution of this Part II is to prove persistency of excitation for a new stochastic process that arises from the analysis of quadratic regression in our approach, and may be of independent interest.
summary_zh: 我们研究了从部分且潜在高维观测中学习状态表征用于控制的问题。我们通过代价驱动的状态表征学习方法解决这一问题，在该方法中，我们通过预测累积代价来在潜在状态空间中学习一个动力学模型。特别地，我们确立了在无限时间跨度、时不变的线性二次高斯（LQG）控制中，使用学习到的潜在模型找到一个近优表征函数和一个近优控制器的有限样本保证。我们研究了两种代价驱动的表征学习方法，这两种方法的不同之处在于是否显式或隐式地学习潜在状态的转移函数。第一种方法也在本文的第一部分中针对有限时间跨度、时变的LQG控制进行了研究。第二种方法与最近在经验强化学习中取得突破的MuZero非常相似，因为它通过预测累积代价来隐式地学习潜在动态。本文第二部分的一个关键技术贡献是证明了我们方法中二次回归分析所产生的一种新的随机过程的持续激励性，这可能具有独立的意义。
tldr: This paper presents finite-sample guarantees for cost-driven state representation learning for infinite-horizon LQG control, using both explicit and implicit (MuZero-like) latent dynamics learning, and proves persistency of excitation for a new stochastic process.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了无限范围 LQG 控制的成本驱动状态表征学习，提出了使用显式和隐式（类似 MuZero）潜在动态学习的有限样本保证，并证明了一种新的随机过程的持续激励。

title: Low-Cost Teleoperation Extension for Mobile Manipulators
summary: Teleoperation of mobile bimanual manipulators requires simultaneous control of high-dimensional systems, often necessitating expensive specialized equipment. We present an open-source teleoperation framework that enables intuitive whole body control using readily available commodity hardware. Our system combines smartphone-based head tracking for camera control, leader arms for bilateral manipulation, and foot pedals for hands-free base navigation. Using a standard smartphone with IMU and display, we eliminate the need for costly VR helmets while maintaining immersive visual feedback. The modular architecture integrates seamlessly with the XLeRobot framework, but can be easily adapted to other types of mobile manipulators. We validate our approach through user studies that demonstrate improved task performance and reduced cognitive load compared to keyboard-based control.
summary_zh: 移动双臂机器人的遥操作需要同时控制高维系统，通常需要昂贵的专用设备。本文提出一个开源遥操作框架，该框架能够使用现成的通用硬件实现直观的全身控制。我们的系统结合了基于智能手机的头部跟踪用于相机控制，引导臂用于双边操作，以及脚踏板用于免手持底盘导航。通过使用带有IMU和显示器的标准智能手机，我们消除了对昂贵VR头盔的需求，同时保持了沉浸式视觉反馈。模块化架构与XLeRobot框架无缝集成，但可以轻松地适应其他类型的移动机器人。我们通过用户研究验证了我们的方法，结果表明与基于键盘的控制相比，任务性能得到了提高，认知负荷得到了降低。
tldr: This paper introduces a low-cost, open-source teleoperation framework for mobile manipulators using commodity hardware like smartphones and leader arms, demonstrating improved task performance and reduced cognitive load compared to keyboard control in user studies.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种低成本的开源移动机械臂遥操作框架，该框架使用智能手机和引导臂等商用硬件，并通过用户研究表明，与基于键盘的控制相比，该框架提高了任务性能并降低了认知负荷。

title: Model-Based and Neural-Aided Approaches for Dog Dead Reckoning
summary: Modern canine applications span medical and service roles, while robotic legged dogs serve as autonomous platforms for high-risk industrial inspection, disaster response, and search and rescue operations. For both, accurate positioning remains a significant challenge due to the cumulative drift inherent in inertial sensing. To bridge this gap, we propose three algorithms for accurate positioning using only inertial sensors, collectively referred to as dog dead reckoning (DDR). To evaluate our approaches, we designed DogMotion, a wearable unit for canine data recording. Using DogMotion, we recorded a dataset of 13 minutes. Additionally, we utilized a robotic legged dog dataset with a duration of 116 minutes. Across the two distinct datasets we demonstrate that our neural-aided methods consistently outperform model-based approaches, achieving an absolute distance error of less than 10\%. Consequently, we provide a lightweight and low-cost positioning solution for both biological and legged robotic dogs. To support reproducibility, our codebase and associated datasets have been made publicly available.
summary_zh: 现代犬类应用涵盖医疗和服务领域，而机器人四足犬则作为自主平台，应用于高风险工业检测、灾害响应以及搜寻和救援行动。对于两者而言，精确的定位依然是一个显著的挑战，这主要是由于惯性传感固有的累积漂移。 为弥合这一差距，我们提出了三种仅使用惯性传感器的精确定位算法，统称为犬类航位推算（DDR）。为了评估我们的方法，我们设计了DogMotion，一种用于犬类数据记录的可穿戴设备。利用DogMotion，我们记录了一个13分钟的数据集。此外，我们还利用了一个时长为116分钟的机器人四足犬数据集。在两个不同的数据集上，我们证明了我们的神经辅助方法始终优于基于模型的方法，实现了小于10%的绝对距离误差。因此，我们为生物犬和机器人四足犬提供了一种轻量化、低成本的定位解决方案。为了支持可复现性，我们的代码库和相关数据集已公开可用。
tldr: This paper introduces three inertial-sensor-based algorithms for accurate dog (biological and robotic) dead reckoning, termed DDR, and demonstrates the superiority of neural-aided methods in two datasets achieving less than 10% absolute distance error. The code and datasets are publicly available.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了三种基于惯性传感器的精确犬类（生物和机器人）航位推算算法，称为DDR，并在两个数据集中证明了神经辅助方法的优越性，实现了小于10%的绝对距离误差。代码和数据集已公开。

title: ACCURATE: Arbitrary-shaped Continuum Reconstruction Under Robust Adaptive Two-view Estimation
summary: Accurate reconstruction of arbitrary-shaped long slender continuum bodies, such as guidewires, catheters and other soft continuum manipulators, is essential for accurate mechanical simulation. However, existing image-based reconstruction approaches often suffer from limited accuracy because they often underutilize camera geometry, or lack generality as they rely on rigid geometric assumptions that may fail for continuum robots with complex and highly deformable shapes. To address these limitations, we propose ACCURATE, a 3D reconstruction framework integrating an image segmentation neural network with a geometry-constrained topology traversal and dynamic programming algorithm that enforces global biplanar geometric consistency, minimizes the cumulative point-to-epipolar-line distance, and remains robust to occlusions and epipolar ambiguities cases caused by noise and discretization. Our method achieves high reconstruction accuracy on both simulated and real phantom datasets acquired using a clinical X-ray C-arm system, with mean absolute errors below 1.0 mm.
summary_zh: 对任意形状的细长连续体（如导丝、导管和其他软性连续体机械臂）进行精确重建对于准确的力学仿真至关重要。然而，现有的基于图像的重建方法通常精度有限，因为它们常常未能充分利用相机几何信息，或者缺乏通用性，原因是它们依赖于刚性几何假设，而这些假设可能无法适用于具有复杂和高度可变形形状的连续体机器人。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出 ACCURATE，一个3D重建框架，其集成了图像分割神经网络以及几何约束的拓扑遍历和动态规划算法。该算法实施全局双平面几何一致性，最小化累积的点到对极线距离，并对由噪声和离散化引起的遮挡和对极模糊情况保持鲁棒性。我们的方法在使用临床X射线C臂系统获取的模拟和真实体模数据集上都实现了高重建精度，平均绝对误差低于1.0毫米。
tldr: The paper introduces ACCURATE, a 3D reconstruction framework for arbitrary-shaped continuum bodies using image segmentation, geometry constraints, and dynamic programming to achieve high accuracy with clinical X-ray data.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为ACCURATE的三维重建框架，用于重建任意形状的连续体，该框架结合了图像分割、几何约束和动态规划，以临床X射线数据实现高精度。

title: Cable-driven Continuum Robotics: Proprioception via Proximal-integrated Force Sensing
summary: Micro-scale continuum robots face significant limitations in achieving three-dimensional contact force perception, primarily due to structural miniaturization, nonlinear mechanical, and sensor integration. To overcome these limitations, this paper introduces a novel proprioception method for cable-driven continuum robots based on proximal-integrated force sensing (i.e., cable tension and six-axis force/torque (F/T) sensor), inspired by the tendon-joint collaborative sensing mechanism of the finger. By integrating biomechanically inspired design principles with nonlinear modeling, the proposed method addresses the challenge of force perception (including the three-dimensional contact force and the location of the contact point) and shape estimation in micro-scale continuum robots. First, a quasi-bionic mapping between human tissues/organs and robot components is established, enabling the transfer of the integrated sensing strategy of tendons, joints, and neural feedback to the robotic system. Second, a multimodal perception strategy is developed based on the structural constraints inherent to continuum robots. The complex relationships among mechanical and material nonlinearities, robot motion states, and contact forces are formulated as an optimization problem to reduce the perception complexity. Finally, experimental validation demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed method. This work lays the foundation for developing safer and smarter continuum robots, enabling broader clinical adoption in complex environments.
summary_zh: 微型连续体机器人在实现三维接触力感知方面面临重大限制，主要原因是结构小型化、非线性力学以及传感器集成。为了克服这些限制，本文提出了一种基于近端集成力感知（即，拉索张力和六轴力/力矩(F/T)传感器）的拉索驱动连续体机器人新型本体感知方法，其灵感来源于手指的肌腱-关节协同感知机制。通过将仿生学设计原则与非线性建模相结合，该方法解决了微型连续体机器人中的力感知（包括三维接触力和接触点位置）和形状估计的难题。首先，建立了人体组织/器官与机器人组件之间的准仿生映射关系，从而可以将肌腱、关节和神经反馈的集成感知策略转移到机器人系统中。其次，基于连续体机器人固有的结构约束，开发了一种多模态感知策略。力学和材料非线性、机器人运动状态和接触力之间的复杂关系被公式化为一个优化问题，以降低感知复杂性。最后，实验验证证明了该方法的有效性。这项工作为开发更安全、更智能的连续体机器人奠定了基础，使其能够在复杂的环境中得到更广泛的临床应用。
tldr: The paper presents a proprioception method for cable-driven continuum robots using proximal-integrated force sensing for 3D contact force perception and shape estimation, addressing limitations in micro-scale robots.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于近端集成力感测的缆索驱动连续体机器人的本体感受方法，用于三维接触力感知和形状估计，解决了微型机器人中的局限性。

title: A Lightweight Digital-Twin-Based Framework for Edge-Assisted Vehicle Tracking and Collision Prediction
summary: Vehicle tracking, motion estimation, and collision prediction are fundamental components of traffic safety and management in Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS).
