Many recent approaches rely on computationally intensive prediction models, which limits their practical deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. This paper presents a lightweight digital-twin-based framework for vehicle tracking and spatiotemporal collision prediction that relies solely on object detection, without requiring complex trajectory prediction networks. The framework is implemented and evaluated in Quanser Interactive Labs (QLabs), a high-fidelity digital twin of an urban traffic environment that enables controlled and repeatable scenario generation. A YOLO-based detector is deployed on simulated edge cameras to localize vehicles and extract frame-level centroid trajectories. Offline path maps are constructed from multiple traversals and indexed using K-D trees to support efficient online association between detected vehicles and road segments. During runtime, consistent vehicle identifiers are maintained, vehicle speed and direction are estimated from the temporal evolution of path indices, and future positions are predicted accordingly. Potential collisions are identified by analyzing both spatial proximity and temporal overlap of predicted future trajectories. Our experimental results across diverse simulated urban scenarios show that the proposed framework predicts approximately 88% of collision events prior to occurrence while maintaining low computational overhead suitable for edge deployment. Rather than introducing a computationally intensive prediction model, this work introduces a lightweight digital-twin-based solution for vehicle tracking and collision prediction, tailored for real-time edge deployment in ITS.
summary_zh: 车辆跟踪、运动估计和碰撞预测是智能交通系统(ITS)中交通安全和管理的基本组成部分。 许多最新的方法依赖于计算密集型的预测模型，这限制了它们在资源受限的边缘设备上的实际部署。 本文提出了一种基于轻量级数字孪生的车辆跟踪和时空碰撞预测框架，该框架仅依赖于目标检测，而无需复杂的轨迹预测网络。 该框架在 Quanser Interactive Labs (QLabs) 中实现和评估，QLabs 是一个高保真度的城市交通环境数字孪生体，能够生成可控和可重复的场景。 基于 YOLO 的检测器被部署在模拟边缘摄像头上，以定位车辆并提取帧级质心轨迹。 离线路径图是通过多次遍历构建的，并使用 K-D 树进行索引，以支持检测到的车辆与路段之间的高效在线关联。 在运行时，保持一致的车辆识别符，车辆速度和方向通过路径指数的时间演变来估计，并相应地预测未来的位置。 通过分析预测未来轨迹的空间邻近度和时间重叠来识别潜在的碰撞。 我们在各种模拟城市场景中的实验结果表明，所提出的框架在事件发生前预测了大约 88% 的碰撞事件，同时保持了适合边缘部署的低计算开销。 本文没有引入计算密集型的预测模型，而是引入了一种基于轻量级数字孪生的解决方案，用于车辆跟踪和碰撞预测，专为 ITS 中的实时边缘部署而设计。
tldr: The paper introduces a lightweight digital-twin framework for edge-assisted vehicle tracking and collision prediction using object detection and K-D trees, achieving 88% collision prediction accuracy in simulated urban scenarios while maintaining low computational overhead.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种轻量级的基于数字孪生的框架，用于边缘辅助的车辆跟踪和碰撞预测，该框架使用目标检测和 K-D 树，在模拟城市场景中实现了 88% 的碰撞预测准确率，同时保持了较低的计算开销。

title: Faster-HEAL: An Efficient and Privacy-Preserving Collaborative Perception Framework for Heterogeneous Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Collaborative perception (CP) is a promising paradigm for improving situational awareness in autonomous vehicles by overcoming the limitations of single-agent perception. However, most existing approaches assume homogeneous agents, which restricts their applicability in real-world scenarios where vehicles use diverse sensors and perception models. This heterogeneity introduces a feature domain gap that degrades detection performance. Prior works address this issue by retraining entire models/major components, or using feature interpreters for each new agent type, which is computationally expensive, compromises privacy, and may reduce single-agent accuracy. We propose Faster-HEAL, a lightweight and privacy-preserving CP framework that fine-tunes a low-rank visual prompt to align heterogeneous features with a unified feature space while leveraging pyramid fusion for robust feature aggregation. This approach reduces the trainable parameters by 94%, enabling efficient adaptation to new agents without retraining large models. Experiments on the OPV2V-H dataset show that Faster-HEAL improves detection performance by 2% over state-of-the-art methods with significantly lower computational overhead, offering a practical solution for scalable heterogeneous CP.
summary_zh: 协同感知(CP)是一种很有前景的范例，它可以通过克服单智能体感知的局限性来提高自动驾驶车辆的态势感知能力。然而，大多数现有方法都假设智能体是同质的，这限制了它们在车辆使用不同传感器和感知模型的现实场景中的适用性。这种异质性引入了特征域差距，从而降低了检测性能。先前的工作通过重新训练整个模型/主要组件，或为每种新型智能体使用特征解释器来解决这个问题，但这样做计算成本高昂，会损害隐私，并可能降低单智能体的精度。我们提出了Faster-HEAL，一种轻量级且保护隐私的CP框架，它通过微调低秩视觉提示来将异构特征与统一特征空间对齐，同时利用金字塔融合来实现鲁棒的特征聚合。这种方法减少了94%的可训练参数，从而无需重新训练大型模型即可高效地适应新的智能体。在OPV2V-H数据集上的实验表明，Faster-HEAL在计算开销显著降低的情况下，比最先进的方法的检测性能提高了2%，为可扩展的异构CP提供了一种实用的解决方案。
tldr: Faster-HEAL introduces a lightweight, privacy-preserving collaborative perception framework addressing feature heterogeneity in autonomous vehicle fleets by fine-tuning low-rank visual prompts and employing pyramid fusion, achieving improved detection performance with reduced computational overhead.
tldr_zh: Faster-HEAL 引入了一种轻量级、保护隐私的协作感知框架，通过微调低秩视觉提示和采用金字塔融合来解决自动驾驶车队中的特征异构性问题，从而以降低的计算开销实现更高的检测性能。

title: Ref-DGS: Reflective Dual Gaussian Splatting
summary: Reflective appearance, especially strong and typically near-field specular reflections, poses a fundamental challenge for accurate surface reconstruction and novel view synthesis. Existing Gaussian splatting methods either fail to model near-field specular reflections or rely on explicit ray tracing at substantial computational cost. We present Ref-DGS, a reflective dual Gaussian splatting framework that addresses this trade-off by decoupling surface reconstruction from specular reflection within an efficient rasterization-based pipeline. Ref-DGS introduces a dual Gaussian scene representation consisting of geometry Gaussians and complementary local reflection Gaussians that capture near-field specular interactions without explicit ray tracing, along with a global environment reflection field for modeling far-field specular reflections. To predict specular radiance, we further propose a lightweight, physically-aware adaptive mixing shader that fuses global and local reflection features. Experiments demonstrate that Ref-DGS achieves state-of-the-art performance on reflective scenes while training substantially faster than ray-based Gaussian methods.
summary_zh: 反射外观，特别是强烈且通常为近场的镜面反射，对精确的表面重建和新视角合成构成了一项根本挑战。现有的高斯溅射方法要么无法建模近场镜面反射，要么依赖于显式光线追踪，且计算成本巨大。我们提出了Ref-DGS，一个反射性双高斯溅射框架，通过在高效的基于光栅化的管线中解耦表面重建与镜面反射来解决这种权衡。Ref-DGS引入了一种双高斯场景表示，由几何高斯和互补性局部反射高斯组成，它们无需显式光线追踪即可捕捉近场镜面相互作用，同时利用全局环境反射场来建模远场镜面反射。为了预测镜面辐射，我们进一步提出了一种轻量级的、具有物理感知能力的自适应混合着色器，用于融合全局和局部反射特征。实验表明，Ref-DGS在反射场景上实现了最先进的性能，同时训练速度比基于光线的高斯方法快得多。
tldr: The paper introduces Ref-DGS, a novel Gaussian splatting framework that efficiently models specular reflections in complex scenes by decoupling surface reconstruction from specular reflection using a dual Gaussian representation and a learned mixing shader. It achieves state-of-the-art performance with faster training compared to ray-based methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Ref-DGS，一种新颖的高斯溅射框架，通过使用双高斯表示和学习的混合着色器将表面重建与镜面反射分离，从而有效地模拟复杂场景中的镜面反射。 与基于光线追踪的方法相比，它以更快的训练速度实现了最先进的性能。

title: Evaluating Synthetic Data for Baggage Trolley Detection in Airport Logistics
summary:
Efficient luggage trolley management is critical for reducing congestion and ensuring asset availability in modern airports. Automated detection systems face two main challenges. First, strict security and privacy regulations limit large-scale data collection. Second, existing public datasets lack the diversity, scale, and annotation quality needed to handle dense, overlapping trolley arrangements typical of real-world operations.
  To address these limitations, we introduce a synthetic data generation pipeline based on a high-fidelity Digital Twin of Algiers International Airport using NVIDIA Omniverse. The pipeline produces richly annotated data with oriented bounding boxes, capturing complex trolley formations, including tightly nested chains. We evaluate YOLO-OBB using five training strategies: real-only, synthetic-only, linear probing, full fine-tuning, and mixed training. This allows us to assess how synthetic data can complement limited real-world annotations.
  Our results show that mixed training with synthetic data and only 40 percent of real annotations matches or exceeds the full real-data baseline, achieving 0.94 mAP@50 and 0.77 mAP@50-95, while reducing annotation effort by 25 to 35 percent. Multi-seed experiments confirm strong reproducibility with a standard deviation below 0.01 on mAP@50, demonstrating the practical effectiveness of synthetic data for automated trolley detection.
summary_zh:
高效的行李手推车管理对于缓解现代机场的拥堵并确保资产可用性至关重要。 自动检测系统面临两个主要挑战。首先，严格的安全和隐私法规限制了大规模数据收集。其次，现有的公共数据集缺乏多样性、规模和标注质量，难以处理现实运营中常见的密集、重叠的手推车排列。
  为了解决这些局限性，我们引入了一种基于阿尔及尔国际机场高保真数字孪生的合成数据生成流程，该流程使用 NVIDIA Omniverse 构建。该流程生成带有方向边界框的丰富标注数据，从而捕捉复杂的手推车形态，包括紧密嵌套的链条。我们使用五种训练策略评估 YOLO-OBB：仅真实数据、仅合成数据、线性探测、完全微调和混合训练。 这使我们能够评估合成数据如何补充有限的真实世界标注。
  实验结果表明，使用合成数据和仅 40% 的真实标注进行的混合训练可以达到或超过完全依赖真实数据的基线，实现 0.94 mAP@50 和 0.77 mAP@50-95，同时减少 25% 至 35% 的标注工作量。多种子实验证实了良好的可重复性，mAP@50 的标准差低于 0.01，证明了合成数据在自动手推车检测中的实际有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces a synthetic data generation pipeline using a Digital Twin to train a baggage trolley detection system, achieving comparable performance to real data with reduced annotation effort.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种使用数字孪生技术生成合成数据的流程，用于训练行李手推车检测系统，并在减少标注工作量的同时，实现了与真实数据相当的性能。

title: Integration of deep generative Anomaly Detection algorithm in high-speed industrial line
summary: Industrial visual inspection in pharmaceutical production requires high accuracy under strict constraints on cycle time, hardware footprint, and operational cost. Manual inline inspection is still common, but it is affected by operator variability and limited throughput. Classical rule-based computer vision pipelines are often rigid and difficult to scale to highly variable production scenarios. To address these limitations, we present a semi-supervised anomaly detection framework based on a generative adversarial architecture with a residual autoencoder and a dense bottleneck, specifically designed for online deployment on a high-speed Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) line. The model is trained only on nominal samples and detects anomalies through reconstruction residuals, providing both classification and spatial localization via heatmaps. The training set contains 2,815,200 grayscale patches. Experiments on a real industrial test kit show high detection performance while satisfying timing constraints compatible with a 500 ms acquisition slot.
summary_zh: 制药生产中的工业视觉检测需要在严格的周期时间、硬件占用空间和运营成本限制下保持高精度。人工在线检测仍然很常见，但它受到操作员差异和有限吞吐量的影响。传统的基于规则的计算机视觉流程通常很僵化，难以扩展到高度可变的生产场景。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种基于生成对抗网络的半监督异常检测框架，该网络具有残差自编码器和密集瓶颈，专门为高速吹灌封（BFS）生产线的在线部署而设计。该模型仅使用合格样本进行训练，并通过重建残差检测异常，从而通过热图提供分类和空间定位。训练集包含2,815,200个灰度图像块。在真实工业测试套件上的实验表明，该模型具有较高的检测性能，同时满足与500毫秒采集时间窗口兼容的时序约束。
tldr: This paper presents a semi-supervised anomaly detection framework using a generative adversarial network with a residual autoencoder, designed for real-time industrial visual inspection on a high-speed production line and demonstrates high detection performance with strict timing constraints.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于生成对抗网络的半监督异常检测框架，该框架使用残差自编码器，专为高速生产线上的实时工业视觉检测而设计，并在严格的时间约束下展示了高检测性能。

title: COOL-MC: Verifying and Explaining RL Policies for Multi-bridge Network Maintenance
summary: Aging bridge networks require proactive, verifiable, and interpretable maintenance strategies, yet reinforcement learning (RL) policies trained solely on reward signals provide no formal safety guarantees and remain opaque to infrastructure managers. We demonstrate COOL-MC as a tool for verifying and explaining RL policies for multi-bridge network maintenance, building on a single-bridge Markov decision process (MDP) from the literature and extending it to a parallel network of three heterogeneous bridges with a shared periodic budget constraint, encoded in the PRISM modeling language. We train an RL agent on this MDP and apply probabilistic model checking and explainability methods to the induced discrete-time Markov chain (DTMC) that arises from the interaction between the learned policy and the underlying MDP. Probabilistic model checking reveals that the trained policy has a safety-violation probability of 3.5\% over the planning horizon, being slightly above the theoretical minimum of 0\% and indicating the suboptimality of the learned policy, noting that these results are based on artificially constructed transition probabilities and deterioration rates rather than real-world data, so absolute performance figures should be interpreted with caution. The explainability analysis further reveals, for instance, a systematic bias in the trained policy toward the state of bridge 1 over the remaining bridges in the network. These results demonstrate COOL-MC's ability to provide formal, interpretable, and practical analysis of RL maintenance policies.
summary_zh: 老化的桥梁网络需要主动、可验证和可解释的维护策略，然而仅基于奖励信号训练的强化学习 (RL) 策略无法提供形式化的安全保证，并且对基础设施管理者来说仍然不透明。我们展示了COOL-MC作为一个工具，用于验证和解释多桥梁网络维护的RL策略，它建立在文献中提出的单桥梁马尔可夫决策过程 (MDP) 的基础上，并将其扩展到具有共享周期性预算约束的三个异构桥梁的并行网络，使用PRISM建模语言进行编码。我们在该MDP上训练了一个RL智能体，并应用概率模型检查和可解释性方法来分析由学习到的策略与底层MDP相互作用而产生的离散时间马尔可夫链 (DTMC)。概率模型检查表明，训练后的策略在规划范围内具有3.5%的安全违规概率，略高于0%的理论最小值，表明学习到的策略并非最优。需要注意的是，这些结果基于人为构建的转移概率和劣化速率，而不是真实世界的数据，因此对绝对性能数据的解释应持谨慎态度。可解释性分析进一步揭示，例如，训练后的策略对网络中桥梁1的状态存在系统性偏差，而忽略了其余桥梁。这些结果证明了COOL-MC能够为RL维护策略提供形式化、可解释和实用的分析。
tldr: The paper introduces COOL-MC, a tool for verifying and explaining RL policies in multi-bridge network maintenance, using probabilistic model checking and explainability methods to analyze learned policies for a three-bridge system.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了COOL-MC，一个用于验证和解释多桥网络维护中强化学习策略的工具，使用概率模型检查和可解释性方法来分析所学策略，应用于三桥系统。

title: Dynamic Vehicle Routing Problem with Prompt Confirmation of Advance Requests
summary: Transit agencies that operate on-demand transportation services have to respond to trip requests from passengers in real time, which involves solving dynamic vehicle routing problems with pick-up and drop-off constraints. Based on discussions with public transit agencies, we observe a real-world problem that is not addressed by prior work: when trips are booked in advance (e.g., trip requests arrive a few hours in advance of their requested pick-up times), the agency needs to promptly confirm whether a request can be accepted or not, and ensure that accepted requests are served as promised. State-of-the-art computational approaches either provide prompt confirmation but lack the ability to continually optimize and improve routes for accepted requests, or they provide continual optimization but cannot guarantee serving all accepted requests. To address this gap, we introduce a novel problem formulation of dynamic vehicle routing with prompt confirmation and continual optimization. We propose a novel computational approach for this vehicle routing problem, which integrates a quick insertion search for prompt confirmation with an anytime algorithm for continual optimization. To maximize the number requests served, we train a non-myopic objective function using reinforcement learning, which guides both the insertion and the anytime algorithms towards optimal, non-myopic solutions. We evaluate our computational approach on a real-world microtransit dataset from a public transit agency in the U.S., demonstrating that our proposed approach provides prompt confirmation while significantly increasing the number of requests served compared to existing approaches.
summary_zh: 运营按需交通服务的公交机构必须实时响应乘客的出行请求，这涉及到解决带有取货和送货约束的动态车辆路径问题。基于与公共交通机构的讨论，我们观察到一个现实世界的问题，之前的研究并未涉及：当提前预订行程时（例如，出行请求比请求的取货时间提前几个小时到达），机构需要迅速确认是否可以接受请求，并确保已接受的请求得到如期服务。现有的最先进的计算方法要么提供快速确认，但缺乏持续优化和改进已接受请求的路线的能力，要么提供持续优化，但无法保证服务所有已接受的请求。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了一种新的动态车辆路径问题公式，其特点是快速确认和持续优化。我们为该车辆路径问题提出了一种新的计算方法，该方法集成了用于快速确认的快速插入搜索和用于持续优化的随时算法。为了最大化服务的请求数量，我们使用强化学习训练一个非近视的目标函数，该函数引导插入和随时算法朝着最优、非近视的解决方案发展。我们在美国一家公共交通机构的真实微公交数据集上评估了我们的计算方法，结果表明，与现有方法相比，我们提出的方法在提供快速确认的同时，显著增加了服务的请求数量。
tldr: This paper introduces a dynamic vehicle routing problem with prompt confirmation for on-demand transportation services. They propose a novel approach combining quick insertion search and an anytime algorithm, trained with reinforcement learning, and demonstrate its effectiveness on real-world data.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种具有即时确认功能的动态车辆路径问题，用于按需交通服务。他们提出了一种新颖的方法，结合了快速插入搜索和随时算法，通过强化学习进行训练，并在真实世界的数据上证明了其有效性。

title: Learning Context-Adaptive Motion Priors for Masked Motion Diffusion Models with Efficient Kinematic Attention Aggregation
summary: Vision-based motion capture solutions often struggle with occlusions, which result in the loss of critical joint information and hinder accurate 3D motion reconstruction. Other wearable alternatives also suffer from noisy or unstable data, often requiring extensive manual cleaning and correction to achieve reliable results. To address these challenges, we introduce the Masked Motion Diffusion Model (MMDM), a diffusion-based generative reconstruction framework that enhances incomplete or low-confidence motion data using partially available high-quality reconstructions within a Masked Autoencoder architecture. Central to our design is the Kinematic Attention Aggregation (KAA) mechanism, which enables efficient, deep, and iterative encoding of both joint-level and pose-level features, capturing structural and temporal motion patterns essential for task-specific reconstruction. We focus on learning context-adaptive motion priors, specialized structural and temporal features extracted by the same reusable architecture, where each learned prior emphasizes different aspects of motion dynamics and is specifically efficient for its corresponding task. This enables the architecture to adaptively specialize without altering its structure. Such versatility allows MMDM to efficiently learn motion priors tailored to scenarios such as motion refinement, completion, and in-betweening. Extensive evaluations on public benchmarks demonstrate that MMDM achieves strong performance across diverse masking strategies and task settings. The source code is available at https://github.com/jjkislele/MMDM.
summary_zh: 基于视觉的动作捕捉方案常常受限于遮挡问题，导致关键关节信息的丢失，阻碍了精确的3D动作重建。其他可穿戴替代方案也存在数据噪声大或不稳定等问题，通常需要大量的人工清理和校正才能获得可靠的结果。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了掩码运动扩散模型（MMDM），这是一个基于扩散的生成式重建框架，它利用掩码自编码器架构中部分可用的高质量重建来增强不完整或低置信度的运动数据。我们设计的核心是运动学注意力聚合（KAA）机制，它能够高效、深入且迭代地编码关节级和姿态级特征，从而捕捉对特定任务重建至关重要的结构和时间运动模式。我们专注于学习上下文自适应的运动先验，这些先验是由相同的可重用架构提取的专业结构和时间特征，其中每个学习到的先验都强调运动动力学的不同方面，并且对于其相应的任务特别有效。这使得该架构能够在不改变其结构的情况下自适应地专门化。这种通用性使得MMDM能够有效地学习针对运动细化、补全和中间帧生成等场景定制的运动先验。在公共基准数据集上的广泛评估表明，MMDM在不同的掩码策略和任务设置下都取得了优异的性能。源代码可在https://github.com/jjkislele/MMDM 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces a Masked Motion Diffusion Model (MMDM) that uses kinematic attention to improve motion capture reconstruction from incomplete or noisy data by learning task-specific motion priors. It demonstrates strong performance in motion refinement, completion, and in-betweening tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种 Masked Motion Diffusion Model (MMDM)，该模型利用运动学注意力通过学习特定于任务的运动先验来改进来自不完整或噪声数据的运动捕捉重建。它在运动细化、补全和插值任务中表现出强大的性能。

title: Fast Attention-Based Simplification of LiDAR Point Clouds for Object Detection and Classification
summary: LiDAR point clouds are widely used in autonomous driving and consist of large numbers of 3D points captured at high frequency to represent surrounding objects such as vehicles, pedestrians, and traffic signs. While this dense data enables accurate perception, it also increases computational cost and power consumption, which can limit real-time deployment. Existing point cloud sampling methods typically face a trade-off: very fast approaches tend to reduce accuracy, while more accurate methods are computationally expensive. To address this limitation, we propose an efficient learned point cloud simplification method for LiDAR data. The method combines a feature embedding module with an attention-based sampling module to prioritize task-relevant regions and is trained end-to-end. We evaluate the method against farthest point sampling (FPS) and random sampling (RS) on 3D object detection on the KITTI dataset and on object classification across four datasets. The method was consistently faster than FPS and achieved similar, and in some settings better, accuracy, with the largest gains under aggressive downsampling. It was slower than RS, but it typically preserved accuracy more reliably at high sampling ratios.
summary_zh: 激光雷达点云在自动驾驶中被广泛应用，它由以高频率捕获的大量3D点组成，用于表示周围的物体，如车辆、行人及交通标志。虽然这种密集数据能够实现精确感知，但同时也增加了计算成本和功耗，这会限制实时部署。现有的点云采样方法通常面临一种权衡：速度很快的方法往往会降低精度，而更精确的方法则计算成本高昂。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了一种高效的、基于学习的激光雷达点云简化方法。该方法结合了特征嵌入模块和基于注意力机制的采样模块，以优先处理任务相关的区域，并进行端到端训练。我们针对KITTI数据集上的3D目标检测以及跨四个数据集的目标分类，评估了该方法与最远点采样（FPS）和随机采样（RS）的对比性能。该方法始终比FPS更快，并且在一些设置中取得了相似甚至更好的精度，在激进的降采样下优势最为明显。它比RS慢，但通常在高采样率下能更可靠地保持精度。
tldr: This paper introduces a fast, attention-based LiDAR point cloud simplification method for object detection and classification, achieving comparable or better accuracy than Farthest Point Sampling (FPS) with improved speed, particularly under aggressive downsampling.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于注意力的快速LiDAR点云简化方法，用于物体检测和分类。该方法在精度上与最远点采样（FPS）相当或更好，且速度更快，尤其是在激进的降采样情况下。

title: Scale-Aware UAV-to-Satellite Cross-View Geo-Localization: A Semantic Geometric Approach
summary: Cross-View Geo-Localization (CVGL) between UAV imagery and satellite images plays a crucial role in target localization and UAV self-positioning. However, most existing methods rely on the idealized assumption of scale consistency between UAV queries and satellite galleries, overlooking the severe scale ambiguity commonly encountered in real-world scenarios. This discrepancy leads to field-of-view misalignment and feature mismatch, significantly degrading CVGL robustness. To address this issue, we propose a geometric framework that recovers the absolute metric scale from monocular UAV images using semantic anchors. Specifically, small vehicles (SVs), characterized by relatively stable prior size distributions and high detectability, are exploited as metric references. A Decoupled Stereoscopic Projection Model is introduced to estimate the absolute image scale from these semantic targets. By decomposing vehicle dimensions into radial and tangential components, the model compensates for perspective distortions in 2D detections of 3D vehicles, enabling more accurate scale estimation. To further reduce intra-class size variation and detection noise, a dual-dimension fusion strategy with Interquartile Range (IQR)-based robust aggregation is employed. The estimated global scale is then used as a physical constraint for scale-adaptive satellite image cropping, improving UAV-to-satellite feature alignment. Experiments on augmented DenseUAV and UAV-VisLoc datasets demonstrate that the proposed method significantly improves CVGL robustness under unknown UAV image scales. Additionally, the framework shows strong potential for downstream applications such as passive UAV altitude estimation and 3D model scale recovery.
summary_zh: 无人机影像与卫星影像之间的跨视角地理定位（CVGL）在目标定位和无人机自主定位中起着至关重要的作用。然而，大多数现有方法依赖于无人机查询影像和卫星图库之间尺度一致的理想化假设，忽略了实际场景中常见的严重尺度模糊性。这种差异导致视场失准和特征不匹配，显著降低了CVGL的鲁棒性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种几何框架，利用语义锚点从单目无人机影像中恢复绝对度量尺度。具体来说，具有相对稳定的先验尺寸分布和高可检测性的小型车辆（SVs）被用作度量参考。我们引入了一种解耦立体投影模型，以从这些语义目标中估计绝对图像尺度。通过将车辆尺寸分解为径向和切向分量，该模型补偿了3D车辆的2D检测中的透视畸变，从而能够更准确地进行尺度估计。为了进一步减少类内尺寸变化和检测噪声，我们采用了一种基于四分位距（IQR）的鲁棒聚合的双维度融合策略。估计的全局尺度随后被用作比例自适应卫星图像裁剪的物理约束，从而改善了无人机到卫星的特征对齐。在增强的DenseUAV和UAV-VisLoc数据集上的实验表明，所提出的方法显著提高了未知无人机图像尺度下的CVGL鲁棒性。此外，该框架显示出在被动无人机高度估计和3D模型尺度恢复等下游应用中的强大潜力。
tldr: This paper proposes a geometric framework for UAV-to-satellite cross-view geo-localization that addresses the scale ambiguity problem by using semantic anchors (small vehicles) to estimate the absolute metric scale from monocular UAV images, enabling scale-adaptive satellite image cropping and improved feature alignment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于无人机到卫星的跨视角地理定位的几何框架，通过使用语义锚点（小型车辆）从单目无人机图像中估计绝对度量尺度，从而解决尺度模糊问题，实现尺度自适应的卫星图像裁剪并改进特征对齐。

title: Selective Transfer Learning of Cross-Modality Distillation for Monocular 3D Object Detection
summary: Monocular 3D object detection is a promising yet ill-posed task for autonomous vehicles due to the lack of accurate depth information. Cross-modality knowledge distillation could effectively transfer depth information from LiDAR to image-based network. However, modality gap between image and LiDAR seriously limits its accuracy. In this paper, we systematically investigate the negative transfer problem induced by modality gap in cross-modality distillation for the first time, including not only the architecture inconsistency issue but more importantly the feature overfitting issue. We propose a selective learning approach named MonoSTL to overcome these issues, which encourages positive transfer of depth information from LiDAR while alleviates the negative transfer on image-based network. On the one hand, we utilize similar architectures to ensure spatial alignment of features between image-based and LiDAR-based networks. On the other hand, we develop two novel distillation modules, namely Depth-Aware Selective Feature Distillation (DASFD) and Depth-Aware Selective Relation Distillation (DASRD), which selectively learn positive features and relationships of objects by integrating depth uncertainty into feature and relation distillations, respectively. Our approach can be seamlessly integrated into various CNN-based and DETR-based models, where we take three recent models on KITTI and a recent model on NuScenes for validation. Extensive experiments show that our approach considerably improves the accuracy of the base models and thereby achieves the best accuracy compared with all recently released SOTA models.
summary_zh: 单目3D目标检测对于自动驾驶车辆来说是一项很有前景但又病态的任务，因为缺乏精确的深度信息。跨模态知识蒸馏可以有效地将深度信息从激光雷达传递到基于图像的网络。然而，图像和激光雷达之间的模态差异严重限制了其准确性。本文首次系统地研究了跨模态蒸馏中由模态差异引起的负迁移问题，不仅包括架构不一致问题，更重要的是特征过拟合问题。我们提出了一种名为MonoSTL的选择性学习方法来克服这些问题，该方法鼓励从激光雷达对深度信息的正迁移，同时减轻图像基网络的负迁移。一方面，我们利用相似的架构来确保基于图像和基于激光雷达的网络之间的特征空间对齐。另一方面，我们开发了两个新的蒸馏模块，即深度感知选择性特征蒸馏（DASFD）和深度感知选择性关系蒸馏（DASRD），它们通过将深度不确定性集成到特征和关系蒸馏中，分别选择性地学习对象的正特征和关系。我们的方法可以无缝地集成到各种基于CNN和基于DETR的模型中，我们选取了KITTI上的三个最新模型和NuScenes上的一个最新模型进行验证。大量实验表明，我们的方法显著提高了基础模型的准确性，从而与所有最近发布的SOTA模型相比，实现了最佳的准确性。
tldr: The paper introduces MonoSTL, a selective transfer learning approach for monocular 3D object detection that addresses negative transfer in cross-modality distillation by selectively learning positive features and relationships from LiDAR data. They achieve SOTA results on KITTI and NuScenes.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为MonoSTL的选择性迁移学习方法，用于单目3D目标检测。该方法通过选择性地学习来自激光雷达数据的积极特征和关系，解决了跨模态蒸馏中的负迁移问题。他们在KITTI和NuScenes上取得了SOTA结果。

title: DogWeave: High-Fidelity 3D Canine Reconstruction from a Single Image via Normal Fusion and Conditional Inpainting
summary: Monocular 3D animal reconstruction is challenging due to complex articulation, self-occlusion, and fine-scale details such as fur. Existing methods often produce distorted geometry and inconsistent textures due to the lack of articulated 3D supervision and limited availability of back-view images in 2D datasets, which makes reconstructing unobserved regions particularly difficult. To address these limitations, we propose DogWeave, a model-based framework for reconstructing high-fidelity 3D canine models from a single RGB image. DogWeave improves geometry by refining a coarsely-initiated parametric mesh into a detailed SDF representation through multi-view normal field optimization using diffusion-enhanced normals. It then generates view-consistent textures through conditional partial inpainting guided by structure and style cues, enabling realistic reconstruction of unobserved regions. Using only about 7,000 dog images processed via our 2D pipeline for training, DogWeave produces complete, realistic 3D models and outperforms state-of-the-art single image to 3d reconstruction methods in both shape accuracy and texture realism for canines.
summary_zh: 单目3D动物重建极具挑战性，原因在于复杂的关节运动、自遮挡以及毛发等精细尺度细节。现有方法常常由于缺乏关节化的3D监督以及2D数据集中背面图像的有限性而产生扭曲的几何结构和不一致的纹理，这使得重建未观察到的区域尤其困难。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出DogWeave，一个基于模型的框架，用于从单张RGB图像重建高保真的3D犬类模型。DogWeave通过使用扩散增强法线进行多视角法线场优化，将粗略初始化的参数网格细化为详细的SDF表示，从而改进几何结构。然后，它通过结构和风格线索引导的有条件部分图像修复，生成视角一致的纹理，从而实现未观察到区域的真实重建。仅使用通过我们的2D流程处理的大约7000张狗图像进行训练，DogWeave就能生成完整、真实的3D模型，并且在犬类的形状精度和纹理真实性方面，优于最先进的单图到3D重建方法。
tldr: DogWeave proposes a novel model-based framework for high-fidelity 3D canine reconstruction from a single image, using normal fusion and conditional inpainting to overcome challenges in geometry and texture generation.
tldr_zh: DogWeave 提出了一个新颖的基于模型的框架，用于从单张图像进行高保真 3D 犬类重建，使用法线融合和条件补全来克服几何和纹理生成中的挑战。

title: Constraints Matrix Diffusion based Generative Neural Solver for Vehicle Routing Problems
summary: Over the past decade, neural network solvers powered by generative artificial intelligence have garnered significant attention in the domain of vehicle routing problems (VRPs), owing to their exceptional computational efficiency and superior reasoning capabilities. In particular, autoregressive solvers integrated with reinforcement learning have emerged as a prominent trend. However, much of the existing work emphasizes large-scale generalization of neural approaches while neglecting the limited robustness of attention-based methods across heterogeneous distributions of problem parameters. Their improvements over heuristic search remain largely restricted to hand-curated, fixed-distribution benchmarks. Furthermore, these architectures tend to degrade significantly when node representations are highly similar or when tasks involve long decision horizons. To address the aforementioned limitations, we propose a novel fusion neural network framework that employs a discrete noise graph diffusion model to learn the underlying constraints of vehicle routing problems and generate a constraint assignment matrix. This matrix is subsequently integrated adaptively into the feature representation learning and decision process of the autoregressive solver, serving as a graph structure mask that facilitates the formation of solutions characterized by both global vision and local feature integration. To the best of our knowledge, this work represents the first comprehensive experimental investigation of neural network model solvers across a 378-combinatorial space spanning four distinct dimensions within the CVRPlib public dataset. Extensive experimental evaluations demonstrate that our proposed fusion model effectively captures and leverages problem constraints, achieving state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmark datasets.
summary_zh: 近年来，受生成式人工智能驱动的神经网络求解器因其卓越的计算效率和优越的推理能力，在车辆路径问题（VRPs）领域备受关注。特别地，集成了强化学习的自回归求解器已成为一种显著趋势。然而，现有的大部分工作侧重于神经网络方法的大规模泛化，而忽略了基于注意力机制的方法在异构问题参数分布下的有限鲁棒性。它们相对于启发式搜索的改进，主要局限于精心设计的固定分布基准测试。此外，这些架构在节点表示高度相似或任务涉及长决策周期时，往往会显著退化。为了解决上述局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的融合神经网络框架，该框架采用离散噪声图扩散模型来学习车辆路径问题的底层约束并生成约束分配矩阵。该矩阵随后自适应地集成到自回归求解器的特征表示学习和决策过程中，充当图结构掩码，促进形成兼具全局视野和局部特征集成特性的解。据我们所知，这项工作代表了首次在CVRPlib公共数据集的四个不同维度内，对跨越378-组合空间的神经网络模型求解器进行全面的实验研究。大量的实验评估表明，我们提出的融合模型能够有效地捕获和利用问题约束，在多个基准数据集上实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel neural network framework using a discrete noise graph diffusion model to learn and apply VRP constraints, improving the performance of autoregressive solvers, especially on heterogeneous and complex distributions.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新的神经网络框架，使用离散噪声图扩散模型来学习和应用VRP约束，从而提高自回归求解器的性能，尤其是在异构和复杂的分布上。

title: Reinforcement learning-based dynamic cleaning scheduling framework for solar energy system
summary: Advancing autonomous green technologies in solar photovoltaic (PV) systems is key to improving sustainability and efficiency in renewable energy production. This study presents a reinforcement learning (RL)-based framework to autonomously optimize the cleaning schedules of PV panels in arid regions, where soiling from dust and other airborne particles significantly reduces energy output. By employing advanced RL algorithms, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and Soft Actor-Critic (SAC), the framework dynamically adjusts cleaning intervals based on uncertain environmental conditions. The proposed approach was applied to a case study in Abu Dhabi, UAE, demonstrating that PPO outperformed SAC and traditional simulation optimization (Sim-Opt) methods, achieving up to 13% cost savings by dynamically responding to weather uncertainties. The results highlight the superiority of flexible, autonomous scheduling over fixed-interval methods, particularly in adapting to stochastic environmental dynamics. This aligns with the goals of autonomous green energy production by reducing operational costs and improving the efficiency of solar power generation systems. This work underscores the potential of RL-driven autonomous decision-making to optimize maintenance operations in renewable energy systems. In future research, it is important to enhance the generalization ability of the proposed RL model, while also considering additional factors and constraints to apply it to different regions.
summary_zh: 在太阳能光伏（PV）系统中推进自主绿色技术是提高可再生能源生产可持续性和效率的关键。本研究提出了一个基于强化学习（RL）的框架，用于自主优化干旱地区光伏面板的清洁计划，在这些地区，来自灰尘和其他空气传播颗粒的污垢会显著降低能量输出。通过采用先进的强化学习算法，近端策略优化（PPO）和软演员-评论家（SAC），该框架能够基于不确定的环境条件动态调整清洁间隔。该方法应用于阿联酋阿布扎比的案例研究，结果表明PPO优于SAC和传统仿真优化（Sim-Opt）方法，通过动态响应天气不确定性，实现了高达13%的成本节约。结果突显了灵活、自主调度优于固定间隔方法的优势，尤其是在适应随机环境动态方面。这符合自主绿色能源生产的目标，即降低运营成本并提高太阳能发电系统的效率。这项工作强调了强化学习驱动的自主决策在优化可再生能源系统维护运营方面的潜力。未来的研究中，重要的是提高所提出的强化学习模型的泛化能力，同时考虑额外的因素和约束条件，以便将其应用于不同的区域。
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning framework for dynamically scheduling the cleaning of solar panels in arid regions, demonstrating improved cost savings compared to traditional methods. They used PPO and SAC to optimize cleaning schedules based on environmental conditions and achieved a 13% cost reduction in a case study in Abu Dhabi.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的框架，用于动态安排干旱地区太阳能电池板的清洗计划，与传统方法相比，实现了更好的成本节约。他们使用PPO和SAC根据环境条件优化清洗计划，并在阿布扎比的案例研究中实现了13%的成本降低。

title: Unifying Sidewinding and Rolling: A Wave-Based Framework for Self-Righting in Elongated Limbless and Multi-Legged Robots
summary: Centipede-like robots offer unique locomotion advantages due to their small cross-sectional area for accessing confined spaces, and their redundant legs enhance robustness in cluttered environments such as search-and-rescue and pipe inspection. However, elongated robots are particularly vulnerable to tipping over when climbing large obstacles, making reliable self-righting essential for field deployment. Self-righting strategies for elongate, multi-legged systems remain poorly understood. In this study, we conduct a comparative biomechanics and robophysical investigation to address three key questions: (1) What self-righting strategies are effective for elongate, many-legged systems? (2) How should these strategies depend on morphological parameters such as leg length and leg number? (3) Is there a morphological limit beyond which reliable self-righting becomes infeasible? We compare two biological exemplars: Scolopendra subspinipes (short legs) and Scutigera coleoptrata (house centipedes with long legs). Scolopendra subspinipes reliably self-rights both during aerial phases and through ground-assisted self-righting, whereas house centipedes rely predominantly on aerial reorientation and struggle to generate effective self-righting torques during ground contact. Motivated by these observations, we construct a parameterized space of bio-inspired self-righting strategies and develop an elongate robot with adjustable leg lengths. Systematic experiments reveal that increasing leg length necessitates a shift in control strategy to prevent torque over-concentration in mid-body actuators, and we identify a critical limb-length threshold above which robust self-righting becomes challenging. These results establish morphology-strategy coupling principles for self-righting in elongate robots and provide design guidelines for centipede-like systems operating in uncertain terrain.
summary_zh: 蜈蚣型机器人因其横截面积小，易于进入狭窄空间，且冗余的腿部提高了在搜索救援和管道检测等杂乱环境中工作的鲁棒性，而具有独特的运动优势。然而，细长型机器人在攀爬大型障碍物时特别容易倾覆，因此可靠的自扶正是现场部署的关键。关于细长型多足系统的自扶正策略仍然缺乏深入的理解。在本研究中，我们进行了一项生物力学和机器人物理学的对比研究，以解决三个关键问题：(1) 对于细长型多足系统，哪些自扶正策略是有效的？ (2) 这些策略应该如何依赖于腿长和腿数等形态参数？ (3) 是否存在一个形态极限，超过该极限后可靠的自扶正变得不可行？ 我们比较了两种生物样本：少棘蜈蚣（短腿）和蚰蜒（长腿的室内蜈蚣）。 少棘蜈蚣在空中阶段和通过地面辅助自扶正过程中均能可靠地自扶正，而蚰蜒主要依赖于空中重新定向，并且难以在地面接触时产生有效的自扶正力矩。 受这些观察结果的启发，我们构建了一个参数化的仿生自扶正策略空间，并开发了一种具有可调节腿长的细长型机器人。 系统实验表明，增加腿长需要控制策略的转变，以防止力矩过度集中在躯干中部的执行器中，并且我们确定了一个临界肢长阈值，超过该阈值后，稳健的自扶正变得具有挑战性。 这些结果确立了细长型机器人自扶正的形态-策略耦合原则，并为在不确定地形中运行的蜈蚣型系统提供了设计指南。
tldr: This paper investigates self-righting strategies for elongated, multi-legged robots, drawing inspiration from centipede locomotion and identifying a critical leg length threshold for robust self-righting.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了细长多足机器人的自扶正策略，从蜈蚣的运动中获得灵感，并确定了实现稳健自扶正的关键腿长阈值。

title: SiamGM: Siamese Geometry-Aware and Motion-Guided Network for Real-Time Satellite Video Object Tracking
summary: Single object tracking in satellite videos is inherently challenged by small target, blurred background, large aspect ratio changes, and frequent visual occlusions. These constraints often cause appearance-based trackers to accumulate errors and lose targets irreversibly. To systematically mitigate both spatial ambiguities and temporal information loss, we propose SiamGM, a novel geometry-aware and motion-guided Siamese network. From a spatial perspective, we introduce an Inter-Frame Graph Attention (IFGA) module, closely integrated with an Aspect Ratio-Constrained Label Assignment (LA) method, establishing fine-grained topological correspondences and explicitly preventing surrounding background noise. From a temporal perspective, we introduce the Motion Vector-Guided Online Tracking Optimization method. By adopting the Normalized Peak-to-Sidelobe Ratio (nPSR) as a dynamic confidence indicator, we propose an Online Motion Model Refinement (OMMR) strategy to utilize historical trajectory information. Evaluations on two challenging SatSOT and SV248S benchmarks confirm that SiamGM outperforms most state-of-the-art trackers in both precision and success metrics. Notably, the proposed components of SiamGM introduce virtually no computational overhead, enabling real-time tracking at 130 frames per second (FPS). Codes and tracking results are available at https://github.com/wenzx18/SiamGM.
summary_zh: 卫星视频中的单目标跟踪天生面临小目标、模糊背景、大长宽比变化以及频繁视觉遮挡等挑战。这些约束通常导致基于外观的跟踪器积累误差并不可逆地丢失目标。为了系统地缓解空间模糊性和时间信息丢失，我们提出了一种新颖的几何感知和运动引导的孪生网络SiamGM。从空间角度来看，我们引入了帧间图注意力(IFGA)模块，并与长宽比约束标签分配(LA)方法紧密结合，从而建立细粒度的拓扑对应关系，并明确地防止周围背景噪声。从时间角度来看，我们引入了运动矢量引导的在线跟踪优化方法。通过采用归一化峰值旁瓣比(nPSR)作为动态置信度指标，我们提出了一种在线运动模型精化(OMMR)策略来利用历史轨迹信息。在两个具有挑战性的SatSOT和SV248S基准上的评估证实，SiamGM在精度和成功率指标上均优于大多数最先进的跟踪器。值得注意的是，SiamGM提出的组件几乎没有引入计算开销，从而能够实现每秒130帧(FPS)的实时跟踪。代码和跟踪结果可在https://github.com/wenzx18/SiamGM上获取。
tldr: The paper introduces SiamGM, a Siamese network for real-time satellite video object tracking that uses geometry-aware and motion-guided techniques, outperforming state-of-the-art trackers with high FPS.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于实时卫星视频目标跟踪的Siamese网络SiamGM，它采用几何感知和运动引导技术，在高性能帧率下优于现有的目标跟踪器。

title: Active Inference for Micro-Gesture Recognition: EFE-Guided Temporal Sampling and Adaptive Learning
summary: Micro-gestures are subtle and transient movements triggered by unconscious neural and emotional activities, holding great potential for human-computer interaction and clinical monitoring. However, their low amplitude, short duration, and strong inter-subject variability make existing deep models prone to degradation under low-sample, noisy, and cross-subject conditions. This paper presents an active inference-based framework for micro-gesture recognition, featuring Expected Free Energy (EFE)-guided temporal sampling and uncertainty-aware adaptive learning. The model actively selects the most discriminative temporal segments under EFE guidance, enabling dynamic observation and information gain maximization. Meanwhile, sample weighting driven by predictive uncertainty mitigates the effects of label noise and distribution shift. Experiments on the SMG dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, achieving consistent improvements across multiple mainstream backbones. Ablation studies confirm that both the EFE-guided observation and the adaptive learning mechanism are crucial to the performance gains. This work offers an interpretable and scalable paradigm for temporal behavior modeling under low-resource and noisy conditions, with broad applicability to wearable sensing, HCI, and clinical emotion monitoring.
summary_zh: 微手势是由无意识的神经和情绪活动引发的细微而短暂的动作，在人机交互和临床监测方面具有巨大潜力。然而，其低幅度、短持续时间和强烈的个体差异性使得现有的深度模型在低样本、噪声和跨个体条件下容易性能下降。本文提出了一种基于主动推理的微手势识别框架，其特点是期望自由能(EFE)引导的时序采样和不确定性感知自适应学习。该模型在EFE引导下主动选择最具区分性的时序片段，实现动态观察和信息增益最大化。同时，由预测不确定性驱动的样本加权减轻了标签噪声和分布偏移的影响。在SMG数据集上的实验表明了该方法的有效性，在多个主流骨干网络上都取得了持续的提升。消融研究证实，EFE引导的观察和自适应学习机制对于性能的提升都至关重要。这项工作为低资源和噪声条件下的时序行为建模提供了一个可解释且可扩展的范例，在可穿戴传感、人机交互和临床情绪监测方面具有广泛的适用性。
tldr: This paper introduces an active inference-based framework for micro-gesture recognition that uses Expected Free Energy (EFE) and uncertainty-aware adaptive learning to improve performance in low-sample, noisy, and cross-subject conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于主动推理的微手势识别框架，该框架利用期望自由能（EFE）和不确定性感知自适应学习来提高在小样本，噪声和跨主体条件下的性能。

title: MAS-H2: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent System for Holistic Cloud-Native Autoscaling
summary: Autoscaling in cloud-native platforms like Kubernetes is reactive and metric-driven, leading to a strategic void problem. This comes from the decoupling of higher-level business policies from lower-level resource provisioning. The strategic void, coupled with a fragmented coordination of pod and node scaling, can lead to significant resource waste and performance degradation under dynamic workloads. In this paper, we present MAS-H2, a new hierarchical multi-agent system that addresses the challenges of autonomic cloud resource management with a complete end-to-end solution. MAS-H2 systematically decomposes the control problem into three layers: a Strategic Agent that formalises business policies (e.g., cost vs. performance) into a global utility function; Planning Agents that produce a joint, proactive scaling plan for pods and nodes with time-series forecasting; and Execution Agents that execute the scaling plan. We built and tested a MAS-H2 prototype as a Kubernetes Operator on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) to benchmark it against the native Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) and Cluster Autoscaler (CA) baselines under two realistic, spiky, and stress-inducing workload scenarios. The results show that the MAS-H2 system maintained application CPU usage under 40% for predictable Heartbeat workloads. This resulted in over 50% less sustained CPU stress than the native HPA baseline, which typically operated above 80%. The MAS-H2 system demonstrated proactive planning in a volatile Chaotic Flash Sale scenario by filtering transient noise and deploying more replicas compared to HPA. It reduced peak CPU load by 55% without under-provisioning. Beyond performance, MAS-H2 seamlessly performed a zero-downtime strategic migration between two cost- and performance-optimised infrastructures.
summary_zh: Kubernetes等云原生平台中的自动伸缩是反应式的，且由指标驱动，导致存在战略空缺问题。这源于高层业务策略与底层资源供应的解耦。战略空缺，加上Pod和节点伸缩的碎片化协同，可能导致动态工作负载下显著的资源浪费和性能下降。本文提出了MAS-H2，一种新型分层多智能体系统，通过完整的端到端解决方案来应对自治云资源管理方面的挑战。MAS-H2系统地将控制问题分解为三个层级：战略智能体，将业务策略（例如，成本与性能的权衡）形式化为全局效用函数；规划智能体，利用时间序列预测为Pod和节点生成联合、主动的伸缩计划；执行智能体，执行伸缩计划。我们构建并在Google Kubernetes Engine（GKE）上以Kubernetes Operator的形式测试了MAS-H2原型系统，在两种逼真的、高峰值的、具有压力诱导性的工作负载场景下，将其与原生Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA)和Cluster Autoscaler (CA)基线进行了对比。结果表明，对于可预测的Heartbeat工作负载，MAS-H2系统将应用程序CPU使用率维持在40%以下。这比原生HPA基线减少了超过50%的持续CPU压力，后者通常运行在80%以上。在波动的Chaotic Flash Sale场景中，MAS-H2系统通过过滤瞬态噪声并部署更多的副本，展示了主动规划的能力，与HPA相比，它降低了55%的峰值CPU负载，而没有出现资源供给不足的情况。除了性能之外，MAS-H2还无缝地在两个成本和性能优化的基础设施之间执行了零停机的战略迁移。
tldr: The paper introduces MAS-H2, a hierarchical multi-agent system for cloud-native autoscaling that addresses the strategic void in Kubernetes resource management, achieving significant CPU load reductions and zero-downtime strategic migrations compared to native autoscalers.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为MAS-H2的分层多智能体系统，用于云原生自动伸缩，解决了Kubernetes资源管理中的战略空缺问题，与原生自动伸缩器相比，实现了显著的CPU负载降低和零停机战略迁移。

title: Generative prediction of laser-induced rocket ignition with dynamic latent space representations
summary: Accurate and predictive scale-resolving simulations of laser-ignited rocket engines are highly time-consuming because the problem includes turbulent fuel-oxidizer mixing dynamics, laser-induced energy deposition, and high-speed flame growth. This is conflated with the large design space primarily corresponding to the laser operating conditions and target location. To enable rapid exploration and uncertainty quantification, we propose a data-driven surrogate modeling approach that combines convolutional autoencoders (cAEs) with neural ordinary differential equations (neural ODEs). The present target application of an ML-based surrogate model to leading-edge multi-physics turbulence simulation is part of a paradigm shift in the deployment of surrogate models towards increasing real-world complexity. Sequentially, the cAE spatially compresses high-dimensional flow fields into a low-dimensional latent space, wherein the system's temporal dynamics are learned via neural ODEs. Once trained, the model generates fast spatiotemporal predictions from initial conditions and specified operating inputs. By learning a surrogate to replace the entirety of the time-evolving simulation, the cost of predicting an ignition trial is reduced by several orders of magnitude, allowing efficient exploration of the input parameter space. Further, as the current framework yields a spatiotemporal field prediction, appraisal of the model output's physical grounding is more tractable. This approach marks a significant step toward real-time digital twins for laser-ignited rocket combustors and represents surrogate modeling in a complex system context.
summary_zh: 激光点火火箭发动机的精确和预测性尺度解析模拟非常耗时，因为该问题包含了湍流燃料-氧化剂混合动力学、激光诱导能量沉积以及高速火焰增长。此外，其巨大的设计空间主要对应于激光工作条件和目标位置，这使得问题更加复杂。为了实现快速探索和不确定性量化，我们提出了一种数据驱动的代理建模方法，该方法结合了卷积自编码器（cAEs）和神经常微分方程（neural ODEs）。将基于机器学习的代理模型应用于前沿多物理场湍流模拟，是代理模型向日益复杂的实际应用部署转变的范例。该方法首先利用cAEs将高维流动场在空间上压缩到低维潜在空间，然后在其中通过神经ODE学习系统的时序动力学。经过训练后，该模型能够根据初始条件和指定的操作输入生成快速时空预测。通过学习一个代理模型来替代整个随时间演变的模拟，预测一次点火试验的成本降低了几个数量级，从而可以高效地探索输入参数空间。此外，由于目前的框架会产生时空场预测，因此对模型输出的物理基础的评估也更易于处理。这种方法标志着激光点火火箭燃烧室的实时数字孪生迈出了重要一步，并代表着复杂系统环境下的代理建模。
tldr: This paper presents a data-driven surrogate modeling approach using convolutional autoencoders and neural ODEs to predict laser-induced rocket ignition, aiming for real-time digital twins and efficient exploration of the input parameter space.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的代理建模方法，使用卷积自编码器和神经 ODE 来预测激光诱导的火箭点火，旨在实现实时数字孪生并高效探索输入参数空间。

title: Inverse-dynamics observer design for a linear single-track vehicle model with distributed tire dynamics
summary: Accurate estimation of the vehicle's sideslip angle and tire forces is essential for enhancing safety and handling performances in unknown driving scenarios. To this end, the present paper proposes an innovative observer that combines a linear single-track model with a distributed representation of the tires and information collected from standard sensors. In particular, by adopting a comprehensive representation of the tires in terms of hyperbolic partial differential equations (PDEs), the proposed estimation strategy exploits dynamical inversion to reconstruct the lumped and distributed vehicle states solely from yaw rate and lateral acceleration measurements. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the observer in estimating the sideslip angle and tire forces even in the presence of noise and model uncertainties.
summary_zh: 车辆侧滑角和轮胎力的精确估计对于在未知驾驶场景中提高安全性和操控性能至关重要。为此，本文提出了一种创新的观测器，它将线性单轨模型与轮胎的分布式表示以及从标准传感器收集的信息相结合。特别地，通过采用双曲型偏微分方程（PDEs）对轮胎进行全面表示，所提出的估计策略利用动态反演，仅从横摆角速度和横向加速度测量值中重建集总和分布式车辆状态。仿真结果表明，即使存在噪声和模型不确定性，该观测器在估计侧滑角和轮胎力方面也具有有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces an observer design using inverse dynamics and a linear single-track vehicle model with distributed tire dynamics to estimate vehicle sideslip angle and tire forces from standard sensor data, demonstrated in simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种观测器设计，该设计采用逆动力学和线性单轨车辆模型（具有分布式轮胎动力学），通过标准传感器数据估计车辆侧滑角和轮胎力，并通过仿真进行了验证。

title: MetaWorld-X: Hierarchical World Modeling via VLM-Orchestrated Experts for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Learning natural, stable, and compositionally generalizable whole-body control policies for humanoid robots performing simultaneous locomotion and manipulation (loco-manipulation) remains a fundamental challenge in robotics. Existing reinforcement learning approaches typically rely on a single monolithic policy to acquire multiple skills, which often leads to cross-skill gradient interference and motion pattern conflicts in high-degree-of-freedom systems. As a result, generated behaviors frequently exhibit unnatural movements, limited stability, and poor generalization to complex task compositions. To address these limitations, we propose MetaWorld-X, a hierarchical world model framework for humanoid control. Guided by a divide-and-conquer principle, our method decomposes complex control problems into a set of specialized expert policies (Specialized Expert Policies, SEP). Each expert is trained under human motion priors through imitation-constrained reinforcement learning, introducing biomechanically consistent inductive biases that ensure natural and physically plausible motion generation. Building upon this foundation, we further develop an Intelligent Routing Mechanism (IRM) supervised by a Vision-Language Model (VLM), enabling semantic-driven expert composition. The VLM-guided router dynamically integrates expert policies according to high-level task semantics, facilitating compositional generalization and adaptive execution in multi-stage loco-manipulation tasks.
summary_zh: 为执行同步运动和操作（loco-manipulation）的人形机器人学习自然、稳定且在组合上具有泛化性的全身控制策略，仍然是机器人领域的一项根本性挑战。现有的强化学习方法通常依赖于单一的整体策略来获得多个技能，这经常导致高自由度系统中出现跨技能梯度干扰和运动模式冲突。因此，生成的行为经常表现出不自然的运动、有限的稳定性以及对复杂任务组合的不良泛化性。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出 MetaWorld-X，一种用于人形机器人控制的分层世界模型框架。在分而治之原则的指导下，我们的方法将复杂的控制问题分解为一组专门的专家策略（Specialized Expert Policies, SEP）。通过模仿约束强化学习，每个专家都在人类运动先验的指导下进行训练，引入生物力学上一致的归纳偏置，确保自然且在物理上合理的运动生成。在此基础上，我们进一步开发了一种由视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Model, VLM）监督的智能路由机制（Intelligent Routing Mechanism, IRM），从而实现语义驱动的专家组合。VLM引导的路由器根据高层任务语义动态地整合专家策略，促进多阶段运动-操作任务中的组合泛化和自适应执行。
tldr: MetaWorld-X is a hierarchical world model framework for humanoid loco-manipulation, using VLM-orchestrated expert policies trained with human motion priors for natural, stable, and generalizable control.
tldr_zh: MetaWorld-X是一个用于人形机器人loco-manipulation的分层世界模型框架，它利用VLM编排的专家策略，并结合人类运动先验进行训练，以实现自然、稳定和可泛化的控制。

title: Interactive World Simulator for Robot Policy Training and Evaluation
summary: Action-conditioned video prediction models (often referred to as world models) have shown strong potential for robotics applications, but existing approaches are often slow and struggle to capture physically consistent interactions over long horizons, limiting their usefulness for scalable robot policy training and evaluation. We present Interactive World Simulator, a framework for building interactive world models from a moderate-sized robot interaction dataset. Our approach leverages consistency models for both image decoding and latent-space dynamics prediction, enabling fast and stable simulation of physical interactions. In our experiments, the learned world models produce interaction-consistent pixel-level predictions and support stable long-horizon interactions for more than 10 minutes at 15 FPS on a single RTX 4090 GPU. Our framework enables scalable demonstration collection solely within the world models to train state-of-the-art imitation policies. Through extensive real-world evaluation across diverse tasks involving rigid objects, deformable objects, object piles, and their interactions, we find that policies trained on world-model-generated data perform comparably to those trained on the same amount of real-world data. Additionally, we evaluate policies both within the world models and in the real world across diverse tasks, and observe a strong correlation between simulated and real-world performance. Together, these results establish the Interactive World Simulator as a stable and physically consistent surrogate for scalable robotic data generation and faithful, reproducible policy evaluation.
summary_zh: 动作条件视频预测模型（通常被称为世界模型）已展现出在机器人应用中的巨大潜力，但现有方法通常速度较慢，并且难以在长远的范围内捕获物理上一致的交互，从而限制了其在可扩展机器人策略训练和评估方面的效用。我们提出了交互式世界模拟器，一个从适中规模的机器人交互数据集中构建交互式世界模型的框架。我们的方法利用一致性模型进行图像解码和隐空间动力学预测，从而能够快速且稳定地模拟物理交互。在我们的实验中，学习到的世界模型产生交互一致的像素级预测，并支持在单个 RTX 4090 GPU 上以 15 FPS 的速度进行超过 10 分钟的稳定长程交互。我们的框架支持仅在世界模型中进行可扩展的演示数据收集，从而训练出最先进的模仿策略。通过对涉及刚性物体、可变形物体、物体堆以及它们之间交互的各种任务进行广泛的真实世界评估，我们发现基于世界模型生成的数据训练的策略的性能与基于相同数量的真实世界数据训练的策略相当。此外，我们在世界模型和真实世界中对策略进行评估，观察到模拟性能与真实世界性能之间存在很强的相关性。总而言之，这些结果证实了交互式世界模拟器是一个稳定且物理上一致的替代方案，能够实现可扩展的机器人数据生成和忠实、可复现的策略评估。
tldr: The paper presents an Interactive World Simulator that leverages consistency models for fast and stable robot interaction simulation, enabling scalable policy training and evaluation with performance comparable to real-world data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种交互式世界模拟器，它利用一致性模型实现快速稳定的机器人交互模拟，从而可以进行可扩展的策略训练与评估，其性能可与真实世界数据相媲美。

title: AtomVLA: Scalable Post-Training for Robotic Manipulation via Predictive Latent World Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate remarkable potential for generalizable robotic manipulation. The execution of complex multi-step behaviors in VLA models can be improved by robust instruction grounding, a critical component for effective control. However, current paradigms predominantly rely on coarse, high-level task instructions during supervised fine-tuning. This instruction grounding gap leaves models without explicit intermediate guidance, leading to severe compounding errors in long-horizon tasks. Therefore, bridging this instruction gap and providing scalable post-training for VLA models is urgent. To tackle this problem, we propose \method, the first subtask-aware VLA framework integrated with a scalable offline post-training pipeline. Our framework leverages a large language model to decompose high-level demonstrations into fine-grained atomic subtasks. This approach utilizes a pretrained predictive world model to score candidate action chunks against subtask goals in the latent space, mitigating error accumulation while significantly improving long-horizon robustness. Furthermore, this approach enables highly efficient Group Relative Policy Optimization without the prohibitive expenses associated with online rollouts on physical robots. Extensive simulations validate that our AtomVLA maintains strong robustness under perturbations. When evaluated against fundamental baseline models, it achieves an average success rate of 97.0\% on the LIBERO benchmark and 48.0\% on the LIBERO-PRO benchmark. Finally, experiments conducted in the real world using the Galaxea R1 Lite platform confirm its broad applicability across diverse tasks, especially long-horizon tasks. All datasets, checkpoints, and code will be released to the public domain following the acceptance of this work for future research.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型在通用机器人操作方面展现出显著潜力。 VLA 模型中复杂多步骤行为的执行可以通过稳健的指令对齐来改进，这是有效控制的关键组成部分。然而，当前的范式主要依赖于监督微调期间的粗粒度、高层任务指令。 这种指令对齐差距使模型缺乏明确的中间指导，导致长时域任务中严重的累积误差。 因此，弥合这一指令差距并为 VLA 模型提供可扩展的后训练迫在眉睫。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 \method，这是第一个集成可扩展离线后训练流程的子任务感知 VLA 框架。 我们的框架利用大型语言模型将高层演示分解为细粒度的原子子任务。 这种方法利用预训练的预测世界模型来评估潜在空间中候选动作块相对于子任务目标的得分，从而缓解误差累积，同时显著提高长时域的鲁棒性。 此外，这种方法能够实现高效的组相对策略优化，而无需在物理机器人上进行在线 rollout 所带来的高昂成本。 大量的仿真验证表明，我们的 AtomVLA 在扰动下保持了强大的鲁棒性。 在针对基本基线模型进行评估时，它在 LIBERO 基准测试中实现了平均 97.0\% 的成功率，在 LIBERO-PRO 基准测试中实现了 48.0\% 的成功率。 最后，使用 Galaxea R1 Lite 平台在真实世界中进行的实验证实了其在各种任务中的广泛适用性，尤其是长时域任务。 所有数据集、检查点和代码将在本文被接受后发布到公共领域，以供未来研究使用。
tldr: The paper introduces AtomVLA, a scalable post-training framework that leverages LLMs for subtask decomposition and a predictive world model for scoring action chunks in the latent space, improving robustness in long-horizon robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AtomVLA，一个可扩展的后训练框架，利用LLM进行子任务分解和预测世界模型在潜在空间中对动作块进行评分，从而提高长周期机器人操作任务的鲁棒性。

title: Seed2Scale: A Self-Evolving Data Engine for Embodied AI via Small to Large Model Synergy and Multimodal Evaluation
summary: Existing data generation methods suffer from exploration limits, embodiment gaps, and low signal-to-noise ratios, leading to performance degradation during self-iteration. To address these challenges, we propose Seed2Scale, a self-evolving data engine that overcomes the data bottleneck through a heterogeneous synergy of "small-model collection, large-model evaluation, and target-model learning". Starting with as few as four seed demonstrations, the engine employs the lightweight Vision-Language-Action model, SuperTiny, as a dedicated collector, leveraging its strong inductive bias for robust exploration in parallel environments. Concurrently, a pre-trained Vision-Language Model is integrated as a Verifer to autonomously perform success/failure judgment and quality scoring for the massive generated trajectories. Seed2Scale effectively mitigates model collapse, ensuring the stability of the self-evolution process. Experimental results demonstrate that Seed2Scale exhibits signifcant scaling potential: as iterations progress, the success rate of the target model shows a robust upward trend, achieving a performance improvement of 131.2%. Furthermore, Seed2Scale signifcantly outperforms existing data augmentation methods, providing a scalable and cost-effective pathway for the large-scale development of Generalist Embodied AI. Project page: https://terminators2025.github.io/Seed2Scale.github.io
summary_zh: 现有数据生成方法面临探索范围受限、具身鸿沟和信噪比低等问题，导致在自我迭代过程中性能下降。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了Seed2Scale，一种自进化数据引擎，通过“小模型收集、大模型评估和目标模型学习”的异构协同克服数据瓶颈。从仅有的四个种子演示开始，该引擎采用轻量级的视觉-语言-动作模型SuperTiny作为专用收集器，利用其强大的归纳偏置在并行环境中进行鲁棒探索。同时，集成一个预训练的视觉-语言模型作为验证器，自主执行成功/失败判断，并对大规模生成轨迹进行质量评分。Seed2Scale有效缓解了模型崩溃，确保了自进化过程的稳定性。实验结果表明，Seed2Scale展现出显著的扩展潜力：随着迭代的进行，目标模型的成功率呈现稳健的上升趋势，实现了131.2%的性能提升。此外，Seed2Scale显著优于现有的数据增强方法，为通用具身人工智能的大规模发展提供了一条可扩展且经济高效的路径。项目主页：https://terminators2025.github.io/Seed2Scale.github.io
tldr: The paper introduces Seed2Scale, a self-evolving data engine for embodied AI that uses a 'small-model collection, large-model evaluation, and target-model learning' strategy with demonstrated significant performance improvements and scaling potential.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为Seed2Scale的自演化数据引擎，用于具身人工智能，它采用了“小模型收集、大模型评估和目标模型学习”的策略，并展示了显著的性能提升和扩展潜力。

title: DyQ-VLA: Temporal-Dynamic-Aware Quantization for Embodied Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are dominant in embodied intelligence but are constrained by inference overheads. While model quantization alleviates these bottlenecks for edge deployment, static quantization approaches remain suboptimal for VLAs due to two critical challenges: (1) Temporal-dynamic sensitivity, where fixed precision wastes resources by ignoring stage-varying error tolerances; and (2) Real-time allocation, where identifying real-time sensitivity to guide bit allocation remains unsolved. To address these challenges, we propose DyQ-VLA, a dynamic quantization framework for VLAs. Specifically, a sensitivity-aware switching strategy leverages real-time kinematic proxies to trigger the bit-width switch, while a kinematic-guided module dynamically allocates the optimal bit-width. Experiments show that DyQ-VLA requires only 30.9% of the original memory footprint while maintaining 99.5% of its original performance, achieving 1.49x simulation and up to 1.43x real-world speedups.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型在具身智能领域占据主导地位，但受到推理开销的限制。尽管模型量化缓解了边缘部署的这些瓶颈，但由于两个关键挑战，静态量化方法对于VLA而言仍然不是最优的：（1）时间-动态敏感性，其中固定精度忽略了阶段变化的误差容限，造成了资源浪费；（2）实时分配，其中识别实时敏感性以指导比特分配仍未解决。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了DyQ-VLA，一种用于VLA的动态量化框架。具体而言，一种敏感性感知切换策略利用实时运动学代理来触发位宽切换，同时一种运动学引导模块动态分配最佳位宽。实验表明，DyQ-VLA只需原始内存占用量的30.9%，同时保持其原始性能的99.5%，实现了1.49倍的模拟加速和高达1.43倍的真实世界加速。
tldr: The paper introduces DyQ-VLA, a dynamic quantization framework for Vision-Language-Action models which leverages real-time kinematic proxies for bit-width switching and allocation, achieving significant memory reduction and speedups while maintaining performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DyQ-VLA，一个针对视觉-语言-动作模型的动态量化框架，利用实时运动学代理进行位宽切换和分配，在保持性能的同时显著减少内存和加速。

title: In-Context Reinforcement Learning for Tool Use in Large Language Models
summary: While large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong reasoning abilities, their performance on complex tasks is often constrained by the limitations of their internal knowledge. A compelling approach to overcome this challenge is to augment these models with external tools -- such as Python interpreters for mathematical computations or search engines for retrieving factual information. However, enabling models to use these tools effectively remains a significant challenge. Existing methods typically rely on cold-start pipelines that begin with supervised fine-tuning (SFT), followed by reinforcement learning (RL). These approaches often require substantial amounts of labeled data for SFT, which is expensive to annotate or synthesize. In this work, we propose In-Context Reinforcement Learning (ICRL), an RL-only framework that eliminates the need for SFT by leveraging few-shot prompting during the rollout stage of RL. Specifically, ICRL introduces in-context examples within the rollout prompts to teach the model how to invoke external tools. Furthermore, as training progresses, the number of in-context examples is gradually reduced, eventually reaching a zero-shot setting where the model learns to call tools independently. We conduct extensive experiments across a range of reasoning and tool-use benchmarks. Results show that ICRL achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating its effectiveness as a scalable, data-efficient alternative to traditional SFT-based pipelines.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）展现出强大的推理能力，但它们在复杂任务上的表现往往受到内部知识的限制。克服这一挑战的一个引人注目的方法是用外部工具来增强这些模型，例如用于数学计算的Python解释器或用于检索事实信息的搜索引擎。然而，使模型能够有效地使用这些工具仍然是一个重要的挑战。现有
tldr: The paper introduces In-Context Reinforcement Learning (ICRL), a novel RL-only framework that enables large language models to effectively use external tools by leveraging few-shot prompting during RL rollouts, eliminating the need for supervised fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了上下文强化学习（ICRL），这是一种新型的纯强化学习框架，通过在强化学习 rollout 阶段利用小样本提示，使大型语言模型能够有效地使用外部工具，从而消除了对监督微调的需求。

title: PIRA-Bench: A Transition from Reactive GUI Agents to GUI-based Proactive Intent Recommendation Agents
summary: Current Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents operate primarily under a reactive paradigm: a user must provide an explicit instruction for the agent to execute a task. However, an intelligent AI assistant should be proactive, which is capable of anticipating user intentions directly from continuous visual inputs, such as mobile or desktop screenshots, and offering timely recommendations without explicit user prompting. Transitioning to this proactive paradigm presents significant challenges. Real-world screen activity is rarely linear; it consists of long-horizon trajectories fraught with noisy browsing, meaningless actions, and multithreaded task-switching. To address this gap, we introduce PIRA-Bench (Proactive Intent Recommendation Agent Benchmark), a novel benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on continuous, weakly-supervised visual inputs. Unlike reactive datasets, PIRA-Bench features complex trajectories with multiple interleaved intents and noisy segments with various user profile contexts, challenging agents to detect actionable events while fitting to user preferences. Furthermore, we propose the PIRF baseline, a memory-aware, state-tracking framework that empowers general MLLMs to manage multiple task threads and handle misleading visual inputs. PIRA-Bench serves as an initial step toward robust and proactive GUI-based personal assistants.
summary_zh: 当前图形用户界面 (GUI) 智能体主要以反应式范式运行：用户必须提供明确指令才能使智能体执行任务。然而，一个智能的 AI 助手应该是主动式的，能够直接从连续的视觉输入（例如移动或桌面屏幕截图）中预测用户意图，并在没有明确用户提示的情况下提供及时的建议。过渡到这种主动式范式带来了重大挑战。现实世界的屏幕活动很少是线性的；它包含长期的轨迹，其中充斥着嘈杂的浏览、无意义的动作和多线程的任务切换。为了弥补这一差距，我们推出了 PIRA-Bench（主动意图推荐智能体基准），这是一个用于评估多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM) 在连续、弱监督视觉输入上的表现的新基准。与反应式数据集不同，PIRA-Bench 具有复杂轨迹，包含多个交错的意图和具有各种用户配置文件上下文的嘈杂片段，这挑战了智能体在适应用户偏好的同时检测可操作事件的能力。此外，我们提出了 PIRF 基线，一个具有记忆感知能力的状态跟踪框架，它使通用 MLLM 能够管理多个任务线程并处理误导性视觉输入。PIRA-Bench 是朝着构建强大而主动的基于 GUI 的个人助理方向迈出的第一步。
tldr: This paper introduces PIRA-Bench, a new benchmark dataset for evaluating multimodal large language models in proactively recommending actions based on continuous GUI screenshots, addressing the limitations of current reactive GUI agents. They also propose a PIRF baseline model to address this problem.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 PIRA-Bench，这是一个新的基准数据集，用于评估多模态大型语言模型在基于连续 GUI 截图主动推荐操作方面的能力，解决了当前被动式 GUI 代理的局限性。他们还提出了一个 PIRF 基线模型来解决这个问题。

title: CMMR-VLN: Vision-and-Language Navigation via Continual Multimodal Memory Retrieval
summary: Although large language models (LLMs) are introduced into vision-and-language navigation (VLN) to improve instruction comprehension and generalization, existing LLM- based VLN lacks the ability to selectively recall and use relevant priori experiences to help navigation tasks, limiting their performance in long-horizon and unfamiliar scenarios. In this work, we propose CMMR-VLN (Continual Multimodal Memory Retrieval based VLN), a VLN framework that endows LLM agents with structured memory and reflection capabilities. Specifically, the CMMR-VLN constructs a multimodal experi- ence memory indexed by panoramic visual images and salient landmarks to retrieve relevant experiences during navigation, introduces a retrieved-augmented generation pipeline to mimick how experienced human navigators leverage priori knowledge, and incorporates a reflection-based memory update strategy that selectively stores complete successful paths and the key initial mistake in failure cases. Comprehensive tests illustrate average success rate improvements of 52.9%, 20.9% and 20.9%, and 200%, 50% and 50% over the NavGPT, the MapGPT, and the DiscussNav in simulation and real tests, respectively eluci- dating the great potential of the CMMR-VLN as a backbone VLN framework.
summary_zh: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）被引入视觉-语言导航（VLN）以提升指令理解和泛化能力，但现有的基于LLM的VLN缺乏选择性地回忆和利用相关先验经验来辅助导航任务的能力，这限制了它们在长程和不熟悉场景中的表现。 在此工作中，我们提出了CMMR-VLN（基于持续多模态记忆检索的VLN），一种赋予LLM智能体结构化记忆和反思能力的VLN框架。 具体而言，CMMR-VLN构建了一个以全景视觉图像和显著地标为索引的多模态经验记忆，用于在导航过程中检索相关经验；引入了一个检索增强的生成流程来模仿经验丰富的导航员利用先验知识的方式；并结合了一种基于反思的记忆更新策略，选择性地存储完整的成功路径和失败案例中的关键初始错误。 综合测试表明，在模拟和真实测试中，其平均成功率分别比NavGPT、MapGPT和DiscussNav提高了52.9%、20.9%和20.9%，以及200%、50%和50%，阐明了CMMR-VLN作为骨干VLN框架的巨大潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces CMMR-VLN, a Vision-and-Language Navigation framework that enhances LLM agents with structured memory and reflection capabilities to improve navigation in long-horizon and unfamiliar scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CMMR-VLN，一种视觉-语言导航框架，通过为LLM代理配备结构化记忆和反思能力，从而提高在长时程和不熟悉场景中的导航能力。

title: Can Vision-Language Models Solve the Shell Game?
summary: Visual entity tracking is an innate cognitive ability in humans, yet it remains a critical bottleneck for Vision-Language Models (VLMs). This deficit is often obscured in existing video benchmarks by visual shortcuts. We introduce VET-Bench, a synthetic diagnostic testbed featuring visually identical objects that necessitate tracking exclusively through spatiotemporal continuity. Our experiments reveal that current state-of-the-art VLMs perform at or near chance level on VET-Bench, exposing a fundamental limitation: an over-reliance on static frame-level features and a failure to maintain entity representations over time. We provide a theoretical analysis drawing connections to the state-tracking problem, proving that fixed-depth transformer-based VLMs are fundamentally limited in tracking indistinguishable objects without intermediate supervision due to expressivity constraints. To address this, we propose Spatiotemporal Grounded Chain-of-Thought (SGCoT): generating object trajectories as explicit intermediate states. Leveraging Molmo2's object tracking ability, we elicit SGCoT reasoning by fine-tuning on synthesized text-only data for alignment. Our method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy exceeding 90% on VET-Bench, demonstrating that VLMs can reliably solve the video shell-game task end-to-end without external tools. Our code and data are available at https://vetbench.github.io .
summary_zh: 视觉实体追踪是人类与生俱来的认知能力，但它仍然是视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的一个关键瓶颈。这种缺陷通常在现有的视频基准测试中被视觉捷径所掩盖。我们引入了VET-Bench，一个合成的诊断测试平台，其特点是视觉上完全相同的物体，需要完全通过时空连续性进行追踪。我们的实验表明，当前最先进的VLMs在VET-Bench上的表现接近或等于随机水平，暴露了一个根本性的局限性：过度依赖静态的帧级别特征，并且未能维持实体在时间上的表征。我们提供了一个理论分析，将此问题与状态追踪问题联系起来，证明基于固定深度Transformer的VLMs由于表达能力限制，在没有中间监督的情况下，在追踪无法区分的物体方面存在根本性的局限性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了时空条件下的思维链（Spatiotemporal Grounded Chain-of-Thought，SGCoT）：将物体轨迹生成为显式的中间状态。利用Molmo2的物体追踪能力，我们通过在合成的纯文本数据上进行微调以实现对齐，从而引发SGCoT推理。我们的方法在VET-Bench上实现了超过90%的最先进准确率，证明了VLMs无需外部工具，即可可靠地端到端解决视频贝壳游戏任务。我们的代码和数据可在https://vetbench.github.io 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces VET-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for VLMs, showing their failure in tracking visually identical objects. They propose Spatiotemporal Grounded Chain-of-Thought (SGCoT) achieving SOTA performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个用于评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）的诊断性基准测试VET-Bench，揭示了它们在跟踪视觉上相同的物体时的失败。他们提出了一种时空接地的链式思考（SGCoT）方法，实现了最先进的性能。

title: $Δ$VLA: Prior-Guided Vision-Language-Action Models via World Knowledge Variation
summary: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models have significantly advanced robotic manipulation by unifying perception, reasoning, and control. To achieve such integration, recent studies adopt a predictive paradigm that models future visual states or world knowledge to guide action generation. However, these models emphasize forecasting outcomes rather than reasoning about the underlying process of change, which is essential for determining how to act. To address this, we propose $Δ$VLA, a prior-guided framework that models world-knowledge variations relative to an explicit current-world knowledge prior for action generation, rather than regressing absolute future world states. Specifically, 1) to construct the current world knowledge prior, we propose the Prior-Guided WorldKnowledge Extractor (PWKE). It extracts manipulable regions, spatial relations, and semantic cues from the visual input, guided by auxiliary heads and prior pseudo labels, thus reducing redundancy. 2) Building upon this, to represent how world knowledge evolves under actions, we introduce the Latent World Variation Quantization (LWVQ). It learns a discrete latent space via a VQ-VAE objective to encode world knowledge variations, shifting prediction from full modalities to compact latent. 3)Moreover, to mitigate interference during variation modeling, we design the Conditional Variation Attention (CV-Atten), whichpromotes disentangled learning and preserves the independence of knowledge representations. Extensive experiments on both simulated benchmarks and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate $Δ$VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance while improving efficiency. Code and real-world execution videos are available at https://github.com/JiuTian-VL/DeltaVLA.
summary_zh: 近期，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过统一感知、推理和控制，显著推进了机器人操作。为了实现这种集成，最近的研究采用了一种预测范式，该范式对未来的视觉状态或世界知识进行建模，以指导动作生成。然而，这些模型侧重于预测结果，而非推理潜在的变化过程，而后者对于确定如何行动至关重要。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了$Δ$VLA，一个先验引导的框架，它对相对于显式当前世界知识先验的世界知识变化进行建模，以用于动作生成，而不是回归绝对的未来世界状态。具体来说，1) 为了构建当前世界知识先验，我们提出了先验引导的世界知识提取器（PWKE）。它在辅助头和先验伪标签的引导下，从视觉输入中提取可操作区域、空间关系和语义线索，从而减少冗余。2) 在此基础上，为了表示世界知识如何在动作下演变，我们引入了潜在世界变化量化（LWVQ）。它通过 VQ-VAE 目标函数学习一个离散的潜在空间，以编码世界知识的变化，从而将预测从完整模态转移到紧凑的潜在空间。3) 此外，为了减轻变化建模过程中的干扰，我们设计了条件变化注意力机制（CV-Atten），它促进了解耦学习并保持了知识表示的独立性。在模拟基准测试和真实世界机器人任务上的大量实验表明，$Δ$VLA 实现了最先进的性能，同时提高了效率。代码和真实世界的执行视频可在 https://github.com/JiuTian-VL/DeltaVLA 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces ΔVLA, a vision-language-action model that emphasizes reasoning about the process of change by modeling world-knowledge variations relative to a current-world knowledge prior, achieving SOTA performance on robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ΔVLA，一种视觉-语言-动作模型，强调通过对相对于当前世界知识先验的世界知识变异进行建模来推理变化的，在机器人操作任务上实现了SOTA性能。

title: SAMoE-VLA: A Scene Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts Vision-Language-Action Model for Autonomous Driving
summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising capabilities in autonomous driving by leveraging the understanding and reasoning strengths of Large Language Models(LLMs).However, our empirical analysis reveals that directly applying existing token-level MoE mechanisms--which are inherited from LLM architectures--to VLA models results in unstable performance and safety degradation in autonomous driving, highlighting a misalignment between token-based expert specialization and scene-level decision-making.To address this, we propose SAMoE-VLA, a scene-adaptive Vision-Language-Action framework that conditions expert selection on structured scene representations instead of token embeddings. Our key idea is to derive the MoE routing signal from bird's-eye-view (BEV) features that encapsulates traffic scene context, enabling scenario-dependent expert weighting and merging tailored to distinct driving conditions. Furthermore, to support temporally consistent reasoning across world-knowledge, perception, language, and action, we introduce a Conditional Cross-Modal Causal Attention mechanism that integrates world state, linguistic intent, and action history into a unified causal reasoning process. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes open loop planning dataset and LangAuto closed-loop benchmark demonstrate that SAMoE-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming prior VLA-based and world-model-based approaches with fewer parameters.Our code will be released soon.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型近期的进展展示了其在自动驾驶领域中利用大型语言模型 (LLMs) 的理解和推理能力的巨大潜力。然而，我们的实验分析表明，直接将现有的、从 LLM 架构继承而来的令牌级 MoE 机制应用于 VLA 模型，会导致自动驾驶中性能不稳定和安全性下降，突显了基于令牌的专家特化与场景级决策之间的不一致。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 SAMoE-VLA，一个场景自适应的视觉-语言-动作框架，它基于结构化的场景表征而非令牌嵌入来调节专家选择。我们的核心思想是从鸟瞰图 (BEV) 特征中提取 MoE 路由信号，该特征封装了交通场景上下文，从而实现针对不同驾驶条件的、依赖于场景的专家权重和合并。此外，为了支持跨世界知识、感知、语言和动作的时间一致性推理，我们引入了一种条件跨模态因果注意力机制，将世界状态、语言意图和动作历史整合到一个统一的因果推理过程中。在 nuScenes 开环规划数据集和 LangAuto 闭环基准测试上的大量实验表明，SAMoE-VLA 实现了最先进的性能，以更少的参数胜过了之前的基于 VLA 和基于世界模型的方法。我们的代码即将发布。
tldr: The paper introduces SAMoE-VLA, a scene-adaptive mixture-of-experts VLA model for autonomous driving that uses BEV features for expert routing instead of token embeddings, and Conditional Cross-Modal Causal Attention for temporal reasoning, achieving SOTA results.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SAMoE-VLA，一种场景自适应的混合专家VLA模型，用于自动驾驶。该模型使用BEV特征进行专家路由，而不是token嵌入，并采用条件跨模态因果注意力进行时间推理，实现了SOTA结果。

title: Exp-Force: Experience-Conditioned Pre-Grasp Force Selection with Vision-Language Models
summary: Accurate pre-contact grasp force selection is critical for safe and reliable robotic manipulation. Adaptive controllers regulate force after contact but still require a reasonable initial estimate. Starting a grasp with too little force requires reactive adjustment, while starting a grasp with too high a force risks damaging fragile objects. This trade-off is particularly challenging for compliant grippers, whose contact mechanics are difficult to model analytically. We propose Exp-Force, an experience-conditioned framework that predicts the minimum feasible grasping force from a single RGB image. The method retrieves a small set of relevant prior grasping experiences and conditions a vision-language model on these examples for in-context inference, without analytic contact models or manually designed heuristics. On 129 object instances, ExpForce achieves a best-case MAE of 0.43 N, reducing error by 72% over zero-shot inference. In real-world tests on 30 unseen objects, it improves appropriate force selection rate from 63% to 87%. These results demonstrate that Exp-Force enables reliable and generalizable pre-grasp force selection by leveraging prior interaction experiences. http://expforcesubmission.github.io/Exp-Force-Website/
summary_zh: 精确的预接触抓取力选择对于安全可靠的机器人操作至关重要。自适应控制器可以在接触后调节力，但仍然需要合理的初始估计。以过小的力开始抓取需要做出反应性调整，而以过大的力开始抓取则有损坏易碎物体的风险。对于顺应性夹爪而言，由于其接触力学难以进行解析建模，这种权衡尤其具有挑战性。我们提出了Exp-Force，一种经验条件框架，可以从单张RGB图像中预测最小可行抓取力。该方法检索一小组相关的先前抓取经验，并利用这些示例对视觉-语言模型进行上下文推理，无需解析接触模型或手动设计的启发式方法。在129个物体实例上，ExpForce实现了最佳情况下的MAE为0.43 N，相较于零样本推理，误差降低了72%。在对30个未见物体的真实世界测试中，它将适当的力选择率从63%提高到87%。这些结果表明，Exp-Force通过利用先前的交互经验，能够实现可靠且可泛化的预抓取力选择。http://expforcesubmission.github.io/Exp-Force-Website/
tldr: Exp-Force uses a vision-language model conditioned on prior grasping experiences to predict the minimum feasible grasping force from an RGB image, improving pre-grasp force selection, especially for compliant grippers.
tldr_zh: Exp-Force 采用视觉-语言模型，以先前的抓取经验为条件，从 RGB 图像预测最小可行的抓取力，从而改善预抓取力的选择，特别适用于柔顺夹爪。

title: Embedding Classical Balance Control Principles in Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Recovery
summary: Humanoid robots remain vulnerable to falls and unrecoverable failure states, limiting their practical utility in unstructured environments. While reinforcement learning has demonstrated stand-up behaviors, existing approaches treat recovery as a pure task-reward problem without an explicit representation of the balance state. We present a unified RL policy that addresses this limitation by embedding classical balance metrics: capture point, center-of-mass state, and centroidal momentum, as privileged critic inputs and shaping rewards directly around these quantities during training, while the actor relies solely on proprioception for zero-shot hardware transfer. Without reference trajectories or scripted contacts, a single policy spans the full recovery spectrum: ankle and hip strategies for small disturbances, corrective stepping under large pushes, and compliant falling with multi-contact stand-up using the hands, elbows, and knees. Trained on the Unitree H1-2 in Isaac Lab, the policy achieves a 93.4% recovery rate across randomized initial poses and unscripted fall configurations. An ablation study shows that removing the balance-informed structure causes stand-up learning to fail entirely, confirming that these metrics provide a meaningful learning signal rather than incidental structure. Sim-to-sim transfer to MuJoCo and preliminary hardware experiments further demonstrate cross-environment generalization. These results show that embedding interpretable balance structure into the learning framework substantially reduces time spent in failure states and broadens the envelope of autonomous recovery.
summary_zh: 人形机器人仍然容易跌倒和进入无法恢复的失效状态，限制了它们在非结构化环境中的实际应用。虽然强化学习已经展示了站立行为，但现有的方法将恢复视为一个纯粹的任务奖励问题，而没有显式地表示平衡状态。我们提出了一种统一的强化学习策略，通过嵌入经典平衡指标来解决这一局限性：捕获点、质心状态和质心动量作为特权评论家输入，并在训练期间直接围绕这些量来塑造奖励，而演员仅依赖于本体感受来实现零样本硬件迁移。在没有参考轨迹或脚本化接触的情况下，单一策略涵盖了完整的恢复范围：针对小扰动的踝关节和髋关节策略，针对大推力的纠正性步进，以及使用手、肘和膝盖进行多接触站立的顺应性跌倒。该策略在Isaac Lab中使用宇树H1-2进行训练，在随机初始姿势和非脚本化跌倒配置中实现了93.4%的恢复率。一项消融研究表明，移除包含平衡信息的结构会导致站立学习完全失败，证实了这些指标提供了有意义的学习信号，而不仅仅是偶然的结构。Sim-to-sim迁移到MuJoCo和初步的硬件实验进一步证明了跨环境的泛化能力。这些结果表明，将可解释的平衡结构嵌入到学习框架中，可以显著减少失效状态下的时间，并拓宽自主恢复的范围。
tldr: This paper enhances humanoid robot recovery using reinforcement learning by incorporating classical balance metrics into the critic and reward function, achieving high recovery rates in simulation and showing potential for sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: 本文通过将经典平衡指标整合到强化学习的评论家和奖励函数中，改进了人形机器人的摔倒恢复能力，在仿真中实现了高恢复率，并显示出从仿真到实际的迁移潜力。

title: FOMO-3D: Using Vision Foundation Models for Long-Tailed 3D Object Detection
summary: In order to navigate complex traffic environments, self-driving vehicles must recognize many semantic classes pertaining to vulnerable road users or traffic control devices. However, many safety-critical objects (e.g., construction worker) appear infrequently in nominal traffic conditions, leading to a severe shortage of training examples from driving data alone. Recent vision foundation models, which are trained on a large corpus of data, can serve as a good source of external prior knowledge to improve generalization. We propose FOMO-3D, the first multi-modal 3D detector to leverage vision foundation models for long-tailed 3D detection.
