tldr_zh: 该论文提出了视觉自实现对齐 (VSFA) 方法，通过在与威胁相关的图像上微调视觉语言模型 (VLM)，以提高其安全性。这种方法无需安全标签，即可诱导模型产生谨慎行为。

title: The Boiling Frog Threshold: Criticality and Blindness in World Model-Based Anomaly Detection Under Gradual Drift
summary: When an RL agent's observations are gradually corrupted, at what drift rate does it "wake up" -- and what determines this boundary? We study world model-based self-monitoring under continuous observation drift across four MuJoCo environments, three detector families (z-score, variance, percentile), and three model capacities. We find that (1) a sharp detection threshold $\varepsilon^*$ exists universally: below it, drift is absorbed as normal variation; above it, detection occurs rapidly. The threshold's existence and sigmoid shape are invariant across all detector families and model capacities, though its position depends on the interaction between detector sensitivity, noise floor structure, and environment dynamics. (2) Sinusoidal drift is completely undetectable by all detector families -- including variance and percentile detectors with no temporal smoothing -- establishing this as a world model property rather than a detector artifact. (3) Within each environment, $\varepsilon^*$ follows a power law in detector parameters ($R^2 = 0.89$-$0.97$), but cross-environment prediction fails ($R^2 = 0.45$), revealing that the missing variable is environment-specific dynamics structure $\partial \mathrm{PE}/\partial\varepsilon$. (4) In fragile environments, agents collapse before any detector can fire ("collapse before awareness"), creating a fundamentally unmonitorable failure mode. Our results reframe $\varepsilon^*$ from an emergent world model property to a three-way interaction between noise floor, detector, and environment dynamics, providing a more defensible and empirically grounded account of self-monitoring boundaries in RL agents.
summary_zh: 当强化学习智能体的观测逐渐被破坏时，它在何种漂移速率下会“醒悟”——以及是什么决定了这个边界？ 我们在四个MuJoCo环境中，三种检测器类型（Z-score、方差、百分位数）和三种模型容量下，研究了在连续观测漂移下基于世界模型的自我监控。 我们发现：（1）普遍存在一个清晰的检测阈值$\varepsilon^*$：低于它，漂移会被当作正常变化吸收；高于它，检测会迅速发生。 该阈值的存在性和S形形状在所有检测器类型和模型容量中都是不变的，尽管其位置取决于检测器灵敏度、噪声基底结构和环境动力学之间的相互作用。（2）所有检测器类型，包括没有时间平滑的方差和百分位数检测器，都无法检测到正弦漂移——这证实了这是一个世界模型的属性，而不是一个检测器伪影。（3）在每个环境中，$\varepsilon^*$遵循检测器参数的幂律 ($R^2 = 0.89$-$0.97$)，但跨环境预测失败 ($R^2 = 0.45$)，揭示了缺失的变量是环境特定的动力学结构 $\partial \mathrm{PE}/\partial\varepsilon$。（4）在脆弱的环境中，智能体在任何检测器触发之前崩溃（“崩溃先于意识”），从而产生一种根本无法监控的失败模式。 我们的结果将$\varepsilon^*$从一个涌现的世界模型属性重新定义为噪声基底、检测器和环境动力学之间的三方相互作用，为强化学习智能体中自我监控的边界提供了一个更具防御性和经验依据的解释。
tldr: This paper investigates the detection of observation drift in RL agents using world models, finding a sharp detection threshold influenced by detector sensitivity, noise floor, and environment dynamics, and identifying undetectable sinusoidal drift.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了在强化学习智能体中使用世界模型检测观测漂移的问题，发现了一个受检测器灵敏度、噪声基底和环境动力学影响的清晰检测阈值，并识别出无法检测到的正弦漂移。

title: ImageEdit-R1: Boosting Multi-Agent Image Editing via Reinforcement Learning
summary: With the rapid advancement of commercial multi-modal models, image editing has garnered significant attention due to its widespread applicability in daily life. Despite impressive progress, existing image editing systems, particularly closed-source or proprietary models, often struggle with complex, indirect, or multi-step user instructions. These limitations hinder their ability to perform nuanced, context-aware edits that align with human intent. In this work, we propose ImageEdit-R1, a multi-agent framework for intelligent image editing that leverages reinforcement learning to coordinate high-level decision-making across a set of specialized, pretrained vision-language and generative agents. Each agent is responsible for distinct capabilities--such as understanding user intent, identifying regions of interest, selecting appropriate editing actions, and synthesizing visual content--while reinforcement learning governs their collaboration to ensure coherent and goal-directed behavior. Unlike existing approaches that rely on monolithic models or hand-crafted pipelines, our method treats image editing as a sequential decision-making problem, enabling dynamic and context-aware editing strategies. Experimental results demonstrate that ImageEdit-R1 consistently outperforms both individual closed-source diffusion models and alternative multi-agent framework baselines across multiple image editing datasets.
summary_zh: 随着商业多模态模型的快速发展，图像编辑因其在日常生活中的广泛适用性而备受关注。尽管取得了令人瞩目的进展，现有的图像编辑系统，特别是闭源或专有模型，常常难以处理复杂、间接或多步骤的用户指令。这些局限性阻碍了它们执行细致入微、能感知上下文并与人类意图对齐的编辑。在本文中，我们提出了ImageEdit-R1，一种智能图像编辑的多智能体框架，它利用强化学习来协调一组专门的、预训练的视觉-语言和生成智能体之间的高级别决策。每个智能体负责不同的能力——例如理解用户意图、识别感兴趣区域、选择适当的编辑操作和合成视觉内容——而强化学习则控制它们的协作，以确保连贯且目标导向的行为。与依赖于单体模型或手工设计的流水线的现有方法不同，我们的方法将图像编辑视为一个序列决策问题，从而实现动态和上下文感知的编辑策略。实验结果表明，在多个图像编辑数据集上，ImageEdit-R1 始终优于单个闭源扩散模型和替代的多智能体框架基线。
tldr: The paper introduces ImageEdit-R1, a reinforcement learning-based multi-agent framework for image editing that outperforms single models and other multi-agent baselines by intelligently coordinating specialized vision-language agents.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个名为 ImageEdit-R1 的图像编辑多智能体框架，该框架基于强化学习，通过智能协调专业化的视觉语言智能体，优于单一模型和其他多智能体基线。

title: ViSA-Enhanced Aerial VLN: A Visual-Spatial Reasoning Enhanced Framework for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Existing aerial Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) methods predominantly adopt a detection-and-planning pipeline, which converts open-vocabulary detections into discrete textual scene graphs. These approaches are plagued by inadequate spatial reasoning capabilities and inherent linguistic ambiguities. To address these bottlenecks, we propose a Visual-Spatial Reasoning (ViSA) enhanced framework for aerial VLN. Specifically, a triple-phase collaborative architecture is designed to leverage structured visual prompting, enabling Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to perform direct reasoning on image planes without the need for additional training or complex intermediate representations. Comprehensive evaluations on the CityNav benchmark demonstrate that the ViSA-enhanced VLN achieves a 70.3\% improvement in success rate compared to the fully trained state-of-the-art (SOTA) method, elucidating its great potential as a backbone for aerial VLN systems.
summary_zh: 现有空中视觉-语言导航（VLN）方法主要采用检测与规划的流程，将开放词汇检测结果转换为离散的文本场景图。这些方法受到空间推理能力不足和固有语言歧义的困扰。为了解决这些瓶颈，我们提出了一种视觉-空间推理（ViSA）增强框架用于空中VLN。具体来说，我们设计了一个三阶段协同架构，利用结构化视觉提示，使视觉-语言模型（VLMs）能够在图像平面上直接进行推理，而无需额外的训练或复杂的中间表示。在CityNav基准上的全面评估表明，与完全训练的当前最优（SOTA）方法相比，ViSA增强的VLN在成功率方面提高了70.3％，阐明了其作为空中VLN系统骨干的巨大潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces ViSA, a visual-spatial reasoning enhanced framework for aerial Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) that leverages structured visual prompting to enable VLMs to reason directly on image planes, achieving significant performance improvements on the CityNav benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为ViSA的视觉-空间推理增强型框架，用于空中视觉-语言导航 (VLN)。该框架利用结构化的视觉提示，使 VLMs 能够直接在图像平面上进行推理，并在 CityNav 基准测试中实现了显著的性能提升。

title: OSExpert: Computer-Use Agents Learning Professional Skills via Exploration
summary: General-purpose computer-use agents have shown impressive performance across diverse digital environments. However, our new benchmark, OSExpert-Eval, indicates they remain far less helpful than human experts. Although inference-time scaling enables adaptation, these agents complete complex tasks inefficiently with degraded performance, transfer poorly to unseen UIs, and struggle with fine-grained action sequences. To solve the problem, we introduce a GUI-based depth-first search (GUI-DFS) exploration algorithm to comprehensively explore and verify an environment's unit functions. The agent then exploits compositionality between unit skills to self-construct a curriculum for composite tasks. To support fine-grained actions, we curate a database of action primitives for agents to discover during exploration; these are saved as a skill set once the exploration is complete. We use the learned skills to improve the agent's performance and efficiency by (1) enriching agents with ready-to-use procedural knowledge, allowing them to plan only once for long trajectories and generate accurate actions, and (2) enabling them to end inference-time scaling earlier by realizing their boundary of capabilities. Extensive experiments show that our environment-learned agent takes a meaningful step toward expert-level computer use, achieving a around 20 percent performance gain on OSExpert-Eval and closing the efficiency gap to humans by around 80 percent
summary_zh: 通用型计算机使用代理在各种数字环境中表现出令人印象深刻的性能。然而，我们新的基准测试OSExpert-Eval表明，它们在实用性方面仍然远不如人类专家。尽管推理时缩放能够实现适应性，但这些代理完成复杂任务的效率低下，性能下降，对未见过的UI的迁移能力较差，并且难以处理细粒度的动作序列。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种基于GUI的深度优先搜索（GUI-DFS）探索算法，以全面探索和验证环境的单元功能。然后，代理利用单元技能之间的组合性，为复合任务进行自我构建课程。为了支持细粒度的动作，我们整理了一个动作原语数据库，供代理在探索过程中发现；这些动作在探索完成后将保存为技能集。我们利用学习到的技能来提高代理的性能和效率，方法是：（1）通过为代理提供即用型的程序知识来丰富它们，使它们只需对长轨迹进行一次规划并生成准确的动作，以及（2）通过意识到自身的能力边界，使它们能够更早地结束推理时缩放。大量实验表明，我们这种环境学习的代理在迈向专家级计算机使用的方向上迈出了有意义的一步，在OSExpert-Eval上实现了约20%的性能提升，并将效率差距缩小到人力的约80%。
tldr: The paper introduces OSExpert, a computer-use agent that learns professional skills through a GUI-based exploration algorithm and action primitive database, achieving significant performance and efficiency gains on the OSExpert-Eval benchmark.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了OSExpert，一种计算机使用代理，通过基于GUI的探索算法和动作原语数据库来学习专业技能，并在OSExpert-Eval基准测试中取得了显著的性能和效率提升。

title: Advancing Automated Algorithm Design via Evolutionary Stagewise Design with LLMs
summary: With the rapid advancement of human science and technology, problems in industrial scenarios are becoming increasingly challenging, bringing significant challenges to traditional algorithm design. Automated algorithm design with LLMs emerges as a promising solution, but the currently adopted black-box modeling deprives LLMs of any awareness of the intrinsic mechanism of the target problem, leading to hallucinated designs. In this paper, we introduce Evolutionary Stagewise Algorithm Design (EvoStage), a novel evolutionary paradigm that bridges the gap between the rigorous demands of industrial-scale algorithm design and the LLM-based algorithm design methods. Drawing inspiration from CoT, EvoStage decomposes the algorithm design process into sequential, manageable stages and integrates real-time intermediate feedback to iteratively refine algorithm design directions. To further reduce the algorithm design space and avoid falling into local optima, we introduce a multi-agent system and a "global-local perspective" mechanism. We apply EvoStage to the design of two types of common optimizers: designing parameter configuration schedules of the Adam optimizer for chip placement, and designing acquisition functions of Bayesian optimization for black-box optimization. Experimental results across open-source benchmarks demonstrate that EvoStage outperforms human-expert designs and existing LLM-based methods within only a couple of evolution steps, even achieving the historically state-of-the-art half-perimeter wire-length results on every tested chip case. Furthermore, when deployed on a commercial-grade 3D chip placement tool, EvoStage significantly surpasses the original performance metrics, achieving record-breaking efficiency. We hope EvoStage can significantly advance automated algorithm design in the real world, helping elevate human productivity.
summary_zh: 随着人类科技的飞速发展，工业场景中的问题变得越来越具有挑战性，给传统算法设计带来了巨大的挑战。利用LLM的自动算法设计作为一种有前景的解决方案应运而生，但目前采用的黑盒建模剥夺了LLM对目标问题内在机制的任何感知，导致了虚假的设计。在本文中，我们介绍了一种新颖的进化范式——演化分阶段算法设计(EvoStage)，它弥合了工业级算法设计的严格需求和基于LLM的算法设计方法之间的差距。EvoStage从思维链（CoT）中汲取灵感，将算法设计过程分解为顺序的、可管理的阶段，并集成实时中间反馈以迭代地改进算法设计方向。为了进一步缩小算法设计空间并避免陷入局部最优，我们引入了一个多智能体系统和一个“全局-局部视角”机制。我们将EvoStage应用于两种常见优化器的设计：为芯片布局设计Adam优化器的参数配置调度，以及为黑盒优化设计贝叶斯优化的采集函数。在开源基准测试上的实验结果表明，EvoStage只需几个进化步骤就能优于人类专家设计和现有的基于LLM的方法，甚至在每个测试的芯片案例中都实现了历史最佳的半周长线网长度结果。此外，当部署在商用级3D芯片布局工具上时，EvoStage显著超越了原始性能指标，实现了破纪录的效率。我们希望EvoStage能够显著推动现实世界中自动算法设计的发展，从而帮助提高人类的生产力。
tldr: The paper introduces EvoStage, a novel evolutionary algorithm design paradigm using LLMs that incorporates stagewise design, real-time feedback, and multi-agent systems to outperform human experts and existing LLM-based methods in optimizer design, showcasing significant improvements in chip placement and Bayesian optimization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为EvoStage的新型进化算法设计范式，它利用大型语言模型（LLM），结合分阶段设计、实时反馈和多智能体系统，在优化器设计方面超越了人类专家和现有的基于LLM的方法，并在芯片布局和贝叶斯优化方面展示了显著的改进。

title: SWE-Fuse: Empowering Software Agents via Issue-free Trajectory Learning and Entropy-aware RLVR Training
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed the software engineering landscape. Recently, numerous LLM-based agents have been developed to address real-world software issue fixing tasks. Despite their state-of-the-art performance, Despite achieving state-of-the-art performance, these agents face a significant challenge: \textbf{Insufficient high-quality issue descriptions.} Real-world datasets often exhibit misalignments between issue descriptions and their corresponding solutions, introducing noise and ambiguity that mislead automated agents and limit their problem-solving effectiveness. We propose \textbf{\textit{SWE-Fuse}}, an issue-description-aware training framework that fuses issue-description-guided and issue-free samples for training SWE agents. It consists of two key modules: (1) An issue-free-driven trajectory learning module for mitigating potentially misleading issue descriptions while enabling the model to learn step-by-step debugging processes; and (2) An entropy-aware RLVR training module, which adaptively adjusts training dynamics through entropy-driven clipping. It applies relaxed clipping under high entropy to encourage exploration, and stricter clipping under low entropy to ensure training stability. We evaluate SWE-Fuse on the widely studied SWE-bench Verified benchmark shows to demonstrate its effectiveness in solving real-world software problems. Specifically, SWE-Fuse outperforms the best 8B and 32B baselines by 43.0\% and 60.2\% in solve rate, respectively. Furthermore, integrating SWE-Fuse with test-time scaling (TTS) enables further performance improvements, achieving solve rates of 49.8\% and 65.2\% under TTS@8 for the 8B and 32B models, respectively.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已经改变了软件工程领域。最近，已经开发出许多基于LLM的智能体来解决实际软件问题修复任务。尽管它们取得了最先进的性能，但这些智能体面临着一个重大挑战：\textbf{高质量问题描述不足。} 真实世界的数据集通常表现出问题描述及其对应解决方案之间的不一致，引入噪声和模糊性，从而误导自动化智能体并限制其解决问题的有效性。我们提出了\textbf{\textit{SWE-Fuse}}，一种问题描述感知训练框架，它融合了问题描述引导和无问题样本来训练SWE智能体。它由两个关键模块组成：（1）一个无问题驱动的轨迹学习模块，用于减轻潜在的误导性问题描述，同时使模型能够学习逐步调试过程；（2）一个熵感知RLVR训练模块，通过熵驱动的裁剪自适应地调整训练动态。它在高熵下应用宽松的裁剪以鼓励探索，在低熵下应用更严格的裁剪以确保训练稳定性。我们对广泛研究的SWE-bench Verified基准进行SWE-Fuse评估，结果表明其在解决实际软件问题方面的有效性。具体而言，SWE-Fuse在解决问题速率方面分别优于最佳8B和32B基线43.0％和60.2％。此外，将SWE-Fuse与测试时缩放（TTS）集成可以进一步提高性能，在TTS@8下，8B和32B模型分别实现了49.8％和65.2％的解决问题速率。
tldr: SWE-Fuse is a training framework for LLM-based software agents that addresses the problem of noisy issue descriptions in real-world datasets by using issue-free trajectory learning and entropy-aware RLVR training, achieving significant performance improvements on the SWE-bench Verified benchmark.
tldr_zh: SWE-Fuse是一个针对基于LLM的软件代理的训练框架，通过使用无问题轨迹学习和熵感知RLVR训练来解决现实世界数据集中嘈杂问题描述的问题，并在SWE-bench Verified基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升。

title: Ares: Adaptive Reasoning Effort Selection for Efficient LLM Agents
summary: Modern agents powered by thinking LLMs achieve high accuracy through long chain-of-thought reasoning but incur substantial inference costs. While many LLMs now support configurable reasoning levels (e.g., high/medium/low), static strategies are often ineffective: using low-effort modes at every step leads to significant performance degradation, while random selection fails to preserve accuracy or provide meaningful cost reduction. However, agents should reserve high reasoning effort for difficult steps like navigating complex website structures, while using lower-effort modes for simpler steps like opening a target URL. In this paper, we propose Ares, a framework for per-step dynamic reasoning effort selection tailored for multi-step agent tasks. Ares employs a lightweight router to predict the lowest appropriate reasoning level for each step based on the interaction history. To train this router, we develop a data generation pipeline that identifies the minimum reasoning effort required for successful step completion. We then fine-tune the router to predict these levels, enabling plug-and-play integration for any LLM agents. We evaluate Ares on a diverse set of agent tasks, including TAU-Bench for tool use agents, BrowseComp-Plus for deep-research agents, and WebArena for web agents. Experimental results show that Ares reduces reasoning token usage by up to 52.7% compared to fixed high-effort reasoning, while introducing minimal degradation in task success rates.
summary_zh: 由思考型LLM驱动的现代智能体通过长链式思维推理实现高准确率，但也带来了巨大的推理成本。虽然许多LLM现在支持可配置的推理等级（例如，高/中/低），但静态策略往往无效：在每个步骤都使用低代价模式会导致性能显著下降，而随机选择则无法保持准确性或提供有意义的成本降低。然而，智能体应该为困难的步骤保留高推理代价，例如导航复杂的网站结构，而对更简单的步骤使用低代价模式，例如打开目标URL。在本文中，我们提出了Ares，一个针对多步骤智能体任务的单步动态推理代价选择框架。Ares采用轻量级路由器，根据交互历史预测每个步骤所需的最低适当推理等级。为了训练该路由器，我们开发了一个数据生成流程，用于识别成功完成步骤所需的最小推理代价。然后，我们对路由器进行微调以预测这些等级，从而为任何LLM智能体实现即插即用的集成。我们在各种智能体任务上评估了Ares，包括用于工具使用智能体的TAU-Bench，用于深度研究智能体的BrowseComp-Plus，以及用于Web智能体的WebArena。实验结果表明，与固定高代价推理相比，Ares将推理token使用量降低了高达52.7%，同时引入了最小的任务成功率降幅。
tldr: Ares is a framework that dynamically selects the reasoning effort level for LLM agents at each step of a multi-step task, reducing token usage while maintaining task success rates. It uses a router trained to predict the minimum reasoning effort needed for each step.
tldr_zh: Ares是一个框架，它可以动态地为LLM代理在多步骤任务的每一步中选择推理工作量级别，从而在保持任务成功率的同时减少token使用量。它使用一个经过训练的路由器来预测每一步所需的最小推理工作量。

title: SynPlanResearch-R1: Encouraging Tool Exploration for Deep Research with Synthetic Plans
summary: Research Agents enable models to gather information from the web using tools to answer user queries, requiring them to dynamically interleave internal reasoning with tool use. While such capabilities can in principle be learned via reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), we observe that agents often exhibit poor exploration behaviors, including premature termination and biased tool usage. As a result, RLVR alone yields limited improvements. We propose SynPlanResearch-R1, a framework that synthesizes tool-use trajectories that encourage deeper exploration to shape exploration during cold-start supervised fine-tuning, providing a strong initialization for subsequent RL. Across seven multi-hop and open-web benchmarks, \framework improves performance by up to 6.0% on Qwen3-8B and 5.8% on Qwen3-4B backbones respectively compared to SOTA baselines. Further analyses of tool-use patterns and training dynamics compared to baselines shed light on the factors underlying these gains. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/HansiZeng/syn-plan-research.
summary_zh: 研究智能体使模型能够利用工具从网络上收集信息，从而回答用户查询，这要求它们能够动态地将内部推理与工具使用交织在一起。尽管原则上这种能力可以通过具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）来学习，但我们观察到智能体常常表现出较差的探索行为，包括过早终止和有偏的工具使用。因此，仅凭RLVR只能获得有限的改进。我们提出了SynPlanResearch-R1，一个框架，它合成工具使用轨迹，以鼓励更深入的探索，从而在冷启动监督式微调期间塑造探索行为，为后续的强化学习提供一个强大的初始化。在七个多跳和开放网络基准测试中，与最先进的基线相比，\framework 将基于 Qwen3-8B 的性能提升了高达 6.0%，将基于 Qwen3-4B 的性能提升了高达 5.8%。与基线相比，对工具使用模式和训练动态的进一步分析，揭示了这些收益背后的因素。我们的代码已在 https://github.com/HansiZeng/syn-plan-research 上公开提供。
tldr: The paper introduces SynPlanResearch-R1, a framework that uses synthetic tool-use trajectories to improve exploration during the training of research agents, leading to performance gains in multi-hop and open-web benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 SynPlanResearch-R1，一个使用合成工具使用轨迹来改善研究智能体训练期间的探索的框架，从而在多跳和开放网络基准测试中实现了性能提升。

title: ProgAgent:A Continual RL Agent with Progress-Aware Rewards
summary: We present ProgAgent, a continual reinforcement learning (CRL) agent that unifies progress-aware reward learning with a high-throughput, JAX-native system architecture. Lifelong robotic learning grapples with catastrophic forgetting and the high cost of reward specification. ProgAgent tackles these by deriving dense, shaped rewards from unlabeled expert videos through a perceptual model that estimates task progress across initial, current, and goal observations. We theoretically interpret this as a learned state-potential function, delivering robust guidance in line with expert behaviors. To maintain stability amid online exploration - where novel, out-of-distribution states arise - we incorporate an adversarial push-back refinement that regularizes the reward model, curbing overconfident predictions on non-expert trajectories and countering distribution shift. By embedding this reward mechanism into a JIT-compiled loop, ProgAgent supports massively parallel rollouts and fully differentiable updates, rendering a sophisticated unified objective feasible: it merges PPO with coreset replay and synaptic intelligence for an enhanced stability-plasticity balance. Evaluations on ContinualBench and Meta-World benchmarks highlight ProgAgent's advantages: it markedly reduces forgetting, boosts learning speed, and outperforms key baselines in visual reward learning (e.g., Rank2Reward, TCN) and continual learning (e.g., Coreset, SI) - surpassing even an idealized perfect memory agent. Real-robot trials further validate its ability to acquire complex manipulation skills from noisy, few-shot human demonstrations.
summary_zh: 我们提出了ProgAgent，一种持续强化学习（CRL）智能体，它统一了感知进度的奖励学习与高吞吐量、JAX原生的系统架构。终身机器人学习面临着灾难性遗忘和高昂的奖励规范成本。ProgAgent通过从无标签的专家视频中推导密集、塑形的奖励来解决这些问题，它使用一个感知模型来估计初始、当前和目标观测之间的任务进度。我们在理论上将其解释为一个学习到的状态势函数，提供与专家行为一致的鲁棒指导。为了在在线探索中保持稳定性 - 此时会出现新的、超出现有分布的状态 - 我们结合了一个对抗性推回精细化（adversarial push-back refinement）方法来正则化奖励模型，抑制对非专家轨迹的过度自信的预测，并对抗分布偏移。通过将这种奖励机制嵌入到一个JIT编译的循环中，ProgAgent支持大规模并行展开和完全可微分的更新，使得一个复杂的统一目标成为可能：它将PPO与核心集回放和突触智能相结合，从而增强了稳定性-可塑性平衡。在ContinualBench和Meta-World基准测试上的评估结果突显了ProgAgent的优势：它显著降低了遗忘，提高了学习速度，并在视觉奖励学习（例如，Rank2Reward、TCN）和持续学习（例如，Coreset、SI）方面优于关键基线，甚至超越了一个理想化的完美记忆智能体。真实机器人试验进一步验证了其从嘈杂、少样本的人类演示中获取复杂操作技能的能力。
tldr: ProgAgent is a continual RL agent that learns dense rewards from unlabeled expert videos, uses an adversarial method for stability, and combines PPO with coreset replay and synaptic intelligence. It shows strong performance on ContinualBench and Meta-World, even surpassing a perfect memory agent.
tldr_zh: ProgAgent是一个持续强化学习智能体，它从无标签的专家视频中学习密集奖励，采用对抗方法来保证稳定性，并结合了PPO、核心集回放和突触智能。在ContinualBench和Meta-World上的表现出色，甚至超过了完美的记忆智能体。

title: Boosting MLLM Spatial Reasoning with Geometrically Referenced 3D Scene Representations
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable success in 2D visual understanding, their ability to reason about 3D space remains limited. To address this gap, we introduce geometrically referenced 3D scene representations (GR3D). Given a set of input images, GR3D annotates objects in the images with unique IDs and encodes their 3D geometric attributes as textual references indexed by these IDs. This representation enables MLLMs to interpret 3D cues using their advanced language-based skills in mathematical reasoning, while concurrently analyzing 2D visual features in a tightly coupled way. We present a simple yet effective approach based on GR3D, which requires no additional training and is readily applicable to different MLLMs. Implemented in a zero-shot setting, our approach boosts GPT-5's performance on VSI-Bench by 8% overall and more than 11% on tasks that rely heavily on spatial layout understanding. Qualitative studies further demonstrate that GR3D empowers MLLMs to perform complex spatial reasoning with highly sparse input views.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型(MLLM)在2D视觉理解方面取得了显著成功，但其对3D空间进行推理的能力仍然有限。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了几何参考的3D场景表示(GR3D)。给定一组输入图像，GR3D用唯一的ID标注图像中的物体，并将它们的3D几何属性编码为由这些ID索引的文本参考。这种表示使得MLLM能够利用其基于语言的先进数学推理能力来解释3D线索，同时以紧密耦合的方式分析2D视觉特征。我们提出了一种基于GR3D的简单而有效的方法，无需额外训练，且可直接应用于不同的MLLM。在零样本设置下，我们的方法使GPT-5在VSI-Bench上的整体性能提升了8%，在严重依赖空间布局理解的任务上提升超过11%。定性研究进一步表明，GR3D使MLLM能够利用高度稀疏的输入视图执行复杂的空间推理。
tldr: The paper introduces geometrically referenced 3D scene representations (GR3D) to enhance MLLMs' 3D spatial reasoning abilities by encoding 3D geometric information as textual references, achieving performance gains on spatial reasoning benchmarks without additional training.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了几何参考的3D场景表示(GR3D)，旨在增强MLLM的3D空间推理能力，通过将3D几何信息编码为文本参考，在空间推理基准测试上实现了性能提升，且无需额外训练。

title: PRISM: Streaming Human Motion Generation with Per-Joint Latent Decomposition
summary:
Text-to-motion generation has advanced rapidly, yet two challenges persist. First, existing motion autoencoders compress each frame into a single monolithic latent vector, entangling trajectory and per-joint rotations in an unstructured representation that downstream generators struggle to model faithfully. Second, text-to-motion, pose-conditioned generation, and long-horizon sequential synthesis typically require separate models or task-specific mechanisms, with autoregressive approaches suffering from severe error accumulation over extended rollouts.
  We present PRISM, addressing each challenge with a dedicated contribution. (1) A joint-factorized motion latent space: each body joint occupies its own token, forming a structured 2D grid (time
  joints) compressed by a causal VAE with forward-kinematics supervision. This simple change to the latent space -- without modifying the generator -- substantially improves generation quality, revealing that latent space design has been an underestimated bottleneck. (2) Noise-free condition injection: each latent token carries its own timestep embedding, allowing conditioning frames to be injected as clean tokens (timestep0) while the remaining tokens are denoised. This unifies text-to-motion and pose-conditioned generation in a single model, and directly enables autoregressive segment chaining for streaming synthesis. Self-forcing training further suppresses drift in long rollouts. With these two components, we train a single motion generation foundation model that seamlessly handles text-to-motion, pose-conditioned generation, autoregressive sequential generation, and narrative motion composition, achieving state-of-the-art on HumanML3D, MotionHub, BABEL, and a 50-scenario user study.
summary_zh:
文本到动作生成技术发展迅速，但仍存在两个挑战。首先，现有的动作自动编码器将每一帧压缩成一个单一的整体潜在向量，将轨迹和每个关节的旋转缠绕在一个非结构化的表示中，下游生成器难以忠实地建模。其次，文本到动作、姿势条件生成和长时程序列合成通常需要单独的模型或特定于任务的机制，而自回归方法在扩展的展开过程中会遭受严重的误差累积。

我们提出了 PRISM，通过专门的贡献来解决每个挑战。(1) 一种联合分解的动作潜在空间：每个身体关节占据其自身的token，形成一个结构化的二维网格（时间 x 关节），并通过带有正向运动学监督的因果 VAE 进行压缩。这种对潜在空间的简单修改——无需修改生成器——显著提高了生成质量，表明潜在空间设计一直是被低估的瓶颈。(2) 无噪声条件注入：每个潜在token都携带其自身的时间步嵌入，允许将条件帧注入为干净的 token（时间步 0），而其余 token 则进行去噪。这在一个模型中统一了文本到动作和姿势条件生成，并直接实现了用于流式合成的自回归片段链接。自强制训练进一步抑制了长时程展开中的漂移。通过这两个组件，我们训练了一个单一的运动生成基础模型，可以无缝处理文本到动作、姿势条件生成、自回归序列生成和叙事运动组合，在 HumanML3D、MotionHub、BABEL 和一个 50 场景的用户研究中实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: PRISM introduces a joint-factorized latent space and noise-free condition injection to improve human motion generation, achieving SOTA results and unifying various motion generation tasks within a single model.
tldr_zh: PRISM 引入了联合分解的潜在空间和无噪声条件注入，以改进人体运动生成，实现了最先进的结果，并将各种运动生成任务统一在一个模型中。

title: SecAgent: Efficient Mobile GUI Agent with Semantic Context
summary: Mobile Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents powered by multimodal large language models have demonstrated promising capabilities in automating complex smartphone tasks. However, existing approaches face two critical limitations: the scarcity of high-quality multilingual datasets, particularly for non-English ecosystems, and inefficient history representation methods. To address these challenges, we present SecAgent, an efficient mobile GUI agent at 3B scale. We first construct a human-verified Chinese mobile GUI dataset with 18k grounding samples and 121k navigation steps across 44 applications, along with a Chinese navigation benchmark featuring multi-choice action annotations. Building upon this dataset, we propose a semantic context mechanism that distills history screenshots and actions into concise, natural language summaries, significantly reducing computational costs while preserving task-relevant information. Through supervised and reinforcement fine-tuning, SecAgent outperforms similar-scale baselines and achieves performance comparable to 7B-8B models on our and public navigation benchmarks. We will open-source the training dataset, benchmark, model, and code to advance research in multilingual mobile GUI automation.
summary_zh: 由多模态大型语言模型驱动的移动图形用户界面（GUI）代理在自动化复杂的智能手机任务方面展现出前景广阔的能力。然而，现有方法面临着两个关键限制：高质量多语言数据集的稀缺性，尤其是在非英语生态系统中；以及效率低下的历史表示方法。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了SecAgent，一种高效的30亿参数规模的移动GUI代理。我们首先构建了一个经过人工验证的中文移动GUI数据集，包含1.8万个基础样本和44个应用程序中12.1万个导航步骤，以及一个具有多项选择动作标注的中文导航基准。在此数据集的基础上，我们提出了一种语义上下文机制，将历史屏幕截图和动作提炼成简洁的自然语言摘要，从而在保留任务相关信息的同时，显著降低计算成本。通过监督和强化微调，SecAgent的性能优于类似规模的基线模型，并在我们自己和公开的导航基准上，实现了与70亿-80亿参数模型相当的性能。我们将开源训练数据集、基准、模型和代码，以推进多语言移动GUI自动化领域的研究。
tldr: The paper introduces SecAgent, a 3B parameter mobile GUI agent trained on a new Chinese GUI dataset with a novel semantic context mechanism for efficient history representation, achieving performance comparable to larger models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 SecAgent，一个 3B 参数的移动 GUI Agent，它基于新构建的中文 GUI 数据集训练，并采用了一种新颖的语义上下文机制以实现有效历史表示。SecAgent 的性能可与更大的模型相媲美。

title: SPIRAL: A Closed-Loop Framework for Self-Improving Action World Models via Reflective Planning Agents
summary: We introduce SPIRAL, a self-improving planning and iterative reflective action world modeling closed-loop framework that enables controllable long-horizon video generation conditioned on high-level semantic actions. Existing one-shot video generation models operate in open-loop, often resulting in incomplete action execution, weak semantic grounding, and temporal drift. SPIRAL formulates ActWM as a closed-loop think-act-reflect process, where generation proceeds step by step under explicit planning and feedback. A PlanAgent decomposes abstract actions into object-centric sub-actions, while a CriticAgent evaluates intermediate results and guides iterative refinement with long-horizon memory. This closed-loop design naturally supports RL evolving optimization, improving semantic alignment and temporal consistency over extended horizons. We further introduce the ActWM-Dataset and ActWM-Bench for training and evaluation. Experiments across multiple TI2V backbones demonstrate consistent gains on ActWM-Bench and mainstream video generation benchmarks, validating SPIRAL's effectiveness.
summary_zh: 我们提出了SPIRAL，一个自改进的规划和迭代反射行为世界建模闭环框架，它能够实现基于高级语义动作的可控长时程视频生成。现有的单次视频生成模型以开环方式运行，通常导致不完整的动作执行、较弱的语义对齐以及时间漂移。SPIRAL将ActWM构建为一个闭环的思考-行动-反射过程，其中生成在显式规划和反馈下逐步进行。一个规划代理（PlanAgent）将抽象动作分解为以对象为中心的子动作，而一个批评代理（CriticAgent）评估中间结果，并通过长时程记忆指导迭代改进。这种闭环设计自然地支持强化学习（RL）演化优化，从而在扩展的时间范围内改善语义对齐和时间一致性。我们进一步引入了ActWM-Dataset和ActWM-Bench用于训练和评估。跨多个TI2V骨干网络的实验表明，在ActWM-Bench和主流视频生成基准测试中都能获得一致的收益，验证了SPIRAL的有效性。
tldr: SPIRAL introduces a closed-loop framework for self-improving action world models, using planning, reflection, and RL to generate controllable long-horizon videos grounded in semantics. They introduce a dataset and benchmark and show improved performance on video generation tasks.
tldr_zh: SPIRAL 提出了一种用于自提升动作世界模型的闭环框架，通过规划、反思和强化学习生成基于语义的可控长时程视频。他们引入了一个数据集和基准测试，并展示了在视频生成任务上的改进性能。

title: SlowBA: An efficiency backdoor attack towards VLM-based GUI agents
summary: Modern vision-language-model (VLM) based graphical user interface (GUI) agents are expected not only to execute actions accurately but also to respond to user instructions with low latency. While existing research on GUI-agent security mainly focuses on manipulating action correctness, the security risks related to response efficiency remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce SlowBA, a novel backdoor attack that targets the responsiveness of VLM-based GUI agents. The key idea is to manipulate response latency by inducing excessively long reasoning chains under specific trigger patterns. To achieve this, we propose a two-stage reward-level backdoor injection (RBI) strategy that first aligns the long-response format and then learns trigger-aware activation through reinforcement learning. In addition, we design realistic pop-up windows as triggers that naturally appear in GUI environments, improving the stealthiness of the attack. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and baselines demonstrate that SlowBA can significantly increase response length and latency while largely preserving task accuracy. The attack remains effective even with a small poisoning ratio and under several defense settings. These findings reveal a previously overlooked security vulnerability in GUI agents and highlight the need for defenses that consider both action correctness and response efficiency. Code can be found in https://github.com/tu-tuing/SlowBA.
summary_zh: 现代的基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的图形用户界面（GUI）代理不仅需要准确执行操作，还需要以低延迟响应用户指令。虽然现有的GUI代理安全研究主要集中在操纵动作的正确性上，但与响应效率相关的安全风险在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本文中，我们提出 SlowBA，一种针对基于VLM的GUI代理响应性的新型后门攻击。其核心思想是通过在特定触发模式下诱导过长的推理链来操纵响应延迟。为了实现这一点，我们提出了一种两阶段的奖励级别后门注入（RBI）策略，该策略首先对齐长响应格式，然后通过强化学习学习触发感知激活。此外，我们设计了逼真的弹出窗口作为触发器，这些触发器自然出现在GUI环境中，从而提高了攻击的隐蔽性。跨多个数据集和基线的广泛实验表明，SlowBA可以显著增加响应长度和延迟，同时在很大程度上保持任务准确性。即使在较小的中毒比例和多种防御设置下，该攻击仍然有效。这些发现揭示了GUI代理中先前被忽视的安全漏洞，并强调需要同时考虑动作正确性和响应效率的防御措施。代码可在 https://github.com/tu-tuing/SlowBA 找到。
tldr: The paper introduces SlowBA, a backdoor attack against VLM-based GUI agents that manipulates response latency by inducing long reasoning chains with specific triggers, while preserving task accuracy. It identifies a previously overlooked security vulnerability in the response efficiency of GUI agents.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为SlowBA的后门攻击，该攻击针对基于VLM的GUI代理，通过特定触发器诱导冗长的推理链来操纵响应延迟，同时保持任务准确性。它揭示了GUI代理响应效率中先前被忽视的安全漏洞。

title: ALOOD: Exploiting Language Representations for LiDAR-based Out-of-Distribution Object Detection
summary: LiDAR-based 3D object detection plays a critical role for reliable and safe autonomous driving systems. However, existing detectors often produce overly confident predictions for objects not belonging to known categories, posing significant safety risks. This is caused by so-called out-of-distribution (OOD) objects, which were not part of the training data, resulting in incorrect predictions. To address this challenge, we propose ALOOD (Aligned LiDAR representations for Out-Of-Distribution Detection), a novel approach that incorporates language representations from a vision-language model (VLM). By aligning the object features from the object detector to the feature space of the VLM, we can treat the detection of OOD objects as a zero-shot classification task. We demonstrate competitive performance on the nuScenes OOD benchmark, establishing a novel approach to OOD object detection in LiDAR using language representations. The source code is available at https://github.com/uulm-mrm/mmood3d.
summary_zh: 基于激光雷达的3D目标检测对于可靠安全的自动驾驶系统至关重要。然而，现有的检测器通常对其不属于已知类别的目标产生过度自信的预测，从而造成显著的安全风险。这是由于所谓的分布外 (OOD) 目标引起的，这些目标不在训练数据中，导致不正确的预测。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出 ALOOD（用于分布外检测的对齐激光雷达表示），这是一种将视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 的语言表示融入其中的新方法。通过将目标检测器的目标特征与 VLM 的特征空间对齐，我们可以将 OOD 目标的检测视为零样本分类任务。我们在 nuScenes OOD 基准测试上展示了具有竞争力的性能，从而建立了一种使用语言表示在激光雷达中进行 OOD 目标检测的新方法。源代码可在 https://github.com/uulm-mrm/mmood3d 获取。
tldr: ALOOD addresses the problem of overconfident predictions on out-of-distribution (OOD) objects in LiDAR-based 3D object detection by aligning object features with language representations from a vision-language model, enabling zero-shot OOD detection.
tldr_zh: ALOOD通过将物体特征与视觉-语言模型中的语言表示对齐，解决了激光雷达3D物体检测中对分布外（OOD）物体的过度自信预测问题，从而实现零样本OOD检测。

title: TrianguLang: Geometry-Aware Semantic Consensus for Pose-Free 3D Localization
summary: Localizing objects and parts from natural language in 3D space is essential for robotics, AR, and embodied AI, yet existing methods face a trade-off between the accuracy and geometric consistency of per-scene optimization and the efficiency of feed-forward inference. We present TrianguLang, a feed-forward framework for 3D localization that requires no camera calibration at inference. Unlike prior methods that treat views independently, we introduce Geometry-Aware Semantic Attention (GASA), which utilizes predicted geometry to gate cross-view feature correspondence, suppressing semantically plausible but geometrically inconsistent matches without requiring ground-truth poses. Validated on five benchmarks including ScanNet++ and uCO3D, TrianguLang achieves state-of-the-art feed-forward text-guided segmentation and localization, reducing user effort from $O(N)$ clicks to a single text query. The model processes each frame at 1008x1008 resolution in $\sim$57ms ($\sim$18 FPS) without optimization, enabling practical deployment for interactive robotics and AR applications. Code and checkpoints are available at https://cwru-aism.github.io/triangulang/.
summary_zh: 在三维空间中，通过自然语言定位物体及其组成部分对于机器人、增强现实和具身人工智能至关重要，但现有方法面临着每场景优化的准确性和几何一致性，与前馈推理的效率之间的权衡。我们提出TrianguLang，一个无需相机校准即可在前馈推理中进行三维定位的框架。与先前独立处理视角的方法不同，我们引入了几何感知语义注意力（GASA），它利用预测的几何信息来控制跨视角的特征对应关系，抑制语义上合理但几何上不一致的匹配，而无需真实的姿态信息。在包括ScanNet++和uCO3D在内的五个基准测试上验证，TrianguLang实现了最先进的前馈文本引导分割和定位，将用户工作量从O(N)次点击减少到单次文本查询。该模型以 1008x1008 分辨率处理每个帧仅需约 57 毫秒（约 18 FPS），无需优化，从而能够实际部署于交互式机器人和增强现实应用中。代码和检查点可在 https://cwru-aism.github.io/triangulang/ 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces TrianguLang, a novel feed-forward framework for pose-free 3D localization from natural language, achieving state-of-the-art performance with high efficiency on several benchmarks, making it suitable for robotics and AR applications.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为TrianguLang的新型前馈框架，用于从自然语言进行无姿态3D定位，在多个基准测试中实现了最先进的性能并具有很高的效率，适用于机器人和AR应用。

title: From Reactive to Map-Based AI: Tuned Local LLMs for Semantic Zone Inference in Object-Goal Navigation
summary: Object-Goal Navigation (ObjectNav) requires an agent to find and navigate to a target object category in unknown environments. While recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents exhibit zero-shot reasoning, they often rely on a "reactive" paradigm that lacks explicit spatial memory, leading to redundant exploration and myopic behaviors. To address these limitations, we propose a transition from reactive AI to "Map-Based AI" by integrating LLM-based semantic inference with a hybrid topological-grid mapping system. Our framework employs a fine-tuned Llama-2 model via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to infer semantic zone categories and target existence probabilities from verbalized object observations. In this study, a "zone" is defined as a functional area described by the set of observed objects, providing crucial semantic co-occurrence cues for finding the target. This semantic information is integrated into a topological graph, enabling the agent to prioritize high-probability areas and perform systematic exploration via Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) optimization. Evaluations in the AI2-THOR simulator demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms traditional frontier exploration and reactive LLM baselines, achieving a superior Success Rate (SR) and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL).
summary_zh: 目标导向导航 (ObjectNav) 要求智能体在未知环境中寻找并导航至目标物体类别。虽然最近基于大型语言模型 (LLM) 的智能体展现出零样本推理能力，但它们通常依赖于缺乏明确空间记忆的“反应式”范例，从而导致冗余探索和短视行为。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出一种从反应式 AI 到“基于地图的 AI”的转变，将基于 LLM 的语义推断与混合拓扑结构-栅格地图系统相结合。我们的框架采用通过低秩自适应 (LoRA) 微调的 Llama-2 模型，从口头描述的物体观察中推断语义区域类别和目标存在概率。在本研究中，“区域”被定义为由所观察到的一组物体描述的功能区，为寻找目标提供关键的语义共现线索. 这种语义信息被整合到拓扑图中，使智能体能够优先考虑高概率区域，并通过旅行商问题 (TSP) 优化执行系统性探索。在 AI2-THOR 模拟器中的评估表明，我们的方法明显优于传统的边界探索和反应式 LLM 基线，实现了更高的成功率 (SR) 和路径长度加权成功率 (SPL)。
tldr: This paper introduces a Map-Based AI framework that integrates a fine-tuned LLM (Llama-2) for semantic zone inference with a hybrid topological-grid mapping system for improved object-goal navigation, demonstrating superior performance over reactive LLM baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于地图的AI框架，该框架集成了微调的LLM (Llama-2) 用于语义区域推理，以及混合拓扑网格映射系统，以改进目标物导航，展示出优于反应式LLM基线的性能。

title: AutoTraces: Autoregressive Trajectory Forecasting via Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: We present AutoTraces, an autoregressive vision-language-trajectory model for robot trajectory forecasting in humam-populated environments, which harnesses the inherent reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to model complex human behaviors. In contrast to prior works that rely solely on textual representations, our key innovation lies in a novel trajectory tokenization scheme, which represents waypoints with point tokens as categorical and positional markers while encoding waypoint numerical values as corresponding point embeddings, seamlessly integrated into the LLM's space through a lightweight encoder-decoder architecture. This design preserves the LLM's native autoregressive generation mechanism while extending it to physical coordinate spaces, facilitates modeling of long-term interactions in trajectory data. We further introduce an automated chain-of-thought (CoT) generation mechanism that leverages a multimodal LLM to infer spatio-temporal relationships from visual observations and trajectory data, eliminating reliance on manual annotation. Through a two-stage training strategy, our AutoTraces achieves SOTA forecasting accuracy, particularly in long-horizon prediction, while exhibiting strong cross-scene generalization and supporting flexible-length forecasting.
summary_zh: 我们提出了AutoTraces，一个自回归的视觉-语言-轨迹模型，用于在有人群环境中进行机器人轨迹预测。该模型利用大型语言模型（LLM）固有的推理能力来建模复杂的人类行为。与先前仅依赖文本表示的工作不同，我们的主要创新在于一种新颖的轨迹token化方案，该方案使用点token将航路点表示为类别和位置标记，同时将航路点数值编码为相应的点嵌入，并通过轻量级的编码器-解码器架构无缝集成到LLM的空间中。这种设计保留了LLM原生的自回归生成机制，同时将其扩展到物理坐标空间，从而促进了轨迹数据中长期交互的建模。我们进一步引入了一种自动化的思维链（CoT）生成机制，利用多模态LLM从视觉观察和轨迹数据中推断时空关系，从而消除了对人工标注的依赖。通过一个两阶段的训练策略，我们的AutoTraces实现了最先进的预测精度，特别是在长程预测方面，同时展现出强大的跨场景泛化能力，并支持灵活长度的预测。
tldr: AutoTraces uses an autoregressive vision-language-trajectory model with a novel trajectory tokenization scheme to improve robot trajectory forecasting in human environments, achieving SOTA accuracy and strong generalization.
tldr_zh: AutoTraces 采用了一种自回归视觉-语言-轨迹模型，结合一种新颖的轨迹标记化方案，以改进在人类环境中的机器人轨迹预测，实现了 SOTA 精度和强大的泛化能力。

title: On the Feasibility and Opportunity of Autoregressive 3D Object Detection
summary: LiDAR-based 3D object detectors typically rely on proposal heads with hand-crafted components like anchor assignment and non-maximum suppression (NMS), complicating training and limiting extensibility. We present AutoReg3D, an autoregressive 3D detector that casts detection as sequence generation. Given point-cloud features, AutoReg3D emits objects in a range-causal (near-to-far) order and encodes each object as a short, discrete-token sequence consisting of its center, size, orientation, velocity, and class. This near-to-far ordering mirrors LiDAR geometry--near objects occlude far ones but not vice versa--enabling straightforward teacher forcing during training and autoregressive decoding at test time. AutoReg3D is compatible across diverse point-cloud or backbones and attains competitive nuScenes performance without anchors or NMS. Beyond parity, the sequential formulation unlocks language-model advances for 3D perception, including GRPO-style reinforcement learning for task-aligned objectives. These results position autoregressive decoding as a viable, flexible alternative for LiDAR-based detection and open a path to importing modern sequence-modeling tools into 3D perception.
summary_zh: 基于激光雷达的3D目标检测器通常依赖于带有手工设计组件（如锚框分配和非极大值抑制（NMS））的候选区域头，这使得训练复杂化并限制了可扩展性。我们提出AutoReg3D，一种自回归3D检测器，它将检测视为序列生成。给定点云特征，AutoReg3D以范围因果（近到远）顺序发射目标，并将每个目标编码为一个由中心、尺寸、方向、速度和类别组成的短离散token序列。这种近到远的排序方式反映了激光雷达的几何特性——近处目标会遮挡远处目标，反之则不然——这使得训练期间的直接教师强制和测试时的自回归解码成为可能。AutoReg3D与各种点云或骨干网络兼容，并在没有锚框或NMS的情况下获得了具有竞争力的nuScenes性能。除了性能之外，这种序列化的建模方式为3D感知解锁了语言模型方面的进展，包括用于任务对齐目标的GRPO风格的强化学习。这些结果表明，自回归解码是一种适用于基于激光雷达的目标检测的可行且灵活的替代方案，并为将现代序列建模工具引入3D感知开辟了一条道路。
tldr: The paper introduces AutoReg3D, an autoregressive 3D object detector for LiDAR data that formulates detection as sequence generation, achieving competitive performance without anchors or NMS and opening possibilities for incorporating language-model techniques like reinforcement learning into 3D perception.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AutoReg3D，一种用于激光雷达数据的自回归3D目标检测器，它将检测问题转化为序列生成，在没有锚框或NMS的情况下实现了有竞争力的性能，并为将诸如强化学习等语言模型技术引入3D感知开辟了可能性。

title: Listening with the Eyes: Benchmarking Egocentric Co-Speech Grounding across Space and Time
summary: In situated collaboration, speakers often use intentionally underspecified deictic commands (e.g., ``pass me \textit{that}''), whose referent becomes identifiable only by aligning speech with a brief co-speech pointing \emph{stroke}. However, many embodied benchmarks admit language-only shortcuts, allowing MLLMs to perform well without learning the \emph{audio--visual alignment} required by deictic interaction. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{Egocentric Co-Speech Grounding (EcoG)}, where grounding is executable only if an agent jointly predicts \textit{What}, \textit{Where}, and \textit{When}. To operationalize this, we present \textbf{EcoG-Bench}, an evaluation-only bilingual (EN/ZH) diagnostic benchmark of \textbf{811} egocentric clips with dense spatial annotations and millisecond-level stroke supervision. It is organized under a \textbf{Progressive Cognitive Evaluation} protocol. Benchmarking state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals a severe executability gap: while human subjects achieve near-ceiling performance on EcoG-Bench (\textbf{96.9\%} strict Eco-Accuracy), the best native video-audio setting remains low (Gemini-3-Pro: \textbf{17.0\%}). Moreover, in a diagnostic ablation, replacing the native video--audio interface with timestamped frame samples and externally verified ASR (with word-level timing) substantially improves the same model (\textbf{17.0\%}$\to$\textbf{42.9\%}). Overall, EcoG-Bench provides a strict, executable testbed for event-level speech--gesture binding, and suggests that multimodal interfaces may bottleneck the observability of temporal alignment cues, independently of model reasoning.
summary_zh: 在情境化协作中，说话者经常使用有意欠规范的指示命令（例如，“把\textit{那个}递给我”），其指称对象只有通过将语音与短暂的同步语音指向\emph{笔划}对齐才能识别。然而，许多具身基准测试允许仅使用语言的捷径，使得多模态大语言模型（MLLM）无需学习指示交互所需的\emph{音视频对齐}即可表现良好。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了\textbf{以自我为中心的语音同步定位（EcoG）}，其中只有当智能体共同预测\textit{什么}、\textit{在哪里}和\textit{何时}时，定位才是可执行的。为了实现这一点，我们提出了\textbf{EcoG-Bench}，这是一个仅供评估的双语（英/中）诊断基准测试集，包含\textbf{811}个以自我为中心的视频片段，具有密集的空间标注和毫秒级的笔划监督。它是在\textbf{渐进式认知评估}协议下组织的。对现有最先进的多模态大语言模型进行基准测试揭示了一个严重的可执行性差距：虽然人类受试者在EcoG-Bench上取得了接近满分的表现（\textbf{96.9\%}严格的Eco-准确率），但最佳的原生视频-音频设置仍然很低（Gemini-3-Pro：\textbf{17.0\%}）。此外，在一个诊断性的消融实验中，用带有时间戳的帧样本和外部验证的ASR（带有词级时间信息）替换原生视频-音频接口，可以显著提高同一模型的性能（\textbf{17.0\%}$\to$\textbf{42.9\%}）。总而言之，EcoG-Bench 为事件级语音-手势绑定提供了一个严格、可执行的测试平台，并表明多模态接口可能会阻碍时间对齐线索的可观察性，这与模型推理无关。
tldr: The paper introduces EcoG-Bench, a new benchmark for evaluating multimodal models' ability to ground co-speech gestures in egocentric videos, highlighting a significant performance gap between humans and current SOTA models and suggesting issues with multimodal interfaces.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EcoG-Bench，一个新的基准，用于评估多模态模型在以自我为中心的视频中对共同语音手势进行定位的能力，突出了人类和当前SOTA模型之间的显著性能差距，并暗示了多模态接口的问题。

title: Toward Unified Multimodal Representation Learning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) has shown impressive performance in aligning visual and textual representations. Recent studies have extended this paradigm to 3D vision to improve scene understanding for autonomous driving. A common strategy is to employ pairwise cosine similarity between modalities to guide the training of a 3D encoder. However, considering the similarity between individual modality pairs rather than all modalities jointly fails to ensure consistent and unified alignment across the entire multimodal space. In this paper, we propose a Contrastive Tensor Pre-training (CTP) framework that simultaneously aligns multiple modalities in a unified embedding space to enhance end-to-end autonomous driving. Compared with pairwise cosine similarity alignment, our method extends the 2D similarity matrix into a multimodal similarity tensor. Furthermore, we introduce a tensor loss to enable joint contrastive learning across all modalities. For experimental validation of our framework, we construct a text-image-point cloud triplet dataset derived from existing autonomous driving datasets. The results show that our proposed unified multimodal alignment framework achieves favorable performance for both scenarios: (i) aligning a 3D encoder with pretrained CLIP encoders, and (ii) pretraining all encoders from scratch.
summary_zh: 对比语言-图像预训练(CLIP)在对齐视觉和文本表示方面表现出令人印象深刻的性能。 近期研究已将此范式扩展到3D视觉，以提升自动驾驶的场景理解能力。 一种常见的策略是利用模态对间的余弦相似度来指导3D编码器的训练。 然而，考虑到个体模态对之间的相似性，而不是所有模态的联合考虑，这无法确保整个多模态空间中一致且统一的对齐。 在本文中，我们提出一个对比张量预训练(CTP)框架，该框架在一个统一的嵌入空间中同时对齐多个模态，以增强端到端自动驾驶。 与成对余弦相似度对齐相比，我们的方法将2D相似度矩阵扩展为多模态相似度张量。 此外，我们引入了一种张量损失，以实现跨所有模态的联合对比学习。 为了对我们的框架进行实验验证，我们构建了一个源自现有自动驾驶数据集的文本-图像-点云三元组数据集。 结果表明，我们提出的统一多模态对齐框架在以下两种场景中均取得了良好的性能：(i) 将3D编码器与预训练的CLIP编码器对齐，以及 (ii) 从头开始预训练所有编码器。
tldr: The paper introduces Contrastive Tensor Pre-training (CTP), a novel framework for unified multimodal representation learning in autonomous driving, using a tensor loss to jointly align text, images, and point clouds.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了对比张量预训练（CTP），这是一种用于自动驾驶中统一多模态表示学习的新框架，使用张量损失来联合对齐文本、图像和点云。

title: OrdinalBench: A Benchmark Dataset for Diagnosing Generalization Limits in Ordinal Number Understanding of Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have advanced across multimodal benchmarks but still show clear gaps in ordinal number understanding, i.e., the ability to track relative positions and generalize to large indices. We present OrdinalBench, a diagnostic benchmark that standardizes ordinal number understanding as an evaluation task for VLMs. The core task is N-th object identification, defined by a starting reference and traversal rule. Task difficulty is controlled along three axes: (i) ordinal magnitude, from small numbers to extreme cases up to 300; (ii) arrangement complexity, from single loops to maze-like paths; and (iii) object count. The benchmark provides 39,000 question-answer pairs, each annotated with a ground-truth reasoning trajectory and balanced across difficulty levels for controlled large-scale testing. Beyond answer-only evaluation, our framework requires models to generate structured stepwise traces of the counting process and provides an open evaluation toolkit that measures both final accuracy and step-level path consistency. Zero-shot evaluations of GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, Qwen2.5-VL, InternVL3.5, and Molmo reveal sharp degradation under large-ordinal and complex-path conditions, highlighting weak generalization despite strong scores on standard multimodal tasks. By framing ordinal number understanding as a core target, OrdinalBench provides a reproducible benchmark and diagnostic framework for developing VLMs with stronger sequential reasoning. All data and code are available at https://ordinalbench.github.io/
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在多模态基准测试中取得了进展，但仍然在序数理解方面表现出明显的差距，即跟踪相对位置和推广到大索引的能力。我们提出了OrdinalBench，一个诊断性基准测试，将序数理解标准化为VLMs的评估任务。核心任务是第N个对象识别，由起始参考和遍历规则定义。任务难度沿三个轴进行控制：（i）序数大小，从小数字到高达300的极端情况；（ii）排列复杂度，从单循环到迷宫状路径；以及（iii）对象计数。该基准测试提供39,000个问答对，每个问答对都标注了真实推理轨迹，并针对受控的大规模测试在难度级别上进行了平衡。除了仅回答的评估之外，我们的框架还要求模型生成计数过程的结构化逐步跟踪，并提供一个开放的评估工具包，用于测量最终准确性和步骤级别的路径一致性。对GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite、Qwen2.5-VL、InternVL3.5和Molmo的零样本评估显示，在大序数和复杂路径条件下性能急剧下降，突出显示了在标准多模态任务上取得高分的同时，泛化能力薄弱。通过将序数理解构建为核心目标，OrdinalBench为开发具有更强顺序推理的VLMs提供了一个可复现的基准测试和诊断框架。所有数据和代码均可在https://ordinalbench.github.io/获取。
tldr: The paper introduces OrdinalBench, a new diagnostic benchmark for evaluating the ordinal number understanding capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), revealing their limitations in generalizing to large ordinal numbers and complex arrangements.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 OrdinalBench，这是一个新的诊断基准，用于评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）的序数理解能力，揭示了它们在推广到大序数和复杂排列方面的局限性。

title: How Far Can Unsupervised RLVR Scale LLM Training?
summary: Unsupervised reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (URLVR) offers a pathway to scale LLM training beyond the supervision bottleneck by deriving rewards without ground truth labels. Recent works leverage model intrinsic signals, showing promising early gains, yet their potential and limitations remain unclear. In this work, we revisit URLVR and provide a comprehensive analysis spanning taxonomy, theory and extensive experiments. We first classify URLVR methods into intrinsic versus external based on reward sources, then establish a unified theoretical framework revealing that all intrinsic methods converge toward sharpening the model's initial distribution This sharpening mechanism succeeds when initial confidence aligns with correctness but fails catastrophically when misaligned. Through systematic experiments, we show intrinsic rewards consistently follow a rise-then-fall pattern across methods, with collapse timing determined by model prior rather than engineering choices. Despite these scaling limits, we find intrinsic rewards remain valuable in test-time training on small datasets, and propose Model Collapse Step to measure model prior, serving as a practical indicator for RL trainability. Finally, we explore external reward methods that ground verification in computational asymmetries, showing preliminary evidence they may escape the confidence-correctness ceiling. Our findings chart boundaries for intrinsic URLVR while motivating paths toward scalable alternatives.
summary_zh: 具有可验证奖励的无监督强化学习 (URLVR) 提供了一条扩展大语言模型训练的途径，使其超越了监督瓶颈，通过在没有真实标签的情况下推导出奖励。 近期工作利用模型内在信号，展现了富有前景的早期收益，但它们的潜力和局限性仍然不明朗。 在这项工作中，我们重新审视了 URLVR，并提供了涵盖分类法、理论和广泛实验的全面分析。 我们首先根据奖励来源将 URLVR 方法分为内在方法和外在方法，然后建立了一个统一的理论框架，揭示了所有内在方法都收敛于锐化模型初始分布。 当初始置信度与正确性对齐时，这种锐化机制会成功，但在失调时会惨遭失败。 通过系统的实验，我们表明内在奖励在各种方法中始终遵循先上升后下降的模式，且崩塌时间由模型先验而非工程选择决定。 尽管存在这些缩放限制，但我们发现内在奖励在小型数据集上的测试时训练中仍然有价值，并提出了“模型崩塌步”来衡量模型先验，作为衡量强化学习可训练性的实用指标。 最后，我们探索了基于计算非对称性来验证的外在奖励方法，初步证据表明它们可能突破置信度-正确性的天花板。 我们的发现标定了内在 URLVR 的边界，同时激发了通往可扩展替代方案的途径。
tldr: The paper analyzes the scaling limitations of unsupervised RLVR for LLM training using intrinsic rewards, showing a rise-then-fall pattern due to model prior, and explores external reward methods as a potential solution.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了使用内在奖励进行无监督 RLVR 训练 LLM 的扩展限制，表明由于模型先验，存在一个上升然后下降的模式，并探索了外部奖励方法作为潜在的解决方案。

title: Integrating Lagrangian Neural Networks into the Dyna Framework for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) is sample-efficient but depends on the accuracy of the learned dynamics, which are often modeled using black-box methods that do not adhere to physical laws. Those methods tend to produce inaccurate predictions when presented with data that differ from the original training set. In this work, we employ Lagrangian neural networks (LNNs), which enforce an underlying Lagrangian structure to train the model within a Dyna-based MBRL framework. Furthermore, we train the LNN using stochastic gradient-based and state-estimation-based optimizers to learn the network's weights. The state-estimation-based method converges faster than the stochastic gradient-based method during neural network training. Simulation results are provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed LNN-based Dyna framework for MBRL.
summary_zh: 基于模型的强化学习(MBRL)具有样本效率，但依赖于所学习动力学的准确性，而这些动力学通常使用不符合物理定律的黑盒方法建模。当遇到与原始训练集不同的数据时，这些方法往往会产生不准确的预测。在这项工作中，我们采用拉格朗日神经网络(LNNs)，它强制执行底层的拉格朗日结构，在一个基于Dyna的MBRL框架内训练模型。此外，我们使用基于随机梯度和基于状态估计的优化器训练LNNs，以学习网络的权重。在神经网络训练期间，基于状态估计的方法比基于随机梯度的方法收敛更快。提供了仿真结果，以说明所提出的基于LNNs的Dyna框架对于MBRL的有效性。
tldr: This paper integrates Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) into a Dyna-based MBRL framework for improved sample efficiency and adherence to physical laws, addressing limitations of black-box dynamics models. They show faster convergence using state-estimation-based optimizers compared to stochastic gradient methods.
tldr_zh: 本文将拉格朗日神经网络（LNNs）集成到基于 Dyna 的 MBRL 框架中，以提高样本效率并遵守物理定律，从而解决了黑盒动力学模型的局限性。结果表明，与随机梯度方法相比，使用基于状态估计的优化器可以实现更快的收敛。

title: MJ1: Multimodal Judgment via Grounded Verification
summary: Multimodal judges struggle to ground decisions in visual evidence. We present MJ1, a multimodal judge trained with reinforcement learning that enforces visual grounding through a structured grounded verification chain (observations $\rightarrow$ claims $\rightarrow$ verification $\rightarrow$ evaluation $\rightarrow$ scoring) and a counterfactual consistency reward that penalizes position bias. Even without training, our mechanism improves base-model accuracy on MMRB2 by +3.8 points on Image Editing and +1.7 on Multimodal Reasoning. After training, MJ1, with only 3B active parameters, achieves 77.0% accuracy on MMRB2 and surpasses orders-of-magnitude larger models like Gemini-3-Pro. These results show that grounded verification and consistency-based training substantially improve multimodal judgment without increasing model scale.
summary_zh: 多模态评判器难以将其决策扎根于视觉证据。我们提出了 MJ1，一个通过强化学习训练的多模态评判器，它通过结构化的扎根验证链（观察 $\rightarrow$ 断言 $\rightarrow$ 验证 $\rightarrow$ 评估 $\rightarrow$ 评分）和惩罚位置偏差的反事实一致性奖励来强制视觉扎根。即使没有经过训练，我们的机制也能使基础模型在 MMRB2 上，图像编辑任务提升 +3.8 个百分点，多模态推理任务提升 +1.7 个百分点。经过训练后，MJ1 仅使用 30 亿个活跃参数，便在 MMRB2 上实现了 77.0% 的准确率，并超越了 Gemini-3-Pro 等体量级更大的模型。这些结果表明，扎根验证和基于一致性的训练可以在不增加模型规模的情况下，大幅提升多模态判断能力。
tldr: The paper introduces MJ1, a multimodal judge trained with reinforcement learning using grounded verification and counterfactual consistency, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy on the MMRB2 benchmark without increasing model scale.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MJ1，一个通过强化学习训练的多模态判决器，它使用基于扎根验证和反事实一致性的方法，在MMRB2基准测试上实现了最先进的准确率，且没有增加模型规模。

title: Diff-Muscle: Efficient Learning for Musculoskeletal Robotic Table Tennis
summary: Musculoskeletal robots provide superior advantages in flexibility and dexterity, positioning them as a promising frontier towards embodied intelligence. However, current research is largely confined to relative simple tasks, restricting the exploration of their full potential in multi-segment coordination. Furthermore, efficient learning remains a challenge, primarily due to the high-dimensional action space and inherent overactuated structures. To address these challenges, we propose Diff-Muscle, a musculoskeletal robot control algorithm that leverages differential flatness to reformulate policy learning from the redundant muscle-activation space into a significantly lower-dimensional joint space. Furthermore, we utilize the highly dynamic robotic table tennis task to evaluate our algorithm. Specifically, we propose a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that integrates a Kinematics-based Muscle Actuation Controller (K-MAC) with high-level trajectory planning, enabling a musculoskeletal robot to perform dexterous and precise rallies. Experimental results demonstrate that Diff-Muscle significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in success rates while maintaining minimal muscle activation. Notably, the proposed framework successfully enables the musculoskeletal robots to achieve continuous rallies in a challenging dual-robot setting.
summary_zh: 肌肉骨骼机器人在灵活性和灵巧性方面具有卓越优势，使其成为具身智能领域一个极具前景的前沿方向。然而，目前的研究主要局限于相对简单的任务，限制了其在多段协调方面的潜力探索。此外，高效学习仍然是一个挑战，这主要是由于高维动作空间和固有的过度驱动结构。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了Diff-Muscle，一种肌肉骨骼机器人控制算法，该算法利用微分平坦性将策略学习从冗余的肌肉激活空间重新表述为显著降低维度的关节空间。此外，我们利用高动态的机器人乒乓球任务来评估我们的算法。具体来说，我们提出了一个分层强化学习框架，该框架集成了基于运动学的肌肉驱动控制器（K-MAC）和高层轨迹规划，使肌肉骨骼机器人能够执行灵巧而精准的连续击球。实验结果表明，Diff-Muscle在成功率方面显著优于最先进的基线方法，同时保持最小的肌肉激活。值得注意的是，所提出的框架成功地使肌肉骨骼机器人在具有挑战性的双机器人环境中实现了连续的连续击球。
tldr: The paper introduces Diff-Muscle, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that leverages differential flatness to enable musculoskeletal robots to perform challenging table tennis rallies more efficiently than existing methods, showcasing potential for complex, coordinated movements.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Diff-Muscle，一种分层强化学习框架，利用微分平坦性使肌肉骨骼机器人能够比现有方法更有效地进行具有挑战性的乒乓球 rallies，展示了在复杂、协调运动方面的潜力。

title: CONTACT: CONtact-aware TACTile Learning for Robotic Disassembly
summary: Robotic disassembly involves contact-rich interactions in which successful manipulation depends not only on geometric alignment but also on force-dependent state transitions. While vision-based policies perform well in structured settings, their reliability often degrades in tight-tolerance, contact-dominated, or deformable scenarios. In this work, we systematically investigate the role of tactile sensing in robotic disassembly through both simulation and real-world experiments. We construct five rigid-body disassembly tasks in simulation with increasing geometric constraints and extraction difficulty. We further design five real-world tasks, including three rigid and two deformable scenarios, to evaluate contact-dependent manipulation. Within a unified learning framework, we compare three sensing configurations: Vision Only, Vision + tactile RGB (TacRGB), and Vision + tactile force field (TacFF). Across both simulation and real-world experiments, TacFF-based policies consistently achieve the highest success rates, with particularly notable gains in contact-dependent and deformable settings. Notably, naive fusion of TacRGB and TacFF underperforms either modality alone, indicating that simple concatenation can dilute task-relevant force information. Our results show that tactile sensing plays a critical, task-dependent role in robotic disassembly, with structured force-field representations being particularly effective in contact-dominated scenarios.
summary_zh: 机器人拆卸涉及富含接触的交互，其中成功操作不仅取决于几何对齐，还取决于力依赖的状态转换。虽然基于视觉的策略在结构化环境中表现良好，但其可靠性通常会在紧公差、接触主导或可变形的场景中降低。在这项工作中，我们通过仿真和真实世界的实验，系统地研究了触觉传感器在机器人拆卸中的作用。我们构建了五个仿真中的刚体拆卸任务，这些任务具有不断增加的几何约束和提取难度。我们进一步设计了五个真实世界的任务，包括三个刚性场景和两个可变形场景，以评估接触依赖的操作。在一个统一的学习框架内，我们比较了三种传感配置：仅视觉（Vision Only）、视觉+触觉RGB（TacRGB）和视觉+触觉力场（TacFF）。在仿真和真实世界的实验中，基于TacFF的策略始终获得最高的成功率，尤其是在接触依赖和可变形场景中取得了显著的提升。值得注意的是，TacRGB和TacFF的简单融合效果均不如单独使用任何一种模式，表明简单的串联会稀释与任务相关的力信息。我们的结果表明，触觉传感器在机器人拆卸中发挥着关键的、任务依赖的作用，其中结构化的力场表示在接触主导的场景中尤其有效。
tldr: This paper explores the use of tactile sensing, particularly force-field representations, in robotic disassembly tasks, demonstrating improved success rates in contact-rich and deformable scenarios compared to vision-only approaches.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了触觉感知，特别是力场表示，在机器人拆卸任务中的应用，并证明与纯视觉方法相比，在接触密集和可变形场景中提高了成功率。

title: An Open-Source Robotics Research Platform for Autonomous Laparoscopic Surgery
summary: Autonomous robot-assisted surgery demands reliable, high-precision platforms that strictly adhere to the safety and kinematic constraints of minimally invasive procedures. Existing research platforms, primarily based on the da Vinci Research Kit, suffer from cable-driven mechanical limitations that degrade state-space consistency and hinder the downstream training of reliable autonomous policies. We present an open-source, robot-agnostic Remote Center of Motion (RCM) controller based on a closed-form analytical velocity solver that enforces the trocar constraint deterministically without iterative optimization. The controller operates in Cartesian space, enabling any industrial manipulator to function as a surgical robot. We provide implementations for the UR5e and Franka Emika Panda manipulators, and integrate stereoscopic 3D perception. We integrate the robot control into a full-stack ROS-based surgical robotics platform supporting teleoperation, demonstration recording, and deployment of learned policies via a decoupled server-client architecture. We validate the system on a bowel grasping and retraction task across phantom, ex vivo, and in vivo porcine laparoscopic procedures. RCM deviations remain sub-millimeter across all conditions, and trajectory smoothness metrics (SPARC, LDLJ) are comparable to expert demonstrations from the JIGSAWS benchmark recorded on the da Vinci system. These results demonstrate that the platform provides the precision and robustness required for teleoperation, data collection and autonomous policy deployment in realistic surgical scenarios.
summary_zh: 自主机器人辅助手术要求可靠、高精度的平台，这些平台必须严格遵守微创手术的安全约束和运动学约束。现有的研究平台，主要基于达芬奇研究套件，受电缆驱动的机械限制影响，会降低状态空间的一致性，并阻碍可靠自主策略的下游训练。我们提出了一种开源的、与机器人无关的远程运动中心（RCM）控制器，它基于闭式解析速度求解器，可确定性地执行套管针约束，而无需迭代优化。该控制器在笛卡尔空间中运行，使任何工业机械臂都能够像手术机器人一样工作。我们提供了适用于UR5e和Franka Emika Panda机械臂的实现，并集成了立体3D感知。我们将机器人控制集成到一个完整的基于ROS的手术机器人平台中，该平台支持远程操作、演示记录，并通过解耦的服务器-客户端架构部署学习到的策略。我们在体模、离体和体内猪腹腔镜手术中的肠道抓取和回缩任务中验证了该系统。在所有条件下，RCM偏差始终保持在亚毫米级，轨迹平滑度指标（SPARC、LDLJ）与在达芬奇系统上记录的JIGSAWS基准专家演示相当。这些结果表明，该平台提供了在实际手术场景中进行远程操作、数据收集和自主策略部署所需的精度和鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper presents an open-source, robot-agnostic surgical robotics platform with a novel RCM controller, validated on various laparoscopic procedures, suitable for teleoperation, data collection, and autonomous policy deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个开源的，与机器人无关的手术机器人平台，该平台具有一种新型RCM控制器，并在各种腹腔镜手术中进行了验证，适用于远程操作、数据收集和自主策略部署。

title: STRIDE: Structured Lagrangian and Stochastic Residual Dynamics via Flow Matching
summary: Robotic systems operating in unstructured environments must operate under significant uncertainty arising from intermittent contacts, frictional variability, and unmodeled compliance. While recent model-free approaches have demonstrated impressive performance, many deployment settings still require predictive models that support planning, constraint handling, and online adaptation. Analytical rigid-body models provide strong physical structure but often fail to capture complex interaction effects, whereas purely data-driven models may violate physical consistency, exhibit data bias, and accumulate long-horizon drift. In this work, we propose STRIDE, a dynamics learning framework that explicitly separates conservative rigid-body mechanics from uncertain, effectively stochastic non-conservative interaction effects. The structured component is modeled using a Lagrangian Neural Network (LNN) to preserve energy-consistent inertial dynamics, while residual interaction forces are represented using Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) to capture multi-modal interaction phenomena. The two components are trained jointly end-to-end, enabling the model to retain physical structure while representing complex stochastic behavior. We evaluate STRIDE on systems of increasing complexity, including a pendulum, the Unitree Go1 quadruped, and the Unitree G1 humanoid. Results show 20% reduction in long-horizon prediction error and 30% reduction in contact force prediction error compared to deterministic residual baselines, supporting more reliable model-based control in uncertain robotic environments.
summary_zh: 在非结构化环境中运行的机器人系统必须在由间歇性接触、摩擦变异性和未建模顺性引起的显著不确定性下运行。虽然最近的无模型方法已经展示了令人印象深刻的性能，但许多部署场景仍然需要支持规划、约束处理和在线自适应的预测模型。解析刚体模型提供了强大的物理结构，但通常无法捕捉复杂的交互效应，而纯粹数据驱动的模型可能违背物理一致性，表现出数据偏差，并累积长时程漂移。 在这项工作中，我们提出了 STRIDE，一个动力学学习框架，它显式地将保守刚体力学与不确定的，有效地随机的非保守交互效应分离。结构化组件使用拉格朗日神经网络 (LNN) 建模，以保持能量一致的惯性动力学，而残差交互力使用条件流匹配 (CFM) 表示，以捕捉多模态交互现象。这两个组件被端到端地联合训练，使模型能够保留物理结构，同时表示复杂的随机行为。我们在复杂性日益增加的系统上评估 STRIDE，包括一个摆、宇树 Go1 四足机器人和宇树 G1 人形机器人。结果表明，与确定性残差基线相比，长时程预测误差降低了 20%，接触力预测误差降低了 30%，从而支持在不确定的机器人环境中进行更可靠的基于模型的控制。
tldr: STRIDE combines Lagrangian Neural Networks for energy-consistent dynamics with Conditional Flow Matching to model uncertain interaction forces in robotics, achieving improved prediction accuracy compared to baselines.
tldr_zh: STRIDE结合了拉格朗日神经网络（LNN）用于能量一致的动力学建模，以及条件流匹配（CFM）来模拟机器人中的不确定交互力，相比基线方法实现了更高的预测精度。

title: LAR-MoE: Latent-Aligned Routing for Mixture of Experts in Robotic Imitation Learning
summary: Imitation learning enables robots to acquire manipulation skills from demonstrations, yet deploying a policy across tasks with heterogeneous dynamics remains challenging, as models tend to average over distinct behavioral modes present in the demonstrations. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures address this by activating specialized subnetworks, but requires meaningful skill decompositions for expert routing. We introduce Latent-Aligned Routing for Mixture of Experts (LAR-MoE), a two-stage framework that decouples unsupervised skill discovery from policy learning. In pre-training, we learn a joint latent representation between observations and future actions through student-teacher co-training. In a post-training stage, the expert routing is regularized to follow the structure of the learned latent space, preventing expert collapse while maintaining parameter efficiency. We evaluate LAR-MoE in simulation and on hardware. On the LIBERO benchmark, our method achieves a 95.2% average success rate with 150M parameters. On a surgical bowel grasping and retraction task, LAR-MoE matches a supervised MoE baseline without requiring any phase annotations, and transfers zero-shot to ex vivo porcine tissue. Our findings suggest that latent-aligned routing provides a principled alternative to supervised skill decomposition, enabling structured expert specialization from unlabeled demonstrations.
summary_zh: 模仿学习使机器人能够从演示中获取操作技能，然而，在具有异构动力学的任务中部署策略仍然具有挑战性，因为模型倾向于对演示中存在的不同行为模式进行平均。混合专家 (MoE) 架构通过激活专门的子网络来解决这个问题，但需要有意义的技能分解来进行专家路由。我们提出了用于混合专家的潜在对齐路由 (LAR-MoE)，这是一个两阶段框架，将无监督技能发现与策略学习解耦。在预训练中，我们通过学生-教师协同训练学习观测和未来动作之间的联合潜在表示。在后训练阶段，专家路由被正则化，以遵循学习到的潜在空间的结构，防止专家崩塌，同时保持参数效率。我们在模拟和硬件上评估了 LAR-MoE。在 LIBERO 基准上，我们的方法以 1.5 亿参数实现了 95.2% 的平均成功率。在外科肠道抓取和牵开任务中，LAR-MoE 在不需要任何阶段注释的情况下，匹配了有监督 MoE 基线，并零样本迁移到离体猪组织。我们的研究结果表明，潜在对齐路由为有监督的技能分解提供了一种原则性的替代方案，能够从无标签的演示中实现结构化的专家专业化。
tldr: The paper introduces LAR-MoE, a method for robotic imitation learning that decouples skill discovery and policy learning using latent-aligned routing in a Mixture of Experts architecture, achieving strong performance on manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了LAR-MoE，一种用于机器人模仿学习的方法，利用混合专家架构中的潜在对齐路由，将技能发现和策略学习解耦，在操作任务上取得了很好的性能。

title: Tactile Recognition of Both Shapes and Materials with Automatic Feature Optimization-Enabled Meta Learning
summary: Tactile perception is indispensable for robots to implement various manipulations dexterously, especially in contact-rich scenarios. However, alongside the development of deep learning techniques, it meanwhile suffers from training data scarcity and a time-consuming learning process in practical applications since the collection of a large amount of tactile data is costly and sometimes even impossible. Hence, we propose an automatic feature optimization-enabled prototypical network to realize meta-learning, i.e., AFOP-ML framework. As a ``learn to learn" network, it not only adapts to new unseen classes rapidly with few-shot, but also learns how to determine the optimal feature space automatically. Based on the four-channel signals acquired from a tactile finger, both shapes and materials are recognized. On a 36-category benchmark, it outperforms several existing approaches by attaining an accuracy of 96.08% in 5-way-1-shot scenario, where only 1 example is available for training. It still remains 88.7% in the extreme 36-way-1-shot case. The generalization ability is further validated through three groups of experiment involving unseen shapes, materials and force/speed perturbations. More insights are additionally provided by this work for the interpretation of recognition tasks and improved design of tactile sensors.
summary_zh: 触觉感知对于机器人灵巧地执行各种操作至关重要，尤其是在富接触场景中。然而，伴随着深度学习技术的发展，触觉感知同时也面临着训练数据稀缺和学习过程耗时的难题，因为大量触觉数据的采集成本高昂，有时甚至是不可能的。有鉴于此，我们提出了一种自动特征优化的原型网络，以实现元学习，即AFOP-ML框架。作为一个“学习如何学习”的网络，它不仅能够以小样本快速适应新的、未见过的类别，还能自动学习如何确定最佳特征空间。基于从触觉手指获取的四通道信号，可以识别形状和材料。在36类基准测试中，它优于几种现有方法，在5路1次学习场景（即仅有1个训练样本）下达到了96.08%的准确率，而在极端情况下，36路1次学习仍然保持88.7%的准确率。通过涉及未见过的形状、材料以及力和速度扰动的三组实验，进一步验证了其泛化能力。此外，这项工作还为识别任务的解释和触觉传感器改进设计提供了更多见解。
tldr: The paper introduces an automatic feature optimization-enabled prototypical network (AFOP-ML) for tactile shape and material recognition, achieving high accuracy in few-shot learning scenarios and demonstrating strong generalization ability.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种自动特征优化原型网络（AFOP-ML），用于触觉形状和材料识别，在少样本学习场景中实现了高精度，并展示了强大的泛化能力。

title: Human-Aware Robot Behaviour in Self-Driving Labs
summary: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) are rapidly transforming research in chemistry and materials science to accelerate new discoveries. Mobile robot chemists (MRCs) play a pivotal role by autonomously navigating the lab to transport samples, effectively connecting synthesis, analysis, and characterisation equipment. The instruments within an SDL are typically designed or retrofitted to be accessed by both human and robotic chemists, ensuring operational flexibility and integration between manual and automated workflows. In many scenarios, human and robotic chemists may need to use the same equipment simultaneously. Currently, MRCs rely on simple LiDAR-based obstruction detection, which forces the robot to passively wait if a human is present. This lack of situational awareness leads to unnecessary delays and inefficient coordination in time-critical automated workflows in human-robot shared labs. To address this, we present an initial study of an embodied, AI-driven perception method that facilitates proactive human-robot interaction in shared-access scenarios. Our method features a hierarchical human intention prediction model that allows the robot to distinguish between preparatory actions (waiting) and transient interactions (accessing the instrument). Our results demonstrate that the proposed approach enhances efficiency by enabling proactive human-robot interaction, streamlining coordination, and potentially increasing the efficiency of autonomous scientific labs.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶实验室 (SDL) 正在迅速改变化学和材料科学领域的研究，以加速新发现。移动机器人化学家 (MRC) 通过自主导航实验室以运输样品，有效连接合成、分析和表征设备，发挥着关键作用。SDL 中的仪器通常被设计或改装为可供人类和机器人化学家访问，从而确保操作的灵活性以及手动和自动化工作流程之间的集成。在许多情况下，人类和机器人化学家可能需要同时使用同一设备。目前，MRC 依赖于简单的基于 LiDAR 的障碍物检测，这迫使机器人被动地等待人的存在。这种情境感知能力的缺乏导致了在人机共享实验室中时间关键型自动化工作流程中不必要的延迟和低效的协作。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一项关于具身、人工智能驱动的感知方法的初步研究，该方法有助于在共享访问场景中实现主动的人机交互。我们的方法采用了一种分层的人类意图预测模型，该模型允许机器人区分准备动作（等待）和瞬时交互（访问仪器）。我们的结果表明，所提出的方法通过实现主动的人机交互、简化协作并可能提高自主科学实验室的效率来增强效率。
tldr: This paper presents a human intention prediction model to improve human-robot interaction in self-driving labs, allowing robots to proactively interact with humans and reduce delays. It enhances efficiency by enabling better coordination between human and robotic chemists.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种人类意图预测模型，旨在改善自动驾驶实验室中的人机交互，使机器人能够主动与人类互动并减少延迟。通过改进人类和机器人化学家之间的协调，从而提高效率。

title: A Recipe for Stable Offline Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Despite remarkable achievements in single-agent offline reinforcement learning (RL), multi-agent RL (MARL) has struggled to adopt this paradigm, largely persisting with on-policy training and self-play from scratch. One reason for this gap comes from the instability of non-linear value decomposition, leading prior works to avoid complex mixing networks in favor of linear value decomposition (e.g., VDN) with value regularization used in single-agent setups. In this work, we analyze the source of instability in non-linear value decomposition within the offline MARL setting. Our observations confirm that they induce value-scale amplification and unstable optimization. To alleviate this, we propose a simple technique, scale-invariant value normalization (SVN), that stabilizes actor-critic training without altering the Bellman fixed point. Empirically, we examine the interaction among key components of offline MARL (e.g., value decomposition, value learning, and policy extraction) and derive a practical recipe that unlocks its full potential.
summary_zh: 尽管单智能体离线强化学习（RL）取得了显著成就，但多智能体强化学习（MARL）却难以采用这种范式，很大程度上仍局限于从零开始的在线策略训练和自博弈。造成这种差距的一个原因是非线性值分解的不稳定性，导致以往的研究倾向于避免复杂的混合网络，转而采用线性值分解（例如，VDN）以及在单智能体设置中使用的值函数正则化。在这项工作中，我们分析了离线MARL环境中非线性值分解的不稳定性来源。我们的观察证实，它们会引起值尺度放大和不稳定的优化。为了缓解这个问题，我们提出了一种简单的技术，尺度不变的值归一化（SVN），它可以在不改变贝尔曼不动点的情况下稳定 Actor-Critic 训练。在实验中，我们检验了离线MARL关键组成部分（例如，值分解、值学习和策略提取）之间的相互作用，并推导出一个实用的方法，以释放其全部潜力。
tldr: This paper identifies instability issues in non-linear value decomposition for offline MARL and proposes a scale-invariant value normalization (SVN) technique to stabilize training, ultimately delivering a recipe for improved offline MARL performance.
tldr_zh: 本文指出了离线多智能体强化学习中非线性值分解的不稳定性问题，提出了一种尺度不变值归一化（SVN）技术来稳定训练，最终提供了一种改善离线多智能体强化学习性能的方案。

title: StructBiHOI: Structured Articulation Modeling for Long--Horizon Bimanual Hand--Object Interaction Generation
summary: Recent progress in 3D hand--object interaction (HOI) generation has primarily focused on single--hand grasp synthesis, while bimanual manipulation remains significantly more challenging. Long--horizon planning instability, fine--grained joint articulation, and complex cross--hand coordination make coherent bimanual generation difficult, especially under multimodal conditions. Existing approaches often struggle to simultaneously ensure temporal consistency, physical plausibility, and semantic alignment over extended sequences. We propose StructBiHOI, a Structured articulation modeling framework for long-horizon Bimanual HOI generation. Our key insight is to structurally disentangle temporal joint planning from frame--level manipulation refinement. Specifically, a jointVAE models long-term joint evolution conditioned on object geometry and task semantics, while a maniVAE refines fine-grained hand poses at the single--frame level. To enable stable and efficient long--sequence generation, we incorporate a state--space--inspired diffusion denoiser based on Mamba, which models long--range dependencies with linear complexity. This hierarchical design facilitates coherent dual-hand coordination and articulated object interaction. Extensive experiments on bimanual manipulation and single-hand grasping benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves superior long--horizon stability, motion realism, and computational efficiency compared to strong baselines.
summary_zh: 3D手部-物体交互（HOI）生成领域的最新进展主要集中在单手抓取合成上，而双手操作仍然极具挑战性。长时程规划的不稳定性、精细的关节铰接以及复杂的交叉手部协调使得连贯的双手生成变得困难，尤其是在多模态条件下。现有方法通常难以在延长序列中同时确保时间一致性、物理合理性和语义对齐。我们提出了StructBiHOI，一个用于长时程双手HOI生成的结构化铰接建模框架。我们的关键见解是，从结构上解耦时间关节规划和帧级别操作细化。具体而言，一个jointVAE根据物体几何形状和任务语义，对长期关节演化进行建模，而一个maniVAE在单帧级别上细化精细的手部姿势。为了实现稳定且高效的长序列生成，我们结合了一个基于Mamba的状态空间启发扩散去噪器，该去噪器以线性复杂度建模远距离依赖关系。这种分层设计有助于连贯的双手机器人协调和铰接物体交互。在双手操作和单手抓取基准测试上的大量实验表明，与强大的基线方法相比，我们的方法在长时程稳定性、运动真实性和计算效率方面均表现出优异的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces StructBiHOI, a framework for generating long-horizon bimanual hand-object interactions, using a hierarchical approach with a jointVAE for long-term planning and a maniVAE for fine-grained refinement, incorporating Mamba for temporal modeling.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 StructBiHOI，一个用于生成长时间双手动手对象交互的框架，它采用分层方法，使用 jointVAE 进行长期规划，使用 maniVAE 进行细粒度细化，并结合 Mamba 进行时间建模。

title: Perception-Aware Communication-Free Multi-UAV Coordination in the Wild
summary: We present a communication-free method for safe multi-robot coordination in complex environments such as forests with dense canopy cover, where GNSS is unavailable. Our approach relies on an onboard anisotropic 3D LiDAR sensor used for SLAM as well as for detecting obstacles and neighboring robots. We develop a novel perception-aware 3D navigation framework that enables robots to safely and effectively progress toward a goal region despite limited sensor field-of-view. The approach is evaluated through extensive simulations across diverse scenarios and validated in real-world field experiments, demonstrating its scalability, robustness, and reliability.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种无需通信的方法，用于在复杂的环境中（例如具有密集树冠覆盖且GNSS不可用的森林）实现安全的多机器人协同。我们的方法依赖于用于SLAM以及检测障碍物和邻近机器人的机载各向异性3D LiDAR传感器。我们开发了一种新型的感知感知型3D导航框架，该框架能够使机器人在传感器视野有限的情况下，安全有效地朝着目标区域前进。该方法通过在各种场景中进行的大量仿真评估，并在真实的野外实验中得到验证，证明了其可扩展性、鲁棒性和可靠性。
tldr: This paper presents a communication-free multi-UAV coordination method using onboard LiDAR for SLAM and obstacle/robot detection in GNSS-denied environments, validated in simulations and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无需通信的多无人机协同方法，该方法使用机载激光雷达进行SLAM以及障碍物/机器人检测，适用于GNSS受限环境，并在模拟和真实世界实验中进行了验证。

title: Hierarchical Multi-Modal Planning for Fixed-Altitude Sparse Target Search and Sampling
summary: Efficient monitoring of sparse benthic phenomena, such as coral colonies, presents a great challenge for Autonomous Underwater Vehicles. Traditional exhaustive coverage strategies are energy-inefficient, while recent adaptive sampling approaches rely on costly vertical maneuvers. To address these limitations, we propose HIMoS (Hierarchical Informative Multi-Modal Search), a fixed-altitude framework for sparse coral search-and-sample missions.
