Theoretically, we prove that LCBO achieves a convergence rate for the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) residual that depends polynomially on the dimension $d$ for common kernels under mild assumptions, offering a rigorous alternative to global BO where regret bounds typically scale exponentially. Extensive evaluations on high-dimensional benchmarks (up to 100D) demonstrate that LCBO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
summary_zh: 对于高维约束问题，贝叶斯优化(BO)仍然面临维度灾难的重大挑战。我们提出了一种名为局部约束贝叶斯优化(LCBO)的新框架，专门为解决此类问题而设计。与在面对严格或复杂约束时容易过早收缩的信任域方法不同，LCBO利用约束惩罚代理模型的微分特性，在快速局部下降和不确定性驱动的探索之间交替进行。在理论上，我们证明了在温和假设下，对于常见核函数，LCBO实现了Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT)残差的收敛速度，其收敛速度以多项式形式依赖于维度$d$，为全局贝叶斯优化提供了一种严格的替代方案，全局贝叶斯优化的后悔界通常呈指数级增长。在高维基准（高达100维）上的广泛评估表明，LCBO始终优于最先进的基线方法。
tldr: The paper introduces Local Constrained Bayesian Optimization (LCBO) for high-dimensional constrained optimization problems, demonstrating polynomial convergence rates and superior performance compared to existing methods in high-dimensional benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了局部约束贝叶斯优化（LCBO），用于解决高维约束优化问题。LCBO在常见核函数下实现了多项式收敛速度，并在高维基准测试中表现优于现有方法。

title: MRDrive: An Open Source Mixed Reality Driving Simulator for Automotive User Research
summary: Designing and evaluating in-vehicle interfaces requires experimental platforms that combine ecological validity with experimental control. Driving simulators are widely used for this purpose. However, they face a fundamental trade-off: high-fidelity physical simulators are costly and difficult to adapt, while virtual reality simulators provide flexibility at the expense of physical interaction with the vehicle. In this work, we present MRDrive, an open mixed-reality driving simulator designed to support HCI research on in-vehicle interaction, attention, and explainability in manual and automated driving contexts. MRDrive enables drivers and passengers to interact with a real vehicle cabin while being fully immersed in a virtual driving environment. We demonstrate the capabilities of MRDrive through a small pilot study that illustrates how the simulator can be used to collect and analyze eye-tracking and touch interaction data in an automated driving scenario. MRDRive is available at: https://github.com/ciao-group/mrdrive
summary_zh: 设计和评估车载界面需要兼顾生态效度和实验控制的实验平台。驾驶模拟器被广泛应用于此目的。然而，它们面临着一个根本性的权衡：高保真物理模拟器成本高昂且难以调整，而虚拟现实模拟器虽然提供了更高的灵活性，但却牺牲了与车辆的物理交互。在这项工作中，我们提出MRDrive，这是一个开放的混合现实驾驶模拟器，旨在支持关于手动和自动驾驶环境中车载交互、注意力和可解释性的人机交互研究。MRDrive使驾驶员和乘客能够在完全沉浸于虚拟驾驶环境中的同时，与真实的车辆座舱进行交互。我们通过一个小型的先导研究证明了MRDrive的功能，该研究展示了如何使用该模拟器在自动驾驶场景中收集和分析眼动追踪和触摸交互数据。MRDrive可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/ciao-group/mrdrive
tldr: The paper introduces MRDrive, an open-source mixed-reality driving simulator that combines a real vehicle cabin with a virtual driving environment for HCI research related to in-vehicle interaction, attention, and explainability during automated and manual driving.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个名为MRDrive的开源混合现实驾驶模拟器，该模拟器将真实的车辆座舱与虚拟驾驶环境相结合，用于人机交互研究，重点关注在自动和手动驾驶模式下车内互动，注意力和可解释性。

title: Trajectory Tracking Control Design for Autonomous Helicopters with Guaranteed Error Bounds
summary: This paper presents a systematic framework for computing formally guaranteed trajectory tracking error bounds for autonomous helicopters based on Robust Positive Invariant (RPI) sets. The approach focuses on establishing a closed-loop translational error dynamics which is cast into polytopic linear parameter-varying form with bounded additive and state-dependent disturbances. Ellipsoidal RPI sets are computed, yielding explicit position error bounds suitable as certified buffer zones in upper-level trajectory planning. Three controller architectures are compared with respect to the conservatism of their error bounds and tracking performance. Simulation results on a nonlinear helicopter model demonstrate that all architectures respect the derived bounds, while highlighting trade-offs between dynamical fidelity and conservatism in invariant set computation.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于鲁棒正不变（RPI）集的自主直升机轨迹跟踪误差界限的形式化保证的计算系统框架。该方法重点在于建立一个闭环平移误差动力学模型，该模型被转化为具有有界加性扰动和状态相关扰动的多胞型线性参数变分形式。计算椭球RPI集，从而产生明确的位置误差界限，适于作为上层轨迹规划中认证的缓冲区域。比较了三种控制器架构，考察其误差界限的保守性和跟踪性能。在非线性直升机模型上的仿真结果表明，所有架构都满足推导出的界限，同时突出了动态保真度和不变集计算中的保守性之间的权衡。
tldr: This paper presents a framework for computing guaranteed trajectory tracking error bounds for autonomous helicopters using Robust Positive Invariant (RPI) sets, comparing different controller architectures in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于鲁棒正不变 (RPI) 集的自主直升机轨迹跟踪误差界限计算框架，并在仿真中比较了不同的控制器架构。

title: Aero-Promptness: Drag-Aware Aerodynamic Manipulability for Propeller-driven Vehicles
summary: This work introduces the Drag-Aware Aerodynamic Manipulability (DAAM), a geometric framework for control allocation in redundant multirotors. By equipping the propeller spin-rate space with a Riemannian metric based on the remaining symmetric acceleration capacity of each motor, the formulation explicitly accounts for motor torque limits and aerodynamic drag. Mapping this metric through the nonlinear thrust law to the generalized force space yields a state-dependent manipulability volume. The log-determinant of this volume acts as a natural barrier function, strictly penalizing drag-induced saturation and low-spin thrust loss. Optimizing this volume along the allocation fibers provides a redundancy resolution strategy inherently invariant to arbitrary coordinate scaling in the generalized-force space. Analytically, we prove that the resulting optimal allocations locally form smooth embedded manifolds, and we geometrically characterize the global jump discontinuities that inevitably arise from physical actuator limits and spin-rate sign transitions.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为“阻力感知气动可操纵性”（DAAM）的几何框架，用于冗余多旋翼飞行器的控制分配。通过赋予螺旋桨转速空间一个基于各电机剩余对称加速度能力的黎曼度量，该公式明确考虑了电机扭矩限制和气动阻力。将该度量通过非线性推力定律映射到广义力空间，产生一个状态相关的可操纵性体积。该体积的对数行列式充当自然的势垒函数，严格惩罚阻力引起的饱和和低转速推力损失。沿着分配纤维优化该体积提供了一种冗余解析策略，该策略天然地对广义力空间中的任意坐标缩放保持不变。在理论上，我们证明了由此产生的最优分配在局部形成光滑的嵌入流形，并从几何上刻画了由物理执行器限制和转速符号转换不可避免地产生的全局跳跃不连续性。
tldr: This paper introduces a geometric framework (DAAM) for control allocation in multirotors, explicitly accounting for motor torque limits and aerodynamic drag to optimize motor control and prevent saturation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个用于多旋翼飞行器控制分配的几何框架（DAAM），该框架显式考虑了电机扭矩限制和空气动力阻力，以优化电机控制并防止饱和。

title: Efficient Policy Learning with Hybrid Evaluation-Based Genetic Programming for Uncertain Agile Earth Observation Satellite Scheduling
summary: The Uncertain Agile Earth Observation Satellite Scheduling Problem (UAEOSSP) is a novel combinatorial optimization problem and a practical engineering challenge that aligns with the current demands of space technology development. It incorporates uncertainties in profit, resource consumption, and visibility, which may render pre-planned schedules suboptimal or even infeasible. Genetic Programming Hyper-Heuristic (GPHH) shows promise for evolving interpretable scheduling policies; however, their simulation-based evaluation incurs high computational costs. Moreover, the design of the constructive method, denoted as Online Scheduling Algorithm (OSA), directly affects fitness assessment, resulting in evaluation-dependent local optima within the policy space. To address these issues, this paper proposes a Hybrid Evaluation-based Genetic Programming (HE-GP) for effectively solving UAEOSSP. A Hybrid Evaluation (HE) mechanism is integrated into the policy-driven OSA, combining exact and approximate filtering modes: exact mode ensures evaluation accuracy through elaborately designed constraint verification modules, while approximate mode reduces computational overhead via simplified logic. HE-GP dynamically switches between evaluation models based on real-time evolutionary state information. Experiments on 16 simulated instance sets demonstrate that HE-GP significantly outperforms handcrafted heuristics and single-evaluation based GPHH, achieving substantial reductions in computational cost while maintaining excellent scheduling performance across diverse scenarios. Specifically, the average training time of HE-GP was reduced by 17.77\% compared to GP employing exclusively exact evaluation, while the optimal policy generated by HE-GP achieved the highest average ranks across all scenarios.
summary_zh: 不确定敏捷地球观测卫星调度问题 (UAEOSSP) 是一种新型组合优化问题，也是一项顺应当前空间技术发展需求的实用工程挑战。它纳入了利润、资源消耗和可见性方面的不确定性，这可能导致预先制定的调度方案变得次优甚至不可行。遗传编程超启发式算法 (GPHH) 在演化可解释调度策略方面展现出潜力；然而，它们的基于仿真的评估会产生高昂的计算成本。此外，构造性方法 (称为在线调度算法 (OSA)) 的设计直接影响适应度评估，导致策略空间内出现依赖于评估的局部最优解。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了一种基于混合评估的遗传编程算法 (HE-GP)，用于有效解决 UAEOSSP。一种混合评估 (HE) 机制被集成到策略驱动的 OSA 中，结合了精确和近似过滤模式：精确模式通过精心设计的约束验证模块来确保评估准确性，而近似模式通过简化的逻辑来降低计算开销。HE-GP 根据实时进化状态信息在评估模型之间动态切换。在 16 个模拟实例集上的实验表明，HE-GP 明显优于手工设计的启发式算法和基于单一评估的 GPHH，在各种场景中实现了计算成本的大幅降低，同时保持了出色的调度性能。具体而言，与仅采用精确评估的 GP 相比，HE-GP 的平均训练时间减少了 17.77％，而 HE-GP 生成的最优策略在所有场景中都获得了最高的平均排名。
tldr: This paper proposes a hybrid evaluation-based genetic programming (HE-GP) approach for solving the Uncertain Agile Earth Observation Satellite Scheduling Problem (UAEOSSP). It achieves significant reductions in computational cost while maintaining scheduling performance compared to handcrafted heuristics and single-evaluation GPHH.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于混合评估的遗传编程 (HE-GP) 方法，用于解决不确定敏捷地球观测卫星调度问题 (UAEOSSP)。与手工启发式方法和基于单一评估的 GPHH 相比，它在保持调度性能的同时，显著降低了计算成本。

title: PSTNet: Physically-Structured Turbulence Network
summary: Reliable real-time estimation of atmospheric turbulence intensity remains an open challenge for aircraft operating across diverse altitude bands, particularly over oceanic, polar, and data-sparse regions that lack operational nowcasting infrastructure. Classical spectral models encode climatological averages rather than the instantaneous atmospheric state, and generic ML regressors offer adaptivity but provide no guarantee that predictions respect fundamental scaling laws. This paper introduces the Physically-Structured Turbulence Network (PSTNet), a lightweight architecture that embeds physics directly into its structure. PSTNet couples four components: (i) a zero-parameter backbone derived from Monin-Obukhov theory, (ii) a regime-gated mixture of specialist sub-networks supervised by Richardson-number-derived soft targets, (iii) Feature-wise Linear Modulation layers conditioning hidden representations on local air-density ratio, and (iv) a Kolmogorov output layer enforcing inertial-subrange scaling as an architectural constraint. The entire model contains only 552 learnable parameters, requiring fewer than 2.5 kB of storage and executing in under 12s on a Cortex-M7 microcontroller. We validate PSTNet on 340 paired six-degree-of-freedom guidance simulations spanning three vehicle classes (Mach 2.8, 4.5, and 8.0) and six operational categories with real-time satellite weather ingestion. PSTNet achieves a mean miss-distance improvement of +2.8% with a 78% win rate and a statistically significant effect size. Our results demonstrate that encoding domain physics as architectural priors yields a more efficient and interpretable path to turbulence estimation accuracy than scaling model capacity, establishing PSTNet as a viable drop-in replacement for legacy look-up tables in resource-constrained, safety-critical on-board guidance systems.
summary_zh: 大气湍流强度的可靠实时估计对于在不同高度带飞行的航空器来说仍然是一个公开挑战，尤其是在缺乏运行中的现况预报基础设施的海洋、极地和数据稀疏区域。经典的谱模型编码的是气候平均值，而不是瞬时大气状态，而通用的机器学习回归模型提供适应性，但不能保证预测符合基本尺度律。本文介绍了一种物理结构湍流网络（PSTNet），这是一种将物理直接嵌入其结构的轻量级架构。 PSTNet耦合了四个组件：（i）一个从莫宁-奥布霍夫理论导出的零参数骨干网络，（ii）一个由理查森数导出的软目标监督的、由专业子网络组成的、受状态门控的混合网络，（iii）特征级线性调制层，根据局部空气密度比调节隐藏表示，以及（iv）一个科尔莫戈罗夫输出层，强制惯性子区尺度作为架构约束。整个模型仅包含552个可学习参数，需要少于2.5 kB的存储空间，并在Cortex-M7微控制器上于12秒内执行。我们在跨越三个车辆类别（马赫数2.8、4.5和8.0）和六个具有实时卫星天气摄取的运行类别的340个配对的六自由度制导模拟中验证了PSTNet。PSTNet实现了+2.8%的平均未命中距离改进，胜率达到78%，并且效应量具有统计显著性。我们的结果表明，与扩展模型容量相比，将领域物理作为架构先验编码可以更有效地、更易于解释地提高湍流估计精度，从而使PSTNet成为资源受限、安全关键的机载制导系统中传统查找表的可行直接替代方案。
tldr: The paper introduces PSTNet, a physically-structured neural network for real-time atmospheric turbulence intensity estimation, achieving performance improvements over traditional methods while being highly resource-efficient. It encodes domain physics as architectural priors for efficient and interpretable turbulence estimation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为PSTNet的物理结构神经网络，用于实时估计大气湍流强度，与传统方法相比，在资源非常有限的情况下实现了性能提升。它将领域物理知识编码为架构先验，从而实现高效且可解释的湍流估计。

title: Online Sparse Synthetic Aperture Radar Imaging
summary: With modern defense applications increasingly relying on inexpensive, autonomous drones, lies the major challenge of designing computationally and memory-efficient onboard algorithms to fulfill mission objectives. This challenge is particularly significant in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR), where large volumes of data must be collected and processed for downstream tasks. We propose an online reconstruction method, the Online Fast Iterative Shrinkage-Thresholding Algorithm (Online FISTA), which incrementally reconstructs a scene with limited data through sparse coding. Rather than requiring storage of all received signal data, the algorithm recursively updates storage matrices for each iteration, greatly reducing memory demands. Online SAR image reconstruction facilitates more complex downstream tasks, such as Automatic Target Recognition (ATR), in an online manner, resulting in a more versatile and integrated framework compared to existing post-collection reconstruction and ATR approaches.
summary_zh: 随着现代防御应用越来越依赖于低成本的自主无人机，设计计算和内存高效的机载算法以完成任务目标成为一项重大挑战。这种挑战在合成孔径雷达(SAR)领域尤为突出，因为需要收集和处理大量数据才能进行后续任务。我们提出了一种在线重建方法，即在线快速迭代收缩阈值算法（Online FISTA），该方法通过稀疏编码以有限的数据增量式地重建场景。该算法无需存储所有接收到的信号数据，而是递归地更新每次迭代的存储矩阵，从而大大降低了内存需求。在线SAR图像重建有助于更复杂的下游任务，例如自动目标识别（ATR），以在线方式进行，与现有的后采集重建和ATR方法相比，形成了一个更通用和集成的框架。
tldr: The paper introduces an online sparse reconstruction method (Online FISTA) for Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imaging, aiming to reduce memory demands and enable online Automatic Target Recognition (ATR) on autonomous drones.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于合成孔径雷达（SAR）成像的在线稀疏重建方法（Online FISTA），旨在降低内存需求，并实现自主无人机上的在线自动目标识别（ATR）。

title: GarmentPainter: Efficient 3D Garment Texture Synthesis with Character-Guided Diffusion Model
summary: Generating high-fidelity, 3D-consistent garment textures remains a challenging problem due to the inherent complexities of garment structures and the stringent requirement for detailed, globally consistent texture synthesis. Existing approaches either rely on 2D-based diffusion models, which inherently struggle with 3D consistency, require expensive multi-step optimization or depend on strict spatial alignment between 2D reference images and 3D meshes, which limits their flexibility and scalability. In this work, we introduce GarmentPainter, a simple yet efficient framework for synthesizing high-quality, 3D-aware garment textures in UV space. Our method leverages a UV position map as the 3D structural guidance, ensuring texture consistency across the garment surface during texture generation. To enhance control and adaptability, we introduce a type selection module, enabling fine-grained texture generation for specific garment components based on a character reference image, without requiring alignment between the reference image and the 3D mesh. GarmentPainter efficiently integrates all guidance signals into the input of a diffusion model in a spatially aligned manner, without modifying the underlying UNet architecture. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GarmentPainter achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of visual fidelity, 3D consistency, and computational efficiency, outperforming existing methods in both qualitative and quantitative evaluations.
summary_zh: 生成高保真、3D一致的服装纹理仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题，这归因于服装结构固有的复杂性以及对细节丰富、全局一致纹理合成的严格要求。现有方法要么依赖于基于2D的扩散模型，由于其内在的3D一致性不足而存在局限性；要么需要昂贵的多步优化；要么依赖于2D参考图像和3D网格之间的严格空间对齐，从而限制了其灵活性和可扩展性。在本文中，我们介绍GarmentPainter，一个简单而高效的框架，用于在UV空间中合成高质量、3D感知的服装纹理。我们的方法利用UV位置图作为3D结构指导，确保纹理生成过程中服装表面的纹理一致性。为了增强控制和适应性，我们引入了一个类型选择模块，能够基于角色参考图像对特定服装组件进行细粒度的纹理生成，而无需参考图像与3D网格之间的对齐。GarmentPainter以空间对齐的方式将所有指导信号有效地整合到扩散模型的输入中，而无需修改底层的UNet架构。大量实验表明，GarmentPainter在视觉保真度、3D一致性和计算效率方面均达到了最先进的性能，在定性和定量评估中均优于现有方法。
tldr: GarmentPainter introduces an efficient diffusion model framework for generating high-fidelity, 3D-consistent garment textures using UV position maps and character reference images, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: GarmentPainter 提出了一种高效的扩散模型框架，利用 UV 位置图和人物参考图像生成高保真、3D 一致的服装纹理，实现了最先进的性能。

title: Airborne Magnetic Anomaly Navigation with Neural-Network-Augmented Online Calibration
summary: Airborne Magnetic Anomaly Navigation (MagNav) provides a jamming-resistant and robust alternative to satellite navigation but requires the real-time compensation of the aircraft platform's large and dynamic magnetic interference. State-of-the-art solutions often rely on extensive offline calibration flights or pre-training, creating a logistical barrier to operational deployment. We present a fully adaptive MagNav architecture featuring a "cold-start" capability that identifies and compensates for the aircraft's magnetic signature entirely in-flight. The proposed method utilizes an extended Kalman filter with an augmented state vector that simultaneously estimates the aircraft's kinematic states as well as the coefficients of the physics-based Tolles-Lawson calibration model and the parameters of a Neural Network to model aircraft interferences. The Kalman filter update is mathematically equivalent to an online Natural Gradient descent, integrating superior convergence and data efficiency of state-of-the-art second-order optimization directly into the navigation filter. To enhance operational robustness, the neural network is constrained to a residual learning role, modeling only the nonlinearities uncorrected by the explainable physics-based calibration baseline. Validated on the MagNav Challenge dataset, our framework effectively bounds inertial drift using a magnetometer-only feature set. The results demonstrate navigation accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art models trained offline, without requiring prior calibration flights or dedicated maneuvers.
summary_zh: 机载磁异常导航(MagNav)为卫星导航提供了一种抗干扰且稳健的替代方案，但需要实时补偿飞机平台大而动态的磁场干扰。目前最先进的解决方案通常依赖于大量的离线校准飞行或预训练，从而为作战部署造成了后勤障碍。我们提出了一种完全自适应的MagNav架构，具有“冷启动”能力，可以在飞行中完全识别和补偿飞机的磁特征。所提出的方法利用扩展卡尔曼滤波器，该滤波器具有一个增广状态向量，可以同时估计飞机的运动学状态，以及基于物理的Tolles-Lawson校准模型的系数和用于建模飞机干扰的神经网络的参数。卡尔曼滤波器更新在数学上等价于在线自然梯度下降，将最先进的二阶优化的卓越收敛性和数据效率直接集成到导航滤波器中。为了增强操作鲁棒性，神经网络被限制为残差学习角色，仅对由可解释的基于物理的校准基线未校正的非线性进行建模。在MagNav挑战数据集上验证，我们的框架使用仅磁力计的特征集有效地约束了惯性漂移。结果表明，导航精度可与离线训练的最新模型相媲美，而无需事先进行校准飞行或专门的机动飞行。
tldr: This paper introduces an airborne magnetic anomaly navigation (MagNav) system with online calibration using a Kalman filter augmented with a neural network, achieving comparable accuracy to offline-trained models without requiring pre-training flights.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种机载磁异常导航（MagNav）系统，该系统使用卡尔曼滤波器和神经网络进行在线校准，无需预先训练飞行即可达到与离线训练模型相当的精度。

title: Outlier-robust Autocovariance Least Square Estimation via Iteratively Reweighted Least Square
summary: The autocovariance least squares (ALS) method is a computationally efficient approach for estimating noise covariances in Kalman filters without requiring specific noise models. However, conventional ALS and its variants rely on the classic least mean squares (LMS) criterion, making them highly sensitive to measurement outliers and prone to severe performance degradation. To overcome this limitation, this paper proposes a novel outlier-robust ALS algorithm, termed ALS-IRLS, based on the iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS) framework. Specifically, the proposed approach introduces a two-tier robustification strategy. First, an innovation-level adaptive thresholding mechanism is employed to filter out heavily contaminated data. Second, the outlier-contaminated autocovariance is formulated using an $ε$-contamination model, where the standard LMS criterion is replaced by the Huber cost function. The IRLS method is then utilized to iteratively adjust data weights based on estimation deviations, effectively mitigating the influence of residual outliers. Comparative simulations demonstrate that ALS-IRLS reduces the root-mean-square error (RMSE) of noise covariance estimates by over two orders of magnitude compared to standard ALS. Furthermore, it significantly enhances downstream state estimation accuracy, outperforming existing outlier-robust Kalman filters and achieving performance nearly equivalent to the ideal Oracle lower bound in the presence of noisy and anomalous data.
summary_zh: 自协方差最小二乘(ALS)方法是一种计算高效的方法，用于估计卡尔曼滤波器中的噪声协方差，而无需特定的噪声模型。然而，传统的ALS及其变体依赖于经典的最小均方(LMS)准则，这使得它们对测量异常值高度敏感，并且容易出现严重的性能下降。为了克服这个限制，本文提出了一种新的具有离群值鲁棒性的ALS算法，称为ALS-IRLS，它基于迭代重加权最小二乘(IRLS)框架。具体而言，提出的方法引入了一个双层鲁棒化策略。首先，采用创新层面的自适应阈值机制来过滤掉严重污染的数据。其次，被离群值污染的自协方差用一个$ε$-污染模型来形式化，其中标准的LMS准则被Huber代价函数所取代。然后利用IRLS方法，根据估计偏差迭代调整数据权重，从而有效地减轻残余离群值的影响。比较仿真表明，与标准ALS相比，ALS-IRLS将噪声协方差估计的均方根误差(RMSE)降低了两个数量级以上。此外，它显著提高了下游状态估计的准确性，优于现有的离群值鲁棒性卡尔曼滤波器，并且在存在噪声和异常数据的情况下，实现了几乎等同于理想的Oracle下界的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces an outlier-robust autocovariance least squares (ALS-IRLS) algorithm for Kalman filters, which significantly improves noise covariance and state estimation accuracy in environments with outliers by using iterative reweighted least squares and a two-tier robustification strategy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于卡尔曼滤波器的抗异常值自协方差最小二乘法（ALS-IRLS）算法，该算法通过使用迭代重加权最小二乘法和双层鲁棒化策略，显著提高了存在异常值环境下的噪声协方差和状态估计精度。

title: Explainable Condition Monitoring via Probabilistic Anomaly Detection Applied to Helicopter Transmissions
summary: We present a novel Explainable methodology for Condition Monitoring, relying on healthy data only. Since faults are rare events, we propose to focus on learning the probability distribution of healthy observations only, and detect Anomalies at runtime. This objective is achieved via the definition of probabilistic measures of deviation from nominality, which allow to detect and anticipate faults. The Bayesian perspective underpinning our approach allows us to perform Uncertainty Quantification to inform decisions. At the same time, we provide descriptive tools to enhance the interpretability of the results, supporting the deployment of the proposed strategy also in safety-critical applications. The methodology is validated experimentally on two use cases: a publicly available benchmark for Predictive Maintenance, and a real-world Helicopter Transmission dataset collected over multiple years. In both applications, the method achieves competitive detection performance with respect to state-of-the-art anomaly detection methods.
summary_zh: 我们提出一种新颖的、仅依赖健康数据的可解释的状态监测方法。 鉴于故障是罕见事件，我们建议重点学习仅针对健康观测值的概率分布，并在运行时检测异常。 这一目标通过定义偏离标称值的概率度量来实现，从而能够检测和预测故障。 我们方法所依赖的贝叶斯视角使我们能够执行不确定性量化，进而为决策提供信息。 同时，我们提供描述性工具来增强结果的可解释性，从而支持所提出策略在安全关键型应用中的部署。 该方法已经在两个用例上通过实验进行了验证：一个公开的预测性维护基准测试和一个多年收集的真实直升机变速箱数据集。 在这两个应用中，该方法在检测性能方面与最先进的异常检测方法相比极具竞争力。
tldr: This paper presents an explainable condition monitoring methodology using probabilistic anomaly detection on healthy data, validated on helicopter transmission datasets. It achieves competitive performance while offering uncertainty quantification and interpretability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种可解释的状态监测方法，该方法仅使用健康数据进行概率异常检测，并在直升机变速箱数据集上进行了验证。它在提供不确定性量化和可解释性的同时，实现了具有竞争力的性能。

title: BEACON: Language-Conditioned Navigation Affordance Prediction under Occlusion
summary: Language-conditioned local navigation requires a robot to infer a nearby traversable target location from its current observation and an open-vocabulary, relational instruction. Existing vision-language spatial grounding methods usually rely on vision-language models (VLMs) to reason in image space, producing 2D predictions tied to visible pixels. As a result, they struggle to infer target locations in occluded regions, typically caused by furniture or moving humans. To address this issue, we propose BEACON, which predicts an ego-centric Bird's-Eye View (BEV) affordance heatmap over a bounded local region including occluded areas. Given an instruction and surround-view RGB-D observations from four directions around the robot, BEACON predicts the BEV heatmap by injecting spatial cues into a VLM and fusing the VLM's output with depth-derived BEV features. Using an occlusion-aware dataset built in the Habitat simulator, we conduct detailed experimental analysis to validate both our BEV space formulation and the design choices of each module. Our method improves the accuracy averaged across geodesic thresholds by 22.74 percentage points over the state-of-the-art image-space baseline on the validation subset with occluded target locations. Our project page is: https://xin-yu-gao.github.io/beacon.
summary_zh: 语言条件下的局部导航要求机器人从当前观测和开放词汇、关系型指令中推断出附近可通行的目标位置。现有的视觉-语言空间定位方法通常依赖于视觉-语言模型 (VLMs) 在图像空间中进行推理，产生绑定到可见像素的 2D 预测。因此，它们难以推断被遮挡区域的目标位置，这些区域通常由家具或移动的人造成。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 BEACON，它可以预测以自我为中心的鸟瞰图 (BEV) 可行性热图，该热图覆盖包括遮挡区域在内的有界局部区域。给定指令和来自机器人周围四个方向的环视 RGB-D 观测，BEACON 通过将空间线索注入 VLM 并将 VLM 的输出与深度导出的 BEV 特征融合来预测 BEV 热图。我们使用在 Habitat 模拟器中构建的具有遮挡感知的数据集进行详细的实验分析，以验证我们的 BEV 空间公式和每个模块的设计选择。在具有遮挡目标位置的验证子集上，我们的方法在测地线阈值平均精度方面比最先进的图像空间基线提高了 22.74 个百分点。我们的项目页面是：https://xin-yu-gao.github.io/beacon.
tldr: The paper introduces BEACON, a method for language-conditioned navigation that predicts a Bird's-Eye View affordance heatmap to infer target locations in occluded environments, outperforming image-space baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了BEACON，一种语言条件导航方法，通过预测鸟瞰图的可负担性热图来推断遮挡环境中的目标位置，优于图像空间基线。

title: Beyond Short-Horizon: VQ-Memory for Robust Long-Horizon Manipulation in Non-Markovian Simulation Benchmarks
summary: The high cost of collecting real-robot data has made robotic simulation a scalable platform for both evaluation and data generation. Yet most existing benchmarks concentrate on simple manipulation tasks such as pick-and-place, failing to capture the non-Markovian characteristics of real-world tasks and the complexity of articulated object interactions. To address this limitation, we present RuleSafe, a new articulated manipulation benchmark built upon a scalable LLM-aided simulation framework. RuleSafe features safes with diverse unlocking mechanisms, such as key locks, password locks, and logic locks, which require different multi-stage reasoning and manipulation strategies. These LLM-generated rules produce non-Markovian and long-horizon tasks that require temporal modeling and memory-based reasoning. We further propose VQ-Memory, a compact and structured temporal representation that uses vector-quantized variational autoencoders (VQ-VAEs) to encode past proprioceptive states into discrete latent tokens. This representation filters low-level noise while preserving high-level task-phase context, providing lightweight yet robust temporal cues that are compatible with existing Vision-Language-Action models (VLA). Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art VLA models and diffusion policies show that VQ-Memory consistently improves long-horizon planning, enhances generalization to unseen configurations, and enables more efficient manipulation with reduced computational cost. Project page: vqmemory.github.io
summary_zh: 收集真实机器人数据的高昂成本使得机器人仿真成为评估和数据生成的可扩展平台。然而，现有的大多数基准测试都集中在简单的操作任务上，例如抓取和放置，未能捕捉到真实世界任务的非马尔可夫特性以及铰接物体交互的复杂性。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了RuleSafe，一个基于可扩展的LLM辅助仿真框架构建的新的铰接操作基准测试。RuleSafe包含具有各种解锁机制的保险箱，例如钥匙锁、密码锁和逻辑锁，这些锁需要不同的多阶段推理和操作策略。这些LLM生成的规则会产生非马尔可夫和长时程任务，需要时间建模和基于记忆的推理。我们进一步提出了VQ-Memory，一种紧凑且结构化的时间表示，它使用向量量化变分自编码器 (VQ-VAEs) 将过去的本体感受状态编码为离散的潜在令牌。这种表示方法在保留高层任务阶段上下文的同时，过滤了低层噪声，从而提供了轻量级但稳健的时间线索，与现有的视觉-语言-动作模型 (VLA) 兼容。对最先进的VLA模型和扩散策略进行的大量实验表明，VQ-Memory持续改进长时程规划，增强了对未见配置的泛化能力，并以降低的计算成本实现了更高效的操作。项目网页：vqmemory.github.io
tldr: The paper introduces RuleSafe, a new non-Markovian robotics benchmark involving safe unlocking, and proposes VQ-Memory, a VQ-VAE based temporal representation, to improve long-horizon planning in manipulation tasks within this benchmark.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个新的非马尔可夫机器人基准测试 RuleSafe，涉及保险箱解锁；并提出 VQ-Memory， 一种基于 VQ-VAE 的时间表示方法，以提高该基准测试中操纵任务的长期规划能力。

title: See, Plan, Rewind: Progress-Aware Vision-Language-Action Models for Robust Robotic Manipulation
summary: Measurement of task progress through explicit, actionable milestones is critical for robust robotic manipulation. This progress awareness enables a model to ground its current task status, anticipate verifiable intermediate states, and detect and recover from failures when progress stalls. To embody this capability, we introduce See, Plan, Rewind (SPR), a progress-aware vision-language-action framework that dynamically grounds language instructions into a sequence of spatial subgoals. SPR operates through a continuous core cycle, Seeing the current state and upcoming milestone, Planning a trajectory towards the next 2D waypoint, and Rewinding to a recoverable state upon failure by monitoring progress against the expected sequence. This closed-loop approach enables robust error correction without requiring additional training data or auxiliary models. Extensive experiments demonstrate the framework's effectiveness, generalization and robustness: SPR outperforms the MolmoAct baseline by 5\% on the LIBERO benchmark. On the challenging LIBERO-Plus benchmark with unseen instructions and initial states, SPR achieves state-of-the-art robustness with the smallest performance drop, surpassing OpenVLA-OFT and UniVLA, demonstrating superior out-of-distribution robustness.
summary_zh: 通过明确、可执行的里程碑来衡量任务进度对于鲁棒的机器人操作至关重要。这种进度感知能力使模型能够确定其当前任务状态，预测可验证的中间状态，并在进度停滞时检测并从故障中恢复。为了体现这种能力，我们引入了一种进度感知的视觉-语言-动作框架，称为“看、计划、回溯”（SPR），该框架能够将语言指令动态地转化为一系列空间子目标。SPR通过一个连续的核心循环运作，即“看”：观察当前状态和即将到来的里程碑；“计划”：规划一条通往下一个二维航点的轨迹；以及“回溯”：通过监控与预期序列的进度来在失败时回溯到可恢复的状态。这种闭环方法无需额外的训练数据或辅助模型即可实现稳健的错误纠正。大量的实验证明了该框架的有效性、泛化性和鲁棒性：SPR在LIBERO基准上比MolmoAct基线高出5%。在具有未见指令和初始状态的具有挑战性的LIBERO-Plus基准上，SPR实现了最先进的鲁棒性，性能下降幅度最小，超过了OpenVLA-OFT和UniVLA，展现了卓越的分布外鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces See, Plan, Rewind (SPR), a progress-aware vision-language-action framework for robust robotic manipulation that uses a closed-loop approach for error correction based on tracking progress towards spatial subgoals. It demonstrated better performance and robustness than existing VLA methods in robotic manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了See, Plan, Rewind (SPR)，一个具有进展意识的视觉-语言-动作框架，用于鲁棒的机器人操作，它使用闭环方法，通过跟踪达到空间子目标的进展来进行错误校正。它在机器人操作基准测试中表现出比现有VLA方法更好的性能和鲁棒性。

title: Implicit Geometry Representations for Vision-and-Language Navigation from Web Videos
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) has long been constrained by the limited diversity and scalability of simulator-curated datasets, which fail to capture the complexity of real-world environments. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a large-scale video-instruction framework derived from web-based room tour videos, enabling agents to learn from natural human walking demonstrations in diverse, realistic indoor settings. Unlike existing datasets, our framework integrates both open-ended description-enriched trajectories and action-enriched trajectories reconstructed in 3D, providing richer spatial and semantic supervision. A key extension in this work is the incorporation of implicit geometry representations, which extract spatial cues directly from RGB frames without requiring fragile 3D reconstruction. This approach substantially improves data utilization, alleviates reconstruction failures, and unlocks large portions of previously unusable video data. Comprehensive experiments across multiple VLN benchmarks (CVDN, SOON, R2R, and REVERIE) demonstrate that our method not only sets new state-of-the-art performance but also enables the development of robust zero-shot navigation agents. By bridging large-scale web videos with implicit spatial reasoning, this work advances embodied navigation towards more scalable, generalizable, and real-world applicable solutions.
summary_zh: 视觉语言导航（VLN）长期以来受到模拟器生成数据集在多样性和可扩展性方面的限制，这些数据集无法捕捉真实世界环境的复杂性。为了克服这一限制，我们引入了一个大规模视频-指令框架，该框架源自于网络上的房间漫游视频，使智能体能够从多样化、真实的室内环境中自然的人类行走演示中学习。与现有数据集不同，我们的框架集成了源于开放式的描述性增强轨迹以及在3D中重建的行动增强轨迹，提供了更丰富的空间和语义监督。本研究的一个关键扩展是结合了隐式几何表示，它直接从RGB帧中提取空间线索，而无需脆弱的3D重建。这种方法大大提高了数据利用率，减轻了重建失败问题，并解锁了大量以前无法使用的视频数据。在多个VLN基准测试（CVDN、SOON、R2R和REVERIE）上的全面实验表明，我们的方法不仅创造了新的最先进性能，而且还能够开发出鲁棒的零样本导航智能体。通过将大规模网络视频与隐式空间推理相结合，这项工作推动了具身导航向更具可扩展性、通用性和适用于现实世界的解决方案发展。
tldr: The paper introduces a new Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) framework using web-based room tour videos and implicit geometry representations to overcome limitations of existing simulator-based datasets, achieving state-of-the-art performance and enabling robust zero-shot navigation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新的视觉语言导航（VLN）框架，该框架使用基于网络的房间游览视频和隐式几何表示，克服了现有基于模拟器的数据集的局限性，实现了最先进的性能，并实现了强大的零样本导航。

title: SPAN-Nav: Generalized Spatial Awareness for Versatile Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Recent embodied navigation approaches leveraging Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate strong generalization in versatile Vision-Language Navigation (VLN). However, reliable path planning in complex environments remains challenging due to insufficient spatial awareness. In this work, we introduce SPAN-Nav, an end-to-end foundation model designed to infuse embodied navigation with universal 3D spatial awareness using RGB video streams. SPAN-Nav extracts spatial priors across diverse scenes through an occupancy prediction task on extensive indoor and outdoor environments. To mitigate the computational burden, we introduce a compact representation for spatial priors, finding that a single token is sufficient to encapsulate the coarse-grained cues essential for navigation tasks. Furthermore, inspired by the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) mechanism, SPAN-Nav utilizes this single spatial token to explicitly inject spatial cues into action reasoning through an end-to end framework. Leveraging multi-task co-training, SPAN-Nav captures task-adaptive cues from generalized spatial priors, enabling robust spatial awareness to generalize even to the task lacking explicit spatial supervision. To support comprehensive spatial learning, we present a massive dataset of 4.2 million occupancy annotations that covers both indoor and outdoor scenes across multi-type navigation tasks. SPAN-Nav achieves state-of-the-art performance across three benchmarks spanning diverse scenarios and varied navigation tasks. Finally, real-world experiments validate the robust generalization and practical reliability of our approach across complex physical scenarios.
summary_zh: 最近利用视觉-语言模型(VLMs)的具身导航方法在多用途视觉-语言导航（VLN）中表现出强大的泛化能力。然而，由于缺乏足够的空间感知能力，在复杂环境中进行可靠的路径规划仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们引入了SPAN-Nav，一个端到端的基础模型，旨在使用RGB视频流将通用的3D空间感知注入到具身导航中。SPAN-Nav通过对广泛的室内和室外环境中的占据预测任务，提取跨不同场景的空间先验。为了减轻计算负担，我们引入了一种紧凑的空间先验表示方法，发现单个token足以封装导航任务所需的高层次线索。此外，受链式思考(CoT)机制的启发，SPAN-Nav利用这个单个空间token，通过一个端到端框架，将空间线索显式地注入到动作推理中。通过多任务协同训练，SPAN-Nav从广义空间先验中捕获任务自适应线索，从而实现鲁棒的空间感知，即使在缺乏显式空间监督的任务中也能泛化。为了支持全面的空间学习，我们提出了一个包含420万个占据标注的大规模数据集，该数据集涵盖了跨多种导航任务的室内和室外场景。SPAN-Nav在涵盖不同场景和不同导航任务的三个基准测试上实现了最先进的性能。最后，真实世界的实验验证了我们的方法在复杂物理场景中的鲁棒泛化能力和实际可靠性。
tldr: SPAN-Nav introduces a foundation model that enhances vision-language navigation with universal 3D spatial awareness by predicting occupancy from RGB video and injecting spatial cues into action reasoning, achieving state-of-the-art performance across diverse benchmarks.
tldr_zh: SPAN-Nav 介绍了一种基础模型，通过预测 RGB 视频的占据情况并将空间线索注入到动作推理中，增强了视觉语言导航的通用 3D 空间感知能力，并在各种基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

title: Latent World Models for Automated Driving: A Unified Taxonomy, Evaluation Framework, and Open Challenges
summary: Emerging generative world models and vision-language-action (VLA) systems are rapidly reshaping automated driving by enabling scalable simulation, long-horizon forecasting, and capability-rich decision making. Across these directions, latent representations serve as the central computational substrate: they compress high-dimensional multi-sensor observations, enable temporally coherent rollouts, and provide interfaces for planning, reasoning, and controllable generation. This paper proposes a unifying latent-space framework that synthesizes recent progress in world models for automated driving. The framework organizes the design space by the target and form of latent representations (latent worlds, latent actions, latent generators; continuous states, discrete tokens, and hybrids) and by structural priors for geometry, topology, and semantics. Building on this taxonomy, the paper articulates five cross-cutting internal mechanics (i.e, structural isomorphism, long-horizon temporal stability, semantic and reasoning alignment, value-aligned objectives and post-training, as well as adaptive computation and deliberation) and connects these design choices to robustness, generalization, and deployability. The work also proposes concrete evaluation prescriptions, including a closed-loop metric suite and a resource-aware deliberation cost, designed to reduce the open-loop / closed-loop mismatch. Finally, the paper identifies actionable research directions toward advancing latent world model for decision-ready, verifiable, and resource-efficient automated driving.
summary_zh: 涌现的生成式世界模型和视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 系统正在通过实现可扩展的仿真、长时程预测以及功能丰富的决策，迅速重塑自动驾驶。在这些方向中，潜在表征作为核心计算基底：它们压缩高维多传感器观测，实现时间上连贯的展开，并为规划、推理和可控生成提供接口。本文提出了一个统一的潜在空间框架，该框架综合了自动驾驶世界模型的最新进展。该框架通过潜在表示的目标和形式（潜在世界、潜在动作、潜在生成器；连续状态、离散令牌和混合形式）以及几何、拓扑和语义的结构先验性来组织设计空间。基于这个分类法，本文阐述了五个贯穿始终的内部机制（即结构同构、长时程时间稳定性、语义和推理对齐、价值对齐目标和后训练，以及自适应计算和审议），并将这些设计选择与鲁棒性、泛化性和可部署性联系起来。该研究还提出了具体的评估方案，包括一个闭环指标套件和一个资源感知的审议成本，旨在减少开环/闭环不匹配。最后，本文确定了可操作的研究方向，以推进用于决策就绪、可验证和资源高效的自动驾驶的潜在世界模型。
tldr: This paper presents a unifying framework and taxonomy for latent world models in automated driving, focusing on representations, internal mechanics, and evaluation, while also identifying open research challenges.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个统一的框架和分类法，用于自动驾驶中潜在的世界模型，重点关注表征、内部机制和评价，同时也识别了开放的研究挑战。

title: PlayWorld: Learning Robot World Models from Autonomous Play
summary: Action-conditioned video models offer a promising path to building general-purpose robot simulators that can improve directly from data. Yet, despite training on large-scale robot datasets, current state-of-the-art video models still struggle to predict physically consistent robot-object interactions that are crucial in robotic manipulation. To close this gap, we present PlayWorld, a simple, scalable, and fully autonomous pipeline for training high-fidelity video world simulators from interaction experience. In contrast to prior approaches that rely on success-biased human demonstrations, PlayWorld is the first system capable of learning entirely from unsupervised robot self-play, enabling naturally scalable data collection while capturing complex, long-tailed physical interactions essential for modeling realistic object dynamics. Experiments across diverse manipulation tasks show that PlayWorld generates high-quality, physically consistent predictions for contact-rich interactions that are not captured by world models trained on human-collected data. We further demonstrate the versatility of PlayWorld in enabling fine-grained failure prediction and policy evaluation, with up to 40% improvements over human-collected data. Finally, we demonstrate how PlayWorld enables reinforcement learning in the world model, improving policy performance by 65% in success rates when deployed in the real world.
summary_zh: 以动作为条件的视频模型为构建通用机器人仿真器提供了一条有希望的途径，这些仿真器可以直接从数据中改进。然而，尽管在大型机器人数据集上进行训练，当前最先进的视频模型仍然难以预测物理上一致的机器人-物体交互，而这对于机器人操作至关重要。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了 PlayWorld，这是一个简单、可扩展且完全自主的流程，用于从交互经验中训练高保真视频世界仿真器。与依赖于成功偏见的人工示教的先前方法不同，PlayWorld 是第一个能够完全从无监督的机器人自博弈中学习的系统，从而实现自然可扩展的数据收集，同时捕获建模真实物体动力学所必需的复杂、长尾物理交互。跨越多种操作任务的实验表明，PlayWorld 为富含接触的交互产生高质量、物理上一致的预测，而这些交互无法被在人工采集数据上训练的世界模型捕获。我们进一步证明了 PlayWorld 在实现精细化故障预测和策略评估方面的多功能性，相比人工采集的数据，性能提升高达 40%。最后，我们展示了 PlayWorld 如何在世界模型中实现强化学习，从而在现实世界部署时将策略性能的成功率提高 65%。
tldr: The paper introduces PlayWorld, a system for training robot world models entirely from unsupervised robot self-play, demonstrating improved physical consistency and performance in manipulation tasks compared to models trained on human-collected data. It enables fine-grained failure prediction, policy evaluation, and improves RL policy performance in the real world.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为 PlayWorld 的系统，该系统完全基于无监督的机器人自主操作来训练机器人世界模型。相比于基于人类数据训练的模型，该系统在操纵任务中表现出更好的物理一致性和性能。它能够进行细粒度的故障预测和策略评估，并提高了强化学习策略在真实世界中的性能。

title: OOD-MMSafe: Advancing MLLM Safety from Harmful Intent to Hidden Consequences
summary: While safety alignment for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has gained significant attention, current paradigms primarily target malicious intent or situational violations. We propose shifting the safety frontier toward consequence-driven safety, a paradigm essential for the robust deployment of autonomous and embodied agents. To formalize this shift, we introduce OOD-MMSafe, a benchmark comprising 455 curated query-image pairs designed to evaluate a model's ability to identify latent hazards within context-dependent causal chains. Our analysis reveals a pervasive causal blindness among frontier models, with the highest 67.5% failure rate in high-capacity closed-source models, and identifies a preference ceiling where static alignment yields format-centric failures rather than improved safety reasoning as model capacity grows. To address these bottlenecks, we develop the Consequence-Aware Safety Policy Optimization (CASPO) framework, which integrates the model's intrinsic reasoning as a dynamic reference for token-level self-distillation rewards. Experimental results demonstrate that CASPO significantly enhances consequence projection, reducing the failure ratio of risk identification to 7.3% for Qwen2.5-VL-7B and 5.7% for Qwen3-VL-4B while maintaining overall effectiveness.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型(MLLM)的安全对齐已获得显著关注，但目前的范式主要针对恶意意图或情景违规。我们提出将安全前沿转移到后果驱动的安全，这是一种对于自主及具身智能体的稳健部署至关重要的范式。为了形式化这种转变，我们引入了OOD-MMSafe，一个包含455个精心设计的查询-图像对的基准，旨在评估模型在上下文相关的因果链中识别潜在风险的能力。我们的分析揭示了前沿模型中普遍存在的因果盲区，其中高容量闭源模型的失败率最高，达到67.5%。我们还发现了一个偏好上限，在此上限处，静态对齐会产生以格式为中心的失败，而非随着模型容量的增长而改善安全推理。为了解决这些瓶颈，我们开发了后果感知安全策略优化(CASPO)框架，该框架将模型的内在推理作为令牌级自蒸馏奖励的动态参考。实验结果表明，CASPO显著增强了后果预测，将Qwen2.5-VL-7B的风险识别失败率降低至7.3%，将Qwen3-VL-4B的风险识别失败率降低至5.7%，同时保持了整体有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces OOD-MMSafe, a benchmark to evaluate MLLMs' ability to identify latent hazards in causal chains, and proposes CASPO, a framework to improve consequence projection, leading to significant reduction in failure rates on risk identification.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了OOD-MMSafe，一个旨在评估MLLM识别因果链中潜在危害能力的基准，并提出了CASPO框架，以提高结果预测，从而显著降低风险识别的失败率。

title: EvoDriveVLA: Evolving Autonomous Driving Vision-Language-Action Model via Collaborative Perception-Planning Distillation
summary: Vision-Language-Action models have shown great promise for autonomous driving, yet they suffer from degraded perception after unfreezing the visual encoder and struggle with accumulated instability in long-term planning. To address these challenges, we propose EvoDriveVLA-a novel collaborative perception-planning distillation framework that integrates self-anchored perceptual constraints and oracle-guided trajectory optimization. Specifically, self-anchored visual distillation leverages self-anchor teacher to deliver visual anchoring constraints, regularizing student representations via trajectory-guided key-region awareness. In parallel, oracle-guided trajectory distillation employs a future-aware oracle teacher with coarse-to-fine trajectory refinement and Monte Carlo dropout sampling to produce high-quality trajectory candidates, thereby selecting the optimal trajectory to guide the student's prediction. EvoDriveVLA achieves SOTA performance in open-loop evaluation and significantly enhances performance in closed-loop evaluation. Our code is available at: https://github.com/hey-cjj/EvoDriveVLA.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型在自动驾驶领域展现了巨大潜力，然而，解冻视觉编码器后，它们会遭受感知能力退化的问题，并在长期规划中面临累积不稳定性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了EvoDriveVLA——一种新型的协同感知-规划蒸馏框架，该框架集成了自锚感知约束和专家引导轨迹优化。具体而言，自锚视觉蒸馏利用自锚定教师传递视觉锚定约束，通过轨迹引导的关键区域感知来规范化学生的表征。同时，专家引导轨迹蒸馏采用具备未来感知能力的专家教师，通过由粗到精的轨迹细化和蒙特卡洛Dropout采样来生成高质量的轨迹候选项，从而选择最优轨迹来指导学生的预测。EvoDriveVLA在开环评估中实现了SOTA性能，并在闭环评估中显著提高了性能。我们的代码已在以下网址提供：https://github.com/hey-cjj/EvoDriveVLA.
tldr: EvoDriveVLA addresses perception degradation and planning instability in autonomous driving vision-language-action models through a collaborative distillation framework using self-anchored perceptual constraints and oracle-guided trajectory optimization, achieving SOTA performance.
tldr_zh: EvoDriveVLA通过协作蒸馏框架解决了自动驾驶视觉-语言-动作模型中感知退化和规划不稳定的问题，该框架利用自锚定感知约束和oracle引导的轨迹优化，实现了SOTA性能。

title: LAP: A Language-Aware Planning Model For Procedure Planning In Instructional Videos
summary: Procedure planning requires a model to predict a sequence of actions that transform a start visual observation into a goal in instructional videos. While most existing methods rely primarily on visual observations as input, they often struggle with the inherent ambiguity where different actions can appear visually similar. In this work, we argue that language descriptions offer a more distinctive representation in the latent space for procedure planning. We introduce Language-Aware Planning (LAP), a novel method that leverages the expressiveness of language to bridge visual observation and planning. LAP uses a finetuned Vision Language Model (VLM) to translate visual observations into text descriptions and to predict actions and extract text embeddings. These text embeddings are more distinctive than visual embeddings and are used in a diffusion model for planning action sequences. We evaluate LAP on three procedure planning benchmarks: CrossTask, Coin, and NIV. LAP achieves new state-of-the-art performance across multiple metrics and time horizons by large margin, demonstrating the significant advantage of language-aware planning.
summary_zh: 过程规划需要一个模型来预测一系列动作，这些动作将起始视觉观察转化为教学视频中的目标。虽然大多数现有方法主要依赖于视觉观察作为输入，但它们常常难以应对固有的歧义性，即不同的动作可能在视觉上看起来相似。在这项工作中，我们认为语言描述在程序规划的潜在空间中提供更具区别性的表示。我们引入了语言感知规划 (LAP)，这是一种新颖的方法，它利用语言的表达能力来桥接视觉观察和规划。 LAP 使用微调的视觉语言模型 (VLM) 将视觉观察转化为文本描述，并预测动作和提取文本嵌入。这些文本嵌入比视觉嵌入更具区别性，并被用于扩散模型中进行动作序列规划。我们在三个过程规划基准测试上评估 LAP：CrossTask、Coin 和 NIV。 LAP 在多个指标和时间跨度上大幅度实现了新的最先进性能，展示了语言感知规划的显著优势。
tldr: The paper introduces Language-Aware Planning (LAP), a method using a finetuned VLM to translate visual observations into text descriptions for improved procedure planning in instructional videos, achieving SOTA results.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了语言感知规划(LAP)，它使用微调的VLM将视觉观察转化为文本描述，以改进教学视频中的程序规划，并取得了最先进的结果。

title: Point Cloud as a Foreign Language for Multi-modal Large Language Model
summary: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) have shown remarkable progress in integrating visual and linguistic understanding. Recent efforts have extended these capabilities to 3D understanding through encoder-based architectures that rely on pre-trained 3D encoders to extract geometric features. However, such approaches suffer from semantic misalignment between geometric and linguistic spaces, resolution sensitivity, and substantial computational overhead. In this work, we present SAGE, the first end-to-end 3D MLLM that directly processes raw point clouds without relying on a pre-trained 3D encoder. Our approach introduces a lightweight 3D tokenizer that combines geometric sampling and neighbourhood aggregation with vector quantization to convert point clouds into discrete tokens--treating 3D data as a foreign language that naturally extends the LLM's vocabulary. Furthermore, to enhance the model's reasoning capability on complex 3D tasks, we propose a preference optimization training strategy with a semantic alignment-based reward, specifically designed for open-ended 3D question answering where responses are descriptive. Extensive experiments across diverse 3D understanding benchmarks demonstrate that our end-to-end approach outperforms existing encoder-based methods while offering significant advantages in computational efficiency, generalization across LLM backbones, and robustness to input resolution variations. Code is available at: github.com/snehaputul/SAGE3D.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在整合视觉和语言理解方面展现了显著的进展。近期的工作通过基于编码器的架构，依赖于预训练的3D编码器提取几何特征，将这些能力扩展到3D理解。然而，这些方法受到几何和语言空间之间的语义不对齐、分辨率敏感性以及巨大的计算开销的困扰。在这项工作中，我们提出了SAGE，首个端到端的3D MLLM，它直接处理原始点云，无需依赖预训练的3D编码器。我们的方法引入了一个轻量级的3D分词器，将几何采样和邻域聚合与矢量量化相结合，将点云转换为离散tokens——将3D数据视为一种外语，自然地扩展了LLM的词汇表。此外，为了增强模型处理复杂3D任务的推理能力，我们提出了一种基于语义对齐奖励的偏好优化训练策略，专门为描述性开放式3D问答而设计。在各种3D理解基准上的广泛实验表明，我们的端到端方法优于现有的基于编码器的方法，同时在计算效率、跨LLM主干的泛化能力以及对输入分辨率变化的鲁棒性方面提供了显著优势。代码可在 github.com/snehaputul/SAGE3D 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces SAGE, the first end-to-end 3D MLLM that directly processes raw point clouds by tokenizing them into a foreign language for LLMs, achieving superior performance and efficiency compared to encoder-based methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SAGE，它是第一个端到端的3D MLLM，通过将原始点云标记化为LLM的外语来直接处理原始点云，从而实现了比基于编码器的方法更好的性能和效率。

title: TiPToP: A Modular Open-Vocabulary Planning System for Robotic Manipulation
summary: We present TiPToP, an extensible modular system that combines pretrained vision foundation models with an existing Task and Motion Planner (TAMP) to solve multi-step manipulation tasks directly from input RGB images and natural-language instructions. Our system aims to be simple and easy-to-use: it can be installed and run on a standard DROID setup in under one hour and adapted to new embodiments with minimal effort. We evaluate TiPToP -- which requires zero robot data -- over 28 tabletop manipulation tasks in simulation and the real world and find it matches or outperforms $π_{0.5}\text{-DROID}$, a vision-language-action (VLA) model fine-tuned on 350 hours of embodiment-specific demonstrations. TiPToP's modular architecture enables us to analyze the system's failure modes at the component level. We analyze results from an evaluation of 173 trials and identify directions for improvement. We release TiPToP open-source to further research on modular manipulation systems and tighter integration between learning and planning. Project website and code: https://tiptop-robot.github.io
summary_zh: 我们提出了 TiPToP，一个可扩展的模块化系统，它将预训练的视觉基础模型与现有的任务和运动规划器 (TAMP) 相结合，直接从输入的 RGB 图像和自然语言指令中解决多步操作任务。我们的系统旨在简单易用：它可以在不到一小时内安装并在标准 DROID 设置上运行，并且可以以最小的努力适应新的机器人形态。我们评估了 TiPToP——它不需要任何机器人数据——在模拟和真实世界的 28 个桌面操作任务中，发现它与 $π_{0.5}\text{-DROID}$ 相当或优于 $π_{0.5}\text{-DROID}$，后者是一个在 350 小时的特定于机器人的演示数据上微调的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型。TiPToP 的模块化架构使我们能够在组件级别分析系统的失效模式。我们分析了 173 个试验的评估结果，并确定了改进的方向。我们开源发布 TiPToP，以进一步研究模块化操作系统以及学习和规划之间更紧密的集成。项目网站和代码：https://tiptop-robot.github.io
tldr: TiPToP is a modular, open-vocabulary robotic manipulation system leveraging pretrained vision foundation models and Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) to solve manipulation tasks from RGB images and natural language, outperforming a fine-tuned VLA model without robot-specific training data.
tldr_zh: TiPToP是一个模块化的、开放词汇的机器人操作系统，利用预训练的视觉基础模型和任务与运动规划（TAMP），通过RGB图像和自然语言解决操作任务，性能优于经过微调的VLA模型，且无需机器人特定的训练数据。

title: Emerging Extrinsic Dexterity in Cluttered Scenes via Dynamics-aware Policy Learning
summary: Extrinsic dexterity leverages environmental contact to overcome the limitations of prehensile manipulation. However, achieving such dexterity in cluttered scenes remains challenging and underexplored, as it requires selectively exploiting contact among multiple interacting objects with inherently coupled dynamics. Existing approaches lack explicit modeling of such complex dynamics and therefore fall short in non-prehensile manipulation in cluttered environments, which in turn limits their practical applicability in real-world environments. In this paper, we introduce a Dynamics-Aware Policy Learning (DAPL) framework that can facilitate policy learning with a learned representation of contact-induced object dynamics in cluttered environments. This representation is learned through explicit world modeling and used to condition reinforcement learning, enabling extrinsic dexterity to emerge without hand-crafted contact heuristics or complex reward shaping. We evaluate our approach in both simulation and the real world. Our method outperforms prehensile manipulation, human teleoperation, and prior representation-based policies by over 25% in success rate on unseen simulated cluttered scenes with varying densities. The real-world success rate reaches around 50% across 10 cluttered scenes, while a practical grocery deployment further demonstrates robust sim-to-real transfer and applicability.
summary_zh: 外在灵巧性利用环境接触来克服抓取操作的局限性。然而，在杂乱场景中实现这种灵巧性仍然具有挑战性且尚未被充分探索，因为它需要有选择性地利用多个相互作用对象之间的接触，这些对象具有内在耦合的动力学。现有方法缺乏对此类复杂动力学的显式建模，因此在杂乱环境中的非抓取操作方面表现不足，这反过来限制了它们在现实世界环境中的实际适用性。在本文中，我们介绍了一种动力学感知策略学习（DAPL）框架，该框架可以通过学习到的杂乱环境中接触引起的物体动力学表示来促进策略学习。这种表示是通过显式的世界建模学习得到的，并用于调节强化学习，从而使得外在灵巧性得以涌现，而无需手工制作的接触启发式方法或复杂的奖励塑造。我们在仿真和真实世界中评估了我们的方法。在具有不同密度的、未见过的模拟杂乱场景中，我们的方法在成功率方面优于抓取操作、人工遥操作和先前的基于表示的策略至少25%。在10个杂乱场景中，真实世界的成功率达到约50%，而实际的杂货部署进一步证明了稳健的仿真到真实世界的迁移和适用性。
tldr: This paper introduces a Dynamics-Aware Policy Learning (DAPL) framework for robot manipulation that learns contact-induced object dynamics in cluttered environments. It uses this learned representation to improve reinforcement learning policies, demonstrating superior performance in simulation and real-world cluttered scenes compared to other methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种动态感知策略学习（DAPL）框架，用于机器人操作，该框架可以学习杂乱环境中接触诱导的物体动力学。它利用这种学习到的表示来改进强化学习策略，在模拟和真实世界的杂乱场景中，其性能优于其他方法。

title: Let's Reward Step-by-Step: Step-Aware Contrastive Alignment for Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments
summary: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires agents to learn complex reasoning from long-horizon human interactions. While Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have driven recent progress, current training paradigms struggle to balance generalization capability, error recovery and training stability. Specifically, (i) policies derived from SFT suffer from compounding errors, struggling to recover from out-of-distribution states, and (ii) Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) methods e.g. GRPO are bottlenecked by sparse outcome rewards. Their binary feedback fails to assign credit to individual steps, leading to gradient signal collapse in failure dominant batches. To address these challenges, we introduce Step-Aware Contrastive Alignment (SACA), a framework designed to extract dense supervision from imperfect trajectories. At its core, the Perception-Grounded Step-Aware auditor evaluates progress step-by-step, disentangling failed trajectories into valid prefixes and exact divergence points. Leveraging these signals, Scenario-Conditioned Group Construction mechanism dynamically routes batches to specialized resampling and optimization strategies. Extensive experiments on VLN-CE benchmarks demonstrate that SACA achieves state-of-the-art performance.
summary_zh: 在连续环境下的视觉-语言导航（VLN-CE）要求智能体从长程人类交互中学习复杂的推理。虽然多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）推动了最近的进展，但当前的训练范式难以平衡泛化能力、错误恢复能力和训练稳定性。具体来说，（i）源自监督微调（SFT）的策略会遭受误差累积的问题，难以从分布外的状态中恢复；（ii）强化微调（RFT）方法，例如GRPO，受到稀疏结果奖励的限制。它们的二元反馈无法将功劳分配给单个步骤，导致在失败占主导地位的批次中出现梯度信号崩溃。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了步骤感知的对比对齐（SACA），这是一个旨在从不完美的轨迹中提取密集监督的框架。其核心在于，感知接地的步骤感知审核器逐步骤地评估进展，将失败的轨迹解耦为有效的轨迹前缀和精确的偏差点。利用这些信号，情境条件下的组构建机制会将批次动态地路由到专门的重采样和优化策略。在VLN-CE基准上的大量实验表明，SACA实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: This paper introduces a Step-Aware Contrastive Alignment (SACA) framework for Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) that uses step-by-step progress evaluation and specialized resampling/optimization strategies to address challenges related to error recovery and sparse rewards, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于连续环境中的视觉-语言导航（VLN-CE）的步进式对比对齐（SACA）框架。该框架通过逐步评估进度以及专门的重采样和优化策略，来解决与错误恢复和稀疏奖励相关的挑战，并取得了最先进的性能。

title: Robotic Scene Cloning:Advancing Zero-Shot Robotic Scene Adaptation in Manipulation via Visual Prompt Editing
summary: Modern robots can perform a wide range of simple tasks and adapt to diverse scenarios in the well-trained environment. However, deploying pre-trained robot models in real-world user scenarios remains challenging due to their limited zero-shot capabilities, often necessitating extensive on-site data collection. To address this issue, we propose Robotic Scene Cloning (RSC), a novel method designed for scene-specific adaptation by editing existing robot operation trajectories. RSC achieves accurate and scene-consistent sample generation by leveraging a visual prompting mechanism and a carefully tuned condition injection module. Not only transferring textures but also performing moderate shape adaptations in response to the visual prompts, RSC demonstrates reliable task performance across a variety of object types. Experiments across various simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that RSC significantly enhances policy generalization in target environments.
summary_zh: 现代机器人可以在训练良好的环境中执行各种简单任务并适应不同的场景。 然而，由于零样本能力的限制，将预训练的机器人模型部署到现实世界的用户场景中仍然具有挑战性，这通常需要大量的现场数据收集。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种名为机器人场景克隆 (RSC) 的新方法，旨在通过编辑现有的机器人操作轨迹来实现特定场景的适应。 RSC 通过利用视觉提示机制和精心调整的条件注入模块来实现准确且场景一致的样本生成。 RSC 不仅可以传递纹理，还可以响应视觉提示进行适度的形状调整，从而在各种对象类型上表现出可靠的任务性能。 在各种模拟和真实世界环境中的实验表明，RSC 显著提高了目标环境中策略的泛化能力。
tldr: The paper introduces Robotic Scene Cloning (RSC), a method to adapt pre-trained robot models to new environments by editing existing trajectories using visual prompting, achieving better zero-shot performance and policy generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了 Robotic Scene Cloning (RSC) 方法，通过使用视觉提示编辑现有轨迹来使预训练的机器人模型适应新环境，从而实现了更好的零样本性能和策略泛化。

title: SCDP: Learning Humanoid Locomotion from Partial Observations via Mixed-Observation Distillation
summary: Distilling humanoid locomotion control from offline datasets into deployable policies remains a challenge, as existing methods rely on privileged full-body states that require complex and often unreliable state estimation. We present Sensor-Conditioned Diffusion Policies (SCDP) that enables humanoid locomotion using only onboard sensors, eliminating the need for explicit state estimation. SCDP decouples sensing from supervision through mixed-observation training: diffusion model conditions on sensor histories while being supervised to predict privileged future state-action trajectories, enforcing the model to infer the motion dynamics under partial observability. We further develop restricted denoising, context distribution alignment, and context-aware attention masking to encourage implicit state estimation within the model and to prevent train-deploy mismatch. We validate SCDP on velocity-commanded locomotion and motion reference tracking tasks. In simulation, SCDP achieves near-perfect success on velocity control (99-100%) and 93% tracking success in AMASS test set, performing comparable to privileged baselines while using only onboard sensors. Finally, we deploy the trained policy on a real G1 humanoid at 50 Hz, demonstrating robust real robot locomotion without external sensing or state estimation.
summary_zh: 从离线数据集中提炼人形机器人运动控制策略并将其部署，仍然是一项挑战，因为现有方法依赖于需要复杂且通常不可靠的状态估计的特权全身状态。我们提出了传感器条件扩散策略（SCDP），它仅使用板载传感器即可实现人形机器人运动，从而消除了对显式状态估计的需求。SCDP通过混合观测训练将感知与监督解耦：扩散模型以传感器历史为条件，同时被监督以预测特权的未来状态-动作轨迹，从而迫使模型在部分可观测性下推断运动动力学。我们进一步开发了限制性去噪、上下文分布对齐和上下文感知注意力掩码，以鼓励模型内部的隐式状态估计，并防止训练-部署不匹配。我们在速度指令运动和运动参考跟踪任务上验证了SCDP。在仿真中，SCDP在速度控制方面实现了接近完美的成功率（99-100%），并且在AMASS测试集中实现了93%的跟踪成功率，在仅使用板载传感器的情况下，性能与特权基线相当。最后，我们将训练好的策略以50 Hz部署到真实的G1人形机器人上，展示了无需外部传感或状态估计的稳健的真实机器人运动。
tldr: The paper presents Sensor-Conditioned Diffusion Policies (SCDP) for humanoid locomotion, enabling control using only onboard sensors by decoupling sensing from supervision through mixed-observation training and several other techniques. It demonstrates successful simulation and real-world deployment on a G1 humanoid.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了传感器条件扩散策略 (SCDP) 用于人形机器人运动，通过混合观测训练和其他多种技术，仅使用板载传感器实现控制，将感知与监督分离开来。它展示了在 G1 人形机器人上的成功仿真和现实世界部署。

title: NS-VLA: Towards Neuro-Symbolic Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are formulated to ground instructions in visual context and generate action sequences for robotic manipulation. Despite recent progress, VLA models still face challenges in learning related and reusable primitives, reducing reliance on large-scale data and complex architectures, and enabling exploration beyond demonstrations. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Neuro-Symbolic Vision-Language-Action (NS-VLA) framework via online reinforcement learning (RL). It introduces a symbolic encoder to embedding vision and language features and extract structured primitives, utilizes a symbolic solver for data-efficient action sequencing, and leverages online RL to optimize generation via expansive exploration. Experiments on robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that NS-VLA outperforms previous methods in both one-shot training and data-perturbed settings, while simultaneously exhibiting superior zero-shot generalizability, high data efficiency and expanded exploration space. Our code is available.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型旨在将指令锚定于视觉语境中，并生成用于机器人操作的动作序列。 尽管最近取得了进展，VLA 模型在学习相关且可复用的基元、减少对大规模数据和复杂架构的依赖、以及实现超越演示的探索方面仍然面临挑战。 为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的神经-符号视觉-语言-动作 (NS-VLA) 框架，该框架通过在线强化学习 (RL) 实现。 它引入了一个符号编码器，用于嵌入视觉和语言特征并提取结构化基元，利用一个符号求解器用于数据高效的动作排序，并利用在线 RL 通过扩展探索来优化生成。 在机器人操作基准测试上的实验表明，NS-VLA 在一次性训练和数据扰动设置中均优于先前的方法，同时表现出卓越的零样本泛化能力、高数据效率和扩展的探索空间。 我们的代码已开源。
tldr: The paper presents a neuro-symbolic vision-language-action (NS-VLA) framework that uses online reinforcement learning to address challenges in robotic manipulation by learning reusable primitives, increasing data efficiency, and enabling exploration beyond demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个神经符号视觉-语言-动作（NS-VLA）框架，该框架使用在线强化学习来解决机器人操作中的挑战，通过学习可重用的原语、提高数据效率以及实现超出演示的探索。

title: Context-Nav: Context-Driven Exploration and Viewpoint-Aware 3D Spatial Reasoning for Instance Navigation
summary: Text-goal instance navigation (TGIN) asks an agent to resolve a single, free-form description into actions that reach the correct object instance among same-category distractors. We present \textit{Context-Nav} that elevates long, contextual captions from a local matching cue to a global exploration prior and verifies candidates through 3D spatial reasoning. First, we compute dense text-image alignments for a value map that ranks frontiers -- guiding exploration toward regions consistent with the entire description rather than early detections. Second, upon observing a candidate, we perform a viewpoint-aware relation check: the agent samples plausible observer poses, aligns local frames, and accepts a target only if the spatial relations can be satisfied from at least one viewpoint. The pipeline requires no task-specific training or fine-tuning; we attain state-of-the-art performance on InstanceNav and CoIN-Bench. Ablations show that (i) encoding full captions into the value map avoids wasted motion and (ii) explicit, viewpoint-aware 3D verification prevents semantically plausible but incorrect stops. This suggests that geometry-grounded spatial reasoning is a scalable alternative to heavy policy training or human-in-the-loop interaction for fine-grained instance disambiguation in cluttered 3D scenes.
summary_zh: 文本-目标实例导航 (TGIN) 任务要求智能体将单个自由形式的描述解析为一系列动作，从而在同类别干扰物中找到正确的目标对象实例。我们提出了 \textit{Context-Nav}，它将长的语境化描述语从局部匹配线索提升为全局探索先验，并通过 3D 空间推理验证候选目标。首先，我们计算密集的文本-图像对齐以生成一个值图，该值图对前沿进行排序，从而引导探索朝向与整个描述一致的区域，而非早期检测。其次，在观察到候选目标时，我们执行视角感知的关系检查：智能体采样合理的观察者姿态，对齐局部坐标系，并且仅当空间关系能够从至少一个视角满足时才接受目标。该流程不需要特定于任务的训练或微调；我们在 InstanceNav 和 CoIN-Bench 上取得了最先进的性能。消融实验表明：(i) 将完整描述语编码到值图中避免了浪费的运动；(ii) 显式的、视角感知的3D验证防止了在语义上合理但并不正确的停止。这表明，几何约束的空间推理是解决复杂 3D 场景中细粒度实例消歧问题的一种可扩展替代方案，可以避免繁重的策略训练或人机交互。
tldr: The paper introduces Context-Nav, a novel approach for text-goal instance navigation that leverages contextual captions for exploration and viewpoint-aware 3D spatial reasoning for candidate verification without task-specific training, achieving SOTA results.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Context-Nav，一种新颖的文本目标实例导航方法，利用上下文标题进行探索，并利用视角感知的 3D 空间推理进行候选验证，无需特定于任务的训练，并取得了 SOTA 结果。

title: StyleVLA: Driving Style-Aware Vision Language Action Model for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) bridge visual perception and linguistic reasoning. In Autonomous Driving (AD), this synergy has enabled Vision Language Action (VLA) models, which translate high-level multimodal understanding into driving behaviors, typically represented as future trajectories. However, existing VLA models mainly generate generic collision-free trajectories. Beyond collision avoidance, adapting to diverse driving styles (e.g., sporty, comfortable) is essential for personalized driving. Moreover, many methods treat trajectory generation as naive token prediction, which can produce kinematically infeasible actions. To address these limitations, we present StyleVLA, a physics-informed VLA framework for generating diverse and physically plausible driving behaviors. We introduce a hybrid loss that combines a kinematic consistency constraint with a continuous regression head to improve trajectory feasibility. To train StyleVLA, built on Qwen3-VL-4B, we construct a large-scale instruction dataset with over 1.2k scenarios, 76k Bird's Eye View (BEV) samples, and 42k First Person View (FPV) samples, with ground-truth trajectories for five driving styles and natural-language instructions. Experiments show that our 4B-parameter StyleVLA significantly outperforms proprietary models (e.g., Gemini-3-Pro) and state-of-the-art VLA models. Using a composite driving score measuring success rate, physical feasibility, and style adherence, StyleVLA achieves 0.55 on BEV and 0.51 on FPV, versus 0.32 and 0.35 for Gemini-3-Pro. These results show that a specialized, physics-informed, lightweight model can surpass closed-source models on domain-specific tasks.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）连接了视觉感知和语言推理。在自动驾驶（AD）领域，这种协同作用促成了视觉语言行动（VLA）模型的诞生，该模型将高层次的多模态理解转化为驾驶行为，通常表示为未来轨迹。然而，现有的VLA模型主要生成通用的、无碰撞轨迹。除了避免碰撞之外，适应不同的驾驶风格（例如，运动型、舒适型）对于个性化驾驶至关重要。此外，许多方法将轨迹生成视为简单的token预测，这可能导致运动学上不可行的动作。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了StyleVLA，一个物理信息驱动的VLA框架，用于生成多样且物理上合理的驾驶行为。我们引入了一种混合损失，它将运动学一致性约束与连续回归头结合起来，以提高轨迹的可行性。为了训练建立在Qwen3-VL-4B上的StyleVLA，我们构建了一个大规模指令数据集，包含超过1.2k个场景，76k个鸟瞰图（BEV）样本和42k个第一人称视角（FPV）样本，以及五种驾驶风格的真实轨迹和自然语言指令。实验表明，我们40亿参数的StyleVLA显著优于专有模型（例如，Gemini-3-Pro）和最先进的VLA模型。使用一个综合驾驶评分来衡量成功率、物理可行性和风格一致性，StyleVLA在BEV上实现了0.55分，在FPV上实现了0.51分，而Gemini-3-Pro分别为0.32分和0.35分。这些结果表明，一个专门的、物理信息驱动的、轻量级模型可以在特定领域的任务上超越闭源模型。
tldr: StyleVLA introduces a physics-informed VLA framework, trained on a new dataset, to generate diverse and physically plausible driving behaviors conditioned on driving style and natural language instructions, outperforming existing and proprietary models.
tldr_zh: StyleVLA 提出了一个受物理信息约束的 VLA 框架，该框架在一个新的数据集上训练，可以根据驾驶风格和自然语言指令生成多样化且物理上合理的驾驶行为，并且优于现有模型和专有模型。

title: SEA-Nav: Efficient Policy Learning for Safe and Agile Quadruped Navigation in Cluttered Environments
summary: Efficiently training quadruped robot navigation in densely cluttered environments remains a significant challenge. Existing methods are either limited by a lack of safety and agility in simple obstacle distributions or suffer from slow locomotion in complex environments, often requiring excessively long training phases. To this end, we propose SEA-Nav (Safe, Efficient, and Agile Navigation), a reinforcement learning framework for quadruped navigation. Within diverse and dense obstacle environments, a differentiable control barrier function (CBF)-based shield constraints the navigation policy to output safe velocity commands. An adaptive collision replay mechanism and hazardous exploration rewards are introduced to increase the probability of learning from critical experiences, guiding efficient exploration and exploitation. Finally, kinematic action constraints are incorporated to ensure safe velocity commands, facilitating successful physical deployment. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first approach that achieves highly challenging quadruped navigation in the real world with minute-level training time.
summary_zh: 在密集杂乱环境中高效训练四足机器人导航仍然是一个重大挑战。现有方法要么受限于在简单障碍物分布中的安全性和敏捷性不足，要么在复杂环境中遭受缓慢的运动速度，并且通常需要过长的训练阶段。为此，我们提出SEA-Nav（安全、高效和敏捷导航），一种用于四足机器人导航的强化学习框架。在多样且密集的障碍物环境中，基于可微控制屏障函数（CBF）的盾状约束限制导航策略输出安全的速度指令。引入自适应碰撞回放机制和危险探索奖励，以增加从关键经验中学习的概率，从而引导高效的探索和利用。最后，结合运动学动作约束，确保安全的速度指令，促进成功的物理部署。据我们所知，这是第一个在现实世界中以分钟级别的训练时间实现极具挑战性的四足机器人导航的方法。
tldr: SEA-Nav is a reinforcement learning framework for quadruped navigation in cluttered environments, utilizing a CBF-based shield, adaptive collision replay, hazardous exploration rewards, and kinematic action constraints to achieve safe and agile navigation with minimal training time.
tldr_zh: SEA-Nav是一个用于复杂环境中四足机器人导航的强化学习框架，它利用基于 CBF 的安全屏障、自适应碰撞回放、危险探索奖励和运动学动作约束，以极短的训练时间实现安全和敏捷的导航。

title: Open-World Motion Forecasting
summary: Motion forecasting aims to predict the future trajectories of dynamic agents in the scene, enabling autonomous vehicles to effectively reason about scene evolution. Existing approaches operate under the closed-world regime and assume fixed object taxonomy as well as access to high-quality perception. Therefore, they struggle in real-world settings where perception is imperfect and object taxonomy evolves over time. In this work, we bridge this fundamental gap by introducing open-world motion forecasting, a novel setting in which new object classes are sequentially introduced over time and future object trajectories are estimated directly from camera images. We tackle this setting by proposing the first end-to-end class-incremental motion forecasting framework to mitigate catastrophic forgetting while simultaneously learning to forecast newly introduced classes. When a new class is introduced, our framework employs a pseudo-labeling strategy to first generate motion forecasting pseudo-labels for all known classes which are then processed by a vision-language model to filter inconsistent and over-confident predictions. Parallelly, our approach further mitigates catastrophic forgetting by using a novel replay sampling strategy that leverages query feature variance to sample previous sequences with informative motion patterns. Extensive evaluation on the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 datasets demonstrates that our approach successfully resists catastrophic forgetting and maintains performance on previously learned classes while improving adaptation to novel ones. Further, we demonstrate that our approach supports zero-shot transfer to real-world driving and naturally extends to end-to-end class-incremental planning, enabling continual adaptation of the full autonomous driving system. We provide the code at https://omen.cs.uni-freiburg.de .
summary_zh: 运动预测旨在预测场景中动态智能体的未来轨迹，使自动驾驶车辆能够有效地推断场景演变。现有方法在封闭世界的范畴内运行，并假设固定的对象分类以及对高质量感知的获取。因此，它们在感知不完善且对象分类随时间演变的真实世界环境中表现不佳。在本文中，我们通过引入开放世界运动预测来弥合这一根本差距，这是一种全新的设置，其中新的对象类别随时间依次引入，并且直接从相机图像估计未来的对象轨迹。我们通过提出首个端到端的类增量运动预测框架来解决此问题，该框架旨在缓解灾难性遗忘，同时学习预测新引入的类别。当引入新的类别时，我们的框架采用伪标记策略，首先为所有已知类别生成运动预测伪标签，然后由视觉-语言模型处理这些伪标签，以过滤不一致和过度自信的预测。与此同时，我们的方法通过使用一种新颖的重放抽样策略来进一步缓解灾难性遗忘，该策略利用查询特征方差来抽样具有信息量运动模式的先前序列。在nuScenes和Argoverse 2数据集上的大量评估表明，我们的方法成功地抵抗了灾难性遗忘，并在先前学习的类别上保持了性能，同时提高了对新类别的适应性。此外，我们证明了我们的方法支持零样本迁移到真实世界驾驶，并自然地扩展到端到端的类增量规划，从而实现完整自动驾驶系统的持续适应。 我们的代码在https://omen.cs.uni-freiburg.de 提供。
tldr: This paper introduces "open-world motion forecasting," addresses the challenge of continual learning in motion forecasting where new object classes are constantly introduced, and proposes a class-incremental learning framework using pseudo-labeling and a replay sampling strategy.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了“开放世界运动预测”，解决了运动预测中不断引入新对象类别的持续学习挑战，并提出了一个使用伪标记和重放采样策略的类增量学习框架。

title: From Flow to One Step: Real-Time Multi-Modal Trajectory Policies via Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation-based Distribution Distillation
summary: Generative policies based on diffusion and flow matching achieve strong performance in robotic manipulation by modeling multi-modal human demonstrations. However, their reliance on iterative Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) integration introduces substantial latency, limiting high-frequency closed-loop control. Recent single-step acceleration methods alleviate this overhead but often exhibit distributional collapse, producing averaged trajectories that fail to execute coherent manipulation strategies. We propose a framework that distills a Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) expert into a fast single-step student via Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation (IMLE). A bi-directional Chamfer distance provides a set-level objective that promotes both mode coverage and fidelity, enabling preservation of the teacher multi-modal action distribution in a single forward pass. A unified perception encoder further integrates multi-view RGB, depth, point clouds, and proprioception into a geometry-aware representation. The resulting high-frequency control supports real-time receding-horizon re-planning and improved robustness under dynamic disturbances.
summary_zh: 基于扩散模型和流匹配的生成策略通过建模多模态人类示教，在机器人操作中取得了优异的性能。然而，它们对迭代式常微分方程(ODE)积分的依赖引入了显著的延迟，限制了高频闭环控制。最近的单步加速方法减轻了这种开销，但通常会表现出分布坍塌，产生平均化的轨迹，无法执行连贯的操作策略。我们提出了一种框架，通过隐式最大似然估计(IMLE)将条件流匹配(CFM)专家提炼成快速单步学生模型。一种双向Chamfer距离提供了一个集合级别目标，既促进了模式覆盖，又保证了保真度，从而能够在单次前向传播中保留教师模型的多模态动作分布。一个统一的感知编码器进一步将多视角RGB、深度、点云和本体感觉信息整合到一个几何感知的表示中。由此产生的高频控制支持实时滚动时域重规划，并提高了在动态扰动下的鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper proposes a framework for distilling a flow-matching-based generative policy into a fast, single-step policy using Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation to enable real-time robotic manipulation with multi-modal demonstrations, addressing the latency issues of flow-based methods and distributional collapse of single-step methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种框架，通过隐式最大似然估计将基于流匹配的生成策略提炼成快速的单步策略，从而实现具有多模态演示的实时机器人操作。该方法解决了基于流的方法的延迟问题以及单步方法中的分布崩溃问题。

title: SPAARS: Safer RL Policy Alignment through Abstract Exploration and Refined Exploitation of Action Space
summary: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising paradigm for robotics by pre-training policies on safe, offline demonstrations and fine-tuning them via online interaction. However, a fundamental challenge remains: how to safely explore online without deviating from the behavioral support of the offline data? While recent methods leverage conditional variational autoencoders (CVAEs) to bound exploration within a latent space, they inherently suffer from an exploitation gap -- a performance ceiling imposed by the decoder's reconstruction loss. We introduce SPAARS, a curriculum learning framework that initially constrains exploration to the low-dimensional latent manifold for sample-efficient, safe behavioral improvement, then seamlessly transfers control to the raw action space, bypassing the decoder bottleneck. SPAARS has two instantiations: the CVAE-based variant requires only unordered (s,a) pairs and no trajectory segmentation; SPAARS-SUPE pairs SPAARS with OPAL temporal skill pretraining for stronger exploration structure at the cost of requiring trajectory chunks. We prove an upper bound on the exploitation gap using the Performance Difference Lemma, establish that latent-space policy gradients achieve provable variance reduction over raw-space exploration, and show that concurrent behavioral cloning during the latent phase directly controls curriculum transition stability. Empirically, SPAARS-SUPE achieves 0.825 normalized return on kitchen-mixed-v0 versus 0.75 for SUPE, with 5x better sample efficiency; standalone SPAARS achieves 92.7 and 102.9 normalized return on hopper-medium-v2 and walker2d-medium-v2 respectively, surpassing IQL baselines of 66.3 and 78.3 respectively, confirming the utility of the unordered-pair CVAE instantiation.
summary_zh: 离线到在线强化学习（RL）为机器人技术提供了一种有前景的范式，它通过在安全的离线演示数据上预训练策略，并通过在线交互进行微调。然而，一个根本性的挑战仍然存在：如何在不偏离离线数据的行为支持的情况下安全地进行在线探索？虽然最近的方法利用条件变分自编码器（CVAE）将探索限制在潜在空间内，但它们固有地遭受利用率差距——一个由解码器的重构损失所设定的性能上限。我们引入了SPAARS，一个课程学习框架，它最初将探索约束到低维潜在流形，以实现样本高效、安全的行为改进，然后无缝地将控制权转移到原始动作空间，绕过了解码器瓶颈。SPAARS有两种实例化：基于CVAE的变体只需要无序的(s,a)对，而不需要轨迹分割；SPAARS-SUPE将SPAARS与OPAL时间技能预训练配对，以获得更强的探索结构，但需要轨迹块为代价。我们利用性能差异引理证明了利用率差距的上界，证明了潜在空间策略梯度实现了可证明的方差降低优于原始空间探索，并表明潜在阶段的并发行为克隆直接控制课程过渡的稳定性。在实验中，SPAARS-SUPE在kitchen-mixed-v0上实现了0.825的归一化回报，而SUPE为0.75，样本效率提高了5倍；独立的SPAARS在hopper-medium-v2和walker2d-medium-v2上分别实现了92.7和102.9的归一化回报，超过了IQL基线的66.3和78.3，证实了无序对CVAE实例化的效用。
tldr: This paper introduces SPAARS, a curriculum learning framework for safe offline-to-online RL that improves sample efficiency and safety in robotics by initially exploring a latent space and then transitioning to the raw action space, outperforming existing methods on benchmark tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了SPAARS，一个用于安全离线到在线强化学习的课程学习框架，通过先在潜在空间探索再过渡到原始动作空间，提高了机器人技术的样本效率和安全性，并在基准任务上优于现有方法。

title: CORAL: Scalable Multi-Task Robot Learning via LoRA Experts
summary: Deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in real-world robotics exposes a core multi-task learning challenge: reconciling task interference in multi-task robotic learning. When multiple tasks are jointly fine-tuned in a single stage, gradients from different tasks can conflict, causing negative transfer and reducing per-task performance. Yet maintaining a separate full checkpoint per task is often storage- and deployment-prohibitive. To address this dilemma, we present CORAL, a backbone- and embodiment-agnostic framework designed primarily to mitigate multi-task interference while remaining naturally extensible to a continuous stream of new tasks. CORAL freezes a single pre-trained VLA backbone and attaches one lightweight Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) expert per task; at runtime, a dynamic inference engine (the CORAL Manager) routes language instructions to the appropriate expert and swaps experts on the fly with zero inference overhead. This strict parameter isolation avoids complex gating networks and prevents parameter-level cross-task interference by construction; as an added capability, it also enables sequentially introducing new tasks without parameter overwriting caused by catastrophic forgetting. We validate CORAL on a real-world Galaxea R1 dual-arm mobile manipulator and three simulation benchmarks (LIBERO, WidowX, Google Robot), where CORAL overcomes fine-grained instructional ambiguity and substantially outperforms joint training, yielding a practical and scalable system for lifelong multi-task robot learning. Website: https://frontierrobo.github.io/CORAL
summary_zh: 在真实世界机器人技术中部署视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型面临着一个核心的多任务学习挑战：调和多任务机器人学习中的任务干涉。当多个任务在单一阶段联合微调时，来自不同任务的梯度可能冲突，导致负迁移并降低每个任务的性能。然而，为每个任务维护一个单独的完整检查点通常会带来存储和部署的限制。为了解决这一难题，我们提出了 CORAL，一种与骨干网络和具身性无关的框架，其主要设计目的是缓解多任务干涉，同时保持对持续新增任务的自然可扩展性。CORAL 冻结了一个预训练的 VLA 骨干网络，并为每个任务附加一个轻量级的低秩适应 (LoRA) 专家；在运行时，一个动态推理引擎（CORAL 管理器）将语言指令路由到相应的专家，并实时切换专家，且无推理开销。这种严格的参数隔离避免了复杂的门控网络，并通过构建防止了参数级的跨任务干涉；作为一项附加能力，它还支持顺序引入新任务，避免了灾难性遗忘导致的参数覆盖。我们在真实世界的 Galaxea R1 双臂移动机械臂和三个仿真基准 (LIBERO, WidowX, Google Robot) 上验证了 CORAL，结果表明 CORAL 克服了细粒度的指令模糊性，并显著优于联合训练，从而产生了一个实用且可扩展的终身多任务机器人学习系统。网站：https://frontierrobo.github.io/CORAL
tldr: The paper introduces CORAL, a scalable multi-task robot learning framework using LoRA experts to mitigate task interference in VLA models while enabling lifelong learning. It achieves superior performance compared to joint training across several robotics benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CORAL，一个可扩展的多任务机器人学习框架，它使用LoRA专家来缓解VLA模型中的任务干扰，同时实现终身学习。它在多个机器人基准测试中实现了优于联合训练的性能。

title: RAE-NWM: Navigation World Model in Dense Visual Representation Space
summary: Visual navigation requires agents to reach goals in complex environments through perception and planning. World models address this task by simulating action-conditioned state transitions to predict future observations. Current navigation world models typically learn state evolution under actions within the compressed latent space of a Variational Autoencoder, where spatial compression often discards fine-grained structural information and hinders precise control. To better understand the propagation characteristics of different representations, we conduct a linear dynamics probe and observe that dense DINOv2 features exhibit stronger linear predictability for action-conditioned transitions. Motivated by this observation, we propose the Representation Autoencoder-based Navigation World Model (RAE-NWM), which models navigation dynamics in a dense visual representation space.
