Our approach relies on a customized implementation of the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) built upon two key components: First, we parameterize trajectories as polynomials, allowing the primal update to be computed in closed form as a minimum-control-effort problem. Second, we introduce the concept of a spatio-temporal allocation graph based on a mixed-integer formulation and pose the slack update as a shortest-path search. The combination of these ingredients results in a solver with several distinct advantages over the state of the art. By jointly optimizing over both discrete spatial and continuous temporal domains, our method accesses a larger search space than existing decoupled approaches, enabling the discovery of superior trajectories. Additionally, the solver's structural robustness ensures reliable convergence from naive initializations, removing the bottleneck of complex warm starting in non-convex environments.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于计算非凸环境中连续轨迹的数值求解器。我们的方法依赖于一种基于交替方向乘子法(ADMM)的定制实现，该实现建立在两个关键组成部分之上：首先，我们将轨迹参数化为多项式，从而允许将原始变量更新计算为闭式形式的最小控制量问题。其次，我们引入了基于混合整数规划的时空分配图的概念，并将松弛变量更新构建为最短路径搜索。这些要素的结合使得该求解器相对于现有技术具有几个明显的优势。通过联合优化离散空间和连续时间域，我们的方法访问比现有解耦方法更大的搜索空间，从而能够发现更优的轨迹。此外，该求解器的结构鲁棒性确保了从简单初始化的可靠收敛，消除了非凸环境中复杂热启动的瓶颈。
tldr: This paper introduces an ADMM-based solver for continuous trajectory optimization in non-convex environments, combining polynomial trajectory parameterization and a spatio-temporal allocation graph for improved performance and robustness compared to state-of-the-art methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于ADMM的求解器，用于在非凸环境中进行连续轨迹优化。该方法结合了多项式轨迹参数化和时空分配图，与最先进的方法相比，性能和鲁棒性有所提高。

title: Distributed Kalman--Consensus Filtering with Adaptive Uncertainty Weighting for Multi-Object Tracking in Mobile Robot Networks
summary: This paper presents an implementation and evaluation of a Distributed Kalman--Consensus Filter (DKCF) for Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) in mobile robot networks operating under partial observability and heterogeneous localization uncertainty. A key challenge in such systems is the fusion of information from agents with differing localization quality, where frame misalignment can lead to inconsistent estimates, track duplication, and ghost tracks. To address this issue, we build upon the MOTLEE framework and retain its frame-alignment methodology, which uses consistently tracked dynamic objects as transient landmarks to improve relative pose estimates between robots. On top of this framework, we propose an uncertainty-aware adaptive consensus weighting mechanism that dynamically adjusts the influence of neighbor information based on the covariance of the transmitted estimates, thereby reducing the impact of unreliable data during distributed fusion. Local tracking is performed using a Kalman Filter (KF) with a Constant Velocity Model (CVM) and Global Nearest Neighbor (GNN) data association. simulation results demonstrate that adaptive weighting effectively protects local estimates from inconsistent data, yielding a MOTA improvement of 0.09 for agents suffering from localization drift, although system performance remains constrained by communication latency.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种分布式卡尔曼-一致性滤波器(DKCF)的实现与评估，用于在部分可观测性和异构定位不确定性下运行的移动机器人网络中的多目标跟踪(MOT)。此类系统中的一个关键挑战是如何融合来自定位质量不同的智能体的信息，其中帧未对齐可能导致不一致的估计、轨迹重复和幽灵轨迹。为了解决这个问题，我们在MOTLEE框架的基础上，保留了其帧对齐方法，该方法使用一致跟踪的动态对象作为瞬态地标来改进机器人之间的相对位姿估计。在此框架之上，我们提出了一种不确定性感知的自适应一致性加权机制，该机制基于所传输估计的协方差动态调整邻域信息的影响，从而减少分布式融合过程中不可靠数据的影响。局部跟踪使用具有恒定速度模型(CVM)的卡尔曼滤波器(KF)和全局最近邻(GNN)数据关联。仿真结果表明，自适应加权有效地保护了局部估计免受不一致数据的影响，对于遭受定位漂移的智能体，MOTA提高了0.09，但系统性能仍受到通信延迟的限制。
tldr: The paper presents a Distributed Kalman--Consensus Filter with adaptive uncertainty weighting for multi-object tracking in mobile robot networks, addressing the challenge of inconsistent estimates due to differing localization quality among agents. They show MOTA improvement for agents with localization drift.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种具有自适应不确定性加权的分布式卡尔曼-共识滤波器，用于移动机器人网络中的多目标跟踪，解决了由于代理之间不同的定位质量而导致的不一致估计的挑战。 结果表明，对于具有定位漂移的代理，MOTA有所提高。

title: Multi-Robot Multitask Gaussian Process Estimation and Coverage
summary: Coverage control is essential for the optimal deployment of agents to monitor or cover areas with sensory demands. While traditional coverage involves single-task robots, increasing autonomy now enables multitask operations. This paper introduces a novel multitask coverage problem and addresses it for both the cases of known and unknown sensory demands. For known demands, we design a federated multitask coverage algorithm and establish its convergence properties. For unknown demands, we employ a multitask Gaussian Process (GP) framework to learn sensory demand functions and integrate it with the multitask coverage algorithm to develop an adaptive algorithm. We introduce a novel notion of multitask coverage regret that compares the performance of the adaptive algorithm against an oracle with prior knowledge of the demand functions. We establish that our algorithm achieves sublinear cumulative regret, and numerically illustrate its performance.
summary_zh: 覆盖控制对于优化部署智能体以监测或覆盖具有感觉需求的区域至关重要。 传统的覆盖范围涉及单任务机器人，而自主性的提高现在可以实现多任务操作。 本文介绍了一种新颖的多任务覆盖问题，并针对已知和未知感觉需求的情况进行了解决。 对于已知需求，我们设计了一种联合多任务覆盖算法，并建立了其收敛性。 对于未知需求，我们采用多任务高斯过程 (GP) 框架来学习感觉需求函数，并将其与多任务覆盖算法相结合，开发了一种自适应算法。 我们引入了一种新的多任务覆盖遗憾概念，该概念将自适应算法的性能与事先了解需求函数的预言机进行比较。 我们证明了我们的算法实现了次线性累积遗憾，并通过数值实验说明了其性能。
tldr: This paper proposes a multitask coverage algorithm for multi-robot systems, addressing both known and unknown sensory demand scenarios using Gaussian Processes for learning unknown demands and establishing sublinear regret bounds for the adaptive algorithm.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于多机器人系统的多任务覆盖算法，解决了已知和未知感觉需求场景。该算法使用高斯过程学习未知需求，并为自适应算法建立了次线性后悔界限。

title: A Robust and Efficient Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Traffic Signal Control
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) in Traffic Signal Control (TSC) faces significant hurdles in real-world deployment due to limited generalization to dynamic traffic flow variations. Existing approaches often overfit static patterns and use action spaces incompatible with driver expectations. This paper proposes a robust Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) framework validated in the Vissim traffic simulator. The framework integrates three mechanisms: (1) Turning Ratio Randomization, a training strategy that exposes agents to dynamic turning probabilities to enhance robustness against unseen scenarios; (2) a stability-oriented Exponential Phase Duration Adjustment action space, which balances responsiveness and precision through cyclical, exponential phase adjustments; and (3) a Neighbor-Based Observation scheme utilizing the MAPPO algorithm with Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE). By leveraging centralized updates, this approach approximates the efficacy of global observations while maintaining scalable local communication. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework outperforms standard RL baselines, reducing average waiting time by over 10%. The proposed model exhibits superior generalization in unseen traffic scenarios and maintains high control stability, offering a practical solution for adaptive signal control.
summary_zh: 针对交通信号控制（TSC）中的强化学习（RL）而言，由于对动态交通流量变化的泛化能力有限，实际部署面临着显著挑战。现有方法通常过度拟合静态模式，并且采用与驾驶员期望不符的动作空间。本文提出了一种鲁棒的多智能体强化学习（MARL）框架，已在Vissim交通模拟器中验证。该框架集成了三种机制：（1）转向率随机化，一种训练策略，使智能体暴露于动态转向概率，以提高对未见场景的鲁棒性；（2）面向稳定性的指数阶段时长调整动作空间，通过周期性的指数阶段调整平衡响应性和精度；以及（3）基于邻居的观测方案，利用具有集中式训练与分散式执行（CTDE）的MAPPO算法。通过利用集中式更新，这种方法在保持可扩展的局部通信的同时，近似于全局观测的有效性。实验结果表明，我们的框架优于标准的RL基线，平均等待时间减少了超过10%。所提出的模型在未见交通场景中表现出卓越的泛化能力，并保持了较高的控制稳定性，为自适应信号控制提供了一种实用的解决方案。
tldr: This paper presents a robust MARL framework for traffic signal control, using turning ratio randomization, an exponential phase duration adjustment action space, and a neighbor-based observation scheme with MAPPO to improve generalization and reduce waiting times.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种鲁棒的多智能体强化学习框架，用于交通信号控制。该框架通过转向比随机化、指数相位时长调整动作空间和基于邻居的观测方案（使用MAPPO），提高了泛化能力并减少了等待时间。

title: Normative Common Ground Replication (NormCoRe): Replication-by-Translation for Studying Norms in Multi-agent AI
summary: In the late 2010s, the fashion trend NormCore framed sameness as a signal of belonging, illustrating how norms emerge through collective coordination. Today, similar forms of normative coordination can be observed in systems based on Multi-agent Artificial Intelligence (MAAI), as AI-based agents deliberate, negotiate, and converge on shared decisions in fairness-sensitive domains. Yet, existing empirical approaches often treat norms as targets for alignment or replication, implicitly assuming equivalence between human subjects and AI agents and leaving collective normative dynamics insufficiently examined. To address this gap, we propose Normative Common Ground Replication (NormCoRe), a novel methodological framework to systematically translate the design of human subject experiments into MAAI environments. Building on behavioral science, replication research, and state-of-the-art MAAI architectures, NormCoRe maps the structural layers of human subject studies onto the design of AI agent studies, enabling systematic documentation of study design and analysis of norms in MAAI. We demonstrate the utility of NormCoRe by replicating a seminal experimental study on distributive justice, in which participants negotiate fairness principles under a "veil of ignorance". We show that normative judgments in AI agent studies can differ from human baselines and are sensitive to the choice of the foundation model and the language used to instantiate agent personas. Our work provides a principled pathway for analyzing norms in MAAI and helps to guide, reflect, and document design choices whenever AI agents are used to automate or support tasks formerly carried out by humans.
summary_zh:
摘要：
在2010年代后期，NormCore时尚潮流将趋同性视为归属感的标志，阐释了规范如何通过集体协调而涌现。如今，类似的规范性协调形式也可见于基于多智能体人工智能（MAAI）的系统中，人工智能体在公平敏感领域进行审议、协商，并就共同决策达成一致。然而，现有的经验方法通常将规范视为对齐或复制的目标，隐含地假设人类受试者和人工智能体之间是等价的，从而导致集体规范动态未得到充分考察。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了规范性共同基础复制（NormCoRe），这是一种新颖的方法论框架，用于系统地将人类受试者实验的设计转化为MAAI环境。NormCoRe立足于行为科学、复制研究和最先进的MAAI架构，将人类受试者研究的结构层映射到人工智能体研究的设计中，从而能够系统地记录研究设计并分析MAAI中的规范。我们通过复制一项关于分配正义的开创性实验研究来展示NormCoRe的效用，在该研究中，参与者在“无知之幕”下协商公平原则。我们表明，人工智能体研究中的规范性判断可能与人类基线不同，并且对基础模型的选择以及用于实例化智能体角色的语言非常敏感。我们的工作为分析MAAI中的规范提供了一条原则性的途径，并有助于指导、反思和记录设计选择，无论何时使用人工智能体来自动化或支持以前由人类执行的任务。
tldr: This paper introduces NormCoRe, a methodology for replicating human subject experiments in multi-agent AI environments to study normative behavior, demonstrating its use with a replication of a distributive justice experiment.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为 NormCoRe 的方法，用于在多智能体人工智能环境中复制人类受试者实验，以研究规范行为。文章通过复制一项关于分配正义的实验来展示该方法的应用。

title: Social, Legal, Ethical, Empathetic and Cultural Norm Operationalisation for AI Agents
summary: As AI agents are increasingly used in high-stakes domains like healthcare and law enforcement, aligning their behaviour with social, legal, ethical, empathetic, and cultural (SLEEC) norms has become a critical engineering challenge. While international frameworks have established high-level normative principles for AI, a significant gap remains in translating these abstract principles into concrete, verifiable requirements. To address this gap, we propose a systematic SLEEC-norm operationalisation process for determining, validating, implementing, and verifying normative requirements. Furthermore, we survey the landscape of methods and tools supporting this process, and identify key remaining challenges and research avenues for addressing them. We thus establish a framework - and define a research and policy agenda - for developing AI agents that are not only functionally useful but also demonstrably aligned with human norms and values.
summary_zh: 随着人工智能代理在医疗保健和执法等高风险领域中日益普及，使其行为与社会、法律、伦理、共情和文化（SLEEC）规范相符已成为一项关键的工程挑战。尽管国际框架已经为人工智能制定了高级别的规范性原则，但在将这些抽象原则转化为具体、可验证的要求方面仍然存在显著差距。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了一种系统性的 SLEEC 规范操作化过程，用于确定、验证、实施和验证规范性要求。此外，我们调查了支持该过程的方法和工具，并确定了解决这些挑战所面临的关键难题和研究方向。因此，我们建立了一个框架，并定义了一个研究和政策议程，旨在开发不仅在功能上有用，而且在实践中与人类规范和价值观保持一致的人工智能代理。
tldr: This paper proposes a systematic process for translating high-level normative principles into concrete requirements for AI agents, aiming to align their behavior with social, legal, ethical, and cultural norms. It surveys existing methods and tools, identifies challenges, and presents a framework for norm-aligned AI development.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种系统化的流程，将高级规范原则转化为人工智能代理的具体需求，旨在使其行为与社会、法律、伦理和文化规范相一致。它调查了现有方法和工具，确定了挑战，并提出了一个与规范对齐的人工智能开发框架。

title: How Intelligence Emerges: A Minimal Theory of Dynamic Adaptive Coordination
summary:
This paper develops a dynamical theory of adaptive coordination in multi-agent systems. Rather than analyzing coordination through equilibrium optimization or agent-centric learning alone, the framework models agents, incentives, and environment as a recursively closed feedback architecture. A persistent environment stores accumulated coordination signals, a distributed incentive field transmits those signals locally, and adaptive agents update in response. Coordination is thus treated as a structural property of coupled dynamics rather than as the solution to a centralized objective.
  The paper establishes three structural results. First, under dissipativity assumptions, the induced closed-loop system admits a bounded forward-invariant region, ensuring viability without requiring global optimality. Second, when incentive signals depend non-trivially on persistent environmental memory, the resulting dynamics generically cannot be reduced to a static global objective defined solely over the agent state space. Third, persistent environmental state induces history sensitivity unless the system is globally contracting.
  A minimal linear specification illustrates how coupling, persistence, and dissipation govern local stability and oscillatory regimes through spectral conditions on the Jacobian. The results establish structural conditions under which intelligent coordination dynamics emerge from incentive-mediated adaptive interaction within a persistent environment, without presuming welfare maximization, rational expectations, or centralized design.
summary_zh:
本文发展了一种多智能体系统中自适应协调的动力学理论。该框架并非仅仅通过均衡优化或以智能体为中心的学习来分析协调，而是将智能体、激励和环境建模为一个递归封闭的反馈架构。一个持久环境存储积累的协调信号，一个分布式激励场在局部传递这些信号，而自适应智能体则做出响应更新。因此，协调被视为耦合动力学的一个结构属性，而不是集中式目标的解决方案。

本文确立了三个结构性结果。首先，在耗散性假设下，诱导的闭环系统容许一个有界的正向不变区域，从而保证了可行性，而无需全局最优性。其次，当激励信号非平凡地依赖于持久环境记忆时，由此产生的动力学通常不能被简化为仅在智能体状态空间上定义的静态全局目标。第三，除非系统是全局收缩的，否则持久环境状态会导致历史敏感性。

一个最小线性规范说明耦合、持久性和耗散性如何通过雅可比矩阵的谱条件来控制局部稳定性和振荡机制。这些结果确立了在持久环境中，智能协调动力学如何从激励介导的自适应交互中涌现的结构性条件，而无需假定福利最大化、理性预期或集中式设计。
tldr: The paper presents a dynamical systems approach to modeling adaptive coordination in multi-agent systems, emphasizing the role of environmental memory and local incentives in the emergence of intelligent coordination without global optimization.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种动力系统方法，用于建模多智能体系统中的自适应协调，强调环境记忆和局部激励在智能协调涌现中的作用，无需全局优化。

title: Real-World Point Tracking with Verifier-Guided Pseudo-Labeling
summary: Models for long-term point tracking are typically trained on large synthetic datasets. The performance of these models degrades in real-world videos due to different characteristics and the absence of dense ground-truth annotations. Self-training on unlabeled videos has been explored as a practical solution, but the quality of pseudo-labels strongly depends on the reliability of teacher models, which vary across frames and scenes. In this paper, we address the problem of real-world fine-tuning and introduce verifier, a meta-model that learns to assess the reliability of tracker predictions and guide pseudo-label generation. Given candidate trajectories from multiple pretrained trackers, the verifier evaluates them per frame and selects the most trustworthy predictions, resulting in high-quality pseudo-label trajectories. When applied for fine-tuning, verifier-guided pseudo-labeling substantially improves the quality of supervision and enables data-efficient adaptation to unlabeled videos. Extensive experiments on four real-world benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art results while requiring less data than prior self-training methods. Project page: https://kuis-ai.github.io/track_on_r
summary_zh: 长期点跟踪模型通常在大规模合成数据集上进行训练。由于不同特性的存在以及缺乏密集的真值标注，这些模型在真实世界视频中的性能会下降。在无标签视频上进行自训练已被探索为一种可行的解决方案，但伪标签的质量强烈依赖于教师模型的可靠性，而这种可靠性在不同帧和场景之间变化。在本文中，我们解决了真实世界微调的问题，并引入了一个验证器，这是一个元模型，它学习评估跟踪器预测的可靠性并指导伪标签生成。给定来自多个预训练跟踪器的候选轨迹，验证器逐帧评估它们，并选择最可信的预测，从而产生高质量的伪标签轨迹。当应用于微调时，验证器引导的伪标签显著提高了监督的质量，并使得能够高效地适应无标签视频。在四个真实世界基准上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在需要比之前的自训练方法更少的数据的情况下，实现了最先进的结果。项目主页：https://kuis-ai.github.io/track_on_r
tldr: The paper introduces a verifier meta-model that assesses the reliability of tracker predictions to generate high-quality pseudo-labels for self-training long-term point tracking models on real-world videos. It achieves state-of-the-art results with improved data efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种验证器元模型，用于评估跟踪器预测的可靠性，从而为在真实世界视频上自训练长期点跟踪模型生成高质量的伪标签。该方法以更高的数据效率实现了最先进的结果。

title: Single Pixel Image Classification using an Ultrafast Digital Light Projector
summary: Pattern recognition and image classification are essential tasks in machine vision. Autonomous vehicles, for example, require being able to collect the complex information contained in a changing environment and classify it in real time. Here, we experimentally demonstrate image classification at multi-kHz frame rates combining the technique of single pixel imaging (SPI) with a low complexity machine learning model. The use of a microLED-on-CMOS digital light projector for SPI enables ultrafast pattern generation for sub-ms image encoding. We investigate the classification accuracy of our experimental system against the broadly accepted benchmarking task of the MNIST digits classification. We compare the classification performance of two machine learning models: An extreme learning machine (ELM) and a backpropagation trained deep neural network. The complexity of both models is kept low so the overhead added to the inference time is comparable to the image generation time. Crucially, our single pixel image classification approach is based on a spatiotemporal transformation of the information, entirely bypassing the need for image reconstruction. By exploring the performance of our SPI based ELM as binary classifier we demonstrate its potential for efficient anomaly detection in ultrafast imaging scenarios.
summary_zh: 模式识别和图像分类是机器视觉中的关键任务。例如，自动驾驶车辆需要能够收集不断变化的环境中包含的复杂信息，并实时对其进行分类。在这里，我们通过实验演示了结合单像素成像 (SPI) 技术和低复杂度机器学习模型，以多kHz帧率进行图像分类。使用基于CMOS的微型LED数字光投影仪进行SPI，可以实现用于亚毫秒级图像编码的超快模式生成。我们针对广泛接受的MNIST数字分类基准测试任务，研究了我们实验系统的分类准确率。我们比较了两种机器学习模型的分类性能：极限学习机 (ELM) 和反向传播训练的深度神经网络。两种模型的复杂度都保持较低水平，因此添加到推理时间的开销与图像生成时间相当。至关重要的是，我们的单像素图像分类方法基于信息的时空变换，完全绕过了图像重建的需求。通过探索我们基于SPI的ELM作为二元分类器的性能，我们证明了其在超快成像场景中用于高效异常检测的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents a single-pixel imaging system using a digital light projector and low-complexity machine learning (ELM and DNN) for ultrafast (multi-kHz) image classification, bypassing image reconstruction, and demonstrating anomaly detection potential on MNIST.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种单像素成像系统，该系统利用数字光投影仪和低复杂度机器学习模型（ELM 和 DNN）实现超快速（多 kHz）图像分类，绕过图像重建，并在 MNIST 上展示了异常检测的潜力。

title: CEI-3D: Collaborative Explicit-Implicit 3D Reconstruction for Realistic and Fine-Grained Object Editing
summary: Existing 3D editing methods often produce unrealistic and unrefined results due to the deeply integrated nature of their reconstruction networks. To address the challenge, this paper introduces CEI-3D, an editing-oriented reconstruction pipeline designed to facilitate realistic and fine-grained editing. Specifically, we propose a collaborative explicit-implicit reconstruction approach, which represents the target object using an implicit SDF network and a differentially sampled, locally controllable set of handler points. The implicit network provides a smooth and continuous geometry prior, while the explicit handler points offer localized control, enabling mutual guidance between the global 3D structure and user-specified local editing regions. To independently control each attribute of the handler points, we design a physical properties disentangling module to decouple the color of the handler points into separate physical properties. We also propose a dual-diffuse-albedo network in this module to process the edited and non-edited regions through separate branches, thereby preventing undesired interference from editing operations. Building on the reconstructed collaborative explicit-implicit representation with disentangled properties, we introduce a spatial-aware editing module that enables part-wise adjustment of relevant handler points. This module employs a cross-view propagation-based 3D segmentation strategy, which helps users to edit the specified physical attributes of a target part efficiently. Extensive experiments on both real and synthetic datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves more realistic and fine-grained editing results than the state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods while requiring less editing time. Our code is available on https://github.com/shiyue001/CEI-3D.
summary_zh: 现有3D编辑方法由于其重建网络的深度集成特性，往往产生不真实且粗糙的结果。为了解决这一挑战，本文提出了一种面向编辑的重建流水线CEI-3D，旨在促进真实且精细的编辑。具体而言，我们提出了一种协作式显式-隐式重建方法，该方法使用隐式SDF网络和一组可微采样、局部可控的处理点来表示目标对象。隐式网络提供平滑且连续的几何先验，而显式处理点提供局部控制，从而实现全局3D结构和用户指定的局部编辑区域之间的相互引导。为了独立控制处理点的每个属性，我们设计了一个物理属性解耦模块，将处理点的颜色解耦为独立的物理属性。我们还在该模块中提出了一个双重漫反射-反照率网络，通过单独的分支处理编辑和非编辑区域，从而防止编辑操作产生不必要的干扰。基于具有解耦属性的重建协作式显式-隐式表示，我们引入了一个空间感知编辑模块，该模块能够对相关处理点进行分部分调整。该模块采用基于跨视图传播的3D分割策略，帮助用户高效地编辑目标部分的指定物理属性。在真实和合成数据集上的大量实验表明，与最先进（SOTA）的方法相比，我们的方法实现了更加真实和精细的编辑结果，同时所需的编辑时间更少。我们的代码已在https://github.com/shiyue001/CEI-3D上提供。
tldr: The paper introduces CEI-3D, a collaborative explicit-implicit 3D reconstruction method for realistic and fine-grained object editing, using an SDF network and handler points with disentangled physical properties. It outperforms SOTA methods in editing quality and efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CEI-3D，一种用于真实和细粒度对象编辑的协同显式-隐式3D重建方法，它使用SDF网络和具有解耦物理属性的处理点。在编辑质量和效率方面优于SOTA方法。

title: R4Det: 4D Radar-Camera Fusion for High-Performance 3D Object Detection
summary: 4D radar-camera sensing configuration has gained increasing importance in autonomous driving. However, existing 3D object detection methods that fuse 4D Radar and camera data confront several challenges. First, their absolute depth estimation module is not robust and accurate enough, leading to inaccurate 3D localization. Second, the performance of their temporal fusion module will degrade dramatically or even fail when the ego vehicle's pose is missing or inaccurate. Third, for some small objects, the sparse radar point clouds may completely fail to reflect from their surfaces. In such cases, detection must rely solely on visual unimodal priors. To address these limitations, we propose R4Det, which enhances depth estimation quality via the Panoramic Depth Fusion module, enabling mutual reinforcement between absolute and relative depth. For temporal fusion, we design a Deformable Gated Temporal Fusion module that does not rely on the ego vehicle's pose. In addition, we built an Instance-Guided Dynamic Refinement module that extracts semantic prototypes from 2D instance guidance. Experiments show that R4Det achieves state-of-the-art 3D object detection results on the TJ4DRadSet and VoD datasets.
summary_zh: 4D雷达-相机传感配置在自动驾驶领域日益重要。然而，现有的融合4D雷达和相机数据的3D目标检测方法面临着若干挑战。首先，它们的绝对深度估计模块不够鲁棒和准确，导致3D定位不精确。其次，当自车位姿缺失或不准确时，它们的时间融合模块的性能会急剧下降甚至失效。第三，对于一些小型物体，稀疏的雷达点云可能完全无法反射到其表面。在这种情况下，检测必须完全依赖视觉单模态先验。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了R4Det，它通过全景深度融合模块增强了深度估计质量，实现了绝对深度和相对深度之间的相互加强。在时间融合方面，我们设计了一个不依赖自车位姿的可变形门控时间融合模块。此外，我们构建了一个实例引导的动态细化模块，从2D实例指导中提取语义原型。实验结果表明，R4Det在TJ4DRadSet和VoD数据集上实现了最先进的3D目标检测结果。
tldr: R4Det proposes a novel 4D radar-camera fusion method for 3D object detection in autonomous driving, enhancing depth estimation and temporal fusion while addressing limitations of existing approaches, achieving state-of-the-art results.
tldr_zh: R4Det提出了一种新的4D雷达相机融合方法，用于自动驾驶中的3D物体检测，增强了深度估计和时间融合，同时解决了现有方法的局限性，实现了最先进的结果。

title: Mango-GS: Enhancing Spatio-Temporal Consistency in Dynamic Scenes Reconstruction using Multi-Frame Node-Guided 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Reconstructing dynamic 3D scenes with photorealistic detail and strong temporal coherence remains a significant challenge. Existing Gaussian splatting approaches for dynamic scene modeling often rely on per-frame optimization, which can overfit to instantaneous states instead of capturing underlying motion dynamics. To address this, we present Mango-GS, a multi-frame, node-guided framework for high-fidelity 4D reconstruction. Mango-GS leverages a temporal Transformer to model motion dependencies within a short window of frames, producing temporally consistent deformations. For efficiency, temporal modeling is confined to a sparse set of control nodes. Each node is represented by a decoupled canonical position and a latent code, providing a stable semantic anchor for motion propagation and preventing correspondence drift under large motion. Our framework is trained end-to-end, enhanced by an input masking strategy and two multi-frame losses to improve robustness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Mango-GS achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction quality and real-time rendering speed, enabling high-fidelity reconstruction and interactive rendering of dynamic scenes.
summary_zh: 重建具有照片级真实细节和强大时间一致性的动态 3D 场景仍然是一个重大挑战。现有的用于动态场景建模的高斯溅射方法通常依赖于逐帧优化，这可能会过拟合到瞬时状态，而不是捕捉潜在的运动动态。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 Mango-GS，一种多帧、节点引导的框架，用于高保真 4D 重建。Mango-GS 利用时间 Transformer 来建模短时间内帧内的运动依赖性，从而产生时间上一致的形变。为了提高效率，时间建模被限制在一组稀疏的控制节点上。每个节点由一个解耦的规范位置和一个潜在代码表示，为运动传播提供了一个稳定的语义锚点，并防止在大运动下出现对应关系漂移。我们的框架经过端到端训练，并通过输入掩码策略和两个多帧损失进行增强，以提高鲁棒性。大量实验表明，Mango-GS 实现了最先进的重建质量和实时渲染速度，从而实现了动态场景的高保真重建和交互式渲染。
tldr: Mango-GS introduces a novel multi-frame, node-guided 4D Gaussian Splatting framework for dynamic scene reconstruction, achieving state-of-the-art quality and real-time rendering by using a temporal Transformer and sparse control nodes to improve temporal coherence.
tldr_zh: Mango-GS 提出了一种新颖的多帧、节点引导的 4D 高斯溅射框架，用于动态场景重建，通过使用时间 Transformer 和稀疏控制节点来提高时间一致性，从而实现了最先进的质量和实时渲染。

title: Mobile-GS: Real-time Gaussian Splatting for Mobile Devices
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a powerful representation for high-quality rendering across a wide range of applications.However, its high computational demands and large storage costs pose significant challenges for deployment on mobile devices. In this work, we propose a mobile-tailored real-time Gaussian Splatting method, dubbed Mobile-GS, enabling efficient inference of Gaussian Splatting on edge devices. Specifically, we first identify alpha blending as the primary computational bottleneck, since it relies on the time-consuming Gaussian depth sorting process. To solve this issue, we propose a depth-aware order-independent rendering scheme that eliminates the need for sorting, thereby substantially accelerating rendering. Although this order-independent rendering improves rendering speed, it may introduce transparency artifacts in regions with overlapping geometry due to the scarcity of rendering order. To address this problem, we propose a neural view-dependent enhancement strategy, enabling more accurate modeling of view-dependent effects conditioned on viewing direction, 3D Gaussian geometry, and appearance attributes. In this way, Mobile-GS can achieve both high-quality and real-time rendering. Furthermore, to facilitate deployment on memory-constrained mobile platforms, we also introduce first-order spherical harmonics distillation, a neural vector quantization technique, and a contribution-based pruning strategy to reduce the number of Gaussian primitives and compress the 3D Gaussian representation with the assistance of neural networks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed Mobile-GS achieves real-time rendering and compact model size while preserving high visual quality, making it well-suited for mobile applications.
summary_zh: 3D高斯溅射(3DGS)已成为一种强大的表示方法，可在各种应用中实现高质量渲染。然而，其高计算需求和巨大的存储成本对移动设备上的部署提出了重大挑战。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种针对移动设备的实时高斯溅射方法，称为Mobile-GS，可在边缘设备上有效推断高斯溅射。具体而言，我们首先将Alpha混合确定为主要的计算瓶颈，因为它依赖于耗时的高斯深度排序过程。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种深度感知的与顺序无关的渲染方案，该方案消除了排序的必要性，从而大大加快了渲染速度。虽然这种与顺序无关的渲染提高了渲染速度，但由于渲染顺序的稀缺性，它可能会在具有重叠几何体的区域中引入透明伪影。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种神经视角相关的增强策略，能够更准确地建模依赖于视角方向、3D高斯几何体和外观属性的视角相关效果。通过这种方式，Mobile-GS可以实现高质量和实时的渲染。此外，为了方便在内存受限的移动平台上部署，我们还引入了一阶球谐函数蒸馏、一种神经向量量化技术和一种基于贡献的剪枝策略，以在神经网络的辅助下减少高斯基元的数量并压缩3D高斯表示。大量实验表明，我们提出的Mobile-GS实现了实时渲染和紧凑的模型尺寸，同时保持了高视觉质量，使其非常适合移动应用。
tldr: The paper introduces Mobile-GS, a real-time 3D Gaussian Splatting method optimized for mobile devices, addressing computational bottlenecks and storage limitations through depth-aware rendering, neural view-dependent enhancement, and compression techniques.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Mobile-GS，一种针对移动设备优化的实时3D高斯溅射方法，通过深度感知渲染、神经视角依赖增强和压缩技术来解决计算瓶颈和存储限制。

title: Towards Automated Initial Probe Placement in Transthoracic Teleultrasound Using Human Mesh and Skeleton Recovery
summary: Cardiac and lung ultrasound are technically demanding because operators must identify patient-specific intercostal acoustic windows and then navigate between standard views by adjusting probe position, rotation, and force across different imaging planes. These challenges are amplified in teleultrasound when a novice or robot faces the difficult task of first placing the probe on the patient without in-person expert assistance. We present a framework for automating Patient registration and anatomy-informed Initial Probe placement Guidance (PIPG) using only RGB images from a calibrated camera. The novice first captures the patient using the camera on a mixed reality (MR) head-mounted display (HMD). An edge server then infers a patient-specific body-surface and skeleton model, with spatial smoothing across multiple views. Using bony landmarks from the predicted skeleton, we estimate the intercostal region and project the guidance back onto the reconstructed body surface. To validate the framework, we overlaid the reconstructed body mesh and the virtual probe pose guidance across multiple transthoracic echocardiography scan planes in situ and measured the quantitative placement error. Pilot experiments with healthy volunteers suggest that the proposed probe placement prediction and MR guidance yield consistent initial placement within anatomical variability acceptable for teleultrasound setup
summary_zh: 心脏和肺部超声在技术上要求很高，因为操作者必须识别患者特定的肋间声窗，然后通过调整探头的位置、旋转和压力在不同的成像平面之间切换，从而获取标准图像。当新手或机器人面临在没有专家现场协助的情况下，首先将探头放置在患者身上的困难任务时，这些挑战在远程超声中会被放大。我们提出了一种框架，仅使用来自校准相机的RGB图像，即可实现患者注册和基于解剖学信息的初始探头放置引导（PIPG）的自动化。新手首先使用混合现实（MR）头戴式显示器（HMD）上的相机捕捉患者。然后，边缘服务器推断出患者特定的体表和骨骼模型，并在多个视角上进行空间平滑处理。利用预测骨骼中的骨性标志，我们估计肋间区域，并将引导投射回重建的体表上。为了验证该框架，我们将重建的身体网格和虚拟探头姿态引导叠加到多个经胸超声心动图扫描平面上，并测量了定量的放置误差。对健康志愿者的初步实验表明，所提出的探头放置预测和MR引导可以在解剖学变异范围内实现一致的初始放置，这对于远程超声设置是可以接受的。
tldr: This paper presents a framework for automated initial probe placement in transthoracic teleultrasound, using RGB images to infer a patient-specific body surface and skeleton model, and employing MR guidance to aid novice users. It addresses the challenge of remote ultrasound setup where expert in-person assistance is not available.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于经胸遥控超声的自动初始探头放置框架，利用RGB图像推断患者特定的体表和骨骼模型，并采用MR引导来帮助新手用户。它解决了远程超声设置中无法获得专家现场帮助的难题。

title: Context-dependent manifold learning: A neuromodulated constrained autoencoder approach
summary: Constrained autoencoders (cAE) provide a successful path towards interpretable dimensionality reduction by enforcing geometric structure on latent spaces. However, standard cAEs cannot adapt to varying physical parameters or environmental conditions without conflating these contextual shifts with the primary input. To address this, we integrated a neuromodulatory mechanism into the cAE framework to allow for context-dependent manifold learning. This paper introduces the Neuromodulated Constrained Autoencoder (NcAE), which adaptively parameterizes geometric constraints via gain and bias tuning conditioned on static contextual information. Experimental results on dynamical systems show that the NcAE accurately captures how manifold geometry varies across different regimes while maintaining rigorous projection properties. These results demonstrate that neuromodulation effectively decouples global contextual parameters from local manifold representations. This architecture provides a foundation for developing more flexible, physics-informed representations in systems subject to (non-stationary) environmental constraints.
summary_zh: 约束自编码器(cAE)通过在潜在空间强制执行几何结构，为可解释的降维提供了一条成功的途径。然而，标准cAEs无法适应变化的物理参数或环境条件，而不会将这些上下文偏移与主要输入混淆。为了解决这个问题，我们将一种神经调节机制集成到cAE框架中，以实现依赖于上下文的流形学习。本文介绍了一种神经调节约束自编码器(NcAE)，它通过基于静态上下文信息的增益和偏置调整，自适应地参数化几何约束。在动力系统上的实验结果表明，NcAE能够准确地捕捉流形几何如何在不同状态下变化，同时保持严格的投影特性。这些结果表明，神经调节有效地将全局上下文参数与局部流形表示解耦。该架构为在受（非平稳）环境约束的系统中开发更灵活、具有物理信息的表示奠定了基础。
tldr: This paper introduces a Neuromodulated Constrained Autoencoder (NcAE) that adapts manifold geometry based on contextual information, decoupling global parameters from local representations. It is demonstrated on dynamical systems to capture manifold variations across different regimes.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种神经调节约束自编码器 (NcAE)，它可以根据上下文信息调整流形几何结构，从而将全局参数与局部表示分离。该方法已在动态系统上进行了演示，以捕获不同状态下的流形变化。

title: Adapting Dijkstra for Buffers and Unlimited Transfers
summary: In recent years, RAPTOR based algorithms have been considered the state-of-the-art for path-finding with unlimited transfers without preprocessing. However, this status largely stems from the evolution of routing research, where Dijkstra-based solutions were superseded by timetable-based algorithms without a systematic comparison. In this work, we revisit classical Dijkstra-based approaches for public transit routing with unlimited transfers and demonstrate that Time-Dependent Dijkstra (TD-Dijkstra) outperforms MR. However, efficient TD-Dijkstra implementations rely on filtering dominated connections during preprocessing, which assumes passengers can always switch to a faster connection. We show that this filtering is unsound when stops have buffer times, as it cannot distinguish between seated passengers who may continue without waiting and transferring passengers who must respect the buffer. To address this limitation, we introduce Transfer Aware Dijkstra (TAD), a modification that scans entire trip sequences rather than individual edges, correctly handling buffer times while maintaining performance advantages over MR. Our experiments on London and Switzerland networks show that we can achieve a greater than two time speed-up over MR while producing optimal results on both networks with and without buffer times.
summary_zh: 近年来，基于RAPTOR的算法被认为是无预处理情况下无限次换乘路径搜索的最先进技术。然而，这一地位主要源于路由研究的演进，其中基于Dijkstra的解决方案被基于时间表的算法所取代，而没有进行系统的比较。在这项工作中，我们重新审视用于公共交通无限次换乘路径搜索的经典Dijkstra算法，并证明时间依赖Dijkstra算法（TD-Dijkstra）优于MR算法。然而，高效的TD-Dijkstra实现依赖于预处理期间过滤被支配的连接，这假设乘客总能切换到更快的连接。我们表明，当站点有缓冲时间时，这种过滤是不健全的，因为它无法区分可能无需等待即可继续的座位乘客和必须遵守缓冲时间的换乘乘客。为了解决这一局限性，我们引入了Transfer Aware Dijkstra（TAD），这是一种修改，它扫描整个行程序列而不是单个边，在正确处理缓冲时间的同时保持了优于MR的性能优势。我们在伦敦和瑞士网络上的实验表明，我们可以在两个网络上实现超过两倍于MR的速度提升，同时在有无缓冲时间的情况下产生最优结果。
tldr: This paper revisits Dijkstra-based approaches for public transit routing, introducing a modification (TAD) to handle buffer times at stops and achieving faster performance than MR while guaranteeing optimal results. It's about more efficient path-finding algorithms, specifically for public transport.
tldr_zh: 本文重新审视了基于Dijkstra算法的公共交通路线规划方法，提出了一种名为TAD的改进方法，可以处理车站的缓冲时间，并且比MR算法更快，同时保证最优结果。 这是一个关于更有效的路径查找算法，专门用于公共交通的。

title: Portfolio of Solving Strategies in CEGAR-based Object Packing and Scheduling for Sequential 3D Printing
summary: Computing power that used to be available only in supercomputers decades ago especially their parallelism is currently available in standard personal computer CPUs even in CPUs for mobile telephones. We show how to effectively utilize the computing power of modern multi-core personal computer CPU to solve the complex combinatorial problem of object arrangement and scheduling for sequential 3D printing. We achieved this by parallelizing the existing CEGAR-SEQ algorithm that solves the sequential object arrangement and scheduling by expressing it as a linear arithmetic formula which is then solved by a technique inspired by counterexample guided abstraction refinement (CEGAR). The original CEGAR-SEQ algorithm uses an object arrangement strategy that places objects towards the center of the printing plate. We propose alternative object arrangement strategies such as placing objects towards a corner of the printing plate and scheduling objects according to their height. Our parallelization is done at the high-level where we execute the CEGAR-SEQ algorithm in parallel with a portfolio of object arrangement strategies, an algorithm is called Porfolio-CEGAR-SEQ. Our experimental evaluation indicates that Porfolio-CEGAR-SEQ outperforms the original CEGAR-SEQ. When a batch of objects for multiple printing plates is scheduled, Portfolio-CEGAR-SEQ often uses fewer printing plates than CEGAR-SEQ.
summary_zh: 几十年前只能在超级计算机上获得的计算能力，特别是其并行性，现在在标准个人电脑 CPU 甚至移动电话 CPU 中都可以获得。我们展示了如何有效利用现代多核个人电脑 CPU 的计算能力来解决顺序 3D 打印中的对象排列和调度这一复杂的组合优化问题。我们通过并行化现有的 CEGAR-SEQ 算法来实现这一点，该算法通过将其表达为线性算术公式来解决顺序对象排列和调度问题，然后通过一种受反例引导抽象精化 (CEGAR) 启发的技巧来求解。原始的 CEGAR-SEQ 算法使用一种对象排列策略，将对象放置在打印板的中心位置。我们提出了替代的对象排列策略，例如将对象放置在打印板的角落附近，并根据对象的高度进行调度。我们的并行化是在高层进行的，即我们使用一系列对象排列策略并行执行 CEGAR-SEQ 算法，该算法被称为 Porfolio-CEGAR-SEQ。我们的实验评估表明，Porfolio-CEGAR-SEQ 优于原始的 CEGAR-SEQ。当调度多个打印板的一批对象时，Portfolio-CEGAR-SEQ 通常使用的打印板数量少于 CEGAR-SEQ。
tldr: The paper introduces Porfolio-CEGAR-SEQ, a parallelized algorithm for object arrangement and scheduling in 3D printing that leverages multiple object arrangement strategies to outperform the original CEGAR-SEQ algorithm.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为Porfolio-CEGAR-SEQ的并行算法，用于3D打印中的物体排列和调度，它利用多种物体排列策略，性能优于原有的CEGAR-SEQ算法。

title: WORKSWORLD: A Domain for Integrated Numeric Planning and Scheduling of Distributed Pipelined Workflows
summary: This work pursues automated planning and scheduling of distributed data pipelines, or workflows. We develop a general workflow and resource graph representation that includes both data processing and sharing components with corresponding network interfaces for scheduling. Leveraging these graphs, we introduce WORKSWORLD, a new domain for numeric domain-independent planners designed for permanently scheduled workflows, like ingest pipelines. Our framework permits users to define data sources, available workflow components, and desired data destinations and formats without explicitly declaring the entire workflow graph as a goal. The planner solves a joint planning and scheduling problem, producing a plan that both builds the workflow graph and schedules its components on the resource graph. We empirically show that a state-of-the-art numeric planner running on commodity hardware with one hour of CPU time and 30GB of memory can solve linear-chain workflows of up to 14 components across eight sites.
summary_zh: 本研究致力于分布式数据流水线或工作流的自动化规划和调度。我们开发了一种通用的工作流和资源图表示方法，该方法包含了数据处理和共享组件，以及用于调度的相应网络接口。基于这些图，我们引入了WORKSWORLD，这是一种针对数值型领域无关规划器的新领域，专为永久调度的流水线工作流（例如摄取流水线）而设计。我们的框架允许用户定义数据源、可用的工作流组件，以及所需的数据目的地和格式，而无需显式声明整个工作流图作为目标。规划器解决一个联合规划和调度问题，生成一个既构建工作流图又在资源图上调度其组件的方案。我们通过实证表明，在普通硬件上运行的、具有一小时CPU时间和30GB内存的先进数值型规划器，可以解决跨越八个站点的、最多包含14个组件的线性链式工作流。
tldr: The paper introduces WORKSWORLD, a new planning domain for numeric domain-independent planners aimed at automated planning and scheduling of distributed data pipelines, demonstrating scalability to linear-chain workflows with up to 14 components.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个名为WORKSWORLD的新规划领域，用于数字领域独立的规划器，旨在自动化规划和调度分布式数据管道。实验表明，该方法能够扩展到最多14个组件的线性链式工作流。

title: Compiling Temporal Numeric Planning into Discrete PDDL+: Extended Version
summary: Since the introduction of the PDDL+ modeling language, it was known that temporal planning with durative actions (as in PDDL 2.1) could be compiled into PDDL+. However, no practical compilation was presented in the literature ever since. We present a practical compilation from temporal planning with durative actions into PDDL+, fully capturing the semantics and only assuming the non-self-overlapping of actions. Our compilation is polynomial, retains the plan length up to a constant factor and is experimentally shown to be of practical relevance for hard temporal numeric problems.
summary_zh: 自从 PDDL+ 建模语言问世以来，人们就知道可以使用 PDDL+ 将带有持续性动作的时序规划（如 PDDL 2.1 中）进行编译。然而，自此以后，文献中一直没有出现实际可行的编译方法。我们提出了一种将带有持续性动作的时序规划编译成 PDDL+ 的实际方法，该方法完全捕捉语义，并且只假设动作之间非自重叠。 我们的编译是多项式的，将计划长度保持在一个常数因子内，并且实验表明它对于困难的时序数值问题具有实际意义。
tldr: This paper presents a practical, polynomial-time compilation method for converting temporal planning problems with durative actions into PDDL+, while preserving plan length up to a constant factor, demonstrating practical relevance for hard problems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种实用的、多项式时间的编译方法，用于将具有持续动作的时间规划问题转换为PDDL+，同时将计划长度保持在一个常数因子内，并证明了其对解决难题的实际意义。

title: Flowcean - Model Learning for Cyber-Physical Systems
summary: Effective models of Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) are crucial for their design and operation. Constructing such models is difficult and time-consuming due to the inherent complexity of CPS. As a result, data-driven model generation using machine learning methods is gaining popularity. In this paper, we present Flowcean, a novel framework designed to automate the generation of models through data-driven learning that focuses on modularity and usability. By offering various learning strategies, data processing methods, and evaluation metrics, our framework provides a comprehensive solution, tailored to CPS scenarios. Flowcean facilitates the integration of diverse learning libraries and tools within a modular and flexible architecture, ensuring adaptability to a wide range of modeling tasks. This streamlines the process of model generation and evaluation, making it more efficient and accessible.
summary_zh: 网络物理系统 (CPS) 的有效模型对于其设计和运行至关重要。由于 CPS 固有的复杂性，构建此类模型既困难又耗时。因此，使用机器学习方法进行数据驱动的模型生成正变得越来越流行。在本文中，我们提出了 Flowcean，这是一个用于通过数据驱动学习自动生成模型的新型框架，其重点在于模块化和可用性。通过提供各种学习策略、数据处理方法和评估指标，我们的框架提供了一个全面的解决方案，专为 CPS 场景量身定制。 Flowcean 促进了各种学习库和工具在模块化和灵活架构中的集成，从而确保了对各种建模任务的适应性。这简化了模型生成和评估的过程，使其更高效、更易于使用。
tldr: Flowcean is a new framework for automating the generation of data-driven Cyber-Physical System models, emphasizing modularity, usability, and flexibility through diverse learning strategies and integration capabilities.
tldr_zh: Flowcean 是一个新的框架，旨在自动化生成数据驱动的网络物理系统模型，通过多样化的学习策略和集成能力来强调模块化、可用性和灵活性。

title: AstroSplat: Physics-Based Gaussian Splatting for Rendering and Reconstruction of Small Celestial Bodies
summary: Image-based surface reconstruction and characterization are crucial for missions to small celestial bodies (e.g., asteroids), as it informs mission planning, navigation, and scientific analysis. Recent advances in Gaussian splatting enable high-fidelity neural scene representations but typically rely on a spherical harmonic intensity parameterization that is strictly appearance-based and does not explicitly model material properties or light-surface interactions. We introduce AstroSplat, a physics-based Gaussian splatting framework that integrates planetary reflectance models to improve the autonomous reconstruction and photometric characterization of small-body surfaces from in-situ imagery. The proposed framework is validated on real imagery taken by NASA's Dawn mission, where we demonstrate superior rendering performance and surface reconstruction accuracy compared to the typical spherical harmonic parameterization.
summary_zh: 基于图像的表面重建和表征对于小天体（如小行星）探测任务至关重要，因为它为任务规划、导航和科学分析提供信息。最近高斯溅射技术的进步实现了高保真度的神经场景表示，但通常依赖于球面谐波强度参数化，该参数化严格基于外观，并且没有明确地对材料特性或光-表面相互作用进行建模。我们介绍AstroSplat，一个基于物理的高斯溅射框架，它集成了行星反射率模型，以改进从小天体表面原位图像进行自主重建和光度表征。所提出的框架已在NASA黎明号任务拍摄的真实图像上进行了验证，结果表明，与典型的球面谐波参数化相比，我们获得了更卓越的渲染性能和表面重建精度。
tldr: AstroSplat introduces a physics-based Gaussian splatting framework for reconstructing and characterizing small celestial bodies from in-situ imagery, improving upon existing methods by explicitly modeling material properties and light-surface interactions, demonstrating superior performance on NASA's Dawn mission data.
tldr_zh: AstroSplat 提出了一种基于物理的 Gaussian splatting 框架，用于从原位图像重建和表征小型天体，通过显式建模材料属性和光-表面相互作用，改进了现有方法，并在 NASA 的 Dawn 任务数据上展示了卓越的性能。

title: Preliminary analysis of RGB-NIR Image Registration techniques for off-road forestry environments
summary: RGB-NIR image registration plays an important role in sensor-fusion, image enhancement and off-road autonomy. In this work, we evaluate both classical and Deep Learning (DL) based image registration techniques to access their suitability for off-road forestry applications. NeMAR, trained under 6 different configurations, demonstrates partial success however, its GAN loss instability suggests challenges in preserving geometric consistency. MURF, when tested on off-road forestry data shows promising large scale feature alignment during shared information extraction but struggles with fine details in dense vegetation. Even though this is just a preliminary evaluation, our study necessitates further refinements for robust, multi-scale registration for off-road forest applications.
summary_zh: RGB-NIR图像配准在传感器融合、图像增强和越野自主导航中扮演着重要角色。在这项工作中，我们评估了基于经典方法和深度学习(DL)的图像配准技术，以评估它们在越野林业应用中的适用性。NeMAR在6种不同配置下训练，显示出部分成功，但其GAN损失的不稳定性表明在保持几何一致性方面存在挑战。MURF在越野林业数据上测试时，在共享信息提取过程中显示出有希望的大尺度特征对齐，但在茂密植被中的精细细节处理方面遇到困难。尽管这只是一个初步评估，但我们的研究表明，需要进一步改进，以实现针对越野森林应用的鲁棒、多尺度配准。
tldr: This paper evaluates RGB-NIR image registration techniques (classical and DL-based) for off-road forestry, finding limitations in NeMAR and MURF, necessitating further research for robust multi-scale registration.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了用于越野林业RGB-NIR图像配准技术（包括传统和基于深度学习的方法），发现NeMAR和MURF存在局限性，因此有必要进一步研究稳健的多尺度配准方法。

title: Single-View Rolling-Shutter SfM
summary: Rolling-shutter (RS) cameras are ubiquitous, but RS SfM (structure-from-motion) has not been fully solved yet. This work suggests an approach to remedy this: We characterize RS single-view geometry of observed world points or lines. Exploiting this geometry, we describe which motion and scene parameters can be recovered from a single RS image and systematically derive minimal reconstruction problems. We evaluate several representative cases with proof-of-concept solvers, highlighting both feasibility and practical limitations.
summary_zh: 滚动快门（RS）相机应用广泛，但RS运动恢复结构（SfM）问题尚未完全解决。本文提出一种解决该问题的途径：我们描述了观测到的世界点或线的RS单视图几何特性。通过利用这些几何特性，我们描述了可以从单张RS图像中恢复哪些运动和场景参数，并系统地推导了最小重建问题。我们使用概念验证求解器评估了几个具有代表性的案例，突出了可行性和实际局限性。
tldr: This paper addresses the rolling-shutter structure-from-motion (SfM) problem from a single view, characterizing the geometry and deriving minimal reconstruction problems. It shows the feasibility and limitations with proof-of-concept solvers.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了单视图下的卷帘快门结构重建(SfM)问题，分析了几何特性并推导了最小重建问题。通过概念验证求解器展示了可行性和局限性。

title: COTONET: A custom cotton detection algorithm based on YOLO11 for stage of growth cotton boll detection
summary: Cotton harvesting is a critical phase where cotton capsules are physically manipulated and can lead to fibre degradation. To maintain the highest quality, harvesting methods must emulate delicate manual grasping, to preserve cotton's intrinsic properties. Automating this process requires systems capable of recognising cotton capsules across various phenological stages. To address this challenge, we propose COTONET, an enhanced custom YOLO11 model tailored with attention mechanisms to improve the detection of difficult instances. The architecture incorporates gradients in non-learnable operations to enhance shape and feature extraction. Key architectural modifications include: the replacement of convolutional blocks with Squeeze-and-Exitation blocks, a redesigned backbone integrating attention mechanisms, and the substitution of standard upsampling operations for Content Aware Reassembly of Features (CARAFE). Additionally, we integrate Simple Attention Modules (SimAM) for primary feature aggregation and Parallel Hybrid Attention Mechanisms (PHAM) for channel-wise, spatial-wise and coordinate-wise attention in the downward neck path. This configuration offers increased flexibility and robustness for interpreting the complexity of cotton crop growth. COTONET aligns with small-to-medium YOLO models utilizing 7.6M parameters and 27.8 GFLOPS, making it suitable for low-resource edge computing and mobile robotics. COTONET outperforms the standard YOLO baselines, achieving a mAP50 of 81.1% and a mAP50-95 of 60.6%.
summary_zh: 棉花采摘是一个关键阶段，在此阶段棉花的棉铃会被物理性地操作，这可能导致纤维降解。为了保持最高质量，采摘方法必须模仿精细的手工抓取，以保留棉花的内在特性。该过程的自动化需要能够识别各种物候期棉铃的系统。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了COTONET，一个增强的定制YOLO11模型，该模型专门设计了注意力机制，以提高对难以检测的实例的检测能力。该架构在不可学习的操作中融入了梯度，以增强形状和特征提取。关键的架构修改包括：用Squeeze-and-Exitation块替换卷积块，重新设计的集成了注意力机制的主干网络，以及用内容感知特征重组（CARAFE）替换标准上采样操作。此外，我们集成了用于主要特征聚合的简单注意力模块（SimAM）和用于下行颈部路径中通道级、空间级和坐标级注意力的并行混合注意力机制（PHAM）。这种配置为解释棉花作物生长的复杂性提供了更大的灵活性和鲁棒性。COTONET与小型到中型的YOLO模型保持一致，利用760万个参数和27.8 GFLOPS，使其适合于低资源边缘计算和移动机器人应用。COTONET的性能优于标准YOLO基线，达到了81.1%的mAP50和60.6%的mAP50-95。
tldr: The paper introduces COTONET, a modified YOLOv11 architecture incorporating attention mechanisms and other enhancements for improved cotton boll detection across various growth stages, suitable for low-resource edge computing.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了COTONET，一种改进的YOLOv11架构，结合了注意力机制和其他增强功能，以提高对不同生长阶段棉铃的检测能力，适用于低资源边缘计算。

title: Shadowless Projection Mapping for Tabletop Workspaces with Synthetic Aperture Projector
summary: Projection mapping (PM) enables augmented reality (AR) experiences without requiring users to wear head-mounted displays and supports multi-user interaction. It is regarded as a promising technology for a variety of applications in which users interact with content superimposed onto augmented objects in tabletop workspaces, including remote collaboration, healthcare, industrial design, urban planning, artwork creation, and office work. However, conventional PM systems often suffer from projection shadows when users occlude the light path. Prior approaches employing multiple distributed projectors can compensate for occlusion, but suffer from latency due to computational processing, degrading the user experience. In this research, we introduce a synthetic-aperture PM system that uses a significantly larger number of projectors, arranged densely in the environment, to achieve delay-free, shadowless projection for tabletop workspaces without requiring computational compensation. To address spatial resolution degradation caused by subpixel misalignment among overlaid projections, we develop and validate an offline blur compensation method whose computation time remains independent of the number of projectors. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our shadowless PM plays a critical role in achieving a fundamental goal of PM: altering material properties without evoking projection-like impression. Specifically, we define this perceptual impression as ``sense of projection (SoP)'' and establish a PM design framework to minimize the SoP based on user studies.
summary_zh: 投影映射（PM）能够实现增强现实（AR）体验，无需用户佩戴头戴式显示器，并支持多用户互动。它被认为是一项前景广阔的技术，适用于用户与叠加在桌面工作区中增强对象上的内容进行交互的各种应用，包括远程协作、医疗保健、工业设计、城市规划、艺术创作和办公工作。然而，传统的PM系统通常会在用户遮挡光路时受到投影阴影的影响。先前采用多个分布式投影仪的方法可以补偿遮挡，但由于计算处理而产生延迟，从而降低了用户体验。在本研究中，我们引入了一种合成孔径PM系统，该系统使用大量投影仪密集地排列在环境中，以实现无需计算补偿的桌面工作区无延迟、无阴影投影。为了解决叠加投影之间亚像素未对准引起的空间分辨率下降问题，我们开发并验证了一种离线模糊补偿方法，该方法的计算时间与投影仪的数量无关。此外，我们证明了我们的无阴影PM在实现PM的一个基本目标方面发挥着关键作用：在不引起类似投影的印象的情况下改变材料属性。具体来说，我们将这种感知印象定义为“投影感（SoP）”，并建立了一个基于用户研究的PM设计框架，以最大限度地减少SoP。
tldr: This paper introduces a synthetic-aperture projection mapping system with many projectors to achieve shadowless projection and minimize the 'sense of projection' on tabletop workspaces, enhanced by an offline blur compensation method.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种合成孔径投影映射系统，该系统使用大量投影仪来实现无阴影投影，并最大限度地减少桌面工作空间中的“投影感”，并通过离线模糊补偿方法进行了增强。

title: High-Precision 6DOF Pose Estimation via Global Phase Retrieval in Fringe Projection Profilometry for 3D Mapping
summary: Digital fringe projection (DFP) enables micrometer-level 3D reconstruction, yet extending it to large-scale mapping remains challenging because six-degree-of-freedom pose estimation often cannot match the reconstruction's precision. Conventional iterative closest point (ICP) registration becomes inefficient on multi-million-point clouds and typically relies on downsampling or feature-based selection, which can reduce local detail and degrade pose precision. Drift-correction methods improve long-term consistency but do not resolve sampling sensitivity in dense DFP point clouds.We propose a high-precision pose estimation method that augments a moving DFP system with a fixed, intrinsically calibrated global projector. Using the global projector's phase-derived pixel constraints and a PnP-style reprojection objective, the method estimates the DFP system pose in a fixed reference frame without relying on deterministic feature extraction, and we experimentally demonstrate sampling invariance under coordinate-preserving subsampling. Experiments demonstrate sub-millimeter pose accuracy against a reference with quantified uncertainty bounds, high repeatability under aggressive subsampling, robust operation on homogeneous surfaces and low-overlap views, and reduced error accumulation when used to correct ICP-based trajectories. The method extends DFP toward accurate 3D mapping in quasi-static scenarios such as inspection and metrology, with the trade-off of time-multiplexed acquisition for the additional projector measurements.
summary_zh: 数字条纹投影(DFP)可实现微米级三维重建，然而将其扩展到大规模测绘仍具有挑战性，因为六自由度姿态估计往往无法与重建精度相匹配。传统的迭代最近点(ICP)配准在数百万点云上效率低下，通常依赖于降采样或基于特征的选择，这会降低局部细节并降低姿态精度。漂移校正方法可以提高长期一致性，但无法解决密集DFP点云中的采样敏感性。我们提出了一种高精度姿态估计方法，该方法利用一个固定的、经过内参标定的全局投影仪来增强移动的DFP系统。该方法使用全局投影仪的相位导出的像素约束以及类似PnP的重投影目标，在固定参考系中估计DFP系统姿态，而无需依赖确定性的特征提取。我们通过实验证明了在坐标保持的二次采样下的采样不变性。实验表明，针对具有量化不确定性边界的参考系，实现了亚毫米级的姿态精度；在激进的二次采样下具有很高的可重复性；在均匀表面和低重叠视图上具有稳健的操作性能；并且在用于校正基于ICP的轨迹时，减少了误差累积。该方法将DFP扩展到准静态场景（如检测和计量）中的精确3D测绘，其代价是用时分复用采集的方式获取额外的投影仪测量数据。
tldr: The paper introduces a high-precision 6DOF pose estimation method for fringe projection profilometry by using a global projector, addressing the limitations of ICP in large-scale 3D mapping and enabling accurate 3D mapping in quasi-static scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种高精度的条纹投影轮廓术六自由度位姿估计方法，该方法使用全局投影仪，解决了ICP在大规模三维mapping中的局限性，并实现了在准静态场景下的精确三维mapping。

title: InstantHDR: Single-forward Gaussian Splatting for High Dynamic Range 3D Reconstruction
summary: High dynamic range (HDR) novel view synthesis (NVS) aims to reconstruct HDR scenes from multi-exposure low dynamic range (LDR) images. Existing HDR pipelines heavily rely on known camera poses, well-initialized dense point clouds, and time-consuming per-scene optimization. Current feed-forward alternatives overlook the HDR problem by assuming exposure-invariant appearance. To bridge this gap, we propose InstantHDR, a feed-forward network that reconstructs 3D HDR scenes from uncalibrated multi-exposure LDR collections in a single forward pass. Specifically, we design a geometry-guided appearance modeling for multi-exposure fusion, and a meta-network for generalizable scene-specific tone mapping. Due to the lack of HDR scene data, we build a pre-training dataset, called HDR-Pretrain, for generalizable feed-forward HDR models, featuring 168 Blender-rendered scenes, diverse lighting types, and multiple camera response functions. Comprehensive experiments show that our InstantHDR delivers comparable synthesis performance to the state-of-the-art optimization-based HDR methods while enjoying $\sim700\times$ and $\sim20\times$ reconstruction speed improvement with our single-forward and post-optimization settings. All code, models, and datasets will be released after the review process.
summary_zh: 高动态范围（HDR）新视角合成（NVS）旨在从多曝光低动态范围（LDR）图像中重建HDR场景。现有HDR流程严重依赖于已知的相机姿态、良好初始化的密集点云以及耗时的逐场景优化。目前的直接前馈替代方案通过假设曝光不变的外观，忽略了HDR问题。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出InstantHDR，一个直接前馈网络，可在单次前向传递中从未经校准的多曝光LDR图像集合中重建3D HDR场景。具体而言，我们设计了一种几何引导的外观建模用于多曝光融合，以及一个用于可泛化场景特定色调映射的元网络。由于缺乏HDR场景数据，我们构建了一个预训练数据集HDR-Pretrain，用于可泛化的直接前馈HDR模型，该数据集包含168个Blender渲染场景、多样化的照明类型以及多种相机响应函数。综合实验表明，我们的InstantHDR在提供与最先进的基于优化的HDR方法相当的合成性能的同时，通过我们的单次前向和后优化设置，实现了约$700\times$和约$20\times$的重建速度提升。所有代码、模型和数据集将在评审过程后发布。
tldr: The paper introduces InstantHDR, a feed-forward network utilizing Gaussian splatting for fast HDR 3D reconstruction from multi-exposure LDR images, achieving comparable or superior performance to optimization-based methods with significantly improved speed.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了InstantHDR，一个使用高斯溅射的前馈网络，用于从多重曝光LDR图像中快速进行HDR 3D重建，与基于优化的方法相比，实现了可比或更优越的性能，并显著提高了速度。

title: Bayesian Optimization of Partially Known Systems using Hybrid Models
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) has gained attention as an efficient algorithm for black-box optimization of expensive-to-evaluate systems, where the BO algorithm iteratively queries the system and suggests new trials based on a probabilistic model fitted to previous samples. Still, the standard BO loop may require a prohibitively large number of experiments to converge to the optimum, especially for high-dimensional and nonlinear systems. We present a hybrid model-based BO formulation that combines the iterative Bayesian learning of BO with partially known mechanistic physical models. Instead of learning a direct mapping from inputs to the objective, we write all known equations for a physics-based model and infer expressions for variables missing equations using a probabilistic model, in our case, a Gaussian process (GP). The final formulation then includes the GP as a constraint in the hybrid model, thereby allowing other physics-based nonlinear and implicit model constraints. This hybrid model formulation yields a constrained, nonlinear stochastic program, which we discretize using the sample-average approximation. In an in-silico optimization of a single-stage distillation, the hybrid BO model based on mass conservation laws yields significantly better designs than a standard BO loop. Furthermore, the hybrid model converges in as few as one iteration, depending on the initial samples, whereas, the standard BO does not converge within 25 for any of the seeds. Overall, the proposed hybrid BO scheme presents a promising optimization method for partially known systems, leveraging the strengths of both mechanistic modeling and data-driven optimization.
summary_zh: 贝叶斯优化 (BO) 作为一种高效的黑盒优化算法，在昂贵评估系统的优化中受到了广泛关注。BO 算法迭代式地查询系统，并基于拟合先前样本的概率模型来建议新的试验。然而，标准的 BO 循环可能需要非常大量的实验才能收敛到最优解，尤其是在高维和非线性系统中。我们提出了一种混合模型驱动的 BO 方案，该方案将 BO 的迭代贝叶斯学习与部分已知的机理物理模型相结合。不同于学习从输入到目标的直接映射，我们为基于物理的模型编写所有已知的方程，并使用概率模型（在我们的案例中为高斯过程（GP））推断缺失方程的变量表达式。最终的公式将 GP 作为混合模型中的约束，从而允许其他的基于物理的非线性和隐式模型约束。这种混合模型公式产生了一个受约束的非线性随机规划，我们使用样本平均近似对其进行离散化。在单级蒸馏的计算机模拟优化中，基于质量守恒定律的混合 BO 模型比标准的 BO 循环产生明显更好的设计。此外，根据初始样本的不同，混合模型在少至一次迭代中即可收敛，而标准 BO 在任何种子下，25 次迭代内均不收敛。总而言之，所提出的混合 BO 方案为部分已知系统提供了一种有前景的优化方法，利用了机理建模和数据驱动优化的优势。
tldr: This paper introduces a hybrid Bayesian Optimization (BO) approach that combines mechanistic physical models with Gaussian Processes to optimize partially known systems, demonstrating faster convergence and better designs compared to standard BO in a distillation optimization problem.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种混合贝叶斯优化(BO)方法，该方法将机械物理模型与高斯过程相结合，以优化部分已知系统。在蒸馏优化问题中，与标准BO相比，该方法表现出更快的收敛速度和更好的设计。

title: Examining Users' Behavioural Intention to Use OpenClaw Through the Cognition--Affect--Conation Framework
summary: This study examines users' behavioural intention to use OpenClaw through the Cognition--Affect--Conation (CAC) framework. The research investigates how cognitive perceptions of the system influence affective responses and subsequently shape behavioural intention. Enabling factors include perceived personalisation, perceived intelligence, and relative advantage, while inhibiting factors include privacy concern, algorithmic opacity, and perceived risk. Survey data from 436 OpenClaw users were analysed using structural equation modelling. The results show that positive perceptions strengthen users' attitudes toward OpenClaw, which increase behavioural intention, whereas negative perceptions increase distrust and reduce intention to use the system. The study provides insights into the psychological mechanisms influencing the adoption of autonomous AI agents.
summary_zh: 本研究通过认知-情感-意动 (CAC) 框架，考察用户使用 OpenClaw 的行为意向。 该研究调查了系统认知感知如何影响情感反应，进而塑造行为意向。 促成因素包括感知到的个性化、感知到的智能和相对优势，而抑制因素包括隐私担忧、算法不透明性和感知到的风险。 使用结构方程模型分析了来自 436 位 OpenClaw 用户的调查数据。 结果表明，积极的感知增强了用户对 OpenClaw 的态度，从而增加了行为意向，而消极的感知则增加了不信任感，并降低了使用该系统的意向。 本研究深入了解了影响自主人工智能代理采用的心理机制。
tldr: This paper uses the Cognition-Affect-Conation (CAC) framework to investigate the factors influencing user adoption of the OpenClaw autonomous AI agent, finding that positive perceptions increase adoption while negative perceptions decrease it.
tldr_zh: 该论文使用认知-情感-意动 (CAC) 框架来研究影响用户采用 OpenClaw 自主 AI 代理的因素，发现积极的认知会增加采用率，而消极的认知会降低采用率。

title: Efficient Cross-View Localization in 6G Space-Air-Ground Integrated Network
summary: Recently, visual localization has become an important supplement to improve localization reliability, and cross-view approaches can greatly enhance coverage and adaptability. Meanwhile, future 6G will enable a globally covered mobile communication system, with a space-air-ground integrated network (SAGIN) serving as key supporting architecture. Inspired by this, we explore an integration of cross-view localization (CVL) with 6G SAGIN, thereby enhancing its performance in latency, energy consumption, and privacy protection. First, we provide a comprehensive review of CVL and SAGIN, highlighting their capabilities, integration opportunities, and potential applications. Benefiting from the fast and extensive image collection and transmission capabilities of the 6G SAGIN architecture, CVL achieves higher localization accuracy and faster processing speed. Then, we propose a split-inference framework for implementing CVL, which fully leverages the distributed communication and computing resources of the 6G SAGIN architecture. Subsequently, we conduct joint optimization of communication, computation, and confidentiality within the proposed split-inference framework, aiming to provide a paradigm and a direction for making CVL efficient. Experimental results validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and provide solutions to the optimization problem. Finally, we discuss potential research directions for 6G SAGIN-enabled CVL.
summary_zh:
摘要：
近年来，视觉定位已成为提高定位可靠性的重要补充，而跨视角方法可以显著增强覆盖范围和适应性。同时，未来的6G将实现全球覆盖的移动通信系统，其中空天地一体化网络(SAGIN)是关键的支撑架构。受此启发，我们探索将跨视角定位(CVL)与6G SAGIN集成，从而提升其在延迟、能耗和隐私保护方面的性能。首先，我们对CVL和SAGIN进行了全面综述，强调了它们的能力、集成机会和潜在应用。受益于6G SAGIN架构快速且广泛的图像采集和传输能力，CVL实现了更高的定位精度和更快的处理速度。然后，我们提出了一种用于实现CVL的拆分推理框架，该框架充分利用了6G SAGIN架构的分布式通信和计算资源。随后，我们在所提出的拆分推理框架内进行通信、计算和保密性的联合优化，旨在为实现CVL的高效性提供一种范式和方向。实验结果验证了所提出框架的有效性，并为优化问题提供了解决方案。最后，我们讨论了6G SAGIN赋能的CVL的潜在研究方向。
tldr: This paper explores integrating cross-view localization (CVL) with 6G space-air-ground integrated networks (SAGIN) to improve localization performance, proposing a split-inference framework and optimizing communication, computation, and confidentiality. The experimental results validate the framework's effectiveness.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了将跨视角定位 (CVL) 与 6G 空天地一体化网络 (SAGIN) 相结合以提高定位性能，提出了一种分裂推理框架并优化了通信、计算和保密性。 实验结果验证了该框架的有效性。

title: Hypercomplex Widely Linear Processing: Fundamentals for Quaternion Machine Learning
summary: Numerous attempts have been made to replicate the success of complex-valued algebra in engineering and science to other hypercomplex domains such as quaternions, tessarines, biquaternions, and octonions. Perhaps, none have matched the success of quaternions. The most useful feature of quaternions lies in their ability to model three-dimensional rotations which, in turn, have found various industrial applications such as in aeronautics and computergraphics. Recently, we have witnessed a renaissance of quaternions due to the rise of machine learning. To equip the reader to contribute to this emerging research area, this chapter lays down the foundation for: - augmented statistics for modelling quaternion-valued random processes, - widely linear models to exploit such advanced statistics, - quaternion calculus and algebra for algorithmic derivations, - mean square estimation for practical considerations. For ease of exposure, several examples are offered to facilitate the learning, understanding, and(hopefully) the adoption of this multidimensional domain.
summary_zh: 为了在工程和科学领域复制复数代数取得的成功，人们已尝试将此方法应用于其他超复数域，如四元数、泰萨林数、双四元数和八元数。然而，似乎没有一种能与四元数相媲美。四元数最实用的特性在于其能够模拟三维旋转，而这种能力又在航空和计算机图形学等各种工业应用中得到了应用。近年来，由于机器学习的兴起，我们见证了四元数的复兴。为使读者能够为这一新兴研究领域做出贡献，本章为以下内容奠定了基础：- 用于建模四元数值随机过程的增强统计方法，- 能够利用这些高级统计信息的广义线性模型，- 用于算法推导的四元数微积分和代数，- 用于实际考虑的均方估计。为了便于理解，提供了几个示例，以促进对这个多维领域的学习、理解和（希望）采用。
tldr: This paper provides foundational knowledge for quaternion machine learning, covering augmented statistics, widely linear models, quaternion calculus, and mean square estimation, aiming to facilitate the adoption of this domain.
tldr_zh: 本文为四元数机器学习提供了基础知识，涵盖增强统计、广义线性模型、四元数微积分和均方估计，旨在促进该领域的应用。

title: DecoVLN: Decoupling Observation, Reasoning, and Correction for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to follow long-horizon instructions and navigate complex 3D environments. However, existing approaches face two major challenges: constructing an effective long-term memory bank and overcoming the compounding errors problem. To address these issues, we propose DecoVLN, an effective framework designed for robust streaming perception and closed-loop control in long-horizon navigation. First, we formulate long-term memory construction as an optimization problem and introduce adaptive refinement mechanism that selects frames from a historical candidate pool by iteratively optimizing a unified scoring function. This function jointly balances three key criteria: semantic relevance to the instruction, visual diversity from the selected memory, and temporal coverage of the historical trajectory. Second, to alleviate compounding errors, we introduce a state-action pair-level corrective finetuning strategy. By leveraging geodesic distance between states to precisely quantify deviation from the expert trajectory, the agent collects high-quality state-action pairs in the trusted region while filtering out the polluted data with low relevance. This improves both the efficiency and stability of error correction. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of DecoVLN, and we have deployed it in real-world environments.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求智能体遵循长程指令并在复杂的 3D 环境中导航。然而，现有方法面临两个主要挑战：构建有效的长期记忆库和克服复合误差问题。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 DecoVLN，一种为长程导航中稳健的流式感知和闭环控制而设计的有效框架。首先，我们将长期记忆构建形式化为一个优化问题，并引入自适应精炼机制，通过迭代优化统一的评分函数，从历史候选池中选择帧。该函数联合平衡三个关键标准：与指令的语义相关性、与已选记忆的视觉多样性以及历史轨迹的时间覆盖率。其次，为了缓解复合误差，我们引入了一种状态-动作对级别的校正微调策略。通过利用状态之间的测地距离来精确量化与专家轨迹的偏差，智能体在可信区域收集高质量的状态-动作对，同时过滤掉低相关性的污染数据。这提高了误差校正的效率和稳定性。大量的实验证明了 DecoVLN 的有效性，并且我们已将其部署在真实环境中。
tldr: DecoVLN addresses long-horizon Vision-and-Language Navigation by decoupling observation, reasoning, and correction through adaptive memory refinement and corrective finetuning, achieving improved performance and stability.
tldr_zh: DecoVLN通过解耦观察、推理和修正，利用自适应记忆优化和纠正性微调，解决了长程视觉-语言导航问题，实现了性能和稳定性的提升。

title: ESPIRE: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Spatial Reasoning of Vision-Language Models
summary: A recent trend in vision-language models (VLMs) has been to enhance their spatial cognition for embodied domains. Despite progress, existing evaluations have been limited both in paradigm and in coverage, hindering rapid, iterative model development. To address these limitations, we propose ESPIRE, a diagnostic benchmark for embodied spatial reasoning. ESPIRE offers a simulated world that physically grounds VLMs and evaluates them on spatial-reasoning-centric robotic tasks, thus narrowing the gap between evaluation and real-world deployment. To adapt VLMs to robotic tasks, we decompose each task into localization and execution, and frame both as generative problems, in stark contrast to predominant discriminative evaluations (e.g., via visual-question answering) that rely on distractors and discard execution. This decomposition further enables a fine-grained analysis beyond passive spatial reasoning toward reasoning to act. We systematically design ESPIRE both at the instruction level and at the environment level, ensuring broad coverage of spatial reasoning scenarios. We use ESPIRE to diagnose a range of frontier VLMs and provide in-depth analysis of their spatial reasoning behaviors.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型 (VLMs) 的一个最新趋势是增强其在具身领域中的空间认知能力。尽管取得了进展，但现有的评估在范式和覆盖范围上都存在局限性，阻碍了快速、迭代的模型开发。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 ESPIRE，一个用于具身空间推理的诊断性基准。ESPIRE 提供了一个模拟世界，可以将 VLM 进行物理接地，并根据以空间推理为中心的机器人任务对其进行评估，从而缩小了评估与实际部署之间的差距。为了使 VLM 适应机器人任务，我们将每个任务分解为定位和执行，并将两者都构建为生成问题，这与主要依赖于干扰项并舍弃执行的判别式评估（例如，通过视觉问答）形成鲜明对比。这种分解进一步实现了超越被动空间推理到推理以采取行动的细粒度分析。我们从指令级别和环境级别系统地设计 ESPIRE，以确保对空间推理场景的广泛覆盖。我们使用 ESPIRE 诊断了一系列前沿 VLM，并深入分析了它们的空间推理行为。
tldr: The paper introduces ESPIRE, a new diagnostic benchmark for evaluating the embodied spatial reasoning abilities of vision-language models in robotic tasks, addressing limitations of existing evaluations by focusing on generative tasks and offering a fine-grained analysis of reasoning to act.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ESPIRE，一个新的诊断基准，用于评估视觉-语言模型在机器人任务中的具身空间推理能力。它通过关注生成任务和提供对推理到行动的细粒度分析，解决了现有评估的局限性。

title: RoboStream: Weaving Spatio-Temporal Reasoning with Memory in Vision-Language Models for Robotics
summary: Enabling reliable long-horizon robotic manipulation is a crucial step toward open-world embodied intelligence. However, VLM-based planners treat each step as an isolated observation-to-action mapping, forcing them to reinfer scene geometry from raw pixels at every decision point while remaining unaware of how prior actions have reshaped the environment. Despite strong short-horizon performance, these systems lack the spatio-temporal reasoning required for persistent geometric anchoring and memory of action-triggered state transitions. Without persistent state tracking, perceptual errors accumulate across the execution horizon, temporarily occluded objects are catastrophically forgotten, and these compounding failures lead to precondition violations that cascade through subsequent steps. In contrast, humans maintain a persistent mental model that continuously tracks spatial relations and action consequences across interactions rather than reconstructing them at each instant. Inspired by this human capacity for causal spatio-temporal reasoning with persistent memory, we propose RoboStream, a training-free framework that achieves geometric anchoring through Spatio-Temporal Fusion Tokens (STF-Tokens), which bind visual evidence to 3D geometric attributes for persistent object grounding, and maintains causal continuity via a Causal Spatio-Temporal Graph (CSTG) that records action-triggered state transitions across steps. This design enables the planner to trace causal chains and preserve object permanence under occlusion without additional training or fine-tuning. RoboStream achieves 90.5% on long-horizon RLBench and 44.4% on challenging real-world block-building tasks, where both SoFar and VoxPoser score 11.1%, demonstrating that spatio-temporal reasoning and causal memory are critical missing components for reliable long-horizon manipulation.
summary_zh: 实现可靠的长程机器人操作是迈向开放世界具身智能的关键一步。然而，基于VLM的规划器将每一步都视为一个孤立的“观察-行动”映射，迫使它们在每个决策点都从原始像素重新推断场景几何结构，同时对先前行动如何重塑环境一无所知。尽管在短程任务中表现出色，但这些系统缺乏持久的几何锚定和对由行动触发的状态转移记忆所需的时空推理能力。由于缺乏持久的状态追踪，感知错误在执行过程中累积，暂时遮挡的物体会被灾难性地遗忘，这些复合故障会导致前提条件违背，并在后续步骤中级联。相比之下，人类维护着一个持久的心理模型，该模型持续追踪跨交互的空间关系和行动后果，而不是在每个时刻都进行重建。受人类具有因果时空推理和持久记忆能力启发，我们提出了RoboStream，这是一个免训练框架，它通过时空融合令牌（STF-Tokens）实现几何锚定，该令牌将视觉证据绑定到3D几何属性，用于持久的物体接地；并通过因果时空图（CSTG）维持因果连续性，该图记录跨步骤的行动触发的状态转移。这种设计使得规划器能够追踪因果链，并在遮挡下保持物体恒常性，而无需额外的训练或微调。RoboStream在长程RLBench上实现了90.5%的成功率，在具有挑战性的真实世界积木搭建任务中实现了44.4%的成功率，而SoFar和VoxPoser的得分均为11.1%，这表明时空推理和因果记忆是可靠长程操作中关键的缺失组件。
tldr: RoboStream is a training-free framework that enhances VLM-based robotic manipulation by incorporating spatio-temporal reasoning and causal memory via Spatio-Temporal Fusion Tokens (STF-Tokens) and a Causal Spatio-Temporal Graph (CSTG), demonstrating improved performance on long-horizon tasks.
tldr_zh: RoboStream是一个无需训练的框架，通过时空融合令牌(STF-Tokens)和因果时空图(CSTG)将时空推理和因果记忆融入基于VLM的机器人操作中，从而提高长程任务的性能。

title: Beyond Dense Futures: World Models as Structured Planners for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Recent world-model-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures have improved robotic manipulation through predictive visual foresight. However, dense future prediction introduces visual redundancy and accumulates errors, causing long-horizon plan drift. Meanwhile, recent sparse methods typically represent visual foresight using high-level semantic subtasks or implicit latent states. These representations often lack explicit kinematic grounding, weakening the alignment between planning and low-level execution. To address this, we propose StructVLA, which reformulates a generative world model into an explicit structured planner for reliable control. Instead of dense rollouts or semantic goals, StructVLA predicts sparse, physically meaningful structured frames. Derived from intrinsic kinematic cues (e.g., gripper transitions and kinematic turning points), these frames capture spatiotemporal milestones closely aligned with task progress. We implement this approach through a two-stage training paradigm with a unified discrete token vocabulary: the world model is first trained to predict structured frames and subsequently optimized to map the structured foresight into low-level actions. This approach provides clear physical guidance and bridges visual planning and motion control. In our experiments, StructVLA achieves strong average success rates of 75.0% on SimplerEnv-WidowX and 94.8% on LIBERO. Real-world deployments further demonstrate reliable task completion and robust generalization across both basic pick-and-place and complex long-horizon tasks.
summary_zh: 基于世界模型的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)架构通过预测性视觉前瞻技术改进了机器人操作。然而，密集的未来预测引入了视觉冗余并累积误差，导致长程规划漂移。同时，最近的稀疏方法通常使用高级语义子任务或隐式潜在状态来表示视觉前瞻。这些表示通常缺乏显式的运动学基础，削弱了规划与底层执行之间的对齐。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了StructVLA，它将生成世界模型重新 формулирует 为一个显式的结构化规划器，用于可靠的控制。StructVLA 预测稀疏、物理意义明确的结构化帧，而不是密集的展开或语义目标。这些帧源于内在运动学线索（例如，夹爪转换和运动学转折点），捕捉到与任务进度紧密对齐的时空里程碑。我们通过一个具有统一离散令牌词汇的两阶段训练范式来实现这种方法：首先训练世界模型来预测结构化帧，然后优化它将结构化前瞻映射到低层动作。这种方法提供了清晰的物理指导，并将视觉规划和运动控制连接起来。在我们的实验中，StructVLA 在 SimplerEnv-WidowX 上实现了 75.0% 的强劲平均成功率，并在 LIBERO 上实现了 94.8% 的成功率。真实世界的部署进一步证明了在基本拾取放置和复杂长程任务中可靠的任务完成和强大的泛化能力。
tldr: The paper introduces StructVLA, a structured planner for robotic manipulation that predicts sparse, physically meaningful structured frames derived from kinematic cues, improving reliability and generalization in both simulation and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了StructVLA，一种用于机器人操作的结构化规划器，它预测从运动学线索导出的稀疏的、具有物理意义的结构化帧，从而提高了仿真和真实世界任务的可靠性和泛化能力。

title: One-Step Flow Policy: Self-Distillation for Fast Visuomotor Policies
summary: Generative flow and diffusion models provide the continuous, multimodal action distributions needed for high-precision robotic policies. However, their reliance on iterative sampling introduces severe inference latency, degrading control frequency and harming performance in time-sensitive manipulation. To address this problem, we propose the One-Step Flow Policy (OFP), a from-scratch self-distillation framework for high-fidelity, single-step action generation without a pre-trained teacher. OFP unifies a self-consistency loss to enforce coherent transport across time intervals, and a self-guided regularization to sharpen predictions toward high-density expert modes. In addition, a warm-start mechanism leverages temporal action correlations to minimize the generative transport distance. Evaluations across 56 diverse simulated manipulation tasks demonstrate that a one-step OFP achieves state-of-the-art results, outperforming 100-step diffusion and flow policies while accelerating action generation by over $100\times$. We further integrate OFP into the $π_{0.5}$ model on RoboTwin 2.0, where one-step OFP surpasses the original 10-step policy. These results establish OFP as a practical, scalable solution for highly accurate and low-latency robot control.
summary_zh: 生成式流模型和扩散模型为高精度机器人策略提供了连续、多模态的动作分布。然而，它们对迭代采样的依赖引入了严重的推理延迟，降低了控制频率并损害时间敏感操作中的性能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种单步流策略（OFP），这是一个从零开始的自蒸馏框架，用于高保真、单步动作生成，无需预训练教师模型。OFP统一了一个自洽性损失，以强制跨时间间隔的连贯传输，以及一个自引导正则化，以锐化预测，使其朝向高密度专家模式。此外，一种热启动机制利用时间动作相关性来最小化生成传输距离。在56个不同的模拟操作任务中的评估表明，单步OFP取得了最先进的结果，优于100步扩散和流策略，同时将动作生成速度提高了100倍以上。我们进一步将OFP集成到RoboTwin 2.0上的$π_{0.5}$模型中，其中单步OFP超越了原有的10步策略。这些结果确立了OFP作为一种实用的、可扩展的解决方案，用于高度准确和低延迟的机器人控制。
tldr: The paper introduces One-Step Flow Policy (OFP), a self-distillation framework that generates high-fidelity actions in a single step, significantly reducing latency compared to iterative flow and diffusion models, resulting in state-of-the-art robotic manipulation performance with over 100x speedup.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了单步流策略 (OFP)，一种自蒸馏框架，可单步生成高保真动作，与迭代流和扩散模型相比，显著降低了延迟，从而实现最先进的机器人操作性能，并实现了超过 100 倍的加速。

title: VGGT-World: Transforming VGGT into an Autoregressive Geometry World Model
summary: World models that forecast scene evolution by generating future video frames devote the bulk of their capacity to photometric details, yet the resulting predictions often remain geometrically inconsistent. We present VGGT-World, a geometry world model that side-steps video generation entirely and instead forecasts the temporal evolution of frozen geometry-foundation-model (GFM) features. Concretely, we repurpose the latent tokens of a frozen VGGT as the world state and train a lightweight temporal flow transformer to autoregressively predict their future trajectory. Two technical challenges arise in this high-dimensional (d=1024) feature space: (i) standard velocity-prediction flow matching collapses, and (ii) autoregressive rollout suffers from compounding exposure bias. We address the first with a clean-target (z-prediction) parameterization that yields a substantially higher signal-to-noise ratio, and the second with a two-stage latent flow-forcing curriculum that progressively conditions the model on its own partially denoised rollouts. Experiments on KITTI, Cityscapes, and TartanAir demonstrate that VGGT-World significantly outperforms the strongest baselines in depth forecasting while running 3.6-5 times faster with only 0.43B trainable parameters, establishing frozen GFM features as an effective and efficient predictive state for 3D world modeling.
summary_zh: 世界模型通过生成未来视频帧来预测场景演变，将其大部分容量用于光度细节，但由此产生的预测通常在几何上仍然不一致。我们提出了 VGGT-World，一种几何世界模型，它完全绕过视频生成，而是预测冻结几何基础模型 (GFM) 特征的时间演变。具体来说，我们将冻结 VGGT 的潜在令牌重新用作世界状态，并训练一个轻量级的时间流变换器来自回归地预测它们的未来轨迹。在这个高维 (d=1024) 特征空间中出现了两个技术挑战：(i) 标准的速度预测流匹配会崩溃，以及 (ii) 自回归展开会受到复合暴露偏差的影响。我们通过使用产生明显更高信噪比的干净目标（z-预测）参数化来解决第一个问题，并通过一个两阶段潜在流强制课程来解决第二个问题，该课程逐步地根据模型自身的局部去噪展开来调节模型。在 KITTI、Cityscapes 和 TartanAir 上的实验表明，VGGT-World 在深度预测方面显著优于最强的基线，同时仅使用 0.43B 可训练参数运行速度提高 3.6-5 倍，从而确立了冻结 GFM 特征作为 3D 世界建模的有效且高效的预测状态。
tldr: This paper introduces VGGT-World, a geometry world model that predicts the temporal evolution of frozen geometry foundation model features autoregressively, achieving state-of-the-art depth forecasting performance with significantly improved speed and efficiency compared to video-based world models.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了VGGT-World，一个几何世界模型，通过自回归方式预测冻结的几何基础模型特征的时间演变，与基于视频的世界模型相比，该模型在深度预测方面实现了最先进的性能，并显著提高了速度和效率。

title: RoboStereo: Dual-Tower 4D Embodied World Models for Unified Policy Optimization
summary: Scalable Embodied AI faces fundamental constraints due to prohibitive costs and safety risks of real-world interaction. While Embodied World Models (EWMs) offer promise through imagined rollouts, existing approaches suffer from geometric hallucinations and lack unified optimization frameworks for practical policy improvement.
