summary_zh: 精确的全局定位对于自动驾驶和机器人技术至关重要，但基于GNSS的方法经常因遮挡和多径效应而性能下降。作为一种新兴的替代方案，跨视角位姿估计预测与带有地理参考的卫星图像相关的地面视角图像对应的3自由度相机位姿。然而，由于空间对应关系有限，现有方法难以弥合地面和卫星视角之间显著的视角差距。我们提出了一种新颖的跨视角位姿估计方法，该方法通过双轴变换（VIRD）构建视角不变表示。VIRD首先对卫星视角应用极坐标变换以建立水平对应关系，然后在地面和极坐标变换后的卫星特征上使用上下文增强的位置注意力来解决垂直方向上的不对齐问题，从而明确地缓解视角差距。引入视角重建损失来进一步加强视角不变性，鼓励导出的表示重建原始图像和跨视角图像。在KITTI和VIGOR数据集上的实验表明，VIRD优于最先进的方法，且无需方向先验，在KITTI上分别将位置和方向的中值误差降低了50.7%和76.5%，在VIGOR上分别降低了18.0%和46.8%。
tldr: This paper proposes a novel cross-view pose estimation method called VIRD using dual-axis transformation to bridge the viewpoint gap between ground-view and satellite images, achieving state-of-the-art results on KITTI and VIGOR datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为VIRD的新颖的跨视角姿态估计方法，该方法使用双轴变换来弥合地面视图和卫星图像之间的视点差距，并在KITTI和VIGOR数据集上实现了最先进的结果。

title: SAVA-X: Ego-to-Exo Imitation Error Detection via Scene-Adaptive View Alignment and Bidirectional Cross View Fusion
summary: Error detection is crucial in industrial training, healthcare, and assembly quality control. Most existing work assumes a single-view setting and cannot handle the practical case where a third-person (exo) demonstration is used to assess a first-person (ego) imitation. We formalize Ego$\rightarrow$Exo Imitation Error Detection: given asynchronous, length-mismatched ego and exo videos, the model must localize procedural steps on the ego timeline and decide whether each is erroneous. This setting introduces cross-view domain shift, temporal misalignment, and heavy redundancy. Under a unified protocol, we adapt strong baselines from dense video captioning and temporal action detection and show that they struggle in this cross-view regime. We then propose SAVA-X, an Align-Fuse-Detect framework with (i) view-conditioned adaptive sampling, (ii) scene-adaptive view embeddings, and (iii) bidirectional cross-attention fusion. On the EgoMe benchmark, SAVA-X consistently improves AUPRC and mean tIoU over all baselines, and ablations confirm the complementary benefits of its components. Code is available at https://github.com/jack1ee/SAVAX.
summary_zh: 错误检测在工业培训、医疗保健和装配质量控制中至关重要。现有的大部分工作假设了单视角设置，无法处理使用第三人称(exo)演示来评估第一人称(ego)模仿的实际情况。我们形式化了Ego$\rightarrow$Exo模仿错误检测：给定异步且长度不匹配的ego和exo视频，模型必须在ego时间线上定位程序步骤，并判断每个步骤是否错误。此设置引入了跨视角域漂移、时间不对齐和大量冗余。在一个统一的协议下，我们调整了来自密集视频字幕和时序动作检测的强大基线，并表明它们在这种跨视角机制中表现不佳。然后，我们提出了SAVA-X，一种Align-Fuse-Detect框架，具有（i）视角条件自适应采样，（ii）场景自适应视角嵌入，以及（iii）双向交叉注意力融合。在EgoMe基准测试中，SAVA-X始终优于所有基线的AUPRC和平均tIoU，并且消融实验证实了其组件的互补优势。代码可在https://github.com/jack1ee/SAVAX获取。
tldr: The paper introduces SAVA-X, a novel framework for detecting errors in ego-to-exo imitation scenarios, addressing challenges like cross-view domain shift and temporal misalignment, and demonstrating improved performance on the EgoMe benchmark.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SAVA-X，一个用于检测ego-to-exo模仿场景中错误的新框架。该框架解决了跨视角领域偏移和时间不对齐等挑战，并在EgoMe基准测试中表现出改进的性能。

title: SAP: Segment Any 4K Panorama
summary: Promptable instance segmentation is widely adopted in embodied and AR systems, yet the performance of foundation models trained on perspective imagery often degrades on 360° panoramas. In this paper, we introduce Segment Any 4K Panorama (SAP), a foundation model for 4K high-resolution panoramic instance-level segmentation. We reformulate panoramic segmentation as fixed-trajectory perspective video segmentation, decomposing a panorama into overlapping perspective patches sampled along a continuous spherical traversal. This memory-aligned reformulation preserves native 4K resolution while restoring the smooth viewpoint transitions required for stable cross-view propagation. To enable large-scale supervision, we synthesize 183,440 4K-resolution panoramic images with instance segmentation labels using the InfiniGen engine. Trained under this trajectory-aligned paradigm, SAP generalizes effectively to real-world 360° images, achieving +17.2 zero-shot mIoU gain over vanilla SAM2 of different sizes on real-world 4K panorama benchmark.
summary_zh: 可提示实例分割已广泛应用于具身和增强现实系统，但基于透视图像训练的基础模型在360°全景图上的性能通常会下降。在本文中，我们引入了Segment Any 4K Panorama (SAP)，这是一个用于4K高分辨率全景实例级分割的基础模型。我们将全景分割重新定义为固定轨迹透视视频分割，将全景图分解为沿连续球面轨迹采样的重叠透视图像块。这种内存对齐的重新定义保留了原生4K分辨率，同时恢复了稳定跨视角传播所需的平滑视点过渡。为了实现大规模监督，我们使用InfiniGen引擎合成了183,440张带有实例分割标签的4K分辨率全景图像。在这一轨迹对齐范式下训练的SAP有效地泛化到真实世界的360°图像，在真实世界的4K全景基准测试中，与不同大小的原始SAM2相比，实现了+17.2的零样本mIoU增益。
tldr: The paper introduces SAP, a foundation model for high-resolution 4K panoramic instance segmentation, trained on synthesized data using a novel trajectory-aligned paradigm for improved zero-shot performance on real-world panoramas.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SAP，一个用于高分辨率4K全景实例分割的基础模型。该模型通过一种新的轨迹对齐范式在合成数据上进行训练，从而提高了在真实全景图像上的零样本表现。

title: A Prediction-as-Perception Framework for 3D Object Detection
summary: Humans combine prediction and perception to observe the world. When faced with rapidly moving birds or insects, we can only perceive them clearly by predicting their next position and focusing our gaze there. Inspired by this, this paper proposes the Prediction-As-Perception (PAP) framework, integrating a prediction-perception architecture into 3D object perception tasks to enhance the model's perceptual accuracy. The PAP framework consists of two main modules: prediction and perception, primarily utilizing continuous frame information as input. Firstly, the prediction module forecasts the potential future positions of ego vehicles and surrounding traffic participants based on the perception results of the current frame. These predicted positions are then passed as queries to the perception module of the subsequent frame. The perceived results are iteratively fed back into the prediction module. We evaluated the PAP structure using the end-to-end model UniAD on the nuScenes dataset. The results demonstrate that the PAP structure improves UniAD's target tracking accuracy by 10% and increases the inference speed by 15%. This indicates that such a biomimetic design significantly enhances the efficiency and accuracy of perception models while reducing computational resource consumption.
summary_zh: 人类结合预测和感知来观察世界。面对快速移动的鸟类或昆虫，我们只有预测它们的下一个位置并将视线集中在那里，才能清晰地感知它们。受此启发，本文提出了一种预测即感知 (PAP) 框架，将预测-感知架构集成到3D目标感知任务中，以提高模型的感知精度。PAP框架由预测和感知两个主要模块组成，主要利用连续帧信息作为输入。首先，预测模块基于当前帧的感知结果预测自我车辆和周围交通参与者潜在的未来位置。然后，这些预测的位置将作为查询传递到后续帧的感知模块。感知结果被迭代地反馈到预测模块中。我们在nuScenes数据集上使用端到端模型UniAD评估了PAP结构。结果表明，PAP结构将UniAD的目标跟踪精度提高了10%，并将推理速度提高了15%。这表明，这种仿生设计显著提高了感知模型的效率和精度，同时降低了计算资源消耗。
tldr: This paper introduces a Prediction-as-Perception (PAP) framework for 3D object detection, inspired by human perception, which uses predicted future positions to enhance perceptual accuracy, showing improvements in tracking and inference speed on the nuScenes dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于3D物体检测的“预测即感知”(PAP)框架，该框架受到人类感知的启发，利用预测的未来位置来提高感知精度，并在nuScenes数据集上展示了在跟踪和推理速度方面的提升。

title: A Reduction Algorithm for Markovian Contextual Linear Bandits
summary: Recent work shows that when contexts are drawn i.i.d., linear contextual bandits can be reduced to single-context linear bandits. This ``contexts are cheap" perspective is highly advantageous, as it allows for sharper finite-time analyses and leverages mature techniques from the linear bandit literature, such as those for misspecification and adversarial corruption. Motivated by applications with temporally correlated availability, we extend this perspective to Markovian contextual linear bandits, where the action set evolves via an exogenous Markov chain. Our main contribution is a reduction that applies under uniform geometric ergodicity. We construct a stationary surrogate action set to solve the problem using a standard linear bandit oracle, employing a delayed-update scheme to control the bias induced by the nonstationary conditional context distributions. We further provide a phased algorithm for unknown transition distributions that learns the surrogate mapping online. In both settings, we obtain a high-probability worst-case regret bound matching that of the underlying linear bandit oracle, with only lower-order dependence on the mixing time.
summary_zh: 最近的研究表明，当上下文以独立同分布方式抽取时，线性上下文 Bandit 问题可以简化为单上下文线性 Bandit 问题。这种“上下文廉价”的视角极具优势，因为它允许更精确的有限时间分析，并利用线性 Bandit 文献中成熟的技术，例如针对模型失配和对抗性破坏的技术。受时间相关可用性的应用驱动，我们将这种视角扩展到马尔可夫上下文线性 Bandit 问题，其中动作集可通过外生马尔可夫链演化。我们的主要贡献是一个在一致几何遍历性下适用的简化方法。我们构建一个平稳的代理动作集，利用标准的线性 Bandit 预言机来解决该问题，并采用延迟更新方案来控制由非平稳条件上下文分布引起的偏差。我们进一步提供了一种用于未知转移分布的分阶段算法，该算法可在线学习代理映射。在这两种设置中，我们都获得了与底层线性 Bandit 预言机相匹配的高概率最坏情况遗憾界，且仅对混合时间具有较低阶的依赖性。
tldr: This paper presents a reduction algorithm for Markovian contextual linear bandits, extending the "contexts are cheap" perspective to scenarios with temporally correlated availability and achieving regret bounds comparable to standard linear bandit oracles.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种马尔科夫上下文线性bandits的降维算法，将“上下文廉价”的观点扩展到具有时间相关可用性的场景，并获得了与标准线性bandit oracles相当的后悔界限。

title: InterEdit: Navigating Text-Guided Multi-Human 3D Motion Editing
summary: Text-guided 3D motion editing has seen success in single-person scenarios, but its extension to multi-person settings is less explored due to limited paired data and the complexity of inter-person interactions. We introduce the task of multi-person 3D motion editing, where a target motion is generated from a source and a text instruction. To support this, we propose InterEdit3D, a new dataset with manual two-person motion change annotations, and a Text-guided Multi-human Motion Editing (TMME) benchmark. We present InterEdit, a synchronized classifier-free conditional diffusion model for TMME. It introduces Semantic-Aware Plan Token Alignment with learnable tokens to capture high-level interaction cues and an Interaction-Aware Frequency Token Alignment strategy using DCT and energy pooling to model periodic motion dynamics. Experiments show that InterEdit improves text-to-motion consistency and edit fidelity, achieving state-of-the-art TMME performance. The dataset and code will be released at https://github.com/YNG916/InterEdit.
summary_zh: 文本引导的3D动作编辑在单人场景中已取得成功，但由于配对数据有限以及人际互动的复杂性，其在多人环境中的扩展研究较少。我们引入了多人3D动作编辑的任务，即从源动作和一个文本指令生成目标动作。为了支持该任务，我们提出了InterEdit3D，一个新的数据集，带有手动双人动作变化标注，以及一个文本引导的多人动作编辑（TMME）基准。 我们提出了InterEdit，一个用于TMME的同步无分类器条件扩散模型。它引入了带可学习token的语义感知计划Token对齐，以捕获高层次的互动线索，以及使用DCT和能量池化的交互感知频率Token对齐策略，以建模周期性运动动力学。实验表明，InterEdit提高了文本到动作的一致性和编辑保真度，实现了最先进的TMME性能。数据集和代码将在https://github.com/YNG916/InterEdit发布。
tldr: The paper introduces a new task, dataset (InterEdit3D), and method (InterEdit) for text-guided multi-person 3D motion editing using a diffusion model with novel alignment strategies for interaction cues and motion dynamics, achieving state-of-the-art performance on their new benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一项新的任务、数据集 (InterEdit3D) 和方法 (InterEdit)，用于文本引导的多人3D运动编辑。该方法使用扩散模型，并采用新颖的对齐策略来捕捉交互线索和运动动力学，并在新基准测试上实现了最先进的性能。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Elliptical Cylinder Motion Control Tasks
summary: The control of devices with limited input always bring attention to solve by research due to its difficulty and non-trival solution. For instance, the inverted pendulum is benchmarking problem in control theory and machine learning. In this work, we are focused on the elliptical cylinder and its motion under limited torque. The inspiration of the problem is from untethered magnetic devices, which due to distance have to operate with limited input torque. In this work, the main goal is to define the control problem of elliptic cylinder with limited input torque and solve it by Reinforcement Learning. As a classical baseline, we evaluate a two-stage controller composed of an energy-shaping swing-up law and a local Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) stabilizer around the target equilibrium. The swing-up controller increases the system's mechanical energy to drive the state toward a neighborhood of the desired equilibrium, a linearization of the nonlinear model yields an LQR that regulates the angle and angular-rate states to the target orientation with bounded input. This swing-up + LQR policy is a strong, interpretable reference for underactuated system and serves a point of comparison to the learned policy under identical limits and parameters. The solution shows that the learning is possible however, the different cases like stabilization in upward position or rotating of half turn are very difficult for increasing mass or ellipses with a strongly unequal perimeter ratio.
summary_zh: 对输入受限的设备的控制一直备受研究关注，原因在于其难度和非平凡的解决方案。例如，倒立摆是控制理论和机器学习中的基准问题。在本工作中，我们专注于椭圆柱及其在有限扭矩下的运动。该问题的灵感来自无线磁性设备，由于距离限制，它们必须在有限的输入扭矩下运行。本工作的主要目标是定义具有有限输入扭矩的椭圆柱的控制问题，并通过强化学习解决它。作为经典的基准，我们评估了一个两阶段控制器，由能量整形上摆律和一个围绕目标平衡点的局部线性二次调节器 (LQR) 稳定器组成。上摆控制器增加系统的机械能，以将状态驱动到所需平衡状态的邻域，非线性模型的线性化产生 LQR，该 LQR 使用有界输入将角度和角速度状态调节到目标方向。这种上摆 + LQR 策略是欠驱动系统的强大且可解释的参考，并作为在相同限制和参数下与学习策略进行比较的基准。解决方案表明学习是可行的，然而，对于增加质量或具有强烈不等周长的椭圆，诸如向上位置的稳定或旋转半圈的不同情况非常困难。
tldr: This paper explores using Reinforcement Learning to control an elliptical cylinder with limited torque, comparing the learned policy against a traditional LQR controller. The results indicate learning is possible but challenging for specific scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用强化学习来控制具有有限扭矩的椭圆柱体，并将学习到的策略与传统的LQR控制器进行比较。结果表明学习是可能的，但在特定情况下具有挑战性。

title: Learning Geometric and Photometric Features from Panoramic LiDAR Scans for Outdoor Place Categorization
summary: Semantic place categorization, which is one of the essential tasks for autonomous robots and vehicles, allows them to have capabilities of self-decision and navigation in unfamiliar environments. In particular, outdoor places are more difficult targets than indoor ones due to perceptual variations, such as dynamic illuminance over twenty-four hours and occlusions by cars and pedestrians. This paper presents a novel method of categorizing outdoor places using convolutional neural networks (CNNs), which take omnidirectional depth/reflectance images obtained by 3D LiDARs as the inputs. First, we construct a large-scale outdoor place dataset named Multi-modal Panoramic 3D Outdoor (MPO) comprising two types of point clouds captured by two different LiDARs. They are labeled with six outdoor place categories: coast, forest, indoor/outdoor parking, residential area, and urban area. Second, we provide CNNs for LiDAR-based outdoor place categorization and evaluate our approach with the MPO dataset. Our results on the MPO dataset outperform traditional approaches and show the effectiveness in which we use both depth and reflectance modalities. To analyze our trained deep networks we visualize the learned features.
summary_zh: 语义场所分类是自主机器人和车辆的关键任务之一，使其能够生存在陌生的环境中进行自主决策和导航。特别是，由于感知变化，例如全天动态光照和车辆及行人的遮挡，室外场所比室内场所更难成为目标。本文提出了一种使用卷积神经网络（CNN）对室外场所进行分类的新方法，该网络以3D激光雷达获取的全向深度/反射率图像作为输入。首先，我们构建了一个名为多模态全景3D室外（MPO）的大规模室外场所数据集，其中包括由两种不同激光雷达捕获的两种类型的点云。它们被标记为六个室外场所类别：海岸、森林、室内/室外停车场、住宅区和城市区域。其次，我们提供了基于激光雷达的室外场所分类的CNN，并使用MPO数据集评估了我们的方法。我们在MPO数据集上的结果优于传统方法，并表明了同时使用深度和反射率模态的有效性。为了分析我们训练的深度网络，我们可视化了学习到的特征。
tldr: The paper introduces a new large-scale outdoor place dataset (MPO) and a CNN-based method for outdoor place categorization using LiDAR data, demonstrating improved performance compared to traditional approaches.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个新的大规模室外场所数据集(MPO)以及一种基于CNN的室外场所分类方法，使用激光雷达数据，并展示了相对于传统方法的性能提升。

title: From Experiments to Expertise: Scientific Knowledge Consolidation for AI-Driven Computational Research
summary: While large language models (LLMs) have transformed AI agents into proficient executors of computational materials science, performing a hundred simulations does not make a researcher. What distinguishes research from routine execution is the progressive accumulation of knowledge -- learning which approaches fail, recognizing patterns across systems, and applying understanding to new problems. However, the prevailing paradigm in AI-driven computational science treats each execution in isolation, largely discarding hard-won insights between runs. Here we present QMatSuite, an open-source platform closing this gap. Agents record findings with full provenance, retrieve knowledge before new calculations, and in dedicated reflection sessions correct erroneous findings and synthesize observations into cross-compound patterns. In benchmarks on a six-step quantum-mechanical simulation workflow, accumulated knowledge reduces reasoning overhead by 67% and improves accuracy from 47% to 3% deviation from literature -- and when transferred to an unfamiliar material, achieves 1% deviation with zero pipeline failures.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 已将人工智能Agent转变为计算材料科学领域的高效执行者，但进行数百次模拟并不能造就一位研究者。研究与常规执行的区别在于知识的逐步积累——学习哪些方法会失败，识别跨系统的模式，并将理解应用于新问题。然而，人工智能驱动的计算科学领域的主流范式将每次执行视为孤立事件，在很大程度上忽略了运行之间来之不易的深刻见解。在此，我们提出了 QMatSuite，一个旨在弥合这一差距的开源平台。Agent记录包含完整溯源的发现，在新计算之前检索知识，并在专门的反思环节中纠正错误的发现，并将观察结果合成为跨化合物的模式。在六步量子力学模拟工作流程的基准测试中，积累的知识将推理开销降低了 67%，并将准确性从与文献偏差的 47% 提高到 3%——并且在转移到不熟悉的材料时，实现了 1% 的偏差，且管道无故障。
tldr: The paper introduces QMatSuite, a platform that enables AI agents to accumulate and reuse knowledge from computational materials science simulations, leading to significant improvements in efficiency and accuracy.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为QMatSuite的平台，该平台使人工智能代理能够积累并重复利用计算材料科学模拟中的知识，从而显著提高效率和准确性。

title: Context is all you need: Towards autonomous model-based process design using agentic AI in flowsheet simulations
summary: Agentic AI systems integrating large language models (LLMs) with reasoning and tooluse capabilities are transforming various domains - in particular, software development. In contrast, their application in chemical process flowsheet modelling remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present an agentic AI framework that delivers assistance in an industrial flowsheet simulation environment. To this end, we show the capabilities of GitHub Copilot (GitHub, Inc., 2026), when using state-of-the-art LLMs, such as Claude Opus 4.6 (Anthropic, PBC, 2026), to generate valid syntax for our in-house process modelling tool Chemasim using the technical documentation and a few commented examples as context. Based on this, we develop a multi-agent system that decomposes process development tasks with one agent solving the abstract problem using engineering knowledge and another agent implementing the solution as Chemasim code. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework for typical flowsheet modelling examples, including (i) a reaction/separation process, (ii) a pressure-swing distillation, and (iii) a heteroazeotropic distillation including entrainer selection. Along these lines, we discuss current limitations of the framework and outline future research directions to further enhance its capabilities.
summary_zh: 集成了大型语言模型（LLMs）并具备推理和工具使用能力的自主AI系统正在变革各个领域，尤其是在软件开发领域。相比之下，它们在化学工艺流程模拟建模中的应用仍然在很大程度上未被探索。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个自主AI框架，可在工业流程模拟环境中提供辅助。为此，我们展示了GitHub Copilot（GitHub, Inc., 2026）在使用最先进的LLMs，如Claude Opus 4.6 (Anthropic, PBC, 2026)时，利用技术文档和一些带有注释的示例作为上下文，为我们的内部流程建模工具Chemasim生成有效语法的能力。在此基础上，我们开发了一个多智能体系统，该系统将工艺开发任务分解，其中一个智能体使用工程知识解决抽象问题，另一个智能体将解决方案实现为Chemasim代码。我们通过典型的流程模拟建模案例证明了我们框架的有效性，包括 (i)反应/分离过程，(ii)变压吸附精馏，以及(iii)包含夹带剂选择的非均相共沸精馏。同时，我们讨论了该框架当前的局限性并概述了未来的研究方向，以进一步增强其能力。
tldr: This paper explores the use of agentic AI, leveraging LLMs like Claude Opus, in chemical process flowsheet modeling within an industrial simulation environment, demonstrating its effectiveness on various flowsheet examples. It proposes a multi-agent system that can both solve abstract problems and implement them as Chemasim code.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了在工业仿真环境中利用代理AI（如Claude Opus等大型语言模型）进行化学工艺流程模拟，并通过多个流程图实例验证了其有效性。文章提出了一个多代理系统，能够解决抽象问题并将其实现为Chemasim代码。

title: IGASA: Integrated Geometry-Aware and Skip-Attention Modules for Enhanced Point Cloud Registration
summary: Point cloud registration (PCR) is a fundamental task in 3D vision and provides essential support for applications such as autonomous driving, robotics, and environmental modeling. Despite its widespread use, existing methods often fail when facing real-world challenges like heavy noise, significant occlusions, and large-scale transformations. These limitations frequently result in compromised registration accuracy and insufficient robustness in complex environments. In this paper, we propose IGASA as a novel registration framework constructed upon a Hierarchical Pyramid Architecture (HPA) designed for robust multi-scale feature extraction and fusion. The framework integrates two pivotal components consisting of the Hierarchical Cross-Layer Attention (HCLA) module and the Iterative Geometry-Aware Refinement (IGAR) module. The HCLA module utilizes skip attention mechanisms to align multi-resolution features and enhance local geometric consistency. Simultaneously, the IGAR module is designed for the fine matching phase by leveraging reliable correspondences established during coarse matching. This synergistic integration within the architecture allows IGASA to adapt effectively to diverse point cloud structures and intricate transformations. We evaluate the performance of IGASA on four widely recognized benchmark datasets including 3D(Lo)Match, KITTI, and nuScenes. Our extensive experiments consistently demonstrate that IGASA significantly surpasses state-of-the-art methods and achieves notable improvements in registration accuracy. This work provides a robust foundation for advancing point cloud registration techniques while offering valuable insights for practical 3D vision applications. The code for IGASA is available in \href{https://github.com/DongXu-Zhang/IGASA}{https://github.com/DongXu-Zhang/IGASA}.
summary_zh: 点云配准 (PCR) 是三维视觉中的一项基本任务，为自动驾驶、机器人和环境建模等应用提供重要支持。尽管其应用广泛，但现有方法在面对真实世界的挑战时，如严重噪声、显著遮挡和大规模变换，通常会失效。这些限制经常导致配准精度降低，在复杂环境中鲁棒性不足。在本文中，我们提出 IGASA，一个建立在分层金字塔架构 (HPA) 之上的新型配准框架，该架构旨在实现稳健的多尺度特征提取和融合。该框架集成了两个关键组件，包括分层跨层注意力 (HCLA) 模块和迭代几何感知细化 (IGAR) 模块。HCLA 模块利用跳跃注意力机制来对齐多分辨率特征并增强局部几何一致性。同时，IGAR 模块专为精细匹配阶段设计，通过利用粗匹配期间建立的可靠对应关系。这种架构内的协同集成使 IGASA 能够有效地适应不同的点云结构和复杂的变换。我们在四个广泛认可的基准数据集（包括 3D(Lo)Match、KITTI 和 nuScenes）上评估了 IGASA 的性能。我们的大量实验始终表明，IGASA 显著超过了最先进的方法，并在配准精度方面取得了显著的改进。这项工作为推进点云配准技术提供了坚实的基础，同时为实际的三维视觉应用提供了宝贵的见解。 IGASA 的代码可在 \href{https://github.com/DongXu-Zhang/IGASA}{https://github.com/DongXu-Zhang/IGASA} 中获取。
tldr: The paper introduces IGASA, a novel point cloud registration framework with integrated modules for robust, geometry-aware multi-scale feature extraction and refinement. It achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmark datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新的点云配准框架IGASA，它集成了几何感知和跳跃注意力模块，用于鲁棒的多尺度特征提取和细化。在多个基准数据集上取得了最先进的结果。

title: Catalyst4D: High-Fidelity 3D-to-4D Scene Editing via Dynamic Propagation
summary: Recent advances in 3D scene editing using NeRF and 3DGS enable high-quality static scene editing. In contrast, dynamic scene editing remains challenging, as methods that directly extend 2D diffusion models to 4D often produce motion artifacts, temporal flickering, and inconsistent style propagation. We introduce Catalyst4D, a framework that transfers high-quality 3D edits to dynamic 4D Gaussian scenes while maintaining spatial and temporal coherence. At its core, Anchor-based Motion Guidance (AMG) builds a set of structurally stable and spatially representative anchors from both original and edited Gaussians. These anchors serve as robust region-level references, and their correspondences are established via optimal transport to enable consistent deformation propagation without cross-region interference or motion drift. Complementarily, Color Uncertainty-guided Appearance Refinement (CUAR) preserves temporal appearance consistency by estimating per-Gaussian color uncertainty and selectively refining regions prone to occlusion-induced artifacts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Catalyst4D achieves temporally stable, high-fidelity dynamic scene editing and outperforms existing methods in both visual quality and motion coherence.
summary_zh: 最近在使用NeRF和3DGS进行3D场景编辑方面取得了进展，实现了高质量的静态场景编辑。相比之下，动态场景编辑仍然具有挑战性，因为直接将2D扩散模型扩展到4D的方法通常会产生运动伪影、时间闪烁和不一致的风格传播。我们引入了Catalyst4D，这是一个将高质量3D编辑转移到动态4D高斯场景中的框架，同时保持空间和时间连贯性。其核心是基于锚点的运动引导(AMG)，它从原始和编辑后的高斯分布中构建了一组结构稳定且具有空间代表性的锚点。这些锚点作为鲁棒的区域级参考，并通过最优传输建立它们的对应关系，从而实现一致的变形传播，而不会产生跨区域干扰或运动漂移。作为补充，颜色不确定性引导的外观优化(CUAR)通过估计每个高斯粒子的颜色不确定性并有选择地优化易于产生遮挡伪影的区域，从而保持时间外观一致性。大量的实验表明，Catalyst4D实现了时间稳定的、高保真度的动态场景编辑，并且在视觉质量和运动连贯性方面优于现有方法。
tldr: Catalyst4D addresses the challenge of dynamic scene editing by introducing Anchor-based Motion Guidance and Color Uncertainty-guided Appearance Refinement to achieve temporally stable and high-fidelity results. It outperforms existing methods in visual quality and motion coherence.
tldr_zh: Catalyst4D通过引入基于锚点的运动引导和颜色不确定性引导的外观优化，解决了动态场景编辑的挑战，实现了时间上的稳定性和高保真度结果。在视觉质量和运动连贯性方面，该方法优于现有方法。

title: CM-Bench: A Comprehensive Cross-Modal Feature Matching Benchmark Bridging Visible and Infrared Images
summary: Infrared-visible (IR-VIS) feature matching plays an essential role in cross-modality visual localization, navigation and perception. Along with the rapid development of deep learning techniques, a number of representative image matching methods have been proposed. However, crossmodal feature matching is still a challenging task due to the significant appearance difference. A significant gap for cross-modal feature matching research lies in the absence of standardized benchmarks and metrics for evaluations. In this paper, we introduce a comprehensive cross-modal feature matching benchmark, CM-Bench, which encompasses 30 feature matching algorithms across diverse cross-modal datasets. Specifically, state-of-the-art traditional and deep learning-based methods are first summarized and categorized into sparse, semidense, and dense methods. These methods are evaluated by different tasks including homography estimation, relative pose estimation, and feature-matching-based geo-localization. In addition, we introduce a classification-network-based adaptive preprocessing front-end that automatically selects suitable enhancement strategies before matching. We also present a novel infrared-satellite cross-modal dataset with manually annotated ground-truth correspondences for practical geo-localization evaluation. The dataset and resource will be available at: https://github.com/SLZ98/CM-Bench.
summary_zh: 红外-可见光(IR-VIS)特征匹配在跨模态视觉定位、导航和感知中起着至关重要的作用。随着深度学习技术的快速发展，已经提出了许多具有代表性的图像匹配方法。然而，由于显著的外观差异，跨模态特征匹配仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。跨模态特征匹配研究的一个重要缺口在于缺乏用于评估的标准化的基准和指标。在本文中，我们引入了一个全面的跨模态特征匹配基准，CM-Bench，它涵盖了跨多个不同跨模态数据集的30种特征匹配算法。具体来说，首先总结了最先进的传统方法和基于深度学习的方法，并将其分为稀疏、半稠密和稠密方法。这些方法通过不同的任务进行评估，包括单应性估计、相对位姿估计和基于特征匹配的地理定位。此外，我们引入了一个基于分类网络的自适应预处理前端，可以在匹配之前自动选择合适的增强策略。我们还提出了一个新的红外-卫星跨模态数据集，该数据集具有手动标注的真实对应关系，用于实际的地理定位评估。数据集和资源将在以下网址提供：https://github.com/SLZ98/CM-Bench。
tldr: The paper introduces CM-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for cross-modal (Infrared-Visible) feature matching, including diverse datasets, algorithms, evaluation tasks, and a novel IR-satellite dataset with ground truth correspondences.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CM-Bench，一个全面的跨模态（红外-可见光）特征匹配基准，包括多样的数据集、算法、评估任务，以及一个新的带有真实对应关系的红外-卫星数据集。

title: VFM-Recon: Unlocking Cross-Domain Scene-Level Neural Reconstruction with Scale-Aligned Foundation Priors
summary: Scene-level neural volumetric reconstruction from monocular videos remains challenging, especially under severe domain shifts. Although recent advances in vision foundation models (VFMs) provide transferable generalized priors learned from large-scale data, their scaleambiguous predictions are incompatible with the scale consistency required by volumetric fusion. To address this gap, we present VFMRecon, the first attempt to bridge transferable VFM priors with scaleconsistent requirements in scene-level neural reconstruction. Specifically, we first introduce a lightweight scale alignment stage that restores multiview scale coherence. We then integrate pretrained VFM features into the neural volumetric reconstruction pipeline via lightweight task-specific adapters, which are trained for reconstruction while preserving the crossdomain robustness of pretrained representations. We train our model on ScanNet train split and evaluate on both in-distribution ScanNet test split and out-of-distribution TUM RGB-D and Tanks and Temples datasets. The results demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-theart performance across all datasets domains. In particular, on the challenging outdoor Tanks and Temples dataset, our model achieves an F1 score of 70.1 in reconstructed mesh evaluation, substantially outperforming the closest competitor, VGGT, which only attains 51.8.
summary_zh: 从单目视频中进行场景级神经体积重建仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在严重的领域偏移下。尽管视觉基础模型(VFMs)的最新进展提供了从大规模数据中学习的可迁移的通用先验知识，但它们尺度模糊的预测与体积融合所需的尺度一致性不兼容。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了VFMRecon，这是首次尝试将可迁移的VFM先验知识与场景级神经重建中的尺度一致性要求结合起来。具体来说，我们首先引入了一个轻量级的尺度对齐阶段，以恢复多视角的尺度一致性。然后，我们将预训练的VFM特征通过轻量级的特定任务适配器集成到神经体积重建流程中，这些适配器经过训练用于重建，同时保持预训练表示的跨领域鲁棒性。我们在ScanNet训练集上训练我们的模型，并在同分布的ScanNet测试集以及异分布的TUM RGB-D和Tanks and Temples数据集上进行评估。结果表明，我们的模型在所有数据集领域中都实现了最先进的性能。特别是在具有挑战性的室外Tanks and Temples数据集上，我们的模型在重建网格评估中实现了70.1的F1分数，大大优于最接近的竞争对手VGGT，后者仅达到51.8。
tldr: The paper introduces VFM-Recon, a method to improve scene-level neural volumetric reconstruction from monocular videos by integrating vision foundation model priors with a novel scale alignment stage, achieving state-of-the-art performance across various datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了VFM-Recon，一种通过结合视觉基础模型先验知识和新的尺度对齐阶段来改进单目视频的场景级神经体重建的方法，并在多个数据集上实现了最先进的性能。

title: CVGL: Causal Learning and Geometric Topology
summary: Cross-view geo-localization (CVGL) aims to estimate the geographic location of a street image by matching it with a corresponding aerial image. This is critical for autonomous navigation and mapping in complex real-world scenarios. However, the task remains challenging due to significant viewpoint differences and the influence of confounding factors. To tackle these issues, we propose the Causal Learning and Geometric Topology (CLGT) framework, which integrates two key components: a Causal Feature Extractor (CFE) that mitigates the influence of confounding factors by leveraging causal intervention to encourage the model to focus on stable, task-relevant semantics; and a Geometric Topology Fusion (GT Fusion) module that injects Bird's Eye View (BEV) road topology into street features to alleviate cross-view inconsistencies caused by extreme perspective changes. Additionally, we introduce a Data-Adaptive Pooling (DA Pooling) module to enhance the representation of semantically rich regions. Extensive experiments on CVUSA, CVACT, and their robustness-enhanced variants (CVUSA-C-ALL and CVACT-C-ALL) demonstrate that CLGT achieves state-of-the-art performance, particularly under challenging real-world corruptions. Our codes are available at https://github.com/oyss-szu/CLGT.
summary_zh: 跨视角地理定位（CVGL）旨在通过将街景图像与对应的航拍图像进行匹配来估计街景图像的地理位置。这对于复杂现实场景中的自主导航和地图绘制至关重要。然而，由于显著的视角差异和混淆因素的影响，该任务仍然具有挑战性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了因果学习和几何拓扑（CLGT）框架，该框架集成了两个关键组件：一个因果特征提取器（CFE），它通过利用因果干预来鼓励模型关注稳定且与任务相关的语义，从而减轻混淆因素的影响；以及一个几何拓扑融合（GT Fusion）模块，它将鸟瞰图（BEV）道路拓扑注入到街景特征中，以减轻由极端视角变化引起的跨视角不一致性。此外，我们引入了一个数据自适应池化（DA Pooling）模块，以增强语义丰富区域的表示。 在CVUSA、CVACT及其鲁棒性增强变体（CVUSA-C-ALL和CVACT-C-ALL）上的大量实验表明，CLGT实现了最先进的性能，尤其是在具有挑战性的现实场景干扰下。我们的代码可在https://github.com/oyss-szu/CLGT获得。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel framework, CLGT, for cross-view geo-localization, combining causal learning and geometric topology to address viewpoint differences and confounding factors, achieving state-of-the-art results on benchmark datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新颖的用于跨视角地理定位的框架 CLGT，结合了因果学习和几何拓扑来解决视角差异和混淆因素，并在基准数据集上取得了最先进的结果。

title: A Spectral Revisit of the Distributional Bellman Operator under the Cramér Metric
summary: Distributional reinforcement learning (DRL) studies the evolution of full return distributions under Bellman updates rather than focusing on expected values. A classical result is that the distributional Bellman operator is contractive under the Cramér metric, which corresponds to an $L^2$ geometry on differences of cumulative distribution functions (CDFs). While this contraction ensures stability of policy evaluation, existing analyses remain largely metric, focusing on contraction properties without elucidating the structural action of the Bellman update on distributions. In this work, we analyse distributional Bellman dynamics directly at the level of CDFs, treating the Cramér geometry as the intrinsic analytical setting. At this level, the Bellman update acts affinely on CDFs and linearly on differences between CDFs, and its contraction property yields a uniform bound on this linear action. Building on this intrinsic formulation, we construct a family of regularised spectral Hilbert representations that realise the CDF-level geometry by exact conjugation, without modifying the underlying Bellman dynamics. The regularisation affects only the geometry and vanishes in the zero-regularisation limit, recovering the native Cramér metric. This framework clarifies the operator structure underlying distributional Bellman updates and provides a foundation for further functional and operator-theoretic analyses in DRL.
summary_zh: 分布强化学习（DRL）研究完整回报分布在贝尔曼更新下的演化，而非聚焦于期望值。一个经典的结论是，分布贝尔曼算子在克拉美（Cramér）度量下是收缩的，这对应于累积分布函数(CDF)差异上的$L^2$几何。虽然这种收缩确保了策略评估的稳定性，但现有的分析主要停留在度量层面，侧重于收缩性质，而没有阐明贝尔曼更新在分布上的结构性作用。在这项工作中，我们在累积分布函数（CDF）层面直接分析分布贝尔曼动力学，将克拉美几何视为内在的分析设定。在这个层面上，贝尔曼更新在CDF上的作用是仿射的，在CDF的差异上的作用是线性的，并且其收缩性质为这种线性作用提供了一致有界性。在此内在公式的基础上，我们构建了一系列正则化的谱希尔伯特表示，通过精确共轭实现CDF层面的几何，而无需修改底层的贝尔曼动力学。正则化仅影响几何，并在零正则化极限下消失，从而恢复原始的克拉美度量。该框架阐明了分布贝尔曼更新的底层算子结构，并为DRL中进一步的泛函和算子理论分析奠定了基础。
tldr: This paper analyzes distributional Bellman dynamics using the Cramér metric, formulating the Bellman update as an affine transformation on CDFs and introducing regularized spectral Hilbert representations for analysis.
tldr_zh: 该论文使用Cramér度量分析了分布贝尔曼动态，将贝尔曼更新公式化为CDF上的仿射变换，并引入了正则化谱希尔伯特表示用于分析。

title: A Feasibility-Enhanced Control Barrier Function Method for Multi-UAV Collision Avoidance
summary: This paper presents a feasibility-enhanced control barrier function (FECBF) framework for multi-UAV collision avoidance. In dense multi-UAV scenarios, the feasibility of the CBF quadratic program (CBF-QP) can be compromised due to internal incompatibility among multiple CBF constraints. To address this issue, we analyze the internal compatibility of CBF constraints and derive a sufficient condition for internal compatibility. Based on this condition, a sign-consistency constraint is introduced to mitigate internal incompatibility. The proposed constraint is incorporated into a decentralized CBF-QP formulation using worst-case estimates and slack variables. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly reduces infeasibility and improves collision avoidance performance compared with existing baselines in dense scenarios. Additional simulations under varying time delays demonstrate the robustness of the proposed method. Real-world experiments validate the practical applicability of the proposed method.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种可行性增强的控制障碍函数 (FECBF) 框架，用于多无人机避撞。 在密集的无人机群中，由于多个 CBF 约束之间的内部不兼容性，CBF 二次规划 (CBF-QP) 的可行性可能会受到影响。 为了解决这个问题，我们分析了 CBF 约束的内部兼容性，并推导出了内部兼容性的充分条件。 基于此条件，引入了符号一致性约束来减轻内部不兼容性。 所提出的约束通过最坏情况估计和松弛变量被纳入到分散式 CBF-QP 公式中。 仿真结果表明，与现有基线方法相比，该方法在密集场景中显著降低了不可行性，并提高了避撞性能。 在不同时间延迟下的额外仿真证明了该方法的鲁棒性。 真实世界的实验验证了该方法的实际适用性。
tldr: This paper introduces a Feasibility-Enhanced Control Barrier Function (FECBF) framework for multi-UAV collision avoidance, addressing the infeasibility issues in dense scenarios by introducing a sign-consistency constraint. Both simulations and real-world experiments validate its effectiveness and robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种可行性增强的控制障碍函数（FECBF）框架，用于多无人机避碰。该方法通过引入符号一致性约束来解决密集场景中的不可行性问题，并通过仿真和实际实验验证了其有效性和鲁棒性。

title: From Passive Monitoring to Active Defence: Resilient Control of Manipulators Under Cyberattacks
summary: Cyber-physical robotic systems are vulnerable to false data injection attacks (FDIAs), in which an adversary corrupts sensor signals while evading residual-based passive anomaly detectors such as the chi-squared test. Such stealthy attacks can induce substantial end-effector deviations without triggering alarms. This paper studies the resilience of redundant manipulators to stealthy FDIAs and advances the architecture from passive monitoring to active defence. We formulate a closed-loop model comprising a feedback-linearized manipulator, a steady-state Kalman filter, and a chi-squared-based anomaly detector. Building on this passive monitoring layer, we propose an active control-level defence that attenuates the control input through a monotone function of an anomaly score generated by a novel actuation-projected, measurement-free state predictor. The proposed design provides probabilistic guarantees on nominal actuation loss and preserves closed-loop stability. From the attacker perspective, we derive a convex QCQP for computing one-step optimal stealthy attacks. Simulations on a 6-DOF planar manipulator show that the proposed defence significantly reduces attack-induced end-effector deviation while preserving nominal task performance in the absence of attacks.
summary_zh: 网络物理机器人系统易受虚假数据注入攻击(FDIA)的影响，在这种攻击中，攻击者会篡改传感器信号，同时躲避基于残差的被动异常检测器，例如卡方检验。这种隐蔽攻击会导致末端执行器产生显著偏差，而不会触发警报。本文研究了冗余机械臂对隐蔽FDIA的抵抗力，并将架构从被动监控推进到主动防御。我们构建了一个闭环模型，包含反馈线性化的机械臂、稳态卡尔曼滤波器和基于卡方的异常检测器。基于此被动监控层，我们提出了一种主动控制级别防御机制，通过一个基于新型驱动投影、无测量状态预测器生成的异常评分的单调函数来衰减控制输入。所提出的设计提供了关于名义驱动损失的概率保证，并保持了闭环稳定性。从攻击者的角度来看，我们推导出一个凸二次约束二次规划(QCQP)，用于计算一步最优隐蔽攻击。在一个六自由度平面机械臂上的仿真结果表明，所提出的防御机制显著降低了攻击引起的末端执行器偏差，同时在没有攻击的情况下保持了名义任务性能。
tldr: This paper proposes an active control-level defense mechanism for robotic manipulators against stealthy cyberattacks that bypass traditional anomaly detection, demonstrating reduced end-effector deviation in simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对机器人操纵器的主动控制层防御机制，用于应对绕过传统异常检测的隐蔽网络攻击，并在仿真中展示了降低末端执行器偏差的效果。

title: Route Fragmentation Based on Resource-centric Prioritisation for Efficient Multi-Robot Path Planning in Agricultural Environments
summary: Agricultural environments present high proportions of spatially dense navigation bottlenecks for long-term navigation and operational planning of agricultural mobile robots. The existing agent-centric multi-robot path planning (MRPP) approaches resolve conflicts from the perspective of agents, rather than from the resources under contention. Further, the density of such contentions limits the capabilities of spatial interleaving, a concept that many planners rely on to achieve high throughput. In this work, two variants of the priority-based Fragment Planner (FP) are presented as resource-centric MRPP algorithms that leverage route fragmentation to enable partial route progression and limit the impact of binary-based waiting. These approaches are evaluated in lifelong simulation over a 3.6km topological map representing a commercial polytunnel environment. Their performances are contrasted against 5 baseline algorithms with varying robotic fleet sizes. The Fragment Planners achieved significant gains in throughput compared with Prioritised Planning (PP) and Priority-Based Search (PBS) algorithms. They further demonstrated a task throughput of 95% of the optimal task throughput over the same time period. This work shows that, for long-term deployment of agricultural robots in corridor-dominant agricultural environments, resource-centric MRPP approaches are a necessity for high-efficacy operational planning.
summary_zh: 农业环境呈现出高比例的空间密集导航瓶颈，对农业移动机器人的长期导航和运行规划构成挑战。现有的以智能体为中心的多机器人路径规划（MRPP）方法从智能体的角度而非竞争资源的角度解决冲突。此外，此类竞争的密度限制了空间交错的能力，而许多规划器依赖这种能力来实现高吞吐量。本文提出了优先级碎片规划器（FP）的两种变体作为资源中心型的MRPP算法，利用路线碎片化来实现部分路线推进，并限制基于二元等待的影响。这些方法在一个代表商业多拱温室环境的3.6公里拓扑地图上进行了终身模拟评估。它们的性能与5种具有不同机器人数量的基线算法进行了对比。与优先级规划（PP）和基于优先级的搜索（PBS）算法相比，碎片规划器在吞吐量方面取得了显著提升。它们还表现出在同一时间段内达到最佳任务吞吐量95%的任务吞吐量。这项工作表明，对于走廊主导型农业环境中农业机器人的长期部署而言，资源中心型的MRPP方法对于高效的运行规划是必要的。
tldr: The paper introduces a resource-centric Multi-Robot Path Planning (MRPP) approach called Fragment Planner (FP) for agricultural robots in bottleneck-prone environments, demonstrating significant throughput gains compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种资源中心的的多机器人路径规划（MRPP）方法，称为碎片规划器（FP），用于在瓶颈多发的农业环境中，相比于现有方法，展示了显著的吞吐量提升。

title: Coordinated Manipulation of Hybrid Deformable-Rigid Objects in Constrained Environments
summary: Coordinated robotic manipulation of deformable linear objects (DLOs), such as ropes and cables, has been widely studied; however, handling hybrid assemblies composed of both deformable and rigid elements in constrained environments remains challenging. This work presents a quasi-static optimization-based manipulation planner that employs a strain-based Cosserat rod model, extending rigid-body formulations to hybrid deformable linear objects (hDLO). The proposed planner exploits the compliance of deformable links to maneuver through constraints while achieving task-space objectives for the object that are unreachable with rigid tools. By leveraging a differentiable model with analytically derived gradients, the method achieves up to a 33x speedup over finite-difference baselines for inverse kinetostatic(IKS) problems. Furthermore, the subsequent trajectory optimization problem, warm-started using the IKS solution, is only practically realizable via analytical derivatives. The proposed algorithm is validated in simulation on various hDLO systems and experimentally on a three-link hDLO manipulated in a constrained environment using a dual-arm robotic system. Experimental results confirm the planner's accuracy, yielding an average deformation error of approximately 3 cm (5% of the deformable link length) between the desired and measured marker positions. Finally, the proposed optimal planner is compared against a sampling-based feasibility planner adapted to the strain-based formulation. The results demonstrate the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed approach for robotic manipulation of hybrid assemblies in constrained environments.
summary_zh: 对可变形线性对象（DLO）如绳索和电缆的协同机器人操作已被广泛研究；然而，在约束环境中处理由可变形和刚性元件组成的混合组件仍然具有挑战性。本文提出了一种基于准静态优化的操作规划器，该规划器采用基于应变的 Cosserat 杆模型，将刚体公式扩展到混合可变形线性对象（hDLO）。所提出的规划器利用可变形环节的柔顺性，在约束条件下进行操作，以实现刚性工具无法达到的对象在任务空间中的目标。通过利用具有解析导数的可微模型，该方法在逆静力学（IKS）问题上实现了比有限差分基线高达 33 倍的加速。此外，后续的轨迹优化问题，使用 IKS 解进行预热，仅通过解析导数才能实际实现。所提出的算法在各种 hDLO 系统上进行了仿真验证，并在一个使用双臂机器人系统在约束环境中操作的三环节 hDLO 上进行了实验验证。实验结果证实了规划器的准确性，在期望 Marker 位置和测量 Marker 位置之间产生了大约 3 厘米（可变形环节长度的 5%）的平均变形误差。最后，将所提出的最优规划器与适用于基于应变公式的基于采样的可行性规划器进行了比较。结果证明了所提出的方法在约束环境中对混合组件进行机器人操作的有效性和适用性。
tldr: This paper introduces a quasi-static optimization-based manipulation planner for hybrid deformable-rigid objects (hDLOs) in constrained environments, demonstrating its effectiveness in simulation and real-world experiments with a dual-arm robot.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于准静态优化的操作规划器，用于在约束环境中操作混合可变形-刚性物体（hDLO），并通过双臂机器人在仿真和真实世界实验中验证了其有效性。

title: Consistent and Efficient MSCKF-based LiDAR-Inertial Odometry with Inferred Cluster-to-Plane Constraints for UAVs
summary: Robust and accurate navigation is critical for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) especially for those with stringent Size, Weight, and Power (SWaP) constraints. However, most state-of-the-art (SOTA) LiDAR-Inertial Odometry (LIO) systems still suffer from estimation inconsistency and computational bottlenecks when deployed on such platforms. To address these issues, this paper proposes a consistent and efficient tightly-coupled LIO framework tailored for UAVs. Within the efficient Multi-State Constraint Kalman Filter (MSCKF) framework, we build coplanar constraints inferred from planar features observed across a sliding window. By applying null-space projection to sliding-window coplanar constraints, we eliminate the direct dependency on feature parameters in the state vector, thereby mitigating overconfidence and improving consistency. More importantly, to further boost the efficiency, we introduce a parallel voxel-based data association and a novel compact cluster-to-plane measurement model. This compact measurement model losslessly reduces observation dimensionality and significantly accelerating the update process. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our method outperforms most state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches by providing a superior balance of consistency and efficiency. It exhibits improved robustness in degenerate scenarios, achieves the lowest memory usage via its map-free nature, and runs in real-time on resource-constrained embedded platforms (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson TX2).
summary_zh: 稳健且精确的导航对于无人机（UAV）至关重要，特别是对于那些具有严格尺寸、重量和功耗（SWaP）约束的无人机。然而，大多数最先进的（SOTA）激光雷达-惯性里程计（LIO）系统在部署于此类平台时，仍然面临着估计不一致和计算瓶颈的问题。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了一种为无人机量身定制的一致且高效的紧耦合LIO框架。在高效的多状态约束卡尔曼滤波器（MSCKF）框架内，我们构建了从滑动窗口中观测到的平面特征推断出的共面约束。通过将零空间投影应用于滑动窗口共面约束，我们消除了状态向量中对特征参数的直接依赖性，从而减轻了过度自信并提高了整体一致性。更重要的是，为了进一步提高效率，我们引入了一种基于体素的并行数据关联策略和一个新型的紧凑型簇到平面测量模型。这种紧凑型测量模型无损地降低了观测数据的维度，并显著加速了更新过程。大量的评估表明，我们的方法通过提供一致性和效率之间的卓越平衡，优于大多数最先进的方法。它在退化场景中表现出更高的鲁棒性，通过其无需地图的特性实现了最低的内存使用量，并且可以在资源受限的嵌入式平台（例如，NVIDIA Jetson TX2）上实时运行。
tldr: This paper presents a novel LiDAR-Inertial Odometry (LIO) framework for UAVs, improving consistency and efficiency by using coplanar constraints, parallel voxel-based data association, and a compact cluster-to-plane measurement model, demonstrating SOTA performance on resource-constrained platforms.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的用于无人机的激光雷达惯性里程计（LIO）框架，通过使用共面约束、并行基于体素的数据关联和紧凑的簇到平面测量模型，提高了系统的一致性和效率，并在资源受限的平台上展示了最先进的性能。

title: AoI-FusionNet: Age-Aware Tightly Coupled Fusion of UWB-IMU under Sparse Ranging Conditions
summary: Accurate motion tracking of snow particles in avalanche events requires robust localization in global navigation satellite system (GNSS)-denied outdoor environments. This paper introduces AoI-FusionNet, a tightly coupled deep learning-based fusion framework that directly combines raw ultra-wideband (UWB) time-of-flight (ToF) measurements with inertial measurement unit (IMU) data for 3D trajectory estimation. Unlike loose-coupled pipelines based on intermediate trilateration, the proposed approach operates directly on heterogeneous sensor inputs, enabling localization even under insufficient ranging availability. The framework integrates an Age-of-Information (AoI)-aware decay module to reduce the influence of stale UWB ranging measurements and a learned attention gating mechanism that adaptively balances the contribution of UWB and IMU modalities based on measurement availability and temporal freshness. To evaluate robustness under limited data and measurement variability, we apply a diffusion-based residual augmentation strategy during training, producing an augmented variant termed AoI-FusionNet-DGAN. We assess the performance of the proposed model using offline post-processing of real-world measurement data collected in an alpine environment and benchmark it against UWB multilateration and loose-coupled fusion baselines. The results demonstrate that AoI-FusionNet substantially reduces mean and tail localization errors under intermittent and degraded sensing conditions.
summary_zh: 在雪崩事件中，对雪粒进行精确的运动跟踪需要在全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）拒止的户外环境中进行稳健的定位。本文介绍了一种名为AoI-FusionNet的紧耦合深度学习融合框架，该框架直接将原始超宽带（UWB）飞行时间（ToF）测量数据与惯性测量单元（IMU）数据相结合，用于三维轨迹估计。与基于中间三边测量的松耦合管道不同，所提出的方法直接对异构传感器输入进行操作，即使在测距可用性不足的情况下也能实现定位。该框架集成了一个信息时效性（AoI）感知衰减模块，以减少陈旧UWB测距测量的影响，以及一个学习到的注意力门控机制，该机制根据测量可用性和时间新鲜度自适应地平衡UWB和IMU模态的贡献。为了评估在有限数据和测量可变性下的鲁棒性，我们在训练过程中应用了基于扩散的残差增强策略，产生了一个增强型变体，称为AoI-FusionNet-DGAN。我们使用在高山环境中收集的真实世界测量数据的离线后处理来评估所提出模型的性能，并将其与UWB多边测量和松耦合融合基线进行基准测试。结果表明，在间歇性和退化感知条件下，AoI-FusionNet显著降低了平均和尾部定位误差。
tldr: The paper introduces AoI-FusionNet, a deep learning framework that tightly couples UWB and IMU data for robust 3D trajectory estimation in GNSS-denied environments, particularly addressing the challenges of sparse ranging and stale measurements.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AoI-FusionNet，一种深度学习框架，用于紧密耦合UWB和IMU数据，以在GNSS拒止环境中实现稳健的3D轨迹估计，特别解决了稀疏测距和陈旧测量带来的挑战。

title: Motion-Specific Battery Health Assessment for Quadrotors Using High-Fidelity Battery Models
summary: Quadrotor endurance is ultimately limited by battery behavior, yet most energy aware planning treats the battery as a simple energy reservoir and overlooks how flight motions induce dynamic current loads that accelerate battery degradation. This work presents an end to end framework for motion aware battery health assessment in quadrotors. We first design a wide range current sensing module to capture motion specific current profiles during real flights, preserving transient features. In parallel, a high fidelity battery model is calibrated using reference performance tests and a metaheuristic based on a degradation coupled electrochemical model.By simulating measured flight loads in the calibrated model, we systematically resolve how different flight motions translate into degradation modes loss of lithium inventory and loss of active material as well as internal side reactions. The results demonstrate that even when two flight profiles consume the same average energy, their transient load structures can drive different degradation pathways, emphasizing the need for motion-aware battery management that balances efficiency with battery degradation.
summary_zh: 四旋翼的续航最终受限于电池性能，然而，大多数能量感知规划将电池视为一个简单的能量储存器，忽略了飞行运动如何产生动态电流负载，从而加速电池衰减。本研究提出了一种端到端的框架，用于四旋翼中运动感知的电池健康评估。首先，我们设计了一个宽范围电流传感模块，以捕捉真实飞行中特定于运动的电流曲线，保留瞬态特征。同时，我们使用参考性能测试和一个基于退化耦合电化学模型的元启发式算法，校准了一个高保真电池模型。通过在校准后的模型中模拟测量的飞行负载，我们系统地解析了不同的飞行运动如何转化为退化模式：锂库存损失、活性材料损失以及内部副反应。结果表明，即使两种飞行轨迹消耗相同的平均能量，它们的瞬态负载结构也会驱动不同的退化路径，强调了运动感知的电池管理的需求，需要在效率和电池退化之间取得平衡。
tldr: This paper presents a framework for motion-aware battery health assessment in quadrotors, showing that different flight motions, even with the same average energy consumption, lead to different degradation pathways. It emphasizes the need for motion-aware battery management.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个无人机运动感知的电池健康评估框架，表明即使平均能量消耗相同，不同的飞行运动也会导致不同的退化途径。强调了运动感知电池管理的必要性。

title: Push, Press, Slide: Mode-Aware Planar Contact Manipulation via Reduced-Order Models
summary: Non-prehensile planar manipulation, including pushing and press-and-slide, is critical for diverse robotic tasks, but notoriously challenging due to hybrid contact mechanics, under-actuation, and asymmetric friction limits that traditionally necessitate computationally expensive iterative control. In this paper, we propose a mode-aware framework for planar manipulation with one or two robotic arms based on contact topology selection and reduced-order kinematic modeling. Our core insight is that complex wrench-twist limit surface mechanics can be abstracted into a discrete library of physically intuitive models. We systematically map various single-arm and bimanual contact topologies to simple non-holonomic formulations, e.g. unicycle for simplified press-and-slide motion. By anchoring trajectory generation to these reduced-order models, our framework computes the required object wrench and distributes feasible, friction-bounded contact forces via a direct algebraic allocator. We incorporate manipulator kinematics to ensure long-horizon feasibility and demonstrate our fast, optimization-free approach in simulation across diverse single-arm and bimanual manipulation tasks.
summary_zh: 非抓取式平面操控，包括推和压滑，对于各种机器人任务至关重要，但由于混合接触力学、欠驱动以及非对称摩擦极限等原因，极具挑战性，传统上需要计算成本高昂的迭代控制。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于接触拓扑选择和降阶运动学建模的、具有一个或两个机器人手臂的平面操控模式感知框架。我们的核心思想是将复杂的力-扭矩极限面力学抽象为一个物理直观模型的离散库。我们系统地将各种单臂和双臂接触拓扑映射到简单的非完整约束公式，例如用于简化压滑运动的独轮车模型。通过将轨迹生成锚定到这些降阶模型，我们的框架计算所需的目标力矩，并通过直接代数分配器分配可行且摩擦有界的接触力。我们结合了机械臂运动学以确保长时域可行性，并在仿真中通过各种单臂和双臂操控任务展示了我们快速且无需优化的方法。
tldr: This paper presents a mode-aware framework for planar manipulation using robotic arms, leveraging reduced-order kinematic models to simplify control and enable fast, optimization-free trajectory generation for tasks like pushing and press-and-slide.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于降阶运动学模型的平面操作模式识别框架，利用机器人手臂简化控制，并为诸如推和按压滑动等任务实现快速、无优化的轨迹生成。

title: FC-Track: Overlap-Aware Post-Association Correction for Online Multi-Object Tracking
summary: Reliable multi-object tracking (MOT) is essential for robotic systems operating in complex and dynamic environments. Despite recent advances in detection and association, online MOT methods remain vulnerable to identity switches caused by frequent occlusions and object overlap, where incorrect associations can propagate over time and degrade tracking reliability. We present a lightweight post-association correction framework (FC-Track) for online MOT that explicitly targets overlap-induced mismatches during inference. The proposed method suppresses unreliable appearance updates under high-overlap conditions using an Intersection over Area (IoA)-based filtering strategy, and locally corrects detection-to-tracklet mismatches through appearance similarity comparison within overlapped tracklet pairs. By preventing short-term mismatches from propagating, our framework effectively mitigates long-term identity switches without resorting to global optimization or re-identification. The framework operates online without global optimization or re-identification, making it suitable for real-time robotic applications. We achieve 81.73 MOTA, 82.81 IDF1, and 66.95 HOTA on the MOT17 test set with a running speed of 5.7 FPS, and 77.52 MOTA, 80.90 IDF1, and 65.67 HOTA on the MOT20 test set with a running speed of 0.6 FPS. Specifically, our framework FC-Track produces only 29.55% long-term identity switches, which is substantially lower than existing online trackers. Meanwhile, our framework maintains state-of-the-art performance on the MOT20 benchmark.
summary_zh: 可靠的多目标跟踪（MOT）对于在复杂和动态环境中运行的机器人系统至关重要。尽管检测和关联方面取得了近期的进展，但在线MOT方法仍然容易受到频繁遮挡和目标重叠导致的身份切换的影响，其中不正确的关联会随着时间的推移而传播并降低跟踪的可靠性。我们提出了一种轻量级的后关联校正框架（FC-Track），用于在线MOT，该框架在推理过程中明确针对重叠引起的错误匹配。该方法使用基于面积交并比（IoA）的过滤策略来抑制高重叠条件下的不可靠外观更新，并通过重叠轨迹对内的外观相似性比较来局部地校正检测到轨迹的错误匹配。通过防止短期错误匹配的传播，我们的框架有效地减少了长期身份切换，而无需诉诸全局优化或重识别。该框架在线运行，无需全局优化或重识别，使其适用于实时机器人应用。我们在MOT17测试集上实现了81.73 MOTA、82.81 IDF1和66.95 HOTA，运行速度为5.7 FPS；在MOT20测试集上实现了77.52 MOTA、80.90 IDF1和65.67 HOTA，运行速度为0.6 FPS。具体而言，我们的框架FC-Track仅产生29.55％的长期身份切换，远低于现有的在线跟踪器。同时，我们的框架在MOT20基准测试中保持了最先进的性能。
tldr: This paper introduces FC-Track, a lightweight post-association correction framework for online multi-object tracking that addresses identity switches caused by occlusions and object overlap, achieving state-of-the-art performance on MOT benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种轻量级的后关联校正框架FC-Track，用于在线多目标跟踪，旨在解决由遮挡和对象重叠导致的身份切换问题，并在MOT基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。

title: CMHANet: A Cross-Modal Hybrid Attention Network for Point Cloud Registration
summary: Robust point cloud registration is a fundamental task in 3D computer vision and geometric deep learning, essential for applications such as large-scale 3D reconstruction, augmented reality, and scene understanding. However, the performance of established learning-based methods often degrades in complex, real world scenarios characterized by incomplete data, sensor noise, and low overlap regions. To address these limitations, we propose CMHANet, a novel Cross-Modal Hybrid Attention Network. Our method integrates the fusion of rich contextual information from 2D images with the geometric detail of 3D point clouds, yielding a comprehensive and resilient feature representation. Furthermore, we introduce an innovative optimization function based on contrastive learning, which enforces geometric consistency and significantly improves the model's robustness to noise and partial observations. We evaluated CMHANet on the 3DMatch and the challenging 3DLoMatch datasets. \rev{Additionally, zero-shot evaluations on the TUM RGB-D SLAM dataset verify the model's generalization capability to unseen domains.} The experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves substantial improvements in both registration accuracy and overall robustness, outperforming current techniques. We also release our code in \href{https://github.com/DongXu-Zhang/CMHANet}{https://github.com/DongXu-Zhang/CMHANet}.
summary_zh: 稳健的点云配准是三维计算机视觉和几何深度学习中的一项基础任务，对于大规模三维重建、增强现实和场景理解等应用至关重要。然而，在复杂、真实世界的场景中，由于数据不完整、传感器噪声和低重叠区域等因素，现有基于学习的方法的性能往往会下降。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的跨模态混合注意力网络CMHANet。我们的方法集成了来自二维图像的丰富上下文信息与三维点云的几何细节，从而产生全面且具有弹性的特征表示。此外，我们引入了一种基于对比学习的创新优化函数，该函数强制执行几何一致性，并显著提高模型对噪声和部分观测的鲁棒性。我们在3DMatch和具有挑战性的3DLoMatch数据集上评估了CMHANet。\rev{此外，在TUM RGB-D SLAM数据集上的零样本评估验证了模型对未见领域的泛化能力。} 实验结果表明，我们的方法在配准精度和整体鲁棒性方面都取得了显著的提升，优于当前的技术。我们也在\href{https://github.com/DongXu-Zhang/CMHANet}{https://github.com/DongXu-Zhang/CMHANet} 上发布了我们的代码。
tldr: The paper introduces CMHANet, a cross-modal hybrid attention network for robust point cloud registration, which integrates 2D image features with 3D point cloud geometry and uses contrastive learning for improved robustness. It shows strong performance on standard datasets and good generalization ability.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CMHANet，一种用于鲁棒点云配准的跨模态混合注意力网络，它结合了2D图像特征和3D点云几何信息，并使用对比学习来提高鲁棒性。该方法在标准数据集上表现出色，并具有良好的泛化能力。

title: Spectral-Geometric Neural Fields for Pose-Free LiDAR View Synthesis
summary: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) have shown remarkable success in image novel view synthesis (NVS), inspiring extensions to LiDAR NVS. However, most methods heavily rely on accurate camera poses for scene reconstruction. The sparsity and textureless nature of LiDAR data also present distinct challenges, leading to geometric holes and discontinuous surfaces. To address these issues, we propose SG-NLF, a pose-free LiDAR NeRF framework that integrates spectral information with geometric consistency. Specifically, we design a hybrid representation based on spectral priors to reconstruct smooth geometry. For pose optimization, we construct a confidence-aware graph based on feature compatibility to achieve global alignment. In addition, an adversarial learning strategy is introduced to enforce cross-frame consistency, thereby enhancing reconstruction quality. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework, especially in challenging low-frequency scenarios. Compared to previous state-of-the-art methods, SG-NLF improves reconstruction quality and pose accuracy by over 35.8% and 68.8%. Our work can provide a novel perspective for LiDAR view synthesis.
summary_zh: 神经辐射场（NeRF）在图像新视角合成（NVS）方面取得了显著成功，从而启发了其在激光雷达NVS中的扩展应用。然而，大多数方法严重依赖于精确的相机位姿来进行场景重建。激光雷达数据的稀疏性和无纹理特性也带来了独特的挑战，导致几何孔洞和不连续表面。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了SG-NLF，一个无位姿的激光雷达NeRF框架，它集成了频谱信息和几何一致性。具体来说，我们设计了一种基于频谱先验的混合表示，以重建平滑的几何结构。对于位姿优化，我们构建了一个基于特征兼容性的置信度感知图，以实现全局对齐。此外，还引入了一种对抗学习策略来强制执行跨帧一致性，从而提高重建质量。综合实验表明了我们框架的有效性，尤其是在具有挑战性的低频场景中。与之前最先进的方法相比，SG-NLF将重建质量和位姿精度分别提高了35.8%和68.8%以上。我们的工作可以为激光雷达视角合成提供一种新的视角。
tldr: The paper introduces SG-NLF, a pose-free LiDAR NeRF framework, to address the challenges of LiDAR view synthesis by integrating spectral information and geometric consistency, achieving significant improvements in reconstruction quality and pose accuracy.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了 SG-NLF，一个无需位姿的 LiDAR NeRF 框架，通过整合频谱信息和几何一致性来解决 LiDAR 视图合成的挑战，并在重建质量和位姿精度方面取得了显著提升。

title: Coherent Human-Scene Reconstruction from Multi-Person Multi-View Video in a Single Pass
summary: Recent advances in 3D foundation models have led to growing interest in reconstructing humans and their surrounding environments. However, most existing approaches focus on monocular inputs, and extending them to multi-view settings requires additional overhead modules or preprocessed data. To this end, we present CHROMM, a unified framework that jointly estimates cameras, scene point clouds, and human meshes from multi-person multi-view videos without relying on external modules or preprocessing. We integrate strong geometric and human priors from Pi3X and Multi-HMR into a single trainable neural network architecture, and introduce a scale adjustment module to solve the scale discrepancy between humans and the scene. We also introduce a multi-view fusion strategy to aggregate per-view estimates into a single representation at test-time. Finally, we propose a geometry-based multi-person association method, which is more robust than appearance-based approaches. Experiments on EMDB, RICH, EgoHumans, and EgoExo4D show that CHROMM achieves competitive performance in global human motion and multi-view pose estimation while running over 8x faster than prior optimization-based multi-view approaches. Project page: https://nstar1125.github.io/chromm.
summary_zh: 三维基础模型的最新进展引发了人们对重建人类及其周围环境的日益增长的兴趣。然而，大多数现有方法侧重于单目输入，将其扩展到多视点设置需要额外的开销模块或预处理数据。为此，我们提出了一种统一框架CHROMM，它可以从多人多视点视频中联合估计相机、场景点云和人体网格，而无需依赖外部模块或预处理。我们将来自Pi3X和Multi-HMR的强几何和人体先验集成到一个可训练的神经网络架构中，并引入了一个尺度调整模块来解决人和场景之间的尺度差异。我们还引入了一种多视点融合策略，在测试时将每个视点的估计聚合到单个表示中。最后，我们提出了一种基于几何的多人关联方法，该方法比基于外观的方法更稳健。在EMDB、RICH、EgoHumans和EgoExo4D上的实验表明，CHROMM在全球人体运动和多视点姿态估计方面取得了具有竞争力的性能，同时其运行速度比之前的基于优化的多视点方法快8倍以上。项目主页：https://nstar1125.github.io/chromm。
tldr: The paper introduces CHROMM, a unified framework for joint reconstruction of humans, camera poses, and scene point clouds from multi-view video, achieving competitive performance with significant speedup compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CHROMM，一个统一的框架，可以从多视角视频中联合重建人物、相机姿态和场景点云，与现有方法相比，实现了具有竞争力的性能，并且速度显著提升。

title: Prompt-Driven Lightweight Foundation Model for Instance Segmentation-Based Fault Detection in Freight Trains
summary: Accurate visual fault detection in freight trains remains a critical challenge for intelligent transportation system maintenance, due to complex operational environments, structurally repetitive components, and frequent occlusions or contaminations in safety-critical regions. Conventional instance segmentation methods based on convolutional neural networks and Transformers often suffer from poor generalization and limited boundary accuracy under such conditions. To address these challenges, we propose a lightweight self-prompted instance segmentation framework tailored for freight train fault detection. Our method leverages the Segment Anything Model by introducing a self-prompt generation module that automatically produces task-specific prompts, enabling effective knowledge transfer from foundation models to domain-specific inspection tasks. In addition, we adopt a Tiny Vision Transformer backbone to reduce computational cost, making the framework suitable for real-time deployment on edge devices in railway monitoring systems. We construct a domain-specific dataset collected from real-world freight inspection stations and conduct extensive evaluations. Experimental results show that our method achieves 74.6 $AP^{\text{box}}$ and 74.2 $AP^{\text{mask}}$ on the dataset, outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods in both accuracy and robustness while maintaining low computational overhead. This work offers a deployable and efficient vision solution for automated freight train inspection, demonstrating the potential of foundation model adaptation in industrial-scale fault diagnosis scenarios. Project page: https://github.com/MVME-HBUT/SAM_FTI-FDet.git
summary_zh:
摘要：
在智能交通系统维护中，由于复杂的运营环境、结构重复的组件以及安全关键区域频繁的遮挡或污染，对货运列车进行准确的视觉故障检测仍然是一个关键挑战。基于卷积神经网络和 Transformer 的传统实例分割方法在这种条件下通常存在泛化性差和边界精度有限的问题。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种轻量级的自提示实例分割框架，专门为货运列车故障检测定制。我们的方法利用 Segment Anything Model，引入一个自提示生成模块，该模块自动生成特定于任务的提示，从而实现从基础模型到领域特定检测任务的有效知识迁移。此外，我们采用 Tiny Vision Transformer 作为骨干网络，以降低计算成本，使该框架适用于铁路监控系统中边缘设备的实时部署。我们构建了一个从真实货运检查站收集的领域特定数据集，并进行了广泛的评估。实验结果表明，我们的方法在该数据集上实现了 74.6 $AP^{\text{box}}$ 和 74.2 $AP^{\text{mask}}$，在精度和鲁棒性方面均优于现有的最先进方法，同时保持了较低的计算开销。这项工作为自动货运列车检查提供了一种可部署且高效的视觉解决方案，展示了基础模型适配在工业规模故障诊断场景中的潜力。项目主页：https://github.com/MVME-HBUT/SAM_FTI-FDet.git
tldr: This paper proposes a lightweight, prompt-driven instance segmentation framework using the Segment Anything Model and a Tiny Vision Transformer for automated fault detection in freight trains, achieving state-of-the-art performance with low computational overhead.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种轻量级的、提示驱动的实例分割框架，该框架使用Segment Anything Model和一个Tiny Vision Transformer，用于自动检测货运列车的故障，以低计算开销实现了最先进的性能。

title: MRGeo: Robust Cross-View Geo-Localization of Corrupted Images via Spatial and Channel Feature Enhancement
summary: Cross-view geo-localization (CVGL) aims to accurately localize street-view images through retrieval of corresponding geo-tagged satellite images. While prior works have achieved nearly perfect performance on certain standard datasets, their robustness in real-world corrupted environments remains under-explored. This oversight causes severe performance degradation or failure when images are affected by corruption such as blur or weather, significantly limiting practical deployment. To address this critical gap, we introduce MRGeo, the first systematic method designed for robust CVGL under corruption. MRGeo employs a hierarchical defense strategy that enhances the intrinsic quality of features and then enforces a robust geometric prior. Its core is the Spatial-Channel Enhancement Block, which contains: (1) a Spatial Adaptive Representation Module that models global and local features in parallel and uses a dynamic gating mechanism to arbitrate their fusion based on feature reliability; and (2) a Channel Calibration Module that performs compensatory adjustments by modeling multi-granularity channel dependencies to counteract information loss. To prevent spatial misalignment under severe corruption, a Region-level Geometric Alignment Module imposes a geometric structure on the final descriptors, ensuring coarse-grained consistency. Comprehensive experiments on both robustness benchmark and standard datasets demonstrate that MRGeo not only achieves an average R@1 improvement of 2.92\% across three comprehensive robustness benchmarks (CVUSA-C-ALL, CVACT\_val-C-ALL, and CVACT\_test-C-ALL) but also establishes superior performance in cross-area evaluation, thereby demonstrating its robustness and generalization capability.
summary_zh: 跨视角地理定位（CVGL）旨在通过检索相应的带有地理标签的卫星图像来精确定位街景图像。 尽管先前的工作在某些标准数据集上几乎实现了完美的性能，但它们在真实世界受损环境中的鲁棒性仍未得到充分研究。 这种疏忽会导致当图像受到诸如模糊或天气等损坏影响时，性能严重下降或失效，从而大大限制了其实际部署。 为了解决这个关键缺口，我们引入了MRGeo，这是第一个为应对损坏下的鲁棒性 CVGL 而设计的系统方法。 MRGeo 采用分层防御策略，增强特征的内在质量，然后强制执行鲁棒的几何先验。 它的核心是空间-通道增强块，它包含：（1）空间自适应表示模块，该模块并行建模全局和局部特征，并使用动态门控机制根据特征可靠性来仲裁它们的融合；以及（2）通道校准模块，该模块通过建模多粒度通道依赖性来执行补偿调整，以抵消信息丢失。 为了防止在严重损坏下的空间错位，区域级几何对齐模块将几何结构施加到最终描述符上，从而确保粗粒度的一致性。 在鲁棒性基准和标准数据集上的综合实验表明，MRGeo 不仅在三个综合鲁棒性基准（CVUSA-C-ALL、CVACT_val-C-ALL 和 CVACT_test-C-ALL）上实现了平均 2.92% 的 R@1 提升，而且还在跨区域评估中建立了卓越的性能，从而证明了其鲁棒性和泛化能力。
tldr: The paper introduces MRGeo, a method for robust cross-view geo-localization (CVGL) that addresses performance degradation in corrupted images by enhancing feature quality and enforcing geometric priors.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了MRGeo，一种鲁棒的跨视角地理定位（CVGL）方法，通过增强特征质量和强制执行几何先验来解决在损坏图像中性能下降的问题。

title: CalliMaster: Mastering Page-level Chinese Calligraphy via Layout-guided Spatial Planning
summary: Page-level calligraphy synthesis requires balancing glyph precision with layout composition. Existing character models lack spatial context, while page-level methods often compromise brushwork detail. In this paper, we present \textbf{CalliMaster}, a unified framework for controllable generation and editing that resolves this conflict by decoupling spatial planning from content synthesis. Inspired by the human cognitive process of ``planning before writing'', we introduce a coarse-to-fine pipeline \textbf{(Text $\rightarrow$ Layout $\rightarrow$ Image)} to tackle the combinatorial complexity of page-scale synthesis. Operating within a single Multimodal Diffusion Transformer, a spatial planning stage first predicts character bounding boxes to establish the global spatial arrangement. This intermediate layout then serves as a geometric prompt for the content synthesis stage, where the same network utilizes flow-matching to render high-fidelity brushwork. Beyond achieving state-of-the-art generation quality, this disentanglement supports versatile downstream capabilities. By treating the layout as a modifiable constraint, CalliMaster enables controllable semantic re-planning: users can resize or reposition characters while the model automatically harmonizes the surrounding void space and brush momentum. Furthermore, we demonstrate the framework's extensibility to artifact restoration and forensic analysis, providing a comprehensive tool for digital cultural heritage.
summary_zh: 页面级书法合成需要在字形精度与布局构图之间取得平衡。现有的字符模型缺乏空间上下文信息，而页面级方法通常会牺牲笔画细节。在本文中，我们提出了一种统一的、可控的书法生成和编辑框架 \textbf{CalliMaster}，通过将空间规划与内容合成解耦来解决这一冲突。受到人类“先规划后书写”认知过程的启发，我们引入了一个由粗到精的流程 \textbf{(文本 $\rightarrow$ 布局 $\rightarrow$ 图像)}，以应对页面尺度合成的组合复杂性。在一个单一的多模态扩散Transformer中运作，空间规划阶段首先预测字符边界框，以建立全局空间布局。这个中间布局随后作为内容合成阶段的几何提示，在该阶段，同一网络利用流匹配（flow-matching）来渲染高保真的笔画。除了实现最先进的生成质量外，这种解耦还支持多种下游功能。通过将布局视为可修改的约束，CalliMaster 实现了可控的语义重规划：用户可以调整字符大小或重新定位字符，而模型会自动协调周围的空白空间和笔势连贯性。此外，我们还展示了该框架在文物修复和取证分析方面的可扩展性，为数字文化遗产提供了一个全面的工具。
tldr: CalliMaster is a unified framework for generating and editing page-level Chinese calligraphy by decoupling spatial layout planning from content synthesis using a Multimodal Diffusion Transformer in a coarse-to-fine pipeline.
tldr_zh: CalliMaster是一个统一的框架，用于生成和编辑页面级中国书法，通过使用多模态扩散变换器，将空间布局规划与内容合成解耦，采用由粗到精的流程。

title: Human-AI Collaborative Autonomous Experimentation With Proxy Modeling for Comparative Observation
summary: Optimization for different tasks like material characterization, synthesis, and functional properties for desired applications over multi-dimensional control parameters need a rapid strategic search through active learning such as Bayesian optimization (BO). However, such high-dimensional experimental physical descriptors are complex and noisy, from which realization of a low-dimensional mathematical scalar metrics or objective functions can be erroneous. Moreover, in traditional purely data-driven autonomous exploration, such objective functions often ignore the subtle variation and key features of the physical descriptors, thereby can fail to discover unknown phenomenon of the material systems. To address this, here we present a proxy-modelled Bayesian optimization (px-BO) via on-the-fly teaming between human and AI agents. Over the loop of BO, instead of defining a mathematical objective function directly from the experimental data, we introduce a voting system on the fly where the new experimental outcome will be compared with existing experiments, and the human agents will choose the preferred samples. These human-guided comparisons are then transformed into a proxy-based objective function via fitting Bradley-Terry (BT) model. Then, to minimize human interaction, this iteratively trained proxy model also acts as an AI agent for future surrogate human votes. Finally, these surrogate votes are periodically validated by human agents, and the corrections are then learned by the proxy model on-the-fly. We demonstrated the performance of the proposed px-BO framework into simulated and BEPS data generated from PTO sample. We find that our approach provided better control of the domain experts for an improved search over traditional data-driven exploration, thus, signifies the importance of human-AI teaming in an accelerated and meaningful material space exploration.
summary_zh: 在多维控制参数下，针对材料表征、合成和所需应用的功能特性等不同任务进行优化，需要通过主动学习（例如贝叶斯优化（BO））进行快速战略搜索。然而，这种高维实验物理描述符是复杂且嘈杂的，从中实现低维数学标量度量或目标函数可能会出错。此外，在传统的纯数据驱动自主探索中，这种目标函数通常忽略物理描述符的细微变化和关键特征，因此可能无法发现材料系统的未知现象。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一种通过人在环人工智能代理的即时协作的代理模型贝叶斯优化（px-BO）。在贝叶斯优化的循环中，我们没有直接从实验数据定义数学目标函数，而是引入了一个即时投票系统，新实验结果将与现有实验进行比较，人类代理将选择更优选的样本。然后，这些人工指导的比较通过拟合 Bradley-Terry（BT）模型转化为基于代理的目标函数。然后，为了最大限度地减少人机交互，这种迭代训练的代理模型也充当人工智能代理，用于未来的替代人工投票。最后，这些替代投票会定期由人类代理进行验证，并且修正会被代理模型即时学习。我们通过模拟和从 PTO 样品生成的 BEPS 数据验证了所提出的 px-BO 框架的性能。我们发现，与传统的数据驱动探索相比，我们的方法为领域专家提供了更好的控制，从而改善了搜索效果，因此，突显了人机协作在加速和有意义的材料空间探索中的重要性。
tldr: This paper introduces a human-AI collaborative Bayesian optimization (px-BO) framework for material discovery, leveraging human input to guide the optimization process by comparing experimental outcomes, which are then learned by a proxy model to minimize human interaction.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种人机协作的贝叶斯优化（px-BO）框架，用于材料发现。该框架利用人类输入来指导优化过程，通过比较实验结果，并由代理模型学习，以最大限度地减少人工干预。

title: A Learning-Based Approach for Contact Detection, Localization, and Force Estimation of Continuum Manipulators With Integrated OFDR Optical Fiber
summary: Continuum manipulators (CMs) are widely used in minimally invasive procedures due to their compliant structure and ability to navigate deep and confined anatomical environments. However, their distributed deformation makes force sensing, contact detection, localization, and force estimation challenging, particularly when interactions occur at unknown arc-length locations along the robot. To address this problem, we propose a cascade learning-based framework (CLF) for CMs instrumented with a single distributed Optical Frequency Domain Reflectometry (OFDR) fiber embedded along one side of the robot. The OFDR sensor provides dense strain measurements along the manipulator backbone, capturing strain perturbations caused by external interactions. The proposed CLF first detects contact using a Gradient Boosting classifier and then estimates contact location and interaction force magnitude using a CNN--FiLM model that predicts a spatial force distribution along the manipulator. Experimental validation on a sensorized tendon-driven CM in an obstructed environment demonstrates that a single distributed OFDR fiber provides sufficient information to jointly infer contact occurrence, location, and force in continuum manipulators.
summary_zh: 连续体机械臂（CMs）因其柔顺的结构和在狭窄、深入的解剖环境中导航的能力而被广泛应用于微创手术。然而，其分布式变形使得力感测、接触检测、定位和力估计具有挑战性，尤其是在机器人沿弧长未知位置发生交互时。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种基于级联学习的框架（CLF），用于配备单根分布式光频域反射（OFDR）光纤的连续体机械臂，该光纤嵌入在机器人的一侧。OFDR传感器提供沿机械臂主干的密集应变测量，捕捉由外部交互引起的应变扰动。所提出的CLF首先使用梯度提升分类器检测接触，然后使用CNN--FiLM模型估计接触位置和交互力的大小，该模型预测沿机械臂的空间力分布。在一个受阻环境中的传感器化肌腱驱动连续体机械臂上的实验验证表明，单根分布式OFDR光纤提供了足够的信息，用于联合推断连续体机械臂中接触的发生、位置和力。
tldr: This paper presents a cascade learning framework utilizing OFDR fiber for contact detection, localization, and force estimation in continuum manipulators, demonstrating successful application in an obstructed environment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种级联学习框架，利用OFDR光纤来实现连续体机械臂的接触检测、定位和力估计，并在障碍环境中成功进行了应用演示。

title: SortScrews: A Dataset and Baseline for Real-time Screw Classification
summary:
Automatic identification of screw types is important for industrial automation, robotics, and inventory management. However, publicly available datasets for screw classification are scarce, particularly for controlled single-object scenarios commonly encountered in automated sorting systems. In this work, we introduce $\textbf{SortScrews}$, a dataset for casewise visual classification of screws. The dataset contains 560 RGB images at $512\times512$ resolution covering six screw types and a background class. Images are captured using a standardized acquisition setup and include mild variations in lighting and camera perspective across four capture settings.
  To facilitate reproducible research and dataset expansion, we also provide a reusable data collection script that allows users to easily construct similar datasets for custom hardware components using inexpensive camera setups.
  We establish baseline results using transfer learning with EfficientNet-B0 and ResNet-18 classifiers pretrained on ImageNet. In addition, we conduct a well-explored failure analysis. Despite the limited dataset size, these lightweight models achieve strong classification accuracy, demonstrating that controlled acquisition conditions enable effective learning even with relatively small datasets. The dataset, collection pipeline, and baseline training code are publicly available at https://github.com/ATATC/SortScrews.
summary_zh:
螺钉类型的自动识别对于工业自动化、机器人技术和库存管理至关重要。然而，公开可用的螺钉分类数据集稀缺，尤其是在自动化分拣系统中常见的受控单物体场景的数据集。在这项工作中，我们推出了 $\textbf{SortScrews}$，一个用于螺钉的按实例视觉分类的数据集。该数据集包含 560 张分辨率为 $512\times512$ 的 RGB 图像，涵盖六种螺钉类型和一个背景类别。图像采用标准化的采集设置捕获，并在四种采集设置中包含光照和相机透视的轻微变化。

  为了方便可重复的研究和数据集扩展，我们还提供了一个可重用的数据收集脚本，允许用户使用廉价的相机设置轻松构建类似的数据集，用于自定义硬件组件。

  我们使用在 ImageNet 上预训练的 EfficientNet-B0 和 ResNet-18 分类器，通过迁移学习建立了基线结果。此外，我们进行了一项充分探索的失效分析。尽管数据集规模有限，但这些轻量级模型实现了强大的分类准确率，表明受控的采集条件即使在相对较小的数据集也能实现有效的学习。数据集、收集流程和基线训练代码已在 https://github.com/ATATC/SortScrews 上公开。
tldr: The paper introduces SortScrews, a new dataset for screw classification with corresponding data collection scripts and baseline results using transfer learning. It aims to facilitate research in industrial automation and robotics via a controlled single-object scenario.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个新的螺丝分类数据集SortScrews，并提供了相应的数据收集脚本和使用迁移学习的基线结果。旨在通过受控的单物体场景促进工业自动化和机器人领域的研究。

title: On Using Machine Learning to Early Detect Catastrophic Failures in Marine Diesel Engines
summary: Catastrophic failures of marine engines imply severe loss of functionality and destroy or damage the systems irreversibly. Being sudden and often unpredictable events, they pose a severe threat to navigation, crew, and passengers. The abrupt nature makes early detection the only effective countermeasure. However, research has concentrated on modeling the gradual degradation of components, with limited attention to sudden and anomalous phenomena. This work proposes a new method for early detection of catastrophic failures. Based on real data from a failed engine, the approach evaluates the derivatives of the deviation between actual sensor readings and expected values of engine variables. Predictions are obtained by a Random Forest, which is the most suitable Machine Learning algorithm among the tested ones. Traditional methods focus on deviations of monitored signals, whereas the proposed approach employs the derivatives of the deviations to provide earlier indications of abnormal dynamics, and to alert that a rapid and dangerous event is breaking out within the system. The method allows the detection of anomalies before measurements reach critical thresholds and alarms are triggered, which is the common method in industry. Consequently, operators can be warned in advance and shut down the engine, then prevent damage and unexpected power loss. Moreover, they have the time to safely change the ship route and avoid potential obstacles. Simulation results conf irm the effectiveness of the proposed approach in anticipating occurrence of catastrophic failures. Validation on real-world data further reinforces the robustness and practical applicability of the method. It is worth noting that data acquisition to train the predictive algorithm is not a problem, since a Deep Learning-based data augmentation procedure is used.
summary_zh: 海洋发动机的灾难性故障意味着严重的性能损失，并不可逆地破坏或损坏系统。这些故障通常是突然且难以预测的事件，对航行、船员和乘客构成严重威胁。由于其突发性，早期检测是唯一有效的应对措施。然而，以往的研究主要集中于对组件的逐渐退化进行建模，而对突发和异常现象关注有限。本文提出了一种用于早期检测灾难性故障的新方法。该方法基于来自故障发动机的真实数据，评估实际传感器读数与发动机变量的预期值之间偏差的导数。预测结果由随机森林算法获得，在测试的机器学习算法中，它是最合适的。传统方法侧重于监测信号的偏差，而本文提出的方法利用偏差的导数，以更早地提供异常动态的指示，并警惕系统内正在爆发的快速且危险的事件。该方法能够在测量值达到临界阈值并触发警报之前检测到异常，而这在工业界是一种常见的做法。因此，操作人员可以提前得到警告并关闭发动机，从而防止损坏和意外的功率损失。此外，他们有时间安全地改变船舶航线，避免潜在障碍。仿真结果证实了所提出的方法在预测灾难性故障发生方面的有效性。在真实世界数据上的验证进一步增强了该方法的稳健性和实际应用性。值得注意的是，用于训练预测算法的数据采集不成问题，因为使用了基于深度学习的数据增强程序。
tldr: This paper proposes a machine learning method using Random Forest to detect catastrophic failures in marine diesel engines by analyzing the derivatives of deviations between actual and expected sensor readings. The method aims to provide earlier warnings compared to traditional threshold-based methods, enabling preventative actions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于随机森林的机器学习方法，通过分析实际传感器读数与预期值的偏差导数来检测船用柴油发动机的灾难性故障。 该方法旨在提供比传统的基于阈值的方法更早的警告，从而能够采取预防措施。

title: Optimizing Task Completion Time Updates Using POMDPs
summary: Managing announced task completion times is a fundamental control problem in project management. While extensive research exists on estimating task durations and task scheduling, the problem of when and how to update completion times communicated to stakeholders remains understudied. Organizations must balance announcement accuracy against the costs of frequent timeline updates, which can erode stakeholder trust and trigger costly replanning. Despite the prevalence of this problem, current approaches rely on static predictions or ad-hoc policies that fail to account for the sequential nature of announcement management. In this paper, we formulate the task announcement problem as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) where the control policy must decide when to update announced completion times based on noisy observations of true task completion. Since most state variables (current time and previous announcements) are fully observable, we leverage the Mixed Observability MDP (MOMDP) framework to enable more efficient policy optimization.
