Our reward structure captures the dual costs of announcement errors and update frequency, enabling synthesis of optimal announcement control policies. Using off-the-shelf solvers, we generate policies that act as feedback controllers, adaptively managing announcements based on belief state evolution. Simulation results demonstrate significant improvements in both accuracy and announcement stability compared to baseline strategies, achieving up to 75\% reduction in unnecessary updates while maintaining or improving prediction accuracy.
summary_zh: 管理已宣布的任务完成时间是项目管理中一项基本的控制问题。尽管存在大量关于估计任务持续时间和任务调度的研究，但关于何时以及如何更新传达给利益相关者的完成时间的问题仍然缺乏研究。组织必须平衡公告的准确性与频繁更新时间线的成本，频繁更新会削弱利益相关者的信任并触发代价高昂的重新计划。尽管这个问题普遍存在，但目前的方法依赖于静态预测或临时策略，而未能考虑到公告管理的顺序性。在本文中，我们将任务公告问题建模为一个部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），在该过程中，控制策略必须根据对实际任务完成时间的噪声观察来决定何时更新已宣布的完成时间。由于大多数状态变量（当前时间和先前的公告）是完全可观察的，因此我们利用混合可观察性MDP（MOMDP）框架来实现更高效的策略优化。我们的奖励结构捕获了公告错误和更新频率的双重成本，从而能够合成最佳的公告控制策略。使用现成的求解器，我们生成了作为反馈控制器运行的策略，从而能够基于信念状态的演化自适应地管理公告。与基线策略相比，仿真结果表明在准确性和公告稳定性方面都有显著提高，在保持或提高预测准确性的同时，不必要的更新减少了高达75%。
tldr: This paper formulates the problem of updating task completion times in project management as a POMDP/MOMDP and demonstrates improved accuracy and reduced update frequency compared to baseline strategies through simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文将项目管理中更新任务完成时间的问题建模为POMDP/MOMDP，并通过模拟结果表明，与基线策略相比，该方法提高了准确性并减少了更新频率。

title: Rooftop Wind Field Reconstruction Using Sparse Sensors: From Deterministic to Generative Learning Methods
summary: Real-time rooftop wind-speed distribution is important for the safe operation of drones and urban air mobility systems, wind control systems, and rooftop utilization. However, rooftop flows show strong nonlinearity, separation, and cross-direction variability, which make flow field reconstruction from sparse sensors difficult. This study develops a learning-from-observation framework using wind-tunnel experimental data obtained by Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) and compares Kriging interpolation with three deep learning models: UNet, Vision Transformer Autoencoder (ViTAE), and Conditional Wasserstein GAN (CWGAN). We evaluate two training strategies, single wind-direction training (SDT) and mixed wind-direction training (MDT), across sensor densities from 5 to 30, test robustness under sensor position perturbations of plus or minus 1 grid, and optimize sensor placement via Proper Orthogonal Decomposition with QR decomposition. Results show that deep learning methods can reconstruct rooftop wind fields from sparse sensor data effectively. Compared with Kriging interpolation, the deep learning models improved SSIM by up to 32.7%, FAC2 by 24.2%, and NMSE by 27.8%. Mixed wind-direction training further improved performance, with gains of up to 173.7% in SSIM, 16.7% in FAC2, and 98.3% in MG compared with single-direction training. The results also show that sensor configuration, optimization, and training strategy should be considered jointly for reliable deployment. QR-based optimization improved robustness by up to 27.8% under sensor perturbations, although with metric-dependent trade-offs. Training on experimental rather than simulated data also provides practical guidance for method selection and sensor placement in different scenarios.
summary_zh: 实时屋顶风速分布对于无人机和城市空中交通系统的安全运行、风力控制系统以及屋顶利用至关重要。然而，屋顶气流表现出强烈的非线性、分离和交叉方向变异性，这使得从稀疏传感器数据重建流场变得困难。本研究开发了一种基于观测学习的框架，利用粒子图像测速（PIV）获得的风洞实验数据，并将克里金插值与三种深度学习模型进行比较：UNet、视觉Transformer自编码器(ViTAE)和条件Wasserstein生成对抗网络(CWGAN)。我们评估了两种训练策略：单一风向训练（SDT）和混合风向训练（MDT），涵盖5到30的传感器密度，测试了传感器位置正负1个网格扰动下的鲁棒性，并通过基于QR分解的本征正交分解优化了传感器布局。结果表明，深度学习方法能够有效地从稀疏传感器数据中重建屋顶风场。与克里金插值相比，深度学习模型在结构相似性指数（SSIM）上提高了高达32.7%，在二倍因子（FAC2）上提高了24.2%，并在均方误差归一化(NMSE)上提高了27.8%。混合风向训练进一步提升了性能，与单风向训练相比，在SSIM上增益高达173.7%，在FAC2上增益16.7%，在几何平均数(MG)上增益98.3%。结果还表明，传感器配置、优化和训练策略应联合考虑，以实现可靠的部署。基于QR的优化将传感器扰动下的鲁棒性提高了高达27.8%，但存在指标相关的权衡。基于实验数据而非模拟数据进行训练，也为不同场景下的方法选择和传感器放置提供了实践指导。
tldr: This paper explores using deep learning models (UNet, ViTAE, CWGAN) with sparse sensor data to reconstruct rooftop wind fields, demonstrating improved performance compared to Kriging interpolation and highlighting the importance of sensor placement optimization and training strategies.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用深度学习模型（UNet, ViTAE, CWGAN）和稀疏传感器数据来重建屋顶风场， 结果表明与Kriging插值相比， 这些模型表现出更好的性能， 并强调了传感器放置优化和训练策略的重要性。

title: Wear Classification of Abrasive Flap Wheels using a Hierarchical Deep Learning Approach
summary: Abrasive flap wheels are common for finishing complex free-form surfaces due to their flexibility. However, this flexibility results in complex wear patterns such as concave/convex flap profiles or flap tears, which influence the grinding result. This paper proposes a novel, vision-based hierarchical classification framework to automate the wear condition monitoring of flap wheels. Unlike monolithic classification approaches, we decompose the problem into three logical levels: (1) state detection (new vs. worn), (2) wear type identification (rectangular, concave, convex) and flap tear detection, and (3) severity assessment (partial vs. complete deformation). A custom-built dataset of real flap wheel images was generated and a transfer learning approach with EfficientNetV2 architecture was used. The results demonstrate high robustness with classification accuracies ranging from 93.8% (flap tears) to 99.3% (concave severity). Furthermore, Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) is utilized to validate that the models learn physically relevant features and examine false classifications. The proposed hierarchical method provides a basis for adaptive process control and wear consideration in automated flap wheel grinding.
summary_zh: 磨料性叶轮由于其灵活性，常用于精加工复杂的自由曲面。然而，这种灵活性会导致复杂的磨损模式，例如凹/凸叶片轮廓或叶片撕裂，从而影响研磨结果。本文提出了一种新颖的、基于视觉的分层分类框架，以实现叶轮磨损状况的自动化监测。与整体式分类方法不同，我们将问题分解为三个逻辑层级：（1）状态检测（新的 vs. 已磨损），（2）磨损类型识别（矩形、凹形、凸形）和叶片撕裂检测，以及（3）严重程度评估（部分 vs. 完全变形）。我们构建了一个自定义的真实叶轮图像数据集，并采用了基于 EfficientNetV2 架构的迁移学习方法。结果表明，该方法具有很高的鲁棒性，分类精度范围从 93.8%（叶片撕裂）到 99.3%（凹形严重程度）。此外，利用梯度加权类激活映射 (Grad-CAM) 来验证模型是否学习到物理相关的特征，并检查错误分类的情况。所提出的分层方法为自适应过程控制和自动化叶轮研磨中的磨损考虑因素提供了基础。
tldr: This paper presents a hierarchical deep learning framework for classifying the wear condition of abrasive flap wheels based on visual inspection, achieving high accuracy in identifying wear state, type, tear detection, and severity.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于视觉检测的分层深度学习框架，用于分类磨料叶轮的磨损状况，并在识别磨损状态、类型、撕裂检测和严重程度方面实现了高精度。

title: Federated Few-Shot Learning on Neuromorphic Hardware: An Empirical Study Across Physical Edge Nodes
summary: Federated learning on neuromorphic hardware remains unexplored because on-chip spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP) produces binary weight updates rather than the floating-point gradients assumed by standard algorithms. We build a two-node federated system with BrainChip Akida AKD1000 processors and run approximately 1,580 experimental trials across seven analysis phases. Of four weight-exchange strategies tested, neuron-level concatenation (FedUnion) consistently preserves accuracy while element-wise weight averaging (FedAvg) destroys it (p = 0.002). Domain-adaptive fine-tuning of the upstream feature extractor accounts for most of the accuracy gains, confirming feature quality as the dominant factor. Scaling feature dimensionality from 64 to 256 yields 77.0% best-strategy federated accuracy (n=30, p < 0.001). Two independent asymmetries (wider features help federation more than individual learning, while binarization hurts federation more) point to a shared prototype complementarity mechanism: cross-node transfer scales with the distinctiveness of neuron prototypes.
summary_zh: 神经形态硬件上的联邦学习仍未被探索，因为片上尖峰时序依赖可塑性 (STDP) 产生的是二值权重更新，而非标准算法假设的浮点梯度。我们构建了一个具有 BrainChip Akida AKD1000 处理器的双节点联邦系统，并在七个分析阶段运行了大约 1,580 次实验试验。在测试的四种权重交换策略中，神经元级别联结 (FedUnion) 能够始终保持准确性，而逐元素权重平均 (FedAvg) 则会破坏准确性 (p = 0.002)。上游特征提取器的领域自适应微调是大部分准确度提升的原因，证实了特征质量是主导因素。将特征维度从 64 扩展到 256 可以产生 77.0% 的最佳策略联邦准确率 (n=30, p < 0.001)。 两个独立的非对称性（更宽的特征比个体学习更有助于联邦，而二值化对联邦的损害更大）指向一种共享的原型互补机制：跨节点传输随神经元原型区分度的增加而扩展。
tldr: This paper explores federated few-shot learning on neuromorphic hardware using BrainChip Akida processors, finding that neuron-level concatenation weight exchange and domain-adaptive fine-tuning significantly impact accuracy. The study reveals prototype complementarity as a key factor for cross-node transfer scaling.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用BrainChip Akida处理器在神经形态硬件上的联邦小样本学习，发现神经元级联接权重交换和领域自适应微调对准确性有显著影响。 研究表明原型互补是跨节点传输缩放的关键因素。

title: From AI Weather Prediction to Infrastructure Resilience: A Correction-Downscaling Framework for Tropical Cyclone Impacts
summary: This paper addresses a missing capability in infrastructure resilience: turning fast, global AI weather forecasts into asset-scale, actionable risk. We introduce the AI-based Correction-Downscaling Framework (ACDF), which transforms coarse AI weather prediction (AIWP) into 500-m, unbiased wind fields and transmission tower/line failure probabilities for tropical cyclones. ACDF separates storm-scale bias correction from terrain-aware downscaling, preventing error propagation while restoring sub-kilometer variability that governs structural loading. Tested on 11 typhoons affecting Zhejiang, China under leave-one-storm-out evaluation, ACDF reduces station-scale wind-speed MAE by 38.8% versus Pangu-Weather, matches observation-assimilated mesoscale analyses, yet runs in 25 s per 12-h cycle on a single GPU. In the Typhoon Hagupit case, ACDF reproduced observed high-wind tails, isolated a coastal high-risk corridor, and flagged the line that failed, demonstrating actionable guidance at tower and line scales. ACDF provides an end-to-end pathway from AI global forecasts to operational, impact-based early warning for critical infrastructure.
summary_zh: 本文旨在解决基础设施韧性方面的一个缺失能力：将快速、全局的AI天气预报转化为资产层面的、可执行的风险预警。我们提出了基于AI的校正-降尺度框架（ACDF），能够将粗糙的AI天气预测（AIWP）转化为500米分辨率的、无偏的风场以及热带气旋期间输电塔/线故障概率。ACDF将风暴尺度的偏差校正与考虑地形的降尺度分离，防止误差传播，同时恢复控制结构荷载的亚千米级变异性。经过对影响中国浙江的11个台风进行的留一风暴法评估测试，与盘古气象相比，ACDF将站点尺度的风速平均绝对误差（MAE）降低了38.8%，与经过观测同化的中尺度分析结果相匹配，且在单个GPU上运行每个12小时周期仅需25秒。在海高斯台风案例中，ACDF重现了观测到的高风速尾部，识别出沿海高风险走廊，并标记出发生故障的线路，展示了塔和线路尺度的可执行指导。ACDF提供了一条从AI全局预报到关键基础设施的、基于影响的运营级早期预警的端到端路径。
tldr: The paper introduces an AI-based correction-downscaling framework (ACDF) that refines global AI weather predictions into asset-scale, actionable risk assessments for infrastructure resilience against tropical cyclones, demonstrating significant improvements in wind field accuracy and failure prediction.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于人工智能的校正降尺度框架（ACDF），该框架将全球人工智能天气预报转化为资产尺度的、可操作的风险评估，用于基础设施在热带气旋中的弹性，并在风场精度和故障预测方面表现出显著改进。

title: SmoothVLA: Aligning Vision-Language-Action Models with Physical Constraints via Intrinsic Smoothness Optimization
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for robotic manipulation. However, existing post-training methods face a dilemma between stability and exploration: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is constrained by demonstration quality and lacks generalization, whereas Reinforcement Learning (RL) improves exploration but often induces erratic, jittery trajectories that violate physical constraints. To bridge this gap, we propose SmoothVLA, a novel reinforcement learning fine-tuning framework that synergistically optimizes task performance and motion smoothness. The technical core is a physics-informed hybrid reward function that integrates binary sparse task rewards with a continuous dense term derived from trajectory jerk. Crucially, this reward is intrinsic, that computing directly from policy rollouts, without requiring extrinsic environment feedback or laborious reward engineering. Leveraging the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), SmoothVLA establishes trajectory smoothness as an explicit optimization prior, guiding the model toward physically feasible and stable control. Extensive experiments on the LIBERO benchmark demonstrate that SmoothVLA outperforms standard RL by 13.8\% in smoothness and significantly surpasses SFT in generalization across diverse tasks. Our work offers a scalable approach to aligning VLA models with physical-world constraints through intrinsic reward optimization.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型已经成为机器人操作的强大范例。然而，现有的后训练方法面临稳定性和探索性之间的两难：监督微调 (SFT) 受限于演示质量且缺乏泛化能力，而强化学习 (RL) 虽然改进了探索，但通常会产生不稳定、抖动的轨迹，违反物理约束。为了弥合这个差距，我们提出了 SmoothVLA，一种新型的强化学习微调框架，可以协同优化任务性能和运动平滑性。其技术核心是基于物理信息的混合奖励函数，该函数将二元稀疏任务奖励与从轨迹加加速度导出的连续稠密项相结合。至关重要的是，该奖励是内在的，可以直接从策略rollout中计算，而无需外部环境反馈或费力耗时的奖励工程。利用群相对策略优化 (GRPO)，SmoothVLA 将轨迹平滑性确立为显式的优化先验，引导模型实现物理可行且稳定的控制。在 LIBERO 基准测试上的大量实验表明，SmoothVLA 在平滑度方面比标准 RL 高出 13.8\%，并且在跨多种任务的泛化能力方面显著优于 SFT。我们的工作提供了一种可扩展的方法，通过内在奖励优化使 VLA 模型与物理世界约束对齐。
tldr: SmoothVLA uses a physics-informed intrinsic reward function, based on trajectory jerk, to fine-tune VLA models via RL, improving smoothness and generalization in robotic manipulation tasks, outperforming standard RL and SFT on the LIBERO benchmark.
tldr_zh: SmoothVLA 提出了一种基于轨迹 jerk 的、物理信息驱动的内在奖励函数，通过强化学习微调 VLA 模型，从而提高机器人操作任务的平滑性和泛化性。在 LIBERO 基准测试中，该方法优于标准强化学习和监督微调。

title: ImagiNav: Scalable Embodied Navigation via Generative Visual Prediction and Inverse Dynamics
summary: Enabling robots to navigate open-world environments via natural language is critical for general-purpose autonomy. Yet, Vision-Language Navigation has relied on end-to-end policies trained on expensive, embodiment-specific robot data. While recent foundation models trained on vast simulation data show promise, the challenge of scaling and generalizing due to the limited scene diversity and visual fidelity in simulation persists. To address this gap, we propose ImagiNav, a novel modular paradigm that decouples visual planning from robot actuation, enabling the direct utilization of diverse in-the-wild navigation videos. Our framework operates as a hierarchy: a Vision-Language Model first decomposes instructions into textual subgoals; a finetuned generative video model then imagines the future video trajectory towards that subgoal; finally, an inverse dynamics model extracts the trajectory from the imagined video, which can then be tracked via a low-level controller. We additionally develop a scalable data pipeline of in-the-wild navigation videos auto-labeled via inverse dynamics and a pretrained Vision-Language Model. ImagiNav demonstrates strong zero-shot transfer to robot navigation without requiring robot demonstrations, paving the way for generalist robots that learn navigation directly from unlabeled, open-world data.
summary_zh: 实现机器人通过自然语言在开放世界环境中导航，对于通用自主性至关重要。然而，视觉-语言导航一直依赖于在昂贵的、特定于具身机器人的数据上训练的端到端策略。虽然最近在大量模拟数据上训练的基础模型显示出潜力，但由于模拟中场景多样性和视觉保真度的限制，其扩展性和泛化性仍然面临挑战。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了一种新颖的模块化范式ImagiNav，它将视觉规划与机器人驱动解耦，从而可以直接利用多样化的真实导航视频。我们的框架以层级方式运行：首先，视觉-语言模型将指令分解为文本子目标；然后，一个经过微调的生成视频模型想象实现该子目标的未来视频轨迹；最后，一个逆动力学模型从想象的视频中提取轨迹，然后可以通过低级控制器进行跟踪。我们还开发了一个可扩展的真实导航视频数据流水线，通过逆动力学和预训练的视觉-语言模型进行自动标注。ImagiNav展示了强大的零样本迁移能力，无需机器人演示即可实现机器人导航，为直接从无标注的开放世界数据中学习导航的通用机器人铺平了道路。
tldr: ImagiNav introduces a modular framework for vision-language navigation that leverages generative video models and inverse dynamics to enable zero-shot transfer to robots using unlabeled, open-world navigation videos, bypassing the need for expensive robot-specific training data.
tldr_zh: ImagiNav 引入了一个视觉-语言导航的模块化框架，利用生成视频模型和逆动力学，使机器人能够使用未标记的开放世界导航视频进行零样本迁移，从而无需昂贵的机器人专用训练数据。

title: ST-VLA: Enabling 4D-Aware Spatiotemporal Understanding for General Robot Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation in open-world environments requires reasoning across semantics, geometry, and long-horizon action dynamics. Existing hierarchical Vision-Language-Action (VLA) frameworks typically use 2D representations to connect high-level reasoning with low-level control, but lack depth awareness and temporal consistency, limiting robustness in complex 3D scenes. We propose ST-VLA, a hierarchical VLA framework using a unified 3D-4D representation to bridge perception and action. ST-VLA converts 2D guidance into 3D trajectories and generates smooth spatial masks that capture 4D spatio-temporal context, providing a stable interface between semantic reasoning and continuous control. To enable effective learning of such representations, we introduce ST-Human, a large-scale human manipulation dataset with 14 tasks and 300k episodes, annotated with 2D, 3D, and 4D supervision via a semi-automated pipeline. Using ST-Human, we train ST-VLM, a spatio-temporal vision-language model that generates spatially grounded and temporally coherent 3D representations to guide policy execution. The smooth spatial masks focus on task-relevant geometry and stabilize latent representations, enabling online replanning and long-horizon reasoning. Experiments on RLBench and real-world manipulation tasks show that \method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, improving zero-shot success rates by 44.6% and 30.3%. These results demonstrate that offloading spatio-temporal reasoning to VLMs with unified 3D-4D representations substantially improves robustness and generalization for open-world robotic manipulation. Project website: https://oucx117.github.io/ST-VLA/.
summary_zh: 在开放世界环境中，机器人操作需要对语义、几何以及长程动作动态进行推理。现有的层级式视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架通常使用2D表示来连接高层推理与低层控制，但缺乏深度感知和时间一致性，从而限制了在复杂3D场景中的鲁棒性。我们提出了ST-VLA，一种使用统一的3D-4D表示来桥接感知和动作的层级式VLA框架。ST-VLA 将2D引导转换为3D轨迹，并生成平滑的空间掩码，捕捉4D时空上下文，从而在语义推理和连续控制之间提供一个稳定的接口。为了有效学习此类表示，我们引入了ST-Human，一个大规模的人类操作数据集，包含14个任务和30万个片段，并通过半自动化流程标注了2D、3D和4D监督信息。利用ST-Human，我们训练了ST-VLM，一种时空视觉-语言模型，它可以生成空间对齐且时间连贯的3D表示来指导策略执行。平滑的空间掩码聚焦于与任务相关的几何信息，并稳定潜在表示，从而实现在线重规划和长程推理。在RLBench和真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，该方法显著优于目前最先进的基线，将零样本成功率分别提高了44.6%和30.3%。这些结果表明，通过具有统一3D-4D表示的视觉-语言模型来分担时空推理负担，可以大幅提高开放世界机器人操作的鲁棒性和泛化能力。项目网站：https://oucx117.github.io/ST-VLA/.
tldr: The paper introduces ST-VLA, a hierarchical Vision-Language-Action framework that uses a 3D-4D representation for improved spatio-temporal reasoning in robot manipulation, along with a new large-scale dataset, ST-Human, demonstrating significant performance gains in real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ST-VLA，一个分层的视觉-语言-动作框架，它使用3D-4D表示来改进机器人操纵中的时空推理，以及一个新的大规模数据集ST-Human，并在现实世界任务中展示了显著的性能提升。

title: Your Vision-Language-Action Model Already Has Attention Heads For Path Deviation Detection
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong potential for predicting semantic actions in navigation tasks, demonstrating the ability to reason over complex linguistic instructions and visual contexts. However, they are fundamentally hindered by visual-reasoning hallucinations that lead to trajectory deviations. Addressing this issue has conventionally required training external critic modules or relying on complex uncertainty heuristics. In this work, we discover that monitoring a few attention heads within a frozen VLA model can accurately detect path deviations without incurring additional computational overhead. We refer to these heads, which inherently capture the spatiotemporal causality between historical visual sequences and linguistic instructions, as Navigation Heads. Using these heads, we propose an intuitive, training-free anomaly-detection framework that monitors their signals to detect hallucinations in real time. Surprisingly, among over a thousand attention heads, a combination of just three is sufficient to achieve a 44.6 % deviation detection rate with a low false-positive rate of 11.7 %. Furthermore, upon detecting a deviation, we bypass the heavy VLA model and trigger a lightweight Reinforcement Learning (RL) policy to safely execute a shortest-path rollback. By integrating this entire detection-to-recovery pipeline onto a physical robot, we demonstrate its practical robustness. All source code will be publicly available.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在预测导航任务中的语义动作方面展现出强大的潜力，证明了其能够推理复杂的语言指令和视觉环境。然而，它们从根本上受到视觉推理幻觉的阻碍，导致轨迹偏差。解决这个问题通常需要训练外部评价模块或依赖复杂的不确定性启发式方法。在这项工作中，我们发现监控冻结的VLA模型中的少量注意力头可以准确地检测路径偏差，而不会产生额外的计算开销。我们将这些固有地捕获历史视觉序列和语言指令之间的时空因果关系的头，称为导航头。利用这些头，我们提出了一个直观的、无需训练的异常检测框架，该框架监控它们的信号以实时检测幻觉。令人惊讶的是，在一千多个注意力头中，仅三个头的组合就足以实现44.6%的偏差检测率，同时保持11.7%的低误报率。此外，在检测到偏差后，我们绕过庞大的VLA模型，并触发一个轻量级的强化学习（RL）策略，以安全地执行最短路径回滚。通过将整个检测到恢复的流程集成到物理机器人上，我们展示了其在实践中的鲁棒性。所有源代码将公开可用。
tldr: The paper presents a method to detect path deviations in Vision-Language-Action models by monitoring specific attention heads, enabling real-time anomaly detection and recovery using a lightweight RL policy, demonstrated on a physical robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通过监控特定注意力头来检测视觉-语言-动作模型中的路径偏差的方法，从而实现实时异常检测，并使用轻量级强化学习策略进行恢复，并在一个物理机器人上进行了演示。

title: vla-eval: A Unified Evaluation Harness for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision Language Action VLA models are typically evaluated using per benchmark scripts maintained independently by each model repository, leading to duplicated code, dependency conflicts, and underspecified protocols. We present vla eval, an open source evaluation harness that decouples model inference from benchmark execution through a WebSocket msgpack protocol with Docker based environment isolation. Models integrate once by implementing a single predict() method; benchmarks integrate once via a four method interface; the full cross evaluation matrix works automatically. A complete evaluation requires only two commands: vla eval serve and vla eval run. The framework supports 13 simulation benchmarks and six model servers. Parallel evaluation via episode sharding and batch inference achieves a 47x throughput improvement, completing 2000 LIBERO episodes in about 18 minutes. Using this infrastructure, we conduct a reproducibility audit of a published VLA model across three benchmarks, finding that all three closely reproduce published values while uncovering undocumented requirements ambiguous termination semantics and hidden normalization statistics that can silently distort results. We additionally release a VLA leaderboard aggregating 657 published results across 17 benchmarks. Framework, evaluation configs, and all reproduction results are publicly available.
summary_zh: 视觉语言动作(VLA)模型通常使用各个模型库独立维护的基准测试脚本进行评估，这导致代码重复、依赖冲突和协议规范不明确。我们提出了vla eval，一个开源的评估工具包，它通过基于WebSocket msgpack协议和基于Docker的环境隔离，将模型推理与基准测试执行解耦。模型只需实现一个 predict() 方法集成一次；基准测试只需实现一个包含四个方法的接口集成一次；完整的交叉评估矩阵便可自动生成。完成一次完整的评估仅需两个命令：vla eval serve 和 vla eval run。该框架支持13个模拟基准测试和6个模型服务器。通过情景分片和批量推理实现的并行评估，吞吐量提升了47倍，在约18分钟内完成了2000个LIBERO情景的模拟。利用该基础设施，我们对已发表的一个VLA模型在三个基准测试上进行了可复现性审计，发现所有三个基准测试都能近似复现已发表的值，同时揭示了未公开的要求、模糊的终止语义以及会悄然扭曲结果的隐藏归一化统计。此外，我们还发布了一个VLA排行榜，汇总了17个基准测试中发布的657个结果。框架、评估配置和所有复现结果均已公开。
tldr: The paper introduces vla-eval, a unified evaluation harness for Vision-Language-Action models, addressing reproducibility and efficiency issues in current evaluation practices by decoupling model inference from benchmark execution. It also includes a reproducibility audit and a leaderboard aggregating results.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了vla-eval，一个用于视觉-语言-动作模型的统一评估平台，通过将模型推理与基准测试执行分离，解决了当前评估实践中存在的重现性和效率问题。它还包括一项重现性审计和一个汇总结果的排行榜。

title: Amortizing Trajectory Diffusion with Keyed Drift Fields
summary: Diffusion-based trajectory planners can synthesize rich, multimodal action sequences for offline reinforcement learning, but their iterative denoising incurs substantial inference-time cost, making closed-loop planning slow under tight compute budgets. We study the problem of achieving diffusion-like trajectory planning behavior with one-step inference, while retaining the ability to sample diverse candidate plans and condition on the current state in a receding-horizon control loop. Our key observation is that conditional trajectory generation fails under naïve distribution-matching objectives when the similarity measure used to align generated trajectories with the dataset is dominated by unconstrained future dimensions. In practice, this causes attraction toward average trajectories, collapses action diversity, and yields near-static behavior. Our key insight is that conditional generative planning requires a conditioning-aware notion of neighborhood: trajectory updates should be computed using distances in a compact key space that reflects the condition, while still applying updates in the full trajectory space. Building on this, we introduce Keyed Drifting Policies (KDP), a one-step trajectory generator trained with a drift-field objective that attracts generated trajectories toward condition-matched dataset windows and repels them from nearby generated samples, using a stop-gradient drifted target to amortize iterative refinement into training. At inference, the resulting policy produces a full trajectory window in a single forward pass. Across standard RL benchmarks and real-time hardware deployments, KDP achieves strong performance with one-step inference and substantially lower planning latency than diffusion sampling. Project website, code and videos: https://keyed-drifting.github.io/
summary_zh: 基于扩散的轨迹规划器可以为离线强化学习合成丰富、多模态的动作序列，但其迭代去噪过程会产生大量的推理时间成本，导致在计算资源有限的情况下闭环规划速度缓慢。我们研究了如何通过单步推理实现类似扩散的轨迹规划行为，同时保留对多样候选方案进行采样以及在滚动时域控制循环中基于当前状态进行调节的能力。我们的主要观察是，当用于将生成轨迹与数据集对齐的相似度度量被未约束的未来维度所主导时，条件轨迹生成会在朴素的分布匹配目标下失效。在实践中，这会导致吸引力转向平均轨迹，导致动作多样性崩塌，并产生近乎静态的行为。我们的关键洞察是，条件生成规划需要一种具有条件感知性质的邻域概念：轨迹更新应该使用反映条件的紧凑密钥空间中的距离进行计算，同时仍然在完整的轨迹空间中应用更新。在此基础上，我们引入了密钥漂移策略（KDP），这是一种使用漂移场目标训练的单步轨迹生成器，该目标将生成的轨迹吸引到条件匹配的数据集窗口，并使用停止梯度漂移目标将它们排斥出附近的生成样本，从而将迭代精炼分摊到训练过程中。在推理时，生成的策略在单个前向传递中产生完整的轨迹窗口。在标准强化学习基准和实时硬件部署中，KDP通过单步推理实现了强大的性能，并且规划延迟远低于扩散采样。项目网站、代码和视频：https://keyed-drifting.github.io/
tldr: This paper introduces Keyed Drifting Policies (KDP), a one-step trajectory generator leveraging a drift-field objective for efficient diffusion-like trajectory planning in reinforcement learning, demonstrating strong performance and lower latency than diffusion sampling.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Keyed Drifting Policies (KDP)，一种单步轨迹生成器，利用漂移场目标函数在强化学习中实现高效的类扩散轨迹规划，与扩散采样相比，表现出强大的性能和更低的延迟。

title: URDF-Anything+: Autoregressive Articulated 3D Models Generation for Physical Simulation
summary: Articulated objects are fundamental for robotics, simulation of physics, and interactive virtual environments. However, reconstructing them from visual input remains challenging, as it requires jointly inferring both part geometry and kinematic structure. We present, an end-to-end autoregressive framework that directly generates executable articulated object models from visual observations. Given image and object-level 3D cues, our method sequentially produces part geometries and their associated joint parameters, resulting in complete URDF models without reliance on multi-stage pipelines. The generation proceeds until the model determines that all parts have been produced, automatically inferring complete geometry and kinematics. Building on this capability, we enable a new Real-Follow-Sim paradigm, where high-fidelity digital twins constructed from visual observations allow policies trained and tested purely in simulation to transfer to real robots without online adaptation. Experiments on large-scale articulated object benchmarks and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that outperforms prior methods in geometric reconstruction quality, joint parameter accuracy, and physical executability.
summary_zh: 关节物体是机器人学、物理模拟和交互式虚拟环境的基础。然而，从视觉输入中重建它们仍然具有挑战性，因为它需要联合推断部件几何形状和运动学结构。我们提出了一种端到端的自回归框架，可以直接从视觉观测中生成可执行的关节物体模型。给定图像和物体级别的3D线索，我们的方法依次生成部件几何形状及其相关的关节参数，从而生成完整的URDF模型，而无需依赖多阶段流程。生成过程会一直持续到模型确定所有部件都已生成完毕，从而自动推断出完整的几何形状和运动学。基于这种能力，我们实现了一种新的实物-跟随-模拟范式，其中从视觉观测构建的高保真数字孪生体允许纯粹在模拟中训练和测试的策略无需在线适应即可转移到真实机器人上。在大型关节物体基准测试和真实机器人任务上的实验表明，我们的模型在几何重建质量、关节参数精度和物理可执行性方面均优于现有方法。
tldr: The paper presents an autoregressive framework, URDF-Anything+, for generating executable articulated object models from visual observations, enabling Real-Follow-Sim and demonstrating improved performance on robotic tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个自回归框架URDF-Anything+，用于从视觉观察中生成可执行的铰接物体模型，实现了Real-Follow-Sim，并在机器人任务中表现出更好的性能。

title: Pixel-level Scene Understanding in One Token: Visual States Need What-is-Where Composition
summary: For robotic agents operating in dynamic environments, learning visual state representations from streaming video observations is essential for sequential decision making. Recent self-supervised learning methods have shown strong transferability across vision tasks, but they do not explicitly address what a good visual state should encode. We argue that effective visual states must capture what-is-where by jointly encoding the semantic identities of scene elements and their spatial locations, enabling reliable detection of subtle dynamics across observations. To this end, we propose CroBo, a visual state representation learning framework based on a global-to-local reconstruction objective. Given a reference observation compressed into a compact bottleneck token, CroBo learns to reconstruct heavily masked patches in a local target crop from sparse visible cues, using the global bottleneck token as context. This learning objective encourages the bottleneck token to encode a fine-grained representation of scene-wide semantic entities, including their identities, spatial locations, and configurations. As a result, the learned visual states reveal how scene elements move and interact over time, supporting sequential decision making. We evaluate CroBo on diverse vision-based robot policy learning benchmarks, where it achieves state-of-the-art performance. Reconstruction analyses and perceptual straightness experiments further show that the learned representations preserve pixel-level scene composition and encode what-moves-where across observations.
summary_zh: 对于在动态环境中运行的机器人代理，从流式视频观测中学习视觉状态表示对于序列决策至关重要。 近期自监督学习方法已展现出在视觉任务中的强大泛化能力，但它们并未明确解决一个良好的视觉状态应编码哪些信息的问题。 我们认为，有效的视觉状态必须通过联合编码场景元素的语义身份及其空间位置来捕捉“what-is-where”，从而能够可靠地检测跨观测的细微动态。 为此，我们提出 CroBo，一个基于全局到局部重建目标的视觉状态表示学习框架。 给定一个压缩为紧凑瓶颈令牌的参考观测，CroBo学习在稀疏可见线索的帮助下，从局部目标裁剪中重建严重掩蔽的图像块，并将全局瓶颈令牌用作上下文。 这种学习目标鼓励瓶颈令牌编码场景范围语义实体的精细表示，包括它们的身份、空间位置和配置。 因此，学习到的视觉状态揭示了场景元素如何随时间移动和交互，从而支持序列决策。 我们在各种基于视觉的机器人策略学习基准上评估了CroBo，并取得了最先进的性能。 重建分析和感知直线度实验进一步表明，学习到的表示保留了像素级别的场景构成，并编码了跨观测的“what-moves-where”。
tldr: The paper introduces CroBo, a self-supervised visual state representation learning framework that uses a global-to-local reconstruction objective to learn detailed scene representations for robotic agents, achieving state-of-the-art performance in vision-based robot policy learning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 CroBo，一个自监督视觉状态表征学习框架，它使用全局到局部的重建目标来学习用于机器人的详细场景表征，并在基于视觉的机器人策略学习中取得了最先进的性能。

title: Fine-tuning is Not Enough: A Parallel Framework for Collaborative Imitation and Reinforcement Learning in End-to-end Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving is typically built upon imitation learning (IL), yet its performance is constrained by the quality of human demonstrations. To overcome this limitation, recent methods incorporate reinforcement learning (RL) through sequential fine-tuning. However, such a paradigm remains suboptimal: sequential RL fine-tuning can introduce policy drift and often leads to a performance ceiling due to its dependence on the pretrained IL policy. To address these issues, we propose PaIR-Drive, a general Parallel framework for collaborative Imitation and Reinforcement learning in end-to-end autonomous driving. During training, PaIR-Drive separates IL and RL into two parallel branches with conflict-free training objectives, enabling fully collaborative optimization. This design eliminates the need to retrain RL when applying a new IL policy. During inference, RL leverages the IL policy to further optimize the final plan, allowing performance beyond prior knowledge of IL. Furthermore, we introduce a tree-structured trajectory neural sampler to group relative policy optimization (GRPO) in the RL branch, which enhances exploration capability. Extensive analysis on NAVSIMv1 and v2 benchmark demonstrates that PaIR-Drive achieves Competitive performance of 91.2 PDMS and 87.9 EPDMS, building upon Transfuser and DiffusionDrive IL baselines. PaIR-Drive consistently outperforms existing RL fine-tuning methods, and could even correct human experts' suboptimal behaviors. Qualitative results further confirm that PaIR-Drive can effectively explore and generate high-quality trajectories.
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶通常建立在模仿学习（IL）的基础上，但其性能受到人类示范质量的限制。为了克服这一局限，最近的方法通过序贯微调融入了强化学习（RL）。然而，这种范式仍然不是最优的：序贯式RL微调可能会引入策略漂移，并且由于其对预训练IL策略的依赖，常常导致性能达到瓶颈。为了解决这些问题，我们提出PaIR-Drive，一种通用的并行框架，用于端到端自动驾驶中模仿学习和强化学习的协同训练。在训练期间，PaIR-Drive将IL和RL分离成两个具有无冲突训练目标的并行分支，从而实现完全协同优化。这种设计消除了在应用新的IL策略时重新训练RL的需求。在推理期间，RL利用IL策略进一步优化最终规划，使得性能超越了IL的先验知识。此外，我们引入了一种树状结构的轨迹神经采样器，以在RL分支中分组相对策略优化（GRPO），从而增强探索能力。在NAVSIMv1和v2基准测试上的广泛分析表明，PaIR-Drive在Transfuser和DiffusionDrive IL基线的基础上，达到了具有竞争力的性能，分别为91.2的PDMS和87.9的EPDMS。PaIR-Drive始终优于现有的RL微调方法，甚至可以纠正人类专家的次优行为。定性结果进一步证实，PaIR-Drive可以有效地探索并生成高质量的轨迹。
tldr: The paper introduces PaIR-Drive, a parallel imitation and reinforcement learning framework for end-to-end autonomous driving that overcomes the limitations of sequential fine-tuning approaches by enabling collaborative optimization and enhanced exploration.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了PaIR-Drive，一个并行的模仿学习和强化学习框架，用于端到端自动驾驶。该框架通过实现协同优化和增强探索能力，克服了顺序微调方法的局限性。

title: Building Explicit World Model for Zero-Shot Open-World Object Manipulation
summary: Open-world object manipulation remains a fundamental challenge in robotics. While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated promising results, they rely heavily on large-scale robot action demonstrations, which are costly to collect and can hinder out-of-distribution generalization. In this paper, we propose an explicit-world-model-based framework for open-world manipulation that achieves zero-shot generalization by constructing a physically grounded digital twin of the environment. The framework integrates open-set perception, digital-twin reconstruction, sampling and evaluation of interaction strategies. By constructing a digital twin of the environment, our approach efficiently explores and evaluates manipulation strategies in physic-enabled simulator and reliably deploys the chosen strategy to the real world. Experimentally, the proposed framework is able to perform multiple open-set manipulation tasks without any task-specific action demonstrations, proving strong zero-shot generalization on both the task and object levels. Project Page: https://bojack-bj.github.io/projects/thesis/
summary_zh: 开放世界物体操作仍然是机器人领域的一个根本挑战。虽然视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已展现出令人鼓舞的结果，但它们严重依赖于大规模的机器人动作演示，这些演示收集成本高昂并且会阻碍分布外泛化。本文提出了一种基于显式世界模型的开放世界操作框架，该框架通过构建一个具有物理基础的环境数字孪生来实现零样本泛化。该框架集成了开放集感知、数字孪生重建、交互策略的采样与评估。通过构建环境的数字孪生，我们的方法能够在物理引擎驱动的仿真器中高效地探索和评估操作策略，并将选定的策略可靠地部署到现实世界。实验表明，所提出的框架能够在没有任何特定任务动作演示的情况下执行多个开放集操作任务，证明了在任务和对象层面上强大的零样本泛化能力。项目主页：https://bojack-bj.github.io/projects/thesis/
tldr: This paper proposes a framework for zero-shot open-world object manipulation by building a physically grounded digital twin, enabling efficient exploration and evaluation of manipulation strategies in simulation before deployment to the real world.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于物理仿真的数字孪生框架，用于零样本开放世界物体操作，通过在仿真环境中高效探索和评估操作策略，然后部署到现实世界。

title: KoopmanFlow: Spectrally Decoupled Generative Control Policy via Koopman Structural Bias
summary: Generative Control Policies (GCPs) show immense promise in robotic manipulation but struggle to simultaneously model stable global motions and high-frequency local corrections. While modern architectures extract multi-scale spatial features, their underlying Probability Flow ODEs apply a uniform temporal integration schedule. Compressed to a single step for real-time Receding Horizon Control (RHC), uniform ODE solvers mathematically smooth over sparse, high-frequency transients entangled within low-frequency steady states. To decouple these dynamics without accumulating pipelined errors, we introduce KoopmanFlow, a parameter-efficient generative policy guided by a Koopman-inspired structural inductive bias. Operating in a unified multimodal latent space with visual context, KoopmanFlow bifurcates generation at the terminal stage. Because visual conditioning occurs before spectral decomposition, both branches are visually guided yet temporally specialized. A macroscopic branch anchors slow-varying trajectories via single-step Consistency Training, while a transient branch uses Flow Matching to isolate high-frequency residuals stimulated by sudden visual cues (e.g., contacts or occlusions). Guided by an explicit spectral prior and optimized via a novel asymmetric consistency objective, KoopmanFlow establishes a fused co-training mechanism. This allows the variant branch to absorb localized dynamics without multi-stage error accumulation. Extensive experiments show KoopmanFlow significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in contact-rich tasks requiring agile disturbance rejection. By trading a surplus latency buffer for a richer structural prior, KoopmanFlow achieves superior control fidelity and parameter efficiency within real-time deployment limits.
summary_zh: 生成控制策略（GCPs）在机器人操作方面展现出巨大潜力，但难以同时建模稳定的全局运动和高频局部修正。尽管现代架构提取了多尺度空间特征，但其底层概率流常微分方程（Probability Flow ODEs）应用了统一的时间积分方案。为了用于实时后退水平线控制（RHC），压缩到单步求解时，统一常微分方程求解器在数学上平滑处理了低频稳态中缠绕的稀疏高频瞬态。为了解耦这些动力学，同时避免累积流水线错误，我们引入了KoopmanFlow，一种由Koopman启发的结构性归纳偏置引导的 parameter-efficient 生成策略。KoopmanFlow在具有视觉上下文的统一多模态潜在空间中运行，在终端阶段对生成进行分叉。由于视觉条件反射发生在谱分解之前，因此两个分支都是视觉引导的，但时间上是特化的。宏观分支通过单步一致性训练（Consistency Training）来锚定缓慢变化的轨迹，而瞬态分支使用流匹配（Flow Matching）来隔离由突然视觉提示（例如，接触或遮挡）刺激的高频残差。在显式谱先验的指导下，并通过一种新颖的非对称一致性目标进行优化，KoopmanFlow建立了一种融合的协同训练机制。这使得变体分支能够吸收局部动力学，而无需多阶段误差累积。大量实验表明，在需要敏捷干扰抑制的富含接触任务中，KoopmanFlow明显优于最先进的基线方法。通过用更丰富的结构先验换取过剩的延迟缓冲区，KoopmanFlow在实时部署限制内实现了卓越的控制保真度和参数效率。
tldr: KoopmanFlow introduces a generative control policy with a Koopman-inspired structural bias, separating stable global motions and high-frequency local corrections for real-time robotic control, achieving superior control fidelity and parameter efficiency.
tldr_zh: KoopmanFlow 引入了一种具有 Koopman 结构偏见的生成控制策略，可分离稳定全局运动和高频局部校正，用于实时机器人控制，从而实现卓越的控制保真度和参数效率。

title: Exploration-assisted Bottleneck Transition Toward Robust and Data-efficient Deformable Object Manipulation
summary: Imitation learning has demonstrated impressive results in robotic manipulation but fails under out-of-distribution (OOD) states. This limitation is particularly critical in Deformable Object Manipulation (DOM), where the near-infinite possible configurations render comprehensive data collection infeasible. Although several methods address OOD states, they typically require exhaustive data or highly precise perception. Such requirements are often impractical for DOM owing to its inherent complexities, including self-occlusion. To address the OOD problem in DOM, we propose a novel framework, Exploration-assisted Bottleneck Transition for Deformable Object Manipulation (ExBot), which addresses the OOD challenge through two key advantages. First, we introduce bottleneck states, standardized configurations that serve as starting points for task execution. This enables the reconceptualization of OOD challenges as the problem of transitioning diverse initial states to these bottleneck states, significantly reducing demonstration requirements. Second, to account for imperfect perception, we partition the OOD state space based on recognizability and employ dual action primitives. This approach enables ExBot to manipulate even unrecognizable states without requiring accurate perception. By concentrating demonstrations around bottleneck states and leveraging exploration to alter perceptual conditions, ExBot achieves both data efficiency and robustness to severe OOD scenarios. Real-world experiments on rope and cloth manipulation demonstrate successful task completion from diverse OOD states, including severe self-occlusions.
summary_zh: 模仿学习在机器人操作中表现出令人瞩目的成果，但在分布外（OOD）状态下会失效。这种局限性在可变形物体操作（DOM）中尤为关键，因为近乎无限的可能配置使得全面的数据收集变得不可行。虽然一些方法解决了OOD状态问题，但它们通常需要详尽的数据或高度精确的感知。由于DOM固有的复杂性，包括自遮挡，这些要求通常是不切实际的。为了解决DOM中的OOD问题，我们提出了一种新颖的框架，即用于可变形物体操作的探索辅助瓶颈过渡（ExBot），该框架通过两个关键优势解决了OOD挑战。首先，我们引入了瓶颈状态，即作为任务执行起点的标准化配置。这使得我们可以将OOD挑战重新概念化为将各种初始状态过渡到这些瓶颈状态的问题，从而显著降低了演示需求。其次，为了应对不完美的感知，我们基于可识别性划分OOD状态空间并采用双重行动原语。这种方法使ExBot即使在无法识别的状态下也能进行操作，而无需准确的感知。通过将演示集中在瓶颈状态周围并利用探索来改变感知条件，ExBot实现了数据效率和对严重OOD场景的鲁棒性。在绳索和布料操作的真实世界实验中，ExBot展示了从各种OOD状态（包括严重的自遮挡）成功完成任务的能力。
tldr: The paper introduces ExBot, a framework for robust and data-efficient deformable object manipulation that uses bottleneck states and exploration to handle out-of-distribution scenarios, demonstrating success in real-world rope and cloth manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 ExBot，一个用于鲁棒和数据高效的可变形物体操作框架，通过使用瓶颈状态和探索来处理分布外场景，并在现实世界的绳索和织物操作任务中取得了成功。

title: Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Real-time Generative Model Predictive Control
summary: Diffusion-based models have recently shown strong performance in trajectory planning, as they are capable of capturing diverse, multimodal distributions of complex behaviors. A key limitation of these models is their slow inference speed, which results from the iterative denoising process. This makes them less suitable for real-time applications such as closed-loop model predictive control (MPC), where plans must be generated quickly and adapted continuously to a changing environment. In this paper, we investigate Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation (IMLE) as an alternative generative modeling approach for planning. IMLE offers strong mode coverage while enabling inference that is two orders of magnitude faster, making it particularly well suited for real-time MPC tasks. Our results demonstrate that IMLE achieves competitive performance on standard offline reinforcement learning benchmarks compared to the standard diffusion-based planner, while substantially improving planning speed in both open-loop and closed-loop settings. We further validate IMLE in a closed-loop human navigation scenario, operating in real-time, demonstrating how it enables rapid and adaptive plan generation in dynamic environments.
summary_zh: 基于扩散的模型最近在轨迹规划中表现出强大的性能，因为它们能够捕获复杂行为的多样性、多模态分布。这些模型的一个关键限制是其缓慢的推理速度，这是由迭代去噪过程导致的。这使得它们不太适合实时应用，例如闭环模型预测控制 (MPC)，在其中必须快速生成计划并持续适应不断变化的环境。在本文中，我们研究了隐式最大似然估计 (IMLE) 作为规划的一种替代生成建模方法。IMLE 提供了强大的模式覆盖，同时使推理速度提高两个数量级，使其特别适合实时 MPC 任务。我们的结果表明，与标准的基于扩散的规划器相比，IMLE 在标准离线强化学习基准测试中实现了具有竞争力的性能，同时在开环和闭环环境中都显著提高了规划速度。我们进一步通过实时运行的闭环人类导航场景验证了 IMLE，展示了它如何在动态环境中实现快速和自适应的计划生成。
tldr: This paper introduces Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation (IMLE) as a faster alternative to diffusion models for real-time Model Predictive Control (MPC), demonstrating competitive offline RL performance and real-time closed-loop human navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种隐式最大似然估计 (IMLE) 方法，作为扩散模型在实时模型预测控制 (MPC) 中的更快替代方案，展示了具有竞争力的离线 RL 性能和实时闭环人类导航。

title: REFINE-DP: Diffusion Policy Fine-tuning for Humanoid Loco-manipulation via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated high-level motion plans with stable, low-level whole-body execution under complex robot-environment dynamics and long-horizon tasks. While diffusion policies (DPs) show promise for learning from demonstrations, deploying them on humanoids poses critical challenges: the motion planner trained offline is decoupled from the low-level controller, leading to poor command tracking, compounding distribution shift, and task failures. The common approach of scaling demonstration data is prohibitively expensive for high-dimensional humanoid systems. To address this challenge, we present REFINE-DP (REinforcement learning FINE-tuning of Diffusion Policy), a hierarchical framework that jointly optimizes a DP high-level planner and an RL-based low-level loco-manipulation controller. The DP is fine-tuned via a PPO-based diffusion policy gradient to improve task success rate, while the controller is simultaneously updated to accurately track the planner's evolving command distribution, reducing the distributional mismatch that degrades motion quality. We validate REFINE-DP on a humanoid robot performing loco-manipulation tasks, including door traversal and long-horizon object transport. REFINE-DP achieves an over $90\%$ success rate in simulation, even in out-of-distribution cases not seen in the pre-trained data, and enables smooth autonomous task execution in real-world dynamic environments. Our proposed method substantially outperforms pre-trained DP baselines and demonstrates that RL fine-tuning is key to reliable humanoid loco-manipulation. https://refine-dp.github.io/REFINE-DP/
summary_zh: 人形机器人的移动操控需要在复杂的机器人-环境动力学和长时程任务下，通过协调的高级运动规划和稳定的低级全身执行来实现。虽然扩散策略（DPs）在模仿学习方面展现出潜力，但将其部署在人形机器人上仍面临严峻挑战：离线训练的运动规划器与低级控制器解耦，导致指令跟踪效果差、分布偏移累积以及任务失败。而对于高维人形机器人系统，常见的扩展演示数据的方法成本过高。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了REFINE-DP（基于强化学习微调的扩散策略），一个联合优化DP高级规划器和基于RL的低级移动操控控制器的分层框架。通过基于PPO的扩散策略梯度微调DP，以提高任务成功率，同时更新控制器以精确跟踪规划器不断演变的指令分布，从而减少降低运动质量的分布不匹配。 我们在人形机器人上执行移动操控任务（包括穿越门和长时程物体运输）验证了REFINE-DP的有效性。REFINE-DP在仿真中实现了超过$90\%$的成功率，即使在预训练数据中未见过的分布外情况下也是如此，并能够在真实世界的动态环境中实现平稳的自主任务执行。我们提出的方法显著优于预训练的DP基线，并证明了RL微调是可靠的人形机器人移动操控的关键。
tldr: REFINE-DP uses reinforcement learning to fine-tune diffusion policies for high-level planning alongside a low-level controller for humanoid loco-manipulation, showing improved success rates in simulation and real-world environments.
tldr_zh: REFINE-DP 使用强化学习来微调扩散策略，用于高级规划，同时结合低级控制器进行人形机器人loco-manipulation，在模拟和实际环境中都显示出更高的成功率。

title: SAATT Nav: a Socially Aware Autonomous Transparent Transportation Navigation Framework for Wheelchairs
summary: While powered wheelchairs reduce physical fatigue as opposed to manual wheelchairs for individuals with mobility impairment, they demand high cognitive workload due to information processing, decision making and motor coordination. Current autonomous systems lack social awareness in navigation and transparency in decision-making, leading to decreased perceived safety and trust from the user and others in context. This work proposes Socially Aware Autonomous Transparent Transportation (SAATT) Navigation framework for wheelchairs as a potential solution. By implementing a Large Language Model (LLM) informed of user intent and capable of predicting other peoples' intent as a decision-maker for its local controller, it is able to detect and navigate social situations, such as passing pedestrians or a pair conversing. Furthermore, the LLM textually communicates its reasoning at each waypoint for transparency. In this experiment, it is compared against a standard global planner, a representative competing social navigation model, and an Ablation study in three simulated environments varied by social levels in eight metrics categorized under Safety, Social Compliance, Efficiency, and Comfort. Overall, SAATT Nav outperforms in most social situations and equivalently or only slightly worse in the remaining metrics, demonstrating the potential of a socially aware and transparent autonomous navigation system to assist wheelchair users.
summary_zh: 针对行动障碍人士而言，电动轮椅相比手动轮椅能减少体力消耗，但也因信息处理、决策制定和运动协调而带来较高的认知负荷。目前现有的自主系统在导航方面缺乏社会意识，决策过程缺乏透明度，导致用户和其他人对其感知的安全性和信任度降低。本研究提出了一种轮椅的社会感知自主透明运输(SAATT)导航框架，作为潜在的解决方案。该框架通过实施一个大型语言模型(LLM)，该模型了解用户的意图，并能够预测其他人的意图，作为其局部控制器的决策者，从而能够检测和导航诸如行人通过或两人交谈等社会场景。此外，LLM以文本形式沟通其在每个航路点的推理，以提高透明度。 在本实验中，在三种具有不同社交水平的模拟环境中，通过安全性、社会合规性、效率和舒适性四大类别的八个指标，将其与标准全局规划器、一个代表性的竞争性社交导航模型以及一项消融研究进行了比较。总体而言，SAATT Nav在大多数社交场景中表现优异，在剩余指标中表现相当或仅略逊一筹，证明了社会感知和透明的自主导航系统在辅助轮椅使用者方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces SAATT Nav, a wheelchair navigation framework using an LLM to achieve socially aware and transparent autonomous navigation, outperforming existing methods in simulated social scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了SAATT Nav，一个使用LLM来实现社会感知和透明自主导航的轮椅导航框架，在模拟的社交场景中优于现有方法。

title: Beyond Binary Success: Sample-Efficient and Statistically Rigorous Robot Policy Comparison
summary: Generalist robot manipulation policies are becoming increasingly capable, but are limited in evaluation to a small number of hardware rollouts. This strong resource constraint in real-world testing necessitates both more informative performance measures and reliable and efficient evaluation procedures to properly assess model capabilities and benchmark progress in the field. This work presents a novel framework for robot policy comparison that is sample-efficient, statistically rigorous, and applicable to a broad set of evaluation metrics used in practice. Based on safe, anytime-valid inference (SAVI), our test procedure is sequential, allowing the evaluator to stop early when sufficient statistical evidence has accumulated to reach a decision at a pre-specified level of confidence. Unlike previous work developed for binary success, our unified approach addresses a wide range of informative metrics: from discrete partial credit task progress to continuous measures of episodic reward or trajectory smoothness, spanning both parametric and nonparametric comparison problems. Through extensive validation on simulated and real-world evaluation data, we demonstrate up to 70% reduction in evaluation burden compared to standard batch methods and up to 50% reduction compared to state-of-the-art sequential procedures designed for binary outcomes, with no loss of statistical rigor. Notably, our empirical results show that competing policies can be separated more quickly when using fine-grained task progress than binary success metrics.
summary_zh: 通用机器人操作策略正变得越来越强大，但其评估通常受限于少量硬件实验。现实世界测试中的这种强烈资源约束要求采用更具信息量的性能指标以及可靠高效的评估程序，以正确评估模型能力并衡量该领域的进展。本文提出了一种新颖的机器人策略比较框架，该框架具有样本高效性、统计严谨性，且适用于实践中使用的广泛评估指标。基于安全的、随时有效的推理 (SAVI)，我们的测试程序是顺序的，允许评估者在积累了足够的统计证据以达到预先设定的置信水平时提前停止。与之前针对二元成功的研究不同，我们统一的方法涵盖了各种信息量大的指标：从离散的部分得分任务进度到连续的片段奖励或轨迹平滑度度量，涵盖了参数和非参数比较问题。通过对模拟和真实世界评估数据的广泛验证，我们证明与标准批量方法相比，评估负担减少了高达 70%，与专为二元结果设计的最新顺序程序相比，评估负担减少了高达 50%，且没有损失统计严谨性。值得注意的是，我们的经验结果表明，与二元成功指标相比，使用细粒度的任务进度可以更快地分离竞争策略。
tldr: This paper introduces a sample-efficient, statistically rigorous sequential testing framework for robot policy comparison using a wider range of performance metrics than binary success, achieving significant reduction in evaluation burden.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种样本高效、统计严格的序贯测试框架，用于机器人策略比较，该框架使用比二元成功更广泛的性能指标，并显著降低了评估负担。

title: Egocentric World Model for Photorealistic Hand-Object Interaction Synthesis
summary: To serve as a scalable data source for embodied AI, world models should act as true simulators that infer interaction dynamics strictly from user actions, rather than mere conditional video generators relying on privileged future object states. In this context, egocentric Human-Object Interaction (HOI) world models are critical for predicting physically grounded first-person rollouts. However, building such models is profoundly challenging due to rapid head motions, severe occlusions, and high-DoF hand articulations that abruptly alter contact topologies. Consequently, existing approaches often circumvent these physics challenges by resorting to conditional video generation with access to known future object trajectories. We introduce EgoHOI, an egocentric HOI world model that breaks away from this shortcut to simulate photorealistic, contact-consistent interactions from action signals alone. To ensure physical accuracy without future-state inputs, EgoHOI distills geometric and kinematic priors from 3D estimates into physics-informed embeddings. These embeddings regularize the egocentric rollouts toward physically valid dynamics. Experiments on the HOT3D dataset demonstrate consistent gains over strong baselines, and ablations validate the effectiveness of our physics-informed design.
summary_zh: 为了满足具身人工智能的可扩展数据源需求，世界模型应当发挥真实模拟器的作用，严格地根据用户动作推断交互动力学，而非仅仅依赖特权未来的对象状态的条件视频生成器。在此背景下，以自我为中心的人-物体交互 (HOI) 世界模型对于预测物理上合理的的第一人称展开至关重要。然而，构建此类模型极具挑战性，因为快速的头部运动、严重的遮挡以及高自由度 (DoF) 的手部关节运动会突然改变接触拓扑。因此，现有的方法通常通过访问已知的未来对象轨迹，转而进行条件视频生成来规避这些物理挑战。我们提出了 EgoHOI，一个以自我为中心的 HOI 世界模型，它摒弃了这种捷径，仅从动作信号模拟出逼真的、接触一致的交互。为了确保物理准确性且无需未来的状态输入，EgoHOI 将来自 3D 估计的几何和运动学先验知识提炼成物理信息嵌入。这些嵌入将以自我为中心的场景展开规范化，使其朝向物理上有效的动力学方向发展。在 HOT3D 数据集上的实验表明，EgoHOI 相对于强大的基线模型具有持续的优势，并且消融实验验证了我们基于物理信息的设计的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces EgoHOI, a novel egocentric Human-Object Interaction (HOI) world model that simulates photorealistic and physically plausible interactions from action signals alone, overcoming limitations of existing methods that rely on future object state information.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EgoHOI，一种新颖的以自我为中心的Human-Object Interaction（HOI）世界模型，它仅从动作信号模拟逼真且物理上合理的交互，克服了现有依赖于未来对象状态信息的方法的局限性。

title: Learning Actionable Manipulation Recovery via Counterfactual Failure Synthesis
summary: While recent foundation models have significantly advanced robotic manipulation, these systems still struggle to autonomously recover from execution errors. Current failure-learning paradigms rely on either costly and unsafe real-world data collection or simulator-based perturbations, which introduce a severe sim-to-real gap. Furthermore, existing visual analyzers predominantly output coarse, binary diagnoses rather than the executable, trajectory-level corrections required for actual recovery. To bridge the gap between failure diagnosis and actionable recovery, we introduce Dream2Fix, a framework that synthesizes photorealistic, counterfactual failure rollouts directly from successful real-world demonstrations. By perturbing actions within a generative world model, Dream2Fix creates paired failure-correction data without relying on simulators. To ensure the generated data is physically viable for robot learning, we implement a structured verification mechanism that strictly filters rollouts for task validity, visual coherence, and kinematic safety. This engine produces a high-fidelity dataset of over 120k paired samples. Using this dataset, we fine-tune a vision-language model to jointly predict failure types and precise recovery trajectories, mapping visual anomalies directly to corrective actions. Extensive real-world robotic experiments show our approach achieves state-of-the-art correction accuracy, improving from 19.7% to 81.3% over prior baselines, and successfully enables zero-shot closed-loop failure recovery in physical deployments.
summary_zh: 尽管近期的基础模型显著推进了机器人操作，但这些系统在自主地从执行错误中恢复方面仍然存在困难。当前的失败学习范式依赖于代价高昂且不安全的真实世界数据收集，或者基于模拟器的扰动，而这会引入严重的模拟到真实世界的鸿沟。此外，现有的视觉分析器主要输出粗略的、二元的诊断结果，而非实际恢复所需的、轨迹级别的可执行修正方案。为弥合失败诊断和可执行恢复之间的差距，我们提出了Dream2Fix，一个直接从成功的真实世界演示中合成逼真的、反事实的失败推演的框架。通过在生成式世界模型中扰动动作，Dream2Fix无需依赖模拟器即可创建成对的失败-修正数据。为了确保生成的数据在物理上对机器人学习可行，我们实施了一个结构化的验证机制，严格筛选推演，以保证任务有效性、视觉一致性和运动学安全性。该引擎生成了一个超过12万个成对样本的高保真数据集。利用该数据集，我们对一个带有视觉-语言的模型进行微调，以联合预测失败类型和精确的恢复轨迹，从而将视觉异常直接映射到修正动作。广泛的真实世界机器人实验表明，我们的方法实现了最先进的修正精度，相比之前的基线从19.7%提高到81.3%，并成功地在物理部署中实现了零样本的闭环失败恢复。
tldr: The paper introduces Dream2Fix, a framework that uses a generative world model to synthesize photorealistic failure-correction data from successful real-world demonstrations, enabling robots to autonomously recover from execution errors with improved accuracy and zero-shot capability.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为Dream2Fix的框架，它利用生成式世界模型从成功的现实世界演示中合成逼真的失败-校正数据，使机器人能够自主地从执行错误中恢复，并提高准确性以及实现零样本能力。

title: Safety-guaranteed and Goal-oriented Semantic Sensing, Communication, and Control for Robotics
summary: Wirelessly-connected robotic system empowers robots with real-time intelligence by leveraging remote computing resources for decision-making. However, the data exchange between robots and base stations often overwhelms communication links, introducing latency that undermines real-time response. To tackle this, goal-oriented semantic communication (GSC) has been introduced into wirelessly-connected robotic systems to extract and transmit only goal-relevant semantic representations, enhancing communication efficiency and task effectiveness. However, existing GSC approaches focused primarily on optimizing effectiveness metrics while overlooking safety requirements, which should be treated as the top priority in real-world robotic systems. To bridge this gap, we propose safety-guaranteed and goal-oriented semantic communication for wirelessly-connected robotic system, aiming to maximize the robotic task effectiveness subject to practical operational safety requirements. We first summarize the general safety requirements and effectiveness metrics across typical robotic tasks, including robot arm grasping, unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-assisted tasks, and multi-robot exploration. We then systematically analyze the unique safety and effectiveness challenges faced by wirelessly-connected robotic system in sensing, communication, and control. Based on these, we further present potential safety-guaranteed and goal-oriented sensing, communication, and control solutions. Finally, a UAV target tracking case study validates that our proposed GSC solutions can significantly improve safety rate and tracking success rate by more than 2 times and 4.5 times, respectively.
summary_zh: 无线连接机器人系统通过利用远程计算资源进行决策，赋予机器人实时智能。然而，机器人和基站之间的数据交换常常使通信链路不堪重负，引入延迟，从而损害实时响应。为了解决这个问题，面向目标的语义通信 (GSC) 被引入无线连接机器人系统，以提取和传输仅与目标相关的语义表示，从而提高通信效率和任务有效性。然而，现有的 GSC 方法主要侧重于优化有效性指标，而忽略了安全要求，而在实际机器人系统中，安全要求应被视为首要任务。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了用于无线连接机器人系统的安全保障和面向目标的语义通信，旨在最大化机器人任务的有效性，同时满足实际操作安全要求。我们首先总结了典型机器人任务中的通用安全要求和有效性指标，包括机器人手臂抓取、无人机 (UAV) 辅助任务和多机器人探索。然后，我们系统地分析了无线连接机器人系统在感知、通信和控制方面面临的独特安全性和有效性挑战。在此基础上，我们进一步提出了潜在的安全保障和面向目标的感知、通信和控制解决方案。最后，一个无人机目标跟踪案例研究验证了我们提出的 GSC 解决方案可以显著提高安全率和跟踪成功率，分别提高 2 倍以上和 4.5 倍以上。
tldr: This paper proposes a safety-guaranteed and goal-oriented semantic communication (GSC) approach for wirelessly-connected robotic systems, aiming to improve communication efficiency and task effectiveness while ensuring safety, demonstrated through a UAV target tracking case study.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种针对无线连接机器人系统的安全保障和目标导向的语义通信（GSC）方法，旨在提高通信效率和任务效力, 同时确保安全，并通过无人机目标跟踪案例研究进行了演示。

title: Chunk-Guided Q-Learning
summary: In offline reinforcement learning (RL), single-step temporal-difference (TD) learning can suffer from bootstrapping error accumulation over long horizons. Action-chunked TD methods mitigate this by backing up over multiple steps, but can introduce suboptimality by restricting the policy class to open-loop action sequences. To resolve this trade-off, we present Chunk-Guided Q-Learning (CGQ), a single-step TD algorithm that guides a fine-grained single-step critic by regularizing it toward a chunk-based critic trained using temporally extended backups. This reduces compounding error while preserving fine-grained value propagation. We theoretically show that CGQ attains tighter critic optimality bounds than either single-step or action-chunked TD learning alone. Empirically, CGQ achieves strong performance on challenging long-horizon OGBench tasks, often outperforming both single-step and action-chunked methods.
summary_zh: 在离线强化学习 (RL) 中，单步时序差分 (TD) 学习可能因长期范围内的自举误差累积而受到影响。分段动作TD方法通过多步回溯来缓解这个问题，但可能因将策略类限制为开环动作序列而引入次优性。为了解决这种权衡，我们提出了一种称为分段引导Q学习 (CGQ) 的单步TD算法，该算法通过将细粒度的单步评论家朝着利用时间扩展备份训练的基于分段的评论家进行正则化来引导前者。这减少了复合误差，同时保留了细粒度的值传播。我们在理论上证明，与单独使用单步或分段动作TD学习相比，CGQ可以获得更严格的评论家最优性界限。在实验中，CGQ在具有挑战性的长范围OGBench任务上取得了强大的性能，通常优于单步和分段动作方法。
tldr: Chunk-Guided Q-Learning (CGQ) mitigates bootstrapping errors in offline RL by regularizing a fine-grained critic with a chunk-based critic, achieving tighter optimality bounds and improved performance on long-horizon tasks.
tldr_zh: Chunk-Guided Q-Learning (CGQ) 通过使用基于块的评论家来规范精细的评论家，从而减轻离线 RL 中的自举误差，从而在长视野任务中实现更严格的最优性界限和改进的性能。

title: LLM-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement
summary: In existing Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement (AVSE) methods, objectives such as Scale-Invariant Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SI-SNR) and Mean Squared Error (MSE) are widely used; however, they often correlate poorly with perceptual quality and provide limited interpretability for optimization. This work proposes a reinforcement learning-based AVSE framework with a Large Language Model (LLM)-based interpretable reward model. An audio LLM generates natural language descriptions of enhanced speech, which are converted by a sentiment analysis model into a 1-5 rating score serving as the PPO reward for fine-tuning a pretrained AVSE model. Compared with scalar metrics, LLM-generated feedback is semantically rich and explicitly describes improvements in speech quality. Experiments on the 4th COG-MHEAR AVSE Challenge (AVSEC-4) dataset show that the proposed method outperforms a supervised baseline and a DNSMOS-based RL baseline in PESQ, STOI, neural quality metrics, and subjective listening tests.
summary_zh: 在现有的视听语音增强（AVSE）方法中，尺度不变信噪比（SI-SNR）和均方误差（MSE）等目标函数被广泛使用；然而，它们通常与感知质量的相关性较差，并且为优化提供的可解释性有限。本工作提出了一种基于强化学习的AVSE框架，该框架采用基于大型语言模型（LLM）的可解释奖励模型。音频LLM生成增强语音的自然语言描述，并通过情感分析模型将其转换为1-5的评分，作为近端策略优化（PPO）的奖励，用于微调预训练的AVSE模型。与标量指标相比，LLM生成的反馈在语义上更丰富，并明确描述了语音质量的改进。在第四届COG-MHEAR AVSE挑战赛（AVSEC-4）数据集上的实验表明，所提出的方法在PESQ、STOI、神经质量指标和主观听力测试方面均优于有监督的基线和基于DNSMOS的强化学习基线。
tldr: This paper proposes an AVSE framework using reinforcement learning with an LLM-based reward model to improve perceptual speech quality, demonstrating superior performance compared to supervised and DNSMOS-based RL baselines on the AVSEC-4 dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于强化学习和LLM奖励模型的AVSE框架，旨在提高感知语音质量。在AVSEC-4数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于监督学习和基于DNSMOS的强化学习基线。

title: AD-Copilot: A Vision-Language Assistant for Industrial Anomaly Detection via Visual In-context Comparison
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive success in natural visual understanding, yet they consistently underperform in industrial anomaly detection (IAD). This is because MLLMs trained mostly on general web data differ significantly from industrial images. Moreover, they encode each image independently and can only compare images in the language space, making them insensitive to subtle visual differences that are key to IAD. To tackle these issues, we present AD-Copilot, an interactive MLLM specialized for IAD via visual in-context comparison. We first design a novel data curation pipeline to mine inspection knowledge from sparsely labeled industrial images and generate precise samples for captioning, VQA, and defect localization, yielding a large-scale multimodal dataset Chat-AD rich in semantic signals for IAD. On this foundation, AD-Copilot incorporates a novel Comparison Encoder that employs cross-attention between paired image features to enhance multi-image fine-grained perception, and is trained with a multi-stage strategy that incorporates domain knowledge and gradually enhances IAD skills. In addition, we introduce MMAD-BBox, an extended benchmark for anomaly localization with bounding-box-based evaluation. The experiments show that AD-Copilot achieves 82.3% accuracy on the MMAD benchmark, outperforming all other models without any data leakage. In the MMAD-BBox test, it achieves a maximum improvement of $3.35\times$ over the baseline. AD-Copilot also exhibits excellent generalization of its performance gains across other specialized and general-purpose benchmarks. Remarkably, AD-Copilot surpasses human expert-level performance on several IAD tasks, demonstrating its potential as a reliable assistant for real-world industrial inspection. All datasets and models will be released for the broader benefit of the community.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM) 在自然视觉理解方面取得了令人瞩目的成功，但在工业异常检测 (IAD) 中的表现却始终欠佳。这是因为 MLLM 主要在通用网络数据上训练，与工业图像存在显著差异。此外，它们独立编码每张图像，并且只能在语言空间比较图像，这使得它们对工业异常检测的关键——细微的视觉差异不敏感。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 AD-Copilot，一种专门用于通过视觉上下文比较进行工业异常检测的交互式 MLLM。我们首先设计了一种新颖的数据管理流程，从稀疏标记的工业图像中挖掘检测知识，并为图像描述、视觉问答和缺陷定位生成精确的样本，从而产生一个蕴含丰富语义信号的大规模多模态数据集 Chat-AD，用于工业异常检测。在此基础上，AD-Copilot 融合了一种新颖的比较编码器，该编码器采用配对图像特征之间的交叉注意力来增强多图像的细粒度感知，并通过结合领域知识并逐步增强工业异常检测技能的多阶段策略进行训练。此外，我们引入了 MMAD-BBox，一个基于边界框评估的异常定位扩展基准。实验表明，AD-Copilot 在 MMAD 基准测试中实现了 82.3% 的准确率，优于所有其他模型，且不存在任何数据泄露。在 MMAD-BBox 测试中，它实现了相对于基线的最高 3.35 倍的提升。AD-Copilot 还在其他专业和通用基准测试中表现出卓越的泛化性能提升。值得注意的是，AD-Copilot 在多个工业异常检测任务中超越了人类专家水平的表现，展示了其作为现实世界工业检测可靠助手的潜力。所有数据集和模型都将发布，以供更广泛的社区受益。
tldr: AD-Copilot is an interactive MLLM specialized for industrial anomaly detection using a curated dataset, a novel comparison encoder, and a multi-stage training strategy, achieving expert-level performance and significant improvements over existing methods.
tldr_zh: AD-Copilot是一个交互式的多模态大语言模型，专为工业异常检测而设计。它使用了一个精心策划的数据集、一种新颖的比较编码器和一个多阶段训练策略，实现了专家级的性能，并显著优于现有方法。

title: $τ$-Voice: Benchmarking Full-Duplex Voice Agents on Real-World Domains
summary: Full-duplex voice agents--systems that listen and speak simultaneously--are rapidly moving from research to production. However, existing evaluations address conversational dynamics and task completion in isolation. We introduce $τ$-voice, a benchmark for evaluating voice agents on grounded tasks with real-world complexity: agents must navigate complex multi-turn conversations, adhere to domain policies, and interact with the environment. The framework extends $τ^2$-bench into a novel voice agent benchmark combining verifiable completion of complex grounded tasks, full-duplex interaction, and realistic audio--enabling direct comparison between voice and text performance. A controllable and realistic voice user simulator provides diverse accents, realistic audio environments, and rich turn-taking dynamics; by decoupling simulation from wall-clock time, the user simulator can use the most capable LLM without real-time constraints. We evaluate task completion (pass@1) and voice interaction quality across 278 tasks: while GPT-5 (reasoning) achieves 85%, voice agents reach only 31--51% under clean conditions and 26--38% under realistic conditions with noise and diverse accents--retaining only 30--45% of text capability; qualitative analysis confirms 79--90% of failures stem from agent behavior, suggesting that observed failures primarily reflect agent behavior under our evaluation setup. $τ$-voice provides a reproducible testbed for measuring progress toward voice agents that are natural, conversational, and reliable.
summary_zh: 全双工语音助手——能够同时听和说的系统——正在迅速从研究走向生产。然而，现有的评估方法将会话动态和任务完成情况割裂开来。我们推出了$τ$-voice，一个用于评估语音助手在具有真实世界复杂性的具身任务上的基准：助手必须驾驭复杂的多轮对话，遵守领域策略，并与环境互动。该框架将$τ^2$-bench扩展为一个新的语音助手基准，结合了复杂具身任务的可验证完成、全双工交互和逼真的音频，实现了语音和文本性能之间的直接比较。一个可控且逼真的语音用户模拟器提供了多样化的口音、逼真的音频环境和丰富的轮流对话动态；通过将模拟与实际运行时间解耦，用户模拟器可以使用最强大的LLM，而不受实时性约束。我们评估了278个任务上的任务完成率（pass@1）和语音交互质量：虽然GPT-5（推理）达到了85%，但语音助手在干净条件下仅达到31-51%，在具有噪声和多样化口音的真实条件下仅达到26-38%，仅保留了文本能力的30-45%；定性分析证实79-90%的失败源于助手行为，表明观察到的失败主要反映了我们评估设置下的助手行为。$τ$-voice为衡量语音助手在自然度、会话性和可靠性方面的进展提供了一个可复现的测试平台。
tldr: The paper introduces $τ$-voice, a benchmark for evaluating full-duplex voice agents on real-world grounded tasks, revealing a significant performance gap between text-based reasoning and voice agent capabilities, especially under realistic conditions.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了$τ$-voice，一种评估全双工语音代理在真实世界任务上的基准。研究表明，基于文本的推理能力和语音代理的能力之间存在显著差距，尤其是在真实条件下。

title: Locatability-Guided Adaptive Reasoning for Image Geo-Localization with Vision-Language Models
summary: The emergence of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) has introduced new paradigms for global image geo-localization through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and reasoning-driven inference. However, RAG methods are constrained by retrieval database quality, while reasoning-driven approaches fail to internalize image locatability, relying on inefficient, fixed-depth reasoning paths that increase hallucinations and degrade accuracy. To overcome these limitations, we introduce an Optimized Locatability Score that quantifies an image's suitability for deep reasoning in geo-localization. Using this metric, we curate Geo-ADAPT-51K, a locatability-stratified reasoning dataset enriched with augmented reasoning trajectories for complex visual scenes. Building on this foundation, we propose a two-stage Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) curriculum with customized reward functions that regulate adaptive reasoning depth, visual grounding, and hierarchical geographical accuracy. Our framework, Geo-ADAPT, learns an adaptive reasoning policy, achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple geo-localization benchmarks, and substantially reduces hallucinations by reasoning both adaptively and efficiently.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）的出现为全局图像地理定位引入了新的范式，即通过检索增强生成（RAG）和推理驱动的推断。然而，RAG方法受限于检索数据库的质量，而推理驱动的方法无法内化图像的可定位性，依赖于低效、固定深度的推理路径，这增加了幻觉并降低了准确性。为了克服这些局限性，我们引入了一个优化的可定位性评分，用于量化图像在地理定位中进行深度推理的适用性。利用该指标，我们整理了Geo-ADAPT-51K，这是一个可定位性分层的推理数据集，其中包含针对复杂视觉场景的增强推理轨迹。在此基础上，我们提出了一个两阶段的群体相对策略优化（GRPO）课程，其中包含自定义的奖励函数，用于调节自适应推理深度、视觉定位和分层地理精度。我们的框架Geo-ADAPT学习了一种自适应推理策略，在多个地理定位基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，并通过自适应和高效的推理显著减少了幻觉。
tldr: This paper introduces Geo-ADAPT, a framework that uses an optimized locatability score and reinforcement learning to adaptively reason for image geo-localization, achieving state-of-the-art performance and reducing hallucinations.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Geo-ADAPT，一个利用优化的可定位性得分和强化学习进行自适应推理的图像地理定位框架，实现了最先进的性能并减少了幻觉。

title: A Multi-Agent Perception-Action Alliance for Efficient Long Video Reasoning
summary: This paper presents a multi-agent perception-action exploration alliance, dubbed A4VL, for efficient long-video reasoning. A4VL operates in a multi-round perception-action exploration loop with a selection of VLM agents. In each round, the team of agents performs video question-answer (VideoQA) via perception exploration followed by action exploration. During perception exploration, each agent learns to extract query-specific perception clue(s) from a few sampled frames and performs clue-based alignment to find the video block(s) that are most relevant to the query-specific event. During action exploration, A4VL performs video reasoning in three steps: (1) each agent produces its initial answer with rational, (2) all agents collaboratively scores one another through cross-reviews and relevance ranking, and (3) based on whether a satisfactory consensus is reached, the decision is made either to start a new round of perception-action deliberation by pruning (e.g., filtering out the lowest performing agent) and re-staging (e.g., new-clue and matching block based perception-action exploration), or to conclude by producing its final answer. The integration of the multi-agent alliance through multi-round perception-action exploration, coupled with event-driven partitioning and cue-guided block alignment, enables A4VL to effectively scale to real world long videos while preserving high quality video reasoning. Evaluation Results on five popular VideoQA benchmarks show that A4VL outperforms 18 existing representative VLMs and 10 recent methods optimized for long-video reasoning, while achieving significantly lower inference latency. Our code is released at https://github.com/git-disl/A4VL.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于高效长视频推理的多智能体感知-行动探索联盟，简称A4VL。A4VL在一个多轮感知-行动探索循环中运行，并选用了VLM智能体。在每一轮循环中，智能体团队通过感知探索和行动探索执行视频问答（VideoQA）。在感知探索阶段，每个智能体都学会从少量采样帧中提取特定于查询的感知线索，并执行基于线索的对齐，以找到与特定于查询的事件最相关的视频块。在行动探索阶段，A4VL分三个步骤进行视频推理：（1）每个智能体产生带有理由的初始答案，（2）所有智能体通过交叉审核和相关性排序协同评分彼此，（3）基于是否达成令人满意的共识，决定是开始新一轮的感知-行动审议（通过剪枝，例如过滤掉表现最差的智能体，以及重新部署，例如基于新线索和匹配块的感知-行动探索），还是通过产生最终答案来结束推理。通过多轮感知-行动探索整合多智能体联盟，并结合事件驱动的分区和线索引导的块对齐，使A4VL能够有效地扩展到真实世界的长视频，同时保持高质量的视频推理。在五个流行的VideoQA基准上的评估结果表明，A4VL优于18个现有的代表性VLM和10个最近的针对长视频推理优化的方法，同时实现了显著更低的推理延迟。我们的代码已发布在https://github.com/git-disl/A4VL。
tldr: The paper introduces A4VL, a multi-agent system for long-video reasoning that uses perception-action exploration to achieve high accuracy and speed on VideoQA tasks, surpassing existing VLMs and long-video reasoning methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了A4VL，一个用于长视频推理的多代理系统，它使用感知-行动探索以在VideoQA任务上实现高精度和速度，超越了现有的视觉语言模型和长视频推理方法。

title: Scene Generation at Absolute Scale: Utilizing Semantic and Geometric Guidance From Text for Accurate and Interpretable 3D Indoor Scene Generation
summary: We present GuidedSceneGen, a text-to-3D generation framework that produces metrically accurate, globally consistent, and semantically interpretable indoor scenes. Unlike prior text-driven methods that often suffer from geometric drift or scale ambiguity, our approach maintains an absolute world coordinate frame throughout the entire generation process. Starting from a textual scene description, we predict a global 3D layout encoding both semantic and geometric structure, which serves as a guiding proxy for downstream stages. A semantics- and depth-conditioned panoramic diffusion model then synthesizes 360° imagery aligned with the global layout, substantially improving spatial coherence. To explore unobserved regions, we employ a video diffusion model guided by optimized camera trajectories that balances coverage and collision avoidance, achieving up to 10x faster sampling compared to exhaustive path exploration. The generated views are fused using 3D Gaussian Splatting, yielding a consistent and fully navigable 3D scene in absolute scale. GuidedSceneGen enables accurate transfer of object poses and semantic labels from layout to reconstruction, and supports progressive scene expansion without re-alignment. Quantitative results and a user study demonstrate greater 3D consistency and layout plausibility compared to recent panoramic text-to-3D baselines.
summary_zh: 我们提出了 GuidedSceneGen，一个文本到3D生成框架，能够生成在度量上准确、全局一致且语义可解释的室内场景。与以往常受几何漂移或尺度模糊困扰的文本驱动方法不同，我们的方法在整个生成过程中保持一个绝对世界坐标系。首先，从文本场景描述出发，我们预测一个编码语义和几何结构的全局3D布局，作为下游阶段的引导代理。 然后，一个语义和深度条件的全景扩散模型合成与全局布局对齐的360°图像，显著提高了空间连贯性。为了探索未观察到的区域，我们采用一个视频扩散模型，该模型由优化的相机轨迹引导，在覆盖范围和避免碰撞之间取得平衡，与穷举路径探索相比，采样速度提高了10倍。 生成的视图使用 3D 高斯溅射进行融合，从而产生一个在绝对尺度上一致且完全可导航的3D场景。 GuidedSceneGen 能够将对象姿态和语义标签从布局准确地转移到重建，并支持场景的逐步扩展而无需重新对齐。 量化结果和用户研究表明，与最近的全景文本到3D基线相比，该方法具有更高的3D一致性和布局合理性。
tldr: The paper introduces GuidedSceneGen, a framework that generates metrically accurate and semantically interpretable 3D indoor scenes from text, using a global 3D layout and panoramic/video diffusion models. It addresses issues of geometric drift and scale ambiguity in existing text-to-3D methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为GuidedSceneGen的框架，它使用全局3D布局和全景/视频扩散模型，从文本生成度量精确且语义可解释的3D室内场景。它解决了现有文本到3D方法中存在的几何漂移和尺度模糊问题。

title: OrigamiBench: An Interactive Environment to Synthesize Flat-Foldable Origamis
summary: Building AI systems that can plan, act, and create in the physical world requires more than pattern recognition. Such systems must understand the causal mechanisms and constraints governing physical processes in order to guide sequential decisions. This capability relies on internal representations, analogous to an internal language model, that relate observations, actions, and resulting environmental changes. However, many existing benchmarks treat visual perception and programmatic reasoning as separate problems, focusing either on visual recognition or on symbolic tasks. The domain of origami provides a natural testbed that integrates these modalities. Constructing shapes through folding operations requires visual perception, reasoning about geometric and physical constraints, and sequential planning, while remaining sufficiently structured for systematic evaluation. We introduce OrigamiBench, an interactive benchmark in which models iteratively propose folds and receive feedback on physical validity and similarity to a target configuration. Experiments with modern vision-language models show that scaling model size alone does not reliably produce causal reasoning about physical transformations. Models fail to generate coherent multi-step folding strategies, suggesting that visual and language representations remain weakly integrated.
summary_zh: 构建能够在物理世界中进行规划、行动和创造的人工智能系统，不仅仅需要模式识别。这类系统必须理解支配物理过程的因果机制和约束，以便指导序列决策。这种能力依赖于内部表征，类似于内部语言模型，将观察、行动和由此产生的环境变化联系起来。然而，许多现有的基准测试将视觉感知和程序化推理视为独立的问题，要么侧重于视觉识别，要么侧重于符号任务。折纸领域提供了一个自然的测试平台，可以整合这些模态。通过折叠操作构造形状需要视觉感知、对几何和物理约束的推理以及序列规划，同时保持足够的结构化以进行系统评估。我们引入了OrigamiBench，一个交互式基准测试，模型在其中迭代地提出折叠方案，并接收关于物理有效性和与目标配置相似性的反馈。使用现代视觉-语言模型进行的实验表明，仅仅扩大模型规模并不能可靠地产生关于物理转换的因果推理。模型无法生成连贯的多步折叠策略，表明视觉和语言表征仍然集成度较低。
tldr: OrigamiBench is introduced as a novel interactive benchmark for training AI systems to understand physical processes via origami folding, revealing the limitations of current vision-language models in causal reasoning and multi-step planning.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个名为OrigamiBench的新型交互式基准，用于训练AI系统通过折纸来理解物理过程，揭示了当前视觉-语言模型在因果推理和多步规划方面的局限性。

title: PhysAlign: Physics-Coherent Image-to-Video Generation through Feature and 3D Representation Alignment
summary: Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) offer a promising approach for simulating dynamic scenes and environments, with broad applications in robotics and media generation. However, existing models often generate temporally incoherent content that violates basic physical intuition, significantly limiting their practical applicability. We propose PhysAlign, an efficient framework for physics-coherent image-to-video (I2V) generation that explicitly addresses this limitation. To overcome the critical scarcity of physics-annotated videos, we first construct a fully controllable synthetic data generation pipeline based on rigid-body simulation, yielding a highly-curated dataset with accurate, fine-grained physics and 3D annotations. Leveraging this data, PhysAlign constructs a unified physical latent space by coupling explicit 3D geometry constraints with a Gram-based spatio-temporal relational alignment that extracts kinematic priors from video foundation models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysAlign significantly outperforms existing VDMs on tasks requiring complex physical reasoning and temporal stability, without compromising zero-shot visual quality. PhysAlign shows the potential to bridge the gap between raw visual synthesis and rigid-body kinematics, establishing a practical paradigm for genuinely physics-grounded video generation. The project page is available at https://physalign.github.io/PhysAlign.
summary_zh: 视频扩散模型（VDMs）为模拟动态场景和环境提供了一种有前景的方法，在机器人学和媒体生成领域有着广泛的应用。然而，现有的模型通常生成时间上不连贯的内容，违反基本的物理直觉，从而严重限制了它们的实际应用性。我们提出了PhysAlign，一个高效的、用于物理一致的图像到视频 (I2V) 生成框架，该框架明确地解决了这一局限性。为了克服物理标注视频的严重稀缺问题，我们首先构建了一个基于刚体仿真的完全可控的合成数据生成流水线，从而产生了一个高度精选的数据集，该数据集具有精确、细粒度的物理和3D标注。利用这些数据，PhysAlign通过将显式的3D几何约束与基于Gram的时空关系对齐相结合来构建一个统一的物理潜在空间，后者从视频基础模型中提取运动学先验。大量实验表明，PhysAlign在需要复杂物理推理和时间稳定性的任务上显著优于现有的VDMs，并且不影响零样本的视觉质量。PhysAlign展示了弥合原始视觉合成与刚体运动学之间差距的潜力，从而为真正基于物理的视频生成建立了一个实用的范例。项目主页地址为https://physalign.github.io/PhysAlign。
tldr: PhysAlign introduces a framework for physics-coherent image-to-video generation by leveraging a synthetic dataset and explicit 3D geometry constraints to improve temporal stability and physical reasoning in generated videos.
tldr_zh: PhysAlign 提出了一个物理一致的图像到视频生成框架，通过利用合成数据集和显式的 3D 几何约束来提高生成视频中的时间稳定性和物理推理能力。

title: QTrack: Query-Driven Reasoning for Multi-modal MOT
summary: Multi-object tracking (MOT) has traditionally focused on estimating trajectories of all objects in a video, without selectively reasoning about user-specified targets under semantic instructions. In this work, we introduce a query-driven tracking paradigm that formulates tracking as a spatiotemporal reasoning problem conditioned on natural language queries. Given a reference frame, a video sequence, and a textual query, the goal is to localize and track only the target(s) specified in the query while maintaining temporal coherence and identity consistency. To support this setting, we construct RMOT26, a large-scale benchmark with grounded queries and sequence-level splits to prevent identity leakage and enable robust evaluation of generalization. We further present QTrack, an end-to-end vision-language model that integrates multimodal reasoning with tracking-oriented localization. Additionally, we introduce a Temporal Perception-Aware Policy Optimization strategy with structured rewards to encourage motion-aware reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach for reasoning-centric, language-guided tracking. Code and data are available at https://github.com/gaash-lab/QTrack
summary_zh: 多目标跟踪（MOT）传统上侧重于估计视频中所有物体的轨迹，而未有选择性地根据语义指令推理用户指定的目标。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种查询驱动的跟踪范式，将跟踪表述为一种以自然语言查询为条件的时空推理问题。 给定一个参考帧、一个视频序列和一个文本查询，目标是仅定位和跟踪查询中指定的目标，同时保持时间连贯性和身份一致性。 为了支持这种设置，我们构建了 RMOT26，一个大规模的基准数据集，包含有根据的查询和序列级别的划分，以防止身份泄露并实现对泛化能力的稳健评估。 我们进一步提出了 QTrack，一个端到端的视觉-语言模型，它集成了多模态推理与面向跟踪的定位。 此外，我们引入了一种具有结构化奖励的时间感知策略优化策略，以鼓励运动感知推理。 大量的实验表明，我们的方法对于以推理为中心、语言引导的跟踪是有效的。 代码和数据可在 https://github.com/gaash-lab/QTrack 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces QTrack, a query-driven multi-object tracking paradigm using vision-language models, trained with a novel reinforcement learning strategy, and evaluated on RMOT26, a new large-scale benchmark with language-grounded queries.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了QTrack，一种查询驱动的多目标跟踪范例，它使用视觉-语言模型，通过一种新颖的强化学习策略进行训练，并在RMOT26上进行评估，RMOT26是一个新的大规模基准，具有语言接地的查询。
