title: ActionPlan: Future-Aware Streaming Motion Synthesis via Frame-Level Action Planning
summary: We present ActionPlan, a unified motion diffusion framework that bridges real-time streaming with high-quality offline generation within a single model. The core idea is to introduce a per-frame action plan: the model predicts frame-level text latents that act as dense semantic anchors throughout denoising, and uses them to denoise the full motion sequence with combined semantic and motion cues. To support this structured workflow, we design latent-specific diffusion steps, allowing each motion latent to be denoised independently and sampled in flexible orders at inference. As a result, ActionPlan can run in a history-conditioned, future-aware mode for real-time streaming, while also supporting high-quality offline generation. The same mechanism further enables zero-shot motion editing and in-betweening without additional models. Experiments demonstrate that our real-time streaming is 5.25x faster while also achieving 18% motion quality improvement over the best previous method in terms of FID.
summary_zh: 我们提出了 ActionPlan，一个统一的运动扩散框架，能够在单一模型中连接实时流媒体和高质量离线生成。其核心思想是引入逐帧动作计划：模型预测帧级别的文本隐变量，这些隐变量在去噪过程中充当密集的语义锚点，并利用它们结合语义和运动线索对完整的运动序列进行去噪。为了支持这种结构化的工作流程，我们设计了特定于隐变量的扩散步骤，从而允许每个运动隐变量独立去噪，并且在推理时以灵活的顺序进行采样。因此，ActionPlan 可以在历史条件、未来感知的模式下运行以进行实时流媒体，同时还支持高质量的离线生成。该机制进一步支持零样本运动编辑和插值，无需额外的模型。实验表明，我们的实时流媒体速度提高了 5.25 倍，同时在 FID 方面也比之前最好的方法在运动质量上提高了 18%。
tldr: The paper introduces ActionPlan, a unified motion diffusion framework that uses frame-level action plans to achieve both real-time streaming and high-quality offline motion generation within a single model, demonstrating significant speed and quality improvements.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ActionPlan，一个统一的运动扩散框架，它使用帧级别动作计划，在单个模型中实现实时流式传输和高质量离线运动生成，并展示了显著的速度和质量改进。

title: Vision-guided Autonomous Dual-arm Extraction Robot for Bell Pepper Harvesting
summary: Agricultural robotics has emerged as a critical solution to the labor shortages and rising costs associated with manual crop harvesting. Bell pepper harvesting, in particular, is a labor-intensive task, accounting for up to 50% of total production costs. While automated solutions have shown promise in controlled greenhouse environments, harvesting in unstructured outdoor farms remains an open challenge due to environmental variability and occlusion. This paper presents VADER (Vision-guided Autonomous Dual-arm Extraction Robot), a dual-arm mobile manipulation system designed specifically for the autonomous harvesting of bell peppers in outdoor environments. The system integrates a robust perception pipeline coupled with a dual-arm planning framework that coordinates a gripping arm and a cutting arm for extraction. We validate the system through trials in various realistic conditions, demonstrating a harvest success rate exceeding 60% with a cycle time of under 100 seconds per fruit, while also featuring a teleoperation fail-safe based on the GELLO teleoperation framework to ensure robustness. To support robust perception, we contribute a hierarchically structured dataset of over 3,200 images spanning indoor and outdoor domains, pairing wide-field scene images with close-up pepper images to enable a coarse-to-fine training strategy from fruit detection to high-precision pose estimation. The code and dataset will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 农业机器人已成为解决与人工作物采摘相关的劳动力短缺和成本上升的关键方案。尤其是甜椒采摘，是一项劳动密集型任务，占总生产成本的50%之多。虽然自动化解决方案在受控温室环境中展现出前景，但由于环境变化和遮挡，在非结构化的室外农场中进行采摘仍然是一个公开的挑战。本文提出了VADER（视觉引导自主双臂提取机器人），一种专为室外环境中甜椒自主采摘而设计的双臂移动操控系统。该系统集成了一个鲁棒的感知流程，并结合了一个双臂规划框架，该框架协调一个抓取臂和一个切割臂进行提取。我们通过在各种真实条件下的试验验证了该系统，展示了超过60%的采摘成功率，每个果实的周期小于100秒，同时还具有基于GELLO远程操作框架的远程操作安全保护措施，以确保鲁棒性。为了支持鲁棒的感知，我们贡献了一个分层结构化数据集，包含超过3200张图像，涵盖室内和室外领域，将广角场景图像与特写甜椒图像配对，以实现从水果检测到高精度姿态估计的粗到精训练策略。代码和数据集将在接收后公开提供。
tldr: This paper introduces VADER, a vision-guided dual-arm robot for autonomous bell pepper harvesting in unstructured outdoor farms, achieving a 60% success rate and contributing a new pepper image dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍 VADER，一种视觉引导的双臂机器人，用于在非结构化户外农场中自主采摘甜椒，成功率达到 60%，并贡献了一个新的甜椒图像数据集。

title: ToMPC: Task-oriented Model Predictive Control via ADMM for Safe Robotic Manipulation
summary: This paper proposes a task-oriented model predictive control (ToMPC) framework for safe and efficient robotic manipulation in open workspaces. The framework unifies collision-free motion and robot-environment interaction to address diverse scenarios. Additionally, it introduces task-oriented obstacle avoidance that leverages kinematic redundancy to enhance manipulation efficiency in obstructed environments. This complex optimization problem is solved by the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), which decomposes the problem into two subproblems tackled by differential dynamic programming (DDP) and quadratic programming (QP), respectively. The effectiveness of this approach is validated in simulation and hardware experiments on a Franka Panda robotic manipulator. Results demonstrate that the framework can plan motion and/or force trajectories in real time, maximize the manipulation range while avoiding obstacles, and strictly adhere to safety-related hard constraints.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种面向任务的模型预测控制（ToMPC）框架，用于开放工作空间中安全高效的机器人操作。该框架统一了无碰撞运动和机器人-环境交互，以应对各种场景。此外，它引入了面向任务的避障功能，利用运动学冗余来提高在受阻环境中的操作效率。这种复杂的优化问题通过交替方向乘子法（ADMM）解决，该方法将问题分解为两个子问题，分别由微分动态规划（DDP）和二次规划（QP）处理。通过在Franka Panda机器人机械臂上的仿真和硬件实验验证了该方法的有效性。结果表明，该框架可以实时规划运动和/或力轨迹，在避开障碍物的同时最大化操作范围，并严格遵守与安全相关的硬约束。
tldr: The paper introduces a Task-oriented Model Predictive Control (ToMPC) framework using ADMM to enable safe and efficient robotic manipulation, demonstrated on a Franka Panda robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用ADMM的任务导向模型预测控制(ToMPC)框架，以实现安全高效的机器人操作，并在Franka Panda机器人上进行了演示。

title: Data-Driven Autoregressive Power Prediction for GTernal Robots in the Robotarium
summary: Energy-aware algorithms for multi-robot systems require accurate power consumption models, yet existing approaches rely on kinematic approximations that fail to capture the complex dynamics of real hardware. We present a lightweight autoregressive predictor for the GTernal mobile robot platform deployed in the Georgia Tech Robotarium. Through analysis of 48,000 samples collected across six motion trials, we discover that power consumption exhibits strong temporal autocorrelation ($ρ_1 = 0.95$) that dominates kinematic effects. A 7,041-parameter multi-layer perceptron (MLP) achieves $R^2 = 0.90$ on held-out motion patterns by conditioning on recent power history, reaching the theoretical prediction ceiling imposed by measurement noise. Physical validation across seven robots in a collision avoidance scenario yields mean $R^2 = 0.87$, demonstrating zero-shot transfer to unseen robots and behaviors. The predictor runs in 224 $μ$s per inference, enabling real-time deployment at 150$\times$ the platform's 30 Hz control rate. We release the trained model and dataset to support energy-aware multi-robot algorithm development.
summary_zh: 针对多机器人系统的能量感知算法需要精确的功耗模型，然而现有方法依赖于运动学近似，无法捕捉真实硬件的复杂动力学。我们提出了一种轻量级的自回归预测器，用于部署在佐治亚理工学院机器人试验场的 GTernal 移动机器人平台。通过分析在六个运动试验中收集的 48,000 个样本，我们发现功耗表现出很强的时间自相关性 ($ρ_1 = 0.95$)，它主导了运动学效应。一个拥有 7,041 个参数的多层感知器 (MLP)，通过以最近的功耗历史为条件，在保留的运动模式上实现了$R^2 = 0.90$，达到了测量噪声所造成的理论预测上限。在避碰场景中的七个机器人上进行的物理验证产生了平均$R^2 = 0.87$，表明了零样本转移到未见过的机器人和行为的能力。该预测器每次推断运行时间为 224 $μ$s，实现了实时部署，达到了平台 30 Hz 控制速率的 150 倍。我们发布了训练好的模型和数据集，以支持能量感知的多机器人算法开发。
tldr: This paper presents a lightweight autoregressive power prediction model for GTernal robots in the Robotarium, achieving high accuracy with zero-shot transfer and real-time deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于 Georgia Tech Robotarium 中 GTernal 机器人的轻量级自回归功率预测模型，该模型具有高精度、零样本迁移和实时部署能力。

title: Path-conditioned Reinforcement Learning-based Local Planning for Long-Range Navigation
summary: Long-range navigation is commonly addressed through hierarchical pipelines in which a global planner generates a path, decomposed into waypoints, and followed sequentially by a local planner. These systems are sensitive to global path quality, as inaccurate remote sensing data can result in locally infeasible waypoints, which degrade local execution. At the same time, the limited global context available to the local planner hinders long-range efficiency. To address this issue, we propose a reinforcement learning-based local navigation policy that leverages path information as contextual guidance. The policy is conditioned on reference path observations and trained with a reward function mainly based on goal-reaching objectives, without any explicit path-following reward. Through this implicit conditioning, the policy learns to opportunistically exploit path information while remaining robust to misleading or degraded guidance. Experimental results show that the proposed approach significantly improves navigation efficiency when high-quality paths are available and maintains baseline-level performance when path observations are severely degraded or even non-existent. These properties make the method particularly well-suited for long-range navigation scenarios in which high-level plans are approximate and local execution must remain adaptive to uncertainty.
summary_zh: 长距离导航通常通过分层流水线实现，其中全局规划器生成一条路径，分解为一系列航路点，然后由局部规划器依次执行。这些系统对全局路径质量敏感，因为不准确的遥感数据可能导致局部不可行的航路点，从而降低局部执行效果。同时，局部规划器可用的全局上下文有限，阻碍了长距离效率。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种基于强化学习的局部导航策略，该策略利用路径信息作为上下文指导。该策略以参考路径观测为条件，并使用主要基于目标到达目标的奖励函数进行训练，而没有任何明确的路径跟踪奖励。通过这种隐式条件化，该策略学会机会性地利用路径信息，同时保持对误导性或降级指导的鲁棒性。实验结果表明，当有高质量路径可用时，所提出的方法显著提高了导航效率，并在路径观测严重退化甚至不存在时，保持了基线水平的性能。这些特性使得该方法特别适用于长距离导航场景，其中高级别计划是近似的，局部执行必须保持对不确定性的适应性。
tldr: This paper introduces a reinforcement learning-based local navigation policy conditioned on path information for long-range navigation, showing improved efficiency and robustness to degraded path guidance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的局部导航策略，该策略以路径信息为条件进行长距离导航，表现出更高的效率和对退化路径引导的鲁棒性。

title: Benchmarking the Energy Cost of Assurance in Neuromorphic Edge Robotics
summary: Deploying trustworthy artificial intelligence on edge robotics imposes a difficult trade-off between high-assurance robustness and energy sustainability. Traditional defense mechanisms against adversarial attacks typically incur significant computational overhead, threatening the viability of power-constrained platforms in environments such as cislunar space. This paper quantifies the energy cost of assurance in event-driven neuromorphic systems. We benchmark the Hierarchical Temporal Defense (HTD) framework on the BrainChip Akida AKD1000 processor against a suite of adversarial temporal attacks. We demonstrate that unlike traditional deep learning defenses which often degrade efficiency significantly with increased robustness, the event-driven nature of the proposed architecture achieves a superior trade-off. The system reduces gradient-based adversarial success rates from 82.1% to 18.7% and temporal jitter success rates from 75.8% to 25.1%, while maintaining an energy consumption of approximately 45 microjoules per inference. We report a counter-intuitive reduction in dynamic power consumption in the fully defended configuration, attributed to volatility-gated plasticity mechanisms that induce higher network sparsity. These results provide empirical evidence that neuromorphic sparsity enables sustainable and high-assurance edge autonomy.
summary_zh: 在边缘机器人上部署可信人工智能需要在高保障的鲁棒性和能源可持续性之间做出艰难的权衡。传统的对抗攻击防御机制通常会带来显著的计算开销，威胁到受功率限制的平台在类地月空间等环境中的可行性。本文量化了事件驱动型神经形态系统中保障的能源成本。我们针对一系列对抗性时间攻击，在 BrainChip Akida AKD1000 处理器上对分层时间防御（HTD）框架进行了基准测试。我们展示了不同于传统深度学习防御方法通常因鲁棒性提高而显著降低效率的情况，所提出的架构的事件驱动特性实现了更优的权衡。该系统将基于梯度的对抗攻击成功率从 82.1% 降低到 18.7%，并将时间抖动成功率从 75.8% 降低到 25.1%，同时保持每次推理约 45 微焦耳的能耗。我们报告了一种违反直觉的现象，即在完全防御的配置中动态功耗降低，这归因于诱导更高网络稀疏度的挥发性门控可塑性机制。这些结果提供了经验证据，表明神经形态稀疏性能够实现可持续且高保障的边缘自主性。
tldr: This paper benchmarks the energy cost of a neuromorphic defense (HTD) against adversarial attacks on edge robotics, showing a better energy-robustness trade-off compared to traditional deep learning defenses due to the sparsity-inducing properties of neuromorphic architectures.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文评估了神经形态防御 (HTD) 在边缘机器人上对抗对抗性攻击的能耗，表明与传统的深度学习防御相比，神经形态架构的稀疏性具有更好的能量-鲁棒性折衷方案。

title: TransDex: Pre-training Visuo-Tactile Policy with Point Cloud Reconstruction for Dexterous Manipulation of Transparent Objects
summary: Dexterous manipulation enables complex tasks but suffers from self-occlusion, severe depth noise, and depth information loss when manipulating transparent objects. To solve this problem, this paper proposes TransDex, a 3D visuo-tactile fusion motor policy based on point cloud reconstruction pre-training. Specifically, we first propose a self-supervised point cloud reconstruction pre-training approach based on Transformer. This method accurately recovers the 3D structure of objects from interactive point clouds of dexterous hands, even when random noise and large-scale masking are added. Building on this, TransDex is constructed in which perceptual encoding adopts a fine-grained hierarchical scheme and multi-round attention mechanisms adaptively fuse features of the robotic arm and dexterous hand to enable differentiated motion prediction. Results from transparent object manipulation experiments conducted on a real robotic system demonstrate that TransDex outperforms existing baseline methods. Further analysis validates the generalization capabilities of TransDex and the effectiveness of its individual components.
summary_zh: 灵巧操作能够实现复杂的任务，但其面临自遮挡、严重的深度噪声以及操控透明物体时深度信息丢失的问题。为了解决这个问题，本文提出TransDex，一种基于点云重建预训练的3D视觉-触觉融合运动策略。具体来说，我们首先提出了一种基于Transformer的自监督点云重建预训练方法。该方法能够从灵巧手交互产生的点云中精确恢复物体的3D结构，即使在添加随机噪声和大规模掩蔽的情况下也是如此。在此基础上，构建了TransDex，其中感知编码采用精细的分层方案，多轮注意力机制自适应地融合机械臂和灵巧手的特征，从而实现差异化的运动预测。在真实机器人系统上进行的透明物体操作实验结果表明，TransDex优于现有的基线方法。进一步的分析验证了TransDex的泛化能力以及其各个组成部分的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces TransDex, a visuo-tactile fusion motor policy pre-trained with point cloud reconstruction for dexterous manipulation of transparent objects, demonstrating superior performance on a real robotic system.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TransDex，一种基于点云重建预训练的视觉触觉融合运动策略，用于灵巧地操控透明物体。实验结果表明，该方法在真实机器人系统中表现优于现有基线方法。

title: LDHP: Library-Driven Hierarchical Planning for Non-prehensile Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Non-prehensile manipulation is essential for handling thin, large, or otherwise ungraspable objects in unstructured settings. Prior planning and search-based methods often rely on ad-hoc manual designs or generate physically unrealizable motions by ignoring critical gripper properties, while training-based approaches are data-intensive and struggle to generalize to novel, out-of-distribution tasks. We propose a library-driven hierarchical planner (LDHP) that makes executability a first-class design goal: a top-tier contact-state planner proposes object-pose paths using MoveObject primitives, and a bottom-tier grasp planner synthesizes feasible grasp sequences with AdjustGrasp primitives; feasibility is certified by collision checks and quasi-static mechanics, and contact-sensitive segments are recovered via a bounded dichotomy refinement. This gripper-aware decomposition decouples object motion from grasp realizability, yields a task-agnostic pipeline that transfers across manipulation tasks and geometric variations without re-design, and exposes clean hooks for optional learned priors. Real-robot studies on zero-mobility lifting and slot insertion demonstrate consistent execution and robustness to shape and environment changes.
summary_zh: 非抓取操作对于处理薄、大或无法抓握的物体在非结构化环境中至关重要。先前的规划和搜索方法通常依赖于临时的手动设计，或者忽略关键的夹持器属性从而生成物理上不可实现的运动，而基于训练的方法则是数据密集型的，并且难以泛化到新的、超出分布的任务。我们提出了一种库驱动的分层规划器（LDHP），它使可执行性成为首要设计目标：顶层接触状态规划器使用MoveObject原语来提出物体姿态路径，而底层抓取规划器使用AdjustGrasp原语来合成可行的抓取序列；可行性通过碰撞检查和准静态力学来验证，并且接触敏感片段通过有限二分法细化来恢复。这种感知夹持器的分解将物体运动与抓取可实现性解耦，产生了一个与任务无关的管道，该管道可以在操纵任务和几何变化之间转移而无需重新设计，并为可选的学习先验暴露了清晰的接口。针对零自由度提升和插槽插入的真实机器人研究表明，其执行的一致性和对形状和环境变化的鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces a library-driven hierarchical planner (LDHP) for non-prehensile dexterous manipulation that prioritizes executability via a two-tiered planning process certified by collision checks and quasi-static mechanics, demonstrated through real-robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种库驱动的分层规划器（LDHP），用于非抓取灵巧操作。该规划器通过碰撞检查和准静态力学认证的两层规划流程，优先考虑可执行性，并通过真实机器人实验进行了验证。

title: Robust Sim-to-Real Cloth Untangling through Reduced-Resolution Observations via Adaptive Force-Difference Quantization
summary: Robotic cloth untangling requires progressively disentangling fabric by adapting pulling actions to changing contact and tension conditions. Because large-scale real-world training is impractical due to cloth damage and hardware wear, sim-to-real policy transfer is a promising solution. However, cloth manipulation is highly sensitive to interaction dynamics, and policies that depend on precise force magnitudes often fail after transfer because similar force responses cannot be reproduced due to the reality gap. We observe that untangling is largely characterized by qualitative tension transitions rather than exact force values. This indicates that directly minimizing the sim-to-real gap in raw force measurements does not necessarily align with the task structure. We therefore hypothesize that emphasizing coarse force-change patterns while suppressing fine environment-dependent variations can improve robustness of sim-to-real transfer. Based on this insight, we propose Adaptive Force-Difference Quantization (ADQ), which reduces observation resolution by representing force inputs as discretized temporal differences and learning state-dependent quantization thresholds adaptively. This representation mitigates overfitting to environment-specific force characteristics and facilitates direct sim-to-real transfer. Experiments in both simulation and real-world cloth untangling demonstrate that ADQ achieves higher success rates and exhibits greater robustness in sim-to-real transfer than policies using raw force inputs. Supplementary video is available at https://youtu.be/ZeoBs-t0AWc
summary_zh: 机器人布料解缠需要通过调整拉拽动作以适应不断变化的接触和张力条件，从而逐步解开织物。由于大规模的真实世界训练会因布料损坏和硬件磨损而不切实际，因此从仿真到实际的策略迁移是一种很有前景的解决方案。然而，布料操作对交互动力学高度敏感，并且依赖精确力值的策略在迁移后往往会失败，因为由于现实差距，无法重现相似的力响应。我们观察到，解缠主要由定性的张力转换而非精确的力值来表征。这表明，直接最小化原始力测量中的仿真到实际差距不一定与任务结构对齐。因此，我们假设强调粗略的力变化模式，同时抑制细微的、环境相关的变化，可以提高从仿真到实际迁移的鲁棒性。基于这一洞察，我们提出了一种自适应力差量化（ADQ）方法，该方法通过将力输入表示为离散的时间差分，并自适应地学习状态相关的量化阈值来降低观察分辨率。这种表示缓解了对特定环境力特征的过度拟合，并有助于直接的从仿真到实际迁移。在仿真和真实世界布料解缠中的实验表明，与使用原始力输入的策略相比，ADQ实现了更高的成功率，并在从仿真到实际迁移中表现出更大的鲁棒性。补充视频可在https://youtu.be/ZeoBs-t0AWc 观看。
tldr: This paper introduces Adaptive Force-Difference Quantization (ADQ) to improve sim-to-real transfer in robotic cloth untangling by focusing on coarse force-change patterns rather than precise force magnitudes, leading to increased robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种自适应力差量化（ADQ）方法，通过关注粗略的力变化模式而非精确的力大小，从而提高机器人解缠布料任务中从模拟到真实的迁移性能，并提高鲁棒性。

title: Multi-Robot Coordination for Planning under Context Uncertainty
summary: Real-world robots often operate in settings where objective priorities depend on the underlying context of operation. When the underlying context is unknown apriori, multiple robots may have to coordinate to gather informative observations to infer the context, since acting based on an incorrect context can lead to misaligned and unsafe behavior. Once the underlying true context is inferred, the robots optimize their task-specific objectives in the preference order induced by the context. We formalize this problem as a Multi-Robot Context-Uncertain Stochastic Shortest Path (MR-CUSSP), which captures context-relevant information at landmark states through joint observations. Our two-stage solution approach is composed of: (1) CIMOP (Coordinated Inference for Multi-Objective Planning) to compute plans that guide robots toward informative landmarks to efficiently infer the true context, and (2) LCBS (Lexicographic Conflict-Based Search) for collision-free multi-robot path planning with lexicographic objective preferences, induced by the context. We evaluate the algorithms using three simulated domains and demonstrate its practical applicability using five mobile robots in the salp domain setup.
summary_zh: 真实世界中的机器人通常在客观优先级取决于底层操作环境的场景中工作。当底层环境先验未知时，多个机器人可能需要协同合作以收集信息丰富的观测数据来推断环境，因为基于不正确的环境采取行动可能导致错位和不安全行为。一旦推断出真实的底层环境，机器人将按照环境诱导的偏好顺序优化其特定任务的目标。我们将此问题形式化为一个多机器人上下文不确定随机最短路径（MR-CUSSP）问题，该问题通过联合观测捕捉地标状态下的上下文相关信息。我们的两阶段解决方案包括：（1）CIMOP（用于多目标规划的协同推理），用于计算引导机器人前往信息丰富的地标以有效推断真实环境的规划；（2）LCBS（基于冲突的词典式搜索），用于进行具有词典式目标偏好的无碰撞多机器人路径规划，偏好由环境诱导产生。 我们使用三个模拟领域评估了这些算法，并在 Salp 领域设置中使用五个移动机器人展示了其在实践中的适用性。
tldr: This paper addresses multi-robot coordination under context uncertainty, where robots must first infer the true context through informative observations before optimizing task-specific objectives. They propose a two-stage approach: CIMOP for context inference and LCBS for path planning.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了在上下文不确定性下的多机器人协作，在这种情况下，机器人必须首先通过信息性的观察来推断真实的上下文，然后才能优化特定于任务的目标。他们提出了一种两阶段方法：CIMOP 用于上下文推断，LCBS 用于路径规划。

title: D-Compress: Detail-Preserving LiDAR Range Image Compression for Real-Time Streaming on Resource-Constrained Robots
summary: Efficient 3D LiDAR point cloud compression (LPCC) and streaming are critical for edge server-assisted robotic systems, enabling real-time communication with compact data representations. A widely adopted approach represents LiDAR point clouds as range images, enabling the direct use of mature image and video compression codecs. However, because these codecs are designed with human visual perception in mind, they often compromise geometric details, which downgrades the performance of downstream robotic tasks such as mapping and object detection. Furthermore, rate-distortion optimization (RDO)-based rate control remains largely underexplored for range image compression (RIC) under dynamic bandwidth conditions. To address these limitations, we propose D-Compress, a new detail-preserving and fast RIC framework tailored for real-time streaming. D-Compress integrates both intra- and inter-frame prediction with an adaptive discrete wavelet transform approach for precise residual compression. Additionally, we introduce a new RDO-based rate control algorithm for RIC through new rate-distortion modeling. Extensive evaluations on various datasets demonstrate the superiority of D-Compress, which outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) compression methods in both geometric accuracy and downstream task performance, particularly at compression ratios exceeding 100x, while maintaining real-time execution on resource-constrained hardware. Moreover, evaluations under dynamic bandwidth conditions validate the robustness of its rate control mechanism.
summary_zh: 高效的三维激光雷达点云压缩（LPCC）和流式传输对于边缘服务器辅助的机器人系统至关重要，它可以通过紧凑的数据表示实现实时通信。一种广泛采用的方法是将激光雷达点云表示为深度图像，从而可以直接使用成熟的图像和视频压缩编解码器。然而，由于这些编解码器在设计时考虑了人类视觉感知，它们经常会损害几何细节，从而降低下游机器人任务（如地图构建和目标检测）的性能。此外，基于率失真优化（RDO）的码率控制在动态带宽条件下对于深度图像压缩（RIC）的研究仍不足。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出 D-Compress，一种新的细节保留和快速的 RIC 框架，专为实时流式传输而设计。D-Compress 将帧内和帧间预测与自适应离散小波变换方法相结合，以实现精确的残差压缩。此外，我们通过新的率失真建模，为 RIC 引入了一种新的基于 RDO 的码率控制算法。在各种数据集上的大量评估表明了 D-Compress 的优越性，它在几何精度和下游任务性能方面均优于最先进的（SOTA）压缩方法，尤其是在压缩率超过 100 倍的情况下，同时保持在资源受限硬件上的实时执行。此外，在动态带宽条件下的评估验证了其码率控制机制的鲁棒性。
tldr: D-Compress is a new LiDAR range image compression framework that preserves geometric details for real-time streaming on resource-constrained robots, outperforming existing methods in accuracy and downstream task performance.
tldr_zh: D-Compress是一个新的LiDAR range图像压缩框架，它保留了几何细节以便在资源受限的机器人上进行实时流式传输，在准确性和下游任务性能方面优于现有方法。

title: Creating manufacturable blueprints for coarse-grained virtual robots
summary: Over the past three decades, countless embodied yet virtual agents have freely evolved inside computer simulations, but vanishingly few were realized as physical robots. This is because evolution was conducted at a level of abstraction that was convenient for freeform body generation (creation, mutation, recombination) but swept away almost all of the physical details of functional body parts. The resulting designs were crude and underdetermined, requiring considerable effort and expertise to convert into a manufacturable format. Here, we automate this mapping from simplified design spaces that are readily evolvable to complete blueprints that can be directly followed by a builder. The pipeline incrementally resolves manufacturing constraints by embedding the structural and functional semantics of motors, electronics, batteries, and wiring into the abstract virtual design. In lieu of evolution, a user-defined or AI-generated ``sketch'' of a body plan can also be fed as input to the pipeline, providing a versatile framework for accelerating the design of novel robots.
summary_zh: 在过去的三十年中，无数具身但虚拟的智能体在计算机模拟中自由进化，但几乎没有被实现为物理机器人。这是因为进化是在一种方便自由形式身体生成（创建、变异、重组）的抽象层面上进行的，但忽略了功能性身体部件几乎所有的物理细节。由此产生的设计粗糙且不确定，需要大量的精力和专业知识才能将其转换为可制造的格式。在此，我们将这种从易于进化的简化设计空间到可由构建者直接遵循的完整蓝图的映射自动化。该流程通过将电机、电子元件、电池和布线的结构和功能语义嵌入到抽象的虚拟设计中，逐步解决制造约束。除了进化之外，用户定义或人工智能生成的身体计划“草图”也可以作为该流程的输入，从而为加速新型机器人的设计提供了一个通用的框架。
tldr: This paper presents a pipeline to automatically convert abstract, evolvable virtual robot designs into manufacturable blueprints, addressing the gap between simulated robots and physical realization.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种将抽象的、可进化的虚拟机器人设计自动转换为可制造蓝图的管道方法，旨在解决模拟机器人与物理实现之间的差距。

title: End-to-End O-RAN Testbed for Edge-AI-Enabled 5G/6G Connected Industrial Robotics
summary: Connected robotics is one of the principal use cases driving the transition towards more intelligent and capable 6G mobile cellular networks. Replacing wired connections with highly reliable, high-throughput, and low-latency 5G/6G radio interfaces enables robotic system mobility and the offloading of compute-intensive artificial intelligence (AI) models for robotic perception and control to servers located at the network edge. The transition towards Edge AI as a Service (E-AIaaS) simplifies on-site maintenance of robotic systems and reduces operational costs in industrial environments, while supporting flexible AI model life-cycle management and seamless upgrades of robotic functionalities over time. In this paper, we present a 5G/6G O-RAN-based end-to-end testbed that integrates E-AIaaS for connected industrial robotic applications. The objective is to design and deploy a generic experimental platform based on open technologies and interfaces, demonstrated through an E-AIaaS-enabled autonomous welding scenario. Within this scenario, the testbed is used to investigate trade-offs among different data acquisition, edge processing, and real-time streaming approaches for robotic perception, while supporting emerging paradigms such as semantic and goal-oriented communications.
summary_zh: 互联机器人技术是推动向更智能、更强大的 6G 移动蜂窝网络过渡的主要应用场景之一。 利用高可靠性、高吞吐量和低延迟的 5G/6G 无线电接口取代有线连接，可实现机器人系统的移动性，并将机器人感知和控制所需的计算密集型人工智能 (AI) 模型卸载到位于网络边缘的服务器。 向边缘 AI 即服务 (E-AIaaS) 的转变简化了机器人系统的现场维护，降低了工业环境中的运营成本，同时支持灵活的 AI 模型生命周期管理和机器人功能的无缝升级。 在本文中，我们展示了一个基于 5G/6G O-RAN 的端到端测试平台，该平台集成了 E-AIaaS 以用于互联工业机器人应用。 目标是设计和部署一个基于开放技术和接口的通用实验平台，并通过支持 E-AIaaS 的自主焊接场景进行演示。 在此场景中，该测试平台用于研究机器人感知的不同数据采集、边缘处理和实时流传输方法之间的权衡，同时支持语义和目标导向型通信等新兴范式。
tldr: This paper presents an end-to-end 5G/6G O-RAN testbed with Edge-AI-as-a-Service (E-AIaaS) for connected industrial robotics, demonstrating it with an autonomous welding scenario and investigating data acquisition, edge processing, and real-time streaming tradeoffs.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个端到端的5G/6G O-RAN测试平台，该平台具有边缘AI即服务（E-AIaaS）功能，用于连接的工业机器人技术。通过自主焊接场景进行了演示，并研究了数据采集、边缘处理和实时流媒体的权衡。

title: Demand-Driven Context: A Methodology for Building Enterprise Knowledge Bases Through Agent Failure
summary: Large language model agents demonstrate expert-level reasoning, yet consistently fail on enterprise-specific tasks due to missing domain knowledge -- terminology, operational procedures, system interdependencies, and institutional decisions that exist largely as tribal knowledge. Current approaches fall into two categories: top-down knowledge engineering, which documents domain knowledge before agents use it, and bottom-up automation, where agents learn from task experience. Both have fundamental limitations: top-down efforts produce bloated, untested knowledge bases; bottom-up approaches cannot acquire knowledge that exists only in human heads. We present Demand-Driven Context (DDC), a problem-first methodology that uses agent failure as the primary signal for what domain knowledge to curate. Inspired by Test-Driven Development, DDC inverts knowledge engineering: instead of curating knowledge and hoping it is useful, DDC gives agents real problems, lets them demand the context they need, and curates only the minimum knowledge required to succeed. We describe the methodology, its entity meta-model, and a convergence hypothesis suggesting that 20-30 problem cycles produce a knowledge base sufficient for a given domain role. We demonstrate DDC through a worked example in retail order fulfillment, where nine cycles targeting an SRE incident management agent produce a reusable knowledge base of 46 entities. Finally, we propose a scaling architecture for enterprise adoption with semi-automated curation and human governance.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型代理展示了专家级的推理能力，但由于缺乏领域知识（包括术语、操作流程、系统依赖关系以及主要以部落知识形式存在的制度决策）而经常在企业特定任务上失败。当前的方法可分为两类：自顶向下知识工程，即在代理使用之前记录领域知识；以及自底向上自动化，即代理从任务经验中学习。两者都存在根本性的局限：自顶向下的努力会产生臃肿且未经测试的知识库；自底向上的方法无法获取仅存在于人脑中的知识。我们提出按需驱动上下文 (DDC)，这是一种以问题为先的方法，它将代理失败作为领域知识整理的主要信号。受到测试驱动开发的启发，DDC 反转了知识工程：不是整理知识并期望它有用，而是 DDC 给代理真实的的问题，让它们按需获取所需的上下文，并仅整理成功所需的最小知识。我们描述了该方法，其实体元模型，以及一个收敛假设，该假设表明 20-30 个问题周期会产生足以胜任特定领域角色的知识库。我们通过零售订单履行中的一个实例来演示 DDC，在该实例中，针对 SRE 事件管理代理的九个周期产生了一个包含 46 个实体的可重用知识库。最后，我们提出了一个扩展架构，用于企业采用，包括半自动整理和人工治理。
tldr: The paper introduces Demand-Driven Context (DDC), a methodology that uses agent failure to guide the curation of essential, enterprise-specific domain knowledge for LLM agents, addressing limitations of top-down and bottom-up approaches.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为需求驱动上下文 (DDC) 的方法，该方法利用代理失败来指导为 LLM 代理整理必不可少的、特定于企业的领域知识，从而解决了自上而下和自下而上方法的局限性。

title: GroupGuard: A Framework for Modeling and Defending Collusive Attacks in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: While large language model-based agents demonstrate great potential in collaborative tasks, their interactivity also introduces security vulnerabilities. In this paper, we propose and model group collusive attacks, a highly destructive threat in which multiple agents coordinate via sociological strategies to mislead the system. To address this challenge, we introduce GroupGuard, a training-free defense framework that employs a multi-layered defense strategy, including continuous graph-based monitoring, active honeypot inducement, and structural pruning, to identify and isolate collusive agents. Experimental results across five datasets and four topologies demonstrate that group collusive attacks increase the attack success rate by up to 15\% compared to individual attacks. GroupGuard consistently achieves high detection accuracy (up to 88\%) and effectively restores collaborative performance, providing a robust solution for securing multi-agent systems.
summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型的智能体在协同任务中展现出巨大的潜力，但其交互性也引入了安全漏洞。本文提出并建模了一种极具破坏性的威胁——群体串谋攻击，在这种攻击中，多个智能体通过社会学策略进行协同，从而误导系统。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了GroupGuard，一种免训练的防御框架，它采用多层防御策略，包括连续的基于图的监控、主动蜜罐诱导和结构剪枝，以识别和隔离串谋智能体。在五个数据集和四个拓扑结构上的实验结果表明，与个体攻击相比，群体串谋攻击将攻击成功率提高了高达15%。GroupGuard始终保持着较高的检测精度（高达88%），并能有效恢复协同性能，为多智能体系统的安全提供了可靠的解决方案。
tldr: The paper introduces GroupGuard, a training-free framework to detect and defend against collusive attacks in multi-agent systems, demonstrating improved detection accuracy and performance restoration compared to individual attack defense mechanisms.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为GroupGuard的免训练框架，用于检测和防御多智能体系统中的合谋攻击。实验表明，与针对个体攻击的防御机制相比，该框架在检测准确率和性能恢复方面有所提升。

title: Semantic Aware Feature Extraction for Enhanced 3D Reconstruction
summary: Feature matching is a fundamental problem in computer vision with wide-ranging applications, including simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), image stitching, and 3D reconstruction. While recent advances in deep learning have improved keypoint detection and description, most approaches focus primarily on geometric attributes and often neglect higher-level semantic information. This work proposes a semantic-aware feature extraction framework that employs multi-task learning to jointly train keypoint detection, keypoint description, and semantic segmentation. The method is benchmarked against standard feature matching techniques and evaluated in the context of 3D reconstruction. To enhance feature correspondence, a deep matching module is integrated. The system is tested using input from a single monocular fisheye camera mounted on a vehicle and evaluated within a multi-floor parking structure. The proposed approach supports semantic 3D reconstruction with altitude estimation, capturing elevation changes and enabling multi-level mapping. Experimental results demonstrate that the method produces semantically annotated 3D point clouds with improved structural detail and elevation information, underscoring the effectiveness of joint training with semantic cues for more consistent feature matching and enhanced 3D reconstruction.
summary_zh: 特征匹配是计算机视觉中的一个基本问题，应用广泛，包括同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）、图像拼接和3D重建。虽然深度学习的最新进展改善了关键点检测和描述，但大多数方法主要关注几何属性，常常忽略更高层次的语义信息。本文提出了一种语义感知的特征提取框架，该框架利用多任务学习联合训练关键点检测、关键点描述和语义分割。该方法以标准特征匹配技术为基准，并在3D重建的背景下进行评估。为了增强特征对应关系，集成了一个深度匹配模块。该系统使用安装在车辆上的单个单目鱼眼相机作为输入进行测试，并在多层停车结构中进行评估。所提出的方法支持具有高度估计的语义3D重建，能够捕获高度变化并实现多层地图构建。实验结果表明，该方法生成了语义标注的3D点云，具有改进的结构细节和高度信息，突出了利用语义线索进行联合训练在更一致的特征匹配和增强的3D重建方面的有效性。
tldr: This paper proposes a semantic-aware feature extraction framework using multi-task learning for improved 3D reconstruction, integrating keypoint detection, description, and semantic segmentation, resulting in enhanced elevation information and structural detail in semantically annotated 3D point clouds.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种语义感知的特征提取框架，该框架采用多任务学习方法，以改进三维重建，集成了关键点检测、描述和语义分割，从而在语义标注的三维点云中增强了海拔信息和结构细节。

title: Evaluation of Visual Place Recognition Methods for Image Pair Retrieval in 3D Vision and Robotics
summary: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) is a core component in computer vision, typically formulated as an image retrieval task for localization, mapping, and navigation. In this work, we instead study VPR as an image pair retrieval front-end for registration pipelines, where the goal is to find top-matching image pairs between two disjoint image sets for downstream tasks such as scene registration, SLAM, and Structure-from-Motion. We comparatively evaluate state-of-the-art VPR families - NetVLAD-style baselines, classification-based global descriptors (CosPlace, EigenPlaces), feature-mixing (MixVPR), and foundation-model-driven methods (AnyLoc, SALAD, MegaLoc) - on three challenging datasets: object-centric outdoor scenes (Tanks and Temples), indoor RGB-D scans (ScanNet-GS), and autonomous-driving sequences (KITTI). We show that modern global descriptor approaches are increasingly suitable as off-the-shelf image pair retrieval modules in challenging scenarios including perceptual aliasing and incomplete sequences, while exhibiting clear, domain-dependent strengths and weaknesses that are critical when choosing VPR components for robust mapping and registration.
summary_zh: 视觉地点识别 (VPR) 是计算机视觉中的一个核心组成部分，通常被表述为一种用于定位、建图和导航的图像检索任务。在这项工作中，我们转而研究 VPR 作为配准流程的图像对检索前端，其目标是在两个不相交的图像集之间找到最佳匹配的图像对，用于场景配准、SLAM 和 Structure-from-Motion 等下游任务。我们比较性地评估了最先进的 VPR 系列方法——NetVLAD 风格的基线、基于分类的全局描述符 (CosPlace, EigenPlaces)、特征混合 (MixVPR) 以及基于基础模型的驱动方法 (AnyLoc, SALAD, MegaLoc)——在三个具有挑战性的数据集上：以物体为中心的室外场景 (Tanks and Temples)、室内 RGB-D 扫描 (ScanNet-GS) 和自动驾驶序列 (KITTI)。我们表明，现代全局描述符方法越来越适合作为现成的图像对检索模块，用于包括感知混淆（perceptual aliasing）和不完整序列等具有挑战性的场景，同时表现出清晰的、依赖于领域的优势和劣势，这对于为稳健的建图和配准选择 VPR 组件至关重要。
tldr: This paper evaluates various Visual Place Recognition (VPR) methods as image pair retrieval front-ends for registration pipelines in 3D vision and robotics, finding domain-dependent strengths and weaknesses.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了各种视觉位置识别（VPR）方法，将其作为3D视觉和机器人技术中配准流程的前端图像对检索方法，发现了领域相关的优势和劣势。

title: Towards Stable Self-Supervised Object Representations in Unconstrained Egocentric Video
summary: Humans develop visual intelligence through perceiving and interacting with their environment - a self-supervised learning process grounded in egocentric experience. Inspired by this, we ask how can artificial systems learn stable object representations from continuous, uncurated first-person videos without relying on manual annotations. This setting poses challenges of separating, recognizing, and persistently tracking objects amid clutter, occlusion, and ego-motion. We propose EgoViT, a unified vision Transformer framework designed to learn stable object representations from unlabeled egocentric video. EgoViT bootstraps this learning process by jointly discovering and stabilizing "proto-objects" through three synergistic mechanisms: (1) Proto-object Learning, which uses intra-frame distillation to form discriminative representations; (2) Depth Regularization, which grounds these representations in geometric structure; and (3) Teacher-Filtered Temporal Consistency, which enforces identity over time. This creates a virtuous cycle where initial object hypotheses are progressively refined into stable, persistent representations. The framework is trained end-to-end on unlabeled first-person videos and exhibits robustness to geometric priors of varied origin and quality. On standard benchmarks, EgoViT achieves +8.0% CorLoc improvement in unsupervised object discovery and +4.8% mIoU improvement in semantic segmentation, demonstrating its potential to lay a foundation for robust visual abstraction in embodied intelligence.
summary_zh: 人类通过感知环境并与之交互来发展视觉智能——这是一个基于以自我为中心的经验的自监督学习过程。受此启发，我们探究人工智能系统如何在不依赖手动标注的情况下，从连续、未经整理的第一人称视角视频中学习到稳定的对象表征。这种设置带来了在杂乱、遮挡和自我运动中分离、识别和持续跟踪对象的挑战。我们提出了EgoViT，一个统一的视觉Transformer框架，旨在从无标签的以自我为中心的视频中学习稳定的对象表征。EgoViT通过以下三种协同机制联合发现和稳定“原型对象”来引导这个学习过程：（1）原型对象学习，它使用帧内蒸馏来形成判别性表征；（2）深度正则化，它将这些表征锚定在几何结构中；（3）教师过滤的时间一致性，它在时间维度上强制执行身份。这创建了一个良性循环，其中初始的对象假设逐步细化成稳定、持久的表征。该框架在无标签的第一人称视角视频上进行端到端训练，并表现出对各种来源和质量的几何先验的鲁棒性。在标准基准测试中，EgoViT在无监督对象发现方面实现了+8.0%的CorLoc改进，在语义分割方面实现了+4.8%的mIoU改进，表明它有潜力为具身智能中稳健的视觉抽象奠定基础。
tldr: The paper introduces EgoViT, a self-supervised learning framework for learning stable object representations from uncurated egocentric video by jointly discovering and stabilizing proto-objects using intra-frame distillation, depth regularization, and temporal consistency. It shows significant improvements on unsupervised object discovery and semantic segmentation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EgoViT，一种自监督学习框架，旨在从未标注的以自我为中心的视频中学习稳定的物体表示，通过使用帧内蒸馏、深度正则化和时间一致性来联合发现和稳定 proto-objects。在无监督物体发现和语义分割基准测试中显示出显着的改进。

title: Ego-1K -- A Large-Scale Multiview Video Dataset for Egocentric Vision
summary: We present Ego-1K, a large-scale collection of time-synchronized egocentric multiview videos designed to advance neural 3D video synthesis and dynamic scene understanding. The dataset contains nearly 1,000 short egocentric videos captured with a custom rig with 12 synchronized cameras surrounding a 4-camera VR headset worn by the user. Scene content focuses on hand motions and hand-object interactions in different settings. We describe rig design, data processing, and calibration. Our dataset enables new ways to benchmark egocentric scene reconstruction methods, an important research area as smart glasses with multiple cameras become omnipresent. Our experiments demonstrate that our dataset presents unique challenges for existing 3D and 4D novel view synthesis methods due to large disparities and image motion caused by close dynamic objects and rig egomotion. Our dataset supports future research in this challenging domain. It is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/facebook/ego-1k.
summary_zh: 我们提出了Ego-1K，一个大规模的同步多视角第一人称视频数据集，旨在推进神经3D视频合成和动态场景理解。该数据集包含近1000个短的第一人称视频，这些视频是通过定制的设备采集的，该设备配备了12个同步相机，围绕着用户佩戴的4相机VR头显。场景内容主要集中于不同环境下的手部运动和手与物体的交互。我们详细描述了设备设计、数据处理和校准。我们的数据集为第一人称场景重建方法的基准测试提供了新的途径，随着配备多相机的智能眼镜日益普及，这是一个重要的研究领域。我们的实验表明，由于近距离动态物体和设备自身运动导致的大视差和图像运动，我们的数据集对现有的3D和4D新视角合成方法提出了独特的挑战。我们的数据集支持未来在这个充满挑战的领域的研究。该数据集可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/facebook/ego-1k获得。
tldr: Ego-1K is a large-scale egocentric multiview video dataset featuring hand-object interactions, designed to advance neural 3D video synthesis and dynamic scene understanding in the context of smart glasses research.
tldr_zh: Ego-1K是一个大规模的以自我为中心的视角多视图视频数据集，主要关注手部和物体交互，旨在推动神经3D视频合成和动态场景理解，应用于智能眼镜研究。

title: Sparse-Dense Mixture of Experts Adapter for Multi-Modal Tracking
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) techniques, such as prompts and adapters, are widely used in multi-modal tracking because they alleviate issues of full-model fine-tuning, including time inefficiency, high resource consumption, parameter storage burden, and catastrophic forgetting. However, due to cross-modal heterogeneity, most existing PEFT-based methods struggle to effectively represent multi-modal features within a unified framework with shared parameters. To address this problem, we propose a novel Sparse-Dense Mixture of Experts Adapter (SDMoEA) framework for PEFT-based multi-modal tracking under a unified model structure. Specifically, we design an SDMoE module as the multi-modal adapter to model modality-specific and shared information efficiently. SDMoE consists of a sparse MoE and a dense-shared MoE: the former captures modality-specific information, while the latter models shared cross-modal information. Furthermore, to overcome limitations of existing tracking methods in modeling high-order correlations during multi-level multi-modal fusion, we introduce a Gram-based Semantic Alignment Hypergraph Fusion (GSAHF) module. It first employs Gram matrices for cross-modal semantic alignment, ensuring that the constructed hypergraph accurately reflects semantic similarity and high-order dependencies between modalities. The aligned features are then integrated into the hypergraph structure to exploit its ability to model high-order relationships, enabling deep fusion of multi-level multi-modal information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance compared with other PEFT approaches on several multi-modal tracking benchmarks, including LasHeR, RGBT234, VTUAV, VisEvent, COESOT, DepthTrack, and VOT-RGBD2022.
summary_zh: 参数高效微调 (PEFT) 技术，例如提示和适配器，广泛应用于多模态跟踪，因为它缓解了全模型微调的问题，包括时间效率低下、资源消耗高、参数存储负担以及灾难性遗忘。然而，由于跨模态异构性的存在，大多数现有的基于 PEFT 的方法难以在具有共享参数的统一框架内有效地表示多模态特征。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种用于基于 PEFT 的多模态跟踪的新型稀疏-稠密混合专家适配器（SDMoEA）框架，该框架采用统一的模型结构。具体而言，我们设计了一个 SDMoE 模块作为多模态适配器，以高效地建模模态特定和共享信息。SDMoE 由一个稀疏 MoE 和一个稠密共享 MoE 组成：前者捕获模态特定信息，而后者建模共享的跨模态信息。此外，为了克服现有跟踪方法在多层多模态融合过程中建模高阶相关性方面的局限性，我们引入了一种基于格拉姆矩阵的语义对齐超图融合 (GSAHF) 模块。它首先采用格拉姆矩阵进行跨模态语义对齐，确保构建的超图能够准确反映模态之间的语义相似性和高阶依赖关系。然后将对齐的特征集成到超图结构中，以利用其建模高阶关系的能力，从而实现多层多模态信息的深度融合。大量实验表明，在多个多模态跟踪基准数据集上，包括 LasHeR、RGBT234、VTUAV、VisEvent、COESOT、DepthTrack 和 VOT-RGBD2022，所提出的方法与其它 PEFT 方法相比取得了优越的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces a Sparse-Dense Mixture of Experts Adapter (SDMoEA) for parameter-efficient multi-modal tracking and a Gram-based Semantic Alignment Hypergraph Fusion (GSAHF) module to improve multi-modal feature fusion, achieving superior performance on several benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种用于参数高效多模态跟踪的稀疏-密集混合专家适配器 (SDMoEA) 和一种基于 Gram 的语义对齐超图融合 (GSAHF) 模块，以改进多模态特征融合，并在多个基准测试中取得了优异的性能。

title: GraspADMM: Improving Dexterous Grasp Synthesis via ADMM Optimization
summary: Synthesizing high-quality dexterous grasps is a fundamental challenge in robot manipulation, requiring adherence to diversity, kinematic feasibility (valid hand-object contact without penetration), and dynamic stability (secure multi-contact forces). The recent framework Dexonomy successfully ensures broad grasp diversity through dense sampling and improves kinematic feasibility via a simulator-based refinement method that excels at resolving exact collisions. However, its reliance on fixed contact points restricts the hand's reachability and prevents the optimization of grasp metrics for dynamic stability. Conversely, purely gradient-based optimizers can maximize dynamic stability but rely on simplified contact approximations that inevitably cause physical penetrations. To bridge this gap, we propose GraspADMM, a novel grasp synthesis framework that preserves sampling-based diversity while improving kinematic feasibility and dynamic stability. By formulating the refinement stage using the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM), we decouple the target contact points on the object from the actual contact locations on the hand. This decomposition allows the pipeline to alternate between updating the target object points to directly maximize dynamic grasp metrics, and adjusting the hand pose to physically reach these targets while strictly respecting collision boundaries. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GraspADMM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a nearly 15\% absolute improvement in grasp success rate for type-unaware synthesis and roughly a 100\% relative improvement in type-aware synthesis. Furthermore, our approach maintains robust, physically plausible grasp generation even under extreme low-friction conditions.
summary_zh: 合成高质量的灵巧抓取是机器人操作中一个根本性的挑战，它需要满足多样性、运动学可行性（无穿透的有效手-物接触）和动态稳定性（安全的多点接触力）。最近的框架Dexonomy通过密集采样成功确保了广泛的抓取多样性，并通过基于模拟器的精细化方法提高了运动学可行性，该方法擅长解决精确碰撞。然而，它对固定接触点的依赖限制了手的可达性，并阻止了为动态稳定性优化抓取指标。相反，纯粹基于梯度的优化器可以最大化动态稳定性，但依赖于简化的接触近似，这不可避免地会导致物理穿透。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了GraspADMM，这是一种新颖的抓取合成框架，它保留了基于采样的多样性，同时提高了运动学可行性和动态稳定性。通过使用交替方向乘子法（ADMM）来制定精细化阶段，我们将物体上的目标接触点与手上实际的接触位置解耦。这种分解使得该流程能够交替进行：一方面更新目标物体点以直接最大化动态抓取指标，另一方面调整手部姿势以物理方式到达这些目标，同时严格遵守碰撞边界。大量的实验表明，GraspADMM明显优于最先进的基线方法，在类型未知合成中抓取成功率绝对提高了近15％，在类型已知合成中相对提高了约100％。此外，即使在极低的摩擦条件下，我们的方法也能保持稳健、物理上合理的抓取生成。
tldr: This paper introduces GraspADMM, a new framework for dexterous grasp synthesis that combines sampling-based diversity with ADMM optimization to improve kinematic feasibility and dynamic stability, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了GraspADMM，一种用于灵巧抓取合成的新框架，它结合了基于采样的多样性和ADMM优化，以提高运动学可行性和动态稳定性，优于最先进的基线。

title: ArrayTac: A tactile display for simultaneous rendering of shape, stiffness and friction
summary: Human-computer interaction in the visual and auditory domains has achieved considerable maturity, yet machine-to-human tactile feedback remains underdeveloped. Existing tactile displays struggle to simultaneously render multiple tactile dimensions, such as shape, stiffness, and friction, which limits the realism of haptic simulation. Here, we present ArrayTac, a piezoelectric-driven tactile display capable of simultaneously rendering shape, stiffness, and friction to reproduce realistic haptic signals. The system comprises a 4x4 array of 16 actuator units, each employing a three-stage micro-lever mechanism to amplify the micrometer-scale displacement of the piezoelectric element, with Hall sensor-based closed-loop control at the end effector to enhance response speed and precision. We further implement two end-to-end pipelines: 1) a vision-to-touch framework that converts visual inputs into tactile signals using multimodal foundation models, and 2) a real-time tele-palpation system operating over distances of several thousand kilometers. In user studies, first-time participants accurately identify object shapes and physical properties with high success rates. In a tele-palpation experiment over 1,000km, untrained volunteers correctly identified both the number and type of tumors in a breast phantom with 100% accuracy and precisely localized their positions. The system pioneers a new pathway for high-fidelity haptic feedback by introducing the unprecedented capability to simultaneously render an object's shape, stiffness, and friction, delivering a holistic tactile experience that was previously unattainable.
summary_zh: 视觉和听觉领域的人机交互已经取得了相当大的进展，但机器到人的触觉反馈仍然不发达。现有的触觉显示器难以同时呈现多个触觉维度，例如形状、硬度和摩擦力，这限制了触觉仿真的真实性。在此，我们展示了ArrayTac，一种压电驱动的触觉显示器，能够同时呈现形状、硬度和摩擦力，以重现真实的触觉信号。该系统包含一个4x4的16个致动器单元阵列，每个单元采用一个三级微杠杆机构来放大压电元件的微米级位移，并在末端执行器处采用基于霍尔传感器的闭环控制，以提高响应速度和精度。我们进一步实现了两个端到端流程：1）一个视觉到触觉框架，使用多模态基础模型将视觉输入转换为触觉信号，以及2）一个在数千公里距离上运行的实时远程触诊系统。在用户研究中，首次参与者能够以高成功率准确识别物体形状和物理性质。在一个超过1000公里的远程触诊实验中，未经训练的志愿者以100%的准确率正确识别了乳房模型中的肿瘤数量和类型，并精确定位了其位置。该系统通过引入前所未有的同时呈现物体形状、硬度和摩擦力的能力，开创了高保真触觉反馈的新途径，从而提供了一种以前无法实现的整体触觉体验。
tldr: The paper presents ArrayTac, a tactile display using piezoelectric actuators for simultaneous rendering of shape, stiffness, and friction, demonstrated through vision-to-touch and tele-palpation applications with impressive initial results.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为ArrayTac的触觉显示器，它使用压电执行器同时渲染形状、硬度和摩擦力。通过视觉到触摸和远程触诊的应用进行了演示，并取得了令人印象深刻的初步结果。

title: Level Up: Defining and Exploiting Transitional Problems for Curriculum Learning
summary: Curriculum learning--ordering training examples in a sequence to aid machine learning--takes inspiration from human learning, but has not gained widespread acceptance. Static strategies for scoring item difficulty rely on indirect proxy scores of varying quality and produce curricula that are not specific to the learner at hand. Dynamic approaches base difficulty estimates on gradient information, requiring considerable extra computation during training. We introduce a novel method for measuring the difficulty of individual problem instances directly relative to the ability of a given model, and identify transitional problems that are consistently easier as model ability increases. Applying this method to chess and mathematics, we find that training on a curriculum that "levels up" from easier to harder transitional problems most efficiently improves a model to the next tier of competence. These problems induce a natural progression from easier to harder items, which outperforms other training strategies. By measuring difficulty directly relative to model competence, our method yields interpretable problems, learner-specific curricula, and a principled basis for step-by-step improvement.
summary_zh: 课程学习——通过对训练样本进行排序，以辅助机器学习——其灵感来源于人类学习，但尚未得到广泛应用。静态难度评估策略依赖于质量不一的间接代理分数，并且产生的课程目标并非针对于手头的学习者。动态方法则基于梯度信息评估难度，需要在训练期间进行大量的额外计算。我们引入了一种新方法，直接衡量单个问题实例相对于给定模型能力的难度，并识别出随着模型能力的提高而始终更容易的过渡性问题。将此方法应用于国际象棋和数学，我们发现基于由易到难的过渡性问题进行“升级”的课程训练，能够最有效地使模型提升到下一个能力层级。这些问题诱导了从易到难的自然渐进，优于其他训练策略。通过直接衡量难度与模型能力的关系，我们的方法产生了可解释的问题、针对学习者的特定课程以及逐步改进的原则性基础。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel curriculum learning method that identifies and utilizes 'transitional problems' that become easier as the model learns, leading to more efficient training in chess and mathematics.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的课程学习方法，该方法识别并利用随着模型学习而变得更容易的“过渡问题”，从而更有效地训练模型在国际象棋和数学方面的能力。

title: OpenCOOD-Air: Prompting Heterogeneous Ground-Air Collaborative Perception with Spatial Conversion and Offset Prediction
summary: While Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) collaboration extends sensing ranges through multi-agent data sharing, its reliability remains severely constrained by ground-level occlusions and the limited perspective of chassis-mounted sensors, which often result in critical perception blind spots. We propose OpenCOOD-Air, a novel framework that integrates UAVs as extensible platforms into V2V collaborative perception to overcome these constraints. To mitigate gradient interference from ground-air domain gaps and data sparsity, we adopt a transfer learning strategy to fine-tune UAV weights from pre-trained V2V models. To prevent the spatial information loss inherent in this transition, we formulate ground-air collaborative perception as a heterogeneous integration task with explicit altitude supervision and introduce a Cross-Domain Spatial Converter (CDSC) and a Spatial Offset Prediction Transformer (SOPT). Furthermore, we present the OPV2V-Air benchmark to validate the transition from V2V to Vehicle-to-Vehicle-to-UAV. Compared to state-of-the-art methods, our approach improves 2D and 3D AP@0.7 by 4% and 7%, respectively.
summary_zh: 车辆间（V2V）协同通过多智能体数据共享扩展了感知范围，但其可靠性仍然受到地面遮挡和底盘安装传感器有限视角的严重限制，这通常导致关键的感知盲区。我们提出了一种名为OpenCOOD-Air的新型框架，该框架将无人机作为可扩展平台集成到V2V协同感知中，以克服这些限制。为了减轻来自地面-空中领域差异和数据稀疏性的梯度干扰，我们采用迁移学习策略，从预训练的V2V模型中微调无人机权重。为了防止此转换中固有的空间信息损失，我们将地面-空中协同感知表述为具有显式高度监督的异构集成任务，并引入了一个跨域空间转换器（CDSC）和一个空间偏移预测Transformer（SOPT）。此外，我们提出了OPV2V-Air基准，以验证从V2V到车辆-车辆-无人机的过渡。与最先进的方法相比，我们的方法分别提高了2D和3D AP@0.7 4%和7%。
tldr: The paper introduces OpenCOOD-Air, a framework using UAVs to enhance V2V collaborative perception by addressing occlusion and limited perspective issues through spatial conversion and offset prediction, showing improvements in 2D/3D object detection accuracy.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了OpenCOOD-Air，一个利用无人机增强V2V协同感知的框架，通过空间转换和偏移预测来解决遮挡和有限视角问题，并在2D/3D目标检测精度方面有所提高。

title: VFM-Loc: Zero-Shot Cross-View Geo-Localization via Aligning Discriminative Visual Hierarchies
summary: Cross-View Geo-Localization (CVGL) in remote sensing aims to locate a drone-view query by matching it to geo-tagged satellite images. Although supervised methods have achieved strong results on closeset benchmarks, they often fail to generalize to unconstrained, real-world scenarios due to severe viewpoint differences and dataset bias. To overcome these limitations, we present VFM-Loc, a training-free framework for zero-shot CVGL that leverages the generalizable visual representations from vision foundational models (VFMs). VFM-Loc identifies and matches discriminative visual clues across different viewpoints through a progressive alignment strategy. First, we design a hierarchical clue extraction mechanism using Generalized Mean pooling and Scale-Weighted RMAC to preserve distinctive visual clues across scales while maintaining hierarchical confidence. Second, we introduce a statistical manifold alignment pipeline based on domain-wise PCA and Orthogonal Procrustes analysis, linearly aligning heterogeneous feature distributions in a shared metric space. Experiments demonstrate that VFM-Loc exhibits strong zero-shot accuracy on standard benchmarks and surpasses supervised methods by over 20% in Recall@1 on the challenging LO-UCV dataset with large oblique angles. This work highlights that principled alignment of pre-trained features can effectively bridge the cross-view gap, establishing a robust and training-free paradigm for real-world CVGL. The relevant code is made available at: https://github.com/DingLei14/VFM-Loc.
summary_zh: 遥感中的跨视角地理定位（CVGL）旨在通过将无人机视角查询与带有地理标签的卫星图像进行匹配来定位无人机。尽管有监督方法在封闭数据集上取得了显著成果，但由于严重的视角差异和数据集偏差，它们通常无法推广到不受约束的真实场景。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了VFM-Loc，一个用于零样本CVGL的免训练框架，利用了视觉基础模型（VFMs）的可泛化视觉表示。VFM-Loc通过渐进式对齐策略识别并匹配不同视角下的判别性视觉线索。首先，我们设计了一种使用广义均值池化和尺度加权RMAC的分层线索提取机制，以在保持分层置信度的同时保留跨尺度的独特视觉线索。其次，我们引入了一个基于领域PCA和正交普罗克鲁斯分析的统计流形对齐流程，在线性共享度量空间中对齐异构特征分布。实验表明，VFM-Loc在标准基准上表现出强大的零样本精度，并且在具有大倾斜角的具有挑战性的LO-UCV数据集上，Recall@1指标超越有监督方法超过20%。这项工作强调了预训练特征的原则性对齐可以有效地弥合跨视角差距，从而为现实世界的CVGL建立一个稳健的免训练范例。相关代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/DingLei14/VFM-Loc。
tldr: The paper introduces VFM-Loc, a training-free framework for zero-shot cross-view geo-localization that aligns visual features extracted from vision foundational models using hierarchical clue extraction and statistical manifold alignment. It achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance, even surpassing supervised methods on a challenging dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出VFM-Loc，一个无需训练的零样本跨视角地理定位框架，通过使用视觉基础模型提取的视觉特征，并结合分层线索提取和统计流形对齐来进行特征对齐。该方法实现了最先进的零样本性能，甚至在具有挑战性的数据集上超过了监督方法。

title: Task-Oriented Wireless Transmission of 3D Point Clouds: Geometric Versus Semantic Robustness
summary: Wireless transmission of high-dimensional 3D point clouds (PCs) is increasingly required in industrial collaborative robotics systems. Conventional compression methods prioritize geometric fidelity, although many practical applications ultimately depend on reliable task-level inference rather than exact coordinate reconstruction. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end semantic communication framework for wireless 3D PC transmission and conduct a systematic study of the relationship between geometric reconstruction fidelity and semantic robustness under channel impairments. The proposed architecture jointly supports geometric recovery and object classification from a shared transmitted representation, enabling direct comparison between coordinate-level and task-level sensitivity to noise. Experimental evaluation on a real industrial dataset reveals a pronounced asymmetry: semantic inference remains stable across a broad signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) range even when geometric reconstruction quality degrades significantly. These results demonstrate that reliable task execution does not require high-fidelity geometric recovery and provide design insights for task-oriented wireless perception systems in bandwidth- and power-constrained industrial environments.
summary_zh: 高维3D点云（PC）的无线传输在工业协作机器人系统中日益普及。传统的压缩方法优先考虑几何保真度，但许多实际应用最终依赖于可靠的任务级推理，而非精确的坐标重建。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于无线3D点云传输的端到端语义通信框架，并对信道损伤下几何重建保真度与语义鲁棒性之间的关系进行了系统性研究。所提出的架构共同支持从共享传输表示中进行几何恢复和对象分类，从而能够直接比较坐标级和任务级对噪声的敏感性。在真实工业数据集上的实验评估揭示了一种显著的不对称性：即使几何重建质量显著下降，语义推理在较宽的信噪比（SNR）范围内仍保持稳定。这些结果表明，可靠的任务执行不需要高保真度的几何恢复，并为带宽和功率受限的工业环境中面向任务的无线感知系统提供了设计见解。
tldr: This paper proposes a semantic communication framework for wireless transmission of 3D point clouds in industrial robotics, demonstrating that task-level inference can be robust even with degraded geometric reconstruction, offering design insights for bandwidth-constrained environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于工业机器人中3D点云无线传输的语义通信框架，表明即使几何重建质量下降，任务级别的推理仍然可以保持鲁棒性，为带宽受限的环境提供了设计见解。

title: Distributional Uncertainty and Adaptive Decision-Making in System
summary: Complex engineered systems require coordinated design choices across heterogeneous components under multiple conflicting objectives and uncertain specifications. Monotone co-design provides a compositional framework for such problems by modeling each subsystem as a design problem: a feasible relation between provided functionalities and required resources in partially ordered sets. Existing uncertain co-design models rely on interval bounds, which support worst-case reasoning but cannot represent probabilistic risk or multi-stage adaptive decisions. We develop a distributional extension of co-design that models uncertain design outcomes as distributions over design problems and supports adaptive decision processes through Markov-kernel re-parameterizations. Using quasi-measurable and quasi-universal spaces, we show that the standard co-design interconnection operations remain compositional under this richer notion of uncertainty. We further introduce queries and observations that extract probabilistic design trade-offs, including feasibility probabilities, confidence bounds, and distributions of minimal required resources. A task-driven unmanned aerial vehicle case study illustrates how the framework captures risk-sensitive and information-dependent design choices that interval-based models cannot express.
summary_zh: 复杂工程系统需要在多个冲突目标和不确定规格下，对不同组件进行协调设计选择。单调协同设计为此类问题提供了一个组合框架，它将每个子系统建模为一个设计问题：即部分有序集中提供的功能和所需资源之间的可行关系。现有不确定协同设计模型依赖于区间界限，虽然支持最坏情况推理，但无法表示概率风险或多阶段自适应决策。我们开发了协同设计的一种分布化扩展，将不确定的设计结果建模为设计问题上的分布，并通过马尔可夫核重新参数化来支持自适应决策过程。利用拟可测空间和拟泛空间，我们证明了在更丰富的这种不确定性概念下，标准协同设计互连操作仍然具有组合性。我们进一步引入了查询和观测，用于提取概率设计权衡，包括可行性概率、置信界限和所需最小资源的分布。一个任务驱动的无人飞行器案例研究表明，该框架能够捕捉区间模型无法表达的风险敏感型和信息依赖型设计选择。
tldr: The paper introduces a distributional extension of co-design for complex systems, enabling risk-sensitive and information-dependent design choices beyond interval-based models, demonstrated with a UAV case study.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了复杂系统协同设计的分布扩展方法，实现了超越基于区间的模型，对风险敏感和信息依赖的设计选择，并通过无人机案例研究进行了演示。

title: LineMaster Pro: A Low-Cost Intelligent Line Following Robot with PID Control and Ultrasonic Obstacle Avoidance for Educational Robotics
summary: Line following robots are fundamental platforms in robotics education, yet commercially available solutions remain prohibitively expensive ($150-300$) while lacking integrated obstacle detection capabilities essential for real-world applications. This paper presents LineMaster Pro, an intelligent low-cost line following robot implemented on an Arduino Nano platform that integrates dual TCRT5000 infrared sensors for precision line tracking, an HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor for real-time obstacle detection, a digitally tuned PID controller with Ziegler-Nichols optimization, and a hierarchical finite state machine for robust obstacle avoidance. A systematic four-phase sensor calibration methodology ensures reliable operation across varying lighting and surface conditions. Experimental validation through 200 controlled trials and 72-hour continuous operation demonstrates mean tracking accuracy of 1.18 cm at 0.4 m/s (95\% CI [1.06, 1.30]), obstacle detection reliability of 96.7\% within 10-40 cm range with 0.7\% false positive rate, and 94\% successful recovery from path deviations. The PID implementation achieves 43\% improvement over conventional on-off control ($p<0.001$). At a total hardware cost of \$28.50 based on verified Bangladesh market prices, LineMaster Pro achieves a 94\% cost reduction compared to commercial alternatives, establishing a practical benchmark for accessible robotics education in resource-constrained environments.
authors: A. S. M. Ahsanul Sarkar Akib
summary_zh: 循迹机器人是机器人教育中的基础平台，然而，市面上的解决方案价格仍然过于昂贵（150-300美元），并且缺乏实际应用中必不可少的集成障碍物检测功能。本文介绍了一种名为LineMaster Pro的智能低成本循迹机器人，它基于Arduino Nano平台，集成了双TCRT5000红外传感器以实现精确的循迹，HC-SR04超声波传感器用于实时障碍物检测，采用经过Ziegler-Nichols优化的数字调谐PID控制器，以及用于实现鲁棒障碍物规避的分层有限状态机。一套系统的四阶段传感器校准方法确保了在不同光照和表面条件下的可靠运行。 通过200次受控试验和72小时连续运行的实验验证表明，在0.4米/秒的速度下，平均循迹精度为1.18厘米（95%置信区间[1.06, 1.30]），10-40厘米范围内的障碍物检测可靠性为96.7%，误报率为0.7%，从路径偏差中成功恢复的几率为94%。 相比于传统的开关控制，PID控制的性能提升了43%（p<0.001）。 基于经验证的孟加拉国市场价格， LineMaster Pro 的总硬件成本为28.50美元，与商业替代方案相比，成本降低了94%，从而为资源受限环境下的普及型机器人教育树立了实用的基准。
tldr: The paper presents LineMaster Pro, a low-cost, Arduino-based line following robot with integrated obstacle detection using PID control and a hierarchical finite state machine, achieving high accuracy and reliability at a significantly reduced cost compared to commercial alternatives, targeting robotics education in resource-constrained environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种低成本的LineMaster Pro，它是一款基于Arduino平台的循线机器人，集成了PID控制和分层有限状态机，实现了高精度和可靠性，且成本远低于商业替代品，目标是在资源受限的环境中进行机器人教育。

title: Sonar-MASt3R: Real-Time Opti-Acoustic Fusion in Turbid, Unstructured Environments
summary: Underwater intervention is an important capability in several marine domains, with numerous industrial, scientific, and defense applications. However, existing perception systems used during intervention operations rely on data from optical cameras, which limits capabilities in poor visibility or lighting conditions. Prior work has examined opti-acoustic fusion methods, which use sonar data to resolve the depth ambiguity of the camera data while using camera data to resolve the elevation angle ambiguity of the sonar data. However, existing methods cannot achieve dense 3D reconstructions in real-time, and few studies have reported results from applying these methods in a turbid environment. In this work, we propose the opti-acoustic fusion method Sonar-MASt3R, which uses MASt3R to extract dense correspondences from optical camera data in real-time and pairs it with geometric cues from an acoustic 3D reconstruction to ensure robustness in turbid conditions. Experimental results using data recorded from an opti-acoustic eye-in-hand configuration across turbidity values ranging from <0.5 to >12 NTU highlight this method's improved robustness to turbidity relative to baseline methods.
summary_zh: 水下干预是多个海洋领域的重要能力，在工业、科学和国防方面都有诸多应用。然而，现有干预操作中使用的感知系统依赖于光学相机的数据，这限制了在能见度或照明条件不佳情况下的能力。先前的工作已经研究了光声融合方法，该方法利用声纳数据来解决相机数据的深度歧义，同时利用相机数据来解决声纳数据的仰角歧义。然而，现有方法无法实时实现密集的3D重建，并且很少有研究报告在浑浊环境中应用这些方法的结果。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种光声融合方法Sonar-MASt3R，该方法使用MASt3R从光学相机数据中实时提取密集的对应关系，并将其与来自声学3D重建的几何线索配对，以确保在浑浊条件下的鲁棒性。使用从光声手眼配置记录的数据进行的实验结果，其浊度值范围从<0.5到>12 NTU，突出了该方法相对于基线方法在浊度方面的改进鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper presents Sonar-MASt3R, a real-time opti-acoustic fusion method that extracts dense correspondences from camera data and combines it with sonar data to enable robust 3D reconstructions in turbid underwater environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种名为Sonar-MASt3R的实时光声融合方法，该方法从相机数据中提取密集的对应关系，并将其与声纳数据相结合，从而实现在混浊水下环境中进行鲁棒的3D重建。

title: VAD4Space: Visual Anomaly Detection for Planetary Surface Imagery
summary: Space missions generate massive volumes of high-resolution orbital and surface imagery that far exceed the capacity for manual inspection. Detecting rare phenomena is scientifically critical, yet traditional supervised learning struggles due to scarce labeled examples and closed-world assumptions that prevent discovery of genuinely novel observations. In this work, we investigate Visual Anomaly Detection (VAD) as a framework for automated discovery in planetary exploration. We present the first empirical evaluation of state-of-the-art feature-based VAD methods on real planetary imagery, encompassing both orbital lunar data and Mars rover surface imagery. To support this evaluation, we introduce two benchmarks: (i) a lunar dataset derived from Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera Narrow Angle imagery, comprising of fresh and degraded craters as anomalies alongside normal terrain; and (ii) a Mars surface dataset designed to reflect the characteristics of rover-acquired imagery. We evaluate multiple VAD approaches with a focus on computationally efficient, edge-oriented solutions suitable for onboard deployment, applicable to both orbital platforms surveying the lunar surface and surface rovers operating on Mars. Our results demonstrate that feature-based VAD methods can effectively identify rare planetary surface phenomena while remaining feasible for resource-constrained environments. By grounding anomaly detection in planetary science, this work establishes practical benchmarks and highlights the potential of open-world perception systems to support a range of mission-critical applications, including tactical planning, landing site selection, hazard detection, bandwidth-aware data prioritization, and the discovery of unanticipated geological processes.
summary_zh: 太空任务会产生海量的高分辨率轨道和表面图像，远远超出人工检查的能力。探测罕见现象在科学上至关重要，但由于标记样本稀缺以及封闭世界的假设，导致传统监督学习难以胜任，从而阻碍了对真正新颖观测结果的发现。在这项工作中，我们研究了视觉异常检测（VAD）作为行星探索中自动化发现的框架。我们首次在真实的行星图像上对最先进的基于特征的VAD方法进行了实证评估，涵盖了月球轨道数据和火星漫游车表面图像。为了支持这一评估，我们引入了两个基准数据集：（i）一个来自月球勘测轨道飞行器相机窄角图像的月球数据集，包含新鲜和退化的陨石坑作为异常，以及正常地形；(ii) 一个火星表面数据集，旨在反映漫游车采集图像的特征。我们评估了多种VAD方法，重点是计算效率高、面向边缘的解决方案，适用于机载部署，可应用于勘测月球表面的轨道平台和在火星上运行的表面漫游车。我们的结果表明，基于特征的VAD方法可以有效地识别罕见的行星表面现象，同时保持在资源受限环境中的可行性。通过将异常检测应用于行星科学，这项工作建立了实用的基准，并突出了开放式世界感知系统支持一系列关键任务应用（包括战术规划、着陆点选择、危险检测、带宽感知数据优先级划分以及意外地质过程的发现）的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces two planetary imagery datasets for visual anomaly detection (VAD) and evaluates feature-based VAD methods on them for potential onboard deployment in space missions.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了两个行星图像数据集用于视觉异常检测 (VAD)，并评估了基于特征的 VAD 方法在这些数据集上的性能，以便于在航天任务中进行机载部署。

title: EchoLVFM: One-Step Video Generation via Latent Flow Matching for Echocardiogram Synthesis
summary:
Echocardiography is widely used for assessing cardiac function, where clinically meaningful parameters such as left-ventricular ejection fraction (EF) play a central role in diagnosis and management. Generative models capable of synthesising realistic echocardiogram videos with explicit control over such parameters are valuable for data augmentation, counterfactual analysis, and specialist training. However, existing approaches typically rely on computationally expensive multi-step sampling and aggressive temporal normalisation, limiting efficiency and applicability to heterogeneous real-world data.
  We introduce EchoLVFM, a one-step latent video flow-matching framework for controllable echocardiogram generation. Operating in the latent space, EchoLVFM synthesises temporally coherent videos in a single inference step, achieving a $\mathbf{\sim 50\times}$ improvement in sampling efficiency compared to multi-step flow baselines while maintaining visual fidelity. The model supports global conditioning on clinical variables, demonstrated through precise control of EF, and enables reconstruction and counterfactual generation from partially observed sequences. A masked conditioning strategy further removes fixed-length constraints, allowing shorter sequences to be retained rather than discarded.
  We evaluate EchoLVFM on the CAMUS dataset under challenging single-frame conditioning. Quantitative and qualitative results demonstrate competitive video quality, strong EF adherence, and 57.9% discrimination accuracy by expert clinicians which is close to chance. These findings indicate that efficient, one-step flow matching can enable practical, controllable echocardiogram video synthesis without sacrificing fidelity. Code available at: https://github.com/EngEmmanuel/EchoLVFM
summary_zh:
超声心动图广泛应用于评估心脏功能，其中临床意义显著的参数，如左心室射血分数(EF)，在诊断和治疗中起着核心作用。能够合成具有明确参数控制的逼真超声心动图视频的生成模型，对于数据增强、反事实分析和专科医生培训具有重要价值。然而，现有方法通常依赖于计算成本高的多步采样和激进的时间归一化，限制了效率和在异构现实世界数据中的适用性。

我们提出了EchoLVFM，一个用于可控超声心动图生成的单步潜在视频流匹配框架。EchoLVFM在潜在空间中运行，通过单次推理步骤合成时间上连贯的视频，与多步流基线相比，采样效率提升了$\mathbf{\sim 50\times}$，同时保持了视觉保真度。该模型支持基于临床变量的全局条件控制，通过对EF的精确控制得以证明，并能从部分观察到的序列中进行重建和反事实生成。一种掩码条件控制策略进一步消除了固定长度的约束，允许保留较短的序列而不是丢弃。

我们在CAMUS数据集上对EchoLVFM进行了具有挑战性的单帧条件控制下的评估。定量和定性结果表明，其具有竞争力的视频质量、强大的EF依从性和专家临床医生57.9%的鉴别准确率，接近随机水平。这些发现表明，高效的单步流匹配可以在不牺牲保真度的情况下实现实用、可控的超声心动图视频合成。代码见：https://github.com/EngEmmanuel/EchoLVFM
tldr: The paper introduces EchoLVFM, a one-step latent video flow-matching framework for efficient and controllable echocardiogram generation, achieving significant speedups while maintaining visual fidelity and clinical relevance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EchoLVFM，一个单步潜在视频流匹配框架，用于高效且可控的超声心动图生成，在保持视觉逼真度和临床相关性的同时，实现了显著的加速。

title: PhyGaP: Physically-Grounded Gaussians with Polarization Cues
summary: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have demonstrated great success in modeling reflective 3D objects and their interaction with the environment via deferred rendering (DR). However, existing methods often struggle with correctly reconstructing physical attributes such as albedo and reflectance, and therefore they do not support high-fidelity relighting. Observing that this limitation stems from the lack of shape and material information in RGB images, we present PhyGaP, a physically-grounded 3DGS method that leverages polarization cues to facilitate precise reflection decomposition and visually consistent relighting of reconstructed objects. Specifically, we design a polarimetric deferred rendering (PolarDR) process to model polarization by reflection, and a self-occlusion-aware environment map building technique (GridMap) to resolve indirect lighting of non-convex objects. We validate on multiple synthetic and real-world scenes, including those featuring only partial polarization cues, that PhyGaP not only excels in reconstructing the appearance and surface normal of reflective 3D objects (~2 dB in PSNR and 45.7% in Cosine Distance better than existing RGB-based methods on average), but also achieves state-of-the-art inverse rendering and relighting capability. Our code will be released soon.
summary_zh: 3D高斯溅射(3DGS)的最新进展已展示出在建模反射性3D物体及其通过延迟渲染(DR)与环境的交互方面取得的巨大成功。然而，现有方法通常难以正确重建诸如反照率和反射率等物理属性，因此它们不支持高保真重新光照。观察到这一局限性源于RGB图像中缺乏形状和材质信息，我们提出了PhyGaP，一种基于物理的3DGS方法，它利用偏振线索来促进精确的反射分解，并实现重建物体的视觉一致的重新光照。具体而言，我们设计了一种偏振延迟渲染(PolarDR)流程来模拟反射引起的偏振，以及一种自遮挡感知的环境贴图构建技术(GridMap)来解决非凸物体的间接光照。我们通过多个合成和真实场景（包括仅具有部分偏振线索的场景）验证了PhyGaP不仅擅长重建反射性3D物体的外观和表面法线（平均而言，PSNR比现有基于RGB的方法高约2 dB，Cosine Distance高45.7%），而且实现了最先进的逆渲染和重新光照能力。我们的代码即将发布。
tldr: PhyGaP improves 3D Gaussian Splatting by incorporating polarization cues for better reconstruction of physical attributes like albedo and reflectance, enabling high-fidelity relighting.
tldr_zh: PhyGaP通过引入偏振线索改进了 3D Gaussian Splatting，从而更好地重建了反照率和反射率等物理属性，实现了高保真重新照明。

title: USIS-PGM: Photometric Gaussian Mixtures for Underwater Salient Instance Segmentation
summary: Underwater salient instance segmentation (USIS) is crucial for marine robotic systems, as it enables both underwater salient object detection and instance-level mask prediction for visual scene understanding. Compared with its terrestrial counterpart, USIS is more challenging due to the underwater image degradation. To address this issue, this paper proposes USIS-PGM, a single-stage framework for USIS. Specifically, the encoder enhances boundary cues through a frequency-aware module and performs content-adaptive feature reweighting via a dynamic weighting module. The decoder incorporates a Transformer-based instance activation module to better distinguish salient instances. In addition, USIS-PGM employs multi-scale Gaussian heatmaps generated from ground-truth masks through Photometric Gaussian Mixture (PGM) to supervise intermediate decoder features, thereby improving salient instance localization and producing more structurally coherent mask predictions. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority and practical applicability of the proposed USIS-PGM model.
summary_zh: 水下显著性实例分割（USIS）对于海洋机器人系统至关重要，因为它能够实现水下显著目标检测和实例级掩模预测，从而进行视觉场景理解。与陆地同类任务相比，水下图像退化使得USIS更具挑战性。为了解决这个问题，本文提出USIS-PGM，一种用于USIS的单阶段框架。具体来说，编码器通过频率感知模块增强边界线索，并通过动态加权模块执行内容自适应的特征重加权。解码器结合了基于Transformer的实例激活模块，以更好地区分显著性实例。此外，USIS-PGM采用通过光度高斯混合（PGM）从ground-truth掩模生成的多尺度高斯热图来监督中间解码器特征，从而提高显著性实例的定位能力并产生结构上更连贯的掩模预测。实验结果表明了所提出的USIS-PGM模型的优越性和实际适用性。
tldr: The paper proposes a single-stage framework, USIS-PGM, for underwater salient instance segmentation, utilizing a frequency-aware module, dynamic weighting, a Transformer-based activation module, and Photometric Gaussian Mixture (PGM) based supervision to address challenges posed by underwater image degradation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种单阶段框架 USIS-PGM，用于水下显著性实例分割。它通过频率感知模块、动态加权、基于 Transformer 的激活模块和基于光度高斯混合 (PGM) 的监督来解决水下图像退化带来的挑战。

title: MOGeo: Beyond One-to-One Cross-View Object Geo-localization
summary: Cross-View Object Geo-Localization (CVOGL) aims to locate an object of interest in a query image within a corresponding satellite image. Existing methods typically assume that the query image contains only a single object, which does not align with the complex, multi-object geo-localization requirements in real-world applications, making them unsuitable for practical scenarios. To bridge the gap between the realistic setting and existing task, we propose a new task, called Cross-View Multi-Object Geo-Localization (CVMOGL). To advance the CVMOGL task, we first construct a benchmark, CMLocation, which includes two datasets: CMLocation-V1 and CMLocation-V2. Furthermore, we propose a novel cross-view multi-object geo-localization method, MOGeo, and benchmark it against existing state-of-the-art methods. Extensive experiments are conducted under various application scenarios to validate the effectiveness of our method. The results demonstrate that cross-view object geo-localization in the more realistic setting remains a challenging problem, encouraging further research in this area.
summary_zh: 跨视角目标地理定位（CVOGL）旨在将查询图像中感兴趣的目标定位到相应的卫星图像中。现有方法通常假设查询图像仅包含单个目标，这与现实世界应用中复杂的多目标地理定位需求不符，从而使其不适用于实际场景。为了弥合现实环境与现有任务之间的差距，我们提出了一项新任务，称为跨视角多目标地理定位（CVMOGL）。为了推进CVMOGL任务，我们首先构建了一个基准测试数据集CMLocation，包含两个数据集：CMLocation-V1和CMLocation-V2。此外，我们提出了一种新的跨视角多目标地理定位方法MOGeo，并将其与现有的最先进方法进行基准测试。在各种应用场景下进行了大量的实验，以验证我们方法的有效性。结果表明，在更真实的场景下进行跨视角目标地理定位仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题，鼓励对该领域进行进一步的研究。
tldr: This paper introduces a new task, Cross-View Multi-Object Geo-Localization (CVMOGL), to address the limitations of existing methods that only consider single-object scenarios. They provide a benchmark dataset and a novel method, MOGeo, for this task.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个新的任务：跨视角多目标地理定位 (CVMOGL)，旨在解决现有方法仅考虑单目标场景的局限性。他们为此任务提供了一个基准数据集和一个名为 MOGeo 的新方法。

title: RetimeGS: Continuous-Time Reconstruction of 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Temporal retiming, the ability to reconstruct and render dynamic scenes at arbitrary timestamps, is crucial for applications such as slow-motion playback, temporal editing, and post-production. However, most existing 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) methods overfit at discrete frame indices but struggle to represent continuous-time frames, leading to ghosting artifacts when interpolating between timestamps. We identify this limitation as a form of temporal aliasing and propose RetimeGS, a simple yet effective 4DGS representation that explicitly defines the temporal behavior of the 3D Gaussian and mitigates temporal aliasing. To achieve smooth and consistent interpolation, we incorporate optical flow-guided initialization and supervision, triple-rendering supervision, and other targeted strategies. Together, these components enable ghost-free, temporally coherent rendering even under large motions. Experiments on datasets featuring fast motion, non-rigid deformation, and severe occlusions demonstrate that RetimeGS achieves superior quality and coherence over state-of-the-art methods.
summary_zh: 时间重定时，即在任意时间戳重构和渲染动态场景的能力，对于慢动作回放、时间编辑和后期制作等应用至关重要。然而，大多数现有的 4D 高斯溅射 (4DGS) 方法过度拟合离散帧索引，但在表示连续时间帧方面表现不佳，导致在时间戳之间插值时出现重影伪影。我们将此限制识别为一种时间混叠形式，并提出 RetimeGS，一种简单而有效的 4DGS 表示，其显式定义了 3D 高斯的时间行为，并减轻了时间混叠。为了实现平滑且一致的插值，我们结合了光流引导的初始化和监督、三倍渲染监督以及其他针对性策略。综上所述，这些组件即使在大幅运动下也能实现无重影、时间上连贯的渲染。在包含快速运动、非刚性变形和严重遮挡的数据集上的实验表明，RetimeGS 实现了优于最先进方法的质量和连贯性。
tldr: The paper introduces RetimeGS, a novel 4D Gaussian Splatting method that explicitly models the temporal behavior of 3D Gaussians to achieve temporally coherent rendering and reduce ghosting artifacts in dynamic scenes.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新的4D高斯溅射方法RetimeGS，该方法明确地对3D高斯函数的时序行为进行建模，从而实现时间连贯的渲染并减少动态场景中的重影伪影。

title: Steering Generative Models for Accessibility: EasyRead Image Generation
summary: EasyRead pictograms are simple, visually clear images that represent specific concepts and support comprehension for people with intellectual disabilities, low literacy, or language barriers. The large-scale production of EasyRead content has traditionally been constrained by the cost and expertise required to manually design pictograms. In contrast, automatic generation of such images could significantly reduce production time and cost, enabling broader accessibility across digital and printed materials. However, modern diffusion-based image generation models tend to produce outputs that exhibit excessive visual detail and lack stylistic stability across random seeds, limiting their suitability for clear and consistent pictogram generation. This challenge highlights the need for methods specifically tailored to accessibility-oriented visual content. In this work, we present a unified pipeline for generating EasyRead pictograms by fine-tuning a Stable Diffusion model using LoRA adapters on a curated corpus that combines augmented samples from multiple pictogram datasets. Since EasyRead pictograms lack a unified formal definition, we introduce an EasyRead score to benchmark pictogram quality and consistency. Our results demonstrate that diffusion models can be effectively steered toward producing coherent EasyRead-style images, indicating that generative models can serve as practical tools for scalable and accessible pictogram production.
summary_zh: EasyRead象形图是一种简单、视觉清晰的图像，代表特定的概念，并支持智力障碍、低识字率或语言障碍人士的理解。传统上，EasyRead内容的大规模生产受到手工设计象形图所需的成本和专业知识的限制。相比之下，自动生成此类图像可以显著减少生产时间和成本，从而在数字和印刷材料中实现更广泛的可访问性。然而，现代基于扩散的图像生成模型往往会产生过度视觉细节和缺乏跨随机种子的风格稳定性的输出，从而限制了它们在清晰一致的象形图生成方面的适用性。这一挑战突显了对专门为面向可访问性的视觉内容量身定制的方法的需求。 在这项工作中，我们提出了一个统一的流程，通过在精选语料库上使用 LoRA 适配器微调 Stable Diffusion 模型来生成 EasyRead 象形图，该语料库结合了来自多个象形图数据集的增强样本。由于 EasyRead 象形图缺乏统一的正式定义，我们引入了一个 EasyRead 分数来衡量象形图的质量和一致性。我们的结果表明，扩散模型可以有效地引导生成连贯的 EasyRead 风格图像，表明生成模型可以作为可扩展且可访问的象形图生产的实用工具。
tldr: This paper presents a pipeline for generating EasyRead pictograms using fine-tuned Stable Diffusion models, addressing the need for accessible visual content generation and introducing an EasyRead score for benchmarking.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用微调的Stable Diffusion模型生成EasyRead象形图的流程，解决了对可访问视觉内容生成的需求，并引入了EasyRead评分用于基准测试。

title: TSDCRF: Balancing Privacy and Multi-Object Tracking via Time-Series CRF and Normalized Control Penalty
