summary: Multi-object tracking in video often requires appearance or location cues that can reveal sensitive identity information, while adding privacy-preserving noise typically disrupts cross-frame association and causes ID switches or target loss. We propose TSDCRF, a plug-in refinement framework that balances privacy and tracking by combining three components: (i) $(\varepsilon,δ)$-differential privacy via calibrated Gaussian noise on sensitive regions under a configurable privacy budget; (ii) a Normalized Control Penalty (NCP) that down-weights unstable or conflicting class predictions before noise injection to stabilize association; and (iii) a time-series dynamic conditional random field (DCRF) that enforces temporal consistency and corrects trajectory deviation after noise, mitigating ID switches and resilience to trajectory hijacking. The pipeline is agnostic to the choice of detector and tracker (e.g., YOLOv4 and DeepSORT). We evaluate on MOT16, MOT17, Cityscapes, and KITTI. Results show that TSDCRF achieves a better privacy--utility trade-off than white noise and prior methods (NTPD, PPDTSA): lower KL-divergence shift, lower tracking RMSE, and improved robustness under trajectory hijacking while preserving privacy. Source code in https://github.com/mabo1215/TSDCRF.git
summary_zh: 视频中的多目标跟踪常常需要依赖外观或位置线索，而这些线索可能泄露敏感的身份信息。然而，添加保护隐私的噪声通常会扰乱跨帧关联，导致身份切换或目标丢失。我们提出TSDCRF，一个插件式优化框架，通过结合三个组件来平衡隐私和跟踪：（i）$(\varepsilon,δ)$-差分隐私，通过在可配置的隐私预算下，对敏感区域施加校准过的 Gaussian 噪声来实现；（ii）一个归一化控制惩罚（NCP），它在注入噪声之前对不稳定或冲突的类别预测进行降权，以稳定关联；以及（iii）一个时间序列动态条件随机场（DCRF），它强制执行时间一致性，并在噪声之后纠正轨迹偏差，从而减轻身份切换并增强对轨迹劫持的抵抗力。该流程对检测器和跟踪器的选择（例如，YOLOv4 和 DeepSORT）是不可知的。我们在 MOT16、MOT17、Cityscapes 和 KITTI 上进行了评估。结果表明，与白噪声和先前的方法（NTPD、PPDTSA）相比，TSDCRF 实现了更好的隐私-效用权衡：更低的 KL 散度偏移、更低的跟踪 RMSE，并在保持隐私的同时提高了在轨迹劫持下的鲁棒性。源代码位于https://github.com/mabo1215/TSDCRF.git。
tldr: The paper proposes TSDCRF, a framework balancing privacy and multi-object tracking by adding calibrated noise, a normalized control penalty, and a time-series DCRF to existing trackers, outperforming previous privacy-preserving methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出TSDCRF框架，通过添加校准噪声、归一化控制惩罚和时间序列DCRF来平衡隐私和多目标跟踪，优于以往的隐私保护方法，适用于现有的跟踪器。

title: Robust Sequential Tracking via Bounded Information Geometry and Non-Parametric Field Actions
summary: Standard sequential inference architectures are compromised by a normalizability crisis when confronted with extreme, structured outliers. By operating on unbounded parameter spaces, state-of-the-art estimators lack the intrinsic geometry required to appropriately sever anomalies, resulting in unbounded covariance inflation and mean divergence. This paper resolves this structural failure by analyzing the abstraction sequence of inference at the meta-prior level (S_2). We demonstrate that extremizing the action over an infinite-dimensional space requires a non-parametric field anchored by a pre-prior, as a uniform volume element mathematically does not exist. By utilizing strictly invariant Delta (or ν) Information Separations on the statistical manifold, we physically truncate the infinite tails of the spatial distribution. When evaluated as a Radon-Nikodym derivative against the base measure, the active parameter space compresses into a strictly finite, normalizable probability droplet. Empirical benchmarks across three domains--LiDAR maneuvering target tracking, high-frequency cryptocurrency order flow, and quantum state tomography--demonstrate that this bounded information geometry analytically truncates outliers, ensuring robust estimation without relying on infinite-tailed distributional assumptions.
summary_zh: 当面对极端、结构化的离群值时，标准的序列推断架构会受到可归一化问题的困扰。由于在无界参数空间上运行，最先进的估计器缺乏适当切断异常所需的内在几何结构，导致无界的协方差膨胀和均值发散。本文通过在元先验层级 (S_2) 分析推断的抽象序列来解决这一结构性失效。我们证明，在无限维空间上对作用量进行极值化需要一个由先验先验锚定的非参数场，因为数学上不存在均匀体积元。通过在统计流形上利用严格不变的Delta (或 ν) 信息分离，我们在物理上截断了空间分布的无限尾部。当作为相对于基本测度的Radon-Nikodym导数进行评估时，活跃参数空间压缩成一个严格有限的、可归一化的概率液滴。在三个领域的实证基准测试——激光雷达机动目标跟踪、高频加密货币订单流和量子态层析成像——表明，这种有界信息几何在解析上截断了离群值，确保了鲁棒估计，而无需依赖无限尾分布假设。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel robust sequential tracking method using bounded information geometry and non-parametric field actions to address the normalizability crisis in state-of-the-art estimators when confronted with extreme outliers. Empirical results show robustness across LiDAR tracking, cryptocurrency order flow, and quantum state tomography.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的鲁棒序列跟踪方法，该方法使用有界信息几何和非参数场作用来解决在面对极端异常值时，最先进的估计器中出现的正态性危机。实验结果表明，该方法在激光雷达跟踪、加密货币订单流和量子态层析成像方面都具有鲁棒性。

title: Standard Acquisition Is Sufficient for Asynchronous Bayesian Optimization
summary: Asynchronous Bayesian optimization is widely used for gradient-free optimization in domains with independent parallel experiments and varying evaluation times. Existing methods posit that standard acquisitions lead to redundant and repeated queries, proposing complex solutions to enforce diversity in queries. Challenging this fundamental premise, we show that methods, like the Upper Confidence Bound, can in fact achieve theoretical guarantees essentially equivalent to those of sequential Thompson sampling. A conceptual analysis of asynchronous Bayesian optimization reveals that existing works neglect intermediate posterior updates, which we find to be generally sufficient to avoid redundant queries. Further investigation shows that by penalizing busy locations, diversity-enforcing methods can over-explore in asynchronous settings, reducing their performance. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that simple standard acquisition functions match or outperform purpose-built asynchronous methods across synthetic and real-world tasks.
summary_zh: 异步贝叶斯优化被广泛应用于具有独立并行实验和不同评估时间的领域中的无梯度优化。现有方法假定标准获取函数会导致冗余和重复的查询，并提出复杂的解决方案来强制查询的多样性。挑战这一基本前提，我们证明了诸如上限置信区间 (Upper Confidence Bound) 的方法实际上可以实现与顺序 Thompson 采样本质上等价的理论保证。对异步贝叶斯优化的概念分析表明，现有工作忽略了中间后验更新，而我们发现这通常足以避免冗余查询。进一步研究表明，通过惩罚繁忙的位置，强制多样性的方法可能会在异步设置中过度探索，从而降低其性能。我们广泛的实验表明，简单的标准获取函数在合成和现实世界的任务中与专门构建的异步方法相匹配或优于它们。
tldr: This paper challenges the common belief that standard acquisition functions are insufficient for asynchronous Bayesian optimization, demonstrating that they can achieve comparable theoretical guarantees and often outperform more complex, purpose-built methods. The authors argue that implicit diversity arising from asynchronous updates is sufficient for effective exploration.
tldr_zh: 本文挑战了异步贝叶斯优化中标准采集函数不足的普遍观点，证明了它们可以实现相当的理论保证，并且通常优于更复杂的、专门构建的方法。作者认为，异步更新所产生的隐式多样性足以实现有效的探索。

title: LPV-MPC for Lateral Control in Full-Scale Autonomous Racing
summary: Autonomous racing has attracted significant attention recently, presenting challenges in selecting an optimal controller that operates within the onboard system's computational limits and meets operational constraints such as limited track time and high costs. This paper introduces a Linear Parameter-Varying Model Predictive Controller (LPV-MPC) for lateral control. Implemented on an IAC AV-24, the controller achieved stable performance at speeds exceeding 160 mph (71.5 m/s). We detail the controller design, the methodology for extracting model parameters, and key system-level and implementation considerations. Additionally, we report results from our final race run, providing a comprehensive analysis of both vehicle dynamics and controller performance. A Python implementation of the framework is available at: https://tinyurl.com/LPV-MPC-acados
summary_zh:
摘要：
近年来，无人赛车备受关注，选择一款能在车载系统的计算限制内运行并满足诸如有限赛道时间和高成本等操作约束的最佳控制器，是一项极具挑战性的任务。本文介绍了一种用于横向控制的线性参数变化模型预测控制器（LPV-MPC）。该控制器在IAC AV-24上实现，并在超过160英里/小时（71.5米/秒）的速度下实现了稳定性能。我们详细介绍了控制器设计、模型参数提取方法以及关键的系统层面和实施方面的考量。此外，我们报告了我们最后一次比赛运行的结果，提供了对车辆动力学和控制器性能的全面分析。框架的Python实现可在以下网址找到：https://tinyurl.com/LPV-MPC-acados
tldr: The paper presents an LPV-MPC controller for autonomous racing, demonstrating stable performance on a real vehicle at high speeds and providing implementation details and analysis of vehicle dynamics and controller performance.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于自动驾驶赛车的LPV-MPC控制器，展示了该控制器在真实车辆上的高速稳定表现，并提供了实现细节和车辆动力学及控制器性能的分析。

title: Fabric Pneumatic Artificial Muscle-Based Head-Neck Exosuit: Design, Modeling, and Evaluation
summary: Wearable exosuits assist human movement in tasks ranging from rehabilitation to daily activities; specifically, head-neck support is necessary for patients with certain neurological disorders. Rigid-link exoskeletons have shown to enable head-neck mobility compared to static braces, but their bulkiness and restrictive structure inspire designs using "soft" actuation methods. In this paper, we propose a fabric pneumatic artificial muscle-based exosuit design for head-neck support. We describe the design of our prototype and physics-based model, enabling us to derive actuator pressures required to compensate for gravitational load. Our modeled range of motion and workspace analysis indicate that the limited actuator lengths impose slight limitations (83% workspace coverage), and gravity compensation imposes a more significant limitation (43% workspace coverage). We introduce compression force along the neck as a novel, potentially comfort-related metric. We further apply our model to compare the torque output of various actuator placement configurations, allowing us to select a design with stability in lateral deviation and high axial rotation torques. The model correctly predicts trends in measured data where wrapping the actuators around the neck is not a significant factor. Our test dummy and human user demonstration confirm that the exosuit can provide functional head support and trajectory tracking, underscoring the potential of artificial muscle-based soft actuation for head-neck mobility assistance.
summary_zh: 可穿戴外骨骼可辅助人类完成从康复到日常活动等任务；特别地，对于患有某些神经系统疾病的患者，头部-颈部支撑是必要的。与静态支具相比，刚性连杆外骨骼已证明能够实现头部-颈部活动，但其体积庞大和结构限制激发了使用“软”驱动方法的设计。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于织物气动人工肌肉的外骨骼设计，用于头部-颈部支撑。我们描述了我们原型的设计和基于物理的模型，使我们能够推导出补偿重力载荷所需的驱动器压力。我们的建模运动范围和工作空间分析表明，有限的驱动器长度施加了轻微限制（83%的工作空间覆盖率），而重力补偿施加了更显著的限制（43%的工作空间覆盖率）。我们引入了沿颈椎的压缩力，作为一个新的、可能与舒适度相关的指标。我们进一步应用我们的模型来比较各种驱动器放置配置的扭矩输出，使我们能够选择一种在横向偏差中具有稳定性并且具有高轴向旋转扭矩的设计。该模型正确地预测了测量数据中的趋势，其中将驱动器缠绕在脖子上不是一个重要因素。我们的测试假人和人类用户演示证实，该外骨骼可以提供功能性的头部支撑和轨迹跟踪，强调了基于人工肌肉的软驱动在头部-颈部活动辅助方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents a fabric pneumatic artificial muscle-based exosuit for head-neck support, including design, modeling, and evaluation with human user demonstration, showcasing its potential for mobility assistance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于织物气动人工肌肉的头部-颈部外骨骼，用于提供头部和颈部的支撑。文章涵盖了设计、建模和评估，并通过人体实验展示了其在辅助行动方面的潜力。

title: Verification and Forward Invariance of Control Barrier Functions for Differential-Algebraic Systems
summary: Differential-algebraic equations (DAEs) arise in power networks, chemical processes, and multibody systems, where algebraic constraints encode physical conservation laws. The safety of such systems is critical, yet safe control is challenging because algebraic constraints restrict allowable state trajectories. Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide computationally efficient safety filters for ordinary differential equation (ODE) systems. However, existing CBF methods are not directly applicable to DAEs due to potential conflicts between the CBF condition and the constraint manifold. This paper introduces DAE-aware CBFs that incorporate the differential-algebraic structure through projected vector fields. We derive conditions that ensure forward invariance of safe sets while preserving algebraic constraints and extend the framework to higher-index DAEs. A systematic verification framework is developed, establishing necessary and sufficient conditions for geometric correctness and feasibility of DAE-aware CBFs. For polynomial systems, sum-of-squares certificates are provided, while for nonpolynomial and neural network candidates, satisfiability modulo theories are used for falsification. The approach is validated on wind turbine and flexible-link manipulator systems.
summary_zh: 差分代数方程（DAEs）广泛存在于电力网络、化学过程和多体系统中，其中代数约束编码物理守恒定律。此类系统的安全性至关重要，但安全控制具有挑战性，因为代数约束限制了允许的状态轨迹。控制屏障函数（CBFs）为常微分方程（ODE）系统提供了计算高效的安全滤波器。然而，由于CBF条件和约束流形之间可能存在冲突，现有CBF方法无法直接应用于DAEs。本文引入了DAE感知的CBFs，通过投影向量场纳入差分代数结构。我们推导了确保安全集前向不变性同时保持代数约束的条件，并将框架扩展到更高指标的DAEs。开发了一个系统的验证框架，建立了DAE感知CBFs几何正确性和可行性的必要和充分条件。对于多项式系统，提供平方和证书，而对于非多项式和神经网络候选函数，则使用基于理论的满足性模求解（SMT）进行证伪。该方法在风力涡轮机和柔性连杆机械臂系统上进行了验证。
tldr: This paper introduces a method to adapt Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) for safety-critical control of Differential-Algebraic Equation (DAE) systems, common in robotics and other engineering domains, by accounting for algebraic constraints.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种将控制障碍函数 (CBF) 应用于微分代数方程 (DAE) 系统安全控制的方法，该方法常见于机器人和其他工程领域，通过考虑代数约束来实现。

title: Traffic and weather driven hybrid digital twin for bridge monitoring
summary: A hybrid digital twin framework is presented for bridge condition monitoring using existing traffic cameras and weather APIs, reducing reliance on dedicated sensor installations. The approach is demonstrated on the Peace Bridge (99 years in service) under high traffic demand and harsh winter exposure. The framework fuses three near-real-time streams: YOLOv8 computer vision from a bridge-deck camera estimates vehicle counts, traffic density, and load proxies; a Lighthill--Whitham--Richards (LWR) model propagates density $ρ(x,t)$ and detects deceleration-driven shockwaves linked to repetitive loading and fatigue accumulation; and weather APIs provide deterioration drivers including temperature cycling, freeze-thaw activity, precipitation-related corrosion potential, and wind effects. Monte Carlo simulation quantifies uncertainty across traffic-environment scenarios, while Random Forest models map fused features to fatigue indicators and maintenance classification. The framework demonstrates utilizing existing infrastructure for cost-effective predictive maintenance of aging, high-traffic bridges in harsh climates.
summary_zh: 一种混合数字孪生框架被提出，用于桥梁状态监测，该框架利用现有的交通摄像头和天气API，从而减少对专用传感器安装的依赖。该方法在和平桥（已服役99年）上进行了演示，该桥梁承受着高交通需求和严酷冬季暴露。该框架融合了三个近实时的信息流：来自桥面摄像头的YOLOv8计算机视觉技术，用于估算车辆计数、交通密度和荷载代理指标；Lighthill-Whitham-Richards (LWR) 模型，用于传播密度 $ρ(x,t)$，并检测与重复荷载和疲劳累积相关的减速驱动的冲击波；以及天气API，用于提供包括温度循环、冻融活动、降水相关腐蚀潜力和风效应等劣化驱动因素。蒙特卡洛模拟量化了不同交通-环境场景下的不确定性，而随机森林模型将融合的特征映射到疲劳指标和维护分类。该框架展示了如何利用现有基础设施，经济高效地对恶劣气候下老化的、高交通流量的桥梁进行预测性维护。
tldr: This paper presents a hybrid digital twin framework for bridge monitoring using existing traffic cameras and weather APIs to estimate traffic load and environmental factors, then uses machine learning to predict fatigue and maintenance needs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个混合数字孪生框架，用于桥梁监测，该框架利用现有的交通摄像头和天气API来估计交通负荷和环境因素，然后使用机器学习来预测疲劳和维护需求。

title: Bidirectional Cross-Attention Fusion of High-Res RGB and Low-Res HSI for Multimodal Automated Waste Sorting
summary: Growing waste streams and the transition to a circular economy require efficient automated waste sorting. In industrial settings, materials move on fast conveyor belts, where reliable identification and ejection demand pixel-accurate segmentation. RGB imaging delivers high-resolution spatial detail, which is essential for accurate segmentation, but it confuses materials that look similar in the visible spectrum. Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) provides spectral signatures that separate such materials, yet its lower spatial resolution limits detail. Effective waste sorting therefore needs methods that fuse both modalities to exploit their complementary strengths. We present Bidirectional Cross-Attention Fusion (BCAF), which aligns high-resolution RGB with low-resolution HSI at their native grids via localized, bidirectional cross-attention, avoiding pre-upsampling or early spectral collapse. BCAF uses two independent backbones: a standard Swin Transformer for RGB and an HSI-adapted Swin backbone that preserves spectral structure through 3D tokenization with spectral self-attention. We also analyze trade-offs between RGB input resolution and the number of HSI spectral slices. Although our evaluation targets RGB-HSI fusion, BCAF is modality-agnostic and applies to co-registered RGB with lower-resolution, high-channel auxiliary sensors. On the benchmark SpectralWaste dataset, BCAF achieves state-of-the-art performance of 76.4% mIoU at 31 images/s and 75.4% mIoU at 55 images/s. We further evaluate a novel industrial dataset: K3I-Cycling (first RGB subset already released on Fordatis). On this dataset, BCAF reaches 62.3% mIoU for material segmentation (paper, metal, plastic, etc.) and 66.2% mIoU for plastic-type segmentation (PET, PP, HDPE, LDPE, PS, etc.).
summary_zh: 不断增长的废弃物流量以及向循环经济的转型都要求高效的自动化废弃物分选。在工业环境中，物料在高速传送带上移动，可靠的识别和剔除需要像素级精度的分割。RGB 成像提供高分辨率的空间细节，这对于准确的分割至关重要，但它会混淆在可见光谱中看起来相似的材料。高光谱成像 (HSI) 提供可以区分此类材料的光谱特征，但其较低的空间分辨率限制了细节。因此，有效的废弃物分选需要融合两种模态的方法，以利用它们互补的优势。我们提出了双向交叉注意力融合 (BCAF)，它通过局部双向交叉注意力，在其原生网格上对齐高分辨率 RGB 和低分辨率 HSI，避免了预上采样或早期光谱塌陷。BCAF 使用两个独立的骨干网络：一个用于 RGB 的标准 Swin Transformer 和一个 HSI 适配的 Swin 骨干网络，该骨干网络通过具有光谱自注意力的 3D Token 化来保留光谱结构。我们还分析了 RGB 输入分辨率和 HSI 光谱切片数量之间的权衡。虽然我们的评估针对 RGB-HSI 融合，但 BCAF 是模态不可知的，并且适用于与低分辨率、高通道辅助传感器共同配准的 RGB。在基准 SpectralWaste 数据集上，BCAF 以 31 帧/秒的速度实现了 76.4% 的 mIoU，以 55 帧/秒的速度实现了 75.4% 的 mIoU，达到了最先进的性能。我们进一步评估了一个新的工业数据集：K3I-Cycling（首个 RGB 子集已在 Fordatis 上发布）。在该数据集上，BCAF 在材料分割（纸张、金属、塑料等）上达到 62.3% 的 mIoU，在塑料类型分割（PET、PP、HDPE、LDPE、PS 等）上达到 66.2% 的 mIoU。
tldr: This paper introduces a Bidirectional Cross-Attention Fusion (BCAF) method to fuse high-resolution RGB and low-resolution HSI for automated waste sorting, achieving state-of-the-art performance on benchmark datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种双向交叉注意力融合（BCAF）方法，用于融合高分辨率RGB和低分辨率HSI以实现自动化垃圾分类，并在基准数据集上实现了最先进的性能。

title: Schrödinger Bridge Over A Compact Connected Lie Group
summary: This work studies the Schrödinger bridge problem for the kinematic equation on a compact connected Lie group. The objective is to steer a controlled diffusion between given initial and terminal densities supported over the Lie group while minimizing the control effort. We develop a coordinate-free formulation of this stochastic optimal control problem that respects the underlying geometric structure of the Lie group, thereby avoiding limitations associated with local parameterizations or embeddings in Euclidean spaces. We establish the existence and uniqueness of solution to the corresponding Schrödinger system. Our results are constructive in that they derive a geometric controller that optimally interpolates probability densities supported over the Lie group. To illustrate the results, we provide numerical examples on $\mathsf{SO}(2)$ and $\mathsf{SO}(3)$.
summary_zh: 本文研究了紧连通李群上运动学方程的薛定谔桥问题。目标是在李群上给定的初始密度和终端密度之间引导一个受控扩散，同时最小化控制代价。我们开发了一种与坐标无关的随机最优控制问题的公式，该公式尊重李群的底层几何结构，从而避免了与局部参数化或嵌入欧几里得空间相关的局限性。我们证明了相应的薛定谔系统解的存在性和唯一性。我们的结果具有构造性，推导出了一种几何控制器，该控制器能够最优地插值李群上支持的概率密度。 为了说明结果，我们提供了在$\mathsf{SO}(2)$和$\mathsf{SO}(3)$上的数值例子。
tldr: This paper tackles the Schrödinger bridge problem on compact connected Lie groups, developing a coordinate-free formulation and providing a geometric controller for optimal density interpolation, with numerical examples on SO(2) and SO(3).
tldr_zh: 本文研究了紧连通李群上的薛定谔桥问题，开发了一种无坐标公式，并提供了一种用于最优密度插值的几何控制器，并在 SO(2) 和 SO(3) 上进行了数值示例。

title: State-space models through the lens of ensemble control
summary: State-space models (SSMs) are effective architectures for sequential modeling, but a rigorous theoretical understanding of their training dynamics is still lacking. In this work, we formulate the training of SSMs as an ensemble optimal control problem, where a shared control law governs a population of input-dependent dynamical systems. We derive Pontryagin's maximum principle (PMP) for this ensemble control formulation, providing necessary conditions for optimality. Motivated by these conditions, we introduce an algorithm based on the method of successive approximations. We prove convergence of this iterative scheme along a subsequence and establish sufficient conditions for global optimality. The resulting framework provides a control-theoretic perspective on SSM training.
summary_zh: 状态空间模型(SSM)是序贯建模的有效架构，但对其训练动态的严谨理论理解仍然不足。在这项工作中，我们将SSM的训练形式化为一个集成最优控制问题，其中一个共享的控制律支配着大量输入相关的动态系统。我们推导了此集成控制形式化的庞特里亚金最大值原理(PMP)，提供了最优性的必要条件。受这些条件的启发，我们引入了一种基于逐次逼近法的算法。我们证明了此迭代方案沿子序列的收敛性，并建立了全局最优性的充分条件。最终得到的框架为SSM训练提供了一个控制理论视角。
tldr: The paper frames SSM training as an ensemble optimal control problem, deriving Pontryagin's maximum principle and proposing a convergent, globally optimal algorithm for training SSMs, offering a control-theoretic view of SSM training.
tldr_zh: 该论文将SSM训练建模为集合最优控制问题，推导了庞特里亚金最大值原理，并提出了一个收敛的、全局最优的SSM训练算法，提供了一种控制理论视角的SSM训练方法。

title: Robust Automatic Differentiation of Square-Root Kalman Filters via Gramian Differentials
summary: Square-root Kalman filters propagate state covariances in Cholesky-factor form for numerical stability, and are a natural target for gradient-based parameter learning in state-space models. Their core operation, triangularization of a matrix $M \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times m}$, is computed via a QR decomposition in practice, but naively differentiating through it causes two problems: the semi-orthogonal factor is non-unique when $m > n$, yielding undefined gradients; and the standard Jacobian formula involves inverses, which diverges when $M$ is rank-deficient. Both are resolved by the observation that all filter outputs relevant to learning depend on the input matrix only through the Gramian $MM^\top$, so the composite loss is smooth in $M$ even where the triangularization is not. We derive a closed-form chain-rule directly from the differential of this Gramian identity, prove it exact for the Kalman log-marginal likelihood and filtered moments, and extend it to rank-deficient inputs via a two-component decomposition: a column-space term based on the Moore--Penrose pseudoinverse, and a null-space correction for perturbations outside the column space of $M$.
summary_zh: 平方根卡尔曼滤波器以Cholesky因子形式传播状态协方差，以提高数值稳定性，并且是状态空间模型中基于梯度的参数学习的天然目标。其核心运算，即矩阵 $M \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times m}$ 的三角化，在实践中通过 QR 分解计算，但直接对其进行微分会导致两个问题：当 $m > n$ 时，半正交因子不唯一，导致梯度未定义；标准的雅可比公式涉及逆，这在 $M$ 秩亏的情况下会发散。这两个问题都通过观察得到解决，即所有与学习相关的滤波器输出都仅仅通过格拉姆矩阵 $MM^\top$ 依赖于输入矩阵，因此即使在三角化不存在的情况下，复合损失在 $M$ 中也是光滑的。我们直接从格拉姆矩阵恒等式的微分中推导出一种闭式链式法则，证明其对于卡尔曼对数边际似然和滤波后矩的精确性，并通过由两部分组成的分解将其扩展到秩亏输入：一个基于 Moore--Penrose 伪逆的列空间项，以及一个用于校正 $M$ 列空间之外扰动的零空间校正项。
tldr: The paper presents a method for robust automatic differentiation of square-root Kalman filters by leveraging Gramian differentials, resolving issues with non-unique semi-orthogonal factors and rank-deficient matrices that arise during triangularization.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种通过利用格拉姆微分对平方根卡尔曼滤波器进行鲁棒自动微分的方法，解决了三角化过程中出现的非唯一半正交因子和秩亏矩阵的问题。

title: Intrinsic Tolerance in C-Arm Imaging: How Extrinsic Re-optimization Preserves 3D Reconstruction Accuracy
summary:
\textbf{Purpose:} C-arm fluoroscopy's 3D reconstruction relies on accurate intrinsic calibration, which is often challenging in clinical practice. This study ensures high-precision reconstruction accuracy by re-optimizing the extrinsic parameters to compensate for intrinsic calibration errors.
  \noindent\textbf{Methods:} We conducted both simulation and real-world experiments using five commercial C-arm systems. Intrinsic parameters were perturbed in controlled increments. Focal length was increased by 100 to 700 pixels ($\approx$20 mm to 140 mm) and principal point by 20 to 200 pixels. For each perturbation, we (1) reconstructed 3D points from known phantom geometries, (2) re-estimated extrinsic poses using standard optimization, and (3) measured reconstruction and reprojection errors relative to ground truth.
  \noindent\textbf{Results:} Even with focal length errors up to 500 pixels ($\approx$100 mm, assuming a nominal focal length of $\sim$1000 mm), mean 3D reconstruction error remained under 0.2 mm. Larger focal length deviations (700 pixels) elevated error to only $\approx$0.3 mm. Principal point shifts up to 200 pixels introduced negligible reconstruction error once extrinsic parameters were re-optimized, with reprojection error increases below 0.5 pixels.
  \noindent\textbf{Conclusion:} Moderate errors in intrinsic calibration can be effectively mitigated by extrinsic re-optimization, preserving submillimeter 3D reconstruction accuracy. This intrinsic tolerance suggests a practical pathway to relax calibration precision requirements, thereby simplifying C-arm system setup and reducing clinical workflow burden without compromising performance.
summary_zh:
**目的：** C臂X射线透视三维重建依赖于精确的内参数标定，这在临床实践中通常具有挑战性。本研究旨在通过重新优化外参数来补偿内参数标定误差，从而确保高精度的重建准确性。

**方法：** 我们使用五台商用C臂系统进行了模拟和真实实验。内参数在受控的增量范围内受到扰动。焦距增加了100到700像素（$\approx$20毫米到140毫米），主点偏移了20到200像素。对于每次扰动，我们（1）从已知的体模几何形状重建三维点；（2）使用标准优化方法重新估计外参数位姿；（3）测量相对于真值的重建误差和重投影误差。

**结果：** 即使焦距误差高达500像素（$\approx$100毫米，假设标称焦距约为$\sim$1000毫米），平均三维重建误差仍低于0.2毫米。更大的焦距偏差（700像素）仅使误差升高到$\approx$0.3毫米。一旦外参数被重新优化，高达200像素的主点偏移引入的重建误差可忽略不计，重投影误差的增加低于0.5像素。

**结论：** 通过外参数重新优化，可以有效缓解内参数标定中的中等误差，从而保持亚毫米级的三维重建精度。这种内参数容错性为放宽标定精度要求提供了一种实用途径，从而简化C臂系统的设置并减轻临床工作流程负担，同时不影响性能。
tldr: This paper demonstrates that accurate 3D reconstruction in C-arm fluoroscopy is achievable even with moderate intrinsic calibration errors, provided that extrinsic parameters are re-optimized, potentially simplifying clinical workflow.
tldr_zh: 本文证明了在C型臂荧光透视中，即使存在适度的内在校准误差，只要重新优化外在参数，就能实现精确的3D重建，从而可能简化临床工作流程。

title: VLA-Thinker: Boosting Vision-Language-Action Models through Thinking-with-Image Reasoning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising capabilities for embodied intelligence, but most existing approaches rely on text-based chain-of-thought reasoning where visual inputs are treated as static context. This limits the ability of the model to actively revisit the environment and resolve ambiguities during long-horizon tasks. We propose VLA-Thinker, a thinking-with-image reasoning framework that models perception as a dynamically invocable reasoning action. To train such a system, we introduce a two-stage training pipeline consisting of (1) an SFT cold-start phase with curated visual Chain-of-Thought data to activate structured reasoning and tool-use behaviors, and (2) GRPO-based reinforcement learning to align complete reasoning-action trajectories with task-level success. Extensive experiments on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 benchmarks demonstrate that VLA-Thinker significantly improves manipulation performance, achieving 97.5% success rate on LIBERO and strong gains across long-horizon robotic tasks. Project and Codes: https://cywang735.github.io/VLA-Thinker/ .
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在具身智能方面展现了令人鼓舞的能力，但现有的大多数方法依赖于基于文本的思维链推理，其中视觉输入被视为静态背景。这限制了模型主动重新审视环境以及在长时程任务中解决歧义的能力。我们提出了 VLA-Thinker，一种利用图像进行思考的推理框架，该框架将感知建模为一种可动态调用的推理动作。为了训练这样的系统，我们引入了一个两阶段训练流程，包括：（1）一个使用精心策划的视觉思维链数据的 SFT 冷启动阶段，以激活结构化推理和工具使用行为；（2）基于 GRPO 的强化学习，以将完整的推理-动作轨迹与任务级别的成功对齐。在 LIBERO 和 RoboTwin 2.0 基准测试上的大量实验表明，VLA-Thinker 显著提高了操作性能，在 LIBERO 上实现了 97.5% 的成功率，并在长时程机器人任务中取得了显著提升。项目和代码：https://cywang735.github.io/VLA-Thinker/ 。
tldr: The paper introduces VLA-Thinker, a vision-language-action model that incorporates dynamically invocable image reasoning to improve performance on long-horizon robotic tasks, achieving significant gains on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 benchmarks through a two-stage training process.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了VLA-Thinker，一种视觉-语言-动作模型，它结合了动态调用的图像推理来提高长时程机器人任务的性能，并通过一个两阶段的训练过程在LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0基准测试中取得了显著的成果。

title: WorldVLM: Combining World Model Forecasting and Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Autonomous driving systems depend on on models that can reason about high-level scene contexts and accurately predict the dynamics of their surrounding environment. Vision- Language Models (VLMs) have recently emerged as promising tools for decision-making and scene understanding, offering strong capabilities in contextual reasoning. However, their limited spatial comprehension constrains their effectiveness as end-to-end driving models. World Models (WM) internalize environmental dynamics to predict future scene evolution. Recently explored as ego-motion predictors and foundation models for autonomous driving, they represent a promising direction for addressing key challenges in the field, particularly enhancing generalization while maintaining dynamic prediction. To leverage the complementary strengths of context-based decision making and prediction, we propose WorldVLM: A hybrid architecture that unifies VLMs and WMs. In our design, the high-level VLM generates behavior commands to guide the driving WM, enabling interpretable and context-aware actions. We evaluate conditioning strategies and provide insights into the hybrid design challenges.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶系统依赖于能够推理高层场景上下文并准确预测周围环境动态的模型。视觉-语言模型（VLMs）最近作为决策制定和场景理解的有前景的工具而出现，在上下文推理方面表现出强大的能力。然而，其有限的空间理解能力制约了它们作为端到端驾驶模型的有效性。世界模型（WM）通过内化环境动态来预测未来场景演化。近期，它们被探索作为自运动预测器和自动驾驶的基础模型，代表了解决该领域关键挑战的一个有前景的方向，尤其是在保持动态预测的同时增强泛化能力。为了利用基于上下文的决策和预测的互补优势，我们提出了WorldVLM：一种统一了VLM和WM的混合架构。在我们的设计中，高层VLM生成行为命令以引导驾驶WM，从而实现可解释且感知上下文的动作。我们评估了调节策略，并提供了对混合设计挑战的见解。
tldr: The paper introduces WorldVLM, a hybrid architecture combining Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for contextual reasoning with World Models (WMs) for predicting environmental dynamics, aiming to improve autonomous driving by leveraging the strengths of both approaches.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种混合架构WorldVLM，它结合了用于上下文推理的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）和用于预测环境动态的世界模型（WMs），旨在通过利用两种方法的优势来改进自动驾驶。

title: AerialVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for UAV Navigation via Minimalist End-to-End Control
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) demands complex visual interpretation and continuous control in dynamic 3D environments. Existing hierarchical approaches rely on dense oracle guidance or auxiliary object detectors, creating semantic gaps and limiting genuine autonomy. We propose AerialVLA, a minimalist end-to-end Vision-Language-Action framework mapping raw visual observations and fuzzy linguistic instructions directly to continuous physical control signals. First, we introduce a streamlined dual-view perception strategy that reduces visual redundancy while preserving essential cues for forward navigation and precise grounding, which additionally facilitates future simulation-to-reality transfer. To reclaim genuine autonomy, we deploy a fuzzy directional prompting mechanism derived solely from onboard sensors, completely eliminating the dependency on dense oracle guidance. Ultimately, we formulate a unified control space that integrates continuous 3-Degree-of-Freedom (3-DoF) kinematic commands with an intrinsic landing signal, freeing the agent from external object detectors for precision landing. Extensive experiments on the TravelUAV benchmark demonstrate that AerialVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance in seen environments. Furthermore, it exhibits superior generalization in unseen scenarios by achieving nearly three times the success rate of leading baselines, validating that a minimalist, autonomy-centric paradigm captures more robust visual-motor representations than complex modular systems.
summary_zh: 面向无人机的视觉-语言导航(VLN)需要在动态3D环境中进行复杂的视觉理解和连续控制。现有的分层方法依赖于密集的先知引导或辅助目标检测器，从而产生语义鸿沟并限制了真正的自主性。我们提出AerialVLA，一个极简的端到端视觉-语言-行动框架，直接将原始视觉观察和模糊语言指令映射到连续的物理控制信号。首先，我们引入了一种简化的双视图感知策略，该策略减少了视觉冗余，同时保留了前向导航和精确定位所需的关键线索，这还有助于未来的模拟到现实的迁移。为了重获真正的自主性，我们部署了一种仅从机载传感器导出的模糊方向提示机制，完全消除了对密集先知引导的依赖。最终，我们构建了一个统一的控制空间，该空间将连续的3自由度(3-DoF)运动学指令与固有的着陆信号集成在一起，从而使智能体摆脱了外部目标检测器以进行精准着陆。在TravelUAV基准测试上的大量实验表明，AerialVLA在已见环境中实现了最先进的性能。此外，通过实现接近领先基线三倍的成功率，它在未见场景中表现出卓越的泛化能力，验证了极简主义的，以自主性为中心的范例比复杂的模块化系统捕获了更强大的视觉-运动表征。
tldr: AerialVLA is a novel end-to-end vision-language-action framework for UAV navigation that uses a minimalist approach to map visual observations and linguistic instructions directly to control signals, achieving SOTA performance and superior generalization.
tldr_zh: AerialVLA是一个新颖的端到端视觉-语言-动作框架，用于无人机导航，它采用极简方法将视觉观察和语言指令直接映射到控制信号，实现了最先进的性能和卓越的泛化能力。

title: V-JEPA 2.1: Unlocking Dense Features in Video Self-Supervised Learning
summary:
We present V-JEPA 2.1, a family of self-supervised models that learn dense, high-quality visual representations for both images and videos while retaining strong global scene understanding. The approach combines four key components. First, a dense predictive loss uses a masking-based objective in which both visible and masked tokens contribute to the training signal, encouraging explicit spatial and temporal grounding. Second, deep self-supervision applies the self-supervised objective hierarchically across multiple intermediate encoder layers to improve representation quality. Third, multi-modal tokenizers enable unified training across images and videos. Finally, the model benefits from effective scaling in both model capacity and training data. Together, these design choices produce representations that are spatially structured, semantically coherent, and temporally consistent.
  Empirically, V-JEPA 2.1 achieves state-of-the-art performance on several challenging benchmarks, including 7.71 mAP on Ego4D for short-term object-interaction anticipation and 40.8 Recall@5 on EPIC-KITCHENS for high-level action anticipation, as well as a 20-point improvement in real-robot grasping success rate over V-JEPA-2 AC. The model also demonstrates strong performance in robotic navigation (5.687 ATE on TartanDrive), depth estimation (0.307 RMSE on NYUv2 with a linear probe), and global recognition (77.7 on Something-Something-V2). These results show that V-JEPA 2.1 significantly advances the state of the art in dense visual understanding and world modeling.
summary_zh:
我们提出了V-JEPA 2.1，一系列自监督模型，用于学习图像和视频的密集、高质量视觉表征，同时保持强大的全局场景理解能力。该方法结合了四个关键组成部分。首先，密集预测损失函数采用基于掩码的目标，其中可见和掩码的token都为训练信号做出贡献，从而鼓励显式的空间和时间定位。其次，深度自监督将自监督目标分层应用于多个中间编码器层，以提高表征质量。第三，多模态tokenizers实现了图像和视频的统一训练。最后，该模型受益于模型容量和训练数据的有效扩展。总之，这些设计选择产生空间结构化、语义连贯且时间一致的表征。

在实验方面，V-JEPA 2.1在多个具有挑战性的基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，包括在Ego4D上短时物体交互预测的7.71 mAP和在EPIC-KITCHENS上高级动作预测的40.8 Recall@5，以及在真实机器人抓取成功率方面比V-JEPA-2 AC提高了20个百分点。该模型还在机器人导航（TartanDrive上的5.687 ATE）、深度估计（在NYUv2上使用线性探测的0.307 RMSE）和全局识别（Something-Something-V2上的77.7）方面表现出强大的性能。这些结果表明，V-JEPA 2.1显著推进了密集视觉理解和世界建模的先进水平。
tldr: V-JEPA 2.1 introduces improvements for self-supervised video learning, resulting in state-of-the-art dense visual representations and significant gains in robotic tasks.
tldr_zh: V-JEPA 2.1 改进了自监督视频学习，实现了最先进的密集视觉表征，并在机器人任务中取得了显著进展。

title: One-Policy-Fits-All: Geometry-Aware Action Latents for Cross-Embodiment Manipulation
summary: Cross-embodiment manipulation is crucial for enhancing the scalability of robot manipulation and reducing the high cost of data collection. However, the significant differences between embodiments, such as variations in action spaces and structural disparities, pose challenges for joint training across multiple sources of data. To address this, we propose One-Policy-Fits-All (OPFA), a framework that enables learning a single, versatile policy across multiple embodiments. We first learn a Geometry-Aware Latent Representation (GaLR), which leverages 3D convolution networks and transformers to build a shared latent action space across different embodiments. Then we design a unified latent retargeting decoder that extracts embodiment-specific actions from the latent representations, without any embodiment-specific decoder tuning. OPFA enables end-to-end co-training of data from diverse embodiments, including various grippers and dexterous hands with arbitrary degrees of freedom, significantly improving data efficiency and reducing the cost of skill transfer. We conduct extensive experiments across 11 different end-effectors. The results demonstrate that OPFA significantly improves policy performance in diverse settings by leveraging heterogeneous embodiment data. For instance, cross-embodiment co-training can improve success rates by more than 50% compared to single-source training. Moreover, by adding only a few demonstrations from a new embodiment (e.g., eight), OPFA can achieve performance comparable to that of a well-trained model with 72 demonstrations.
summary_zh: 跨具身操控对于增强机器人操作的可扩展性以及降低高昂的数据收集成本至关重要。然而，不同具身之间的显著差异，例如动作空间的变化和结构上的差异，给跨多个数据源的联合训练带来了挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了“一策略通吃（OPFA）”框架，该框架能够跨多个具身学习通用的、多功能的策略。 我们首先学习一种几何感知潜在表示（GaLR），它利用3D卷积网络和Transformer来构建跨不同具身的共享潜在动作空间。然后，我们设计了一个统一的潜在重定向解码器，该解码器从潜在表示中提取特定于具身的动作，而无需任何特定于具身的解码器调整。OPFA能够对来自不同具身的数据进行端到端的协同训练，包括各种夹爪和具有任意自由度的灵巧手，从而显著提高数据效率并降低技能迁移的成本。 我们在11种不同的末端执行器上进行了广泛的实验。结果表明，OPFA通过利用异构具身数据，显著提高了在各种设置下的策略性能。 例如，与单源训练相比，跨具身协同训练可以将成功率提高50%以上。 此外，通过仅添加来自新具身的一些演示数据（例如，八个），OPFA可以达到与具有72个演示数据的训练良好的模型相当的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces One-Policy-Fits-All (OPFA), a framework that leverages geometry-aware latent representations and unified latent retargeting to enable cross-embodiment robot manipulation, significantly improving data efficiency and skill transfer across diverse end-effectors.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了One-Policy-Fits-All (OPFA)框架，它利用几何感知潜在表示和统一潜在重定向，实现跨具身机器人操作，显著提高数据效率和跨不同末端执行器的技能转移。

title: R3DP: Real-Time 3D-Aware Policy for Embodied Manipulation
summary: Embodied manipulation requires accurate 3D understanding of objects and their spatial relations to plan and execute contact-rich actions. While large-scale 3D vision models provide strong priors, their computational cost incurs prohibitive latency for real-time control. We propose Real-time 3D-aware Policy (R3DP), which integrates powerful 3D priors into manipulation policies without sacrificing real-time performance. A core innovation of R3DP is the asynchronous fast-slow collaboration module, which seamlessly integrates large-scale 3D priors into the policy without compromising real-time performance. The system maintains real-time efficiency by querying the pre-trained slow system (VGGT) only on sparse key frames, while simultaneously employing a lightweight Temporal Feature Prediction Network (TFPNet) to predict features for all intermediate frames. By leveraging historical data to exploit temporal correlations, TFPNet explicitly improves task success rates through consistent feature estimation. Additionally, to enable more effective multi-view fusion, we introduce a Multi-View Feature Fuser (MVFF) that aggregates features across views by explicitly incorporating camera intrinsics and extrinsics. R3DP offers a plug-and-play solution for integrating large models into real-time inference systems. We evaluate R3DP against multiple baselines across different visual configurations. R3DP effectively harnesses large-scale 3D priors to achieve superior results, outperforming single-view and multi-view DP by 32.9% and 51.4% in average success rate, respectively. Furthermore, by decoupling heavy 3D reasoning from policy execution, R3DP achieves a 44.8% reduction in inference time compared to a naive DP+VGGT integration.
summary_zh: 具身操作需要对物体的精确3D理解及其空间关系，以规划并执行接触丰富的动作。虽然大规模3D视觉模型提供了强大的先验知识，但其计算成本导致实时控制的延迟过高。我们提出实时3D感知策略（R3DP），它将强大的3D先验知识集成到操作策略中，而不会牺牲实时性能。R3DP的一个核心创新是异步快速-慢速协作模块，该模块无缝地将大规模3D先验知识集成到策略中，而不会影响实时性能。该系统通过仅在稀疏关键帧上查询预训练的慢速系统（VGGT）来保持实时效率，同时采用轻量级的时间特征预测网络（TFPNet）来预测所有中间帧的特征。通过利用历史数据来挖掘时间相关性，TFPNet通过一致的特征估计明确地提高了任务成功率。此外，为了实现更有效的多视角融合，我们引入了一种多视角特征融合器（MVFF），它通过明确地结合相机内参和外参来聚合不同视角的特征。R3DP为将大型模型集成到实时推理系统中提供了一种即插即用的解决方案。我们在不同的视觉配置下针对多个基线评估了R3DP。R3DP有效地利用大规模3D先验知识来实现卓越的结果，在平均成功率方面，分别优于单视角DP和多视角DP 32.9%和51.4%。此外，通过将繁重的3D推理与策略执行分离，R3DP与简单的DP+VGGT集成相比，推理时间减少了44.8%。
tldr: R3DP introduces a real-time 3D-aware policy for embodied manipulation that leverages asynchronous fast-slow collaboration to integrate large-scale 3D priors without sacrificing speed, achieving significant performance improvements in manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: R3DP提出了一种用于具身操作的实时3D感知策略，该策略利用异步快慢协作来集成大规模3D先验，而不会牺牲速度，从而在操作任务中实现了显著的性能提升。

title: Physics-Informed Policy Optimization via Analytic Dynamics Regularization
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved strong performance in robotic control; however, state-of-the-art policy learning methods, such as actor-critic methods, still suffer from high sample complexity and often produce physically inconsistent actions. This limitation stems from neural policies implicitly rediscovering complex physics from data alone, despite accurate dynamics models being readily available in simulators. In this paper, we introduce a novel physics-informed RL framework, called PIPER, that seamlessly integrates physical constraints directly into neural policy optimization with analytical soft physics constraints. At the core of our method is the integration of a differentiable Lagrangian residual as a regularization term within the actor's objective. This residual, extracted from a robot's simulator description, subtly biases policy updates towards dynamically consistent solutions. Crucially, this physics integration is realized through an additional loss term during policy optimization, requiring no alterations to existing simulators or core RL algorithms. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly improves learning efficiency, stability, and control accuracy, establishing a new paradigm for efficient and physically consistent robotic control.
summary_zh: 强化学习(RL)在机器人控制领域取得了显著成果；然而，诸如Actor-Critic方法等最先进的策略学习方法仍然受到高样本复杂性的困扰，并且经常产生与物理规律不一致的动作。该局限性源于神经网络策略仅从数据中隐式地重新学习复杂的物理规律，尽管模拟器中已经可以获得精确的动力学模型。在本文中，我们介绍了一种新型的物理信息增强强化学习框架，称为PIPER，它通过解析的软物理约束将物理约束无缝地集成到神经网络策略优化中。我们方法的核心是将一个可微分的拉格朗日残差作为正则化项整合到Actor的目标函数中。该残差从机器人的模拟器描述中提取，巧妙地引导策略更新趋向于动态一致的解。至关重要的是，这种物理集成是通过策略优化期间的一个额外的损失项来实现的，不需要改变现有的模拟器或核心的RL算法。大量实验表明，我们的方法显著提高了学习效率、稳定性和控制精度，为高效和物理一致的机器人控制建立了一个新的范例。
tldr: The paper introduces PIPER, a physics-informed reinforcement learning framework that integrates analytical soft physics constraints into policy optimization, improving learning efficiency, stability, and control accuracy in robotics.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为PIPER的物理信息强化学习框架，它将解析软物理约束集成到策略优化中，从而提高机器人学习的效率、稳定性和控制精度。

title: OCRA: Object-Centric Learning with 3D and Tactile Priors for Human-to-Robot Action Transfer
summary: We present OCRA, an Object-Centric framework for video-based human-to-Robot Action transfer that learns directly from human demonstration videos to enable robust manipulation. Object-centric learning emphasizes task-relevant objects and their interactions while filtering out irrelevant background, providing a natural and scalable way to teach robots. OCRA leverages multi-view RGB videos, the state-of-the-art 3D foundation model VGGT, and advanced detection and segmentation models to reconstruct object-centric 3D point clouds, capturing rich interactions between objects. To handle properties not easily perceived by vision alone, we incorporate tactile priors via a large-scale dataset of over one million tactile images. These 3D and tactile priors are fused through a multimodal module (ResFiLM) and fed into a Diffusion Policy to generate robust manipulation actions. Extensive experiments on both vision-only and visuo-tactile tasks show that OCRA significantly outperforms existing baselines and ablations, demonstrating its effectiveness for learning from human demonstration videos.
summary_zh: 我们提出了 OCRA，一个面向对象的框架，用于基于视频的人类到机器人动作迁移，它直接从人类演示视频中学习，实现稳健的操纵。面向对象的学习强调任务相关的对象及其交互，同时过滤掉无关的背景，提供了一种自然且可扩展的机器人教学方式。OCRA 利用多视角 RGB 视频、最先进的 3D 基础模型 VGGT 以及先进的检测和分割模型来重建面向对象的 3D 点云，捕捉对象之间丰富的交互。为了处理仅凭视觉难以感知的属性，我们通过一个包含超过一百万张触觉图像的大规模数据集来整合触觉先验。这些 3D 和触觉先验通过一个多模态模块 (ResFiLM) 融合，并输入到扩散策略中，以生成稳健的操纵动作。在仅视觉和视触觉任务上的大量实验表明，OCRA 显著优于现有的基线和消融实验，证明了其从人类演示视频中学习的有效性。
tldr: OCRA is an object-centric framework using 3D and tactile priors to transfer human actions to robots, outperforming baselines in manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: OCRA是一个以物体为中心的框架，利用3D和触觉先验知识将人类动作迁移到机器人上，在操作任务中优于基线方法。

title: eNavi: Event-based Imitation Policies for Low-Light Indoor Mobile Robot Navigation
summary: Event cameras provide high dynamic range and microsecond-level temporal resolution, making them well-suited for indoor robot navigation, where conventional RGB cameras degrade under fast motion or low-light conditions. Despite advances in event-based perception spanning detection, SLAM, and pose estimation, there remains limited research on end-to-end control policies that exploit the asynchronous nature of event streams. To address this gap, we introduce a real-world indoor person-following dataset collected using a TurtleBot 2 robot, featuring synchronized raw event streams, RGB frames, and expert control actions across multiple indoor maps, trajectories under both normal and low-light conditions. We further build a multimodal data preprocessing pipeline that temporally aligns event and RGB observations while reconstructing ground-truth actions from odometry to support high-quality imitation learning. Building on this dataset, we propose a late-fusion RGB-Event navigation policy that combines dual MobileNet encoders with a transformer-based fusion module trained via behavioral cloning. A systematic evaluation of RGB-only, Event-only, and RGB-Event fusion models across 12 training variations ranging from single-path imitation to general multi-path imitation shows that policies incorporating event data, particularly the fusion model, achieve improved robustness and lower action prediction error, especially in unseen low-light conditions where RGB-only models fail. We release the dataset, synchronization pipeline, and trained models at https://eventbasedvision.github.io/eNavi/
summary_zh: 事件相机提供高动态范围和微秒级时间分辨率，使其非常适合室内机器人导航，在快速运动或低光照条件下，传统RGB相机性能会下降。尽管基于事件的感知在检测、SLAM和姿态估计方面取得了进展，但利用事件流异步特性的端到端控制策略研究仍然有限。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了一个真实的室内人员跟随数据集，该数据集使用TurtleBot 2机器人采集，包含同步的原始事件流、RGB帧以及在多个室内地图、正常和低光照条件下的轨迹中的专家控制动作。我们进一步构建了一个多模态数据预处理流水线，该流水线在时间上对齐事件和RGB观测，同时从里程计重建真实动作，以支持高质量的模仿学习。基于此数据集，我们提出了一个基于后期融合的RGB-事件导航策略，该策略结合了双MobileNet编码器和一个基于Transformer的融合模块，并通过行为克隆进行训练。对RGB-only、Event-only和RGB-Event融合模型在12种训练变体（从单路径模仿到通用多路径模仿）中的系统评估表明，包含事件数据的策略，特别是融合模型，实现了更高的鲁棒性和更低的动作预测误差，尤其是在 RGB-only 模型失效的未见过低光照条件下。 我们在 https://eventbasedvision.github.io/eNavi/ 上发布数据集、同步流水线和训练好的模型。
tldr: This paper introduces an event-based imitation learning approach for robot navigation in challenging lighting conditions, along with a new real-world dataset and a multimodal (RGB and event) navigation policy. Results show improved robustness compared to RGB-only methods, especially in low light.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于事件的模仿学习方法，用于在具有挑战性光照条件下的机器人导航，并提供了一个新的真实世界数据集和一个多模态（RGB和事件）导航策略。结果表明，与仅使用RGB的方法相比，该方法具有更高的鲁棒性，特别是在弱光条件下。

title: From Scanning Guidelines to Action: A Robotic Ultrasound Agent with LLM-Based Reasoning
summary: Robotic ultrasound offers advantages over free-hand scanning, including improved reproducibility and reduced operator dependency. In clinical practice, US acquisition relies heavily on the sonographer's experience and situational judgment. When transferring this process to robotic systems, such expertise is often encoded explicitly through fixed procedures and task-specific models, yielding pipelines that can be difficult to adapt to new scanning tasks. In this work, we propose a unified framework for autonomous robotic US scanning that leverages a LLM-based agent to interpret US scanning guidelines and execute scans by dynamically invoking a set of provided software tools. Instead of encoding fixed scanning procedures, the LLM agent retrieves and reasons over guideline steps from scanning handbooks and adapts its planning decisions based on observations and the current scanning state. This enables the system to handle variable and decision-dependent workflows, such as adjusting scanning strategies, repeating steps, or selecting the appropriate next tool call in response to image quality or anatomical findings. Because the reasoning underlying tool selection is also critical for transparent and trustworthy planning, we further fine tune the LLM agent using a RL based strategy to improve both its reasoning quality and the correctness of tool selection and parameterization, while maintaining robust generalization to unseen guidelines and related tasks. We first validate the approach via verbal execution on 10 US scanning guidelines, assessing reasoning as well as tool selection and parameterization, and showing the benefit of RL fine tuning. We then demonstrate real world feasibility on robotic scanning of the gallbladder, spine, and kidney. Overall, the framework follows diverse guidelines and enables reliable autonomous scanning across multiple anatomical targets within a unified system.
summary_zh: 机器人超声相比于徒手扫描具有优势，包括提高可重复性和减少对操作者的依赖。在临床实践中，超声图像的获取很大程度上依赖于超声医师的经验和情境判断。当将该过程转移到机器人系统时，此类专业知识通常通过固定的程序和特定任务模型进行显式编码，从而导致流程难以适应新的扫描任务。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种统一的自主机器人超声扫描框架，该框架利用基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体来解释超声扫描指南，并通过动态调用一组提供的软件工具来执行扫描。该系统不编码固定的扫描程序，而是从扫描手册中检索指南步骤并进行推理，并根据观察结果和当前的扫描状态调整其规划决策。这使系统能够处理可变和决策依赖型的工作流程，例如调整扫描策略、重复步骤或选择适当的下一个工具调用，以响应图像质量或解剖学发现。由于工具选择背后的推理对于透明和可信赖的规划至关重要，我们进一步使用基于强化学习（RL）的策略来微调LLM智能体，以提高其推理质量以及工具选择和参数化的正确性，同时保持对未见指南和相关任务的稳健泛化能力。我们首先通过对10个超声扫描指南进行口头执行来验证该方法，评估推理以及工具选择和参数化，并展示RL微调的优势。然后，我们证明了其在胆囊、脊柱和肾脏的机器人扫描中的实际可行性。总体而言，该框架遵循不同的指南，并支持在统一的系统中对多个解剖目标进行可靠的自主扫描。
tldr: This paper introduces a robotic ultrasound scanning framework that utilizes a LLM-based agent to interpret scanning guidelines and dynamically control a robot using provided software tools, achieving autonomous scanning across multiple anatomical targets. They use RL to fine-tune the LLM for improved reasoning and tool selection.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种机器人超声扫描框架，该框架利用基于LLM的代理来解释扫描指南并动态控制机器人使用提供的软件工具，实现了跨多个解剖目标的自主扫描。他们使用强化学习来微调大型语言模型，以提高推理和工具选择能力。

title: WestWorld: A Knowledge-Encoded Scalable Trajectory World Model for Diverse Robotic Systems
summary: Trajectory world models play a crucial role in robotic dynamics learning, planning, and control. While recent works have explored trajectory world models for diverse robotic systems, they struggle to scale to a large number of distinct system dynamics and overlook domain knowledge of physical structures. To address these limitations, we introduce WestWorld, a knoWledge-Encoded Scalable Trajectory World model for diverse robotic systems. To tackle the scalability challenge, we propose a novel system-aware Mixture-of-Experts (Sys-MoE) that dynamically combines and routes specialized experts for different robotic systems via a learnable system embedding. To further enhance zero-shot generalization, we incorporate domain knowledge of robot physical structures by introducing a structural embedding that aligns trajectory representations with morphological information. After pretraining on 89 complex environments spanning diverse morphologies across both simulation and real-world settings, WestWorld achieves significant improvements over competitive baselines in zero- and few-shot trajectory prediction. Additionally, it shows strong scalability across a wide range of robotic environments and significantly improves performance on downstream model-based control for different robots. Finally, we deploy our model on a real-world Unitree Go1, where it demonstrates stable locomotion performance (see our demo on the website: https://westworldrobot.github.io/). The code will be available upon publication.
summary_zh: 轨迹世界模型在机器人动力学学习、规划和控制中起着至关重要的作用。虽然最近的研究已经探索了用于各种机器人系统的轨迹世界模型，但它们难以扩展到大量不同的系统动力学，并且忽略了物理结构的领域知识。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了WestWorld，一种用于多样化机器人系统的知识编码可扩展轨迹世界模型。为了应对可扩展性挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的系统感知混合专家模型（Sys-MoE），它通过一个可学习的系统嵌入，动态地组合和路由针对不同机器人系统的专门专家。为了进一步增强零样本泛化能力，我们通过引入一个结构嵌入，将轨迹表示与形态信息对齐，从而融入了机器人物理结构的领域知识。在包含模拟和真实世界环境中89个具有不同形态的复杂环境下的预训练之后，WestWorld在零样本和少样本轨迹预测方面取得了优于竞争基线的显著改进。此外，它在各种机器人环境中表现出强大的可扩展性，并显著提高了不同机器人的下游基于模型的控制性能。最后，我们在一个真实的宇树Go1上部署了我们的模型，该模型展示了稳定的运动性能（请在我们的网站上查看演示：https://westworldrobot.github.io/）。代码将在发布后提供。
tldr: WestWorld introduces a knowledge-encoded trajectory world model for diverse robotic systems, using a system-aware Mixture-of-Experts and structural embeddings to improve scalability and zero-shot generalization, demonstrating significant improvements in trajectory prediction and model-based control, including real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: WestWorld提出了一个知识编码的轨迹世界模型，用于各种机器人系统。它利用系统感知的混合专家模型和结构嵌入来提高可扩展性和零样本泛化能力，在轨迹预测和基于模型的控制方面显示出显著改进，包括实际部署。

title: OxyGen: Unified KV Cache Management for Vision-Language-Action Models under Multi-Task Parallelism
summary: Embodied AI agents increasingly require parallel execution of multiple tasks, such as manipulation, conversation, and memory construction, from shared observations under distinct time constraints. Recent Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) architecturally support such heterogeneous outputs, yet existing inference systems fail to achieve efficient multi-task parallelism for on-device deployment due to redundant computation and resource contention. We identify isolated KV cache management as the root cause. To address this, we propose unified KV cache management, an inference paradigm that treats KV cache as a first-class shared resource across tasks and over time. This abstraction enables two key optimizations: cross-task KV sharing eliminates redundant prefill of shared observations, while cross-frame continuous batching decouples variable-length language decoding from fixed-rate action generation across control cycles. We implement this paradigm for $π_{0.5}$, the most popular MoT VLA, and evaluate under representative robotic configurations. OxyGen achieves up to 3.7$\times$ speedup over isolated execution, delivering over 200 tokens/s language throughput and 70 Hz action frequency simultaneously without action quality degradation.
summary_zh: 具体化人工智能代理越来越需要并行执行多项任务，例如操控、对话和记忆构建，这些任务基于共享的观察数据，但具有不同的时间约束。最近的混合Transformer（MoT）视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在架构上支持这种异构输出，但由于冗余计算和资源竞争，现有的推理系统无法实现高效的多任务并行，以满足设备上的部署需求。我们发现隔离的KV缓存管理是根本原因。为了解决这个问题，我们提出统一KV缓存管理，这是一种将KV缓存视为跨任务和跨时间的顶级共享资源的推理范例。这种抽象化实现了两个关键优化：跨任务的KV共享消除了共享观测的冗余预填充，而跨帧的连续批处理则将可变长度的语言解码与固定速率的跨控制周期的动作生成解耦。我们为最流行的MoT VLA，$π_{0.5}$ 实现了这种范例，并在具有代表性的机器人配置下进行了评估。OxyGen 相对于隔离执行实现了高达3.7倍的加速，在不降低动作质量的前提下，同时实现了超过200 tokens/s的语言吞吐量和70 Hz的动作频率。
tldr: The paper introduces OxyGen, a unified KV cache management system for Vision-Language-Action models that enables efficient multi-task parallelism by sharing KV caches across tasks and frames, resulting in significant speedups without sacrificing action quality.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了OxyGen，一个用于视觉-语言-行动模型的统一KV缓存管理系统，通过跨任务和帧共享KV缓存，实现了高效的多任务并行，从而在不牺牲行动质量的情况下实现了显著的加速。

title: VIP-Loco: A Visually Guided Infinite Horizon Planning Framework for Legged Locomotion
summary: Perceptive locomotion for legged robots requires anticipating and adapting to complex, dynamic environments. Model Predictive Control (MPC) serves as a strong baseline, providing interpretable motion planning with constraint enforcement, but struggles with high-dimensional perceptual inputs and rapidly changing terrain. In contrast, model-free Reinforcement Learning (RL) adapts well across visually challenging scenarios but lacks planning. To bridge this gap, we propose VIP-Loco, a framework that integrates vision-based scene understanding with RL and planning. During training, an internal model maps proprioceptive states and depth images into compact kinodynamic features used by the RL policy. At deployment, the learned models are used within an infinite-horizon MPC formulation, combining adaptability with structured planning. We validate VIP-Loco in simulation on challenging locomotion tasks, including slopes, stairs, crawling, tilting, gap jumping, and climbing, across three robot morphologies: a quadruped (Unitree Go1), a biped (Cassie), and a wheeled-biped (TronA1-W). Through ablations and comparisons with state-of-the-art methods, we show that VIP-Loco unifies planning and perception, enabling robust, interpretable locomotion in diverse environments.
summary_zh: 用于腿足机器人的感知运动需要预测并适应复杂、动态的环境。模型预测控制(MPC)作为一种强大的基线方法，能够提供具有约束实施的可解释运动规划，但难以处理高维感知输入和快速变化的地形。相比之下，无模型强化学习(RL)能够很好地适应视觉挑战性场景，但缺乏规划能力。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了VIP-Loco，一个将基于视觉的场景理解与RL和规划相结合的框架。在训练期间，一个内部模型将本体感受状态和深度图像映射到紧凑的运动学特征，供RL策略使用。在部署时，学习到的模型被用于无限时域MPC公式中，将适应性与结构化规划相结合。我们在仿真环境中验证了VIP-Loco在具有挑战性的运动任务中的性能，包括斜坡、楼梯、爬行、倾斜、跳跃和攀爬，覆盖了三种机器人形态：四足机器人（Unitree Go1）、双足机器人（Cassie）和轮式双足机器人（TronA1-W）。通过消融实验和与最先进方法的比较，我们表明 VIP-Loco 统一了规划和感知，从而在各种环境中实现了稳健且可解释的运动。
tldr: The paper introduces VIP-Loco, a framework combining vision-based scene understanding, reinforcement learning, and model predictive control for robust legged locomotion in complex environments, validated on multiple robot morphologies and tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了VIP-Loco，一个结合了基于视觉的场景理解、强化学习和模型预测控制的框架，用于在复杂环境中实现稳健的足式运动，并在多种机器人形态和任务上进行了验证。

title: Data-Driven Physics Embedded Dynamics with Predictive Control and Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupeds
summary: State of the art quadrupedal locomotion approaches integrate Model Predictive Control (MPC) with Reinforcement Learning (RL), enabling complex motion capabilities with planning and terrain adaptive behaviors. However, they often face compounding errors over long horizons and have limited interpretability due to the absence of physical inductive biases. We address these issues by integrating Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) into an RL MPC framework, enabling physically consistent dynamics learning. At deployment, our inverse dynamics infinite horizon MPC scheme avoids costly matrix inversions, improving computational efficiency by up to 4x with minimal loss of task performance. We validate our framework through multiple ablations of the proposed LNN and its variants. We show improved sample efficiency, reduced long-horizon error, and faster real time planning compared to unstructured neural dynamics. Lastly, we also test our framework on the Unitree Go1 robot to show real world viability.
summary_zh: 最先进的四足运动方法集成了模型预测控制 (MPC) 与强化学习 (RL)，从而实现了具有规划和地形自适应行为的复杂运动能力。然而，它们经常面临长时域内的累积误差，并且由于缺乏物理归纳偏置而导致可解释性有限。 我们通过将拉格朗日神经网络 (LNN) 集成到 RL MPC 框架中来解决这些问题，从而实现物理一致的动力学学习。 在部署时，我们的逆动力学无限时域 MPC 方案避免了代价高昂的矩阵求逆，在任务性能损失最小的情况下，将计算效率提高了高达 4 倍。 我们通过对所提出的 LNN 及其变体的多次消融实验验证了我们的框架。结果表明，与非结构化神经动力学相比，我们的框架具有更高的样本效率、更低的长期误差和更快的实时规划能力。 最后，我们还在宇树 Go1 机器人上测试了我们的框架，以展示其在现实世界中的可行性。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel RL MPC framework for quadruped locomotion that integrates Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) to enable physically consistent dynamics learning, improving efficiency and reducing long-horizon errors. It demonstrates real-world viability on a Unitree Go1 robot.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新的用于四足机器人运动的 RL MPC 框架，该框架集成了拉格朗日神经网络 (LNN)，以实现物理一致的动力学学习，从而提高效率并减少长程误差。并在宇树Go1机器人上展示了现实世界的可行性。

title: OmniClone: Engineering a Robust, All-Rounder Whole-Body Humanoid Teleoperation System
summary: Whole-body humanoid teleoperation enables humans to remotely control humanoid robots, serving as both a real-time operational tool and a scalable engine for collecting demonstrations for autonomous learning. Despite recent advances, existing systems are validated using aggregate metrics that conflate distinct motion regimes, masking critical failure modes. This lack of diagnostic granularity, compounded by tightly coupled and labor-intensive system configurations, hinders robust real-world deployment. A key open challenge is building a teleoperation system that is simultaneously robust, versatile, and affordable for practical use. Here we present OmniClone, a whole-body humanoid teleoperation system that achieves high-fidelity, multi-skill control on a single consumer GPU with modest data requirements. Central to our approach is OmniBench, a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates policies across stratified motion categories and difficulty levels on unseen motions, exposing the narrow specialization of prior systems. Guided by these diagnostics, we identify an optimized training data recipe and integrate system-level improvements: subject-agnostic retargeting and robust communication, that collectively reduce Mean Per-Joint Position Error (MPJPE) by over 66% while requiring orders-of-magnitude fewer computational resources than comparable methods. Crucially, OmniClone is control-source-agnostic: a single unified policy supports real-time teleoperation, generated motion playback, and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, while generalizing across operators of vastly different body proportions. By uniting diagnostic evaluation with practical engineering, OmniClone provides an accessible foundation for scalable humanoid teleoperation and autonomous learning.
summary_zh: 全身人形机器人遥操作使人类能够远程控制人形机器人，既作为实时操作工具，又作为收集自主学习演示的可扩展引擎。尽管最近取得了进展，但现有系统采用的是聚合指标进行验证，这些指标混淆了不同的运动状态，掩盖了关键的失效模式。这种诊断粒度的不足，再加上紧密耦合且劳动密集型的系统配置，阻碍了稳健的实际部署。一个关键的开放性挑战是构建一个对实际使用来说同时具备稳健性、通用性和经济性的遥操作系统。在此，我们提出了 OmniClone，一个全身人形机器人遥操作系统，它仅需一个消费级 GPU 和适量的数据即可实现高保真、多技能的控制。我们方法的核心是 OmniBench，一个诊断基准测试，它在未见过的运动上评估策略在分层运动类别和难度级别上的表现，揭示了先前系统的狭隘专业化。在这些诊断的指导下，我们确定了一个优化的训练数据配方，并集成了系统级的改进措施：与主体无关的重定向和稳健的通信，这些措施共同降低了超过 66% 的平均关节位置误差（MPJPE），并且所需的计算资源比同类方法少几个数量级。至关重要的是，OmniClone 与控制源无关：一个统一的策略支持实时遥操作、生成运动回放以及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，同时泛化到体型比例差异巨大的操作者。通过将诊断评估与实际工程相结合，OmniClone 为可扩展的人形机器人遥操作和自主学习奠定了易于获取的基础。
tldr: The paper introduces OmniClone, a robust and versatile whole-body humanoid teleoperation system, along with OmniBench, a new diagnostic benchmark, showing substantial improvements in performance and resource efficiency while supporting multiple control sources.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了OmniClone，一个鲁棒且通用的全身人形机器人遥操作系统，以及OmniBench，一个新的诊断基准，展示了在性能和资源效率方面的显著改进，同时支持多种控制来源。

title: A Real-Time Neuro-Symbolic Ethical Governor for Safe Decision Control in Autonomous Robotic Manipulation
summary: Ethical decision governance has become a critical requirement for autonomous robotic systems operating in human-centered and safety-sensitive environments. This paper presents a real-time neuro-symbolic ethical governor designed to enable risk-aware supervisory control in autonomous robotic manipulation tasks. The proposed framework integrates transformer-based ethical reasoning with a probabilistic ethical risk field formulation and a threshold-based override control mechanism. language-grounded ethical intent inference capability is learned from natural language task descriptions using a fine-tuned DistilBERT model trained on the ETHICS commonsense dataset. A continuous ethical risk metric is subsequently derived from predicted unsafe action probability, confidence uncertainty, and probabilistic variance to support adaptive decision filtering. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is validated through simulated autonomous robot-arm task scenarios involving varying levels of human proximity and operational hazard. Experimental results demonstrate stable model convergence, reliable ethical risk discrimination, and improved safety-aware decision outcomes without significant degradation of task execution efficiency. The proposed neuro-symbolic architecture further provides enhanced interpretability compared with purely data-driven safety filters, enabling transparent ethical reasoning in real-time control loops. The findings suggest that ethical decision governance can be effectively modeled as a dynamic supervisory risk layer for autonomous robotic systems, with potential applicability to broader cyber-physical and assistive robotics domains.
summary_zh: 伦理决策治理已成为在以人为中心和安全敏感环境中运行的自主机器人系统的关键需求。本文提出了一种实时的神经符号伦理管理器，旨在实现自主机器人操作任务中的风险感知监督控制。所提出的框架将基于Transformer的伦理推理与概率伦理风险场建模和基于阈值的覆写控制机制相结合。语言接地的伦理意图推断能力通过使用在ETHICS常识数据集上微调的DistilBERT模型，从自然语言任务描述中学习。随后，从预测的不安全行为概率、置信度不确定性和概率方差中推导出连续的伦理风险指标，以支持自适应决策过滤。通过涉及不同程度的人员接近和操作危害的模拟自主机器人手臂任务场景验证了所提出方法的有效性。实验结果表明，模型收敛稳定，伦理风险判别可靠，并且在不显著降低任务执行效率的情况下，改进了具有安全意识的决策结果。与纯粹的数据驱动安全滤波器相比，所提出的神经符号架构进一步提供了增强的可解释性，从而能够在实时控制回路中实现透明的伦理推理。研究结果表明，伦理决策治理可以有效地建模为自主机器人系统的动态监督风险层，并具有应用于更广泛的网络物理和辅助机器人领域的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces a neuro-symbolic ethical governor for autonomous robot manipulation, using a transformer-based ethical reasoning system to improve safety in human-robot interaction, validated in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于自主机器人操作的神经符号伦理调控器，使用基于Transformer的伦理推理系统来提高人机交互的安全性，并在仿真中进行了验证。

title: Navigation beyond Wayfinding: Robots Collaborating with Visually Impaired Users for Environmental Interactions
summary: Robotic guidance systems have shown promise in supporting blind and visually impaired (BVI) individuals with wayfinding and obstacle avoidance. However, most existing systems assume a clear path and do not support a critical aspect of navigation - environmental interactions that require manipulating objects to enable movement. These interactions are challenging for a human-robot pair because they demand (i) precise localization and manipulation of interaction targets (e.g., pressing elevator buttons) and (ii) dynamic coordination between the user's and robot's movements (e.g., pulling out a chair to sit). We present a collaborative human-robot approach that combines our robotic guide dog's precise sensing and localization capabilities with the user's ability to perform physical manipulation. The system alternates between two modes: lead mode, where the robot detects and guides the user to the target, and adaptation mode, where the robot adjusts its motion as the user interacts with the environment (e.g., opening a door). Evaluation results show that our system enables navigation that is safer, smoother, and more efficient than both a traditional white cane and a non-adaptive guiding system, with the performance gap widening as tasks demand higher precision in locating interaction targets. These findings highlight the promise of human-robot collaboration in advancing assistive technologies toward more generalizable and realistic navigation support.
summary_zh: 机器人引导系统在辅助盲人和视力障碍者（BVI）进行寻路和避障方面展现出潜力。然而，大多数现有系统都假定路径畅通，且不支持导航的一个关键方面——需要操纵物体才能实现移动的环境互动。这些互动对人机协作构成挑战，因为它们需要(i)精确的定位和操纵互动目标（例如，按下电梯按钮）以及(ii)用户和机器人运动之间的动态协调（例如，拉出椅子坐下）。我们提出了一种协作式人机方法，该方法结合了我们的机器人导盲犬的精确感知和定位能力以及用户进行物理操纵的能力。该系统在两种模式之间交替：引导模式，机器人检测目标并引导用户到达目标；以及适应模式，机器人根据用户与环境的互动调整其运动（例如，打开门）。评估结果表明，与传统的盲杖和非自适应引导系统相比，我们的系统能够实现更安全、更流畅、更高效的导航，并且随着任务对定位互动目标精度要求的提高，性能差距会扩大。这些发现突出了人机协作在推进辅助技术，使其朝着更具通用性和更真实的导航支持方向发展的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces a collaborative human-robot system for visually impaired users that goes beyond simple wayfinding by enabling environmental interactions like manipulating objects, showing improved safety and efficiency compared to traditional methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种人机协作系统，旨在帮助视障用户完成导航，该系统超越了简单的寻路功能，能够实现与环境的交互，例如操作物体，实验结果表明，与传统方法相比，该系统在安全性和效率方面有所提升。

title: TransCurriculum: Multi-Dimensional Curriculum Learning for Fast & Stable Locomotion
summary: High-speed legged locomotion struggles with stability and transfer losses at higher command velocities during deployment. One reason is that most curricula vary difficulty along single axis, for example increase the range of command velocities, terrain difficulty, or domain parameters (e.g. friction or payload mass) using either fixed update rule or instantaneous rewards while ignoring how the history of robot training has evolved. We propose TransCurriculum, a transformer-based multi-dimensional curriculum learning approach for agile quadrupedal locomotion. TransCurriculum adapts to 3 axes, velocity command targets, terrain difficulty, and domain randomization parameters (friction and payload mass). Rather than feeding task reward history directly into the low-level control policy, our formulation exploits it at the curriculum level. A transformer-based teacher retrieves the sequence of rewards and uses it to predict future rewards, success rate, and learning progress to guide expansion of this multidimensional curriculum towards high performing task bins. Finally we validate our approach on the Unitree Go1 robot in simulation (Isaac Gym) and deploy it zero-shot on Go1 hardware. Our TransCurriculum policy achieves a maximum velocity of 6.3 m/s in simulation and outperforms prior curriculum baselines. We tested our TransCurriculum trained policy on terrains (carpets, slopes, tiles, concrete), achieving a forward velocity of 4.1 m/s on carpet surpassing the fastest curriculum methods by 18.8% and achieves maximum zero-shot value among all tested methods. Our multi-dimensional curriculum also reduces the transfer loss to 18% from 27% for command only curriculum, demonstrating the benefits of joint training over velocity, terrain and domain randomization dimension while keeping the task success rate of 80-90% on rigid indoor and outdoor surfaces.
summary_zh: 高速腿式运动在部署期间，当指令速度较高时，通常面临稳定性和迁移损失的挑战。一个原因是大多数课程沿单一轴改变难度，例如使用固定的更新规则或瞬时奖励，来增加指令速度范围、地形难度或领域参数（例如摩擦力或负载质量），同时忽略了机器人训练历史的演变过程。我们提出TransCurriculum，一种基于Transformer的多维度课程学习方法，用于灵敏的四足运动。TransCurriculum能够适应三个轴：速度指令目标、地形难度和领域随机化参数（摩擦力和负载质量）。我们的方法不是直接将任务奖励历史输入到低层控制策略中，而是在课程级别利用它。一个基于Transformer的教师模型检索奖励序列，并利用它来预测未来奖励、成功率和学习进度，从而指导这个多维度课程向高性能的任务区间扩展。最后，我们在仿真（Isaac Gym）的宇树Go1机器人上验证了我们的方法，并在Go1硬件上进行了零样本部署。我们的TransCurriculum策略在仿真中实现了6.3米/秒的最大速度，并且优于之前的课程学习基线。我们在多种地形（地毯、斜坡、瓷砖、混凝土）上测试了经过TransCurriculum训练的策略，在地毯上实现了4.1米/秒的前向速度，超过了最快的课程学习方法18.8%，并在所有测试方法中实现了最高的零样本价值。我们的多维度课程还将迁移损失从仅指令课程的27%降低到18%，证明了在速度、地形和领域随机化维度上进行联合训练的优势，同时在刚性室内和室外表面保持80-90%的任务成功率。
tldr: The paper introduces TransCurriculum, a transformer-based multi-dimensional curriculum learning approach for quadrupedal locomotion that adapts to velocity, terrain, and domain randomization, achieving high speeds and improved zero-shot transfer on the Unitree Go1 robot.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于Transformer的多维课程学习方法TransCurriculum，用于四足机器人的运动控制。它适应速度、地形和域随机化，在Unitree Go1机器人上实现了更高的速度和更好的零样本迁移。

title: Infinite Problem Generator: Verifiably Scaling Physics Reasoning Data with Agentic Workflows
summary: Training large language models for complex reasoning is bottlenecked by the scarcity of verifiable, high-quality data. In domains like physics, standard text augmentation often introduces hallucinations, while static benchmarks lack the reasoning traces required for fine-tuning. We introduce the Infinite Problem Generator (IPG), an agentic framework that synthesizes physics problems with guaranteed solvability through a Formula-as-Code paradigm. Unlike probabilistic text generation, IPG constructs solutions as executable Python programs, enforcing strict mathematical consistency. As a proof-of-concept, we release ClassicalMechanicsV1, a high-fidelity corpus of 1,335 classical mechanics problems expanded from 165 expert seeds. The corpus demonstrates high structural diversity, spanning 102 unique physical formulas with an average complexity of 3.05 formulas per problem. Furthermore, we identify a Complexity Blueprint, demonstrating a strong linear correlation ($R^2 \approx 0.95$) between formula count and verification code length. This relationship establishes code complexity as a precise, proxy-free metric for problem difficulty, enabling controllable curriculum generation. We release the full IPG pipeline, the ClassicalMechanicsV1 dataset, and our evaluation report to support reproducible research in reasoning-intensive domains.
summary_zh: 训练用于复杂推理的大型语言模型面临着可验证、高质量数据稀缺的瓶颈。在物理学等领域，标准的文本增强方法常常会引入幻觉，而静态基准测试缺乏微调所需的推理轨迹。我们引入无限问题生成器 (IPG)，这是一个代理框架，它通过“公式即代码”范式合成具有保证可解性的物理问题。与概率文本生成不同，IPG 将解决方案构建为可执行的 Python 程序，从而强制执行严格的数学一致性。作为概念验证，我们发布了 ClassicalMechanicsV1，这是一个高保真语料库，包含 1,335 个经典力学问题，由 165 个专家种子扩展而来。该语料库展示了高度的结构多样性，涵盖 102 个唯一的物理公式，每个问题的平均复杂度为 3.05 个公式。此外，我们确定了一个复杂性蓝图，证明了公式数量与验证代码长度之间存在很强的线性相关性（$R^2 \approx 0.95$）。这种关系将代码复杂性确立为问题难度的精确、无代理度量，从而实现可控的课程生成。为了支持推理密集型领域的可复现研究，我们发布了完整的 IPG 流程、ClassicalMechanicsV1 数据集以及我们的评估报告。
tldr: The paper introduces the Infinite Problem Generator (IPG), an agentic framework that uses a Formula-as-Code paradigm to generate a large, verifiable dataset of classical mechanics problems. It demonstrates a controllable curriculum generation based on code complexity.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为无限问题生成器（IPG）的智能体框架，它使用“公式即代码”范式来生成大量的、可验证的经典力学问题数据集。它展示了一种基于代码复杂性的可控课程生成方法。

title: AgentProcessBench: Diagnosing Step-Level Process Quality in Tool-Using Agents
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have evolved into tool-using agents, they remain brittle in long-horizon interactions. Unlike mathematical reasoning where errors are often rectifiable via backtracking, tool-use failures frequently induce irreversible side effects, making accurate step-level verification critical. However, existing process-level benchmarks are predominantly confined to closed-world mathematical domains, failing to capture the dynamic and open-ended nature of tool execution. To bridge this gap, we introduce AgentProcessBench, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating step-level effectiveness in realistic, tool-augmented trajectories. The benchmark comprises 1,000 diverse trajectories and 8,509 human-labeled step annotations with 89.1% inter-annotator agreement. It features a ternary labeling scheme to capture exploration and an error propagation rule to reduce labeling ambiguity. Extensive experiments reveal key insights: (1) weaker policy models exhibit inflated ratios of correct steps due to early termination; (2) distinguishing neutral and erroneous actions remains a significant challenge for current models; and (3) process-derived signals provide complementary value to outcome supervision, significantly enhancing test-time scaling. We hope AgentProcessBench can foster future research in reward models and pave the way toward general agents. The code and data are available at https://github.com/RUCBM/AgentProcessBench.
summary_zh: 虽然大型语言模型（LLMs）已经发展成为使用工具的智能体，但它们在长程交互中仍然表现得较为脆弱。与可以通过回溯来纠正错误的数学推理不同，工具使用失败通常会产生不可逆的副作用，因此准确的步骤级验证至关重要。然而，现有的过程级基准测试主要局限于封闭世界的数学领域，无法捕捉工具执行的动态和开放特性。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了AgentProcessBench，这是第一个专门评估真实、工具增强轨迹中的步骤级有效性的基准测试。该基准测试包含1,000条不同的轨迹和8,509个人工标注的步骤注释，注释者之间的协议一致性达到89.1%。它采用三元标注方案来捕捉探索行为，并使用误差传播规则来减少标注歧义。大量实验揭示了关键的见解：（1）较弱的策略模型由于早期终止而表现出过高的正确步骤比例；（2）区分中性和错误动作仍然是当前模型面临的重大挑战；（3）过程衍生的信号为结果监督提供了补充价值，显著增强了测试时的扩展性。我们希望AgentProcessBench能够促进奖励模型方面的未来研究，并为通用智能体铺平道路。代码和数据可在https://github.com/RUCBM/AgentProcessBench获得。
tldr: The paper introduces AgentProcessBench, a new benchmark for evaluating step-level effectiveness of tool-using agents in realistic, open-ended environments, addressing the limitations of existing benchmarks focused on closed-world mathematical domains and revealing challenges in current models' ability to distinguish between neutral and erroneous tool-use actions.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AgentProcessBench，一个新的基准，用于评估工具使用代理在现实、开放环境中的步进级别有效性，解决了现有基准主要关注封闭世界数学领域的限制，并揭示了当前模型区分中性和错误工具使用行为的能力所面临的挑战。

title: The Pulse of Motion: Measuring Physical Frame Rate from Visual Dynamics
summary: While recent generative video models have achieved remarkable visual realism and are being explored as world models, true physical simulation requires mastering both space and time. Current models can produce visually smooth kinematics, yet they lack a reliable internal motion pulse to ground these motions in a consistent, real-world time scale. This temporal ambiguity stems from the common practice of indiscriminately training on videos with vastly different real-world speeds, forcing them into standardized frame rates. This leads to what we term chronometric hallucination: generated sequences exhibit ambiguous, unstable, and uncontrollable physical motion speeds. To address this, we propose Visual Chronometer, a predictor that recovers the Physical Frames Per Second (PhyFPS) directly from the visual dynamics of an input video. Trained via controlled temporal resampling, our method estimates the true temporal scale implied by the motion itself, bypassing unreliable metadata. To systematically quantify this issue, we establish two benchmarks, PhyFPS-Bench-Real and PhyFPS-Bench-Gen. Our evaluations reveal a harsh reality: state-of-the-art video generators suffer from severe PhyFPS misalignment and temporal instability. Finally, we demonstrate that applying PhyFPS corrections significantly improves the human-perceived naturalness of AI-generated videos. Our project page is https://xiangbogaobarry.github.io/Visual_Chronometer/.
summary_zh: 虽然最近的生成视频模型在视觉真实性方面取得了显著进展，并被探索用作世界模型，但真正的物理模拟需要精通空间和时间。 当前的模型可以产生视觉上流畅的运动学，但它们缺乏可靠的内部运动脉冲，无法将这些运动以一致的、真实世界的时间尺度进行锚定。这种时间模糊性源于普遍存在的做法，即不加区分地训练具有截然不同的真实世界速度的视频，迫使它们适应标准化的帧率。这导致了我们称之为计时幻觉的现象：生成的序列表现出模糊、不稳定和不可控的物理运动速度。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了视觉时计（Visual Chronometer），一个直接从输入视频的视觉动态中恢复物理帧率（PhyFPS）的预测器。通过控制的时间重采样进行训练，我们的方法估计了运动本身所隐含的真实时间尺度，绕过了不可靠的元数据。为了系统地量化这个问题，我们建立了两个基准，PhyFPS-Bench-Real和PhyFPS-Bench-Gen。我们的评估揭示了一个严峻的现实：最先进的视频生成器遭受严重的PhyFPS错位和时间不稳定。最后，我们证明了应用PhyFPS校正显著提高了人工智能生成视频的人类感知自然度。我们的项目页面是https://xiangbogaobarry.github.io/Visual_Chronometer/。
tldr: This paper introduces Visual Chronometer, a method to estimate the true physical frame rate (PhyFPS) from video dynamics, revealing and addressing temporal inconsistencies in generated videos, which improves perceived naturalness.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为Visual Chronometer的方法，用于从视频动态中估计真实的物理帧率 (PhyFPS)，揭示并解决生成视频中的时间不一致性问题，从而提高感知到的自然度。

title: AgroNVILA: Perception-Reasoning Decoupling for Multi-view Agricultural Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Agricultural multimodal reasoning requires robust spatial understanding across varying scales, from ground-level close-ups to top-down UAV and satellite imagery. Existing Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) suffer from a significant "terrestrial-centric" bias, causing scale confusion and logic drift during complex agricultural planning. To address this, we introduce the first large-scale AgroOmni (288K), a multi-view training corpus designed to capture diverse spatial topologies and scales in modern precision agriculture. Built on this dataset, we propose AgroNVILA, an MLLM that utilizes a novel Perception-Reasoning Decoupling (PRD) architecture. On the perception side, we incorporate a View-Conditioned Meta-Net (VCMN), which injects macroscopic spatial context into visual tokens, resolving scale ambiguities with minimal computational overhead. On the reasoning side, Agriculture-aware Relative Policy Optimization (ARPO) leverages reinforcement learning to align the model's decision-making with expert agricultural logic, preventing statistical shortcuts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AgroNVILA outperforms state-of-the-art MLLMs, achieving significant improvements (+15.18%) in multi-altitude agricultural reasoning, reflecting its robust capability for holistic agricultural spatial planning.
summary_zh: 农业多模态推理需要在不同尺度上具备稳健的空间理解能力，从地面近景到俯视无人机和卫星图像。现有的多模态大型语言模型(MLLM)存在显著的“陆地中心”偏差，导致复杂农业规划过程中的尺度混淆和逻辑漂移。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了首个大规模的AgroOmni（288K），这是一个多视角训练语料库，旨在捕捉现代精准农业中多样的空间拓扑结构和尺度。基于该数据集，我们提出了AgroNVILA，一个利用了新型感知-推理解耦(PRD)架构的MLLM。在感知方面，我们引入了视图条件元网络(VCMN)，它将宏观空间上下文注入视觉标记中，以最小的计算开销消除尺度模糊。在推理方面，农业感知相对策略优化(ARPO)利用强化学习使模型的决策与专家农业逻辑对齐，防止统计捷径。大量实验表明，AgroNVILA优于最先进的MLLM，在多高度农业推理方面取得了显著的改进（+15.18%），反映了其在整体农业空间规划中的强大能力。
tldr: The paper introduces AgroNVILA, a new MLLM designed for robust spatial understanding in agriculture, featuring a Perception-Reasoning Decoupling architecture and a large-scale multi-view training corpus called AgroOmni, outperforming existing MLLMs in multi-altitude agricultural reasoning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AgroNVILA，一种新的多模态大语言模型，专为农业领域强大的空间理解而设计。它采用了解耦的感知-推理架构，并使用名为AgroOmni的大规模多视角训练语料库，在多高度农业推理方面优于现有的多模态大语言模型。

title: 4D Synchronized Fields: Motion-Language Gaussian Splatting for Temporal Scene Understanding
summary: Current 4D representations decouple geometry, motion, and semantics: reconstruction methods discard interpretable motion structure; language-grounded methods attach semantics after motion is learned, blind to how objects move; and motion-aware methods encode dynamics as opaque per-point residuals without object-level organization. We propose 4D Synchronized Fields, a 4D Gaussian representation that learns object-factored motion in-loop during reconstruction and synchronizes language to the resulting kinematics through a per-object conditioned field. Each Gaussian trajectory is decomposed into shared object motion plus an implicit residual, and a kinematic-conditioned ridge map predicts temporal semantic variation, yielding a single representation in which reconstruction, motion, and semantics are structurally coupled and enabling open-vocabulary temporal queries that retrieve both objects and moments. On HyperNeRF, 4D Synchronized Fields achieves 28.52 dB mean PSNR, the highest among all language-grounded and motion-aware baselines, within 1.5 dB of reconstruction-only methods. On targeted temporal-state retrieval, the kinematic-conditioned field attains 0.884 mean accuracy, 0.815 mean vIoU, and 0.733 mean tIoU, surpassing 4D LangSplat (0.620, 0.433, and 0.439 respectively) and LangSplat (0.415, 0.304, and 0.262).
