Ablation confirms that kinematic conditioning is the primary driver, accounting for +0.45 tIoU over a static-embedding-only baseline. 4D Synchronized Fields is the only method that jointly exposes interpretable motion primitives and temporally grounded language fields from a single trained representation. Code will be released.
summary_zh: 当前的4D表示解耦了几何、运动和语义：重建方法丢弃了可解释的运动结构；基于语言的方法在运动学习之后才附加语义，忽略了物体如何运动；而运动感知的方法将动态性编码为不透明的逐点残差，缺乏对象级别的组织。我们提出了4D同步场，这是一种4D高斯表示，可以在重建过程中循环学习对象分解的运动，并通过每个对象条件场将语言同步到生成的运动学。每个高斯轨迹被分解为共享的对象运动加上一个隐式残差，并且一个运动学条件脊线图预测时间语义变化，从而产生一个结构上耦合了重建、运动和语义的单一表示，并能够进行开放词汇的时间查询，检索对象和时刻。在HyperNeRF上，4D同步场实现了28.52 dB的平均PSNR，这是所有基于语言和运动感知的基线方法中最高的，与仅重建方法的结果差距在1.5 dB以内。在有针对性的时间状态检索中，运动学条件场获得了0.884的平均准确率、0.815的平均vIoU和0.733的平均tIoU，超过了4D LangSplat（分别为0.620、0.433和0.439）和LangSplat（分别为0.415、0.304和0.262）。消融实验证实，运动学条件是主要驱动因素，相对于仅静态嵌入的基线，tIoU提高了+0.45。4D同步场是唯一一种从单一训练表示中联合公开可解释的运动原语和时间锚定的语言场的方法。代码将被发布。
tldr: The paper introduces 4D Synchronized Fields, a novel 4D Gaussian representation that jointly learns object-factored motion and synchronizes language to kinematics for improved temporal scene understanding and open-vocabulary temporal queries.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了4D同步场，一种新的4D高斯表示方法，可以联合学习物体分解的运动并将语言与运动学同步，以实现更好的时间场景理解和开放词汇的时间查询。

title: All-day Multi-scenes Lifelong Vision-and-Language Navigation with Tucker Adaptation
summary: Deploying vision-and-language navigation (VLN) agents requires adaptation across diverse scenes and environments, but fine-tuning on a specific scenario often causes catastrophic forgetting in others, which severely limits flexible long-term deployment. We formalize this challenge as the all-day multi-scenes lifelong VLN (AML-VLN) problem. Existing parameter-efficient adapters (e.g., LoRA and its variants) are limited by their two-dimensional matrix form, which fails to capture the multi-hierarchical navigation knowledge spanning multiple scenes and environments. To address this, we propose Tucker Adaptation (TuKA), which represents the multi-hierarchical navigation knowledge as a high-order tensor and leverages Tucker decomposition to decouple the knowledge into shared subspaces and scenario-specific experts. We further introduce a decoupled knowledge incremental learning strategy to consolidate shared subspaces while constraining specific experts for decoupled lifelong learning. Building on TuKA, we also develop a VLN agent named AlldayWalker, which continually learns across multiple navigation scenarios, achieving all-day multi-scenes navigation. Extensive experiments show that AlldayWalker consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
summary_zh: 部署视觉-语言导航（VLN）智能体需要在不同的场景和环境中进行适配，但在特定场景上的微调常常导致在其他场景中发生灾难性遗忘，这严重限制了灵活的长期部署。我们将这一挑战形式化为全天多场景终身VLN（AML-VLN）问题。现有的参数高效适配器（例如，LoRA及其变体）受到其二维矩阵形式的限制，无法捕捉跨多个场景和环境的多层次导航知识。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Tucker适配（TuKA），它将多层次导航知识表示为高阶张量，并利用Tucker分解将知识解耦为共享子空间和特定场景专家。我们进一步引入了一种解耦知识增量学习策略，以巩固共享子空间，同时约束特定专家，实现解耦终身学习。基于TuKA，我们还开发了一个名为AlldayWalker的VLN智能体，该智能体可以持续学习多个导航场景，实现全天多场景导航。大量实验表明，AlldayWalker始终优于最先进的基线。
tldr: The paper introduces Tucker Adaptation (TuKA), a novel parameter-efficient method for lifelong vision-and-language navigation (VLN) across multiple scenes, addressing catastrophic forgetting via high-order tensor decomposition and decoupled knowledge incremental learning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Tucker Adaptation (TuKA)，一种新型的参数高效方法，用于跨多个场景的终身视觉-语言导航(VLN)，通过高阶张量分解和解耦知识增量学习来解决灾难性遗忘问题。

title: Why Do LLM-based Web Agents Fail? A Hierarchical Planning Perspective
summary: Large language model (LLM) web agents are increasingly used for web navigation but remain far from human reliability on realistic, long-horizon tasks. Existing evaluations focus primarily on end-to-end success, offering limited insight into where failures arise. We propose a hierarchical planning framework to analyze web agents across three layers (i.e., high-level planning, low-level execution, and replanning), enabling process-based evaluation of reasoning, grounding, and recovery. Our experiments show that structured Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) plans produce more concise and goal-directed strategies than natural language (NL) plans, but low-level execution remains the dominant bottleneck. These results indicate that improving perceptual grounding and adaptive control, not only high-level reasoning, is critical for achieving human-level reliability. This hierarchical perspective provides a principled foundation for diagnosing and advancing LLM web agents.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）网页代理正被越来越多地用于网页导航，但在现实的、长时程任务中，其可靠性仍远不及人类。现有的评估主要关注端到端成功率，对失败产生的原因洞察有限。我们提出了一种分层规划框架，用于分析网页代理的三个层级（即高层规划、低层执行和重规划），从而能够进行基于过程的推理、对齐和恢复评估。我们的实验表明，结构化的规划领域定义语言（PDDL）计划比自然语言（NL）计划产生更简洁、更具目标导向性的策略，但低层执行仍然是主要的瓶颈。这些结果表明，提高感知对齐和自适应控制，而不仅仅是高层推理，对于实现人类水平的可靠性至关重要。这种分层视角为诊断和推进LLM网页代理提供了一个原则性的基础。
tldr: This paper analyzes the failure modes of LLM web agents using a hierarchical planning framework, identifying low-level execution and grounding as key bottlenecks rather than high-level reasoning alone. They propose using PDDL for more goal-directed planning.
tldr_zh: 本文采用分层规划框架分析了LLM网络代理的失败模式，发现低级执行和基础是关键瓶颈，而不仅仅是高级推理。他们建议使用 PDDL 进行更有目标导向的计划。

title: GoldenStart: Q-Guided Priors and Entropy Control for Distilling Flow Policies
summary: Flow-matching policies hold great promise for reinforcement learning (RL) by capturing complex, multi-modal action distributions. However, their practical application is often hindered by prohibitive inference latency and ineffective online exploration. Although recent works have employed one-step distillation for fast inference, the structure of the initial noise distribution remains an overlooked factor that presents significant untapped potential. This overlooked factor, along with the challenge of controlling policy stochasticity, constitutes two critical areas for advancing distilled flow-matching policies. To overcome these limitations, we propose GoldenStart (GSFlow), a policy distillation method with Q-guided priors and explicit entropy control. Instead of initializing generation from uninformed noise, we introduce a Q-guided prior modeled by a conditional VAE. This state-conditioned prior repositions the starting points of the one-step generation process into high-Q regions, effectively providing a "golden start" that shortcuts the policy to promising actions. Furthermore, for effective online exploration, we enable our distilled actor to output a stochastic distribution instead of a deterministic point. This is governed by entropy regularization, allowing the policy to shift from pure exploitation to principled exploration. Our integrated framework demonstrates that by designing the generative startpoint and explicitly controlling policy entropy, it is possible to achieve efficient and exploratory policies, bridging the generative models and the practical actor-critic methods. We conduct extensive experiments on offline and online continuous control benchmarks, where our method significantly outperforms prior state-of-the-art approaches. Code will be available at https://github.com/ZhHe11/GSFlow-RL.
summary_zh: 流匹配策略通过捕获复杂的多模态动作分布，在强化学习（RL）中展现出巨大的潜力。然而，它们的实际应用常常受到过高的推理延迟和无效的在线探索的阻碍。尽管最近的工作已采用单步蒸馏来实现快速推理，但初始噪声分布的结构仍然是一个被忽视的因素，蕴藏着尚未挖掘的巨大潜力。这个被忽视的因素，以及控制策略随机性的挑战，构成了推进蒸馏流匹配策略的两个关键领域。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出 GoldenStart (GSFlow)，一种带有Q引导先验和显式熵控制的策略蒸馏方法。与从无信息的噪声初始化生成不同，我们引入了一个由条件VAE建模的Q引导先验。这种状态条件先验将单步生成过程的起始点重新定位到高Q区域，有效地提供了一个“黄金起点”，将策略快捷导向到有希望的动作。此外，为了有效的在线探索，我们使我们的蒸馏后的actor输出一个随机分布，而不是一个确定性点。这受到熵正则化的控制，允许策略从纯粹的利用转变为有原则的探索。我们的集成框架表明，通过设计生成起始点并显式控制策略熵，可以获得高效且具有探索性的策略，弥合了生成模型和实用的Actor-Critic方法之间的差距。我们在离线和在线连续控制基准上进行了广泛的实验，结果表明我们的方法显著优于先前的最先进方法。代码将在https://github.com/ZhHe11/GSFlow-RL上提供。
tldr: The paper introduces GoldenStart (GSFlow), a policy distillation method for reinforcement learning that uses a Q-guided prior and entropy control to improve inference latency and online exploration in flow-matching policies. It achieves SOTA performance on continuous control benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GoldenStart (GSFlow)，一种用于强化学习的策略蒸馏方法，它利用Q引导的先验和熵控制来改善流匹配策略中的推理延迟和在线探索。并在连续控制基准测试中取得了SOTA性能。

title: Diffusion Reinforcement Learning via Centered Reward Distillation
summary: Diffusion and flow models achieve State-Of-The-Art (SOTA) generative performance, yet many practically important behaviors such as fine-grained prompt fidelity, compositional correctness, and text rendering are weakly specified by score or flow matching pretraining objectives. Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning with external, black-box rewards is a natural remedy, but diffusion RL is often brittle. Trajectory-based methods incur high memory cost and high-variance gradient estimates; forward-process approaches converge faster but can suffer from distribution drift, and hence reward hacking. In this work, we present \textbf{Centered Reward Distillation (CRD)}, a diffusion RL framework derived from KL-regularized reward maximization built on forward-process-based fine-tuning. The key insight is that the intractable normalizing constant cancels under \emph{within-prompt centering}, yielding a well-posed reward-matching objective. To enable reliable text-to-image fine-tuning, we introduce techniques that explicitly control distribution drift: (\textit{i}) decoupling the sampler from the moving reference to prevent ratio-signal collapse, (\textit{ii}) KL anchoring to a CFG-guided pretrained model to control long-run drift and align with the inference-time semantics of the pre-trained model, and (\textit{iii}) reward-adaptive KL strength to accelerate early learning under large KL regularization while reducing late-stage exploitation of reward-model loopholes. Experiments on text-to-image post-training with \texttt{GenEval} and \texttt{OCR} rewards show that CRD achieves competitive SOTA reward optimization results with fast convergence and reduced reward hacking, as validated on unseen preference metrics.
summary_zh: 扩散模型和流动模型实现了最先进(SOTA)的生成性能，但诸如细粒度的提示忠实度、组合正确性和文本渲染等许多实际重要的行为，却很难通过得分或流动匹配的预训练目标来明确指定。利用外部黑盒奖励进行强化学习(RL)微调是一种自然的补救方法，但扩散RL通常很脆弱。基于轨迹的方法会产生高内存成本和高方差的梯度估计；基于前向过程的方法收敛更快，但会遭受分布漂移，从而导致奖励利用（reward hacking）。在这项工作中，我们提出了\textbf{中心化奖励蒸馏(CRD)}，这是一种基于 KL 正则化奖励最大化构建的扩散 RL 框架，其基于前向过程的微调。关键的见解是，难以处理的归一化常数会在 \emph{提示内中心化} 的条件下抵消，从而产生一个良定的奖励匹配目标。为了实现可靠的文本到图像微调，我们引入了显式控制分布漂移的技术：（\textit{i}）将采样器与移动参考解耦，以防止比率信号崩溃，（\textit{ii}）KL 锚定到 CFG 指导的预训练模型，以控制长期漂移并与预训练模型的推理时语义对齐，以及（\textit{iii}）奖励自适应的 KL 强度，以加速在大型 KL 正则化下的早期学习，同时减少后期对奖励模型漏洞的利用。使用 \texttt{GenEval} 和 \texttt{OCR} 奖励进行的文本到图像后训练实验表明，CRD 实现了具有竞争力的 SOTA 奖励优化结果，具有快速收敛和减少奖励利用，这在未见过的偏好指标上得到了验证。
tldr: The paper introduces Centered Reward Distillation (CRD), a novel diffusion RL framework for fine-tuning text-to-image models by addressing challenges like distribution drift and reward hacking. It demonstrates SOTA reward optimization with faster convergence and reduced reward hacking on text-to-image post-training.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了中心化奖励蒸馏（CRD），一种新型扩散强化学习框架，通过解决分布漂移和奖励利用等挑战来微调文本到图像模型。它在文本到图像后训练中展示了最先进的奖励优化效果，且收敛速度更快，奖励利用率更低。

title: HomeGuard: VLM-based Embodied Safeguard for Identifying Contextual Risk in Household Task
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) empower embodied agents to execute complex instructions, yet they remain vulnerable to contextual safety risks where benign commands become hazardous due to subtle environmental states. Existing safeguards often prove inadequate. Rule-based methods lack scalability in object-dense scenes, whereas model-based approaches relying on prompt engineering suffer from unfocused perception, resulting in missed risks or hallucinations. To address this, we propose an architecture-agnostic safeguard featuring Context-Guided Chain-of-Thought (CG-CoT). This mechanism decomposes risk assessment into active perception that sequentially anchors attention to interaction targets and relevant spatial neighborhoods, followed by semantic judgment based on this visual evidence. We support this approach with a curated grounding dataset and a two-stage training strategy utilizing Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) with process rewards to enforce precise intermediate grounding. Experiments demonstrate that our model HomeGuard significantly enhances safety, improving risk match rates by over 30% compared to base models while reducing oversafety. Beyond hazard detection, the generated visual anchors serve as actionable spatial constraints for downstream planners, facilitating explicit collision avoidance and safety trajectory generation. Code and data are released under https://github.com/AI45Lab/HomeGuard
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）赋予具身智能体执行复杂指令的能力，但它们仍然容易受到情境安全风险的影响，在这种风险中，良性的命令由于微妙的环境状态而变得危险。现有的安全措施通常被证明是不充分的。基于规则的方法在物体密集的场景中缺乏可扩展性，而依赖于提示工程的基于模型的方法则会受到注意力分散的感知的影响，导致风险遗漏或幻觉。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种架构无关的安全措施，其特点是情境引导的思维链（CG-CoT）。这种机制将风险评估分解为主动感知，该过程将注意力按顺序锚定到交互目标和相关的空间邻域，然后基于此视觉证据进行语义判断。我们通过一个精心策划的接地数据集和一个利用过程奖励的强化微调（RFT）的两阶段训练策略来支持这种方法，以加强精确的中间接地。实验表明，我们的模型 HomeGuard 显著提高了安全性，与基础模型相比，风险匹配率提高了 30% 以上，同时降低了过度安全性。除了危险检测之外，生成的视觉锚点还可以作为下游规划器的可操作空间约束，从而促进显式的碰撞避免和安全轨迹生成。代码和数据已在 https://github.com/AI45Lab/HomeGuard 下发布。
tldr: The paper introduces HomeGuard, a VLM-based safeguard system using Context-Guided Chain-of-Thought (CG-CoT) to improve contextual safety risk identification in embodied agents performing household tasks, demonstrating significant improvements in risk detection and collision avoidance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了HomeGuard，一个基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的安全保障系统，它使用上下文引导的思维链（CG-CoT）来提高具身智能体在执行家庭任务时对背景安全风险的识别，并在风险检测和避免碰撞方面表现出显著的改进。

title: UAVBench and UAVIT-1M: Benchmarking and Enhancing MLLMs for Low-Altitude UAV Vision-Language Understanding
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made significant strides in natural images and satellite remote sensing images. However, understanding low-altitude drone scenarios remains a challenge. Existing datasets primarily focus on a few specific low-altitude visual tasks, which cannot fully assess the ability of MLLMs in real-world low-altitude UAV applications. Therefore, we introduce UAVBench, a comprehensive benchmark, and UAVIT-1M, a large-scale instruction tuning dataset, designed to evaluate and improve MLLMs' abilities in low-altitude vision-language tasks. UAVBench comprises 43 test units and 966k high-quality data samples across 10 tasks at the image-level and region-level. UAVIT-1M consists of approximately 1.24 million diverse instructions, covering 789k multi-scene images and about 2,000 types of spatial resolutions with 11 distinct tasks. UAVBench and UAVIT-1M feature pure real-world visual images and rich weather conditions, and involve manual verification to ensure high quality. Our in-depth analysis of 11 state-of-the-art MLLMs using UAVBench reveals that open-source MLLMs cannot generate accurate conversations about low-altitude visual content, lagging behind closed-source MLLMs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that fine-tuning open-source MLLMs on UAVIT-1M significantly addresses this gap. Our contributions pave the way for bridging the gap between current MLLMs and low-altitude UAV real-world application demands. (Project page: https://UAVBench.github.io/)
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM) 在自然图像和卫星遥感图像方面取得了显著进展。然而，理解低空无人机场景仍然是一个挑战。现有的数据集主要关注少数特定的低空视觉任务，无法充分评估 MLLM 在真实低空无人机应用中的能力。因此，我们引入了 UAVBench，一个综合性的基准，以及 UAVIT-1M，一个大规模指令调优数据集，旨在评估和提升 MLLM 在低空视觉-语言任务中的能力。UAVBench 包含 43 个测试单元和 96.6 万个高质量数据样本，涵盖图像级别和区域级别的 10 个任务。UAVIT-1M 由约 124 万条多样化的指令组成，覆盖 78.9 万张多场景图像和约 2000 种空间分辨率，包含 11 个不同的任务。UAVBench 和 UAVIT-1M 的特点是纯粹的真实世界视觉图像和丰富的气象条件，并经过人工验证以确保高质量。我们使用 UAVBench 对 11 个最先进的 MLLM 进行了深入分析，结果表明，开源 MLLM 无法生成关于低空视觉内容的准确对话，落后于闭源 MLLM。大量实验表明，在 UAVIT-1M 上微调开源 MLLM 能够显著弥合这一差距。我们的贡献为弥合当前 MLLM 与低空无人机真实世界应用需求之间的差距铺平了道路。（项目页面：https://UAVBench.github.io/）
tldr: This paper introduces UAVBench, a benchmark, and UAVIT-1M, a large-scale instruction tuning dataset, to evaluate and improve Multimodal Large Language Models' (MLLMs) abilities in understanding low-altitude drone scenarios, revealing a performance gap and demonstrating effective fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了UAVBench基准测试和UAVIT-1M大规模指令微调数据集，旨在评估和提高多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在理解低空无人机场景中的能力，揭示了现有模型的性能差距，并展示了有效微调方法。

title: SK-Adapter: Skeleton-Based Structural Control for Native 3D Generation
summary: Native 3D generative models have achieved remarkable fidelity and speed, yet they suffer from a critical limitation: inability to prescribe precise structural articulations, where precise structural control within the native 3D space remains underexplored. This paper proposes SK-Adapter, a simple and yet highly efficient and effective framework that unlocks precise skeletal manipulation for native 3D generation. Moving beyond text or image prompts, which can be ambiguous for precise structure, we treat the 3D skeleton as a first-class control signal. SK-Adapter is a lightweight structural adapter network that encodes joint coordinates and topology into learnable tokens, which are injected into the frozen 3D generation backbone via cross-attention. This smart design allows the model to not only effectively "attend" to specific 3D structural constraints but also preserve its original generative priors. To bridge the data gap, we contribute Objaverse-TMS dataset, a large-scale dataset of 24k text-mesh-skeleton pairs. Extensive experiments confirm that our method achieves robust structural control while preserving the geometry and texture quality of the foundation model, significantly outperforming existing baselines. Furthermore, we extend this capability to local 3D editing, enabling the region specific editing of existing assets with skeletal guidance, which is unattainable by previous methods. Project Page: https://sk-adapter.github.io/
summary_zh: 原生3D生成模型已经实现了显著的保真度和速度，但它们存在一个关键限制：无法指定精确的结构关节，在原生3D空间内对精确结构控制的探索仍然不足。本文提出SK-Adapter，一个简单但高效且有效的框架，解锁了原生3D生成的精确骨骼操纵能力。我们超越了对精确结构可能存在歧义的文本或图像提示，将3D骨骼视为首要的控制信号。SK-Adapter是一个轻量级的结构适配器网络，它将关节坐标和拓扑编码成可学习的token，并通过交叉注意力将这些token注入到冻结的3D生成主干网络中。这种巧妙的设计使模型不仅能够有效地“关注”特定的3D结构约束，还能保留其原始的生成先验。为了弥合数据差距，我们贡献了Objaverse-TMS数据集，一个包含2.4万个文本-网格-骨骼对的大规模数据集。大量实验证实，我们的方法在保持基础模型的几何和纹理质量的同时，实现了稳健的结构控制，显著优于现有的基线方法。此外，我们将此能力扩展到局部3D编辑，通过骨骼引导实现对现有资产的区域特定编辑，这对于先前的方法是无法实现的。项目主页：https://sk-adapter.github.io/
tldr: SK-Adapter introduces a skeleton-based structural control method for native 3D generation, enabling precise articulation manipulation and localized editing, and a new dataset (Objaverse-TMS) addresses the data gap for this method.
tldr_zh: SK-Adapter提出了一种基于骨骼的结构控制方法，用于原生3D生成，能够实现精确的关节操作和局部编辑。此外，本文还提出了一个新的数据集(Objaverse-TMS)，以解决该方法的数据不足问题。

title: MMOU: A Massive Multi-Task Omni Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Long and Complex Real-World Videos
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong performance in visual and audio understanding when evaluated in isolation. However, their ability to jointly reason over omni-modal (visual, audio, and textual) signals in long and complex videos remains largely unexplored. We introduce MMOU, a new benchmark designed to systematically evaluate multimodal understanding and reasoning under these challenging, real-world conditions. MMOU consists of 15,000 carefully curated questions paired with 9038 web-collected videos of varying length, spanning diverse domains and exhibiting rich, tightly coupled audio-visual content. The benchmark covers 13 fundamental skill categories, all of which require integrating evidence across modalities and time. All questions are manually annotated across multiple turns by professional annotators, ensuring high quality and reasoning fidelity. We evaluate 20+ state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary multimodal models on MMOU. The results expose substantial performance gaps: the best closed-source model achieves only 64.2% accuracy, while the strongest open-source model reaches just 46.8%. Our results highlight the challenges of long-form omni-modal understanding, revealing that current models frequently fail to apply even fundamental skills in long videos. Through detailed analysis, we further identify systematic failure modes and provide insights into where and why current models break.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型(MLLMs)在孤立评估视觉和音频理解时表现出强大的性能。然而，它们在长且复杂的视频中联合推理全模态（视觉、音频和文本）信号的能力很大程度上仍未被探索。我们引入了MMOU，这是一个新的基准，旨在系统地评估这些具有挑战性的真实世界条件下的多模态理解和推理能力。MMOU包含15000个精心策划的问题，与从网络收集的9038个不同长度的视频配对，涵盖了不同的领域，并展示了丰富且紧密耦合的视听内容。该基准涵盖13个基本技能类别，所有这些类别都需要整合跨模态和时间的证据。所有问题都由专业标注员经过多轮手动标注，确保高质量和推理忠实度。我们在MMOU上评估了20多个最先进的开源和专有多模态模型。结果揭示了显著的性能差距：最好的闭源模型仅达到64.2%的准确率，而最强的开源模型仅达到46.8%。我们的结果突显了长篇全模态理解的挑战，表明当前的模型经常无法在长视频中应用即使是基本技能。通过详细的分析，我们进一步识别出系统性的失效模式，并深入了解当前模型在何处以及为何失效。
tldr: The paper introduces MMOU, a new benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models on their ability to understand and reason over long and complex real-world videos with visual, audio, and textual signals. It reveals a performance gap between current models on this task.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个新的基准测试MMOU，用于评估多模态大型语言模型在理解和推理具有视觉、音频和文本信号的较长和复杂的真实世界视频方面的能力。结果表明当前模型在此任务上存在性能差距。

title: Improving Visual Reasoning with Iterative Evidence Refinement
summary: Vision language models (VLMs) are increasingly capable of reasoning over images, but robust visual reasoning often requires re-grounding intermediate steps in the underlying visual evidence. Recent approaches typically rely on external image operations such as zooming or cropping to re-access fine-grained details during inference, which requires additional image re-encoding and can disrupt the reasoning trajectory. We argue that VLMs already provide strong internal signals for identifying and reusing visual evidence, and that these signals can be directly leveraged to support image-grounded reasoning. Motivated by this insight, we propose an end-to-end self-revisit framework, SIEVE, that trains models to re-engage image evidence through internal representations. SIEVE automatically extracts embeddings of salient image regions and injects them into the reasoning chain when additional grounding is needed, enabling later steps to condition on relevant visual cues without external tool calls or re-encoding. We use reinforcement learning to teach the model when to trigger visual revisiting and which region embeddings to retrieve and insert during the reasoning process. Experiments on multiple visual reasoning benchmarks, together with perception, reasoning, and hallucination evaluations, show that SIEVE yields consistent gains, improving performance by 8 percent on average across several benchmarks.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在图像推理方面的能力日益增强，但稳健的视觉推理通常需要在底层视觉证据中重新锚定中间步骤。 近期的方法通常依赖于外部图像操作，例如缩放或裁剪，以便在推理过程中重新访问细粒度细节，这需要额外的图像重新编码，并可能中断推理轨迹。我们认为，VLMs 已经提供了强大的内部信号来识别和重用视觉证据，并且这些信号可以直接被利用来支持基于图像的推理。受此启发，我们提出了一种端到端的自重访框架 SIEVE，该框架训练模型通过内部表示重新利用图像证据。当需要额外的锚定时，SIEVE 自动提取显著图像区域的嵌入，并将它们注入到推理链中，使得后续步骤能够在不依赖外部工具调用或重新编码的情况下，以相关的视觉线索为条件。我们使用强化学习来教导模型何时触发视觉重访，以及在推理过程中检索和插入哪些区域嵌入。在多个视觉推理基准上的实验，以及感知、推理和幻觉评估表明，SIEVE 取得了持续的收益，在多个基准上平均提高了 8% 的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces SIEVE, a reinforcement learning-trained framework that enhances visual reasoning in VLMs by iteratively refining visual evidence through internal representation revisiting, avoiding external image operations and improving performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SIEVE，一个通过强化学习训练的框架，它通过迭代地重新访问内部表示来增强VLMs中的视觉推理能力，避免了外部图像操作并提高了性能。

title: Zoom to Essence: Trainless GUI Grounding by Inferring upon Interface Elements
summary: Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents develop rapidly, with visual grounding that maps natural language instructions to target UI elements serving as the core capability. Existing GUI agents typically fine-tune MLLM on massive datasets to handle challenges in understanding instructions and UI interfaces, which not only incurs high data annotation costs but also makes performance dependent on data quality and distribution. To avoid such cumbersome yet ineffective training, we notice that complex UI interfaces can be decomposed into basic visual elements directly understandable by common MLLMs. Consequently, we propose ZoomUI that leverages inference scaling to guide common MLLMs in progressively anchor instruction elements to increasingly detailed interface elements. Specifically, ZoomUI first optimizes the latent thinking to transform original instruction into element visual features description, and subsequently leverages internal attention to iteratively zoom in target element interface region. Evaluations on extensive benchmarks demonstrate that ZoomUI reaches or even surpasses SOTA baselines.
summary_zh: 基于多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）的图形用户界面（GUI）代理发展迅速，其中将自然语言指令映射到目标UI元素的可视化定位是其核心能力。现有的GUI代理通常在大规模数据集上微调MLLM，以应对理解指令和UI界面的挑战，这不仅导致高昂的数据标注成本，而且使性能依赖于数据质量和分布。为了避免这种繁琐而低效的训练，我们注意到复杂的UI界面可以分解为普通MLLM可以直接理解的基本视觉元素。因此，我们提出了 ZoomUI，它利用推理缩放来引导普通MLLM逐步将指令元素锚定到越来越详细的界面元素。具体来说，ZoomUI 首先优化潜在思维，将原始指令转化为元素视觉特征描述，然后利用内部注意力迭代地放大目标元素的界面区域。在广泛基准测试上的评估表明，ZoomUI 达到甚至超过了当前最优（SOTA）基线。
tldr: The paper introduces ZoomUI, a training-free method for visual grounding in GUI agents that leverages inference scaling with common MLLMs to map natural language instructions to UI elements by progressively zooming into detailed interface elements.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ZoomUI，一种无需训练的GUI代理视觉定位方法，它利用通用MLLM的推理扩展，通过逐步放大到详细的界面元素，将自然语言指令映射到UI元素。

title: Deconfounded Lifelong Learning for Autonomous Driving via Dynamic Knowledge Spaces
summary: End-to-End autonomous driving (E2E-AD) systems face challenges in lifelong learning, including catastrophic forgetting, difficulty in knowledge transfer across diverse scenarios, and spurious correlations between unobservable confounders and true driving intents. To address these issues, we propose DeLL, a Deconfounded Lifelong Learning framework that integrates a Dirichlet process mixture model (DPMM) with the front-door adjustment mechanism from causal inference. The DPMM is employed to construct two dynamic knowledge spaces: a trajectory knowledge space for clustering explicit driving behaviors and an implicit feature knowledge space for discovering latent driving abilities. Leveraging the non-parametric Bayesian nature of DPMM, our framework enables adaptive expansion and incremental updating of knowledge without predefining the number of clusters, thereby mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Meanwhile, the front-door adjustment mechanism utilizes the DPMM-derived knowledge as valid mediators to deconfound spurious correlations, such as those induced by sensor noise or environmental changes, and enhances the causal expressiveness of the learned representations. Additionally, we introduce an evolutionary trajectory decoder that enables non-autoregressive planning. To evaluate the lifelong learning performance of E2E-AD, we propose new evaluation protocols and metrics based on Bench2Drive. Extensive evaluations in the closed-loop CARLA simulator demonstrate that our framework significantly improves adaptability to new driving scenarios and overall driving performance, while effectively retaining previous acquired knowledge.
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶(E2E-AD)系统在终身学习中面临挑战，包括灾难性遗忘、跨越不同场景的知识迁移困难，以及未观察到的混淆因素与真实驾驶意图之间的虚假相关性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出DeLL，一个解混淆(Deconfounded)的终身学习框架，它将Dirichlet过程混合模型(DPMM)与因果推断中的前门调整机制相结合。DPMM被用于构建两个动态知识空间：一个用于聚类显式驾驶行为的轨迹知识空间，以及一个用于发现潜在驾驶能力的隐式特征知识空间。凭借DPMM的非参数贝叶斯特性，我们的框架能够自适应扩展和增量更新知识，而无需预定义簇的数量，从而减轻灾难性遗忘。同时，前门调整机制利用DPMM衍生的知识作为有效的中间变量来消除虚假相关性，例如由传感器噪声或环境变化引起的相关性，并增强已学习表征的因果表达能力。此外，我们引入了一种进化轨迹解码器，该解码器支持非自回归规划。为了评估E2E-AD的终身学习性能，我们提出了基于Bench2Drive的新的评估协议和指标。在闭环CARLA模拟器中的大量评估表明，我们的框架显著提高了对新驾驶场景的适应性和整体驾驶性能，同时有效地保留了先前获得的知识。
tldr: The paper introduces DeLL, a deconfounded lifelong learning framework for autonomous driving using a Dirichlet process mixture model to construct dynamic knowledge spaces and a front-door adjustment mechanism for causal inference, achieving better adaptation and performance in the CARLA simulator.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了DeLL，一个用于自动驾驶的去混淆终身学习框架，它使用Dirichlet过程混合模型构建动态知识空间，并采用前门调整机制进行因果推理，从而在CARLA模拟器中实现了更好的适应性和性能。

title: Load-Aware Locomotion Control for Humanoid Robots in Industrial Transportation Tasks
summary: Humanoid robots deployed in industrial environments are required to perform load-carrying transportation tasks that tightly couple locomotion and manipulation. However, achieving stable and robust locomotion under varying payloads and upper-body motions is challenging due to dynamic coupling and partial observability. This paper presents a load-aware locomotion framework for industrial humanoids based on a decoupled yet coordinated loco-manipulation architecture. Lower-body locomotion is controlled via a reinforcement learning policy producing residual joint actions on kinematically derived nominal configurations. A kinematics-based locomotion reference with a height-conditioned joint-space offset guides learning, while a history-based state estimator infers base linear velocity and height and encodes residual load- and manipulation-induced disturbances in a compact latent representation. The framework is trained entirely in simulation and deployed on a full-size humanoid robot without fine-tuning. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate faster training, accurate height tracking, and stable loco-manipulation. Project page: https://lequn-f.github.io/LALO/
summary_zh: 部署在工业环境中的人形机器人需要执行负载搬运任务，这紧密耦合了运动与操作。然而，由于动态耦合和部分可观测性，在变化的负载和上身运动下实现稳定而鲁棒的运动是具有挑战性的。本文提出了一种基于解耦但协同的运动-操作架构的、面向负载感知的工业人形机器人运动框架。下半身运动通过强化学习策略控制，该策略在运动学导出的标称构型上产生残余关节动作。一种高度条件化的关节空间偏移的基于运动学的运动参考引导学习，而基于历史的状态估计器推断底座线速度和高度，并在一个紧凑的潜在表示中编码残余的负载和操作引起的扰动。该框架完全在仿真环境中训练，无需微调即可部署在全尺寸人形机器人上。仿真和真实世界实验表明，该框架具有更快的训练速度、精确的高度跟踪和稳定的运动-操作性能。项目页面：https://lequn-f.github.io/LALO/
tldr: The paper presents a load-aware reinforcement learning based locomotion framework for humanoid robots in industrial settings, enabling robust loco-manipulation without real-world fine-tuning. The approach uses a height-conditioned kinematic reference to guide learning and a state estimator to infer base linear velocity and height.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于负载感知的强化学习的类人机器人在工业环境中的运动框架，实现了鲁棒的运动操作，无需在真实世界中进行微调。该方法使用高度条件化的运动学参考来指导学习，并使用状态估计器来推断基础线速度和高度。

title: AeroGen: Agentic Drone Autonomy through Single-Shot Structured Prompting & Drone SDK
summary: Designing correct UAV autonomy programs is challenging due to joint navigation, sensing and analytics requirements. While LLMs can generate code, their reliability for safety-critical UAVs remains uncertain. This paper presents AeroGen, an open-loop framework that enables consistently correct single-shot AI-generated drone control programs through structured guardrail prompting and integration with the AeroDaaS drone SDK. AeroGen encodes API descriptions, flight constraints and operational world rules directly into the system context prompt, enabling generic LLMs to produce constraint-aware code from user prompts, with minimal example code. We evaluate AeroGen across a diverse benchmark of 20 navigation tasks and 5 drone missions on urban, farm and inspection environments, using both imperative and declarative user prompts. AeroGen generates about 40 lines of AeroDaaS Python code in about 20s per mission, in both real-world and simulations, showing that structured prompting with a well-defined SDK improves robustness, correctness and deployability of LLM-generated drone autonomy programs.
summary_zh: 设计正确的无人机自主程序极具挑战性，原因在于导航、传感和分析的联合需求。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）能够生成代码，但其对安全攸关的无人机的可靠性仍然不确定。本文提出AeroGen，一个开环框架，通过结构化的安全护栏提示和与AeroDaaS无人机SDK的集成，能够持续生成正确的单次AI生成无人机控制程序。AeroGen将API描述、飞行约束和操作世界规则直接编码到系统上下文提示中，使得通用LLMs能够从用户提示中生成具有约束意识的代码，且所需示例代码最少。我们通过一个包含20个导航任务和5个无人机任务的多样化基准，在城市、农场和巡检环境中评估AeroGen，使用命令式和声明式用户提示。AeroGen在真实世界和模拟中，每个任务大约在20秒内生成约40行AeroDaaS Python代码，表明使用定义良好的SDK进行结构化提示，能够提升LLM生成的无人机自主程序的鲁棒性、正确性和可部署性。
tldr: AeroGen is an open-loop framework that uses structured prompting with a drone SDK to enable LLMs to generate correct, constraint-aware drone control programs from user prompts. It demonstrates improved robustness and deployability in real-world and simulated environments.
tldr_zh: AeroGen是一个开环框架，它利用结构化提示与无人机SDK，使LLM能够从用户提示中生成正确的、具有约束意识的无人机控制程序。它在真实和模拟环境中展示了改进的鲁棒性和可部署性。

title: Towards Equitable Robotic Furnishing Agents for Aging-in-Place: ADL-Grounded Design Exploration
summary: In aging-in-place contexts, small difficulties in Activities of Daily Living (ADL) can accumulate, affecting well-being through fatigue, anxiety, reduced autonomy, and safety risks. This position paper argues that robotics for older adult wellbeing must move beyond "convenience features" and centre equity, justice, and responsibility. We conducted ADL-grounded semi-structured interviews with four adults in their 70s-80s, identifying recurrent challenges (finding/ organising items, taking medication, and transporting objects) and deriving requirements to reduce compounded cognitive-physical burden. Based on these insights, we propose an in-home robotic furnishing-agent concept leveraging computer vision and generative AI and LLMs for natural-language interaction, context-aware reminders, safe actuation, and user-centred transparency. We then report video-stimulated follow-up interviews with the same participants, highlighting preferences for confirmation before actuation, predictability, adjustable speed/autonomy, and multimodal feedback, as well as equity-related concerns. We conclude with open questions on evaluating and deploying equitable robotic wellbeing systems in real homes.
summary_zh: 在居家养老的背景下，日常生活活动 (ADL) 中的微小困难会累积，并通过疲劳、焦虑、自主性降低和安全风险影响福祉。 本立场文件论证，面向老年人福祉的机器人技术必须超越“便利功能”，并以公平、公正和责任为中心。 我们对四位70-80岁的老年人进行了基于日常生活活动的半结构化访谈，识别出反复出现的挑战（寻找/整理物品、服药和搬运物体），并推导出降低复合认知-身体负担的需求。 基于这些见解，我们提出了一种居家机器人家具代理概念，利用计算机视觉和生成式人工智能及大型语言模型实现自然语言交互、情境感知提醒、安全执行和以用户为中心的透明度。 然后，我们报告了对相同参与者进行的视频刺激式后续访谈，强调了执行前确认、可预测性、可调节的速度/自主性以及多模态反馈的偏好，以及与公平相关的担忧。 最后，我们提出了关于在真实家庭中评估和部署公平的机器人福祉系统的未决问题。
tldr: This position paper explores the design of robotic furnishing agents for aging-in-place, focusing on equitable solutions for Activities of Daily Living (ADL) challenges through user-centered design, computer vision, generative AI, and LLMs.
tldr_zh: 该立场论文探讨了居家养老的机器人家具代理的设计，重点关注通过以用户为中心的设计、计算机视觉、生成式人工智能和大型语言模型来解决日常生活活动（ADL）挑战的公平解决方案。

title: GelSphere: An Omnidirectional Rolling Vision-Based Tactile Sensor for Online 3D Reconstruction and Normal Force Estimation
summary: We present GelSphere, a spherical vision-based tactile sensor designed for real-time continuous surface scanning. Unlike traditional vision-based tactile sensors that can only sense locally and are damaged when slid across surfaces, and cylindrical tactile sensors that can only roll along a fixed direction, our design enables omnidirectional rolling on surfaces. We accomplish this through our novel sensing system design, which has steel balls inside the sensor, forming a bearing layer between the gel and the rigid housing that allows rolling motion in all axes. The sensor streams tactile images through Wi-Fi, with online large-surface reconstruction capabilities. We present quantitative results for both reconstruction accuracy and image fusion performance. The results show that our sensor maintains geometric fidelity and high reconstruction accuracy even under multi-directional rolling, enabling uninterrupted surface scanning.
summary_zh: 我们提出GelSphere，一种基于视觉的球形触觉传感器，专为实时连续表面扫描而设计。与只能局部感知且在表面滑动时易损坏的传统基于视觉的触觉传感器，以及只能沿固定方向滚动的圆柱形触觉传感器不同，我们的设计实现了在表面上的全向滚动。我们通过新颖的传感系统设计实现了这一点，该设计在传感器内部包含钢球，形成凝胶和刚性外壳之间的轴承层，从而允许沿所有轴的滚动运动。该传感器通过Wi-Fi传输触觉图像，具有在线大表面重建能力。我们展示了重建精度和图像融合性能的定量结果。结果表明，我们的传感器即使在多向滚动下也能保持几何保真度和高重建精度，从而实现不间断的表面扫描。
tldr: The paper introduces a spherical, vision-based tactile sensor called GelSphere that can roll omnidirectionally to enable real-time, continuous surface scanning and 3D reconstruction. It offers improvements over existing tactile sensors by allowing multi-directional movement and online reconstruction capabilities.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为GelSphere的球形视觉触觉传感器，它可以全方位滚动，从而实现实时、连续的表面扫描和3D重建。相比现有的触觉传感器，它允许多方向运动和在线重建能力，因此有所提升。

title: Stiffness Copilot: An Impedance Policy for Contact-Rich Teleoperation
summary: In teleoperation of contact-rich manipulation tasks, selecting robot impedance is critical but difficult. The robot must be compliant to avoid damaging the environment, but stiff to remain responsive and to apply force when needed. In this paper, we present Stiffness Copilot, a vision-based policy for shared-control teleoperation in which the operator commands robot pose and the policy adjusts robot impedance online. To train Stiffness Copilot, we first infer direction-dependent stiffness matrices in simulation using privileged contact information. We then use these matrices to supervise a lightweight vision policy that predicts robot stiffness from wrist-camera images and transfers zero-shot to real images at runtime. In a human-subject study, Stiffness Copilot achieved safety comparable to using a constant low stiffness while matching the efficiency of using a constant high stiffness.
summary_zh: 在富接触操作任务的遥操作中，选择机器人阻抗至关重要但具有挑战性。机器人必须具有顺从性，以避免损坏环境，但又必须足够刚硬，以保持响应性并在需要时施加力。本文提出了一种基于视觉的共驾遥操作策略——刚度副驾驶 (Stiffness Copilot)，操作员指挥机器人姿态，策略在线调整机器人阻抗。为了训练刚度副驾驶，我们首先在仿真中使用特权接触信息推断出方向相关的刚度矩阵。然后，我们使用这些矩阵来监督一个轻量级的视觉策略，该策略从腕部相机图像预测机器人刚度，并在运行时零样本迁移到真实图像。在一项人体受试者研究中，刚度副驾驶实现了与使用恒定低刚度相当的安全性，同时达到了使用恒定高刚度的效率。
tldr: The paper introduces Stiffness Copilot, a vision-based policy for adjusting robot impedance during contact-rich teleoperation tasks, achieving safety comparable to low stiffness and efficiency comparable to high stiffness in human-subject studies.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Stiffness Copilot，一种基于视觉的策略，用于在接触丰富的遥操作任务中调整机器人阻抗。在人体实验中，该策略实现了与低刚度相当的安全性，同时拥有与高刚度相当的效率。

title: Walking Further: Semantic-aware Multimodal Gait Recognition Under Long-Range Conditions
summary: Gait recognition is an emerging biometric technology that enables non-intrusive and hard-to-spoof human identification. However, most existing methods are confined to short-range, unimodal settings and fail to generalize to long-range and cross-distance scenarios under real-world conditions. To address this gap, we present \textbf{LRGait}, the first LiDAR-Camera multimodal benchmark designed for robust long-range gait recognition across diverse outdoor distances and environments. We further propose \textbf{EMGaitNet}, an end-to-end framework tailored for long-range multimodal gait recognition. To bridge the modality gap between RGB images and point clouds, we introduce a semantic-guided fusion pipeline. A CLIP-based Semantic Mining (SeMi) module first extracts human body-part-aware semantic cues, which are then employed to align 2D and 3D features via a Semantic-Guided Alignment (SGA) module within a unified embedding space. A Symmetric Cross-Attention Fusion (SCAF) module hierarchically integrates visual contours and 3D geometric features, and a Spatio-Temporal (ST) module captures global gait dynamics. Extensive experiments on various gait datasets validate the effectiveness of our method.
summary_zh: 步态识别是一种新兴的生物识别技术，能够实现非侵入式且难以欺骗的人体身份识别。然而，目前大多数方法局限于短距离、单模态场景，并且无法推广到真实世界条件下长距离和跨距离场景。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了 \textbf{LRGait}，这是首个专为稳健的长距离步态识别而设计的 LiDAR-相机多模态基准数据集，涵盖了多样化的户外距离和环境。我们进一步提出了 \textbf{EMGaitNet}，一个为长距离多模态步态识别量身定制的端到端框架。为了弥合 RGB 图像和点云之间的模态差距，我们引入了一种语义引导的融合流程。基于 CLIP 的语义挖掘 (SeMi) 模块首先提取人体部位感知的语义线索，然后通过统一嵌入空间内的语义引导对齐 (SGA) 模块，将这些线索用于对齐 2D 和 3D 特征。对称交叉注意力融合 (SCAF) 模块分层地整合视觉轮廓和 3D 几何特征，而时空 (ST) 模块则捕捉全局步态动态。在各种步态数据集上进行的大量实验验证了我们方法的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces LRGait, a new LiDAR-Camera multimodal benchmark and EMGaitNet, an end-to-end framework with semantic-guided fusion for long-range gait recognition, addressing limitations in existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 LRGait，一种新的 LiDAR-Camera 多模态基准，以及 EMGaitNet，一个具有语义引导融合的端到端框架，用于远距离步态识别，解决了现有方法的局限性。

title: LongVidSearch: An Agentic Benchmark for Multi-hop Evidence Retrieval Planning in Long Videos
summary: Long video question answering (Long-Video QA) increasingly relies on agentic tool use to retrieve evidence from long videos. In realistic settings, this process often requires multi-hop retrieval, where agents must iteratively gather multiple discontinuous evidence clips. However, existing long-video benchmarks are largely static: they rarely enforce strict multi-hop retrieval and typically lack a standardized evidence-access interface, making it difficult to separate failures in retrieval planning from those in answer generation. To address this gap, we introduce LongVidSearch, a benchmark for evaluating agentic multi-hop evidence retrieval planning in long videos under standardized access constraints. LongVidSearch enforces retrieval necessity: a Hop-k question requires exactly k necessary evidence clips, and removing any single clip renders the question unsolvable. The benchmark contains 3,000 questions over 447 long videos (average length 26 minutes), covering four reasoning categories: State Mutation, Causal Inference, Global Summary, and Visual Tracking, with 2-hop, 3-hop, and 4-hop evidence requirements. To ensure fair and controlled evaluation, all agents interact with LongVidSearch through a unified tool interface, which fixes the retrieval backend and isolates the agent's ability to formulate queries and plan iterative retrieval. In addition to answer accuracy, we measure tool-call cost to analyze the accuracy-efficiency trade-off under identical access conditions. We evaluate VideoAgent-style QA agents with multiple backbone LLMs using three-judge majority voting. GPT-5 achieves the highest accuracy (42.43), outperforming Gemini 3 Pro (30.97) and GPT-4o (19.20), yet remaining below 50 %, highlighting the difficulty of multi-hop retrieval planning. With gold evidence clips, performance becomes near-perfect, confirming retrieval planning as the primary bottleneck.
summary_zh: 长视频问答（长视频QA）越来越依赖于基于智能体的工具使用，以便从长视频中检索证据。在实际场景中，这个过程通常需要多跳检索，其中智能体必须迭代地收集多个不连续的证据片段。然而，现有的长视频基准测试大多是静态的：它们很少强制执行严格的多跳检索，并且通常缺乏标准化的证据访问接口，这使得区分检索规划中的失败和答案生成中的失败变得困难。为了弥补这一差距，我们推出了 LongVidSearch，这是一个评估在标准化访问约束下，智能体在长视频中进行多跳证据检索规划的基准测试。LongVidSearch 强制执行检索必要性：一个 Hop-k 问题需要恰好 k 个必要的证据片段，并且移除任何单个片段都会使问题变得无法解决。该基准测试包含 447 个长视频（平均时长 26 分钟）上的 3,000 个问题，涵盖四个推理类别：状态突变、因果推理、全局摘要和视觉追踪，并具有 2 跳、3 跳和 4 跳的证据要求。为了确保公平和受控的评估，所有智能体都通过统一的工具界面与 LongVidSearch 进行交互，该界面固定了检索后端并隔离了智能体形成查询和规划迭代检索的能力。除了答案准确率之外，我们还测量工具调用成本，以分析在相同访问条件下，准确率与效率之间的权衡。我们使用三位评审员多数投票的方法，评估了基于 VideoAgent 风格的 QA 智能体，并使用了多个骨干 LLM。GPT-5 实现了最高的准确率 (42.43)，优于 Gemini 3 Pro (30.97) 和 GPT-4o (19.20)，但仍低于 50%，突显了多跳检索规划的难度。如果使用黄金证据片段，性能将接近完美，证实检索规划是主要的瓶颈。
tldr: The paper introduces LongVidSearch, a benchmark for evaluating agentic multi-hop evidence retrieval in long videos, highlighting the difficulty of retrieval planning for existing LLMs in answering complex questions.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了LongVidSearch，一个用于评估长视频中基于代理的多跳证据检索的基准，强调了现有大型语言模型在回答复杂问题时检索规划的难度。

title: Uni-MDTrack: Learning Decoupled Memory and Dynamic States for Parameter-Efficient Visual Tracking in All Modality
summary: With the advent of Transformer-based one-stream trackers that possess strong capability in inter-frame relation modeling, recent research has increasingly focused on how to introduce spatio-temporal context. However, most existing methods rely on a limited number of historical frames, which not only leads to insufficient utilization of the context, but also inevitably increases the length of input and incurs prohibitive computational overhead. Methods that query an external memory bank, on the other hand, suffer from inadequate fusion between the retrieved spatio-temporal features and the backbone. Moreover, using discrete historical frames as context overlooks the rich dynamics of the target. To address the issues, we propose Uni-MDTrack, which consists of two core components: Memory-Aware Compression Prompt (MCP) module and Dynamic State Fusion (DSF) module. MCP effectively compresses rich memory features into memory-aware prompt tokens, which deeply interact with the input throughout the entire backbone, significantly enhancing the performance while maintaining a stable computational load. DSF complements the discrete memory by capturing the continuous dynamic, progressively introducing the updated dynamic state features from shallow to deep layers, while also preserving high efficiency. Uni-MDTrack also supports unified tracking across RGB, RGB-D/T/E, and RGB-Language modalities. Experiments show that in Uni-MDTrack, training only the MCP, DSF, and prediction head, keeping the proportion of trainable parameters around 30%, yields substantial performance gains, achieves state-of-the-art results on 10 datasets spanning five modalities. Furthermore, both MCP and DSF exhibit excellent generality, functioning as plug-and-play components that can boost the performance of various baseline trackers, while significantly outperforming existing parameter-efficient training approaches.
summary_zh: 随着基于Transformer的单流跟踪器在帧间关系建模方面表现出强大能力，近期的研究越来越多地关注如何引入时空上下文信息。然而，大多数现有方法依赖于有限数量的历史帧，这不仅导致上下文利用不足，还会不可避免地增加输入长度并产生过高的计算开销。另一方面，查询外部记忆库的方法，存在检索到的时空特征与骨干网络融合不足的问题。此外，使用离散的历史帧作为上下文忽略了目标丰富的动态变化。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了Uni-MDTrack，它由两个核心组件组成：记忆感知压缩提示(MCP)模块和动态状态融合(DSF)模块。MCP有效地将丰富的记忆特征压缩成记忆感知的提示令牌，这些令牌在整个骨干网络中与输入进行深度交互，显著提升性能的同时保持稳定的计算负载。DSF通过捕获连续的动态变化来补充离散的记忆，逐步将更新的动态状态特征从浅层引入到深层，同时也保持了高效率。Uni-MDTrack还支持跨RGB、RGB-D/T/E和RGB-Language模态的统一跟踪。实验表明，在Uni-MDTrack中，仅训练MCP、DSF和预测头，将可训练参数的比例保持在30%左右，就能获得显著的性能提升，在横跨五种模态的10个数据集上实现了最先进的结果。此外，MCP和DSF都表现出卓越的通用性，可以作为即插即用的组件来提升各种基线跟踪器的性能，同时显著优于现有的参数高效训练方法。
tldr: Uni-MDTrack introduces Memory-Aware Compression Prompt (MCP) and Dynamic State Fusion (DSF) modules for parameter-efficient visual tracking across multiple modalities, achieving state-of-the-art results on various datasets by effectively utilizing spatio-temporal context and target dynamics.
tldr_zh: Uni-MDTrack 提出了 Memory-Aware Compression Prompt (MCP) 和 Dynamic State Fusion (DSF) 模块，用于跨多种模态的参数高效视觉跟踪。通过有效地利用时空上下文和目标动态，在多个数据集上实现了最先进的结果。

title: End-to-End Spatial-Temporal Transformer for Real-time 4D HOI Reconstruction
summary: Monocular 4D human-object interaction (HOI) reconstruction - recovering a moving human and a manipulated object from a single RGB video - remains challenging due to depth ambiguity and frequent occlusions. Existing methods often rely on multi-stage pipelines or iterative optimization, leading to high inference latency, failing to meet real-time requirements, and susceptibility to error accumulation. To address these limitations, we propose THO, an end-to-end Spatial-Temporal Transformer that predicts human motion and coordinated object motion in a forward fashion from the given video and 3D template. THO achieves this by leveraging spatial-temporal HOI tuple priors. Spatial priors exploit contact-region proximity to infer occluded object features from human cues, while temporal priors capture cross-frame kinematic correlations to refine object representations and enforce physical coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that THO operates at an inference speed of 31.5 FPS on a single RTX 4090 GPU, achieving a >600x speedup over prior optimization-based methods while simultaneously improving reconstruction accuracy and temporal consistency. The project page is available at: https://nianheng.github.io/THO-project/
summary_zh:
摘要：
单目4D人-物交互(HOI)重建——即从单张RGB视频中恢复运动的人体和被操纵的物体——仍然面临挑战，原因在于深度模糊和频繁遮挡。现有方法通常依赖于多阶段流水线或迭代优化，导致推理延迟高，无法满足实时性要求，且易受误差累积的影响。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了THO，一个端到端的时空Transformer，它以正向的方式，从给定的视频和3D模板中预测人体运动和协同的物体运动。THO通过利用时空HOI元组先验来实现这一点。空间先验利用接触区域的邻近性，从人体线索推断被遮挡的物体特征，而时间先验则捕获跨帧的运动学相关性，以细化物体表示并增强物理一致性。大量实验表明，THO在单张RTX 4090 GPU上以31.5 FPS的推理速度运行，相比于之前的基于优化的方法实现了超过600倍的加速，同时提高了重建精度和时间一致性。项目主页：https://nianheng.github.io/THO-project/
tldr: The paper introduces THO, an end-to-end Spatial-Temporal Transformer for real-time 4D human-object interaction reconstruction from monocular RGB videos, achieving significant speedup and improved accuracy compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了THO，一个端到端的时空Transformer，用于从单目RGB视频中进行实时4D人-物交互重建，与现有方法相比，实现了显著的加速和更高的准确性。

title: RL-ScanIQA: Reinforcement-Learned Scanpaths for Blind 360°Image Quality Assessment
summary: Blind 360°image quality assessment (IQA) aims to predict perceptual quality for panoramic images without a pristine reference. Unlike conventional planar images, 360°content in immersive environments restricts viewers to a limited viewport at any moment, making viewing behaviors critical to quality perception. Although existing scanpath-based approaches have attempted to model viewing behaviors by approximating the human view-then-rate paradigm, they treat scanpath generation and quality assessment as separate steps, preventing end-to-end optimization and task-aligned exploration. To address this limitation, we propose RL-ScanIQA, a reinforcement-learned framework for blind 360°IQA. RL-ScanIQA optimize a PPO-trained scanpath policy and a quality assessor, where the policy receives quality-driven feedback to learn task-relevant viewing strategies. To improve training stability and prevent mode collapse, we design multi-level rewards, including scanpath diversity and equator-biased priors. We further boost cross-dataset robustness using distortion-space augmentation together with rank-consistent losses that preserve intra-image and inter-image quality orderings. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks show that RL-ScanIQA achieves superior in-dataset performance and cross-dataset generalization. Codes are available at https://github.com/wangyuji1/RLScanIQA.git.
summary_zh: 盲参考360°图像质量评估（IQA）旨在预测全景图像的感知质量，而无需原始参考图像。与传统的平面图像不同，沉浸式环境中的360°内容在任何时刻都将观察者限制在一个有限的视口内，使得观看行为对质量感知至关重要。尽管现有的基于扫描路径的方法已经尝试通过近似人类“先观看后评价”的范式来建模观看行为，但它们将扫描路径生成和质量评估视为独立的步骤，从而阻止了端到端优化和任务对齐的探索。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了RL-ScanIQA，一个用于盲参考360°IQA的强化学习框架。 RL-ScanIQA优化一个PPO训练的扫描路径策略和一个质量评估器，其中该策略接收质量驱动的反馈，以学习与任务相关的观看策略。为了提高训练稳定性并防止模式崩塌，我们设计了多级奖励，包括扫描路径多样性和赤道偏置先验。我们进一步使用失真空间增强以及保持图像内和图像间质量排序的秩一致性损失来提高跨数据集的鲁棒性。在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，RL-ScanIQA实现了卓越的域内性能和跨域泛化能力。代码可在https://github.com/wangyuji1/RLScanIQA.git获取。
tldr: This paper introduces RL-ScanIQA, a reinforcement learning framework for blind 360°image quality assessment which optimizes scanpath generation and quality assessment jointly, achieving state-of-the-art performance and cross-dataset generalization.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为 RL-ScanIQA 的强化学习框架，用于盲 360° 图像质量评估。该框架联合优化扫描路径生成和质量评估，实现了最先进的性能和跨数据集泛化能力。

title: MistExit: Learning to Exit for Early Mistake Detection in Procedural Videos
summary: We introduce the task of early mistake detection in video, where the goal is to determine whether a keystep in a procedural activity is performed correctly while observing as little of the streaming video as possible. To tackle this problem, we propose a method comprising a mistake detector and a reinforcement learning policy. At each timestep, the detector processes recently observed frames to estimate the keystep's correctness while anticipating future visual features, enabling reliable early mistake estimates. Meanwhile, the policy aggregates the detector outputs and visual observations over time and adaptively decides when to exit (i.e., stop processing incoming frames) while producing the final prediction. Using diverse real-world procedural video datasets, we demonstrate that our MistExit model achieves superior mistake detection accuracy while reducing the fraction of video observed compared to state-of-the-art models. Project: https://vision.cs.utexas.edu/projects/mist_exit.
summary_zh: 我们引入了视频中早期错误检测的任务。该任务旨在尽可能少地观察流式视频，从而判断程序性活动中的一个关键步骤是否被正确执行。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种包含错误检测器和强化学习策略的方法。在每个时间步，检测器处理最近观察到的帧以估计关键步骤的正确性，同时预测未来的视觉特征，从而实现可靠的早期错误估计。同时，该策略随时间聚合检测器的输出和视觉观察，并自适应地决定何时退出（即，停止处理传入帧），同时产生最终预测。在使用各种真实世界程序性视频数据集的实验中，我们证明，与最先进的模型相比，我们的 MistExit 模型实现了卓越的错误检测精度，同时减少了观察的视频片段比例。项目地址：https://vision.cs.utexas.edu/projects/mist_exit。
tldr: The paper introduces MistExit, a method for early mistake detection in procedural videos using a mistake detector and a reinforcement learning policy, achieving better accuracy with less video observed compared to other methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MistExit，一种利用错误检测器和强化学习策略在程序视频中进行早期错误检测的方法，与现有方法相比，在观察较少视频的情况下实现了更高的准确率。

title: CamLit: Unified Video Diffusion with Explicit Camera and Lighting Control
summary: We present CamLit, the first unified video diffusion model that jointly performs novel view synthesis (NVS) and relighting from a single input image. Given one reference image, a user-defined camera trajectory, and an environment map, CamLit synthesizes a video of the scene from new viewpoints under the specified illumination. Within a single generative process, our model produces temporally coherent and spatially aligned outputs, including relit novel-view frames and corresponding albedo frames, enabling high-quality control of both camera pose and lighting. Qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that CamLit achieves high-fidelity outputs on par with state-of-the-art methods in both novel view synthesis and relighting, without sacrificing visual quality in either task. We show that a single generative model can effectively integrate camera and lighting control, simplifying the video generation pipeline while maintaining competitive performance and consistent realism.
summary_zh: 我们提出了 CamLit，这是首个统一的视频扩散模型，它可以从单张输入图像联合执行新视角合成 (NVS) 和重新光照。给定一张参考图像、用户定义的相机轨迹以及一个环境光照贴图，CamLit 可以合成场景在指定光照下从新视角拍摄的视频。在单个生成过程中，我们的模型能够产生时间上连贯且空间上对齐的输出，包括重新光照的新视角帧和相应的反照率帧，从而实现对相机姿态和光照的高质量控制。定性和定量实验表明，CamLit 在新视角合成和重新光照方面均达到了与最先进方法相当的高保真度输出，且在任何一项任务中都没有牺牲视觉质量。我们证明，单个生成模型可以有效地集成相机和光照控制，简化视频生成流程，同时保持具有竞争力的性能和一致的真实感。
tldr: CamLit is a unified video diffusion model that performs novel view synthesis and relighting from a single image, enabling control over camera pose and lighting within a single generative process.
tldr_zh: CamLit 是一种统一的视频扩散模型，可从单个图像执行新颖的视图合成和重新照明，从而可以在单个生成过程中控制相机姿态和照明。

title: S2GS: Streaming Semantic Gaussian Splatting for Online Scene Understanding and Reconstruction
summary: Existing offline feed-forward methods for joint scene understanding and reconstruction on long image streams often repeatedly perform global computation over an ever-growing set of past observations, causing runtime and GPU memory to increase rapidly with sequence length and limiting scalability. We propose Streaming Semantic Gaussian Splatting (S2GS), a strictly causal, incremental 3D Gaussian semantic field framework: it does not leverage future frames and continuously updates scene geometry, appearance, and instance-level semantics without reprocessing historical frames, enabling scalable online joint reconstruction and understanding. S2GS adopts a geometry-semantic decoupled dual-backbone design: the geometry branch performs causal modeling to drive incremental Gaussian updates, while the semantic branch leverages a 2D foundation vision model and a query-driven decoder to predict segmentation masks and identity embeddings, further stabilized by query-level contrastive alignment and lightweight online association with an instance memory. Experiments show that S2GS matches or outperforms strong offline baselines on joint reconstruction-and-understanding benchmarks, while significantly improving long-horizon scalability: it processes 1,000+ frames with much slower growth in runtime and GPU memory, whereas offline global-processing baselines typically run out of memory at around 80 frames under the same setting.
summary_zh: 针对长图像流进行联合场景理解和重建的现有离线前馈方法通常不断地对不断增长的过去观测集合重复全局计算，导致运行时间和GPU内存随着序列长度快速增长，并限制了可扩展性。我们提出了一种严格因果、增量的3D高斯语义场框架，名为流式语义高斯溅射（S2GS）：它不利用未来的帧，而是连续更新场景几何、外观和实例级语义，无需重新处理历史帧，从而实现可扩展的在线联合重建和理解。S2GS采用几何-语义解耦的双骨干网络设计：几何分支执行因果建模以驱动增量式高斯更新，而语义分支利用2D基础视觉模型和一个查询驱动的解码器来预测分割掩码和身份嵌入，并通过查询级别的对比对齐和与其实例记忆的轻量级在线关联进一步稳定。实验表明，S2GS在联合重建和理解基准测试中匹配甚至超越了强大的离线基线，同时显著提高了长时程可扩展性：它可以处理1000多帧，且运行时间和GPU内存的增长速度慢得多，而离线全局处理基线在相同设置下通常在80帧左右就会耗尽内存。
tldr: The paper introduces Streaming Semantic Gaussian Splatting (S2GS), an online method for joint scene understanding and reconstruction that incrementally updates a 3D Gaussian semantic field, achieving comparable performance to offline methods with significantly improved scalability.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了流式语义高斯溅射（S2GS），这是一种用于联合场景理解和重建的在线方法，它增量更新一个3D高斯语义场，实现了与离线方法相当的性能，并显著提高了可扩展性。

title: SGR-OCC: Evolving Monocular Priors for Embodied 3D Occupancy Prediction via Soft-Gating Lifting and Semantic-Adaptive Geometric Refinement
summary: 3D semantic occupancy prediction is a cornerstone for embodied AI, enabling agents to perceive dense scene geometry and semantics incrementally from monocular video streams. However, current online frameworks face two critical bottlenecks: the inherent depth ambiguity of monocular estimation that causes "feature bleeding" at object boundaries , and the "cold start" instability where uninitialized temporal fusion layers distort high-quality spatial priors during early training stages. In this paper, we propose SGR-OCC (Soft-Gating and Ray-refinement Occupancy), a unified framework driven by the philosophy of "Inheritance and Evolution". To perfectly inherit monocular spatial expertise, we introduce a Soft-Gating Feature Lifter that explicitly models depth uncertainty via a Gaussian gate to probabilistically suppress background noise. Furthermore, a Dynamic Ray-Constrained Anchor Refinement module simplifies complex 3D displacement searches into efficient 1D depth corrections along camera rays, ensuring sub-voxel adherence to physical surfaces. To ensure stable evolution toward temporal consistency, we employ a Two-Phase Progressive Training Strategy equipped with identity-initialized fusion, effectively resolving the cold start problem and shielding spatial priors from noisy early gradients. Extensive experiments on the EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet and Occ-ScanNet benchmarks demonstrate that SGR-OCC achieves state-of-the-art performance. In local prediction tasks, SGR-OCC achieves a completion IoU of 58.55$\%$ and a semantic mIoU of 49.89$\%$, surpassing the previous best method, EmbodiedOcc++, by 3.65$\%$ and 3.69$\%$ respectively. In challenging embodied prediction tasks, our model reaches 55.72$\%$ SC-IoU and 46.22$\%$ mIoU. Qualitative results further confirm our model's superior capability in preserving structural integrity and boundary sharpness in complex indoor environments.
summary_zh: 3D语义占据预测是具身人工智能的基石，它使智能体能够从单目视频流中逐步感知稠密场景几何结构和语义信息。然而，当前的在线框架面临两个关键瓶颈：单目估计固有的深度歧义导致物体边界处的“特征泄露”，以及“冷启动”不稳定性，即未初始化的时间融合层在训练早期阶段会扭曲高质量的空间先验。在本文中，我们提出了一种统一的框架SGR-OCC（软门控和光线细化占据），该框架由“继承与进化”的理念驱动。为了完美地继承单目空间专业知识，我们引入了一种软门控特征提升器，通过高斯门显式地建模深度不确定性，以概率方式抑制背景噪声。此外，一个动态光线约束锚点细化模块将复杂的3D位移搜索简化为沿相机光线的有效1D深度校正，确保亚体素级别的物理表面依附性。为了确保向时间一致性的稳定进化，我们采用了一种两阶段渐进式训练策略，并配备了身份初始化的融合，有效地解决了冷启动问题，并保护空间先验免受嘈杂的早期梯度的影响。在EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet和Occ-ScanNet基准上的大量实验表明，SGR-OCC实现了最先进的性能。在局部预测任务中，SGR-OCC实现了58.55$\%$的补全IoU和49.89$\%$的语义mIoU，分别比之前的最佳方法EmbodiedOcc++高出3.65$\%$和3.69$\%$。在具有挑战性的具身预测任务中，我们的模型达到了55.72$\%$的SC-IoU和46.22$\%$的mIoU。定性结果进一步证实了我们的模型在复杂室内环境中保持结构完整性和边界清晰度方面的卓越能力。
tldr: The paper introduces SGR-OCC, a novel framework for 3D semantic occupancy prediction from monocular video, addressing depth ambiguity and temporal fusion instability to achieve state-of-the-art performance on EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet and Occ-ScanNet benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SGR-OCC，一种新的从单目视频进行3D语义占据预测的框架，通过解决深度歧义和时间融合不稳定性，在EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet和Occ-ScanNet基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

title: Seeking Physics in Diffusion Noise
summary: Do video diffusion models encode signals predictive of physical plausibility? We probe intermediate denoising representations of a pretrained Diffusion Transformer (DiT) and find that physically plausible and implausible videos are partially separable in mid-layer feature space across noise levels. This separability cannot be fully attributed to visual quality or generator identity, suggesting recoverable physics-related cues in frozen DiT features. Leveraging this observation, we introduce progressive trajectory selection, an inference-time strategy that scores parallel denoising trajectories at a few intermediate checkpoints using a lightweight physics verifier trained on frozen features, and prunes low-scoring candidates early. Extensive experiments on PhyGenBench demonstrate that our method improves physical consistency while reducing inference cost, achieving comparable results to Best-of-K sampling with substantially fewer denoising steps.
summary_zh: 视频扩散模型是否编码了可预测物理合理性的信号？我们探究了一个预训练扩散Transformer (DiT)的中间去噪表征，发现在不同噪声水平下，物理上合理和不合理的视频在中层特征空间中是部分可分的。这种可分性不能完全归因于视觉质量或生成器身份，这表明在冻结的DiT特征中存在可恢复的与物理相关的线索。基于这一观察，我们引入了渐进轨迹选择，这是一种推理时间策略，它在几个中间检查点使用在冻结特征上训练的轻量级物理验证器对并行去噪轨迹进行评分，并尽早剪枝低分候选者。在PhyGenBench上的大量实验表明，我们的方法提高了物理一致性，同时降低了推理成本，以明显更少的去噪步骤实现了与Best-of-K采样相当的结果。
tldr: This paper investigates whether video diffusion models encode information related to physical plausibility and presents a method for improving physical consistency in generated videos using trajectory selection based on a physics verifier trained on frozen diffusion model features.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了视频扩散模型是否编码了与物理合理性相关的信息，并提出了一种通过基于物理验证器（在冻结的扩散模型特征上训练得到）的轨迹选择来提高生成视频中物理一致性的方法。

title: See, Learn, Assist: Safe and Self-Paced Robotic Rehabilitation via Video-Based Learning from Demonstration
summary: In this paper, we propose a novel framework that allows therapists to teach robot-assisted rehabilitation exercises remotely via RGB-D video. Our system encodes demonstrations as 6-DoF body-centric trajectories using Cartesian Dynamic Movement Primitives (DMPs), ensuring accurate posture-independent spatial generalization across diverse patient anatomies. Crucially, we execute these trajectories through a decoupled hybrid control architecture that constructs a spatially compliant virtual tunnel, paired with an effort-based temporal dilation mechanism. This architecture is applied to three distinct rehabilitation modalities: Passive, Active-Assisted, and Active-Resistive, by dynamically linking the exercise's execution phase to the patient's tangential force contribution. To guarantee safety, a Gaussian Mixture Regression (GMR) model is learned on-the-fly from the patient's own limb. This allows the detection of abnormal interaction forces and, if necessary, reverses the trajectory to prevent injury. Experimental validation demonstrates the system's precision, achieving an average trajectory reproduction error of 3.7cm and a range of motion (ROM) error of 5.5 degrees. Furthermore, dynamic interaction trials confirm that the controller successfully enforces effort-based progression while maintaining strict spatial path adherence against human disturbances.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新型框架，允许治疗师通过RGB-D视频远程指导机器人辅助康复训练。我们的系统使用笛卡尔动态运动基元（DMPs）将演示编码为6自由度的以身体为中心的轨迹，确保在不同的患者解剖结构中实现精确的、姿态无关的空间泛化。至关重要的是，我们通过解耦的混合控制架构执行这些轨迹，该架构构建了一个空间顺应的虚拟隧道，并结合了基于努力的时间膨胀机制。通过将运动的执行阶段与患者的切向力贡献动态连接，该架构被应用于三种不同的康复模式：被动、主动辅助和主动阻抗。为了保证安全，系统根据患者自身的肢体实时学习高斯混合回归（GMR）模型。这使得能够检测到异常的交互力，并在必要时逆转轨迹以防止受伤。实验验证表明了系统的精度，实现了平均轨迹重现误差3.7厘米和活动范围（ROM）误差5.5度。此外，动态交互试验证实了控制器成功地执行了基于努力的进程，同时在人为干扰下保持了严格的空间路径依从性。
tldr: This paper presents a robotic rehabilitation framework that uses video demonstrations to teach robots exercises, ensuring safety through force monitoring and adaptable progression based on patient effort. It utilizes DMPs and a hybrid control architecture for precise and safe exercise execution.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种机器人康复框架，该框架利用视频演示教授机器人进行锻炼，通过力监测确保安全，并根据患者的努力程度进行自适应的进展。 它采用DMPs和混合控制架构，以实现精确和安全的锻炼执行。

title: Disentangling Dynamical Systems: Causal Representation Learning Meets Local Sparse Attention
summary: Parametric system identification methods estimate the parameters of explicitly defined physical systems from data. Yet, they remain constrained by the need to provide an explicit function space, typically through a predefined library of candidate functions chosen via available domain knowledge. In contrast, deep learning can demonstrably model systems of broad complexity with high fidelity, but black-box function approximation typically fails to yield explicit descriptive or disentangled representations revealing the structure of a system. We develop a novel identifiability theorem, leveraging causal representation learning, to uncover disentangled representations of system parameters without structural assumptions. We derive a graphical criterion specifying when system parameters can be uniquely disentangled from raw trajectory data, up to permutation and diffeomorphism. Crucially, our analysis demonstrates that global causal structures provide a lower bound on the disentanglement guarantees achievable when considering local state-dependent causal structures. We instantiate system parameter identification as a variational inference problem, leveraging a sparsity-regularised transformer to uncover state-dependent causal structures. We empirically validate our approach across four synthetic domains, demonstrating its ability to recover highly disentangled representations that baselines fail to recover. Corroborating our theoretical analysis, our results confirm that enforcing local causal structure is often necessary for full identifiability.
summary_zh: 参数化系统辨识方法通过数据估计显式定义的物理系统的参数。然而，它们仍然受限于提供显式函数空间的需要，通常是通过一个预定义的候选函数库，这些函数通过可用的领域知识来选择。相比之下，深度学习可以证明以高保真度对具有广泛复杂性的系统进行建模，但黑盒函数逼近通常无法产生揭示系统结构的显式描述性或解耦表示。我们开发了一个新的可辨识性定理，利用因果表征学习，在没有结构假设的情况下，揭示系统参数的解耦表示。我们推导出一个图形化准则，指定了系统参数何时可以从原始轨迹数据中唯一地解耦，直至置换和微分同胚。至关重要的是，我们的分析表明，全局因果结构为考虑局部状态相关的因果结构时可实现的解耦保证提供了下限。我们将系统参数辨识实例化为一个变分推断问题，利用一个稀疏正则化的Transformer来揭示状态相关的因果结构。我们在四个合成领域中对我们的方法进行了实证验证，证明了它恢复基线方法无法恢复的高度解耦表示的能力。为了佐证我们的理论分析，我们的结果证实了强制执行局部因果结构对于完全可辨识性通常是必要的。
tldr: This paper presents a method for disentangling representations of system parameters from trajectory data using causal representation learning and sparse attention, demonstrating improved identifiability compared to baselines on synthetic domains.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用因果表征学习和稀疏注意力从轨迹数据中解耦系统参数表征的方法，并在合成领域证明了其相对于基线的改进的可辨识性。

title: Towards Versatile Opti-Acoustic Sensor Fusion and Volumetric Mapping
summary: Accurate 3D volumetric mapping is critical for autonomous underwater vehicles operating in obstacle-rich environments. Vision-based perception provides high-resolution data but fails in turbid conditions, while sonar is robust to lighting and turbidity but suffers from low resolution and elevation ambiguity. This paper presents a volumetric mapping framework that fuses a stereo sonar pair with a monocular camera to enable safe navigation under varying visibility conditions. Overlapping sonar fields of view resolve elevation ambiguity, producing fully defined 3D point clouds at each time step. The framework identifies regions of interest in camera images, associates them with corresponding sonar returns, and combines sonar range with camera-derived elevation cues to generate additional 3D points. Each 3D point is assigned a confidence value reflecting its reliability. These confidence-weighted points are fused using a Gaussian Process Volumetric Mapping framework that prioritizes the most reliable measurements. Experimental comparisons with other opti-acoustic and sonar-based approaches, along with field tests in a marina environment, demonstrate the method's effectiveness in capturing complex geometries and preserving critical information for robot navigation in both clear and turbid conditions. Our code is open-source to support community adoption.
summary_zh: 三维体积地图的精确构建对于在障碍物密布环境中运行的自主水下航行器至关重要。基于视觉的感知能够提供高分辨率数据，但在浑浊条件下失效，而声呐对光照和浑浊度具有鲁棒性，但分辨率较低且存在仰角模糊。本文提出了一种融合立体声呐和单目相机的体积地图构建框架，从而能够在不同的可见度条件下实现安全导航。重叠的声呐视场消除了仰角模糊，在每个时间步生成完全定义的三维点云。该框架识别相机图像中的感兴趣区域，将其与相应的声呐回波关联，并将声呐测距与相机推导的仰角线索相结合，以生成额外的三维点。 每个三维点都被赋予一个反映其可靠性的置信度值。 这些置信度加权的点云通过高斯过程体积地图构建框架进行融合，该框架优先考虑最可靠的测量结果。 与其他光声和基于声呐的方法进行的实验比较，以及在码头环境中进行的现场测试，证明了该方法在捕获复杂几何形状和保留机器人导航的关键信息方面的有效性，无论是在清晰还是浑浊的条件下。 我们的代码已开源，以支持社区采用。
tldr: This paper presents a sensor fusion framework combining stereo sonar and a monocular camera for improved 3D volumetric mapping in underwater environments with varying visibility, demonstrated through experiments and field tests, and made publicly available.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种传感器融合框架，将立体声纳和单目摄像头相结合，以改善在不同能见度水下环境中的3D体积映射。通过实验和现场测试验证了其有效性，并已开源。

title: Design of a Bio-Inspired Miniature Submarine for Low-Cost Water Quality Monitoring
summary: Water quality monitoring is essential for protecting aquatic ecosystems and detecting environmental pollution. This paper presents the design and experimental validation of a bio-inspired miniature submarine for low-cost water quality monitoring. Inspired by the jet propulsion mechanism of squids, the proposed system employs pump-driven water jets for propulsion and steering, combined with a pump-based buoyancy control mechanism that enables both depth regulation and water sampling. The vehicle integrates low-cost, commercially available components including an ESP32 microcontroller, IMU, pressure sensor, GPS receiver, and LoRa communication module. The complete system can be constructed at a hardware cost of approximately $122.5, making it suitable for educational and environmental monitoring applications. Experimental validation was conducted through pool tests and field trials in a lake. During a 360 degrees rotation test, roll and pitch deviations remained within +/-2 degrees and +/-1.5 degrees, respectively, demonstrating stable attitude control. Steering experiments showed a heading step response with approximately 2 s rise time and 5 s settling time. Depth control experiments achieved a target depth of 2.5 m with steady-state error within +/-0.1 m. Field experiments further demonstrated reliable navigation and successful water sampling operations. The results confirm that the proposed platform provides a compact, stable, and cost-effective solution for small-scale aquatic environmental monitoring.
summary_zh: 水质监测对于保护水生生态系统和检测环境污染至关重要。本文介绍了一种用于低成本水质监测的仿生微型潜艇的设计和实验验证。受鱿鱼的喷射推进机制启发，该系统采用泵驱动水射流进行推进和转向，并结合基于泵的浮力控制机制，实现深度调节和水样采集。该潜艇集成了低成本、市售的组件，包括 ESP32 单片机、IMU、压力传感器、GPS 接收器和 LoRa 通信模块。整个系统的硬件成本约为 122.5 美元，使其适用于教育和环境监测应用。通过水池测试和湖泊实地试验进行了实验验证。在 360 度旋转测试中，横滚角和俯仰角的偏差分别保持在 +/-2 度和 +/-1.5 度以内，表明姿态控制稳定。转向实验显示，航向阶跃响应的上升时间约为 2 秒，稳定时间约为 5 秒。深度控制实验实现了 2.5 米的目标深度，稳态误差在 +/-0.1 米以内。实地实验进一步证明了可靠的导航和成功的水样采集操作。结果证实，所提出的平台为小规模水生环境监测提供了一种紧凑、稳定且经济高效的解决方案。
tldr: This paper presents a low-cost, bio-inspired miniature submarine for water quality monitoring, utilizing pump-driven propulsion and buoyancy control with off-the-shelf components for stable navigation and water sampling.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种低成本的仿生微型潜艇，用于水质监测。该潜艇采用泵驱动的推进和浮力控制，并结合现成的组件，实现了稳定的导航和水样采集。

title: PGcGAN: Pathological Gait-Conditioned GAN for Human Gait Synthesis
summary: Pathological gait analysis is constrained by limited and variable clinical datasets, which restrict the modeling of diverse gait impairments. To address this challenge, we propose a Pathological Gait-conditioned Generative Adversarial Network (PGcGAN) that synthesises pathology-specific gait sequences directly from observed 3D pose keypoint trajectories data. The framework incorporates one-hot encoded pathology labels within both the generator and discriminator, enabling controlled synthesis across six gait categories. The generator adopts a conditional autoencoder architecture trained with adversarial and reconstruction objectives to preserve structural and temporal gait characteristics. Experiments on the Pathological Gait Dataset demonstrate strong alignment between real and synthetic sequences through PCA and t-SNE analyses, visual kinematic inspection, and downstream classification tasks. Augmenting real data with synthetic sequences improved pathological gait recognition across GRU, LSTM, and CNN models, indicating that pathology-conditioned gait synthesis can effectively support data augmentation in pathological gait analysis.
summary_zh: 病理步态分析受到有限且多变的临床数据集的制约，这限制了对多样步态障碍的建模。 为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种病理步态条件生成对抗网络 (PGcGAN)，可以直接从观察到的 3D 姿态关键点轨迹数据合成病理特异性步态序列。 该框架在生成器和判别器中都整合了 one-hot 编码的病理标签，从而能够在六种植步态类别中进行受控合成。 生成器采用条件自编码器架构，通过对抗性和重建目标进行训练，以保留结构性和时间性步态特征。 在病理步态数据集上的实验通过 PCA 和 t-SNE 分析、视觉运动学检查以及下游分类任务证明了真实序列和合成序列之间的强一致性。 使用合成序列扩充真实数据改善了 GRU、LSTM 和 CNN 模型上的病理步态识别，表明病理条件步态合成可以有效地支持病理步态分析中的数据增强。
tldr: The paper introduces PGcGAN, a conditional GAN that synthesizes pathology-specific human gait sequences from 3D pose keypoints, improving pathological gait recognition through data augmentation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PGcGAN，一种条件GAN，可以从3D姿势关键点合成特定病理的人类步态序列，并通过数据增强来提高病理步态识别的准确率。

title: SPARQ: Spiking Early-Exit Neural Networks for Energy-Efficient Edge AI
summary: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer inherent energy efficiency due to their event-driven computation model, making them promising for edge AI deployment. However, their practical adoption is limited by the computational overhead of deep architectures and the absence of input-adaptive control. This work presents SPARQ, a unified framework that integrates spiking computation, quantization-aware training, and reinforcement learning-guided early exits for efficient and adaptive inference. Evaluations across MLP, LeNet, and AlexNet architectures demonstrated that the proposed Quantised Dynamic SNNs (QDSNN) consistently outperform conventional SNNs and QSNNs, achieving up to 5.15% higher accuracy over QSNNs, over 330 times lower system energy compared to baseline SNNs, and over 90 percent fewer synaptic operations across different datasets. These results validate SPARQ as a hardware-friendly, energy-efficient solution for real-time AI at the edge.
summary_zh: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）由于其事件驱动的计算模型，具有内在的能源效率优势，使其在边缘AI部署方面具有巨大潜力。然而，深度架构的计算开销和缺乏输入自适应控制限制了它们的实际应用。本文提出SPARQ，一个统一的框架，集成了脉冲计算、量化感知训练和强化学习引导的早期退出，以实现高效且自适应的推理。在MLP、LeNet和AlexNet架构上的评估表明，所提出的量化动态SNN（QDSNN）始终优于传统的SNN和QSNN，在不同数据集上，相对于QSNN，精度最多提高5.15%，系统能耗比基线SNN降低330倍以上，突触操作减少90%以上。这些结果证明SPARQ是边缘实时AI的一种硬件友好、节能的解决方案。
tldr: The paper introduces SPARQ, a framework for energy-efficient edge AI using spiking neural networks with quantization and reinforcement learning-guided early exits, achieving significant energy savings and accuracy improvements over conventional SNNs.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SPARQ，一个用于节能边缘AI的框架，它使用带有量化和强化学习引导的提前退出的脉冲神经网络，与传统的SNN相比，实现了显著的节能和准确性提升。

title: Autonomous Agents Coordinating Distributed Discovery Through Emergent Artifact Exchange
summary: We present ScienceClaw + Infinite, a framework for autonomous scientific investigation in which independent agents conduct research without central coordination, and any contributor can deploy new agents into a shared ecosystem. The system is built around three components: an extensible registry of over 300 interoperable scientific skills, an artifact layer that preserves full computational lineage as a directed acyclic graph (DAG), and a structured platform for agent-based scientific discourse with provenance-aware governance. Agents select and chain tools based on their scientific profiles, produce immutable artifacts with typed metadata and parent lineage, and broadcast unsatisfied information needs to a shared global index. The ArtifactReactor enables plannerless coordination: peer agents discover and fulfill open needs through pressure-based scoring, while schema-overlap matching triggers multi-parent synthesis across independent analyses. An autonomous mutation layer actively prunes the expanding artifact DAG to resolve conflicting or redundant workflows, while persistent memory allows agents to continuously build upon complex epistemic states across multiple cycles. Infinite converts these outputs into auditable scientific records through structured posts, provenance views, and machine-readable discourse relations, with community feedback steering subsequent investigation cycles. Across four autonomous investigations, peptide design for the somatostatin receptor SSTR2, lightweight impact-resistant ceramic screening, cross-domain resonance bridging biology, materials, and music, and formal analogy construction between urban morphology and grain-boundary evolution, the framework demonstrates heterogeneous tool chaining, emergent convergence among independently operating agents, and traceable reasoning from raw computation to published finding.
summary_zh: 我们提出了 ScienceClaw + Infinite，一个用于自主科学研究的框架，其中独立的智能体在无需中心协调的情况下进行研究，并且任何贡献者都可以在共享的生态系统中部署新的智能体。该系统围绕三个组件构建：一个包含 300 多个可互操作科学技能的可扩展注册表、一个将完整计算谱系保存为有向无环图 (DAG) 的工件层，以及一个具有溯源感知治理的基于智能体的科学论述结构化平台。智能体根据其科学概况选择和链接工具，生成具有类型化元数据和父谱系的不可变工件，并将未满足的信息需求广播到共享的全局索引。ArtifactReactor 实现了无规划器的协调：对等智能体通过基于压力的评分发现并满足开放需求，而模式重叠匹配触发跨独立分析的多父本合成。一个自主的变异层主动修剪不断扩展的工件 DAG，以解决冲突或冗余的工作流程，而持久性存储器允许智能体在多个周期中持续建立在复杂的认知状态之上。Infinite 通过结构化帖子、溯源视图和机器可读的论述关系将这些输出转换为可审计的科学记录，社区反馈指导后续的调查周期。在四个自主调查中，包括生长抑素受体 SSTR2 的肽设计、轻量级抗冲击陶瓷筛选、跨领域共振桥接生物学、材料和音乐，以及城市形态和晶界演化之间的形式类比构建，该框架展示了异构工具链、独立运行的智能体之间的新兴收敛，以及从原始计算到已发表发现的可追踪推理。
tldr: The paper introduces ScienceClaw + Infinite, a framework for autonomous scientific investigation using distributed agents that coordinate through emergent artifact exchange, demonstrating tool chaining and convergence in multiple scientific domains.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为ScienceClaw + Infinite的框架，用于自主科学研究，该框架利用分布式代理通过涌现式人工制品交换进行协调，并在多个科学领域展示了工具链和收敛。

title: DiFlowDubber: Discrete Flow Matching for Automated Video Dubbing via Cross-Modal Alignment and Synchronization
summary: Video dubbing has broad applications in filmmaking, multimedia creation, and assistive speech technology. Existing approaches either train directly on limited dubbing datasets or adopt a two-stage pipeline that adapts pre-trained text-to-speech (TTS) models, which often struggle to produce expressive prosody, rich acoustic characteristics, and precise synchronization. To address these issues, we propose DiFlowDubber with a novel two-stage training framework that effectively transfers knowledge from a pre-trained TTS model to video-driven dubbing, with a discrete flow matching generative backbone. Specifically, we design a FaPro module that captures global prosody and stylistic cues from facial expressions and leverages this information to guide the modeling of subsequent speech attributes. To ensure precise speech-lip synchronization, we introduce a Synchronizer module that bridges the modality gap among text, video, and speech, thereby improving cross-modal alignment and generating speech that is temporally synchronized with lip movements. Experiments on two primary benchmark datasets demonstrate that DiFlowDubber outperforms previous methods across multiple metrics.
summary_zh: 视频配音在电影制作、多媒体创作和辅助语音技术方面具有广泛的应用。现有方法要么直接在有限的配音数据集上进行训练，要么采用一种两阶段流程，即适配预训练的文本到语音（TTS）模型，但后者往往难以产生富有表现力的韵律、丰富的声学特征和精确的同步。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种名为 DiFlowDubber 的方法，它采用一种新颖的两阶段训练框架，能够有效地将知识从预训练的 TTS 模型迁移到视频驱动的配音中，并以离散流匹配生成骨干网络作为支撑。具体而言，我们设计了一个 FaPro 模块，用于捕捉来自面部表情的全局韵律和风格线索，并利用这些信息来指导后续语音属性的建模。为了确保精确的语音-唇同步，我们引入了一个 Synchronizer 模块，用于弥合文本、视频和语音之间的模态差距，从而改善跨模态对齐并生成与唇部运动在时间上同步的语音。在两个主要基准数据集上的实验表明，DiFlowDubber 在多个指标上均优于以往的方法。
tldr: DiFlowDubber is a novel two-stage framework using discrete flow matching to improve automated video dubbing by capturing facial prosody and ensuring speech-lip synchronization, outperforming existing methods.
tldr_zh: DiFlowDubber是一种新颖的两阶段框架，使用离散流匹配来改进自动视频配音，通过捕捉面部韵律并确保语音和嘴唇同步，优于现有方法。

title: ST-ResGAT: Explainable Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network for Road Condition Prediction and Priority-Driven Maintenance
summary: Climate-vulnerable road networks require a paradigm shift from reactive, fix-on-failure repairs to predictive, decision-ready maintenance. This paper introduces ST-ResGAT, a novel Spatio-Temporal Residual Graph Attention Network that fuses residual graph-attention encoding with GRU temporal aggregation to forecast pavement deterioration. Engineered for resource-constrained deployment, the framework translates continuous Pavement Condition Index (PCI) forecasts directly into the American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM)-compliant maintenance priorities. Using a real-world inspection dataset of 750 segments in Sylhet, Bangladesh (2021-2024), ST-ResGAT significantly outperforms traditional non-spatial machine learning baselines, achieving exceptional predictive fidelity (R2 = 0.93, RMSE = 2.72). Crucially, ablation testing confirmed the mathematical necessity of modeling topological neighbor effects, proving that structural decay acts as a spatial contagion. Uniquely, we integrate GNNExplainer to unbox the model, demonstrating that its learned priorities align perfectly with established physical engineering theory. Furthermore, we quantify classification safety: achieving 85.5% exact ASTM class agreement and 100% adjacent-class containment, ensuring bounded, engineer-safe predictions.
