To connect model outputs to policy, we generate localized longitudinal maintenance profiles, perform climate stress-testing, and derive Pareto sustainability frontiers. ST-ResGAT therefore offers a practical, explainable, and sustainable blueprint for intelligent infrastructure management in high-risk, low-resource geological settings.
summary_zh: 气候脆弱型道路网络需要从被动的、故障修复式的维修模式转变为预测性的、决策就绪型的维护模式。本文提出了一种新的时空残差图注意力网络(ST-ResGAT)，它融合了残差图注意力编码和GRU时间聚合，以预测路面劣化。该框架专为资源受限的部署而设计，能够将连续的路面状况指数(PCI)预测直接转化为符合美国材料试验协会(ASTM)标准的维护优先级。利用孟加拉国锡莱特750段道路的真实检测数据集（2021-2024年），ST-ResGAT显著优于传统的非空间机器学习基线模型，实现了卓越的预测精度(R2 = 0.93, RMSE = 2.72)。至关重要的是，消融实验证实了对拓扑邻居效应进行建模的数学必要性，证明了结构衰退表现为一种空间传染。独特之处在于，我们集成了GNNExplainer来解释模型，证明其学习到的优先级与已建立的物理工程理论完全吻合。此外，我们量化了分类安全性：实现了85.5%的准确ASTM等级一致性和100%的邻近等级包含性，确保了有界限的、工程师安全的预测。为了将模型输出与政策联系起来，我们生成了本地化的纵向维护曲线，进行了气候压力测试，并推导出了帕累托可持续性前沿。因此，ST-ResGAT为高风险、低资源地质环境下的智能基础设施管理提供了一个实用的、可解释的和可持续的蓝图。
tldr: This paper introduces ST-ResGAT, a novel spatio-temporal graph neural network for predicting road conditions and prioritizing maintenance, demonstrating significant performance gains and explainability on a real-world dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为ST-ResGAT的新型时空图神经网络，用于预测道路状况并优先安排维护，在真实世界数据集上展示了显著的性能提升和可解释性。

title: Expanding mmWave Datasets for Human Pose Estimation with Unlabeled Data and LiDAR Datasets
summary: Current mmWave datasets for human pose estimation (HPE) are scarce and lack diversity in both point cloud (PC) attributes and human poses, severely hampering the generalization ability of their trained models. On the other hand, unlabeled mmWave HPE data and diverse LiDAR HPE datasets are readily available. We propose EMDUL, a novel approach to expand the volume and diversity of an existing mmWave dataset using unlabeled mmWave data and a LiDAR dataset. EMDUL trains a pseudo-label estimator to annotate the unlabeled mmWave data and is able to convert, or translate, a given annotated LiDAR PC to its mmWave counterpart. Expanded with both LiDAR-converted and pseudo-labeled mmWave PCs, our mmWave dataset significantly boosts the performance and generalization ability of all our HPE models, with substantial 15.1% and 18.9% error reductions for in-domain and out-of-domain settings, respectively.
summary_zh: 用于人体姿态估计(HPE)的现有毫米波数据集稀缺，且在点云(PC)属性和人体姿态方面都缺乏多样性，严重阻碍了训练模型的泛化能力。另一方面，无标签的毫米波HPE数据和多样化的LiDAR HPE数据集却容易获得。我们提出 EMDUL，这是一种新颖的方法，利用无标签的毫米波数据和LiDAR数据集来扩展现有毫米波数据集的规模和多样性。EMDUL训练一个伪标签估计器来标注无标签的毫米波数据，并且能够转换，或翻译，给定的已标注LiDAR点云到其毫米波对应物。经过LiDAR转换和伪标签毫米波点云的扩展，我们的毫米波数据集显著提高了所有HPE模型的性能和泛化能力，在域内和域外设置中分别实现了15.1%和18.9%的误差大幅降低。
tldr: The paper introduces a method, EMDUL, to augment mmWave human pose estimation datasets using unlabeled mmWave data and LiDAR datasets, demonstrating significant performance improvements in both in-domain and out-of-domain scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为EMDUL的方法，利用未标记的毫米波数据和激光雷达数据集来扩充毫米波人体姿态估计数据集，并在领域内和领域外场景中都显示出显著的性能提升。

title: Wi-Spike: A Low-power WiFi Human Multi-action Recognition Model with Spiking Neural Networks
summary: WiFi-based human action recognition (HAR) has gained significant attention due to its non-intrusive and privacy-preserving nature. However, most existing WiFi sensing models predominantly focus on improving recognition accuracy, while issues of power consumption and energy efficiency remain insufficiently discussed. In this work, we present Wi-Spike, a bio-inspired spiking neural network (SNN) framework for efficient and accurate action recognition using WiFi channel state information (CSI) signals. Specifically, leveraging the event-driven and low-power characteristics of SNNs, Wi-Spike introduces spiking convolutional layers for spatio-temporal feature extraction and a novel temporal attention mechanism to enhance discriminative representation. The extracted features are subsequently encoded and classified through spiking fully connected layers and a voting layer. Comprehensive experiments on three benchmark datasets (NTU-Fi-HAR, NTU-Fi-HumanID, and UT-HAR) demonstrate that Wi-Spike achieves competitive accuracy in single-action recognition and superior performance in multi-action recognition tasks. As for energy consumption, Wi-Spike reduces the energy cost by at least half compared with other methods, while still achieving 95.83% recognition accuracy in human activity recognition. More importantly, Wi-Spike establishes a new state-of-the-art in WiFi-based multi-action HAR, offering a promising solution for real-time, energy-efficient edge sensing applications.
summary_zh: 基于WiFi的人体行为识别(HAR)因其非侵入性和保护隐私的特性而备受关注。然而，现有的大多数WiFi感知模型主要侧重于提高识别准确率，而对功耗和能效问题的讨论不足。在这项工作中，我们提出了Wi-Spike，一个受生物启发的脉冲神经网络(SNN)框架，用于利用WiFi信道状态信息(CSI)信号进行高效、准确的动作识别。具体来说，Wi-Spike利用SNN的事件驱动和低功耗特性，引入脉冲卷积层进行时空特征提取，并采用一种新颖的时间注意力机制来增强判别性表示。提取的特征随后通过脉冲全连接层和投票层进行编码和分类。在三个基准数据集（NTU-Fi-HAR、NTU-Fi-HumanID 和 UT-HAR）上的综合实验表明，Wi-Spike在单动作识别中实现了具有竞争力的准确率，并在多动作识别任务中表现出卓越的性能。在能量消耗方面，Wi-Spike至少降低了一半的能量成本，同时在人体活动识别中仍能达到95.83%的识别准确率。更重要的是，Wi-Spike在基于WiFi的多动作HAR中建立了新的最先进水平，为实时、节能的边缘感知应用提供了一种有希望的解决方案。
tldr: The paper introduces Wi-Spike, a low-power Spiking Neural Network (SNN) framework for WiFi-based human multi-action recognition, achieving competitive accuracy and significantly reduced energy consumption compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为Wi-Spike的低功耗脉冲神经网络(SNN)框架，用于基于WiFi的人体多动作识别，与现有方法相比，实现了具有竞争力的准确率并显著降低了能耗。

title: Direct Object-Level Reconstruction via Probabilistic Gaussian Splatting
summary: Object-level 3D reconstruction play important roles across domains such as cultural heritage digitization, industrial manufacturing, and virtual reality. However, existing Gaussian Splatting-based approaches generally rely on full-scene reconstruction, in which substantial redundant background information is introduced, leading to increased computational and storage overhead. To address this limitation, we propose an efficient single-object 3D reconstruction method based on 2D Gaussian Splatting. By directly integrating foreground-background probability cues into Gaussian primitives and dynamically pruning low-probability Gaussians during training, the proposed method fundamentally focuses on an object of interest and improves the memory and computational efficiency. Our pipeline leverages probability masks generated by YOLO and SAM to supervise probabilistic Gaussian attributes, replacing binary masks with continuous probability values to mitigate boundary ambiguity. Additionally, we propose a dual-stage filtering strategy for training's startup to suppress background Gaussians. And, during training, rendered probability masks are conversely employed to refine supervision and enhance boundary consistency across views. Experiments conducted on the MIP-360, T&T, and NVOS datasets demonstrate that our method exhibits strong self-correction capability in the presence of mask errors and achieves reconstruction quality comparable to standard 3DGS approaches, while requiring only approximately 1/10 of their Gaussian amount. These results validate the efficiency and robustness of our method for single-object reconstruction and highlight its potential for applications requiring both high fidelity and computational efficiency.
summary_zh: 对象级别的3D重建在文化遗产数字化、工业制造和虚拟现实等领域发挥着重要作用。然而，现有的基于高斯溅射的方法通常依赖于完整场景重建，其中引入了大量的冗余背景信息，导致计算和存储开销增加。为了解决这个局限性，我们提出了一种基于2D高斯溅射的高效单对象3D重建方法。通过直接将前景-背景概率线索集成到高斯基元中，并在训练期间动态修剪低概率高斯分布，该方法从根本上专注于目标对象，并提高了内存和计算效率。我们的流程利用YOLO和SAM生成的概率掩码来监督概率高斯属性，用连续概率值代替二元掩码来减轻边界模糊。此外，我们提出了一种用于训练启动的双阶段过滤策略，以抑制背景高斯分布。并且，在训练过程中，渲染的概率掩码被反过来用于细化监督，并增强跨视图的边界一致性。在MIP-360、T&T和NVOS数据集上进行的实验表明，我们的方法在存在掩码错误的情况下表现出很强的自我校正能力，并实现了与标准3DGS方法相当的重建质量，同时仅需大约1/10的高斯分布数量。这些结果验证了我们方法对于单对象重建的效率和鲁棒性，并突出了其在需要高保真度和计算效率的应用中的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces an efficient Gaussian Splatting-based method for single-object 3D reconstruction, achieving comparable quality to full-scene methods with significantly reduced computational and storage overhead by incorporating foreground-background probability cues and a dual-stage filtering strategy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于高斯溅射的单物体3D重建的高效方法。通过结合前景-背景概率线索和双阶段过滤策略，该方法在显著降低计算和存储开销的同时，实现了与全场景方法相媲美的重建质量。

title: RegFormer++: An Efficient Large-Scale 3D LiDAR Point Registration Network with Projection-Aware 2D Transformer
summary: Although point cloud registration has achieved remarkable advances in object-level and indoor scenes, large-scale LiDAR registration methods has been rarely explored before. Challenges mainly arise from the huge point scale, complex point distribution, and numerous outliers within outdoor LiDAR scans. In addition, most existing registration works generally adopt a two-stage paradigm: They first find correspondences by extracting discriminative local descriptors and then leverage robust estimators (e.g. RANSAC) to filter outliers, which are highly dependent on well-designed descriptors and post-processing choices. To address these problems, we propose a novel end-to-end differential transformer network, termed RegFormer++, for large-scale point cloud alignment without requiring any further post-processing. Specifically, a hierarchical projection-aware 2D transformer with linear complexity is proposed to project raw LiDAR points onto a cylindrical surface and extract global point features, which can improve resilience to outliers due to long-range dependencies. Because we fill original 3D coordinates into 2D projected positions, our designed transformer can benefit from both high efficiency in 2D processing and accuracy from 3D geometric information. Furthermore, to effectively reduce wrong point matching, a Bijective Association Transformer (BAT) is designed, combining both cross attention and all-to-all point gathering. To improve training stability and robustness, a feature-transformed optimal transport module is also designed for regressing the final pose transformation. Extensive experiments on KITTI, NuScenes, and Argoverse datasets demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of both accuracy and efficiency.
summary_zh: 尽管点云配准在对象级别和室内场景中取得了显著进展，但大规模激光雷达配准方法此前鲜有探索。挑战主要源于户外激光雷达扫描中庞大的点云规模、复杂的点分布以及大量的离群点。此外，大多数现有的配准工作通常采用两阶段范式：首先通过提取判别性局部描述符来寻找对应关系，然后利用鲁棒估计器（例如RANSAC）来过滤离群点，这高度依赖于精心设计的描述符和后处理选择。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的端到端可微变换器网络，称为RegFormer++，用于大规模点云对齐，而无需任何额外的后处理。具体而言，我们提出了一种具有线性复杂度的分层投影感知2D变换器，将原始激光雷达点投影到圆柱表面上并提取全局点特征，这可以提高对长程依赖关系的抗离群点能力。 由于我们将原始3D坐标填充到2D投影位置中，因此我们设计的变换器可以受益于2D处理的高效率和3D几何信息的准确性。 此外，为了有效减少错误的点匹配，我们设计了一个双射关联变换器（BAT），结合了交叉注意力和全对全点聚集。 为了提高训练稳定性和鲁棒性，我们还设计了一个特征变换的最优传输模块，用于回归最终的位姿变换。 在KITTI、NuScenes和Argoverse数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的模型在准确性和效率方面均实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: RegFormer++ is an end-to-end transformer network for large-scale LiDAR point cloud registration that achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency by using a hierarchical projection-aware 2D transformer and a Bijective Association Transformer (BAT). It outperforms existing methods on standard datasets without post-processing.
tldr_zh: RegFormer++ 是一个端到端的Transformer网络，用于大规模激光雷达点云配准，通过使用分层投影感知2D Transformer和双射关联Transformer (BAT)，实现了最先进的精度和效率。它在标准数据集上优于现有方法，且无需后处理。

title: CIPHER: Culvert Inspection through Pairwise Frame Selection and High-Efficiency Reconstruction
summary: Automated culvert inspection systems can help increase the safety and efficiency of flood management operations. As a key step to this system, we present an efficient RGB-based 3D reconstruction pipeline for culvert-like structures in visually repetitive environments. Our approach first selects informative frame pairs to maximize viewpoint diversity while ensuring valid correspondence matching using a plug-and-play module, followed by a reconstruction model that simultaneously estimates RGB appearance, geometry, and semantics in real-time. Experiments demonstrate that our method effectively generates accurate 3D reconstructions and depth maps, enhancing culvert inspection efficiency with minimal human intervention.
summary_zh: 自动化涵洞检测系统有助于提高洪水管理工作的安全性和效率。作为该系统的关键步骤，我们提出了一种高效的基于RGB的3D重建流程，用于视觉重复环境中的涵洞状结构。我们的方法首先使用一个即插即用模块选择信息量大的帧对，以最大化视点多样性，同时确保有效的对应匹配，然后使用一个重建模型实时估计RGB外观、几何形状和语义信息。实验表明，我们的方法能够有效地生成精确的3D重建和深度图，从而以最少的人工干预提高涵洞检测效率。
tldr: The paper introduces an automated RGB-based 3D reconstruction pipeline for culvert inspection, using informative frame selection and real-time estimation of appearance, geometry, and semantics.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于涵洞检测的自动化 RGB 3D 重建流程，它利用信息丰富的帧选择和外观、几何和语义的实时估计。

title: DualSwinFusionSeg: Multimodal Martian Landslide Segmentation via Dual Swin Transformer with Multi-Scale Fusion and UNet++
summary: Automated segmentation of Martian landslides, particularly in tectonically active regions such as Valles Marineris,is important for planetary geology, hazard assessment, and future robotic exploration. However, detecting landslides from planetary imagery is challenging due to the heterogeneous nature of available sensing modalities and the limited number of labeled samples. Each observation combines RGB imagery with geophysical measurements such as digital elevation models, slope maps, thermal inertia, and contextual grayscale imagery, which differ significantly in resolution and statistical properties. To address these challenges, we propose DualSwinFusionSeg, a multimodal segmentation architecture that separates modality-specific feature extraction and performs multi-scale cross-modal fusion. The model employs two parallel Swin Transformer V2 encoders to independently process RGB and auxiliary geophysical inputs, producing hierarchical feature representations. Corresponding features from the two streams are fused at multiple scales and decoded using a UNet++ decoder with dense nested skip connections to preserve fine boundary details. Extensive ablation studies evaluate modality contributions, loss functions, decoder architectures, and fusion strategies. Experiments on the MMLSv2 dataset from the PBVS 2026 Mars-LS Challenge show that modality-specific encoders and simple concatenation-based fusion improve segmentation accuracy under limited training data. The final model achieves 0.867 mIoU and 0.905 F1 on the development benchmark and 0.783 mIoU on the held-out test set, demonstrating strong performance for multimodal planetary surface segmentation.
summary_zh: 火星滑坡的自动分割，尤其是在诸如水手谷等构造活跃地区，对于行星地质学、灾害评估和未来机器人探索至关重要。然而，由于可用传感方式的异质性和标记样本数量的有限性，从行星图像中检测滑坡具有挑战性。每次观测结合了RGB图像与地球物理测量数据，例如数字高程模型、坡度图、热惯量和上下文灰度图像，这些数据在分辨率和统计属性上存在显著差异。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了 DualSwinFusionSeg，一种多模态分割架构，它分离了模态特定的特征提取，并执行多尺度跨模态融合。该模型采用两个并行的Swin Transformer V2编码器来独立处理RGB和辅助地球物理输入，从而产生分层特征表示。来自两个流的相应特征在多个尺度上融合，并使用具有密集嵌套跳跃连接的UNet++解码器进行解码，以保留精细的边界细节。广泛的消融研究评估了模态贡献、损失函数、解码器架构和融合策略。在 PBVS 2026 Mars-LS 挑战赛的 MMLSv2 数据集上的实验表明，模态特定的编码器和基于简单连接的融合在有限的训练数据下提高了分割精度。最终模型在开发基准上实现了 0.867 mIoU 和 0.905 F1，在保留测试集上实现了 0.783 mIoU，证明了其在多模态行星表面分割方面的强大性能。
tldr: The paper introduces DualSwinFusionSeg, a multimodal segmentation architecture using dual Swin Transformers and UNet++ for segmenting Martian landslides from heterogeneous data, achieving promising results on the MMLSv2 dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DualSwinFusionSeg，一种多模态分割架构，使用双Swi Transformer和UNet++从异构数据中分割火星滑坡，并在MMLSv2数据集上取得了有希望的结果。

title: Geometry-Aware Set-Membership Multilateration: Directional Bounds and Anchor Selection
summary:
In this paper, we study anchor selection for range-based localization under unknown-but-bounded measurement errors. We start from the convex localization set $\X=\Xd\cap\Hset$ recently introduced in \cite{CalafioreSIAM}, where $\Xd$ is a polyhedron obtained from pairwise differences of squared-range
  equations between the unknown location $x$ and the anchors, and $\Hset$ is the intersection of upper-range hyperspheres. Our first goal is \emph{offline} design: we derive geometry-only E- and D-type scores from the centered scatter matrix $S(A)=AQ_mA\tran$, where $A$ collects the anchor coordinates and $Q_m=I_m-\frac{1}{m}\one\one\tran$ is the centering projector, showing that $λ_{\min}(S(A))$ controls worst-direction and diameter surrogates for the polyhedral certificate $\Xd$, while $\det S(A)$ controls principal-axis volume surrogates. Our second goal is \emph{online} uncertainty assessment for a selected subset of anchors: exploiting the special structure $\X=\Xd\cap\Hset$, we derive a simplex-aggregated enclosing ball for $\Hset$ and an exact support-function formula for $\Hset$, which lead to finite hybrid bounds for the actual localization set $\X$, even when the polyhedral certificate deteriorates. Numerical experiments are performed in two dimensions, showing that geometry-based subset selection is close to an oracle combinatorial search, that the D-score slightly dominates the E-score for the area-oriented metric considered here, and that the new $\Hset$-aware certificates track the realized size of the selected localization set closely.
summary_zh: 本文研究了在未知有界测量误差下，基于测距定位的锚点选择问题。我们从最近在\cite{CalafioreSIAM}中提出的凸定位集$\X=\Xd\cap\Hset$出发，其中$\Xd$是由未知位置$x$与锚点之间平方测距方程的成对差异得到的多面体，而$\Hset$是上限测距超球的交集。我们的首要目标是\emph{离线}设计：我们从中心散射矩阵$S(A)=AQ_mA\tran$中推导出仅与几何相关的E型和D型得分，其中$A$收集锚点坐标，$Q_m=I_m-\frac{1}{m}\one\one\tran$是中心投影算子。我们证明了$λ_{\min}(S(A))$控制多面体证书$\Xd$的最坏方向和直径替代指标，而$\det S(A)$控制主轴体积替代指标。我们的第二个目标是针对选定锚点子集的\emph{在线}不确定性评估：利用$\X=\Xd\cap\Hset$的特殊结构，我们推导出$\Hset$的单纯形聚合包络球以及$\Hset$的精确支撑函数公式，即使在多面体证书恶化的情况下，也能为实际定位集$\X$提供有限混合界限。数值实验在二维中进行，结果表明基于几何的子集选择接近于神谕组合搜索，对于此处考虑的面向面积的度量而言，D得分略优于E得分，并且新的$\Hset$感知证书能够紧密跟踪所选定位集的实际大小。
tldr: This paper focuses on anchor selection for range-based localization with bounded measurement errors, deriving geometry-based scores for offline design and uncertainty assessment methods for online implementation with tighter bounds. Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了在有界测量误差下，基于范围的定位中的锚点选择问题。推导了几何信息驱动的离线设计评分，并针对在线实施提出了一种不确定性评估方法来获得更紧密的边界。数值实验验证了该方法的有效性。

title: H-RINS: Hierarchical Tightly-coupled Radar-Inertial Navigation via Smoothing and Mapping
summary: Millimeter-wave radar provides robust perception in visually degraded environments. However, radar-inertial state estimation is inherently susceptible to drift. Because radar yields only sparse, body-frame velocity measurements, it provides weak constraints on absolute orientation. Consequently, IMU biases remain poorly observable over the short time horizons typical of sliding-window filters. To address this fundamental observability challenge, we propose a tightly coupled, hierarchical radar-inertial factor graph framework. Our architecture decouples the estimation problem into a high-rate resetting graph and a persistent global graph. The resetting graph fuses IMU preintegration, radar velocities, and adaptive Zero-Velocity Updates (ZUPT) to generate the smooth, low-latency odometry required for real-time control. Concurrently, the persistent graph is a full-state factor graph maintaining the complete information of poses, velocities, and biases by fusing inertial data with keyframe-based geometric mapping and loop closures. Leveraging Incremental Smoothing and Mapping, the persistent graph can operate without explicit marginalization of variables, preserving their information while ensuring long-term bias observability. The cornerstone of our approach is a probabilistic tight-coupling mechanism: fully observable, optimized biases and their exact covariances are continuously injected from the persistent graph into the resetting graph's prior, effectively anchoring the high-rate estimator against integration drift. Extensive evaluations demonstrate our system achieves high accuracy with drift-reduced estimation at 27x real-time execution speeds. We release the implementation code and datasets upon the acceptance of the paper.
summary_zh: 毫米波雷达在视觉退化的环境中提供了稳健的感知能力。然而，雷达惯性状态估计本质上容易受到漂移的影响。由于雷达仅产生稀疏的、本体坐标系下的速度测量，它对绝对姿态提供的约束较弱。因此，在滑动窗口滤波器典型的短时间内，IMU偏差仍然难以观测。为了应对这一基本的可观测性挑战，我们提出了一种紧耦合的、分层的雷达惯性因子图框架。我们的架构将估计问题解耦为一个高频率重置图和一个持久的全局图。重置图融合了IMU预积分、雷达速度和自适应的零速更新（ZUPT），以生成实时控制所需的平滑、低延迟的里程计。同时，持久图是一个完整的状态因子图，通过融合惯性数据与基于关键帧的几何地图和闭环检测，维护姿态、速度和偏差的完整信息。利用增量平滑与建图，持久图可以在没有变量显式边缘化的情况下运行，在保留其信息的同时保证长期偏差的可观测性。我们方法的基石是一种概率紧耦合机制：完全可观测的、优化的偏差及其精确的协方差从持久图中连续注入重置图的先验中，从而有效地将高频率估计器锚定，防止积分漂移。大量的评估表明，我们的系统实现了高精度，并在27倍实时执行速度下实现了漂移减少的估计。我们将在论文被接受后发布实现代码和数据集。
tldr: This paper presents H-RINS, a hierarchical radar-inertial navigation system that tightly couples a high-rate resetting graph with a persistent global graph to achieve accurate and drift-reduced state estimation, particularly in visually degraded environments, running at 27x real-time.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文提出了 H-RINS，一个分层雷达-惯性导航系统，它将一个高速率重置图和一个持久的全局图紧密耦合，以实现精确且漂移减少的状态估计，尤其是在视觉退化的环境中，并以 27 倍的实时速度运行。

title: STAG-CN: Spatio-Temporal Apiary Graph Convolutional Network for Disease Onset Prediction in Beehive Sensor Networks
summary: Honey bee colony losses threaten global pollination services, yet current monitoring systems treat each hive as an isolated unit, ignoring the spatial pathways through which diseases spread across apiaries. This paper introduces the Spatio-Temporal Apiary Graph Convolutional Network (STAG-CN), a graph neural network that models inter-hive relationships for disease onset prediction. STAG-CN operates on a dual adjacency graph combining physical co-location and climatic sensor correlation among hive sessions, and processes multivariate IoT sensor streams through a temporal--spatial--temporal sandwich architecture built on causal dilated convolutions and Chebyshev spectral graph convolutions. Evaluated on the Korean AI Hub apiculture dataset (dataset \#71488) with expanding-window temporal cross-validation, STAG-CN achieves an F1 score of 0.607 at a three-day forecast horizon. An ablation study reveals that the climatic adjacency matrix alone matches full-model performance (F1\,=\,0.607), while the physical adjacency alone yields F1\,=\,0.274, indicating that shared environmental response patterns carry stronger predictive signal than spatial proximity for disease onset. These results establish a proof-of-concept for graph-based biosecurity monitoring in precision apiculture, demonstrating that inter-hive sensor correlations encode disease-relevant information invisible to single-hive approaches.
summary_zh: 蜜蜂蜂群的损失威胁着全球的授粉服务，然而目前的监测系统将每个蜂箱视为一个孤立的单元，忽略了疾病在蜂场间传播的空间路径。本文介绍了一种时空蜂场图卷积网络 (STAG-CN)，这是一种对蜂箱间关系进行建模以预测疾病发生的图神经网络。STAG-CN 基于双邻接图运行，该图结合了蜂箱会话间的物理共址和气候传感器相关性，并通过基于因果扩张卷积和切比雪夫谱图卷积构建的时序-空间-时序三明治架构处理多元物联网传感器流。在韩国 AI Hub 养蜂数据集（数据集 \#71488）上，通过扩展窗口时序交叉验证进行评估，STAG-CN 在三天预测范围内达到了 0.607 的 F1 分数。消融研究表明，仅气候邻接矩阵即可匹配完整模型的性能（F1 = 0.607），而仅物理邻接矩阵产生 F1 = 0.274，表明对于疾病发生，共享的环境响应模式比空间邻近性携带更强的预测信号。这些结果为精准养蜂中的基于图的生物安全监测建立了概念验证，证明了蜂箱间传感器相关性编码了单蜂箱方法不可见的疾病相关信息。
tldr: The paper introduces STAG-CN, a spatio-temporal graph convolutional network, to predict disease onset in beehives using sensor data and graph-based inter-hive relationships, showing that climatic sensor correlations are more important than physical proximity for prediction.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了STAG-CN，一种时空图卷积网络，利用传感器数据和基于图的蜂箱间关系来预测蜂箱疾病的发生，结果表明气候传感器相关性对于预测比物理邻近更重要。

title: In-Field 3D Wheat Head Instance Segmentation From TLS Point Clouds Using Deep Learning Without Manual Labels
summary: 3D instance segmentation for laser scanning (LiDAR) point clouds remains a challenge in many remote sensing-related domains. Successful solutions typically rely on supervised deep learning and manual annotations, and consequently focus on objects that can be well delineated through visual inspection and manual labeling of point clouds. However, for tasks with more complex and cluttered scenes, such as in-field plant phenotyping in agriculture, such approaches are often infeasible. In this study, we tackle the task of in-field wheat head instance segmentation directly from terrestrial laser scanning (TLS) point clouds. To address the problem and circumvent the need for manual annotations, we propose a novel two-stage pipeline. To obtain the initial 3D instance proposals, the first stage uses 3D-to-2D multi-view projections, the Grounded SAM pipeline for zero-shot 2D object-centric segmentation, and multi-view label fusion. The second stage uses these initial proposals as noisy pseudo-labels to train a supervised 3D panoptic-style segmentation neural network. Our results demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed approach and show performance improvementsrelative to Wheat3DGS, a recent alternative solution for in-field wheat head instance segmentation without manual 3D annotations based on multi-view RGB images and 3D Gaussian Splatting, showcasing TLS as a competitive sensing alternative. Moreover, the results show that both stages of the proposed pipeline can deliver usable 3D instance segmentation without manual annotations, indicating promising, low-effort transferability to other comparable TLS-based point cloud segmentation tasks.
summary_zh: 激光扫描(LiDAR)点云的3D实例分割在许多遥感相关领域仍然面临挑战。成功的解决方案通常依赖于有监督的深度学习和手动标注，因此主要集中于可以通过目视检查和点云手动标注清晰描绘的对象。然而，对于场景更加复杂和杂乱的任务，例如农业中的田间植物表型分析，这些方法通常不可行。在本研究中，我们直接从地面激光扫描(TLS)点云中解决田间麦穗实例分割的任务。为了解决该问题并规避手动标注的需求，我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段流程。为了获得初始的3D实例提议，第一阶段采用3D到2D的多视角投影、用于零样本2D以对象为中心的分割的Grounded SAM流程以及多视图标签融合。第二阶段使用这些初始提议作为噪声伪标签，来训练一个有监督的3D全景式分割神经网络。我们的结果证明了所提出方法的可行性，并显示出相对于Wheat3DGS的性能提升，后者是最近一种基于多视角RGB图像和3D高斯溅射的、无需手动3D标注的田间麦穗实例分割替代解决方案，从而表明TLS是一种具有竞争力的传感替代方案。此外，结果表明，所提出的流程的两个阶段都可以提供可用的、无需手动标注的3D实例分割，表明该方法具有有希望的、低成本的可迁移性，可用于其他类似的基于TLS的点云分割任务。
tldr: The paper presents a novel two-stage deep learning pipeline for 3D wheat head instance segmentation from TLS point clouds without manual labels, using Grounded SAM and panoptic-style segmentation, demonstrating competitive performance relative to alternative methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新颖的两阶段深度学习流程，用于从TLS点云中进行3D小麦头实例分割，无需手动标签。该流程使用Grounded SAM和全景分割，并展示了相对于其他方法的竞争性能。

title: Semi-Automatic Flute Robot and Its Acoustic Sensing
summary: Flute performance requires mastery of complex fingering combinations and register-dependent embouchure control, particularly jet offset adjustment for low-register production. Existing haptic and semi-automated systems do not address both aspects simultaneously through mechanical actuation. To our knowledge, no prior system fully automates fingering while mechanically assisting low-register tone production without requiring embouchure control. We developed a semi-automatic flute robot with an automatic fingering mechanism: fourteen servo motors actuate all keys via wire-based and rack-and-pinion drives in response to MIDI input, enabling performers to produce complete musical pieces through airflow alone. A jet offset assist mechanism rotates the head joint by a calibrated $22^\circ$ during low-register passages, shifting the jet offset toward a low-register configuration without modifying the instrument or embouchure. Fundamental frequency estimation confirmed correct pitch production across the chromatic range (C4--C7) and during musical performance. All key and lever movements were completed within 77.50~ms, corresponding to tempo capacity exceeding standard requirements. Harmonic analysis ($Δ\mathrm{SPL} = \mathrm{SPL}_2 - \mathrm{SPL}_3$) showed a consistent increase in $Δ$SPL for all low-register notes when activated, consistent with the intended jet offset shift. Head joint rotation completed within 40.00~ms. These results demonstrate mechanical feasibility of integrating automated fingering and register-dependent jet offset assistance under controlled conditions.
summary_zh: 长笛演奏需要精通复杂指法组合以及依赖于音区变化的口风控制，特别是低音区发音所需的喷射偏置调整。现有的触觉和半自动化系统并未通过机械驱动同时解决这两个方面。据我们所知，此前没有系统能在无需口风控制的情况下，在机械辅助低音区发音的同时，完全自动化指法。我们开发了一种半自动长笛机器人，配备自动指法机制：十四个伺服电机通过基于导线和齿轮齿条传动的方式，根据MIDI输入来驱动所有键，使演奏者仅通过气流即可演奏完整的乐曲。喷射偏置辅助机制在低音区乐段期间将头管旋转校准后的22°，从而在不改变乐器或口风的情况下，将喷射偏置调整到低音区配置。基频估计证实了在整个半音阶范围（C4--C7）和音乐演奏过程中音高的准确产生。所有琴键和杠杆的运动都在77.50毫秒内完成，对应的速度能力超过了标准要求。谐波分析（$Δ\mathrm{SPL} = \mathrm{SPL}_2 - \mathrm{SPL}_3$）表明，激活后所有低音区音符的$Δ$SPL均一致增加，与预期的喷射偏置改变一致。头管旋转在40.00毫秒内完成。这些结果证明了在受控条件下集成自动化指法和依赖于音区的喷射偏置辅助在机械上的可行性。
tldr: The paper presents a semi-automatic flute robot that automates fingering and provides mechanical assistance for low-register tone production by adjusting the head joint, demonstrating feasibility through pitch and harmonic analysis.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种半自动长笛机器人，通过自动化指法和机械辅助低音区发声（通过调整吹口），并通过音高和泛音分析证明了其可行性。

title: Inclusive AI for Group Interactions: Predicting Gaze-Direction Behaviors in People with Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities
summary: Artificial agents that support human group interactions hold great promise, especially in sensitive contexts such as well-being promotion and therapeutic interventions. However, current systems struggle to mediate group interactions involving people who are not neurotypical. This limitation arises because most AI detection models (e.g., for turn-taking) are trained on data from neurotypical populations. This work takes a step toward inclusive AI by addressing the challenge of eye contact detection, a core component of non-verbal communication, with and for people with Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities. First, we introduce a new dataset, Multi-party Interaction with Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities (MIDD), capturing atypical gaze and engagement patterns. Second, we present the results of a comparative analysis with neurotypical datasets, highlighting differences in class imbalance, speaking activity, gaze distribution, and interaction dynamics. Then, we evaluate classifiers ranging from SVMs to FSFNet, showing that fine-tuning on MIDD improves performance, though notable limitations remain. Finally, we present the insights gathered through a focus group with six therapists to interpret our quantitative findings and understand the practical implications of atypical gaze and engagement patterns. Based on these results, we discuss data-driven strategies and emphasize the importance of feature choice for building more inclusive human-centered tools.
summary_zh: 支持人类群体互动的智能体具有广阔的应用前景，尤其是在诸如福利促进和治疗干预等敏感领域。然而，当前的系统难以调解涉及非典型神经人群体的群体互动。这一局限性的产生是因为大多数AI检测模型（例如，用于轮流发言的检测模型）都是使用来自典型神经人群的数据训练的。这项工作通过解决目光接触检测这一挑战，朝着构建更具包容性的AI迈出一步，目光接触是非语言交流的核心组成部分，且与智力和发育障碍人士息息相关。首先，我们引入一个新的数据集，即智力和发育障碍人士参与的多方互动（MIDD），用于捕捉非典型的注视和参与模式。其次，我们展示了与典型神经数据集进行比较分析的结果，突出了类别不平衡、说话活动、注视分布和互动动态方面的差异。然后，我们评估了从支持向量机（SVM）到FSFNet的各种分类器，结果表明在MIDD上进行微调可以提高性能，但仍然存在明显的局限性。最后，我们展示了通过与六位治疗师进行的焦点小组访谈收集的见解，以解释我们的定量研究结果并了解非典型注视和参与模式的实际意义。基于这些结果，我们讨论了数据驱动的策略，并强调了特征选择对于构建更具包容性的人工智能工具的重要性。
tldr: This paper introduces a new dataset (MIDD) of multi-party interactions with individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities and explores the challenges of gaze detection to build more inclusive AI systems, showing that fine-tuning helps but limitations remain, with insights from therapists adding practical context.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个新的数据集(MIDD)，该数据集包含智力和发育障碍人士的多方互动，并探讨了注视检测的挑战，以构建更具包容性的人工智能系统。结果表明，微调有所帮助，但仍然存在局限性，来自治疗师的见解增加了实际背景。

title: Towards Generalizable Robotic Manipulation in Dynamic Environments
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel in static manipulation but struggle in dynamic environments with moving targets. This performance gap primarily stems from a scarcity of dynamic manipulation datasets and the reliance of mainstream VLAs on single-frame observations, restricting their spatiotemporal reasoning capabilities. To address this, we introduce DOMINO, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for generalizable dynamic manipulation, featuring 35 tasks with hierarchical complexities, over 110K expert trajectories, and a multi-dimensional evaluation suite. Through comprehensive experiments, we systematically evaluate existing VLAs on dynamic tasks, explore effective training strategies for dynamic awareness, and validate the generalizability of dynamic data. Furthermore, we propose PUMA, a dynamics-aware VLA architecture. By integrating scene-centric historical optical flow and specialized world queries to implicitly forecast object-centric future states, PUMA couples history-aware perception with short-horizon prediction. Results demonstrate that PUMA achieves state-of-the-art performance, yielding a 6.3% absolute improvement in success rate over baselines. Moreover, we show that training on dynamic data fosters robust spatiotemporal representations that transfer to static tasks. All code and data are available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/DOMINO.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型在静态操作中表现出色，但在具有移动目标的动态环境中表现不佳。这种性能差距主要源于动态操作数据集的稀缺，以及主流 VLA 模型对单帧观测的依赖，限制了其时空推理能力。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 DOMINO，一个用于可泛化动态操作的大规模数据集和基准，包含 35 个具有层级复杂度的任务、超过 11 万条专家轨迹以及一个多维度评估套件。通过全面的实验，我们系统地评估了现有 VLA 模型在动态任务中的表现，探索了用于动态感知的有效训练策略，并验证了动态数据的泛化性。此外，我们提出了 PUMA，一个动态感知型 VLA 架构。通过集成以场景为中心的历史光流和专门的世界查询来隐式地预测以物体为中心的未来状态，PUMA 将历史感知与短时程预测相结合。结果表明，PUMA 达到了最先进的性能，在成功率上比基线模型取得了 6.3% 的绝对提升。此外，我们证明了在动态数据上进行训练可以培养鲁棒的时空表征，并迁移到静态任务中。所有代码和数据均可在 https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/DOMINO 上获取。
tldr: The paper introduces DOMINO, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for dynamic robotic manipulation, and PUMA, a dynamics-aware VLA architecture, demonstrating improved performance and generalizability in dynamic environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DOMINO，一个用于动态机器人操作的大规模数据集和基准测试，以及PUMA，一个动态感知的 VLA 架构，展示了在动态环境中改进的性能和泛化能力。

title: From Passive Observer to Active Critic: Reinforcement Learning Elicits Process Reasoning for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Accurate process supervision remains a critical challenge for long-horizon robotic manipulation. A primary bottleneck is that current video MLLMs, trained primarily under a Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) paradigm, function as passive "Observers" that recognize ongoing events rather than evaluating the current state relative to the final task goal. In this paper, we introduce PRIMO R1 (Process Reasoning Induced Monitoring), a 7B framework that transforms video MLLMs into active "Critics". We leverage outcome-based Reinforcement Learning to incentivize explicit Chain-of-Thought generation for progress estimation. Furthermore, our architecture constructs a structured temporal input by explicitly anchoring the video sequence between initial and current state images. Supported by the proposed PRIMO Dataset and Benchmark, extensive experiments across diverse in-domain environments and out-of-domain real-world humanoid scenarios demonstrate that PRIMO R1 achieves state-of-the-art performance. Quantitatively, our 7B model achieves a 50% reduction in the mean absolute error of specialized reasoning baselines, demonstrating significant relative accuracy improvements over 72B-scale general MLLMs. Furthermore, PRIMO R1 exhibits strong zero-shot generalization on difficult failure detection tasks. We establish state-of-the-art performance on RoboFail benchmark with 67.0% accuracy, surpassing closed-source models like OpenAI o1 by 6.0%.
summary_zh: 精确的过程监控仍然是长程机器人操作的一个关键挑战。一个主要的瓶颈在于，当前主要在监督微调 (SFT) 范式下训练的视频多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 作为被动的“观察者”发挥作用，识别正在发生的事件，而不是根据最终任务目标评估当前状态。在本文中，我们引入了 PRIMO R1 (过程推理引导的监控)，一个将视频多模态大语言模型转化为主动“评论员”的 7B 框架。我们利用基于结果的强化学习来激励显式的思维链生成，以进行进度估计。此外，我们的架构通过显式地将视频序列锚定在初始状态和当前状态图像之间，来构建一个结构化的时间输入。在所提出的 PRIMO 数据集和基准测试的支持下，跨不同领域内环境和领域外真实世界人形机器人场景的大量实验表明，PRIMO R1 实现了最先进的性能。定量地讲，我们的 7B 模型实现了专业推理基线平均绝对误差的 50% 降低，表明相对于 72B 规模的通用多模态大语言模型，相对准确度得到了显著提高。此外，PRIMO R1 在困难的故障检测任务中表现出强大的零样本泛化能力。我们在 RoboFail 基准测试上建立了最先进的性能，准确率为 67.0%，超过了像 OpenAI o1 这样的闭源模型 6.0%。
tldr: The paper introduces PRIMO R1, a reinforcement learning framework that transforms video MLLMs into active "Critics" for process supervision in robotic manipulation, achieving state-of-the-art performance and strong zero-shot generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PRIMO R1，一个强化学习框架，将视频 MLLM 转变为主动 "评论家"，用于机器人操作中的过程监督，实现了最先进的性能和强大的零样本泛化。

title: MA-VLCM: A Vision Language Critic Model for Value Estimation of Policies in Multi-Agent Team Settings
summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) commonly relies on a centralized critic to estimate the value function. However, learning such a critic from scratch is highly sample-inefficient and often lacks generalization across environments. At the same time, large vision-language-action models (VLAs) trained on internet-scale data exhibit strong multimodal reasoning and zero-shot generalization capabilities, yet directly deploying them for robotic execution remains computationally prohibitive, particularly in heterogeneous multi-robot systems with diverse embodiments and resource constraints. To address these challenges, we propose Multi-Agent Vision-Language-Critic Models (MA-VLCM), a framework that replaces the learned centralized critic in MARL with a pretrained vision-language model fine-tuned to evaluate multi-agent behavior. MA-VLCM acts as a centralized critic conditioned on natural language task descriptions, visual trajectory observations, and structured multi-agent state information. By eliminating critic learning during policy optimization, our approach significantly improves sample efficiency while producing compact execution policies suitable for deployment on resource-constrained robots. Results show good zero-shot return estimation on models with differing VLM backbones on in-distribution and out-of-distribution scenarios in multi-agent team settings
summary_zh: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）通常依赖于一个中心化的评论家来估计价值函数。然而，从零开始学习这样的评论家非常耗费样本，并且常常缺乏跨环境的泛化能力。与此同时，在互联网规模数据上训练的大型视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）展现出强大的多模态推理和零样本泛化能力，但直接将其部署于机器人执行仍然在计算上是令人难以想象的，尤其是在具有不同形态和资源约束的异构多机器人系统中。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了多智能体视觉-语言-评论家模型（MA-VLCM），该框架用一个经过微调的预训练视觉-语言模型来替代MARL中学习的中心化评论家，以评估多智能体行为。MA-VLCM充当一个中心化的评论家，其以自然语言任务描述、视觉轨迹观测和结构化的多智能体状态信息为条件。通过消除策略优化期间的评论家学习，我们的方法显著提高了样本效率，同时生成了适用于部署在资源受限机器人上的紧凑型执行策略。结果表明，在多智能体团队环境中，使用不同VLM骨干的模型在同分布和异分布情况下都表现出良好的零样本回报估计。
tldr: The paper introduces MA-VLCM, a framework that replaces the learned centralized critic in MARL with a fine-tuned vision-language model, improving sample efficiency and enabling deployment on resource-constrained robots by leveraging VLMs for multi-agent behavior evaluation conditioned on language task descriptions.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了MA-VLCM，一个使用微调的视觉-语言模型替代MARL中学习的中心化评论器的框架。通过利用VLM进行多智能体行为评估，并以语言任务描述为条件，从而提高样本效率，并能够在资源受限的机器人上部署。

title: NavThinker: Action-Conditioned World Models for Coupled Prediction and Planning in Social Navigation
summary: Social navigation requires robots to act safely in dynamic human environments. Effective behavior demands thinking ahead: reasoning about how the scene and pedestrians evolve under different robot actions rather than reacting to current observations alone. This creates a coupled prediction-planning challenge, where robot actions and human motion mutually influence each other. To address this challenge, we propose NavThinker, a future-aware framework that couples an action-conditioned world model with on-policy reinforcement learning. The world model operates in the Depth Anything V2 patch feature space and performs autoregressive prediction of future scene geometry and human motion; multi-head decoders then produce future depth maps and human trajectories, yielding a future-aware state aligned with traversability and interaction risk. Crucially, we train the policy with DD-PPO while injecting world-model think-ahead signals via: (i) action-conditioned future features fused into the current observation embedding and (ii) social reward shaping from predicted human trajectories. Experiments on single- and multi-robot Social-HM3D show state-of-the-art navigation success, with zero-shot transfer to Social-MP3D and real-world deployment on a Unitree Go2, validating generalization and practical applicability. Webpage: https://github.com/hutslib/NavThinker.
summary_zh: 社交导航要求机器人在动态的人类环境中安全行动。有效的行为需要前瞻性思考：推断场景和行人如何在不同的机器人动作下演变，而不是仅仅对当前的观察做出反应。这产生了一个耦合的预测-规划挑战，即机器人动作和人类运动相互影响。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出NavThinker，一个具有未来意识的框架，它将一个动作条件化的世界模型与在策略强化学习相结合。世界模型在Depth Anything V2补丁特征空间中运行，并执行未来场景几何结构和人类运动的自回归预测；然后，多头解码器生成未来的深度图和人类轨迹，从而产生一个具有未来意识的状态，该状态与可通行性和交互风险对齐。至关重要的是，我们使用DD-PPO训练策略，同时通过以下方式注入世界模型的前瞻性思考信号：（i）动作条件化的未来特征，融合到当前的观察嵌入中，以及（ii）来自预测的人类轨迹的社交奖励塑造。在单机器人和多机器人Social-HM3D上的实验表明了最先进的导航成功率，并实现了到Social-MP3D的零样本迁移以及在宇树Go2上的真实世界部署，验证了泛化能力和实际适用性。 网页：https://github.com/hutslib/NavThinker。
tldr: NavThinker proposes an action-conditioned world model for social navigation, coupling future prediction with reinforcement learning, demonstrating superior performance in simulated and real-world environments.
tldr_zh: NavThinker 提出了一个用于社交导航的动作条件世界模型，将未来预测与强化学习相结合，并在模拟和真实环境中展示了卓越的性能。

title: AnoleVLA: Lightweight Vision-Language-Action Model with Deep State Space Models for Mobile Manipulation
summary: In this study, we address the problem of language-guided robotic manipulation, where a robot is required to manipulate a wide range of objects based on visual observations and natural language instructions. This task is essential for service robots that operate in human environments, and requires safety, efficiency, and task-level generality. Although Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have demonstrated strong performance for this task, their deployment in resource-constrained environments remains challenging because of the computational cost of standard transformer backbones. To overcome this limitation, we propose AnoleVLA, a lightweight VLA that uses a deep state space model to process multimodal sequences efficiently. The model leverages its lightweight and fast sequential state modeling to process visual and textual inputs, which allows the robot to generate trajectories efficiently. We evaluated the proposed method in both simulation and physical experiments. Notably, in real-world evaluations, AnoleVLA outperformed a representative large-scale VLA by 21 points for the task success rate while achieving an inference speed approximately three times faster.
summary_zh: 本研究探讨了语言引导的机器人操作问题，即要求机器人能够根据视觉观测和自然语言指令来操作各种物体。这项任务对于在人类环境中运行的服务型机器人至关重要，并要求具备安全性、效率和任务层面的通用性。虽然视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）已在该任务上展现出强大的性能，但由于标准Transformer骨干网络计算成本高昂，它们在资源受限环境中的部署仍然具有挑战性。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种轻量级VLA——AnoleVLA，它使用深度状态空间模型来高效处理多模态序列。该模型利用其轻量且快速的序列状态建模能力来处理视觉和文本输入，从而使机器人能够高效地生成轨迹。我们在仿真和物理实验中对所提出的方法进行了评估。值得注意的是，在真实环境评估中，AnoleVLA在任务成功率方面比一个具有代表性的大规模VLA高出21个百分点，同时推理速度快了大约三倍。
tldr: AnoleVLA is presented as a lightweight vision-language-action model using deep state space models. It achieves higher task success rates and faster inference speeds than large-scale VLAs in real-world robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: AnoleVLA是一个轻量级的视觉-语言-动作模型，它利用深度状态空间模型。在真实世界的机器人操作任务中，其任务成功率更高，推理速度比大型视觉-语言-动作模型更快。

title: AutoMoT: A Unified Vision-Language-Action Model with Asynchronous Mixture-of-Transformers for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Integrating vision-language models (VLMs) into end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving (AD) systems has shown promise in improving scene understanding. However, existing integration strategies suffer from several limitations: they either struggle to resolve distribution misalignment between reasoning and action spaces, underexploit the general reasoning capabilities of pretrained VLMs, or incur substantial inference latency during action policy generation, which degrades driving performance. To address these challenges, we propose \OURS in this work, an end-to-end AD framework that unifies reasoning and action generation within a single vision-language-action (VLA) model. Our approach leverages a mixture-of-transformer (MoT) architecture with joint attention sharing, which preserves the general reasoning capabilities of pre-trained VLMs while enabling efficient fast-slow inference through asynchronous execution at different task frequencies. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks, under both open- and closed-loop settings, demonstrate that \OURS achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art methods. We further investigate the functional boundary of pre-trained VLMs in AD, examining when AD-tailored fine-tuning is necessary. Our results show that pre-trained VLMs can achieve competitive multi-task scene understanding performance through semantic prompting alone, while fine-tuning remains essential for action-level tasks such as decision-making and trajectory planning. We refer to \href{https://automot-website.github.io/}{Project Page} for the demonstration videos and qualitative results.
summary_zh: 将视觉-语言模型（VLMs）集成到端到端（E2E）自动驾驶（AD）系统已显示出改进场景理解的潜力。然而，现有的集成策略存在若干局限性：它们要么难以解决推理空间和动作空间之间的分布不匹配问题，要么未能充分利用预训练VLMs的通用推理能力，要么在动作策略生成过程中产生显著的推理延迟，从而降低驾驶性能。为了解决这些挑战，我们在本文中提出了\OURS，一个端到端的AD框架，它将推理和动作生成统一在一个单一的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中。我们的方法利用了一种具有联合注意力共享的混合Transformer（MoT）架构，它保留了预训练VLMs的通用推理能力，同时通过在不同任务频率下的异步执行，实现了高效的快慢推理。在多个基准数据集上，在开放循环和闭环设置下的广泛实验表明，与最先进的方法相比，\OURS实现了具有竞争力的性能。我们进一步研究了预训练VLMs在AD中的功能边界，考察了何时需要针对AD的微调。我们的结果表明，预训练VLMs可以通过语义提示来实现具有竞争力的多任务场景理解性能，而微调对于决策和轨迹规划等动作级别任务仍然至关重要。我们参考\href{https://automot-website.github.io/}{项目页面}以获取演示视频和定性结果。
tldr: The paper introduces AutoMoT, an end-to-end autonomous driving framework that uses a unified vision-language-action model with a mixture-of-transformer architecture for efficient reasoning and action generation, showing competitive performance on various benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了一种名为AutoMoT的端到端自动驾驶框架，该框架使用统一的视觉-语言-动作模型和混合Transformer架构，以进行高效的推理和动作生成，并在多个基准测试中表现出竞争性的性能。

title: D-MEM: Dopamine-Gated Agentic Memory via Reward Prediction Error Routing
summary: Autonomous LLM agents require structured long-term memory, yet current "append-and-evolve" systems like A-MEM face O(N^2) write-latency and excessive token costs. We introduce D-MEM (Dopamine-Gated Agentic Memory), a biologically inspired architecture that decouples short-term interaction from cognitive restructuring via a Fast/Slow routing system based on Reward Prediction Error (RPE). A lightweight Critic Router evaluates stimuli for Surprise and Utility. Routine, low-RPE inputs are bypassed or cached in an O(1) fast-access buffer. Conversely, high-RPE inputs, such as factual contradictions or preference shifts, trigger a "dopamine" signal, activating the O(N) memory evolution pipeline to reshape the agent's knowledge graph. To evaluate performance under realistic conditions, we introduce the LoCoMo-Noise benchmark, which injects controlled conversational noise into long-term sessions. Evaluations demonstrate that D-MEM reduces token consumption by over 80%, eliminates O(N^2) bottlenecks, and outperforms baselines in multi-hop reasoning and adversarial resilience. By selectively gating cognitive restructuring, D-MEM provides a scalable, cost-efficient foundation for lifelong agentic memory.
summary_zh: 自主LLM智能体需要结构化的长期记忆，但现有的“追加-演化”系统，如A-MEM，面临O(N^2)的写入延迟和过高的Token成本。我们引入D-MEM（多巴胺门控智能体记忆），一种受生物学启发的架构，它通过基于奖励预测误差(RPE)的快/慢路由系统，将短期交互与认知重构解耦。一个轻量级的评论家路由评估刺激的惊奇度和效用。常规的、低RPE的输入被绕过或缓存在O(1)快速访问缓冲区中。相反，高RPE的输入，如事实矛盾或偏好转变，会触发一个“多巴胺”信号，激活O(N)的记忆演化流水线，以重塑智能体的知识图谱。为了在实际条件下评估性能，我们引入了LoCoMo-Noise基准，它将受控的对话噪声注入到长期会话中。评估表明，D-MEM将Token消耗降低了80%以上，消除了O(N^2)的瓶颈，并在多跳推理和对抗性鲁棒性方面优于基线。通过选择性地门控认知重构，D-MEM为终身智能体记忆提供了一个可扩展、经济高效的基础。
tldr: D-MEM introduces a biologically inspired memory architecture for LLM agents that uses reward prediction error (RPE) to selectively update long-term memory, reducing token consumption and improving performance in long-term reasoning and adversarial resilience.
tldr_zh: D-MEM提出了一种受生物学启发的LLM Agent记忆架构，该架构使用奖励预测误差（RPE）选择性地更新长期记忆，从而减少token消耗并提高长期推理和鲁棒性。

title: Look Before Acting: Enhancing Vision Foundation Representations for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation, in which reliable action prediction critically depends on accurately interpreting and integrating visual observations conditioned on language instructions. Although recent works have sought to enhance the visual capabilities of VLA models, most approaches treat the LLM backbone as a black box, providing limited insight into how visual information is grounded into action generation. Therefore, we perform a systematic analysis of multiple VLA models across different action-generation paradigms and observe that sensitivity to visual tokens progressively decreases in deeper layers during action generation. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{DeepVision-VLA}, built on a \textbf{Vision-Language Mixture-of-Transformers (VL-MoT)} framework. This framework enables shared attention between the vision foundation model and the VLA backbone, injecting multi-level visual features from the vision expert into deeper layers of the VLA backbone to enhance visual representations for precise and complex manipulation. In addition, we introduce \textbf{Action-Guided Visual Pruning (AGVP)}, which leverages shallow-layer attention to prune irrelevant visual tokens while preserving task-relevant ones, reinforcing critical visual cues for manipulation with minimal computational overhead. DeepVision-VLA outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods by 9.0\% and 7.5\% on simulated and real-world tasks, respectively, providing new insights for the design of visually enhanced VLA models.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型最近作为一种有前景的机器人操作范式出现，其中可靠的动作预测关键取决于准确地解释和整合以语言指令为条件的视觉观察。尽管最近的研究试图增强 VLA 模型的视觉能力，但大多数方法将 LLM 主干视为黑盒，对视觉信息如何融入到动作生成中提供的 insights 有限。因此，我们对跨越不同动作生成范式的多个 VLA 模型进行了系统分析，并观察到在动作生成过程中，对视觉 token 的敏感度在更深的层中逐渐降低。受此观察的启发，我们提出了 \textbf{DeepVision-VLA}，它建立在一个 \textbf{视觉-语言混合 Transformer (VL-MoT)} 框架之上。该框架实现了视觉基础模型和 VLA 主干之间的共享注意力，并将来自视觉专家的多层视觉特征注入到 VLA 主干的更深层中，以增强视觉表示，从而实现精确而复杂的操作。此外，我们引入了 \textbf{动作引导的视觉剪枝 (AGVP)}，它利用浅层注意力来剪除不相关的视觉 token，同时保留与任务相关的 token，从而以最小的计算开销强化用于操作的关键视觉线索。DeepVision-VLA 在模拟和真实世界的任务中分别优于先前的最先进方法 9.0% 和 7.5%，为视觉增强的 VLA 模型的设计提供了新的见解。
tldr: This paper introduces DeepVision-VLA, a Vision-Language-Action model that enhances visual representations by injecting multi-level visual features into deeper layers and pruning irrelevant visual tokens, achieving state-of-the-art performance in robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 DeepVision-VLA，一种视觉-语言-动作模型，通过将多层视觉特征注入到更深层并修剪不相关的视觉标记来增强视觉表示，从而在机器人操作中实现了最先进的性能。

title: Trajectory-Diversity-Driven Robust Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to navigate photo-realistic environments following natural language instructions. Current methods predominantly rely on imitation learning, which suffers from limited generalization and poor robustness to execution perturbations. We present NavGRPO, a reinforcement learning framework that learns goal-directed navigation policies through Group Relative Policy Optimization. By exploring diverse trajectories and optimizing via within-group performance comparisons, our method enables agents to distinguish effective strategies beyond expert paths without requiring additional value networks. Built on ScaleVLN, NavGRPO achieves superior robustness on R2R and REVERIE benchmarks with +3.0% and +1.71% SPL improvements in unseen environments. Under extreme early-stage perturbations, we demonstrate +14.89% SPL gain over the baseline, confirming that goal-directed RL training builds substantially more robust navigation policies. Code and models will be released.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求智能体根据自然语言指令在逼真的照片环境中进行导航。当前的方法主要依赖于模仿学习，这存在泛化能力有限以及对执行扰动鲁棒性差的问题。我们提出 NavGRPO，一种强化学习框架，它通过群组相对策略优化来学习以目标为导向的导航策略。 通过探索多样化的轨迹并通过群组内的性能比较进行优化，我们的方法使智能体能够区分专家路径之外的有效策略，而无需额外的价值网络。 NavGRPO 构建于 ScaleVLN 之上，在 R2R 和 REVERIE 基准测试中获得了卓越的鲁棒性，在未见环境中 SPL 分别提高了 +3.0% 和 +1.71%。 在极端的早期阶段扰动下，我们的 SPL 增益超过基线 +14.89%，证实了以目标为导向的强化学习训练构建了更加鲁棒的导航策略。 代码和模型将开源。
tldr: The paper introduces NavGRPO, a reinforcement learning framework for Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) that uses group relative policy optimization to achieve robustness against execution perturbations, demonstrating improved performance on R2R and REVERIE benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种用于视觉语言导航的强化学习框架NavGRPO，它使用组相对策略优化来实现对执行扰动的鲁棒性，并在R2R和REVERIE基准测试中表现出改进的性能。

title: RealVLG-R1: A Large-Scale Real-World Visual-Language Grounding Benchmark for Robotic Perception and Manipulation
summary: Visual-language grounding aims to establish semantic correspondences between natural language and visual entities, enabling models to accurately identify and localize target objects based on textual instructions. Existing VLG approaches focus on coarse-grained, object-level localization, while traditional robotic grasping methods rely predominantly on geometric cues and lack language guidance, which limits their applicability in language-driven manipulation scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose the RealVLG framework, which integrates the RealVLG-11B dataset and the RealVLG-R1 model to unify real-world visual-language grounding and grasping tasks. RealVLG-11B dataset provides multi-granularity annotations including bounding boxes, segmentation masks, grasp poses, contact points, and human-verified fine-grained language descriptions, covering approximately 165,000 images, over 800 object instances, 1.3 million segmentation, detection, and language annotations, and roughly 11 billion grasping examples. Building on this dataset, RealVLG-R1 employs Reinforcement Fine-tuning on pretrained large-scale vision-language models to predict bounding boxes, segmentation masks, grasp poses, and contact points in a unified manner given natural language instructions. Experimental results demonstrate that RealVLG supports zero-shot perception and manipulation in real-world unseen environments, establishing a unified semantic-visual multimodal benchmark that provides a comprehensive data and evaluation platform for language-driven robotic perception and grasping policy learning. All data and code are publicly available at https://github.com/lif314/RealVLG-R1.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言对齐旨在建立自然语言和视觉实体之间的语义对应关系，使模型能够根据文本指令准确地识别和定位目标对象。 现有的视觉-语言对齐方法主要关注粗粒度的对象级定位，而传统的机器人抓取方法主要依赖于几何线索，缺乏语言引导，这限制了它们在语言驱动操作场景中的适用性。 为解决这些局限性，我们提出了RealVLG框架，该框架集成了RealVLG-11B数据集和RealVLG-R1模型，以统一现实世界的视觉-语言对齐和抓取任务。 RealVLG-11B数据集提供多粒度标注，包括边界框、分割掩码、抓取姿态、接触点和人工验证的细粒度语言描述，涵盖约165,000张图像、超过800个对象实例、130万个分割、检测和语言标注，以及约110亿个抓取示例。 在此数据集之上，RealVLG-R1采用对预训练的大规模视觉-语言模型进行强化微调的方法，以统一的方式预测自然语言指令下的边界框、分割掩码、抓取姿态和接触点。 实验结果表明，RealVLG支持真实世界未见环境中的零样本感知和操作，从而建立了一个统一的语义-视觉多模态基准，为语言驱动的机器人感知和抓取策略学习提供了全面的数据和评估平台。 所有数据和代码均可在 https://github.com/lif314/RealVLG-R1 上公开获取。
tldr: The paper introduces RealVLG-R1, a large-scale real-world visual-language grounding benchmark for robotic perception and manipulation, featuring a dataset (RealVLG-11B) and a model (RealVLG-R1) for unified grounding and grasping based on language instructions.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RealVLG-R1，一个大规模的真实世界视觉-语言接地的基准测试，用于机器人感知和操作。它包含一个数据集（RealVLG-11B）和一个模型（RealVLG-R1），用于基于语言指令的统一接地和抓取。

title: HSImul3R: Physics-in-the-Loop Reconstruction of Simulation-Ready Human-Scene Interactions
summary: We present HSImul3R, a unified framework for simulation-ready 3D reconstruction of human-scene interactions (HSI) from casual captures, including sparse-view images and monocular videos. Existing methods suffer from a perception-simulation gap: visually plausible reconstructions often violate physical constraints, leading to instability in physics engines and failure in embodied AI applications. To bridge this gap, we introduce a physically-grounded bi-directional optimization pipeline that treats the physics simulator as an active supervisor to jointly refine human dynamics and scene geometry. In the forward direction, we employ Scene-targeted Reinforcement Learning to optimize human motion under dual supervision of motion fidelity and contact stability. In the reverse direction, we propose Direct Simulation Reward Optimization, which leverages simulation feedback on gravitational stability and interaction success to refine scene geometry. We further present HSIBench, a new benchmark with diverse objects and interaction scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HSImul3R produces the first stable, simulation-ready HSI reconstructions and can be directly deployed to real-world humanoid robots.
summary_zh: 我们提出了HSImul3R，一个统一的框架，用于从随意拍摄的图像（包括稀疏视角的图像和单目视频）中进行可用于仿真的三维人类-场景交互（HSI）重建。现有方法受限于感知-仿真差距：视觉上合理的重建通常违反物理约束，导致物理引擎中的不稳定性和具身人工智能应用中的失败。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了一种物理驱动的双向优化流程，该流程将物理模拟器视为一个主动监督器，以联合优化人类动力学和场景几何。在正向方向，我们采用以场景为目标的强化学习，在运动保真度和接触稳定性的双重监督下，优化人类运动。在反向方向，我们提出了直接仿真奖励优化，该方法利用重力稳定性以及交互成功方面的仿真反馈来优化场景几何。我们进一步提出了HSIBench，一个新的基准，包含多种多样的物体和交互场景。大量的实验证明，HSImul3R 产生首批稳定、可用于仿真的 HSI 重建结果，并且可以直接部署到现实世界的人形机器人中。
tldr: HSImul3R presents a physics-in-the-loop framework for reconstructing simulation-ready human-scene interactions from casual captures, addressing the perception-simulation gap with a physically-grounded optimization pipeline and a new benchmark called HSIBench.
tldr_zh: HSImul3R 提出了一个物理在环框架，用于从偶然拍摄中重建可用于仿真的场景中人与人的互动，通过物理基础的优化管道和一个名为 HSIBench 的新基准来解决感知-仿真差距。

title: Panoramic Affordance Prediction
summary: Affordance prediction serves as a critical bridge between perception and action in embodied AI. However, existing research is confined to pinhole camera models, which suffer from narrow Fields of View (FoV) and fragmented observations, often missing critical holistic environmental context. In this paper, we present the first exploration into Panoramic Affordance Prediction, utilizing 360-degree imagery to capture global spatial relationships and holistic scene understanding. To facilitate this novel task, we first introduce PAP-12K, a large-scale benchmark dataset containing over 1,000 ultra-high-resolution (12k, 11904 x 5952) panoramic images with over 12k carefully annotated QA pairs and affordance masks. Furthermore, we propose PAP, a training-free, coarse-to-fine pipeline inspired by the human foveal visual system to tackle the ultra-high resolution and severe distortion inherent in panoramic images. PAP employs recursive visual routing via grid prompting to progressively locate targets, applies an adaptive gaze mechanism to rectify local geometric distortions, and utilizes a cascaded grounding pipeline to extract precise instance-level masks. Experimental results on PAP-12K reveal that existing affordance prediction methods designed for standard perspective images suffer severe performance degradation and fail due to the unique challenges of panoramic vision. In contrast, PAP framework effectively overcomes these obstacles, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baselines and highlighting the immense potential of panoramic perception for robust embodied intelligence.
summary_zh: 具身人工智能中，可供性预测是连接感知与动作的关键桥梁。然而，现有研究局限于针孔相机模型，该模型视野狭窄（FoV）且观测零散，常常遗漏关键的整体环境背景。本文首次探索了全景可供性预测，利用360度图像来捕捉全局空间关系和整体场景理解。为了促进这项新颖任务，我们首先推出了 PAP-12K，这是一个大规模基准数据集，包含超过 1,000 张超高分辨率（12k，11904 x 5952）全景图像，以及超过 12,000 个精心标注的 QA 对和可供性掩码。此外，我们提出 PAP，一个受人类中央凹视觉系统启发的、无需训练的、由粗到精的流水线，以解决全景图像中固有的超高分辨率和严重失真问题。PAP 采用基于网格提示的递归视觉路由来逐步定位目标，应用自适应凝视机制来校正局部几何失真，并利用级联 grounding 流水线来提取精确的实例级掩码。在 PAP-12K 上的实验结果表明，为标准透视图像设计的现有可供性预测方法由于全景视觉的独特挑战而遭受严重的性能下降并失效。相比之下，PAP 框架有效地克服了这些障碍，显著优于最先进的基线方法，并突出了全景感知在实现稳健的具身智能方面的巨大潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces Panoramic Affordance Prediction (PAP), a new task and benchmark dataset (PAP-12K) for affordance prediction using 360-degree imagery, along with a novel training-free pipeline (PAP) to address the unique challenges of panoramic vision.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了全景可供性预测（PAP），这是一个新的任务和基准数据集（PAP-12K），用于使用360度图像进行可供性预测，以及一个新颖的免训练流水线（PAP），以解决全景视觉的独特挑战。

title: Kimodo: Scaling Controllable Human Motion Generation
summary: High-quality human motion data is becoming increasingly important for applications in robotics, simulation, and entertainment. Recent generative models offer a potential data source, enabling human motion synthesis through intuitive inputs like text prompts or kinematic constraints on poses. However, the small scale of public mocap datasets has limited the motion quality, control accuracy, and generalization of these models. In this work, we introduce Kimodo, an expressive and controllable kinematic motion diffusion model trained on 700 hours of optical motion capture data. Our model generates high-quality motions while being easily controlled through text and a comprehensive suite of kinematic constraints including full-body keyframes, sparse joint positions/rotations, 2D waypoints, and dense 2D paths. This is enabled through a carefully designed motion representation and two-stage denoiser architecture that decomposes root and body prediction to minimize motion artifacts while allowing for flexible constraint conditioning. Experiments on the large-scale mocap dataset justify key design decisions and analyze how the scaling of dataset size and model size affect performance.
summary_zh: 高质量的人体运动数据在机器人、仿真和娱乐应用领域变得越来越重要。近期的生成模型提供了一个潜在的数据来源，能够通过文本提示或姿势的运动学约束等直观输入来合成人体运动。然而，公共动作捕捉数据集规模较小，限制了这些模型的运动质量、控制精度和泛化能力。在本文中，我们推出了Kimodo，一个富有表现力且可控的运动学运动扩散模型，该模型在700小时的光学动作捕捉数据上进行训练。我们的模型生成高质量的运动，同时能够通过文本和一套全面的运动学约束（包括全身关键帧、稀疏关节位置/旋转、2D路标点和密集2D路径）轻松控制。这得益于精心设计的运动表示和两阶段去噪器架构，该架构将根节点和身体预测分解，以最大限度地减少运动伪影，同时允许灵活的约束条件设定。在大规模动作捕捉数据集上的实验验证了关键的设计决策，并分析了数据集规模和模型规模的扩大如何影响性能。
tldr: Kimodo is a kinematic motion diffusion model trained on a large mocap dataset (700 hours) that allows for high-quality, controllable human motion generation via text and various kinematic constraints.
tldr_zh: Kimodo是一个运动学运动扩散模型，它在大型运动捕捉数据集（700小时）上训练，允许通过文本和各种运动学约束生成高质量、可控的人体运动。

title: RoCo Challenge at AAAI 2026: Benchmarking Robotic Collaborative Manipulation for Assembly Towards Industrial Automation
summary: Embodied Artificial Intelligence (EAI) is rapidly developing, gradually subverting previous autonomous systems' paradigms from isolated perception to integrated, continuous action. This transition is highly significant for industrial robotic manipulation, promising to free human workers from repetitive, dangerous daily labor. To benchmark and advance this capability, we introduce the Robotic Collaborative Assembly Assistance (RoCo) Challenge with a dataset towards simulation and real-world assembly manipulation. Set against the backdrop of human-centered manufacturing, this challenge focuses on a high-precision planetary gearbox assembly task, a demanding yet highly representative operation in modern industry. Built upon a self-developed data collection, training, and evaluation system in Isaac Sim, and utilizing a dual-arm robot for real-world deployment, the challenge operates in two phases. The Simulation Round defines fine-grained task phases for step-wise scoring to handle the long-horizon nature of the assembly. The Real-World Round mirrors this evaluation with physical gearbox components and high-quality teleoperated datasets. The core tasks require assembling an epicyclic gearbox from scratch, including mounting three planet gears, a sun gear, and a ring gear. Attracting over 60 teams and 170+ participants from more than 10 countries, the challenge yielded highly effective solutions, most notably ARC-VLA and RoboCola. Results demonstrate that a dual-model framework for long-horizon multi-task learning is highly effective, and the strategic utilization of recovery-from-failure curriculum data is a critical insight for successful deployment. This report outlines the competition setup, evaluation approach, key findings, and future directions for industrial EAI. Our dataset, CAD files, code, and evaluation results can be found at: https://rocochallenge.github.io/RoCo2026/.
summary_zh: 具身人工智能（EAI）正在快速发展，逐渐颠覆以往自主系统从孤立感知到集成、连续行动的范式。这种转变对于工业机器人操作具有重大意义，有望将人类工人从重复、危险的日常劳动中解放出来。为了评估和推进这一能力，我们推出了机器人协同装配辅助（RoCo）挑战赛，并提供数据集，用于模拟和真实世界的装配操作。该挑战赛以人为中心的制造为背景，着重于高精度行星齿轮箱装配任务，这是现代工业中一项要求苛刻且具有高度代表性的操作。该挑战赛建立在Isaac Sim中自主开发的数据收集、训练和评估系统之上，并利用双臂机器人进行真实世界的部署，分为两个阶段进行。模拟轮定义了精细的任务阶段，用于逐步评分，以处理装配的长周期特性。真实世界轮则采用物理齿轮箱组件和高质量遥操作数据集来反映这种评估。核心任务需要从头开始装配行星齿轮箱，包括安装三个行星齿轮、一个太阳齿轮和一个齿圈。本次挑战赛吸引了来自10多个国家的60多个团队和170多名参与者，产生了高效的解决方案，其中最值得注意的是ARC-VLA和RoboCola。结果表明，用于长周期多任务学习的双模型框架非常有效，并且策略性地利用从失败中恢复的课程数据是成功部署的关键见解。本报告概述了竞赛设置、评估方法、主要发现以及工业EAI的未来方向。我们的数据集、CAD文件、代码和评估结果可在以下网址找到：https://rocochallenge.github.io/RoCo2026/。
tldr: The RoCo Challenge at AAAI 2026 focuses on benchmarking robotic collaborative assembly manipulation for industrial automation, using a dual-arm robot and a realistic epicyclic gearbox assembly task in simulation and the real world, revealing effective solutions for long-horizon multi-task learning and recovery from failure.
tldr_zh: AAAI 2026 的 RoCo 挑战赛旨在评估机器人协作装配操作在工业自动化中的应用，在模拟和现实世界中使用双臂机器人和现实的行星齿轮箱装配任务，揭示了长时期多任务学习和从故障中恢复的有效解决方案。

title: Zero-Shot Generalization from Motion Demonstrations to New Tasks
summary: Learning motion policies from expert demonstrations is an essential paradigm in modern robotics. While end-to-end models aim for broad generalization, they require large datasets and computationally heavy inference. Conversely, learning dynamical systems (DS) provides fast, reactive, and provably stable control from very few demonstrations. However, existing DS learning methods typically model isolated tasks and struggle to reuse demonstrations for novel behaviors. In this work, we formalize the problem of combining isolated demonstrations within a shared workspace to enable generalization to unseen tasks. The Gaussian Graph is introduced, which reinterprets spatial components of learned motion primitives as discrete vertices with connections to one another. This formulation allows us to bridge continuous control with discrete graph search. We propose two frameworks leveraging this graph: Stitching, for constructing time-invariant DSs, and Chaining, giving a sequence-based DS for complex motions while retaining convergence guarantees. Simulations and real-robot experiments show that these methods successfully generalize to new tasks where baseline methods fail.
summary_zh: 从专家演示中学习运动策略是现代机器人技术中的一种重要范式。尽管端到端模型旨在实现广泛的泛化，但它们需要大型数据集和计算量大的推理。相反，学习动力系统（DS）能够从极少的演示中提供快速、反应灵敏且可证明稳定的控制。然而，现有的DS学习方法通常对孤立的任务进行建模，难以重用演示来完成新的行为。在这项工作中，我们将共享工作空间内组合孤立演示的问题形式化，以实现对未见任务的泛化。我们引入了高斯图，它将学习到的运动基元的空间分量重新解释为离散顶点，彼此之间存在连接。这种形式化允许我们将连续控制与离散图搜索连接起来。我们提出了利用此图的两个框架：拼接（Stitching），用于构建时不变DS；链式连接（Chaining），提供基于序列的DS用于复杂运动，同时保留收敛保证。仿真和真实机器人实验表明，这些方法成功地泛化到基线方法失败的新任务。
tldr: This paper introduces a method for generalizing motion policies learned from demonstrations to new robotic tasks by representing motion primitives as a Gaussian Graph, enabling both time-invariant and sequence-based dynamical systems for control.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种将从演示中学习到的运动策略推广到新的机器人任务的方法，通过将运动原语表示为高斯图，从而实现用于控制的时不变和基于序列的动力系统。

title: Efficient Morphology-Control Co-Design via Stackelberg Proximal Policy Optimization
summary: Morphology-control co-design concerns the coupled optimization of an agent's body structure and control policy. This problem exhibits a bi-level structure, where the control dynamically adapts to the morphology to maximize performance. Existing methods typically neglect the control's adaptation dynamics by adopting a single-level formulation that treats the control policy as fixed when optimizing morphology. This can lead to inefficient optimization, as morphology updates may be misaligned with control adaptation. In this paper, we revisit the co-design problem from a game-theoretic perspective, modeling the intrinsic coupling between morphology and control as a novel variant of a Stackelberg game. We propose Stackelberg Proximal Policy Optimization (Stackelberg PPO), which explicitly incorporates the control's adaptation dynamics into morphology optimization. By modeling this intrinsic coupling, our method aligns morphology updates with control adaptation, thereby stabilizing training and improving learning efficiency. Experiments across diverse co-design tasks demonstrate that Stackelberg PPO outperforms standard PPO in both stability and final performance, opening the way for dramatically more efficient robotics designs.
summary_zh: 形态控制协同设计关注智能体身体结构和控制策略的耦合优化。该问题呈现双层结构，其中控制动态适应形态以最大化性能。现有方法通常忽略控制的适应动态，而是采用单层公式，在优化形态时将控制策略视为固定不变。这可能导致效率低下，因为形态更新可能与控制适应不一致。在本文中，我们从博弈论的角度重新审视协同设计问题，将形态和控制之间的内在耦合建模为 Stackelberg 博弈的一种新变体。我们提出了 Stackelberg 近端策略优化(Stackelberg PPO)，它将控制的适应动态显式地融入到形态优化中。通过对这种内在耦合进行建模，我们的方法使形态更新与控制适应对齐，从而稳定训练并提高学习效率。在各种协同设计任务上的实验表明，Stackelberg PPO 在稳定性和最终性能方面均优于标准 PPO，为更高效的机器人设计开辟了道路。
tldr: This paper introduces Stackelberg Proximal Policy Optimization (Stackelberg PPO) for efficient morphology-control co-design in robotics, addressing the limitations of existing methods by explicitly modeling the adaptation dynamics between morphology and control.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Stackelberg近端策略优化(Stackelberg PPO)方法，用于机器人中高效的形态-控制协同设计，通过显式地建模形态和控制之间的自适应动态，解决了现有方法的局限性。

title: MoE-ACT: Scaling Multi-Task Bimanual Manipulation with Sparse Language-Conditioned Mixture-of-Experts Transformers
summary: The ability of robots to handle multiple tasks under a unified policy is critical for deploying embodied intelligence in real-world household and industrial applications. However, out-of-distribution variation across tasks often causes severe task interference and negative transfer when training general robotic policies. To address this challenge, we propose a lightweight multi-task imitation learning framework for bimanual manipulation, termed Mixture-of-Experts-Enhanced Action Chunking Transformer (MoE-ACT), which integrates sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) modules into the Transformer encoder of ACT. The MoE layer decomposes a unified task policy into independently invoked expert components. Through adaptive activation, it naturally decouples multi-task action distributions in latent space. During decoding, Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) dynamically modulates action tokens to improve consistency between action generation and task instructions. In parallel, multi-scale cross-attention enables the policy to simultaneously focus on both low-level and high-level semantic features, providing rich visual information for robotic manipulation. We further incorporate textual information, transitioning the framework from a purely vision-based model to a vision-centric, language-conditioned action generation system. Experimental validation in both simulation and a real-world dual-arm setup shows that MoE-ACT substantially improves multi-task performance. Specifically, MoE-ACT outperforms vanilla ACT by an average of 33% in success rate. These results indicate that MoE-ACT provides stronger robustness and generalization in complex multi-task bimanual manipulation environments. Our open-source project page can be found at https://j3k7.github.io/MoE-ACT/.
summary_zh: 机器人执行统一策略下的多项任务的能力对于在现实世界的家庭和工业应用中部署具身智能至关重要。然而，跨任务的分布外变化通常会导致训练通用机器人策略时出现严重的任务干扰和负迁移。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种轻量级的双臂操作多任务模仿学习框架，称为专家混合增强动作分块Transformer (MoE-ACT)，它将稀疏专家混合(MoE)模块集成到ACT的Transformer编码器中。MoE层将统一任务策略分解为独立调用的专家组件。通过自适应激活，它自然地解耦了潜在空间中的多任务动作分布。在解码过程中，特征线性调制(FiLM)动态地调节动作令牌，以提高动作生成和任务指令之间的一致性。同时，多尺度交叉注意力使策略能够同时关注低级和高级语义特征，为机器人操作提供丰富的视觉信息。我们进一步整合了文本信息，将框架从纯粹的基于视觉的模型过渡到以视觉为中心、语言条件化的动作生成系统。在仿真和真实世界的双臂设置中的实验验证表明，MoE-ACT显著提高了多任务性能。具体来说，MoE-ACT的成功率平均比原始ACT高出33%。这些结果表明，MoE-ACT在复杂的多任务双臂操作环境中提供了更强的鲁棒性和泛化性。我们的开源项目页面可以在https://j3k7.github.io/MoE-ACT/ 找到。
tldr: The paper introduces MoE-ACT, a multi-task imitation learning framework for bimanual manipulation that uses Mixture-of-Experts and Transformers to improve performance and generalization in complex robotic tasks, showing a 33% improvement over vanilla ACT.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MoE-ACT，一种用于双臂操作的多任务模仿学习框架，它使用混合专家和Transformer来提高复杂机器人任务中的性能和泛化能力，与普通ACT相比，成功率提高了33%。

title: HapticVLA: Contact-Rich Manipulation via Vision-Language-Action Model without Inference-Time Tactile Sensing
summary: Tactile sensing is a crucial capability for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures, as it enables dexterous and safe manipulation in contact-rich tasks. However, reliance on dedicated tactile hardware increases cost and reduces reproducibility across robotic platforms. We argue that tactile-aware manipulation can be learned offline and deployed without direct haptic feedback at inference. To this end, we present HapticVLA, which proceeds in two tightly coupled stages: Safety-Aware Reward-Weighted Flow Matching (SA-RWFM) and Tactile Distillation (TD). SA-RWFM trains a flow-matching action expert that incorporates precomputed, safety-aware tactile rewards penalizing excessive grasping force and suboptimal grasping trajectories. TD further transfers this tactile-aware capability into a conventional VLA: we distill a compact tactile token from the SA-RWFM teacher and train a student VLA to predict that token from vision and state modalities, enabling tactile-aware action generation at inference without requiring on-board tactile sensors. This design preserves contact-rich tactile-aware reasoning within VLA while removing the need for on-board tactile sensors during deployment. On real-world experiments, HapticVLA achieves a mean success rate of 86.7%, consistently outperforming baseline VLAs - including versions provided with direct tactile feedback during inference.
summary_zh: 触觉感知是视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 架构的关键能力，因为它能够实现富接触任务中的灵巧和安全操作。然而，对专用触觉硬件的依赖会增加成本并降低机器人平台之间的可重复性。我们认为，触觉感知的操作可以在离线学习，并在推理时无需直接触觉反馈即可部署。为此，我们提出了 HapticVLA，它包含两个紧密耦合的阶段：安全感知奖励加权流匹配 (SA-RWFM) 和触觉蒸馏 (TD)。SA-RWFM 训练一个流匹配动作专家，该专家整合了预先计算的、安全感知的触觉奖励，以惩罚过度的抓取力和次优的抓取轨迹。TD 进一步将这种触觉感知能力转移到传统的 VLA 中：我们从 SA-RWFM 教师中提炼出一个紧凑的触觉标记，并训练一个学生 VLA 从视觉和状态模态预测该标记，从而在推理时实现触觉感知的动作生成，而无需板载触觉传感器。这种设计保留了 VLA 中富接触的触觉感知推理，同时消除了部署期间对板载触觉传感器的需求。在真实世界的实验中，HapticVLA 实现了 86.7% 的平均成功率，始终优于基线 VLA，包括在推理期间提供直接触觉反馈的版本。
tldr: HapticVLA enables contact-rich robot manipulation by training a VLA model offline using tactile rewards and distilling tactile knowledge into a sensor-free student VLA, achieving high success rates in real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: HapticVLA通过离线训练VLA模型，利用触觉奖励并将触觉知识提炼到无传感器的学生VLA中，实现了接触丰富的机器人操作，并在真实世界任务中取得了很高的成功率。

title: NavGSim: High-Fidelity Gaussian Splatting Simulator for Large-Scale Navigation
summary: Simulating realistic environments for robots is widely recognized as a critical challenge in robot learning, particularly in terms of rendering and physical simulation. This challenge becomes even more pronounced in navigation tasks, where trajectories often extend across multiple rooms or entire floors. In this work, we present NavGSim, a Gaussian Splatting-based simulator designed to generate high-fidelity, large-scale navigation environments. Built upon a hierarchical 3D Gaussian Splatting framework, NavGSim enables photorealistic rendering in expansive scenes spanning hundreds of square meters. To simulate navigation collisions, we introduce a Gaussian Splatting-based slice technique that directly extracts navigable areas from reconstructed Gaussians. Additionally, for ease of use, we provide comprehensive NavGSim APIs supporting multi-GPU development, including tools for custom scene reconstruction, robot configuration, policy training, and evaluation. To evaluate NavGSim's effectiveness, we train a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model using trajectories collected from NavGSim and assess its performance in both simulated and real-world environments. Our results demonstrate that NavGSim significantly enhances the VLA model's scene understanding, enabling the policy to handle diverse navigation queries effectively.
summary_zh: 为机器人模拟逼真环境是机器人学习中公认的关键挑战，尤其是在渲染和物理模拟方面。在导航任务中，这一挑战更为突出，因为轨迹通常会跨越多个房间或整个楼层。 本文提出NavGSim，一种基于高斯溅射的模拟器，旨在生成高保真、大规模的导航环境。 NavGSim构建于分层3D高斯溅射框架之上，能够在跨越数百平方米的广阔场景中实现照片级逼真的渲染。为了模拟导航碰撞，我们引入了一种基于高斯溅射的切片技术，该技术能够直接从重建的高斯分布中提取可导航区域。 此外，为了方便使用，我们提供了全面的NavGSim API，支持多GPU开发，包括用于自定义场景重建、机器人配置、策略训练和评估的工具。 为了评估NavGSim的有效性，我们使用从NavGSim收集的轨迹训练了一个视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型，并评估了其在模拟和真实环境中的性能。 我们的结果表明，NavGSim显著增强了VLA模型的场景理解能力，使策略能够有效地处理各种导航查询。
tldr: The paper introduces NavGSim, a Gaussian Splatting-based simulator for generating high-fidelity, large-scale navigation environments, demonstrating its effectiveness by training a Vision-Language-Action model.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍NavGSim，一个基于高斯溅射的模拟器，用于生成高保真、大规模的导航环境，并通过训练视觉-语言-动作模型证明了其有效性。

title: What Matters for Scalable and Robust Learning in End-to-End Driving Planners?
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving has gained significant attention for its potential to learn robust behavior in interactive scenarios and scale with data. Popular architectures often build on separate modules for perception and planning connected through latent representations, such as bird's eye view feature grids, to maintain end-to-end differentiability. This paradigm emerged mostly on open-loop datasets, with evaluation focusing not only on driving performance, but also intermediate perception tasks. Unfortunately, architectural advances that excel in open-loop often fail to translate to scalable learning of robust closed-loop driving. In this paper, we systematically re-examine the impact of common architectural patterns on closed-loop performance: (1) high-resolution perceptual representations, (2) disentangled trajectory representations, and (3) generative planning. Crucially, our analysis evaluates the combined impact of these patterns, revealing both unexpected limitations as well as underexplored synergies. Building on these insights, we introduce BevAD, a novel lightweight and highly scalable end-to-end driving architecture. BevAD achieves 72.7% success rate on the Bench2Drive benchmark and demonstrates strong data-scaling behavior using pure imitation learning. Our code and models are publicly available here: https://dmholtz.github.io/bevad/
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶因其在交互式场景中学习稳健行为和利用数据进行扩展的潜力而备受关注。流行的架构通常建立在独立的感知和规划模块之上，并通过潜在表示（如鸟瞰图特征网格）连接，以保持端到端可微性。这种范式主要出现在开环数据集上，评估不仅关注驾驶性能，还关注中间感知任务。然而，在开环中表现出色的架构进展往往无法转化为稳健闭环驾驶的可扩展学习。在本文中，我们系统地重新审视了常见架构模式对闭环性能的影响：(1) 高分辨率感知表示，(2) 解耦的轨迹表示，以及 (3) 生成式规划。至关重要的是，我们的分析评估了这些模式的综合影响，揭示了意想不到的局限性以及未充分探索的协同效应。基于这些见解，我们引入了BevAD，一种新型轻量级且高度可扩展的端到端驾驶架构。BevAD在Bench2Drive基准测试中取得了72.7%的成功率，并展示了使用纯模仿学习的强大数据扩展行为。我们的代码和模型在此处公开提供：https://dmholtz.github.io/bevad/
tldr: This paper investigates the efficacy of different architectural choices in end-to-end autonomous driving planners, identifying limitations and synergies. It introduces BevAD, a novel architecture achieving state-of-the-art performance on a driving benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了端到端自动驾驶规划器中不同架构选择的有效性，识别了局限性和协同效应。 它介绍了一种名为BevAD的新型架构，该架构在驾驶基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

title: KiRAS: Keyframe Guided Self-Imitation for Robust and Adaptive Skill Learning in Quadruped Robots
summary: With advances in reinforcement learning and imitation learning, quadruped robots can acquire diverse skills within a single policy by imitating multiple skill-specific datasets. However, the lack of datasets on complex terrains limits the ability of such multi-skill policies to generalize effectively in unstructured environments. Inspired by animation, we adopt keyframes as minimal and universal skill representations, relaxing dataset constraints and enabling the integration of terrain adaptability with skill diversity. We propose Keyframe Guided Self-Imitation for Robust and Adaptive Skill Learning (KiRAS), an end-to-end framework for acquiring and transitioning between diverse skill primitives on complex terrains. KiRAS first learns diverse skills on flat terrain through keyframe-guided self-imitation, eliminating the need for expert datasets; then continues training the same policy network on rough terrains to enhance robustness. To eliminate catastrophic forgetting, a proficiency-based Skill Initialization Technique is introduced. Experiments on Solo-8 and Unitree Go1 robots show that KiRAS enables robust skill acquisition and smooth transitions across challenging terrains. This framework demonstrates its potential as a lightweight platform for multi-skill generation and dataset collection. It further enables flexible skill transitions that enhance locomotion on challenging terrains.
summary_zh: 随着强化学习和模仿学习的进步，四足机器人可以通过模仿多个特定技能的数据集，在单个策略中获得多种技能。然而，缺乏复杂地形的数据集限制了这种多技能策略在非结构化环境中有效泛化的能力。受动画的启发，我们采用关键帧作为最小且通用的技能表示，放宽了数据集的约束，并实现了地形适应性与技能多样性的集成。我们提出了一种名为关键帧引导的自模仿用于稳健和适应性技能学习（KiRAS）的端到端框架，用于在复杂地形上获取并过渡不同技能基元。KiRAS首先通过关键帧引导的自模仿学习在平坦地形上的多种技能，消除了对专家数据集的需求； 然后在粗糙地形上继续训练相同的策略网络，以增强稳健性。为了消除灾难性遗忘，引入了一种基于熟练度的技能初始化技术。在Solo-8和Unitree Go1机器人上的实验表明，KiRAS能够实现稳健的技能获取和在具有挑战性的地形上的平滑过渡。该框架展示了其作为多技能生成和数据集收集的轻量级平台的潜力。它进一步实现了灵活的技能过渡，从而增强了在具有挑战性的地形上的运动能力。
tldr: The paper introduces KiRAS, a keyframe-guided self-imitation framework for quadruped robots to learn robust and adaptive skills on complex terrains without expert datasets, using a two-stage training approach and a skill initialization technique.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了KiRAS，一种基于关键帧引导的自模仿框架，用于四足机器人学习在复杂地形上稳健且适应性强的技能，无需专家数据集，采用两阶段训练方法和技能初始化技术。

title: ForceVLA2: Unleashing Hybrid Force-Position Control with Force Awareness for Contact-Rich Manipulation
