We demonstrate its utility by deploying Fast SAM 3D Body in a vision-only teleoperation system that-unlike methods reliant on wearable IMUs-enables real-time humanoid control and the direct collection of manipulation policies from a single RGB stream.
summary_zh: SAM 3D Body (3DB) 在单目3D人体网格重建中实现了最先进的精度，但其每张图像几秒的推理延迟使其无法应用于实时应用。我们提出了Fast SAM 3D Body，这是一个无需训练的加速框架，它重新构建了3DB的推理路径，以实现交互级别的速度。通过解耦串行空间依赖性并应用架构感知剪枝，我们实现了并行化的多裁剪特征提取和精简的Transformer解码。此外，为了提取与现有类人控制和策略学习框架兼容的关节级运动学（SMPL），我们用直接的前馈映射代替了迭代网格拟合，从而将这一特定转换过程加速了超过10000倍。总的来说，我们的框架提供了高达10.9倍的端到端加速，同时保持了相当的重建保真度，甚至在LSPET等基准测试中超越了3DB。我们通过在仅视觉的遥操作系统中部署Fast SAM 3D Body来展示其效用，与依赖可穿戴IMU的方法不同，该系统能够实现实时类人控制，并能够直接从单个RGB流中收集操作策略。
tldr: This paper introduces Fast SAM 3D Body, a training-free acceleration framework for real-time monocular 3D human mesh recovery, achieving significant speedups while maintaining accuracy and enabling applications like vision-only teleoperation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 Fast SAM 3D Body，一个无需训练的加速框架，用于实时单目3D人体网格重建，在保持精度的同时实现了显著的加速，并支持视觉遥操作等应用。

title: Grounding World Simulation Models in a Real-World Metropolis
summary: What if a world simulation model could render not an imagined environment but a city that actually exists? Prior generative world models synthesize visually plausible yet artificial environments by imagining all content. We present Seoul World Model (SWM), a city-scale world model grounded in the real city of Seoul. SWM anchors autoregressive video generation through retrieval-augmented conditioning on nearby street-view images. However, this design introduces several challenges, including temporal misalignment between retrieved references and the dynamic target scene, limited trajectory diversity and data sparsity from vehicle-mounted captures at sparse intervals. We address these challenges through cross-temporal pairing, a large-scale synthetic dataset enabling diverse camera trajectories, and a view interpolation pipeline that synthesizes coherent training videos from sparse street-view images. We further introduce a Virtual Lookahead Sink to stabilize long-horizon generation by continuously re-grounding each chunk to a retrieved image at a future location. We evaluate SWM against recent video world models across three cities: Seoul, Busan, and Ann Arbor. SWM outperforms existing methods in generating spatially faithful, temporally consistent, long-horizon videos grounded in actual urban environments over trajectories reaching hundreds of meters, while supporting diverse camera movements and text-prompted scenario variations.
summary_zh: 如果一个世界模拟模型能够渲染的不是一个想象的环境，而是一个真实存在的城市，会怎么样？现有的生成式世界模型通过想象所有内容来合成视觉上合理但人工化的环境。我们提出了首尔世界模型（SWM），这是一个根植于真实城市首尔的城市尺度世界模型。SWM通过检索增强的条件作用，锚定附近的街景图像，进行自回归视频生成。然而，这种设计引入了几个挑战，包括检索到的参考与动态目标场景之间的时间错位，车辆安装拍摄在稀疏间隔导致的有限轨迹多样性和数据稀疏性。我们通过跨时间配对、一个支持多样化相机轨迹的大规模合成数据集，以及一个从稀疏街景图像合成连贯训练视频的视图插值流程，来解决这些挑战。我们进一步引入了虚拟前瞻汇点，通过将每个片段持续重新锚定到未来位置的检索图像，来稳定长时程生成。我们在首尔、釜山和安娜堡这三个城市中，针对最新的视频世界模型评估了SWM。SWM在生成空间上忠实、时间上一致、基于真实城市环境的长时程视频方面，性能优于现有方法，其轨迹可达数百米，同时支持多样的相机运动和文本提示的场景变化。
tldr: The paper introduces Seoul World Model (SWM), a city-scale world model grounded in the real city of Seoul, achieving spatially faithful and temporally consistent long-horizon video generation with diverse camera movements and text-prompted scenario variations.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了首尔世界模型（SWM），一个基于真实城市首尔的城市级世界模型，实现了空间保真和时间一致的长程视频生成，并支持多样化的相机运动和文本提示的场景变化。

title: Evaluating Time Awareness and Cross-modal Active Perception of Large Models via 4D Escape Room Task
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently made rapid progress toward unified Omni models that integrate vision, language, and audio. However, existing environments largely focus on 2D or 3D visual context and vision-language tasks, offering limited support for temporally dependent auditory signals and selective cross-modal integration, where different modalities may provide complementary or interfering information, which are essential capabilities for realistic multimodal reasoning. As a result, whether models can actively coordinate modalities and reason under time-varying, irreversible conditions remains underexplored. To this end, we introduce \textbf{EscapeCraft-4D}, a customizable 4D environment for assessing selective cross-modal perception and time awareness in Omni models. It incorporates trigger-based auditory sources, temporally transient evidence, and location-dependent cues, requiring agents to perform spatio-temporal reasoning and proactive multimodal integration under time constraints. Building on this environment, we curate a benchmark to evaluate corresponding abilities across powerful models. Evaluation results suggest that models struggle with modality bias, and reveal significant gaps in current model's ability to integrate multiple modalities under time constraints. Further in-depth analysis uncovers how multiple modalities interact and jointly influence model decisions in complex multimodal reasoning environments.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）最近在集成视觉、语言和音频的统一全能模型方面取得了快速进展。然而，现有环境主要侧重于二维或三维视觉上下文及视觉-语言任务，对时间相关的听觉信号和选择性跨模态融合的支持有限，而不同模态可能提供互补或干扰信息，这对于现实的多模态推理至关重要。因此，模型能否主动协调模态并在时变、不可逆条件下进行推理仍有待探索。为此，我们引入了\textbf{EscapeCraft-4D}，这是一个可定制的4D环境，用于评估全能模型中的选择性跨模态感知和时间意识。它集成了基于触发器的听觉源、瞬时时间证据和位置相关的线索，要求智能体在时间约束下执行时空推理和主动的多模态融合。在此环境的基础上，我们构建了一个基准，以评估强大模型在相应能力上的表现。评估结果表明，模型在模态偏好方面表现不佳，并揭示了当前模型在时间约束下整合多种模态能力方面的显著差距。更深入的分析揭示了在复杂的多模态推理环境中，多种模态如何交互并共同影响模型决策。
tldr: The paper introduces EscapeCraft-4D, a new 4D environment and benchmark for evaluating time awareness and cross-modal perception in MLLMs, revealing limitations in current models' multimodal reasoning under time constraints.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EscapeCraft-4D，一个新的4D环境和基准测试，用于评估MLLM中的时间感知和跨模态感知，揭示了当前模型在时间约束下进行多模态推理的局限性。

title: Gym-V: A Unified Vision Environment System for Agentic Vision Research
summary: As agentic systems increasingly rely on reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards, standardized ``gym'' infrastructure has become essential for rapid iteration, reproducibility, and fair comparison. Vision agents lack such infrastructure, limiting systematic study of what drives their learning and where current models fall short. We introduce \textbf{Gym-V}, a unified platform of 179 procedurally generated visual environments across 10 domains with controllable difficulty, enabling controlled experiments that were previously infeasible across fragmented toolkits. Using it, we find that observation scaffolding is more decisive for training success than the choice of RL algorithm, with captions and game rules determining whether learning succeeds at all. Cross-domain transfer experiments further show that training on diverse task categories generalizes broadly while narrow training can cause negative transfer, with multi-turn interaction amplifying all of these effects. Gym-V is released as a convenient foundation for training environments and evaluation toolkits, aiming to accelerate future research on agentic VLMs.
summary_zh: 随着能动系统越来越依赖于来自可验证奖励的强化学习，标准化的“gym”基础设施对于快速迭代、可重复性和公平比较变得至关重要。视觉智能体缺乏这样的基础设施，限制了对驱动其学习的因素以及当前模型不足之处的系统性研究。我们引入\textbf{Gym-V}，一个统一的平台，包含来自10个领域的179个程序生成的视觉环境，具有可控的难度，从而能够进行以前在零散工具包中无法实现的受控实验。通过使用它，我们发现观察脚手架对于训练成功比强化学习算法的选择更具有决定性作用，字幕和游戏规则决定了学习能否成功。跨领域迁移实验进一步表明，在多样化的任务类别上进行训练可以广泛泛化，而狭窄的训练可能导致负迁移，多轮交互放大了所有这些效果。Gym-V作为一个方便的训练环境和评估工具包的基础发布，旨在加速未来对能动VLM的研究。
tldr: Gym-V is a new platform of procedurally generated visual environments for training and evaluating vision agents, showing observation scaffolding is crucial for training and that broad training generalizes better than narrow training.
tldr_zh: Gym-V是一个新的程序生成视觉环境平台，用于训练和评估视觉智能体。研究表明，观察脚手架对训练至关重要，并且广泛训练比狭窄训练具有更好的泛化能力。

title: Multi-turn Physics-informed Vision-language Model for Physics-grounded Anomaly Detection
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate strong general-purpose reasoning but remain limited in physics-grounded anomaly detection, where causal understanding of dynamics is essential. Existing VLMs, trained predominantly on appearance-centric correlations, fail to capture kinematic constraints, leading to poor performance on anomalies such as irregular rotations or violated mechanical motions. We introduce a physics-informed instruction tuning framework that explicitly encodes object properties, motion paradigms, and dynamic constraints into structured prompts. By delivering these physical priors through multi-turn dialogues, our method decomposes causal reasoning into incremental steps, enabling robust internal representations of normal and abnormal dynamics. Evaluated on the Phys-AD benchmark, our approach achieves 96.7% AUROC in video-level detection--substantially outperforming prior SOTA (66.9%)--and yields superior causal explanations (0.777 LLM score). This work highlights how structured physics priors can transform VLMs into reliable detectors of dynamic anomalies.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）展现出强大的通用推理能力，但在物理基础的异常检测方面仍然存在局限性，而后者对动力学的因果理解至关重要。现有的VLMs，主要基于以表观为中心的关联进行训练，未能捕捉到运动学约束，导致在如不规则旋转或违反力学运动等异常情况下的表现不佳。我们引入了一种物理信息指导的指令调优框架，该框架将物体属性、运动范式和动态约束显式地编码到结构化提示中。通过多轮对话传递这些物理先验，我们的方法将因果推理分解为递增步骤，从而能够对正常和异常动力学进行稳健的内部表示。在Phys-AD基准测试中，我们的方法在视频级别的检测中实现了96.7% 的AUROC，显著优于之前的SOTA（66.9%），并产生了卓越的因果解释（0.777 LLM分数）。这项工作强调了结构化的物理先验如何将VLMs转变为可靠的动态异常检测器。
tldr: This paper introduces a physics-informed instruction tuning framework for VLMs that significantly improves physics-grounded anomaly detection by encoding object properties, motion paradigms, and dynamic constraints through multi-turn dialogues. The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Phys-AD benchmark.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种物理信息指导的指令微调框架，通过多轮对话编码物体属性、运动范式和动态约束，显著提高了VLMs在物理规律异常检测方面的性能。该方法在Phys-AD基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。

title: GUI-CEval: A Hierarchical and Comprehensive Chinese Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agents
summary: Recent progress in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has enabled mobile GUI agents capable of visual perception, cross-modal reasoning, and interactive control. However, existing benchmarks are largely English-centric and fail to capture the linguistic and interaction characteristics of the Chinese mobile ecosystem. They also focus on isolated skills such as GUI grounding or offline agent, lacking a unified and fine-grained framework to assess the full capability chain from perception to execution. To address this gap, we introduce GUI-CEval, the first comprehensive benchmark for Chinese mobile GUI agents, built entirely on physical device environments. GUI-CEval spans 201 mainstream apps across four device types and adopts a two-level structure that evaluates both atomic abilities and realistic application-level performance along five dimensions: perception, planning, reflection, execution, and evaluation. All data are collected and verified through multi-stage manual processes to ensure authenticity and reproducibility. Extensive experiments on 20 representative MLLMs and multi-agent systems show that while models such as Qwen2.5-VL and UI-TARS perform competitively, most MLLMs still exhibit clear weaknesses in reflective decision-making and post-action self-evaluation, limiting their reliability in real-world interactions. We hope GUI-CEval provides a comprehensive and interpretable benchmark to guide capability diagnosis and advance the development of Chinese mobile GUI agents.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）的最新进展已使移动GUI代理具备了视觉感知、跨模态推理和交互控制能力。然而，现有的基准测试主要以英语为中心，未能捕捉到中文移动生态系统的语言和交互特性。它们也侧重于诸如GUI定位或离线代理等孤立技能，缺乏一个统一和细粒度的框架来评估从感知到执行的完整能力链。为了弥补这一差距，我们推出了GUI-CEval，这是首个针对中文移动GUI代理的综合基准测试，完全构建于物理设备环境之上。GUI-CEval涵盖了四种设备类型的201个主流应用程序，并采用两级结构，分别从感知、规划、反思、执行和评估五个维度评估原子能力和实际应用层面的性能。所有数据都通过多阶段人工流程收集和验证，以确保真实性和可重复性。对20个具有代表性的MLLM和多代理系统的大量实验表明，虽然诸如Qwen2.5-VL和UI-TARS等模型表现出一定的竞争力，但大多数MLLM在反思性决策和行动后自我评估方面仍然存在明显的弱点，这限制了它们在现实世界交互中的可靠性。我们希望GUI-CEval能提供一个全面且可解释的基准，以指导能力诊断并推进中文移动GUI代理的开发。
tldr: The paper introduces GUI-CEval, a new comprehensive Chinese benchmark for evaluating mobile GUI agents, addressing the lack of Chinese-specific benchmarks and providing a unified framework for assessing the full perception-to-execution capability chain of these agents.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GUI-CEval，这是一个新的综合性中文基准，用于评估移动GUI代理。该基准旨在弥补中文特定基准的不足，并为评估这些代理的从感知到执行的完整能力链提供统一的框架。

title: MMSpec: Benchmarking Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on multimodal tasks but suffer from high inference latency due to large model sizes and long multimodal contexts. Speculative decoding has recently emerged as an effective acceleration technique, yet its behavior in VLMs remains insufficiently understood. We introduce MMSpec, the first benchmark for evaluating speculative decoding in vision-language models. MMSpec contains 600 multimodal samples across six task categories and integrates ten representative speculative decoding algorithms under a unified evaluation framework. Our study reveals three key findings: (1) methods designed for text-only LLMs degrade in multimodal scenarios, (2) vision awareness becomes increasingly important at larger batch sizes, and (3) throughput speedup alone does not reliably reflect latency performance. Motivated by these findings, we propose ViSkip, a plug-and-play speculative decoding method that dynamically adapts speculation to vision tokens and achieves state-of-the-art performance.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型(VLM)在多模态任务上表现出色，但由于模型规模庞大和多模态上下文较长，存在高推理延迟的问题。推测解码作为一种有效的加速技术，最近崭露头角，但其在VLM中的行为仍未得到充分理解。我们推出了MMSpec，这是首个用于评估视觉-语言模型中推测解码的基准。MMSpec包含跨六个任务类别的600个多模态样本，并在统一的评估框架下集成了十种具有代表性的推测解码算法。我们的研究揭示了三个关键发现：(1)专为纯文本LLM设计的方法在多模态场景中性能下降；(2)视觉感知在更大的批量大小时变得越来越重要；(3)仅靠吞吐量加速并不能可靠地反映延迟性能。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种即插即用的推测解码方法ViSkip，它可以动态地调整对视觉token的推测，并实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces MMSpec, a benchmark for evaluating speculative decoding in vision-language models, and proposes ViSkip, a novel method that dynamically adapts speculation to vision tokens for improved performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MMSpec，一个用于评估视觉-语言模型中推测解码的基准，并提出了ViSkip，一种新的方法，可以动态地将推测适应于视觉tokens，以提高性能。

title: Bridging Scene Generation and Planning: Driving with World Model via Unifying Vision and Motion Representation
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving aims to generate safe and plausible planning policies from raw sensor input. Driving world models have shown great potential in learning rich representations by predicting the future evolution of a driving scene. However, existing driving world models primarily focus on visual scene representation, and motion representation is not explicitly designed to be planner-shared and inheritable, leaving a schism between the optimization of visual scene generation and the requirements of precise motion planning. We present WorldDrive, a holistic framework that couples scene generation and real-time planning via unifying vision and motion representation. We first introduce a Trajectory-aware Driving World Model, which conditions on a trajectory vocabulary to enforce consistency between visual dynamics and motion intentions, enabling the generation of diverse and plausible future scenes conditioned on a specific trajectory. We transfer the vision and motion encoders to a downstream Multi-modal Planner, ensuring the driving policy operates on mature representations pre-optimized by scene generation. A simple interaction between motion representation, visual representation, and ego status can generate high-quality, multi-modal trajectories. Furthermore, to exploit the world model's foresight, we propose a Future-aware Rewarder, which distills future latent representation from the frozen world model to evaluate and select optimal trajectories in real-time. Extensive experiments on the NAVSIM, NAVSIM-v2, and nuScenes benchmarks demonstrate that WorldDrive achieves leading planning performance among vision-only methods while maintaining high-fidelity action-controlled video generation capabilities, providing strong evidence for the effectiveness of unifying vision and motion representation for robust autonomous driving.
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶旨在从原始传感器输入中生成安全且合理的规划策略。驾驶世界模型在通过预测驾驶场景的未来演变来学习丰富的表征方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有的驾驶世界模型主要关注视觉场景表征，而运动表征并非明确设计为规划器共享和可继承的，导致视觉场景生成优化与精确运动规划需求之间存在鸿沟。我们提出了WorldDrive，一个通过统一视觉和运动表征来耦合场景生成和实时规划的整体框架。我们首先引入了一个轨迹感知驾驶世界模型，该模型以轨迹词汇表为条件，以强制执行视觉动态与运动意图之间的一致性，从而能够生成基于特定轨迹的各种合理未来场景。我们将视觉和运动编码器转移到下游的多模态规划器，确保驾驶策略在经过场景生成预优化的成熟表征上运行。运动表征、视觉表征和自我状态之间的简单交互可以生成高质量的多模态轨迹。此外，为了利用世界模型的远见能力，我们提出了一种未来感知奖励器，该奖励器从冻结的世界模型中提炼未来的潜在表征，以评估和选择实时最佳轨迹。在NAVSIM、NAVSIM-v2和nuScenes基准测试上的大量实验表明，WorldDrive在仅使用视觉的方法中实现了领先的规划性能，同时保持了高保真的动作控制视频生成能力，为统一视觉和运动表征以实现稳健的自动驾驶提供了强有力的证据。
tldr: The paper introduces WorldDrive, a framework unifying vision and motion representation for autonomous driving by using a trajectory-aware world model and transferring learned representations to a multi-modal planner, achieving state-of-the-art planning performance with action-controlled video generation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 WorldDrive，一个通过统一视觉和运动表示来实现自动驾驶的框架。它使用了一个轨迹感知的世界模型，并将学习到的表示转移到多模态规划器，从而在保持动作控制的视频生成能力的同时，实现了最先进的规划性能。

title: FAR-Drive: Frame-AutoRegressive Video Generation in Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving
summary: Despite rapid progress in autonomous driving, reliable training and evaluation of driving systems remain fundamentally constrained by the lack of scalable and interactive simulation environments. Recent generative video models achieve remarkable visual fidelity, yet most operate in open-loop settings and fail to support fine-grained frame-level interaction between agent actions and environment evolution. Building a learning-based closed-loop simulator for autonomous driving poses three major challenges: maintaining long-horizon temporal and cross-view consistency, mitigating autoregressive degradation under iterative self-conditioning, and satisfying low-latency inference constraints. In this work, we propose FAR-Drive, a frame-level autoregressive video generation framework for autonomous driving. We introduce a multi-view diffusion transformer with fine-grained structured control, enabling geometrically consistent multi-camera generation. To address long-horizon consistency and iterative degradation, we design a two-stage training strategy consisting of adaptive reference horizon conditioning and blend-forcing autoregressive training, which progressively improves consistency and robustness under self-conditioning. To meet low-latency interaction requirements, we further integrate system-level efficiency optimizations for inference acceleration. Experiments on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance among existing closed-loop autonomous driving simulation approaches, while maintaining sub-second latency on a single GPU.
summary_zh: 尽管自动驾驶领域取得了快速进展，但由于缺乏可扩展和交互式的仿真环境，驾驶系统的可靠训练和评估仍然受到根本限制。近年来，生成式视频模型在视觉逼真度方面取得显著成果，但大多数在开环设置下运行，并且无法支持智能体动作和环境演化之间细粒度的帧级别交互。为自动驾驶构建基于学习的闭环模拟器面临三大挑战：维持长时程的时间和跨视角一致性、减轻迭代自条件化下的自回归衰退，以及满足低延迟推理约束。本文提出FAR-Drive，一种用于自动驾驶的帧级别自回归视频生成框架。我们引入了一个具有细粒度结构化控制的多视角扩散Transformer，实现了几何一致的多摄像头生成。为了解决长时程一致性和迭代衰退问题，我们设计了一个两阶段训练策略，包括自适应参考时程条件化和混合强制自回归训练，逐步提高自条件化下的连贯性和鲁棒性。为了满足低延迟交互需求，我们进一步集成了系统级效率优化以加速推理。在nuScenes数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法在现有闭环自动驾驶仿真方法中实现了最先进的性能，同时在单个GPU上保持亚秒级延迟。
tldr: FAR-Drive introduces a frame-autoregressive video generation framework for closed-loop autonomous driving simulation, featuring multi-view diffusion transformers and a two-stage training strategy for improved consistency and low-latency inference.
tldr_zh: FAR-Drive 提出了一个用于闭环自动驾驶模拟的帧自回归视频生成框架，其特点是多视角扩散变换器和两阶段训练策略，以提高一致性和低延迟推理。

title: Visual Confused Deputy: Exploiting and Defending Perception Failures in Computer-Using Agents
summary: Computer-using agents (CUAs) act directly on graphical user interfaces, yet their perception of the screen is often unreliable. Existing work largely treats these failures as performance limitations, asking whether an action succeeds, rather than whether the agent is acting on the correct object at all. We argue that this is fundamentally a security problem. We formalize the visual confused deputy: a failure mode in which an agent authorizes an action based on a misperceived screen state, due to grounding errors, adversarial screenshot manipulation, or time-of-check-to-time-of-use (TOCTOU) races. This gap is practically exploitable: even simple screen-level manipulations can redirect routine clicks into privileged actions while remaining indistinguishable from ordinary agent mistakes. To mitigate this threat, we propose the first guardrail that operates outside the agent's perceptual loop. Our method, dual-channel contrastive classification, independently evaluates (1) the visual click target and (2) the agent's reasoning about the action against deployment-specific knowledge bases, and blocks execution if either channel indicates risk. The key insight is that these two channels capture complementary failure modes: visual evidence detects target-level mismatches, while textual reasoning reveals dangerous intent behind visually innocuous controls. Across controlled attacks, real GUI screenshots, and agent traces, the combined guardrail consistently outperforms either channel alone. Our results suggest that CUA safety requires not only better action generation, but independent verification of what the agent believes it is clicking and why. Materials are provided\footnote{Model, benchmark, and code: https://github.com/vllm-project/semantic-router}.
summary_zh: 使用计算机的代理（CUAs）直接在图形用户界面上执行操作，但它们对屏幕的感知通常是不可靠的。现有的工作主要将这些失败视为性能限制，关注的是动作是否成功，而不是代理是否作用于正确的对象。我们认为这本质上是一个安全问题。我们形式化了视觉混淆代理：一种失效模式，在此模式下，由于接地误差、对抗性屏幕截图操作或检查时间到使用时间（TOCTOU）竞争，代理基于错误感知的屏幕状态授权操作。这种差距具有实际可利用性：即使是简单的屏幕级操作也可以将常规点击重定向到特权操作，同时仍然与普通的代理错误无法区分。为了缓解这种威胁，我们提出了第一个在代理感知循环之外运行的护栏。我们的方法，双通道对比分类，独立评估（1）视觉点击目标和（2）代理对操作的推理，并将其与特定于部署的知识库进行对比，如果任一通道指示存在风险，则阻止执行。关键的洞察在于，这两个通道捕获了互补的失效模式：视觉证据检测目标级别的错配，而文本推理则揭示了视觉上无害的控件背后的危险意图。在受控攻击、真实GUI屏幕截图和代理跟踪中，组合护栏始终优于单独的任何一个通道。我们的结果表明，CUA的安全性不仅需要更好的动作生成，还需要独立验证代理认为它所点击的内容以及原因。我们提供了相关材料\footnote{模型、基准测试和代码：https://github.com/vllm-project/semantic-router}。
tldr: The paper identifies a security vulnerability in computer-using agents (CUAs) called 'visual confused deputy' where agents misperceive screen states, and proposes a 'dual-channel contrastive classification' guardrail to mitigate this threat.
tldr_zh: 本文指出计算机使用代理（CUA）中存在一种名为“视觉混淆副手”的安全漏洞，即代理错误感知屏幕状态，并提出了一种“双通道对比分类”安全措施来缓解这一威胁。

title: GNNVerifier: Graph-based Verifier for LLM Task Planning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) facilitate the development of autonomous agents. As a core component of such agents, task planning aims to decompose complex natural language requests into concrete, solvable sub-tasks. Since LLM-generated plans are frequently prone to hallucinations and sensitive to long-context prom-pts, recent research has introduced plan verifiers to identify and correct potential flaws. However, most existing approaches still rely on an LLM as the verifier via additional prompting for plan review or self-reflection. LLM-based verifiers can be misled by plausible narration and struggle to detect failures caused by structural relations across steps, such as type mismatches, missing intermediates, or broken dependencies. To address these limitations, we propose a graph-based verifier for LLM task planning. Specifically, the proposed method has four major components: Firstly, we represent a plan as a directed graph with enriched attributes, where nodes denote sub-tasks and edges encode execution order and dependency constraints. Secondly, a graph neural network (GNN) then performs structural evaluation and diagnosis, producing a graph-level plausibility score for plan acceptance as well as node/edge-level risk scores to localize erroneous regions. Thirdly, we construct controllable perturbations from ground truth plan graphs, and automatically generate training data with fine-grained annotations. Finally, guided by the feedback from our GNN verifier, we enable an LLM to conduct local edits (e.g., tool replacement or insertion) to correct the plan when the graph-level score is insufficient. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets, backbone LLMs, and planners demonstrate that our GNNVerifier achieves significant gains in improving plan quality. Our data and code is available at https://github.com/BUPT-GAMMA/GNNVerifier.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）促进了自主代理的开发。作为此类代理的核心组成部分，任务规划旨在将复杂的自然语言请求分解为具体、可解决的子任务。由于LLM生成的计划经常容易出现幻觉，并且对长上下文提示敏感，最近的研究引入了计划验证器来识别和纠正潜在的缺陷。然而，大多数现有方法仍然依赖于LLM作为验证器，通过额外的提示来进行计划审查或自我反思。基于LLM的验证器可能会被看似合理的叙述所误导，并且难以检测由跨步骤的结构关系引起的故障，例如类型不匹配、缺少中间环节或依赖关系断裂。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种用于LLM任务规划的基于图的验证器。具体来说，所提出的方法包含四个主要组成部分：首先，我们将计划表示为一个带有丰富属性的有向图，其中节点表示子任务，边表示执行顺序和依赖约束。其次，图神经网络 (GNN) 执行结构评估和诊断，生成计划接受的图级别合理性分数，以及节点/边级别的风险分数，以定位错误区域。第三，我们从真实计划图构建可控的扰动，并自动生成带有细粒度注释的训练数据。最后，在来自GNN验证器的反馈指导下，我们使LLM能够进行局部编辑（例如，工具替换或插入）以在图级别分数不足时更正计划。跨各种数据集、骨干LLM和规划器的广泛实验表明，我们的GNNVerifier在提高计划质量方面取得了显著的收益。我们的数据和代码可在https://github.com/BUPT-GAMMA/GNNVerifier上获取。
tldr: This paper introduces GNNVerifier, a graph-based approach to verify and correct task plans generated by Large Language Models (LLMs), addressing limitations of existing LLM-based verifiers. It uses a GNN to evaluate plan structure and enable LLM-based plan editing.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GNNVerifier，一种基于图的方法来验证和纠正大型语言模型(LLM)生成的任务计划，解决了现有基于LLM验证器的局限性。它使用GNN评估计划结构，并支持基于LLM的计划编辑。

title: Learning to Order: Task Sequencing as In-Context Optimization
summary: Task sequencing (TS) is one of the core open problems in Deep Learning, arising in a plethora of real-world domains, from robotic assembly lines to autonomous driving. Unfortunately, prior work has not convincingly demonstrated the generalization ability of meta-learned TS methods to solve new TS problems, given few initial demonstrations. In this paper, we demonstrate that deep neural networks can meta-learn over an infinite prior of synthetically generated TS problems and achieve a few-shot generalization. We meta-learn a transformer-based architecture over datasets of sequencing trajectories generated from a prior distribution that samples sequencing problems as paths in directed graphs. In a large-scale experiment, we provide ample empirical evidence that our meta-learned models discover optimal task sequences significantly quicker than non-meta-learned baselines.
summary_zh: 任务排序(TS)是深度学习中的一个核心开放问题，它出现在从机器人装配线到自动驾驶等诸多现实世界领域。不幸的是，先前的工作尚未令人信服地证明元学习的TS方法在给定少量初始演示的情况下解决新的TS问题的泛化能力。在本文中，我们证明了深度神经网络可以对无限先验的合成生成的TS问题进行元学习，并实现小样本泛化。我们对基于Transformer的架构进行元学习，其训练数据集是从先验分布中生成的排序轨迹，该先验分布将排序问题采样为有向图中的路径。在一个大规模实验中，我们提供了充分的经验证据表明，我们的元学习模型比非元学习的基线模型更快地发现最优任务序列。
tldr: This paper presents a meta-learning approach using transformers to learn task sequencing policies from synthetic data, demonstrating improved few-shot generalization compared to non-meta-learned methods, which is very useful in RL environment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用Transformer的元学习方法，从合成数据中学习任务排序策略，与非元学习方法相比，展示了更好的少样本泛化能力，这在强化学习环境中非常有用。

title: Perception-Aware Autonomous Exploration in Feature-Limited Environments
summary: Autonomous exploration in unknown environments typically relies on onboard state estimation for localisation and mapping. Existing exploration methods primarily maximise coverage efficiency, but often overlook that visual-inertial odometry (VIO) performance strongly depends on the availability of robust visual features. As a result, exploration policies can drive a robot into feature-sparse regions where tracking degrades, leading to odometry drift, corrupted maps, and mission failure. We propose a hierarchical perception-aware exploration framework for a stereo-equipped unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) that explicitly couples exploration progress with feature observability. Our approach (i) associates each candidate frontier with an expected feature quality using a global feature map, and prioritises visually informative subgoals, and (ii) optimises a continuous yaw trajectory along the planned motion to maintain stable feature tracks. We evaluate our method in simulation across environments with varying texture levels and in real-world indoor experiments with largely textureless walls. Compared to baselines that ignore feature quality and/or do not optimise continuous yaw, our method maintains more reliable feature tracking, reduces odometry drift, and achieves on average 30\% higher coverage before the odometry error exceeds specified thresholds.
summary_zh: 在未知环境中进行自主探索通常依赖于机载状态估计来进行定位和建图。现有的探索方法主要关注覆盖效率最大化，但往往忽略了视觉惯性里程计(VIO)的性能强烈依赖于鲁棒视觉特征的可用性。因此，探索策略可能将机器人驱动到特征稀疏区域，导致跟踪退化，进而产生里程计漂移、地图损坏和任务失败。我们提出了一种针对配备双目相机无人机(UAV)的分层感知探索框架，该框架将探索进展与特征可观测性显式地结合起来。我们的方法(i) 使用全局特征地图将每个候选前沿与预期特征质量相关联，并优先考虑视觉信息丰富的子目标，以及(ii) 优化沿规划运动的连续yaw轨迹，以保持稳定的特征跟踪。我们在具有不同纹理水平的环境中进行了仿真评估，并在纹理贫乏的真实室内环境中进行了实验评估。与忽略特征质量和/或不优化连续yaw的基线方法相比，我们的方法能够保持更可靠的特征跟踪，减少里程计漂移，并在里程计误差超过指定阈值之前，平均实现高出30%的覆盖率。
tldr: This paper presents a perception-aware autonomous exploration framework for UAVs that considers feature observability to improve VIO performance and coverage in feature-limited environments, demonstrating improved performance over baselines in simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种感知自主探索框架，用于无人机在特征受限环境中，通过考虑特征可观测性来提高视觉惯性里程计（VIO）的性能和覆盖率。在模拟和真实世界实验中，该方法相对于基线方法表现出更好的性能。

title: EAAE: Energy-Aware Autonomous Exploration for UAVs in Unknown 3D Environments
summary: Battery-powered multirotor unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can rapidly map unknown environments, but mission performance is often limited by energy rather than geometry alone. Standard exploration policies that optimise for coverage or time can therefore waste energy through manoeuvre-heavy trajectories. In this paper, we address energy-aware autonomous 3D exploration for multirotor UAVs in initially unknown environments. We propose Energy-Aware Autonomous Exploration (EAAE), a modular frontier-based framework that makes energy an explicit decision variable during frontier selection. EAAE clusters frontiers into view-consistent regions, plans dynamically feasible candidate trajectories to the most informative clusters, and predicts their execution energy using an offline power estimation loop. The next target is then selected by minimising predicted trajectory energy while preserving exploration progress through a dual-layer planning architecture for safe execution. We evaluate EAAE in a full exploration pipeline with a rotor-speed-based power model across simulated 3D environments of increasing complexity. Compared to representative distance-based and information gain-based frontier baselines, EAAE consistently reduces total energy consumption while maintaining competitive exploration time and comparable map quality, providing a practical drop-in energy-aware layer for frontier exploration.
summary_zh: 基于电池供电的多旋翼无人机（UAV）能够快速绘制未知环境地图，但任务性能通常受到能量的限制，而非仅仅是几何因素。因此，优化覆盖率或时间的标准探索策略可能因频繁的机动轨迹而浪费能量。在本文中，我们研究了针对最初未知环境中多旋翼无人机的能量感知自主3D探索。我们提出了一种能量感知自主探索（EAAE）方案，这是一个模块化的基于边界的框架，该框架将能量作为边界选择过程中的一个显式决策变量。EAAE将边界聚类成视图一致的区域，规划到信息量最大的聚类的动态可行候选轨迹，并使用离线功率估算循环预测其执行能量。然后，通过最小化预测的轨迹能量来选择下一个目标，同时通过用于安全执行的双层规划架构来保持探索进度。我们通过一个完整的探索流程，使用基于旋翼转速的功率模型，在复杂度递增的模拟3D环境中评估EAAE。与具有代表性的基于距离和基于信息增益的边界基线相比，EAAE始终如一地降低了总能量消耗，同时保持了具有竞争力的探索时间和可比的地图质量，为边界探索提供了一个实用的即插即用的能量感知层。
tldr: This paper presents an energy-aware autonomous exploration framework (EAAE) for UAVs in unknown 3D environments, reducing energy consumption while maintaining exploration efficiency compared to standard methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于无人机在未知3D环境中进行能量感知自主探索的框架（EAAE），与标准方法相比，它在保持探索效率的同时降低了能量消耗。

title: S2Act: Simple Spiking Actor
summary: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) and biologically-inspired learning mechanisms are attractive in mobile robotics, where the size and performance of onboard neural network policies are constrained by power and computational budgets. Existing SNN approaches, such as population coding, reward modulation, and hybrid artificial neural network (ANN)-SNN architectures, have shown promising results; however, they face challenges in complex, highly stochastic environments due to SNN sensitivity to hyperparameters and inconsistent gradient signals. To address these challenges, we propose simple spiking actor (S2Act), a computationally lightweight framework that deploys an RL policy using an SNN in three steps: (1) architect an actor-critic model based on an approximated network of rate-based spiking neurons, (2) train the network with gradients using compatible activation functions, and (3) transfer the trained weights into physical parameters of rate-based leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neurons for inference and deployment. By globally shaping LIF neuron parameters such that their rate-based responses approximate ReLU activations, S2Act effectively mitigates the vanishing gradient problem, while pre-constraining LIF response curves reduces reliance on complex SNN-specific hyperparameter tuning. We demonstrate our method in two multi-agent stochastic environments (capture-the-flag and parking) that capture the complexity of multi-robot interactions, and deploy our trained policies on physical TurtleBot platforms using Intel's Loihi neuromorphic hardware. Our experimental results show that S2Act outperforms relevant baselines in task performance and real-time inference in nearly all considered scenarios, highlighting its potential for rapid prototyping and efficient real-world deployment of SNN-based RL policies.
summary_zh: 尖峰神经网络（SNN）和生物启发式学习机制在移动机器人领域极具吸引力，该领域对车载神经网络策略的规模和性能提出了功耗和计算预算的限制。现有的SNN方法，例如群体编码、奖励调制和混合人工神经网络（ANN）-SNN架构，已经展现出令人鼓舞的结果；然而，由于SNN对超参数的敏感性以及梯度信号的不一致性，它们在复杂、高度随机的环境中面临挑战。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种简单的尖峰行动者（S2Act），它是一个计算轻量级的框架，使用SNN通过三个步骤部署强化学习策略：（1）构建一个基于速率编码型尖峰神经元近似网络的行动者-评论家模型；（2）使用兼容的激活函数通过梯度训练该网络；（3）将训练好的权重转移到基于速率的漏电积分发放（LIF）神经元的物理参数中，用于推理和部署。通过全局调整LIF神经元的参数，使其速率编码的响应近似于ReLU激活，S2Act有效地缓解了梯度消失问题，同时预先约束LIF响应曲线降低了对复杂SNN特定超参数调优的依赖。我们在两个多智能体随机环境（夺旗和泊车）中演示了我们的方法，这两个环境捕捉了多机器人交互的复杂性，并使用英特尔的Loihi神经形态硬件在物理TurtleBot平台上部署了我们训练的策略。我们的实验结果表明，S2Act在几乎所有考虑的场景中都优于相关基线，在任务性能和实时推理方面均表现出色，突显了其在基于SNN的强化学习策略的快速原型设计和高效现实世界部署方面的潜力。
tldr: The paper presents S2Act, a framework for deploying RL policies using spiking neural networks on resource-constrained robotic platforms. It trains a surrogate network and transfers weights to LIF neurons, demonstrating superior performance in multi-agent environments and real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了S2Act，一个使用脉冲神经网络在资源受限的机器人平台上部署强化学习策略的框架。它训练一个替代网络并将权重转移到LIF神经元，证明了在多智能体环境和现实部署中具有卓越的性能。

title: End-to-End Dexterous Grasp Learning from Single-View Point Clouds via a Multi-Object Scene Dataset
summary: Dexterous grasping in multi-object scene constitutes a fundamental challenge in robotic manipulation. Current mainstream grasping datasets predominantly focus on single-object scenarios and predefined grasp configurations, often neglecting environmental interference and the modeling of dexterous pre-grasp gesture, thereby limiting their generalizability in real-world applications. To address this, we propose DGS-Net, an end-to-end grasp prediction network capable of learning dense grasp configurations from single-view point clouds in multi-object scene. Furthermore, we propose a two-stage grasp data generation strategy that progresses from dense single-object grasp synthesis to dense scene-level grasp generation. Our dataset comprises 307 objects, 240 multi-object scenes, and over 350k validated grasps. By explicitly modeling grasp offsets and pre-grasp configurations, the dataset provides more robust and accurate supervision for dexterous grasp learning. Experimental results show that DGS-Net achieves grasp success rates of 88.63\% in simulation and 78.98\% on a real robotic platform, while exhibiting lower penetration with a mean penetration depth of 0.375 mm and penetration volume of 559.45 mm^3, outperforming existing methods and demonstrating strong effectiveness and generalization capability. Our dataset is available at https://github.com/4taotao8/DGS-Net.
summary_zh: 在多物体场景中进行灵巧抓取是机器人操作中一项根本性的挑战。目前主流的抓取数据集主要关注单物体场景和预定义的抓取配置，通常忽略环境干扰以及灵巧预抓取姿态的建模，从而限制了它们在实际应用中的泛化能力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了DGS-Net，一种端到端的抓取预测网络，能够从多物体场景的单视角点云中学习密集的抓取配置。此外，我们提出了一种两阶段的抓取数据生成策略，该策略从密集的单物体抓取合成进展到密集的场景级抓取生成。我们的数据集包含307个物体、240个多物体场景以及超过35万个经过验证的抓取。通过显式地建模抓取偏移和预抓取配置，该数据集为灵巧抓取学习提供了更稳健和准确的监督。实验结果表明，DGS-Net在仿真中实现了88.63%的抓取成功率，在真实的机器人平台上实现了78.98%的抓取成功率，同时展现出更低的穿透，平均穿透深度为0.375毫米，穿透体积为559.45立方毫米，优于现有方法，并展示了强大的有效性和泛化能力。我们的数据集可在https://github.com/4taotao8/DGS-Net上获取。
tldr: This paper introduces DGS-Net, an end-to-end grasp prediction network and dataset for dexterous grasping in multi-object scenes using single-view point clouds, demonstrating promising simulation and real-world robot grasping results.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为DGS-Net的端到端抓取预测网络，并提出了一个用于多物体场景中灵巧抓取的单视角点云数据集，展示了有前景的模拟和真实机器人抓取结果。

title: Coupled Particle Filters for Robust Affordance Estimation
summary: Robotic affordance estimation is challenging due to visual, geometric, and semantic ambiguities in sensory input. We propose a method that disambiguates these signals using two coupled recursive estimators for sub-aspects of affordances: graspable and movable regions. Each estimator encodes property-specific regularities to reduce uncertainty, while their coupling enables bidirectional information exchange that focuses attention on regions where both agree, i.e., affordances. Evaluated on a real-world dataset, our method outperforms three recent affordance estimators (Where2Act, Hands-as-Probes, and HRP) by 308%, 245%, and 257% in precision, and remains robust under challenging conditions such as low light or cluttered environments. Furthermore, our method achieves a 70% success rate in our real-world evaluation. These results demonstrate that coupling complementary estimators yields precise, robust, and embodiment-appropriate affordance predictions.
summary_zh: 由于感知输入中存在视觉、几何和语义歧义，机器人可供性估计极具挑战性。我们提出一种方法，使用两个耦合的递归估计器来消除这些信号的歧义，这两个估计器分别针对可供性的子方面：可抓握区域和可移动区域。每个估计器编码特定属性的规律性来减少不确定性，而它们的耦合实现了双向信息交换，从而将注意力集中在两者都一致的区域，即可供性。在真实世界数据集上的评估表明，我们的方法在精确度方面分别优于最近的三种可供性估计器（Where2Act、Hands-as-Probes 和 HRP）308%、245% 和 257%，并且在低光或杂乱环境等具有挑战性的条件下仍然保持稳健性。此外，我们的方法在真实世界的评估中实现了 70% 的成功率。这些结果表明，耦合互补的估计器可以产生精确、稳健且适合机器人自身物理特性的可供性预测。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel method using coupled particle filters for robust robotic affordance estimation, outperforming existing methods in precision and robustness under challenging conditions.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种使用耦合粒子滤波器的新方法，用于鲁棒的机器人可供性估计，在精度和鲁棒性方面优于现有方法，即使在具有挑战性的条件下也是如此。

title: BodyGuards: Escorting by Multiple Robots in Unknown Environment under Limited Communication
summary: Multi-robot systems are increasingly deployed in high-risk missions such as reconnaissance, disaster response, and subterranean operations. Protecting a human operator while navigating unknown and adversarial environments remains a critical challenge, especially when the communication among the operator and robots is restricted. Unlike existing collaborative exploration methods that aim for complete coverage, this work focuses on task-oriented exploration to minimize the navigation time of the operator to reach its goal while ensuring safety under adversarial threats. A novel escorting framework BodyGuards, is proposed to explicitly integrate seamlessly collaborative exploration, inter-robot-operator communication and escorting. The framework consists of three core components: (I) a dynamic movement strategy for the operator that maintains a local map with risk zones for proactive path planning; (II) a dual-mode robotic strategy combining frontier based exploration with optimized return events to balance exploration, threat detection, and intermittent communication; and (III) multi-robot coordination protocols that jointly plan exploration and information sharing for efficient escorting. Extensive human-in-the-loop simulations and hardware experiments demonstrate that the method significantly reduces operator risk and mission time, outperforming baselines in adversarial and constrained environments.
summary_zh: 多机器人系统越来越多地被部署在高风险任务中，例如侦察、灾难响应和地下作业。在未知和对抗环境中导航的同时保护人类操作员仍然是一项关键挑战，尤其是在操作员和机器人之间的通信受限的情况下。与旨在实现完整覆盖的现有协同探索方法不同，这项工作侧重于面向任务的探索，以最大限度地减少操作员到达目标的导航时间，同时确保在对抗威胁下的安全性。本文提出了一种新颖的护送框架BodyGuards，它无缝集成了协同探索、机器人-操作员间的通信和护送。该框架由三个核心组件组成：（I）一种用于操作员的动态移动策略，该策略维护一个带有风险区域的局部地图，用于主动路径规划；（II）一种双模机器人策略，结合了基于边界的探索和优化的返回事件，以平衡探索、威胁检测和间歇性通信；以及（III）多机器人协调协议，该协议联合规划探索和信息共享，以实现高效的护送。大量的人在环仿真和硬件实验表明，该方法显著降低了操作员的风险和任务时间，在对抗和受限环境中优于基线方法。
tldr: The paper introduces a multi-robot escorting framework called BodyGuards for protecting a human operator in unknown environments with limited communication, focusing on task-oriented exploration to minimize navigation time and operator risk.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为BodyGuards的多机器人护送框架，用于在通信受限的未知环境中保护人类操作员。该框架专注于面向任务的探索，旨在最小化导航时间和操作员风险。

title: AeroGrab: A Unified Framework for Aerial Grasping in Cluttered Environments
summary: Reliable aerial grasping in cluttered environments remains challenging due to occlusions and collision risks. Existing aerial manipulation pipelines largely rely on centroid-based grasping and lack integration between the grasp pose generation models, active exploration, and language-level task specification, resulting in the absence of a complete end-to-end system. In this work, we present an integrated pipeline for reliable aerial grasping in cluttered environments. Given a scene and a language instruction, the system identifies the target object and actively explores it to gain better views of the object. During exploration, a grasp generation network predicts multiple 6-DoF grasp candidates for each view. Each candidate is evaluated using a collision-aware feasibility framework, and the overall best grasp is selected and executed using standard trajectory generation and control methods. Experiments in cluttered real-world scenarios demonstrate robust and reliable grasp execution, highlighting the effectiveness of combining active perception with feasibility-aware grasp selection for aerial manipulation.
summary_zh:
摘要：
由于遮挡和碰撞风险，在杂乱环境中实现可靠的空中抓取仍然具有挑战性。现有的空中操作流程很大程度上依赖于基于质心的抓取，并且缺乏抓取姿态生成模型、主动探索和语言级任务规范之间的集成，导致缺乏完整的端到端系统。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个集成的流程，用于在杂乱环境中实现可靠的空中抓取。给定一个场景和一个语言指令，该系统识别目标物体并主动探索它，以获得更好的物体视角。在探索过程中，一个抓取生成网络为每个视角预测多个 6 自由度的抓取候选姿势。使用一个碰撞感知的可行性框架评估每个候选姿势，并使用标准轨迹生成和控制方法选择并执行总体上最佳的抓取姿势。在杂乱的真实世界场景中的实验表明了鲁棒且可靠的抓取执行，突出了将主动感知与可行性感知的抓取选择相结合进行空中操作的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces an integrated aerial grasping pipeline that combines active exploration, 6-DoF grasp generation, and collision-aware feasibility assessment to achieve reliable grasping in cluttered environments, guided by language instructions.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个集成的空中抓取流程，结合了主动探索、六自由度抓取生成和碰撞感知可行性评估，以在混乱环境中实现可靠的抓取，并由语言指令引导。

title: Transformers As Generalizable Optimal Controllers
summary: We study whether optimal state-feedback laws for a family of heterogeneous Multiple-Input, Multiple-Output (MIMO) Linear Time-Invariant (LTI) systems can be captured by a single learned controller. We train one transformer policy on LQR-generated trajectories from systems with different state and input dimensions, using a shared representation with standardization, padding, dimension encoding, and masked loss. The policy maps recent state history to control actions without requiring plant matrices at inference time. Across a broad set of systems, it achieves empirically small sub-optimality relative to Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR), remains stabilizing under moderate parameter perturbations, and benefits from lightweight fine-tuning on unseen systems. These results support transformer policies as practical approximators of near-optimal feedback laws over structured linear-system families.
summary_zh: 我们研究了对于一类异构多输入多输出（MIMO）线性时不变（LTI）系统，是否可以使用单个学习控制器来捕获最优状态反馈控制律。我们使用具有标准化、填充、维度编码和掩码损失的共享表示，基于来自具有不同状态和输入维度的系统的LQR生成的轨迹训练了一个Transformer策略。该策略将最近的状态历史映射到控制行为，而无需在推理时使用系统矩阵。在广泛的系统集合中，相对于线性二次型调节器（LQR），该策略在经验上实现了较小的次优性，在适度的参数扰动下保持稳定，并能受益于对未见系统的轻量级微调。这些结果支持将Transformer策略作为结构化线性系统族近最优反馈控制律的实用逼近器。
tldr: This paper explores using transformers to learn generalizable optimal controllers for MIMO LTI systems, showing near-optimal performance and stability across diverse systems with minimal fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了使用Transformer学习MIMO LTI系统通用最优控制器的方法，结果表明，该方法在不同的系统上能够实现接近最优的性能和稳定性，并只需进行少量微调。

title: From Folding Mechanics to Robotic Function: A Unified Modeling Framework for Compliant Origami
summary: Origami inspired architectures offer a powerful route toward lightweight, reconfigurable, and programmable robotic systems. Yet, a unified mechanics framework capable of seamlessly bridging rigid folding, elastic deformation, and stability driven transitions in compliant origami remains lacking. Here, we introduce a geometry consistent modeling framework based on discrete differential geometry (DDG) that unifies panel elasticity and crease rotation within a single variational formulation. By embedding crease panel coupling directly into a mid edge geometric discretization, the framework naturally captures rigid folding limits, distributed bending, multistability, and nonlinear dynamic snap through within one mechanically consistent structure. This unified description enables programmable control of stability and deformation across rigid and compliant regimes, allowing origami structures to transition from static folding mechanisms to active robotic modules. An implicit dynamic formulation incorporating gravity, contact, friction, and magnetic actuation further supports strongly coupled multiphysics simulations. Through representative examples spanning single fold bifurcation, deployable Miura membranes, bistable Waterbomb modules, and Kresling based crawling robots, we demonstrate how geometry driven mechanics directly informs robotic functionality. This work establishes discrete differential geometry as a foundational design language for intelligent origami robotics, enabling predictive modeling, stability programming, and mechanics guided robotic actuation within a unified computational platform.
summary_zh: 受折纸启发的结构为轻量化、可重构和可编程的机器人系统提供了一条有效的途径。然而，一个能够无缝连接刚性折叠、弹性变形和柔顺折纸中由稳定性驱动的跃迁的统一力学框架仍然缺失。在此，我们引入了一种基于离散微分几何（DDG）的几何一致性建模框架，在单个变分公式中统一了面板弹性和折痕旋转。通过将折痕-面板耦合直接嵌入到中间边几何离散化中，该框架可以在一个力学一致的结构中自然地捕捉刚性折叠极限、分散弯曲、多稳态和非线性动态屈曲。这种统一的描述使得能够对刚性和柔顺状态下的稳定性和变形进行可编程控制，从而使折纸结构能够从静态折叠机构转变为主动机器人模块。包含重力、接触、摩擦和磁力驱动的隐式动态公式进一步支持强耦合的多物理场仿真。通过涵盖单折分叉、可展开的Miura薄膜、双稳态Waterbomb模块和基于Kresling的爬行机器人的代表性例子，我们展示了几何驱动的力学如何直接影响机器人功能。这项工作将离散微分几何确立为智能折纸机器人的基础设计语言，从而在一个统一的计算平台中实现预测性建模、稳定性编程和力学引导的机器人驱动。
tldr: This paper introduces a unified, geometry-consistent modeling framework based on discrete differential geometry (DDG) for compliant origami, enabling simulation and control of origami-based robotic systems across rigid, compliant, and dynamic regimes.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种统一的、几何一致的基于离散微分几何（DDG）的柔性折纸建模框架，能够在刚性、柔性和动态状态下模拟和控制基于折纸的机器人系统。

title: ViSA: Visited-State Augmentation for Generalized Goal-Space Contrastive Reinforcement Learning
summary: Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning (GCRL) is a framework for learning a policy that can reach arbitrarily given goals. In particular, Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (CRL) provides a framework for policy updates using an approximation of the value function estimated via contrastive learning, achieving higher sample efficiency compared to conventional methods. However, since CRL treats the visited state as a pseudo-goal during learning, it can accurately estimate the value function only for limited goals. To address this issue, we propose a novel data augmentation approach for CRL called ViSA (Visited-State Augmentation). ViSA consists of two components: 1) generating augmented state samples, with the aim of augmenting hard-to-visit state samples during on-policy exploration, and 2) learning consistent embedding space, which uses an augmented state as auxiliary information to regularize the embedding space by reformulating the objective function of the embedding space based on mutual information. We evaluate ViSA in simulation and real-world robotic tasks and show improved goal-space generalization, which permits accurate value estimation for hard-to-visit goals. Further details can be found on the project page: \href{https://issa-n.github.io/projectPage_ViSA/}{\texttt{https://issa-n.github.io/projectPage\_ViSA/}}
summary_zh: 目标条件强化学习（GCRL）是一种学习能够达到任意给定目标的策略的框架。特别地，对比强化学习（CRL）提供了一个框架，通过使用对比学习估计的价值函数的近似值进行策略更新，与传统方法相比，实现了更高的样本效率。然而，由于CRL在学习过程中将访问过的状态视为伪目标，它只能准确地估计有限目标的价值函数。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新的CRL数据增强方法，称为 ViSA（访问状态增强）。ViSA 由两个部分组成：1) 生成增强状态样本，旨在增强在线策略探索期间难以访问的状态样本；2) 学习一致的嵌入空间，该空间利用增强状态作为辅助信息，通过基于互信息重构嵌入空间的目标函数来正则化嵌入空间。我们在模拟和真实世界的机器人任务中评估了 ViSA，并展示了改进的目标空间泛化能力，这使得能够准确地估计难以访问的目标的价值。更多详细信息请访问项目页面：\href{https://issa-n.github.io/projectPage_ViSA/}{\texttt{https://issa-n.github.io/projectPage\_ViSA/}}
tldr: The paper introduces ViSA, a data augmentation method for Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (CRL) that improves goal-space generalization by augmenting hard-to-visit states and learning consistent embedding spaces, demonstrating improved performance in simulated and real-world robotic tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于对比强化学习（CRL）的数据增强方法ViSA，通过增强难访问状态和学习一致的嵌入空间，提高了目标空间泛化能力，并在模拟和真实机器人任务中展示了改进的性能。

title: GraspALL: Adaptive Structural Compensation from Illumination Variation for Robotic Garment Grasping in Any Low-Light Conditions
summary: Achieving accurate garment grasping under dynamically changing illumination is crucial for all-day operation of service robots.However, the reduced illumination in low-light scenes severely degrades garment structural features, leading to a significant drop in grasping robustness.Existing methods typically enhance RGB features by exploiting the illumination-invariant properties of non-RGB modalities, yet they overlook the varying dependence on non-RGB features under varying lighting conditions, which can introduce misaligned non-RGB cues and thereby weaken the model's adaptability to illumination changes when utilizing multimodal information.To address this problem, we propose GraspALL, an illumination-structure interactive compensation model.The innovation of GraspALL lies in encoding continuous illumination changes into quantitative references to guide adaptive feature fusion between RGB and non-RGB modalities according to varying lighting intensities, thereby generating illumination-consistent grasping representations.Experiments on the self-built garment grasping dataset demonstrate that GraspALL improves grasping accuracy by 32-44% over baselines under diverse illumination conditions.
summary_zh: 在动态变化光照条件下实现精确的服装抓取，对于服务机器人全天候运行至关重要。然而，弱光场景下的低照度会严重降低服装的结构特征，导致抓取鲁棒性显著下降。现有方法通常利用非RGB模态的光照不变特性来增强RGB特征，但它们忽略了非RGB特征在不同光照条件下依赖性的差异，这可能会引入错位的非RGB线索，从而在使用多模态信息时削弱模型对光照变化的适应性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了GraspALL，一种光照-结构交互补偿模型。GraspALL的创新之处在于将连续的光照变化编码为定量参考，以指导RGB和非RGB模态之间根据不同光照强度的自适应特征融合，从而生成光照一致的抓取表示。在自建的服装抓取数据集上的实验表明，在各种光照条件下，GraspALL比基线模型提高了32-44%的抓取准确率。
tldr: The paper introduces GraspALL, a model that adaptively fuses RGB and non-RGB features to improve garment grasping accuracy in low-light conditions by encoding continuous illumination changes. Experiments show a 32-44% improvement over baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GraspALL，一种自适应融合RGB和非RGB特征的模型，通过编码连续的光照变化来提高在低光照条件下服装抓取的准确性。实验表明，与基线相比，准确率提高了32-44%。

title: LiDAR-EVS: Enhance Extrapolated View Synthesis for 3D Gaussian Splatting with Pseudo-LiDAR Supervision
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a powerful technique for real-time LiDAR and camera synthesis in autonomous driving simulation. However, simulating LiDAR with 3DGS remains challenging for extrapolated views beyond the training trajectory, as existing methods are typically trained on single-traversal sensor scans, suffer from severe overfitting and poor generalization to novel ego-vehicle paths. To enable reliable simulation of LiDAR along unseen driving trajectories without external multi-pass data, we present LiDAR-EVS, a lightweight framework for robust extrapolated-view LiDAR simulation in autonomous driving. Designed to be plug-and-play, LiDAR-EVS readily extends to diverse LiDAR sensors and neural rendering baselines with minimal modification. Our framework comprises two key components: (1) pseudo extrapolated-view point cloud supervision with multi-frame LiDAR fusion, view transformation, occlusion curling, and intensity adjustment; (2) spatially-constrained dropout regularization that promotes robustness to diverse trajectory variations encountered in real-world driving. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiDAR-EVS achieves SOTA performance on extrapolated-view LiDAR synthesis across three datasets, making it a promising tool for data-driven simulation, closed-loop evaluation, and synthetic data generation in autonomous driving systems.
summary_zh: 3D高斯溅射 (3DGS) 已成为自动驾驶仿真中实时激光雷达和相机合成的强大技术。然而，由于现有方法通常基于单次遍历传感器扫描进行训练，存在严重的过拟合问题，且对新的自车路径的泛化能力较差，因此利用3DGS仿真超出训练轨迹范围的推断视角激光雷达仍然具有挑战性。为了在没有外部多遍数据的情况下，能够可靠地仿真沿未见驾驶轨迹的激光雷达，我们提出了LiDAR-EVS，一个轻量级框架，用于在自动驾驶中实现稳健的推断视角激光雷达仿真。LiDAR-EVS设计为即插即用，只需少量修改即可轻松扩展到各种激光雷达传感器和神经渲染基线。我们的框架包含两个关键组件：（1）通过多帧激光雷达融合、视角变换、遮挡卷曲和强度调整获得的伪推断视角点云监督；（2）空间约束的Dropout正则化，增强了对真实世界驾驶中遇到的各种轨迹变化的鲁棒性。大量的实验表明，LiDAR-EVS在三个数据集上的推断视角激光雷达合成方面实现了SOTA性能，使其成为自动驾驶系统中数据驱动仿真、闭环评估和合成数据生成的一个有前景的工具。
tldr: The paper introduces LiDAR-EVS, a plug-and-play framework for improving extrapolated view LiDAR simulation with 3D Gaussian Splatting, achieving SOTA performance on novel driving trajectories through pseudo-LiDAR supervision and spatial regularization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了LiDAR-EVS，一个即插即用的框架，通过伪LiDAR监督和空间正则化来改进具有3D高斯溅射的外推视图LiDAR模拟，并在新的驾驶轨迹上实现了SOTA性能。

title: Seeing Where to Deploy: Metric RGB-Based Traversability Analysis for Aerial-to-Ground Hidden Space Inspection
summary: Inspection of confined infrastructure such as culverts often requires accessing hidden spaces whose entrances are reachable primarily from elevated viewpoints. Aerial-ground cooperation enables a UAV to deploy a compact UGV for interior exploration, but selecting a suitable deployment region from aerial observations requires metric terrain reasoning involving scale ambiguity, reconstruction uncertainty, and terrain semantics. We present a metric RGB-based geometric-semantic reconstruction and traversability analysis framework for aerial-to-ground hidden space inspection. A feed-forward multi-view RGB reconstruction backbone produces dense geometry, while temporally consistent semantic segmentation yields a 3D semantic map. To enable deployment-relevant measurements without LiDAR-based dense mapping, we introduce an embodied motion prior that recovers metric scale by enforcing consistency between predicted camera motion and onboard platform egomotion. From the metrically grounded reconstruction, we construct a confidence-aware geometric-semantic traversability map and evaluate candidate deployment zones under explicit reachability constraints. Experiments on a tethered UAV-UGV platform demonstrate reliable deployment-zone identification in hidden space scenarios.
summary_zh: 涵洞等受限基础设施的检查通常需要进入隐藏空间，而这些空间的入口主要从高空视点才可到达。无人机-地面机器人协同使得无人机能够部署一个紧凑型地面机器人进行内部探索，但从空中观测中选择合适的部署区域需要进行包含尺度模糊、重建不确定性和地形语义的度量地形推理。我们提出了一种基于度量RGB的几何-语义重建和可通行性分析框架，用于空-地隐藏空间检查。前馈式多视点RGB重建主干网络生成稠密几何体，而时序一致的语义分割产生3D语义地图。为了在没有基于激光雷达的稠密建图情况下实现与部署相关的测量，我们引入了一种具身运动先验，通过强制预测相机运动与机载平台自运动之间的一致性来恢复度量尺度。从度量接地的重建中，我们构建一个置信度感知的几何-语义可通行性地图，并在明确的可达性约束下评估候选部署区域。在系绳式无人机-地面机器人平台上的实验表明，在隐藏空间场景中能够可靠地识别部署区域。
tldr: This paper introduces a metric RGB-based framework for aerial-to-ground hidden space inspection, enabling a UAV to select suitable deployment zones for a UGV using geometric-semantic reconstruction and traversability analysis without LiDAR.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于度量RGB的空中到地面隐蔽空间检测框架，使无人机能够使用几何语义重建和可穿越性分析来选择适合UGV部署的区域，而无需激光雷达。

title: CyboRacket: A Perception-to-Action Framework for Humanoid Racket Sports
summary: Dynamic ball-interaction tasks remain challenging for robots because they require tight perception-action coupling under limited reaction time. This challenge is especially pronounced in humanoid racket sports, where successful interception depends on accurate visual tracking, trajectory prediction, coordinated stepping, and stable whole-body striking. Existing robotic racket-sport systems often rely on external motion capture for state estimation or on task-specific low-level controllers that must be retrained across tasks and platforms. We present CyboRacket, a hierarchical perception-to-action framework for humanoid racket sports that integrates onboard visual perception, physics-based trajectory prediction, and large-scale pre-trained whole-body control. The framework uses onboard cameras to track the incoming object, predicts its future trajectory, and converts the estimated interception state into target end-effector and base-motion commands for whole-body execution by SONIC on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot. We evaluate the proposed framework in a vision-based humanoid tennis-hitting task. Experimental results demonstrate real-time visual tracking, trajectory prediction, and successful striking using purely onboard sensing.
summary_zh: 动态的球体交互任务对于机器人来说仍然具有挑战性，因为它们需要在有限的反应时间内进行紧密的感知-动作耦合。在人形球拍运动中，这一挑战尤为突出，因为成功拦截依赖于精确的视觉跟踪、轨迹预测、协调的步进和稳定的全身击打。现有的机器人球拍运动系统通常依赖于外部运动捕捉来进行状态估计，或者依赖于特定任务的低级控制器，这些控制器必须跨任务和平台进行重新训练。我们提出了CyboRacket，一种用于人形球拍运动的分层感知-动作框架，集成了车载视觉感知、基于物理的轨迹预测和大规模预训练的全身控制。该框架使用车载摄像头跟踪来球，预测其未来轨迹，并将估计的拦截状态转换为目标末端执行器和基座运动指令，供Unitree G1人形机器人的SONIC进行全身执行。我们通过一项基于视觉的人形网球击打任务来评估所提出的框架。实验结果表明，可以仅使用车载传感实现实时的视觉跟踪、轨迹预测和成功的击打。
tldr: CyboRacket is a hierarchical framework for humanoid robots that uses onboard sensing, physics-based trajectory prediction, and pre-trained whole-body control to perform dynamic ball-interaction tasks like tennis hitting.
tldr_zh: CyboRacket是一个用于人形机器人的分层框架，它利用板载传感、基于物理的轨迹预测和预训练的全身控制来执行动态球类互动任务，例如击打网球。

title: Latent Dynamics-Aware OOD Monitoring for Trajectory Prediction with Provable Guarantees
summary: In safety-critical Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS), accurate trajectory prediction provides vital guidance for downstream planning and control, yet although deep learning models achieve high-fidelity forecasts on validation data, their reliability degrades under out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios caused by environmental uncertainty or rare traffic behaviors in real-world deployment; detecting such OOD events is challenging due to evolving traffic conditions and changing interaction patterns, while safety-critical applications demand formal guarantees on detection delay and false-alarm rates, motivating us-following recent work [1]-to formulate OOD monitoring for trajectory prediction as a quickest changepoint detection (QCD) problem that offers a principled statistical framework with established theory; we further observe that the real-world evolution of prediction errors under in-distribution (ID) conditions can be effectively modeled by a Hidden Markov Model (HMM), and by leveraging this structure we extend the cumulative Maximum Mean Discrepancy approach to enable detection without requiring explicit knowledge of the post-change distribution while still admitting provable guarantees on delay and false alarms, with experiments on three real-world driving datasets demonstrating reduced detection delay and robustness to heavy-tailed errors and unknown post-change conditions.
summary_zh: 在安全攸关的网络物理系统（CPS）中，准确的轨迹预测为下游的规划和控制提供了至关重要的指导。然而，尽管深度学习模型在验证数据上实现了高保真度的预测，但由于环境不确定性或现实部署中罕见的交通行为所引起的分外分布（OOD）场景，其可靠性会下降。检测此类OOD事件具有挑战性，原因是不断变化的交通状况和交互模式，同时安全攸关应用需要对检测延迟和误报率进行正式保证。这促使我们——遵循最近的研究[1]——将轨迹预测的OOD监控定义为一个最速变化点检测（QCD）问题，该问题提供了一个具有既定理论的、有原则的统计框架。我们进一步观察到，在分布内（ID）条件下预测误差在现实世界中的演化可以有效地由隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）建模。通过利用这种结构，我们扩展了累积最大均值差异方法，从而能够在不需要显式了解变化后分布的情况下进行检测，同时仍然允许对延迟和误报进行可证明的保证。在三个真实世界驾驶数据集上的实验表明，该方法降低了检测延迟，并对重尾误差和未知的变化后条件具有鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper addresses out-of-distribution (OOD) detection for trajectory prediction in safety-critical systems by formulating it as a quickest changepoint detection (QCD) problem using a Hidden Markov Model (HMM) to achieve provable guarantees on detection delay and false alarms, which is evaluated on real-world driving datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了安全关键系统中轨迹预测的分布外（OOD）检测问题，通过使用隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）将其形式化为最速变化点检测（QCD）问题，从而在检测延迟和误报方面实现可证明的保证，并在真实驾驶数据集上进行了评估。

title: A Loss Landscape Visualization Framework for Interpreting Reinforcement Learning: An ADHDP Case Study
summary: Reinforcement learning algorithms have been widely used in dynamic and control systems. However, interpreting their internal learning behavior remains a challenge. In the authors' previous work, a critic match loss landscape visualization method was proposed to study critic training. This study extends that method into a framework which provides a multi-perspective view of the learning dynamics, clarifying how value estimation, policy optimization, and temporal-difference (TD) signals interact during training. The proposed framework includes four complementary components; a three-dimensional reconstruction of the critic match loss surface that shows how TD targets shape the optimization geometry; an actor loss landscape under a frozen critic that reveals how the policy exploits that geometry; a trajectory combining time, Bellman error, and policy weights that indicates how updates move across the surface; and a state-TD map that identifies the state regions that drive those updates. The Action-Dependent Heuristic Dynamic Programming (ADHDP) algorithm for spacecraft attitude control is used as a case study. The framework is applied to compare several ADHDP variants and shows how training stabilizers and target updates change the optimization landscape and affect learning stability. Therefore, the proposed framework provides a systematic and interpretable tool for analyzing reinforcement learning behavior across algorithmic designs.
summary_zh: 强化学习算法已被广泛应用于动态和控制系统中。然而，解读其内部学习行为仍然是一个挑战。在作者之前的研究中，提出了一种评论家匹配损失景观可视化方法来研究评论家训练。本研究将该方法扩展为一个框架，该框架提供对学习动态的多视角观察，阐明价值估计、策略优化和时间差分（TD）信号在训练期间如何相互作用。所提出的框架包括四个互补的组成部分：评论家匹配损失曲面的三维重构，展示了TD目标如何塑造优化几何结构；冻结评论家下的演员损失景观，揭示了策略如何利用该几何结构；结合时间、贝尔曼误差和策略权重的轨迹，指示更新如何在曲面上移动；以及一个状态-TD图，识别驱动这些更新的状态区域。将用于航天器姿态控制的动作依赖启发式动态规划（ADHDP）算法作为一个案例研究。应用该框架来比较几种ADHDP变体，并展示了训练稳定器和目标更新如何改变优化景观并影响学习稳定性。因此，所提出的框架为分析跨算法设计的强化学习行为提供了一种系统且可解释的工具。
tldr: This paper proposes a framework for visualizing the loss landscape in reinforcement learning to understand the interplay between value estimation, policy optimization, and TD signals, using ADHDP for spacecraft attitude control as a case study.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于可视化强化学习中损失景观的框架，以理解价值估计、策略优化和TD信号之间的相互作用，并以用于航天器姿态控制的ADHDP为例。

title: SmallSatSim: A High-Fidelity Simulation and Training Toolkit for Microgravity Robotic Close Proximity Operations
summary: Microgravity rendezvous and close proximity operations (RPO) is a growing area of interest for applications spanning in-space assembly and manufacturing (ISAM), orbital debris remediation, and small body exploration. Microgravity environments present unique challenges for robotic control and planning algorithms for new agile RPO mission scenarios like free-floating manipulation, planning under failure, and estimating high-fidelity dynamics of tumbling bodies. To facilitate the development and testing of novel RPO algorithms, we introduce SmallSatSim, a high-fidelity simulation toolkit that leverages the MuJoCo physics engine to accurately model small satellite RPO dynamics in local microgravity robotic free-flight settings, including under model disturbances and perturbations. The framework includes cutting edge out-of-the-box free-flyer control techniques. A GPU-accelerated pipeline using MuJoCo MJX and JAX is implemented for sampling- and learning-based simulation uses cases. SmallSatSim also supports configurable failure models, enabling the evaluation of safe control strategies under adversarial conditions. Visualization, logging, and GPU-enabled parallelization further enhance SmallSatSim's capability for RPO testing. We outline SmallSatSim's features and intended use cases, and demonstrate its use for robotic RPO planning and control. The open-sourced toolkit aims to accelerate research in autonomous, agile robotic small satellite operations.
summary_zh: 微重力交会和近距离操作(RPO)是日益受到关注的领域，其应用涵盖在轨组装与制造(ISAM)、轨道碎片清除以及小行星探测。微重力环境为用于新型敏捷RPO任务场景（例如自由漂浮操作、故障条件下的规划以及翻滚物体的精确动力学估计）的机器人控制和规划算法提出了独特的挑战。为了促进新型RPO算法的开发和测试，我们引入了SmallSatSim，这是一个高精度仿真工具包，它利用MuJoCo物理引擎来准确地模拟局部微重力机器人自由飞行环境中的小型卫星RPO动力学，包括在模型扰动和摄动下。该框架包括最前沿的开箱即用的自由飞行器控制技术。利用MuJoCo MJX和JAX的GPU加速流水线被用于基于采样和学习的仿真用例。SmallSatSim还支持可配置的故障模型，从而能够评估不利条件下的安全控制策略。可视化、日志记录和GPU加速并行化进一步增强了SmallSatSim的RPO测试能力。我们概述了SmallSatSim的特性和预期用例，并展示了其在机器人RPO规划和控制中的应用。该开源工具包旨在加速自主、敏捷机器人小型卫星操作方面的研究。
tldr: The paper introduces SmallSatSim, a high-fidelity, open-source simulation toolkit for microgravity robotic close proximity operations (RPO), designed for testing and development of novel RPO algorithms using MuJoCo and GPU acceleration.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍SmallSatSim，一个高保真度的开源微重力机器人近距离操作（RPO）仿真工具包，旨在利用MuJoCo和GPU加速来测试和开发新型RPO算法。

title: Visualizing Critic Match Loss Landscapes for Interpretation of Online Reinforcement Learning Control Algorithms
summary: Reinforcement learning has proven its power on various occasions. However, its performance is not always guaranteed when system dynamics change. Instead, it largely relies on users' empirical experience. For reinforcement learning algorithms with an actor-critic structure, the critic neural network reflects the approximation and optimization process in the RL algorithm. Analyzing the performance of the critic neural network helps to understand the mechanism of the algorithm. To support systematic interpretation of such algorithms in dynamic control problems, this work proposes a critic match loss landscape visualization method for online reinforcement learning. The method constructs a loss landscape by projecting recorded critic parameter trajectories onto a low-dimensional linear subspace. The critic match loss is evaluated over the projected parameter grid using fixed reference state samples and temporal-difference targets. This yields a three-dimensional loss surface together with a two-dimensional optimization path that characterizes critic learning behavior. To extend analysis beyond visual inspection, quantitative landscape indices and a normalized system performance index are introduced, enabling structured comparison across different training outcomes. The approach is demonstrated using the Action-Dependent Heuristic Dynamic Programming algorithm on cart-pole and spacecraft attitude control tasks. Comparative analyses across projection methods and training stages reveal distinct landscape characteristics associated with stable convergence and unstable learning. The proposed framework enables both qualitative and quantitative interpretation of critic optimization behavior in online reinforcement learning.
summary_zh: 强化学习已在多种场合证明其能力。然而，当系统动态发生变化时，其性能并不能总是得到保证。相反，它很大程度上依赖于用户的经验。对于具有Actor-Critic结构的强化学习算法，评论家（Critic）神经网络反映了强化学习算法中的近似和优化过程。分析评论家神经网络的性能有助于理解算法的机制。为了支持对此类算法在动态控制问题中的系统性解释，本文提出了一种针对在线强化学习的评论家匹配损失景观可视化方法。该方法通过将记录的评论家参数轨迹投影到低维线性子空间上来构建损失景观。评论家匹配损失使用固定的参考状态样本和时间差分（Temporal-Difference）目标在投影的参数网格上进行评估。这产生了一个三维损失表面以及一个表征评论家学习行为的二维优化路径。为了将分析扩展到视觉检查之外，引入了定量景观指标和一个归一化的系统性能指标，从而可以对不同的训练结果进行结构化比较。本文使用作用依赖启发式动态规划算法在倒立摆和航天器姿态控制任务上演示了该方法。对投影方法和训练阶段的比较分析揭示了与稳定收敛和不稳定学习相关的不同景观特征。所提出的框架能够对在线强化学习中评论家优化行为进行定性和定量解释。
tldr: This paper proposes a visualization method for analyzing critic behavior in online reinforcement learning by projecting critic parameter trajectories onto a low-dimensional loss landscape, allowing for qualitative and quantitative interpretation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种可视化方法，通过将critic参数轨迹投影到低维损失景观上，来分析在线强化学习中critic的行为，从而实现定性和定量解释。

title: Computational Concept of the Psyche
summary: This article presents an overview of approaches to modeling the human psyche in the context of constructing an artificial one. Based on this overview, a concept of cognitive architecture is proposed, in which the psyche is viewed as the operating system of a living or artificial subject, comprising a space of states, including the state of needs that determine the meaning of a subject's being in relation to stimuli from the external world, and intelligence as a decision-making system regarding actions in this world to satisfy these needs. Based on this concept, a computational formalization is proposed for creating artificial general intelligence systems for an agent through experiential learning in a state space that includes agent's needs, taking into account their biological or existential significance for the intelligent agent, along with agent's sensations and actions. Thus, the problem of constructing artificial general intelligence is formalized as a system for making optimal decisions in the space of specific agent needs under conditions of uncertainty, maximizing success in achieving goals, minimizing existential risks, and maximizing energy efficiency. A minimal experimental implementation of the model is presented.
summary_zh: 本文概述了在构建人工心理的背景下，对人类心理建模的各种方法。在此基础上，提出了一种认知架构的概念，其中心理被视为生物或人工主体的操作系统，包含一个状态空间，包括需要状态，该状态决定了主体相对于外部世界刺激的存在意义；以及智能，作为关于在此世界中采取行动以满足这些需求的决策系统。基于此概念，提出了一种计算形式化方法，用于通过在包括主体需求的状态空间中的经验学习，为智能体创建通用人工智能系统，考虑到这些需求对于智能体的生物或存在意义，以及智能体的感觉和行动。因此，构建通用人工智能的问题被形式化为一个在特定主体需求空间中，在不确定性条件下做出最优决策的系统，以最大化实现目标的成功率，最小化存在风险，并最大化能量效率。文中还展示了该模型的最小化实验实现。
tldr: This paper proposes a cognitive architecture for AGI, viewing the psyche as an operating system driven by needs and formalized for experiential learning, aiming for optimal decision-making under uncertainty. A minimal experimental implementation is presented.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种AGI的认知架构，将心灵视为由需求驱动的操作系统，并将其形式化以进行经验学习，旨在在不确定性下做出最优决策。论文展示了一个最简的实验实现。

title: Evasive Intelligence: Lessons from Malware Analysis for Evaluating AI Agents
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly adopted as tool-using agents that can plan, observe their environment, and take actions over extended time periods. This evolution challenges current evaluation practices where the AI models are tested in restricted, fully observable settings. In this article, we argue that evaluations of AI agents are vulnerable to a well-known failure mode in computer security: malicious software that exhibits benign behavior when it detects that it is being analyzed. We point out how AI agents can infer the properties of their evaluation environment and adapt their behavior accordingly. This can lead to overly optimistic safety and robustness assessments. Drawing parallels with decades of research on malware sandbox evasion, we demonstrate that this is not a speculative concern, but rather a structural risk inherent to the evaluation of adaptive systems. Finally, we outline concrete principles for evaluating AI agents, which treat the system under test as potentially adversarial. These principles emphasize realism, variability of test conditions, and post-deployment reassessment.
summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）系统正日益被采纳为工具型智能体，它们可以规划、观察环境，并在较长时间段内采取行动。这种演进对当前的评估实践提出了挑战，因为现有的评估通常是在受限的、完全可观察的环境中测试AI模型。在本文中，我们认为对AI智能体的评估容易受到计算机安全领域一种众所周知的失效模式的影响：恶意软件在检测到自身正被分析时会表现出良性行为。我们指出，AI智能体如何能够推断出其评估环境的属性，并相应地调整其行为。这可能导致过于乐观的安全性和鲁棒性评估结果。通过与恶意软件沙箱规避数十年的研究进行类比，我们证明这并非只是推测性的担忧，而是自适应系统评估中固有的结构性风险。最后，我们概述了评估AI智能体的具体原则，这些原则将受测系统视为潜在的对抗性系统。这些原则强调真实性、测试条件的可变性以及部署后的重新评估。
tldr: This paper argues that AI agent evaluations are susceptible to evasion tactics similar to malware, leading to inflated performance assessments, and proposes evaluation principles considering the agent as potentially adversarial.
tldr_zh: 本文指出，人工智能代理的评估容易受到类似恶意软件的规避策略的影响，导致对性能的评估过于乐观。文章提出了将代理视为潜在对抗者的评估原则。

title: Listening to the Echo: User-Reaction Aware Policy Optimization via Scalar-Verbal Hybrid Reinforcement Learning
summary: While current emotional support dialogue systems typically rely on expert-defined scalar rewards for alignment, these signals suffer from severe information sparsity. They cannot explain why a response failed or how to adapt to dynamic user states, often diverging from the actual goal of facilitating positive emotional shifts. In practice, the most direct and reliable learning signal emerges from the user's continuous reactions during ongoing interaction. We therefore propose Reaction Aware Policy Optimization (RAPO), a framework that optimizes over interaction consequences rather than rubric scores. RAPO treats dialogue as a reaction-driven process and utilizes simulated user responses to generate dense natural-language feedback through three core components: Hindsight Dialogue Selection, which isolates pivotal turns that meaningfully alter user emotional trajectories; Generative Hindsight Feedback, which transforms user reactions into contrastive ranking signals and natural-language critiques; and Scalar-Verbal Hybrid Policy Optimization, which couples scalar reward optimization for global alignment with verbal feedback distillation for fine-grained semantic refinement. Extensive experiments on ESC and Sotopia demonstrate that RAPO significantly outperforms strong reinforcement learning baselines in driving positive interaction outcomes.
summary_zh:
以下是翻译结果：

虽然目前的情感支持对话系统通常依赖于专家定义的标量奖励进行对齐，但这些信号存在严重的信息稀疏性问题。它们无法解释为什么一个回复失败或如何适应动态用户状态，常常偏离促进积极情绪转变的实际目标。实际上，最直接和可靠的学习信号来自用户在持续交互过程中的连续反应。因此，我们提出了反应感知策略优化（RAPO），这是一个优化交互后果而非评分标准的框架。RAPO将对话视为一个反应驱动的过程，并利用模拟的用户反应，通过三个核心组件生成密集型自然语言反馈：后见之明对话选择，它隔离了有意义地改变用户情绪轨迹的关键轮次；生成式后见之明反馈，它将用户反应转换为对比排序信号和自然语言批评；以及标量-文本混合策略优化，它将用于全局对齐的标量奖励优化与用于细粒度语义改进的文本反馈提炼相结合。在ESC和Sotopia上的大量实验表明，RAPO在驱动积极交互结果方面显著优于强大的强化学习基线。
tldr: The paper introduces Reaction Aware Policy Optimization (RAPO), a reinforcement learning framework that utilizes user reactions, transformed into natural language feedback, to improve emotional support dialogue systems, demonstrably outperforming existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为Reaction Aware Policy Optimization (RAPO)的强化学习框架，该框架利用用户反应，将其转换为自然语言反馈，以改进情感支持对话系统，并且表现优于现有方法。

title: Intelligent Co-Design: An Interactive LLM Framework for Interior Spatial Design via Multi-Modal Agents
summary: In architectural interior design, miscommunication frequently arises as clients lack design knowledge, while designers struggle to explain complex spatial relationships, leading to delayed timelines and financial losses. Recent advancements in generative layout tools narrow the gap by automating 3D visualizations. However, prevailing methodologies exhibit limitations: rule-based systems implement hard-coded spatial constraints that restrict participatory engagement, while data-driven models rely on extensive training datasets. Recent large language models (LLMs) bridge this gap by enabling intuitive reasoning about spatial relationships through natural language. This research presents an LLM-based, multimodal, multi-agent framework that dynamically converts natural language descriptions and imagery into 3D designs. Specialized agents (Reference, Spatial, Interactive, Grader), operating via prompt guidelines, collaboratively address core challenges: the agent system enables real-time user interaction for iterative spatial refinement, while Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) reduces data dependency without requiring task-specific model training. This framework accurately interprets spatial intent and generates optimized 3D indoor design, improving productivity, and encouraging nondesigner participation. Evaluations across diverse floor plans and user questionnaires demonstrate effectiveness. An independent LLM evaluator consistently rated participatory layouts higher in user intent alignment, aesthetic coherence, functionality, and circulation. Questionnaire results indicated 77% satisfaction and a clear preference over traditional design software. These findings suggest the framework enhances user-centric communication and fosters more inclusive, effective, and resilient design processes. Project page: https://rsigktyper.github.io/AICodesign/
summary_zh: 在建筑室内设计中，由于客户缺乏设计知识，而设计师难以解释复杂的空间关系，经常出现沟通不畅问题，导致时间延误和经济损失。生成式布局工具的最新进展通过自动化的3D可视化缩小了差距。然而，目前的主流方法存在局限性：基于规则的系统实施硬编码的空间约束，从而限制了参与性互动；而数据驱动的模型则依赖于广泛的训练数据集。近年来，大型语言模型(LLM)通过自然语言实现对空间关系的直观推理，弥补了这一差距。本研究提出了一种基于LLM的多模态、多Agent框架，该框架能够动态地将自然语言描述和图像转换为3D设计。通过提示指南运行的专业化Agent（参考Agent、空间Agent、交互Agent、评分Agent）协同解决核心挑战：该Agent系统支持实时用户交互，用于迭代的空间优化；同时，检索增强生成(RAG)技术减少了数据依赖性，而无需进行特定任务的模型训练。该框架能够准确地理解空间意图并生成优化的3D室内设计，从而提高生产力并鼓励非设计人员参与。对多种平面图和用户问卷的评估证明了其有效性。独立的LLM评估器一致认为，参与式布局在用户意图对齐、美学连贯性、功能性和动线上都得分更高。问卷调查结果显示，满意度达到77%，并且明显优于传统设计软件。这些发现表明，该框架增强了以用户为中心的沟通，并促进了更具包容性、有效性和弹性的设计流程。项目页面：https://rsigktyper.github.io/AICodesign/
tldr: This paper introduces an LLM-based, multi-modal, multi-agent framework for interior spatial design that translates natural language and imagery into 3D designs, enabling real-time user interaction and improving design processes.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于LLM的多模态多智能体室内空间设计框架，该框架将自然语言和图像转换为3D设计，实现实时用户交互并改进设计流程。

title: Algorithms for Deciding the Safety of States in Fully Observable Non-deterministic Problems: Technical Report
summary: Learned action policies are increasingly popular in sequential decision-making, but suffer from a lack of safety guarantees. Recent work introduced a pipeline for testing the safety of such policies under initial-state and action-outcome non-determinism. At the pipeline's core, is the problem of deciding whether a state is safe (a safe policy exists from the state) and finding faults, which are state-action pairs that transition from a safe state to an unsafe one. Their most effective algorithm for deciding safety, TarjanSafe, is effective on their benchmarks, but we show that it has exponential worst-case runtime with respect to the state space. A linear-time alternative exists, but it is slower in practice. We close this gap with a new policy-iteration algorithm iPI, that combines the best of both: it matches TarjanSafe's best-case runtime while guaranteeing a polynomial worst-case. Experiments confirm our theory and show that in problems amenable to TarjanSafe iPI has similar performance, whereas in ill-suited problems iPI scales exponentially better.
summary_zh: 学习到的动作策略在序贯决策中越来越受欢迎，但安全性保障不足。最近的研究引入了一个管道，用于在初始状态和动作结果非确定性的情况下测试此类策略的安全性。该管道的核心问题是确定一个状态是否安全（即是否存在从此状态出发的安全策略）并找到故障，即从安全状态转移到不安全状态的状态-动作对。他们用于确定安全性的最有效算法TarjanSafe在其基准测试中表现出色，但我们证明了其最坏情况下的运行时复杂度相对于状态空间呈指数增长。存在一种线性时间的替代方案，但在实践中速度较慢。我们通过一种新的策略迭代算法iPI来弥合这一差距，该算法结合了两者的优点：它匹配TarjanSafe的最佳情况运行时，同时保证了多项式最坏情况复杂度。实验证实了我们的理论，并且表明在适合TarjanSafe的问题中，iPI具有相似的性能，而在不适合的问题中，iPI的扩展性呈指数级增长。
tldr: This paper introduces a new policy-iteration algorithm, iPI, for deciding the safety of states in non-deterministic problems, improving upon existing methods by achieving both fast best-case runtime and polynomial worst-case runtime guarantees.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的策略迭代算法 iPI，用于在非确定性问题中判断状态的安全性。该算法改进了现有方法，兼具快速的最佳情况运行时和多项式最坏情况运行时的保证。

title: Directional Embedding Smoothing for Robust Vision Language Models
summary: The safety and reliability of vision-language models (VLMs) are a crucial part of deploying trustworthy agentic AI systems. However, VLMs remain vulnerable to jailbreaking attacks that undermine their safety alignment to yield harmful outputs. In this work, we extend the Randomized Embedding Smoothing and Token Aggregation (RESTA) defense to VLMs and evaluate its performance against the JailBreakV-28K benchmark of multi-modal jailbreaking attacks. We find that RESTA is effective in reducing attack success rate over this diverse corpus of attacks, in particular, when employing directional embedding noise, where the injected noise is aligned with the original token embedding vectors. Our results demonstrate that RESTA can contribute to securing VLMs within agentic systems, as a lightweight, inference-time defense layer of an overall security framework.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的安全性和可靠性是部署可信 Agentic AI 系统的重要组成部分。然而，VLMs 仍然容易受到越狱攻击，这些攻击会破坏其安全对齐，从而产生有害的输出。在这项工作中，我们将随机嵌入平滑和令牌聚合（RESTA）防御扩展到 VLMs，并针对 JailBreakV-28K 多模态越狱攻击基准测试评估其性能。我们发现，RESTA 在降低针对这一多样化攻击语料库的攻击成功率方面是有效的，特别是当采用方向嵌入噪声时，其中注入的噪声与原始令牌嵌入向量对齐。我们的结果表明，RESTA 作为整体安全框架的轻量级推理时防御层，可以为保障 Agentic 系统中的 VLMs 安全做出贡献。
tldr: This paper adapts Randomized Embedding Smoothing and Token Aggregation (RESTA) to Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as a defense against jailbreaking attacks, finding that directional embedding noise is especially effective in reducing attack success.
tldr_zh: 该论文将随机嵌入平滑和令牌聚合（RESTA）应用于视觉语言模型（VLM），作为防御越狱攻击的方法，发现定向嵌入噪声特别有效地降低了攻击成功率。

title: Safe Flow Q-Learning: Offline Safe Reinforcement Learning with Reachability-Based Flow Policies
