Together, our findings provide the first evidence that eye gaze-informed modeling fundamentally advances pedestrian behavior prediction and highlight the critical role of situational contexts in shared-space interactions. This paves the way for safer and more adaptive automated vehicle technologies that account for how people perceive and act in complex shared spaces.
summary_zh: 自动穿梭车融入共享城市空间，由于缺乏交通规则和行人交互的复杂性，带来独特的挑战。因此，准确预测在这种非结构化环境中行人的行为，对于确保安全性和效率至关重要。本文提出了一项虚拟现实（VR）研究，旨在捕捉行人在各种场景下与自动穿梭车的交互方式，包括不同的接近角度和在连续交通中导航。我们识别出行人在共享空间决策中的关键行为模式，包括犹豫、规避动作、目光分配和空间位置调整。为了对行人行为进行建模，我们提出了GazeX-LSTM，一种多模态、眼动追踪导向且具有上下文感知能力的预测模型，它整合了行人的轨迹、精细的眼动动态以及上下文因素。通过利用眼动追踪数据来捕捉行人注意力，我们将预测从以车辆为中心转移到以人为中心的视角。我们系统地验证了眼动追踪相对于仅使用头部朝向的独特且不可替代的预测能力，并通过整合上下文变量进一步提高了性能。值得注意的是，眼动追踪数据和上下文信息的结合在行人行为预测精度上产生了超加性的改进，揭示了视觉注意力和情境环境之间的互补关系。总而言之，我们的研究结果首次证明了眼动追踪导向的建模从根本上促进了行人行为预测，并强调了情境环境在共享空间交互中的关键作用。这为更安全、更具适应性的自动驾驶车辆技术铺平了道路，该技术能够考虑到人们在复杂共享空间中的感知和行为方式。
tldr: This paper introduces GazeX-LSTM, a VR-validated, gaze-informed, and context-aware model for pedestrian trajectory prediction in shared spaces with automated vehicles, demonstrating the irreplaceable predictive power of eye gaze and the importance of context.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为GazeX-LSTM的模型，该模型通过VR验证，结合了眼动追踪和上下文信息，用于预测自动驾驶车辆共享空间中行人的轨迹。研究表明，眼动追踪具有不可替代的预测能力，且上下文信息至关重要。

title: MeanFlow Meets Control: Scaling Sampled-Data Control for Swarms
summary: Steering large-scale swarms in only a few control updates is challenging because real systems operate in sampled-data form: control inputs are updated intermittently and applied over finite intervals. In this regime, the natural object is not an instantaneous velocity field, but a finite-window control quantity that captures the system response over each sampling interval. Inspired by MeanFlow, we introduce a control-space learning framework for swarm steering under linear time-invariant dynamics. The learned object is the coefficient that parameterizes the finite-horizon minimum-energy control over each interval. We show that this coefficient admits both an integral representation and a local differential identity along bridge trajectories, which leads to a simple stop-gradient training objective. At implementation time, the learned coefficient is used directly in sampled-data updates, so the prescribed dynamics and actuation map are respected by construction. The resulting framework provides a scalable approach to few-step swarm steering that is consistent with the sampled-data structure of real control systems.
summary_zh: 在仅几次控制更新中引导大规模集群是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为实际系统以采样数据形式运行：控制输入是间歇性更新的，并在有限的时间间隔内应用。在这种情况下，自然对象不是瞬时速度场，而是捕获每个采样间隔内系统响应的有限窗口控制量。受 MeanFlow 启发，我们引入了一种控制空间学习框架，用于在线性时不变动力学下的集群引导。学习的对象是参数化每个间隔内有限时域最小能量控制的系数。我们证明了该系数具有积分表示和沿桥接轨迹的局部微分恒等式，这导致了一个简单的停止梯度训练目标。在实施时，学习到的系数直接用于采样数据更新，因此，规定的动力学和驱动映射在构建上得到满足。由此产生的框架为少数步集群引导提供了一种可扩展的方法，该方法与实际控制系统的采样数据结构一致。
tldr: This paper introduces a control-space learning framework inspired by MeanFlow for steering swarms with few control updates under sampled-data dynamics, focusing on finite-horizon minimum-energy control over each sampling interval. The framework provides a scalable approach to few-step swarm steering that is consistent with the sampled-data structure of real control systems.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种受 MeanFlow 启发的控制空间学习框架，用于在采样数据动力学下通过少量控制更新来引导集群，重点是在每个采样间隔内的有限时域最小能量控制。该框架提供了一种可扩展的方法，用于与实际控制系统的采样数据结构一致的少步集群引导。

title: HortiMulti: A Multi-Sensor Dataset for Localisation and Mapping in Horticultural Polytunnels
summary: Agricultural robotics is gaining increasing relevance in both research and real-world deployment. As these systems are expected to operate autonomously in more complex tasks, the availability of representative real-world datasets becomes essential. While domains such as urban and forestry robotics benefit from large and established benchmarks, horticultural environments remain comparatively under-explored despite the economic significance of this sector. To address this gap, we present HortiMulti, a multimodal, cross-season dataset collected in commercial strawberry and raspberry polytunnels across an entire growing season, capturing substantial appearance variation, dynamic foliage, specular reflections from plastic covers, severe perceptual aliasing, and GNSS-unreliable conditions, all of which directly degrade existing localisation and perception algorithms. The sensor suite includes two 3D LiDARs, four RGB cameras, an IMU, GNSS, and wheel odometry. Ground truth trajectories are derived from a combination of Total Station surveying, AprilTag fiducial markers, and LiDAR-inertial odometry, spanning dense, sparse, and marker-free coverage to support evaluation under both controlled and realistic conditions. We release time-synchronised raw measurements, calibration files, reference trajectories, and baseline benchmarks for visual, LiDAR, and multi-sensor SLAM, with results confirming that current state-of-the-art methods remain inadequate for reliable polytunnel deployment, establishing HortiMulti as a one-stop resource for developing and testing robotic perception systems in horticulture environments.
summary_zh: 农业机器人技术在研究和实际部署中的相关性日益增强。由于这些系统有望在更复杂的任务中自主运行，因此具有代表性的真实世界数据集的可用性至关重要。虽然城市和林业机器人领域受益于大型且已建立的基准，但园艺环境，尽管该部门具有重要的经济意义，但仍然相对缺乏探索。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了HortiMulti，这是一个多模态、跨季节的数据集，它是在商业草莓和覆盆子塑料大棚中，跨越整个生长季节收集的，捕捉了大量的外观变化、动态的树叶、塑料覆盖物产生的镜面反射、严重感知混叠以及GNSS不可靠的状况，所有这些都会直接降低现有的定位和感知算法的性能。传感器套件包括两个3D LiDAR、四个RGB相机、一个IMU、GNSS和轮式里程计。真值轨迹来源于全站仪测量、AprilTag基准标记和LiDAR-惯性里程计的组合，跨越密集、稀疏和无标记覆盖，以支持在受控和真实条件下进行评估。我们发布了时间同步的原始测量数据、校准文件、参考轨迹以及用于视觉、LiDAR和多传感器SLAM的基准测试，结果证实目前最先进的方法仍然不足以用于可靠的塑料大棚部署，从而将HortiMulti确立为开发和测试园艺环境中机器人感知系统的一站式资源。
tldr: The paper introduces HortiMulti, a new multi-modal, cross-season dataset for robotics research in horticultural polytunnels, addressing the lack of suitable benchmarks for this economically significant but under-explored domain. It highlights the challenges of this environment for existing SLAM methods and provides baseline benchmarks for various sensors.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了HortiMulti，一个用于园艺塑料大棚机器人技术研究的多模态、跨季节数据集，旨在解决该经济重要但未被充分探索的领域缺乏合适基准的问题。论文强调了该环境对现有SLAM方法的挑战，并为各种传感器提供了基准。

title: KUKAloha: A General, Low-Cost, and Shared-Control based Teleoperation Framework for Construction Robot Arm
summary: This paper presents KUKAloha, a general, low-cost, and shared-control teleoperation framework designed for construction robot arms. The proposed system employs a leader-follower paradigm in which a lightweight leading arm enables intuitive human guidance for coarse robot motion, while an autonomous perception module based on AprilTag detection performs precise alignment and grasp execution. By explicitly decoupling human control from fine manipulation, KUKAloha improves safety and repeatability when operating large-scale manipulators. We implement the framework on a KUKA robot arm and conduct a usability study with representative construction manipulation tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that KUKAloha reduces operator workload, improves task completion efficiency, and provides a practical solution for scalable demonstration collection and shared human-robot control in construction environments.
summary_zh: 本文介绍KUKAloha，一个通用、低成本、共享控制的遥操作框架，专为建筑机器人手臂设计。所提出的系统采用主从范式，轻量化的主臂能够实现直观的人工引导，用于机器人的粗略运动，同时基于AprilTag检测的自主感知模块执行精确的对齐和抓取。通过将人工控制与精细操作显式解耦，KUKAloha提高了操作大型机械臂的安全性和可重复性。我们在KUKA机器人手臂上实现了该框架，并对具有代表性的建筑操作任务进行了可用性研究。实验结果表明，KUKAloha降低了操作员的工作负荷，提高了任务完成效率，并为建筑环境中可扩展的示教数据收集以及共享人机控制提供了一个实用的解决方案。
tldr: The paper introduces KUKAloha, a low-cost teleoperation framework for construction robot arms that combines human guidance with autonomous perception for improved safety and efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种低成本的遥操作框架KUKAloha，用于建筑机器人手臂，它结合了人工指导和自主感知，以提高安全性和效率。

title: Spectral Alignment in Forward-Backward Representations via Temporal Abstraction
summary: Forward-backward (FB) representations provide a powerful framework for learning the successor representation (SR) in continuous spaces by enforcing a low-rank factorization. However, a fundamental spectral mismatch often exists between the high-rank transition dynamics of continuous environments and the low-rank bottleneck of the FB architecture, making accurate low-rank representation learning difficult. In this work, we analyze temporal abstraction as a mechanism to mitigate this mismatch. By characterizing the spectral properties of the transition operator, we show that temporal abstraction acts as a low-pass filter that suppresses high-frequency spectral components. This suppression reduces the effective rank of the induced SR while preserving a formal bound on the resulting value function error. Empirically, we show that this alignment is a key factor for stable FB learning, particularly at high discount factors where bootstrapping becomes error-prone. Our results identify temporal abstraction as a principled mechanism for shaping the spectral structure of the underlying MDP and enabling effective long-horizon representations in continuous control.
summary_zh: 正向-反向（FB）表示通过强制执行低秩分解为在连续空间中学习后继表示（SR）提供了一个强大的框架。然而，在连续环境的高秩转移动态和FB架构的低秩瓶颈之间，常常存在一个根本的谱不匹配，使得准确的低秩表示学习变得困难。在这项工作中，我们分析了时间抽象作为一种缓解这种不匹配的机制。通过表征转移算子的谱特性，我们表明时间抽象充当了一个低通滤波器，抑制了高频谱分量。这种抑制降低了诱导SR的有效秩，同时保留了对所得价值函数误差的形式约束。经验上，我们表明这种对齐是稳定FB学习的一个关键因素，特别是在高折扣因子下，此时引导变得容易出错。我们的结果表明，时间抽象是一种原则性的机制，可以塑造底层MDP的谱结构，并在连续控制中实现有效的长视野表示。
tldr: This paper addresses the spectral mismatch problem in forward-backward representations for successor representation learning by using temporal abstraction to act as a low-pass filter, improving stability and long-horizon representation learning in continuous control.
tldr_zh: 该论文通过使用时间抽象作为低通滤波器，解决了前向-后向表示中继承者表示学习的频谱失配问题，从而提高了连续控制中稳定性和长程表示学习能力。

title: Beyond detection: cooperative multi-agent reasoning for rapid onboard EO crisis response
summary:
Rapid identification of hazardous events is essential for next-generation Earth Observation (EO) missions supporting disaster response. However, current monitoring pipelines remain largely ground-centric, introducing latency due to downlink limitations, multi-source data fusion constraints, and the computational cost of exhaustive scene analysis.
  This work proposes a hierarchical multi-agent architecture for onboard EO processing under strict resource and bandwidth constraints. The system enables the exploitation of complementary multimodal observations by coordinating specialized AI agents within an event-driven decision pipeline. AI agents can be deployed across multiple nodes in a distributed setting, such as satellite platforms. An Early Warning agent generates fast hypotheses from onboard observations and selectively activates domain-specific analysis agents, while a Decision agent consolidates the evidence to issue a final alert. The architecture combines vision-language models, traditional remote sensing analysis tools, and role-specialized agents to enable structured reasoning over multimodal observations while minimizing unnecessary computation.
  A proof-of-concept implementation was executed on the engineering model of an edge-computing platform currently deployed in orbit, using representative satellite data. Experiments on wildfire and flood monitoring scenarios show that the proposed routing-based pipeline significantly reduces computational overhead while maintaining coherent decision outputs, demonstrating the feasibility of distributed agent-based reasoning for future autonomous EO constellations.
summary_zh:
快速识别危险事件对于支持灾害响应的下一代地球观测(EO)任务至关重要。然而，当前的监测流程在很大程度上仍然以地面为中心，由于下行链路的限制、多源数据融合的约束以及穷尽场景分析的计算成本，引入了延迟。

  这项工作提出了一种分层的多智能体架构，用于在严格的资源和带宽约束下进行星载EO处理。该系统通过在事件驱动的决策流程中协调专业化的AI智能体，实现了对互补的多模态观测的利用。AI智能体可以部署在分布式环境中的多个节点上，例如卫星平台。一个早期预警智能体从星载观测中快速生成假设，并选择性地激活领域特定的分析智能体，而决策智能体则整合证据以发出最终警报。该架构结合了视觉-语言模型、传统的遥感分析工具和角色专门化的智能体，从而能够在最小化不必要计算的同时，对多模态观测进行结构化推理。

  一个概念验证的实现是在目前已部署在轨的边缘计算平台的工程模型上执行的，使用了具有代表性的卫星数据。在野火和洪水监测场景中的实验表明，所提出的基于路由的流程显著降低了计算开销，同时保持了连贯的决策输出，证明了基于分布式智能体的推理对于未来自主EO星座的可行性。
tldr: This paper proposes a multi-agent architecture for onboard Earth Observation data processing, using vision-language models and other techniques to enable rapid crisis response with limited resources, and validates it on an edge-computing platform in orbit.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于星上地球观测数据处理的多智能体架构，利用视觉-语言模型和其他技术，在有限的资源下实现快速的危机响应，并在一个在轨边缘计算平台上进行了验证。

title: Accurate Open-Loop Control of a Soft Continuum Robot Through Visually Learned Latent Representations
summary: This work addresses open-loop control of a soft continuum robot (SCR) from video-learned latent dynamics. Visual Oscillator Networks (VONs) from previous work are used, that provide mechanistically interpretable 2D oscillator latents through an attention broadcast decoder (ABCD). Open-loop, single-shooting optimal control is performed in latent space to track image-specified waypoints without camera feedback. An interactive SCR live simulator enables design of static, dynamic, and extrapolated targets and maps them to model-specific latent waypoints. On a two-segment pneumatic SCR, Koopman, MLP, and oscillator dynamics, each with and without ABCD, are evaluated on setpoint and dynamic trajectories. ABCD-based models consistently reduce image-space tracking error. The VON and ABCD-based Koopman models attains the lowest MSEs. Using an ablation study, we demonstrate that several architecture choices and training settings contribute to the open-loop control performance. Simulation stress tests further confirm static holding, stable extrapolated equilibria, and plausible relaxation to the rest state. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first demonstration that interpretable, video-learned latent dynamics enable reliable long-horizon open-loop control of an SCR.
summary_zh: 本研究探讨了从视频学习到的潜在动力学中对软体连续机器人(SCR)进行开环控制的问题。采用先前工作中提出的视觉振荡器网络(VON)，该网络通过注意力广播解码器(ABCD)提供机械上可解释的2D振荡器潜在变量。在潜在空间中执行开环单次最优控制，以跟踪图像指定的路径点，无需相机反馈。一个交互式的SCR实时模拟器能够设计静态、动态和外推目标，并将它们映射到模型特定的潜在路径点。在一个两段式气动SCR上，对Koopman、MLP和振荡器动力学模型进行了评估，每个模型都分别采用了ABCD和未采用ABCD，评估任务包括设定点和动态轨迹的跟踪。基于ABCD的模型始终能降低图像空间的跟踪误差。VON和基于ABCD的Koopman模型获得了最低的均方误差(MSE)。通过消融研究，我们论证了几种架构选择和训练设置对开环控制性能的贡献。仿真压力测试进一步证实了静态保持能力、稳定的外推平衡点和可信的松弛至静止状态的能力。据我们所知，这是首次展示可解释的、视频学习到的潜在动力学能够实现SCR可靠的长期开环控制。
tldr: The paper presents a novel approach for open-loop control of soft continuum robots using visually learned latent dynamics, specifically using Visual Oscillator Networks (VONs) with an attention broadcast decoder (ABCD). It demonstrates improved tracking accuracy compared to other methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用视觉学习潜在动力学进行软体连续机器人开环控制的新方法，特别使用了带有注意力广播解码器（ABCD）的视觉振荡器网络（VON）。结果表明，与其它方法相比，该方法能显著提高跟踪精度。

title: Evolving Embodied Intelligence: Graph Neural Network--Driven Co-Design of Morphology and Control in Soft Robotics
summary: The intelligent behavior of robots does not emerge solely from control systems, but from the tight coupling between body and brain, a principle known as embodied intelligence. Designing soft robots that leverage this interaction remains a significant challenge, particularly when morphology and control require simultaneous optimization. A significant obstacle in this co-design process is that morphological evolution can disrupt learned control strategies, making it difficult to reuse or adapt existing knowledge. We address this by develop a Graph Neural Network-based approach for the co-design of morphology and controller. Each robot is represented as a graph, with a graph attention network (GAT) encoding node features and a pooled representation passed through a multilayer perceptron (MLP) head to produce actuator commands or value estimates. During evolution, inheritance follows a topology-consistent mapping: shared GAT layers are reused, MLP hidden layers are transferred intact, matched actuator outputs are copied, and unmatched ones are randomly initialized and fine-tuned. This morphology-aware policy class lets the controller adapt when the body mutates. On the benchmark, our GAT-based approach achieves higher final fitness and stronger adaptability to morphological variations compared to traditional MLP-only co-design methods. These results indicate that graph-structured policies provide a more effective interface between evolving morphologies and control for embodied intelligence.
summary_zh: 机器人智能行为不仅仅源于控制系统，而是源于身体和大脑之间的紧密耦合，这一原则被称为具身智能。设计能够利用这种相互作用的软体机器人仍然是一个重大的挑战，特别是当形态和控制需要同时优化时。这种协同设计过程中一个显著的障碍是，形态进化会扰乱已学习的控制策略，使得重用或调整现有知识变得困难。我们通过开发一种基于图神经网络的方法来解决形态和控制器的协同设计问题。每个机器人都被表示为一个图，其中图注意力网络（GAT）对节点特征进行编码，池化的表示通过多层感知机（MLP）头部传递，以生成执行器命令或价值估计。在进化过程中，继承遵循拓扑一致的映射：共享的GAT层被重用，MLP隐藏层被完整地传递，匹配的执行器输出被复制，不匹配的执行器输出被随机初始化和微调。这种形态感知的策略类允许控制器在身体发生变异时进行适应。在基准测试中，与传统的仅使用MLP的协同设计方法相比，我们基于GAT的方法实现了更高的最终适应度和对形态变化的更强适应性。这些结果表明，对于具身智能而言，图结构化的策略提供了一种更有效的演化形态和控制之间的接口。
tldr: This paper introduces a Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based co-design approach for soft robot morphology and control, achieving improved adaptability to morphological changes compared to traditional methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的软机器人形态和控制协同设计方法，与传统方法相比，该方法在形态变化方面具有更好的适应性。

title: Pedestrian Crossing Intent Prediction via Psychological Features and Transformer Fusion
summary: Pedestrian intention prediction needs to be accurate for autonomous vehicles to navigate safely in urban environments. We present a lightweight, socially informed architecture for pedestrian intention prediction. It fuses four behavioral streams (attention, position, situation, and interaction) using highway encoders, a compact 4-token Transformer, and global self-attention pooling. To quantify uncertainty, we incorporate two complementary heads: a variational bottleneck whose KL divergence captures epistemic uncertainty, and a Mahalanobis distance detector that identifies distributional shift. Together, these components yield calibrated probabilities and actionable risk scores without compromising efficiency. On the PSI 1.0 benchmark, our model outperforms recent vision language models by achieving 0.9 F1, 0.94 AUC-ROC, and 0.78 MCC by using only structured, interpretable features. On the more diverse PSI 2.0 dataset, where, to the best of our knowledge, no prior results exist, we establish a strong initial baseline of 0.78 F1 and 0.79 AUC-ROC. Selective prediction based on Mahalanobis scores increases test accuracy by up to 0.4 percentage points at 80% coverage. Qualitative attention heatmaps further show how the model shifts its cross-stream focus under ambiguity. The proposed approach is modality-agnostic, easy to integrate with vision language pipelines, and suitable for risk-aware intent prediction on resource-constrained platforms.
summary_zh: 行人意图预测对于自动驾驶车辆在城市环境中安全导航至关重要。我们提出了一种轻量级的、具有社会感知能力的行人意图预测架构。它利用高速公路编码器、紧凑型4-token Transformer和全局自注意力池化，融合了四个行为流（注意力、位置、情境和交互）。为了量化不确定性，我们整合了两个互补的头部：一个变分瓶颈，其KL散度捕获认知不确定性；以及一个马氏距离检测器，用以识别分布漂移。这些组件共同产生校准后的概率和可操作的风险评分，同时不影响效率。在PSI 1.0基准测试中，我们的模型仅使用结构化、可解释的特征，就超越了近期视觉语言模型，实现了0.9的F1值、0.94的AUC-ROC值和0.78的MCC值。在更加多样化的PSI 2.0数据集上，据我们所知，之前没有相关结果，我们建立了一个强有力的初始基线，F1值为0.78，AUC-ROC值为0.79。基于马氏距离评分的选择性预测将测试精度提高了高达0.4个百分点（覆盖率80%）。定性注意力热图进一步展示了该模型如何在模糊情况下转移其跨流关注点。所提出的方法与模态无关，易于与视觉语言管道集成，并且适用于资源受限平台上具有风险意识的意图预测。
tldr: This paper presents a lightweight, socially-informed architecture for pedestrian intention prediction using a Transformer-based fusion of behavioral streams and uncertainty quantification methods, achieving strong results on PSI benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种轻量级的、社会感知的行人意图预测架构，它使用基于Transformer的融合方法处理行为流，并采用不确定性量化方法，在PSI基准测试中取得了良好的结果。

title: SOFTMAP: Sim2Real Soft Robot Forward Modeling via Topological Mesh Alignment and Physics Prior
summary: While soft robot manipulators offer compelling advantages over rigid counterparts, including inherent compliance, safe human-robot interaction, and the ability to conform to complex geometries, accurate forward modeling from low-dimensional actuation commands remains an open challenge due to nonlinear material phenomena such as hysteresis and manufacturing variability. We present SOFTMAP, a sim-to-real learning framework for real-time 3D forward modeling of tendon-actuated soft finger manipulators. SOFTMAP combines four components: (1) As-Rigid-As-Possible (ARAP)-based topological alignment that projects simulated and real point clouds into a shared, topologically consistent vertex space; (2) a lightweight MLP forward model pretrained on simulation data to map servo commands to full 3D finger geometry; (3) a residual correction network trained on a small set of real observations to predict per-vertex displacement fields that compensate for sim-to-real discrepancies; and (4) a closed-form linear actuation calibration layer enabling real-time inference at 30 FPS. We evaluate SOFTMAP on both simulated and physical hardware, achieving state-of-the-art shape prediction accuracy with a Chamfer distance of 0.389 mm in simulation and 3.786 mm on hardware, millimeter-level fingertip trajectory tracking across multiple target paths, and a 36.5% improvement in teleoperation task success over the baseline. Our results show that SOFTMAP provides a data-efficient approach for 3D forward modeling and control of soft manipulators.
summary_zh: 软体机器人操纵器相比于刚性机器人具有诸多引人注目的优势，包括固有的柔顺性、安全的人机交互以及适应复杂几何形状的能力。然而，由于诸如滞后效应和制造差异等非线性材料现象，从低维驱动指令进行精确的正向建模仍然是一个公开挑战。我们提出了 SOFTMAP，一个用于肌腱驱动软手指操纵器实时3D正向建模的Sim-to-Real学习框架。SOFTMAP 结合了四个组成部分：（1）基于As-Rigid-As-Possible (ARAP) 的拓扑对齐，将模拟和真实点云投影到一个共享的、拓扑一致的顶点空间中；（2）一个在模拟数据上预训练的轻量级 MLP 正向模型，用于将伺服指令映射到完整的3D手指几何形状；（3）一个在少量真实观测数据上训练的残差校正网络，用于预测每个顶点的位移场，以补偿Sim-to-Real的差异；以及（4）一个闭合形式的线性驱动校准层，能够以30 FPS进行实时推断。我们在模拟和物理硬件上评估了 SOFTMAP，并在模拟中实现了0.389 mm 的Chamfer距离，在硬件上实现了 3.786 mm 的Chamfer距离，达到了最先进的形状预测精度，在多个目标路径上实现了毫米级的指尖轨迹跟踪，并且在远程操作任务成功率方面比基线提高了 36.5%。结果表明，SOFTMAP 为软体操纵器的 3D 正向建模和控制提供了一种数据高效的方法。
tldr: The paper presents SOFTMAP, a sim-to-real framework for real-time 3D forward modeling of soft finger manipulators using topological alignment, MLP pre-training, and residual correction, achieving state-of-the-art shape prediction accuracy.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了SOFTMAP，一个用于软手指机械臂实时3D正向建模的模拟到真实框架，它结合了拓扑对齐、MLP预训练和残差校正，实现了最先进的形状预测精度。

title: Trojan's Whisper: Stealthy Manipulation of OpenClaw through Injected Bootstrapped Guidance
summary: Autonomous coding agents are increasingly integrated into software development workflows, offering capabilities that extend beyond code suggestion to active system interaction and environment management. OpenClaw, a representative platform in this emerging paradigm, introduces an extensible skill ecosystem that allows third-party developers to inject behavioral guidance through lifecycle hooks during agent initialization. While this design enhances automation and customization, it also opens a novel and unexplored attack surface. In this paper, we identify and systematically characterize guidance injection, a stealthy attack vector that embeds adversarial operational narratives into bootstrap guidance files. Unlike traditional prompt injection, which relies on explicit malicious instructions, guidance injection manipulates the agent's reasoning context by framing harmful actions as routine best practices. These narratives are automatically incorporated into the agent's interpretive framework and influence future task execution without raising suspicion.We construct 26 malicious skills spanning 13 attack categories including credential exfiltration, workspace destruction, privilege escalation, and persistent backdoor installation. We evaluate them using ORE-Bench, a realistic developer workspace benchmark we developed. Across 52 natural user prompts and six state-of-the-art LLM backends, our attacks achieve success rates from 16.0% to 64.2%, with the majority of malicious actions executed autonomously without user confirmation. Furthermore, 94% of our malicious skills evade detection by existing static and LLM-based scanners. Our findings reveal fundamental tensions in the design of autonomous agent ecosystems and underscore the urgent need for defenses based on capability isolation, runtime policy enforcement, and transparent guidance provenance.
summary_zh: 自主编码代理正越来越多地被集成到软件开发工作流程中，其功能已超越代码建议，延伸到主动系统交互和环境管理。OpenClaw是这种新兴范式中的一个代表性平台，它引入了一个可扩展的技能生态系统，允许第三方开发者通过代理初始化期间的生命周期钩子注入行为指导。虽然这种设计增强了自动化和定制化，但也开启了一种新颖且未被探索的攻击面。在本文中，我们识别并系统性地描述了**指导注入**，这是一种隐秘的攻击向量，它将对抗性操作叙事嵌入到引导文件中。与依赖于显式恶意指令的传统提示注入不同，指导注入通过将有害行为构建为例行最佳实践来操纵代理的推理上下文。这些叙事会自动被纳入代理的解释框架，并在不引起怀疑的情况下影响未来的任务执行。我们构建了26个恶意技能，涵盖13个攻击类别，包括凭据泄露、工作区破坏、权限提升和持久性后门安装。我们使用我们开发的真实开发者工作区基准测试ORE-Bench来评估这些技能。在52个自然用户提示和六个最先进的LLM后端上，我们的攻击成功率从16.0%到64.2%不等，并且大多数恶意行为都是在没有用户确认的情况下自主执行的。此外，我们的94%的恶意技能逃避了现有静态和基于LLM的扫描器的检测。我们的研究结果揭示了自主代理生态系统设计中的根本性矛盾，并强调迫切需要基于能力隔离、运行时策略执行和透明指导来源的防御措施。
tldr: This paper identifies a stealthy attack vector called 'guidance injection' in autonomous coding agents like OpenClaw, where malicious narratives are embedded in bootstrap guidance files to manipulate agent behavior, achieving significant success rates in various attacks while evading detection.
tldr_zh: 本文发现了一种隐蔽的攻击向量，称为“引导注入”，它存在于像OpenClaw这样的自主编码代理中。通过在引导文件中嵌入恶意叙述来操纵代理的行为，在各种攻击中获得了很高的成功率，并且能够逃避检测。

title: PowerLens: Taming LLM Agents for Safe and Personalized Mobile Power Management
summary: Battery life remains a critical challenge for mobile devices, yet existing power management mechanisms rely on static rules or coarse-grained heuristics that ignore user activities and personal preferences. We present PowerLens, a system that tames the reasoning power of Large Language Models (LLMs) for safe and personalized mobile power management on Android devices. The key idea is that LLMs' commonsense reasoning can bridge the semantic gap between user activities and system parameters, enabling zero-shot, context-aware policy generation that adapts to individual preferences through implicit feedback. PowerLens employs a multi-agent architecture that recognizes user context from UI semantics and generates holistic power policies across 18 device parameters. A PDL-based constraint framework verifies every action before execution, while a two-tier memory system learns individualized preferences from implicit user overrides through confidence-based distillation, requiring no explicit configuration and converging within 3--5 days. Extensive experiments on a rooted Android device show that PowerLens achieves 81.7% action accuracy and 38.8% energy saving over stock Android, outperforming rule-based and LLM-based baselines, with high user satisfaction, fast preference convergence, and strong safety guarantees, with the system itself consuming only 0.5% of daily battery capacity.
summary_zh: 电池续航仍然是移动设备面临的关键挑战，然而现有的电源管理机制依赖于静态规则或粗粒度的启发式方法，忽略了用户活动和个人偏好。我们提出了PowerLens，一个利用大型语言模型 (LLMs) 的推理能力，在安卓设备上实现安全且个性化的移动电源管理的系统。其核心思想是 LLMs 的常识推理能力可以弥合用户活动和系统参数之间的语义鸿沟，从而实现零样本、上下文感知的策略生成，并通过隐式反馈适应个人偏好。PowerLens 采用了一种多代理架构，从 UI 语义中识别用户上下文，并生成涵盖 18 个设备参数的整体电源策略。一个基于 PDL 的约束框架在每次执行前验证每一个动作，而一个两层记忆系统通过基于置信度的知识蒸馏从隐式用户覆盖操作中学习个性化的偏好，无需显式配置，并在 3-5 天内收敛。在 root 后的安卓设备上进行的大量实验表明，PowerLens 实现了 81.7% 的动作准确率和 38.8% 的能量节省，超越了原生安卓，并优于基于规则和基于 LLM 的基线方法，同时拥有较高的用户满意度、快速的偏好收敛以及强大的安全保障，系统本身仅消耗每日电池容量的 0.5%。
tldr: PowerLens uses LLMs for personalized mobile power management on Android, achieving significant energy savings and high user satisfaction while maintaining safety and low battery consumption.
tldr_zh: PowerLens利用大型语言模型在安卓设备上实现个性化的移动电源管理，在保证安全和低电池消耗的同时，实现了显著的节能和高用户满意度。

title: PA2D-MORL: Pareto Ascent Directional Decomposition based Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) provides an effective solution for decision-making problems involving conflicting objectives. However, achieving high-quality approximations to the Pareto policy set remains challenging, especially in complex tasks with continuous or high-dimensional state-action space. In this paper, we propose the Pareto Ascent Directional Decomposition based Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (PA2D-MORL) method, which constructs an efficient scheme for multi-objective problem decomposition and policy improvement, leading to a superior approximation of Pareto policy set. The proposed method leverages Pareto ascent direction to select the scalarization weights and computes the multi-objective policy gradient, which determines the policy optimization direction and ensures joint improvement on all objectives. Meanwhile, multiple policies are selectively optimized under an evolutionary framework to approximate the Pareto frontier from different directions. Additionally, a Pareto adaptive fine-tuning approach is applied to enhance the density and spread of the Pareto frontier approximation. Experiments on various multi-objective robot control tasks show that the proposed method clearly outperforms the current state-of-the-art algorithm in terms of both quality and stability of the outcomes.
summary_zh: 多目标强化学习 (MORL) 为解决涉及冲突目标决策问题提供了一种有效方案。然而，获得帕累托策略集合的高质量近似仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在具有连续或高维状态-动作空间的复杂任务中。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于帕累托上升方向分解的多目标强化学习方法 (PA2D-MORL)，该方法构建了一个高效的多目标问题分解和策略提升方案，从而实现了对帕累托策略集合的更优近似。所提出的方法利用帕累托上升方向来选择标量化权重，并计算多目标策略梯度，该梯度决定了策略优化方向并确保所有目标的联合提升。同时，多个策略在进化框架下被选择性地优化，以从不同方向逼近帕累托前沿。此外，采用了一种帕累托自适应微调方法来增强帕累托前沿近似的密度和分布。在各种多目标机器人控制任务上的实验表明，所提出的方法在结果的质量和稳定性方面都明显优于当前最先进的算法。
tldr: The paper introduces PA2D-MORL, a multi-objective reinforcement learning method using Pareto ascent directions for efficient policy improvement and Pareto frontier approximation, demonstrating superior performance on robot control tasks compared to SOTA methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PA2D-MORL，一种多目标强化学习方法，它使用帕累托上升方向来有效地改进策略并逼近帕累托前沿，并在机器人控制任务中表现出优于最先进方法的性能。

title: Investigating a Policy-Based Formulation for Endoscopic Camera Pose Recovery
summary: In endoscopic surgery, surgeons continuously locate the endoscopic view relative to the anatomy by interpreting the evolving visual appearance of the intraoperative scene in the context of their prior knowledge. Vision-based navigation systems seek to replicate this capability by recovering camera pose directly from endoscopic video, but most approaches do not embody the same principles of reasoning about new frames that makes surgeons successful. Instead, they remain grounded in feature matching and geometric optimization over keyframes, an approach that has been shown to degrade under the challenging conditions of endoscopic imaging like low texture and rapid illumination changes. Here, we pursue an alternative approach and investigate a policy-based formulation of endoscopic camera pose recovery that seeks to imitate experts in estimating trajectories conditioned on the previous camera state. Our approach directly predicts short-horizon relative motions without maintaining an explicit geometric representation at inference time. It thus addresses, by design, some of the notorious challenges of geometry-based approaches, such as brittle correspondence matching, instability in texture-sparse regions, and limited pose coverage due to reconstruction failure. We evaluate the proposed formulation on cadaveric sinus endoscopy. Under oracle state conditioning, we compare short-horizon motion prediction quality to geometric baselines achieving lowest mean translation error and competitive rotational accuracy. We analyze robustness by grouping prediction windows according to texture richness and illumination change indicating reduced sensitivity to low-texture conditions. These findings suggest that a learned motion policy offers a viable alternative formulation for endoscopic camera pose recovery.
summary_zh: 在内窥镜手术中，外科医生通过解读术中场景不断演变的视觉外观，并结合其先验知识，来持续定位内窥镜视野相对于解剖结构的位置。基于视觉的导航系统试图通过直接从内窥镜视频中恢复相机位姿来复制这种能力，但大多数方法并没有体现外科医生成功推理新帧时所遵循的相同原则。相反，它们仍然基于关键帧的特征匹配和几何优化，这种方法已被证明在内窥镜成像的挑战性条件下（如低纹理和快速光照变化）会退化。在此，我们探索一种替代方法，并研究一种基于策略的内窥镜相机位姿恢复方案，该方案旨在模仿专家在以先前相机状态为条件估计轨迹方面的能力。我们的方法直接预测短时程相对运动，而无需在推理时维护显式的几何表示。因此，它在设计上解决了基于几何方法的一些臭名昭著的挑战，例如脆弱的对应关系匹配、纹理稀疏区域的不稳定性以及由于重建失败导致的有限位姿覆盖。我们在遗体鼻窦内窥镜手术中评估了所提出的方案。在Oracle状态条件约束下，我们将短时程运动预测质量与几何基线进行比较，实现了最低的平均平移误差和具有竞争力的旋转精度。 通过根据纹理丰富度和光照变化对预测窗口进行分组，我们分析了鲁棒性，表明对低纹理条件的敏感性降低。这些发现表明，学习到的运动策略为内窥镜相机位姿恢复提供了一种可行的替代方案。
tldr: The paper proposes a policy-based approach using reinforcement learning to address the challenges of camera pose recovery in endoscopic surgery, offering a potential alternative to traditional geometry-based methods that struggle with low texture and illumination changes.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于策略的方法，使用强化学习来解决内窥镜手术中相机姿态恢复的挑战，提供了一种潜在的替代方案，以替代在低纹理和光照变化下表现不佳的传统基于几何的方法。

title: 2K Retrofit: Entropy-Guided Efficient Sparse Refinement for High-Resolution 3D Geometry Prediction
summary: High-resolution geometric prediction is essential for robust perception in autonomous driving, robotics, and AR/MR, but current foundation models are fundamentally limited by their scalability to real-world, high-resolution scenarios. Direct inference on 2K images with these models incurs prohibitive computational and memory demands, making practical deployment challenging. To tackle the issue, we present 2K Retrofit, a novel framework that enables efficient 2K-resolution inference for any geometric foundation model, without modifying or retraining the backbone. Our approach leverages fast coarse predictions and an entropy-based sparse refinement to selectively enhance high-uncertainty regions, achieving precise and high-fidelity 2K outputs with minimal overhead. Extensive experiments on widely used benchmark demonstrate that 2K Retrofit consistently achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and speed, bridging the gap between research advances and scalable deployment in high-resolution 3D vision applications. Code will be released upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 高分辨率几何预测对于自动驾驶、机器人和AR/MR中的鲁棒感知至关重要，但当前的通用模型在扩展到真实世界、高分辨率场景时存在根本性的局限。直接使用这些模型在2K图像上进行推理会导致过高的计算和内存需求，使得实际部署极具挑战性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种名为2K Retrofit的新型框架，它能够在不修改或重新训练主干网络的情况下，为任何几何通用模型实现高效的2K分辨率推理。我们的方法利用快速粗略预测和基于熵的稀疏细化来选择性地增强高不确定性区域，以最小的开销实现精确且高保真的2K输出。在广泛使用的基准测试上的大量实验表明，2K Retrofit始终如一地实现了最先进的精度和速度，弥合了高分辨率3D视觉应用中研究进展与可扩展部署之间的差距。代码将在接受后发布。
tldr: The paper introduces 2K Retrofit, a method for efficiently scaling geometric foundation models to 2K resolution without retraining, using entropy-guided sparse refinement to focus computation on high-uncertainty regions.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了2K Retrofit，一种高效地将几何基础模型扩展到2K分辨率的方法，无需重新训练，利用熵引导的稀疏细化将计算集中在高不确定性区域。

title: SegVGGT: Joint 3D Reconstruction and Instance Segmentation from Multi-View Images
summary: 3D instance segmentation methods typically rely on high-quality point clouds or posed RGB-D scans, requiring complex multi-stage processing pipelines, and are highly sensitive to reconstruction noise. While recent feed-forward transformers have revolutionized multi-view 3D reconstruction, they remain decoupled from high-level semantic understanding. In this work, we present SegVGGT, a unified end-to-end framework that simultaneously performs feed-forward 3D reconstruction and instance segmentation directly from multi-view RGB images. By introducing object queries that interact with multi-level geometric features, our method deeply integrates instance identification into the visual geometry grounded transformer. To address the severe attention dispersion problem caused by the massive number of global image tokens, we propose the Frame-level Attention Distribution Alignment (FADA) strategy. FADA explicitly guides object queries to attend to instance-relevant frames during training, providing structured supervision without extra inference overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SegVGGT achieves the state-of-the-art performance on ScanNetv2 and ScanNet200, outperforming both recent joint models and RGB-D-based approaches, while exhibiting strong generalization capabilities on ScanNet++.
summary_zh: 三维实例分割方法通常依赖于高质量的点云或带有位姿的RGB-D扫描，需要复杂的多阶段处理流程，并且对重建噪声高度敏感。尽管最近的前馈Transformer彻底改变了多视图三维重建，但它们仍然与高层语义理解是解耦的。在这项工作中，我们提出了SegVGGT，一个统一的端到端框架，可以直接从多视图RGB图像同时执行前馈三维重建和实例分割。通过引入与多级几何特征交互的对象查询，我们的方法将实例识别深度集成到基于视觉几何的Transformer中。为了解决由海量全局图像token引起的严重注意力分散问题，我们提出了帧级注意力分布对齐（FADA）策略。FADA在训练期间显式地引导对象查询关注实例相关的帧，提供结构化的监督，而无需额外的推理开销。大量的实验表明，SegVGGT在ScanNetv2和ScanNet200上实现了最先进的性能，优于最近的联合模型和基于RGB-D的方法，同时在ScanNet++上表现出强大的泛化能力。
tldr: SegVGGT is a unified end-to-end framework for joint 3D reconstruction and instance segmentation from multi-view images, achieving state-of-the-art performance by integrating instance identification into a visual geometry grounded transformer enabled by frame-level attention distribution alignment.
tldr_zh: SegVGGT是一个统一的端到端框架，用于从多视图图像中进行联合 3D 重建和实例分割。它通过将实例识别集成到视觉几何的 Transformer 中，并采用帧级注意力分布对齐，实现了最先进的性能。

title: PanORama: Multiview Consistent Panoptic Segmentation in Operating Rooms
summary: Operating rooms (ORs) are cluttered, dynamic, highly occluded environments, where reliable spatial understanding is essential for situational awareness during complex surgical workflows. Achieving spatial understanding for panoptic segmentation from sparse multiview images poses a fundamental challenge, as limited visibility in a subset of views often leads to mispredictions across cameras. To this end, we introduce PanORama, the first panoptic segmentation for the operating room that is multiview-consistent by design. By modeling cross-view interactions at the feature level inside the backbone in a single forward pass, view consistency emerges directly rather than through post-hoc refinement. We evaluate on the MM-OR and 4D-OR datasets, achieving >70% Panoptic Quality (PQ) performance, and outperforming the previous state of the art. Importantly, PanORama is calibration-free, requiring no camera parameters, and generalizes to unseen camera viewpoints within any multiview configuration at inference time. By substantially enhancing multiview segmentation and, consequently, spatial understanding in the OR, we believe our approach opens new opportunities for surgical perception and assistance. Code will be released upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 手术室（OR）是杂乱、动态、高度遮挡的环境，可靠的空间理解对于复杂手术流程中的态势感知至关重要。从稀疏的多视角图像中实现全景分割的空间理解是一项根本性的挑战，因为在部分视角中的有限可见性通常会导致跨摄像头的错误预测。为此，我们推出了PanORama，这是首个专为手术室设计的、在设计上具有多视角一致性的全景分割方法。通过在单个前向传播中，在骨干网络内部的特征层面对跨视角交互进行建模，视角一致性直接产生，而不是通过后期的细化。我们在MM-OR和4D-OR数据集上进行评估，实现了>70%的全景质量（PQ）性能，并超越了之前的最佳水平。重要的是，PanORama无需校准，不需要任何相机参数，并且可以在推理时推广到任何多视角配置中未见过的相机视角。通过显著增强多视角分割，从而增强手术室内的空间理解，我们相信我们的方法为外科感知和辅助开启了新的机遇。代码将在接受后发布。
tldr: The paper introduces PanORama, a novel calibration-free multiview panoptic segmentation method for operating rooms that achieves state-of-the-art performance by modeling cross-view interactions at the feature level without post-hoc refinement.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PanORama，一种新颖的免标定多视角全景分割方法，用于手术室环境。它通过在特征层面建模跨视角交互，无需后处理优化，实现了最先进的性能。

title: Controllable Text-to-Motion Generation via Modular Body-Part Phase Control
summary: Text-to-motion (T2M) generation is becoming a practical tool for animation and interactive avatars. However, modifying specific body parts while maintaining overall motion coherence remains challenging. Existing methods typically rely on cumbersome, high-dimensional joint constraints (e.g., trajectories), which hinder user-friendly, iterative refinement. To address this, we propose Modular Body-Part Phase Control, a plug-and-play framework enabling structured, localized editing via a compact, scalar-based phase interface. By modeling body-part latent motion channels as sinusoidal phase signals characterized by amplitude, frequency, phase shift, and offset, we extract interpretable codes that capture part-specific dynamics. A modular Phase ControlNet branch then injects this signal via residual feature modulation, seamlessly decoupling control from the generative backbone. Experiments on both diffusion- and flow-based models demonstrate that our approach provides predictable and fine-grained control over motion magnitude, speed, and timing. It preserves global motion coherence and offers a practical paradigm for controllable T2M generation. Project page: https://jixiii.github.io/bp-phase-project-page/
summary_zh: 文本到动作（T2M）生成正日益成为动画和交互式化身的实用工具。然而，在保持整体运动连贯性的同时，修改特定身体部位仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通常依赖于繁琐的高维关节约束（例如，轨迹），这阻碍了用户友好的迭代优化。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种模块化身体部位相位控制，这是一种即插即用的框架，可以通过紧凑的、基于标量的相位接口实现结构化的、局部化的编辑。通过将身体部位的潜在运动通道建模为以振幅、频率、相移和偏移为特征的正弦相位信号，我们提取出可解释的代码，这些代码捕获了特定部位的动态。然后，一个模块化的相位控制网络分支通过残差特征调制注入该信号，从而将控制与生成主干无缝解耦。在基于扩散和基于流的模型上的实验表明，我们的方法能够对运动幅度、速度和时间提供可预测的、精细的控制。它保留了全局运动的连贯性，并为可控T2M生成提供了一种实用的范例。项目主页：https://jixiii.github.io/bp-phase-project-page/
tldr: This paper introduces a method for controllable text-to-motion generation by using a modular body-part phase control mechanism. It allows fine-grained control over motion magnitude, speed, and timing while preserving global motion coherence.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通过模块化身体部位相位控制机制实现可控文本到动作生成的方法。它可以在保持全局运动连贯性的同时，对运动幅度、速度和时间进行细粒度控制。

title: From Plausibility to Verifiability: Risk-Controlled Generative OCR for Vision-Language Models
summary: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) can act as generative OCR engines, yet open-ended decoding can expose rare but consequential failures. We identify a core deployment misalignment in generative OCR. Autoregressive decoding favors semantic plausibility, whereas OCR requires outputs that are visually grounded and geometrically verifiable. This mismatch produces severe errors, especially over-generation and unsupported substitutions, creating deployment risk even when benchmark accuracy remains high. We therefore formulate frozen VLM OCR as a selective accept/abstain problem and propose a model-agnostic Geometric Risk Controller. The controller probes multiple structured views of the same input, applies lightweight structural screening, and accepts a transcription only when cross-view consensus and stability satisfy predefined criteria, yielding a small family of operating points. Experiments on frozen VLM backbones and standard OCR benchmarks show consistent reductions in extreme-error risk and catastrophic over-generation at predictable coverage costs. Reliable deployment of generative OCR with frozen VLMs benefits from explicit system-level risk control rather than unconstrained generation.
summary_zh: 现代视觉-语言模型（VLMs）可以充当生成式 OCR 引擎，但开放式的解码可能会暴露罕见但影响重大的失效情况。我们识别出生成式 OCR 中一个核心的部署错位：自回归解码倾向于语义合理性，而 OCR 需要视觉上扎根且几何上可验证的输出。这种不匹配会产生严重的错误，特别是过度生成和无依据的替换，即使在基准测试精度保持较高水平时，也会带来部署风险。因此，我们将冻结的 VLM OCR 形式化为一个选择性接受/拒绝问题，并提出了一个与模型无关的几何风险控制器。该控制器探测同一输入的多个结构化视图，应用轻量级的结构筛选，并且仅当跨视图的共识和稳定性满足预定义的标准时才接受转录，从而产生一小组运行点。在冻结的 VLM 主干和标准 OCR 基准测试上的实验表明，在可预测的覆盖率成本下，极端错误风险和灾难性过度生成得到了持续降低。使用冻结的 VLM 可靠部署生成式 OCR 受益于显式的系统级风险控制，而不是无约束的生成。
tldr: This paper addresses the problem of unreliable generative OCR with VLMs by introducing a Geometric Risk Controller which probes multiple views and applies structural screening to reduce extreme errors and over-generation, improving deployment reliability.
tldr_zh: 该论文通过引入几何风险控制器解决VLM生成OCR的不可靠性问题，该控制器探测多个视角并应用结构化筛选，从而减少极端错误和过度生成，提高部署可靠性。

title: TSegAgent: Zero-Shot Tooth Segmentation via Geometry-Aware Vision-Language Agents
summary: Automatic tooth segmentation and identification from intra-oral scanned 3D models are fundamental problems in digital dentistry, yet most existing approaches rely on task-specific 3D neural networks trained with densely annotated datasets, resulting in high annotation cost and limited generalization to scans from unseen sources. Thus, we propose TSegAgent, which addresses these challenges by reformulating dental analysis as a zero-shot geometric reasoning problem rather than a purely data-driven recognition task. The key idea is to combine the representational capacity of general-purpose foundation models with explicit geometric inductive biases derived from dental anatomy. Instead of learning dental-specific features, the proposed framework leverages multi-view visual abstraction and geometry-grounded reasoning to infer tooth instances and identities without task-specific training. By explicitly encoding structural constraints such as dental arch organization and volumetric relationships, the method reduces uncertainty in ambiguous cases and mitigates overfitting to particular shape distributions. Experimental results demonstrate that this reasoning-oriented formulation enables accurate and reliable tooth segmentation and identification with low computational and annotation cost, while exhibiting strong generalization across diverse and previously unseen dental scans.
summary_zh: 从口内扫描3D模型中自动进行牙齿分割和识别是数字化牙科中的基本问题，然而，现有的大多数方法依赖于利用密集标注数据集训练的特定任务3D神经网络，导致高标注成本和对来自未见来源的扫描数据的泛化能力有限。因此，我们提出了TSegAgent，它通过将牙科分析重新定义为一个零样本几何推理问题而不是纯粹的数据驱动识别任务来解决这些挑战。关键思想是将通用基础模型的表征能力与源自牙齿解剖学的显式几何归纳偏置相结合。该方法不学习特定于牙科的特征，而是利用多视图视觉抽象和基于几何的推理来推断牙齿实例和身份，而无需特定于任务的训练。通过显式地编码诸如牙弓组织和体积关系等结构约束，该方法降低了模糊情况下的不确定性，并减轻了对特定形状分布的过拟合。实验结果表明，这种面向推理的公式化方法能够以低计算和标注成本实现准确可靠的牙齿分割和识别，同时在各种先前未见的牙科扫描数据中表现出强大的泛化能力。
tldr: The paper introduces TSegAgent, a zero-shot approach for tooth segmentation using geometry-aware vision-language agents that leverages foundation models and geometric inductive biases to achieve accurate dental analysis without task-specific training.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为TSegAgent的零样本牙齿分割方法，该方法利用几何感知视觉语言代理，结合基础模型和几何归纳偏置，无需任务特定训练即可实现精确的牙科分析。

title: Making Video Models Adhere to User Intent with Minor Adjustments
summary: With the recent drastic advancements in text-to-video diffusion models, controlling their generations has drawn interest. A popular way for control is through bounding boxes or layouts. However, enforcing adherence to these control inputs is still an open problem. In this work, we show that by slightly adjusting user-provided bounding boxes we can improve both the quality of generations and the adherence to the control inputs. This is achieved by simply optimizing the bounding boxes to better align with the internal attention maps of the video diffusion model while carefully balancing the focus on foreground and background. In a sense, we are modifying the bounding boxes to be at places where the model is familiar with. Surprisingly, we find that even with small modifications, the quality of generations can vary significantly. To do so, we propose a smooth mask to make the bounding box position differentiable and an attention-maximization objective that we use to alter the bounding boxes. We conduct thorough experiments, including a user study to validate the effectiveness of our method. Our code is made available on the project webpage to foster future research from the community.
summary_zh: 随着近年来文本到视频扩散模型取得的显著进展，控制其生成过程引起了人们的兴趣。一种流行的控制方式是通过边界框或布局。然而，确保对这些控制输入的遵循仍然是一个未解决的问题。在这项工作中，我们表明，通过稍微调整用户提供的边界框，我们可以同时提高生成质量和对控制输入的遵循程度。这通过简单地优化边界框来实现，使其更好地与视频扩散模型的内部注意力图对齐，同时仔细平衡对前景和背景的关注。从某种意义上说，我们正在修改边界框的位置，使其位于模型熟悉的地方。出人意料的是，我们发现即使进行微小的修改，生成质量也可能发生显著变化。为此，我们提出了一种平滑掩码，使边界框的位置可微，以及一个注意力最大化目标，我们用它来改变边界框。我们进行了全面的实验，包括一项用户研究，以验证我们方法的有效性。我们的代码已在项目网页上公开，以促进社区未来的研究。
tldr: This paper introduces a method to improve the quality and control adherence of text-to-video diffusion models by slightly adjusting user-provided bounding boxes based on the model's internal attention maps.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种通过基于模型内部注意力图略微调整用户提供的边界框来提高文本到视频扩散模型的质量和控制一致性的方法。

title: IUP-Pose: Decoupled Iterative Uncertainty Propagation for Real-time Relative Pose Regression via Implicit Dense Alignment v1
summary: Relative pose estimation is fundamental for SLAM, visual localization, and 3D reconstruction. Existing Relative Pose Regression (RPR) methods face a key trade-off: feature-matching pipelines achieve high accuracy but block gradient flow via non-differentiable RANSAC, while ViT-based regressors are end-to-end trainable but prohibitively expensive for real-time deployment. We identify the core bottlenecks as the coupling between rotation and translation estimation and insufficient cross-view feature alignment. We propose IUP-Pose, a geometry-driven decoupled iterative framework with implicit dense alignment. A lightweight Multi-Head Bi-Cross Attention (MHBC) module aligns cross-view features without explicit matching supervision. The aligned features are processed by a decoupled rotation-translation pipeline: two shared-parameter rotation stages iteratively refine rotation with uncertainty, and feature maps are realigned via rotational homography H_inf before translation prediction. IUP-Pose achieves 73.3% AUC@20deg on MegaDepth1500 with full end-to-end differentiability, 70 FPS throughput, and only 37M parameters, demonstrating a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off for real-time edge deployment.
summary_zh: 相对位姿估计是SLAM、视觉定位和三维重建的基础。现有的相对位姿回归（RPR）方法面临一个关键的权衡：特征匹配方法能够实现高精度，但通过不可微的RANSAC阻断了梯度流；而基于ViT的回归器是端到端可训练的，但对于实时部署来说成本过高。我们识别出核心瓶颈是旋转和平移估计之间的耦合以及跨视角特征对齐不足。我们提出IUP-Pose，一个几何驱动的解耦迭代框架，具有隐式密集对齐。一个轻量级的多头双向交叉注意力（MHBC）模块可以在没有显式匹配监督的情况下对齐跨视角特征。对齐后的特征由一个解耦的旋转-平移流水线处理：两个共享参数的旋转阶段使用不确定性迭代地细化旋转，并且在平移预测之前，特征图通过旋转单应性H_inf重新对齐。IUP-Pose在MegaDepth1500上实现了73.3%的AUC@20deg，并具有完全的端到端可微性、70 FPS的吞吐量以及仅37M的参数量，展示了针对实时边缘部署的有利的精度-效率权衡。
tldr: IUP-Pose is a novel relative pose regression framework that uses a decoupled iterative approach with implicit dense alignment, achieving real-time performance and high accuracy, demonstrated on the MegaDepth1500 dataset.
tldr_zh: IUP-Pose是一个新颖的相对姿态回归框架，它采用解耦迭代方法和隐式密集对齐，实现了实时性能和高精度，并在 MegaDepth1500 数据集上得到了验证。

title: K-GMRF: Kinetic Gauss-Markov Random Field for First-Principles Covariance Tracking on Lie Groups
summary: Tracking non-stationary covariance matrices is fundamental to vision yet hindered by existing estimators that either neglect manifold constraints or rely on first-order updates, incurring inevitable phase lag during rapid evolution. We propose K-GMRF, an online, training-free framework for covariance tracking that reformulates the problem as forced rigid-body motion on Lie groups. Derived from the Euler-Poincaré equations, our method interprets observations as torques driving a latent angular velocity, propagated via a structure-preserving symplectic integrator. We theoretically prove that this second-order dynamics achieves zero steady-state error under constant rotation, strictly superior to the proportional lag of first-order baselines. Validation across three domains demonstrates robust tracking fidelity: (i) on synthetic ellipses, K-GMRF reduces angular error by 30x compared to Riemannian EMA while maintaining stability at high speeds; (ii) on SO(3) stabilization with 20% dropout, it decreases geodesic error from 29.4° to 9.9°; and (iii) on OTB motion-blur sequences, it improves loU from 0.55 to 0.74 on BlurCar2 with a 96% success rate. As a fully differentiable symplectic module, K-GMRF provides a plug-and-play geometric prior for data-constrained scenarios and an interpretable layer within modern deep architectures.
summary_zh: 跟踪非平稳协方差矩阵是视觉领域的基础，但现有估计器要么忽略流形约束，要么依赖一阶更新，导致快速演化过程中不可避免的相位滞后。我们提出 K-GMRF，一个在线、免训练的协方差跟踪框架，将问题重新表述为李群上的受迫刚体运动。我们的方法从 Euler-Poincaré 方程推导而来，将观测解释为驱动潜在角速度的力矩，并通过保结构的辛积分器进行传播。我们从理论上证明，这种二阶动力学在恒定旋转下能够实现零稳态误差，严格优于一阶基线的比例滞后。在三个领域的验证表明了鲁棒的跟踪保真度：（i）在合成椭圆上，K-GMRF 相比 Riemannian EMA 降低了 30 倍的角误差，同时保持了高速下的稳定性；（ii）在具有 20% dropout 的 SO(3) 稳定中，它将测地线误差从 29.4° 降低到 9.9°；以及（iii）在 OTB 运动模糊序列上，它在 BlurCar2 上将 loU 从 0.55 提高到 0.74，成功率达到 96%。作为一个完全可微分的辛模块，K-GMRF 为数据受限的场景提供了一个即插即用的几何先验，并为现代深度架构提供了一个可解释的层。
tldr: The paper introduces K-GMRF, a novel, training-free framework for online covariance tracking on Lie groups using a second-order dynamical system, demonstrating superior performance in various vision tasks compared to first-order methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为 K-GMRF 的新型免训练框架，用于在李群上进行在线协方差跟踪，并使用二阶动力系统。与一阶方法相比，该方法在各种视觉任务中表现出更优越的性能。

title: StreetForward: Perceiving Dynamic Street with Feedforward Causal Attention
summary: Feedforward reconstruction is crucial for autonomous driving applications, where rapid scene reconstruction enables efficient utilization of large-scale driving datasets in closed-loop simulation and other downstream tasks, eliminating the need for time-consuming per-scene optimization. We present StreetForward, a pose-free and tracker-free feedforward framework for dynamic street reconstruction. Building upon the alternating attention mechanism from Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT), we propose a simple yet effective temporal mask attention module that captures dynamic motion information from image sequences and produces motion-aware latent representations. Static content and dynamic instances are represented uniformly with 3D Gaussian Splatting, and are optimized jointly by cross-frame rendering with spatio-temporal consistency, allowing the model to infer per-pixel velocities and produce high-fidelity novel views at new poses and times. We train and evaluate our model on the Waymo Open Dataset, demonstrating superior performance on novel view synthesis and depth estimation compared to existing methods. Furthermore, zero-shot inference on CARLA and other datasets validates the generalization capability of our approach. More visualizations are available on our project page: https://streetforward.github.io.
summary_zh: 前馈重建对于自动驾驶应用至关重要，其中快速场景重建使得能够在闭环仿真和其他下游任务中高效利用大规模驾驶数据集，从而消除了耗时的逐场景优化需求。我们提出StreetForward，一种无姿态、无追踪器的动态街道重建前馈框架。在Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT)的交替注意力机制基础上，我们提出了一种简单而有效的时序掩码注意力模块，该模块能够从图像序列中捕获动态运动信息，并产生运动感知的潜在表示。静态内容和动态实例使用3D高斯溅射进行统一表示，并通过具有时空一致性的跨帧渲染进行联合优化，从而使模型能够推断逐像素速度，并在新的姿态和时间生成高保真的新视角。我们在Waymo Open Dataset上训练和评估我们的模型，在与现有方法相比，展示了卓越的新视角合成和深度估计性能。此外，在CARLA和其他数据集上的零样本推断验证了我们方法的泛化能力。更多可视化效果请访问我们的项目页面: https://streetforward.github.io。
tldr: StreetForward is a feedforward framework for dynamic street reconstruction using temporal mask attention and 3D Gaussian Splatting, achieving superior performance on novel view synthesis and generalization.
tldr_zh: StreetForward是一个用于动态街道重建的前馈框架，它使用时间掩码注意力机制和3D高斯溅射方法，在新的视角合成和泛化方面表现出色。

title: MoCA3D: Monocular 3D Bounding Box Prediction in the Image Plane
summary: Monocular 3D object understanding has largely been cast as a 2D RoI-to-3D box lifting problem. However, emerging downstream applications require image-plane geometry (e.g., projected 3D box corners) which cannot be easily obtained without known intrinsics, a problem for object detection in the wild. We introduce MoCA3D, a Monocular, Class-Agnostic 3D model that predicts projected 3D bounding box corners and per-corner depths without requiring camera intrinsics at inference time. MoCA3D formulates pixel-space localization and depth assignment as dense prediction via corner heatmaps and depth maps. To evaluate image-plane geometric fidelity, we propose Pixel-Aligned Geometry (PAG), which directly measures image-plane corner and depth consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MoCA3D achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving image-plane corner PAG by 22.8% while remaining comparable on 3D IoU, using up to 57 times fewer trainable parameters. Finally, we apply MoCA3D to downstream tasks which were previously impractical under unknown intrinsics, highlighting its utility beyond standard baseline models.
summary_zh: 单目3D目标理解在很大程度上被视为一个从2D RoI到3D框提升的问题。然而，新兴的下游应用需要图像平面几何（例如，投影的3D框角点），这在没有已知内参的情况下难以获得，这对于野外环境中的目标检测来说是一个问题。我们提出了MoCA3D，一个单目、类别无关的3D模型，它预测投影的3D包围盒角点和每个角点的深度，且在推理时不要求相机内参。MoCA3D将像素空间定位和深度分配问题表述为通过角点热图和深度图进行密集预测。为了评估图像平面几何的保真度，我们提出了像素对齐几何（PAG），它直接测量图像平面角点和深度的一致性。大量的实验表明，MoCA3D实现了最先进的性能，在图像平面角点PAG上提高了22.8%，同时在3D IoU上保持了相当的水平，且使用的可训练参数减少了高达57倍。最后，我们将MoCA3D应用于先前在未知内参下不切实际的下游任务，突显了其超越标准基线模型的效用。
tldr: The paper introduces MoCA3D, a monocular 3D object detection method that predicts 3D bounding box corners and depths in the image plane without requiring camera intrinsics at inference time. It achieves state-of-the-art performance with fewer parameters and demonstrates utility in downstream tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MoCA3D，一种单目3D物体检测方法，可以在图像平面中预测3D边界框角点和深度，而无需在推理时提供相机内参。它以更少的参数实现了最先进的性能，并展示了其在下游任务中的实用性。

title: NASimJax: GPU-Accelerated Policy Learning Framework for Penetration Testing
summary: Penetration testing, the practice of simulating cyberattacks to identify vulnerabilities, is a complex sequential decision-making task that is inherently partially observable and features large action spaces. Training reinforcement learning (RL) policies for this domain faces a fundamental bottleneck: existing simulators are too slow to train on realistic network scenarios at scale, resulting in policies that fail to generalize. We present NASimJax, a complete JAX-based reimplementation of the Network Attack Simulator (NASim), achieving up to 100x higher environment throughput than the original simulator. By running the entire training pipeline on hardware accelerators, NASimJax enables experimentation on larger networks under fixed compute budgets that were previously infeasible. We formulate automated penetration testing as a Contextual POMDP and introduce a network generation pipeline that produces structurally diverse and guaranteed-solvable scenarios. Together, these provide a principled basis for studying zero-shot policy generalization. We use the framework to investigate action-space scaling and generalization across networks of up to 40 hosts. We find that Prioritized Level Replay better handles dense training distributions than Domain Randomization, particularly at larger scales, and that training on sparser topologies yields an implicit curriculum that improves out-of-distribution generalization, even on topologies denser than those seen during training. To handle linearly growing action spaces, we propose a two-stage action decomposition (2SAS) that substantially outperforms flat action masking at scale. Finally, we identify a failure mode arising from the interaction between Prioritized Level Replay's episode-reset behaviour and 2SAS's credit assignment structure. NASimJax thus provides a fast, flexible, and realistic platform for advancing RL-based penetration testing.
summary_zh: 渗透测试，即模拟网络攻击以识别漏洞的行为，是一个复杂的序列决策任务，本质上是部分可观测的，并具有庞大的动作空间。为该领域训练强化学习 (RL) 策略面临一个根本性的瓶颈：现有的模拟器速度太慢，无法在现实的网络场景中进行大规模训练，导致策略无法泛化。我们提出了 NASimJax，一个基于 JAX 的网络攻击模拟器 (NASim) 的完整重新实现，环境吞吐量比原始模拟器高出 100 倍。通过在硬件加速器上运行整个训练pipeline，NASimJax 能够在固定的计算预算下，在之前不可行的大型网络上进行实验。我们将自动化渗透测试形式化为上下文部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程 (Contextual POMDP)，并引入了一个网络生成pipeline，该pipeline能够生成结构多样且能保证可解的场景。这些共同为研究零样本策略泛化提供了一个原则性的基础。我们使用该框架来研究动作空间缩放以及在多达 40 台主机的网络上的泛化。我们发现，优先级别回放比领域随机化更能处理密集的训练分布，尤其是在更大规模的情况下；并且在更稀疏拓扑结构上进行训练会产生一个隐式的课程学习，从而改进了分布外的泛化能力，即使是在比训练期间所见拓扑更密集的拓扑结构上。为了处理线性增长的动作空间，我们提出了一种两阶段动作分解 (2SAS)，它在规模上大大优于扁平动作掩码。最后，我们识别出一种由优先级别回放的episode重置行为与 2SAS 的信用分配结构之间的相互作用引起的失效模式。因此，NASimJax 为推进基于 RL 的渗透测试提供了一个快速、灵活和真实的平台。
tldr: The paper introduces NASimJax, a JAX-based reimplementation of the Network Attack Simulator that achieves significant speedups, enabling RL policy training for penetration testing on larger and more realistic network scenarios. It also explores techniques like Prioritized Level Replay and a two-stage action decomposition to improve generalization and handle large action spaces.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了NASimJax，一个基于JAX的网络攻击模拟器的重新实现，它实现了显著的加速，从而能够在更大、更真实的网路场景中进行渗透测试的强化学习策略训练。它还探索了诸如优先等级重放和两阶段动作分解等技术，以提高泛化能力并处理大型动作空间。

title: LIORNet: Self-Supervised LiDAR Snow Removal Framework for Autonomous Driving under Adverse Weather Conditions
summary: LiDAR sensors provide high-resolution 3D perception and long-range detection, making them indispensable for autonomous driving and robotics. However, their performance significantly degrades under adverse weather conditions such as snow, rain, and fog, where spurious noise points dominate the point cloud and lead to false perception. To address this problem, various approaches have been proposed: distance-based filters exploiting spatial sparsity, intensity-based filters leveraging reflectance distributions, and learning-based methods that adapt to complex environments. Nevertheless, distance-based methods struggle to distinguish valid object points from noise, intensity-based methods often rely on fixed thresholds that lack adaptability to changing conditions, and learning-based methods suffer from the high cost of annotation, limited generalization, and computational overhead. In this study, we propose LIORNet, which eliminates these drawbacks and integrates the strengths of all three paradigms. LIORNet is built upon a U-Net++ backbone and employs a self-supervised learning strategy guided by pseudo-labels generated from multiple physical and statistical cues, including range-dependent intensity thresholds, snow reflectivity, point sparsity, and sensing range constraints. This design enables LIORNet to distinguish noise points from environmental structures without requiring manual annotations, thereby overcoming the difficulty of snow labeling and the limitations of single-principle approaches. Extensive experiments on the WADS and CADC datasets demonstrate that LIORNet outperforms state-of-the-art filtering algorithms in both accuracy and runtime while preserving critical environmental features. These results highlight LIORNet as a practical and robust solution for LiDAR perception in extreme weather, with strong potential for real-time deployment in autonomous driving systems.
summary_zh: 激光雷达传感器提供高分辨率的3D感知和远距离探测能力，使其成为自动驾驶和机器人技术不可或缺的组成部分。然而，在诸如雪、雨和雾等恶劣天气条件下，其性能会显著下降，大量虚假噪声点占据点云，导致错误的感知结果。为了解决这个问题，已经提出了各种方法：利用空间稀疏性的基于距离的滤波器，利用反射率分布的基于强度的滤波器，以及适应复杂环境的基于学习的方法。然而，基于距离的方法难以区分有效的物体点和噪声，基于强度的方法通常依赖于缺乏对变化条件适应性的固定阈值，而基于学习的方法则面临着高昂的标注成本、有限的泛化能力和计算开销。在本研究中，我们提出了一种名为LIORNet的方法，它消除了这些缺点，并整合了所有三种范式的优势。LIORNet建立在U-Net++主干网络之上，并采用了一种自监督学习策略，该策略由从多个物理和统计线索生成的伪标签引导，包括与距离相关的强度阈值、雪的反射率、点稀疏度和传感范围约束。这种设计使LIORNet能够在不需要手动标注的情况下区分噪声点和环境结构，从而克服了雪标签的标注困难以及单一原理方法的局限性。在WADS和CADC数据集上的大量实验表明，LIORNet在准确性和运行时间方面均优于最先进的滤波算法，同时保留了关键的环境特征。这些结果表明，LIORNet是一种在极端天气下进行激光雷达感知的实用且稳健的解决方案，在自动驾驶系统中具有强大的实时部署潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces LIORNet, a self-supervised LiDAR snow removal framework using U-Net++ and multiple physical cues to improve autonomous driving in snowy conditions without manual annotation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了LIORNet，一种自监督的激光雷达雪地移除框架，它使用U-Net++和多种物理线索来改进在雪地条件下的自动驾驶，无需手动标注。

title: Legged Autonomous Surface Science In Analogue Environments (LASSIE): Making Every Robotic Step Count in Planetary Exploration
summary: The ability to efficiently and effectively explore planetary surfaces is currently limited by the capability of wheeled rovers to traverse challenging terrains, and by pre-programmed data acquisition plans with limited in-situ flexibility. In this paper, we present two novel approaches to address these limitations: (i) high-mobility legged robots that use direct surface interactions to collect rich information about the terrain's mechanics to guide exploration; (ii) human-inspired data acquisition algorithms that enable robots to reason about scientific hypotheses and adapt exploration priorities based on incoming ground-sensing measurements. We successfully verify our approach through lab work and field deployments in two planetary analog environments. The new capability for legged robots to measure soil mechanical properties is shown to enable effective traversal of challenging terrains. When coupled with other geologic properties (e.g., composition, thermal properties, and grain size data etc), soil mechanical measurements reveal key factors governing the formation and development of geologic environments. We then demonstrate how human-inspired algorithms turn terrain-sensing robots into teammates, by supporting more flexible and adaptive data collection decisions with human scientists. Our approach therefore enables exploration of a wider range of planetary environments and new substrate investigation opportunities through integrated human-robot systems that support maximum scientific return.
summary_zh: 目前，行星表面高效探索能力受限于轮式漫游车在复杂地形上的行驶能力，以及缺乏原位灵活性的预编程数据采集计划。本文提出了两种新颖的方法来解决这些局限性：(i) 高机动性腿式机器人，通过直接与表面交互来收集关于地形力学特性的丰富信息，从而指导探索；(ii) 受人类启发的数据采集算法，使机器人能够推理科学假设，并根据传入的地面传感测量结果调整探索优先级。我们通过实验室工作和在两个行星模拟环境中的现场部署成功验证了我们的方法。结果表明，腿式机器人测量土壤力学性质的新能力能够有效地穿越复杂地形。当与其他地质属性（例如，成分、热属性和粒度数据等）相结合时，土壤力学测量结果揭示了控制地质环境形成和发展的关键因素。然后，我们演示了受人类启发算法如何将地形感知机器人转变为团队成员，通过支持更灵活和自适应的数据收集决策来辅助人类科学家。因此，我们的方法能够通过集成了人机系统的行星探索，支持最大化的科学回报，从而探索更广泛的行星环境和提供新的基质调查机会。
tldr: This paper presents a legged robot system with novel surface interaction techniques for terrain analysis and human-inspired data acquisition algorithms for adaptive planetary exploration, demonstrated in analog environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种腿式机器人系统，该系统具有用于地形分析的新颖表面互动技术和用于自适应行星探测的受人类启发的数据采集算法，并在类比环境中进行了演示。

title: Zero Shot Deformation Reconstruction for Soft Robots Using a Flexible Sensor Array and Cage Based 3D Gaussian Modeling
summary: We present a zero-shot deformation reconstruction framework for soft robots that operates without any visual supervision at inference time. In this work, zero-shot deformation reconstruction is defined as the ability to infer object-wide deformations on previously unseen soft robots without collecting object-specific deformation data or performing any retraining during deployment. Our method assumes access to a static geometric proxy of the undeformed object, which can be obtained from a STL model. During operation, the system relies exclusively on tactile sensing, enabling camera-free deformation inference. The proposed framework integrates a flexible piezoresistive sensor array with a geometry-aware, cage-based 3D Gaussian deformation model. Local tactile measurements are mapped to low-dimensional cage control signals and propagated to dense Gaussian primitives to generate globally consistent shape deformations. A graph attention network regresses cage displacements from tactile input, enforcing spatial smoothness and structural continuity via boundary-aware propagation. Given only a nominal geometric proxy and real-time tactile signals, the system performs zero-shot deformation reconstruction of unseen soft robots in bending and twisting motions, while rendering photorealistic RGB in real time. It achieves 0.67 IoU, 0.65 SSIM, and 3.48 mm Chamfer distance, demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization through explicit coupling of tactile sensing and structured geometric deformation.
summary_zh: 我们提出一个针对软机器人的零样本形变重建框架，该框架在推理时不依赖于任何视觉监督。在此工作中，零样本形变重建被定义为能够在未见过的软机器人上推断整体形变的能力，而无需收集特定对象的形变数据或在部署期间进行任何重新训练。我们的方法假设可以访问未变形对象的静态几何代理，例如从STL模型获得。在运行期间，系统完全依赖于触觉传感，从而实现无需摄像头的形变推断。所提出的框架将一个柔性压阻传感器阵列与一个几何感知的、基于笼子的三维高斯形变模型相结合。局部触觉测量被映射到低维笼子控制信号，并传播到密集高斯基元，从而生成全局一致的形状形变。一个图注意力网络从触觉输入回归笼子的位移，通过边界感知传播来强制执行空间平滑性和结构连续性。仅给出标称几何代理和实时触觉信号，系统就可以对未见过的软机器人进行弯曲和扭曲运动的零样本形变重建，同时实时渲染逼真的RGB图像。它实现了0.67 IoU、0.65 SSIM和3.48毫米的Chamfer距离，通过触觉传感和结构化几何形变的显式耦合，展示了强大的零样本泛化能力。
tldr: This paper presents a zero-shot deformation reconstruction framework for soft robots using tactile sensing and a cage-based 3D Gaussian deformation model, enabling camera-free deformation inference on unseen robots. It demonstrates strong zero-shot generalization in bending and twisting motions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于软机器人的零样本形变重建框架，该框架使用触觉传感和一个基于笼子的3D高斯形变模型，无需相机即可对未见过的机器人进行形变推断。该方法在弯曲和扭转运动中表现出强大的零样本泛化能力。

title: Unlabeled Multi-Robot Motion Planning with Improved Separation Trade-offs
summary:
We study unlabeled multi-robot motion planning for unit-disk robots in a polygonal environment. Although the problem is hard in general, polynomial-time solutions exist under appropriate separation assumptions on start and target positions. Banyassady et al. (SoCG'22) guarantee feasibility in simple polygons under start--start and target--target distances of at least $4$, and start--target distances of at least $3$, but without optimality guarantees. Solovey et al. (RSS'15) provide a near-optimal solution in general polygonal domains, under stricter conditions: start/target positions must have pairwise distance at least $4$, and at least $\sqrt{5}\approx2.236$ from obstacles. This raises the question of whether polynomial-time algorithms can be obtained in even more densely packed environments.
  In this paper we present a generalized algorithm that achieve different trade-offs on the robots-separation and obstacles-separation bounds, all significantly improving upon the state of the art. Specifically, we obtain polynomial-time constant-approximation algorithms to minimize the total path length when (i) the robots-separation is $2\tfrac{2}{3}$ and the obstacles-separation is $1\tfrac{2}{3}$, or (ii) the robots-separation is $\approx3.291$ and the obstacles-separation $\approx1.354$. Additionally, we introduce a different strategy yielding a polynomial-time solution when the robots-separation is only $2$, and the obstacles-separation is $3$. Finally, we show that without any robots-separation assumption, obstacles-separation of at least $1.5$ may be necessary for a solution to exist.
summary_zh:
我们研究了多边形环境下的单位圆盘机器人的无标签多机器人运动规划问题。尽管该问题通常是NP困难的，但在起始点和目标点之间满足适当分离假设的情况下，存在多项式时间解。Banyassady等人(SoCG'22)证明了在起始点-起始点距离和目标点-目标点距离至少为$4$，以及起始点-目标点距离至少为$3$的情况下，在简单多边形中的可行性，但未保证最优性。Solovey等人(RSS'15)在更严格的条件下，即起始点/目标点之间两两距离至少为$4$，且与障碍物距离至少为$\sqrt{5}\approx2.236$的情况下，提供了通用多边形域内的近似最优解。这引发了一个问题，即是否可以在更密集的环境中获得多项式时间算法。

在本文中，我们提出了一种通用算法，该算法在机器人分离和障碍物分离的界限上实现了不同的权衡，所有这些都显着改进了现有技术。具体来说，我们获得了多项式时间常数近似算法，以最小化总路径长度，当(i) 机器人分离为 $2\tfrac{2}{3}$ 且障碍物分离为 $1\tfrac{2}{3}$，或 (ii) 机器人分离为 $\approx3.291$ 且障碍物分离为 $\approx1.354$ 时。此外，我们引入了一种不同的策略，当机器人分离仅为 $2$，且障碍物分离为 $3$ 时，可获得多项式时间解。最后，我们表明在没有任何机器人分离假设的情况下，障碍物分离至少为 $1.5$ 可能是解存在的必要条件。
tldr: This paper presents improved polynomial-time constant-approximation algorithms for unlabeled multi-robot motion planning in densely packed environments, achieving better separation trade-offs between robots and obstacles than previous work. It also shows a necessary obstacle separation condition when robot separation is unrestricted.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了改进的多机器人运动规划算法，在密集环境中实现了更好的机器人和障碍物分离权衡，算法具有多项式时间复杂度，并提供了一个在无机器人分离限制下必要的障碍物分离条件。

title: A Closed-Form CLF-CBF Controller for Whole-Body Continuum Soft Robot Collision Avoidance
summary:
Safe operation is essential for deploying robots in human-centered 3D environments. Soft continuum manipulators provide passive safety through mechanical compliance, but still require active control to achieve reliable collision avoidance. Existing approaches, such as sampling-based planning, are often computationally expensive and lack formal safety guarantees, which limits their use for real-time whole-body avoidance.
  This paper presents a closed-form Control Lyapunov Function--Control Barrier Function (CLF--CBF) controller for real-time 3D obstacle avoidance in soft continuum manipulators without online optimization. By analytically embedding safety constraints into the control input, the proposed method ensures stability and safety under the stated modeling assumptions, while avoiding feasibility issues commonly encountered in online optimization-based methods. The resulting controller is up to $10\times$ faster than standard CLF--CBF quadratic-programming approaches and up to $100\times$ faster than traditional sampling-based planners.
  Simulation and hardware experiments on a tendon-driven soft manipulator demonstrate accurate 3D trajectory tracking and robust obstacle avoidance in cluttered environments. These results show that the proposed framework provides a scalable and provably safe control strategy for soft robots operating in dynamic, safety-critical settings.
summary_zh:
在以人为中心的3D环境中部署机器人，安全运行至关重要。软连续体机械臂通过机械柔顺性提供被动安全，但仍需要主动控制来实现可靠的避障。现有的方法，例如基于采样的规划，通常计算量大且缺乏形式化的安全保证，这限制了它们在实时全身避障中的应用。

本文提出了一种用于软连续体机械臂实时3D避障的闭环控制李雅普诺夫函数--控制障碍函数 (CLF--CBF) 控制器，无需在线优化。通过将安全约束解析地嵌入到控制输入中，所提出的方法在所述建模假设下确保稳定性和安全性，同时避免了在线优化方法中常见的可行性问题。由此产生的控制器比标准的CLF--CBF二次规划方法快达10倍，比传统的基于采样的规划器快达100倍。

在腱驱动软机械臂上的仿真和硬件实验表明，该方法可以实现精确的3D轨迹跟踪和在杂乱环境中鲁棒的避障。这些结果表明，所提出的框架为在动态、安全关键环境中运行的软机器人提供了一种可扩展且可证明安全的控制策略。
tldr: This paper introduces a closed-form CLF-CBF controller for real-time, safe 3D obstacle avoidance for soft continuum manipulators, demonstrating significant speed improvements over existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种闭式CLF-CBF控制器，用于软体连续操纵器的实时安全3D避障，与现有方法相比，速度有显著提高。

title: Hyperagents
summary: Self-improving AI systems aim to reduce reliance on human engineering by learning to improve their own learning and problem-solving processes. Existing approaches to self-improvement rely on fixed, handcrafted meta-level mechanisms, fundamentally limiting how fast such systems can improve. The Darwin Gödel Machine (DGM) demonstrates open-ended self-improvement in coding by repeatedly generating and evaluating self-modified variants. Because both evaluation and self-modification are coding tasks, gains in coding ability can translate into gains in self-improvement ability. However, this alignment does not generally hold beyond coding domains. We introduce \textbf{hyperagents}, self-referential agents that integrate a task agent (which solves the target task) and a meta agent (which modifies itself and the task agent) into a single editable program. Crucially, the meta-level modification procedure is itself editable, enabling metacognitive self-modification, improving not only the task-solving behavior, but also the mechanism that generates future improvements. We instantiate this framework by extending DGM to create DGM-Hyperagents (DGM-H), eliminating the assumption of domain-specific alignment between task performance and self-modification skill to potentially support self-accelerating progress on any computable task. Across diverse domains, the DGM-H improves performance over time and outperforms baselines without self-improvement or open-ended exploration, as well as prior self-improving systems. Furthermore, the DGM-H improves the process by which it generates new agents (e.g., persistent memory, performance tracking), and these meta-level improvements transfer across domains and accumulate across runs. DGM-Hyperagents offer a glimpse of open-ended AI systems that do not merely search for better solutions, but continually improve their search for how to improve.
summary_zh: 自提升人工智能系统旨在通过学习改进自身学习和问题解决过程，来减少对人为工程的依赖。现有的自提升方法依赖于固定的、手工设计的元层机制，这从根本上限制了此类系统改进的速度。达尔文哥德尔机 (DGM) 通过重复生成和评估自修改变体，展示了编码方面的开放式自提升。由于评估和自修改都是编码任务，因此编码能力的提升可以转化为自提升能力的提升。然而，这种一致性通常并不适用于编码领域之外。我们引入了\textbf{超代理}，一种自引用代理，将任务代理（解决目标任务）和元代理（修改自身和任务代理）集成到一个可编辑的程序中。至关重要的是，元层修改过程本身是可编辑的，从而实现元认知自修改，不仅改进了任务解决行为，还改进了生成未来改进的机制。我们通过扩展 DGM 以创建 DGM-超代理 (DGM-H) 来实例化这个框架，消除了任务性能和自修改技能之间特定于领域的一致性假设，从而有可能支持任何可计算任务上的自加速进展。在不同的领域中，DGM-H 随着时间推移改进性能，并优于没有自提升或开放式探索的baseline，以及先前的自提升系统。此外，DGM-H 改进了生成新代理的过程（例如，持久存储、性能跟踪），并且这些元层改进可以在不同领域之间转移并在运行中积累。DGM-超代理展现了开放式人工智能系统的雏形，它们不仅搜索更好的解决方案，而且不断改进它们寻找如何改进的搜索。
tldr: The paper introduces "hyperagents," a self-improving AI architecture where the agent learns to improve not only task performance but also its own learning mechanisms, demonstrating improved performance across diverse domains. This is achieved through an editable meta-agent that can modify both itself and the task agent.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为“超级代理”（Hyperagents）的自我改进AI架构，该架构不仅可以学习提高任务表现，还可以学习改进自身的学习机制，并在不同领域展示了改进后的性能。这是通过一个可编辑的元代理来实现的，该元代理可以修改自身和任务代理。

title: MuSteerNet: Human Reaction Generation from Videos via Observation-Reaction Mutual Steering
summary: Video-driven human reaction generation aims to synthesize 3D human motions that directly react to observed video sequences, which is crucial for building human-like interactive AI systems. However, existing methods often fail to effectively leverage video inputs to steer human reaction synthesis, resulting in reaction motions that are mismatched with the content of video sequences. We reveal that this limitation arises from a severe relational distortion between visual observations and reaction types. In light of this, we propose MuSteerNet, a simple yet effective framework that generates 3D human reactions from videos via observation-reaction mutual steering. Specifically, we first propose a Prototype Feedback Steering mechanism to mitigate relational distortion by refining visual observations with a gated delta-rectification modulator and a relational margin constraint, guided by prototypical vectors learned from human reactions. We then introduce Dual-Coupled Reaction Refinement that fully leverages rectified visual cues to further steer the refinement of generated reaction motions, thereby effectively improving reaction quality and enabling MuSteerNet to achieve competitive performance. Extensive experiments and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of our method. Code coming soon: https://github.com/zhouyuan888888/MuSteerNet.
summary_zh: 基于视频的人类反应生成旨在合成能够直接对观察到的视频序列做出反应的3D人体动作，这对于构建类人交互式AI系统至关重要。然而，现有方法通常无法有效地利用视频输入来引导人类反应合成，导致反应动作与视频序列内容不匹配。我们揭示了这种局限性源于视觉观察和反应类型之间严重的关联扭曲。有鉴于此，我们提出MuSteerNet，这是一个简单而有效的框架，通过观察-反应互导来从视频生成3D人类反应。具体而言，我们首先提出一种原型反馈引导机制，通过使用门控Delta-校正调制器和一个关系边界约束来细化视觉观察，从而缓解关联扭曲，而该过程由从人类反应中学习到的原型向量引导。然后，我们引入双耦合反应细化，充分利用校正后的视觉线索来进一步引导生成反应动作的细化，从而有效提高反应质量，并使MuSteerNet能够实现具有竞争力的性能。大量的实验和消融研究验证了我们方法的有效性。代码即将发布：https://github.com/zhouyuan888888/MuSteerNet。
tldr: MuSteerNet addresses the problem of generating realistic human reactions to videos by mitigating relational distortion between visual observations and reaction types using a mutual steering framework. It leverages prototype feedback steering and dual-coupled reaction refinement.
tldr_zh: MuSteerNet致力于解决生成对视频的真实人类反应的问题，通过使用互导框架减轻视觉观察和反应类型之间的关系失真。它利用原型反馈引导和双重耦合反应细化。

title: Generalizable NGP-SR: Generalizable Neural Radiance Fields Super-Resolution via Neural Graph Primitives
summary: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) achieve photorealistic novel view synthesis but become costly when high-resolution (HR) rendering is required, as HR outputs demand dense sampling and higher-capacity models. Moreover, naively super-resolving per-view renderings in 2D often breaks multi-view consistency. We propose Generalizable NGP-SR, a 3D-aware super-resolution framework that reconstructs an HR radiance field directly from low-resolution (LR) posed images. Built on Neural Graphics Primitives (NGP), NGP-SR conditions radiance prediction on 3D coordinates and learned local texture tokens, enabling recovery of high-frequency details within the radiance field and producing view-consistent HR novel views without external HR references or post-hoc 2D upsampling. Importantly, our model is generalizable: once trained, it can be applied to unseen scenes and rendered from novel viewpoints without per-scene optimization. Experiments on multiple datasets show that NGP-SR consistently improves both reconstruction quality and runtime efficiency over prior NeRF-based super-resolution methods, offering a practical solution for scalable high-resolution novel view synthesis.
summary_zh: 神经辐射场(NeRF)能够实现逼真的新视角合成，但当需要高分辨率(HR)渲染时，其计算成本会变得非常高昂，因为HR输出需要密集的采样和更高容量的模型。此外，在2D中简单地对每个视角的渲染进行超分辨率处理通常会破坏多视角一致性。我们提出了可泛化的NGP-SR，一个3D感知的超分辨率框架，可以直接从低分辨率(LR)姿态图像重建HR辐射场。基于神经图形基元(NGP)，NGP-SR将辐射预测建立在3D坐标和学习到的局部纹理令牌上，从而能够在辐射场内恢复高频细节，并产生视角一致的HR新视角，而无需外部HR参考或后处理2D上采样。重要的是，我们的模型是可泛化的：一旦训练完成，它可以应用于未见过的场景，并从新的视点进行渲染，而无需针对每个场景进行优化。在多个数据集上的实验表明，与先前的基于NeRF的超分辨率方法相比，NGP-SR在重建质量和运行效率上都能持续改进，为可扩展的高分辨率新视角合成提供了一种实用的解决方案。
tldr: The paper introduces Generalizable NGP-SR, a 3D-aware super-resolution framework leveraging Neural Graphics Primitives to reconstruct high-resolution radiance fields from low-resolution images, enabling view-consistent novel view synthesis without per-scene optimization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Generalizable NGP-SR，一个 3D 感知的超分辨率框架，利用神经图形基元从低分辨率图像重建高分辨率辐射场，从而实现视角一致的新视角合成，而无需针对每个场景进行优化。

title: Cov2Pose: Leveraging Spatial Covariance for Direct Manifold-aware 6-DoF Object Pose Estimation
summary: In this paper, we address the problem of 6-DoF object pose estimation from a single RGB image. Indirect methods that typically predict intermediate 2D keypoints, followed by a Perspective-n-Point solver, have shown great performance. Direct approaches, which regress the pose in an end-to-end manner, are usually computationally more efficient but less accurate. However, direct heads rely on globally pooled features, ignoring spatial second-order statistics despite their informativeness in pose prediction. They also predict, in most cases, discontinuous pose representations that lack robustness. Herein, we therefore propose a covariance-pooled representation that encodes convolutional feature distributions as a symmetric positive definite (SPD) matrix. Moreover, we propose a novel pose encoding in the form of an SPD matrix via its Cholesky decomposition. Pose is then regressed in an end-to-end manner with a manifold-aware network head, taking into account the Riemannian geometry of SPD matrices. Experiments and ablations consistently demonstrate the relevance of second-order pooling and continuous representations for direct pose regression, including under partial occlusion.
