summary_zh: 本文探讨了从单张RGB图像中进行6自由度物体姿态估计的问题。通常预测中间二维关键点，然后使用透视-n-点解算器的间接方法已经展现出优异的性能。直接方法以端到端的方式回归姿态，通常计算效率更高，但精度较低。然而，直接方法依赖于全局池化的特征，忽略了空间二阶统计信息，尽管它们在姿态预测中具有信息量。此外，在大多数情况下，它们预测的姿态表示是不连续的，缺乏鲁棒性。因此，我们在此提出一种协方差池化的表示方法，该方法将卷积特征分布编码为对称正定（SPD）矩阵。此外，我们提出了一种新颖的姿态编码方法，以SPD矩阵的形式通过其Cholesky分解来实现。然后采用流形感知网络头部以端到端的方式回归姿态，同时考虑到SPD矩阵的黎曼几何。实验和消融研究一致表明了在直接姿态回归中二阶池化和连续表示的相关性，包括在部分遮挡情况下。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel direct 6-DoF object pose estimation method using covariance pooling and a manifold-aware network head for continuous pose representation, demonstrating improved accuracy and robustness compared to previous direct methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的直接6自由度物体姿态估计方法，该方法利用协方差池化和流形感知网络头来实现连续姿态表示，与之前的直接方法相比，提高了准确性和鲁棒性。

title: FlashCap: Millisecond-Accurate Human Motion Capture via Flashing LEDs and Event-Based Vision
summary: Precise motion timing (PMT) is crucial for swift motion analysis. A millisecond difference may determine victory or defeat in sports competitions. Despite substantial progress in human pose estimation (HPE), PMT remains largely overlooked by the HPE community due to the limited availability of high-temporal-resolution labeled datasets. Today, PMT is achieved using high-speed RGB cameras in specialized scenarios such as the Olympic Games; however, their high costs, light sensitivity, bandwidth, and computational complexity limit their feasibility for daily use. We developed FlashCap, the first flashing LED-based MoCap system for PMT. With FlashCap, we collect a millisecond-resolution human motion dataset, FlashMotion, comprising the event, RGB, LiDAR, and IMU modalities, and demonstrate its high quality through rigorous validation. To evaluate the merits of FlashMotion, we perform two tasks: precise motion timing and high-temporal-resolution HPE. For these tasks, we propose ResPose, a simple yet effective baseline that learns residual poses based on events and RGBs. Experimental results show that ResPose reduces pose estimation errors by ~40% and achieves millisecond-level timing accuracy, enabling new research opportunities. The dataset and code will be shared with the community.
summary_zh: 精确运动时间（PMT）对于快速运动分析至关重要。毫秒级的差异可能决定体育比赛中的胜负。尽管人体姿态估计（HPE）取得了显著进展，但由于缺乏高时间分辨率的标注数据集，PMT在很大程度上被HPE领域所忽视。目前，PMT通常在奥运会等特定场景中使用高速RGB相机实现；然而，其高昂的成本、对光照的敏感性、带宽限制和计算复杂度限制了其在日常使用中的可行性。我们开发了FlashCap，这是第一个基于闪烁LED的运动捕捉系统（MoCap），用于PMT。利用FlashCap，我们收集了一个毫秒级分辨率的人体运动数据集FlashMotion，其包含事件、RGB、LiDAR和IMU多种模态，并通过严格的验证证明了其高质量。为了评估FlashMotion的优点，我们执行了两项任务：精确运动时间和高时间分辨率的HPE。针对这些任务，我们提出了ResPose，一个简单而有效的基线模型，它学习基于事件和RGB的残差姿态。实验结果表明，ResPose将姿态估计误差降低了约40%，并实现了毫秒级的计时精度，从而为新的研究机会提供了可能。数据集和代码将与社区共享。
tldr: The paper introduces FlashCap, a millisecond-accurate human motion capture system using flashing LEDs and event-based vision, along with a new high-resolution dataset (FlashMotion) and a baseline model (ResPose) that improves pose estimation by ~40% and achieves millisecond-level timing accuracy.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种使用闪烁LED和事件视觉的毫秒级精确人体运动捕捉系统 FlashCap，以及一个新的高分辨率数据集 (FlashMotion) 和一个基线模型 (ResPose)，该模型将姿态估计提高了约 40%，并实现了毫秒级的定时精度。

title: PCSTracker: Long-Term Scene Flow Estimation for Point Cloud Sequences
summary: Point cloud scene flow estimation is fundamental to long-term and fine-grained 3D motion analysis. However, existing methods are typically limited to pairwise settings and struggle to maintain temporal consistency over long sequences as geometry evolves, occlusions emerge, and errors accumulate. In this work, we propose PCSTracker, the first end-to-end framework specifically designed for consistent scene flow estimation in point cloud sequences. Specifically, we introduce an iterative geometry motion joint optimization module (IGMO) that explicitly models the temporal evolution of point features to alleviate correspondence inconsistencies caused by dynamic geometric changes. In addition, a spatio-temporal point trajectory update module (STTU) is proposed to leverage broad temporal context to infer plausible positions for occluded points, ensuring coherent motion estimation. To further handle long sequences, we employ an overlapping sliding-window inference strategy that alternates cross-window propagation and in-window refinement, effectively suppressing error accumulation and maintaining stable long-term motion consistency. Extensive experiments on the synthetic PointOdyssey3D and real-world ADT3D datasets show that PCSTracker achieves the best accuracy in long-term scene flow estimation and maintains real-time performance at 32.5 FPS, while demonstrating superior 3D motion understanding compared to RGB-D-based approaches.
summary_zh: 点云场景流估计是长期和细粒度3D 运动分析的基础。 然而，现有方法通常仅限于成对设置，并且难以在几何演变、遮挡出现和误差累积的情况下，在长序列中保持时间一致性。 在这项工作中，我们提出了PCSTracker，这是第一个专门为点云序列中一致的场景流估计而设计的端到端框架。 具体来说，我们引入了一个迭代几何运动联合优化模块（IGMO），该模块显式地建模了点特征的时间演变，以减轻由动态几何变化引起的对应关系不一致。 此外，还提出了一种时空点轨迹更新模块（STTU），利用广泛的时间上下文来推断被遮挡点的合理位置，从而确保连贯的运动估计。 为了进一步处理长序列，我们采用重叠滑动窗口推理策略，交替进行跨窗口传播和窗口内细化，有效地抑制误差累积并保持稳定的长期运动一致性。 在合成的PointOdyssey3D和真实的ADT3D数据集上的大量实验表明，PCSTracker在长期场景流估计中实现了最佳精度，并保持了32.5 FPS 的实时性能，同时与基于RGB-D的方法相比，表现出卓越的3D 运动理解能力。
tldr: The paper introduces PCSTracker, a novel end-to-end framework for long-term scene flow estimation in point cloud sequences, addressing limitations of existing pairwise methods by incorporating temporal consistency, occlusion handling, and error suppression.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PCSTracker，一种用于点云序列中长期场景流估计的端到端框架。它通过整合时间一致性、遮挡处理和误差抑制，解决了现有成对方法的局限性。

title: Heavy-Tailed and Long-Range Dependent Noise in Stochastic Approximation: A Finite-Time Analysis
summary: Stochastic approximation (SA) is a fundamental iterative framework with broad applications in reinforcement learning and optimization. Classical analyses typically rely on martingale difference or Markov noise with bounded second moments, but many practical settings, including finance and communications, frequently encounter heavy-tailed and long-range dependent (LRD) noise. In this work, we study SA for finding the root of a strongly monotone operator under these non-classical noise models. We establish the first finite-time moment bounds in both settings, providing explicit convergence rates that quantify the impact of heavy tails and temporal dependence. Our analysis employs a noise-averaging argument that regularizes the impact of noise without modifying the iteration. Finally, we apply our general framework to stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and gradient play, and corroborate our finite-time analysis through numerical experiments.
summary_zh: 随机逼近 (SA) 是一种基本的迭代框架，在强化学习和优化领域有着广泛的应用。传统的分析通常依赖于鞅差或具有有界二阶矩的马尔可夫噪声，但许多实际场景，包括金融和通信，经常遇到重尾和长程相关 (LRD) 噪声。 在这项工作中，我们研究了在这些非经典噪声模型下，使用 SA 寻找强单调算子的根。我们建立了这两种情况下首个有限时间矩界限，提供了量化重尾和时间依赖性影响的显式收敛速度。我们的分析采用了一种噪声平均论证，可以在不修改迭代的情况下规范化噪声的影响。最后，我们将我们的通用框架应用于随机梯度下降 (SGD) 和梯度博弈，并通过数值实验证实了我们的有限时间分析。
tldr: This paper analyzes stochastic approximation (SA) under heavy-tailed and long-range dependent noise, providing finite-time convergence guarantees and applying it to SGD and gradient play. The analysis uses a novel noise-averaging technique.
tldr_zh: 该论文分析了重尾和长程依赖噪声下的随机逼近（SA），提供了有限时间收敛保证，并将其应用于SGD和梯度博弈。该分析使用了一种新颖的噪声平均技术。

title: Deep Hilbert--Galerkin Methods for Infinite-Dimensional PDEs and Optimal Control
summary:
We develop deep learning-based approximation methods for fully nonlinear second-order PDEs on separable Hilbert spaces, such as HJB equations for infinite-dimensional control, by parameterizing solutions via Hilbert--Galerkin Neural Operators (HGNOs). We prove the first Universal Approximation Theorems (UATs) which are sufficiently powerful to address these problems, based on novel topologies for Hessian terms and corresponding novel continuity assumptions on the fully nonlinear operator. These topologies are non-sequential and non-metrizable, making the problem delicate. In particular, we prove UATs for functions on Hilbert spaces, together with their Fréchet derivatives up to second order, and for unbounded operators applied to the first derivative, ensuring that HGNOs are able to approximate all the PDE terms. For control problems, we further prove UATs for optimal feedback controls in terms of our approximating value function HGNO.
  We develop numerical training methods, which we call Deep Hilbert--Galerkin and Hilbert Actor-Critic (reinforcement learning) Methods, for these problems by minimizing the $L^2_μ(H)$-norm of the residual of the PDE on the whole Hilbert space, not just a projected PDE to finite dimensions. This is the first paper to propose such an approach. The models considered arise in many applied sciences, such as functional differential equations in physics and Kolmogorov and HJB PDEs related to controlled PDEs, SPDEs, path-dependent systems, partially observed stochastic systems, and mean-field SDEs. We numerically solve examples of Kolmogorov and HJB PDEs related to the optimal control of deterministic and stochastic heat and Burgers' equations, demonstrating the promise of our deep learning-based approach.
summary_zh:
我们开发了基于深度学习的近似方法，用于求解可分离希尔伯特空间上的全非线性二阶偏微分方程，例如无限维控制的HJB方程，方法是通过希尔伯特-伽辽金神经算子（HGNOs）参数化解。我们基于 Hessian 项的新颖拓扑结构以及全非线性算子相应的新的连续性假设，证明了首个足以解决这些问题的通用逼近定理（UATs）。这些拓扑结构是非序列的和非可度量的，这使得问题变得微妙。特别是，我们证明了希尔伯特空间上的函数及其一阶和二阶Fréchet导数的UAT，以及应用于一阶导数的无界算子的UAT，确保了HGNOs能够逼近所有的PDE项。对于控制问题，我们进一步证明了最优反馈控制关于我们逼近值函数HGNO的UAT。

我们开发了数值训练方法，称之为深度希尔伯特-伽辽金和希尔伯特Actor-Critic（强化学习）方法，通过最小化整个希尔伯特空间上PDE残差的 $L^2_μ(H)$-范数来求解这些问题，而不仅仅是投影到有限维度的 PDE 。这是第一篇提出这种方法的论文。所考虑的模型出现在许多应用科学中，例如物理学中的泛函微分方程以及与受控PDE、SPDE、路径依赖系统、部分观测的随机系统和平均场SDE相关的 Kolmogorov 和 HJB PDE。我们数值求解了与确定性和随机热方程以及 Burgers' 方程的最优控制相关的 Kolmogorov 和 HJB PDE 示例，展示了我们基于深度学习方法的前景。
tldr: This paper introduces Deep Hilbert-Galerkin Methods using HGNOs for solving high-dimensional, fully nonlinear PDEs and optimal control problems, proving universal approximation theorems and demonstrating promising results on control problems related to heat and Burgers' equations.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了基于深度学习的 Hilbert-Galerkin 方法，使用 HGNOs 来解决高维、完全非线性偏微分方程和最优控制问题。论文证明了通用逼近定理，并在与热方程和 Burgers 方程相关的控制问题上展示了有希望的结果。

title: Optimizing Resource-Constrained Non-Pharmaceutical Interventions for Multi-Cluster Outbreak Control Using Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
summary: Non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs), such as diagnostic testing and quarantine, are crucial for controlling infectious disease outbreaks but are often constrained by limited resources, particularly in early outbreak stages. In real-world public health settings, resources must be allocated across multiple outbreak clusters that emerge asynchronously, vary in size and risk, and compete for a shared resource budget. Here, a cluster corresponds to a group of close contacts generated by a single infected index case. Thus, decisions must be made under uncertainty and heterogeneous demands, while respecting operational constraints. We formulate this problem as a constrained restless multi-armed bandit and propose a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework. A global controller learns a continuous action cost multiplier that adjusts global resource demand, while a generalized local policy estimates the marginal value of allocating resources to individuals within each cluster. We evaluate the proposed framework in a realistic agent-based simulator of SARS-CoV-2 with dynamically arriving clusters. Across a wide range of system scales and testing budgets, our method consistently outperforms RMAB-inspired and heuristic baselines, improving outbreak control effectiveness by 20%-30%. Experiments on up to 40 concurrently active clusters further demonstrate that the hierarchical framework is highly scalable and enables faster decision-making than the RMAB-inspired method.
summary_zh: 非药物干预措施（NPIs），如诊断检测和隔离，对于控制传染病爆发至关重要，但通常受到资源限制，尤其是在疫情爆发的早期阶段。在真实的公共卫生环境中，资源必须在多个异步出现、规模和风险各异且竞争共享资源预算的疫情集群之间进行分配。在此，一个集群对应于由单个感染的指标病例产生的一组密切接触者。因此，必须在不确定性和异构需求下做出决策，同时遵守操作约束。我们将此问题建模为一个受约束的restless multi-armed bandit问题，并提出一个分层强化学习框架。一个全局控制器学习一个连续的行动成本倍数，用于调整全局资源需求，而一个广义的局部策略估计将资源分配给每个集群内个体的边际价值。我们在一个真实的、具有动态到达集群的SARS-CoV-2的基于代理的仿真器中评估了所提出的框架。在广泛的系统规模和检测预算下，我们的方法始终优于受RMAB启发的基线方法和启发式方法，将疫情控制效果提高了20%-30%。对多达40个并发活动集群的实验进一步表明，该分层框架具有高度可扩展性，并且能够比受RMAB启发的基线方法更快地做出决策。
tldr: This paper introduces a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework to optimize resource allocation for controlling multi-cluster disease outbreaks, demonstrating improved performance and scalability compared to baselines in a SARS-CoV-2 simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分层强化学习框架，用于优化资源分配以控制多集群疾病爆发。在 SARS-CoV-2 模拟中，该方法比基线方法表现出更好的性能和可扩展性。

title: Uncertainty Matters: Structured Probabilistic Online Mapping for Motion Prediction in Autonomous Driving
summary: Online map generation and trajectory prediction are critical components of the autonomous driving perception-prediction-planning pipeline. While modern vectorized mapping models achieve high geometric accuracy, they typically treat map estimation as a deterministic task, discarding structural uncertainty. Existing probabilistic approaches often rely on diagonal covariance matrices, which assume independence between points and fail to capture the strong spatial correlations inherent in road geometry. To address this, we propose a structured probabilistic formulation for online map generation. Our method explicitly models intra-element dependencies by predicting a dense covariance matrix, parameterized via a Low-Rank plus Diagonal (LRPD) covariance decomposition. This formulation represents uncertainty as a combination of a low-rank component, which captures global spatial structure, and a diagonal component representing independent local noise, thereby capturing geometric correlations without the prohibitive computational cost of full covariance matrices. Evaluations on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate that our uncertainty-aware framework yields consistent improvements in online map generation quality compared to deterministic baselines. Furthermore, our approach establishes new state-of-the-art performance for map-based motion prediction, highlighting the critical role of uncertainty in planning tasks. Code is published under link-available-soon.
summary_zh: 在线地图生成和轨迹预测是自动驾驶感知-预测-规划流程中的关键组成部分。虽然现代向量化地图模型实现了很高的几何精度，但它们通常将地图估计视为一个确定性任务，丢弃了结构性不确定性。现有的概率方法往往依赖于对角协方差矩阵，该矩阵假设点之间的独立性，并且无法捕捉道路几何形状中固有的强空间相关性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种用于在线地图生成的结构化概率公式。我们的方法通过预测一个稠密协方差矩阵来显式地建模元素内部依赖关系，该矩阵通过低秩加对角 (LRPD) 的协方差分解进行参数化。此公式将不确定性表示为低秩分量（捕捉全局空间结构）和对角分量（表示独立的局部噪声）的组合，从而在不产生完整协方差矩阵的过高计算成本的情况下捕捉了几何相关性。在 nuScenes 数据集上的评估表明，与确定性基线相比，我们具有不确定性意识的框架在在线地图生成质量方面产生了持续改进。此外，我们的方法为基于地图的运动预测建立了新的最先进性能，突出了不确定性在规划任务中的关键作用。代码将在 link-available-soon 下发布。
tldr: This paper introduces a structured probabilistic approach for online map generation in autonomous driving, using a Low-Rank plus Diagonal (LRPD) covariance decomposition to model uncertainty and improve motion prediction. The method achieves state-of-the-art results on the nuScenes dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶在线地图生成的结构化概率方法，使用低秩加对角(LRPD)协方差分解来建模不确定性并改进运动预测。该方法在nuScenes数据集上实现了最先进的性能。

title: Multi-Agent Motion Planning on Industrial Magnetic Levitation Platforms: A Hybrid ADMM-HOCBF approach
summary: This paper presents a novel hybrid motion planning method for holonomic multi-agent systems. The proposed decentralised model predictive control (MPC) framework tackles the intractability of classical centralised MPC for a growing number of agents while providing safety guarantees. This is achieved by combining a decentralised version of the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) with a centralised high-order control barrier function (HOCBF) architecture. Simulation results show significant improvement in scalability over classical centralised MPC. We validate the efficacy and real-time capability of the proposed method by developing a highly efficient C++ implementation and deploying the resulting trajectories on a real industrial magnetic levitation platform.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于全向多智能体系统的新型混合运动规划方法。所提出的分散式模型预测控制（MPC）框架在保证安全性的同时，解决了传统集中式MPC在智能体数量增长时难以处理的问题。这通过结合分散式交替方向乘子法（ADMM）与集中式高阶控制障碍函数（HOCBF）架构来实现。仿真结果表明，与传统的集中式MPC相比，该方法在可扩展性方面有显著提高。为了验证所提出方法的有效性和实时性，我们开发了一个高效的C++实现，并将生成的轨迹部署在一个真实的工业磁悬浮平台上。
tldr: This paper introduces a decentralized MPC framework for multi-agent motion planning on magnetic levitation platforms using a hybrid ADMM-HOCBF approach, demonstrating improved scalability and real-time capabilities in simulations and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于磁悬浮平台上多智能体运动规划的去中心化MPC框架，该框架采用混合ADMM-HOCBF方法，并在仿真和实际实验中展示了改进的可扩展性和实时性能。

title: Real-Time Structural Detection for Indoor Navigation from 3D LiDAR Using Bird's-Eye-View Images
summary: Efficient structural perception is essential for mapping and autonomous navigation on resource-constrained robots. Existing 3D methods are computationally prohibitive, while traditional 2D geometric approaches lack robustness. This paper presents a lightweight, real-time framework that projects 3D LiDAR data into 2D Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) images to enable efficient detection of structural elements relevant to mapping and navigation. Within this representation, we systematically evaluate several feature extraction strategies, including classical geometric techniques (Hough Transform, RANSAC, and LSD) and a deep learning detector based on YOLO-OBB. The resulting detections are integrated through a spatiotemporal fusion module that improves stability and robustness across consecutive frames. Experiments conducted on a standard mobile robotic platform highlight clear performance trade-offs. Classical methods such as Hough and LSD provide fast responses but exhibit strong sensitivity to noise, with LSD producing excessive segment fragmentation that leads to system congestion. RANSAC offers improved robustness but fails to meet real-time constraints. In contrast, the YOLO-OBB-based approach achieves the best balance between robustness and computational efficiency, maintaining an end-to-end latency (satisfying 10 Hz operation) while effectively filtering cluttered observations in a low-power single-board computer (SBC) without using GPU acceleration. The main contribution of this work is a computationally efficient BEV-based perception pipeline enabling reliable real-time structural detection from 3D LiDAR on resource-constrained robotic platforms that cannot rely on GPU-intensive processing.
summary_zh: 高效的结构感知对于资源受限机器人上的地图构建和自主导航至关重要。现有的 3D 方法计算量过大，而传统的 2D 几何方法缺乏鲁棒性。本文提出了一种轻量级、实时的框架，该框架将 3D LiDAR 数据投影到 2D 鸟瞰图 (BEV) 图像中，从而能够有效检测与地图构建和导航相关的结构元素。在该表示形式下，我们系统地评估了几种特征提取策略，包括经典几何技术（Hough 变换、RANSAC 和 LSD）和一个基于 YOLO-OBB 的深度学习检测器。通过时空融合模块整合检测结果，提高了连续帧之间的稳定性和鲁棒性。在标准移动机器人平台上进行的实验突出了清晰的性能权衡。Hough 和 LSD 等经典方法提供了快速响应，但对噪声表现出很强的敏感性，其中 LSD 产生过度的片段碎片化，导致系统拥塞。RANSAC 提供了更高的鲁棒性，但未能满足实时约束。相比之下，基于 YOLO-OBB 的方法在鲁棒性和计算效率之间取得了最佳平衡，在低功耗单板计算机 (SBC) 上无需使用 GPU 加速即可维持端到端延迟（满足 10 Hz 运行），同时有效地过滤杂乱的观测结果。这项工作的主要贡献是一种计算效率高的基于 BEV 的感知流程，能够在无法依赖 GPU 密集型处理的资源受限机器人平台上，实现来自 3D LiDAR 的可靠实时结构检测。
tldr: This paper presents a real-time, lightweight framework for structural element detection from 3D LiDAR data for indoor robot navigation by projecting data into a Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) and using a YOLO-OBB detector on a resource-constrained platform.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种轻量级的实时框架，通过将3D激光雷达数据投影到鸟瞰图（BEV）中，并使用YOLO-OBB检测器，在资源受限的平台上进行室内机器人导航的结构元素检测。

title: LoD-Loc v3: Generalized Aerial Localization in Dense Cities using Instance Silhouette Alignment
summary: We present LoD-Loc v3, a novel method for generalized aerial visual localization in dense urban environments. While prior work LoD-Loc v2 achieves localization through semantic building silhouette alignment with low-detail city models, it suffers from two key limitations: poor cross-scene generalization and frequent failure in dense building scenes. Our method addresses these challenges through two key innovations. First, we develop a new synthetic data generation pipeline that produces InsLoD-Loc - the largest instance segmentation dataset for aerial imagery to date, comprising 100k images with precise instance building annotations. This enables trained models to exhibit remarkable zero-shot generalization capability. Second, we reformulate the localization paradigm by shifting from semantic to instance silhouette alignment, which significantly reduces pose estimation ambiguity in dense scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LoD-Loc v3 outperforms existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines, achieving superior performance in both cross-scene and dense urban scenarios with a large margin. The project is available at https://nudt-sawlab.github.io/LoD-Locv3/.
summary_zh: 我们提出了LoD-Loc v3，一种针对密集城市环境中通用航拍视觉定位的新方法。之前的研究LoD-Loc v2通过语义建筑物轮廓与低细节度城市模型的对齐来实现定位，但存在两个主要局限性：泛化能力差以及在密集建筑物场景中频繁失效。我们的方法通过两项关键创新解决了这些挑战。首先，我们开发了一种新的合成数据生成流程，产生了InsLoD-Loc——迄今为止最大的航拍图像实例分割数据集，包含10万张带有精确实例建筑物标注的图像。这使得训练后的模型能够展现出卓越的零样本泛化能力。其次，我们通过从语义轮廓对齐转变为实例轮廓对齐来重新构建定位范式，从而显著降低了在密集场景中的姿态估计模糊性。大量的实验表明，LoD-Loc v3优于现有的最先进（SOTA）基线方法，在跨场景和密集城市场景中均以大幅优势实现了卓越的性能。该项目可在https://nudt-sawlab.github.io/LoD-Locv3/上获取。
tldr: LoD-Loc v3 introduces a new method for aerial visual localization in dense urban environments using instance silhouette alignment and a large-scale instance segmentation dataset (InsLoD-Loc), achieving superior performance in cross-scene and dense urban scenarios.
tldr_zh: LoD-Loc v3 提出了一种新的城市密集区域的空中视觉定位方法，该方法利用实例轮廓对齐和一个大型实例分割数据集 (InsLoD-Loc)，在跨场景和城市密集场景中实现了卓越的性能。

title: Real-Time Optical Communication Using Event-Based Vision with Moving Transmitters
summary: In multi-robot systems, traditional radio frequency (RF) communication struggles with contention and jamming. Optical communication offers a strong alternative. However, conventional frame-based cameras suffer from limited frame rates, motion blur, and reduced robustness under high dynamic range lighting. Event cameras support microsecond temporal resolution and high dynamic range, making them extremely sensitive to scene changes under fast relative motion with an optical transmitter. Leveraging these strengths, we develop a complete optical communication system capable of tracking moving transmitters and decoding messages in real time. Our system achieves over $95\%$ decoding accuracy for text transmission during motion by implementing a Geometry-Aware Unscented Kalman Filter (GA-UKF), achieving 7x faster processing speed compared to the previous state-of-the-art method, while maintaining equivalent tracking accuracy at transmitting frequencies $\geq$ 1 kHz.
summary_zh: 在多机器人系统中，传统的射频（RF）通信面临着竞争和干扰的问题。光通信提供了一个强大的替代方案。然而，传统的基于帧的相机受到帧率限制、运动模糊以及在高动态范围光照下鲁棒性降低的影响。事件相机支持微秒级的时间分辨率和高动态范围，使其对带有光学发射器的快速相对运动下的场景变化极其敏感。利用这些优势，我们开发了一个完整的光通信系统，能够实时跟踪移动的发射器并解码消息。通过实现几何感知无迹卡尔曼滤波器（GA-UKF），我们的系统在运动过程中实现了超过 $95\%$ 的文本传输解码准确率，相比于之前的最先进方法，处理速度提高了7倍，同时在 $\geq$ 1 kHz的传输频率下保持了相当的跟踪精度。
tldr: This paper presents a real-time optical communication system for multi-robot systems using event cameras and a Geometry-Aware Unscented Kalman Filter (GA-UKF) to track moving optical transmitters and decode messages with high accuracy and speed.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于多机器人系统的实时光学通信系统，该系统使用事件相机和几何感知无迹卡尔曼滤波器 (GA-UKF) 来跟踪移动光学发射器并以高精度和速度解码消息。

title: Exact and Approximate Convex Reformulation of Linear Stochastic Optimal Control with Chance Constraints
summary: In this paper, we present an equivalent convex optimization formulation for discrete-time stochastic linear systems subject to linear chance constraints, alongside a tight convex relaxation for quadratic chance constraints. By lifting the state vector to encode moment information explicitly, the formulation captures linear chance constraints on states and controls across multiple time steps exactly, without conservatism, yielding strict improvements in both feasibility and optimality. For quadratic chance constraints, we derive convex approximations that are provably less conservative than existing methods. We validate the framework on minimum-snap trajectory generation for a quadrotor, demonstrating that the proposed approach remains feasible at noise levels an order of magnitude beyond the operating range of prior formulations.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种离散时间随机线性系统的等价凸优化公式，其中系统受线性机会约束，并为二次机会约束提出一种紧致的凸松弛。通过提升状态向量以显式编码矩信息，该公式能够精确地捕捉跨多个时间步的状态和控制上的线性机会约束，而不会引入保守性，从而在可行性和最优性方面都取得显著提升。对于二次机会约束，我们推导出凸近似，经验证其保守性低于现有方法。我们在四旋翼的最小急动量轨迹生成问题上验证了该框架，实验表明，所提出的方法在噪声水平比先前公式的运行范围高一个数量级的情况下仍能保持可行性。
tldr: This paper presents convex reformulations and relaxations for stochastic linear optimal control with chance constraints, improving feasibility and optimality compared to existing methods, validated on quadrotor trajectory generation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对具有机会约束的随机线性最优控制的凸重构和松弛方法，与现有方法相比提高了可行性和最优性，并在四旋翼飞行器轨迹生成上得到了验证。

title: Design-OS: A Specification-Driven Framework for Engineering System Design with a Control-Systems Design Case
summary: Engineering system design -- whether mechatronic, control, or embedded -- often proceeds in an ad hoc manner, with requirements left implicit and traceability from intent to parameters largely absent. Existing specification-driven and systematic design methods mostly target software, and AI-assisted tools tend to enter the workflow at solution generation rather than at problem framing. Human--AI collaboration in the design of physical systems remains underexplored. This paper presents Design-OS, a lightweight, specification-driven workflow for engineering system design organized in five stages: concept definition, literature survey, conceptual design, requirements definition, and design definition. Specifications serve as the shared contract between human designers and AI agents; each stage produces structured artifacts that maintain traceability and support agent-augmented execution. We position Design-OS relative to requirements-driven design, systematic design frameworks, and AI-assisted design pipelines, and demonstrate it on a control systems design case using two rotary inverted pendulum platforms -- an open-source SimpleFOC reaction wheel and a commercial Quanser Furuta pendulum -- showing how the same specification-driven workflow accommodates fundamentally different implementations. A blank template and the full design-case artifacts are shared in a public repository to support reproducibility and reuse. The workflow makes the design process visible and auditable, and extends specification-driven orchestration of AI from software to physical engineering system design.
summary_zh: 工程系统设计——无论是机电系统、控制系统还是嵌入式系统——通常以一种临时性的方式进行，需求往往是隐式的，从意图到参数的可追溯性也大多缺失。现有的规范驱动和系统化设计方法主要针对软件，而人工智能辅助工具往往在解决方案生成阶段而非问题框架确定阶段进入工作流程。物理系统设计中人与人工智能的协作仍有待探索。本文提出Design-OS，一种轻量级的、规范驱动的工程系统设计工作流程，分为五个阶段：概念定义、文献调研、概念设计、需求定义和设计定义。规范作为人类设计师和人工智能代理之间的共享契约；每个阶段都产生结构化的制品，以保持可追溯性并支持代理增强的执行。我们将Design-OS定位在需求驱动设计、系统化设计框架和人工智能辅助设计流程之间，并在一个控制系统设计案例中对其进行了演示，该案例使用两个旋转倒立摆平台——一个开源的SimpleFOC反作用轮和一个商业化的Quanser Furuta摆——展示了相同的规范驱动工作流程如何适应根本不同的实现方式。一个空白模板和完整的设计案例制品在一个公共存储库中共享，以支持可重复性和重用。该工作流程使设计过程可见和可审计，并将来自软件的人工智能规范驱动编排扩展到物理工程系统设计。
tldr: This paper introduces Design-OS, a specification-driven workflow for engineering system design that integrates human designers and AI agents, demonstrated through a control systems design case using rotary inverted pendulums.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种规范驱动的工程系统设计工作流程 Design-OS，该流程集成了人类设计师和人工智能代理，并通过使用旋转倒立摆的控制系统设计案例进行了演示。

title: On the Ability of Transformers to Verify Plans
summary: Transformers have shown inconsistent success in AI planning tasks, and theoretical understanding of when generalization should be expected has been limited. We take important steps towards addressing this gap by analyzing the ability of decoder-only models to verify whether a given plan correctly solves a given planning instance. To analyse the general setting where the number of objects -- and thus the effective input alphabet -- grows at test time, we introduce C*-RASP, an extension of C-RASP designed to establish length generalization guarantees for transformers under the simultaneous growth in sequence length and vocabulary size. Our results identify a large class of classical planning domains for which transformers can provably learn to verify long plans, and structural properties that significantly affects the learnability of length generalizable solutions. Empirical experiments corroborate our theory.
summary_zh: Transformer模型在人工智能规划任务中表现出不一致的成功，并且关于何时应预期泛化能力的理论理解有限。我们通过分析仅解码器模型验证给定计划是否正确解决给定规划实例的能力，朝着弥补这一差距迈出了重要一步。为了分析对象数量（以及由此产生的有效输入字母表）在测试时增长的一般情况，我们引入了C*-RASP，这是一种C-RASP的扩展，旨在为在序列长度和词汇量同时增长的情况下Transformer模型建立长度泛化保证。我们的结果确定了一大类经典的规划领域，Transformer模型可以被证明能够学习验证长计划，以及显著影响长度可泛化解决方案可学习性的结构属性。经验实验证实了我们的理论。
tldr: The paper investigates the ability of Transformers to verify plans in AI planning, providing theoretical guarantees for length generalization under growing vocabulary size using C*-RASP, and identifying structural properties affecting learnability.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了Transformer在AI规划中验证计划的能力，使用C*-RASP为词汇量增长情况下的长度泛化提供了理论保证，并确定了影响可学习性的结构属性。

title: RAM: Recover Any 3D Human Motion in-the-Wild
summary: RAM incorporates a motion-aware semantic tracker with adaptive Kalman filtering to achieve robust identity association under severe occlusions and dynamic interactions. A memory-augmented Temporal HMR module further enhances human motion reconstruction by injecting spatio-temporal priors for consistent and smooth motion estimation. Moreover, a lightweight Predictor module forecasts future poses to maintain reconstruction continuity, while a gated combiner adaptively fuses reconstructed and predicted features to ensure coherence and robustness. Experiments on in-the-wild multi-person benchmarks such as PoseTrack and 3DPW, demonstrate that RAM substantially outperforms previous state-of-the-art in both Zero-shot tracking stability and 3D accuracy, offering a generalizable paradigm for markerless 3D human motion capture in-the-wild.
summary_zh: RAM融合了运动感知语义追踪器和自适应卡尔曼滤波，以在严重遮挡和动态交互下实现鲁棒的身份关联。一个记忆增强的时序HMR模块通过注入时空先验来增强人体运动重建，从而实现一致且平滑的运动估计。此外，一个轻量级的预测器模块预测未来姿态以保持重建的连续性，而一个门控组合器自适应地融合重建的和预测的特征，以确保连贯性和鲁棒性。在PoseTrack和3DPW等真实场景下的多人基准数据集上的实验表明，RAM在零样本跟踪稳定性和3D精度方面均显著优于先前的最先进方法，为真实场景下无标记3D人体运动捕捉提供了一种可泛化的范例。
tldr: The paper introduces RAM, a novel framework for robust 3D human motion capture in unconstrained environments, achieving superior accuracy and stability through motion-aware tracking, memory-augmented temporal modeling, and predictive pose forecasting.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了RAM，一种用于在不受约束的环境中进行鲁棒的3D人体运动捕捉的新框架，通过运动感知的跟踪、记忆增强的时间建模和预测性的姿势预测，实现了卓越的准确性和稳定性。

title: Learning Hierarchical Orthogonal Prototypes for Generalized Few-Shot 3D Point Cloud Segmentation
summary: Generalized few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation aims to adapt to novel classes from only a few annotations while maintaining strong performance on base classes, but this remains challenging due to the inherent stability-plasticity trade-off: adapting to novel classes can interfere with shared representations and cause base-class forgetting. We present HOP3D, a unified framework that learns hierarchical orthogonal prototypes with an entropy-based few-shot regularizer to enable robust novel-class adaptation without degrading base-class performance. HOP3D introduces hierarchical orthogonalization that decouples base and novel learning at both the gradient and representation levels, effectively mitigating base-novel interference. To further enhance adaptation under sparse supervision, we incorporate an entropy-based regularizer that leverages predictive uncertainty to refine prototype learning and promote balanced predictions. Extensive experiments on ScanNet200 and ScanNet++ demonstrate that HOP3D consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines under both 1-shot and 5-shot settings. The code is available at https://fdueblab-hop3d.github.io/.
summary_zh: 广义少样本3D点云分割旨在仅利用少量标注信息来适应新的类别，同时保持在基础类别上的强大性能，但由于固有的稳定性-可塑性权衡，这仍然具有挑战性：适应新类别可能会干扰共享表示，导致基础类别遗忘。我们提出了HOP3D，一个统一的框架，它学习具有基于熵的少样本正则化器的分层正交原型，以实现鲁棒的新类别适应，而不会降低基础类别性能。HOP3D引入了分层正交化，在梯度和表示层面解耦基础学习和新类别学习，从而有效缓解基础-新类别的干扰。为了在稀疏监督下进一步增强适应性，我们结合了一个基于熵的正则化器，利用预测不确定性来细化原型学习并促进平衡的预测。在ScanNet200和ScanNet++上的大量实验表明，在1-shot和5-shot设置下，HOP3D始终优于最先进的基线方法。代码可在https://fdueblab-hop3d.github.io/获取。
tldr: This paper introduces HOP3D, a novel framework for generalized few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation employing hierarchical orthogonal prototypes and an entropy-based regularizer to mitigate base-class forgetting during adaptation to novel classes. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on ScanNet200 and ScanNet++.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为 HOP3D 的新型框架，用于广义小样本 3D 点云分割。该框架采用分层正交原型和基于熵的正则化器，以减轻适应新类别期间的基类遗忘问题。在 ScanNet200 和 ScanNet++ 数据集上，其性能优于最先进的方法。

title: Uncertainty-aware Prototype Learning with Variational Inference for Few-shot Point Cloud Segmentation
summary: Few-shot 3D semantic segmentation aims to generate accurate semantic masks for query point clouds with only a few annotated support examples. Existing prototype-based methods typically construct compact and deterministic prototypes from the support set to guide query segmentation. However, such rigid representations are unable to capture the intrinsic uncertainty introduced by scarce supervision, which often results in degraded robustness and limited generalization. In this work, we propose UPL (Uncertainty-aware Prototype Learning), a probabilistic approach designed to incorporate uncertainty modeling into prototype learning for few-shot 3D segmentation. Our framework introduces two key components. First, UPL introduces a dual-stream prototype refinement module that enriches prototype representations by jointly leveraging limited information from both support and query samples. Second, we formulate prototype learning as a variational inference problem, regarding class prototypes as latent variables. This probabilistic formulation enables explicit uncertainty modeling, providing robust and interpretable mask predictions. Extensive experiments on the widely used ScanNet and S3DIS benchmarks show that our UPL achieves consistent state-of-the-art performance under different settings while providing reliable uncertainty estimation. The code is available at https://fdueblab-upl.github.io/.
summary_zh: 少样本3D语义分割旨在仅利用少量标注的支持样本为查询点云生成精确的语义掩码。现有的基于原型的方法通常从支持集中构建紧凑且确定性的原型，以指导查询分割。然而，这种刚性的表示无法捕捉稀疏监督带来的内在不确定性，这通常会导致鲁棒性降低和泛化能力受限。在这项工作中，我们提出了UPL（不确定性感知原型学习），这是一种概率方法，旨在将不确定性建模融入到少样本3D分割的原型学习中。我们的框架引入了两个关键组成部分。首先，UPL引入了一个双流原型精化模块，通过联合利用来自支持样本和查询样本的有限信息来丰富原型表示。其次，我们将原型学习公式化为一个变分推断问题，将类别原型视为潜在变量。这种概率公式能够显式地进行不确定性建模，从而提供鲁棒且可解释的掩码预测。在广泛使用的 ScanNet 和 S3DIS 基准上的大量实验表明，我们的 UPL 在不同的设置下都能实现一致的最新性能，同时提供可靠的不确定性估计。 代码可在 https://fdueblab-upl.github.io/ 获取。
tldr: This paper introduces an Uncertainty-aware Prototype Learning (UPL) framework for few-shot 3D semantic segmentation, using variational inference to model uncertainty in learned prototypes, achieving state-of-the-art results on ScanNet and S3DIS.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于少样本3D语义分割的“不确定性感知原型学习”（UPL）框架，该框架使用变分推理来建模学习原型中的不确定性，并在ScanNet和S3DIS上取得了最先进的结果。

title: Dual Prompt-Driven Feature Encoding for Nighttime UAV Tracking
summary: Robust feature encoding constitutes the foundation of UAV tracking by enabling the nuanced perception of target appearance and motion, thereby playing a pivotal role in ensuring reliable tracking. However, existing feature encoding methods often overlook critical illumination and viewpoint cues, which are essential for robust perception under challenging nighttime conditions, leading to degraded tracking performance. To overcome the above limitation, this work proposes a dual prompt-driven feature encoding method that integrates prompt-conditioned feature adaptation and context-aware prompt evolution to promote domain-invariant feature encoding. Specifically, the pyramid illumination prompter is proposed to extract multi-scale frequency-aware illumination prompts. %The dynamic viewpoint prompter adapts the sampling to different viewpoints, enabling the tracker to learn view-invariant features. The dynamic viewpoint prompter modulates deformable convolution offsets to accommodate viewpoint variations, enabling the tracker to learn view-invariant features. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of the proposed dual prompt-driven tracker (DPTracker) in tackling nighttime UAV tracking. Ablation studies highlight the contribution of each component in DPTracker. Real-world tests under diverse nighttime UAV tracking scenarios further demonstrate the robustness and practical utility. The code and demo videos are available at https://github.com/yiheng-wang-duke/DPTracker.
summary_zh: 稳健的特征编码是无人机跟踪的基础，它能够细致地感知目标的外观和运动，从而在确保可靠跟踪方面发挥关键作用。然而，现有的特征编码方法通常忽略了关键的照明和视点线索，而这些线索对于在具有挑战性的夜间条件下实现稳健感知至关重要，从而导致跟踪性能下降。为了克服上述限制，本文提出了一种双提示驱动的特征编码方法，该方法集成了提示条件下的特征自适应和上下文感知的提示演化，以促进领域不变的特征编码。具体而言，我们提出了金字塔照明提示器，用于提取多尺度频率感知的照明提示。动态视点提示器调整采样以适应不同的视点，使跟踪器能够学习视点不变的特征。动态视点提示器调制可变形卷积的偏移量以适应视点变化，使跟踪器能够学习视点不变的特征。大量实验验证了所提出的双提示驱动跟踪器（DPTracker）在解决夜间无人机跟踪问题上的有效性。消融研究突出了DPTracker中每个组件的贡献。在各种夜间无人机跟踪场景下的真实世界测试进一步证明了其稳健性和实用性。 代码和演示视频可在https://github.com/yiheng-wang-duke/DPTracker获取。
tldr: This paper introduces a dual prompt-driven feature encoding method (DPTracker) for robust nighttime UAV tracking, addressing the limitations of existing methods by incorporating illumination and viewpoint cues. It uses pyramid illumination prompter and dynamic viewpoint prompter to extract domain-invariant feature and shows improvements in nighttime UAV tracking performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种双提示驱动的特征编码方法（DPTracker）用于鲁棒的夜间无人机跟踪，通过结合光照和视点线索来解决现有方法的局限性。它使用金字塔光照提示器和动态视点提示器来提取域不变特征，并在夜间无人机跟踪性能方面显示出改进。

title: PFM-VEPAR: Prompting Foundation Models for RGB-Event Camera based Pedestrian Attribute Recognition
summary: Event-based pedestrian attribute recognition (PAR) leverages motion cues to enhance RGB cameras in low-light and motion-blur scenarios, enabling more accurate inference of attributes like age and emotion. However, existing two-stream multimodal fusion methods introduce significant computational overhead and neglect the valuable guidance from contextual samples. To address these limitations, this paper proposes an Event Prompter. Discarding the computationally expensive auxiliary backbone, this module directly applies extremely lightweight and efficient Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) and Inverse DCT (IDCT) operations to the event data. This design extracts frequency-domain event features at a minimal computational cost, thereby effectively augmenting the RGB branch. Furthermore, an external memory bank designed to provide rich prior knowledge, combined with modern Hopfield networks, enables associative memory-augmented representation learning. This mechanism effectively mines and leverages global relational knowledge across different samples. Finally, a cross-attention mechanism fuses the RGB and event modalities, followed by feed-forward networks for attribute prediction. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets fully validate the effectiveness of the proposed RGB-Event PAR framework. The source code of this paper will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenPAR
summary_zh: 基于事件的行人属性识别 (PAR) 利用运动线索增强低光照和运动模糊场景下的RGB相机，从而更准确地推断年龄和情绪等属性。然而，现有的双流多模态融合方法引入了显著的计算开销，并忽略了来自上下文样本的宝贵指导。为了解决这些限制，本文提出了一种事件提示器 (Event Prompter)。该模块摒弃了计算昂贵的辅助骨干网络，直接对事件数据应用极其轻量且高效的离散余弦变换 (DCT) 和逆离散余弦变换 (IDCT) 操作。这种设计以最小的计算成本提取频域事件特征，从而有效地增强了RGB分支。此外，一个旨在提供丰富先验知识的外部记忆库，结合现代霍普菲尔德网络，实现了关联记忆增强的表征学习。这种机制有效地挖掘和利用了不同样本之间的全局关系知识。最后，一个跨注意力机制融合了RGB和事件模态，然后通过前馈网络进行属性预测。在多个基准数据集上进行的大量实验充分验证了所提出的RGB-事件PAR框架的有效性。本文的源代码将在 https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenPAR 上发布。
tldr: The paper introduces PFM-VEPAR, a framework for RGB-Event based pedestrian attribute recognition. It uses an Event Prompter with DCT/IDCT and Hopfield Networks for efficient feature extraction and incorporates an external memory bank to leverage global knowledge, demonstrating improved performance on benchmark datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了PFM-VEPAR，一个基于RGB-Event的行人属性识别框架。它使用带有DCT/IDCT的Event Prompter和Hopfield网络以进行高效的特征提取，并结合外部记忆库以利用全局知识，在基准数据集上展示了改进的性能。

title: Subspace Kernel Learning on Tensor Sequences
summary: Learning from structured multi-way data, represented as higher-order tensors, requires capturing complex interactions across tensor modes while remaining computationally efficient. We introduce Uncertainty-driven Kernel Tensor Learning (UKTL), a novel kernel framework for $M$-mode tensors that compares mode-wise subspaces derived from tensor unfoldings, enabling expressive and robust similarity measure. To handle large-scale tensor data, we propose a scalable Nyström kernel linearization with dynamically learned pivot tensors obtained via soft $k$-means clustering. A key innovation of UKTL is its uncertainty-aware subspace weighting, which adaptively down-weights unreliable mode components based on estimated confidence, improving robustness and interpretability in comparisons between input and pivot tensors. Our framework is fully end-to-end trainable and naturally incorporates both multi-way and multi-mode interactions through structured kernel compositions. Extensive evaluations on action recognition benchmarks (NTU-60, NTU-120, Kinetics-Skeleton) show that UKTL achieves state-of-the-art performance, superior generalization, and meaningful mode-wise insights. This work establishes a principled, scalable, and interpretable kernel learning paradigm for structured multi-way and multi-modal tensor sequences.
summary_zh: 从表示为高阶张量的结构化多路数据中学习，需要在捕捉张量模式之间的复杂交互作用的同时，保持计算效率。我们引入了不确定性驱动的核张量学习(UKTL)，这是一种用于$M$阶张量的新型核框架，它通过比较从张量展开中导出的模式子空间，实现富有表现力且鲁棒的相似性度量。为了处理大规模张量数据，我们提出了一种可扩展的Nyström核线性化方法，该方法利用通过软$k$-均值聚类获得的动态学习的枢轴张量。UKTL的一个关键创新之处在于其不确定性感知子空间加权，该加权基于估计的置信度自适应地降低不可靠模式分量的权重，从而提高输入张量和枢轴张量之间比较的鲁棒性和可解释性。我们的框架是完全端到端可训练的，并且通过结构化的核组合自然地结合了多路和多模式交互。在动作识别基准(NTU-60、NTU-120、Kinetics-Skeleton)上的大量评估表明，UKTL实现了最先进的性能、卓越的泛化能力和有意义的模式洞察。这项工作为结构化的多路和多模态张量序列建立了一种有原则、可扩展和可解释的核学习范式。
tldr: This paper introduces Uncertainty-driven Kernel Tensor Learning (UKTL), a new kernel method for handling multi-way tensor data, achieving state-of-the-art performance on action recognition benchmarks with improved robustness and interpretability.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的处理多路张量数据的核方法，即不确定性驱动的核张量学习 (UKTL)，该方法在动作识别基准测试上取得了最先进的性能，并提高了鲁棒性和可解释性。

title: Beyond the Desk: Barriers and Future Opportunities for AI to Assist Scientists in Embodied Physical Tasks
summary: More scientists are now using AI, but prior studies have examined only how they use it 'at the desk' for computer-based work. However, given that scientific work often happens 'beyond the desk' at lab and field sites, we conducted the first study of how scientific practitioners use AI for embodied physical tasks. We interviewed 12 scientific practitioners doing hands-on lab and fieldwork in domains like nuclear fusion, primate cognition, and biochemistry, and found three barriers to AI adoption in these settings: 1) experimental setups are too high-stakes to risk AI errors, 2) constrained environments make it hard to use AI, and 3) AI cannot match the tacit knowledge of humans. Participants then developed speculative designs for future AI assistants to 1) monitor task status, 2) organize lab-wide knowledge, 3) monitor scientists' health, 4) do field scouting, 5) do hands-on chores. Our findings point toward AI as background infrastructure to support physical work rather than replacing human expertise.
summary_zh: 现在越来越多的科学家开始使用人工智能，但以往的研究仅考察了他们在“办公桌前”如何利用人工智能进行基于计算机的工作。鉴于科学研究也经常发生在实验室和野外的“办公桌之外”，我们首次研究了科学从业者如何在具身物理任务中使用人工智能。我们访谈了12位在核聚变、灵长类动物认知和生物化学等领域从事实际实验室和野外工作的科学从业者，并发现了在这些场景中采用人工智能的三个障碍：1）实验设置的风险太高，无法承受人工智能的错误，2）受限的环境使得人工智能难以应用，以及3）人工智能无法匹敌人类的内隐知识。参与者随后针对未来的人工智能助手设计了推测性的方案，以实现以下功能：1）监控任务状态，2）组织实验室范围内的知识，3）监测科学家的健康状况，4）进行野外侦察，以及5）执行实际的杂务。 我们的研究结果表明，人工智能应作为支持物理工作的后台基础设施，而不是取代人类的专业知识。
tldr: This paper explores the barriers and potential opportunities for AI to assist scientists in embodied physical tasks beyond desk work, identifying key challenges and proposing speculative designs for future AI assistants.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了人工智能在辅助科学家进行实验室和现场物理任务时所面临的障碍和潜在机遇，指出了关键挑战，并为未来的AI助手提出了推测性的设计方案。

title: TRACE: Trajectory Recovery with State Propagation Diffusion for Urban Mobility
summary: High-quality GPS trajectories are essential for location-based web services and smart city applications, including navigation, ride-sharing and delivery. However, due to low sampling rates and limited infrastructure coverage during data collection, real-world trajectories are often sparse and feature unevenly distributed location points. Recovering these trajectories into dense and continuous forms is essential but challenging, given their complex and irregular spatio-temporal patterns. In this paper, we introduce a novel diffusion model for trajectory recovery named TRACE, which reconstruct dense and continuous trajectories from sparse and incomplete inputs. At the core of TRACE, we propose a State Propagation Diffusion Model (SPDM), which integrates a novel memory mechanism, so that during the denoising process, TRACE can retain and leverage intermediate results from previous steps to effectively reconstruct those hard-to-recover trajectory segments. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets show that TRACE outperforms the state-of-the-art, offering $>$26\% accuracy improvement without significant inference overhead. Our work strengthens the foundation for mobile and web-connected location services, advancing the quality and fairness of data-driven urban applications. Code is available at: https://github.com/JinmingWang/TRACE
summary_zh: 高质量的GPS轨迹对于基于位置的web服务和智慧城市应用至关重要，包括导航、共享出行和外卖配送等。然而，由于数据采集期间采样率低和基础设施覆盖范围有限，真实世界的轨迹通常是稀疏的，并具有分布不均匀的位置点。将这些轨迹恢复成密集和连续的形式至关重要但具有挑战性，因为它们具有复杂和不规则的时空模式。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于轨迹恢复的新型扩散模型，名为TRACE，它可以从稀疏和不完整的输入中重建密集和连续的轨迹。TRACE的核心是我们提出了一种状态传播扩散模型（SPDM），该模型集成了一种新颖的记忆机制，以便在去噪过程中，TRACE可以保留和利用先前步骤的中间结果，从而有效地重建那些难以恢复的轨迹片段。在多个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，TRACE优于现有技术，在没有显著推理开销的情况下，提供>26%的准确率提升。我们的工作加强了移动和web连接位置服务的基础，提高了数据驱动的城市应用的质量和公平性。代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/JinmingWang/TRACE
tldr: The paper introduces TRACE, a diffusion model with a novel state propagation mechanism, for recovering dense and continuous trajectories from sparse GPS data, achieving significant accuracy improvements over existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为TRACE的扩散模型，它具有新颖的状态传播机制，可用于从稀疏GPS数据中恢复密集且连续的轨迹，并且比现有方法具有显着的准确性提升。

title: When both Grounding and not Grounding are Bad -- A Partially Grounded Encoding of Planning into SAT (Extended Version)
summary: Classical planning problems are typically defined using lifted first-order representations, which offer compactness and generality. While most planners ground these representations to simplify reasoning, this can cause an exponential blowup in size. Recent approaches instead operate directly on the lifted level to avoid full grounding. We explore a middle ground between fully lifted and fully grounded planning by introducing three SAT encodings that keep actions lifted while partially grounding predicates. Unlike previous SAT encodings, which scale quadratically with plan length, our approach scales linearly, enabling better performance on longer plans. Empirically, our best encoding outperforms the state of the art in length-optimal planning on hard-to-ground domains.
summary_zh: 经典规划问题通常使用提升的一阶表示法定义，这种表示法提供了紧凑性和通用性。虽然大多数规划器会实例化这些表示法以简化推理，但这可能导致规模呈指数级增长。最近的方法直接在提升的层面上操作，以避免完全实例化。我们探索了完全提升和完全实例化规划之间的一个中间地带，通过引入三种SAT编码来保持动作在提升状态，同时部分实例化谓词。与之前随规划长度呈二次方增长的SAT编码不同，我们的方法呈线性增长，从而提高了更长规划的性能。从实验结果来看，我们最好的编码在难以实例化的领域中，在长度最优规划方面优于现有技术。
tldr: This paper introduces SAT encodings for classical planning that partially ground predicates while keeping actions lifted, achieving linear scaling with plan length and outperforming state-of-the-art on hard-to-ground domains.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种用于经典规划的SAT编码方法，该方法部分地对谓词进行接地，同时保持动作提升，实现了与计划长度的线性缩放，并在难以接地的领域中优于最先进的方法。

title: Synergistic Perception and Generative Recomposition: A Multi-Agent Orchestration for Expert-Level Building Inspection
summary: Building facade defect inspection is fundamental to structural health monitoring and sustainable urban maintenance, yet it remains a formidable challenge due to extreme geometric variability, low contrast against complex backgrounds, and the inherent complexity of composite defects (e.g., cracks co-occurring with spalling). Such characteristics lead to severe pixel imbalance and feature ambiguity, which, coupled with the critical scarcity of high-quality pixel-level annotations, hinder the generalization of existing detection and segmentation models. To address gaps, we propose \textit{FacadeFixer}, a unified multi-agent framework that treats defect perception as a collaborative reasoning task rather than isolated recognition. Specifically,\textit{FacadeFixer} orchestrates specialized agents for detection and segmentation to handle multi-type defect interference, working in tandem with a generative agent to enable semantic recomposition. This process decouples intricate defects from noisy backgrounds and realistically synthesizes them onto diverse clean textures, generating high-fidelity augmented data with precise expert-level masks. To support this, we introduce a comprehensive multi-task dataset covering six primary facade categories with pixel-level annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \textit{FacadeFixer} significantly outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines. Specifically, it excels in capturing pixel-level structural anomalies and highlights generative synthesis as a robust solution to data scarcity in infrastructure inspection. Our code and dataset will be made publicly available.
summary_zh: 建筑立面缺陷检测是结构健康监测和可持续城市维护的基础，但由于极端的几何变异性、与复杂背景的低对比度以及复合缺陷（例如，与剥落同时出现的裂缝）的内在复杂性，它仍然是一个巨大的挑战。这些特性导致了严重的像素不平衡和特征模糊，再加上高质量像素级标注的极度稀缺，阻碍了现有检测和分割模型的泛化能力。为了弥补这些差距，我们提出了\textit{FacadeFixer}，一个统一的多智能体框架，它将缺陷感知视为一个协同推理任务，而不是孤立的识别。具体来说，\textit{FacadeFixer}协调专门用于检测和分割的智能体来处理多类型缺陷干扰，同时与生成智能体协同工作以实现语义重构。此过程将复杂的缺陷从嘈杂的背景中解耦，并将它们逼真地合成到不同的干净纹理上，从而生成具有精确专家级掩码的高保真增强数据。为了支持这一点，我们引入了一个全面的多任务数据集，其中涵盖了六个主要的立面类别，并带有像素级标注。大量的实验表明，\textit{FacadeFixer} 显著优于最先进(SOTA)的基线模型。具体来说，它擅长捕获像素级的结构异常，并突出了生成合成作为基础设施检测中数据稀缺问题的稳健解决方案。我们的代码和数据集将公开提供。
tldr: The paper introduces FacadeFixer, a multi-agent framework that uses generative recomposition and collaborative reasoning to address the challenges of building facade defect inspection, achieving state-of-the-art results and addressing data scarcity through high-fidelity augmented data generation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 FacadeFixer，一个多智能体框架，它使用生成重组和协作推理来解决建筑立面缺陷检测的挑战，通过高保真增强数据生成实现了最先进的结果，并解决了数据稀缺问题。

title: ReManNet: A Riemannian Manifold Network for Monocular 3D Lane Detection
summary: Monocular 3D lane detection remains challenging due to depth ambiguity and weak geometric constraints. Mainstream methods rely on depth guidance, BEV projection, and anchor- or curve-based heads with simplified physical assumptions, remapping high-dimensional image features while only weakly encoding road geometry. Lacking an invariant geometric-topological coupling between lanes and the underlying road surface, 2D-to-3D lifting is ill-posed and brittle, often degenerating into concavities, bulges, and twists. To address this, we propose the Road-Manifold Assumption: the road is a smooth 2D manifold in $\mathbb{R}^3$, lanes are embedded 1D submanifolds, and sampled lane points are dense observations, thereby coupling metric and topology across surfaces, curves, and point sets. Building on this, we propose ReManNet, which first produces initial lane predictions with an image backbone and detection heads, then encodes geometry as Riemannian Gaussian descriptors on the symmetric positive-definite (SPD) manifold, and fuses these descriptors with visual features through a lightweight gate to maintain coherent 3D reasoning. We also propose the 3D Tunnel Lane IoU (3D-TLIoU) loss, a joint point-curve objective that computes slice-wise overlap of tubular neighborhoods along each lane to improve shape-level alignment. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that ReManNet achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) or competitive results. On OpenLane, it improves F1 by +8.2% over the baseline and by +1.8% over the previous best, with scenario-level gains of up to +6.6%. The code will be publicly available at https://github.com/changehome717/ReManNet.
summary_zh: 由于深度模糊性和较弱的几何约束，单目3D车道线检测仍然具有挑战性。主流方法依赖于深度引导、BEV投影以及基于锚点或曲线的检测头，并采用简化的物理假设，在仅微弱地编码道路几何结构的同时，重新映射高维图像特征。由于缺乏车道线与底层路面之间不变的几何-拓扑耦合，2D到3D的提升是病态的且脆弱的，经常退化成凹陷、凸起和扭曲。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了道路流形假设：道路是$\mathbb{R}^3$中的一个光滑的2D流形，车道线是嵌入的1D子流形，而采样的车道线点是密集的观测值，从而耦合了表面、曲线和点集之间的度量和拓扑。在此基础上，我们提出了ReManNet，它首先通过图像骨干网络和检测头生成初始车道线预测，然后将几何结构编码为对称正定（SPD）流形上的黎曼高斯描述符，并通过轻量级的门控机制将这些描述符与视觉特征融合，以保持连贯的3D推理。我们还提出了3D隧道车道IoU (3D-TLIoU)损失，这是一个联合的点-曲线目标，用于计算沿每条车道线的管状邻域的逐片重叠，以改善形状级别的对齐。在标准基准上的大量实验表明，ReManNet实现了最先进（SOTA）或具有竞争力的结果。在OpenLane上，它比基线提高了+8.2%的F1分数，比之前的最佳结果提高了+1.8%，场景级别的提升高达+6.6%。代码将在https://github.com/changehome717/ReManNet上公开。
tldr: The paper introduces ReManNet, a novel approach for monocular 3D lane detection that leverages Riemannian geometry and a road-manifold assumption to improve accuracy and robustness, achieving state-of-the-art results on standard benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为 ReManNet 的新型单目 3D 车道线检测方法，该方法利用黎曼几何和道路流形假设来提高准确性和鲁棒性，并在标准基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。

title: GravCal: Single-Image Calibration of IMU Gravity Priors with Per-Sample Confidence
summary:
Gravity estimation is fundamental to visual-inertial perception, augmented reality, and robotics, yet gravity priors from IMUs are often unreliable under linear acceleration, vibration, and transient motion. Existing methods often estimate gravity directly from images or assume reasonably accurate inertial input, leaving the practical problem of correcting a noisy gravity prior from a single image largely unaddressed.
  We present GravCal, a feedforward model for single-image gravity prior calibration. Given one RGB image and a noisy gravity prior, GravCal predicts a corrected gravity direction and a per-sample confidence score. The model combines two complementary predictions, including a residual correction of the input prior and a prior-independent image estimate, and uses a learned gate to fuse them adaptively.
  Extensive experiments show strong gains over raw inertial priors: GravCal reduces mean angular error from 22.02° (IMU prior) to 14.24°, with larger improvements when the prior is severely corrupted. We also introduce a novel dataset of over 148K frames with paired VIO-derived ground-truth gravity and Mahony-filter IMU priors across diverse scenes and arbitrary camera orientations. The learned gate also correlates with prior quality, making it a useful confidence signal for downstream systems.
summary_zh:
重力估计是视觉惯性感知、增强现实和机器人学的基石。然而，来自IMU的重力先验在受到线性加速度、振动和瞬态运动的影响时，往往不可靠。现有方法通常直接从图像中估计重力，或假设惯性输入足够精确，这使得从单张图像校正噪声重力先验这一实际问题在很大程度上未得到解决。

我们提出了GravCal，一个用于单图像重力先验校准的前馈模型。给定一张RGB图像和一个噪声重力先验，GravCal预测一个校正后的重力方向和一个逐样本置信度得分。该模型结合了两类互补的预测结果，包括对输入先验的残差校正和一个与先验无关的图像估计，并使用一个学习到的门控机制来对它们进行自适应融合。

大量的实验表明，相比原始惯性先验，GravCal具有显著优势：它将平均角度误差从22.02°（IMU先验）降低到14.24°，并在先验严重损坏时Improvements更大。我们还引入了一个新的包含超过14.8万帧的数据集，该数据集包含通过视觉惯性里程计（VIO）导出的真实重力以及Mahony滤波器IMU先验，涵盖了各种场景和任意相机姿态。所学习的门控机制也与先验质量相关，使其成为下游系统有用的置信度信号。
tldr: GravCal presents a feedforward model that calibrates noisy IMU gravity priors from a single image, significantly improving gravity estimation accuracy compared to raw IMU data, especially when the prior is corrupted. The paper also provides a new dataset for gravity estimation research.
tldr_zh: GravCal 提出了一种前馈模型，可以从单张图像校准嘈杂的 IMU 重力先验，显著提高了重力估计的准确性，尤其是在先验被破坏的情况下。该论文还提供了一个新的数据集用于重力估计研究。

title: HiFiGaze: Improving Eye Tracking Accuracy Using Screen Content Knowledge
summary: We present a new and accurate approach for gaze estimation on consumer computing devices. We take advantage of continued strides in the quality of user-facing cameras found in e.g., smartphones, laptops, and desktops - 4K or greater in high-end devices - such that it is now possible to capture the 2D reflection of a device's screen in the user's eyes. This alone is insufficient for accurate gaze tracking due to the near-infinite variety of screen content. Crucially, however, the device knows what is being displayed on its own screen - in this work, we show this information allows for robust segmentation of the reflection, the location and size of which encodes the user's screen-relative gaze target. We explore several strategies to leverage this useful signal, quantifying performance in a user study. Our best performing model reduces mean tracking error by ~8% compared to a baseline appearance-based model. A supplemental study reveals an additional 10-20% improvement if the gaze-tracking camera is located at the bottom of the device.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种新型且精确的方法，用于在消费级计算设备上进行视线估计。我们利用了用户端摄像头质量的持续进步，例如在高端设备中，智能手机、笔记本电脑和台式机上的摄像头达到4K或更高，使得现在可以捕捉到用户眼中设备屏幕的2D反射。然而，由于屏幕内容的近乎无限多样性，仅凭这一点不足以实现精确的视线追踪。但至关重要的是，设备知道自身屏幕上显示的内容——在这项工作中，我们表明该信息能够对屏幕反射进行鲁棒的分割，其位置和大小编码了用户相对于屏幕的视线目标。我们探索了几种利用这种有用信号的策略，并在用户研究中量化了性能。与基于外观的基线模型相比，我们性能最佳的模型将平均追踪误差降低了约8%。一项补充研究表明，如果视线追踪摄像头位于设备底部，则可额外提高10-20%的性能。
tldr: This paper presents a novel gaze estimation method that leverages screen content information to improve accuracy by segmenting screen reflections in the user's eyes, resulting in a significant error reduction compared to appearance-based models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的眼动追踪方法，该方法利用屏幕内容信息来提高准确性，通过分割用户眼睛中的屏幕反射来实现，与基于外观的模型相比，实现了显着的误差降低。

title: SeeClear: Reliable Transparent Object Depth Estimation via Generative Opacification
summary: Monocular depth estimation remains challenging for transparent objects, where refraction and transmission are difficult to model and break the appearance assumptions used by depth networks. As a result, state-of-the-art estimators often produce unstable or incorrect depth predictions for transparent materials. We propose SeeClear, a novel framework that converts transparent objects into generative opaque images, enabling stable monocular depth estimation for transparent objects. Given an input image, we first localize transparent regions and transform their refractive appearance into geometrically consistent opaque shapes using a diffusion-based generative opacification module. The processed image is then fed into an off-the-shelf monocular depth estimator without retraining or architectural changes. To train the opacification model, we construct SeeClear-396k, a synthetic dataset containing 396k paired transparent-opaque renderings. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets show that SeeClear significantly improves depth estimation for transparent objects. Project page: https://heyumeng.com/SeeClear-web/
summary_zh: 单目深度估计对于透明物体而言仍然具有挑战性，因为折射和透射难以建模，并且破坏了深度网络所使用的外观假设。因此，最先进的估计器常常会对透明材料产生不稳定或不正确的深度预测。我们提出了一种新颖的框架SeeClear，它将透明物体转化为生成的不透明图像，从而实现对透明物体的稳定单目深度估计。给定一张输入图像，我们首先定位透明区域，并使用基于扩散的生成式不透明化模块将其折射外观转换为几何上一致的不透明形状。然后，将处理后的图像输入到现成的单目深度估计器中，而无需进行重新训练或架构更改。为了训练不透明化模型，我们构建了SeeClear-396k，一个包含39.6万对配对的透明-不透明渲染图的合成数据集。在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上的实验表明，SeeClear显著提高了透明物体的深度估计性能。项目主页：https://heyumeng.com/SeeClear-web/
tldr: The paper proposes SeeClear, a framework that uses a diffusion-based generative model to convert transparent objects into opaque images, thus improving monocular depth estimation without retraining existing depth estimators.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了SeeClear，一个使用基于扩散的生成模型将透明物体转换为不透明图像的框架，从而在不重新训练现有深度估计器的情况下，提高了单目深度估计的准确性。

title: SurfaceXR: Fusing Smartwatch IMUs and Egocentric Hand Pose for Seamless Surface Interactions
summary: Mid-air gestures in Extended Reality (XR) often cause fatigue and imprecision. Surface-based interactions offer improved accuracy and comfort, but current egocentric vision methods struggle due to hand tracking challenges and unreliable surface plane estimation. We introduce SurfaceXR, a sensor fusion approach combining headset-based hand tracking with smartwatch IMU data to enable robust inputs on everyday surfaces. Our insight is that these modalities are complementary: hand tracking provides 3D positional data while IMUs capture high-frequency motion. A 21-participant study validates SurfaceXR's effectiveness for touch tracking and 8-class gesture recognition, demonstrating significant improvements over single-modality approaches.
summary_zh: 扩展现实(XR)中的空中手势操作通常会导致疲劳和精度不足。基于表面的交互能提高精度和舒适度，但目前以自我为中心的视觉方法因手部追踪挑战和不可靠的表面平面估计而难以应用。我们引入SurfaceXR，一种传感器融合方法，结合了头显手部追踪和智能手表IMU数据，以在日常表面上实现稳健的输入。我们的核心思想是这两种模态具有互补性：手部追踪提供3D位置数据，而IMU捕捉高频运动。一项包含21名参与者的研究验证了SurfaceXR在触摸追踪和8类手势识别方面的有效性，结果表明它比单一模态方法有显著改进。
tldr: SurfaceXR combines smartwatch IMU data with headset-based hand tracking for accurate and comfortable surface-based XR interactions, showing improvements in touch tracking and gesture recognition. It addresses the limitations of egocentric vision-based methods.
tldr_zh: SurfaceXR结合智能手表IMU数据和头显手部追踪，实现了准确舒适的基于表面的XR交互，并在触摸追踪和手势识别方面有所提升。它解决了以自我为中心的视觉方法的局限性。

title: Infinite-dimensional spherical-radial decomposition for probabilistic functions, with application to constrained optimal control and Gaussian process regression
summary: The spherical-radial decomposition (SRD) is an efficient method for estimating probabilistic functions and their gradients defined over finite-dimensional elliptical distributions. In this work, we generalize the SRD to infinite stochastic dimensions by combining subspace SRD with standard Monte Carlo methods. The resulting method, which we call hybrid infinite-dimensional SRD (hiSRD) provides an unbiased, low-variance estimator for convex sets arising, for instance, in chance-constrained optimization. We provide a theoretical analysis of the variance of finite-dimensional SRD as the dimension increases, and show that the proposed hybrid method eliminates truncation-induced bias, reduces variance, and allows the computation of derivatives of probabilistic functions. We present comprehensive numerical studies for a risk-neutral stochastic PDE optimal control problem with joint chance state constraints, and for optimizing kernel parameters in Gaussian process regression under the constraint that the posterior process satisfies joint chance constraints.
summary_zh: 球面径向分解(SRD)是一种有效的方法，用于估计定义在有限维椭圆分布上的概率函数及其梯度。在本工作中，我们通过将子空间SRD与标准蒙特卡洛方法相结合，将SRD推广到无限随机维度。由此产生的方法，我们称之为混合无限维SRD (hiSRD)，为凸集提供了一种无偏、低方差的估计器，这些凸集例如出现在机会约束优化中。我们提供了有限维SRD方差随维度增加的理论分析，并表明所提出的混合方法消除了截断引起的偏差，降低了方差，并且允许计算概率函数的导数。我们针对具有联合机会状态约束的风险中性随机PDE最优控制问题，以及在高斯过程回归中优化核参数（约束为后验过程满足联合机会约束）进行了全面的数值研究。
tldr: This paper generalizes spherical-radial decomposition to infinite stochastic dimensions for probabilistic function estimation, offering improvements for problems with chance constraints, such as stochastic PDE optimal control and Gaussian process regression.
tldr_zh: 本文将球形径向分解推广到无限随机维度，用于概率函数估计，为具有机会约束的问题（如随机PDE最优控制和高斯过程回归）提供了改进。

title: Verifiable Error Bounds for Physics-Informed Neural Network Solutions of Lyapunov and Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman Equations
summary: Many core problems in nonlinear systems analysis and control can be recast as solving partial differential equations (PDEs) such as Lyapunov and Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equations. Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a promising mesh-free approach for approximating their solutions, but in most existing works there is no rigorous guarantee that a small PDE residual implies a small solution error. This paper develops verifiable error bounds for approximate solutions of Lyapunov and HJB equations, with particular emphasis on PINN-based approximations. For both the Lyapunov and HJB PDEs, we show that a verifiable residual bound yields relative error bounds with respect to the true solutions as well as computable a posteriori estimates in terms of the approximate solutions. For the HJB equation, this also yields certified upper and lower bounds on the optimal value function on compact sublevel sets and quantifies the optimality gap of the induced feedback policy. We further show that one-sided residual bounds already imply that the approximation itself defines a valid Lyapunov or control Lyapunov function. We illustrate the results with numerical examples.
summary_zh: 非线性系统分析和控制中的许多核心问题都可以转化为求解偏微分方程（PDEs），例如Lyapunov方程和Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman（HJB）方程。物理信息神经网络（PINNs）已经成为一种有前途的无网格方法来逼近这些方程的解，但多数现有工作中并没有严格的保证，即小的PDE残差意味着小的解误差。本文为Lyapunov方程和HJB方程的近似解开发了可验证的误差界限，特别强调基于PINN的近似。对于Lyapunov和HJB PDEs，我们证明了可验证的残差界限能够得出相对于真实解的相对误差界限，以及基于近似解的可计算的后验估计。对于HJB方程，这也能得出紧子水平集上最优值函数的认证上下界，并量化了诱导反馈策略的最优性差距。我们进一步表明，单侧残差界限已经暗示了近似本身定义了一个有效的Lyapunov函数或控制Lyapunov函数。我们用数值例子说明了结果。
tldr: This paper presents verifiable error bounds for Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) solutions to Lyapunov and Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equations, providing a rigorous framework to guarantee solution accuracy and quantify optimality gaps.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Lyapunov和Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB)方程的基于物理信息神经网络(PINN)解的可验证误差界限，提供了一个严格的框架来保证解的准确性并量化最优性差距。

title: Bridging Conformal Prediction and Scenario Optimization: Discarded Constraints and Modular Risk Allocation
summary: Scenario optimization and conformal prediction share a common goal, that is, turning finite samples into safety margins. Yet, different terminology often obscures the connection between their respective guarantees. This paper revisits that connection directly from a systems-and-control viewpoint. Building on the recent conformal/scenario bridge of \citet{OSullivanRomaoMargellos2026}, we extend the forward direction to feasible sample-and-discard scenario algorithms. Specifically, if the final decision is determined by a stable subset of the retained sampled constraints, the classical mean violation law admits a direct exchangeability-based derivation. In this view, discarded samples naturally appear as admissible exceptions. We also introduce a simple modular composition rule that combines several blockwise calibration certificates into a single joint guarantee. This rule proves particularly useful in multi-output prediction and finite-horizon control, where engineers must distribute risk across coordinates, constraints, or prediction steps. Finally, we provide numerical illustrations using a calibrated multi-step tube around an identified predictor. These examples compare alternative stage-wise risk allocations and highlight the resulting performance and safety trade-offs in a standard constraint-tightening problem.
summary_zh: 情景优化和共形预测拥有一个共同的目标，即将有限样本转化为安全裕度。然而，不同的术语常常掩盖了它们各自保证之间的联系。本文从系统与控制的角度直接地重新审视这种联系。在\citet{OSullivanRomaoMargellos2026}最近提出的共形/情景桥梁的基础上，我们扩展了正向推导至可行的样本丢弃情景算法。具体而言，如果最终决策由保留样本约束的稳定子集决定，则经典的平均违约定律可以得到一个基于可交换性的直接推导。在这种视角下，丢弃的样本自然地表现为可接受的例外。我们还引入了一个简单的模块化组合规则，可以将多个分块校准证书组合成一个单一的联合保证。该规则在多输出预测和有限时域控制中尤其有用，在这些场景中，工程师必须在坐标、约束或预测步骤之间分配风险。最后，我们提供数值示例，使用围绕已识别预测器的校准多步管道。这些示例比较了不同的阶段性风险分配，并突出了标准约束收紧问题中由此产生的性能和安全权衡。
tldr: This paper bridges conformal prediction and scenario optimization, offering a systems-and-control perspective with extensions for feasible sample-and-discard algorithms and modular risk allocation, demonstrating applications in multi-output prediction and finite-horizon control.
tldr_zh: 该论文桥接了适形预测和场景优化，提供了系统与控制的视角，扩展了可行的样本丢弃算法和模块化风险分配，并在多输出预测和有限范围控制中展示了应用。

title: A Unified Platform and Quality Assurance Framework for 3D Ultrasound Reconstruction with Robotic, Optical, and Electromagnetic Tracking
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) Ultrasound (US) can facilitate diagnosis, treatment planning, and image-guided therapy. However, current studies rarely provide a comprehensive evaluation of volumetric accuracy and reproducibility, highlighting the need for robust Quality Assurance (QA) frameworks, particularly for tracked 3D US reconstruction using freehand or robotic acquisition. This study presents a QA framework for 3D US reconstruction and a flexible open source platform for tracked US research. A custom phantom containing geometric inclusions with varying symmetry properties enables straightforward evaluation of optical, electromagnetic, and robotic kinematic tracking for 3D US at different scanning speeds and insonation angles. A standardised pipeline performs real-time segmentation and 3D reconstruction of geometric targets (DSC = 0.97, FPS = 46) without GPU acceleration, followed by automated registration and comparison with ground-truth geometries. Applying this framework showed that our robotic 3D US achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance (DSC-3D = 0.94 +- 0.01, HD95 = 1.17 +- 0.12), approaching the spatial resolution limit imposed by the transducer. This work establishes a flexible experimental platform and a reproducible validation methodology for 3D US reconstruction. The proposed framework enables robust cross-platform comparisons and improved reporting practices, supporting the safe and effective clinical translation of 3D ultrasound in diagnostic and image-guided therapy applications.
summary_zh: 三维(3D)超声(US)能够促进诊断、治疗计划和图像引导治疗。然而，当前的研究很少对体积精度和可重复性进行全面评估，突显了对稳健的质量保证(QA)框架的需求，特别是对于使用徒手或机器人采集进行跟踪式3D超声重建。本研究提出了一种用于3D超声重建的质量保证框架以及一个灵活的开放源代码平台，用于跟踪式超声研究。一个包含具有不同对称性几何形状的定制体模，能够直接评估光學、电磁和机器人运动学跟踪，用于不同扫描速度和声束入射角下的3D超声。一个标准化的流程执行几何目标的实时分割和3D重建（DSC = 0.97, FPS = 46），无需GPU加速，然后进行自动配准并与真实几何形状进行比较。应用该框架表明，我们的机器人3D超声达到了最先进的重建性能（DSC-3D = 0.94 +- 0.01, HD95 = 1.17 +- 0.12），接近于换能器所施加的空间分辨率极限。这项工作建立了一个灵活的实验平台和一个可重复的验证方法，用于3D超声重建。所提出的框架能够实现稳健的跨平台比较和改进的报告实践，支持3D超声在诊断和图像引导治疗应用中的安全有效的临床转化。
tldr: This paper introduces a quality assurance framework and open-source platform for 3D ultrasound reconstruction using robotic, optical, and electromagnetic tracking, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance with a custom phantom and standardized pipeline.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于3D超声重建的质量保证框架和开源平台，该框架使用机器人、光学和电磁跟踪，并通过自定义幻影和标准化流程展示了最先进的性能。

title: Radar-Inertial Odometry with Online Spatio-Temporal Calibration via Continuous-Time IMU Modeling
summary: Radar-Inertial Odometry (RIO) has emerged as a robust alternative to vision- and LiDAR-based odometry in challenging conditions such as low light, fog, featureless environments, or in adverse weather. However, many existing RIO approaches assume known radar-IMU extrinsic calibration or rely on sufficient motion excitation for online extrinsic estimation, while temporal misalignment between sensors is often neglected or treated independently. In this work, we present a RIO framework that performs joint online spatial and temporal calibration within a factor-graph optimization formulation, based on continuous-time modeling of inertial measurements using uniform cubic B-splines. The proposed continuous-time representation of acceleration and angular velocity accurately captures the asynchronous nature of radar-IMU measurements, enabling reliable convergence of both the temporal offset and extrinsic calibration parameters, without relying on scan matching, target tracking, or environment-specific assumptions.
summary_zh: 雷达-惯性里程计（RIO）已成为在诸如低光照、雾霾、无特征环境或恶劣天气等挑战性条件下，一种稳健的、替代视觉和激光雷达里程计的方案。然而，许多现有的RIO方法假定已知雷达-惯性测量单元（IMU）的外参标定，或依赖于充分的运动激励来进行在线外参估计，同时传感器之间的时间未对准经常被忽略或独立处理。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种RIO框架，该框架基于使用均匀三次B样条曲线的惯性测量的连续时间建模，在因子图优化公式中执行联合在线空间和时间标定。所提出的加速度和角速度的连续时间表示精确地捕获了雷达-IMU测量值的异步特性，从而实现了时间偏移和外参标定参数的可靠收敛，而无需依赖于扫描匹配、目标跟踪或特定于环境的假设。
tldr: This paper presents a Radar-Inertial Odometry (RIO) framework with online spatio-temporal calibration, addressing the issue of unknown radar-IMU extrinsic calibration and temporal misalignment using continuous-time IMU modeling.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种雷达惯性里程计（RIO）框架，具有在线时空校准功能，通过连续时间IMU建模解决了雷达-IMU外部校准未知以及时间不对齐的问题。

title: Sense4HRI: A ROS 2 HRI Framework for Physiological Sensor Integration and Synchronized Logging
summary: Physiological signals are increasingly relevant to estimate the mental states of users in human-robot interaction (HRI), yet ROS 2-based HRI frameworks still lack reusable support to integrate such data streams in a standardized way. Therefore, we propose Sense4HRI, an adapted framework for human-robot interaction in ROS 2 that integrates physiological measurements and derived user-state indicators. The framework is designed to be extensible, allowing the integration of additional physiological sensors, their interpretation, and multimodal fusion to provide a robust assessment of the mental states of users. In addition, it introduces reusable interfaces for timestamped physiological time-series data and supports synchronized logging of physiological signals together with experiment context, enabling interoperable and traceable multimodal analysis within ROS 2-based HRI systems.
summary_zh: 生理信号在人机交互(HRI)中越来越重要，可用于估计用户心理状态，但基于ROS 2的HRI框架仍然缺乏可重用的支持，以标准化方式集成此类数据流。因此，我们提出了Sense4HRI，一个为ROS 2中人机交互改进的框架，它集成了生理测量和衍生的用户状态指标。该框架被设计为可扩展的，允许集成额外的生理传感器、对其的解释以及多模态融合，从而提供对用户心理状态的稳健评估。此外，它还引入了用于带时间戳的生理时间序列数据的可重用接口，并支持生理信号与实验上下文的同步日志记录，从而实现基于ROS 2的HRI系统中可互操作且可追溯的多模态分析。
tldr: The paper presents Sense4HRI, a ROS 2 framework for integrating and logging physiological sensor data to estimate user mental states in HRI, aiming to improve reusability and interoperability.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了Sense4HRI，一个基于ROS 2的框架，用于集成和记录生理传感器数据，以估计人机交互中的用户心理状态，旨在提高可重用性和互操作性。

title: DeepStock: Reinforcement Learning with Policy Regularizations for Inventory Management
summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) provides a general-purpose methodology for training inventory policies that can leverage big data and compute. However, off-the-shelf implementations of DRL have seen mixed success, often plagued by high sensitivity to the hyperparameters used during training. In this paper, we show that by imposing policy regularizations, grounded in classical inventory concepts such as "Base Stock", we can significantly accelerate hyperparameter tuning and improve the final performance of several DRL methods. We report details from a 100% deployment of DRL with policy regularizations on Alibaba's e-commerce platform, Tmall. We also include extensive synthetic experiments, which show that policy regularizations reshape the narrative on what is the best DRL method for inventory management.
summary_zh: 深度强化学习（DRL）提供了一种通用的方法，用于训练能够利用大数据和计算能力的库存策略。 然而，现成的 DRL 实现效果参差不齐，通常受到训练期间使用的超参数的高度敏感性困扰。 在本文中，我们表明，通过施加基于经典库存概念（如“基准库存”）的策略正则化，我们可以显著加速超参数调整，并提高几种 DRL 方法的最终性能。 我们报告了在阿里巴巴电商平台天猫上， 100% 部署具有策略正则化的 DRL 的详细信息。 我们还包含大量的合成实验，这些实验表明，策略正则化重塑了关于哪种 DRL 方法最适合库存管理的观点。
tldr: The paper introduces policy regularizations, grounded in classical inventory concepts, to improve the performance and hyperparameter tuning of DRL methods for inventory management, with successful deployment on Alibaba's Tmall.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于经典库存概念的策略正则化方法，以提高DRL方法在库存管理中的性能和超参数调整，并在阿里巴巴天猫平台上成功部署。

title: TinyML Enhances CubeSat Mission Capabilities
summary: Earth observation (EO) missions traditionally rely on transmitting raw or minimally processed imagery from satellites to ground stations for computationally intensive analysis. This paradigm is infeasible for CubeSat systems due to stringent constraints on the onboard embedded processors, energy availability, and communication bandwidth. To overcome these limitations, the paper presents a TinyML-based Convolutional Neural Networks (ConvNets) model optimization and deployment pipeline for onboard image classification, enabling accurate, energy-efficient, and hardware-aware inference under CubeSat-class constraints. Our pipeline integrates structured iterative pruning, post-training INT8 quantization, and hardware-aware operator mapping to compress models and align them with the heterogeneous compute architecture of the STM32N6 microcontroller from STMicroelectronics. This Microcontroller Unit (MCU) integrates a novel Arm Cortex-M55 core and a Neural-ART Neural Processing Unit (NPU), providing a realistic proxy for CubeSat onboard computers. The paper evaluates the proposed approach on three EO benchmark datasets (i.e., EuroSAT, RS_C11, MEDIC) and four models (i.e., SqueezeNet, MobileNetV3, EfficientNet, MCUNetV1). We demonstrate an average reduction in RAM usage of 89.55% and Flash memory of 70.09% for the optimized models, significantly decreasing downlink bandwidth requirements while maintaining task-acceptable accuracy (with a drop ranging from 0.4 to 8.6 percentage points compared to the Float32 baseline). The energy consumption per inference ranges from 0.68 mJ to 6.45 mJ, with latency spanning from 3.22 ms to 30.38 ms. These results fully satisfy the stringent energy budgets and real-time constraints required for efficient onboard EO processing.
summary_zh: 地球观测(EO)任务传统上依赖于将来自卫星的原始或最小处理过的图像传输到地面站，以进行计算密集型分析。由于对星载嵌入式处理器、能源可用性和通信带宽的严格限制，这种范例对于立方体卫星系统是不可行的。为了克服这些限制，本文提出了一种基于TinyML的卷积神经网络(ConvNets)模型优化和部署流程，用于星载图像分类，从而能够在立方体卫星级别的约束下实现准确、节能且具备硬件感知能力的推理。我们的流程集成了结构化迭代剪枝、训练后 INT8 量化和硬件感知算子映射，以压缩模型并使其与意法半导体(STMicroelectronics)的 STM32N6 微控制器的异构计算架构对齐。该微控制单元(MCU)集成了新型 Arm Cortex-M55 内核和 Neural-ART 神经网络处理单元(NPU)，为立方体卫星星载计算机提供了现实的代理。本文在三个 EO 基准数据集（即 EuroSAT、RS_C11、MEDIC）和四个模型（即 SqueezeNet、MobileNetV3、EfficientNet、MCUNetV1）上评估了所提出的方法。我们证明了优化后的模型的 RAM 使用量平均减少了 89.55%，Flash 存储器平均减少了 70.09%，从而显著降低了下行链路带宽需求，同时保持了任务可接受的精度（与 Float32 基线相比，下降幅度在 0.4 到 8.6 个百分点之间）。每次推理的能耗范围为 0.68 mJ 到 6.45 mJ，延迟时间为 3.22 ms 到 30.38 ms。这些结果完全满足高效星载 EO 处理所需的严格的能源预算和实时约束。
tldr: This paper presents a TinyML pipeline for onboard image classification on CubeSats, optimizing CNN models for energy efficiency and reducing bandwidth requirements by using structured pruning, quantization, and hardware-aware mapping, demonstrating significant memory and energy reduction on relevant datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于CubeSat星上图像分类的TinyML流程，通过结构化剪枝、量化和硬件感知映射来优化CNN模型，提高能源效率并降低带宽需求，并在相关数据集上展示了显著的内存和能源消耗降低。

title: Template-based Object Detection Using a Foundation Model
summary: Most currently used object detection methods are learning-based, and can detect objects under varying appearances. Those models require training and a training dataset. We focus on use cases with less data variation, but the requirement of being free of generation of training data and training. Such a setup is for example desired in automatic testing of graphical interfaces during software development, especially for continuous integration testing. In our approach, we use segments from segmentation foundation models and combine them with a simple feature-based classification method. This saves time and cost when changing the object to be searched or its design, as nothing has to be retrained and no dataset has to be created. We evaluate our method on the task of detecting and classifying icons in navigation maps, which is used to simplify and automate the testing of user interfaces in automotive industry. Our methods achieve results almost on par with learning-based object detection methods like YOLO, without the need for training.
summary_zh: 目前大多数目标检测方法都是基于学习的，可以检测不同外观下的目标。这些模型需要训练和训练数据集。我们关注数据变异较少，且无需生成训练数据和训练的使用场景。例如，在软件开发过程中图形界面的自动测试中，尤其是在持续集成测试中，需要这样的设置。在我们的方法中，我们使用来自分割基础模型的片段，并将其与简单的基于特征的分类方法相结合。当更改要搜索的对象或其设计时，这节省了时间和成本，因为无需重新训练，也无需创建数据集。我们在导航地图中检测和分类图标的任务上评估了我们的方法，这用于简化和自动化汽车行业中用户界面的测试。我们的方法实现了与基于学习的目标检测方法（如YOLO）几乎相当的结果，而无需训练。
tldr: This paper presents a template-based object detection method using segmentation foundation models and feature-based classification, which avoids training and data generation, achieving comparable results to YOLO in UI testing.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于分割基础模型和特征分类的模板对象检测方法，无需训练和数据生成，在用户界面测试中取得了与YOLO相当的效果。

title: Recognising BSL Fingerspelling in Continuous Signing Sequences
summary: Fingerspelling is a critical component of British Sign Language (BSL), used to spell proper names, technical terms, and words that lack established lexical signs. Fingerspelling recognition is challenging due to the rapid pace of signing and common letter omissions by native signers, while existing BSL fingerspelling datasets are either small in scale or temporally and letter-wise inaccurate. In this work, we introduce a new large-scale BSL fingerspelling dataset, FS23K, constructed using an iterative annotation framework. In addition, we propose a fingerspelling recognition model that explicitly accounts for bi-manual interactions and mouthing cues. As a result, with refined annotations, our approach halves the character error rate (CER) compared to the prior state of the art on fingerspelling recognition. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of our method and highlight its potential to support future research in sign language understanding and scalable, automated annotation pipelines. The project page can be found at https://taeinkwon.com/projects/fs23k/.
