summary_zh: 指拼是英国手语(BSL)的关键组成部分，用于拼写专有名词、技术术语以及缺乏既定词汇符号的单词。由于手语的快速节奏以及母语手语者常见的字母省略，指拼识别具有挑战性。同时，现有的BSL指拼数据集规模较小，或在时间上和字母层面上不够准确。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个新的大规模BSL指拼数据集FS23K，该数据集是使用迭代式标注框架构建的。此外，我们提出了一种指拼识别模型，该模型显式地考虑了双手互动和口型线索。结果表明，通过精细化的标注，与以往最先进的指拼识别方法相比，我们的方法将字错误率(CER)降低了一半。这些发现证明了我们方法的有效性，并强调了其在支持手语理解和可扩展的自动化标注流程方面的潜力。项目主页地址为https://taeinkwon.com/projects/fs23k/。
tldr: This paper introduces a new large-scale BSL fingerspelling dataset (FS23K) and a novel fingerspelling recognition model that leverages bi-manual interactions and mouthing cues, achieving state-of-the-art results.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个新的大规模BSL手指拼写数据集(FS23K)，并提出了一个新的手指拼写识别模型，该模型利用双手互动和口型线索，实现了最先进的结果。

title: Mixed Integer vs. Continuous Model Predictive Controllers for Binary Thruster Control: A Comparative Study
summary: Binary on/off thrusters are commonly used for spacecraft attitude and position control during proximity operations. However, their discrete nature poses challenges for conventional continuous control methods. The control of these discrete actuators is either explicitly formulated as a mixed-integer optimization problem or handled in a two-layer approach, where a continuous controller's output is converted to binary commands using analog-to digital modulation techniques such as Delta-Sigma-modulation. This paper provides the first systematic comparison between these two paradigms for binary thruster control, contrasting continuous Model Predictive Control (MPC) with Delta-Sigma modulation against direct Mixed-Integer MPC (MIMPC) approaches. Furthermore, we propose a new variant of MPC for binary actuated systems, which is informed using the state of the Delta-Sigma Modulator. The two variations for the continuous MPC along with the MIMPC are evaluated through extensive simulations using ESA's REACSA platform. Results demonstrate that while all approaches perform similarly in high-thrust regimes, MIMPC achieves superior fuel efficiency in low-thrust conditions. Continuous MPC with modulation shows instabilities at higher thrust levels, while binary informed MPC, which incorporates modulator dynamics, improves robustness and reduces the efficiency gap to the MIMPC. It can be seen from the simulated and real-system experiments that MIMPC offers complete stability and fuel efficiency benefits, particularly for resource-constrained missions, while continuous control methods remain attractive for computationally limited applications.
summary_zh: 二元开关推进器常用于近距离操作期间的航天器姿态和位置控制。然而，其离散特性对传统的连续控制方法提出了挑战。这些离散执行器的控制要么被显式地公式化为一个混合整数优化问题，要么采用双层方法处理，其中连续控制器的输出使用诸如Delta-Sigma调制等模数调制技术转换为二元指令。本文对这两种二元推进器控制范例进行了首次系统性比较，将带有Delta-Sigma调制的连续模型预测控制(MPC)与直接混合整数MPC (MIMPC)方法进行了对比。此外，我们提出了一种新的针对二元驱动系统MPC的变体，该变体利用Delta-Sigma调制器的状态进行信息更新。连续MPC的两种变体以及MIMPC都通过欧洲航天局(ESA)的REACSA平台进行了广泛的仿真评估。结果表明，虽然所有方法在高推力状态下表现相似，但MIMPC在低推力条件下实现了卓越的燃料效率。带有调制的连续MPC在较高推力水平下表现出不稳定性，而结合调制器动态的二元信息MPC提高了鲁棒性并缩小了与MIMPC的效率差距。从仿真和真实系统实验可以看出，MIMPC提供了完全的稳定性和燃料效率优势，特别是对于资源受限的任务，而连续控制方法对于计算能力有限的应用仍然具有吸引力。
tldr: This paper compares mixed-integer MPC (MIMPC) and continuous MPC with Delta-Sigma modulation for controlling binary thrusters in spacecraft, showing MIMPC's superior fuel efficiency in low-thrust regimes and stability benefits.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了混合整数MPC (MIMPC) 和带有 Delta-Sigma 调制的连续 MPC 在控制航天器二进制推进器方面的性能，结果表明 MIMPC 在低推力状态下具有更高的燃油效率和更好的稳定性。

title: Towards Practical World Model-based Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show strong generalization for robotic control, but finetuning them with reinforcement learning (RL) is constrained by the high cost and safety risks of real-world interaction. Training VLA models in interactive world models avoids these issues but introduces several challenges, including pixel-level world modeling, multi-view consistency, and compounding errors under sparse rewards. Building on recent advances across large multimodal models and model-based RL, we propose VLA-MBPO, a practical framework to tackle these problems in VLA finetuning. Our approach has three key design choices: (i) adapting unified multimodal models (UMMs) for data-efficient world modeling; (ii) an interleaved view decoding mechanism to enforce multi-view consistency; and (iii) chunk-level branched rollout to mitigate error compounding. Theoretical analysis and experiments across simulation and real-world tasks demonstrate that VLA-MBPO significantly improves policy performance and sample efficiency, underscoring its robustness and scalability for real-world robotic deployment.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人控制方面展现出强大的泛化能力，但使用强化学习（RL）对其进行微调受到现实世界交互的高成本和安全风险的限制。在交互式世界模型中训练VLA模型可以避免这些问题，但引入了几个挑战，包括像素级世界建模、多视角一致性和稀疏奖励下的误差累积。在大型多模态模型和基于模型的强化学习的最新进展基础上，我们提出了 VLA-MBPO，这是一个解决 VLA 微调中这些问题的实用框架。我们的方法有三个关键设计选择：（i）调整统一多模态模型（UMMs）以实现数据高效的世界建模；（ii）一种交错视角解码机制，以强制执行多视角一致性；以及（iii）分块分支式展开，以减轻误差累积。理论分析以及在模拟和真实世界任务中的实验表明，VLA-MBPO 显著提高了策略性能和样本效率，突显了其在现实世界机器人部署中的鲁棒性和可扩展性。
tldr: The paper introduces VLA-MBPO, a framework for finetuning Vision-Language-Action models in interactive world models to improve policy performance and sample efficiency for robotic control, addressing challenges like pixel-level world modeling and error compounding.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了VLA-MBPO，一个用于在交互式世界模型中微调视觉-语言-动作模型的框架，旨在提高机器人控制的策略性能和样本效率，并解决了像素级世界建模和误差累积等挑战。

title: Memory Over Maps: 3D Object Localization Without Reconstruction
summary: Target localization is a prerequisite for embodied tasks such as navigation and manipulation. Conventional approaches rely on constructing explicit 3D scene representations to enable target localization, such as point clouds, voxel grids, or scene graphs. While effective, these pipelines incur substantial mapping time, storage overhead, and scalability limitations. Recent advances in vision-language models suggest that rich semantic reasoning can be performed directly on 2D observations, raising a fundamental question: is a complete 3D scene reconstruction necessary for object localization? In this work, we revisit object localization and propose a map-free pipeline that stores only posed RGB-D keyframes as a lightweight visual memory--without constructing any global 3D representation of the scene. At query time, our method retrieves candidate views, re-ranks them with a vision-language model, and constructs a sparse, on-demand 3D estimate of the queried target through depth backprojection and multi-view fusion. Compared to reconstruction-based pipelines, this design drastically reduces preprocessing cost, enabling scene indexing that is over two orders of magnitude faster to build while using substantially less storage. We further validate the localized targets on downstream object-goal navigation tasks. Despite requiring no task-specific training, our approach achieves strong performance across multiple benchmarks, demonstrating that direct reasoning over image-based scene memory can effectively replace dense 3D reconstruction for object-centric robot navigation. Project page: https://ruizhou-cn.github.io/memory-over-maps/
summary_zh: 目标定位是导航和操作等具身任务的先决条件。传统方法依赖于构建显式的 3D 场景表示来实现目标定位，例如点云、体素网格或场景图。虽然有效，但这些流程会带来大量的建图时间、存储开销和可扩展性限制。视觉-语言模型的最新进展表明，可以直接在 2D 观测上进行丰富的语义推理，从而引发了一个根本问题：物体定位是否需要完整的 3D 场景重建？在这项工作中，我们重新审视了物体定位，并提出了一种无地图流程，该流程仅将带有位姿的 RGB-D 关键帧存储为一个轻量级的视觉记忆——而不构建场景的任何全局 3D 表示。在查询时，我们的方法检索候选视图，使用视觉-语言模型对其进行重新排序，并通过深度反投影和多视图融合构建查询目标的稀疏、按需的 3D 估计。与基于重建的流程相比，这种设计大大降低了预处理成本，使得场景索引的构建速度提高了两个数量级以上，同时使用的存储空间也大大减少。我们进一步验证了下游物体目标导航任务中的定位目标。尽管不需要特定于任务的训练，但我们的方法在多个基准测试中都取得了强大的性能，证明了基于图像的场景记忆上的直接推理可以有效地取代用于以物体为中心的机器人导航的密集 3D 重建。项目主页：https://ruizhou-cn.github.io/memory-over-maps/
tldr: The paper proposes a map-free object localization pipeline using a visual memory of posed RGB-D keyframes and a vision-language model, avoiding explicit 3D scene reconstruction for faster indexing and reduced storage, achieving strong performance in object-goal navigation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种无需地图的物体定位流程，它使用位姿 RGB-D 关键帧的视觉记忆和一个视觉语言模型，避免了显式的 3D 场景重建，从而实现了更快的索引和更少的存储，并在物体目标导航中取得了良好的效果。

title: Seed1.8 Model Card: Towards Generalized Real-World Agency
summary: We present Seed1.8, a foundation model aimed at generalized real-world agency: going beyond single-turn prediction to multi-turn interaction, tool use, and multi-step execution. Seed1.8 keeps strong LLM and vision-language performance while supporting a unified agentic interface-search, code generation and execution, and GUI interaction. For deployment, it offers latency- and cost-aware inference, including configurable thinking modes and optimized visual encoding for images and video. We report evaluations on standard benchmarks and application-aligned workflows spanning foundational skills, multimodal understanding, and agentic behavior. Seed1.8 is released to support further research and development on interactive, real-world use cases.
summary_zh: 我们提出了Seed1.8，一个旨在实现通用现实世界代理的基础模型：超越单轮预测，支持多轮交互、工具使用和多步骤执行。 Seed1.8保持了强大的LLM和视觉-语言性能，同时还支持统一的代理接口——搜索、代码生成和执行，以及GUI交互。 为了部署，它提供了延迟和成本感知的推理，包括可配置的思考模式和针对图像和视频的优化视觉编码。 我们报告了在标准基准测试和应用对齐的工作流程上的评估结果，涵盖基础技能、多模态理解和代理行为。 Seed1.8已发布，以支持对交互式、现实世界用例的进一步研究和开发。
tldr: Seed1.8 is a new foundation model designed for generalized real-world agency, enabling multi-turn interaction, tool use, and multi-step execution with improved LLM and vision-language performance.
tldr_zh: Seed1.8 是一种新的基础模型，旨在实现通用现实世界代理，通过改进 LLM 和视觉语言性能，实现多轮交互、工具使用和多步骤执行。

title: Glove2Hand: Synthesizing Natural Hand-Object Interaction from Multi-Modal Sensing Gloves
summary: Understanding hand-object interaction (HOI) is fundamental to computer vision, robotics, and AR/VR. However, conventional hand videos often lack essential physical information such as contact forces and motion signals, and are prone to frequent occlusions. To address the challenges, we present Glove2Hand, a framework that translates multi-modal sensing glove HOI videos into photorealistic bare hands, while faithfully preserving the underlying physical interaction dynamics. We introduce a novel 3D Gaussian hand model that ensures temporal rendering consistency. The rendered hand is seamlessly integrated into the scene using a diffusion-based hand restorer, which effectively handles complex hand-object interactions and non-rigid deformations. Leveraging Glove2Hand, we create HandSense, the first multi-modal HOI dataset featuring glove-to-hand videos with synchronized tactile and IMU signals. We demonstrate that HandSense significantly enhances downstream bare-hand applications, including video-based contact estimation and hand tracking under severe occlusion.
summary_zh: 理解手-物体交互（HOI）是计算机视觉、机器人学以及AR/VR的基础。然而，传统的手部视频通常缺乏必要的物理信息，如接触力和运动信号，并且容易出现频繁遮挡。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了Glove2Hand，一个将多模态传感手套HOI视频转换为照片级真实裸手的框架，同时忠实地保留了底层的物理交互动力学。我们引入了一种新颖的3D高斯手部模型，以确保时间渲染一致性。渲染后的手部通过基于扩散的手部修复器无缝集成到场景中，从而有效地处理复杂的手-物体交互和非刚性形变。利用Glove2Hand，我们创建了HandSense，这是首个多模态HOI数据集，其中包含手套到裸手的视频，并同步了触觉和IMU信号。我们证明了HandSense可以显著提升下游裸手应用，包括基于视频的接触估计和严重遮挡下的手部追踪。
tldr: The paper introduces Glove2Hand, a framework converting multi-modal sensing glove data into photorealistic bare-hand videos, along with the HandSense dataset to improve hand-object interaction understanding in computer vision and robotics.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了 Glove2Hand, 一个将多模态传感手套数据转换为逼真的裸手视频的框架，以及 HandSense 数据集，旨在提升计算机视觉和机器人领域中对手部-物体交互的理解。

title: Swim2Real: VLM-Guided System Identification for Sim-to-Real Transfer
summary: We present Swim2Real, a pipeline that calibrates a 16-parameter robotic fish simulator from swimming videos using vision-language model (VLM) feedback, requiring no hand-designed search stages. Calibrating soft aquatic robots is particularly challenging because nonlinear fluid-structure coupling makes the parameter landscape chaotic, simplified fluid models introduce a persistent sim-to-real gap, and controlled aquatic experiments are difficult to reproduce. Prior work on this platform required three manually tailored stages to handle this complexity. The VLM compares simulated and real videos and proposes parameter updates. A backtracking line search then validates each step size, tripling the accept rate from 14% to 42% by recovering proposals where the direction is correct but the magnitude is too large. Swim2Real calibrates all 16 parameters simultaneously, most closely matching real fish velocities across all motor frequencies (MAE = 7.4 mm/s, 43% lower than the next-best method), with zero outlier seeds across five runs. Motor commands from the trained policy transfer to the physical fish at 50 Hz, completing the pipeline from swimming video to real-world deployment. Downstream RL policies swim 12% farther than those from BayesOpt-calibrated simulators and 90% farther than CMA-ES. These results demonstrate that VLM-guided calibration can close the sim-to-real gap for aquatic robots directly from video, enabling zero-shot RL transfer to physical swimmers without manual system identification, a step toward automated, general-purpose simulator tuning for underwater robotics.
summary_zh: 我们提出了Swim2Real，一个利用视觉-语言模型(VLM)反馈，从游泳视频中校准一个16参数的机器人鱼模拟器的流程，无需人工设计的搜索阶段。软体水下机器人的校准尤为具有挑战性，因为非线性流固耦合使参数空间变得混乱，简化的流体模型引入了持续存在的仿真-现实差距，并且受控的水下实验难以重现。先前针对该平台的工作需要三个手工定制的阶段来处理这种复杂性。VLM比较模拟和真实视频，并提出参数更新。然后，一个回溯线搜索验证每个步长，通过恢复方向正确但幅度过大的提案，将接受率从14%提高到42%。Swim2Real同时校准所有16个参数，在所有电机频率下最接近地匹配真实鱼的速度（MAE=7.4 mm/s，比次优方法低43%），在五次运行中没有离群种子。来自训练策略的电机指令以50 Hz的频率传输到物理鱼，完成了从游泳视频到现实世界部署的流程。下游强化学习(RL)策略比来自贝叶斯优化校准的模拟器游得远12%，比CMA-ES游得远90%。这些结果表明，VLM引导的校准可以直接从视频缩小水下机器人的仿真-现实差距，从而实现对物理游泳者的零样本RL迁移，无需手动系统辨识，这是朝着水下机器人自动化、通用模拟器调整迈出的一步。
tldr: Swim2Real uses a Vision-Language Model to calibrate a robotic fish simulator from swimming videos, enabling zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of RL policies with significantly improved performance compared to other calibration methods.
tldr_zh: Swim2Real使用视觉语言模型从游泳视频中校准机器人鱼模拟器，从而实现RL策略的零样本sim-to-real迁移，与其它校准方法相比，性能显著提高。

title: Does Peer Observation Help? Vision-Sharing Collaboration for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) systems are fundamentally constrained by partial observability, as an agent can only accumulate knowledge from locations it has personally visited. As multiple robots increasingly coexist in shared environments, a natural question arises: can agents navigating the same space benefit from each other's observations? In this work, we introduce Co-VLN, a minimalist, model-agnostic framework for systematically investigating whether and how peer observations from concurrently navigating agents can benefit VLN. When independently navigating agents identify common traversed locations, they exchange structured perceptual memory, effectively expanding each agent's receptive field at no additional exploration cost. We validate our framework on the R2R benchmark under two representative paradigms (the learning-based DUET and the zero-shot MapGPT), and conduct extensive analytical experiments to systematically reveal the underlying dynamics of peer observation sharing in VLN. Results demonstrate that vision-sharing enabled model yields substantial performance improvements across both paradigms, establishing a strong foundation for future research in collaborative embodied navigation.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言导航（VLN）系统从根本上受到部分可观测性的限制，因为智能体只能从其亲自访问过的位置积累知识。随着多个机器人在共享环境中日益共存，一个自然的问题随之产生：在同一空间中导航的智能体能否从彼此的观测中获益？在这项工作中，我们引入了Co-VLN，一个极简的、与模型无关的框架，用于系统地研究并发导航的智能体的同伴观测是否以及如何能够帮助VLN。当独立导航的智能体识别出共同遍历的位置时，它们会交换结构化的感知记忆，从而有效地扩展每个智能体的感受野，而无需额外的探索成本。我们在R2R基准上，在两种具有代表性的范例（基于学习的DUET和零样本MapGPT）下验证了我们的框架，并进行了广泛的分析实验，以系统地揭示VLN中同伴观测共享的底层动态。结果表明，视觉共享赋能的模型在两种范例下都产生了显著的性能提升，为未来在协作具身导航方面的研究奠定了坚实的基础。
tldr: This paper introduces Co-VLN, a framework that enables VLN agents to share perceptual memories to improve navigation performance, showing significant improvements on the R2R benchmark.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Co-VLN，一个允许VLN智能体共享感知记忆以提高导航性能的框架，并在R2R基准测试中显示出显著改进。

title: RoboECC: Multi-Factor-Aware Edge-Cloud Collaborative Deployment for VLA Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are mainstream in embodied intelligence but face high inference costs. Edge-Cloud Collaborative (ECC) deployment offers an effective fix by easing edge-device computing pressure to meet real-time needs. However, existing ECC frameworks are suboptimal for VLA models due to two challenges: (1) Diverse model structures hinder optimal ECC segmentation point identification; (2) Even if the optimal split point is determined, changes in network bandwidth can cause performance drift. To address these issues, we propose a novel ECC deployment framework for various VLA models, termed RoboECC. Specifically, we propose a model-hardware co-aware segmentation strategy to help find the optimal segmentation point for various VLA models. Moreover, we propose a network-aware deployment adjustment approach to adapt to the network fluctuations for maintaining optimal performance. Experiments demonstrate that RoboECC achieves a speedup of up to 3.28x with only 2.55x~2.62x overhead.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-行动 (VLA) 模型是具身智能领域的主流，但面临着高推理成本的问题。边缘-云协同 (ECC) 部署通过缓解边缘设备的计算压力以满足实时需求，提供了一种有效的解决方案。然而，由于两个挑战，现有的 ECC 框架对于 VLA 模型而言并非最优：（1）多样化的模型结构阻碍了最佳 ECC 分割点的识别；（2）即使确定了最佳分割点，网络带宽的变化也可能导致性能漂移。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的 ECC 部署框架 RoboECC，用于各种 VLA 模型。具体而言，我们提出了一种模型-硬件协同感知的分割策略，以帮助找到各种 VLA 模型的最佳分割点。此外，我们还提出了一种网络感知的部署调整方法，以适应网络波动，从而维持最佳性能。实验表明，RoboECC 实现了高达 3.28 倍的加速，而开销仅为 2.55 倍 ~ 2.62 倍。
tldr: RoboECC is a novel edge-cloud collaborative (ECC) framework tailored for VLA models, addressing challenges in segmentation and network fluctuation adaptation to achieve significant speedups.
tldr_zh: RoboECC是一个为VLA模型量身定制的新型边缘-云协同(ECC)框架，解决了分割和网络波动适应方面的挑战，实现了显著的加速。

title: Enhancing Vision-Based Policies with Omni-View and Cross-Modality Knowledge Distillation for Mobile Robots
summary: Vision-based policies are widely applied in robotics for tasks such as manipulation and locomotion. On lightweight mobile robots, however, they face a trilemma of limited scene transferability, restricted onboard computation resources, and sensor hardware cost. To address these issues, we propose a knowledge distillation approach that transfers knowledge from an information-rich, appearance invariant omniview depth policy to a lightweight monocular policy. The key idea is to train the student not only to mimic the expert actions but also to align with the latent embeddings of the omni view depth teacher. Experiments demonstrate that omni-view and depth inputs improve the scene transfer and navigation performance, and that the proposed distillation method enhances the performance of a singleview monocular policy, compared with policies solely imitating actions. Real world experiments further validate the effectiveness and practicality of our approach. Code will be released publicly.
summary_zh: 基于视觉的策略广泛应用于机器人操作和运动等任务中。然而，在轻量级移动机器人上，它们面临环境泛化能力有限、受限的板载计算资源和传感器硬件成本的三难困境。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种知识蒸馏方法，该方法将信息丰富且外观不变的全景深度策略的知识迁移到轻量级单目策略。关键思想是不仅训练学生策略模仿专家动作，还要与全景深度教师的潜在嵌入对齐。实验表明，全景和深度输入提高了场景泛化能力和导航性能，并且与仅模仿动作的策略相比，所提出的蒸馏方法增强了单目单视角策略的性能。真实世界的实验进一步验证了我们方法的有效性和实用性。代码将公开发布。
tldr: This paper proposes a knowledge distillation approach to transfer knowledge from an omni-view depth policy to a lightweight monocular policy for mobile robot navigation, addressing limitations in scene transferability, computation, and sensor cost.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种知识蒸馏方法，将全方位深度策略的知识迁移到轻量级单目策略，用于解决移动机器人导航中场景泛化能力、计算资源和传感器成本的限制。

title: ROI-Driven Foveated Attention for Unified Egocentric Representations in Vision-Language-Action Systems
summary:
The development of embodied AI systems is increasingly constrained by the availability and structure of physical interaction data. Despite recent advances in vision-language-action (VLA) models, current pipelines suffer from high data collection cost, limited cross-embodiment alignment, and poor transfer from internet-scale visual data to robot control.
  We propose a region-of-interest (ROI) driven engineering workflow that introduces an egocentric, geometry-grounded data representation. By projecting end-effector poses via forward kinematics (FK) into a single external camera, we derive movement-aligned hand-centric ROIs without requiring wrist-mounted cameras or multi-view systems. Unlike directly downsampling the full frame, ROI is cropped from the original image before resizing, preserving high local information density for contact-critical regions while retaining global context.
  We present a reproducible pipeline covering calibration, synchronization, ROI generation, deterministic boundary handling, and metadata governance. The resulting representation is embodiment-aligned and viewpoint-normalized, enabling data reuse across heterogeneous robots. We argue that egocentric ROI serves as a practical data abstraction for scalable collection and cross-embodiment learning, bridging internet-scale perception and robot-specific control.
summary_zh:
具身人工智能系统的发展日益受到物理交互数据的可用性和结构的限制。尽管视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型取得了最新进展，但当前的流程仍面临数据收集成本高、跨主体对齐性有限以及互联网规模的视觉数据向机器人控制的迁移效果不佳等问题。

我们提出了一种区域兴趣(ROI)驱动的工程流程，引入了一种以自我为中心、几何约束的数据表示方法。通过将末端执行器的姿态经由正向运动学(FK)投影到单个外部摄像头，我们无需腕载摄像头或多视图系统即可推导出运动对齐的以手为中心的ROI。与直接下采样完整帧不同，ROI在调整大小之前从原始图像中裁剪，从而在保留全局上下文的同时，为接触关键区域保持高局部信息密度。

我们提出了一个可复现的流程，涵盖校准、同步、ROI生成、确定性边界处理和元数据管理。由此产生的表示是主体对齐和视角归一化的，从而能够在异构机器人之间实现数据重用。我们认为，以自我为中心的ROI可以作为一种实用的数据抽象，用于可扩展的收集和跨主体学习，从而弥合互联网规模的感知和机器人特定控制之间的差距。
tldr: This paper proposes a ROI-driven, geometry-grounded data representation using a single external camera to create egocentric views for vision-language-action systems, aiming to improve data efficiency and cross-embodiment learning in robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种ROI驱动的、基于几何的数据表示方法，使用单个外部摄像头创建以自我为中心的视角，用于视觉-语言-动作系统，旨在提高机器人技术中的数据效率和跨具身学习。

title: E-SocialNav: Efficient Socially Compliant Navigation with Language Models
summary: Language models (LMs) are increasingly applied to robotic navigation; however, existing benchmarks primarily emphasize navigation success rates while paying limited attention to social compliance. Moreover, relying on large-scale LMs can raise efficiency concerns, as their heavy computational overhead leads to slower response times and higher energy consumption, making them impractical for real-time deployment on resource-constrained robotic platforms. In this work, we evaluate the social compliance of GPT-4o and Claude in robotic navigation and propose E-SocialNav, an efficient LM designed for socially compliant navigation. Despite being trained on a relatively small dataset, E-SocialNav consistently outperforms zero-shot baselines in generating socially compliant behaviors. By employing a two-stage training pipeline consisting of supervised fine-tuning followed by direct preference optimization, E-SocialNav achieves strong performance in both text-level semantic similarity to human annotations and action accuracy. The source code is available at https://github.com/Dr-LingXiao/ESocialNav.
summary_zh: 语言模型（LM）越来越多地应用于机器人导航；然而，现有的基准测试主要强调导航成功率，而对社会合规性的关注有限。此外，依赖大型语言模型可能会引发效率问题，因为它们庞大的计算开销会导致响应时间变慢和能源消耗增高，使其不适用于资源受限的机器人平台上进行实时部署。在这项工作中，我们评估了GPT-4o和Claude在机器人导航中的社会合规性，并提出了E-SocialNav，一种为社会合规导航设计的效率语言模型。尽管E-SocialNav是在一个相对较小的数据集上训练的，但它在生成社会合规行为方面始终优于零样本基线。通过采用一个由监督微调和直接偏好优化组成的两阶段训练流水线，E-SocialNav在文本层面的语义相似度（与人类标注相比）和动作准确性方面都取得了优异的性能。源代码可在https://github.com/Dr-LingXiao/ESocialNav获取。
tldr: The paper introduces E-SocialNav, an efficient language model for socially compliant robot navigation, outperforming zero-shot baselines with a relatively small dataset and a two-stage training process.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了E-SocialNav，一种用于社交合规机器人导航的高效语言模型，通过相对较小的数据集和两阶段训练过程，性能优于零样本基线。

title: StageCraft: Execution Aware Mitigation of Distractor and Obstruction Failures in VLA Models
summary: Large scale pre-training on text and image data along with diverse robot demonstrations has helped Vision Language Action models (VLAs) to generalize to novel tasks, objects and scenes. However, these models are still susceptible to failure in the presence of execution-time impediments such as distractors and physical obstructions in the robot's workspace. Existing policy improvement methods finetune base VLAs to improve generalization, yet they still struggle in unseen distractor settings. To address this problem, we investigate whether internet-scale pretraining of large vision-language models (VLMs) can be leveraged to reason about these impediments and mitigate policy failures. To this end, we propose StageCraft, a training-free approach to improve pretrained VLA policy performance by manipulating the environment's initial state using VLM-based in-context reasoning. StageCraft takes policy rollout videos and success labels as input and leverages VLM's reasoning ability to infer which objects in the initial state need to be manipulated to avoid anticipated execution failures. StageCraft is an extensible plug-and-play module that does not introduce additional constraints on the underlying policy, and only requires a few policy rollouts to work. We evaluate performance of state-of-the-art VLA models with StageCraft and show an absolute 40% performance improvement across three real world task domains involving diverse distractors and obstructions. Our simulation experiments in RLBench empirically show that StageCraft tailors its extent of intervention based on the strength of the underlying policy and improves its performance with more in-context samples. Videos of StageCraft in effect can be found at https://stagecraft-decorator.github.io/stagecraft/ .
summary_zh: 在文本和图像数据以及多样的机器人演示数据上进行大规模预训练，已然助力视觉语言动作模型（VLA）泛化到新的任务、物体和场景。然而，这些模型在遇到执行时障碍，如机器人工作空间内的干扰项和物理障碍时，仍然容易失败。现有的策略改进方法会微调基础VLA模型以提升泛化能力，但在未见过的干扰项环境中仍然表现不佳。为了解决这个问题，我们研究了是否可以利用大型视觉语言模型（VLM）的互联网规模预训练，来推理这些障碍并减轻策略失败。为此，我们提出StageCraft，一种免训练的方法，通过使用基于VLM的上下文推理来操纵环境的初始状态，从而提高预训练VLA策略的性能。 StageCraft以策略rollout视频和成功标签作为输入，并利用VLM的推理能力来推断初始状态中哪些物体需要被操纵，以避免预期的执行失败。StageCraft是一个可扩展的即插即用模块，不会对底层策略引入额外的约束，并且仅需少量策略rollout即可工作。 我们评估了具有StageCraft的现有先进VLA模型的性能，并在涉及各种干扰项和障碍的三个真实世界任务领域中展示了高达40%的绝对性能提升。 我们在RLBench中的模拟实验经验表明，StageCraft会根据底层策略的强度来调整其干预程度，并随着更多上下文样本的增加而提高其性能。 StageCraft的效果视频可在https://stagecraft-decorator.github.io/stagecraft/ 上找到。
tldr: The paper introduces StageCraft, a training-free method that uses VLMs to reason about and mitigate distractor/obstruction failures in VLA models by manipulating the environment's initial state. It demonstrates a 40% performance improvement on real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为StageCraft的免训练方法，它利用视觉语言模型（VLM）来推理并减轻视觉语言动作模型（VLA）在遇到干扰和障碍时的失败，通过操纵环境的初始状态实现。实验表明，在现实世界任务中，性能提高了40%。

title: Multi-Robot Learning-Informed Task Planning Under Uncertainty
summary: We want a multi-robot team to complete complex tasks in minimum time where the locations of task-relevant objects are not known. Effective task completion requires reasoning over long horizons about the likely locations of task-relevant objects, how individual actions contribute to overall progress, and how to coordinate team efforts. Planning in this setting is extremely challenging: even when task-relevant information is partially known, coordinating which robot performs which action and when is difficult, and uncertainty introduces a multiplicity of possible outcomes for each action, which further complicates long-horizon decision-making and coordination. To address this, we propose a multi-robot planning abstraction that integrates learning to estimate uncertain aspects of the environment with model-based planning for long-horizon coordination. We demonstrate the efficient multi-stage task planning of our approach for 1, 2, and 3 robot teams over competitive baselines in large ProcTHOR household environments. Additionally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach with a team of two LoCoBot mobile robots in real household settings.
summary_zh: 我们希望多机器人团队在最短时间内完成复杂的任务，其中与任务相关的物体的位置未知。 有效完成任务需要对与任务相关的物体可能的位置，个体行为如何促成整体进展，以及如何协调团队努力进行长时域推理。 在这种设定下进行规划极具挑战性：即使与任务相关的信息部分已知，协调哪个机器人执行哪个动作以及何时执行依然困难，而不确定性为每个动作带来了多种可能的结果，这进一步复杂化了长时域决策和协调。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种多机器人规划抽象方法，该方法集成了学习以估计环境的不确定性方面，并结合基于模型的规划来进行长时域协调。 我们在大型 ProcTHOR 家庭环境中，针对1、2和3个机器人的团队，通过与有竞争力的基线方法进行比较，证明了我们方法的高效多阶段任务规划能力。 此外，我们还通过在真实家庭环境中部署由两台 LoCoBot 移动机器人组成的团队，证明了我们方法的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces a multi-robot task planning approach that integrates learning for environment uncertainty estimation with model-based planning for long-horizon coordination, demonstrated in simulation and on real robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种多机器人任务规划方法，该方法将学习用于环境不确定性估计与基于模型的规划相结合，以实现长时程协调，并在模拟和真实机器人上进行了演示。

title: Grounded Chess Reasoning in Language Models via Master Distillation
summary: Language models often lack grounded reasoning capabilities in specialized domains where training data is scarce but bespoke systems excel. We introduce a general framework for distilling expert system reasoning into natural language chain-of-thought explanations, enabling compact models to acquire domain expertise and the ability to generate faithful, grounded explanations. Rather than distilling only final outputs, we capture the full reasoning process, transforming opaque expert computations into transparent, step-by-step explanations. We demonstrate this approach in chess, a canonical reasoning domain where language models continue to underperform. Our 4B parameter model, C1, advances from a near-zero baseline to 48.1% accuracy, outperforming all open-source models and most frontier proprietary systems. Notably, C1 surpasses its distillation teacher and generates solutions in two orders of magnitude fewer tokens than baselines. Unlike prior neural chess approaches that predict only best moves, C1 generates explainable solutions revealing strategic reasoning. Our pipeline combines supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with theme-balanced data sampling for comprehensive tactical coverage. Master Distillation demonstrates how to inject expert-level knowledge into compact models for under-optimized domains, offering a recipe for unlocking RLVR where LLMs lack sufficient base capabilities.
summary_zh: 语言模型在专业领域通常缺乏植根的推理能力，这些领域的训练数据稀缺，但定制系统却表现出色。我们介绍了一个通用框架，用于将专家系统的推理提炼成自然语言的思维链解释，使紧凑型模型能够获得领域专业知识以及生成忠实、有依据的解释能力。我们并非仅提炼最终输出，而是捕获完整的推理过程，将不透明的专家计算转换成透明的、逐步的解释。我们在国际象棋中展示了这种方法，国际象棋是一个典型的推理领域，语言模型在这个领域仍然表现不佳。我们的40亿参数模型C1，从接近零的基线水平提升到48.1%的准确率，超过了所有开源模型和大多数前沿的专有系统。值得注意的是，C1超越了其提炼教师模型，并以比基线少两个数量级的token生成解决方案。与之前仅预测最佳棋步的神经国际象棋方法不同，C1生成可解释的解决方案，揭示战略推理。我们的流程结合了监督微调和强化学习，以及用于全面战术覆盖的主题平衡数据采样。大师级提炼（Master Distillation）展示了如何将专家级的知识注入到欠优化的领域的紧凑型模型中，为解锁LLM缺乏足够基础能力的RLVR提供了一种方案。
tldr: This paper introduces a master distillation framework to inject expert system reasoning into compact language models, demonstrated in chess, achieving state-of-the-art performance and explainable solutions with a 4B parameter model.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种主蒸馏框架，用于将专家系统的推理注入到紧凑的语言模型中，并在国际象棋中进行了演示。通过一个40亿参数的模型，实现了最先进的性能和可解释的解决方案。

title: Solver-Aided Verification of Policy Compliance in Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
summary: Tool-augmented Large Language Models (TaLLMs) extend LLMs with the ability to invoke external tools, enabling them to interact with real-world environments. However, a major limitation in deploying TaLLMs in sensitive applications such as customer service and business process automation is a lack of reliable compliance with domain-specific operational policies regarding tool-use and agent behavior. Current approaches merely steer LLMs to adhere to policies by including policy descriptions in the LLM context, but these provide no guarantees that policy violations will be prevented. In this paper, we introduce an SMT solver-aided framework to enforce tool-use policy compliance in TaLLM agents. Specifically, we use an LLM-assisted, human-guided approach to translate natural-language-specified tool-use policies into formal logic (SMT-LIB-2.0) constraints over agent-observable state and tool arguments. At runtime, planned tool calls are intercepted and checked against the constraints using the Z3 solver as a pre-condition to the tool call. Tool invocations that violate the policy are blocked. We evaluated on the TauBench benchmark and demonstrate that solver-aided policy checking reduces policy violations while maintaining overall task accuracy. These results suggest that integrating formal reasoning into TaLLM execution can improve tool-call policy compliance and overall reliability.
summary_zh: 工具增强型大型语言模型 (TaLLMs) 通过赋予 LLM 调用外部工具的能力来扩展它们，使其能够与真实世界环境交互。然而，在客户服务和业务流程自动化等敏感应用中部署 TaLLMs 的一个主要限制是，缺乏对特定领域的操作策略的可靠遵从性，这些策略涉及工具使用和代理行为。目前的方法仅仅是通过在 LLM 上下文中包含策略描述来引导 LLM 遵守策略，但这并不能保证能够防止违反策略。在本文中，我们介绍了一种 SMT 求解器辅助框架，以在 TaLLM 代理中强制执行工具使用策略合规性。具体而言，我们使用一种 LLM 辅助、人工指导的方法，将自然语言指定的工具使用策略转换为形式逻辑 (SMT-LIB-2.0) 约束，这些约束作用在代理可观察状态和工具参数上。在运行时，计划的工具调用会被拦截，并使用 Z3 求解器作为工具调用的前置条件，根据约束进行检查。违反策略的工具调用将被阻止。我们对 TauBench 基准进行了评估，结果表明，求解器辅助策略检查可在保持总体任务准确性的同时减少策略违规行为。这些结果表明，将形式推理集成到 TaLLM 执行中可以提高工具调用策略的合规性和整体可靠性。
tldr: The paper introduces a framework to enforce tool-use policy compliance in Tool-Augmented LLMs (TaLLMs) by using an SMT solver to check planned tool calls against formal logic constraints derived from natural language policies, demonstrating reduced policy violations on the TauBench benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个框架，通过使用SMT求解器根据从自然语言策略推导出的形式逻辑约束来检查计划的工具调用，从而在工具增强型LLM (TaLLM)中强制执行工具使用策略合规性，并在TauBench基准测试中展示了减少策略违规的情况。

title: Understanding Behavior Cloning with Action Quantization
summary: Behavior cloning is a fundamental paradigm in machine learning, enabling policy learning from expert demonstrations across robotics, autonomous driving, and generative models. Autoregressive models like transformer have proven remarkably effective, from large language models (LLMs) to vision-language-action systems (VLAs). However, applying autoregressive models to continuous control requires discretizing actions through quantization, a practice widely adopted yet poorly understood theoretically. This paper provides theoretical foundations for this practice. We analyze how quantization error propagates along the horizon and interacts with statistical sample complexity. We show that behavior cloning with quantized actions and log-loss achieves optimal sample complexity, matching existing lower bounds, and incurs only polynomial horizon dependence on quantization error, provided the dynamics are stable and the policy satisfies a probabilistic smoothness condition. We further characterize when different quantization schemes satisfy or violate these requirements, and propose a model-based augmentation that provably improves the error bound without requiring policy smoothness. Finally, we establish fundamental limits that jointly capture the effects of quantization error and statistical complexity.
summary_zh: 行为克隆是机器学习中的一个基本范式，它能够从专家演示中学习策略，应用于机器人、自动驾驶和生成模型等领域。诸如Transformer的自回归模型已被证明非常有效，从大型语言模型（LLM）到视觉-语言-动作系统（VLA）都得到了广泛应用。然而，将自回归模型应用于连续控制需要通过量化来离散化动作，这是一种被广泛采用但理论上理解不足的做法。本文为此实践提供了理论基础。我们分析了量化误差如何沿时间跨度传播以及如何与统计样本复杂度相互作用。我们证明，使用量化动作和对数损失的行为克隆可以实现最佳的样本复杂度，匹配现有的下界，并且量化误差仅导致关于horizon的多项式依赖性，只要动力系统是稳定的并且策略满足概率平滑条件。我们进一步描述了不同的量化方案何时满足或违反这些要求，并提出了一种基于模型的增强方法，该方法能够证明可以改善误差界限且无需策略平滑性。最后，我们建立了同时捕捉量化误差和统计复杂性影响的基本界限。
tldr: This paper provides theoretical foundations for behavior cloning with action quantization, showing optimal sample complexity and polynomial horizon dependence on quantization error under certain conditions, and proposes a model-based augmentation to improve error bounds.
tldr_zh: 本文为带动作量化的行为克隆提供了理论基础，表明在一定条件下可以实现最佳的样本复杂度和量化误差的polynomial水平上的依赖关系，并提出了一种基于模型的增强方法来改进误差界限。

title: ToFormer: Towards Large-scale Scenario Depth Completion for Lightweight ToF Camera
summary: Time-of-Flight (ToF) cameras possess compact design and high measurement precision to be applied to various robot tasks. However, their limited sensing range restricts deployment in large-scale scenarios. Depth completion has emerged as a potential solution to expand the sensing range of ToF cameras, but existing research lacks dedicated datasets and struggles to generalize to ToF measurements. In this paper, we propose a full-stack framework that enables depth completion in large-scale scenarios for short-range ToF cameras. First, we construct a multi-sensor platform with a reconstruction-based pipeline to collect real-world ToF samples with dense large-scale ground truth, yielding the first LArge-ScalE scenaRio ToF depth completion dataset (LASER-ToF). Second, we propose a sensor-aware depth completion network that incorporates a novel 3D branch with a 3D-2D Joint Propagation Pooling (JPP) module and Multimodal Cross-Covariance Attention (MXCA), enabling effective modeling of long-range relationships and efficient 3D-2D fusion under non-uniform ToF depth sparsity. Moreover, our network can utilize the sparse point cloud from visual SLAM as a supplement to ToF depth to further improve prediction accuracy. Experiments show that our method achieves an 8.6% lower mean absolute error than the second-best method, while maintaining lightweight design to support onboard deployment. Finally, to verify the system's applicability on real robots, we deploy proposed method on a quadrotor at a 10Hz runtime, enabling reliable large-scale mapping and long-range planning in challenging environments for short-range ToF cameras.
summary_zh: 飞行时间(ToF)相机具有紧凑的设计和高测量精度，可应用于各种机器人任务。然而，其有限的传感范围限制了在大规模场景中的部署。深度补全已成为扩展ToF相机传感范围的潜在解决方案，但现有研究缺乏专用数据集，且难以推广到ToF测量。本文提出了一种全栈框架，使短程ToF相机能够在大型场景中进行深度补全。首先，我们构建了一个基于重建的流水线的多传感器平台，以收集具有稠密大型地面真值的真实世界ToF样本，从而产生了第一个大规模场景ToF深度补全数据集（LASER-ToF）。其次，我们提出了一种传感器感知的深度补全网络，该网络包含一个新的3D分支，具有3D-2D联合传播池化（JPP）模块和多模态交叉协方差注意力（MXCA），从而能够有效地建模长程关系并在非均匀ToF深度稀疏性下实现高效的3D-2D融合。此外，我们的网络可以利用来自视觉SLAM的稀疏点云作为ToF深度的补充，以进一步提高预测精度。实验表明，我们的方法比第二好的方法实现了低8.6%的平均绝对误差，同时保持了轻量级设计以支持机载部署。最后，为了验证系统在实际机器人上的适用性，我们将提出的方法部署在四旋翼无人机上，运行频率为10Hz，使短程ToF相机能够在具有挑战性的环境中实现可靠的大规模建图和长程规划。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel depth completion framework (ToFormer) and dataset (LASER-ToF) for expanding the sensing range of short-range ToF cameras in large-scale robotic scenarios, demonstrating improved accuracy and real-time performance on a quadrotor.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的深度补全框架 (ToFormer) 和数据集 (LASER-ToF)，用于扩大短程 ToF 相机在大型机器人场景中的传感范围，并在四旋翼飞行器上展示了更高的精度和实时性能。

title: Speedup Patch: Learning a Plug-and-Play Policy to Accelerate Embodied Manipulation
summary: While current embodied policies exhibit remarkable manipulation skills, their execution remains unsatisfactorily slow as they inherit the tardy pacing of human demonstrations. Existing acceleration methods typically require policy retraining or costly online interactions, limiting their scalability for large-scale foundation models. In this paper, we propose Speedup Patch (SuP), a lightweight, policy-agnostic framework that enables plug-and-play acceleration using solely offline data. SuP introduces an external scheduler that adaptively downsamples action chunks provided by embodied policies to eliminate redundancies. Specifically, we formalize the optimization of our scheduler as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) aimed at maximizing efficiency without compromising task performance. Since direct success evaluation is infeasible in offline settings, SuP introduces World Model based state deviation as a surrogate metric to enforce safety constraints. By leveraging a learned world model as a virtual evaluator to predict counterfactual trajectories, the scheduler can be optimized via offline reinforcement learning. Empirical results on simulation benchmarks (Libero, Bigym) and real-world tasks validate that SuP achieves an overall 1.8x execution speedup for diverse policies while maintaining their original success rates.
summary_zh: 当前具身智能策略展现出卓越的操作技能，但其执行速度仍然慢得令人不满意，因为它们继承了人类演示的迟缓节奏。现有的加速方法通常需要策略重训练或代价高昂的在线交互，限制了它们在大规模基础模型上的可扩展性。在本文中，我们提出了一种轻量级的、与策略无关的框架Speedup Patch (SuP)，它可以仅使用离线数据实现即插即用的加速。SuP引入了一个外部调度器，它自适应地对具身智能策略提供的动作块进行降采样，以消除冗余。具体而言，我们将调度器的优化形式化为一个约束马尔可夫决策过程(CMDP)，旨在最大化效率而不损害任务性能。由于在离线环境中直接评估成功与否是不可行的，SuP引入了基于世界模型的状态偏差作为代理指标来实施安全约束。通过利用学习到的世界模型作为虚拟评估器来预测反事实轨迹，调度器可以通过离线强化学习进行优化。在模拟基准（Libero、Bigym）和真实世界任务上的经验结果验证了SuP能够为各种策略实现整体1.8倍的执行速度提升，同时保持其原始成功率。
tldr: The paper introduces Speedup Patch (SuP), a policy-agnostic framework that accelerates embodied manipulation policies by adaptively downsampling action chunks using a learned world model for offline reinforcement learning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Speedup Patch (SuP)，一个策略无关的框架，它通过使用学习到的世界模型进行离线强化学习，自适应地对动作块进行降采样，从而加速具身操作策略。

title: GHOST: Ground-projected Hypotheses from Observed Structure-from-Motion Trajectories
summary: We present a scalable self-supervised approach for segmenting feasible vehicle trajectories from monocular images for autonomous driving in complex urban environments. Leveraging large-scale dashcam videos, we treat recorded ego-vehicle motion as implicit supervision and recover camera trajectories via monocular structure-from-motion, projecting them onto the ground plane to generate spatial masks of traversed regions without manual annotation. These automatically generated labels are used to train a deep segmentation network that predicts motion-conditioned path proposals from a single RGB image at run time, without explicit modeling of road or lane markings. Trained on diverse, unconstrained internet data, the model implicitly captures scene layout, lane topology, and intersection structure, and generalizes across varying camera configurations. We evaluate our approach on NuScenes, demonstrating reliable trajectory prediction, and further show transfer to an electric scooter platform through light fine-tuning. Our results indicate that large-scale ego-motion distillation yields structured and generalizable path proposals beyond the demonstrated trajectory, enabling trajectory hypothesis estimation via image segmentation.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种可扩展的自监督方法，用于从单目图像中分割出可行的车辆轨迹，以用于复杂城市环境中的自动驾驶。利用大规模行车记录仪视频，我们将记录的自车运动视为隐式监督，并通过单目运动结构恢复相机轨迹，将其投影到地面上生成已行驶区域的空间掩码，无需手动标注。这些自动生成的标签用于训练一个深度分割网络，该网络在运行时从单个RGB图像中预测运动条件下的路径提议，而无需显式建模道路或车道线标记。该模型在多样化的、不受约束的互联网数据上训练，隐式捕获场景布局、车道拓扑结构和交叉路口结构，并能推广到不同的相机配置。我们在NuScenes上评估了所提出的方法，展示了可靠的轨迹预测，并通过少量微调进一步展示了其向电动滑板车平台的迁移能力。我们的结果表明，大规模自车运动提炼能够产生超出所展示轨迹的结构化且可泛化的路径提议，从而可以通过图像分割实现轨迹假设估计。
tldr: The paper introduces a self-supervised method for segmenting feasible vehicle trajectories from monocular images using large-scale dashcam videos and structure-from-motion, demonstrating its effectiveness on NuScenes and transferability to other platforms.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种自监督方法，利用大规模行车记录仪视频和运动结构算法从单目图像中分割出可行的车辆轨迹，并在NuScenes数据集上验证了其有效性，并展示了其在其他平台上的迁移能力。

title: Current state of the multi-agent multi-view experimental and digital twin rendezvous (MMEDR-Autonomous) framework
summary: As near-Earth resident space objects proliferate, there is an increasing demand for reliable technologies in applications of on-orbit servicing, debris removal, and orbit modification. Rendezvous and docking are critical mission phases for such applications and can benefit from greater autonomy to reduce operational complexity and human workload. Machine learning-based methods can be integrated within the guidance, navigation, and control (GNC) architecture to design a robust rendezvous and docking framework. In this work, the Multi-Agent Multi-View Experimental and Digital Twin Rendezvous (MMEDR-Autonomous) is introduced as a unified framework comprising a learning-based optical navigation network, a reinforcement learning-based guidance approach under ongoing development, and a hardware-in-the-loop testbed. Navigation employs a lightweight monocular pose estimation network with multi-scale feature fusion, trained on realistic image augmentations to mitigate domain shift. The guidance component is examined with emphasis on learning stability, reward design, and systematic hyperparameter tuning under mission-relevant constraints. Prior Control Barrier Function results for Clohessy-Wiltshire dynamics are reviewed as a basis for enforcing safety and operational constraints and for guiding future nonlinear controller design within the MMEDR-Autonomous framework. The MMEDR-Autonomous framework is currently progressing toward integrated experimental validation in multi-agent rendezvous scenarios.
summary_zh: 随着近地空间物体数量的激增，对在轨服务、碎片清除和轨道修改等应用中可靠技术的需求日益增长。交会对接是此类任务的关键阶段，可以通过提高自主性来降低操作复杂性和人为工作量。可以把基于机器学习的方法集成到制导、导航与控制(GNC)架构中，以设计一个鲁棒的交会对接框架。本文介绍了一种统一框架，即多智能体多视角实验和数字孪生交会对接(MMEDR-Autonomous)，该框架包含一个基于学习的光学导航网络、一个正在开发中的基于强化学习的制导方法，以及一个硬件在环测试平台。导航采用轻量级的单目姿态估计网络，具有多尺度特征融合，并在逼真的图像增强上进行训练，以减轻领域迁移的影响。对制导组件进行了考察，重点是学习稳定性、奖励函数设计以及在任务相关的约束条件下进行系统的超参数调整。对先前针对Clohessy-Wiltshire动力学的控制障碍函数结果进行了回顾，作为实施安全和操作约束以及指导MMEDR-Autonomous框架内未来非线性控制器设计的基础。MMEDR-Autonomous框架目前正在向多智能体交会对接场景中的集成实验验证推进。
tldr: The paper introduces the MMEDR-Autonomous framework for autonomous rendezvous and docking, leveraging machine learning for navigation and guidance, with a focus on realistic image augmentations and reinforcement learning techniques.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了MMEDR-Autonomous框架，用于自主交会对接，利用机器学习进行导航和制导，重点关注逼真的图像增强和强化学习技术。

title: High-Speed, All-Terrain Autonomy: Ensuring Safety at the Limits of Mobility
summary: A novel local trajectory planner, capable of controlling an autonomous off-road vehicle on rugged terrain at high-speed is presented. Autonomous vehicles are currently unable to safely operate off-road at high-speed, as current approaches either fail to predict and mitigate rollovers induced by rough terrain or are not real-time feasible. To address this challenge, a novel model predictive control (MPC) formulation is developed for local trajectory planning. A new dynamics model for off-road vehicles on rough, non-planar terrain is derived and used for prediction. Extreme mobility, including tire liftoff without rollover, is safely enabled through a new energy-based constraint. The formulation is analytically shown to mitigate rollover types ignored by many state-of-the-art methods, and real-time feasibility is achieved through parallelized GPGPU computation. The planner's ability to provide safe, extreme trajectories is studied through both simulated trials and full-scale physical experiments. The results demonstrate fewer rollovers and more successes compared to a state-of-the-art baseline across several challenging scenarios that push the vehicle to its mobility limits.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新型局部轨迹规划器，该规划器能够以高速控制自主越野车辆在崎岖地形上行驶。目前，自主车辆无法在越野地形上安全高速行驶，因为现有方法要么无法预测和减轻由粗糙地形引起的侧翻，要么不具备实时可行性。为了解决这一挑战，本文开发了一种用于局部轨迹规划的新型模型预测控制（MPC）公式。我们推导了一种适用于粗糙、非平面地形上越野车辆的新型动力学模型，并将其用于预测。通过一种新的基于能量的约束，安全地实现了包括轮胎离地而不翻车的极限移动能力。理论分析表明，该公式可以减轻许多最先进方法所忽略的侧翻类型，并通过并行化的GPGPU计算实现实时可行性。通过模拟试验和全尺寸物理实验研究了规划器提供安全、极限轨迹的能力。结果表明，在多个将车辆推向移动极限的挑战性场景中，与最先进的基线相比，侧翻次数更少，成功率更高。
tldr: This paper presents a novel MPC-based trajectory planner for high-speed, all-terrain autonomous vehicles, addressing rollover risks and enabling safer operation at mobility limits using a new dynamics model and energy-based constraint, validated through simulations and physical experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的基于MPC的轨迹规划器，用于高速全地形自动驾驶车辆。该规划器通过采用新的动力学模型和基于能量的约束，解决了侧翻风险，并能够在车辆的机动性极限下实现更安全的操作。通过仿真和物理实验验证了该方法。

title: An Open Source Computer Vision and Machine Learning Framework for Affordable Life Science Robotic Automation
summary: We present an open-source robotic framework that integrates computer vision and machine learning based inverse kinematics to enable low-cost laboratory automation tasks such as colony picking and liquid handling. The system uses a custom trained U-net model for semantic segmentation of microbial cultures, combined with Mixture Density Network for predicating joint angles of a simple 5-DOF robot arm. We evaluated the framework using a modified robot arm, upgraded with a custom liquid handling end-effector. Experimental results demonstrate the framework's feasibility for precise, repeatable operations, with mean positional error below 1 mm and joint angle prediction errors below 4 degrees and colony detection capabilities with IoU score of 0.537 and Dice coefficient of 0.596.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种开源机器人框架，该框架集成了基于计算机视觉和机器学习的逆运动学，以实现低成本的实验室自动化任务，例如菌落挑取和液体处理。该系统使用定制训练的U-net模型进行微生物培养的语义分割，并结合混合密度网络来预测一个简单5自由度机器人手臂的关节角度。我们使用一个经过改装的机器人手臂对该框架进行了评估，该手臂升级了一个定制的液体处理末端执行器。实验结果表明了该框架在精确、可重复操作方面的可行性，其平均位置误差低于1毫米，关节角度预测误差低于4度，菌落检测能力的IoU得分为0.537，Dice系数为0.596。
tldr: This paper presents an open-source robotic framework using computer vision and machine learning for low-cost laboratory automation, achieving precise colony picking and liquid handling with a 5-DOF robot arm.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个开源机器人框架，该框架利用计算机视觉和机器学习技术实现低成本的实验室自动化，使用五自由度机器人手臂实现了精确的菌落挑选和液体操作。

title: Dodgersort: Uncertainty-Aware VLM-Guided Human-in-the-Loop Pairwise Ranking
summary: Pairwise comparison labeling is emerging as it yields higher inter-rater reliability than conventional classification labeling, but exhaustive comparisons require quadratic cost. We propose Dodgersort, which leverages CLIP-based hierarchical pre-ordering, a neural ranking head and probabilistic ensemble (Elo, BTL, GP), epistemic--aleatoric uncertainty decomposition, and information-theoretic pair selection. It reduces human comparisons while improving the reliability of the rankings. In visual ranking tasks in medical imaging, historical dating, and aesthetics, Dodgersort achieves a 11--16\% annotation reduction while improving inter-rater reliability. Cross-domain ablations across four datasets show that neural adaptation and ensemble uncertainty are key to this gain. In FG-NET with ground-truth ages, the framework extracts 5--20$\times$ more ranking information per comparison than baselines, yielding Pareto-optimal accuracy--efficiency trade-offs.
summary_zh: 成对比较标注正逐渐兴起，因为它比传统的分类标注产生更高的评分者间信度，但穷尽式的比较需要二次方的时间成本。我们提出了Dodgersort方法，它利用基于CLIP的分层预排序、神经排序头和概率集成（Elo、BTL、GP）、认知-偶然不确定性分解，以及信息论的pair选择。它减少了人工比较的数量，同时提高了排序的可靠性。在医学影像、历史年代测定和美学领域的视觉排序任务中，Dodgersort实现了11%-16%的标注减少，同时提高了评分者间信度。跨越四个数据集的跨域消融研究表明，神经适应和集成不确定性是实现这种增益的关键。在具有真实年龄的FG-NET数据集中，该框架每个比较提取的排序信息比基线方法多5-20倍，从而产生了帕累托最优的准确率-效率权衡。
tldr: The paper introduces Dodgersort, a VLM-guided active learning method for pairwise ranking that reduces annotation effort and improves inter-rater reliability by leveraging uncertainty estimation. It is applied to ranking datasets in medical imaging, historical dating, and aesthetics.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Dodgersort，一种VLM引导的主动学习方法，用于成对排序。该方法利用不确定性估计来减少标注工作量并提高评分者间一致性，并应用于医学影像、历史年代和美学领域的排序数据集。

title: SWE-Next: Scalable Real-World Software Engineering Tasks for Agents
summary: Executable software engineering data is valuable for training SWE agents, but scaling it remains difficult for two reasons: only a small fraction of real repository changes yield verifiable, high-signal task instances, and naively building repository-specific environments quickly becomes the dominant systems cost. We present SWE-Next, an execution-grounded framework for scalable SWE task and trajectory collection. On the data side, SWE-Next mines real merged pull requests, executes candidate base/merged commit pairs, and retains only those that produce strict test improvements without regressions, yielding self-verifying instances. It also applies strict submission gating so that collected trajectories remain evidence-driven rather than speculative. On the systems side, SWE-Next introduces reusable repo-quarter profiles, which reuse the same environment across nearby commits in time while keeping each task run separate and reproducible. Using only 30 hours and 639GB of environment storage, SWE-Next processes 3,971 seed repositories and 102,582 candidate commit pairs mined from real merged PRs to construct a dataset of 2,308 self-verifying instances. Experiments show that SWE-Next improves downstream pass@1 with fewer or comparable training trajectories, indicating that its gains come not from a stronger trajectory generator, but from higher-signal execution-grounded supervision and more efficient data collection.
summary_zh: 可执行的软件工程数据对于训练软件工程智能体至关重要，但扩展这种数据仍然面临两个难题：真实仓库变更中只有一小部分能够产生可验证、高信噪比的任务实例，并且粗放地构建特定仓库环境很快就会成为主要的系统成本。我们提出了SWE-Next，一个基于执行的框架，用于可扩展的软件工程任务和轨迹收集。在数据方面，SWE-Next挖掘真实的合并拉取请求，执行候选的基准/合并提交对，并且仅保留那些产生严格测试改进而没有回归的提交对，从而产生自验证的实例。它还应用了严格的提交门控，以确保收集的轨迹保持为证据驱动，而不是推测性的。在系统方面，SWE-Next引入了可重用的仓库四分位点配置文件，这些配置文件在时间上跨相邻提交重复使用相同的环境，同时保持每个任务运行的独立性和可重现性。SWE-Next仅使用30小时和639GB的环境存储空间，就处理了3,971个种子仓库和从真实合并PR中挖掘的102,582个候选提交对，构建了一个包含2,308个自验证实例的数据集。实验表明，SWE-Next使用更少或相当的训练轨迹即可提高下游pass@1指标，这表明其增益并非来自更强的轨迹生成器，而是来自更高信噪比的基于执行的监督和更高效的数据收集。
tldr: SWE-Next is a framework for scalable collection of high-quality software engineering tasks, focusing on execution-grounded self-verifying instances extracted from real-world repositories with efficient environment management.
tldr_zh: SWE-Next是一个可扩展的软件工程任务高质量数据集收集框架，专注于从真实世界的代码仓库中提取基于执行的、自我验证的实例，并使用高效的环境管理。

title: LLM-Driven Heuristic Synthesis for Industrial Process Control: Lessons from Hot Steel Rolling
summary: Industrial process control demands policies that are interpretable and auditable, requirements that black-box neural policies struggle to meet. We study an LLM-driven heuristic synthesis framework for hot steel rolling, in which a language model iteratively proposes and refines human-readable Python controllers using rich behavioral feedback from a physics-based simulator. The framework combines structured strategic ideation, executable code generation, and per-component feedback across diverse operating conditions to search over control logic for height reduction, interpass time, and rolling velocity. Our first contribution is an auditable controller-synthesis pipeline for industrial process control. The generated controllers are explicit programs accessible to expert review, and we pair them with an automated audit pipeline that formally verifies key safety and monotonicity properties for the best synthesized heuristic. Our second contribution is a principled budget allocation strategy for LLM-driven heuristic search: we show that Luby-style universal restarts -- originally developed for randomized algorithms -- transfer directly to this setting, eliminating the need for problem-specific budget tuning. A single 160-iteration Luby campaign approaches the hindsight-optimal budget allocation derived from 52 ad-hoc runs totalling 730 iterations.
summary_zh: 工业过程控制需要可解释和可审计的策略，而黑盒神经策略难以满足这些要求。我们研究了一种基于大型语言模型（LLM）的热轧钢材启发式合成框架，其中语言模型使用来自基于物理模拟器的丰富行为反馈，迭代地提出和改进人类可读的Python控制器。该框架结合了结构化的战略构想、可执行的代码生成以及跨不同操作条件的组件级反馈，以搜索用于压下量、道间时间和轧制速度的控制逻辑。我们的第一个贡献是一个用于工业过程控制的可审计控制器合成流程。生成的控制器是专家审查人员可以访问的显式程序，并且我们将它们与一个自动化的审计流程配对，该流程正式验证最佳合成启发式的关键安全性和单调性属性。我们的第二个贡献是为LLM驱动的启发式搜索提供一种有原则的预算分配策略：我们表明，Luby风格的通用重启——最初为随机算法开发——可以直接转移到此设置中，从而消除了对特定问题预算调整的需求。一次单一的160次迭代的 Luby 活动接近事后最优预算分配，该分配来自总计730次迭代的 52 次特殊运行。
tldr: This paper presents an LLM-driven framework for synthesizing interpretable and auditable controllers for industrial process control, specifically hot steel rolling, and introduces a budget allocation strategy for LLM-driven heuristic search using Luby-style restarts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种由LLM驱动的框架，用于合成可解释和可审计的工业过程控制控制器，特别是热轧钢，并引入了一种使用Luby式重启的LLM驱动的启发式搜索的预算分配策略。

title: Does This Gradient Spark Joy?
summary: Policy gradient computes a backward pass for every sample, even though the backward pass is expensive and most samples carry little learning value. The Delightful Policy Gradient (DG) provides a forward-pass signal of learning value: \emph{delight}, the product of advantage and surprisal (negative log-probability). We introduce the \emph{Kondo gate}, which compares delight against a compute price and pays for a backward pass only when the sample is worth it, thereby tracing a quality--cost Pareto frontier. In bandits, zero-price gating preserves useful gradient signal while removing perpendicular noise, and delight is a more reliable screening signal than additive combinations of value and surprise. On MNIST and transformer token reversal, the Kondo gate skips most backward passes while retaining nearly all of DG's learning quality, with gains that grow as problems get harder and backward passes become more expensive. Because the gate tolerates approximate delight, a cheap forward pass can screen samples before expensive backpropagation, suggesting a speculative-decoding-for-training paradigm.
summary_zh: 策略梯度对每个样本都进行反向传播，即使反向传播代价高昂，且大多数样本的学习价值很小。“Delightful Policy Gradient (DG)”算法提供了一种前向传播的学习价值信号：\emph{delight}，即优势函数和惊讶度（负对数概率）的乘积。我们引入了\emph{Kondo门控}机制，它将delight值与计算代价进行比较，并且仅在样本值得时才支付反向传播的代价，从而追踪质量-成本的帕累托前沿。在多臂赌博机问题中，零代价门控保留了有用的梯度信号，同时消除了垂直噪声，并且delight值是比价值和惊讶度的加性组合更可靠的筛选信号。在 MNIST 数据集和 Transformer 令牌反转任务上，Kondo 门控跳过了大多数反向传播，同时保留了几乎所有 DG 算法的学习质量，并且随着问题难度增加和反向传播变得更加昂贵，增益也会增加。由于门控能够容忍近似的 delight 值，因此廉价的前向传播可以在昂贵的反向传播之前筛选样本，从而提出了一种推测解码用于训练的范式。
tldr: The paper introduces the Delightful Policy Gradient (DG) with a "Kondo gate" that selectively computes backward passes based on a "delight" signal, which is the product of advantage and surprisal, improving efficiency in policy gradient methods by skipping unnecessary computations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为“愉悦策略梯度”（DG）的方法，它使用一个“近藤门”根据“愉悦度”信号（优势函数和惊讶度的乘积）来选择性地计算反向传播，从而通过跳过不必要的计算来提高策略梯度方法的效率。

title: Delightful Distributed Policy Gradient
summary: Distributed reinforcement learning trains on data from stale, buggy, or mismatched actors, producing actions with high surprisal (negative log-probability) under the learner's policy. The core difficulty is not surprising data per se, but \emph{negative learning from surprising data}. High-surprisal failures can dominate the update direction despite carrying little useful signal, while high-surprisal successes reveal opportunities the current policy would otherwise miss. The \textit{Delightful Policy Gradient} (DG) separates these cases by gating each update with delight, the product of advantage and surprisal, suppressing rare failures and amplifying rare successes without behavior probabilities. Under contaminated sampling, the cosine similarity between the standard policy gradient and the true gradient collapses, while DG's grows as the policy improves. No sign-blind reweighting, including exact importance sampling, can reproduce this effect. On MNIST with simulated staleness, DG without off-policy correction outperforms importance-weighted PG with exact behavior probabilities. On a transformer sequence task with staleness, actor bugs, reward corruption, and rare discovery, DG achieves roughly $10{\times}$ lower error. When all four frictions act simultaneously, its compute advantage is order-of-magnitude and grows with task complexity.
summary_zh: 分布式强化学习在来自陈旧、存在缺陷或不匹配的执行者的数据上进行训练，产生在学习者的策略下具有高惊异度（负对数概率）的动作。核心困难并非惊异数据本身，而是\textit{从惊异数据中进行的负学习}。高惊异度的失败可能主导更新方向，尽管它们携带的有用信号很少，而高惊异度的成功则揭示了当前策略原本会错失的机会。\textit{令人愉悦的策略梯度}（DG）通过使用喜悦度（优势函数和惊异度的乘积）对每次更新进行门控来分离这些情况，抑制罕见的失败并放大罕见的成功，而无需行为概率。在受污染的采样下，标准策略梯度与真实梯度之间的余弦相似度会崩溃，而DG的则随着策略的改进而增长。包括精确重要性采样在内的任何盲签名的重新加权都无法重现这种效果。在使用模拟陈旧度的MNIST上，没有离策略校正的DG优于具有精确行为概率的经过重要性加权的PG。在一个具有陈旧度、执行者缺陷、奖励损坏和罕见发现的Transformer序列任务上，DG实现了大约$10{\times}$更低的误差。当所有四种摩擦同时起作用时，DG的计算优势达到了一个数量级，并且随着任务复杂性的增加而增加。
tldr: The paper introduces Delightful Policy Gradient (DG), a method for reinforcement learning that selectively amplifies rare successes and suppresses rare failures in noisy distributed training environments, demonstrating improved performance over importance sampling in the presence of data staleness, bugs, and reward corruption.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为 Delightful Policy Gradient (DG) 的强化学习方法，该方法选择性地放大嘈杂的分布式训练环境中的罕见成功并抑制罕见失败，在存在数据陈旧、错误和奖励腐败的情况下，表现优于重要性采样。

title: CAMA: Exploring Collusive Adversarial Attacks in c-MARL
summary: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (c-MARL) has been widely deployed in real-world applications, such as social robots, embodied intelligence, UAV swarms, etc. Nevertheless, many adversarial attacks still exist to threaten various c-MARL systems. At present, the studies mainly focus on single-adversary perturbation attacks and white-box adversarial attacks that manipulate agents' internal observations or actions. To address these limitations, we in this paper attempt to study collusive adversarial attacks through strategically organizing a set of malicious agents into three collusive attack modes: Collective Malicious Agents, Disguised Malicious Agents, and Spied Malicious Agents. Three novelties are involved: i) three collusive adversarial attacks are creatively proposed for the first time, and a unified framework CAMA for policy-level collusive attacks is designed; ii) the attack effectiveness is theoretically analyzed from the perspectives of disruptiveness, stealthiness, and attack cost; and iii) the three collusive adversarial attacks are technically realized through agent's observation information fusion, attack-trigger control. Finally, multi-facet experiments on four SMAC II maps are performed, and experimental results showcase the three collusive attacks have an additive adversarial synergy, strengthening attack outcome while maintaining high stealthiness and stability over long horizons. Our work fills the gap for collusive adversarial learning in c-MARL.
summary_zh: 合作式多智能体强化学习 (c-MARL) 已广泛应用于社会机器人、具身智能、无人机群等实际应用中。然而，仍然存在许多对抗性攻击威胁着各种 c-MARL 系统。目前，研究主要集中于单一对抗者扰动攻击和白盒对抗性攻击，后者操纵智能体的内部观察或动作。为了解决这些局限性，本文尝试研究共谋对抗性攻击，通过策略性地将一组恶意智能体组织成三种共谋攻击模式：集体恶意智能体、伪装恶意智能体和间谍恶意智能体。本文包含三个创新点：i) 首次创造性地提出了三种共谋对抗性攻击，并设计了一个统一的策略级别共谋攻击框架 CAMA；ii) 从破坏性、隐蔽性和攻击成本的角度对攻击有效性进行了理论分析；iii) 通过智能体的观察信息融合和攻击触发控制，在技术上实现了这三种共谋对抗性攻击。最后，在四个 SMAC II 地图上进行了多方面的实验，实验结果表明，这三种共谋攻击具有累加的对抗协同效应，在增强攻击效果的同时，在较长时间范围内保持高隐蔽性和稳定性。我们的工作填补了 c-MARL 中共谋对抗性学习的空白。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel Collusive Adversarial Multi-Agent (CAMA) attack framework for c-MARL systems, exploring three collusive attack modes and demonstrating their effectiveness in SMAC II environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新颖的协同对抗多智能体（CAMA）攻击框架，用于 c-MARL 系统，探索了三种协同攻击模式，并在 SMAC II 环境中证明了它们的有效性。

title: ALARA for Agents: Least-Privilege Context Engineering Through Portable Composable Multi-Agent Teams
summary: Industry practitioners and academic researchers regularly use multi-agent systems to accelerate their work, yet the frameworks through which these systems operate do not provide a simple, unified mechanism for scalably managing the critical aspects of the agent harness, impacting both the quality of individual human-agent interactions and the capacity for practitioners to coordinate toward common goals through shared agent infrastructure. Agent frameworks have enabled increasingly sophisticated multi-agent systems, but the behavioral specifications that define what these agents can do remain fragmented across prose instruction files, framework-internal configuration, and mechanisms like MCP servers that operate separately from individual agent definitions, making these specifications difficult to share, version, or collaboratively maintain across teams and projects. Applying the ALARA principle from radiation safety (exposures kept as low as reasonably achievable) to agent context, we introduce a declarative context-agent-tool (CAT) data layer expressed through interrelated files that scope each agent's tool access and context to the minimum its role requires, and \texttt{npcsh}, a command-line shell for executing it. Because the system parses and enforces these files structurally, modifying an agent's tool list produces a guaranteed behavioral change rather than a suggestion the model may or may not follow. We evaluate 22 locally-hosted models from 0.6B to 35B parameters across 115 practical tasks spanning file operations, web search, multi-step scripting, tool chaining, and multi-agent delegation, characterizing which model families succeed at which task categories and where they break down across $\sim$2500 total executions.
summary_zh: 行业从业者和学术研究人员经常使用多智能体系统来加速他们的工作，然而，这些系统运行所依赖的框架并没有提供一个简单、统一的机制来可扩展地管理智能体集群的关键方面，这影响了个人人机交互的质量以及从业者通过共享智能体基础设施协调以实现共同目标的能力。智能体框架已经实现了日益复杂的多智能体系统，但是定义这些智能体行为能力的规范仍然分散在散文式的指令文件、框架内部配置以及诸如MCP服务器之类的独立于个体智能体定义运行的机制中，这使得这些规范难以跨团队和项目共享、版本化或协同维护。我们将辐射安全中的ALARA原则（暴露量保持在合理可行的最低水平）应用于智能体上下文，引入了一个通过相互关联的文件表达的声明式上下文-智能体-工具（CAT）数据层，该层将每个智能体的工具访问权限和上下文限制在其角色所需的最小值，以及用于执行该层的命令行shell \texttt{npcsh}。由于系统从结构上解析并执行这些文件，因此修改智能体的工具列表会产生有保证的行为变化，而不是模型可能或可能不遵循的建议。我们评估了来自0.6B到35B参数的22个本地托管模型，涵盖了115个实际任务，包括文件操作、网络搜索、多步脚本编写、工具链式调用和多智能体委派，从而描述了哪些模型家族在哪些任务类别上取得了成功，以及它们在约2500次总执行中在哪些方面崩溃。
tldr: The paper introduces a framework (ALARA with CAT and npcsh) for managing agent tool access and context in multi-agent systems, aiming for safer and more maintainable agent behaviors. It evaluates the system on various tasks and LLMs.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个框架（ALARA与CAT和npcsh），用于管理多智能体系统中智能体的工具访问和上下文，目标是实现更安全、更易于维护的智能体行为。该系统在各种任务和大型语言模型上进行了评估。

title: Scene Graph-guided SegCaptioning Transformer with Fine-grained Alignment for Controllable Video Segmentation and Captioning
summary: Recent advancements in multimodal large models have significantly bridged the representation gap between diverse modalities, catalyzing the evolution of video multimodal interpretation, which enhances users' understanding of video content by generating correlated modalities. However, most existing video multimodal interpretation methods primarily concentrate on global comprehension with limited user interaction. To address this, we propose a novel task, Controllable Video Segmentation and Captioning (SegCaptioning), which empowers users to provide specific prompts, such as a bounding box around an object of interest, to simultaneously generate correlated masks and captions that precisely embody user intent. An innovative framework Scene Graph-guided Fine-grained SegCaptioning Transformer (SG-FSCFormer) is designed that integrates a Prompt-guided Temporal Graph Former to effectively captures and represents user intent through an adaptive prompt adaptor, ensuring that the generated content well aligns with the user's requirements. Furthermore, our model introduces a Fine-grained Mask-linguistic Decoder to collaboratively predict high-quality caption-mask pairs using a Multi-entity Contrastive loss, as well as provide fine-grained alignment between each mask and its corresponding caption tokens, thereby enhancing users' comprehension of videos. Comprehensive experiments conducted on two benchmark datasets demonstrate that SG-FSCFormer achieves remarkable performance, effectively capturing user intent and generating precise multimodal outputs tailored to user specifications. Our code is available at https://github.com/XuZhang1211/SG-FSCFormer.
summary_zh: 多模态大型模型领域的最新进展显著弥合了不同模态之间的表征差距，催化了视频多模态解释的演变，它通过生成相关的模态来增强用户对视频内容的理解。然而，现有的大多数视频多模态解释方法主要集中于全局理解，并且用户交互有限。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一项新颖的任务，即可控视频分割和描述（SegCaptioning），它赋予用户提供特定提示的能力，例如围绕感兴趣对象的一个边界框，以便同时生成与用户意图精确相关的掩码和描述。我们设计了一个创新的框架，即场景图引导的细粒度SegCaptioning Transformer (SG-FSCFormer)，该框架集成了一个提示引导的时序图Transformer，通过自适应提示适配器有效地捕获和表示用户的意图，确保生成的内容与用户的需求良好对齐。此外，我们的模型引入了一个细粒度掩码-语言解码器，利用多实体对比损失协同预测高质量的描述-掩码对，并且提供每个掩码及其对应的描述tokens之间的细粒度对齐，从而增强用户对视频的理解。在两个基准数据集上进行的全面实验表明，SG-FSCFormer取得了显著的性能，有效地捕获了用户意图，并生成了根据用户规范定制的精确多模态输出。我们的代码可在https://github.com/XuZhang1211/SG-FSCFormer上获取。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel task, Controllable Video Segmentation and Captioning (SegCaptioning), and proposes SG-FSCFormer, a Scene Graph-guided Transformer, to generate correlated masks and captions from user-provided prompts, demonstrating improved performance on benchmark datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一项新任务，即可控视频分割和字幕生成（SegCaptioning），并提出了SG-FSCFormer，一个场景图引导的Transformer，用于从用户提供的提示生成相关的掩码和字幕，并在基准数据集上展示了更好的性能。

title: PiLoT: Neural Pixel-to-3D Registration for UAV-based Ego and Target Geo-localization
summary: We present PiLoT, a unified framework that tackles UAV-based ego and target geo-localization. Conventional approaches rely on decoupled pipelines that fuse GNSS and Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO) for ego-pose estimation, and active sensors like laser rangefinders for target localization. However, these methods are susceptible to failure in GNSS-denied environments and incur substantial hardware costs and complexity. PiLoT breaks this paradigm by directly registering live video stream against a geo-referenced 3D map. To achieve robust, accurate, and real-time performance, we introduce three key contributions: 1) a Dual-Thread Engine that decouples map rendering from core localization thread, ensuring both low latency while maintaining drift-free accuracy; 2) a large-scale synthetic dataset with precise geometric annotations (camera pose, depth maps). This dataset enables the training of a lightweight network that generalizes in a zero-shot manner from simulation to real data; and 3) a Joint Neural-Guided Stochastic-Gradient Optimizer (JNGO) that achieves robust convergence even under aggressive motion. Evaluations on a comprehensive set of public and newly collected benchmarks show that PiLoT outperforms state-of-the-art methods while running over 25 FPS on NVIDIA Jetson Orin platform. Our code and dataset is available at: https://github.com/Choyaa/PiLoT.
summary_zh: 我们提出了PiLoT，一个用于解决基于无人机的自身和目标地理定位的统一框架。传统方法依赖于解耦的流程，融合GNSS和视觉惯性里程计（VIO）以进行自身姿态估计，并使用诸如激光测距仪等主动传感器进行目标定位。然而，这些方法在GNSS拒止环境中容易失效，并且会产生大量的硬件成本和复杂性。PiLoT通过直接将实时视频流与地理参考3D地图进行配准，打破了这一范式。为了实现稳健、准确和实时的性能，我们引入了三个关键贡献：1) 一个双线程引擎，将地图渲染与核心定位线程解耦，确保低延迟的同时保持无漂移的精度；2) 一个具有精确几何标注（相机姿态、深度图）的大规模合成数据集。该数据集能够在零样本方式下，从模拟到真实数据泛化地训练一个轻量级网络；3) 一个联合神经引导的随机梯度优化器（JNGO），即使在剧烈运动下也能实现稳健的收敛。在全面的公开和新收集的benchmark上的评估表明，PiLoT优于最先进的方法，同时在NVIDIA Jetson Orin平台上以超过25 FPS的速度运行。我们的代码和数据集可在以下网址获得：https://github.com/Choyaa/PiLoT.
tldr: PiLoT is a UAV-based ego and target geo-localization framework that registers live video streams against a geo-referenced 3D map using a neural network and optimization techniques, demonstrating real-time performance in GNSS-denied environments.
tldr_zh: PiLoT是一个基于无人机的自我和目标地理定位框架，它使用神经网络和优化技术将实时视频流与地理参考的3D地图进行注册，在GNSS受限环境中展示了实时性能。

title: Reinforcement Learning from Multi-Source Imperfect Preferences: Best-of-Both-Regimes Regret
summary: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) replaces hard-to-specify rewards with pairwise trajectory preferences, yet regret-oriented theory often assumes that preference labels are generated consistently from a single ground-truth objective. In practical RLHF systems, however, feedback is typically \emph{multi-source} (annotators, experts, reward models, heuristics) and can exhibit systematic, persistent mismatches due to subjectivity, expertise variation, and annotation/modeling artifacts. We study episodic RL from \emph{multi-source imperfect preferences} through a cumulative imperfection budget: for each source, the total deviation of its preference probabilities from an ideal oracle is at most $ω$ over $K$ episodes. We propose a unified algorithm with regret $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{K/M}+ω)$, which exhibits a best-of-both-regimes behavior: it achieves $M$-dependent statistical gains when imperfection is small (where $M$ is the number of sources), while remaining robust with unavoidable additive dependence on $ω$ when imperfection is large. We complement this with a lower bound $\tildeΩ(\max\{\sqrt{K/M},ω\})$, which captures the best possible improvement with respect to $M$ and the unavoidable dependence on $ω$, and a counterexample showing that naïvely treating imperfect feedback as as oracle-consistent can incur regret as large as $\tildeΩ(\min\{ω\sqrt{K},K\})$. Technically, our approach involves imperfection-adaptive weighted comparison learning, value-targeted transition estimation to control hidden feedback-induced distribution shift, and sub-importance sampling to keep the weighted objectives analyzable, yielding regret guarantees that quantify when multi-source feedback provably improves RLHF and how cumulative imperfection fundamentally limits it.
summary_zh: 从人类反馈中进行强化学习（RLHF）使用成对轨迹偏好代替难以明确定义的奖励，然而，面向后悔的理论通常假设偏好标签是从单一真实目标一致生成的。但在实际的 RLHF 系统中，反馈通常是\emph{多源的}（标注员、专家、奖励模型、启发式方法），并且会由于主观性、专业知识差异和标注/建模的人为因素而表现出系统性的、持续的不匹配。我们通过累积的不完美预算研究了 \emph{多源不完美偏好} 的情景强化学习：对于每个来源，其偏好概率与理想神谕之间的总偏差在 $K$ 个情节中最多为 $ω$。我们提出了一种统一的算法，其后悔值为 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{K/M}+ω)$，该算法表现出两全其美的行为：当不完美性较小时，它实现了依赖于 $M$ 的统计增益（其中 $M$ 是来源数量），而当不完美性较大时，它仍然具有难以避免的对 $ω$ 的加性依赖性。我们通过下界 $\tildeΩ(\max\{\sqrt{K/M},ω\})$ 对此进行了补充，该下界捕捉了关于 $M$ 的最佳改进和对 $ω$ 的不可避免的依赖性，以及一个反例，表明天真地将不完美的反馈视为神谕一致可能会导致高达 $\tildeΩ(\min\{ω\sqrt{K},K\})$ 的后悔值。在技术上，我们的方法包括不完美性自适应加权比较学习、价值目标转移估计以控制隐藏的反馈引起的分布偏移，以及子重要性采样以保持加权目标的可分析性，从而产生量化多源反馈何时可证明地改进 RLHF 以及累积不完美性从根本上限制其的后悔保证。
tldr: This paper studies reinforcement learning from multi-source imperfect preferences, providing a unified algorithm with a regret bound that balances statistical gains and robustness to imperfection. It offers theoretical analysis and a lower bound to quantify the limits of multi-source feedback in RLHF.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了来自多源不完善偏好的强化学习，提出了一种统一的算法，该算法具有权衡统计增益和对不完善的鲁棒性的遗憾界限。它提供了理论分析和下限，以量化多源反馈在RLHF中的局限性。

title: TRGS-SLAM: IMU-Aided Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Blurry, Rolling Shutter, and Noisy Thermal Images
summary: Thermal cameras offer several advantages for simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) with mobile robots: they provide a passive, low-power solution to operating in darkness, are invariant to rapidly changing or high dynamic range illumination, and can see through fog, dust, and smoke. However, uncooled microbolometer thermal cameras, the only practical option in most robotics applications, suffer from significant motion blur, rolling shutter distortions, and fixed pattern noise. In this paper, we present TRGS-SLAM, a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) based thermal inertial SLAM system uniquely capable of handling these degradations. To overcome the challenges of thermal data, we introduce a model-aware 3DGS rendering method and several general innovations to 3DGS SLAM, including B-spline trajectory optimization with a two-stage IMU loss, view-diversity-based opacity resetting, and pose drift correction schemes. Our system demonstrates accurate tracking on real-world, fast motion, and high-noise thermal data that causes all other tested SLAM methods to fail. Moreover, through offline refinement of our SLAM results, we demonstrate thermal image restoration competitive with prior work that required ground truth poses.
summary_zh: 热成像相机为移动机器人的同步定位与建图（SLAM）提供了诸多优势：它们提供了一种被动的、低功耗的方案，可在黑暗环境中运行，对快速变化或高动态范围的光照具有不变性，并且能够穿透雾、尘和烟。然而，非制冷微测辐射热计热成像相机是大多数机器人应用中唯一的实用选择，其弊端在于存在显著的运动模糊、卷帘快门畸变和固定模式噪声。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于3D高斯溅射（3DGS）的热惯性SLAM系统TRGS-SLAM，它能够独特地处理这些退化现象。为了克服热数据带来的挑战，我们引入了一种模型感知的3DGS渲染方法和几项针对3DGS SLAM的通用创新，包括具有两阶段IMU损失的B样条轨迹优化、基于视图多样性的不透明度重置以及姿态漂移校正方案。我们的系统在真实世界的快速运动和高噪声热数据上展示了精确的跟踪效果，而所有其他测试的SLAM方法均无法胜任。此外，通过对我们的SLAM结果进行离线优化，我们展示了与以往需要真值姿态的工作相比，具有竞争力的热图像复原效果。
tldr: This paper presents TRGS-SLAM, a novel 3D Gaussian Splatting based SLAM system designed specifically for thermal images suffering from motion blur, rolling shutter, and noise, demonstrating superior performance compared to existing SLAM methods in challenging thermal imaging scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 TRGS-SLAM，一种基于 3D 高斯溅射的新型 SLAM 系统，专门设计用于处理存在运动模糊、卷帘快门和噪声问题的热图像。该系统在具有挑战性的热成像场景中展示了优于现有 SLAM 方法的性能。

title: RayMap3R: Inference-Time RayMap for Dynamic 3D Reconstruction
summary: Streaming feed-forward 3D reconstruction enables real-time joint estimation of scene geometry and camera poses from RGB images. However, without explicit dynamic reasoning, streaming models can be affected by moving objects, causing artifacts and drift. In this work, we propose RayMap3R, a training-free streaming framework for dynamic scene reconstruction. We observe that RayMap-based predictions exhibit a static-scene bias, providing an internal cue for dynamic identification. Based on this observation, we construct a dual-branch inference scheme that identifies dynamic regions by contrasting RayMap and image predictions, suppressing their interference during memory updates. We further introduce reset metric alignment and state-aware smoothing to preserve metric consistency and stabilize predicted trajectories. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance among streaming approaches on dynamic scene reconstruction across multiple benchmarks.
summary_zh: 流式前馈3D重建能够从RGB图像中实时联合估计场景几何结构和相机位姿。然而，在没有明确动态推理的情况下，流式模型会受到移动物体的影响，导致伪影和漂移。在这项工作中，我们提出了RayMap3R，一种用于动态场景重建的无需训练的流式框架。我们观察到基于RayMap的预测表现出静态场景偏差，为动态识别提供了一个内部线索。基于此观察，我们构建了一个双分支推理方案，通过对比RayMap和图像预测来识别动态区域，从而抑制它们在内存更新过程中的干扰。我们进一步引入了重置度量对齐和状态感知平滑，以保持度量一致性并稳定预测轨迹。我们的方法在多个基准测试中，在动态场景重建的流式方法中实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: RayMap3R is a training-free streaming framework for dynamic scene reconstruction that leverages static-scene bias in RayMap predictions to identify and suppress dynamic regions, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: RayMap3R 是一种无需训练的动态场景重建流式框架，它利用 RayMap 预测中的静态场景偏差来识别和抑制动态区域，从而实现最先进的性能。

title: Characterizing the onset and offset of motor imagery during passive arm movements induced by an upper-body exoskeleton
summary: Two distinct technologies have gained attention lately due to their prospects for motor rehabilitation: robotics and brain-machine interfaces (BMIs). Harnessing their combined efforts is a largely uncharted and promising direction that has immense clinical potential. However, a significant challenge is whether motor intentions from the user can be accurately detected using non-invasive BMIs in the presence of instrumental noise and passive movements induced by the rehabilitation exoskeleton. As an alternative to the straightforward continuous control approach, this study instead aims to characterize the onset and offset of motor imagery during passive arm movements induced by an upper-body exoskeleton to allow for the natural control (initiation and termination) of functional movements. Ten participants were recruited to perform kinesthetic motor imagery (MI) of the right arm while attached to the robot, simultaneously cued with LEDs indicating the initiation and termination of a goal-oriented reaching task. Using electroencephalogram signals, we built a decoder to detect the transition between i) rest and beginning MI and ii) maintaining and ending MI. Offline decoder evaluation achieved group average onset accuracy of 60.7% and 66.6% for offset accuracy, revealing that the start and stop of MI could be identified while attached to the robot. Furthermore, pseudo-online evaluation could replicate this performance, forecasting reliable online exoskeleton control in the future. Our approach showed that participants could produce quality and reliable sensorimotor rhythms regardless of noise or passive arm movements induced by wearing the exoskeleton, which opens new possibilities for BMI control of assistive devices.
summary_zh: 机器人技术和脑机接口（BMI）这两种截然不同的技术，由于其在运动功能康复方面的潜力，近来备受关注。结合它们各自的优势是一个很大程度上未被探索但极具前景的方向，具有巨大的临床潜力。然而，一个重要的挑战是，在仪器噪声和康复外骨骼引起的被动运动存在的情况下，是否可以使用非侵入式BMI准确检测用户的运动意图。本研究没有采用直接的连续控制方法，而是旨在表征由上肢外骨骼诱导的被动手臂运动期间运动意象（MI）的开始和结束，从而实现功能性运动的自然控制（启动和终止）。招募了十名参与者，他们在连接到机器人时进行右臂的动觉运动意象（MI），同时通过LED提示目标导向的抓取任务的开始和结束。利用脑电图信号，我们构建了一个解码器来检测i）静息状态和运动意象开始之间以及 ii）保持运动意象和运动意象结束之间的转换。离线解码器评估实现了组平均开始准确率60.7%和结束准确率66.6%，表明在连接到机器人时可以识别运动意象的启动和停止。此外，伪在线评估可以重现这种性能，预测了未来可靠的在线外骨骼控制。我们的方法表明，参与者可以产生高质量且可靠的感觉运动节律，而与穿戴外骨骼引起的噪声或被动手臂运动无关，这为辅助设备的脑机接口控制开辟了新的可能性。
tldr: This paper investigates the detection of motor imagery (MI) onset and offset using EEG signals during passive arm movements induced by an exoskeleton, achieving moderate accuracy and suggesting feasibility for BMI control of assistive devices.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了在由外骨骼诱导的被动手臂运动期间，使用脑电信号检测运动想象（MI）的开始和结束，实现了中等精度，并表明了辅助设备BMI控制的可行性。

title: PlanaReLoc: Camera Relocalization in 3D Planar Primitives via Region-Based Structure Matching
summary: While structure-based relocalizers have long strived for point correspondences when establishing or regressing query-map associations, in this paper, we pioneer the use of planar primitives and 3D planar maps for lightweight 6-DoF camera relocalization in structured environments. Planar primitives, beyond being fundamental entities in projective geometry, also serve as region-based representations that encapsulate both structural and semantic richness. This motivates us to introduce PlanaReLoc, a streamlined plane-centric paradigm where a deep matcher associates planar primitives across the query image and the map within a learned unified embedding space, after which the 6-DoF pose is solved and refined under a robust framework. Through comprehensive experiments on the ScanNet and 12Scenes datasets across hundreds of scenes, our method demonstrates the superiority of planar primitives in facilitating reliable cross-modal structural correspondences and achieving effective camera relocalization without requiring realistically textured/colored maps, pose priors, or per-scene training.
