We conduct experiments on two benchmarks and real-world free-moving articulated objects. Experimental results demonstrate that FreeArtGS consistently excels in reconstructing free-moving articulated objects and remains highly competitive in previous reconstruction settings, proving itself a practical and effective solution for realistic asset generation. The project page is available at: https://freeartgs.github.io/
summary_zh: 增强现实和机器人技术日益增长的需求推动了对具有高扩展性的铰接物体重建的需求。然而，现有的从离散铰接状态或随意单目视频进行重建的方法需要复杂的轴对齐，或者覆盖范围不足，限制了它们的适用性。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为FreeArtGS的新方法，用于在自由移动场景下重建铰接物体。自由移动场景是一种设置简单且具有高扩展性的新设置。FreeArtGS结合了自由移动部件分割、关节估计和端到端优化，仅需单目RGB-D视频作为输入。通过利用现成的点追踪和特征模型的先验进行优化，自由移动部件分割模块可以识别在非约束捕获下由相对运动产生的刚性部件。关节估计模块校准统一的物体到相机姿态，并从部件分割中稳健地恢复关节类型和轴。最后，基于3DGS的端到端优化被用于联合重建铰接物体的视觉纹理、几何形状和关节角度。我们在两个基准数据集和真实世界的自由移动铰接物体上进行了实验。实验结果表明，FreeArtGS在重建自由移动铰接物体方面始终表现出色，并且在以前的重建设置中也保持了很强的竞争力，证明了其作为现实资产生成实用且有效的解决方案。项目主页：https://freeartgs.github.io/
tldr: FreeArtGS introduces a novel method for reconstructing articulated objects from monocular RGB-D videos under free-moving scenarios, combining part segmentation, joint estimation, and Gaussian Splatting-based optimization.
tldr_zh: FreeArtGS 提出了一种新的方法，用于在自由移动场景下，从单目 RGB-D 视频中重建铰接物体。该方法结合了部件分割、关节估计和基于高斯溅射的优化。

title: Disengagement Analysis and Field Tests of a Prototypical Open-Source Level 4 Autonomous Driving System
summary: Proprietary Autonomous Driving Systems are typically evaluated through disengagements, unplanned manual interventions to alter vehicle behavior, as annually reported by the California Department of Motor Vehicles. However, the real-world capabilities of prototypical open-source Level 4 vehicles over substantial distances remain largely unexplored. This study evaluates a research vehicle running an Autoware-based software stack across 236 km of mixed traffic. By classifying 30 disengagements across 26 rides with a novel five-level criticality framework, we observed a spatial disengagement rate of 0.127 1/km. Interventions predominantly occurred at lower speeds near static objects and traffic lights. Perception and Planning failures accounted for 40% and 26.7% of disengagements, respectively, largely due to object-tracking losses and operational deadlocks caused by parked vehicles. Frequent, unnecessary interventions highlighted a lack of trust on the part of the safety driver. These results show that while open-source software enables extensive operations, disengagement analysis is vital for uncovering robustness issues missed by standard metrics.
summary_zh: 专有自动驾驶系统通常通过脱离（disengagement）来评估，即对车辆行为进行未经计划的人工干预，加州机动车辆管理局每年都会报告此类数据。然而，原型开源四级自动驾驶车辆在长距离行驶中的实际能力仍然在很大程度上未被探索。本研究评估了一辆运行基于Autoware软件栈的研究车辆在236公里混合交通场景下的表现。通过使用一种新的五级严重性框架对26次行驶中的30次脱离进行分类，我们观察到空间脱离率为0.127 1/公里。干预主要发生在接近静态物体和红绿灯的低速区域。感知和规划失效分别占脱离的40%和26.7%，主要原因是物体跟踪丢失和因停放车辆导致的操作死锁。频繁且不必要的干预凸显了安全员缺乏信任。这些结果表明，虽然开源软件能够实现广泛的操作，但脱离分析对于揭示标准指标遗漏的鲁棒性问题至关重要。
tldr: This paper analyzes disengagements in a Level 4 open-source autonomous driving system during field tests, identifying failure modes and highlighting the importance of disengagement analysis for robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了在Level 4开源自动驾驶系统现场测试中的脱离情况，识别了故障模式，并强调了脱离分析对于系统鲁棒性的重要性。

title: Memory-Efficient Boundary Map for Large-Scale Occupancy Grid Mapping
summary: Determining the occupancy status of locations in the environment is a fundamental task for safety-critical robotic applications. Traditional occupancy grid mapping methods subdivide the environment into a grid of voxels, each associated with one of three occupancy states: free, occupied, or unknown. These methods explicitly maintain all voxels within the mapped volume and determine the occupancy state of a location by directly querying the corresponding voxel that the location falls within. However, maintaining all grid voxels in high-resolution and large-scale scenarios requires substantial memory resources. In this paper, we introduce a novel representation that only maintains the boundary of the mapped volume. Specifically, we explicitly represent the boundary voxels, such as the occupied voxels and frontier voxels, while free and unknown voxels are automatically represented by volumes within or outside the boundary, respectively. As our representation maintains only a closed surface in two-dimensional (2D) space, instead of the entire volume in three-dimensional (3D) space, it significantly reduces memory consumption. Then, based on this 2D representation, we propose a method to determine the occupancy state of arbitrary locations in the 3D environment. We term this method as boundary map. Besides, we design a novel data structure for maintaining the boundary map, supporting efficient occupancy state queries. Theoretical analyses of the occupancy state query algorithm are also provided. Furthermore, to enable efficient construction and updates of the boundary map from the real-time sensor measurements, we propose a global-local mapping framework and corresponding update algorithms. Finally, we will make our implementation of the boundary map open-source on GitHub to benefit the community:https://github.com/hku-mars/BDM.
summary_zh: 确定环境中位置的占据状态是安全攸关型机器人应用的一项基本任务。传统的占据栅格地图构建方法将环境细分为体素网格，每个体素关联三种占据状态之一：自由、占据或未知。这些方法显式地维护映射体量内的所有体素，并通过直接查询位置所在的对应体素来确定该位置的占据状态。然而，在高分辨率和大规模场景中维护所有栅格体素需要大量的内存资源。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的表示方法，它仅维护映射体量的边界。具体来说，我们显式地表示边界体素，例如被占据的体素和边界体素，而自由和未知的体素分别通过边界内部或外部的体量自动表示。由于我们的表示方法仅在二维（2D）空间中维护一个闭合曲面，而不是在三维（3D）空间中的整个体量，因此它显著降低了内存消耗。然后，基于这种二维表示，我们提出了一种确定三维环境中任意位置占据状态的方法。我们将此方法称为边界地图。此外，我们还设计了一种新的数据结构来维护边界地图，支持高效的占据状态查询。同时提供了占据状态查询算法的理论分析。此外，为了能够从实时传感器测量数据中高效地构建和更新边界地图，我们提出了一种全局-局部地图构建框架和相应的更新算法。最后，我们将在GitHub上开源边界地图的实现，以造福于社区：https://github.com/hku-mars/BDM。
tldr: This paper introduces a memory-efficient occupancy grid mapping method called "boundary map" that only maintains the boundaries of the mapped volume, reducing memory consumption in large-scale scenarios and enabling efficient occupancy state queries.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为“边界地图”的内存高效占用栅格地图构建方法，该方法仅维护映射体积的边界，从而减少了大规模场景中的内存消耗，并实现了高效的占用状态查询。

title: RTD-RAX: Fast, Safe Trajectory Planning for Systems under Unknown Disturbances
summary: Reachability-based Trajectory Design (RTD) is a provably safe, real-time trajectory planning framework that combines offline reachable-set computation with online trajectory optimization. However, standard RTD implementations suffer from two key limitations: conservatism induced by worst-case reachable-set overapproximations, and an inability to account for real-time disturbances during execution. This paper presents RTD-RAX, a runtime-assurance extension of RTD that utilizes a non-conservative RTD formulation to rapidly generate goal-directed candidate trajectories, and utilizes mixed monotone reachability for fast, disturbance-aware online safety certification. When proposed trajectories fail safety certification under real-time uncertainty, a repair procedure finds nearby safe trajectories that preserve progress toward the goal while guaranteeing safety under real-time disturbances.
summary_zh: 基于可达性的轨迹设计(RTD)是一种可证明安全、实时的轨迹规划框架，它将离线可达集计算与在线轨迹优化相结合。然而，标准的RTD实现存在两个关键限制：由最坏情况可达集过度近似引起的保守性，以及无法考虑执行过程中的实时扰动。本文提出了RTD-RAX，一种RTD的运行时保障扩展，它利用非保守的RTD公式快速生成以目标为导向的候选轨迹，并利用混合单调可达性进行快速、感知扰动的在线安全认证。当提出的轨迹在实时不确定性下未能通过安全认证时，修复程序会找到附近的、安全的轨迹，这些轨迹在保证实时扰动下的安全性的同时，保持朝向目标的进展。
tldr: The paper introduces RTD-RAX, an extension of Reachability-based Trajectory Design (RTD) that addresses conservatism and real-time disturbance handling through non-conservative trajectory generation and disturbance-aware online safety certification, thus enabling fast and safe trajectory planning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RTD-RAX，它是可达性轨迹设计（RTD）的扩展，通过非保守的轨迹生成和干扰感知的在线安全认证，解决了保守性和实时干扰处理问题，从而实现了快速且安全的轨迹规划。

title: LRC-WeatherNet: LiDAR, RADAR, and Camera Fusion Network for Real-time Weather-type Classification in Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous vehicles face major perception and navigation challenges in adverse weather such as rain, fog, and snow, which degrade the performance of LiDAR, RADAR, and RGB camera sensors. While each sensor type offers unique strengths, such as RADAR robustness in poor visibility and LiDAR precision in clear conditions, they also suffer distinct limitations when exposed to environmental obstructions. This study proposes LRC-WeatherNet, a novel multi-sensor fusion framework that integrates LiDAR, RADAR, and camera data for real-time classification of weather conditions. By employing both early fusion using a unified Bird's Eye View representation and mid-level gated fusion of modality-specific feature maps, our approach adapts to the varying reliability of each sensor under changing weather. Evaluated on the extensive MSU-4S dataset covering nine weather types, LRC-WeatherNet achieves superior classification performance and computational efficiency, significantly outperforming unimodal baselines in adverse conditions. This work is the first to combine all three modalities for robust, real-time weather classification in autonomous driving. We release our trained models and source code in https://github.com/nouralhudaalbashir/LRC-WeatherNet.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶车辆在雨、雾和雪等恶劣天气中面临着感知和导航方面的重大挑战，这些天气会降低激光雷达、雷达和 RGB 相机传感器的性能。虽然每种传感器类型都具有独特的优势，例如雷达在低能见度下的鲁棒性和激光雷达在晴朗条件下的精确度，但它们在暴露于环境障碍物时也会受到明显的限制。本研究提出了一种新的多传感器融合框架 LRC-WeatherNet，该框架集成了激光雷达、雷达和相机数据，用于实时分类天气状况。通过采用统一的鸟瞰图表示的早期融合以及模态特定特征图的中层门控融合，我们的方法能够适应于每个传感器在不断变化的天气条件下的不同可靠性。在涵盖九种天气类型的广泛的 MSU-4S 数据集上进行评估后，LRC-WeatherNet 实现了卓越的分类性能和计算效率，在恶劣条件下显著优于单模态基线。这项工作是首次将所有三种模态结合起来，用于自动驾驶中鲁棒、实时的天气分类。我们将在 https://github.com/nouralhudaalbashir/LRC-WeatherNet 发布我们训练好的模型和源代码。
tldr: The paper introduces LRC-WeatherNet, a multi-sensor fusion framework (LiDAR, RADAR, camera) for real-time weather classification in autonomous driving, achieving superior performance on the MSU-4S dataset. They are releasing the code and trained models.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了LRC-WeatherNet，一个多传感器融合框架（激光雷达、雷达、相机），用于自动驾驶中的实时天气分类，并在MSU-4S数据集上实现了卓越的性能。他们发布了代码和训练好的模型。

title: Agentic Personas for Adaptive Scientific Explanations with Knowledge Graphs
summary:
AI explanation methods often assume a static user model, producing non-adaptive explanations regardless of expert goals, reasoning strategies, or decision contexts. Knowledge graph-based explanations, despite their capacity for grounded, path-based reasoning, inherit this limitation. In complex domains such as scientific discovery, this assumption fails to capture the diversity of cognitive strategies and epistemic stances among experts, preventing explanations that foster deeper understanding and informed decision-making. However, the scarcity of human experts limits the use of direct human feedback to produce adaptive explanations.
  We present a reinforcement learning approach for scientific explanation generation that incorporates agentic personas, structured representations of expert reasoning strategies, that guide the explanation agent towards specific epistemic preferences. In an evaluation of knowledge graph-based explanations for drug discovery, we tested two personas that capture distinct epistemic stances derived from expert feedback.
  Results show that persona-driven explanations match state-of-the-art predictive performance while persona preferences closely align with those of their corresponding experts. Adaptive explanations were consistently preferred over non-adaptive baselines (n = 22), and persona-based training reduces feedback requirements by two orders of magnitude. These findings demonstrate how agentic personas enable scalable adaptive explainability for AI systems in complex and high-stakes domains.
summary_zh:
人工智能解释方法通常假定一个静态用户模型，产生非自适应的解释，而不考虑专家目标、推理策略或决策背景。基于知识图谱的解释，尽管其具备基于路径的扎根推理能力，也继承了这一局限性。在科学发现等复杂领域，这种假设无法捕捉专家之间认知策略和认知立场的多样性，从而阻碍了促进更深层次理解和知情决策的解释。然而，人类专家的稀缺性限制了使用直接的人工反馈来产生自适应解释。

我们提出了一种用于科学解释生成的强化学习方法，该方法融合了主体性人物角色，即专家推理策略的结构化表示，引导解释代理朝着特定的认知偏好发展。在对药物发现的基于知识图谱的解释的评估中，我们测试了两种人物角色，它们捕捉了源自专家反馈的截然不同的认知立场。

结果表明，人物角色驱动的解释在保持最先进预测性能的同时，人物角色偏好与其对应的专家偏好紧密一致。自适应解释始终优于非自适应基线（n = 22），并且基于人物角色的训练将反馈需求降低了两个数量级。这些发现表明，在复杂且高风险的领域，主体性人物角色如何为人工智能系统实现可扩展的自适应可解释性。
tldr: The paper introduces a reinforcement learning approach using "agentic personas" to generate adaptive scientific explanations from knowledge graphs, tailored to different expert reasoning strategies in drug discovery. This method reduces the need for extensive human feedback and improves explanation preference compared to non-adaptive baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种使用“智能角色”的强化学习方法，用于从知识图中生成自适应的科学解释，这些解释是根据药物发现中不同专家的推理策略量身定制的。此方法减少了对大量人工反馈的需求，并提高了与非自适应基线相比的解释偏好。

title: The Golden Subspace: Where Efficiency Meets Generalization in Continual Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) aims to enable models to adapt online to unlabeled data streams under distribution shift without accessing source data. Existing CTTA methods face an efficiency-generalization trade-off: updating more parameters improves adaptation but severely reduces online inference efficiency. An ideal solution is to achieve comparable adaptation with minimal feature updates; we call this minimal subspace the golden subspace. We prove its existence in a single-step adaptation setting and show that it coincides with the row space of the pretrained classifier. To enable online maintenance of this subspace, we introduce the sample-wise Average Gradient Outer Product (AGOP) as an efficient proxy for estimating the classifier weights without retraining. Building on these insights, we propose Guided Online Low-rank Directional adaptation (GOLD), which uses a lightweight adapter to project features onto the golden subspace and learns a compact scaling vector while the subspace is dynamically updated via AGOP. Extensive experiments on classification and segmentation benchmarks, including autonomous-driving scenarios, demonstrate that GOLD attains superior efficiency, stability, and overall performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/AIGNLAI/GOLD.
summary_zh: 持续测试时自适应 (CTTA) 旨在使模型能够在不访问源数据的情况下，在线适应分布偏移下的无标签数据流。现有的 CTTA 方法面临效率-泛化的权衡：更新更多参数可以改善自适应，但会严重降低在线推理效率。一个理想的解决方案是用最少的特征更新实现相当的自适应；我们将这个最小子空间称为黄金子空间。我们证明了它在单步自适应环境中存在，并表明它与预训练分类器的行空间重合。为了实现对该子空间的在线维护，我们引入了基于样本的平均梯度外积 (AGOP) 作为一种无需重新训练即可有效估计分类器权重的代理。基于这些见解，我们提出了引导式在线低秩定向自适应 (GOLD)，它使用一个轻量级适配器将特征投影到黄金子空间上，并学习一个紧凑的缩放向量，同时通过 AGOP 动态更新子空间。在包括自动驾驶场景在内的各种分类和分割基准测试中进行的大量实验表明，GOLD 获得了卓越的效率、稳定性和整体性能。 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/AIGNLAI/GOLD 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces GOLD, a method for Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) that achieves high efficiency and generalization by adapting models within a learned "golden subspace" derived from classifier weights, demonstrated on classification and segmentation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为GOLD的持续测试时自适应（CTTA）方法，该方法通过在从分类器权重导出的“黄金子空间”中调整模型来实现高效率和泛化性，并在分类和分割任务中进行了演示。

title: FedCVU: Federated Learning for Cross-View Video Understanding
summary: Federated learning (FL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for privacy-preserving multi-camera video understanding. However, applying FL to cross-view scenarios faces three major challenges: (i) heterogeneous viewpoints and backgrounds lead to highly non-IID client distributions and overfitting to view-specific patterns, (ii) local distribution biases cause misaligned representations that hinder consistent cross-view semantics, and (iii) large video architectures incur prohibitive communication overhead. To address these issues, we propose FedCVU, a federated framework with three components: VS-Norm, which preserves normalization parameters to handle view-specific statistics; CV-Align, a lightweight contrastive regularization module to improve cross-view representation alignment; and SLA, a selective layer aggregation strategy that reduces communication without sacrificing accuracy. Extensive experiments on action understanding and person re-identification tasks under a cross-view protocol demonstrate that FedCVU consistently boosts unseen-view accuracy while maintaining strong seen-view performance, outperforming state-of-the-art FL baselines and showing robustness to domain heterogeneity and communication constraints.
summary_zh: 联邦学习（FL）已经成为隐私保护的多摄像头视频理解领域中一种很有前景的范式。然而，将FL应用于跨视角场景面临三大挑战：（i）异构的视角和背景导致高度非独立同分布（non-IID）的客户端分布，以及过拟合视角特定的模式；（ii）局部分布偏差导致未对齐的表征，阻碍一致的跨视角语义；（iii）大型视频架构会导致过高的通信开销。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 FedCVU，一个包含三个组件的联邦框架：VS-Norm，它保留归一化参数来处理视角特定的统计信息；CV-Align，一个轻量级的对比正则化模块，以提升跨视角表征对齐；以及SLA，一种选择性层聚合策略，在不牺牲准确率的情况下降低通信成本。在跨视角协议下的动作理解和行人重识别任务上进行的大量实验表明，FedCVU 在保持强大的已见视角性能的同时，持续提升未见视角的准确率，优于最先进的FL基线，并在领域异构性和通信约束下表现出鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces FedCVU, a federated learning framework for cross-view video understanding that addresses challenges of non-IID data, representation misalignment, and communication overhead using novel techniques like VS-Norm, CV-Align, and SLA.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了FedCVU，一个用于跨视角视频理解的联邦学习框架，它使用VS-Norm、CV-Align和SLA等新技术，解决了非独立同分布数据、表征不对齐和通信开销等问题。

title: No Dense Tensors Needed: Fully Sparse Object Detection on Event-Camera Voxel Grids
summary: Event cameras produce asynchronous, high-dynamic-range streams well suited for detecting small, fast-moving drones, yet most event-based detectors convert the sparse event stream into dense tensors, discarding the representational efficiency of neuromorphic sensing. We propose SparseVoxelDet, to our knowledge the first fully sparse object detector for event cameras, in which backbone feature extraction, feature pyramid fusion, and the detection head all operate exclusively on occupied voxel positions through 3D sparse convolutions; no dense feature tensor is instantiated at any stage of the pipeline. On the FRED benchmark (629,832 annotated frames), SparseVoxelDet achieves 83.38% mAP at 50 while processing only 14,900 active voxels per frame (0.23% of the T.H.W grid), compared to 409,600 pixels for the dense YOLOv11 baseline (87.68% mAP at 50). Relaxing the IoU threshold from 0.50 to 0.40 recovers mAP to 89.26%, indicating that the remaining accuracy gap is dominated by box regression precision rather than detection capability. The sparse representation yields 858 times GPU memory compression and 3,670 times storage reduction relative to the equivalent dense 3D voxel tensor, with data-structure size that scales with scene dynamics rather than sensor resolution. Error forensics across 119,459 test frames confirms that 71 percent of failures are localization near-misses rather than missed targets. These results demonstrate that native sparse processing is a viable paradigm for event-camera object detection, exploiting the structural sparsity of neuromorphic sensor data without requiring neuromorphic computing hardware, and providing a framework whose representation cost is governed by scene activity rather than pixel count, a property that becomes increasingly valuable as event cameras scale to higher resolutions.
summary_zh: 事件相机产生异步、高动态范围的数据流，非常适合检测小型、快速移动的无人机。然而，大多数基于事件的检测器将稀疏的事件流转换为稠密张量，从而舍弃了神经形态感知的表征效率。我们提出了SparseVoxelDet，据我们所知，这是第一个完全稀疏的事件相机目标检测器，其骨干特征提取、特征金字塔融合以及检测头均完全通过3D稀疏卷积作用于已占据的体素位置；管道的任何阶段都不会实例化稠密特征张量。在FRED基准（629,832个带标注帧）上，SparseVoxelDet在处理每个帧仅14,900个活动体素（占T.H.W网格的0.23%）的情况下，实现了83.38%的mAP@50，而稠密的YOLOv11基线则需要处理409,600个像素（mAP@50为87.68%）。将IoU阈值从0.50降低到0.40可将mAP恢复到89.26%，表明剩余的精度差距主要由框回归精度而非检测能力主导。相对于等效的稠密3D体素张量，稀疏表示实现了858倍的GPU内存压缩和3,670倍的存储空间缩减，数据结构的大小随场景动态而非传感器分辨率进行缩放。对119,459个测试帧的错误分析证实，71%的失败是定位上的接近失误，而不是目标丢失。这些结果表明，原生稀疏处理是事件相机目标检测的可行范例，利用了神经形态传感器数据的结构稀疏性，而无需神经形态计算硬件，并提供了一个框架，其表征成本由场景活动而非像素数量决定，当事件相机扩展到更高分辨率时，这种特性变得越来越有价值。
tldr: The paper introduces SparseVoxelDet, a novel fully sparse object detector for event cameras that operates directly on sparse voxel grids, achieving comparable accuracy to dense methods with significantly reduced memory and storage requirements.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为SparseVoxelDet的新型全稀疏事件相机对象检测器，该检测器直接在稀疏体素网格上运行，在显著降低内存和存储需求的情况下，实现了与密集方法相当的准确率。

title: 4DGS360: 360° Gaussian Reconstruction of Dynamic Objects from a Single Video
summary: We introduce 4DGS360, a diffusion-free framework for 360$^{\circ}$ dynamic object reconstruction from casual monocular video. Existing methods often fail to reconstruct consistent 360$^{\circ}$ geometry, as their heavy reliance on 2D-native priors causes initial points to overfit to visible surface in each training view. 4DGS360 addresses this challenge through a advanced 3D-native initialization that mitigates the geometric ambiguity of occluded regions. Our proposed 3D tracker, AnchorTAP3D, produces reinforced 3D point trajectories by leveraging confident 2D track points as anchors, suppressing drift and providing reliable initialization that preserves geometry in occluded regions. This initialization, combined with optimization, yields coherent 360$^{\circ}$ 4D reconstructions. We further present iPhone360, a new benchmark where test cameras are placed up to 135$^{\circ}$ apart from training views, enabling 360$^{\circ}$ evaluation that existing datasets cannot provide. Experiments show that 4DGS360 achieves state-of-the-art performance on the iPhone360, iPhone, and DAVIS datasets, both qualitatively and quantitatively.
summary_zh: 我们提出了4DGS360，一个用于从随意的单目视频中重建360°动态物体的无扩散框架。现有方法通常无法重建一致的360°几何结构，因为它们对2D原生先验的过度依赖会导致初始点过度拟合每个训练视图中可见的表面。4DGS360通过一种先进的3D原生初始化应对这一挑战，从而减轻了遮挡区域的几何模糊性。我们提出的3D追踪器，AnchorTAP3D，通过利用置信的2D追踪点作为锚点，产生强化的3D点轨迹，抑制漂移并提供可靠的初始化，从而在遮挡区域中保留几何结构。这种初始化与优化相结合，可产生连贯的360° 4D重建。我们进一步提出了iPhone360，一个新的基准数据集，其中测试相机与训练视图之间的距离高达135°，从而实现现有数据集无法提供的360°评估。实验表明，无论在定性还是定量方面，4DGS360在iPhone360、iPhone和DAVIS数据集上均实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces 4DGS360, a novel diffusion-free framework for reconstructing 360° dynamic objects from monocular video using a 3D-native initialization and a new benchmark dataset (iPhone360) for comprehensive evaluation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了4DGS360，一种新的无扩散框架，通过单目视频重建360°动态物体，它使用3D原生初始化和一个新的benchmark数据集（iPhone360）来进行全面评估。

title: PAS3R: Pose-Adaptive Streaming 3D Reconstruction for Long Video Sequences
summary: Online monocular 3D reconstruction enables dense scene recovery from streaming video but remains fundamentally limited by the stability-adaptation dilemma: the reconstruction model must rapidly incorporate novel viewpoints while preserving previously accumulated scene structure. Existing streaming approaches rely on uniform or attention-based update mechanisms that often fail to account for abrupt viewpoint transitions, leading to trajectory drift and geometric inconsistencies over long sequences. We introduce PAS3R, a pose-adaptive streaming reconstruction framework that dynamically modulates state updates according to camera motion and scene structure. Our key insight is that frames contributing significant geometric novelty should exert stronger influence on the reconstruction state, while frames with minor viewpoint variation should prioritize preserving historical context. PAS3R operationalizes this principle through a motion-aware update mechanism that jointly leverages inter-frame pose variation and image frequency cues to estimate frame importance. To further stabilize long-horizon reconstruction, we introduce trajectory-consistent training objectives that incorporate relative pose constraints and acceleration regularization. A lightweight online stabilization module further suppresses high-frequency trajectory jitter and geometric artifacts without increasing memory consumption. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that PAS3R significantly improves trajectory accuracy, depth estimation, and point cloud reconstruction quality in long video sequences while maintaining competitive performance on shorter sequences.
summary_zh: 在线单目3D重建能够从视频流中恢复密集的场景信息，但仍然受到稳定性-适应性困境的根本限制：重建模型必须快速整合新的视角，同时保留先前积累的场景结构。现有的流式处理方法依赖于均匀或基于注意力的更新机制，这些机制通常无法有效处理突发的视角转换，从而导致长序列中的轨迹漂移和几何不一致性。我们提出了PAS3R，一种姿态自适应的流式重建框架，它根据相机运动和场景结构动态地调节状态更新。我们的关键洞察是，对几何结构贡献显著新信息的帧应在重建状态中发挥更大的影响，而视角变化较小的帧应优先保留历史上下文。PAS3R通过一种运动感知更新机制来实现这一原则，该机制联合利用帧间姿态变化和图像频率线索来估计帧的重要性。为了进一步稳定长时程重建，我们引入了轨迹一致性训练目标，其中包含相对姿态约束和加速度正则化。轻量级的在线稳定模块进一步抑制了高频轨迹抖动和几何伪影，而不会增加内存消耗。在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，PAS3R显著提高了长视频序列中的轨迹精度、深度估计和点云重建质量，同时在较短序列上保持了竞争性的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces PAS3R, a pose-adaptive streaming 3D reconstruction framework that improves trajectory accuracy and reconstruction quality in long video sequences by dynamically modulating state updates based on camera motion and scene structure, addressing the stability-adaptation dilemma.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PAS3R，一个姿态自适应的流式3D重建框架，通过根据相机运动和场景结构动态调整状态更新，提高了长视频序列中的轨迹精度和重建质量，解决了稳定性和适应性之间的难题。

title: Feasibility of Augmented Reality-Guided Robotic Ultrasound with Cone-Beam CT Integration for Spine Procedures
summary: Accurate needle placement in spine interventions is critical for effective pain management, yet it depends on reliable identification of anatomical landmarks and careful trajectory planning. Conventional imaging guidance often relies both on CT and X-ray fluoroscopy, exposing patients and staff to high dose of radiation while providing limited real-time 3D feedback. We present an optical see-through augmented reality (OST-AR)-guided robotic system for spine procedures that provides in situ visualization of spinal structures to support needle trajectory planning. We integrate a cone-beam CT (CBCT)-derived 3D spine model which is co-registered with live ultrasound, enabling users to combine global anatomical context with local, real-time imaging. We evaluated the system in a phantom user study involving two representative spine procedures: facet joint injection and lumbar puncture. Sixteen participants performed insertions under two visualization conditions: conventional screen vs. AR. Results show that AR significantly reduces execution time and across-task placement error, while also improving usability, trust, and spatial understanding and lowering cognitive workload. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of AR-guided robotic ultrasound for spine interventions, highlighting its potential to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and user experience in image-guided procedures.
summary_zh: 在脊柱介入治疗中，准确的针尖定位对于有效疼痛管理至关重要，而这取决于对解剖标志的可靠识别和细致的轨迹规划。传统的影像引导通常依赖CT和X射线透视，使患者和医务人员暴露于高剂量辐射中，同时提供的实时3D反馈有限。我们提出了一种光学透视增强现实（OST-AR）引导的脊柱手术机器人系统，该系统提供脊柱结构的现场可视化，以支持针尖轨迹规划。我们集成了一个锥形束CT（CBCT）衍生的3D脊柱模型，该模型与实时超声图像进行配准，使用户能够将全局解剖背景与局部实时成像相结合。我们在一个假体用户研究中评估了该系统，涉及两个具有代表性的脊柱手术：关节突关节注射和腰椎穿刺。16名参与者在两种可视化条件下进行了插管操作：传统屏幕显示与AR显示。结果表明，AR显著减少了执行时间和跨任务定位误差，同时提高了可用性、信任度、空间理解能力并降低了认知负荷。这些发现证明了AR引导机器人超声在脊柱介入治疗中的可行性，突出了其在提高图像引导手术的准确性、效率和用户体验方面的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces an augmented reality-guided robotic ultrasound system, integrated with cone-beam CT, for spine procedures. A user study on phantoms showed that the AR system reduces execution time, improves accuracy and usability, and lowers cognitive workload compared to conventional screen visualization.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种增强现实引导的机器人超声系统，该系统与锥形束CT集成，用于脊柱手术。对模型进行的用户研究表明，与传统的屏幕可视化相比，增强现实系统可减少执行时间、提高准确性和可用性，并降低认知负荷。

title: MineRobot: A Unified Framework for Kinematics Modeling and Solving of Underground Mining Robots in Virtual Environments
summary: Underground mining robots are increasingly operated in virtual environments (VEs) for training, planning, and digital-twin applications, where reliable kinematics is essential for avoiding hazardous in-situ trials. Unlike typical open-chain industrial manipulators, mining robots are often closed-chain mechanisms driven by linear actuators and involving planar four-bar linkages, which makes both kinematics modeling and real-time solving challenging. We present \emph{MineRobot}, a unified framework for modeling and solving the kinematics of underground mining robots in VEs. First, we introduce the Mining Robot Description Format (MRDF), a domain-specific representation that parameterizes kinematics for mining robots with native semantics for actuators and loop closures. Second, we develop a topology-processing pipeline that contracts four-bar substructures into generalized joints and, for each actuator, extracts an Independent Topologically Equivalent Path (ITEP), which is classified into one of four canonical types. Third, leveraging ITEP independence, we compose per-type solvers into an actuator-centered sequential forward-kinematics (FK) pipeline. Building on the same decomposition, we formulate inverse kinematics (IK) as a bound-constrained optimization problem and solve it with a Gauss--Seidel-style procedure that alternates actuator-length updates. By converting coupled closed-loop kinematics into a sequence of small topology-aware solves, the framework avoids robot-specific hand derivations and supports efficient computation. Experiments demonstrate that MineRobot provides the real-time performance and robustness required by VE applications.
summary_zh: 地下矿山采掘机器人在虚拟环境（VEs）中用于培训、规划和数字孪生应用日益普及，可靠的运动学模型对于避免危险的现场试验至关重要。与典型的开链工业机械臂不同，采掘机器人通常是闭链机构，由线性致动器驱动并涉及平面四杆机构，这使得运动学建模和实时求解都具有挑战性。我们提出 \emph{MineRobot}，一个用于在虚拟环境中建模和求解地下采掘机器人运动学的统一框架。首先，我们引入了采掘机器人描述格式（MRDF），这是一种特定领域的表示方法，它使用致动器和闭环的原生语义参数化采掘机器人的运动学。其次，我们开发了一个拓扑处理流程，将四杆子结构收缩成广义关节，并针对每个致动器，提取一个独立拓扑等效路径（ITEP），该路径被分类为四种规范类型之一。第三，利用 ITEP 的独立性，我们将每种类型的求解器组合成一个以致动器为中心的顺序正向运动学（FK）流程。在相同分解的基础上，我们将逆向运动学（IK）表述为一个受约束的优化问题，并使用高斯-赛德尔风格的程序来求解它，该程序交替进行致动器长度更新。通过将耦合的闭环运动学转换为一系列小的拓扑感知求解，该框架避免了特定于机器人的手动推导，并支持高效计算。实验表明，MineRobot 提供了 VE 应用所需的实时性能和鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper presents MineRobot, a framework for modeling and solving kinematics of underground mining robots in virtual environments, addressing the challenges posed by their closed-chain mechanisms and planar four-bar linkages. It features a domain-specific representation (MRDF) and topology-aware solvers for real-time performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 MineRobot，一个用于在虚拟环境中建模和求解地下采矿机器人运动学的框架，解决了其闭链机构和平面四杆联动机构带来的挑战。它具有特定领域的表示（MRDF）和拓扑感知求解器，可实现实时性能。

title: Collision-Free Velocity Scheduling for Multi-Agent Systems on Predefined Routes via Inexact-Projection ADMM
summary: In structured multi-agent transportation systems, agents often must follow predefined routes, making spatial rerouting undesirable or impossible. This paper addresses route-constrained multi-agent coordination by optimizing waypoint passage times while preserving each agent's assigned waypoint order and nominal route assignment. A differentiable surrogate trajectory model maps waypoint timings to smooth position profiles and captures first-order tracking lag, enabling pairwise safety to be encoded through distance-based penalties evaluated on a dense temporal grid spanning the mission horizon. The resulting nonlinear and nonconvex velocity-scheduling problem is solved using an inexact-projection Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) algorithm that combines structured timing updates with gradient-based collision-correction steps and avoids explicit integer sequencing variables. Numerical experiments on random-crossing, bottleneck, and graph-based network scenarios show that the proposed method computes feasible and time-efficient schedules across a range of congestion levels and yields shorter mission completion times than a representative hierarchical baseline in the tested bottleneck cases.
summary_zh: 在结构化的多智能体运输系统中，智能体通常必须遵循预定义的路线，使得空间上的重新规划路线变得不可取或不可能。本文通过优化航路点通过时间来解决路线约束下的多智能体协同问题，同时保持每个智能体分配的航路点顺序和标称路线分配不变。一种可微分的替代轨迹模型将航路点时间映射到平滑的位置轮廓，并捕获一阶跟踪滞后，使得可以通过基于距离的惩罚来编码成对安全性，这些惩罚是在跨越任务范围的密集时间网格上评估的。由此产生的非线性且非凸的速度调度问题，使用一种非精确投影的交替方向乘子法（ADMM）算法来解决，该算法结合了结构化的时间更新和基于梯度的碰撞校正步骤，并避免了显式的整数排序变量。在随机交叉、瓶颈和基于图的网络场景中的数值实验表明，所提出的方法可以在各种拥堵级别下计算出可行且时间高效的调度方案，并且在测试的瓶颈案例中，比代表性的分层基线产生更短的任务完成时间。
tldr: This paper presents a collision-free velocity scheduling method for multi-agent systems on predefined routes using an inexact-projection ADMM algorithm, demonstrating efficient and time-saving schedules in various scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于非精确投影ADMM算法的多智能体系统预定义路径上的无碰撞速度调度方法，并在各种场景下展示了高效且省时的调度。

title: Optimal Solutions for the Moving Target Vehicle Routing Problem with Obstacles via Lazy Branch and Price
summary: The Moving Target Vehicle Routing Problem with Obstacles (MT-VRP-O) seeks trajectories for several agents that collectively intercept a set of moving targets. Each target has one or more time windows where it must be visited, and the agents must avoid static obstacles and satisfy speed and capacity constraints. We introduce Lazy Branch-and-Price with Relaxed Continuity (Lazy BPRC), which finds optimal solutions for the MT-VRP-O. Lazy BPRC applies the branch-and-price framework for VRPs, which alternates between a restricted master problem (RMP) and a pricing problem. The RMP aims to select a sequence of target-time window pairings (called a tour) for each agent to follow, from a limited subset of tours. The pricing problem adds tours to the limited subset. Conventionally, solving the RMP requires computing the cost for an agent to follow each tour in the limited subset. Computing these costs in the MT-VRP-O is computationally intensive, since it requires collision-free motion planning between moving targets. Lazy BPRC defers cost computations by solving the RMP using lower bounds on the costs of each tour, computed via motion planning with relaxed continuity constraints. We lazily evaluate the true costs of tours as-needed. We compute a tour's cost by searching for a shortest path on a Graph of Convex Sets (GCS), and we accelerate this search using our continuity relaxation method. We demonstrate that Lazy BPRC runs up to an order of magnitude faster than two ablations.
summary_zh: 具有障碍物的移动目标车辆路径问题(MT-VRP-O)旨在为多个智能体寻找轨迹，使其共同拦截一组移动目标。每个目标拥有一个或多个必须被访问的时间窗口，且智能体必须避开静态障碍，并满足速度和容量约束。我们提出了具有松弛连续性的惰式分支定价法(Lazy BPRC)，它能为MT-VRP-O找到最优解。Lazy BPRC应用了VRP的分支定价框架，该框架在受限主问题(RMP)和定价问题之间交替迭代。RMP旨在从有限的路径集合中，为每个智能体选择一系列目标-时间窗口配对（称为路径）以便追踪。定价问题则是向有限的路径集合中添加新的路径。传统上，解决RMP需要计算智能体遵循有限集合中每条路径的成本。在MT-VRP-O中计算这些成本是计算密集型的，因为它需要在移动目标之间进行无碰撞运动规划。Lazy BPRC通过使用每条路径成本的下界来解决RMP，从而延迟了成本计算，这些下界通过具有松弛连续性约束的运动规划计算得出。我们根据需要惰性地评估路径的真实成本。我们通过在凸集图(GCS)上搜索最短路径来计算路径的成本，并使用我们的连续性松弛方法加速此搜索过程。我们证明Lazy BPRC的运行速度比两种消融研究方法快一个数量级。
tldr: This paper introduces Lazy Branch-and-Price with Relaxed Continuity (Lazy BPRC), a method for solving the Moving Target Vehicle Routing Problem with Obstacles (MT-VRP-O) optimally, outperforming ablations by up to an order of magnitude.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为 Lazy BPRC 的方法，用于解决带障碍物的移动目标车辆路径问题（MT-VRP-O），性能优于其他变体方法，速度提高了近一个数量级。

title: Auction-Based Task Allocation with Energy-Conscientious Trajectory Optimization for AMR Fleets
summary: This paper presents a hierarchical two-stage framework for multi-robot task allocation and trajectory optimization in asymmetric task spaces: (1) a sequential auction allocates tasks using closed-form bid functions, and (2) each robot independently solves an optimal control problem for energy-minimal trajectories with a physics-based battery model, followed by a collision avoidance refinement step using pairwise proximity penalties. Event-triggered warm-start rescheduling with bounded trigger frequency handles robot faults, priority arrivals, and energy deviations. Across 505 scenarios with 2-20 robots and up to 100 tasks on three factory layouts, both energy- and distance-based auction variants achieve 11.8% average energy savings over nearest-task allocation, with rescheduling latency under 10 ms. The central finding is that bid-metric performance is regime-dependent: in uniform workspaces, distance bids outperform energy bids by 3.5% (p < 0.05, Wilcoxon) because a 15.7% closed-form approximation error degrades bid ranking accuracy to 87%; however, when workspace friction heterogeneity is sufficient (r < 0.85 energy-distance correlation), a zone-aware energy bid outperforms distance bids by 2-2.4%. These results provide practitioner guidance: use distance bids in near-uniform terrain and energy-aware bids when friction variation is significant.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种分层的两阶段框架，用于在非对称任务空间中进行多机器人任务分配和轨迹优化：（1）一种使用闭式投标函数的顺序拍卖分配任务，以及（2）每个机器人独立求解一个最优控制问题，以获得具有基于物理的电池模型的能量最小化轨迹，然后使用成对邻近惩罚进行碰撞避免细化步骤。事件触发的温启动重新调度，具有有界触发频率，用于处理机器人故障、优先级到达和能量偏差。在三个工厂布局上的505个场景中，使用2-20个机器人和最多100个任务，基于能量和基于距离的拍卖变体都实现了比最近任务分配平均节省11.8%的能量，重新调度延迟低于10毫秒。中心发现是投标指标性能是依赖于环境的：在均匀的工作空间中，距离投标优于能量投标3.5%（p < 0.05，Wilcoxon），因为15.7%的闭式近似误差将投标排名准确性降低到87%； 然而，当工作空间摩擦异质性足够时（能量-距离相关性r < 0.85），区域感知能量投标优于距离投标2-2.4%。这些结果为从业者提供了指导：在近乎均匀的地形中使用距离投标，并在摩擦变化显着时使用能量感知投标。
tldr: This paper introduces a two-stage auction-based task allocation and energy-efficient trajectory optimization framework for AMR fleets and demonstrates the benefits of energy-aware bidding in heterogeneous environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种两阶段的基于拍卖的任务分配和节能轨迹优化框架，用于AMR车队，并证明了在异构环境中采用能量感知竞标的优势。

title: TiCo: Time-Controllable Training for Spoken Dialogue Models
summary: We propose TiCo, a simple post-training method for enabling spoken dialogue models (SDMs) to follow time-constrained instructions and generate responses with controllable duration. This capability is valuable for real-world spoken language systems such as voice assistants and interactive agents, where controlling response duration can improve interaction quality. However, despite their strong ability to generate natural spoken responses, existing models lack time awareness and struggle to follow duration-related instructions (e.g., "Please generate a response lasting about 15 seconds"). Through an empirical evaluation of both open-source and commercial SDMs, we show that they frequently fail to satisfy such time-control requirements. TiCo addresses this limitation by enabling models to estimate elapsed speaking time during generation through Spoken Time Markers (STM) (e.g., <10.6 seconds>). These markers help the model maintain awareness of time and adjust the remaining content to meet the target duration. TiCo is simple and efficient: it requires only a small amount of data and no additional question-answer pairs, relying instead on self-generation and reinforcement learning. Experimental results show that TiCo significantly improves adherence to duration constraints while preserving response quality.
summary_zh: 我们提出 TiCo，一种简单的后训练方法，用于使语音对话模型（SDM）能够遵循时间约束指令，并生成具有可控时长的回复。这种能力对于现实世界的语音语言系统（如语音助手和交互代理）非常有价值，因为控制回复时长可以提高交互质量。然而，尽管现有模型具有生成自然语音回复的强大能力，但它们缺乏时间意识，难以遵循与时长相关的指令（例如，“请生成一个时长约为 15 秒的回复”）。通过对开源和商业 SDM 的实证评估，我们表明它们经常无法满足此类时间控制要求。TiCo 通过使模型能够在生成过程中通过语音时间标记 (STM)（例如，<10.6 秒>）估计已用语音时间来解决这一限制。这些标记有助于模型保持对时间的感知，并调整剩余内容以满足目标时长。TiCo 简单高效：它只需要少量数据，无需额外的问答对，而是依赖于自我生成和强化学习。实验结果表明，TiCo 在保持回复质量的同时，显著提高了对时长约束的遵守程度。
tldr: The paper introduces TiCo, a post-training method that enables spoken dialogue models to generate responses with controllable duration by using Spoken Time Markers (STM), improving adherence to duration constraints while preserving response quality.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为TiCo的后训练方法，它通过使用语音时间标记（STM），使语音对话模型能够生成具有可控持续时间的响应，从而在保持响应质量的同时，显著提高了对持续时间约束的依从性。

title: CayleyPy-4: AI-Holography. Towards analogs of holographic string dualities for AI tasks
summary:
This is the fourth paper in the CayleyPy project, which applies AI methods to the exploration of large graphs. In this work, we suggest the existence of a new discrete version of holographic string dualities for this setup, and discuss their relevance to AI systems and mathematics. Many modern AI tasks -- such as those addressed by GPT-style language models or RL systems -- can be viewed as direct analogues of predicting particle trajectories on graphs. We investigate this problem for a large family of Cayley graphs, for which we show that surprisingly it admits a dual description in terms of discrete strings. We hypothesize that such dualities may extend to a range of AI systems where they can lead to more efficient computational approaches. In particular, string holographic images of states are proposed as natural candidates for data embeddings, motivated by the "complexity = volume" principle in AdS/CFT.
  For Cayley graphs of the symmetric group S_n, our results indicate that the corresponding dual objects are flat, planar polygons. The diameter of the graph is equal to the number of integer points inside the polygon scaled by n. Vertices of the graph can be mapped holographically to paths inside the polygon, and the usual graph distances correspond to the area under the paths, thus directly realising the "complexity = volume" paradigm. We also find evidence for continuous CFTs and dual strings in the large n limit. We confirm this picture and other aspects of the duality in a large initial set of examples. We also present new datasets (obtained by a combination of ML and conventional tools) which should be instrumental in establishing the duality for more general cases.
summary_zh:
这是CayleyPy项目的第四篇论文，该项目将人工智能方法应用于大型图的探索。在这项工作中，我们提出了针对这种设置的一种新的离散全息弦对偶性的存在性，并讨论了它们与人工智能系统和数学的相关性。许多现代人工智能任务——例如GPT风格的语言模型或强化学习系统所解决的任务——都可以被视为预测图上粒子轨迹的直接类比。我们针对一大类Cayley图研究了这个问题，并表明令人惊讶的是，它允许用离散弦来描述对偶性。我们假设这种对偶性可能扩展到一系列人工智能系统中，从而可以带来更有效的计算方法。特别地，受AdS/CFT中“复杂性=体积”原则的驱动，弦的全息状态图像被提议作为数据嵌入的自然候选者。

对于对称群S_n的Cayley图，我们的结果表明，相应的对偶对象是扁平的平面多边形。图的直径等于多边形内部整数点的数量乘以n。图的顶点可以全息地映射到多边形内部的路径，并且通常的图距离对应于路径下的面积，从而直接实现“复杂性=体积”范式。我们还发现，在n趋于无穷大的极限条件下，存在连续共形场论（CFTs）和对偶弦的证据。我们通过大量的初始示例证实了这种图景和对偶性的其他方面。我们还展示了新的数据集（通过机器学习和传统工具相结合获得），这些数据集应该有助于建立更一般情况下的对偶性。
tldr: This paper explores a novel duality between AI tasks on Cayley graphs and discrete strings, potentially leading to more efficient AI computations and data embeddings inspired by holographic string dualities.
tldr_zh: 本文探索了 Cayley 图上的 AI 任务与离散弦之间的新型对偶性，有望实现更高效的 AI 计算和受全息弦对偶性启发的数据嵌入。

title: Evolutionary Biparty Multiobjective UAV Path Planning: Problems and Empirical Comparisons
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have been widely used in urban missions, and proper planning of UAV paths can improve mission efficiency while reducing the risk of potential third-party impact. Existing work has considered all efficiency and safety objectives for a single decision-maker (DM) and regarded this as a multiobjective optimization problem (MOP). However, there is usually not a single DM but two DMs, i.e., an efficiency DM and a safety DM, and the DMs are only concerned with their respective objectives. The final decision is made based on the solutions of both DMs. In this paper, for the first time, biparty multiobjective UAV path planning (BPMO-UAVPP) problems involving both efficiency and safety departments are modeled. The existing multiobjective immune algorithm with nondominated neighbor-based selection (NNIA), the hybrid evolutionary framework for the multiobjective immune algorithm (HEIA), and the adaptive immune-inspired multiobjective algorithm (AIMA) are modified for solving the BPMO-UAVPP problem, and then biparty multiobjective optimization algorithms, including the BPNNIA, BPHEIA, and BPAIMA, are proposed and comprehensively compared with traditional multiobjective evolutionary algorithms and typical multiparty multiobjective evolutionary algorithms (i.e., OptMPNDS and OptMPNDS2). The experimental results show that BPAIMA performs better than ordinary multiobjective evolutionary algorithms such as NSGA-II and multiparty multiobjective evolutionary algorithms such as OptMPNDS, OptMPNDS2, BPNNIA and BPHEIA.
summary_zh: 无人机（UAV）已被广泛应用于城市任务中，合理规划无人机路径可以提高任务效率，同时降低潜在第三方影响的风险。现有工作主要针对单一决策者（DM）考虑了所有效率和安全目标，并将其视为多目标优化问题（MOP）。然而，通常存在两个决策者，即效率决策者和安全决策者，且决策者只关注各自的目标。最终决策基于双方决策者的解决方案制定。本文首次对涉及效率和安全部门的双方多目标无人机路径规划（BPMO-UAVPP）问题进行了建模。针对该BPMO-UAVPP问题，对现有基于非支配邻域选择的多目标免疫算法（NNIA）、多目标免疫算法的混合进化框架（HEIA）和自适应免疫启发的多目标算法（AIMA）进行了改进，进而提出了双边多目标优化算法，包括BPNNIA、BPHEIA和BPAIMA，并与传统多目标进化算法和典型的多方多目标进化算法（即OptMPNDS和OptMPNDS2）进行了全面比较。实验结果表明，BPAIMA的性能优于普通多目标进化算法（如NSGA-II）和多方多目标进化算法（如OptMPNDS、OptMPNDS2、BPNNIA和BPHEIA）。
tldr: This paper models a new biparty multiobjective UAV path planning problem considering both efficiency and safety departments, adapting existing algorithms and comparing them with traditional and multiparty approaches, finding that the BPAIMA algorithm performs best.
tldr_zh: 该论文针对效率和安全部门建模了一个新的双边多目标无人机路径规划问题，改编现有算法并将其与传统和多方方法进行比较，发现BPAIMA算法表现最佳。

title: Effective Strategies for Asynchronous Software Engineering Agents
summary: AI agents have become increasingly capable at isolated software engineering (SWE) tasks such as resolving issues on Github. Yet long-horizon tasks involving multiple interdependent subtasks still pose challenges both with respect to accuracy, and with respect to timely completion. A natural approach to solving these long-horizon tasks in a timely manner is asynchronous multi-agent collaboration, where multiple agents work on different parts of the task at the same time. But effective application of multi-agent systems has proven surprisingly difficult: concurrent edits by multiple agents interfere with each other, dependencies are difficult to synchronize, and combining partial progress into a coherent whole is challenging. On the other hand, human developers have long relied on mature collaboration infrastructure to manage these challenges in large software projects. Inspired by these collaboration primitives, we introduce Centralized Asynchronous Isolated Delegation (CAID), a structured multi-agent coordination paradigm grounded in three core SWE primitives: centralized task delegation, asynchronous execution, and isolated workspaces. CAID constructs dependency-aware task plans through a central manager, executes subtasks concurrently in isolated workspaces, and consolidates progress via structured integration with executable test-based verification. In empirical evaluation, we find that CAID improves accuracy over single-agent baselines by 26.7% absolute on paper reproduction tasks (PaperBench) and 14.3% on Python library development tasks (Commit0). Through systematic analysis, we find that branch-and-merge is a central coordination mechanism for multi-agent collaboration, and that SWE primitives such as git worktree, git commit, and git merge enable it to be realized in a reliable and executable manner.
summary_zh: 人工智能代理在解决Github上的问题等孤立的软件工程（SWE）任务中已变得越来越强大。然而，涉及多个相互依赖的子任务的长期任务在准确性和及时完成方面仍然面临挑战。 解决这些长期任务的一个自然方法是异步多智能体协作，即多个智能体同时处理任务的不同部分。 但是，多智能体系统的有效应用已被证明异常困难：多个智能体的并发编辑会相互干扰，依赖项难以同步，并且将部分进度整合为一个连贯的整体具有挑战性。 另一方面，人类开发人员长期以来一直依赖成熟的协作基础设施来管理大型软件项目中的这些挑战。 受这些协作原语的启发，我们引入了集中式异步隔离委派（CAID），这是一种基于三个核心SWE原语构建的结构化多智能体协调范例：集中式任务委派、异步执行和隔离工作空间。 CAID通过中央管理器构建依赖感知任务计划，在隔离的工作空间中并发执行子任务，并通过基于可执行测试的验证进行结构化集成来巩固进度。 在实证评估中，我们发现CAID在论文复现任务（PaperBench）上相对于单智能体基线的准确性绝对提高了26.7%，在Python库开发任务（Commit0）上提高了14.3%。 通过系统分析，我们发现分支与合并是多智能体协作的核心协调机制，并且git worktree、git commit和git merge等SWE原语能够以可靠和可执行的方式实现它。
tldr: The paper introduces Centralized Asynchronous Isolated Delegation (CAID), a multi-agent coordination paradigm inspired by software engineering collaboration primitives, and demonstrates its effectiveness in improving accuracy on paper reproduction and library development tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了中心化异步隔离委托 (CAID)，这是一种受软件工程协作原语启发的 ​​多智能体协作范式，并证明了其在提高论文复现和库开发任务准确性方面的有效性。

title: The Myhill-Nerode Theorem for Bounded Interaction: Canonical Abstractions via Agent-Bounded Indistinguishability
summary: Any capacity-limited observer induces a canonical quotient on its environment: two situations that no bounded agent can distinguish are, for that agent, the same. We formalise this for finite POMDPs. A fixed probe family of finite-state controllers induces a closed-loop Wasserstein pseudometric on observation histories and a probe-exact quotient merging histories that no controller in the family can distinguish. The quotient is canonical, minimal, and unique-a bounded-interaction analogue of the Myhill-Nerode theorem. For clock-aware probes, it is exactly decision-sufficient for objectives that depend only on the agent's observations and actions; for latent-state rewards, we use an observation-Lipschitz approximation bound. The main theorem object is the clock-aware quotient; scalable deterministic-stationary experiments study a tractable coarsening with gap measured on small exact cases and explored empirically at larger scale. We validate theorem-level claims on Tiger and GridWorld. We also report operational case studies on Tiger, GridWorld, and RockSample as exploratory diagnostics of approximation behavior and runtime, not as theorem-facing evidence when no exact cross-family certificate is available; heavier stress tests are archived in the appendix and artifact package.
summary_zh: 任何能力受限的观察者都会在其环境中诱导出一个规范商：对于该观察者来说，任何有界智能体无法区分的两种情境是相同的。我们针对有限POMDP对这一点进行了形式化。一个有限状态控制器组成的固定探针族在观测历史记录上诱导出一个闭环Wasserstein伪度量，以及一个探针精确商，该商合并了任何该探针族中的控制器都无法区分的历史记录。该商是规范的、最小的且唯一的——是Myhill-Nerode定理的有界交互模拟。对于时钟感知探针，它对仅依赖于智能体的观测和动作的目标来说，是精确的决策充分的；对于潜在状态奖励，我们使用一个观测Lipschitz逼近边界。主要定理对象是时钟感知商；可扩展的确定性平稳实验研究了一个可处理的粗化，其间隙在小规模精确案例上进行测量，并在较大规模上进行经验探索。我们在Tiger和GridWorld上验证了定理级别的声明。我们还报告了在Tiger、GridWorld和RockSample上的操作案例研究，作为逼近行为和运行时的探索性诊断，而不是在没有精确跨族证书可用时的定理相关证据；更重的压力测试已存档在附录和工件包中。
tldr: This paper formalizes a bounded-interaction analogue of the Myhill-Nerode theorem for finite POMDPs, creating canonical quotients based on a fixed probe family of finite-state controllers, and validates it on Tiger and GridWorld.
tldr_zh: 本文针对有限POMDP形式化了Myhill-Nerode定理的有界交互模拟，基于有限状态控制器的一个固定探针族创建了规范商，并在Tiger和GridWorld上进行了验证。

title: Cross-Instance Gaussian Splatting Registration via Geometry-Aware Feature-Guided Alignment
summary: We present Gaussian Splatting Alignment (GSA), a novel method for aligning two independent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) models via a similarity transformation (rotation, translation, and scale), even when they are of different objects in the same category (e.g., different cars). In contrast, existing methods can only align 3DGS models of the same object (e.g., the same car) and often must be given true scale as input, while we estimate it successfully. GSA leverages viewpoint-guided spherical map features to obtain robust correspondences and introduces a two-step optimization framework that aligns 3DGS models while keeping them fixed. First, we apply an iterative feature-guided absolute orientation solver as our coarse registration, which is robust to poor initialization (e.g., 180 degrees misalignment or a 10x scale gap). Next, we use a fine registration step that enforces multi-view feature consistency, inspired by inverse radiance-field formulations. The first step already achieves state-of-the-art performance, and the second further improves results. In the same-object case, GSA outperforms prior works, often by a large margin, even when the other methods are given the true scale. In the harder case of different objects in the same category, GSA vastly surpasses them, providing the first effective solution for category-level 3DGS registration and unlocking new applications. Project webpage: https://bgu-cs-vil.github.io/GSA-project/
summary_zh: 我们提出了高斯溅射对齐(GSA)，一种用于通过相似变换（旋转、平移和缩放）对齐两个独立的3D高斯溅射(3DGS)模型的新方法，即使它们是同一类别中的不同对象（例如，不同的汽车）。 相反，现有方法只能对齐同一对象的3DGS模型（例如，同一辆汽车），并且通常必须以真实尺度作为输入，而我们成功地估计了它。 GSA利用视点引导的球面地图特征来获得鲁棒的对应关系，并引入了一个两步优化框架，该框架在固定3DGS模型的同时，对齐它们。 首先，我们应用一个迭代的特征引导的绝对方向求解器作为我们的粗略配准，它对较差的初始化（例如，180度错位或10倍的尺度差距）具有鲁棒性。 接下来，我们使用一个精细配准步骤，该步骤强制执行多视图特征一致性，灵感来自逆辐射场公式。 第一步已经实现了最先进的性能，第二步进一步提高了结果。 在同一对象的情况下，GSA优于先前的工作，通常以很大的优势，即使其他方法被赋予真实尺度。 在同一类别中不同对象的更困难情况下，GSA大大超过了它们，为类别级别的3DGS配准提供了第一个有效的解决方案，并开启了新的应用。 项目网页：https://bgu-cs-vil.github.io/GSA-project/
tldr: This paper introduces GSA, a novel method for aligning 3D Gaussian Splatting models of different objects within the same category via similarity transformations, outperforming existing methods that are limited to the same object and often require true scale input.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GSA，一种新颖的方法，用于通过相似变换对同一类别中不同对象的3D高斯溅射模型进行对齐，优于现有仅限于相同对象且通常需要真实尺度输入的现有方法。

title: Thermal Topology Collapse: Universal Physical Patch Attacks on Infrared Vision Systems
summary: Although infrared pedestrian detectors have been widely deployed in visual perception tasks, their vulnerability to physical adversarial attacks is becoming increasingly apparent. Existing physical attack methods predominantly rely on instance-specific online optimization and rigid pattern design, leading to high deployment costs and insufficient physical robustness. To address these limitations, this work proposes the Universal Physical Patch Attack (UPPA), the first universal physical attack method in the infrared domain. This method employs geometrically constrained parameterized Bezier blocks to model perturbations and utilizes the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm to perform unified optimization across the global data distribution, thus maintaining topological stability under dynamic deformations. In the physical deployment phase, we materialize the optimized digital perturbations into physical cold patches, achieving a continuous and smooth low-temperature distribution that naturally aligns with the thermal radiation characteristics of infrared imaging. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UPPA achieves an outstanding physical attack success rate without any online computational overhead, while also exhibiting strong cross-domain generalization and reliable black-box transferability.
summary_zh: 尽管红外行人检测器已广泛应用于视觉感知任务中，但其易受物理对抗攻击的影响正变得越来越明显。现有的物理攻击方法主要依赖于特定实例的在线优化和刚性图案设计，导致部署成本高昂且物理鲁棒性不足。为了解决这些局限性，本文提出了一种通用物理贴片攻击（UPPA），这是红外领域首个通用物理攻击方法。该方法采用几何约束的参数化贝塞尔块来建模扰动，并利用粒子群优化（PSO）算法对全局数据分布进行统一优化，从而在动态形变下保持拓扑稳定性。在物理部署阶段，我们将优化后的数字扰动实体化为物理冷贴片，实现连续平滑的低温分布，自然契合红外成像的热辐射特性。大量实验表明，UPPA无需任何在线计算开销即可实现出色的物理攻击成功率，同时还表现出强大的跨域泛化能力和可靠的黑盒可迁移性。
tldr: This paper introduces a universal physical patch attack (UPPA) for infrared pedestrian detectors using optimized cold patches, achieving high attack success rates and generalization with no online computation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种用于红外行人检测器的通用物理补丁攻击（UPPA），它使用优化的冷补丁，在无需在线计算的情况下实现了高攻击成功率和泛化能力。

title: Benchmarking Recurrent Event-Based Object Detection for Industrial Multi-Class Recognition on MTEvent
summary: Event cameras are attractive for industrial robotics because they provide high temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and reduced motion blur. However, most event-based object detection studies focus on outdoor driving scenarios or limited class settings. In this work, we benchmark recurrent ReYOLOv8s on MTEvent for industrial multi-class recognition and use a non-recurrent YOLOv8s variant as a baseline to analyze the effect of temporal memory. On the MTEvent validation split, the best scratch recurrent model (C21) reaches 0.285 mAP50, corresponding to a 9.6% relative improvement over the nonrecurrent YOLOv8s baseline (0.260). Event-domain pretraining has a stronger effect: GEN1-initialized fine-tuning yields the best overall result of 0.329 mAP50 at clip length 21, and unlike scratch training, GEN1-pretrained models improve consistently with clip length. PEDRo initialization drops to 0.251, indicating that mismatched source-domain pretraining can be less effective than training from scratch. Persistent failure modes are dominated by class imbalance and human-object interaction. Overall, we position this work as a focused benchmarking and analysis study of recurrent event-based detection in industrial environments.
summary_zh: Event相机在高时间分辨率、高动态范围和运动模糊减少等特性方面对工业机器人具有吸引力。然而，大多数基于事件的对象检测研究集中于户外驾驶场景或有限类别设置。在这项工作中，我们对MTEvent上的循环ReYOLOv8s进行了基准测试，用于工业多类别识别，并使用非循环YOLOv8s变体作为基线来分析时间记忆的影响。在MTEvent验证集上，最佳的从头训练循环模型(C21)达到了0.285 mAP50，相对于非循环YOLOv8s基线(0.260)有9.6%的相对改进。事件域预训练具有更强的影响：GEN1初始化的微调在片段长度为21时产生了0.329 mAP50的最佳整体结果，并且与从头训练不同，GEN1预训练模型随着片段长度的增加而持续改善。PEDRo初始化降至0.251，表明不匹配的源域预训练可能不如从头训练有效。持续的失败模式主要由类别不平衡和人-物交互主导。总而言之，我们将这项工作定位为对工业环境中基于循环事件的检测进行有重点的基准测试和分析研究。
tldr: This paper benchmarks recurrent event-based object detection (ReYOLOv8s) on MTEvent for industrial multi-class recognition, demonstrating the benefits of recurrent models and event-domain pretraining.
tldr_zh: 本文对基于事件的循环对象检测 (ReYOLOv8s) 在 MTEvent 上进行了基准测试，用于工业多类识别，展示了循环模型和事件域预训练的优势。

title: RefracGS: Novel View Synthesis Through Refractive Water Surfaces with 3D Gaussian Ray Tracing
summary: Novel view synthesis (NVS) through non-planar refractive surfaces presents fundamental challenges due to severe, spatially varying optical distortions. While recent representations like NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) excel at NVS, their assumption of straight-line ray propagation fails under these conditions, leading to significant artifacts. To overcome this limitation, we introduce RefracGS, a framework that jointly reconstructs the refractive water surface and the scene beneath the interface. Our key insight is to explicitly decouple the refractive boundary from the target objects: the refractive surface is modeled via a neural height field, capturing wave geometry, while the underlying scene is represented as a 3D Gaussian field. We formulate a refraction-aware Gaussian ray tracing approach that accurately computes non-linear ray trajectories using Snell's law and efficiently renders the underlying Gaussian field while backpropagating the loss gradients to the parameterized refractive surface. Through end-to-end joint optimization of both representations, our method ensures high-fidelity NVS and view-consistent surface recovery. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world scenes with complex waves demonstrate that RefracGS outperforms prior refractive methods in visual quality, while achieving 15x faster training and real-time rendering at 200 FPS. The project page for RefracGS is available at https://yimgshao.github.io/refracgs/.
summary_zh: 通过非平面折射表面进行新视角合成（NVS）由于严重的、空间变化的 оптическую искажения сталкивается с фундаментальными трудностями. Хотя современные представления, такие как NeRF и 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), преуспевают в NVS, их предположение о прямолинейном распространении лучей терпит неудачу в этих условиях, приводя к значительным артефактам. Чтобы преодолеть это ограничение, мы представляем RefracGS, структуру, которая совместно реконструирует поверхность преломления воды и сцену под интерфейсом. Наша ключевая идея состоит в том, чтобы явно отделить преломляющую границу от целевых объектов: поверхность преломления моделируется с помощью нейронного поля высот, захватывающего геометрию волн, в то время как базовая сцена представлена в виде 3D-гауссова поля. Мы формулируем метод трассировки гауссовых лучей с учетом преломления, который точно вычисляет нелинейные траектории лучей, используя закон Снеллиуса, и эффективно отображает базовое гауссово поле, одновременно обратным распространяя градиенты потерь на параметризованную поверхность преломления. Благодаря сквозной совместной оптимизации обоих представлений наш метод обеспечивает высокоточное NVS и последовательное восстановление поверхности. Эксперименты как на синтетических, так и на реальных сценах со сложными волнами показывают, что RefracGS превосходит предыдущие методы преломления по визуальному качеству, одновременно достигая в 15 раз более быстрой скорости обучения и рендеринга в реальном времени со скоростью 200 кадров в секунду. Проектная страница для RefracGS доступна по адресу https://yimgshao.github.io/refracgs/.
tldr: RefracGS introduces a novel method for novel view synthesis through refractive water surfaces by jointly reconstructing the refractive surface and the scene beneath it using a neural height field and 3D Gaussian Splatting with refraction-aware ray tracing, achieving superior performance and speed.
tldr_zh: RefracGS提出了一种新的方法，通过折射水面进行新视角合成，通过使用神经高度场和3D高斯溅射以及折射感知光线追踪，联合重建折射表面及其下方的场景，从而实现卓越的性能和速度。

title: HACMatch Semi-Supervised Rotation Regression with Hardness-Aware Curriculum Pseudo Labeling
summary: Regressing 3D rotations of objects from 2D images is a crucial yet challenging task, with broad applications in autonomous driving, virtual reality, and robotic control. Existing rotation regression models often rely on large amounts of labeled data for training or require additional information beyond 2D images, such as point clouds or CAD models. Therefore, exploring semi-supervised rotation regression using only a limited number of labeled 2D images is highly valuable. While recent work FisherMatch introduces semi-supervised learning to rotation regression, it suffers from rigid entropy-based pseudo-label filtering that fails to effectively distinguish between reliable and unreliable unlabeled samples. To address this limitation, we propose a hardness-aware curriculum learning framework that dynamically selects pseudo-labeled samples based on their difficulty, progressing from easy to complex examples. We introduce both multi-stage and adaptive curriculum strategies to replace fixed-threshold filtering with more flexible, hardness-aware mechanisms. Additionally, we present a novel structured data augmentation strategy specifically tailored for rotation estimation, which assembles composite images from augmented patches to introduce feature diversity while preserving critical geometric integrity. Comprehensive experiments on PASCAL3D+ and ObjectNet3D demonstrate that our method outperforms existing supervised and semi-supervised baselines, particularly in low-data regimes, validating the effectiveness of our curriculum learning framework and structured augmentation approach.
summary_zh: 从2D图像回归物体的3D旋转是一个至关重要但具有挑战性的任务，在自动驾驶、虚拟现实和机器人控制等领域有着广泛的应用。现有的旋转回归模型通常依赖于大量的标注数据进行训练，或者需要除2D图像之外的额外信息，例如点云或CAD模型。因此，探索仅使用少量标注2D图像的半监督旋转回归具有很高的价值。虽然最近的FisherMatch工作将半监督学习引入了旋转回归，但它采用基于刚性熵的伪标签过滤，无法有效区分可靠和不可靠的未标注样本。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种硬度感知课程学习框架，该框架基于样本的难度动态选择伪标签样本，从简单到复杂的例子逐步推进。我们引入了多阶段和自适应课程策略，以用更灵活、硬度感知的机制来代替固定阈值过滤。此外，我们提出了一种专为旋转估计量身定制的新型结构化数据增强策略，该策略从增强的图像块组装合成图像，以引入特征多样性，同时保留关键的几何完整性。在PASCAL3D+和ObjectNet3D上的综合实验表明，我们的方法优于现有的监督和半监督基线，尤其是在低数据量的情况下，验证了我们的课程学习框架和结构化增强方法的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces a hardness-aware curriculum learning framework for semi-supervised 3D rotation regression from 2D images, using structured data augmentation and demonstrating improved performance in low-data regimes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种硬度感知课程学习框架，用于从2D图像进行半监督3D旋转回归，采用结构化数据增强，并在低数据情况下表现出改进的性能。

title: FluidGaussian: Propagating Simulation-Based Uncertainty Toward Functionally-Intelligent 3D Reconstruction
summary: Real objects that inhabit the physical world follow physical laws and thus behave plausibly during interaction with other physical objects. However, current methods that perform 3D reconstructions of real-world scenes from multi-view 2D images optimize primarily for visual fidelity, i.e., they train with photometric losses and reason about uncertainty in the image or representation space. This appearance-centric view overlooks body contacts and couplings, conflates function-critical regions (e.g., aerodynamic or hydrodynamic surfaces) with ornamentation, and reconstructs structures suboptimally, even when physical regularizers are added. All these can lead to unphysical and implausible interactions. To address this, we consider the question: How can 3D reconstruction become aware of real-world interactions and underlying object functionality, beyond visual cues? To answer this question, we propose FluidGaussian, a plug-and-play method that tightly couples geometry reconstruction with ubiquitous fluid-structure interactions to assess surface quality at high granularity. We define a simulation-based uncertainty metric induced by fluid simulations and integrate it with active learning to prioritize views that improve both visual and physical fidelity. In an empirical evaluation on NeRF Synthetic (Blender), Mip-NeRF 360, and DrivAerNet++, our FluidGaussian method yields up to +8.6% visual PSNR (Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio) and -62.3% velocity divergence during fluid simulations. Our code is available at https://github.com/delta-lab-ai/FluidGaussian.
summary_zh: 真实物体遵循物理定律，因此在与其它物理物体交互时表现出合理的行为。然而，目前从多视角2D图像重建真实世界场景的方法主要优化视觉保真度，即它们使用光度损失进行训练并在图像或表示空间中推断不确定性。这种以外观为中心的视角忽略了物体接触和耦合，将功能关键区域（例如，空气动力学或流体动力学表面）与装饰混淆，并以次优方式重建结构，即使添加了物理正则化项也无法避免。所有这些都可能导致不符合物理规律且不合理的交互。为了解决这个问题，我们考虑以下问题：除了视觉线索之外，3D 重建如何才能感知真实世界的交互和底层对象的功能？为了回答这个问题，我们提出了 FluidGaussian，一种即插即用方法，它将几何重建与普遍存在的流固耦合交互紧密结合，以在高粒度下评估表面质量。我们定义了一个由流体模拟引起的基于模拟的不确定性度量，并将其与主动学习相结合，以优先考虑那些可以提高视觉和物理保真度的视角。在 NeRF Synthetic (Blender)、Mip-NeRF 360 和 DrivAerNet++ 上的实证评估中，我们的 FluidGaussian 方法在流体模拟期间产生了高达 +8.6% 的视觉 PSNR（峰值信噪比）和 -62.3% 的速度散度。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/delta-lab-ai/FluidGaussian 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces FluidGaussian, a method to incorporate fluid-structure interaction simulations into 3D reconstruction to improve both visual and physical fidelity, outperforming existing methods on several datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 FluidGaussian，一种将流体-结构相互作用模拟融入 3D 重建的方法，旨在提高视觉和物理保真度，并在多个数据集上优于现有方法。

title: Constrained Online Convex Optimization with Memory and Predictions
summary: We study Constrained Online Convex Optimization with Memory (COCO-M), where both the loss and the constraints depend on a finite window of past decisions made by the learner. This setting extends the previously studied unconstrained online optimization with memory framework and captures practical problems such as the control of constrained dynamical systems and scheduling with reconfiguration budgets. For this problem, we propose the first algorithms that achieve sublinear regret and sublinear cumulative constraint violation under time-varying constraints, both with and without predictions of future loss and constraint functions. Without predictions, we introduce an adaptive penalty approach that guarantees sublinear regret and constraint violation. When short-horizon and potentially unreliable predictions are available, we reinterpret the problem as online learning with delayed feedback and design an optimistic algorithm whose performance improves as prediction accuracy improves, while remaining robust when predictions are inaccurate. Our results bridge the gap between classical constrained online convex optimization and memory-dependent settings, and provide a versatile learning toolbox with diverse applications.
summary_zh: 我们研究了带记忆的约束在线凸优化(COCO-M)，其中损失函数和约束条件都依赖于学习者过去决策的一个有限窗口。该设定扩展了先前研究的带记忆的非约束在线优化框架，并涵盖了实际问题，例如约束动态系统的控制和具有重配置预算的调度。针对该问题，我们提出了首批能够在时变约束条件下实现次线性遗憾和次线性累积约束违反的算法，包括有和没有未来损失函数和约束函数预测的情况。在没有预测的情况下，我们引入了一种自适应惩罚方法，保证次线性遗憾和约束违反。当存在短视程且可能不可靠的预测时，我们将该问题重新解释为带延迟反馈的在线学习，并设计了一种乐观算法，其性能随预测精度的提高而提高，同时在预测不准确时保持鲁棒性。我们的结果弥合了经典约束在线凸优化与依赖记忆的设置之间的差距，并提供了一个通用的学习工具箱，具有多种应用。
tldr: This paper introduces algorithms for Constrained Online Convex Optimization with Memory (COCO-M), achieving sublinear regret and constraint violation with and without predictions, potentially applicable to constrained dynamical systems and scheduling.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了用于约束在线凸优化与记忆 (COCO-M) 的算法，在有或没有预测的情况下，实现了亚线性后悔和约束违规，可能适用于约束动力系统和调度。

title: 6D Robotic OCT Scanning of Curved Tissue Surfaces
summary: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) is a non-invasive volumetric imaging modality with high spatial and temporal resolution. For imaging larger tissue structures, OCT probes need to be moved to scan the respective area. For handheld scanning, stitching of the acquired OCT volumes requires overlap to register the images. For robotic scanning and stitching, a typical approach is to restrict the motion to translations, as this avoids a full hand-eye calibration, which is complicated by the small field of view of most OCT probes. However, stitching by registration or by translational scanning are limited when curved tissue surfaces need to be scanned. We propose a marker for full six-dimensional hand-eye calibration of a robot mounted OCT probe. We show that the calibration results in highly repeatable estimates of the transformation. Moreover, we evaluate robotic scanning of two phantom surfaces to demonstrate that the proposed calibration allows for consistent scanning of large, curved tissue surfaces. As the proposed approach is not relying on image registration, it does not suffer from a potential accumulation of errors along a scan path. We also illustrate the improvement compared to conventional 3D-translational robotic scanning.
summary_zh: 光学相干断层扫描(OCT)是一种具有高空间和时间分辨率的非侵入式体积成像技术。为了对较大的组织结构进行成像，OCT探头需要移动以扫描相应的区域。对于手持式扫描，拼接获得的OCT体数据需要重叠才能进行图像配准。对于机器人扫描和拼接，一种典型的方法是将运动限制为平移，因为这避免了完整的手眼标定，而手眼标定会因大多数OCT探头的小视野而变得复杂。然而，当需要扫描弯曲的组织表面时，通过配准或平移扫描进行拼接会受到限制。我们提出了一种用于安装在机器人上的OCT探头进行完整六维手眼标定的标记。我们展示了该标定方法可以得到具有高度可重复性的变换估计。此外，我们评估了两个体模表面的机器人扫描，以证明所提出的标定方法可以对大的弯曲组织表面进行一致的扫描。由于所提出的方法不依赖于图像配准，因此它不会受到沿扫描路径潜在的误差累积的影响。我们还展示了与传统的三维平移机器人扫描相比的改进。
tldr: This paper presents a 6D robotic scanning method for OCT probes, enabling accurate scanning of curved tissue surfaces without relying on image registration, which is particularly useful for applications where translational scanning is insufficient.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于光学相干断层扫描（OCT）探头的六自由度机器人扫描方法，该方法能够准确扫描弯曲的组织表面，且不依赖于图像配准，这对于传统平移扫描不足的应用场景尤为有用。

title: A Blueprint for Self-Evolving Coding Agents in Vehicle Aerodynamic Drag Prediction
summary: High-fidelity vehicle drag evaluation is constrained less by solver runtime than by workflow friction: geometry cleanup, meshing retries, queue contention, and reproducibility failures across teams. We present a contract-centric blueprint for self-evolving coding agents that discover executable surrogate pipelines for predicting drag coefficient $C_d$ under industrial constraints. The method formulates surrogate discovery as constrained optimization over programs, not static model instances, and combines Famou-Agent-style evaluator feedback with population-based island evolution, structured mutations (data, model, loss, and split policies), and multi-objective selection balancing ranking quality, stability, and cost. A hard evaluation contract enforces leakage prevention, deterministic replay, multi-seed robustness, and resource budgets before any candidate is admitted. Across eight anonymized evolutionary operators, the best system reaches a Combined Score of 0.9335 with sign-accuracy 0.9180, while trajectory and ablation analyses show that adaptive sampling and island migration are primary drivers of convergence quality. The deployment model is explicitly ``screen-and-escalate'': surrogates provide high-throughput ranking for design exploration, but low-confidence or out-of-distribution cases are automatically escalated to high-fidelity CFD. The resulting contribution is an auditable, reusable workflow for accelerating aerodynamic design iteration while preserving decision-grade reliability, governance traceability, and safety boundaries.
summary_zh: 高保真车辆阻力评估的瓶颈与其说是求解器运行时间，不如说是工作流程中的摩擦：几何清理、网格重试、队列竞争以及跨团队的重现性失败。我们提出了一种以契约为中心的蓝图，使用能够自进化的编码代理，在工业约束下发现可执行的代理模型流程，用于预测阻力系数$C_d$。该方法将代理模型发现形式化为对程序的约束优化，而非静态模型实例，并结合了Famou-Agent风格的评估器反馈、基于种群的岛屿进化、结构化变异（数据、模型、损失和分割策略）以及平衡排序质量、稳定性和成本的多目标选择。严格的评估契约在允许任何候选者进入之前，强制执行泄漏预防、确定性重放、多种子鲁棒性和资源预算。在八个匿名化的进化算子中，最佳系统达到了0.9335的综合得分和0.9180的符号精度，而轨迹和消融分析表明，自适应采样和岛屿迁移是收敛质量的主要驱动因素。部署模型明确地采用“筛选和升级”策略：代理模型为设计探索提供高吞吐量排序，但低置信度或超出分布的案例会自动升级到高保真计算流体动力学（CFD）。最终的贡献是一个可审计、可重用的工作流程，用于加速空气动力学设计迭代，同时保持决策级的可靠性、治理可追溯性和安全边界。
tldr: This paper introduces a self-evolving coding agent framework for predicting vehicle aerodynamic drag, focusing on workflow efficiency, surrogate model discovery, and robust evaluation contracts for industrial applications.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于预测车辆空气动力学阻力的自进化编码代理框架，重点关注工作流程效率、代理模型发现以及工业应用中强大的评估合约。

title: Biophysics-Enhanced Neural Representations for Patient-Specific Respiratory Motion Modeling
summary: A precise spatial delivery of the radiation dose is crucial for the treatment success in radiotherapy. In the lung and upper abdominal region, respiratory motion introduces significant treatment uncertainties, requiring special motion management techniques. To address this, respiratory motion models are commonly used to infer the patient-specific respiratory motion and target the dose more efficiently. In this work, we investigate the possibility of using implicit neural representations (INR) for surrogate-based motion modeling. Therefore, we propose physics-regularized implicit surrogate-based modeling for respiratory motion (PRISM-RM). Our new integrated respiratory motion model is free of a fixed reference breathing state. Unlike conventional pairwise registration techniques, our approach provides a trajectory-aware spatio-temporally continuous and diffeomorphic motion representation, improving generalization to extrapolation scenarios. We introduce biophysical constraints, ensuring physiologically plausible motion estimation across time beyond the training data. Our results show that our trajectory-aware approach performs on par in interpolation and improves the extrapolation ability compared to our initially proposed INR-based approach. Compared to sequential registration-based approaches both our approaches perform equally well in interpolation, but underperform in extrapolation scenarios. However, the methodical features of INRs make them particularly effective for respiratory motion modeling, and with their performance steadily improving, they demonstrate strong potential for advancing this field.
summary_zh: 精确的空间剂量传递对于放射治疗的成功至关重要。在肺部和上腹部区域，呼吸运动会引入显著的治疗不确定性，需要特殊的运动管理技术。为了解决这个问题，呼吸运动模型通常用于推断患者特定的呼吸运动，并更有效地瞄准剂量。在这项工作中，我们研究了使用隐式神经表示（INR）进行基于替代模型的运动建模的可能性。因此，我们提出了一种用于呼吸运动的物理正则化隐式替代模型（PRISM-RM）。我们新的集成呼吸运动模型没有固定的参考呼吸状态。与传统的成对配准技术不同，我们的方法提供了一个轨迹感知的、时空连续且微分同胚的运动表示，提高了对推断场景的泛化能力。我们引入了生物物理约束，确保在超出训练数据范围的时间内估计出生理上合理的运动。我们的结果表明，我们的轨迹感知方法在插值方面表现相当，并且与我们最初提出的基于INR的方法相比，提高了推断能力。与基于序列配准的方法相比，这两种方法在插值方面表现同样出色，但在推断场景中表现较差。然而，INR的方法学特征使其特别适用于呼吸运动建模，并且随着其性能的稳步提高，它展现出推动该领域发展的强大潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces a physics-regularized implicit neural representation (INR) for modeling patient-specific respiratory motion in radiotherapy, improving generalization to extrapolation scenarios and ensuring physiologically plausible motion estimation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种物理正则化的隐式神经表示（INR），用于建模放射治疗中患者特定的呼吸运动，提高了外推场景的泛化能力，并确保生理上合理的运动估计。

title: Deep S2P: Integrating Learning Based Stereo Matching Into the Satellite Stereo Pipeline
summary: Digital Surface Model generation from satellite imagery is a core task in Earth observation and is commonly addressed using classical stereoscopic matching algorithms in satellite pipelines as in the Satellite Stereo Pipeline (S2P). While recent learning-based stereo matchers achieve state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks, their integration into operational satellite pipelines remains challenging due to differences in viewing geometry and disparity assumptions. In this work, we integrate several modern learning-based stereo matchers, including StereoAnywhere, MonSter, Foundation Stereo, and a satellite fine-tuned variant of MonSter, into the Satellite Stereo Pipeline, adapting the rectification stage to enforce compatible disparity polarity and range. We release the corresponding code to enable reproducible use of these methods in large-scale Earth observation workflows. Experiments on satellite imagery show consistent improvements over classical cost-volume-based approaches in terms of Digital Surface Model accuracy, although commonly used metrics such as mean absolute error exhibit saturation effects. Qualitative results reveal substantially improved geometric detail and sharper structures, highlighting the need for evaluation strategies that better reflect perceptual and structural fidelity. At the same time, performance over challenging surface types such as vegetation remains limited across all evaluated models, indicating open challenges for learning-based stereo in natural environments.
summary_zh: 从卫星影像生成数字表面模型是地球观测中的核心任务，通常使用卫星流程中的经典立体匹配算法来解决，例如卫星立体流程（S2P）。虽然最近基于学习的立体匹配器在标准基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，但由于视角几何和视差假设的差异，将它们集成到操作型卫星流程中仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们将几种现代基于学习的立体匹配器，包括StereoAnywhere、MonSter、Foundation Stereo以及MonSter的一个卫星微调变体，集成到卫星立体流程中，并调整了校正阶段以强制实现兼容的视差极性和范围。我们发布了相应的代码，以支持在大型地球观测工作流程中可重现地使用这些方法。在卫星影像上的实验表明，在数字表面模型精度方面，相对于基于经典代价体的算法，有持续的改进，尽管常用的指标，如平均绝对误差，表现出饱和效应。定性结果揭示了几何细节的显著改善和更清晰的结构，突显了需要更好地反映感知和结构保真度的评估策略。与此同时，所有评估模型在诸如植被等具有挑战性的地表类型上的性能仍然有限，表明基于学习的立体匹配在自然环境中仍存在开放性挑战。
tldr: This paper integrates recent learning-based stereo matching algorithms into a Satellite Stereo Pipeline (S2P), demonstrating improvements in Digital Surface Model accuracy compared to classical methods, while also highlighting limitations in handling challenging surface types like vegetation.
tldr_zh: 该论文将最新的基于学习的立体匹配算法集成到卫星立体流水线（S2P）中，与经典方法相比，证明了数字表面模型精度的提高，同时也强调了处理植被等具有挑战性的表面类型的局限性。

title: SARe: Structure-Aware Large-Scale 3D Fragment Reassembly
summary: 3D fragment reassembly aims to recover the rigid poses of unordered fragment point clouds or meshes in a common object coordinate system to reconstruct the complete shape. The problem becomes particularly challenging as the number of fragments grows, since the target shape is unknown and fragments provide weak semantic cues. Existing end-to-end approaches are prone to cascading failures due to unreliable contact reasoning, most notably inaccurate fragment adjacencies. To address this, we propose Structure-Aware Reassembly (SARe), a generative framework with SARe-Gen for Euclidean-space assembly generation and SARe-Refine for inference-time refinement, with explicit contact modeling. SARe-Gen jointly predicts fracture-surface token probabilities and an inter-fragment contact graph to localize contact regions and infer candidate adjacencies. It adopts a query-point-based conditioning scheme and extracts aligned local geometric tokens at query locations from a frozen geometry encoder, yielding queryable structural representations without additional structural pretraining. We further introduce an inference-time refinement stage, SARe-Refine. By verifying candidate contact edges with geometric-consistency checks, it selects reliable substructures and resamples the remaining uncertain regions while keeping verified parts fixed, leading to more stable and consistent assemblies in the many-fragment regime. We evaluate SARe across three settings, including synthetic fractures, simulated fractures from scanned real objects, and real physically fractured scans. The results demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, with more graceful degradation and higher success rates as the fragment count increases in challenging large-scale reassembly.
summary_zh: 3D碎片重组旨在恢复无序碎片点云或网格在通用物体坐标系中的刚性姿态，以重建完整的形状。随着碎片数量的增加，尤其是在目标形状未知且碎片提供微弱语义线索的情况下，该问题变得极具挑战性。现有的端到端方法容易因不可靠的接触推理（尤其是不准确的碎片邻接关系）而导致级联失效。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了结构感知重组(SARe)，这是一个生成式框架，包含用于欧几里得空间装配生成的SARe-Gen和用于推理时精化的SARe-Refine，并显式地进行接触建模。SARe-Gen联合预测断裂表面 token 概率和碎片间接触图，以定位接触区域并推断候选邻接关系。它采用基于查询点的条件化方案，并从冻结的几何编码器中提取查询位置处的对齐局部几何 token，从而产生无需额外结构预训练的可查询结构表示。我们进一步引入了一个推理时精化阶段SARe-Refine。通过使用几何一致性检查来验证候选接触边，它选择可靠的子结构，并在保持已验证部分固定的同时，对剩余的不确定区域进行重采样，从而在多碎片的场景中产生更稳定和一致的装配结果。我们在三种设置下评估了 SARe，包括合成断裂、扫描真实对象模拟断裂和真实的物理断裂扫描。结果表明，SARe 具有最先进的性能，并且在具有挑战性的大规模重组中，随着碎片数量的增加，SARe 的性能退化更为平缓，成功率更高。
tldr: The paper introduces SARe, a structure-aware generative framework for large-scale 3D fragment reassembly that addresses cascading failures in existing methods by explicit contact modeling and inference-time refinement, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SARe，一种结构感知的生成式框架，用于大规模3D碎片重组。它通过显式的接触建模和推理时细化来解决现有方法中出现的级联失败问题，并实现了最先进的性能。

title: BadminSense: Enabling Fine-Grained Badminton Stroke Evaluation on a Single Smartwatch
summary: Evaluating badminton performance often requires expert coaching, which is rarely accessible for amateur players. We present BadminSense, a smartwatch-based system for fine-grained badminton performance analysis using wearable sensing. Through interviews with experienced badminton players, we identified four system design requirements with three implementation insights that guide the development of BadminSense. We then collected a badminton strokes dataset on 12 experienced badminton amateurs and annotated it with fine-grained labels, including stroke type, expert-assessed stroke rating, and shuttle impact location. Built on this dataset, BadminSense segments and classifies strokes, predicts stroke quality, and estimates shuttle impact location using vibration signal from an off-the-shelf smartwatch. Our evaluations show that BadminSense achieves a stroke classification accuracy of 91.43%, an average quality rating error of 0.438, and an average impact location estimation error of 12.9%. A real-world usability study further demonstrates BadminSense's potential to provide reliable and meaningful support for daily badminton practice.
