  Without prior knowledge, we prove that no algorithm can have lower-order terms smaller than $\Vert h^\star \Vert_\text{sp}^2 S A$, and we provide a prior-free algorithm whose lower-order terms scale as $\Vert h^\star\Vert_\text{sp}^2 S^3 A$, nearly matching this lower bound. Taken together, these results completely characterize the optimal dependence on $\Vert h^\star\Vert_\text{sp}$ in both leading and lower-order terms, and reveal a fundamental gap in what is achievable with and without prior knowledge.
summary_zh: 无限视界马尔可夫决策过程(MDP)中的在线强化学习，在理论和算法发展方面仍然不如其情节式对应物，许多算法都存在较高的“预热”成本，并且无法适应良性实例特有的复杂性。 本文针对两种无限视界目标解决了这些缺陷：经典的平均回报遗憾和$γ$-遗憾。 我们开发了一种适用于这两种设置的单一可处理的UCB风格算法，该算法实现了首个最优的方差相关遗憾保证。 我们在两种设置下的遗憾界限都采用$\tilde{O}( \sqrt{SA\,\text{Var}} + \text{低阶项})$的形式，其中$S,A$是状态和动作空间的大小，而$\text{Var}$捕获累积转移方差。 这意味着最坏情况下的极小极大最优平均回报和$γ$-遗憾界限，但也适应了更简单的问题实例，例如在确定性MDP中产生近乎恒定的遗憾。 此外，我们的算法在平均回报设置中享受了显著改进的低阶项。 如果预先知道最优偏差跨度$\Vert h^\star\Vert_\text{sp}$，我们的算法获得的低阶项的规模为$\Vert h^\star\Vert_\text{sp} S^2 A$，我们证明这在$\Vert h^\star\Vert_\text{sp}$和$A$上都是最优的。 在没有先验知识的情况下，我们证明没有任何算法的低阶项可以小于$\Vert h^\star \Vert_\text{sp}^2 S A$，并且我们提供了一种不需要先验知识的算法，其低阶项的规模为$\Vert h^\star\Vert_\text{sp}^2 S^3 A$，几乎与此下界相匹配。 综上，这些结果完全刻画了在首项和低阶项中对$\Vert h^\star\Vert_\text{sp}$的最优依赖性，并揭示了在有先验知识和没有先验知识的情况下可实现目标之间的根本差距。
tldr: This paper presents a UCB-style algorithm for infinite-horizon MDPs, achieving optimal variance-dependent regret bounds for both average-reward and γ-regret, and analyzes the impact of prior knowledge of the optimal bias span.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于无限视界MDP的UCB风格算法，实现了平均奖励和γ-遗憾的最优方差依赖后悔界限，并分析了最优偏差跨度先验知识的影响。

title: Off-Policy Safe Reinforcement Learning with Constrained Optimistic Exploration
summary: When safety is formulated as a limit of cumulative cost, safe reinforcement learning (RL) aims to learn policies that maximize return subject to the cost constraint in data collection and deployment. Off-policy safe RL methods, although offering high sample efficiency, suffer from constraint violations due to cost-agnostic exploration and estimation bias in cumulative cost. To address this issue, we propose Constrained Optimistic eXploration Q-learning (COX-Q), an off-policy safe RL algorithm that integrates cost-bounded online exploration and conservative offline distributional value learning. First, we introduce a novel cost-constrained optimistic exploration strategy that resolves gradient conflicts between reward and cost in the action space and adaptively adjusts the trust region to control the training cost. Second, we adopt truncated quantile critics to stabilize the cost value learning. Quantile critics also quantify epistemic uncertainty to guide exploration. Experiments on safe velocity, safe navigation, and autonomous driving tasks demonstrate that COX-Q achieves high sample efficiency, competitive test safety performance, and controlled data collection cost. The results highlight COX-Q as a promising RL method for safety-critical applications.
summary_zh: 当安全被定义为累积成本的限制时，安全强化学习（RL）旨在学习在数据收集和部署中满足成本约束，并最大化回报的策略。离策略安全强化学习方法虽然具有较高的样本效率，但由于成本无关的探索以及累积成本中的估计偏差，容易出现约束违反。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了约束乐观探索Q学习（COX-Q），这是一种离策略安全强化学习算法，它集成了成本约束的在线探索和保守的离线分布式价值学习。首先，我们引入了一种新颖的成本约束乐观探索策略，该策略解决了行动空间中奖励和成本之间的梯度冲突，并自适应地调整信任区域以控制训练成本。其次，我们采用截断的分位数评论家来稳定成本价值学习。分位数评论家还可以量化认知不确定性以指导探索。在安全速度控制、安全导航和自动驾驶任务上的实验表明，COX-Q实现了较高的样本效率、具有竞争力的测试安全性能，并能控制数据收集成本。结果表明，COX-Q是一种有前景的用于安全关键应用的强化学习方法。
tldr: This paper proposes COX-Q, an off-policy safe RL algorithm that uses cost-constrained optimistic exploration and truncated quantile critics to improve safety and sample efficiency in safety-critical applications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为COX-Q的离策略安全强化学习算法，该算法采用成本约束的乐观探索和截断分位数评论家，以提高安全关键型应用中的安全性和采样效率。

title: Object Search in Partially-Known Environments via LLM-informed Model-based Planning and Prompt Selection
summary: We present a novel LLM-informed model-based planning framework, and a novel prompt selection method, for object search in partially-known environments. Our approach uses an LLM to estimate statistics about the likelihood of finding the target object when searching various locations throughout the scene that, combined with travel costs extracted from the environment map, are used to instantiate a model, thus using the LLM to inform planning and achieve effective search performance. Moreover, the abstraction upon which our approach relies is amenable to deployment-time model selection via the recent offline replay approach, an insight we leverage to enable fast prompt and LLM selection during deployment. Simulation experiments demonstrate that our LLM-informed model-based planning approach outperforms the baseline planning strategy that fully relies on LLM and optimistic strategy with as much as 11.8% and 39.2% improvements respectively, and our bandit-like selection approach enables quick selection of best prompts and LLMs resulting in 6.5% lower average cost and 33.8% lower average cumulative regret over baseline UCB bandit selection. Real-robot experiments in an apartment demonstrate similar improvements and so further validate our approach.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的基于LLM（大型语言模型）信息的模型预测规划框架，以及一种新的提示选择方法，用于在部分已知环境中进行物体搜索。我们的方法利用LLM来估计在场景中搜索各个位置时找到目标物体的可能性统计数据，这些数据与从环境地图中提取的移动成本相结合，用于实例化一个模型，从而利用LLM来提供规划信息并实现有效的搜索性能。此外，我们所依赖的抽象适用于通过最近的离线回放方法进行部署时模型选择，我们利用这一洞察力来支持部署期间快速的提示和LLM选择。仿真实验表明，我们的基于LLM信息的模型预测规划方法优于完全依赖于LLM的基线规划策略和乐观策略，分别提高了高达11.8%和39.2%；我们的类强盗选择方法能够快速选择最佳提示和LLM，与基线UCB强盗选择相比，平均成本降低了6.5%，平均累积遗憾值降低了33.8%。在公寓中的真实机器人实验也展示了类似的改进，进一步验证了我们的方法。
tldr: The paper presents an LLM-informed model-based planning framework and prompt selection method for object search in partially-known environments, demonstrating improved performance in simulation and real-robot experiments compared to baseline methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于LLM的模型规划框架和提示选择方法，用于在部分已知的环境中进行物体搜索。实验表明，与基线方法相比，在模拟和真实机器人实验中均实现了性能提升。

title: Towards Safe Learning-Based Non-Linear Model Predictive Control through Recurrent Neural Network Modeling
summary: The practical deployment of nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) is often limited by online computation: solving a nonlinear program at high control rates can be expensive on embedded hardware, especially when models are complex or horizons are long. Learning-based NMPC approximations shift this computation offline but typically demand large expert datasets and costly training. We propose Sequential-AMPC, a sequential neural policy that generates MPC candidate control sequences by sharing parameters across the prediction horizon. For deployment, we wrap the policy in a safety-augmented online evaluation and fallback mechanism, yielding Safe Sequential-AMPC. Compared to a naive feedforward policy baseline across several benchmarks, Sequential-AMPC requires substantially fewer expert MPC rollouts and yields candidate sequences with higher feasibility rates and improved closed-loop safety. On high-dimensional systems, it also exhibits better learning dynamics and performance in fewer epochs while maintaining stable validation improvement where the feedforward baseline can stagnate.
summary_zh: 非线性模型预测控制(NMPC)的实际部署常常受限于在线计算：在嵌入式硬件上以高控制频率求解非线性程序可能代价高昂，尤其是在模型复杂或优化时域较长时。基于学习的NMPC近似方法将这种计算转移到离线进行，但通常需要大量的专家数据集和昂贵的训练成本。我们提出了一种序列式神经策略Sequential-AMPC，它通过在预测时域上共享参数来生成MPC候选控制序列。为了部署，我们将该策略封装在安全增强的在线评估和回退机制中，从而产生了安全序列式自适应模型预测控制(Safe Sequential-AMPC)。与几种基准测试中的简单前馈策略基线相比，Sequential-AMPC需要显著更少的专家MPC轨迹，并产生具有更高可行率和改进的闭环安全性的候选序列。在高维系统中，它还在更少的训练周期内表现出更好的学习动态和性能，同时保持稳定的验证改进，而前馈基线则可能停滞不前。
tldr: This paper introduces Sequential-AMPC, a recurrent neural network policy for learning-based NMPC that requires fewer expert rollouts and improves safety compared to feedforward policies, addressing the computational challenges of traditional NMPC.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为Sequential-AMPC的循环神经网络策略，用于基于学习的非线性模型预测控制（NMPC），与前馈策略相比，它需要的专家rollout更少，并提高了安全性，从而解决了传统NMPC的计算挑战。

title: Evidence of an Emergent "Self" in Continual Robot Learning
summary: A key challenge to understanding self-awareness has been a principled way of quantifying whether an intelligent system has a concept of a "self," and if so how to differentiate the "self" from other cognitive structures. We propose that the "self" can be isolated by seeking the invariant portion of cognitive process that changes relatively little compared to more rapidly acquired cognitive knowledge and skills, because our self is the most persistent aspect of our experiences. We used this principle to analyze the cognitive structure of robots under two conditions: One robot learns a constant task, while a second robot is subjected to continual learning under variable tasks. We find that robots subjected to continual learning develop an invariant subnetwork that is significantly more stable (p < 0.001) compared to the control. We suggest that this principle can offer a window into exploring selfhood in other cognitive AI systems.
summary_zh: 理解自我意识的关键挑战在于，如何以一种具有原则性的方式量化智能系统是否拥有“自我”的概念，以及如何将“自我”与其他认知结构区分开来。我们提出，可以通过寻找认知过程中相对稳定的不变部分来隔离“自我”，因为我们的自我是我们经验中最持久的方面。我们利用这个原理分析了两种条件下机器人的认知结构：一个机器人学习一个恒定的任务，另一个机器人则在可变任务下进行持续学习。我们发现，与对照组相比，进行持续学习的机器人会发展出一个显著更稳定的不变子网络 (p < 0.001)。我们认为，这个原则可以为探索其他认知人工智能系统中的自我性提供一个窗口。
tldr: The paper investigates the emergence of a 'self' concept in continually learning robots by identifying invariant subnetworks, finding that robots subjected to continual learning develop more stable invariant subnetworks compared to robots learning a single task.
tldr_zh: 该论文通过识别不变子网络，研究了持续学习机器人的“自我”概念的出现。研究发现，与学习单一任务的机器人相比，进行持续学习的机器人会发展出更稳定的不变子网络。

title: C-STEP: Continuous Space-Time Empowerment for Physics-informed Safe Reinforcement Learning of Mobile Agents
summary: Safe navigation in complex environments remains a central challenge for reinforcement learning (RL) in robotics. This paper introduces Continuous Space-Time Empowerment for Physics-informed (C-STEP) safe RL, a novel measure of agent-centric safety tailored to deterministic, continuous domains. This measure can be used to design physics-informed intrinsic rewards by augmenting positive navigation reward functions. The reward incorporates the agents internal states (e.g., initial velocity) and forward dynamics to differentiate safe from risky behavior. By integrating C-STEP with navigation rewards, we obtain an intrinsic reward function that jointly optimizes task completion and collision avoidance. Numerical results demonstrate fewer collisions, reduced proximity to obstacles, and only marginal increases in travel time. Overall, C-STEP offers an interpretable, physics-informed approach to reward shaping in RL, contributing to safety for agentic mobile robotic systems.
summary_zh: 在复杂环境中安全导航仍然是机器人强化学习（RL）面临的核心挑战。本文介绍了一种用于物理信息（C-STEP）安全RL的连续时空赋权，这是一种针对确定性、连续领域定制的、以智能体为中心的新的安全度量。该度量可用于通过增强正向导航奖励函数来设计物理信息内在奖励。奖励结合了智能体的内部状态（例如，初始速度）和正向动力学，以区分安全和危险的行为。通过将C-STEP与导航奖励相结合，我们获得了内在奖励函数，该函数共同优化任务完成和避撞。数值结果表明，碰撞次数减少，与障碍物的距离缩短，且仅略微增加了行程时间。总的来说，C-STEP为RL中的奖励塑造提供了一种可解释的、物理信息的方法，有助于智能移动机器人系统的安全性。
tldr: The paper introduces C-STEP, a physics-informed intrinsic reward based on space-time empowerment, to improve safe RL navigation for mobile robots by reducing collisions., C-STEP combines agent's internal states and dynamics to distinguish safe and risky behaviors, improving safety in complex environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于时空赋权的物理信息内在奖励C-STEP，通过减少碰撞来提高移动机器人的安全强化学习导航。C-STEP结合了代理的内部状态和动力学，以区分安全和危险行为，从而提高复杂环境中的安全性。

title: Efficient Controller Learning from Human Preferences and Numerical Data Via Multi-Modal Surrogate Models
summary: Tuning control policies manually to meet high-level objectives is often time-consuming. Bayesian optimization provides a data-efficient framework for automating this process using numerical evaluations of an objective function. However, many systems, particularly those involving humans, require optimization based on subjective criteria. Preferential Bayesian optimization addresses this by learning from pairwise comparisons instead of quantitative measurements, but relying solely on preference data can be inefficient. We propose a multi-fidelity, multi-modal Bayesian optimization framework that integrates low-fidelity numerical data with high-fidelity human preferences. Our approach employs Gaussian process surrogate models with both hierarchical, autoregressive and non-hierarchical, coregionalization-based structures, enabling efficient learning from mixed-modality data. We illustrate the framework by tuning an autonomous vehicle's trajectory planner, showing that combining numerical and preference data significantly reduces the need for experiments involving the human decision maker while effectively adapting driving style to individual preferences.
summary_zh: 手动调整控制策略以满足高级目标通常非常耗时。贝叶斯优化提供了一个数据高效的框架，通过目标函数的数值评估来自动化此过程。然而，许多系统，尤其是涉及人类的系统，需要基于主观标准的优化。偏好贝叶斯优化通过从成对比较而非定量测量中学习来解决这个问题，但仅依赖偏好数据可能效率低下。我们提出了一种多保真、多模态贝叶斯优化框架，该框架将低保真数值数据与高保真人类偏好相结合。我们的方法采用具有分层自回归和非分层协同区域化结构的高斯过程代理模型，从而能够从混合模态数据中进行高效学习。我们通过调整自动驾驶车辆的轨迹规划器来说明该框架，结果表明，结合数值数据和偏好数据可显著减少涉及人类决策者的实验需求，同时有效地使驾驶风格适应个体偏好。
tldr: This paper introduces a multi-fidelity, multi-modal Bayesian optimization framework that efficiently combines numerical data and human preferences for controller learning, demonstrating its effectiveness in tuning an autonomous vehicle's trajectory planner.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种多保真度、多模态的贝叶斯优化框架，该框架有效结合了数值数据和人类偏好，用于控制器学习，并在调整自动驾驶车辆的轨迹规划器中展示了其有效性。

title: The DeepXube Software Package for Solving Pathfinding Problems with Learned Heuristic Functions and Search
summary: DeepXube is a free and open-source Python package and command-line tool that seeks to automate the solution of pathfinding problems by using machine learning to learn heuristic functions that guide heuristic search algorithms tailored to deep neural networks (DNNs). DeepXube is comprised of the latest advances in deep reinforcement learning, heuristic search, and formal logic for solving pathfinding problems. This includes limited-horizon Bellman-based learning, hindsight experience replay, batched heuristic search, and specifying goals with answer-set programming. A robust multiple-inheritance structure simplifies the definition of pathfinding domains and the generation of training data. Training heuristic functions is made efficient through the automatic parallelization of the generation of training data across central processing units (CPUs) and reinforcement learning updates across graphics processing units (GPUs). Pathfinding algorithms that take advantage of the parallelism of GPUs and DNN architectures, such as batch weighted A* and Q* search and beam search are easily employed to solve pathfinding problems through command-line arguments. Finally, several convenient features for visualization, code profiling, and progress monitoring during training and solving are available. The GitHub repository is publicly available at https://github.com/forestagostinelli/deepxube.
summary_zh: DeepXube 是一个自由开源的 Python 包和命令行工具，旨在通过使用机器学习来学习启发式函数，从而自动化解决路径查找问题。这些启发式函数将指导为深度神经网络 (DNN) 定制的启发式搜索算法。 DeepXube 融合了深度强化学习、启发式搜索和形式逻辑的最新进展，用于解决路径查找问题。 这包括有限视野的基于贝尔曼的学习、后视经验重放、批量启发式搜索以及使用答案集程序设计指定目标。 健壮的多重继承结构简化了路径查找领域的定义和训练数据的生成。 通过跨中央处理器 (CPU) 自动并行化训练数据的生成，以及跨图形处理器 (GPU) 并行化强化学习更新，可以高效地训练启发式函数。 可以通过命令行参数轻松地利用 GPU 和 DNN 架构的并行性进行路径查找的算法，例如批量加权 A* 和 Q* 搜索以及束搜索，以解决路径查找问题。最后，还提供了一些方便的功能，用于在训练和求解过程中进行可视化、代码分析和进度监控。 GitHub 存储库可在 https://github.com/forestagostinelli/deepxube 上公开获取。
tldr: DeepXube is a Python package for automating pathfinding solutions using machine learning to learn heuristic functions for deep neural networks, leveraging reinforcement learning, heuristic search, and formal logic.
tldr_zh: DeepXube是一个Python软件包，旨在通过机器学习学习启发式函数来自动化路径规划问题的解决方案，并利用强化学习、启发式搜索和形式逻辑来处理深度神经网络。

title: Self Paced Gaussian Contextual Reinforcement Learning
summary: Curriculum learning improves reinforcement learning (RL) efficiency by sequencing tasks from simple to complex. However, many self-paced curriculum methods rely on computationally expensive inner-loop optimizations, limiting their scalability in high-dimensional context spaces. In this paper, we propose Self-Paced Gaussian Curriculum Learning (SPGL), a novel approach that avoids costly numerical procedures by leveraging a closed-form update rule for Gaussian context distributions. SPGL maintains the sample efficiency and adaptability of traditional self-paced methods while substantially reducing computational overhead. We provide theoretical guarantees on convergence and validate our method across several contextual RL benchmarks, including the Point Mass, Lunar Lander, and Ball Catching environments. Experimental results show that SPGL matches or outperforms existing curriculum methods, especially in hidden context scenarios, and achieves more stable context distribution convergence. Our method offers a scalable, principled alternative for curriculum generation in challenging continuous and partially observable domains.
summary_zh:
以下是翻译结果：

课程学习通过从简单到复杂的任务排序改善强化学习(RL)的效率。然而，许多自步课程方法依赖于计算代价昂贵的内循环优化，限制了它们在高维上下文空间中的可扩展性。在本文中，我们提出自步高斯课程学习(SPGL)，一种新颖的方法，通过利用高斯上下文分布的闭式更新规则来避免代价高昂的数值过程。 SPGL保持了传统自步方法的样本效率和适应性，同时显著降低了计算开销。我们提供了关于收敛性的理论保证，并在几个上下文强化学习基准上验证了我们的方法，包括点质量、月球着陆器和接球环境。实验结果表明，SPGL匹配或优于现有的课程方法，特别是在隐藏上下文场景中，并且实现了更稳定的上下文分布收敛。我们的方法为具有挑战性的连续和部分可观察领域中的课程生成提供了一种可扩展的、基于原则的替代方案。
tldr: The paper introduces Self-Paced Gaussian Curriculum Learning (SPGL) for contextual reinforcement learning, which utilizes a closed-form update rule for Gaussian context distributions to improve scalability and performance compared to existing curriculum learning methods, especially in hidden context scenarios. It's validated on standard RL benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种用于上下文强化学习的自定步调高斯课程学习（SPGL）方法。该方法利用高斯上下文分布的闭式更新规则，与现有的课程学习方法相比，提高了可扩展性和性能，尤其是在隐藏上下文场景中。该方法已在标准强化学习基准上进行了验证。

title: BXRL: Behavior-Explainable Reinforcement Learning
summary:
A major challenge of Reinforcement Learning is that agents often learn undesired behaviors that seem to defy the reward structure they were given. Explainable Reinforcement Learning (XRL) methods can answer queries such as "explain this specific action", "explain this specific trajectory", and "explain the entire policy". However, XRL lacks a formal definition for behavior as a pattern of actions across many episodes. We provide such a definition, and use it to enable a new query: "Explain this behavior".
  We present Behavior-Explainable Reinforcement Learning (BXRL), a new problem formulation that treats behaviors as first-class objects. BXRL defines a behavior measure as any function $m : Π\to \mathbb{R}$, allowing users to precisely express the pattern of actions that they find interesting and measure how strongly the policy exhibits it. We define contrastive behaviors that reduce the question "why does the agent prefer $a$ to $a'$?" to "why is $m(π)$ high?" which can be explored with differentiation. We do not implement an explainability method; we instead analyze three existing methods and propose how they could be adapted to explain behavior. We present a port of the HighwayEnv driving environment to JAX, which provides an interface for defining, measuring, and differentiating behaviors with respect to the model parameters.
summary_zh:
强化学习的一个主要挑战是，智能体常常会学习到不期望的行为，这些行为似乎与它们被赋予的奖励结构相悖。可解释的强化学习（XRL）方法可以回答诸如“解释这个特定动作”、“解释这个特定轨迹”和“解释整个策略”等问题。然而，XRL缺乏对行为作为一个跨多个 episode 的动作模式的正式定义。我们提供了这样的定义，并使用它来启用一个新的查询：“解释这种行为”。

我们提出了行为可解释强化学习（BXRL），这是一种将行为视为一等对象的新问题公式。BXRL 将行为度量定义为任何函数 $m : Π\to \mathbb{R}$，允许用户精确地表达他们感兴趣的动作模式，并度量策略在多大程度上表现出这种模式。我们定义了对比行为，将问题“为什么智能体更喜欢 $a$ 而不是 $a'$？”简化为“为什么 $m(π)$ 很高？”，这可以通过微分进行探索。我们没有实现一种可解释性方法；而是分析了三种现有方法，并提出了如何调整它们来解释行为。我们提出了 HighwayEnv 驾驶环境到 JAX 的移植，它提供了一个接口，用于定义、测量和区分相对于模型参数的行为。
tldr: The paper introduces Behavior-Explainable Reinforcement Learning (BXRL), a framework for explaining behaviors (patterns of actions) in RL agents, using a formal definition of behavior and contrastive explanations.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了行为可解释强化学习 (BXRL)，它是一个用于解释 RL 智能体中行为（动作模式）的框架，使用了行为的形式化定义和对比解释。

title: Dual-Gated Epistemic Time-Dilation: Autonomous Compute Modulation in Asynchronous MARL
summary: While Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) algorithms achieve unprecedented successes across complex continuous domains, their standard deployment strictly adheres to a synchronous operational paradigm. Under this paradigm, agents are universally forced to execute deep neural network inferences at every micro-frame, regardless of immediate necessity. This dense throughput acts as a fundamental barrier to physical deployment on edge-devices where thermal and metabolic budgets are highly constrained. We propose Epistemic Time-Dilation MAPPO (ETD-MAPPO), augmented with a Dual-Gated Epistemic Trigger. Instead of depending on rigid frame-skipping (macro-actions), agents autonomously modulate their execution frequency by interpreting aleatoric uncertainty (via Shannon entropy of their policy) and epistemic uncertainty (via state-value divergence in a Twin-Critic architecture). To format this, we structure the environment as a Semi-Markov Decision Process (SMDP) and build the SMDP-Aligned Asynchronous Gradient Masking Critic to ensure proper credit assignment. Empirical findings demonstrate massive improvements (> 60% relative baseline acquisition leaps) over current temporal models. By assessing LBF, MPE, and the 115-dimensional state space of Google Research Football (GRF), ETD correctly prevented premature policy collapse. Remarkably, this unconstrained approach leads to emergent Temporal Role Specialization, reducing computational overhead by a statistically dominant 73.6% entirely during off-ball execution without deteriorating centralized task dominance.
summary_zh: 多智能体强化学习(MARL)算法在复杂连续领域取得了前所未有的成功，但其标准部署严格遵循同步操作模式。在这种模式下，无论是否立即需要，智能体都被普遍强制在每个微帧执行深度神经网络推理。这种密集吞吐量构成了在边缘设备上进行物理部署的根本障碍，因为边缘设备的散热和代谢预算受到高度限制。我们提出了认知时间膨胀MAPPO (ETD-MAPPO)，它通过双门控认知触发器进行增强。智能体不再依赖于刚性的帧跳跃（宏动作），而是通过解释随机不确定性（通过策略的香农熵）和认知不确定性（通过双重评论家架构中的状态值差异）来自主调节其执行频率。为了实现这一点，我们将环境构建为半马尔可夫决策过程(SMDP)，并构建了SMDP对齐的异步梯度掩蔽评论家，以确保正确的信用分配。经验结果表明，与当前的时间模型相比，有了巨大的改进（> 60%的相对基线获取飞跃）。通过评估LBF、MPE和谷歌足球研究(GRF)的115维状态空间，ETD正确地阻止了策略的过早崩溃。值得注意的是，这种非约束方法导致了涌现的时间角色专业化，完全在非球执行期间将计算开销降低了统计上占优势的73.6%，而没有降低集中式任务主导地位。
tldr: The paper introduces Epistemic Time-Dilation MAPPO (ETD-MAPPO), an asynchronous MARL method that autonomously modulates agent execution frequency based on uncertainty, achieving significant compute reduction and performance improvements in various environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Epistemic Time-Dilation MAPPO (ETD-MAPPO)，一种异步MARL方法，它基于不确定性自主调节代理的执行频率，在各种环境中实现了显著的计算量减少和性能提升。

title: ORACLE: Orchestrate NPC Daily Activities using Contrastive Learning with Transformer-CVAE
summary: The integration of Non-player characters (NPCs) within digital environments has been increasingly recognized for its potential to augment user immersion and cognitive engagement. The sophisticated orchestration of their daily activities, reflecting the nuances of human daily routines, contributes significantly to the realism of digital environments. Nevertheless, conventional approaches often produce monotonous repetition, falling short of capturing the intricacies of real human activity plans. In response to this, we introduce ORACLE, a novel generative model for the synthesis of realistic indoor daily activity plans, ensuring NPCs' authentic presence in digital habitats. Exploiting the CASAS smart home dataset's 24-hour indoor activity sequences, ORACLE addresses challenges in the dataset, including its imbalanced sequential data, the scarcity of training samples, and the absence of pre-trained models encapsulating human daily activity patterns. ORACLE's training leverages the sequential data processing prowess of Transformers, the generative controllability of Conditional Variational Autoencoders (CVAE), and the discriminative refinement of contrastive learning. Our experimental results validate the superiority of generating NPC activity plans and the efficacy of our design strategies over existing methods.
summary_zh: 非玩家角色（NPC）在数字环境中的集成，因其增强用户沉浸感和认知参与的潜力而日益受到重视。对其日常活动的精细编排，反映了人类日常生活的细微差别，对数字环境的真实性做出了重要贡献。然而，传统方法往往产生单调的重复，无法捕捉到真实人类活动计划的复杂性。为应对这一情况，我们推出ORACLE，一种新型生成模型，用于合成逼真的室内日常活动计划，以确保NPC在数字栖息地中的真实存在。ORACLE利用CASAS智能家居数据集的24小时室内活动序列，解决了数据集中的挑战，包括其不平衡的序列数据、稀缺的训练样本以及缺乏封装人类日常活动模式的预训练模型。ORACLE的训练利用了Transformer的序列数据处理能力、条件变分自编码器（CVAE）的生成可控性以及对比学习的判别细化。我们的实验结果验证了生成NPC活动计划的优越性以及我们的设计策略相对于现有方法的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces ORACLE, a novel generative model using Transformers, CVAE, and contrastive learning to synthesize realistic daily activity plans for NPCs in digital environments, addressing limitations in existing datasets and methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为ORACLE的新型生成模型，它使用Transformer、CVAE和对比学习来合成数字环境中NPC的逼真日常活动计划，解决了现有数据集和方法的局限性。

title: CoordLight: Learning Decentralized Coordination for Network-Wide Traffic Signal Control
summary: Adaptive traffic signal control (ATSC) is crucial in alleviating congestion, maximizing throughput and promoting sustainable mobility in ever-expanding cities. Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) has recently shown significant potential in addressing complex traffic dynamics, but the intricacies of partial observability and coordination in decentralized environments still remain key challenges in formulating scalable and efficient control strategies. To address these challenges, we present CoordLight, a MARL-based framework designed to improve intra-neighborhood traffic by enhancing decision-making at individual junctions (agents), as well as coordination with neighboring agents, thereby scaling up to network-level traffic optimization. Specifically, we introduce the Queue Dynamic State Encoding (QDSE), a novel state representation based on vehicle queuing models, which strengthens the agents' capability to analyze, predict, and respond to local traffic dynamics. We further propose an advanced MARL algorithm, named Neighbor-aware Policy Optimization (NAPO). It integrates an attention mechanism that discerns the state and action dependencies among adjacent agents, aiming to facilitate more coordinated decision-making, and to improve policy learning updates through robust advantage calculation. This enables agents to identify and prioritize crucial interactions with influential neighbors, thus enhancing the targeted coordination and collaboration among agents. Through comprehensive evaluations against state-of-the-art traffic signal control methods over three real-world traffic datasets composed of up to 196 intersections, we empirically show that CoordLight consistently exhibits superior performance across diverse traffic networks with varying traffic flows. The code is available at https://github.com/marmotlab/CoordLight
summary_zh: 自适应交通信号控制（ATSC）对于缓解拥堵、最大化通行能力以及在不断扩张的城市中促进可持续出行至关重要。近年来，多智能体强化学习（MARL）在应对复杂的交通动态方面展现出巨大的潜力，但分散式环境中部分可观测性和协调性的复杂性仍然是制定可扩展且高效的控制策略的关键挑战。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了CoordLight，一个基于MARL的框架，旨在通过增强单个交叉口（智能体）的决策制定以及与相邻智能体的协调，从而改善邻域内部的交通状况，进而扩展到网络级别的交通优化。具体而言，我们引入了一种基于车辆排队模型的创新状态表示，即队列动态状态编码（QDSE），它增强了智能体分析、预测和响应本地交通动态的能力。我们进一步提出了一种先进的MARL算法，名为邻居感知策略优化（NAPO）。它集成了一种注意力机制，可以辨别相邻智能体之间的状态和行动依赖关系，旨在促进更协调的决策制定，并通过稳健的优势计算来改进策略学习更新。这使得智能体能够识别并优先考虑与具有影响力的邻居的关键互动，从而增强智能体之间的有针对性的协调和协作。通过在由多达196个交叉口组成的三个真实世界交通数据集上，针对最先进的交通信号控制方法进行全面评估，我们通过实验表明，CoordLight在具有不同交通流量的各种交通网络中始终表现出卓越的性能。代码可在https://github.com/marmotlab/CoordLight获得。
tldr: The paper introduces CoordLight, a MARL-based framework with Queue Dynamic State Encoding (QDSE) and Neighbor-aware Policy Optimization (NAPO) for decentralized traffic signal control, demonstrating superior performance on real-world datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CoordLight，一个基于MARL的框架，具有队列动态状态编码（QDSE）和邻居感知策略优化（NAPO），用于分散式交通信号控制，并在真实世界数据集中表现出卓越的性能。

title: Attack Assessment and Augmented Identity Recognition for Human Skeleton Data
summary: Machine learning models trained on small data sets for security applications are especially vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Person identification from LiDAR based skeleton data requires time consuming and expensive data acquisition for each subject identity. Recently, Assessment and Augmented Identity Recognition for Skeletons (AAIRS) has been used to train Hierarchical Co-occurrence Networks for Person Identification (HCN-ID) with small LiDAR based skeleton data sets. However, AAIRS does not evaluate robustness of HCN-ID to adversarial attacks or inoculate the model to defend against such attacks. Popular perturbation-based approaches to generating adversarial attacks are constrained to targeted perturbations added to real training samples, which is not ideal for inoculating models with small training sets. Thus, we propose Attack-AAIRS, a novel addition to the AAIRS framework. Attack-AAIRS leverages a small real data set and a GAN generated synthetic data set to assess and improve model robustness against unseen adversarial attacks. Rather than being constrained to perturbations of limited real training samples, the GAN learns the distribution of adversarial attack samples that exploit weaknesses in HCN-ID. Attack samples drawn from this distribution augment training for inoculation of the HCN-ID to improve robustness. Ten-fold cross validation of Attack-AAIRS yields increased robustness to unseen attacks- including FGSM, PGD, Additive Gaussian Noise, MI-FGSM, and BIM. The HCN-ID Synthetic Data Quality Score for Attack-AAIRS indicates that generated attack samples are of similar quality to the original benign synthetic samples generated by AAIRS. Furthermore, inoculated models show consistent final test accuracy with the original model trained on real data, demonstrating that our method improves robustness to adversarial attacks without reducing test performance on real data.
summary_zh: 使用小数据集训练的安全应用机器学习模型尤其容易受到对抗攻击。从基于激光雷达的骨骼数据进行人员识别，需要为每个个体身份进行耗时且昂贵的数据采集。最近，骨骼评估和增强身份识别（AAIRS）已被用于训练分层共现网络进行人员识别（HCN-ID），使用基于激光雷达的小型骨骼数据集。然而，AAIRS并未评估HCN-ID对对抗攻击的鲁棒性，也未接种模型以防御此类攻击。流行的基于扰动的对抗攻击生成方法仅限于添加到真实训练样本的有针对性的扰动，这对于使用小型训练集接种模型而言并不理想。因此，我们提出了Attack-AAIRS，这是对AAIRS框架的新颖补充。Attack-AAIRS利用小型真实数据集和GAN生成的合成数据集来评估和提高模型对未见对抗攻击的鲁棒性。GAN不再局限于对有限的真实训练样本进行扰动，而是学习利用HCN-ID弱点的对抗攻击样本分布。从该分布中提取的攻击样本增加了训练，用于HCN-ID的接种，从而提高鲁棒性。Attack-AAIRS的十折交叉验证提高了对未见攻击的鲁棒性，包括FGSM、PGD、加性高斯噪声、MI-FGSM和BIM。Attack-AAIRS的HCN-ID合成数据质量评分表明，生成的攻击样本与AAIRS生成的原始良性合成样本具有相似的质量。此外，接种后的模型显示出与在真实数据上训练的原始模型一致的最终测试准确率，表明我们的方法提高了对抗攻击的鲁棒性，而不会降低真实数据的测试性能。
tldr: This paper introduces Attack-AAIRS, a novel framework that uses GAN-generated adversarial examples to improve the robustness of LiDAR-based skeleton identification systems against various attacks without sacrificing performance on real data.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为 Attack-AAIRS 的新框架，该框架使用 GAN 生成的对抗样本来提高基于 LiDAR 的骨骼识别系统对各种攻击的鲁棒性，同时不牺牲在真实数据上的性能。

title: How unconstrained machine-learning models learn physical symmetries
summary: The requirement of generating predictions that exactly fulfill the fundamental symmetry of the corresponding physical quantities has profoundly shaped the development of machine-learning models for physical simulations. In many cases, models are built using constrained mathematical forms that ensure that symmetries are enforced exactly. However, unconstrained models that do not obey rotational symmetries are often found to have competitive performance, and to be able to \emph{learn} to a high level of accuracy an approximate equivariant behavior with a simple data augmentation strategy. In this paper, we introduce rigorous metrics to measure the symmetry content of the learned representations in such models, and assess the accuracy by which the outputs fulfill the equivariant condition. We apply these metrics to two unconstrained, transformer-based models operating on decorated point clouds (a graph neural network for atomistic simulations and a PointNet-style architecture for particle physics) to investigate how symmetry information is processed across architectural layers and is learned during training. Based on these insights, we establish a rigorous framework for diagnosing spectral failure modes in ML models. Enabled by this analysis, we demonstrate that one can achieve superior stability and accuracy by strategically injecting the minimum required inductive biases, preserving the high expressivity and scalability of unconstrained architectures while guaranteeing physical fidelity.
summary_zh: 对预测结果精确满足物理量基本对称性的要求深刻地影响了用于物理模拟的机器学习模型的发展。在许多情况下，模型是使用受约束的数学形式构建的，以确保严格执行对称性。然而，未受约束的、不遵守旋转对称性的模型通常具有竞争性的性能，并且可以通过简单的数据增强策略\emph{学习}到高精度的近似等变行为。在本文中，我们引入了严格的指标来衡量此类模型中习得表征的对称性含量，并评估输出满足等变条件的准确性。我们将这些指标应用于两个在带装饰的点云上运行的、基于Transformer的未受约束模型（用于原子模拟的图神经网络和用于粒子物理的PointNet风格架构），以研究对称性信息如何在架构层中处理并在训练期间学习。基于这些见解，我们建立了一个严格的框架，用于诊断机器学习模型中的谱失效模式。通过这种分析，我们证明可以通过策略性地注入所需的最少归纳偏置，同时保留未受约束架构的高表达性和可扩展性，并保证物理保真度，从而实现卓越的稳定性和准确性。
tldr: The paper analyzes how unconstrained machine learning models learn physical symmetries, introduces metrics to measure the symmetry content in learned representations, and demonstrates improved stability and accuracy by injecting minimal inductive biases.
tldr_zh: 这篇文章分析了无约束机器学习模型如何学习物理对称性，引入了衡量学习表征中对称性内容的指标，并通过注入最少的归纳偏置，展示了更高的稳定性和准确性。

title: Wireless communication empowers online scheduling of partially-observable transportation multi-robot systems in a smart factory
summary: Achieving agile and reconfigurable production flows in smart factories depends on online multi-robot task assignment (MRTA), which requires online collision-free and congestion-free route scheduling of transportation multi-robot systems (T-MRS), e.g., collaborative automatic guided vehicles (AGVs). Due to the real-time operational requirements and dynamic interactions between T-MRS and production MRS, online scheduling under partial observability in dynamic factory environments remains a significant and under-explored challenge. This paper proposes a novel communication-enabled online scheduling framework that explicitly couples wireless machine-to-machine (M2M) networking with route scheduling, enabling AGVs to exchange intention information, e.g., planned routes, to overcome partial observations and assist complex computation of online scheduling. Specifically, we determine intelligent AGVs' intention and sensor data as new M2M traffic and tailor the retransmission-free multi-link transmission networking to meet real-time operation demands. This scheduling-oriented networking is then integrated with a simulated annealing-based MRTA scheme and a congestion-aware A*-based route scheduling method. The integrated communication and scheduling scheme allows AGVs to dynamically adjust collision-free and congestion-free routes with reduced computational overhead. Numerical experiments shows the impacts from wireless communication on the performance of T-MRS and suggest that the proposed integrated scheme significantly enhances scheduling efficiency compared to other baselines, even under high AGV load conditions and limited channel resources. Moreover, the results reveal that the scheduling-oriented wireless M2M communication design fundamentally differs from human-to-human communications, implying new technological opportunities in a wireless networked smart factory.
summary_zh: 在智能工厂中实现敏捷且可重构的生产流程依赖于在线多机器人任务分配（MRTA），这需要对运输多机器人系统（T-MRS）进行在线无碰撞、无拥塞的路径规划，例如协作式自动引导车辆（AGV）。由于实时运行要求以及 T-MRS 和生产 MRS 之间的动态交互，在动态工厂环境中，基于部分可观测性的在线调度仍然是一个重大且未被充分探索的挑战。本文提出了一种新型的基于通信的在线调度框架，该框架将无线机器对机器（M2M）网络与路径规划显式耦合，使 AGV 能够交换意图信息（例如，计划路径），以克服部分观测并辅助在线调度的复杂计算。具体而言，我们将智能 AGV 的意图和传感器数据确定为新的 M2M 流量，并定制了免重传的多链路传输网络，以满足实时运行需求。然后，将这种面向调度的网络与基于模拟退火的 MRTA 方案以及基于 A* 算法的拥塞感知路径规划方法集成。集成的通信和调度方案使 AGV 能够动态调整无碰撞、无拥塞的路径，同时降低计算开销。数值实验表明了无线通信对 T-MRS 性能的影响，并表明与其它基线方法相比，即使在高 AGV 负载条件和有限信道资源下，所提出的集成方案也能显著提高调度效率。此外，结果表明，面向调度的无线 M2M 通信设计与人际通信有着根本区别，这预示着无线网络智能工厂中新的技术机遇。
tldr: This paper proposes a communication-enabled online scheduling framework for transportation multi-robot systems (T-MRS) in smart factories, integrating wireless machine-to-machine (M2M) networking with route scheduling to improve efficiency under partial observability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于智能工厂中运输多机器人系统 (T-MRS) 的通信使能在线调度框架，该框架将无线机器对机器 (M2M) 网络与路径调度相结合，以提高在部分可观测性下的效率。

title: Energy-Efficient Hierarchical Federated Anomaly Detection for the Internet of Underwater Things via Selective Cooperative Aggregation
summary: Anomaly detection is a core service in the Internet of Underwater Things, yet training accurate distributed models underwater is difficult because acoustic links are low-bandwidth, energy-intensive, and often unable to support direct sensor-to-surface communication. Standard flat federated learning therefore faces two coupled limitations in underwater deployments: expensive long-range transmissions and reduced participation when only a subset of sensors can reach the gateway. This paper proposes an energy-efficient hierarchical federated learning framework for underwater anomaly detection based on three components: feasibility-aware sensor-to-fog association, compressed model-update transmission, and selective cooperative aggregation among fog nodes. The proposed three-tier architecture localises most communication within short-range clusters while activating fog-to-fog exchange only when smaller clusters can benefit from nearby larger neighbours. A physics-grounded underwater acoustic model is used to evaluate detection quality, communication energy, and network participation jointly. In large synthetic deployments, only about 48% of sensors can directly reach the gateway in the 200-sensor case, whereas hierarchical learning preserves full participation through feasible fog paths. Selective cooperation matches the detection accuracy of always-on inter-fog exchange while reducing its energy by 31-33%, and compressed uploads reduce total energy by 71-95% in matched sensitivity tests. Experiments on three real benchmarks further show that low-overhead hierarchical methods remain competitive in detection quality, while flat federated learning defines the minimum-energy operating point. These results provide practical design guidance for underwater deployments operating under severe acoustic communication constraints.
summary_zh: 异常检测是水下物联网中的一项核心服务，然而，训练准确的水下分布式模型非常困难，因为声学链路带宽低、能源密集，且通常无法支持直接的传感器到水面通信。因此，标准扁平联邦学习在水下部署中面临着两个相关的限制：昂贵的远距离传输，以及只有一部分传感器能到达网关时导致的参与度降低。本文提出了一种用于水下异常检测的节能分层联邦学习框架，该框架基于三个组成部分：可行性感知的传感器到雾节点关联、压缩的模型更新传输，以及雾节点之间的选择性协同聚合。所提出的三层架构将大部分通信本地化在短距离集群内，仅当较小的集群可以从附近较大的邻居中受益时，才激活雾节点之间的交换。使用一个基于物理的水下声学模型来联合评估检测质量、通信能量和网络参与度。在大型合成部署中，在200个传感器的情况下，只有约48%的传感器可以直接到达网关，而分层学习通过可行的雾节点路径保留了完全的参与度。选择性协同能够在达到常开雾节点间交换的检测准确度的同时，将其能量降低31-33%，并且在匹配的灵敏度测试中，压缩上传可以将总能量降低71-95%。在三个真实基准上的实验进一步表明，低开销的分层方法在检测质量上仍然具有竞争力，而扁平联邦学习定义了最小能量操作点。这些结果为在严苛声学通信约束下运行的水下部署提供了实用的设计指导。
tldr: This paper presents an energy-efficient hierarchical federated learning framework for anomaly detection in the Internet of Underwater Things, addressing communication constraints and limited sensor participation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对水下物联网中异常检测的节能分层联邦学习框架，旨在解决通信约束和有限的传感器参与问题。

title: Learning Response-Statistic Shifts and Parametric Roll Episodes from Wave--Vessel Time Series via LSTM Functional Models
summary: Parametric roll is a rare but high-consequence instability that can trigger abrupt regime changes in ship response, including pronounced shifts in roll statistics and tail risk. This paper develops a data-driven surrogate that learns the nonlinear, causal functional mapping from incident wave--motion time series to vessel motions, and demonstrates that the surrogate reproduces both (i) parametric roll episodes and (ii) the associated statistical shifts in the response. Crucially, the learning framework is data-source agnostic: the paired wave--motion time series can be obtained from controlled experiments (e.g., towing-tank or basin tests with wave probes and motion tracking) when a hull exists, or from high-fidelity simulations during design when experiments are not yet available. To provide a controlled severe-sea demonstration, we generate training data with a URANS numerical wave tank, using long-crested irregular seas synthesized from a modified Pierson--Moskowitz spectrum. The demonstration dataset comprises 49 random-phase realizations for each of three sea states, simulated at a fixed forward speed selected to yield encounter conditions under which parametric-roll episodes can occur. A stacked LSTM surrogate is trained on wave-elevation time series and evaluated on held-out realizations using time-domain accuracy and distributional fidelity metrics. In the most severe case, the model tracks the onset and growth of large-amplitude roll consistent with parametric excitation, and captures the corresponding changes in roll probability density functions (PDFs). We further compare loss-function choices (MSE, relative-entropy-based objectives, and amplitude-weighted variants) and show how they trade average error for improved tail fidelity relevant to operability and risk assessment.
summary_zh: 参数横摇是一种罕见但后果严重的失稳现象，会导致船舶响应的突发性状态改变，包括横摇统计数据的显著变化和尾部风险。本文开发了一种数据驱动的替代模型，用于学习从入射波-运动时间序列到船体运动的非线性、因果函数映射，并证明该替代模型既能重现（i）参数横摇事件，又能重现（ii）响应中相关的统计变化。至关重要的是，该学习框架对数据源具有不可知性：成对的波-运动时间序列可以从受控实验中获得（例如，存在船体的拖曳水池或水池测试，使用波高仪和运动跟踪），或者在设计阶段实验尚未可用时，可以从高精度仿真中获得。为了提供一个受控的恶劣海况演示，我们使用基于修正Pierson-Moskowitz谱合成的长峰不规则波，通过URANS数值水池生成训练数据。演示数据集包含三种海况下的49个随机相位实现，均以固定的前向速度进行模拟，该速度的选择旨在产生能够发生参数横摇事件的遭遇条件。一个堆叠LSTM替代模型在波高时间序列上进行训练，并使用时域精度和分布保真度指标在保留的实现上进行评估。在最恶劣的情况下，该模型能够跟踪与参数激励一致的大幅度横摇的开始和增长，并捕获横摇概率密度函数（PDF）的相应变化。我们进一步比较了损失函数的选择（MSE、基于相对熵的目标函数以及幅度加权变体），并展示了它们如何权衡平均误差与改进的尾部保真度，后者对于可操作性和风险评估至关重要。
tldr: This paper presents an LSTM-based surrogate model for predicting parametric roll in ships from wave data, demonstrating its ability to capture both roll episodes and statistical shifts. The model is data-source agnostic, allowing training from experiments or high-fidelity simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于LSTM的代理模型，用于从波浪数据中预测船舶的参数横摇，展示了其捕捉横摇事件和统计变化的能力。该模型具有数据源无关性，允许从实验或高保真模拟中进行训练。

title: Hierarchical Spatial-Temporal Graph-Enhanced Model for Map-Matching
summary: The integration of GNSS data into portable devices has led to the generation of vast amounts of trajectory data, which is crucial for applications such as map-matching. To tackle the limitations of rule-based methods, recent works in deep learning for trajectory-related tasks occur. However, existing models remain challenging due to issues such as the difficulty of large-scale data labeling, ineffective modeling of spatial-temporal relationships, and discrepancies between training and test data distributions. To tackle these challenges, we propose HSTGMatch, a novel model designed to enhance map-matching performance. Our approach involves a two-stage process: hierarchical self-supervised learning and spatial-temporal supervised learning. We introduce a hierarchical trajectory representation, leveraging both grid cells and geographic tuples to capture moving patterns effectively. The model constructs an Adaptive Trajectory Adjacency Graph to dynamically capture spatial relationships, optimizing GATs for improved efficiency. Furthermore, we incorporate a Spatial-Temporal Factor to extract relevant features and employ a decay coefficient to address variations in trajectory length. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the model's superior performance, module effectiveness, and robustness, providing a promising solution for overcoming the existing limitations in map-matching applications. The source code of HSTGMatch is publicly available on GitHub at https://github.com/Nerooo-g/HSTGMatch.
summary_zh: 将GNSS数据集成到便携式设备中产生了大量的轨迹数据，这对于地图匹配等应用至关重要。为了克服基于规则方法的局限性，近年来涌现出许多用于轨迹相关任务的深度学习方法。然而，由于大规模数据标注的困难、时空关系建模的低效以及训练和测试数据分布的差异等问题，现有模型仍然面临挑战。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的模型HSTGMatch，旨在提高地图匹配性能。我们的方法包括两个阶段：分层自监督学习和时空监督学习。我们引入了一种分层轨迹表示，利用网格单元和地理元组来有效地捕捉移动模式。该模型构建一个自适应轨迹邻接图来动态捕捉空间关系，并优化GAT以提高效率。此外，我们结合了一个时空因子来提取相关特征，并采用衰减系数来解决轨迹长度的变化问题。我们的大量实验证明了该模型的优越性能、模块有效性和鲁棒性，为克服地图匹配应用中现有的局限性提供了一种有前景的解决方案。HSTGMatch的源代码已在GitHub上公开发布，地址为https://github.com/Nerooo-g/HSTGMatch。
tldr: The paper introduces HSTGMatch, a novel hierarchical spatial-temporal graph-enhanced model for map-matching that uses self-supervised and supervised learning to improve performance and robustness by addressing limitations in existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为HSTGMatch的新型分层时空图增强地图匹配模型，该模型利用自监督和监督学习来提高性能和鲁棒性，解决了现有方法的局限性。

title: The impact of sensor placement on graph-neural-network-based leakage detection
summary: Sensor placement for leakage detection in water distribution networks is an important and practical challenge for water utilities. Recent work has shown that graph neural networks can estimate and predict pressures and detect leaks, but their performance strongly depends on the available sensor measurements and configurations. In this paper, we investigate how sensor placement influences the performance of GNN-based leakage detection. We propose a novel PageRank-Centrality-based sensor placement method and demonstrate that it substantially impacts reconstruction, prediction, and leakage detection on the EPANET Net1.
summary_zh: 用于配水管网泄漏检测的传感器布置是供水企业面临的一项重要且具有实践意义的挑战。最近的研究表明，图神经网络可以估计和预测压力并检测泄漏，但其性能在很大程度上取决于可用的传感器测量数据和配置。在本文中，我们研究了传感器布置如何影响基于GNN的泄漏检测的性能。我们提出了一种新颖的基于PageRank中心性的传感器布置方法，并证明了它对EPANET Net1上的重建、预测和泄漏检测产生了显著影响。
tldr: This paper explores the impact of sensor placement strategies on the performance of graph neural networks for leakage detection in water distribution networks, proposing a PageRank-Centrality-based method for improved performance.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了传感器放置策略对图神经网络在供水网络泄漏检测中的性能影响，并提出了一种基于网页排名中心性的方法以提高性能。

title: Vega: Learning to Drive with Natural Language Instructions
summary: Vision-language-action models have reshaped autonomous driving to incorporate languages into the decision-making process. However, most existing pipelines only utilize the language modality for scene descriptions or reasoning and lack the flexibility to follow diverse user instructions for personalized driving. To address this, we first construct a large-scale driving dataset (InstructScene) containing around 100,000 scenes annotated with diverse driving instructions with the corresponding trajectories. We then propose a unified Vision-Language-World-Action model, Vega, for instruction-based generation and planning. We employ the autoregressive paradigm to process visual inputs (vision) and language instructions (language) and the diffusion paradigm to generate future predictions (world modeling) and trajectories (action). We perform joint attention to enable interactions between the modalities and use individual projection layers for different modalities for more capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method not only achieves superior planning performance but also exhibits strong instruction-following abilities, paving the way for more intelligent and personalized driving systems.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型已经重塑了自动驾驶，将语言融入决策过程。然而，现有的大多数流程仅利用语言模态进行场景描述或推理，缺乏根据不同的用户指令进行个性化驾驶的灵活性。为了解决这个问题，我们首先构建了一个大型驾驶数据集（InstructScene），其中包含约10万个场景，并标注了各种驾驶指令以及相应的轨迹。然后，我们提出了一个统一的视觉-语言-世界-动作模型Vega，用于基于指令的生成和规划。我们采用自回归范式处理视觉输入（视觉）和语言指令（语言），并采用扩散范式生成未来预测（世界建模）和轨迹（动作）。我们执行联合注意力以实现模态之间的交互，并为不同的模态使用单独的投影层以获得更多能力。大量的实验表明，我们的方法不仅实现了卓越的规划性能，还表现出强大的指令遵循能力，为更智能和个性化的驾驶系统铺平了道路。
tldr: The paper introduces Vega, a vision-language-world-action model for autonomous driving that follows diverse natural language instructions, trained on a newly constructed large-scale dataset, InstructScene, and demonstrating superior performance in planning and instruction following.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种用于自动驾驶的视觉-语言-世界-动作模型Vega，该模型可以遵循各种自然语言指令，并使用新建的大规模数据集InstructScene进行训练，并在规划和指令遵循方面表现出卓越的性能。

title: MMaDA-VLA: Large Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Model with Unified Multi-Modal Instruction and Generation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models aim to control robots for manipulation from visual observations and natural-language instructions. However, existing hierarchical and autoregressive paradigms often introduce architectural overhead, suffer from temporal inconsistency and long-horizon error accumulation, and lack a mechanism to capture environment dynamics without extra modules. To this end, we present MMaDA-VLA, a fully native pre-trained large diffusion VLA model that unifies multi-modal understanding and generation in a single framework. Our key idea is a native discrete diffusion formulation that embeds language, images, and continuous robot controls into one discrete token space and trains a single backbone with masked token denoising to jointly generate a future goal observation and an action chunk in parallel. Iterative denoising enables global, order-free refinement, improving long-horizon consistency while grounding actions in predicted future visual outcomes without auxiliary world models. Experiments across simulation benchmarks and real-world tasks show state-of-the-art performance, achieving 98.0% average success on LIBERO and 4.78 average length on CALVIN.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的目的是从视觉观测和自然语言指令控制机器人进行操作。然而，现有的分层和自回归范式通常引入架构开销，遭受时间不一致性和长程误差累积，并且缺乏在没有额外模块的情况下捕获环境动态的机制。为此，我们提出了MMaDA-VLA，一个完全原生的预训练大型扩散VLA模型，它在单个框架中统一了多模态理解和生成。我们的关键思想是一种原生的离散扩散公式，它将语言、图像和连续机器人控制嵌入到一个离散token空间中，并使用掩码token去噪训练一个单一骨干网络，以并行生成未来的目标观测和一个动作块。迭代去噪能够进行全局的、无序的精细化，提高长程一致性，同时将动作与预测的未来视觉结果相关联，而无需辅助世界模型。在仿真基准测试和真实世界任务中的实验表明，该模型具有最先进的性能，在LIBERO上实现了98.0%的平均成功率，在CALVIN上实现了4.78的平均长度。
tldr: The paper introduces MMaDA-VLA, a novel diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action model that unifies multi-modal understanding and generation for robot control, achieving state-of-the-art performance on long-horizon tasks by predicting future visual states and actions in parallel.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 MMaDA-VLA，一种新颖的基于扩散的视觉-语言-动作模型，它统一了多模态理解和生成，用于机器人控制。通过并行预测未来视觉状态和动作，在长时域任务上实现了最先进的性能。

title: LaMP: Learning Vision-Language-Action Policies with 3D Scene Flow as Latent Motion Prior
summary: We introduce \textbf{LaMP}, a dual-expert Vision-Language-Action framework that embeds dense 3D scene flow as a latent motion prior for robotic manipulation. Existing VLA models regress actions directly from 2D semantic visual features, forcing them to learn complex 3D physical interactions implicitly. This implicit learning strategy degrades under unfamiliar spatial dynamics. LaMP addresses this limitation by aligning a flow-matching \emph{Motion Expert} with a policy-predicting \emph{Action Expert} through gated cross-attention. Specifically, the Motion Expert generates a one-step partially denoised 3D scene flow, and its hidden states condition the Action Expert without full multi-step reconstruction. We evaluate LaMP on the LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and SimplerEnv-WidowX simulation benchmarks as well as real-world experiments. LaMP consistently outperforms evaluated VLA baselines across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and SimplerEnv-WidowX benchmarks, achieving the highest reported average success rates under the same training budgets. On LIBERO-Plus OOD perturbations, LaMP shows improved robustness with an average 9.7% gain over the strongest prior baseline. Our project page is available at https://summerwxk.github.io/lamp-project-page/.
summary_zh: 我们提出了\textbf{LaMP}，一个双专家视觉-语言-动作框架，它将密集的3D场景流嵌入为机器人操作的潜在运动先验。现有的VLA模型直接从2D语义视觉特征回归动作，迫使它们隐式地学习复杂的3D物理交互。这种隐式学习策略在不熟悉的空间动态下会性能下降。LaMP通过门控交叉注意力将一个流匹配的\emph{运动专家}与一个策略预测的\emph{动作专家}对齐来解决这个局限性。具体来说，运动专家生成单步部分去噪的3D场景流，并且其隐藏状态调节动作专家，而无需完整的多步重建。我们在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和SimplerEnv-WidowX模拟基准以及真实世界实验中评估了LaMP。LaMP在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和SimplerEnv-WidowX基准上始终优于所评估的VLA基线，在相同的训练预算下实现了报告的最高平均成功率。在LIBERO-Plus的OOD扰动上，LaMP表现出更好的鲁棒性，相比最强的先验基线平均提升了9.7%。我们的项目页面可以在https://summerwxk.github.io/lamp-project-page/上找到。
tldr: The paper introduces LaMP, a Vision-Language-Action framework that uses 3D scene flow as a latent motion prior for robotic manipulation, improving robustness and performance compared to existing methods, particularly in out-of-distribution scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了LaMP，一个视觉-语言-动作框架，它使用3D场景流作为机器人操作的潜在运动先验，与现有方法相比，提高了鲁棒性和性能，尤其是在分布外场景中。

title: $π$, But Make It Fly: Physics-Guided Transfer of VLA Models to Aerial Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models such as $π_0$ have demonstrated remarkable generalization across diverse fixed-base manipulators. However, transferring these foundation models to aerial platforms remains an open challenge due to the fundamental mismatch between the quasi-static dynamics of fixed-base arms and the underactuated, highly dynamic nature of flight. In this work, we introduce AirVLA, a system that investigates the transferability of manipulation-pretrained VLAs to aerial pick-and-place tasks. We find that while visual representations transfer effectively, the specific control dynamics required for flight do not. To bridge this "dynamics gap" without retraining the foundation model, we introduce a Payload-Aware Guidance mechanism that injects payload constraints directly into the policy's flow-matching sampling process. To overcome data scarcity, we further utilize a Gaussian Splatting pipeline to synthesize navigation training data. We evaluate our method through a cumulative 460 real-world experiments which demonstrate that this synthetic data is a key enabler of performance, unlocking 100% success in navigation tasks where directly fine-tuning on teleoperation data alone attains 81% success. Our inference-time intervention, Payload-Aware Guidance, increases real-world pick-and-place task success from 23% to 50%. Finally, we evaluate the model on a long-horizon compositional task, achieving a 62% overall success rate. These results suggest that pre-trained manipulation VLAs, with appropriate data augmentation and physics-informed guidance, can transfer to aerial manipulation and navigation, as well as the composition of these tasks.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，如$π_0$，已经在各种固定底座机械臂上展现了卓越的泛化能力。然而，由于固定底座机械臂的准静态动力学与欠驱动、高度动态的飞行本质之间存在根本性的不匹配，将这些基础模型迁移到空中平台仍然是一个公开的挑战。在这项工作中，我们引入了AirVLA，一个研究操作预训练的VLA模型向空中拾取放置任务可迁移性的系统。我们发现，虽然视觉表征能够有效迁移，但飞行所需的特定控制动力学却不能。为了在不重新训练基础模型的情况下弥合这种“动力学差距”，我们引入了一种有效载荷感知引导机制，将有效载荷约束直接注入到策略的流匹配采样过程中。为了克服数据稀缺问题，我们进一步利用高斯溅射管线来合成导航训练数据。我们通过累计460次真实世界实验评估了我们的方法，证明了合成数据是性能的关键推动因素，在导航任务中实现了100%的成功率，而仅通过远程操作数据进行微调则仅达到81%的成功率。我们的推理时干预，有效载荷感知引导，将真实世界拾取放置任务的成功率从23%提高到50%。最后，我们评估了该模型在一个长时程组合任务上的表现，实现了62%的整体成功率。这些结果表明，经过适当的数据增强和物理信息引导，预训练的操作VLA模型可以迁移到空中操作和导航，以及这些任务的组合。
tldr: This paper introduces AirVLA, a system that transfers manipulation-pretrained VLAs to aerial pick-and-place tasks by addressing the dynamics gap with payload-aware guidance and synthetic data augmentation, achieving improved success rates in real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了AirVLA，该系统通过有效负载感知引导和合成数据增强来解决动态差距，从而将操纵预训练的VLA转移到空中拾取和放置任务，在真实世界的实验中提高了成功率。

title: HiSpatial: Taming Hierarchical 3D Spatial Understanding in Vision-Language Models
summary: Achieving human-like spatial intelligence for vision-language models (VLMs) requires inferring 3D structures from 2D observations, recognizing object properties and relations in 3D space, and performing high-level spatial reasoning. In this paper, we propose a principled hierarchical framework that decomposes the learning of 3D spatial understanding in VLMs into four progressively complex levels, from geometric perception to abstract spatial reasoning. Guided by this framework, we construct an automated pipeline that processes approximately 5M images with over 45M objects to generate 3D spatial VQA pairs across diverse tasks and scenes for VLM supervised fine-tuning. We also develop an RGB-D VLM incorporating metric-scale point maps as auxiliary inputs to further enhance spatial understanding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple spatial understanding and reasoning benchmarks, surpassing specialized spatial models and large proprietary systems such as Gemini-2.5-pro and GPT-5. Moreover, our analysis reveals clear dependencies among hierarchical task levels, offering new insights into how multi-level task design facilitates the emergence of 3D spatial intelligence.
summary_zh: 对于视觉语言模型 (VLM) 而言，实现类人的空间智能需要从 2D 观测中推断 3D 结构，识别 3D 空间中的物体属性和关系，并执行高层次的空间推理。本文提出了一种有原则的分层框架，将 VLM 中 3D 空间理解的学习分解为四个渐进复杂的层级，从几何感知到抽象空间推理。在该框架的指导下，我们构建了一个自动化流水线，处理约 500 万张图像和 4500 万个以上的物体，从而在不同的任务和场景中生成 3D 空间 VQA 对，用于 VLM 的监督式微调。我们还开发了一种 RGB-D VLM，将度量尺度的点云图作为辅助输入，以进一步增强空间理解。大量实验表明，我们的方法在多个空间理解和推理基准测试上取得了最先进的性能，超越了专门的空间模型和大型专有系统，如 Gemini-2.5-pro 和 GPT-5。此外，我们的分析揭示了分层任务层级之间清晰的依赖关系，为多层级任务设计如何促进 3D 空间智能的涌现提供了新的见解。
tldr: The paper introduces a hierarchical framework and a large-scale dataset for improving 3D spatial understanding in vision-language models, achieving state-of-the-art results and outperforming large proprietary models.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个分层框架和一个大规模数据集，用于提升视觉语言模型中的3D空间理解能力，并取得了最先进的结果，优于大型专有模型。

title: Intern-S1-Pro: Scientific Multimodal Foundation Model at Trillion Scale
summary: We introduce Intern-S1-Pro, the first one-trillion-parameter scientific multimodal foundation model. Scaling to this unprecedented size, the model delivers a comprehensive enhancement across both general and scientific domains. Beyond stronger reasoning and image-text understanding capabilities, its intelligence is augmented with advanced agent capabilities. Simultaneously, its scientific expertise has been vastly expanded to master over 100 specialized tasks across critical science fields, including chemistry, materials, life sciences, and earth sciences. Achieving this massive scale is made possible by the robust infrastructure support of XTuner and LMDeploy, which facilitates highly efficient Reinforcement Learning (RL) training at the 1-trillion parameter level while ensuring strict precision consistency between training and inference. By seamlessly integrating these advancements, Intern-S1-Pro further fortifies the fusion of general and specialized intelligence, working as a Specializable Generalist, demonstrating its position in the top tier of open-source models for general capabilities, while outperforming proprietary models in the depth of specialized scientific tasks.
summary_zh: 我们推出了Intern-S1-Pro，首个万亿参数的科学多模态基础模型。得益于前所未有的规模，该模型在通用和科学领域都实现了全面的增强。除了更强的推理和图文理解能力外，其智能还通过先进的 Agent 能力得到了提升。同时，其科学专业知识也得到了极大的扩展，掌握了化学、材料、生命科学和地球科学等关键科学领域的 100 多项专业任务。能够实现如此巨大的规模，得益于 XTuner 和 LMDeploy 提供的强大基础设施支持，它们促进了万亿参数级别的高效强化学习 (RL) 训练，同时确保了训练和推理之间严格的精度一致性。通过无缝集成这些进步，Intern-S1-Pro 进一步加强了通用和专业智能的融合，作为一个可特化的通用模型，它展示了其在通用能力开源模型中的顶级地位，同时在专业科学任务的深度上优于专有模型。
tldr: Intern-S1-Pro is a new trillion-parameter scientific multimodal foundation model that achieves SOTA performance in both general and specialized scientific tasks, leveraging efficient RL training infrastructure.
tldr_zh: Intern-S1-Pro是一个新的万亿参数科学多模态基础模型，利用高效的强化学习训练基础设施，在通用任务和专业的科学任务中都实现了SOTA性能。

title: Drive My Way: Preference Alignment of Vision-Language-Action Model for Personalized Driving
summary: Human driving behavior is inherently personal, which is shaped by long-term habits and influenced by short-term intentions. Individuals differ in how they accelerate, brake, merge, yield, and overtake across diverse situations. However, existing end-to-end autonomous driving systems either optimize for generic objectives or rely on fixed driving modes, lacking the ability to adapt to individual preferences or interpret natural language intent. To address this gap, we propose Drive My Way (DMW), a personalized Vision-Language-Action (VLA) driving framework that aligns with users' long-term driving habits and adapts to real-time user instructions. DMW learns a user embedding from our personalized driving dataset collected across multiple real drivers and conditions the policy on this embedding during planning, while natural language instructions provide additional short-term guidance. Closed-loop evaluation on the Bench2Drive benchmark demonstrates that DMW improves style instruction adaptation, and user studies show that its generated behaviors are recognizable as each driver's own style, highlighting personalization as a key capability for human-centered autonomous driving. Our data and code are available at https://dmw-cvpr.github.io/.
summary_zh: 人类驾驶行为本质上具有个性化，受到长期习惯塑造并受短期意图影响。个体在不同情况下加速、刹车、并道、让行和超车的方式各不相同。然而，现有的端到端自动驾驶系统要么针对通用目标进行优化，要么依赖于固定的驾驶模式，缺乏适应个体偏好或解释自然语言意图的能力。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了“以我方式驾驶”(Drive My Way, DMW)，这是一个个性化的视觉-语言-动作(VLA) 驾驶框架，它与用户的长期驾驶习惯保持一致，并适应实时的用户指令。DMW从我们跨多个真实驾驶员和条件收集的个性化驾驶数据集中学习用户嵌入，并在规划期间根据此嵌入调节策略，同时自然语言指令提供额外的短期指导。在Bench2Drive基准测试上的闭环评估表明，DMW提高了风格指令适应性，用户研究表明，其生成的行为可识别为每个驾驶员自身的风格，突出了个性化作为以人为中心的自动驾驶的关键能力。我们的数据和代码可在https://dmw-cvpr.github.io/ 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces Drive My Way (DMW), a personalized Vision-Language-Action (VLA) driving framework that learns individual driving styles and adapts to real-time user instructions, improving style instruction adaptation and generating recognizable driving behaviors.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Drive My Way (DMW)，一个个性化的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)驾驶框架，能够学习个体驾驶风格并适应实时用户指令，从而提升风格指令适应性并生成可识别的驾驶行为。

title: SoftMimicGen: A Data Generation System for Scalable Robot Learning in Deformable Object Manipulation
summary: Large-scale robot datasets have facilitated the learning of a wide range of robot manipulation skills, but these datasets remain difficult to collect and scale further, owing to the intractable amount of human time, effort, and cost required. Simulation and synthetic data generation have proven to be an effective alternative to fuel this need for data, especially with the advent of recent work showing that such synthetic datasets can dramatically reduce real-world data requirements and facilitate generalization to novel scenarios unseen in real-world demonstrations. However, this paradigm has been limited to rigid-body tasks, which are easy to simulate. Deformable object manipulation encompasses a large portion of real-world manipulation and remains a crucial gap to address towards increasing adoption of the synthetic simulation data paradigm. In this paper, we introduce SoftMimicGen, an automated data generation pipeline for deformable object manipulation tasks. We introduce a suite of high-fidelity simulation environments that encompasses a wide range of deformable objects (stuffed animal, rope, tissue, towel) and manipulation behaviors (high-precision threading, dynamic whipping, folding, pick-and-place), across four robot embodiments: a single-arm manipulator, bimanual arms, a humanoid, and a surgical robot. We apply SoftMimicGen to generate datasets across the task suite, train high-performing policies from the data, and systematically analyze the data generation system. Project website: \href{https://softmimicgen.github.io}{softmimicgen.github.io}.
summary_zh: 大规模机器人数据集促进了各种机器人操作技能的学习，但由于需要大量的人力、精力和成本，这些数据集仍然难以收集和进一步扩展。仿真和合成数据生成已被证明是满足这种数据需求的有效替代方案，尤其是最近的研究表明，这种合成数据集可以显著减少对真实世界数据的需求，并促进泛化到真实世界演示中未见过的新场景。然而，这种范式一直局限于易于仿真的刚体任务。可变形物体操作涵盖了真实世界操作的很大一部分，并且仍然是弥补合成仿真数据范式推广应用的关键缺口。在本文中，我们介绍了SoftMimicGen，一个用于可变形物体操作任务的自动化数据生成流水线。我们引入了一套高保真仿真环境，涵盖了广泛的可变形物体（毛绒玩具、绳索、纸巾、毛巾）和操作行为（高精度穿线、动态鞭打、折叠、拾取和放置），并应用于四种机器人形态：单臂机械臂、双臂、人形机器人和手术机器人。我们应用SoftMimicGen在整个任务套件中生成数据集，利用这些数据训练高性能策略，并系统地分析数据生成系统。项目网站：\href{https://softmimicgen.github.io}{softmimicgen.github.io}。
tldr: The paper introduces SoftMimicGen, a data generation pipeline for deformable object manipulation using high-fidelity simulation environments across various robots and tasks, aiming to address the limitations of synthetic data generation in robotics which are mostly confined to rigid-body tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SoftMimicGen，一个用于可变形物体操作的数据生成管道，它使用高保真仿真环境，涵盖多种机器人和任务，旨在解决机器人领域中合成数据生成主要局限于刚体任务的局限性。

title: Persistent Robot World Models: Stabilizing Multi-Step Rollouts via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Action-conditioned robot world models generate future video frames of the manipulated scene given a robot action sequence, offering a promising alternative for simulating tasks that are difficult to model with traditional physics engines. However, these models are optimized for short-term prediction and break down when deployed autoregressively: each predicted clip feeds back as context for the next, causing errors to compound and visual quality to rapidly degrade. We address this through the following contributions. First, we introduce a reinforcement learning (RL) post-training scheme that trains the world model on its own autoregressive rollouts rather than on ground-truth histories. We achieve this by adapting a recent contrastive RL objective for diffusion models to our setting and show that its convergence guarantees carry over exactly. Second, we design a training protocol that generates and compares multiple candidate variable-length futures from the same rollout state, reinforcing higher-fidelity predictions over lower-fidelity ones. Third, we develop efficient, multi-view visual fidelity rewards that combine complementary perceptual metrics across camera views and are aggregated at the clip level for dense, low-variance training signal. Fourth, we show that our approach establishes a new state-of-the-art for rollout fidelity on the DROID dataset, outperforming the strongest baseline on all metrics (e.g., LPIPS reduced by 14% on external cameras, SSIM improved by 9.1% on the wrist camera), winning 98% of paired comparisons, and achieving an 80% preference rate in a blind human study.
summary_zh: 动作条件机器人世界模型能够根据机器人动作序列生成被操作场景的未来视频帧，为模拟传统物理引擎难以建模的任务提供了一种很有前景的替代方案。然而，这些模型为了短期预测而优化，并在自回归部署时失效：每个预测的片段都作为上下文反馈给下一个片段，导致误差累积，视觉质量迅速下降。我们通过以下贡献来解决这个问题。首先，我们引入了一种强化学习（RL）后训练方案，该方案基于世界模型自身的自回归展开（rollout）而非真实历史数据来训练世界模型。我们通过将最近的一种用于扩散模型的对比式RL目标函数适配到我们的环境来实现这一点，并证明了其收敛保证可以完全延续。其次，我们设计了一种训练协议，该协议从同一展开状态生成并比较多个候选的变长未来，从而强化高保真度的预测，抑制低保真度的预测。第三，我们开发了高效的多视角视觉保真度奖励，其结合了跨相机视角的互补感知指标，并在片段级别进行聚合，以获得密集的、低方差的训练信号。第四，我们证明了我们的方法在DROID数据集上建立了新的滚动展开保真度水平，在所有指标上都优于最强的基线（例如，外部相机上的LPIPS降低了14%，腕式相机上的SSIM提高了9.1%），在成对比较中赢得了98%的胜利，并在盲人人类研究中达到了80%的偏好率。
tldr: This paper addresses the problem of error compounding in autoregressive robot world models, proposing a reinforcement learning based post-training scheme with novel rewards and training protocols to improve rollout fidelity, achieving state-of-the-art results on the DROID dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文解决了自回归机器人世界模型中误差累积的问题，提出了一种基于强化学习的后训练方案，采用了新的奖励和训练协议来提高rollout的保真度，并在DROID数据集上取得了最先进的成果。

title: Towards Generalizable Robotic Data Flywheel: High-Dimensional Factorization and Composition
summary: The lack of sufficiently diverse data, coupled with limited data efficiency, remains a major bottleneck for generalist robotic models, yet systematic strategies for collecting and curating such data are not fully explored. Task diversity arises from implicit factors that are sparsely distributed across multiple dimensions and are difficult to define explicitly. To address this challenge, we propose F-ACIL, a heuristic factor-aware compositional iterative learning framework that enables structured data factorization and promotes compositional generalization. F-ACIL decomposes the data distribution into structured factor spaces such as object, action, and environment. Based on the factorized formulation, we develop a factor-wise data collection and an iterative training paradigm that promotes compositional generalization over the high-dimensional factor space, leading to more effective utilization of real-world robotic demonstrations. With extensive real-world experiments, we show that F-ACIL can achieve more than 45% performance gains with 5-10$\times$ fewer demonstrations comparing to that of which without the strategy. The results suggest that structured factorization offers a practical pathway toward efficient compositional generalization in real-world robotic learning. We believe F-ACIL can inspire more systematic research on building generalizable robotic data flywheel strategies. More demonstrations can be found at: https://f-acil.github.io/
summary_zh: 缺乏足够多样性的数据，以及有限的数据效率，仍然是通用机器人模型的主要瓶颈，然而系统化的数据收集和组织策略尚未得到充分探索。任务多样性源于隐性因素，这些因素稀疏地分布在多个维度上，难以明确定义。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种启发式的、具有因素意识的组合迭代学习框架F-ACIL，该框架能够进行结构化的数据分解，并促进组合泛化。F-ACIL将数据分布分解为结构化的因素空间，例如物体、动作和环境。基于分解后的公式，我们开发了一种针对因素的数据收集方法和一种迭代训练范式，旨在促进高维因素空间上的组合泛化，从而更有效地利用真实世界的机器人演示数据。通过大量的真实世界实验，我们表明，与没有采用该策略的情况相比，F-ACIL能够以减少5-10倍的演示数据量，实现超过45%的性能提升。结果表明，结构化分解为真实世界机器人学习中高效的组合泛化提供了一条实用途径。我们相信，F-ACIL能够启发更多关于构建可泛化的机器人数据飞轮策略的系统性研究。更多演示可在 https://f-acil.github.io/ 找到。
tldr: The paper introduces F-ACIL, a framework for factorizing robotic data into structured factor spaces to improve data efficiency and compositional generalization in robot learning, achieving significant performance gains with fewer demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 F-ACIL，一个将机器人数据分解成结构化因子空间的框架，以提高机器人学习中的数据效率和组合泛化能力，用更少的演示实现了显著的性能提升。

title: Towards Embodied AI with MuscleMimic: Unlocking full-body musculoskeletal motor learning at scale
summary: Learning motor control for muscle-driven musculoskeletal models is hindered by the computational cost of biomechanically accurate simulation and the scarcity of validated, open full-body models. Here we present MuscleMimic, an open-source framework for scalable motion imitation learning with physiologically realistic, muscle-actuated humanoids. MuscleMimic provides two validated musculoskeletal embodiments - a fixed-root upper-body model (126 muscles) for bimanual manipulation and a full-body model (416 muscles) for locomotion - together with a retargeting pipeline that maps SMPL-format motion capture data onto musculoskeletal structures while preserving kinematic and dynamic consistency. Leveraging massively parallel GPU simulation, the framework achieves order-of-magnitude training speedups over prior CPU-based approaches while maintaining comprehensive collision handling, enabling a single generalist policy to be trained on hundreds of diverse motions within days. The resulting policy faithfully reproduces a broad repertoire of human movements under full muscular control and can be fine-tuned to novel motions within hours. Biomechanical validation against experimental walking and running data demonstrates strong agreement in joint kinematics (mean correlation r = 0.90), while muscle activation analysis reveals both the promise and fundamental challenges of achieving physiological fidelity through kinematic imitation alone. By lowering the computational and data barriers to musculoskeletal simulation, MuscleMimic enables systematic model validation across diverse dynamic movements and broader participation in neuromuscular control research. Code, models, checkpoints, and retargeted datasets are available at: https://github.com/amathislab/musclemimic
summary_zh: 使用肌肉驱动的骨骼肌肉模型进行运动控制学习受到生物力学精确仿真的计算成本以及经过验证的、开放的全身体模型的稀缺性的阻碍。本文提出了MuscleMimic，一个开源框架，用于使用生理上逼真的肌肉驱动的人形机器人进行可扩展的运动模仿学习。MuscleMimic提供了两个经过验证的骨骼肌肉模型：用于双手操作的固定根部的上半身模型（126块肌肉）和用于运动的全身体模型（416块肌肉），以及一个重定向流水线，该流水线将SMPL格式的运动捕捉数据映射到骨骼肌肉结构上，同时保持运动学和动力学的一致性。通过利用大规模并行GPU仿真，该框架实现了比以往基于CPU的方法高一个数量级的训练速度提升，同时保持了全面的碰撞处理能力，使单个通用策略能够在几天内对数百种不同的运动进行训练。由此产生的策略在完全肌肉控制下真实地再现了广泛的人类运动，并且可以在数小时内对新的运动进行微调。针对实验行走和跑步数据的生物力学验证表明，关节运动学方面具有很强的一致性（平均相关性r = 0.90），而肌肉激活分析揭示了仅通过运动学模仿来实现生理保真度的希望和根本挑战。通过降低骨骼肌肉仿真的计算和数据壁垒，MuscleMimic能够对各种动态运动进行系统的模型验证，并扩大神经肌肉控制研究的参与范围。代码、模型、检查点和重定向数据集可在以下网址获得：https://github.com/amathislab/musclemimic
tldr: MuscleMimic is an open-source framework for scalable motion imitation learning with muscle-actuated humanoids, enabling faster training and biomechanically validated motion reproduction.
tldr_zh: MuscleMimic是一个开源框架，用于肌肉驱动的人形机器人的可扩展运动模仿学习，能够实现更快的训练和生物力学验证的运动再现。

title: LILAC: Language-Conditioned Object-Centric Optical Flow for Open-Loop Trajectory Generation
summary: We address language-conditioned robotic manipulation using flow-based trajectory generation, which enables training on human and web videos of object manipulation and requires only minimal embodiment-specific data. This task is challenging, as object trajectory generation from pre-manipulation images and natural language instructions requires appropriate instruction-flow alignment. To tackle this challenge, we propose the flow-based Language Instruction-guided open-Loop ACtion generator (LILAC). This flow-based Vision-Language-Action model (VLA) generates object-centric 2D optical flow from an RGB image and a natural language instruction, and converts the flow into a 6-DoF manipulator trajectory. LILAC incorporates two key components: Semantic Alignment Loss, which strengthens language conditioning to generate instruction-aligned optical flow, and Prompt-Conditioned Cross-Modal Adapter, which aligns learned visual prompts with image and text features to provide rich cues for flow generation. Experimentally, our method outperformed existing approaches in generated flow quality across multiple benchmarks. Furthermore, in physical object manipulation experiments using free-form instructions, LILAC demonstrated a superior task success rate compared to existing methods. The project page is available at https://lilac-75srg.kinsta.page/.
summary_zh: 我们提出一种基于流的轨迹生成方法来解决语言条件下的机器人操作问题，该方法支持在人类和网络操作视频上进行训练，并且只需要最少的特定实体数据。 这项任务具有挑战性，因为从预操作图像和自然语言指令生成对象轨迹需要适当的指令-流对齐。 为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了基于流的语言指令引导式开环动作生成器（LILAC）。 这种基于流动的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）从RGB图像和自然语言指令中生成以对象为中心的2D光流，并将该光流转换为6自由度的机械臂轨迹。 LILAC包含两个关键组件：语义对齐损失，它增强了语言调节能力以生成与指令对齐的光流；以及提示条件跨模态适配器，它将学习到的视觉提示与图像和文本特征对齐，以为光流生成提供丰富的线索。 实验表明，我们的方法在多个基准测试中优于现有方法所生成的光流质量。 此外，在使用自由形式指令进行的物理对象操作实验中，LILAC展示了优于现有方法的任务成功率。 项目页面见：https://lilac-75srg.kinsta.page/.
tldr: The paper introduces LILAC, a flow-based Vision-Language-Action model that generates object-centric optical flow conditioned on natural language instructions to control robotic manipulators, achieving improved performance in both simulated and physical experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了LILAC，一个基于流的视觉-语言-动作模型，它生成以自然语言指令为条件的以对象为中心的光流来控制机器人操作器，并在模拟和物理实验中实现了改进的性能。

title: Temporally Decoupled Diffusion Planning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Motion planning in dynamic urban environments requires balancing immediate safety with long-term goals. While diffusion models effectively capture multi-modal decision-making, existing approaches treat trajectories as monolithic entities, overlooking heterogeneous temporal dependencies where near-term plans are constrained by instantaneous dynamics and far-term plans by navigational goals. To address this, we propose Temporally Decoupled Diffusion Model (TDDM), which reformulates trajectory generation via a noise-as-mask paradigm. By partitioning trajectories into segments with independent noise levels, we implicitly treat high noise as information voids and weak noise as contextual cues. This compels the model to reconstruct corrupted near-term states by leveraging internal correlations with better-preserved temporal contexts. Architecturally, we introduce a Temporally Decoupled Adaptive Layer Normalization (TD-AdaLN) to inject segment-specific timesteps. During inference, our Asymmetric Temporal Classifier-Free Guidance utilizes weakly noised far-term priors to guide immediate path generation. Evaluations on the nuPlan benchmark show TDDM approaches or exceeds state-of-the-art baselines, particularly excelling in the challenging Test14-hard subset.
summary_zh: 动态城市环境下的运动规划需要在即时安全性和长期目标之间取得平衡。虽然扩散模型能够有效捕捉多模态决策过程，但现有方法将轨迹视为单一实体，忽略了异构时间依赖性——即近期规划受瞬时动力学约束，而远期规划受导航目标约束。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了时间解耦扩散模型(TDDM)，它通过噪声即掩码范式来重新定义轨迹生成。通过将轨迹划分为具有独立噪声水平的片段，我们隐式地将高噪声视为信息空缺，而弱噪声视为上下文线索。这迫使模型通过利用与更好保留的时间上下文的内部关联来重建被破坏的近期状态。在架构上，我们引入了时间解耦自适应层归一化(TD-AdaLN)来注入特定于片段的时间步长。在推理过程中，我们的非对称时间无分类器引导利用弱噪声远期先验来指导即时路径生成。在nuPlan基准测试上的评估表明，TDDM接近或超过了最先进的基线，尤其是在具有挑战性的Test14-hard子集中表现出色。
tldr: The paper introduces a Temporally Decoupled Diffusion Model (TDDM) for autonomous driving motion planning, improving performance by treating near-term and far-term trajectory segments with different noise levels and adaptive normalization. It achieves state-of-the-art results on the nuPlan benchmark, particularly in challenging scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种用于自动驾驶运动规划的时间解耦扩散模型（TDDM），通过对近期和远期轨迹段采用不同的噪声水平和自适应归一化来提高性能。它在nuPlan基准测试中取得了最先进的结果，尤其是在具有挑战性的场景中。

title: Modernising Reinforcement Learning-Based Navigation for Embodied Semantic Scene Graph Generation
summary:
Semantic world models enable embodied agents to reason about objects, relations, and spatial context beyond purely geometric representations. In Organic Computing, such models are a key enabler for objective-driven self-adaptation under uncertainty and resource constraints. The core challenge is to acquire observations maximising model quality and downstream usefulness within a limited action budget.
  Semantic scene graphs (SSGs) provide a structured and compact representation for this purpose. However, constructing them within a finite action horizon requires exploration strategies that trade off information gain against navigation cost and decide when additional actions yield diminishing returns.
  This work presents a modular navigation component for Embodied Semantic Scene Graph Generation and modernises its decision-making by replacing the policy-optimisation method and revisiting the discrete action formulation. We study compact and finer-grained, larger discrete motion sets and compare a single-head policy over atomic actions with a factorised multi-head policy over action components. We evaluate curriculum learning and optional depth-based collision supervision, and assess SSG completeness, execution safety, and navigation behaviour.
  Results show that replacing the optimisation algorithm alone improves SSG completeness by 21\% relative to the baseline under identical reward shaping. Depth mainly affects execution safety (collision-free motion), while completeness remains largely unchanged. Combining modern optimisation with a finer-grained, factorised action representation yields the strongest overall completeness--efficiency trade-off.
summary_zh:
语义世界模型使具身智能体能够推理超出纯几何表示的物体、关系和空间环境。在有机计算中，这种模型是目标驱动的、在不确定性和资源约束下进行自适应的关键促成因素。核心挑战在于获取能最大化模型质量和下游使用性的观测，同时控制在有限的行动预算内。

语义场景图 (SSG) 为此目的提供了一种结构化且紧凑的表示。然而，在有限的动作范围内的构建需要兼顾信息增益和导航成本的探索策略，并需判断何时额外行动会产生边际效益递减。

本工作提出了一种用于具身语义场景图生成的模块化导航组件，并通过替换策略优化方法和重新审视离散动作定义的方式，使其决策过程现代化。我们研究了紧凑的、细粒度的、较大的离散运动集合，并将原子动作上的单头策略与动作组件上的分解型多头策略进行了比较。我们评估了课程学习和可选的基于深度的碰撞监督，并评估了SSG的完整性、执行安全性和导航行为。

结果表明，仅替换优化算法，在相同的奖励塑造下，SSG的完整性就相对于基线提高了 21\%。深度主要影响执行安全性（无碰撞运动），而完整性基本保持不变。将现代优化方法与更细粒度的、分解型的动作表示相结合，可以产生最强的整体完整性-效率权衡。
tldr: This paper improves reinforcement learning-based navigation for embodied agents constructing semantic scene graphs by modernizing the policy optimization method and revisiting action representation, demonstrating improved completeness and safety.
tldr_zh: 该论文通过改进策略优化方法并重新审视动作表示，改进了基于强化学习的具身智能体构建语义场景图的导航，证明了完整性和安全性得到提升。

title: Integrating Deep RL and Bayesian Inference for ObjectNav in Mobile Robotics
summary: Autonomous object search is challenging for mobile robots operating in indoor environments due to partial observability, perceptual uncertainty, and the need to trade off exploration and navigation efficiency. Classical probabilistic approaches explicitly represent uncertainty but typically rely on handcrafted action-selection heuristics, while deep reinforcement learning enables adaptive policies but often suffers from slow convergence and limited interpretability. This paper proposes a hybrid object-search framework that integrates Bayesian inference with deep reinforcement learning. The method maintains a spatial belief map over target locations, updated online through Bayesian inference from calibrated object detections, and trains a reinforcement learning policy to select navigation actions directly from this probabilistic representation. The approach is evaluated in realistic indoor simulation using Habitat 3.0 and compared against developed baseline strategies. Across two indoor environments, the proposed method improves success rate while reducing search effort. Overall, the results support the value of combining Bayesian belief estimation with learned action selection to achieve more efficient and reliable objectsearch behavior under partial observability.
summary_zh: 自主物体搜索对于在室内环境中运行的移动机器人来说是一项极具挑战的任务，这是因为存在部分可观测性、感知不确定性以及需要在探索和导航效率之间进行权衡的需求。经典的概率方法明确地表示不确定性，但通常依赖于手工设计的动作选择启发式算法，而深度强化学习能够实现自适应策略，但往往面临着收敛速度慢和可解释性有限的问题。本文提出了一种混合物体搜索框架，该框架将贝叶斯推断与深度强化学习相结合。该方法维护一个关于目标位置的空间置信度地图，并通过从校准后的物体检测结果中进行的贝叶斯推断在线更新该地图，并训练一个强化学习策略，以直接从这种概率表示中选择导航动作。该方法在使用Habitat 3.0的逼真室内模拟环境中进行了评估，并与已开发的基线策略进行了比较。在两个室内环境中，所提出的方法提高了成功率，同时减少了搜索工作量。总而言之，结果表明，结合贝叶斯置信度估计和学习到的动作选择，有助于在部分可观测性下实现更高效和可靠的物体搜索行为。
