tldr: The paper introduces Fast-dVLA, a technique to improve the performance and reduce the computational cost of adapting pretrained VLA models for robotic tasks by decoupling auxiliary training objectives and using capability vectors for enhanced finetuning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Fast-dVLA，一种通过分离辅助训练目标，并使用能力向量进行增强微调，从而改进VLA预训练模型在机器人任务中的性能并降低计算成本的技术。

title: A Mentalistic Interface for Probing Folk-Psychological Attribution to Non-Humanoid Robots
summary: This paper presents an experimental platform for studying intentional-state attribution toward a non-humanoid robot. The system combines a simulated robot, realistic task environments, and large language model-based explanatory layers that can express the same behavior in mentalistic, teleological, or mechanistic terms. By holding behavior constant while varying the explanatory frame, the platform provides a controlled way to investigate how language and framing shape the adoption of the intentional stance in robotics.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一个用于研究对非人形机器人进行意图状态归属的实验平台。该系统结合了模拟机器人、逼真的任务环境以及基于大型语言模型的解释层，这些解释层可以用心理主义、目的论或机械论术语来表达相同的行为。通过保持行为不变而改变解释框架，该平台提供了一种可控的方式来研究语言和框架如何塑造在机器人领域意图姿态的采用。
tldr: This paper introduces a platform to study how different explanations of robot behavior (mentalistic, teleological, mechanistic) influence intentional-state attribution by humans, holding the robot's behavior constant.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个平台，用于研究对机器人行为的不同解释（心理主义、目的论、机械论）如何影响人类的意向状态归因，同时保持机器人的行为不变。

title: Visualizing Impedance Control in Augmented Reality for Teleoperation: Design and User Evaluation
summary: Teleoperation for contact-rich manipulation remains challenging, especially when using low-cost, motion-only interfaces that provide no haptic feedback. Virtual reality controllers enable intuitive motion control but do not allow operators to directly perceive or regulate contact forces, limiting task performance. To address this, we propose an augmented reality (AR) visualization of the impedance controller's target pose and its displacement from each robot end effector. This visualization conveys the forces generated by the controller, providing operators with intuitive, real-time feedback without expensive haptic hardware. We evaluate the design in a dual-arm manipulation study with 17 participants who repeatedly reposition a box with and without the AR visualization. Results show that AR visualization reduces completion time by 24% for force-critical lifting tasks, with no significant effect on sliding tasks where precise force control is less critical. These findings indicate that making the impedance target visible through AR is a viable approach to improve human-robot interaction for contact-rich teleoperation.
summary_zh: 接触丰富的远端操控仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在使用仅提供运动控制而无触觉反馈的低成本界面时。虚拟现实控制器虽然能实现直观的运动控制，但无法让操作者直接感知或调节接触力，从而限制了任务表现。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种增强现实（AR）可视化方法来呈现阻抗控制器的目标姿态以及其与每个机器人末端执行器的位移。这种可视化能够传递控制器产生的力，从而在无需昂贵的触觉硬件的情况下，为操作者提供直观的实时反馈。我们通过一项双臂操控研究评估了该设计，其中17名参与者在有或没有AR可视化的情况下反复重新定位一个盒子。结果表明，对于力关键的抬升任务，AR可视化将完成时间缩短了24%，而对于需要精确力控制程度较低的滑动任务，则没有显著影响。这些发现表明，通过AR使阻抗目标可见是一种可行的改进接触丰富远端操控人机交互的方法。
tldr: The paper presents an augmented reality visualization of impedance control in teleoperation, showing improved performance in force-critical tasks by providing real-time feedback on contact forces without haptic hardware.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种远程操作中阻抗控制的增强现实可视化方法，通过提供接触力的实时反馈，在对力敏感的任务中提高了性能，而无需触觉硬件。

title: System Design for Maintaining Internal State Consistency in Long-Horizon Robotic Tabletop Games
summary: Long-horizon tabletop games pose a distinct systems challenge for robotics: small perceptual or execution errors can invalidate accumulated task state, propagate across decision-making modules, and ultimately derail interaction. This paper studies how to maintain internal state consistency in turn-based, multi-human robotic tabletop games through deliberate system design rather than isolated component improvement. Using Mahjong as a representative long-horizon setting, we present an integrated architecture that explicitly maintains perceptual, execution, and interaction state, partitions high-level semantic reasoning from time-critical perception and control, and incorporates verified action primitives with tactile-triggered recovery to prevent premature state corruption. We further introduce interaction-level monitoring mechanisms to detect turn violations and hidden-information breaches that threaten execution assumptions. Beyond demonstrating complete-game operation, we provide an empirical characterization of failure modes, recovery effectiveness, cross-module error propagation, and hardware-algorithm trade-offs observed during deployment. Our results show that explicit partitioning, monitored state transitions, and recovery mechanisms are critical for sustaining executable consistency over extended play, whereas monolithic or unverified pipelines lead to measurable degradation in end-to-end reliability. The proposed system serves as an empirical platform for studying system-level design principles in long-horizon, turn-based interaction.
summary_zh: 长时程桌面游戏为机器人技术带来独特的系统挑战：微小的感知或执行错误可能导致累积的任务状态失效，并在决策模块间传播，最终破坏交互。本文研究如何在回合制、多人参与的机器人桌面游戏中，通过审慎的系统设计而非孤立的组件改进来维持内部状态一致性。以麻将作为代表性的长时程环境，我们提出了一种集成架构，该架构显式地维护了感知状态、执行状态和交互状态，将高层语义推理与时间关键的感知和控制相分离，并结合了经过验证的动作原语与触觉触发的恢复机制，以防止状态过早损坏。我们进一步引入交互层级的监控机制，以检测违反回合规则和隐藏信息泄露的情况，从而避免威胁执行假设。除了演示完整的游戏操作，我们还提供了部署过程中观察到的失效模式、恢复有效性、跨模块误差传播以及硬件-算法权衡的实证表征。我们的结果表明，显式分区、受监控的状态转换和恢复机制对于在长时间游戏中维持可执行的一致性至关重要，而单片或未经验证的流水线会导致端到端可靠性的显著下降。所提出的系统为研究长时程、回合制交互中的系统级设计原则提供了一个实证平台。
tldr: The paper presents a system design for robotic tabletop games, particularly Mahjong, focusing on maintaining internal state consistency through explicit partitioning, monitored state transitions, and recovery mechanisms to address the challenges of long-horizon tasks with potential perceptual and execution errors.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于机器人桌面游戏（特别是麻将）的系统设计，重点是通过显式划分、监控状态转换和恢复机制来维护内部状态一致性，从而解决具有潜在感知和执行错误的长期任务的挑战。

title: UMBRELLA: Uncertainty-aware Multi-robot Reactive Coordination under Dynamic Temporal Logic Tasks
summary: Multi-robot systems can be extremely efficient for accomplishing team-wise tasks by acting concurrently and collaboratively. However, most existing methods either assume static task features or simply replan when environmental changes occur. This paper addresses the challenging problem of coordinating multi-robot systems for collaborative tasks involving dynamic and moving targets. We explicitly model the uncertainty in target motion prediction via Conformal Prediction(CP), while respecting the spatial-temporal constraints specified by Linear Temporal Logic (LTL). The proposed framework (UMBRELLA) combines the Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) over partial plans with uncertainty-aware rollouts, and introduces a CP-based metric to guide and accelerate the search. The objective is to minimize the Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) of the average makespan. For tasks released online, a receding-horizon planning scheme dynamically adjusts the assignments based on updated task specifications and motion predictions. Spatial and temporal constraints among the tasks are always ensured, and only partial synchronization is required for the collaborative tasks during online execution. Extensive large-scale simulations and hardware experiments demonstrate substantial reductions in both the average makespan and its variance by 23% and 71%, compared with static baselines.
summary_zh: 多机器人系统通过并发和协作执行团队任务，可以展现出极高的效率。然而，现有的大多数方法要么假设静态的任务特征，要么仅在环境变化时进行重新规划。本文旨在解决多机器人系统在协作任务中协调动态和移动目标的难题。我们通过符合预测(CP)显式地对目标运动预测中的不确定性进行建模，同时遵守线性时序逻辑(LTL)指定的时空约束。所提出的框架(UMBRELLA)结合了基于蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)的部分计划与不确定性感知的在线推演，并引入基于CP的度量来指导和加速搜索。目标是最小化平均最大完工时间的条件风险价值(CVaR)。对于在线发布的任务，滚动时域规划方案会根据更新的任务规范和运动预测动态调整分配。任务之间的空间和时间约束始终得到保证，并且在线执行期间协作任务仅需要部分同步。大量的规模化仿真和硬件实验表明，与静态基线相比，平均最大完工时间和其方差分别显著降低了23%和71%。
tldr: This paper presents UMBRELLA, a framework for multi-robot coordination under dynamic LTL tasks that incorporates uncertainty in target motion prediction using Conformal Prediction and minimizes the Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) of the makespan.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了UMBRELLA，一个在动态LTL任务下进行多机器人协同的框架，它利用Conformal Prediction来处理目标运动预测的不确定性，并最小化平均完工时间的条件风险价值(CVaR)。

title: IntentReact: Guiding Reactive Object-Centric Navigation via Topological Intent
summary: Object-goal visual navigation requires robots to reason over semantic structure and act effectively under partial observability. Recent approaches based on object-level topological maps enable long-horizon navigation without dense geometric reconstruction, but their execution remains limited by the gap between global topological guidance and local perception-driven control. In particular, local decisions are made solely from the current egocentric observation, without access to information beyond the robot's field of view. As a result, the robot may persist along its current heading even when initially oriented away from the goal, moving toward directions that do not decrease the global topological distance. In this work, we propose IntentReact, an intent-conditioned object-centric navigation framework that introduces a compact interface between global topological planning and reactive object-centric control. Our approach encodes global topological guidance as a low-dimensional directional signal, termed intent, which conditions a learned waypoint prediction policy to bias navigation toward topologically consistent progression. This design enables the robot to promptly reorient when local observations are misleading, guiding motion toward directions that decrease global topological distance while preserving the reactivity and robustness of object-centric control. We evaluate the proposed framework through extensive experiments, demonstrating improved navigation success and execution quality compared to prior object-centric navigation methods.
summary_zh: 基于物体目标的视觉导航要求机器人能够理解语义结构，并在部分可观测性下有效行动。最近基于物体级拓扑地图的方法能够实现长程导航，而无需进行密集的几何重建，但其执行仍受到全局拓扑引导和局部感知驱动控制之间的差距的限制。特别是，局部决策仅根据当前的自我中心观测做出，无法获取机器人视野之外的信息。因此，即使机器人最初偏离目标方向，也可能坚持当前航向，朝着不会缩短全局拓扑距离的方向移动。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种意图条件物体中心导航框架IntentReact，该框架在全局拓扑规划和反应式物体中心控制之间引入了一个紧凑的接口。我们的方法将全局拓扑引导编码为一种低维度的方向信号，称为意图，该意图调节一个学习到的航点预测策略，从而使导航偏向拓扑一致的前进。这种设计使机器人在局部观测具有误导性时能够迅速重新定向，引导运动朝着缩短全局拓扑距离的方向前进，同时保持物体中心控制的反应性和鲁棒性。我们通过广泛的实验评估了所提出的框架，结果表明，与之前的物体中心导航方法相比，导航成功率和执行质量均有所提高。
tldr: The paper introduces IntentReact, a new object-centric navigation framework that uses a low-dimensional 'intent' signal derived from global topological planning to guide local reactive control, improving navigation success and robustness under partial observability.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了IntentReact，一种新的以对象为中心的导航框架，它使用来自全局拓扑规划的低维“意图”信号来指导局部反应控制，从而提高在部分可观测情况下的导航成功率和鲁棒性。

title: Connectivity-Aware Representations for Constrained Motion Planning via Multi-Scale Contrastive Learning
summary: The objective of constrained motion planning is to connect start and goal configurations while satisfying task-specific constraints. Motion planning becomes inefficient or infeasible when the configurations lie in disconnected regions, known as essentially mutually disconnected (EMD) components. Constraints further restrict feasible space to a lower-dimensional submanifold, while redundancy introduces additional complexity because a single end-effector pose admits infinitely many inverse kinematic solutions that may form discrete self-motion manifolds. This paper addresses these challenges by learning a connectivity-aware representation for selecting start and goal configurations prior to planning. Joint configurations are embedded into a latent space through multi-scale manifold learning across neighborhood ranges from local to global, and clustering generates pseudo-labels that supervise a contrastive learning framework. The proposed framework provides a connectivity-aware measure that biases the selection of start and goal configurations in connected regions, avoiding EMDs and yielding higher success rates with reduced planning time. Experiments on various manipulation tasks showed that our method achieves 1.9 times higher success rates and reduces the planning time by a factor of 0.43 compared to baselines.
summary_zh: 受约束的运动规划的目标是在满足特定任务约束的同时，连接起始和目标构型。当构型位于不连通的区域时，运动规划会变得低效或不可行，这些区域被称为本质上互不连通（EMD）的分量。约束进一步将可行空间限制到低维子流形，而冗余引入了额外的复杂性，因为单个末端执行器姿态允许无限多个逆运动学解，这些解可能形成离散的自运动流形。本文通过学习一种具有连通性感知的表示，用于在规划之前选择起始和目标构型，从而解决这些挑战。关节构型通过多尺度流形学习嵌入到潜在空间中，学习范围涵盖从局部到全局的邻域范围，聚类生成伪标签，用于监督对比学习框架。所提出的框架提供了一种具有连通性感知的度量，它偏向于在连通区域中选择起始和目标构型，避免EMD，并以更短的规划时间获得更高的成功率。在各种操作任务上的实验表明，与基线方法相比，我们的方法成功率提高了 1.9 倍，并将规划时间缩短了 0.43 倍。
tldr: This paper introduces a multi-scale contrastive learning approach to learn connectivity-aware representations for motion planning, improving success rates and reducing planning time by selecting start and goal configurations in connected regions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种多尺度对比学习方法，用于学习运动规划的连通性感知表示，通过选择连通区域中的起始和目标配置，提高成功率并减少规划时间。

title: CTS-PLL: A Robust and Anytime Framework for Collaborative Task Sequencing and Multi-Agent Path Finding
summary: The Collaborative Task Sequencing and Multi-Agent Path Finding (CTS-MAPF) problem requires agents to accomplish sequences of tasks while avoiding collisions, posing significant challenges due to its combinatorial complexity. This work introduces CTS-PLL, a hierarchical framework that extends the configuration-based CTS-MAPF planning paradigm with two key enhancements: a lock agents detection and release mechanism leveraging a complete planning method for local re-planning, and an anytime refinement procedure based on Large Neighborhood Search (LNS). These additions ensure robustness in dense environments and enable continuous improvement of solution quality. Extensive evaluations across sparse and dense benchmarks demonstrate that CTS-PLL achieves higher success rates and solution quality compared with existing methods, while maintaining competitive runtime efficiency. Real-world robot experiments further demonstrate the feasibility of the approach in practice.
summary_zh: 协作任务排序与多智能体路径规划（CTS-MAPF）问题要求智能体完成一系列任务，同时避免碰撞，其组合复杂性带来了巨大的挑战。 本文提出了一种分层框架CTS-PLL，它通过两项关键改进扩展了基于配置的CTS-MAPF规划范式：一种利用完整规划方法进行局部重新规划的锁定智能体检测与释放机制，以及一种基于大规模邻域搜索（LNS）的随时改进过程。 这些补充确保了在密集环境中的鲁棒性，并能够持续提高解决方案的质量。 在稀疏和密集的 benchmarks 上进行的广泛评估表明，与现有方法相比，CTS-PLL 实现了更高的成功率和解决方案质量，同时保持了具有竞争力的运行时效率。 真实的机器人实验进一步证明了该方法在实践中的可行性。
tldr: The paper introduces CTS-PLL, a novel framework for Collaborative Task Sequencing and Multi-Agent Path Finding (CTS-MAPF) that leverages lock detection/release and anytime refinement to achieve higher success rates, solution quality, and runtime efficiency in both simulated and real-world settings.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为CTS-PLL的新型框架，用于协作任务排序和多智能体路径规划（CTS-MAPF）。该框架利用锁检测/释放机制和随时优化策略，在模拟和真实环境中实现了更高的成功率、解决方案质量和运行效率。

title: Learning Rollout from Sampling:An R1-Style Tokenized Traffic Simulation Model
summary: Learning diverse and high-fidelity traffic simulations from human driving demonstrations is crucial for autonomous driving evaluation. The recent next-token prediction (NTP) paradigm, widely adopted in large language models (LLMs), has been applied to traffic simulation and achieves iterative improvements via supervised fine-tuning (SFT). However, such methods limit active exploration of potentially valuable motion tokens, particularly in suboptimal regions. Entropy patterns provide a promising perspective for enabling exploration driven by motion token uncertainty. Motivated by this insight, we propose a novel tokenized traffic simulation policy, R1Sim, which represents an initial attempt to explore reinforcement learning based on motion token entropy patterns, and systematically analyzes the impact of different motion tokens on simulation outcomes. Specifically, we introduce an entropy-guided adaptive sampling mechanism that focuses on previously overlooked motion tokens with high uncertainty yet high potential. We further optimize motion behaviors using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), guided by a safety-aware reward design. Overall, these components enable a balanced exploration-exploitation trade-off through diverse high-uncertainty sampling and group-wise comparative estimation, resulting in realistic, safe, and diverse multi-agent behaviors. Extensive experiments on the Waymo Sim Agent benchmark demonstrate that R1Sim achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art methods.
summary_zh: 从人类驾驶演示中学习多样且高保真的交通模拟对于自动驾驶评估至关重要。最近的下一令牌预测（NTP）范式，被广泛应用于大型语言模型（LLM），已被应用于交通模拟，并通过监督微调（SFT）实现了迭代改进。然而，这些方法限制了对潜在有价值的运动令牌的主动探索，尤其是在次优区域。熵模式为启用由运动令牌不确定性驱动的探索提供了一个有前景的视角。受此启发，我们提出了一种新型的令牌化交通模拟策略R1Sim，这是基于运动令牌熵模式探索强化学习的初步尝试，并系统地分析了不同运动令牌对模拟结果的影响。具体来说，我们引入了一种熵引导的自适应采样机制，该机制侧重于先前被忽视的、具有高不确定性但高潜力的运动令牌。我们进一步利用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）优化运动行为，并以安全感知的奖励设计为指导。总而言之，这些组件通过多样性的高不确定性采样和组间比较估计，实现了平衡的探索-利用权衡，从而产生真实、安全且多样化的多智能体行为。在Waymo Sim Agent基准测试中的大量实验表明，与最先进的方法相比，R1Sim取得了具有竞争力的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces R1Sim, a novel tokenized traffic simulation policy that uses entropy-guided adaptive sampling and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to improve the realism, safety, and diversity of multi-agent behaviors by exploring previously overlooked motion tokens. Experiments demonstrate competitive performance on the Waymo Sim Agent benchmark.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新颖的令牌化交通仿真策略R1Sim，它使用熵引导的自适应抽样和组相对策略优化（GRPO）来提高多智能体行为的真实性、安全性和多样性，通过探索以前被忽视的具有高潜力的运动令牌。实验表明，在Waymo Sim Agent基准测试中，取得了具有竞争力的性能。

title: CROSS: A Mixture-of-Experts Reinforcement Learning Framework for Generalizable Large-Scale Traffic Signal Control
summary: Recent advances in robotics, automation, and artificial intelligence have enabled urban traffic systems to operate with increasing autonomy towards future smart cities, powered in part by the development of adaptive traffic signal control (ATSC), which dynamically optimizes signal phases to mitigate congestion and optimize traffic. However, achieving effective and generalizable large-scale ATSC remains a significant challenge due to the diverse intersection topologies and highly dynamic, complex traffic demand patterns across the network. Existing RL-based methods typically use a single shared policy for all scenarios, whose limited representational capacity makes it difficult to capture diverse traffic dynamics and generalize to unseen environments. To address these challenges, we propose CROSS, a novel Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)-based decentralized RL framework for generalizable ATSC. We first introduce a Predictive Contrastive Clustering (PCC) module that forecasts short-term state transitions to identify latent traffic patterns, followed by clustering and contrastive learning to enhance pattern-level representation. We further design a Scenario-Adaptive MoE module that augments a shared policy with multiple experts, thus enabling adaptive specialization and more flexible scenario-specific strategies. We conduct extensive experiments in the SUMO simulator on both synthetic and real-world traffic datasets. Compared with state-of-the-art baselines, CROSS achieves superior performance and generalization through improved representation of diverse traffic scenarios.
summary_zh:
摘要：
机器人、自动化和人工智能领域的最新进展使得城市交通系统能够以日益增长的自主性运行，从而迈向未来的智慧城市，这部分得益于自适应交通信号控制（ATSC）的发展，该技术能够动态优化信号相位，以缓解拥堵并优化交通。然而，由于网络中多样化的交叉路口拓扑结构和高度动态、复杂的交通需求模式，实现有效的、可推广的大规模ATSC仍然是一个重大挑战。现有的基于强化学习（RL）的方法通常对所有场景使用单一的共享策略，其有限的表征能力使得难以捕捉多样化的交通动态并推广到未见过的环境。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出CROSS，一种新颖的基于混合专家（MoE）的去中心化RL框架，用于可推广的ATSC。我们首先引入一个预测对比聚类（PCC）模块，该模块预测短期的状态转移，以识别潜在的交通模式，然后进行聚类和对比学习，以增强模式级别的表示。我们进一步设计了一个场景自适应 MoE 模块，该模块使用多个专家来增强共享策略，从而实现自适应专业化和更灵活的特定场景策略。我们在 SUMO 模拟器上，在合成和真实世界交通数据集上进行了广泛的实验。与最先进的基线方法相比，CROSS 通过改进对多样化交通场景的表示，实现了卓越的性能和泛化能力。
tldr: The paper introduces CROSS, a Mixture-of-Experts Reinforcement Learning framework for adaptive traffic signal control (ATSC) that uses predictive contrastive clustering and scenario-adaptive MoE to improve generalization across diverse traffic scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为CROSS的混合专家强化学习框架，用于自适应交通信号控制（ATSC）。该框架使用预测对比聚类和场景自适应MoE来提高在各种交通场景中的泛化能力。

title: Integrated Multi-Drone Task Allocation, Sequencing, and Optimal Trajectory Generation in Obstacle-Rich 3D Environments
summary: Coordinating teams of aerial robots in cluttered three-dimensional (3D) environments requires a principled integration of discrete mission planning-deciding which robot serves which goals and in what order -- with continuous-time trajectory synthesis that enforces collision avoidance and dynamic feasibility. This paper introduces IMD-TAPP (Integrated Multi-Drone Task Allocation and Path Planning), an end-to-end framework that jointly addresses multi-goal allocation, tour sequencing, and safe trajectory generation for quadrotor teams operating in obstacle-rich spaces. IMD--TAPP first discretizes the workspace into a 3D navigation graph and computes obstacle-aware robot-to-goal and goal-to-goal travel costs via graph-search-based pathfinding. These costs are then embedded within an Injected Particle Swarm Optimization (IPSO) scheme, guided by multiple linear assignment, to efficiently explore coupled assignment/ordering alternatives and to minimize mission makespan. Finally, the resulting waypoint tours are transformed into time-parameterized minimum-snap trajectories through a generation-and-optimization routine equipped with iterative validation of obstacle clearance and inter-robot separation, triggering re-planning when safety margins are violated. Extensive MATLAB simulations across cluttered 3D scenarios demonstrate that IMD--TAPP consistently produces dynamically feasible, collision-free trajectories while achieving competitive completion times. In a representative case study with two drones serving multiple goals, the proposed approach attains a minimum mission time of 136~s while maintaining the required safety constraints throughout execution.
summary_zh: 在复杂的三维环境中协调无人机编队需要对离散任务规划（决定哪个无人机服务哪个目标以及服务顺序）与连续时间轨迹合成进行有原则的整合，以确保避碰和动力学可行性。本文提出了 IMD-TAPP (集成多无人机任务分配和路径规划)，这是一个端到端框架，它联合处理多目标分配、巡视排序以及适用于在障碍物丰富的空间中运行的四旋翼无人机编队的安全轨迹生成。 IMD-TAPP 首先将工作空间离散化为 3D 导航图，并通过基于图搜索的路径寻找来计算具有避障能力的无人机到目标和目标到目标的行进成本。然后，这些成本被嵌入到 Injected Particle Swarm Optimization (IPSO) 方案中，该方案由多个线性分配引导，以高效地探索耦合的分配/排序替代方案并最小化任务完成时间。最后，通过一个具备迭代验证障碍物清除和无人机间距的生成和优化例程，将生成的航路点巡视转化为时间参数化的最小抖动轨迹，并在安全裕度被违反时触发重新规划。广泛的 MATLAB 仿真在复杂的 3D 场景中表明，IMD-TAPP 始终产生动力学可行、无碰撞的轨迹，同时实现具有竞争力的完成时间。在一个具有代表性的案例研究中，两架无人机服务多个目标，所提出的方法实现了 136 秒的最小任务时间，并在整个执行过程中保持了所需的安全约束。
tldr: This paper introduces IMD-TAPP, an end-to-end framework for integrated multi-drone task allocation, sequencing, and trajectory generation in complex 3D environments, demonstrating its effectiveness in minimizing mission completion time while maintaining safety constraints through MATLAB simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个名为IMD-TAPP的端到端框架，用于在复杂的3D环境中集成多无人机任务分配、排序和轨迹生成。MATLAB仿真结果表明，该框架在满足安全约束的同时，能够有效地最小化任务完成时间。

title: Just Zoom In: Cross-View Geo-Localization via Autoregressive Zooming
summary: Cross-view geo-localization (CVGL) estimates a camera's location by matching a street-view image to geo-referenced overhead imagery, enabling GPS-denied localization and navigation. Existing methods almost universally formulate CVGL as an image-retrieval problem in a contrastively trained embedding space. This ties performance to large batches and hard negative mining, and it ignores both the geometric structure of maps and the coverage mismatch between street-view and overhead imagery. In particular, salient landmarks visible from the street view can fall outside a fixed satellite crop, making retrieval targets ambiguous and limiting explicit spatial inference over the map. We propose Just Zoom In, an alternative formulation that performs CVGL via autoregressive zooming over a city-scale overhead map. Starting from a coarse satellite view, the model takes a short sequence of zoom-in decisions to select a terminal satellite cell at a target resolution, without contrastive losses or hard negative mining. We further introduce a realistic benchmark with crowd-sourced street views and high-resolution satellite imagery that reflects real capture conditions. On this benchmark, Just Zoom In achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving Recall@1 within 50 m by 5.5% and Recall@1 within 100 m by 9.6% over the strongest contrastive-retrieval baseline. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of sequential coarse-to-fine spatial reasoning for cross-view geo-localization.
summary_zh: 跨视角地理定位 (CVGL) 通过将街景图像与具有地理参考的俯视图像进行匹配来估计相机的位置，从而实现无 GPS 定位的本地化和导航。现有的方法几乎普遍地将 CVGL 建模为在对比学习训练的嵌入空间中的图像检索问题。这使得性能受限于大批量和难负样本挖掘，并忽略了地图的几何结构以及街景和俯视图像之间的覆盖范围不匹配。特别地，从街景可见的显著地标可能落在固定的卫星裁剪区域之外，导致检索目标模糊，并限制了在地图上进行明确的空间推理。我们提出了一种替代方案，名为“Just Zoom In”，它通过在城市尺度俯视地图上进行自回归缩放来执行 CVGL。从粗略的卫星视图开始，模型采集一系列短的放大决策，以选择目标分辨率下的终端卫星单元，而无需对比损失或难负样本挖掘。我们进一步引入了一个现实的基准测试，其中包含众包的街景和高分辨率卫星图像，反映了真实的捕获条件。在这个基准测试中，Just Zoom In 实现了最先进的性能，在 50 米范围内的 Recall@1 指标上提高了 5.5%，在 100 米范围内的 Recall@1 指标上提高了 9.6%，超过了最强的对比检索基线。这些结果证明了顺序的粗到精的空间推理对于跨视角地理定位的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces "Just Zoom In," a novel cross-view geo-localization method using autoregressive zooming over satellite imagery, achieving state-of-the-art results on a new realistic benchmark by avoiding contrastive learning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了“Just Zoom In”，一种新颖的跨视角地理定位方法，通过在卫星图像上进行自回归缩放，避免了对比学习，并在一个新的真实基准测试上取得了最先进的结果。

title: Macroscopic Characteristics of Mixed Traffic Flow with Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Automated and Human-Driven Vehicles
summary: Automated Vehicle (AV) control in mixed traffic, where AVs coexist with human-driven vehicles, poses significant challenges in balancing safety, efficiency, comfort, fuel efficiency, and compliance with traffic rules while capturing heterogeneous driver behavior. Traditional car-following models, such as the Intelligent Driver Model (IDM), often struggle to generalize across diverse traffic scenarios and typically do not account for fuel efficiency, motivating the use of learning-based approaches. Although Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has shown strong microscopic performance in car-following conditions, its macroscopic traffic flow characteristics remain underexplored. This study focuses on analyzing the macroscopic traffic flow characteristics and fuel efficiency of DRL-based models in mixed traffic. A Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) algorithm is implemented for AVs' control and trained using the NGSIM highway dataset, enabling realistic interaction with human-driven vehicles. Traffic performance is evaluated using the Fundamental Diagram (FD) under varying driver heterogeneity, heterogeneous time-gap penetration levels, and different shares of RL-controlled vehicles. A macroscopic level comparison of fuel efficiency between the RL-based AV model and the IDM is also conducted. Results show that traffic performance is sensitive to the distribution of safe time gaps and the proportion of RL vehicles. Transitioning from fully human-driven to fully RL-controlled traffic can increase road capacity by approximately 7.52%. Further, RL-based AVs also improve average fuel efficiency by about 28.98% at higher speeds (above 50 km/h), and by 1.86% at lower speeds (below 50 km/h) compared to the IDM. Overall, the DRL framework enhances traffic capacity and fuel efficiency without compromising safety.
summary_zh: 在混合交通流中，自动驾驶车辆（AV）与人为驾驶车辆共存，自动驾驶控制面临着在安全、效率、舒适性、燃油效率以及遵守交通规则之间取得平衡的严峻挑战，同时还需要捕捉异质驾驶员行为。诸如智能驾驶员模型（IDM）等传统跟驰模型通常难以推广到各种交通场景，通常也不考虑燃油效率，这促使了基于学习方法的使用。虽然深度强化学习（DRL）在跟驰条件下表现出强大的微观性能，但其宏观交通流特性仍有待探索。本研究侧重于分析基于DRL模型在混合交通流中的宏观交通流特性和燃油效率。采用双延迟深度确定性策略梯度（TD3）算法控制自动驾驶车辆，并使用NGSIM高速公路数据集进行训练，从而实现与人为驾驶车辆的真实交互。使用基本图（FD）评估交通性能，考虑了不同的驾驶员异质性、异质时距渗透率以及不同比例的强化学习控制车辆。同时，还对基于强化学习的自动驾驶车辆模型与IDM之间的宏观层面燃油效率进行了比较。结果表明，交通性能对安全时距的分布和强化学习车辆的比例敏感。从完全人为驾驶交通过渡到完全强化学习控制交通，可将道路通行能力提高约7.52%。此外，与IDM相比，基于强化学习的自动驾驶车辆在高速度（高于50公里/小时）时，平均燃油效率也提高了约28.98%，在低速度（低于50公里/小时）时，平均燃油效率提高了约1.86%。总而言之，该DRL框架在不牺牲安全性的前提下，提高了交通通行能力和燃油效率。
tldr: This paper explores the macroscopic traffic flow characteristics and fuel efficiency of Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL)-controlled Automated Vehicles (AVs) in mixed traffic, demonstrating improvements in road capacity and fuel efficiency compared to traditional car-following models.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了在混合交通中，基于深度强化学习（DRL）控制的自动驾驶车辆（AV）的宏观交通流特性和燃油效率，结果表明与传统的车辆跟随模型相比，道路通行能力和燃油效率均有所提高。

title: Large Language Models as Optimization Controllers: Adaptive Continuation for SIMP Topology Optimization
summary: We present a framework in which a large language model (LLM) acts as an online adaptive controller for SIMP topology optimization, replacing conventional fixed-schedule continuation with real-time, state-conditioned parameter decisions. At every $k$-th iteration, the LLM receives a structured observation$-$current compliance, grayness index, stagnation counter, checkerboard measure, volume fraction, and budget consumption$-$and outputs numerical values for the penalization exponent $p$, projection sharpness $β$, filter radius $r_{\min}$, and move limit $δ$ via a Direct Numeric Control interface. A hard grayness gate prevents premature binarization, and a meta-optimization loop uses a second LLM pass to tune the agent's call frequency and gate threshold across runs. We benchmark the agent against four baselines$-$fixed (no-continuation), standard three-field continuation, an expert heuristic, and a schedule-only ablation$-$on three 2-D problems (cantilever, MBB beam, L-bracket) at $120\!\times\!60$ resolution and two 3-D problems (cantilever, MBB beam) at $40\!\times\!20\!\times\!10$ resolution, all run for 300 iterations. A standardized 40-iteration sharpening tail is applied from the best valid snapshot so that compliance differences reflect only the exploration phase. The LLM agent achieves the lowest final compliance on every benchmark: $-5.7\%$ to $-18.1\%$ relative to the fixed baseline, with all solutions fully binary. The schedule-only ablation underperforms the fixed baseline on two of three problems, confirming that the LLM's real-time intervention$-$not the schedule geometry$-$drives the gain. Code and reproduction scripts will be released upon publication.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一个框架，其中大型语言模型（LLM）充当SIMP拓扑优化的在线自适应控制器，以实时、状态条件化的参数决策取代了传统固定方案的延拓方法。在每个第$k$次迭代中，LLM接收结构化观测数据——当前柔顺性、灰度指数、停滞计数器、棋盘格度量、体积分数和预算消耗——并通过直接数值控制接口输出惩罚指数$p$、投影锐度$β$、过滤半径$r_{\min}$和移动极限$δ$的数值。一个硬灰度门阻止过早的二值化，并且一个元优化循环使用第二次LLM传递来调整代理的调用频率和跨运行的门限。我们针对四个基线——固定（无延拓）、标准三场延拓、专家启发式方法和一个仅包含时间表的消融实验——在三个二维问题（悬臂梁、MBB梁、L型支架，$120\!\times\!60$分辨率）和两个三维问题（悬臂梁、MBB梁，$40\!\times\!20\!\times\!10$分辨率）上对该代理进行了基准测试，所有测试均运行300次迭代。从最佳有效快照应用标准化的40次迭代锐化尾部，以便柔顺性差异仅反映探索阶段。 LLM代理在每个基准测试中都实现了最低的最终柔顺性：相对于固定基线，降低了$-5.7\%$至$-18.1\%$，且所有解都是完全二值的。仅包含时间表的消融实验在三个问题中的两个上表现不如固定基线，这证实了LLM的实时干预——而不是时间表的几何形状——驱动了性能提升。代码和复现脚本将在发表时发布。
tldr: This paper presents a framework using a large language model (LLM) as an online adaptive controller for topology optimization, demonstrating improved performance compared to traditional methods. The LLM dynamically adjusts parameters based on real-time feedback.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种框架，使用大型语言模型（LLM）作为拓扑优化的在线自适应控制器，与传统方法相比，性能有所提高。LLM根据实时反馈动态调整参数。

title: Rethinking Failure Attribution in Multi-Agent Systems: A Multi-Perspective Benchmark and Evaluation
summary: Failure attribution is essential for diagnosing and improving multi-agent systems (MAS), yet existing benchmarks and methods largely assume a single deterministic root cause for each failure. In practice, MAS failures often admit multiple plausible attributions due to complex inter-agent dependencies and ambiguous execution trajectories. We revisit MAS failure attribution from a multi-perspective standpoint and propose multi-perspective failure attribution, a practical paradigm that explicitly accounts for attribution ambiguity. To support this setting, we introduce MP-Bench, the first benchmark designed for multi-perspective failure attribution in MAS, along with a new evaluation protocol tailored to this paradigm. Through extensive experiments, we find that prior conclusions suggesting LLMs struggle with failure attribution are largely driven by limitations in existing benchmark designs. Our results highlight the necessity of multi-perspective benchmarks and evaluation protocols for realistic and reliable MAS debugging.
summary_zh: 故障归因对于诊断和改进多智能体系统(MAS)至关重要，然而，现有的基准测试和方法在很大程度上假设每次故障都只有一个确定的根本原因。在实践中，由于复杂的智能体间依赖关系和模糊的执行轨迹，MAS故障通常允许多种合理的归因。我们从多视角角度重新审视MAS故障归因，并提出了多视角故障归因，这是一个实用范例，明确考虑了归因的歧义性。为了支持这种设置，我们引入了MP-Bench，这是第一个专为MAS中的多视角故障归因设计的基准测试，同时提出了针对此范例量身定制的新评估协议。通过大量的实验，我们发现先前认为大型语言模型难以进行故障归因的结论，很大程度上受到现有基准测试设计局限性的驱动。我们的结果强调了多视角基准测试和评估协议对于现实和可靠的MAS调试的必要性。
tldr: This paper addresses the limitations of existing MAS failure attribution benchmarks by introducing a new multi-perspective benchmark (MP-Bench) and evaluation protocol, demonstrating that LLMs perform better than previously thought when evaluated with a more realistic approach.
tldr_zh: 本文通过引入新的多视角基准测试 (MP-Bench) 和评估协议，解决了现有 MAS 故障归因基准测试的局限性，表明使用更实际的方法进行评估时，LLM 的性能优于之前的预期。

title: TIGFlow-GRPO: Trajectory Forecasting via Interaction-Aware Flow Matching and Reward-Driven Optimization
summary: Human trajectory forecasting is important for intelligent multimedia systems operating in visually complex environments, such as autonomous driving and crowd surveillance. Although Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) has shown strong ability in modeling trajectory distributions from spatio-temporal observations, existing approaches still focus primarily on supervised fitting, which may leave social norms and scene constraints insufficiently reflected in generated trajectories. To address this issue, we propose TIGFlow-GRPO, a two-stage generative framework that aligns flow-based trajectory generation with behavioral rules. In the first stage, we build a CFM-based predictor with a Trajectory-Interaction-Graph (TIG) module to model fine-grained visual-spatial interactions and strengthen context encoding. This stage captures both agent-agent and agent-scene relations more effectively, providing more informative conditional features for subsequent alignment. In the second stage, we perform Flow-GRPO post-training,where deterministic flow rollout is reformulated as stochastic ODE-to-SDE sampling to enable trajectory exploration, and a composite reward combines view-aware social compliance with map-aware physical feasibility. By evaluating trajectories explored through SDE rollout, GRPO progressively steers multimodal predictions toward behaviorally plausible futures. Experiments on the ETH/UCY and SDD datasets show that TIGFlow-GRPO improves forecasting accuracy and long-horizon stability while generating trajectories that are more socially compliant and physically feasible. These results suggest that the proposed framework provides an effective way to connect flow-based trajectory modeling with behavior-aware alignment in dynamic multimedia environments.
summary_zh: 人类轨迹预测对于在视觉复杂环境中运行的智能多媒体系统至关重要，例如自动驾驶和人群监控。虽然条件流匹配（CFM）在建模来自时空观测的轨迹分布方面表现出强大的能力，但现有方法仍然主要侧重于监督拟合，这可能导致生成的轨迹未能充分反映社会规范和场景约束。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种名为TIGFlow-GRPO的两阶段生成框架，该框架将基于流的轨迹生成与行为规则对齐。在第一阶段，我们构建一个基于CFM的预测器，其中包含轨迹-交互-图（TIG）模块，以建模细粒度的视觉-空间交互并加强上下文编码。这一阶段更有效地捕捉了主体-主体和主体-场景关系，为后续对齐提供了更具信息性的条件特征。在第二阶段，我们执行Flow-GRPO后训练，其中确定性流展开被重新表述为随机ODE-to-SDE采样，以实现轨迹探索，并且复合奖励结合了视角感知的社会合规性和地图感知的物理可行性。通过评估由SDE展开探索的轨迹，GRPO逐渐将多模态预测引导至行为上合理的未来。在ETH/UCY和SDD数据集上的实验表明，TIGFlow-GRPO提高了预测精度和长时程稳定性，同时生成了更符合社会规范和物理上可行的轨迹。这些结果表明，所提出的框架提供了一种有效的方法，可以将基于流的轨迹建模与动态多媒体环境中行为感知对齐联系起来。
tldr: The paper introduces TIGFlow-GRPO, a two-stage framework for human trajectory forecasting that combines Conditional Flow Matching with a Trajectory-Interaction-Graph module and reward-driven optimization to improve accuracy, stability, social compliance, and physical feasibility.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TIGFlow-GRPO，一个用于人类轨迹预测的两阶段框架，它结合了条件流匹配、轨迹交互图模块和奖励驱动的优化，以提高准确性、稳定性、社会合规性和物理可行性。

title: Unleashing Guidance Without Classifiers for Human-Object Interaction Animation
summary: Generating realistic human-object interaction (HOI) animations remains challenging because it requires jointly modeling dynamic human actions and diverse object geometries. Prior diffusion-based approaches often rely on hand-crafted contact priors or human-imposed kinematic constraints to improve contact quality. We propose LIGHT, a data-driven alternative in which guidance emerges from the denoising pace itself, reducing dependence on manually designed priors. Building on diffusion forcing, we factor the representation into modality-specific components and assign individualized noise levels with asynchronous denoising schedules. In this paradigm, cleaner components guide noisier ones through cross-attention, yielding guidance without auxiliary classifiers. We find that this data-driven guidance is inherently contact-aware, and can be enhanced when training is augmented with a broad spectrum of synthetic object geometries, encouraging invariance of contact semantics to geometric diversity. Extensive experiments show that pace-induced guidance more effectively mirrors the benefits of contact priors than conventional classifier-free guidance, while achieving higher contact fidelity, more realistic HOI generation, and stronger generalization to unseen objects and tasks.
summary_zh: 生成逼真的人-物交互（HOI）动画仍然具有挑战性，因为它需要联合建模动态的人类动作和多样化的物体几何形状。 先前基于扩散的方法通常依赖于手工制作的接触先验或人为施加的运动学约束来提高接触质量。 我们提出LIGHT，这是一种数据驱动的替代方案，其中指导来自去噪节奏本身，从而减少对手动设计的先验的依赖。 基于扩散强制，我们将表示分解为模态特定的组件，并使用异步去噪计划为每个组件分配单独的噪声水平。 在这种范式中，更干净的组件通过交叉注意力引导噪声较大的组件，从而在没有辅助分类器的情况下产生指导。 我们发现这种数据驱动的指导本质上是接触感知的，并且当训练通过广泛的合成物体几何形状增强时，可以得到增强，鼓励接触语义对几何多样性的不变性。 大量实验表明，与传统的无分类器指导相比，节奏诱导的指导能够更有效地反映接触先验的优势，同时实现更高的接触保真度、更逼真的人-物交互生成以及对未见物体和任务更强的泛化能力。
tldr: The paper introduces LIGHT, a diffusion-based method for generating realistic human-object interaction animations by using asynchronous denoising schedules to achieve contact-aware guidance without relying on hand-crafted priors or classifiers, leading to improved contact fidelity and generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为LIGHT的扩散模型，用于生成逼真的人机交互动画。它通过异步去噪计划实现接触感知引导，无需依赖手工设计的先验知识或分类器，从而提高了接触逼真度和泛化能力。

title: GeoHeight-Bench: Towards Height-Aware Multimodal Reasoning in Remote Sensing
summary: Current Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) in Earth Observation typically neglect the critical "vertical" dimension, limiting their reasoning capabilities in complex remote sensing geometries and disaster scenarios where physical spatial structures often outweigh planar visual textures. To bridge this gap, we introduce a comprehensive evaluation framework dedicated to height-aware remote sensing understanding. First, to overcome the severe scarcity of annotated data, we develop a scalable, VLM-driven data generation pipeline utilizing systematic prompt engineering and metadata extraction. This pipeline constructs two complementary benchmarks: GeoHeight-Bench for relative height analysis, and a more challenging GeoHeight-Bench+ for holistic, terrain-aware reasoning. Furthermore, to validate the necessity of height perception, we propose GeoHeightChat, the first height-aware remote sensing LMM baseline. Serving as a strong proof of concept, our baseline demonstrates that synergizing visual semantics with implicitly injected height geometric features effectively mitigates the "vertical blind spot", successfully unlocking a new paradigm of interactive height reasoning in existing optical models.
summary_zh: 地球观测领域当前的大型多模态模型（LMM）通常忽略至关重要的“垂直”维度，限制了其在复杂遥感几何结构和灾害场景中的推理能力，在这些场景中，物理空间结构的重要性往往超过平面视觉纹理。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了一个全面的评估框架，专门用于感知高度的遥感理解。首先，为了克服标注数据严重稀缺的问题，我们开发了一种可扩展的、VLM 驱动的数据生成流水线，利用系统的提示工程和元数据提取。该流水线构建了两个互补的基准：用于相对高度分析的 GeoHeight-Bench，以及一个更具挑战性的、用于整体地形感知推理的 GeoHeight-Bench+。 此外，为了验证高度感知的必要性，我们提出了 GeoHeightChat，这是第一个感知高度的遥感 LMM 基线。 作为概念验证，我们的基线表明，将视觉语义与隐含注入的高度几何特征相结合，能有效缓解“垂直盲点”，成功开启了现有光学模型中交互式高度推理的新范例。
tldr: This paper introduces GeoHeight-Bench, a height-aware evaluation framework and baseline (GeoHeightChat) for Large Multimodal Models in remote sensing, addressing the neglect of vertical information in existing models and demonstrating improved reasoning in complex scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了GeoHeight-Bench，这是一个针对遥感领域大型多模态模型的高度感知评估框架和基线(GeoHeightChat)。该框架旨在解决现有模型忽略垂直信息的不足，并展示了模型在复杂场景中更好的推理能力。

title: Knowledge-Guided Failure Prediction: Detecting When Object Detectors Miss Safety-Critical Objects
summary: Object detectors deployed in safety-critical environments can fail silently, e.g. missing pedestrians, workers, or other safety-critical objects without emitting any warning. Traditional Out Of Distribution (OOD) detection methods focus on identifying unfamiliar inputs, but do not directly predict functional failures of the detector itself. We introduce Knowledge Guided Failure Prediction (KGFP), a representation-based monitoring framework that treats missed safety-critical detections as anomalies to be detected at runtime. KGFP measures semantic misalignment between internal object detector features and visual foundation model embeddings using a dual-encoder architecture with an angular distance metric. A key property is that when either the detector is operating outside its competence or the visual foundation model itself encounters novel inputs, the two embeddings diverge, producing a high-angle signal that reliably flags unsafe images. We compare our novel KGFS method to baseline OOD detection methods. On COCO person detection, applying KGFP as a selective-prediction gate raises person recall among accepted images from 64.3% to 84.5% at 5% False Positive Rate (FPR), and maintains strong performance across six COCO-O visual domains, outperforming OOD baselines by large margins. Our code, models, and features are published at https://gitlab.cc-asp.fraunhofer.de/iosb_public/KGFP.
summary_zh: 在安全攸关环境中部署的目标检测器可能会无声地失效，例如，漏检行人、工人或其他安全攸关目标，且不发出任何警告。传统的分布外 (OOD) 检测方法侧重于识别不熟悉的输入，但不能直接预测检测器自身的功能性故障。我们引入了知识引导的故障预测 (KGFP)，这是一种基于表征的监控框架，将漏检的安全攸关目标视为运行时需要检测的异常。KGFP 使用带有角度距离度量的双编码器架构，测量内部目标检测器特征和视觉基础模型嵌入之间的语义失调。一个关键特性是，当检测器在其能力范围之外运行，或视觉基础模型本身遇到新颖输入时，两个嵌入会发散，产生一个高角度信号，从而可靠地标记不安全图像。我们将我们新颖的 KGFP 方法与基准 OOD 检测方法进行了比较。在 COCO 行人检测中，应用 KGFP 作为选择性预测门可以将接受图像中的行人召回率从 64.3% 提高到 84.5%，且误报率 (FPR) 为 5%，并在六个 COCO-O 视觉领域保持了强大的性能，大幅优于 OOD 基线。我们的代码、模型和特征发布于 https://gitlab.cc-asp.fraunhofer.de/iosb_public/KGFP。
tldr: This paper introduces Knowledge Guided Failure Prediction (KGFP) to detect when object detectors fail to identify safety-critical objects, using semantic misalignment between object detector features and visual foundation model embeddings. KGFP improves pedestrian detection recall and outperforms OOD baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了知识引导的失败预测 (KGFP)，用于检测目标检测器在识别安全关键目标时何时失败。 KGFP 通过使用目标检测器特征和视觉基础模型嵌入之间的语义不对齐来工作，并提高了行人检测召回率，优于传统的 OOD 基线。

title: V2U4Real: A Real-world Large-scale Dataset for Vehicle-to-UAV Cooperative Perception
summary: Modern autonomous vehicle perception systems are often constrained by occlusions, blind spots, and limited sensing range. While existing cooperative perception paradigms, such as Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) and Vehicle-to-Infrastructure (V2I), have demonstrated their effectiveness in mitigating these challenges, they remain limited to ground-level collaboration and cannot fully address large-scale occlusions or long-range perception in complex environments. To advance research in cross-view cooperative perception, we present V2U4Real, the first large-scale real-world multi-modal dataset for Vehicle-to-UAV (V2U) cooperative object perception. V2U4Real is collected by a ground vehicle and a UAV equipped with multi-view LiDARs and RGB cameras. The dataset covers urban streets, university campuses, and rural roads under diverse traffic scenarios, comprising over 56K LiDAR frames, 56K multi-view camera images, and 700K annotated 3D bounding boxes across four classes. To support a wide range of research tasks, we establish benchmarks for single-agent 3D object detection, cooperative 3D object detection, and object tracking. Comprehensive evaluations of several state-of-the-art models demonstrate the effectiveness of V2U cooperation in enhancing perception robustness and long-range awareness. The V2U4Real dataset and codebase is available at https://github.com/VjiaLi/V2U4Real.
summary_zh: 现代自动驾驶车辆感知系统通常受到遮挡、盲点和有限感知范围的限制。虽然现有的协同感知范式，例如车-车通信（V2V）和车-路通信（V2I），已经证明了它们在缓解这些挑战方面的有效性，但它们仍然局限于地面层面的协作，无法完全解决复杂环境中的大规模遮挡或远距离感知问题。为了推进跨视角协同感知的研究，我们提出了 V2U4Real，这是首个用于车-无人机通信（V2U）协同目标感知的真实世界大规模多模态数据集。V2U4Real 由一辆地面车辆和一个配备多视角激光雷达和 RGB 相机的无人机采集。该数据集涵盖城市街道、大学校园和乡村道路等多种交通场景，包含超过 5.6 万帧激光雷达数据、5.6 万张多视角相机图像以及跨四个类别的 70 万个标注的 3D 边界框。为了支持广泛的研究任务，我们建立了单智能体 3D 目标检测、协同 3D 目标检测和目标跟踪的基准。对几种最先进模型的综合评估表明，V2U 协作在增强感知鲁棒性和远距离感知能力方面是有效的。V2U4Real 数据集和代码库可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/VjiaLi/V2U4Real。
tldr: The paper introduces V2U4Real, a large-scale real-world dataset for Vehicle-to-UAV cooperative perception, designed to address limitations of existing cooperative perception systems by leveraging UAV-based observation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了V2U4Real，一个大规模的真实世界车辆到无人机协同感知数据集，旨在通过利用基于无人机的观测来解决现有协同感知系统的局限性。

title: Bilingual Text-to-Motion Generation: A New Benchmark and Baselines
summary: Text-to-motion generation holds significant potential for cross-linguistic applications, yet it is hindered by the lack of bilingual datasets and the poor cross-lingual semantic understanding of existing language models. To address these gaps, we introduce BiHumanML3D, the first bilingual text-to-motion benchmark, constructed via LLM-assisted annotation and rigorous manual correction. Furthermore, we propose a simple yet effective baseline, Bilingual Motion Diffusion (BiMD), featuring Cross-Lingual Alignment (CLA). CLA explicitly aligns semantic representations across languages, creating a robust conditional space that enables high-quality motion generation from bilingual inputs, including zero-shot code-switching scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BiMD with CLA achieves an FID of 0.045 vs. 0.169 and R@3 of 82.8\% vs. 80.8\%, significantly outperforms monolingual diffusion models and translation baselines on BiHumanML3D, underscoring the critical necessity and reliability of our dataset and the effectiveness of our alignment strategy for cross-lingual motion synthesis. The dataset and code are released at \href{https://wengwanjiang.github.io/BilingualT2M-page}{https://wengwanjiang.github.io/BilingualT2M-page}
summary_zh: 文本到动作生成在跨语言应用方面具有巨大的潜力，但缺乏双语数据集和现有语言模型较差的跨语言语义理解阻碍了其发展。为了解决这些问题，我们推出了BiHumanML3D，这是首个双语文本到动作基准，通过LLM辅助标注和严格的人工校正构建而成。此外，我们提出了一个简单而有效的基线模型，即双语动作扩散（BiMD），其特点是跨语言对齐（CLA）。CLA显式地对齐了跨语言的语义表示，创建了一个强大的条件空间，能够从双语输入生成高质量的动作，包括零样本代码切换场景。大量的实验表明，带有CLA的BiMD在BiHumanML3D上实现了0.045的FID（vs. 0.169）和82.8%的R@3（vs. 80.8%），显著优于单语扩散模型和翻译基线，突显了我们数据集的关键必要性和可靠性，以及我们对齐策略在跨语言动作合成方面的有效性。数据集和代码已发布在\href{https://wengwanjiang.github.io/BilingualT2M-page}{https://wengwanjiang.github.io/BilingualT2M-page}。
tldr: The paper introduces BiHumanML3D, a new bilingual (English and Chinese) text-to-motion dataset, and proposes Bilingual Motion Diffusion (BiMD) with Cross-Lingual Alignment (CLA) for effective cross-lingual motion generation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了BiHumanML3D，一个新的双语（英语和中文）文本到动作的数据集，并提出了带有跨语言对齐（CLA）的双语运动扩散（BiMD）方法，用于有效的跨语言运动生成。

title: Label What Matters: Modality-Balanced and Difficulty-Aware Multimodal Active Learning
summary: Multimodal learning integrates complementary information from different modalities such as image, text, and audio to improve model performance, but its success relies on large-scale labeled data, which is costly to obtain. Active learning (AL) mitigates this challenge by selectively annotating informative samples. In multimodal settings, many approaches implicitly assume that modality importance is stable across rounds and keep selection rules fixed at the fusion stage, which leaves them insensitive to the dynamic nature of multimodal learning, where the relative value of modalities and the difficulty of instances shift as training proceeds. To address this issue, we propose RL-MBA, a reinforcement-learning framework for modality-balanced, difficulty-aware multimodal active learning. RL-MBA models sample selection as a Markov Decision Process, where the policy adapts to modality contributions, uncertainty, and diversity, and the reward encourages accuracy gains and balance. Two key components drive this adaptability: (1) Adaptive Modality Contribution Balancing (AMCB), which dynamically adjusts modality weights via reinforcement feedback, and (2) Evidential Fusion for DifficultyAware Policy Adjustment (EFDA), which estimates sample difficulty via uncertainty-based evidential fusion to prioritize informative samples. Experiments on Food101, KineticsSound, and VGGSound demonstrate that RL-MBA consistently outperforms strong baselines, improving both classification accuracy and modality fairness under limited labeling budgets.
summary_zh: 多模态学习整合来自不同模态（如图像、文本和音频）的互补信息以提升模型性能，但其成功依赖于大规模标注数据，而获取这些数据成本高昂。主动学习 (AL) 通过选择性地标注信息量大的样本来缓解这一挑战。在多模态场景中，许多方法隐式地假设模态重要性在各轮迭代中保持稳定，并在融合阶段保持选择规则不变，这使得它们对多模态学习的动态特性不敏感，而模态的相对价值和实例的难度会随着训练的进行而变化。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种基于强化学习的框架 RL-MBA，用于模态平衡、难度感知的多模态主动学习。RL-MBA 将样本选择建模为一个马尔可夫决策过程，其中策略适应模态贡献、不确定性和多样性，并且奖励鼓励准确率提升和平衡。两个关键组成部分驱动了这种适应性：(1) 自适应模态贡献平衡 (AMCB)，它通过强化反馈动态调整模态权重；(2) 用于难度感知策略调整的证据融合 (EFDA)，它通过基于不确定性的证据融合来估计样本难度，从而优先考虑信息量大的样本。在 Food101、KineticsSound 和 VGGSound 上的实验表明，在有限的标注预算下，RL-MBA 始终优于强大的基线方法，从而提高了分类准确率和模态公平性。
tldr: The paper introduces RL-MBA, a reinforcement learning framework for multimodal active learning that dynamically adjusts modality weights and prioritizes informative samples based on estimated difficulty, outperforming existing methods on several datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RL-MBA，一个用于多模态主动学习的强化学习框架，它可以动态调整模态权重，并根据估计的难度来优先选择信息量大的样本，在多个数据集上优于现有方法。

title: GDPO-Listener: Expressive Interactive Head Generation via Auto-Regressive Flow Matching and Group reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization
summary: Generating realistic 3D head motion for dyadic interactions is a significant challenge in virtual human synthesis. While recent methods achieve impressive results with speaking heads, they frequently suffer from the `Regression-to-the-Mean' problem in listener motions, collapsing into static faces, and lack the parameter space for complex nonverbal motions. In this paper, we propose GDPO-Listener, a novel framework that achieves highly expressive speaking and listening motion generation. First, we introduce an Auto-Regressive Flow Matching architecture enabling stable supervised learning. Second, to overcome kinematic stillness, we apply the Group reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization (GDPO). By isolating reward normalization across distinct FLAME parameter groups, GDPO explicitly incentivizes high variance expressive generations. Finally, we enable explicit semantic text control for customizable responses. Extensive evaluations across the Seamless Interaction and DualTalk datasets demonstrate superior performance compared to existing baselines on long-term kinematic variance, visual expressivity and semantic controllability.
summary_zh: 为二元互动生成逼真的3D头部运动是虚拟人合成领域的一项重大挑战。虽然近期的研究在说话头部的运动生成方面取得了显著成果，但它们在听者运动中常常面临“回归均值”的问题，导致静态面部，并且缺乏复杂非语言运动的参数空间。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为GDPO-Listener的新框架，它实现了极具表现力的说话和聆听运动生成。首先，我们引入了一种自回归流匹配架构，从而实现稳定的监督学习。其次，为了克服运动学上的停滞，我们应用了分组奖励解耦策略优化（GDPO）。通过对不同的FLAME参数组进行独立的奖励归一化，GDPO显式地激励高方差的表现力生成。最后，我们实现了显式的语义文本控制，从而实现可定制的响应。在Seamless Interaction和DualTalk数据集上的广泛评估表明，与现有的基线方法相比，我们的方法在长期运动学方差、视觉表现力和语义可控性方面都具有优越的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces GDPO-Listener, a novel framework for generating expressive 3D head motions for both speaking and listening in dyadic interactions, addressing the 'Regression-to-the-Mean' problem via Auto-Regressive Flow Matching and Group reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了GDPO-Listener，一种新颖的框架，用于生成对话互动中富有表现力的3D头部运动，通过自回归流匹配和组奖励解耦策略优化解决“回归均值”问题。

title: AVControl: Efficient Framework for Training Audio-Visual Controls
summary: Controlling video and audio generation requires diverse modalities, from depth and pose to camera trajectories and audio transformations, yet existing approaches either train a single monolithic model for a fixed set of controls or introduce costly architectural changes for each new modality. We introduce AVControl, a lightweight, extendable framework built on LTX-2, a joint audio-visual foundation model, where each control modality is trained as a separate LoRA on a parallel canvas that provides the reference signal as additional tokens in the attention layers, requiring no architectural changes beyond the LoRA adapters themselves. We show that simply extending image-based in-context methods to video fails for structural control, and that our parallel canvas approach resolves this. On the VACE Benchmark, we outperform all evaluated baselines on depth- and pose-guided generation, inpainting, and outpainting, and show competitive results on camera control and audio-visual benchmarks. Our framework supports a diverse set of independently trained modalities: spatially-aligned controls such as depth, pose, and edges, camera trajectory with intrinsics, sparse motion control, video editing, and, to our knowledge, the first modular audio-visual controls for a joint generation model. Our method is both compute- and data-efficient: each modality requires only a small dataset and converges within a few hundred to a few thousand training steps, a fraction of the budget of monolithic alternatives. We publicly release our code and trained LoRA checkpoints.
summary_zh: 用于控制视频和音频生成需要多种模态，从深度和姿态到相机轨迹和音频变换，然而现有方法要么为固定的控制集训练单个整体模型，要么为每种新模态引入代价高昂的架构变更。我们提出了AVControl，一个轻量级、可扩展的框架，构建于联合视听基础模型LTX-2之上，其中每种控制模态都被训练为一个独立的LoRA，位于一个并行画布上，该画布提供参考信号作为注意力层中的额外token，除了LoRA适配器本身之外，无需任何架构变更。我们表明，简单地将基于图像的上下文学习方法扩展到视频，在结构化控制方面会失效，而我们的并行画布方法解决了这个问题。在VACE基准测试中，我们在深度和姿态引导生成、修复和外推方面优于所有评估的基线，并在相机控制和视听基准测试中表现出具有竞争力的结果。我们的框架支持多种独立训练的模态：空间对齐的控制，例如深度、姿态和边缘，带有内参的相机轨迹，稀疏运动控制，视频编辑，以及据我们所知，首个用于联合生成模型的模块化视听控制。我们的方法兼具计算和数据效率：每种模态仅需要少量数据集，并在几百到几千个训练步骤内收敛，这只是整体替代方案预算的一小部分。我们公开了我们的代码和训练好的LoRA检查点。
tldr: AVControl is a new framework for training audio-visual controls using LoRA adapters on a parallel canvas built on LTX-2, a joint audio-visual foundation model. It achieves state-of-the-art results on various audio-visual control tasks with better compute and data efficiency.
tldr_zh: AVControl 是一个用于训练视听控制的新框架，它利用 LTX-2 上的 LoRA 适配器和一个并行画布。它在各种视听控制任务上实现了最先进的结果，并具有更好的计算和数据效率。

title: Lookalike3D: Seeing Double in 3D
summary: 3D object understanding and generation methods produce impressive results, yet they often overlook a pervasive source of information in real-world scenes: repeated objects. We introduce the task of lookalike object detection in indoor scenes, which leverages repeated and complementary cues from identical and near-identical object pairs. Given an input scene, the task is to classify pairs of objects as identical, similar or different using multiview images as input. To address this, we present Lookalike3D, a multiview image transformer that effectively distinguishes such object pairs by harnessing strong semantic priors from large image foundation models. To support this task, we collected the 3DTwins dataset, containing 76k manually annotated identical, similar and different pairs of objects based on ScanNet++, and show an improvement of 104% IoU over baselines. We demonstrate how our method improves downstream tasks such as enabling joint 3D object reconstruction and part co-segmentation, turning repeated and lookalike objects into a powerful cue for consistent, high-quality 3D perception. Our code, dataset and models will be made publicly available.
summary_zh: 3D物体理解和生成方法已经取得了令人瞩目的成果，但它们通常忽略了现实世界场景中一种普遍存在的信息来源：重复出现的物体。我们提出了室内场景中相似物检测的任务，该任务利用来自相同和近乎相同的物体对的重复和互补线索。给定一个输入场景，该任务旨在使用多视角图像作为输入，将物体对分类为相同、相似或不同。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Lookalike3D，一种多视角图像Transformer，它通过利用来自大型图像基础模型的强大语义先验来有效地区分这些物体对。为了支持这项任务，我们收集了3DTwins数据集，其中包含基于ScanNet++的7.6万个手动标注的相同、相似和不同的物体对，并展示了相对于基线方法104% IoU的提升。我们证明了我们的方法如何改进下游任务，例如实现联合3D物体重建和部件协同分割，将重复和相似物体转化为一致、高质量3D感知的强大线索。我们的代码、数据集和模型将公开发布。
tldr: The paper introduces Lookalike3D, a method and dataset (3DTwins) for detecting identical/similar object pairs in 3D scenes using a multiview image transformer, designed to improve 3D object understanding and downstream tasks like reconstruction and part co-segmentation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Lookalike3D，一种使用多视图图像Transformer检测3D场景中相同/相似物体对的方法和数据集(3DTwins)，旨在改进3D物体理解和下游任务，如重建和部件协同分割。

title: SEVerA: Verified Synthesis of Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Recent advances have shown the effectiveness of self-evolving LLM agents on tasks such as program repair and scientific discovery. In this paradigm, a planner LLM synthesizes an agent program that invokes parametric models, including LLMs, which are then tuned per task to improve performance. However, existing self-evolving agent frameworks provide no formal guarantees of safety or correctness. Because such programs are often executed autonomously on unseen inputs, this lack of guarantees raises reliability and security concerns. We formulate agentic code generation as a constrained learning problem, combining hard formal specifications with soft objectives capturing task utility. We introduce Formally Guarded Generative Models (FGGM), which allow the planner LLM to specify a formal output contract for each generative model call using first-order logic. Each FGGM call wraps the underlying model in a rejection sampler with a verified fallback, ensuring every returned output satisfies the contract for any input and parameter setting. Building on FGGM, we present SEVerA (Self-Evolving Verified Agents), a three-stage framework: Search synthesizes candidate parametric programs containing FGGM calls; Verification proves correctness with respect to hard constraints for all parameter values, reducing the problem to unconstrained learning; and Learning applies scalable gradient-based optimization, including GRPO-style fine-tuning, to improve the soft objective while preserving correctness. We evaluate SEVerA on Dafny program verification, symbolic math synthesis, and policy-compliant agentic tool use ($τ^2$-bench). Across tasks, SEVerA achieves zero constraint violations while improving performance over unconstrained and SOTA baselines, showing that formal behavioral constraints not only guarantee correctness but also steer synthesis toward higher-quality agents.
summary_zh: 最近的进展表明，自演化的LLM智能体在程序修复和科学发现等任务上表现出高效性。在这种范式中，规划器LLM合成一个智能体程序，该程序调用参数化模型（包括LLM），然后针对每个任务进行调整以提高性能。然而，现有的自演化智能体框架没有提供关于安全性或正确性的正式保证。由于这些程序通常在未知的输入上自主执行，这种缺乏保证引发了可靠性和安全性的担忧。我们将智能体代码生成形式化为一个受约束的学习问题，将硬性形式化规范与捕捉任务效用的软性目标相结合。我们引入了形式化守护生成模型（FGGM），它允许规划器LLM使用一阶逻辑为每个生成模型调用指定一个形式化的输出契约。每个FGGM调用都将底层模型封装在一个带有验证回退的拒绝采样器中，确保每个返回的输出在任何输入和参数设置下都满足契约。基于FGGM，我们提出了SEVerA（自演化验证智能体），这是一个三阶段框架：搜索合成包含FGGM调用的候选参数化程序；验证证明对于所有参数值的硬性约束的正确性，从而将问题简化为无约束学习；学习应用可扩展的基于梯度的优化，包括GRPO风格的微调，以在保持正确性的前提下改进软性目标。我们在Dafny程序验证、符号数学合成和符合策略的智能体工具使用（$τ^2$-bench）上评估了SEVerA。在所有任务中，SEVerA实现了零约束违反，同时提高了优于无约束基线和SOTA基线的性能，表明形式化行为约束不仅保证了正确性，而且引导合成朝着更高质量的智能体发展。
tldr: The paper introduces SEVerA, a framework for synthesizing self-evolving LLM agents with formal guarantees of safety and correctness, validated on program verification, symbolic math synthesis, and policy-compliant tool use.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 SEVerA，一个用于合成具有形式化安全性和正确性保证的自进化 LLM 代理的框架，已在程序验证、符号数学合成和符合策略的工具使用方面进行了验证。

title: Learning to Staff: Offline Reinforcement Learning and Fine-Tuned LLMs for Warehouse Staffing Optimization
summary: We investigate machine learning approaches for optimizing real-time staffing decisions in semi-automated warehouse sortation systems. Operational decision-making can be supported at different levels of abstraction, with different trade-offs. We evaluate two approaches, each in a matching simulation environment. First, we train custom Transformer-based policies using offline reinforcement learning on detailed historical state representations, achieving a 2.4% throughput improvement over historical baselines in learned simulators. In high-volume warehouse operations, improvements of this size translate to significant savings. Second, we explore LLMs operating on abstracted, human-readable state descriptions. These are a natural fit for decisions that warehouse managers make using high-level operational summaries. We systematically compare prompting techniques, automatic prompt optimization, and fine-tuning strategies. While prompting alone proves insufficient, supervised fine-tuning combined with Direct Preference Optimization on simulator-generated preferences achieves performance that matches or slightly exceeds historical baselines in a hand-crafted simulator. Our findings demonstrate that both approaches offer viable paths toward AI-assisted operational decision-making. Offline RL excels with task-specific architectures. LLMs support human-readable inputs and can be combined with an iterative feedback loop that can incorporate manager preferences.
summary_zh: 我们研究了使用机器学习方法优化半自动化仓库分拣系统中实时人员配置决策的问题。 运营决策支持可以在不同的抽象层面上进行，并带来不同的权衡。我们评估了两种方法，每种方法都在一个匹配的仿真环境中进行。首先，我们使用离线强化学习在详细的历史状态表示上训练定制的基于Transformer的策略，在学习到的模拟器中实现了比历史基线提高2.4%的吞吐量。 在高吞吐量仓库运营中，这种规模的改进可以转化为显著的节省。其次，我们探索了基于抽象的、人类可读的状态描述运行的大型语言模型（LLM）。这些模型天然适合仓库管理人员使用高层次运营摘要进行的决策。 我们系统地比较了提示技术、自动提示优化和微调策略。虽然单独的提示证明是不够的，但监督微调与模拟器生成的偏好上的直接偏好优化相结合，可以在手工模拟器中达到或略微超过历史基线的性能。我们的研究结果表明，这两种方法都为 AI 辅助运营决策提供了可行的途径。 离线强化学习在特定任务架构中表现出色。 大型语言模型支持人类可读的输入，并且可以与迭代反馈循环相结合，从而可以整合管理人员的偏好。
tldr: This paper explores offline RL and fine-tuned LLMs for warehouse staffing optimization, finding that offline RL with specialized architectures outperforms historical baselines, while fine-tuned LLMs match baselines and offer human-readable input benefits.
tldr_zh: 该论文探索了离线强化学习和微调的LLM在仓库人员配置优化中的应用，发现离线强化学习配合专用架构优于历史基线，而微调的LLM与基线持平，并提供了人类可读的输入优势。

title: Characterization of Constraints in Flexible Unknown Environments
summary: This paper presents an online path planning algorithm for safe autonomous manipulation of a flexibly constrained object in an unknown environment. Methods for real time identification and characterization of perceived flexible constraints and global stiffness are presented. Used in tandem, these methods allow a robot to simultaneously explore, characterize, and manipulate an elastic system safely. Navigation without a-priori knowledge of the system is achieved using constraint exploration based on local force and position information. The perceived constraint stiffness is considered at multiple poses along an object's (system) trajectory. Using stiffness eigenvector information, global stiffness behavior is characterized and identified using an atlas of simple mechanical constraints, such as hinges and planar constraints. Validation of these algorithms is carried out by simulation and experimentally. The ability to recognize several common simple mechanical constraints (such as a flexible hinge) in real time, and to subsequently identify relevant screw parameters is demonstrated. These results suggest the feasibility of simultaneous global constrain/stiffness exploration and safe manipulation of flexibly constrained objects. We believe that this approach will eventually enable safe cooperative manipulation in applications such as organ retraction and manipulation during surgery
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种在线路径规划算法，用于在未知环境中安全自主地操纵受柔性约束的对象。论文给出了对感知到的柔性约束和全局刚度进行实时识别和表征的方法。这些方法协同使用，允许机器人同时探索、表征和安全地操纵弹性系统。在没有系统先验知识的情况下，通过基于局部力和位置信息的约束探索来实现导航。在对象（系统）轨迹上的多个姿态处考虑感知到的约束刚度。利用刚度特征向量信息，通过简单机械约束图集（例如铰链和平面约束）来表征和识别全局刚度行为。通过仿真和实验验证了这些算法。实验证明了实时识别几种常见的简单机械约束（如柔性铰链）以及随后识别相关螺旋参数的能力。这些结果表明，同时进行全局约束/刚度探索和安全操纵受柔性约束对象的可能性。我们认为，这种方法最终将能够在诸如手术过程中器官回缩和操作等应用中实现安全的协同操作。
tldr: The paper presents an online path planning algorithm for safe autonomous manipulation of flexibly constrained objects in unknown environments, enabling simultaneous exploration, characterization, and manipulation using real-time constraint identification and stiffness characterization.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种在线路径规划算法，用于在未知环境中安全自主地操作具有柔性约束的物体。该算法能够通过实时约束识别和刚度表征，同时进行探索、表征和操作。

title: Saranga: MilliWatt Ultrasound for Navigation in Visually Degraded Environments on Palm-Sized Aerial Robots
summary: Tiny palm-sized aerial robots possess exceptional agility and cost-effectiveness in navigating confined and cluttered environments. However, their limited payload capacity directly constrains the sensing suite on-board the robot, thereby limiting critical navigational tasks in Global Positioning System (GPS)-denied wild scenes. Common methods for obstacle avoidance use cameras and LIght Detection And Ranging (LIDAR), which become ineffective in visually degraded conditions such as low visibility, dust, fog or darkness. Other sensors, such as RAdio Detection And Ranging (RADAR), have high power consumption, making them unsuitable for tiny aerial robots. Inspired by bats, we propose Saranga, a low-power ultrasound-based perception stack that localizes obstacles using a dual sonar array. We present two key solutions to combat the low Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio of $-4.9$ decibels: physical noise reduction and a deep learning based denoising method. Firstly, we present a practical way to block propeller induced ultrasound noise on the weak echoes. The second solution is to train a neural network to utilize the \textcolor{black}{long horizon of ultrasound echoes} for finding signal patterns under high amounts of uncorrelated noise where classical methods were insufficient. We generalize to the real world by using a synthetic data generation pipeline and limited real noise data for training. We enable a palm-sized aerial robot to navigate in visually degraded conditions of dense fog, darkness, and snow in a cluttered environment with thin and transparent obstacles using only on-board sensing and computation. We provide extensive real world results to demonstrate the efficacy of our approach.
summary_zh: 微型掌上无人机在导航受限和杂乱环境方面具有卓越的敏捷性和成本效益。然而，其有限的有效载荷能力直接限制了机载传感套件，从而限制了在全球定位系统（GPS）受限的野外场景中的关键导航任务。常用的避障方法使用相机和激光雷达（LIDAR），但在视觉退化条件下，如低能见度、灰尘、雾或黑暗中，这些方法会变得无效。其他传感器，如雷达（RADAR），功耗很高，不适合微型无人机。受蝙蝠的启发，我们提出了Saranga，一种基于超声波的低功耗感知堆栈，它使用双声呐阵列来定位障碍物。我们提出了两种关键解决方案来应对-4.9分贝的低峰值信噪比：物理噪声降低和基于深度学习的去噪方法。首先，我们提出了一种实用的方法来阻挡螺旋桨引起的超声噪声对微弱回声的影响。第二个解决方案是训练一个神经网络，利用超声波回声的长时程来寻找大量不相关噪声下的信号模式，而经典方法无法胜任。我们通过使用合成数据生成管道和有限的真实噪声数据进行训练，推广到现实世界。我们使掌上无人机能够在仅使用机载传感和计算的情况下，在杂乱环境中浓雾、黑暗和降雪等视觉退化条件下，通过稀薄和透明的障碍物进行导航。我们提供了大量的真实世界结果来证明我们方法的有效性。
tldr: The paper presents Saranga, a low-power ultrasound-based perception stack for enabling navigation in visually degraded environments on palm-sized aerial robots by employing physical noise reduction and deep learning-based denoising.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了Saranga，一种低功耗的、基于超声波的感知系统，通过物理降噪和基于深度学习的去噪方法，使掌上无人机能够在视觉退化的环境中导航。

title: Natural-Language Agent Harnesses
summary: Agent performance increasingly depends on \emph{harness engineering}, yet harness design is usually buried in controller code and runtime-specific conventions, making it hard to transfer, compare, and study as a scientific object. We ask whether the high-level control logic of an agent harness can instead be externalized as a portable executable artifact. We introduce \textbf{Natural-Language Agent Harnesses} (NLAHs), which express harness behavior in editable natural language, and \textbf{Intelligent Harness Runtime} (IHR), a shared runtime that executes these harnesses through explicit contracts, durable artifacts, and lightweight adapters. Across coding and computer-use benchmarks, we conduct controlled evaluations of operational viability, module ablation, and code-to-text harness migration.
summary_zh: 智能体的性能越来越依赖于\emph{线路工程设计}，然而线路设计通常隐藏在控制器代码和运行时特定的约定中，这使得它难以作为一种科学对象进行迁移、比较和研究。我们探究是否可以将智能体线路的高级控制逻辑外化为可移植的可执行工件。我们引入了\textbf{自然语言智能体线路} (NLAHs)，它使用可编辑的自然语言表达线路行为，以及\textbf{智能线路运行时} (IHR)，一个通过显式契约、持久工件和轻量级适配器来执行这些线路的共享运行时。在编程和计算机使用基准测试中，我们对可操作性、模块消融和代码到文本线路迁移进行了受控评估。
tldr: The paper introduces Natural-Language Agent Harnesses (NLAHs) and an Intelligent Harness Runtime (IHR) to externalize and execute agent harness behavior using natural language, demonstrating viability and transferability across coding and computer-use benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种自然语言Agent Harness（NLAH）和一个智能Harness运行环境（IHR），该方法可以通过自然语言外部化并执行agent harness行为，并在编码和计算机使用benchmarks中展示了可行性和可移植性。

title: A Gait Foundation Model Predicts Multi-System Health Phenotypes from 3D Skeletal Motion
summary: Gait is increasingly recognized as a vital sign, yet current approaches treat it as a symptom of specific pathologies rather than a systemic biomarker. We developed a gait foundation model for 3D skeletal motion from 3,414 deeply phenotyped adults, recorded via a depth camera during five motor tasks. Learned embeddings outperformed engineered features, predicting age (Pearson r = 0.69), BMI (r = 0.90), and visceral adipose tissue area (r = 0.82). Embeddings significantly predicted 1,980 of 3,210 phenotypic targets; after adjustment for age, BMI, VAT, and height, gait provided independent gains in all 18 body systems in males and 17 of 18 in females, and improved prediction of clinical diagnoses and medication use. Anatomical ablation revealed that legs dominated metabolic and frailty predictions while torso encoded sleep and lifestyle phenotypes. These findings establish gait as an independent multi-system biosignal, motivating translation to consumer-grade video and its integration as a scalable, passive vital sign.
summary_zh: 步态正日益被认为是重要的生命体征，但当前的方法将其视为特定病理的症状，而非全身性生物标志物。我们基于3,414名深度表型成人，通过深度相机记录的五个运动任务中的3D骨骼运动数据，开发了一个步态基础模型。该模型学习到的嵌入特征优于人工设计的特征，能预测年龄（Pearson相关系数r = 0.69）、身体质量指数BMI（r = 0.90）和内脏脂肪组织面积（r = 0.82）。嵌入特征显著预测了3,210个表型目标中的1,980个；在校正年龄、BMI、内脏脂肪组织面积和身高后，步态对男性所有18个身体系统和女性18个身体系统中的17个系统提供了独立的增益，并提高了对临床诊断和药物使用的预测。解剖消融分析显示，腿部在代谢和虚弱预测中占据主导地位，而躯干则编码了睡眠和生活方式表型。这些发现确立了步态作为一种独立的、多系统的生物信号，推动了其向消费级视频的转化，并将其作为一种可扩展的被动生命体征进行整合。
tldr: This paper introduces a gait foundation model trained on skeletal motion data that effectively predicts a wide range of health phenotypes, demonstrating gait's potential as a comprehensive biosignal. This opens avenues for passive health monitoring using consumer-grade video.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个步态基础模型，该模型在骨骼运动数据上训练，能够有效预测广泛的健康表型，证明了步态作为综合生物信号的潜力。这为使用消费级视频进行被动健康监测开辟了道路。

title: Decentralized Task Scheduling in Distributed Systems: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach
summary: Efficient task scheduling in large-scale distributed systems presents significant challenges due to dynamic workloads, heterogeneous resources, and competing quality-of-service requirements. Traditional centralized approaches face scalability limitations and single points of failure, while classical heuristics lack adaptability to changing conditions. This paper proposes a decentralized multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (DRL-MADRL) framework for task scheduling in heterogeneous distributed systems. We formulate the problem as a Decentralized Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (Dec-POMDP) and develop a lightweight actor-critic architecture implemented using only NumPy, enabling deployment on resource-constrained edge devices without heavyweight machine learning frameworks. Using workload characteristics derived from the publicly available Google Cluster Trace dataset, we evaluate our approach on a 100-node heterogeneous system processing 1,000 tasks per episode over 30 experimental runs. Experimental results demonstrate 15.6% improvement in average task completion time (30.8s vs 36.5s for random baseline), 15.2% energy efficiency gain (745.2 kWh vs 878.3 kWh), and 82.3% SLA satisfaction compared to 75.5% for baselines, with all improvements statistically significant (p < 0.001). The lightweight implementation requires only NumPy, Matplotlib, and SciPy. Complete source code and experimental data are provided for full reproducibility at https://github.com/danielbenniah/marl-distributed-scheduling.
summary_zh: 大规模分布式系统中高效的任务调度面临着诸多挑战，包括动态的工作负载、异构的资源以及相互竞争的服务质量需求。传统的集中式方法面临着可扩展性限制和单点故障，而经典的启发式方法则缺乏对变化条件的适应性。本文提出了一种用于异构分布式系统中任务调度的去中心化多智能体深度强化学习 (DRL-MADRL) 框架。我们将该问题建模为去中心化部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程 (Dec-POMDP)，并开发了一种轻量级的 Actor-Critic 架构，该架构仅使用 NumPy 实现，从而能够在资源受限的边缘设备上部署，而无需重量级的机器学习框架。我们使用从公开的 Google 集群轨迹数据集导出的工作负载特征，在一个 100 节点异构系统上评估了我们的方法，该系统在 30 次实验中，每次处理 1,000 个任务。实验结果表明，与随机基线相比，平均任务完成时间提高了 15.6%（30.8 秒 vs 36.5 秒），能源效率提高了 15.2%（745.2 kWh vs 878.3 kWh），服务水平协议 (SLA) 满足度为 82.3%，而基线为 75.5%，所有改进均具有统计学意义（p < 0.001）。该轻量级实现仅需要 NumPy、Matplotlib 和 SciPy。完整的源代码和实验数据已在 https://github.com/danielbenniah/marl-distributed-scheduling 上提供，以实现完全的可复现性。
tldr: This paper presents a decentralized multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (DRL-MADRL) framework for task scheduling in heterogeneous distributed systems, achieving significant improvements in task completion time, energy efficiency, and SLA satisfaction compared to baselines, with a lightweight implementation for edge deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于异构分布式系统中任务调度的去中心化多智能体深度强化学习 (DRL-MADRL) 框架，与基线相比，在任务完成时间、能源效率和 SLA 满意度方面取得了显着改进，并且该实现是轻量级的，适合边缘部署。

title: AnyHand: A Large-Scale Synthetic Dataset for RGB(-D) Hand Pose Estimation
summary: We present AnyHand, a large-scale synthetic dataset designed to advance the state of the art in 3D hand pose estimation from both RGB-only and RGB-D inputs. While recent works with foundation approaches have shown that an increase in the quantity and diversity of training data can markedly improve performance and robustness in hand pose estimation, existing real-world-collected datasets on this task are limited in coverage, and prior synthetic datasets rarely provide occlusions, arm details, and aligned depth together at scale. To address this bottleneck, our AnyHand contains 2.5M single-hand and 4.1M hand-object interaction RGB-D images, with rich geometric annotations. In the RGB-only setting, we show that extending the original training sets of existing baselines with AnyHand yields significant gains on multiple benchmarks (FreiHAND and HO-3D), even when keeping the architecture and training scheme fixed. More impressively, the model trained with AnyHand shows stronger generalization to the out-of-domain HO-Cap dataset, without any fine-tuning. We also contribute a lightweight depth fusion module that can be easily integrated into existing RGB-based models. Trained with AnyHand, the resulting RGB-D model achieves superior performance on the HO-3D benchmark, showing the benefits of depth integration and the effectiveness of our synthetic data.
summary_zh: 我们提出了AnyHand，一个大规模的合成数据集，旨在推进基于仅RGB和RGB-D输入的3D手部姿态估计技术水平。 近期基于基础模型的研究表明，训练数据的数量和多样性的增加可以显著提高手部姿态估计的性能和鲁棒性，但现有真实世界采集的数据集在覆盖范围上存在局限性，并且之前的合成数据集很少能大规模地提供遮挡、手臂细节和对齐的深度信息。 为了解决这个瓶颈，我们的AnyHand包含了250万张单手和410万张手部-物体交互的RGB-D图像，并具有丰富的几何标注。 在仅RGB的设置下，我们表明，通过使用AnyHand扩展现有基线的原始训练集，可以在多个基准（FreiHAND和HO-3D）上获得显著提升，即使保持架构和训练方案不变。 更令人印象深刻的是，使用AnyHand训练的模型对域外HO-Cap数据集表现出更强的泛化能力，无需任何微调。 我们还贡献了一个轻量级的深度融合模块，可以轻松地集成到现有的基于RGB的模型中。 使用AnyHand训练后，所得到的RGB-D模型在HO-3D基准上实现了卓越的性能，表明了深度集成的优势和我们合成数据的有效性。
tldr: The paper introduces AnyHand, a large-scale synthetic RGB-D hand pose estimation dataset (2.5M single-hand and 4.1M hand-object interaction images) which improves performance and generalization on benchmarks when used for training, even for RGB-only models and out-of-domain datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AnyHand，一个大规模的合成RGB-D手部姿态估计数据集（250万张单手和410万张手-物体交互图像）。该数据集用于训练可以提高基准测试的性能和泛化能力，即使是RGB-only模型和out-of-domain数据集。

title: LEMMA: Laplacian pyramids for Efficient Marine SeMAntic Segmentation
summary:
Semantic segmentation in marine environments is crucial for the autonomous navigation of unmanned surface vessels (USVs) and coastal Earth Observation events such as oil spills. However, existing methods, often relying on deep CNNs and transformer-based architectures, face challenges in deployment due to their high computational costs and resource-intensive nature. These limitations hinder the practicality of real-time, low-cost applications in real-world marine settings.
  To address this, we propose LEMMA, a lightweight semantic segmentation model designed specifically for accurate remote sensing segmentation under resource constraints. The proposed architecture leverages Laplacian Pyramids to enhance edge recognition, a critical component for effective feature extraction in complex marine environments for disaster response, environmental surveillance, and coastal monitoring. By integrating edge information early in the feature extraction process, LEMMA eliminates the need for computationally expensive feature map computations in deeper network layers, drastically reducing model size, complexity and inference time. LEMMA demonstrates state-of-the-art performance across datasets captured from diverse platforms while reducing trainable parameters and computational requirements by up to 71x, GFLOPs by up to 88.5\%, and inference time by up to 84.65\%, as compared to existing models. Experimental results highlight its effectiveness and real-world applicability, including 93.42\% IoU on the Oil Spill dataset and 98.97\% mIoU on Mastr1325.
summary_zh:
海洋环境中的语义分割对于无人水面艇（USV）的自主导航以及诸如漏油事件等沿海地球观测任务至关重要。然而，现有的方法，通常依赖于深度卷积神经网络（CNNs）和基于Transformer的架构，由于其高昂的计算成本和资源密集型特性，在部署方面面临挑战。这些限制阻碍了其在现实世界海洋环境中实时、低成本应用的实用性。

为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 LEMMA，一个专为资源约束条件下精确遥感分割而设计的轻量级语义分割模型。所提出的架构利用拉普拉斯金字塔来增强边缘识别能力，这是在复杂海洋环境中进行灾害响应、环境监测和海岸监测时有效特征提取的关键组成部分。通过在特征提取过程的早期集成边缘信息，LEMMA 消除了在更深层网络中进行计算密集型特征图计算的需求，从而大幅降低了模型大小、复杂性和推理时间。与现有模型相比，LEMMA 在从不同平台捕获的数据集上展示了最先进的性能，同时将可训练参数减少高达 71 倍，GFLOPs 减少高达 88.5%，推理时间减少高达 84.65%。实验结果突出了其有效性和现实应用性，包括在漏油数据集上达到 93.42% 的 IoU 和在 Mastr1325 数据集上达到 98.97% 的 mIoU。
tldr: The paper presents LEMMA, a lightweight semantic segmentation model using Laplacian Pyramids for improved edge recognition in marine environments, achieving state-of-the-art performance with significantly reduced computational costs.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了LEMMA，一种轻量级的语义分割模型，它使用拉普拉斯金字塔来提高海洋环境中边缘识别的准确性，并在显著降低计算成本的同时实现了最先进的性能。

title: Hyperspectral Trajectory Image for Multi-Month Trajectory Anomaly Detection
summary: Trajectory anomaly detection underpins applications from fraud detection to urban mobility analysis. Dense GPS methods preserve fine-grained evidence such as abnormal speeds and short-duration events, but their quadratic cost makes multi-month analysis intractable; consequently, no existing approach detects anomalies over multi-month dense GPS trajectories. The field instead relies on scalable sparse stay-point methods that discard this evidence, forcing separate architectures for each regime and preventing knowledge transfer. We argue this bottleneck is unnecessary: human trajectories, dense or sparse, share a natural two-dimensional cyclic structure along within-day and across-day axes. We therefore propose TITAnD (Trajectory Image Transformer for Anomaly Detection), which reformulates trajectory anomaly detection as a vision problem by representing trajectories as a Hyperspectral Trajectory Image (HTI): a day x time-of-day grid whose channels encode spatial, semantic, temporal, and kinematic information from either modality, unifying both under a single representation. Under this formulation, agent-level detection reduces to image classification and temporal localization to semantic segmentation. To model this representation, we introduce the Cyclic Factorized Transformer (CFT), which factorizes attention along the two temporal axes, encoding the cyclic inductive bias of human routines, while reducing attention cost by orders of magnitude and enabling dense multi-month anomaly detection for the first time. Empirically, TITAnD achieves the best AUC-PR across sparse and dense benchmarks, surpassing vision models like UNet while being 11-75x faster than the Transformer with comparable memory, demonstrating that vision reformulation and structure-aware modeling are jointly essential. Code will be made public soon.
summary_zh: 轨迹异常检测是欺诈检测到城市交通分析等应用的基础。 密集GPS方法保留了诸如异常速度和短时事件等细粒度证据，但其二次复杂度使得多月份分析变得难以处理； 因此，目前没有现有方法可以在多月份密集GPS轨迹上检测异常。 该领域转而依赖于可扩展的稀疏停留点方法，该方法丢弃了这些证据，迫使每种模式使用单独的架构，并阻止了知识转移。 我们认为这种瓶颈是不必要的：人类轨迹，无论是密集还是稀疏，都沿着日内和日间轴共享一个自然的二维循环结构。 因此，我们提出了TITAnD（用于异常检测的轨迹图像Transformer），它通过将轨迹表示为高光谱轨迹图像（HTI）将轨迹异常检测重新定义为一个视觉问题：一个天x时间网格，其通道编码来自任一模态的空间、语义、时间和运动学信息，将两者统一在一个单一表示下。 在这种公式下，主体级别检测减少为图像分类，而时间定位减少为语义分割。 为了建模这种表示，我们引入了循环因子分解Transformer（CFT），它沿着两个时间轴分解注意力，编码人类例程的循环归纳偏置，同时将注意力成本降低几个数量级，并首次实现密集的数月异常检测。 实验表明，TITAnD在稀疏和密集基准测试中都实现了最佳的AUC-PR，超过了像UNet这样的视觉模型，同时比具有可比内存的Transformer快11-75倍，这表明视觉重新定义和结构感知建模共同至关重要。 代码即将公开。
