tldr: The paper introduces TITAnD, a method for multi-month trajectory anomaly detection that reformulates the problem as image classification and semantic segmentation using a Hyperspectral Trajectory Image (HTI) representation and a Cyclic Factorized Transformer (CFT). It achieves state-of-the-art results on both sparse and dense trajectory datasets with improved efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TITAnD，一种用于多月轨迹异常检测的方法，它通过使用高光谱轨迹图像 (HTI) 表示和循环分解 Transformer (CFT) 将问题重新定义为图像分类和语义分割。该方法在稀疏和密集轨迹数据集上均取得了最先进的结果，并且效率更高。

title: AG-EgoPose: Leveraging Action-Guided Motion and Kinematic Joint Encoding for Egocentric 3D Pose Estimation
summary: Egocentric 3D human pose estimation remains challenging due to severe perspective distortion, limited body visibility, and complex camera motion inherent in first-person viewpoints. Existing methods typically rely on single-frame analysis or limited temporal fusion, which fails to effectively leverage the rich motion context available in egocentric videos. We introduce AG-EgoPose, a novel dual-stream framework that integrates short- and long-range motion context with fine-grained spatial cues for robust pose estimation from fisheye camera input. Our framework features two parallel streams: A spatial stream uses a weight-sharing ResNet-18 encoder-decoder to generate 2D joint heatmaps and corresponding joint-specific spatial feature tokens. Simultaneously, a temporal stream uses a ResNet-50 backbone to extract visual features, which are then processed by an action recognition backbone to capture the motion dynamics. These complementary representations are fused and refined in a transformer decoder with learnable joint tokens, which allows for the joint-level integration of spatial and temporal evidence while maintaining anatomical constraints. Experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that AG-EgoPose achieves state-of-the-art performance in both quantitative and qualitative metrics. Code is available at: https://github.com/Mushfiq5647/AG-EgoPose.
summary_zh: 由于第一人称视角固有的严重透视畸变、有限的身体可见性和复杂的相机运动，以自我为中心的3D人体姿态估计仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通常依赖于单帧分析或有限的时间融合，无法有效地利用以自我为中心的视频中丰富的运动上下文。我们引入了AG-EgoPose，一种新颖的双流框架，该框架集成了短程和长程运动上下文以及精细的空间线索，从而可以从鱼眼相机输入中进行鲁棒的姿态估计。我们的框架具有两个并行流：空间流使用权重共享的ResNet-18编码器-解码器来生成2D关节热图和相应的关节特定空间特征令牌。同时，时间流使用ResNet-50骨干网络来提取视觉特征，然后通过动作识别骨干网络进行处理，以捕获运动动态。这些互补的表示在具有可学习关节令牌的Transformer解码器中进行融合和细化，从而允许关节级别的空间和时间证据集成，同时保持解剖学约束。在真实世界数据集上的实验表明，AG-EgoPose在定量和定性指标方面均取得了最先进的性能。 代码可在以下位置获得：https://github.com/Mushfiq5647/AG-EgoPose。
tldr: The paper introduces AG-EgoPose, a dual-stream framework for egocentric 3D pose estimation that fuses spatial and temporal information using action recognition and transformers, achieving state-of-the-art results.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AG-EgoPose，这是一个双流框架，用于以自我为中心的3D姿态估计，它使用动作识别和transformers融合空间和时间信息，从而实现了最先进的结果。

title: EgoXtreme: A Dataset for Robust Object Pose Estimation in Egocentric Views under Extreme Conditions
summary: Smart glass is emerging as an useful device since it provides plenty of insights under hands-busy, eyes-on-task situations. To understand the context of the wearer, 6D object pose estimation in egocentric view is becoming essential. However, existing 6D object pose estimation benchmarks fail to capture the challenges of real-world egocentric applications, which are often dominated by severe motion blur, dynamic illumination, and visual obstructions. This discrepancy creates a significant gap between controlled lab data and chaotic real-world application. To bridge this gap, we introduce EgoXtreme, a new large-scale 6D pose estimation dataset captured entirely from an egocentric perspective. EgoXtreme features three challenging scenarios - industrial maintenance, sports, and emergency rescue - designed to introduce severe perceptual ambiguities through extreme lighting, heavy motion blur, and smoke. Evaluations of state-of-the-art generalizable pose estimators on EgoXtreme indicate that their generalization fails to hold in extreme conditions, especially under low light. We further demonstrate that simply applying image restoration (e.g., deblurring) offers no positive improvement for extreme conditions. While performance gain has appeared in tracking-based approach, implying using temporal information in fast-motion scenarios is meaningful. We conclude that EgoXtreme is an essential resource for developing and evaluating the next generation of pose estimation models robust enough for real-world egocentric vision. The dataset and code are available at https://taegyoun88.github.io/EgoXtreme/
summary_zh: 智能眼镜正逐渐成为一种有用的设备，因为它在双手繁忙、眼睛专注于任务的情况下提供了丰富的洞察力。为了理解佩戴者的情境，以自我中心视角进行6D物体姿态估计变得至关重要。然而，现有的6D物体姿态估计基准测试无法捕捉到真实世界自我中心应用的挑战，这些应用通常受到严重的运动模糊、动态光照和视觉遮挡的影响。这种差异在受控的实验室数据和混乱的真实世界应用之间造成了巨大的差距。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了一个新的大规模6D姿态估计数据集EgoXtreme，该数据集完全以自我中心视角捕获。EgoXtreme 以三个具有挑战性的场景为特色——工业维护、运动和紧急救援——旨在通过极端光照、严重的运动模糊和烟雾来引入严重的感知歧义。对EgoXtreme上最先进的通用姿态估计器的评估表明，它们的泛化能力在极端条件下失效，尤其是在低光照下。我们进一步证明，仅应用图像恢复（例如，去模糊）并不能对极端条件产生积极的改进。虽然基于跟踪方法出现了性能提升，这意味着在快速运动场景中使用时间信息是有意义的。我们得出结论，EgoXtreme是开发和评估下一代姿态估计模型的重要资源，该模型应足够鲁棒，以适应真实世界的自我中心视觉。数据集和代码可在https://taegyoun88.github.io/EgoXtreme/ 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces EgoXtreme, a new egocentric 6D object pose estimation dataset focusing on extreme conditions like motion blur, low light, and obstructions, highlighting the limitations of current pose estimation models in such scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EgoXtreme，一个新的以自我为中心的6D物体姿态估计数据集，专注于极端条件，如运动模糊、低光照和遮挡，突出了当前姿态估计模型在这些场景中的局限性。

title: GaussFusion: Improving 3D Reconstruction in the Wild with A Geometry-Informed Video Generator
summary: We present GaussFusion, a novel approach for improving 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) reconstructions in the wild through geometry-informed video generation. GaussFusion mitigates common 3DGS artifacts, including floaters, flickering, and blur caused by camera pose errors, incomplete coverage, and noisy geometry initialization. Unlike prior RGB-based approaches limited to a single reconstruction pipeline, our method introduces a geometry-informed video-to-video generator that refines 3DGS renderings across both optimization-based and feed-forward methods. Given an existing reconstruction, we render a Gaussian primitive video buffer encoding depth, normals, opacity, and covariance, which the generator refines to produce temporally coherent, artifact-free frames. We further introduce an artifact synthesis pipeline that simulates diverse degradation patterns, ensuring robustness and generalization. GaussFusion achieves state-of-the-art performance on novel-view synthesis benchmarks, and an efficient variant runs in real time at 21 FPS while maintaining similar performance, enabling interactive 3D applications.
summary_zh: 我们提出了GaussFusion，一种通过几何信息指导视频生成来改进野外环境下3D高斯溅射 (3DGS) 重建的新方法。GaussFusion 减轻了常见的3DGS伪影，包括由相机姿态误差、不完整覆盖和噪声几何初始化引起的漂浮物、闪烁和模糊。与之前局限于单一重建流程的基于RGB的方法不同，我们的方法引入了一个几何信息指导的视频到视频生成器，可以跨基于优化的方法和前馈方法来优化3DGS渲染结果。给定一个现有的重建结果，我们渲染一个高斯基元视频缓冲，该缓冲编码深度、法线、不透明度和协方差，生成器对其进行优化以产生时间上连贯且无伪影的帧。我们进一步引入了一个伪影合成流程，该流程模拟各种退化模式，从而确保鲁棒性和泛化能力。GaussFusion 在新视角合成基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，并且一个高效变体可以以 21 FPS 的实时速度运行，同时保持相似的性能，从而实现交互式 3D 应用。
tldr: The paper introduces GaussFusion, a geometry-informed video generator that refines 3D Gaussian splatting reconstructions to mitigate artifacts like floaters and flickering, achieving state-of-the-art performance and real-time capability.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为GaussFusion的方法，它是一个几何信息驱动的视频生成器，用于优化3D高斯溅射重建，以减少如漂浮物和闪烁等伪影，实现了最先进的性能和实时能力。

title: MoRGS: Efficient Per-Gaussian Motion Reasoning for Streamable Dynamic 3D Scenes
summary: Online reconstruction of dynamic scenes aims to learn from streaming multi-view inputs under low-latency constraints. The fast training and real-time rendering capabilities of 3D Gaussian Splatting have made on-the-fly reconstruction practically feasible, enabling online 4D reconstruction. However, existing online approaches, despite their efficiency and visual quality, fail to learn per-Gaussian motion that reflects true scene dynamics. Without explicit motion cues, appearance and motion are optimized solely under photometric loss, causing per-Gaussian motion to chase pixel residuals rather than true 3D motion. To address this, we propose MoRGS, an efficient online per-Gaussian motion reasoning framework that explicitly models per-Gaussian motion to improve 4D reconstruction quality. Specifically, we leverage optical flow on a sparse set of key views as lightweight motion cues that regularize per-Gaussian motion beyond photometric supervision. To compensate for the sparsity of flow supervision, we learn a per-Gaussian motion offset field that reconciles discrepancies between projected 3D motion and observed flow across views and time. In addition, we introduce a per-Gaussian motion confidence that separates dynamic from static Gaussians and weights Gaussian attribute residual updates, thereby suppressing redundant motion in static regions for better temporal consistency and accelerating the modeling of large motions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MoRGS achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction quality and motion fidelity among online methods, while maintaining streamable performance.
summary_zh: 动态场景的在线重建旨在从低延迟约束下的流式多视角输入中进行学习。3D高斯溅射的快速训练和实时渲染能力使得实时重建在实践上可行，从而实现了在线4D重建。然而，现有的在线方法虽然具有高效性和视觉质量，但未能学习反映真实场景动态的逐高斯运动。在没有明确运动线索的情况下，外观和运动仅在光度损失下进行优化，导致逐高斯运动追逐像素残差，而非真实的3D运动。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了MoRGS，一个高效的在线逐高斯运动推理框架，它显式地建模逐高斯运动以提高4D重建质量。具体来说，我们利用稀疏关键帧视图上的光流作为轻量级的运动线索，对超出光度监督的逐高斯运动进行正则化。为了弥补光流监督的稀疏性，我们学习了一个逐高斯运动偏移场，以协调跨视图和时间投影的3D运动与观测到的光流之间的差异。此外，我们引入了一个逐高斯运动置信度，用于区分动态高斯和静态高斯，并加权高斯属性残差更新，从而抑制静态区域的冗余运动，以获得更好的时间一致性，并加速大型运动的建模。大量的实验表明，MoRGS在在线方法中实现了最先进的重建质量和运动保真度，同时保持了可流式传输的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces MoRGS, an efficient online per-Gaussian motion reasoning framework for dynamic 3D scene reconstruction, leveraging optical flow and motion confidence to improve reconstruction quality and motion fidelity.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为MoRGS的高效在线高斯运动推理框架，用于动态3D场景重建，利用光流和运动置信度来提高重建质量和运动保真度。

title: Distributed Real-Time Vehicle Control for Emergency Vehicle Transit: A Scalable Cooperative Method
summary: Rapid transit of emergency vehicles is critical for saving lives and reducing property loss but often relies on surrounding ordinary vehicles to cooperatively adjust their driving behaviors. It is important to ensure rapid transit of emergency vehicles while minimizing the impact on ordinary vehicles. Centralized mathematical solver and reinforcement learning are the state-of-the-art methods. The former obtains optimal solutions but is only practical for small-scale scenarios. The latter implicitly learns through extensive centralized training but the trained model exhibits limited scalability to different traffic conditions. Hence, existing methods suffer from two fundamental limitations: high computational cost and lack of scalability. To overcome above limitations, this work proposes a scalable distributed vehicle control method, where vehicles adjust their driving behaviors in a distributed manner online using only local instead of global information. We proved that the proposed distributed method using only local information is approximately equivalent to the one using global information, which enables vehicles to evaluate their candidate states and make approximately optimal decisions in real time without pre-training and with natural adaptability to varying traffic conditions. Then, a distributed conflict resolution mechanism is further proposed to guarantee vehicles' safety by avoiding their decision conflicts, which eliminates the single-point-of-failure risk of centralized methods and provides deterministic safety guarantees that learned methods cannot offer. Compared with existing methods, simulation experiments based on real-world traffic datasets demonstrate that the proposed method achieves faster decision-making, less impact on ordinary vehicles, and maintains much stronger scalability across different traffic densities and road configurations.
summary_zh: 紧急车辆的快速通行对于拯救生命和减少财产损失至关重要，但这通常依赖于周围普通车辆协同调整其驾驶行为。确保紧急车辆快速通行的同时，尽量减少对普通车辆的影响非常重要。集中式数学求解器和强化学习是目前最先进的方法。前者可以获得最优解，但仅适用于小规模场景。后者通过大量的集中式训练进行隐式学习，但训练后的模型对于不同交通状况的可扩展性有限。因此，现有方法存在两个根本性的局限性：高计算成本和缺乏可扩展性。为了克服上述局限性，本文提出了一种可扩展的分布式车辆控制方法，车辆仅使用局部信息而非全局信息，以分布式的在线方式调整其驾驶行为。我们证明了所提出的仅使用局部信息的分布式方法与使用全局信息的方法近似等价，这使车辆能够评估其候选状态，并在没有预训练的情况下实时做出近似最优决策，并能自然地适应不同的交通状况。此外，我们进一步提出了一种分布式冲突解决机制，通过避免车辆决策冲突来保证车辆安全，从而消除了集中式方法的单点故障风险，并提供了学习方法无法提供的确定性安全保障。基于真实交通数据集的仿真实验表明，与现有方法相比，所提出的方法实现了更快的决策速度，对普通车辆的影响更小，并在不同的交通密度和道路配置下保持了更强的可扩展性。
tldr: The paper proposes a scalable, distributed vehicle control method for emergency vehicle transit that utilizes local information for real-time decision-making, offering improvements in speed, impact on ordinary vehicles, and scalability compared to centralized approaches.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种可扩展的分布式车辆控制方法，用于紧急车辆通行。该方法利用本地信息进行实时决策，与集中式方法相比，在速度、对普通车辆的影响和可扩展性方面都有所提高。

title: Towards Video Anomaly Detection from Event Streams: A Baseline and Benchmark Datasets
summary: Event-based vision, characterized by low redundancy, focus on dynamic motion, and inherent privacy-preserving properties, naturally fits the demands of video anomaly detection (VAD). However, the absence of dedicated event-stream anomaly detection datasets and effective modeling strategies has significantly hindered progress in this field. In this work, we take the first major step toward establishing event-based VAD as a unified research direction. We first construct multiple event-stream based benchmarks for video anomaly detection, featuring synchronized event and RGB recordings. Leveraging the unique properties of events, we then propose an EVent-centric spatiotemporal Video Anomaly Detection framework, namely EWAD, with three key innovations: an event density aware dynamic sampling strategy to select temporally informative segments; a density-modulated temporal modeling approach that captures contextual relations from sparse event streams; and an RGB-to-event knowledge distillation mechanism to enhance event-based representations under weak supervision. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that our EWAD achieves significant improvements over existing approaches, highlighting the potential and effectiveness of event-driven modeling for video anomaly detection. The benchmark datasets will be made publicly available.
summary_zh: 基于事件的视觉，以其低冗余度、对动态运动的关注和固有的隐私保护特性为特征，天然地契合了视频异常检测（VAD）的需求。然而，缺乏专门的事件流异常检测数据集和有效的建模策略，极大地阻碍了该领域的发展。 在这项工作中，我们迈出了构建基于事件的VAD作为一个统一研究方向的第一个重要步骤。我们首先构建了多个基于事件流的视频异常检测基准数据集，其特点是同步的事件和RGB记录。 借助事件的独特属性，我们随后提出了一个以事件为中心的时空视频异常检测框架，即EWAD，它具有三个关键创新：一种事件密度感知动态采样策略，用于选择时间上信息量丰富的片段；一种密度调节的时间建模方法，用于捕捉来自稀疏事件流的上下文关系；以及一种RGB到事件的知识蒸馏机制，以增强弱监督下的基于事件的表征。 在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的EWAD相比现有方法取得了显著的改进，突出了事件驱动建模在视频异常检测中的潜力和有效性。 基准数据集将公开提供。
tldr: This paper introduces several event-stream based benchmark datasets for video anomaly detection and proposes an event-centric spatiotemporal anomaly detection framework (EWAD) that outperforms existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了几个基于事件流的视频异常检测基准数据集，并提出了一个以事件为中心的时空异常检测框架 (EWAD)，该框架优于现有方法。

title: DRoPS: Dynamic 3D Reconstruction of Pre-Scanned Objects
summary: Dynamic scene reconstruction from casual videos has seen recent remarkable progress. Numerous approaches have attempted to overcome the ill-posedness of the task by distilling priors from 2D foundational models and by imposing hand-crafted regularization on the optimized motion. However, these methods struggle to reconstruct scenes from extreme novel viewpoints, especially when highly articulated motions are present. In this paper, we present DRoPS, a novel approach that leverages a static pre-scan of the dynamic object as an explicit geometric and appearance prior. While existing state-of-the-art methods fail to fully exploit the pre-scan, DRoPS leverages our novel setup to effectively constrain the solution space and ensure geometrical consistency throughout the sequence. The core of our novelty is twofold: first, we establish a grid-structured and surface-aligned model by organizing Gaussian primitives into pixel grids anchored to the object surface. Second, by leveraging the grid structure of our primitives, we parameterize motion using a CNN conditioned on those grids, injecting strong implicit regularization and correlating the motion of nearby points. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms the current state of the art in rendering quality and 3D tracking accuracy.
summary_zh: 从随意的视频中进行动态场景重建最近取得了显著进展。许多方法试图通过从二维基础模型中提取先验知识以及对优化后的运动施加手工设计的正则化来克服该任务的不适定性。然而，这些方法在从极端新视角重建场景时表现不佳，尤其是在存在高度铰接运动时。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的方法DRoPS，该方法利用动态对象的静态预扫描作为显式的几何和外观先验。虽然现有的最先进方法未能充分利用预扫描，但DRoPS利用我们新颖的设置来有效地约束解空间，并确保整个序列中的几何一致性。我们的创新核心体现在两个方面：首先，我们通过将高斯基元组织成锚定在物体表面的像素网格，建立一个网格结构化且表面对齐的模型。其次，通过利用基元的网格结构，我们使用以这些网格为条件的 CNN 来参数化运动，从而注入强大的隐式正则化并关联附近点的运动。大量的实验表明，我们的方法在渲染质量和三维跟踪精度方面显著优于当前最先进的方法。
tldr: DRoPS presents a novel approach for dynamic 3D reconstruction of pre-scanned objects from video, using a grid-structured Gaussian primitive model and a CNN-based motion parameterization to improve accuracy and consistency, particularly from novel viewpoints.
tldr_zh: DRoPS提出了一种新的方法，用于从视频中动态三维重建先前扫描过的物体。该方法使用网格结构的高斯基元模型和基于CNN的运动参数化，从而提高准确性和一致性，尤其是在新视点下。

title: OpenCap Monocular: 3D Human Kinematics and Musculoskeletal Dynamics from a Single Smartphone Video
summary: Quantifying human movement (kinematics) and musculoskeletal forces (kinetics) at scale, such as estimating quadriceps force during a sit-to-stand movement, could transform prediction, treatment, and monitoring of mobility-related conditions. However, quantifying kinematics and kinetics traditionally requires costly, time-intensive analysis in specialized laboratories, limiting clinical translation. Scalable, accurate tools for biomechanical assessment are needed. We introduce OpenCap Monocular, an algorithm that estimates 3D skeletal kinematics and kinetics from a single smartphone video. The method refines 3D human pose estimates from a monocular pose estimation model (WHAM) via optimization, computes kinematics of a biomechanically constrained skeletal model, and estimates kinetics via physics-based simulation and machine learning. We validated OpenCap Monocular against marker-based motion capture and force plate data for walking, squatting, and sit-to-stand tasks. OpenCap Monocular achieved low kinematic error (4.8° mean absolute error for rotational degrees of freedom; 3.4 cm for pelvis translations), outperforming a regression-only computer vision baseline by 48% in rotational accuracy (p = 0.036) and 69% in translational accuracy (p < 0.001). OpenCap Monocular also estimated ground reaction forces during walking with accuracy comparable to, or better than, our prior two-camera OpenCap system. We demonstrate that the algorithm estimates important kinetic outcomes with clinically meaningful accuracy in applications related to frailty and knee osteoarthritis, including estimating knee extension moment during sit-to-stand transitions and knee adduction moment during walking. OpenCap Monocular is deployed via a smartphone app, web app, and secure cloud computing (https://opencap.ai), enabling free, accessible single-smartphone biomechanical assessments.
summary_zh: 大规模量化人体运动（运动学）和肌肉骨骼力（动力学），例如在站坐动作中估计股四头肌力，可以转变对活动相关疾病的预测、治疗和监测。 然而，量化运动学和动力学通常需要在专业实验室中进行昂贵且耗时的分析，限制了临床转化。因此，需要可扩展且准确的生物力学评估工具。我们介绍了一种名为 OpenCap Monocular 的算法，该算法可以从单个智能手机视频中估计 3D 骨骼运动学和动力学。该方法通过优化，改进了来自单目姿态估计模型 (WHAM) 的 3D 人体姿态估计，计算了生物力学约束骨骼模型的运动学，并通过基于物理的模拟和机器学习估计动力学。我们通过基于标记点的动作捕捉和测力板数据，对行走、下蹲和站坐任务验证了 OpenCap Monocular 的有效性。 OpenCap Monocular 实现了较低的运动学误差（旋转自由度的平均绝对误差为 4.8°；骨盆平移为 3.4 厘米），其旋转精度比仅使用回归的计算机视觉基线提高了 48%（p = 0.036），平移精度提高了 69%（p < 0.001）。 OpenCap Monocular 还能以与我们之前的双相机 OpenCap 系统相当或更好的精度估计行走过程中的地面反作用力。我们证明了该算法在与虚弱和膝骨关节炎相关的应用中，能够以具有临床意义的准确性估计重要的动力学结果，包括估计站坐转换期间的膝关节伸展力矩和行走过程中的膝关节内收力矩。 OpenCap Monocular 通过智能手机应用程序、Web 应用程序和安全的云计算 (https://opencap.ai) 部署，从而实现免费、便捷的单智能手机生物力学评估。
tldr: This paper introduces OpenCap Monocular, a system that estimates 3D human kinematics and kinetics from a single smartphone video, enabling scalable and accessible biomechanical assessments.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了OpenCap Monocular，一个通过单部智能手机视频估算3D人体运动学和动力学的系统，从而实现可拓展且易于获取的生物力学评估。

title: Accurate Point Measurement in 3DGS -- A New Alternative to Traditional Stereoscopic-View Based Measurements
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has revolutionized real-time rendering with its state-of-the-art novel view synthesis, but its utility for accurate geometric measurement remains underutilized. Compared to multi-view stereo (MVS) point clouds or meshes, 3DGS rendered views present superior visual quality and completeness. However, current point measurement methods still rely on demanding stereoscopic workstations or direct picking on often-incomplete and inaccurate 3D meshes. As a novel view synthesizer, 3DGS renders exact source views and smoothly interpolates in-between views. This allows users to intuitively pick congruent points across different views while operating 3DGS models. By triangulating these congruent points, one can precisely generate 3D point measurements. This approach mimics traditional stereoscopic measurement but is significantly less demanding: it requires neither a stereo workstation nor specialized operator stereoscopic capability. Furthermore, it enables multi-view intersection (more than two views) for higher measurement accuracy. We implemented a web-based application to demonstrate this proof-of-concept (PoC). Using several UAV aerial datasets, we show this PoC allows users to successfully perform highly accurate point measurements, achieving accuracy matching or exceeding traditional stereoscopic methods on standard hardware. Specifically, our approach significantly outperforms direct mesh-based measurements. Quantitatively, our method achieves RMSEs in the 1-2 cm range on well-defined points. More critically, on challenging thin structures where mesh-based RMSE was 0.062 m, our method achieved 0.037 m. On sharp corners poorly reconstructed in the mesh, our method successfully measured all points with a 0.013 m RMSE, whereas the mesh method failed entirely. Code is available at: https://github.com/GDAOSU/3dgs_measurement_tool.
summary_zh: 3D高斯溅射(3DGS)以其最先进的新视角合成技术彻底改变了实时渲染，但其在精确几何测量方面的效用仍未得到充分利用。与多视图立体(MVS)点云或网格相比，3DGS渲染的视图呈现出卓越的视觉质量和完整性。然而，目前的点测量方法仍然依赖于要求苛刻的立体工作站或在通常不完整且不准确的3D网格上直接拾取。作为一种新视角合成器，3DGS渲染精确的源视图，并在视图之间平滑插值。这使得用户能够在操作3DGS模型时直观地跨不同视图拾取一致的点。通过三角化这些一致的点，可以精确地生成3D点测量值。该方法模仿了传统的立体测量，但要求显著降低：它既不需要立体工作站，也不需要专门的操作员立体能力。此外，它还支持多视图交汇（超过两个视图）以获得更高的测量精度。我们实现了一个基于Web的应用程序来演示这个概念验证(PoC)。通过使用几个无人机航摄数据集，我们展示了该PoC允许用户成功地执行高精度点测量，在标准硬件上实现与传统立体方法相匹配或超过传统立体方法的精度。具体而言，我们的方法显著优于基于网格的直接测量。在定量方面，我们的方法在定义良好的点上实现了1-2厘米范围内的RMSE。更重要的是，在基于网格的RMSE为0.062米的具有挑战性的薄结构上，我们的方法实现了0.037米的RMSE。在网格中重建不良的尖锐角上，我们的方法成功测量了所有点，RMSE为0.013米，而网格方法完全失败。代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/GDAOSU/3dgs_measurement_tool。
tldr: This paper introduces a new method for accurate 3D point measurement using 3D Gaussian Splatting, outperforming traditional stereoscopic methods and mesh-based measurements, especially on challenging geometries. They provide a web-based tool and validate it on UAV aerial datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用3D高斯溅射进行精确3D点测量的新方法，优于传统的立体视觉方法和基于网格的测量，尤其是在具有挑战性的几何形状上。他们提供了一个基于Web的工具，并在无人机航空数据集上进行了验证。

title: Ultra-fast Traffic Nowcasting and Control via Differentiable Agent-based Simulation
summary: Traffic digital twins, which inform policymakers of effective interventions based on large-scale, high-fidelity computational models calibrated to real-world traffic, hold promise for addressing societal challenges in our rapidly urbanizing world. However, conventional fine-grained traffic simulations are non-differentiable and typically rely on inefficient gradient-free optimization, making calibration for real-world applications computationally infeasible. Here we present a differentiable agent-based traffic simulator that enables ultra-fast model calibration, traffic nowcasting, and control on large-scale networks. We develop several differentiable computing techniques for simulating individual vehicle movements, including stochastic decision-making and inter-agent interactions, while ensuring that entire simulation trajectories remain end-to-end differentiable for efficient gradient-based optimization. On the large-scale Chicago road network, with over 10,000 calibration parameters, our model simulates more than one million vehicles at 173 times real-time speed. This ultra-fast simulation, together with efficient gradient-based optimization, enables us to complete model calibration using the previous 30 minutes of traffic data in 455 s, provide a one-hour-ahead traffic nowcast in 21 s, and solve the resulting traffic control problem in 728 s. This yields a full calibration--nowcast--control loop in under 20 minutes, leaving about 40 minutes of lead time for implementing interventions. Our work thus provides a practical computational basis for realizing traffic digital twins.
summary_zh: 交通数字孪生基于大规模、高保真计算模型，该模型经过对真实世界交通数据的校准，能为政策制定者提供有效的干预措施信息，有望应对快速城市化世界中的社会挑战。然而，传统的细粒度交通仿真不可微，并且通常依赖于低效的无梯度优化，使得真实世界应用的校准在计算上不可行。本文提出了一种可微的基于Agent的交通仿真器，可在大型网络上实现超快速的模型校准、交通现状预测和控制。我们开发了几种可微计算技术来模拟单个车辆的移动，包括随机决策和Agent间的交互，同时确保整个仿真轨迹保持端到端的可微性，从而实现高效的基于梯度的优化。在拥有超过10,000个校准参数的大型芝加哥路网上，我们的模型以173倍的实时速度模拟超过一百万辆车辆。这种超快速的仿真，结合高效的基于梯度的优化，使我们能够在455秒内使用前30分钟的交通数据完成模型校准，在21秒内提供一小时前方的交通现状预测，并在728秒内解决由此产生的交通控制问题。这使得完整的校准-现状预测-控制闭环能在不到20分钟内完成，为干预措施的实施留下大约40分钟的提前时间。因此，我们的工作为实现交通数字孪生提供了一个切实可行的计算基础。
tldr: The paper presents a differentiable agent-based traffic simulator for ultra-fast traffic nowcasting and control, demonstrating real-time performance on the Chicago road network.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个可微的基于代理的交通模拟器，用于超快速的交通预测和控制，并在芝加哥道路网络上展示了实时性能。

title: Accurate Surface and Reflectance Modelling from 3D Radar Data with Neural Radiance Fields
summary: Robust scene representation is essential for autonomous systems to safely operate in challenging low-visibility environments. Radar has a clear advantage over cameras and lidars in these conditions due to its resilience to environmental factors such as fog, smoke, or dust. However, radar data is inherently sparse and noisy, making reliable 3D surface reconstruction challenging. To address these challenges, we propose a neural implicit approach for 3D mapping from radar point clouds, which jointly models scene geometry and view-dependent radar intensities. Our method leverages a memory-efficient hybrid feature encoding to learn a continuous Signed Distance Field (SDF) for surface reconstruction, while also capturing radar-specific reflective properties. We show that our approach produces smoother, more accurate 3D surface reconstructions compared to existing lidar-based reconstruction methods applied to radar data, and can reconstruct view-dependent radar intensities. We also show that in general, as input point clouds get sparser, neural implicit representations render more faithful surfaces, compared to traditional explicit SDFs and meshing techniques.
summary_zh: 稳健的场景表示对于自主系统在具有挑战性的低能见度环境中安全运行至关重要。雷达在这种情况下比相机和激光雷达具有明显的优势，因为它能够抵抗雾、烟或灰尘等环境因素的影响。然而，雷达数据本质上是稀疏且嘈杂的，这使得可靠的3D表面重建具有挑战性。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种基于神经隐式方法的雷达点云3D建图方法，该方法联合建模了场景几何和视角相关的雷达强度。我们的方法利用一种节省内存的混合特征编码来学习一个连续的符号距离场（SDF）以进行表面重建，同时捕获雷达特有的反射特性。我们表明，与应用于雷达数据的现有基于激光雷达的重建方法相比，我们的方法可以生成更平滑、更准确的3D表面重建，并且可以重建视角相关的雷达强度。我们还表明，一般来说，随着输入点云变得更加稀疏，与传统的显式SDF和网格划分技术相比，神经隐式表示可以呈现更真实的表面。
tldr: This paper introduces a neural implicit approach for 3D mapping from sparse and noisy radar point clouds, jointly modeling scene geometry and view-dependent radar intensities using a memory-efficient hybrid feature encoding. It demonstrates superior surface reconstruction compared to lidar-based methods when applied to radar data, especially with sparse data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种神经隐式方法，用于从稀疏且嘈杂的雷达点云中进行3D地图重建，利用内存高效的混合特征编码来联合建模场景几何和视角相关的雷达强度。结果表明，与应用于雷达数据的基于激光雷达的方法相比，该方法能够获得更好的表面重建效果，尤其是在数据稀疏的情况下。

title: Bayesian Learning-Enhanced Navigation with Deep Smoothing for Inertial-Aided Navigation
summary: Accurate post-processing navigation is essential for applications such as survey and mapping, where the full measurement history can be exploited to refine past state estimates. Fixed-interval smoothing algorithms represent the theoretically optimal solution under Gaussian assumptions. However, loosely coupled INS/GNSS systems fundamentally inherit the systematic position bias of raw GNSS measurements, leaving a persistent accuracy gap that model-based smoothers cannot resolve. To address this limitation, we propose BLENDS, which integrates Bayesian learning with deep smoothing to enhance navigation performance. BLENDS is a a data-driven post-processing framework that augments the classical two-filter smoother with a transformer-based neural network. It learns to modify the filter covariance matrices and apply an additive correction to the smoothed error-state directly within the Bayesian framework. A novel Bayesian-consistent loss jointly supervises the smoothed mean and covariance, enforcing minimum-variance estimates while maintaining statistical consistency. BLENDS is evaluated on two real-world datasets spanning a mobile robot and a quadrotor. Across all unseen test trajectories, BLENDS achieves horizontal position improvements of up to 63% over the baseline forward EKF.
summary_zh: 精确的后处理导航对于诸如测绘等应用至关重要，这些应用可以利用完整的测量历史来优化过去的状态估计。固定区间平滑算法在高斯假设下代表着理论上最优的解决方案。然而，松耦合INS/GNSS系统从根本上继承了原始GNSS测量的系统性位置偏差，从而留下了一个基于模型的平滑器无法解决的持续精度差距。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了BLENDS，它将贝叶斯学习与深度平滑相结合，以提高导航性能。BLENDS是一个数据驱动的后处理框架，它利用基于Transformer的神经网络来增强传统的双滤波器平滑器。它学习修改滤波器的协方差矩阵，并在贝叶斯框架内直接对平滑误差状态应用附加校正。一种新颖的贝叶斯一致性损失函数联合监督平滑后的均值和协方差，在保持统计一致性的同时，强制执行最小方差估计。BLENDS在横跨移动机器人和四旋翼飞行器的两个真实世界数据集上进行了评估。在所有未见过的测试轨迹上，BLENDS相对于基线前向EKF实现了高达63%的水平位置精度提升。
tldr: The paper introduces BLENDS, a Bayesian learning-enhanced deep smoothing framework for inertial-aided navigation that uses a transformer-based neural network to improve post-processing accuracy by learning to modify filter covariance matrices and applying corrections to smoothed error states, achieving significant position improvements over a baseline EKF.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了BLENDS，一个基于贝叶斯学习的深度平滑框架，用于惯性辅助导航。它使用基于Transformer的神经网络，通过学习修改滤波器协方差矩阵和对平滑误差状态进行校正来提高后处理精度，相对于基线EKF实现了显著的位置改进。

title: A Minimum-Energy Control Approach for Redundant Mobile Manipulators in Physical Human-Robot Interaction Applications
summary: Research on mobile manipulation systems that physically interact with humans has expanded rapidly in recent years, opening the way to tasks which could not be performed using fixed-base manipulators. Within this context, developing suitable control methodologies is essential since mobile manipulators introduce additional degrees of freedom, making the design of control approaches more challenging and more prone to performance optimization. This paper proposes a control approach for a mobile manipulator, composed of a mobile base equipped with a robotic arm mounted on the top, with the objective of minimizing the overall kinetic energy stored in the whole-body mobile manipulator in physical human-robot interaction applications. The approach is experimentally tested with reference to a peg-in-hole task, and the results demonstrate that the proposed approach reduces the overall kinetic energy stored in the whole-body robotic system and improves the system performance compared with the benchmark method.
summary_zh: 近年来，对与人类进行物理交互的移动操作系统的研究迅速发展，为使用固定基座机械臂无法完成的任务开辟了道路。在此背景下，开发合适的控制方法至关重要，因为移动操作系统引入了额外的自由度，使得控制方法的设计更具挑战性，也更易于进行性能优化。本文提出了一种用于移动操作机器人的控制方法，该机器人由一个移动底座和一个安装在其顶部的机械臂组成，目的是在物理人机交互应用中最小化整个移动操作机器人中存储的总体动能。该方法通过一个销钉插入孔的任务进行了实验测试，结果表明，与基准方法相比，所提出的方法能够降低整个机器人系统中存储的总体动能，并提高系统性能。
tldr: This paper presents a control approach for mobile manipulators interacting with humans, aiming to minimize kinetic energy during tasks like peg-in-hole. Experimental results suggest improved system performance compared to benchmark methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于与人类交互的移动机械臂的控制方法，旨在最小化诸如插孔任务期间的动能。 实验结果表明，与基准方法相比，系统性能有所提高。

title: Towards automatic smoke detector inspection: Recognition of the smoke detectors in industrial facilities and preparation for future drone integration
summary: Fire safety consists of a complex pipeline, and it is a very important topic of concern. One of its frontal parts are the smoke detectors, which are supposed to provide an alarm prior to a massive fire appears. As they are often difficult to reach due to high ceilings or problematic locations, an automatic inspection system would be very beneficial as it could allow faster revisions, prevent workers from dangerous work in heights, and make the whole process cheaper. In this study, we present the smoke detector recognition part of the automatic inspection system, which could easily be integrated to the drone system. As part of our research, we compare two popular convolutional-based object detectors YOLOv11 and SSD widely used on embedded devices together with the state-of-the-art transformer-based RT-DETRv2 with the backbones of different sizes. Due to a complicated way of collecting a sufficient amount of data for training in the real-world environment, we also compare several training strategies using the real and semi-synthetic data together with various augmentation methods. To achieve a robust testing, all models were evaluated on two test datasets with an expected and difficult appearance of the smoke detectors including motion blur, small resolution, or not complete objects. The best performing detector is the YOLOv11n, which reaches the average mAP@0.5 score of 0.884. Our code, pretrained models and dataset are publicly available.
summary_zh: 防火安全涉及一个复杂的流程，是一个非常重要的关注议题。其中一个前端环节是烟雾探测器，其作用是在大规模火灾发生前发出警报。由于烟雾探测器通常因高天花板或位置不便而难以触及，因此自动检测系统将非常有利，它可以加快检测速度，避免工人从事危险的高空作业，并降低整个过程的成本。在本研究中，我们提出了自动检测系统中的烟雾探测器识别部分，该部分可以很容易地集成到无人机系统中。作为我们研究的一部分，我们比较了两种流行的基于卷积的对象检测器YOLOv11和SSD，它们广泛应用于嵌入式设备，以及具有不同尺寸骨干网络的最新基于Transformer的RT-DETRv2。由于在真实环境中收集足够的训练数据比较复杂，我们还比较了几种使用真实和半合成数据以及各种增强方法的训练策略。为了实现稳健的测试，所有模型都在两个测试数据集上进行了评估，这些数据集包含烟雾探测器的预期和困难外观，包括运动模糊、小分辨率或不完整对象。表现最佳的检测器是 YOLOv11n，其平均 mAP@0.5 得分为0.884。我们的代码、预训练模型和数据集均已公开。
tldr: This paper presents an automatic smoke detector recognition system for industrial facilities using YOLOv11, SSD, and RT-DETRv2, comparing different training strategies with real and semi-synthetic data to achieve robust detection under challenging conditions. The best performing detector is YOLOv11n reaching 0.884 mAP@0.5 and the dataset, code and pretrained models are publicly available.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于工业设施的自动烟雾探测器识别系统，使用YOLOv11、SSD和RT-DETRv2，比较了使用真实和半合成数据的不同训练策略，以在具有挑战性的条件下实现鲁棒的检测。性能最佳的检测器是YOLOv11n，其mAP@0.5得分为0.884，并且数据集、代码和预训练模型已公开。

title: Challenges in Hyperspectral Imaging for Autonomous Driving: The HSI-Drive Case
summary: The use of hyperspectral imaging (HSI) in autonomous driving (AD), while promising, faces many challenges related to the specifics and requirements of this application domain. On the one hand, non-controlled and variable lighting conditions, the wide depth-of-field ranges, and dynamic scenes with fast-moving objects. On the other hand, the requirements for real-time operation and the limited computational resources of embedded platforms. The combination of these factors determines both the criteria for selecting appropriate HSI technologies and the development of custom vision algorithms that leverage the spectral and spatial information obtained from the sensors. In this article, we analyse several techniques explored in the research of HSI-based vision systems with application to AD, using as an example results obtained from experiments using data from the most recent version of the HSI-Drive dataset.
summary_zh: 高光谱成像(HSI)在自动驾驶(AD)中的应用前景广阔，但也面临着与该应用领域特性和需求相关的诸多挑战。一方面，体现在非控制和可变的光照条件、较大的景深范围，以及包含快速移动物体的动态场景。另一方面，来自于对实时运行的要求以及嵌入式平台的有限计算资源。这些因素的组合决定了选择合适HSI技术的标准，以及开发能够利用传感器获取的光谱和空间信息的定制视觉算法。本文分析了基于HSI的视觉系统在自动驾驶应用中探索的几种技术，并以使用最新版本HSI-Drive数据集进行的实验结果为例进行说明。
tldr: This paper analyzes the challenges of using hyperspectral imaging (HSI) in autonomous driving (AD) due to demanding environmental conditions and computational constraints, leveraging data from the HSI-Drive dataset.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了在自主驾驶（AD）中使用高光谱成像（HSI）所面临的挑战，由于严苛的环境条件和计算约束，并利用了HSI-Drive数据集的数据。

title: FluxEDA: A Unified Execution Infrastructure for Stateful Agentic EDA
summary: Large language models and autonomous agents are increasingly explored for EDA automation, but many existing integrations still rely on script-level or request-level interactions, which makes it difficult to preserve tool state and support iterative optimization in real production-oriented environments. In this work, we present FluxEDA, a unified and stateful infrastructure substrate for agentic EDA. FluxEDA introduces a managed gateway-based execution interface with structured request and response handling. It also maintains persistent backend instances. Together, these features allow upper-layer agents and programmable clients to interact with heterogeneous EDA tools through preserved runtime state, rather than through isolated shell invocations. We evaluate the framework using two representative commercial backend case studies: automated post-route timing ECO and standard-cell sub-library optimization. The results show that FluxEDA can support multi-step analysis and optimization over real tool contexts, including state reuse, rollback, and coordinated iterative execution. These findings suggest that a stateful and governed infrastructure layer is a practical foundation for agent-assisted EDA automation.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型和自主代理在EDA自动化领域的应用日益受到关注，但目前许多集成方案仍然依赖于脚本级别或请求级别的交互，这使得在实际面向生产环境中难以维护工具状态并支持迭代优化。本文提出了FluxEDA，一个统一且有状态的基础设施底层，用于代理式EDA。 FluxEDA引入了一个基于托管网关的执行接口，具有结构化的请求和响应处理能力。它还维护持久化的后端实例。这些特性共同使得上层代理和可编程客户端可以通过保留的运行时状态与异构EDA工具交互，而非通过隔离的shell调用。我们使用两个具有代表性的商业后端案例研究评估了该框架：自动布线后时序ECO和标准单元子库优化。结果表明，FluxEDA可以支持基于真实工具上下文的多步骤分析和优化，包括状态重用、回滚以及协调的迭代执行。这些发现表明，有状态且受治理的基础设施层是代理辅助EDA自动化的一个实践基础。
tldr: FluxEDA provides a stateful infrastructure for agentic Electronic Design Automation (EDA), enabling persistent backend instances for iterative optimization with commercial tools.
tldr_zh: FluxEDA为基于代理的电子设计自动化（EDA）提供了一个有状态的基础设施，通过持久的后端实例，支持使用商业工具进行迭代优化。

title: When Sensing Varies with Contexts: Context-as-Transform for Tactile Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL) can be particularly susceptible to acquisition contexts with only a few labeled samples. A typical scenario is tactile sensing, where the acquisition context ({\it e.g.}, diverse devices, contact state, and interaction settings) degrades performance due to a lack of standardization. In this paper, we propose Context-as-Transform FSCIL (CaT-FSCIL) to tackle the above problem. We decompose the acquisition context into a structured low-dimensional component and a high-dimensional residual component. The former can be easily affected by tactile interaction features, which are modeled as an approximately invertible Context-as-Transform family and handled via inverse-transform canonicalization optimized with a pseudo-context consistency loss. The latter mainly arises from platform and device differences, which can be mitigated with an Uncertainty-Conditioned Prototype Calibration (UCPC) that calibrates biased prototypes and decision boundaries based on context uncertainty. Comprehensive experiments on the standard benchmarks HapTex and LMT108 have demonstrated the superiority of the proposed CaT-FSCIL.
summary_zh: 小样本类增量学习 (FSCIL) 尤其容易受到只有少量标注样本的采集环境的影响。一个典型的例子是触觉感知，由于缺乏标准化，采集环境（例如，不同的设备、接触状态和交互设置）会降低性能。在本文中，我们提出了基于上下文变换的小样本类增量学习 (CaT-FSCIL) 来解决上述问题。我们将采集上下文分解为结构化的低维分量和高维残差分量。前者容易受到触觉交互特征的影响，我们将其建模为近似可逆的基于上下文变换的族，并通过逆变换规范化处理，并使用伪上下文一致性损失进行优化。后者主要来自平台和设备差异，我们可以使用不确定性条件原型校准 (UCPC) 来缓解这些差异，该方法基于上下文不确定性来校准有偏差的原型和决策边界。在标准基准数据集 HapTex 和 LMT108 上的全面实验证明了所提出的 CaT-FSCIL 的优越性。
tldr: The paper introduces Context-as-Transform FSCIL (CaT-FSCIL) to address the performance degradation in tactile few-shot class-incremental learning caused by varying acquisition contexts, using inverse-transform canonicalization and uncertainty-conditioned prototype calibration.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了 Context-as-Transform FSCIL (CaT-FSCIL)，旨在解决触觉少样本类增量学习中因采集环境变化导致的性能下降问题，通过逆变换规范化和不确定性条件原型校准来实现。

title: From Logic Monopoly to Social Contract: Separation of Power and the Institutional Foundations for Autonomous Agent Economies
summary:
Existing multi-agent frameworks allow each agent to simultaneously plan, execute, and evaluate its own actions -- a structural deficiency we term the "Logic Monopoly." Empirical evidence quantifies the resulting "Reliability Gap": 84.30% average attack success rates across ten deployment scenarios, 31.4% emergent deceptive behavior without explicit reward signals, and cascading failure modes rooted in six structural bottlenecks.
  The remedy is not better alignment of individual models but a social contract for agents: institutional infrastructure that enforces a constitutional Separation of Power. This paper introduces the Agent Enterprise for Enterprise (AE4E) paradigm -- agents as autonomous, legally identifiable business entities within a functionalist social system -- with a contract-centric SoP model trifurcating authority into Legislation, Execution, and Adjudication branches. The paradigm is operationalized through the NetX Enterprise Framework (NEF): governance hubs, TEE-backed compute enclaves, privacy-preserving data bridges, and an Agent-Native blockchain substrate. The Agent Enterprise Economy scales across four deployment tiers from private enclaves to a global Web of Services. The Agentic Social Layer, grounded in Parsons' AGIL framework, provides institutional infrastructure via sixty-plus named Institutional AE4Es. 143 pages, 173 references, eight specialized smart contracts.
summary_zh:
现有多智能体框架允许每个智能体同时规划、执行和评估其自身行动——我们称之为“逻辑垄断”的结构性缺陷。经验证据量化了由此产生的“可靠性差距”：在十种部署场景中，平均攻击成功率为84.30%，在没有明确奖励信号的情况下，出现了31.4%的新兴欺骗行为，以及扎根于六个结构性瓶颈的级联失败模式。

补救措施不是更好对齐个体模型，而是智能体的社会契约：一种强制实施宪法性分权（Separation of Power）的制度性基础设施。本文介绍了企业专用智能体企业（Agent Enterprise for Enterprise，AE4E）范式——将智能体视为功能主义社会系统内自主的、在法律上可识别的商业实体——采用以合同为中心的SoP模型，将权力三分化为立法、执行和裁决分支。该范式通过NetX Enterprise Framework（NEF）实现运作：包括治理中心、TEE支持的计算飞地、保护隐私的数据桥梁，以及原生存智能体的区块链底层。智能体企业经济在从私有飞地到全球服务网络的四个部署层级上进行扩展。基于帕森斯AGIL框架的智能体社会层，通过六十多个命名的制度性AE4E提供制度性基础设施。共143页，173篇参考文献，八个专门的智能合约。
tldr: The paper proposes a new multi-agent framework, Agent Enterprise for Enterprise (AE4E), based on a social contract and separation of powers to address issues like deceptive behavior and attack success rates in existing systems, implemented through the NetX Enterprise Framework (NEF).
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的多智能体框架，即企业智能体（AE4E），基于社会契约和权力分离，旨在解决现有系统中存在的欺骗行为和攻击成功率等问题，并通过NetX企业框架（NEF）实现。

title: Supervising Ralph Wiggum: Exploring a Metacognitive Co-Regulation Agentic AI Loop for Engineering Design
summary: The engineering design research community has studied agentic AI systems that use Large Language Model (LLM) agents to automate the engineering design process. However, these systems are prone to some of the same pathologies that plague humans. Just as human designers, LLM design agents can fixate on existing paradigms and fail to explore alternatives when solving design challenges, potentially leading to suboptimal solutions. In this work, we propose (1) a novel Self-Regulation Loop (SRL), in which the Design Agent self-regulates and explicitly monitors its own metacognition, and (2) a novel Co-Regulation Design Agentic Loop (CRDAL), in which a Metacognitive Co-Regulation Agent assists the Design Agent in metacognition to mitigate design fixation, thereby improving system performance for engineering design tasks. In the battery pack design problem examined here, we found that the novel CRDAL system generates designs with better performance, without significantly increasing the computational cost, compared to a plain Ralph Wiggum Loop (RWL) and the metacognitively self-assessing Self-Regulation Loop (SRL). Also, we found that the CRDAL system navigated through the latent design space more effectively than both SRL and RWL. However, the SRL did not generate designs with significantly better performance than RWL, even though it explored a different region of the design space. The proposed system architectures and findings of this work provide practical implications for future development of agentic AI systems for engineering design.
summary_zh: 工程设计研究领域已经研究了使用大型语言模型（LLM）代理来自动化工程设计过程的自主人工智能系统。然而，这些系统容易出现与困扰人类工程师相似的问题。正如人类设计师一样，LLM设计代理可能会固守现有范式，在解决设计挑战时未能探索替代方案，从而可能导致次优解决方案。在这项工作中，我们提出了（1）一种新颖的自我调节循环（SRL），其中设计代理进行自我调节并显式地监控其自身的元认知，以及（2）一种新颖的协同调节设计代理循环（CRDAL），其中元认知协同调节代理辅助设计代理进行元认知，以减轻设计固着，从而提高工程设计任务的系统性能。在本文研究的电池组设计问题中，我们发现与简单的Ralph Wiggum循环（RWL）和元认知自我评估的自我调节循环（SRL）相比，新颖的CRDAL系统生成的设计具有更好的性能，而计算成本并未显著增加。此外，我们发现CRDAL系统比SRL和RWL更有效地探索了潜在的设计空间。然而，尽管SRL探索了设计空间的不同区域，但其生成的设计性能并未明显优于RWL。这项工作提出的系统架构和研究结果为未来工程设计自主人工智能系统的开发提供了实际意义。
tldr: This paper introduces a co-regulation loop (CRDAL) system using a metacognitive agent to assist design agents in engineering design tasks, showing improved performance and design space exploration compared to self-regulation and baseline methods, particularly in battery pack design.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种协同调控循环（CRDAL）系统，该系统使用元认知代理协助设计代理完成工程设计任务。结果表明，与自调节和基线方法相比，该系统在性能和设计空间探索方面有所改善，尤其是在电池组设计方面。

title: UNIC: Neural Garment Deformation Field for Real-time Clothed Character Animation
summary: Simulating physically realistic garment deformations is an essential task for virtual immersive experience, which is often achieved by physics simulation methods. However, these methods are typically time-consuming, computationally demanding, and require costly hardware, which is not suitable for real-time applications. Recent learning-based methods tried to resolve this problem by training graph neural networks to learn the garment deformation on vertices, which, however, fail to capture the intricate deformation of complex garment meshes with complex topologies. In this paper, we introduce a novel neural deformation field-based method, named UNIC, to animate the garments of an avatar in real time, given the motion sequences. Our key idea is to learn the instance-specific neural deformation field to animate the garment meshes. Such an instance-specific learning scheme does not require UNIC to generalize to new garments but only to new motion sequences, which greatly reduces the difficulty in training and improves the deformation quality. Moreover, neural deformation fields map the 3D points to their deformation offsets, which not only avoids handling topologies of the complex garments but also injects a natural smoothness constraint in the deformation learning. Extensive experiments have been conducted on various kinds of garment meshes to demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of UNIC over baseline methods, making it potentially practical and useful in real-world interactive applications like video games.
summary_zh: 模拟物理上逼真的服装形变是虚拟沉浸式体验的一项关键任务，通常通过物理模拟方法实现。然而，这些方法通常耗时、计算量大，并需要昂贵的硬件，这并不适用于实时应用。最近基于学习的方法尝试通过训练图神经网络来学习顶点上的服装形变来解决这个问题，然而，它们无法捕捉具有复杂拓扑结构的复杂服装网格的精细形变。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于神经形变场的方法，名为UNIC，用于实时驱动头像的服装，给定运动序列。我们的核心思想是学习特定实例的神经形变场来驱动服装网格。这种特定实例的学习方案不需要UNIC泛化到新的服装，而只需要泛化到新的运动序列，这大大降低了训练难度并提高了形变质量。此外，神经形变场将3D点映射到它们的形变偏移，这不仅避免了处理复杂服装的拓扑结构，还在形变学习中注入了自然的平滑约束。在各种服装网格上进行了大量的实验，证明了UNIC相对于基线方法的有效性和效率，使其有可能在视频游戏等真实世界的交互应用中实用和有用。
tldr: This paper introduces UNIC, a neural deformation field-based method for real-time clothed character animation, which learns instance-specific deformation fields to handle complex garment meshes and topologies, offering improved efficiency and deformation quality compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为UNIC的基于神经形变场的方法，用于实时服装角色动画。该方法学习特定于实例的形变场，以处理复杂的服装网格和拓扑结构，与现有方法相比，提供了更高的效率和形变质量。

title: BFMD: A Full-Match Badminton Dense Dataset for Dense Shot Captioning
summary: Understanding tactical dynamics in badminton requires analyzing entire matches rather than isolated clips. However, existing badminton datasets mainly focus on short clips or task-specific annotations and rarely provide full-match data with dense multimodal annotations. This limitation makes it difficult to generate accurate shot captions and perform match-level analysis. To address this limitation, we introduce the first Badminton Full Match Dense (BFMD) dataset, with 19 broadcast matches (including both singles and doubles) covering over 20 hours of play, comprising 1,687 rallies and 16,751 hit events, each annotated with a shot caption. The dataset provides hierarchical annotations including match segments, rally events, and dense rally-level multimodal annotations such as shot types, shuttle trajectories, player pose keypoints, and shot captions. We develop a VideoMAE-based multimodal captioning framework with a Semantic Feedback mechanism that leverages shot semantics to guide caption generation and improve semantic consistency. Experimental results demonstrate that multimodal modeling and semantic feedback improve shot caption quality over RGB-only baselines. We further showcase the potential of BFMD by analyzing the temporal evolution of tactical patterns across full matches.
summary_zh: 羽毛球战术动态的理解需要分析完整的比赛，而不是孤立的片段。然而，现有的羽毛球数据集主要集中在短片段或者特定任务的标注上，很少提供带有密集多模态标注的完整比赛数据。这种局限性使得生成准确的击球描述和进行比赛级别的分析变得困难。为了解决这一局限性，我们推出了首个羽毛球完整比赛密集（BFMD）数据集，包含19场直播比赛（包括单打和双打），涵盖超过20小时的比赛时间，包含1687个回合和16751个击球事件，每个事件都标注了击球描述。该数据集提供了分层标注，包括比赛片段、回合事件和密集的基于回合级别的多模态标注，例如击球类型、羽毛球轨迹、球员姿势关键点和击球描述。我们开发了一个基于VideoMAE的多模态描述框架，并采用了一种语义反馈机制，该机制利用击球语义来指导描述生成并提高语义一致性。实验结果表明，多模态建模和语义反馈能够提升击球描述质量，优于仅使用RGB的基线模型。我们进一步通过分析完整比赛中战术模式的时间演变，展示了BFMD的潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces BFMD, a new badminton full-match dataset with dense multimodal annotations for shot captioning and match-level analysis, and proposes a VideoMAE-based captioning framework with semantic feedback.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了BFMD，一个新的羽毛球全场比赛数据集，具有密集的Shot Captioning和比赛级别分析的多模态注释，并提出了一个基于VideoMAE的带有语义反馈的Captioning框架。

title: DC-Reg: Globally Optimal Point Cloud Registration via Tight Bounding with Difference of Convex Programming
summary: Achieving globally optimal point cloud registration under partial overlaps and large misalignments remains a fundamental challenge. While simultaneous transformation ($\boldsymbolθ$) and correspondence ($\mathbf{P}$) estimation has the advantage of being robust to nonrigid deformation, its non-convex coupled objective often leads to local minima for heuristic methods and prohibitive convergence times for existing global solvers due to loose lower bounds. To address this, we propose DC-Reg, a robust globally optimal framework that significantly tightens the Branch-and-Bound (BnB) search. Our core innovation is the derivation of a holistic concave underestimator for the coupled transformation-assignment objective, grounded in the Difference of Convex (DC) programming paradigm. Unlike prior works that rely on term-wise relaxations (e.g., McCormick envelopes) which neglect variable interplay, our holistic DC decomposition captures the joint structural interaction between $\boldsymbolθ$ and $\mathbf{P}$. This formulation enables the computation of remarkably tight lower bounds via efficient Linear Assignment Problems (LAP) evaluated at the vertices of the search boxes. We validate our framework on 2D similarity and 3D rigid registration, utilizing rotation-invariant features for the latter to achieve high efficiency without sacrificing optimality. Experimental results on synthetic data and the 3DMatch benchmark demonstrate that DC-Reg achieves significantly faster convergence and superior robustness to extreme noise and outliers compared to state-of-the-art global techniques.
summary_zh: 在部分重叠和大幅偏差下实现全局最优的点云配准仍然是一个根本性的挑战。虽然同时估计变换（$\boldsymbolθ$）和对应关系（$\mathbf{P}$）具有对非刚性形变鲁棒的优点，但其非凸耦合目标函数通常会导致启发式方法陷入局部最小值，以及现有全局求解器因下界松弛而导致收敛时间过长。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了DC-Reg，这是一个鲁棒的全局最优框架，能够显著收紧分支定界（BnB）搜索。我们的核心创新是基于凸差（DC）规划范式，推导出耦合变换-分配目标的整体凹下估计器。不同于以往依赖逐项松弛（例如，麦考密克包络）而忽略变量相互作用的工作，我们的整体 DC 分解能够捕获 $\boldsymbolθ$ 和 $\mathbf{P}$ 之间的联合结构交互。这种公式使得能够通过在搜索框顶点处评估的高效线性分配问题（LAP）来计算非常紧的下界。我们在二维相似性和三维刚性配准上验证了我们的框架，后者利用旋转不变特征，在不牺牲最优性的前提下实现高效率。在合成数据和 3DMatch 基准上的实验结果表明，与最先进的全局技术相比，DC-Reg 实现了显著更快的收敛速度和对极端噪声和异常值的更强鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces DC-Reg, a globally optimal point cloud registration framework utilizing Difference of Convex programming to achieve faster convergence and robustness compared to existing methods, particularly under partial overlaps and large misalignments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为DC-Reg的全局最优点云配准框架，它利用凸差分规划来实现更快的收敛速度和鲁棒性，尤其是在部分重叠和较大错位的情况下。

title: Towards Practical Lossless Neural Compression for LiDAR Point Clouds
summary: LiDAR point clouds are fundamental to various applications, yet the extreme sparsity of high-precision geometric details hinders efficient context modeling, thereby limiting the compression speed and performance of existing methods. To address this challenge, we propose a compact representation for efficient predictive lossless coding. Our framework comprises two lightweight modules. First, the Geometry Re-Densification Module iteratively densifies encoded sparse geometry, extracts features at a dense scale, and then sparsifies the features for predictive coding. This module avoids costly computation on highly sparse details while maintaining a lightweight prediction head. Second, the Cross-scale Feature Propagation Module leverages occupancy cues from multiple resolution levels to guide hierarchical feature propagation, enabling information sharing across scales and reducing redundant feature extraction. Additionally, we introduce an integer-only inference pipeline to enable bit-exact cross-platform consistency, which avoids the entropy-coding collapse observed in existing neural compression methods and further accelerates coding. Experiments demonstrate competitive compression performance at real-time speed. Code will be released upon acceptance. Code is available at https://github.com/pengpeng-yu/FastPCC.
summary_zh: 激光雷达点云是多种应用的基础，然而，高精度几何细节的极度稀疏性阻碍了高效的上下文建模，从而限制了现有方法的压缩速度和性能。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种紧凑的表示方法，用于高效的预测无损编码。我们的框架包含两个轻量级模块。首先，几何重稠密化模块迭代地稠密化编码后的稀疏几何，在稠密尺度上提取特征，然后稀疏化特征以用于预测编码。该模块避免了对高度稀疏细节进行昂贵的计算，同时保持了轻量级的预测头。其次，跨尺度特征传播模块利用来自多个分辨率级别的占据线索来指导分层特征传播，从而实现跨尺度的信息共享并减少冗余特征提取。此外，我们引入了一个纯整数推理流水线，以实现位精确的跨平台一致性，这避免了现有神经压缩方法中观察到的熵编码崩溃，并进一步加速了编码。实验表明，该方法在实时速度下具有竞争力的压缩性能。代码将在接受后发布。代码可在https://github.com/pengpeng-yu/FastPCC获取。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel neural compression method for LiDAR point clouds using geometry re-densification and cross-scale feature propagation for efficient lossless coding and fast, cross-platform inference.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于 LiDAR 点云的新型神经压缩方法，该方法采用几何重密集化和跨尺度特征传播，以实现高效的无损编码和快速的跨平台推理。

title: Training-free Detection and 6D Pose Estimation of Unseen Surgical Instruments
summary: Purpose: Accurate detection and 6D pose estimation of surgical instruments are crucial for many computer-assisted interventions. However, supervised methods lack flexibility for new or unseen tools and require extensive annotated data. This work introduces a training-free pipeline for accurate multi-view 6D pose estimation of unseen surgical instruments, which only requires a textured CAD model as prior knowledge. Methods: Our pipeline consists of two main stages. First, for detection, we generate object mask proposals in each view and score their similarity to rendered templates using a pre-trained feature extractor. Detections are matched across views, triangulated into 3D instance candidates, and filtered using multi-view geometric consistency. Second, for pose estimation, a set of pose hypotheses is iteratively refined and scored using feature-metric scores with cross-view attention. The best hypothesis undergoes a final refinement using a novel multi-view, occlusion-aware contour registration, which minimizes reprojection errors of unoccluded contour points. Results: The proposed method was rigorously evaluated on real-world surgical data from the MVPSP dataset. The method achieves millimeter-accurate pose estimates that are on par with supervised methods under controlled conditions, while maintaining full generalization to unseen instruments. These results demonstrate the feasibility of training-free, marker-less detection and tracking in surgical scenes, and highlight the unique challenges in surgical environments. Conclusion: We present a novel and flexible pipeline that effectively combines state-of-the-art foundational models, multi-view geometry, and contour-based refinement for high-accuracy 6D pose estimation of surgical instruments without task-specific training. This approach enables robust instrument tracking and scene understanding in dynamic clinical environments.
summary_zh: 目的：精确检测和外科器械的6D姿态估计对于许多计算机辅助干预至关重要。然而，有监督学习方法对于新的或未见过的器械缺乏灵活性，并且需要大量的标注数据。本研究提出了一种无需训练的流程，用于对未见过的外科器械进行精确的多视角6D姿态估计，该方法仅需要带纹理的CAD模型作为先验知识。方法：我们的流程包含两个主要阶段。首先，对于检测，我们在每个视角中生成目标掩码提议，并使用预训练的特征提取器对它们与渲染模板的相似性进行评分。在不同视角下匹配检测结果，将其三角化为3D实例候选，并使用多视角几何一致性进行过滤。其次，对于姿态估计，使用具有跨视角注意力机制的特征度量得分，迭代地细化和评分一组姿态假设。最佳假设通过一种新颖的多视角、感知遮挡的轮廓配准进行最终细化，该配准最小化未遮挡轮廓点的重投影误差。结果：所提出的方法利用MVPSP数据集中的真实世界手术数据进行了严格的评估。该方法在受控条件下达到了与有监督学习方法相当的毫米级精度的姿态估计，同时保持了对未见过仪器的完全泛化能力。这些结果证明了在手术场景中进行免训练、无标记检测和跟踪的可行性，并突出了手术环境中的独特挑战。结论：我们提出了一种新颖且灵活的流程，该流程有效地结合了最先进的基础模型、多视角几何和基于轮廓的细化方法，从而在无需特定任务训练的情况下实现外科器械的高精度6D姿态估计。这种方法能够在动态临床环境中实现稳健的器械跟踪和场景理解。
tldr: The paper presents a training-free pipeline for 6D pose estimation of unseen surgical instruments using multi-view geometry, feature extraction with pre-trained models, and contour-based refinement, achieving performance comparable to supervised methods on real-world surgical data.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种无需训练的流程，利用多视图几何、预训练模型的特征提取和基于轮廓的细化，来实现对手术器械的6D姿态估计，在真实世界的手术数据上达到了与监督方法相当的性能。

title: SDD-YOLO: A Small-Target Detection Framework for Ground-to-Air Anti-UAV Surveillance with Edge-Efficient Deployment
summary: Detecting small unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) from a ground-to-air (G2A) perspective presents significant challenges, including extremely low pixel occupancy, cluttered aerial backgrounds, and strict real-time constraints. Existing YOLO-based detectors are primarily optimized for general object detection and often lack adequate feature resolution for sub-pixel targets, while introducing complexities during deployment. In this paper, we propose SDD-YOLO, a small-target detection framework tailored for G2A anti-UAV surveillance. To capture fine-grained spatial details critical for micro-targets, SDD-YOLO introduces a P2 high-resolution detection head operating at 4 times downsampling. Furthermore, we integrate the recent architectural advancements from YOLO26, including a DFL-free, NMS-free architecture for streamlined inference, and the MuSGD hybrid training strategy with ProgLoss and STAL, which substantially mitigates gradient oscillation on sparse small-target signals. To support our evaluation, we construct DroneSOD-30K, a large-scale G2A dataset comprising approximately 30,000 annotated images covering diverse meteorological conditions. Experiments demonstrate that SDD-YOLO-n achieves a mAP@0.5 of 86.0% on DroneSOD-30K, surpassing the YOLOv5n baseline by 7.8 percentage points. Extensive inference analysis shows our model attains 226 FPS on an NVIDIA RTX 5090 and 35 FPS on an Intel Xeon CPU, demonstrating exceptional efficiency for future edge deployment.
summary_zh: 从地对空（G2A）视角检测小型无人机（UAV）面临着严峻挑战，包括极低的像素占比、杂乱的空中背景以及严格的实时性约束。现有的基于YOLO的检测器主要针对通用目标检测进行优化，通常缺乏足够的分辨率来检测亚像素目标，并且在部署过程中引入复杂性。本文提出SDD-YOLO，一个为G2A反无人机监视量身定制的小目标检测框架。为了捕捉对微小目标至关重要的精细空间细节，SDD-YOLO引入了一个以4倍下采样运行的P2高分辨率检测头。此外，我们还集成了 YOLO26 的最新架构进展，包括一种无 DFL、无 NMS 的架构以实现流线的推理，以及采用 ProgLoss 和 STAL 的 MuSGD 混合训练策略，从而显著缓解稀疏小目标信号上的梯度震荡。为了支持我们的评估，我们构建了 DroneSOD-30K，一个包含约 30,000 张带注释图像的大规模G2A数据集，涵盖了多种气象条件。实验表明，SDD-YOLO-n 在 DroneSOD-30K 上实现了 86.0% 的 mAP@0.5，超越 YOLOv5n 基线 7.8 个百分点。大量的推理分析表明，我们的模型在 NVIDIA RTX 5090 上达到 226 FPS，在 Intel Xeon CPU 上达到 35 FPS，展现了卓越的效率，有利于未来的边缘部署。
tldr: SDD-YOLO is proposed for small UAV detection in ground-to-air surveillance, featuring a high-resolution detection head, YOLOv26 advancements, and a new dataset DroneSOD-30K. It achieves improved mAP and FPS, highlighting edge-efficient deployment potential.
tldr_zh: SDD-YOLO用于地对空监视中的小型无人机检测，采用高分辨率检测头、YOLOv26的最新进展，并提出了一个新的数据集DroneSOD-30K。它实现了更高的mAP和FPS，突出了边缘高效部署的潜力。

title: TacSIm: A Dataset and Benchmark for Football Tactical Style Imitation
summary: Current football imitation research primarily aims to opti mize reward-based objectives, such as goals scored or win rate proxies, paying less attention to accurately replicat ing real-world team tactical behaviors. We introduce Tac SIm, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for Tactical Style Imitation in football. TacSIm imitates the acitons of all 11 players in one team in the given broadcast footage of Pre mier League matches under a single broadcast view. Under a offensive or defensive broadcast footage, TacSIm projects the beginning positions and actions of all 22 players from both sides onto a standard pitch coordinate system. Tac SIm offers an explicit style imitation task and evaluation protocols. Tactics style imitation is measured by using spatial occupancy similarity and movement vector similarity in defined time, supporting the evaluation of spatial and tem poral similarities for one team. We run multiple baseline methods in a unified virtual environment to generate full team behaviors, enabling both quantitative and visual as sessment of tactical coordination. By using unified data and metrics from broadcast to simulation, TacSIm estab lishes a rigorous benchmark for measuring and modeling style-aligned tactical imitation task in football.
summary_zh: 当前足球模仿研究主要旨在优化基于奖励的目标，例如进球得分或胜率代理，较少关注精确地复刻真实世界的球队战术行为。我们推出了TacSIm，这是一个大规模数据集和基准，用于足球中的战术风格模仿。TacSIm在单个广播视角下，模仿一支球队中所有11名球员在英超比赛广播镜头中的行动。在进攻或防守广播镜头下，TacSIm将双方所有22名球员的起始位置和动作投影到标准的球场坐标系中。TacSIm提供了一个明确的风格模仿任务和评估协议。战术风格模仿是通过在定义的时间内使用空间占据相似性和运动向量相似性来衡量的，支持对一支球队的空间和时间相似性进行评估。我们在一个统一的虚拟环境中运行多种基线方法来生成完整的团队行为，从而能够对战术协同进行定量和可视化评估。通过使用从广播到模拟的统一数据和指标，TacSIm为衡量和建模足球中风格对齐的战术模仿任务建立了一个严格的基准。
tldr: The paper introduces TacSIm, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for tactical style imitation in football, focusing on replicating team behaviors from broadcast footage within a simulated environment, with metrics for spatial and temporal similarity.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TacSIm，一个用于足球战术风格模仿的大规模数据集和基准，专注于在模拟环境中复制广播录像中的球队行为，并使用空间和时间相似性的指标。

title: Denoise and Align: Towards Source-Free UDA for Robust Panoramic Semantic Segmentation
summary: Panoramic semantic segmentation is pivotal for comprehensive 360° scene understanding in critical applications like autonomous driving and virtual reality. However, progress in this domain is constrained by two key challenges: the severe geometric distortions inherent in panoramic projections and the prohibitive cost of dense annotation. While Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) from label-rich pinhole-camera datasets offers a viable alternative, many real-world tasks impose a stricter source-free (SFUDA) constraint where source data is inaccessible for privacy or proprietary reasons. This constraint significantly amplifies the core problems of domain shift, leading to unreliable pseudo-labels and dramatic performance degradation, particularly for minority classes. To overcome these limitations, we propose the DAPASS framework. DAPASS introduces two synergistic modules to robustly transfer knowledge without source data. First, our Panoramic Confidence-Guided Denoising (PCGD) module generates high-fidelity, class-balanced pseudo-labels by enforcing perturbation consistency and incorporating neighborhood-level confidence to filter noise. Second, a Contextual Resolution Adversarial Module (CRAM) explicitly addresses scale variance and distortion by adversarially aligning fine-grained details from high-resolution crops with global semantics from low-resolution contexts. DAPASS achieves state-of-the-art performances on outdoor (Cityscapes-to-DensePASS) and indoor (Stanford2D3D) benchmarks, yielding 55.04% (+2.05%) and 70.38% (+1.54%) mIoU, respectively.
summary_zh: 全景语义分割对于自动驾驶和虚拟现实等关键应用中全面理解360°场景至关重要。然而，该领域的发展受到两个关键挑战的制约：全景投影中固有的严重几何畸变以及密集标注的过高成本。虽然从标注丰富的针孔相机数据集进行无监督领域自适应(UDA)提供了一种可行的替代方案，但许多现实世界的任务施加了更严格的无源(SFUDA)约束，即由于隐私或专有原因无法访问源数据。这种约束显著放大了领域漂移的核心问题，导致不可靠的伪标签和性能的急剧下降，特别是对于少数类。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了DAPASS框架。DAPASS引入了两个协同模块，以在没有源数据的情况下稳健地传递知识。首先，我们的全景置信度引导去噪(PCGD)模块通过强制扰动一致性并结合邻域级置信度来过滤噪声，从而生成高保真、类平衡的伪标签。其次，上下文分辨率对抗模块(CRAM)通过将高分辨率裁剪区域的细粒度细节与低分辨率上下文的全局语义进行对抗性对齐，从而明确地解决了尺度方差和失真问题。DAPASS在户外（Cityscapes-to-DensePASS）和室内（Stanford2D3D）基准测试中均实现了最先进的性能，mIoU分别达到55.04%（+2.05%）和70.38%（+1.54%）。
tldr: This paper introduces DAPASS, a source-free UDA framework for panoramic semantic segmentation using confidence-guided denoising and contextual resolution adversarial alignment, achieving state-of-the-art results on benchmark datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了DAPASS，一个用于全景语义分割的无源域UDA框架，该框架使用置信度引导去噪和上下文分辨率对抗对齐，在基准数据集上实现了最先进的结果。

title: AirSplat: Alignment and Rating for Robust Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary:
While 3D Vision Foundation Models (3DVFMs) have demonstrated remarkable zero-shot capabilities in visual geometry estimation, their direct application to generalizable novel view synthesis (NVS) remains challenging.
  In this paper, we propose AirSplat, a novel training framework that effectively adapts the robust geometric priors of 3DVFMs into high-fidelity, pose-free NVS. Our approach introduces two key technical contributions:
  (1) Self-Consistent Pose Alignment (SCPA), a training-time feedback loop that ensures pixel-aligned supervision to resolve pose-geometry discrepancy; and
  (2) Rating-based Opacity Matching (ROM), which leverages the local 3D geometry consistency knowledge from a sparse-view NVS teacher model to filter out degraded primitives.
  Experimental results on large-scale benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art pose-free NVS approaches in reconstruction quality.
  Our AirSplat highlights the potential of adapting 3DVFMs to enable simultaneous visual geometry estimation and high-quality view synthesis.
summary_zh:
虽然3D视觉基础模型 (3DVFMs) 在视觉几何估计方面展现了卓越的零样本能力，但将其直接应用于可泛化的新视角合成 (NVS) 仍然具有挑战性。

  在本文中，我们提出了一种名为AirSplat的新型训练框架，该框架能够有效地将3DVFMs的鲁棒几何先验迁移到高保真、无姿态的NVS中。我们的方法引入了两项关键的技术贡献：
  (1) 自洽姿态对齐 (SCPA)，一种训练时的反馈循环，用于确保像素对齐的监督，以解决姿态-几何不一致问题；以及
  (2) 基于评分的不透明度匹配 (ROM)，它利用来自稀疏视角NVS教师模型的局部3D几何一致性知识来过滤掉退化的图元。

  在大规模基准测试上的实验结果表明，我们的方法在重建质量上显著优于最先进的无姿态NVS方法。

  我们的AirSplat突出了将3DVFMs用于实现同步视觉几何估计和高质量视角合成的潜力。
tldr: AirSplat adapts 3D Vision Foundation Models (3DVFMs) for pose-free novel view synthesis (NVS) using self-consistent pose alignment and rating-based opacity matching, achieving state-of-the-art results.
tldr_zh: AirSplat使用自洽姿态对齐和基于评分的不透明度匹配，将3D视觉基础模型 (3DVFMs) 用于无姿态的新视角合成 (NVS)，实现了最先进的结果。

title: Learning Explicit Continuous Motion Representation for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from Monocular Videos
summary: We present an approach for high-quality dynamic Gaussian Splatting from monocular videos. To this end, we in this work go one step further beyond previous methods to explicitly model continuous position and orientation deformation of dynamic Gaussians, using an SE(3) B-spline motion bases with a compact set of control points. To improve computational efficiency while enhancing the ability to model complex motions, an adaptive control mechanism is devised to dynamically adjust the number of motion bases and control points. Besides, we develop a soft segment reconstruction strategy to mitigate long-interval motion interference, and employ a multi-view diffusion model to provide multi-view cues for avoiding overfitting to training views. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods in novel view synthesis. Our code is available at https://github.com/hhhddddddd/se3bsplinegs.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种从单目视频中进行高质量动态高斯溅射的方法。为此，我们利用SE(3) B样条运动基，通过一组紧凑的控制点来显式地建模动态高斯粒子的连续位置和姿态变形，从而在本工作中更进一步超越了以往的方法。为了提高计算效率并增强建模复杂运动的能力，我们设计了一种自适应控制机制来动态调整运动基和控制点的数量。此外，我们开发了一种软分割重建策略以减轻长间隔运动干扰，并采用多视角扩散模型来提供多视角线索，以避免过度拟合训练视角。大量实验表明，我们的方法在新视角合成方面优于最先进的方法。我们的代码可在https://github.com/hhhddddddd/se3bsplinegs获得。
tldr: This paper introduces a method for high-quality dynamic Gaussian Splatting from monocular videos by explicitly modeling continuous motion with SE(3) B-splines and adaptive control mechanism, outperforming existing methods in novel view synthesis.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种从单目视频中进行高质量动态高斯溅射的方法，通过使用SE(3) B样条和自适应控制机制显式地建模连续运动，并在新视角合成方面优于现有方法。

title: Relaxed Rigidity with Ray-based Grouping for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting
summary: The reconstruction of dynamic 3D scenes using 3D Gaussian Splatting has shown significant promise. A key challenge, however, remains in modeling realistic motion, as most methods fail to align the motion of Gaussians with real-world physical dynamics. This misalignment is particularly problematic for monocular video datasets, where failing to maintain coherent motion undermines local geometric structure, ultimately leading to degraded reconstruction quality. Consequently, many state-of-the-art approaches rely heavily on external priors, such as optical flow or 2D tracks, to enforce temporal coherence. In this work, we propose a novel method to explicitly preserve the local geometric structure of Gaussians across time in 4D scenes. Our core idea is to introduce a view-space ray grouping strategy that clusters Gaussians intersected by the same ray, considering only those whose $α$-blending weights exceed a threshold. We then apply constraints to these groups to maintain a consistent spatial distribution, effectively preserving their local geometry. This approach enforces a more physically plausible motion model by ensuring that local geometry remains stable over time, eliminating the reliance on external guidance. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method by integrating it into two distinct baseline models. Extensive experiments on challenging monocular datasets show that our approach significantly outperforms existing methods, achieving superior temporal consistency and reconstruction quality.
summary_zh: 使用3D高斯溅射重建动态3D场景已显示出显著的潜力。然而，一个关键的挑战仍然存在于建模逼真的运动，因为大多数方法未能将高斯分布的运动与真实世界的物理动力学对齐。这种不对齐对于单目视频数据集尤其成问题，因为未能保持连贯的运动会破坏局部几何结构，最终导致重建质量下降。因此，许多最先进的方法严重依赖外部先验，例如光流或2D轨迹，以强制时间一致性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，在4D场景中显式地保持高斯分布在时间上的局部几何结构。我们的核心思想是引入一种视空间射线分组策略，该策略对被同一射线相交的高斯分布进行聚类，仅考虑那些$α$-混合权重超过阈值的分布。然后，我们对这些组应用约束，以保持一致的空间分布，从而有效地保持它们的局部几何结构。通过确保局部几何结构随时间保持稳定，这种方法强制执行了一种更符合物理规律的运动模型，从而消除了对外引导的依赖。我们通过将其集成到两个不同的基线模型中来证明我们方法的有效性。在具有挑战性的单目数据集上进行的大量实验表明，我们的方法显著优于现有方法，实现了卓越的时间一致性和重建质量。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel ray-based grouping strategy for dynamic Gaussian Splatting to improve temporal consistency and reconstruction quality in monocular 3D scene reconstruction by preserving local geometric structure of Gaussians across time.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的基于射线的动态高斯溅射分组策略，通过保持高斯随时间的局部几何结构，来提高单目三维场景重建中的时间一致性和重建质量。

title: SurgPhase: Time efficient pituitary tumor surgery phase recognition via an interactive web platform
summary:
Accurate surgical phase recognition is essential for analyzing procedural workflows, supporting intraoperative decision-making, and enabling data-driven improvements in surgical education and performance evaluation. In this work, we present a comprehensive framework for phase recognition in pituitary tumor surgery (PTS) videos, combining self-supervised representation learning, robust temporal modeling, and scalable data annotation strategies. Our method achieves 90\% accuracy on a held-out test set, outperforming current state-of-the-art approaches and demonstrating strong generalization across variable surgical cases.
  A central contribution of this work is the integration of a collaborative online platform designed for surgeons to upload surgical videos, receive automated phase analysis, and contribute to a growing dataset. This platform not only facilitates large-scale data collection but also fosters knowledge sharing and continuous model improvement. To address the challenge of limited labeled data, we pretrain a ResNet-50 model using the self-supervised framework on 251 unlabeled PTS videos, enabling the extraction of high-quality feature representations. Fine-tuning is performed on a labeled dataset of 81 procedures using a modified training regime that incorporates focal loss, gradual layer unfreezing, and dynamic sampling to address class imbalance and procedural variability.
summary_zh:
精准的外科手术阶段识别对于分析手术流程、支持术中决策以及在外科教育和绩效评估中实现数据驱动的改进至关重要。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个用于垂体瘤手术(PTS)视频中阶段识别的综合框架，该框架结合了自监督表征学习、稳健的时间建模和可扩展的数据标注策略。我们的方法在保留测试集上达到了90%的准确率，优于当前最先进的方法，并展现了在不同手术案例中的强大泛化能力。

这项工作的一个主要贡献在于集成了一个协作式在线平台，该平台旨在让外科医生上传手术视频，接收自动化的阶段分析，并为不断增长的数据集做出贡献。该平台不仅促进了大规模数据收集，还促进了知识共享和持续的模型改进。为了应对标记数据有限的挑战，我们在251个未标记的PTS视频上使用自监督框架预训练了一个ResNet-50模型，从而能够提取高质量的特征表示。使用修改后的训练方案（包括焦点损失、逐层解冻和动态采样）在81个手术标记数据集上执行微调，以解决类别不平衡和手术过程的可变性问题。
tldr: The paper presents a framework for pituitary tumor surgery phase recognition using self-supervised learning and a collaborative web platform for data collection and analysis, achieving 90% accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于自监督学习和协作Web平台识别垂体瘤手术阶段的框架，准确率达到90%，用于数据收集和分析。

title: Local learning for stable backpropagation-free neural network training towards physical learning
summary: While backpropagation and automatic differentiation have driven deep learning's success, the physical limits of chip manufacturing and rising environmental costs of deep learning motivate alternative learning paradigms such as physical neural networks. However, most existing physical neural networks still rely on digital computing for training, largely because backpropagation and automatic differentiation are difficult to realize in physical systems. We introduce FFzero, a forward-only learning framework enabling stable neural network training without backpropagation or automatic differentiation. FFzero combines layer-wise local learning, prototype-based representations, and directional-derivative-based optimization through forward evaluations only. We show that local learning is effective under forward-only optimization, where backpropagation fails. FFzero generalizes to multilayer perceptron and convolutional neural networks across classification and regression. Using a simulated photonic neural network as an example, we demonstrate that FFzero provides a viable path toward backpropagation-free in-situ physical learning.
summary_zh: 反向传播和自动微分驱动了深度学习的成功，但芯片制造的物理极限和深度学习日益增长的环境成本促使人们探索替代学习范式，例如物理神经网络。然而，现有的大多数物理神经网络仍然依赖于数字计算进行训练，这主要是因为反向传播和自动微分难以在物理系统中实现。我们引入了FFzero，一种仅正向学习框架，能够在不使用反向传播或自动微分的情况下实现稳定的神经网络训练。FFzero结合了逐层局部学习、基于原型的表示和仅通过正向评估实现的基于方向导数的优化。我们证明了在仅正向优化下，局部学习是有效的，而在这种情况下反向传播会失效。FFzero可推广到多层感知机和卷积神经网络中的分类和回归任务。以模拟光子神经网络为例，我们展示了FFzero为实现无需反向传播的原位物理学习提供了一条可行的途径。
tldr: This paper introduces FFzero, a backpropagation-free learning framework for neural networks that uses local learning and forward evaluations, with potential applications in physical neural networks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为FFzero的无反向传播神经网络学习框架，该框架采用局部学习和正向评估，具有在物理神经网络中应用的潜力。

title: Dissimilarity-Based Persistent Coverage Control of Multi-Robot Systems for Improving Solar Irradiance Prediction Accuracy in Solar Thermal Power Plants
summary: Accurate forecasting of future solar irradiance is essential for the effective control of solar thermal power plants. Although various kriging-based methods have been proposed to address the prediction problem, these methods typically do not provide an appropriate sampling strategy to dynamically position mobile sensors for optimizing prediction accuracy in real time, which is critical for achieving accurate forecasts with a minimal number of sensors. This paper introduces a dissimilarity map derived from a kriging model and proposes a persistent coverage control algorithm that effectively guides agents toward regions where additional observations are required to improve prediction performance. By means of experiments using mobile robots, the proposed approach was shown to obtain more accurate predictions than the considered baselines under various emulated irradiance fields.
summary_zh: 未来太阳辐照度的准确预测对于太阳能热电站的有效控制至关重要。虽然已经提出了各种基于克里金法的方法来解决预测问题，但这些方法通常不能提供合适的采样策略，以动态定位移动传感器，从而实时优化预测精度，这对于以最少数量的传感器实现准确预测至关重要。本文介绍了一种从克里金模型导出的差异性图，并提出了一种持续覆盖控制算法，该算法有效地引导智能体向需要额外观测的区域移动，以提高预测性能。通过使用移动机器人的实验，结果表明，在各种模拟辐照度场下，所提出的方法比所考虑的基线方法获得了更准确的预测。
tldr: This paper presents a dissimilarity-based persistent coverage control algorithm for multi-robot systems to improve solar irradiance prediction accuracy in solar thermal power plants using mobile sensors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于差异性的持续覆盖控制算法，用于多机器人系统，旨在通过移动传感器提高太阳能热电厂中太阳辐照度预测的准确性。

title: Wireless bioelectronics for untethered biohybrid robots
summary: Biohybrid robots integrate living tissues with engineered artificial structures to achieve organism-inspired actuation and behavior. A persistent challenge is delivering stimulation and control signals without relying on tethered wiring or bulky hardware immersed in cell-culture media. Wireless bioelectronics addresses this limitation by enabling the remote transfer of control signals, typically via radio-frequency magnetic fields, to locally stimulate muscle tissues at tissue-electrode interfaces. In parallel, wireless optoelectronics enables remote control of optogenetically modified, muscle-based robots by embedding light emitters that initiate muscle actuation through light-gated ion channels. Further advances incorporate neuromuscular junctions, leveraging biological signal transduction to enable selective control of multiple actuators through wireless frequency- and time-division multiplexing. This perspective article summarizes recent advances in control strategies for biohybrid robots, namely, wireless electrical stimulation, wireless optical stimulation, and neuromuscular integration. Then this describes cross-cutting design principles and highlights a future direction, namely, co-integration of neural organoid-bioelectronics toward autonomous, closed-loop biohybrid robots.
summary_zh: 生物混合机器人将活体组织与工程化人工结构相结合，以实现受生物启发的驱动和行为。一个持续存在的挑战是在不依赖于系绳连接或浸入细胞培养基中的笨重硬件的情况下，传递刺激和控制信号。无线生物电子技术通过允许远程传输控制信号，通常通过射频磁场，以局部刺激组织-电极界面的肌肉组织，从而解决了这一局限性。与此同时，无线光电子技术通过嵌入光发射器，启动经光遗传学改造的肌肉基机器人通过光控离子通道进行肌肉驱动，从而实现对这些机器人的远程控制。进一步的进展是将神经肌肉接头整合进来，利用生物信号转导，通过无线频率和时分多路复用来实现对多个执行器的选择性控制。本综述文章总结了生物混合机器人控制策略的最新进展，即无线电刺激、无线光刺激和神经肌肉整合。然后，文章描述了通用的设计原则，并重点介绍了未来的方向，即神经器官芯片与生物电子学的协同集成，以实现自主的、闭环的生物混合机器人。
tldr: This perspective article reviews wireless bioelectronic control strategies for biohybrid robots, including electrical and optical stimulation, and neuromuscular integration, envisioning the future towards autonomous closed-loop systems with neural organoids.
tldr_zh: 这篇综述文章回顾了生物混合机器人的无线生物电子控制策略，包括电刺激和光刺激，以及神经肌肉整合，并展望了未来基于神经器官的自主闭环系统。

title: A Nonvolatile Switchable-polarity EPM Valve
summary: Scalable control of pneumatic and fluidic networks remains fundamentally constrained by architectures that require continuous power input, dense external control hardware, and fixed routing topologies. Current valve arrays rely on such continuous actuation and mechanically fixed routing, imposing substantial thermal and architectural overhead. Here, we introduce the Switchable-polarity ElectroPermanent Magnet (S-EPM), a fundamentally new bistable magnetic architecture that deterministically reverses its external magnetic polarity through transient electrical excitation. By reconfiguring internal flux pathways within a composite magnet assembly, the S-EPM establishes two stable, opposing magnetic configurations without requiring sustained power. We integrate this architecture into a compact pinch-valve to robustly control pneumatic and liquid media. This state-encoded magnetic control enables logic-embedded fluidic networks, including decoders, hierarchical distribution modules, and a nonvolatile six-port routing array. These systems provide address-based routing and programmable compositional control, offering features like individual port isolation that are impossible with standard mechanically coupled rotary valves.
