By embedding functionality in persistent magnetic states rather than continuous power or static plumbing, this work establishes a scalable foundation for digital fluidics and autonomous laboratory platforms.
summary_zh: 气动和流体网络的可扩展控制仍然受到根本性架构的限制，这些架构需要持续的功率输入、密集的外部控制硬件和固定的路由拓扑。当前的阀阵列依赖于这种持续驱动和机械固定的路由，带来了巨大的热管理和架构开销。在此，我们介绍了一种可切换极性的电永磁体（S-EPM），一种全新的双稳态磁性架构，它可以通过瞬态电激励确定性地反转其外部磁极性。通过重构复合磁体组件内的内部磁通路径，S-EPM建立了两种稳定的、相反的磁性配置，而无需持续的功率供应。我们将这种架构集成到紧凑型夹管阀中，以稳健地控制气动和液态介质。这种状态编码的磁控制实现了逻辑嵌入的流体网络，包括解码器、分层分配模块和一个非易失性的六端口路由阵列。这些系统提供了基于地址的路由和可编程的成分控制，并提供了诸如独立端口隔离等功能，这些功能对于标准的机械耦合旋转阀来说是不可能的。通过将功能嵌入到持久的磁性状态而不是持续的功率或静态管道中，这项工作为数字流体和自主实验室平台奠定了可扩展的基础。
tldr: The paper introduces a new bistable magnetic valve (S-EPM) that uses transient electrical excitation to achieve nonvolatile switching of fluidic networks, enabling logic-embedded fluidics and autonomous laboratory platforms.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新型双稳态磁阀 (S-EPM)，它利用瞬态电激励实现流体网络的非易失性切换，从而实现逻辑嵌入式流体和自主实验室平台。

title: IndustriConnect: MCP Adapters and Mock-First Evaluation for AI-Assisted Industrial Operations
summary: AI assistants can decompose multi-step workflows, but they do not natively speak industrial protocols such as Modbus, MQTT/Sparkplug B, or OPC UA, so this paper presents INDUSTRICONNECT, a prototype suite of Model Context Protocol (MCP) adapters that expose industrial operations as schema-discoverable AI tools while preserving protocol-specific connectivity and safety controls; the system uses a common response envelope and a mock-first workflow so adapter behavior can be exercised locally before connecting to plant equipment, and a deterministic benchmark covering normal, fault-injected, stress, and recovery scenarios evaluates the flagship adapters, comprising 870 runs (480 normal, 210 fault-injected, 120 stress, 60 recovery trials) and 2820 tool calls across 7 fault scenarios and 12 stress scenarios, where the normal suite achieved full success, the fault suite confirmed structured error handling with adapter-level uint16 range validation, the stress suite identified concurrency boundaries, and same-session recovery after endpoint restart is demonstrated for all three protocols, with results providing evidence spanning adapter correctness, concurrency behavior, and structured error handling for AI-assisted industrial operations.
summary_zh: AI 助手可以分解多步骤工作流程，但它们原生不支持诸如 Modbus、MQTT/Sparkplug B 或 OPC UA 等工业协议。因此，本文提出了 INDUSTRICONNECT，这是一个模型上下文协议 (MCP) 适配器原型套件，该套件将工业操作暴露为可进行模式发现的 AI 工具，同时保留协议特定的连接性和安全控制。该系统使用通用的响应信封和“模拟优先”的工作流程，以便在连接到工厂设备之前可以在本地执行适配器行为。一项确定性的基准测试涵盖了正常、故障注入、压力和恢复场景，对旗舰适配器进行了评估，包含了 870 次运行（480 次正常、210 次故障注入、120 次压力、60 次恢复试验）以及跨 7 个故障场景和 12 个压力场景的 2820 次工具调用。结果显示：正常套件实现了完全成功，故障套件确认了通过适配器级别的 uint16 范围验证实现的结构化错误处理，压力套件确定了并发边界，以及针对所有三种协议都演示了端点重启后的同会话恢复。这些结果提供了证据，涵盖了 AI 辅助工业操作的适配器正确性、并发行为和结构化错误处理。
tldr: The paper presents IndustriConnect, a suite of MCP adapters enabling AI assistants to interact with industrial protocols while maintaining safety and connectivity. It uses a mock-first approach and reports successful benchmark results across normal, fault-injected, stress, and recovery scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了IndustriConnect，一套MCP适配器，使AI助手能够在保持安全和连接性的前提下与工业协议进行交互。它采用了一种mock-first的方法，并报告了在正常、故障注入、压力和恢复情况下的成功基准测试结果。

title: Towards Comprehensive Real-Time Scene Understanding in Ophthalmic Surgery through Multimodal Image Fusion
summary:
Purpose: The integration of multimodal imaging into operating rooms paves the way for comprehensive surgical scene understanding. In ophthalmic surgery, by now, two complementary imaging modalities are available: operating microscope (OPMI) imaging and real-time intraoperative optical coherence tomography (iOCT). This first work toward temporal OPMI and iOCT feature fusion demonstrates the potential of multimodal image processing for multi-head prediction through the example of precise instrument tracking in vitreoretinal surgery.
  Methods: We propose a multimodal, temporal, real-time capable network architecture to perform joint instrument detection, keypoint localization, and tool-tissue distance estimation. Our network design integrates a cross-attention fusion module to merge OPMI and iOCT image features, which are efficiently extracted via a YoloNAS and a CNN encoder, respectively. Furthermore, a region-based recurrent module leverages temporal coherence.
  Results: Our experiments demonstrate reliable instrument localization and keypoint detection (95.79% mAP50) and show that the incorporation of iOCT significantly improves tool-tissue distance estimation, while achieving real-time processing rates of 22.5 ms per frame. Especially for close distances to the retina (below 1 mm), the distance estimation accuracy improved from 284 $μm$ (OPMI only) to 33 $μm$ (multimodal).
  Conclusion: Feature fusion of multimodal imaging can enhance multi-task prediction accuracy compared to single-modality processing and real-time processing performance can be achieved through tailored network design. While our results demonstrate the potential of multi-modal processing for image-guided vitreoretinal surgery, they also underline key challenges that motivate future research toward more reliable, consistent, and comprehensive surgical scene understanding.
summary_zh:
目的：将多模态成像技术集成到手术室中，为全面理解手术场景提供了途径。在眼科手术中，目前有两种互补的成像方式：手术显微镜（OPMI）成像和实时术中光学相干断层扫描（iOCT）。这项关于OPMI和iOCT时序特征融合的初步工作，通过在玻璃体视网膜手术中进行精确的器械追踪这一实例，展示了多模态图像处理在多任务预测方面的潜力。
方法：我们提出了一种多模态、时序、具有实时能力的网络架构，以执行联合的器械检测、关键点定位和工具-组织距离估计。我们的网络设计集成了一个交叉注意力融合模块来合并OPMI和iOCT图像特征，这些特征分别通过YoloNAS和一个CNN编码器高效提取。此外，基于区域的循环模块利用了时间一致性。
结果：我们的实验证明了可靠的器械定位和关键点检测（95.79%的mAP50），并表明纳入iOCT显著提高了工具-组织距离估计的准确性，同时实现了每帧22.5毫秒的实时处理速度。特别是对于靠近视网膜的近距离（低于1 mm），距离估计精度从284 $μm$（仅 OPMI）提高到33 $μm$（多模态）。
结论：与单模态处理相比，多模态成像的特征融合可以提高多任务预测的准确性，并且可以通过定制的网络设计来实现实时处理性能。虽然我们的结果展示了多模态处理在图像引导的玻璃体视网膜手术中的潜力，但它们也强调了关键挑战，这些挑战激励着未来朝着更可靠、一致和全面的手术场景理解进行研究。
tldr: This paper presents a real-time capable multimodal network for instrument tracking in ophthalmic surgery by fusing operating microscope and intraoperative optical coherence tomography images, demonstrating improved accuracy in tool-tissue distance estimation compared to single-modality processing.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种实时多模态网络，通过融合手术显微镜和术中光学相干断层扫描图像来实现眼科手术中的器械跟踪，与单模态处理相比，在工具-组织距离估计方面表现出更高的精度。

title: Insights on back marking for the automated identification of animals
summary: To date, there is little research on how to design back marks to best support individual-level monitoring of uniform looking species like pigs. With the recent surge of machine learning-based monitoring solutions, there is a particular need for guidelines on the design of marks that can be effectively recognised by such algorithms. This study provides valuable insights on effective back mark design, based on the analysis of a machine learning model, trained to distinguish pigs via their back marks. Specifically, a neural network of type ResNet-50 was trained to classify ten pigs with unique back marks. The analysis of the model's predictions highlights the significance of certain design choices, even in controlled settings. Most importantly, the set of back marks must be designed such that each mark remains unambiguous under conditions of motion blur, diverse view angles and occlusions, caused by animal behaviour. Further, the back mark design must consider data augmentation strategies commonly employed during model training, like colour, flip and crop augmentations. The generated insights can support individual-level monitoring in future studies and real-world applications by optimizing back mark design.
summary_zh: 迄今为止，关于如何设计背部标记以最佳支持对外观相似物种（如猪）的个体层面监测的研究很少。随着基于机器学习的监测解决方案的近来涌现，尤其需要关于标记设计的指导原则，以便此类算法能够有效地识别这些标记。本研究基于对一个机器学习模型的分析，为有效的背部标记设计提供了有价值的见解，该模型被训练以通过背部标记来区分猪。具体来说，训练了一个ResNet-50类型的神经网络来对十头具有独特背部标记的猪进行分类。对该模型预测的分析突出了某些设计选择的重要性，即使在受控环境中也是如此。最重要的是，背部标记的集合必须经过设计，以确保每个标记在运动模糊、不同视角以及由动物行为引起的遮挡条件下保持明确。此外，背部标记设计必须考虑模型训练期间常用的数据增强策略，如颜色、翻转和裁剪增强。所产生的见解可以通过优化背部标记设计，从而支持未来研究和实际应用中的个体层面监测。
tldr: This paper investigates the design principles for back marks on animals (specifically pigs) to optimize their recognition by machine learning models under realistic conditions like motion blur and occlusion.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了动物（特别是猪）背部标记的设计原则，以优化机器学习模型在运动模糊和遮挡等真实条件下的识别。

title: ET-SAM: Efficient Point Prompt Prediction in SAM for Unified Scene Text Detection and Layout Analysis
summary: Previous works based on Segment Anything Model (SAM) have achieved promising performance in unified scene text detection and layout analysis. However, the typical reliance on pixel-level text segmentation for sampling thousands of foreground points as prompts leads to unsatisfied inference latency and limited data utilization. To address above issues, we propose ET-SAM, an Efficient framework with two decoders for unified scene Text detection and layout analysis based on SAM. Technically, we customize a lightweight point decoder that produces word heatmaps for achieving a few foreground points, thereby eliminating excessive point prompts and accelerating inference. Without the dependence on pixel-level segmentation, we further design a joint training strategy to leverage existing data with heterogeneous text-level annotations. Specifically, the datasets with multi-level, word-level only, and line-level only annotations are combined in parallel as a unified training set. For these datasets, we introduce three corresponding sets of learnable task prompts in both the point decoder and hierarchical mask decoder to mitigate discrepancies across datasets.Extensive experiments demonstrate that, compared to the previous SAM-based architecture, ET-SAM achieves about 3$\times$ inference acceleration while obtaining competitive performance on HierText, and improves an average of 11.0% F-score on Total-Text, CTW1500, and ICDAR15.
summary_zh: 基于分割一切模型(SAM)的先前工作在统一场景文本检测和版面分析中取得了可喜的成果。然而，典型地依赖像素级文本分割来采样数千个前景点作为提示导致了不令人满意的推理延迟和有限的数据利用率。为了解决上述问题，我们提出ET-SAM，一个高效的框架，具有两个解码器，用于基于SAM的统一场景文本检测和版面分析。在技术上，我们定制了一个轻量级的点解码器，生成单词热图以获得少量的前景点，从而消除过多的点提示并加速推理。在不依赖像素级分割的情况下，我们进一步设计了一种联合训练策略，以利用现有的具有异构文本级标注的数据。具体而言，具有多级、仅单词级和仅行级标注的数据集并行组合成一个统一的训练集。对于这些数据集，我们在点解码器和分层掩码解码器中引入了三组相应的可学习的任务提示，以缓解数据集之间的差异。大量实验表明，与之前的基于SAM的架构相比，ET-SAM实现了约3倍的推理加速，同时在HierText数据集上获得了具有竞争力的性能，并在Total-Text、CTW1500和ICDAR15数据集上平均提高了11.0%的F1值。
tldr: The paper proposes ET-SAM, an efficient SAM-based framework for scene text detection and layout analysis, which achieves faster inference and improved performance through a lightweight point decoder and a joint training strategy leveraging diverse text annotations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了ET-SAM，一个高效的基于SAM的框架，用于场景文本检测和布局分析。它通过轻量级的点解码器和联合训练策略实现了更快的推理速度和更高的性能，该策略利用了多种文本注释。

title: Longitudinal Digital Phenotyping for Early Cognitive-Motor Screening
summary: Early detection of atypical cognitive-motor development is critical for timely intervention, yet traditional assessments rely heavily on subjective, static evaluations. The integration of digital devices offers an opportunity for continuous, objective monitoring through digital biomarkers. In this work, we propose an AI-driven longitudinal framework to model developmental trajectories in children aged 18 months to 8 years. Using a dataset of tablet-based interactions collected over multiple academic years, we analyzed six cognitive-motor tasks (e.g., fine motor control, reaction time). We applied dimensionality reduction (t-SNE) and unsupervised clustering (K-Means++) to identify distinct developmental phenotypes and tracked individual transitions between these profiles over time. Our analysis reveals three distinct profiles: low, medium, and high performance. Crucially, longitudinal tracking highlights a high stability in the low-performance cluster (>90% retention in early years), suggesting that early deficits tend to persist without intervention. Conversely, higher-performance clusters show greater variability, potentially reflecting engagement factors. This study validates the use of unsupervised learning on touchscreen data to uncover heterogeneous developmental paths. The identified profiles serve as scalable, data-driven proxies for cognitive growth, offering a foundation for early screening tools and personalized pediatric interventions.
summary_zh: 异常认知-运动发育的早期检测对于及时干预至关重要，然而，传统的评估方法严重依赖于主观、静态的评价。数字设备的整合为通过数字生物标记物进行连续、客观的监测提供了机会。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种人工智能驱动的纵向框架，用于建模18个月至8岁儿童的发育轨迹。我们使用从多个学年收集的基于平板电脑交互的数据集，分析了六项认知-运动任务（例如，精细运动控制、反应时间）。我们应用了降维（t-SNE）和无监督聚类（K-Means++）来识别不同的发育表型，并追踪个体在这些表型之间随时间的转移。我们的分析揭示了三种不同的表型：低、中和高性能。至关重要的是，纵向追踪显示低性能集群具有很高的稳定性（早期保留率>90%），表明早期的缺陷在没有干预的情况下往往会持续存在。相反，更高性能的集群表现出更大的变异性，可能反映了参与因素。这项研究验证了使用触摸屏数据进行无监督学习来揭示异质性发育路径的有效性。所识别的表型可作为可扩展的、数据驱动的认知增长代理，为早期筛查工具和个性化儿科干预提供基础。
tldr: The paper presents an AI-driven longitudinal framework using tablet-based interaction data to identify distinct cognitive-motor developmental profiles in children, showing potential for early screening and personalized interventions.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文提出了一个AI驱动的纵向框架，使用平板电脑交互数据来识别儿童的不同认知-运动发展概况，展示了早期筛查和个性化干预的潜力。

title: VLA-OPD: Bridging Offline SFT and Online RL for Vision-Language-Action Models via On-Policy Distillation
summary: Although pre-trained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models exhibit impressive generalization in robotic manipulation, post-training remains crucial to ensure reliable performance during deployment. However, standard offline Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) suffers from distribution shifts and catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained capabilities, while online Reinforcement Learning (RL) struggles with sparse rewards and poor sample efficiency. In this paper, we propose On-Policy VLA Distillation (VLA-OPD), a framework bridging the efficiency of SFT with the robustness of RL. Instead of relying on sparse environmental rewards, VLA-OPD leverages an expert teacher to provide dense, token-level supervision on the student's self-generated trajectories. This enables active error correction on policy-induced states while preserving pre-trained general capabilities through gentle alignment. Crucially, we formulate VLA-OPD via a Reverse-KL objective. Unlike standard Forward-KL that induces mode-covering entropy explosion, or Hard-CE that causes premature entropy collapse, our bounded mode-seeking objective ensures stable policy learning by filtering out the teacher's epistemic uncertainty while maintaining action diversity. Experiments on LIBERO and RoboTwin2.0 benchmarks demonstrate that VLA-OPD significantly improves sample efficiency over RL and robustness over SFT, while effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting during post-training.
summary_zh: 尽管预训练的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型在机器人操作中展现出令人印象深刻的泛化能力，但后训练对于确保部署期间的可靠性能仍然至关重要。然而，标准的离线监督微调 (SFT) 会受到分布偏移和预训练能力的灾难性遗忘的影响，而在线强化学习 (RL) 则面临稀疏奖励和样本效率低下的问题。在本文中，我们提出了一种在线策略VLA蒸馏 (VLA-OPD) 框架，该框架将SFT的效率与RL的鲁棒性结合起来。VLA-OPD并非依赖稀疏的环境奖励，而是利用专家示教者在学生的自生成轨迹上提供密集的token级别监督。这使得能够在策略诱导的状态上进行主动纠错，并通过温和对齐来保留预训练的通用能力。至关重要的是，我们通过反向KL目标来形式化VLA-OPD。与引发模式覆盖熵爆炸的标准正向KL不同，或者导致过早的熵崩溃的 Hard-CE 不同，我们有界的模式寻找目标通过过滤示教者的认知不确定性同时保持动作多样性，来确保稳定的策略学习。在 LIBERO 和 RoboTwin2.0 基准测试上的实验表明，VLA-OPD 显著提高了相对于 RL 的样本效率和相对于 SFT 的鲁棒性，同时有效地减轻了后训练期间的灾难性遗忘。
tldr: The paper introduces VLA-OPD, a novel framework that combines offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and online reinforcement learning (RL) for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by using on-policy distillation with a Reverse-KL objective to improve sample efficiency, robustness, and mitigate catastrophic forgetting.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为VLA-OPD的新框架，它结合了离线监督微调（SFT）和在线强化学习（RL）来改进视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。该框架通过使用带有反向KL目标函数的在策略蒸馏，以提高样本效率、鲁棒性并减轻灾难性遗忘。

title: DiffusionAnything: End-to-End In-context Diffusion Learning for Unified Navigation and Pre-Grasp Motion
summary: Efficiently predicting motion plans directly from vision remains a fundamental challenge in robotics, where planning typically requires explicit goal specification and task-specific design. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models infer actions directly from visual input but demand massive computational resources, extensive training data, and fail zero-shot in novel scenes. We present a unified image-space diffusion policy handling both meter-scale navigation and centimeter-scale manipulation via multi-scale feature modulation, with only 5 minutes of self-supervised data per task. Three key innovations drive the framework: (1) Multi-scale FiLM conditioning on task mode, depth scale, and spatial attention enables task-appropriate behavior in a single model; (2) trajectory-aligned depth prediction focuses metric 3D reasoning along generated waypoints; (3) self-supervised attention from AnyTraverse enables goal-directed inference without vision-language models and depth sensors. Operating purely from RGB input (2.0 GB memory, 10 Hz), the model achieves robust zero-shot generalization to novel scenes while remaining suitable for onboard deployment.
summary_zh: 从视觉直接高效地预测运动规划在机器人学中仍然是一项基础性的挑战，因为传统的规划通常需要明确的目标规范和特定任务的设计。近年来出现的视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型可以直接从视觉输入推断行动，但需要大量的计算资源和训练数据，并且在新场景中无法实现零样本泛化。我们提出了一种统一的图像空间扩散策略，通过多尺度特征调制来处理米级导航和厘米级操作任务，每个任务仅需5分钟的自监督数据。该框架由三个关键创新驱动：（1）基于任务模式、深度尺度和空间注意力的多尺度FiLM调节使得单个模型能够实现适合任务的行为；（2）轨迹对齐的深度预测将度量3D推理集中在生成的航点上；（3）来自AnyTraverse的自监督注意力无需视觉-语言模型和深度传感器即可实现目标导向的推理。该模型仅基于RGB输入（2.0 GB内存，10 Hz）运行，实现了对新场景的鲁棒零样本泛化，同时适用于车载部署。
tldr: The paper presents DiffusionAnything, a unified image-space diffusion policy for robot navigation and manipulation that works from RGB input with minimal self-supervised data and demonstrates zero-shot generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了DiffusionAnything，一个统一的图像空间扩散策略，用于机器人导航和操作，仅需RGB输入和最少的自监督数据，并展示了零样本泛化能力。

title: Policy-Guided World Model Planning for Language-Conditioned Visual Navigation
summary: Navigating to a visually specified goal given natural language instructions remains a fundamental challenge in embodied AI. Existing approaches either rely on reactive policies that struggle with long-horizon planning, or employ world models that suffer from poor action initialization in high-dimensional spaces. We present PiJEPA, a two-stage framework that combines the strengths of learned navigation policies with latent world model planning for instruction-conditioned visual navigation. In the first stage, we finetune an Octo-based generalist policy, augmented with a frozen pretrained vision encoder (DINOv2 or V-JEPA-2), on the CAST navigation dataset to produce an informed action distribution conditioned on the current observation and language instruction. In the second stage, we use this policy-derived distribution to warm-start Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) planning over a separately trained JEPA world model, which predicts future latent states in the embedding space of the same frozen encoder. By initializing the MPPI sampling distribution from the policy prior rather than from an uninformed Gaussian, our planner converges faster to high-quality action sequences that reach the goal. We systematically study the effect of the vision encoder backbone, comparing DINOv2 and V-JEPA-2, across both the policy and world model components. Experiments on real-world navigation tasks demonstrate that PiJEPA significantly outperforms both standalone policy execution and uninformed world model planning, achieving improved goal-reaching accuracy and instruction-following fidelity.
summary_zh: 在具身智能中，根据自然语言指令导航至视觉指定的目标仍然是一项根本性的挑战。现有方法要么依赖于难以进行长时程规划的反应式策略，要么采用在高维空间中存在不良动作初始化的世界模型。我们提出了PiJEPA，一个两阶段框架，它结合了学习到的导航策略的优势和用于指令条件视觉导航的潜在世界模型规划。在第一阶段，我们基于CAST导航数据集，微调一个基于Octo的通用策略，并使用冻结的预训练视觉编码器（DINOv2或V-JEPA-2）进行增强，以生成一个基于当前观测和语言指令的信息丰富的动作分布。在第二阶段，我们使用这个由策略导出的分布来热启动模型预测路径积分（MPPI）规划，该规划基于一个单独训练的JEPA世界模型，该模型预测了在相同冻结编码器的嵌入空间中的未来潜在状态。通过从策略先验而不是从不确定的高斯分布来初始化MPPI采样分布，我们的规划器能够更快地收敛到达到高质量的动作序列，最终到达目标。我们系统地研究了视觉编码器骨干网络的影响，比较了DINOv2和V-JEPA-2在策略和世界模型组件之间的表现。在真实世界导航任务上的实验表明，PiJEPA显著优于独立的策略执行和不确定的世界模型规划，实现了更高的目标到达精度和指令遵从保真度。
tldr: The paper introduces PiJEPA, a framework leveraging a policy-guided approach to enhance world model planning for language-conditioned visual navigation, outperforming standard policy execution and uninformed planning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PiJEPA，一个利用策略引导方法来增强世界模型规划的框架，用于语言条件下的视觉导航，其性能优于标准的策略执行和无信息规划方法。

title: Can Vision Foundation Models Navigate? Zero-Shot Real-World Evaluation and Lessons Learned
summary: Visual Navigation Models (VNMs) promise generalizable, robot navigation by learning from large-scale visual demonstrations. Despite growing real-world deployment, existing evaluations rely almost exclusively on success rate, whether the robot reaches its goal, which conceals trajectory quality, collision behavior, and robustness to environmental change. We present a real-world evaluation of five state-of-the-art VNMs (GNM, ViNT, NoMaD, NaviBridger, and CrossFormer) across two robot platforms and five environments spanning indoor and outdoor settings. Beyond success rate, we combine path-based metrics with vision-based goal-recognition scores and assess robustness through controlled image perturbations (motion blur, sunflare). Our analysis uncovers three systematic limitations: (a) even architecturally sophisticated diffusion and transformer-based models exhibit frequent collisions, indicating limited geometric understanding; (b) models fail to discriminate between different locations that are perceptually similar, however some semantics differences are present, causing goal prediction errors in repetitive environments; and (c) performance degrades under distribution shift. We will publicly release our evaluation codebase and dataset to facilitate reproducible benchmarking of VNMs.
summary_zh: 视觉导航模型(VNMs)有望通过学习大规模视觉演示实现可泛化的机器人导航。尽管现实世界中的部署日益增长，但现有的评估几乎完全依赖于成功率，即机器人是否到达目标，这掩盖了轨迹质量、碰撞行为以及对环境变化的鲁棒性。我们对五个最先进的VNMs（GNM、ViNT、NoMaD、NaviBridger和CrossFormer）在两个机器人平台和五个涵盖室内和室外环境的场景中进行了真实世界的评估。除了成功率之外，我们还将基于路径的指标与基于视觉的目标识别分数相结合，并通过受控的图像扰动（运动模糊、阳光耀斑）来评估鲁棒性。我们的分析揭示了三个系统性的局限：(a) 即使是架构复杂的基于扩散和Transformer的模型也会频繁发生碰撞，表明几何理解有限；(b) 模型无法区分感知上相似的不同位置，但存在一些语义差异，导致在重复环境中出现目标预测错误；(c) 性能在分布偏移下会下降。我们将公开发布我们的评估代码库和数据集，以促进VNMs的可复现基准测试。
tldr: This paper presents a real-world evaluation of five vision navigation models, identifying limitations related to collision avoidance, perceptual aliasing, and distribution shift. They also release a codebase and dataset for reproducible benchmarking.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文对五个视觉导航模型进行了真实世界的评估，识别了在避撞、感知混淆和分布偏移方面的局限性。他们还将发布代码库和数据集，以方便可重现的基准测试。

title: Beyond Language: Grounding Referring Expressions with Hand Pointing in Egocentric Vision
summary: Traditional Visual Grounding (VG) predominantly relies on textual descriptions to localize objects, a paradigm that inherently struggles with linguistic ambiguity and often ignores non-verbal deictic cues prevalent in real-world interactions. In natural egocentric engagements, hand-pointing combined with speech forms the most intuitive referring mechanism. To bridge this gap, we introduce EgoPoint-Ground, the first large-scale multimodal dataset dedicated to egocentric deictic visual grounding. Comprising over \textbf{15k} interactive samples in complex scenes, the dataset provides rich, multi-grained annotations including hand-target bounding box pairs and dense semantic captions. We establish a comprehensive benchmark for hand-pointing referring expression resolution, evaluating a wide spectrum of mainstream Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and state-of-the-art VG architectures. Furthermore, we propose SV-CoT, a novel baseline framework that reformulates grounding as a structured inference process, synergizing gestural and linguistic cues through a Visual Chain-of-Thought paradigm. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SV-CoT achieves an $\textbf{11.7\%}$ absolute improvement over existing methods, effectively mitigating semantic ambiguity and advancing the capability of agents to comprehend multimodal physical intents. The dataset and code will be made publicly available.
summary_zh: 传统视觉定位（VG）主要依赖文本描述来定位物体，这种范式固有地难以处理语言歧义，并常常忽略现实世界交互中普遍存在的非语言指示线索。在自然的以自我为中心的互动中，手势指向结合语音构成了最直观的指代机制。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了EgoPoint-Ground，这是第一个大规模多模态数据集，专门用于以自我为中心的指示性视觉定位。该数据集包含复杂场景中的超过\textbf{15k}个交互样本，提供了丰富的、多粒度的标注，包括手部目标边界框对和密集的语义字幕。我们为手势指向指代表达式解析建立了一个全面的基准，评估了广泛的主流多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）和最先进的VG架构。此外，我们提出了一种新的基线框架SV-CoT，它将定位重构为一个结构化推理过程，通过视觉思维链范式协同手势和语言线索。大量实验表明，SV-CoT比现有方法实现了$\textbf{11.7\%}$的绝对提升，有效地缓解了语义歧义，并提升了智能体理解多模态物理意图的能力。数据集和代码将公开发布。
tldr: The paper introduces EgoPoint-Ground, a new large-scale egocentric dataset for hand-pointing visual grounding, proposes a novel SV-CoT framework, and demonstrates significant improvements over existing methods in resolving semantic ambiguity in multimodal physical intent understanding.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EgoPoint-Ground，一个用于手势指向视觉定位的大规模第一人称视角数据集。论文提出了一种新颖的SV-CoT框架，并在理解多模态物理意图方面表现出显著的改进，有效缓解了语义模糊性。

title: Meta-Adaptive Beam Search Planning for Transformer-Based Reinforcement Learning Control of UAVs with Overhead Manipulators under Flight Disturbances
summary: Drones equipped with overhead manipulators offer unique capabilities for inspection, maintenance, and contact-based interaction. However, the motion of the drone and its manipulator is tightly linked, and even small attitude changes caused by wind or control imperfections shift the end-effector away from its intended path. This coupling makes reliable tracking difficult and also limits the direct use of learning-based arm controllers that were originally designed for fixed-base robots. These effects appear consistently in our tests whenever the UAV body experiences drift or rapid attitude corrections. To address this behavior, we develop a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework with a transformer-based double deep Q learning (DDQN), with the core idea of using an adaptive beam-search planner that applies a short-horizon beam search over candidate control sequences using the learned critic as the forward estimator. This allows the controller to anticipate the end-effector's motion through simulated rollouts rather than executing those actions directly on the actual model, realizing a software-in-the-loop (SITL) approach. The lookahead relies on value estimates from a Transformer critic that processes short sequences of states, while a DDQN backbone provides the one-step targets needed to keep the learning process stable. Evaluated on a 3-DoF aerial manipulator under identical training conditions, the proposed meta-adaptive planner shows the strongest overall performance with a 10.2% reward increase, a substantial reduction in mean tracking error (from about 6% to 3%), and a 29.6% improvement in the combined reward-error metric relative to the DDQN baseline. Our method exhibits elevated stability in tracking target tip trajectory (by maintaining 5 cm tracking error) when the drone base exhibits drifts due to external disturbances, as opposed to the fixed-beam and Transformer-only variants.
summary_zh: 配备有顶部机械臂的无人机为检查、维护和接触式交互提供了独特的能力。然而，无人机及其机械臂的运动紧密耦合，即使由风或控制缺陷导致的微小姿态变化也会使末端执行器偏离其预期路径。这种耦合使得可靠的跟踪变得困难，并且也限制了原本为固定底座机器人设计的基于学习的机械臂控制器的直接使用。在我们的测试中，每当无人飞行器（UAV）本体出现漂移或快速姿态修正时，这些影响都会持续出现。为了解决这种行为，我们开发了一种基于强化学习（RL）的框架，该框架采用基于Transformer的双层深度Q学习（DDQN），其核心思想是使用自适应波束搜索规划器，该规划器利用学习到的评论家作为前向估计器，在候选控制序列上应用短时程波束搜索。这使得控制器能够通过模拟推演来预测末端执行器的运动，而不是直接在实际模型上执行这些动作，从而实现软件在环（SITL）方法。前瞻性搜索依赖于来自Transformer评论家的价值估计，该评论家处理短序列状态，而DDQN骨干网络提供了保持学习过程稳定所需的一步目标。在相同的训练条件下，对3自由度空中机械臂进行评估，结果表明，所提出的元自适应规划器表现出最强的总体性能，奖励增加了10.2%，平均跟踪误差显著降低（从大约6%降至3%），并且相对于DDQN基线，组合的奖励-误差指标提高了29.6%。与固定波束和仅使用Transformer的变体相比，我们的方法在跟踪目标尖端轨迹时表现出更高的稳定性（通过保持5厘米的跟踪误差），即使无人机底座因外部干扰而出现漂移。
tldr: The paper presents a transformer-based reinforcement learning framework with an adaptive beam-search planner for controlling UAVs with overhead manipulators, demonstrating improved tracking and stability under flight disturbances compared to baseline methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于Transformer的强化学习框架，该框架具有自适应波束搜索规划器，用于控制带有顶部机械臂的无人机。 实验表明，与基线方法相比，该方法在飞行干扰下具有更好的跟踪和稳定性。

title: Adapt as You Say: Online Interactive Bimanual Skill Adaptation via Human Language Feedback
summary: Developing general-purpose robots capable of autonomously operating in human living environments requires the ability to adapt to continuously evolving task conditions. However, adapting high-dimensional coordinated bimanual skills to novel task variations at deployment remains a fundamental challenge. In this work, we present BiSAIL (Bimanual Skill Adaptation via Interactive Language), a novel framework that enables zero-shot online adaptation of offline-learned bimanual skills through interactive language feedback. The key idea of BiSAIL is to adopt a hierarchical reason-then-modulate paradigm, which first infers generalized adaptation objectives from multimodal task variations, and then adapts bimanual motions via diffusion modulation to achieve the inferred objectives. Extensive real-robot experiments across six bimanual tasks and two dual-arm platforms demonstrate that BiSAIL significantly outperforms existing methods in human-in-the-loop adaptability, task generalization and cross-embodiment scalability. This work enables the development of adaptive bimanual assistants that can be flexibly customized by non-expert users via intuitive verbal corrections. Experimental videos and code are available at https://rip4kobe.github.io/BiSAIL/.
summary_zh: 开发能够在人类生活环境中自主运行的通用机器人，需要具备适应不断演变的任务条件的能力。然而，在部署时将高维协调双臂技能适应于新的任务变化仍然是一个根本性的挑战。在这项工作中，我们提出了BiSAIL（通过交互式语言进行双臂技能适配），这是一种新颖的框架，能够通过交互式语言反馈对离线学习的双臂技能进行零样本在线适配。BiSAIL的关键思想是采用一种分层的思考-然后-调制范式，该范式首先从多模态任务变化中推断出广义的适配目标，然后通过扩散调制来适配双臂运动，以实现推断出的目标。在六个双臂任务和两个双臂平台上进行的广泛真实机器人实验表明，BiSAIL在人机协同适应性、任务泛化性和跨平台可扩展性方面显著优于现有方法。这项工作支持开发自适应双臂助手，非专业用户可以通过直观的口头修正对其进行灵活定制。实验视频和代码可在https://rip4kobe.github.io/BiSAIL/获取。
tldr: The paper introduces BiSAIL, a novel framework for online adaptation of bimanual robot skills using human language feedback, demonstrating improved adaptability and generalization in real-robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为BiSAIL的新框架，该框架使用人类语言反馈在线调整双臂机器人技能，并在真实机器人实验中表现出更高的适应性和泛化能力。

title: 120 Minutes and a Laptop: Minimalist Image-goal Navigation via Unsupervised Exploration and Offline RL
summary: The prevailing paradigm for image-goal visual navigation often assumes access to large-scale datasets, substantial pretraining, and significant computational resources. In this work, we challenge this assumption. We show that we can collect a dataset, train an in-domain policy, and deploy it to the real world (1) in less than 120 minutes, (2) on a consumer laptop, (3) without any human intervention. Our method, MINav, formulates image-goal navigation as an offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning problem, combining unsupervised data collection with hindsight goal relabeling and offline policy learning. Experiments in simulation and the real world show that MINav improves exploration efficiency, outperforms zero-shot navigation baselines in target environments, and scales favorably with dataset size. These results suggest that effective real-world robotic learning can be achieved with high computational efficiency, lowering the barrier to rapid policy prototyping and deployment.
summary_zh: 图像目标视觉导航的主流范式通常假定能够访问大规模数据集、进行大量的预训练以及拥有可观的计算资源。在这项工作中，我们挑战了这个假设。我们表明，我们可以在以下条件下收集数据集、训练领域内策略并将其部署到现实世界：（1）耗时少于120分钟；（2）在消费级笔记本电脑上完成；（3）无需任何人工干预。我们的方法MINav将图像目标导航形式化为离线目标条件强化学习问题，结合了无监督数据收集、后见之明目标重标记和离线策略学习。在仿真和现实世界中的实验表明，MINav提高了探索效率，在目标环境中优于零样本导航基线，并随着数据集规模的增大而表现出良好的扩展性。这些结果表明，高效的现实世界机器人学习是可以实现的，从而降低了快速策略原型设计和部署的门槛。
tldr: The paper presents MINav, a method for image-goal visual navigation that achieves real-world deployment with limited time (120 minutes) and resources (laptop) using unsupervised exploration and offline reinforcement learning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为MINav的图像目标视觉导航方法，该方法使用无监督探索和离线强化学习，在有限的时间（120分钟）和资源（笔记本电脑）下实现了现实世界的部署。

title: Generalizable task-oriented object grasping through LLM-guided ontology and similarity-based planning
summary: Task-oriented grasping (TOG) is more challenging than simple object grasping because it requires precise identification of object parts and careful selection of grasping areas to ensure effective and robust manipulation. While recent approaches have trained large-scale vision-language models to integrate part-level object segmentation with task-aware grasp planning, their instability in part recognition and grasp inference limits their ability to generalize across diverse objects and tasks. To address this issue, we introduce a novel, geometry-centric strategy for more generalizable TOG that does not rely on semantic features from visual recognition, effectively overcoming the viewpoint sensitivity of model-based approaches. Our main proposals include: 1) an object-part-task ontology for functional part selection based on intuitive human commands, constructed using a Large Language Model (LLM); 2) a sampling-based geometric analysis method for identifying the selected object part from observed point clouds, incorporating multiple point distribution and distance metrics; and 3) a similarity matching framework for imitative grasp planning, utilizing similar known objects with pre-existing segmentation and grasping knowledge as references to guide the planning for unknown targets. We validate the high accuracy of our approach in functional part selection, identification, and grasp generation through real-world experiments. Additionally, we demonstrate the method's generalization capabilities to novel-category objects by extending existing ontological knowledge, showcasing its adaptability to a broad range of objects and tasks.
summary_zh: 面向任务的抓取（TOG）比简单的物体抓取更具挑战性，因为它需要精确识别物体的各个部分，并仔细选择抓取区域，以确保有效和稳健的操作。虽然最近的方法已经训练了大规模的视觉-语言模型，将零件级别的物体分割与任务感知的抓取规划相结合，但它们在零件识别和抓取推断方面的不稳定限制了其在不同物体和任务中进行泛化的能力。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的、以几何为中心的策略，用于更具泛化性的TOG，该策略不依赖于视觉识别的语义特征，有效地克服了基于模型的方法的视点敏感性。我们的主要提议包括：1) 使用大型语言模型（LLM）构建的、基于直观的人工指令进行功能性零件选择的物体-零件-任务本体；2) 一种基于采样的几何分析方法，用于从观察到的点云中识别所选物体零件，其中结合了多种点分布和距离度量；以及3) 一种用于模仿性抓取规划的相似性匹配框架，利用具有预先存在的分割和抓取知识的相似已知物体作为参考，来指导对未知目标的规划。我们通过真实世界的实验验证了我们的方法在功能性零件选择、识别和抓取生成方面的高精度。此外，我们通过扩展现有的本体知识，展示了该方法对新类别物体的泛化能力，突出了其对广泛物体和任务的适应性。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel geometry-centric task-oriented grasping approach that leverages LLMs for ontology creation and similarity-based planning to improve generalization on novel objects and tasks, overcoming limitations of vision-language model based approaches.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的、以几何为中心的任务导向抓取方法，该方法利用大型语言模型（LLM）进行本体创建和基于相似性的规划，以提高对新对象和任务的泛化能力，克服了基于视觉-语言模型的方法的局限性。

title: Realtime-VLA V2: Learning to Run VLAs Fast, Smooth, and Accurate
summary: In deployment of the VLA models to real-world robotic tasks, execution speed matters. In previous work arXiv:2510.26742 we analyze how to make neural computation of VLAs on GPU fast. However, we leave the question of how to actually deploy the VLA system on the real robots open. In this report we describe a set of practical techniques to achieve the end-to-end result of running a VLA-driven robot at an impressive speed in real world tasks that require both accuracy and dexterity. The stack of technology ranges across calibration, planning & control, and learning based method to identify optimal execution speed. In the tasks we show, the robot even executes in a speed on par with casual human operation and approaching the hardware limit of our lightweight arm. The unaccelerated videos and inference traces are provided in https://dexmal.github.io/realtime-vla-v2/.
summary_zh: 在将VLA模型部署到真实世界机器人任务中时，执行速度至关重要。在先前的论文arXiv:2510.26742中，我们分析了如何加速GPU上VLA的神经计算。然而，如何真正将VLA系统部署到真实机器人上的问题仍然悬而未决。在本报告中，我们描述了一套实用技术，以最终实现VLA驱动的机器人在需要精度和灵巧度的真实世界任务中以令人印象深刻的速度运行。该技术栈涵盖了校准、规划与控制以及基于学习的方法，以确定最佳执行速度。在我们展示的任务中，机器人的执行速度甚至可以与普通人操作的速度相媲美，并接近我们轻量级手臂的硬件极限。未加速的视频和推理轨迹可在https://dexmal.github.io/realtime-vla-v2/中找到。
tldr: This paper presents practical techniques for deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models on real robots, achieving impressive speed, accuracy, and dexterity in real-world tasks, rivaling human-level performance and approaching hardware limits.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一系列将 Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型部署到真实机器人上的实用技术，在需要精准性和灵活性的实际任务中，实现了令人印象深刻的速度、精度和灵活性，性能可与人类水平相媲美，并接近硬件极限。

title: DFM-VLA: Iterative Action Refinement for Robot Manipulation via Discrete Flow Matching
summary: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models that encode actions using a discrete tokenization scheme are increasingly adopted for robotic manipulation, but existing decoding paradigms remain fundamentally limited. Whether actions are decoded sequentially by autoregressive VLAs or in parallel by discrete diffusion VLAs, once a token is generated, it is typically fixed and cannot be revised in subsequent iterations, so early token errors cannot be effectively corrected later. We propose DFM-VLA, a discrete flow matching VLA for iterative refinement of action tokens. DFM-VLA~models a token-level probability velocity field that dynamically updates the full action sequence across refinement iterations. We investigate two ways to construct the velocity field: an auxiliary velocity-head formulation and an action-embedding-guided formulation. Our framework further adopts a two-stage decoding strategy with an iterative refinement stage followed by deterministic validation for stable convergence. Extensive experiments on CALVIN, LIBERO, and real-world manipulation tasks show that DFM-VLA consistently outperforms strong autoregressive, discrete diffusion, and continuous diffusion baselines in manipulation performance while retaining high inference efficiency. In particular, DFM-VLA achieves an average success length of 4.44 on CALVIN and an average success rate of 95.7\% on LIBERO, highlighting the value of action refinement via discrete flow matching for robotic manipulation. Our project is available \url{https://chris1220313648.github.io/DFM-VLA/}
summary_zh: 采用离散令牌化方案编码动作的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型正越来越多地应用于机器人操作，但现有的解码范式仍然存在根本性的局限性。无论是通过自回归VLA顺序解码动作，还是通过离散扩散VLA并行解码动作，一旦生成一个令牌，通常会被固定，且无法在后续迭代中修改，因此早期的令牌错误无法在后期有效地修正。我们提出DFM-VLA，一种用于迭代优化动作令牌的离散流匹配VLA。DFM-VLA建模了一个令牌级别的概率速度场，该速度场在优化迭代过程中动态更新整个动作序列。我们研究了构建速度场的两种方法：一种辅助速度头公式和一种动作嵌入引导的公式。我们的框架进一步采用了一种两阶段解码策略，包含迭代优化阶段和用于稳定收敛的确定性验证阶段。在CALVIN、LIBERO和真实世界操作任务上的大量实验表明，DFM-VLA在操作性能上始终优于强大的自回归、离散扩散和连续扩散基线，同时保持了较高的推理效率。特别是，DFM-VLA在CALVIN上实现了平均成功长度4.44，在LIBERO上实现了平均成功率95.7\%，突显了通过离散流匹配进行动作优化在机器人操作中的价值。我们的项目可在 \url{https://chris1220313648.github.io/DFM-VLA/} 上获取。
tldr: The paper proposes DFM-VLA, a discrete flow matching Vision-Language-Action model for robotic manipulation that iteratively refines action tokens, outperforming existing autoregressive and diffusion-based methods on standard benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了DFM-VLA，一种用于机器人操作的离散流匹配视觉-语言-动作模型，该模型迭代地改进动作tokens，并在标准基准测试中优于现有的自回归和基于扩散的方法。

title: Emergent Neural Automaton Policies: Learning Symbolic Structure from Visuomotor Trajectories
summary: Scaling robot learning to long-horizon tasks remains a formidable challenge. While end-to-end policies often lack the structural priors needed for effective long-term reasoning, traditional neuro-symbolic methods rely heavily on hand-crafted symbolic priors. To address the issue, we introduce ENAP (Emergent Neural Automaton Policy), a framework that allows a bi-level neuro-symbolic policy adaptively emerge from visuomotor demonstrations. Specifically, we first employ adaptive clustering and an extension of the L* algorithm to infer a Mealy state machine from visuomotor data, which serves as an interpretable high-level planner capturing latent task modes. Then, this discrete structure guides a low-level reactive residual network to learn precise continuous control via behavior cloning (BC). By explicitly modeling the task structure with discrete transitions and continuous residuals, ENAP achieves high sample efficiency and interpretability without requiring task-specific labels. Extensive experiments on complex manipulation and long-horizon tasks demonstrate that ENAP outperforms state-of-the-art (SoTA) end-to-end VLA policies by up to 27% in low-data regimes, while offering a structured representation of robotic intent (Fig. 1).
summary_zh: 将机器人学习推广到长程任务仍然是一个巨大的挑战。虽然端到端策略通常缺乏有效长期推理所需的结构先验，但传统的神经符号方法严重依赖手工设计的符号先验。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了ENAP（涌现神经自动机策略），这是一个允许双层神经符号策略自适应地从视觉运动演示中涌现的框架。具体来说，我们首先利用自适应聚类和一个扩展的L*算法，从视觉运动数据中推断出一个Mealy状态机，该状态机作为可解释的高层规划器，能够捕捉潜在的任务模式。然后，这种离散结构引导一个低层反应式残差网络通过行为克隆（BC）学习精确的连续控制。通过使用离散转换和连续残差显式地建模任务结构，ENAP在不需要特定任务标签的情况下实现了高样本效率和可解释性。在复杂的机械手操作和长程任务上的大量实验表明，在低数据情况下，ENAP的性能优于最先进（SoTA）的端到端VLA策略高达27%，同时提供了机器人意图的结构化表示（图1）。
tldr: The paper introduces ENAP, a neuro-symbolic framework that learns a Mealy state machine from visuomotor demonstrations to guide low-level continuous control, outperforming end-to-end policies in long-horizon robotic tasks with low data.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为ENAP的神经符号框架，该框架从视觉运动演示中学习Mealy状态机来指导低级连续控制，在低数据量下的长程机器人任务中优于端到端策略。

title: Chasing Autonomy: Dynamic Retargeting and Control Guided RL for Performant and Controllable Humanoid Running
summary: Humanoid robots have the promise of locomoting like humans, including fast and dynamic running. Recently, reinforcement learning (RL) controllers that can mimic human motions have become popular as they can generate very dynamic behaviors, but they are often restricted to single motion play-back which hinders their deployment in long duration and autonomous locomotion. In this paper, we present a pipeline to dynamically retarget human motions through an optimization routine with hard constraints to generate improved periodic reference libraries from a single human demonstration. We then study the effect of both the reference motion and the reward structure on the reference and commanded velocity tracking, concluding that a goal-conditioned and control-guided reward which tracks dynamically optimized human data results in the best performance. We deploy the policy on hardware, demonstrating its speed and endurance by achieving running speeds of up to 3.3 m/s on a Unitree G1 robot and traversing hundreds of meters in real-world environments. Additionally, to demonstrate the controllability of the locomotion, we use the controller in a full perception and planning autonomy stack for obstacle avoidance while running outdoors.
summary_zh: 人形机器人有望像人类一样进行运动，包括快速和动态的跑步。 近年来，能够模仿人类动作的强化学习（RL）控制器越来越受欢迎，因为它们可以产生非常动态的行为，但它们通常仅限于单一动作回放，这阻碍了它们在长时间和自主运动中的部署。 在本文中，我们提出了一种流水线，通过带有硬约束的优化程序动态地重定向人类动作，从而从单个人类演示中生成改进的周期性参考库。 然后，我们研究了参考运动和奖励结构对参考速度和指令速度跟踪的影响，得出结论，跟踪动态优化的人类数据的目标条件和控制引导奖励可实现最佳性能。 我们将该策略部署在硬件上，通过在宇树G1机器人上实现高达3.3米/秒的跑步速度并在真实环境中行进数百米来展示其速度和耐力。 此外，为了展示运动的可控性，我们将该控制器用于完整的感知和规划自主堆栈中，以在户外跑步时进行避障。
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning pipeline for humanoid robot running, using dynamically retargeted human motions to improve performance, controllability, and robustness, with successful hardware deployment and obstacle avoidance demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于人形机器人跑步的强化学习流程，使用动态重新定位的人类运动来提高性能、可控性和鲁棒性，并在硬件部署和避障演示中取得了成功。

title: Massive Parallel Deep Reinforcement Learning for Active SLAM
summary: Recent advances in parallel computing and GPU acceleration have created new opportunities for computation-intensive learning problems such as Active SLAM -- where actions are selected to reduce uncertainty and improve joint mapping and localization. However, existing DRL-based approaches remain constrained by the lack of scalable parallel training. In this work, we address this challenge by proposing a scalable end-to-end DRL framework for Active SLAM that enables massively parallel training. Compared with the state of the art, our method significantly reduces training time, supports continuous action spaces and facilitates the exploration of more realistic scenarios. It is released as an open-source framework to promote reproducibility and community adoption.
summary_zh: 并行计算和GPU加速的最新进展为计算密集型学习问题（如主动SLAM）创造了新的机遇，在主动SLAM中，动作被选择以减少不确定性并改进联合地图构建和定位。然而，现有的基于DRL的方法仍然受到缺乏可扩展并行训练的限制。在这项工作中，我们通过提出一个可扩展的端到端DRL框架来解决这一挑战，该框架用于主动SLAM并支持大规模并行训练。与最先进的方法相比，我们的方法显著减少了训练时间，支持连续动作空间，并促进了对更真实场景的探索。它已作为开源框架发布，以促进可重复性和社区采纳。
tldr: This paper introduces a scalable, massively parallel deep reinforcement learning framework for Active SLAM, significantly reducing training time and supporting continuous action spaces in more realistic scenarios. The framework is open-sourced for reproducibility.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个可扩展的大规模并行深度强化学习框架，用于主动SLAM，显著减少了训练时间，并在更真实的场景中支持连续动作空间。该框架已开源，以提高可重复性。

title: Vision2Web: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Visual Website Development with Agent Verification
summary: Recent advances in large language models have improved the capabilities of coding agents, yet systematic evaluation of complex, end-to-end website development remains limited. To address this gap, we introduce Vision2Web, a hierarchical benchmark for visual website development, spanning from static UI-to-code generation, interactive multi-page frontend reproduction, to long-horizon full-stack website development. The benchmark is constructed from real-world websites and comprises a total of 193 tasks across 16 categories, with 918 prototype images and 1,255 test cases. To support flexible, thorough and reliable evaluation, we propose workflow-based agent verification paradigm based on two complementary components: a GUI agent verifier and a VLM-based judge. We evaluate multiple visual language models instantiated under different coding-agent frameworks, revealing substantial performance gaps at all task levels, with state-of-the-art models still struggling on full-stack development.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型的最新进展提高了编码代理的能力，但对复杂、端到端网站开发的系统性评估仍然有限。为了弥补这一差距，我们推出了 Vision2Web，这是一个用于视觉网站开发的分层基准测试，涵盖从静态UI到代码的生成、交互式多页面前端复现，到长时域全栈网站开发。该基准测试基于真实世界的网站构建，包含16个类别共193项任务，以及918张原型图像和1255个测试用例。为了支持灵活、彻底和可靠的评估，我们提出了一种基于工作流的代理验证范式，该范式基于两个互补的组件：一个GUI代理验证器和一个基于VLM的评判器。我们评估了在不同编码代理框架下实例化的多个视觉语言模型，揭示了所有任务级别上存在的显著性能差距，其中最先进的模型仍然在全栈开发方面表现挣扎。
tldr: The paper introduces Vision2Web, a hierarchical benchmark for visual website development, and proposes a workflow-based agent verification paradigm. Experiments reveal performance gaps in state-of-the-art VLMs when applied to full-stack website development.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Vision2Web，一个用于可视化网站开发的分层基准测试，并提出了一种基于工作流的代理验证范式。实验表明，最先进的视觉语言模型在应用于全栈网站开发时存在性能差距。

title: AIRA_2: Overcoming Bottlenecks in AI Research Agents
summary: Existing research has identified three structural performance bottlenecks in AI research agents: (1) synchronous single-GPU execution constrains sample throughput, limiting the benefit of search; (2) a generalization gap where validation-based selection causes performance to degrade over extended search horizons; and (3) the limited capability of fixed, single-turn LLM operators imposes a ceiling on search performance. We introduce AIRA$_2$, which addresses these bottlenecks through three architectural choices: an asynchronous multi-GPU worker pool that increases experiment throughput linearly; a Hidden Consistent Evaluation protocol that delivers a reliable evaluation signal; and ReAct agents that dynamically scope their actions and debug interactively. On MLE-bench-30, AIRA$_2$ achieves a mean Percentile Rank of 71.8% at 24 hours - surpassing the previous best of 69.9% - and steadily improves to 76.0% at 72 hours. Ablation studies reveal that each component is necessary and that the "overfitting" reported in prior work was driven by evaluation noise rather than true data memorization.
summary_zh: 现有研究已确定AI研究代理中的三个结构性性能瓶颈：（1）同步单GPU执行约束了样本吞吐量，限制了搜索的收益；（2）泛化差距，其中基于验证的选择导致性能在扩展搜索范围内下降；以及（3）固定、单轮LLM算子的有限能力对搜索性能施加了上限。我们引入AIRA$_2$，它通过三个架构选择来解决这些瓶颈：一个异步多GPU工作池，线性地提高实验吞吐量；一个隐藏一致性评估协议，提供可靠的评估信号；以及动态确定其行动范围并以交互方式进行调试的ReAct代理。在MLE-bench-30上，AIRA$_2$在24小时内实现了71.8%的平均百分比排名，超过了之前最佳的69.9%，并在72小时时稳步提高到76.0%。消融研究表明每个组件都是必要的，并且先前工作中报告的“过拟合”是由评估噪声驱动的，而不是真正的数据记忆。
tldr: AIRA_2 addresses bottlenecks in AI research agents by introducing asynchronous multi-GPU execution, a Hidden Consistent Evaluation protocol, and ReAct agents, achieving improved performance on MLE-bench-30.
tldr_zh: AIRA_2通过引入异步多GPU执行、隐藏一致性评估协议和ReAct代理来解决AI研究代理中的瓶颈，从而在MLE-bench-30上实现了性能的提升。

title: Reflect to Inform: Boosting Multimodal Reasoning via Information-Gain-Driven Verification
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong multimodal reasoning performance, yet we identify a recurring failure mode in long-form generation: as outputs grow longer, models progressively drift away from image evidence and fall back on textual priors, resulting in ungrounded reasoning and hallucinations. Interestingly, Based on attention analysis, we find that MLLMs have a latent capability for late-stage visual verification that is present but not consistently activated. Motivated by this observation, we propose Visual Re-Examination (VRE), a self-evolving training framework that enables MLLMs to autonomously perform visual introspection during reasoning without additional visual inputs. Rather than distilling visual capabilities from a stronger teacher, VRE promotes iterative self-improvement by leveraging the model itself to generate reflection traces, making visual information actionable through information gain. Extensive experiments across diverse multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that VRE consistently improves reasoning accuracy and perceptual reliability, while substantially reducing hallucinations, especially in long-chain settings. Code is available at https://github.com/Xiaobu-USTC/VRE.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）在多模态推理方面取得了显著的性能，然而我们发现了一种在长文本生成中反复出现的失效模式：随着输出文本长度的增加，模型逐渐偏离图像证据，转而依赖文本先验知识，导致无根据的推理和幻觉。基于注意力分析，我们发现MLLM具有潜在的后期视觉验证能力，虽然存在但未被持续激活。受此观察启发，我们提出视觉再审查（VRE），一种自演化训练框架，使MLLM能够在推理过程中自主执行视觉内省，而无需额外的视觉输入。VRE并非从更强的教师模型中提炼视觉能力，而是利用模型自身生成反思轨迹，通过信息增益使视觉信息可操作，从而促进迭代式的自我改进。在各种多模态基准上的广泛实验表明，VRE能持续提高推理准确性和感知可靠性，同时显著减少幻觉，尤其是在长链情景中。代码可在https://github.com/Xiaobu-USTC/VRE 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces Visual Re-Examination (VRE), a self-evolving training framework for MLLMs that enables visual introspection during reasoning to improve accuracy, reduce hallucinations, and enhance perceptual reliability, particularly in long-chain reasoning scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为视觉重检（VRE）的自进化训练框架，用于多模态大型语言模型（MLLM），该框架能够在推理过程中进行视觉自省，从而提高准确性、减少幻觉并增强感知可靠性，尤其是在长链推理场景中。

title: PhysVid: Physics Aware Local Conditioning for Generative Video Models
summary: Generative video models achieve high visual fidelity but often violate basic physical principles, limiting reliability in real-world settings. Prior attempts to inject physics rely on conditioning: frame-level signals are domain-specific and short-horizon, while global text prompts are coarse and noisy, missing fine-grained dynamics. We present PhysVid, a physics-aware local conditioning scheme that operates over temporally contiguous chunks of frames. Each chunk is annotated with physics-grounded descriptions of states, interactions, and constraints, which are fused with the global prompt via chunk-aware cross-attention during training. At inference, we introduce negative physics prompts (descriptions of locally relevant law violations) to steer generation away from implausible trajectories. On VideoPhy, PhysVid improves physical commonsense scores by $\approx 33\%$ over baseline video generators, and by up to $\approx 8\%$ on VideoPhy2. These results show that local, physics-aware guidance substantially increases physical plausibility in generative video and marks a step toward physics-grounded video models.
summary_zh: 生成式视频模型能够实现高视觉保真度，但常常违背基本的物理原理，限制了其在现实世界环境中的可靠性。以往注入物理知识的尝试依赖于条件约束：帧级别的信号特定于领域且短视距，而全局文本提示则粗略且有噪声，遗漏了精细的动力学。我们提出了PhysVid，一种物理感知的局部条件约束方案，其操作于时间上连续的帧块。每个帧块都被标注有基于物理的对状态、交互和约束的描述，训练期间通过块感知的交叉注意力将这些信息与全局提示融合。在推理阶段，我们引入了负物理提示（对局部相关物理定律违反的描述），以引导生成过程远离不合理的轨迹。在VideoPhy数据集上，PhysVid 相比基线视频生成器，在物理常识评分上提高了约33%，在VideoPhy2数据集上提高了高达约8%。这些结果表明，局部的、物理感知的指导显著提高了生成式视频中的物理合理性，并标志着朝着基于物理的视频模型方向迈出了一步。
tldr: The paper introduces PhysVid, a method for improving the physical plausibility of generated videos by incorporating physics-grounded local conditioning via chunk-aware cross-attention, leading to improved performance on physical commonsense benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PhysVid，一种通过融入物理相关的局部条件信息来提高生成视频物理合理性的方法。该方法通过分块感知交叉注意力来实现，从而在物理常识基准测试上提高了性能。

title: GUIDE: Resolving Domain Bias in GUI Agents through Real-Time Web Video Retrieval and Plug-and-Play Annotation
summary: Large vision-language models have endowed GUI agents with strong general capabilities for interface understanding and interaction. However, due to insufficient exposure to domain-specific software operation data during training, these agents exhibit significant domain bias - they lack familiarity with the specific operation workflows (planning) and UI element layouts (grounding) of particular applications, limiting their real-world task performance. In this paper, we present GUIDE (GUI Unbiasing via Instructional-Video Driven Expertise), a training-free, plug-and-play framework that resolves GUI agent domain bias by autonomously acquiring domain-specific expertise from web tutorial videos through a retrieval-augmented automated annotation pipeline. GUIDE introduces two key innovations. First, a subtitle-driven Video-RAG pipeline unlocks video semantics through subtitle analysis, performing progressive three-stage retrieval - domain classification, topic extraction, and relevance matching - to identify task-relevant tutorial videos. Second, a fully automated annotation pipeline built on an inverse dynamics paradigm feeds consecutive keyframes enhanced with UI element detection into VLMs, inferring the required planning and grounding knowledge that are injected into the agent's corresponding modules to address both manifestations of domain bias. Extensive experiments on OSWorld demonstrate GUIDE's generality as a plug-and-play component for both multi-agent systems and single-model agents. It consistently yields over 5% improvements and reduces execution steps - without modifying any model parameters or architecture - validating GUIDE as an architecture-agnostic enhancement to bridge GUI agent domain bias.
summary_zh: 大型视觉语言模型赋予了GUI代理强大的通用界面理解和交互能力。然而，由于在训练过程中缺乏对特定领域软件操作数据的充分暴露，这些代理表现出显著的领域偏差——它们不熟悉特定应用程序的具体操作流程（规划）和UI元素布局（定位），限制了其在真实世界中的任务表现。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为GUIDE（通过教学视频驱动的专业知识进行GUI去偏差）的免训练、即插即用框架，该框架通过检索增强的自动化标注流程，自主地从网络教程视频中获取特定领域的专业知识，从而解决GUI代理的领域偏差问题。GUIDE引入了两个关键创新。首先，一个字幕驱动的Video-RAG流程通过字幕分析解锁视频语义，执行渐进式的三阶段检索——领域分类、主题提取和相关性匹配——以识别与任务相关的教程视频。其次，一个建立在逆动力学范式上的全自动标注流程将增强了UI元素检测的连续关键帧输入到视觉语言模型中，推断所需的规划和定位知识，并将这些知识注入到代理的相应模块中，以解决领域偏差的两种表现形式。在OSWorld上的大量实验表明，GUIDE作为多代理系统和单模型代理的即插即用组件具有通用性。它持续产生超过5%的性能提升并减少执行步骤——无需修改任何模型参数或架构——验证了GUIDE作为一种架构无关的增强方法，能够弥合GUI代理的领域偏差。
tldr: The paper introduces GUIDE, a training-free framework to mitigate domain bias in GUI agents by autonomously learning from web tutorial videos via retrieval-augmented annotation, improving performance without modifying model parameters.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GUIDE，一个无需训练的框架，通过检索增强的自动标注，自主地从网络教程视频中学习，从而减轻GUI代理中的领域偏差，并在不修改模型参数的情况下提高性能。

title: Clawed and Dangerous: Can We Trust Open Agentic Systems?
summary:
Open agentic systems combine LLM-based planning with external capabilities, persistent memory, and privileged execution. They are used in coding assistants, browser copilots, and enterprise automation. OpenClaw is a visible instance of this broader class.
  Without much attention yet, their security challenge is fundamentally different from that of traditional software that relies on predictable execution and well-defined control flow. In open agentic systems, everything is ''probabilistic'': plans are generated at runtime, key decisions may be shaped by untrusted natural-language inputs and tool outputs, execution unfolds in uncertain environments, and actions are taken under authority delegated by human users. The central challenge is therefore not merely robustness against individual attacks, but the governance of agentic behavior under persistent uncertainty.
  This paper systematizes the area through a software engineering lens. We introduce a six-dimensional analytical taxonomy and synthesize 50 papers spanning attacks, benchmarks, defenses, audits, and adjacent engineering foundations. From this synthesis, we derive a reference doctrine for secure-by-construction agent platforms, together with an evaluation scorecard for assessing platform security posture. Our review shows that the literature is relatively mature in attack characterization and benchmark construction, but remains weak in deployment controls, operational governance, persistent-memory integrity, and capability revocation. These gaps define a concrete engineering agenda for building agent ecosystems that are governable, auditable, and resilient under compromise.
summary_zh:
开放式自主智能体系统将基于大型语言模型的规划与外部能力、持久性记忆和特权执行相结合，应用于代码助手、浏览器副驾驶和企业自动化等场景。OpenClaw是这一更广泛类别的一个典型实例。

然而目前尚缺乏关注的是，它们的安全挑战与依赖可预测执行和明确控制流的传统软件有着根本不同。在开放式自主智能体系统中，一切都是“概率性的”：计划在运行时生成，关键决策可能受到不可信的自然语言输入和工具输出的影响，执行在不确定的环境中展开，行动是在人类用户授权下进行的。因此，核心挑战不仅仅是抵御单个攻击的鲁棒性，而是在持续不确定性下对自主智能体行为的治理。

本文通过软件工程的视角系统化地研究了该领域。我们引入了一个六维度分析分类法，并综合了涵盖攻击、基准测试、防御、审计以及相关的工程基础的50篇论文。基于这种综合，我们推导出安全设计自主智能体平台的参考原则，以及评估平台安全态势的评估记分卡。我们的综述表明，文献在攻击特征和基准构建方面相对成熟，但在部署控制、运营治理、持久性记忆完整性和能力撤销方面仍然薄弱。这些差距为构建可治理、可审计和在妥协情况下具有弹性的智能体生态系统定义了一个具体的工程议程。
tldr: This paper analyzes the security challenges of open agentic systems like OpenClaw, proposes a taxonomy and reference doctrine for secure development, and identifies gaps in current research regarding deployment controls and governance.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了开放式 Agentic 系统（如 OpenClaw）的安全挑战，提出了安全开发的分类标准和参考原则，并指出了当前研究在部署控制和治理方面的差距。

title: Towards GUI Agents: Vision-Language Diffusion Models for GUI Grounding
summary: Autoregressive (AR) vision-language models (VLMs) have long dominated multimodal understanding, reasoning, and graphical user interface (GUI) grounding. Recently, discrete diffusion vision-language models (DVLMs) have shown strong performance in multimodal reasoning, offering bidirectional attention, parallel token generation, and iterative refinement. However, their potential for GUI grounding remains unexplored. In this work, we evaluate whether discrete DVLMs can serve as a viable alternative to AR models for GUI grounding. We adapt LLaDA-V for single-turn action and bounding-box prediction, framing the task as text generation from multimodal input. To better capture the hierarchical structure of bounding-box geometry, we propose a hybrid masking schedule that combines linear and deterministic masking, improving grounding accuracy by up to 6.1 points in Step Success Rate (SSR) over the GUI-adapted LLaDA-V trained with linear masking. Evaluations on four datasets spanning web, desktop, and mobile interfaces show that the adapted diffusion model with hybrid masking consistently outperforms the linear-masked variant and performs competitively with autoregressive counterparts despite limited pretraining. Systematic ablations reveal that increasing diffusion steps, generation length, and block length improves accuracy but also increases latency, with accuracy plateauing beyond a certain number of diffusion steps. Expanding the training data with diverse GUI domains further reduces latency by about 1.3 seconds and improves grounding accuracy by an average of 20 points across benchmarks. These results demonstrate that discrete DVLMs are a promising modeling framework for GUI grounding and represent an important step toward diffusion-based GUI agents.
summary_zh: 自回归（AR）视觉-语言模型（VLMs）长期以来在多模态理解、推理和图形用户界面（GUI）定位方面占据主导地位。最近，离散扩散视觉-语言模型（DVLMs）在多模态推理方面表现出强大的性能，提供了双向注意力、并行令牌生成和迭代优化。然而，它们在 GUI 定位方面的潜力尚未被探索。在这项工作中，我们评估离散 DVLMs 是否可以作为 GUI 定位中 AR 模型的可行替代方案。我们调整了 LLaDA-V 用于单轮动作和边界框预测，将该任务定义为从多模态输入生成文本。为了更好地捕捉边界框几何的层次结构，我们提出了一种混合掩码调度策略，该策略结合了线性掩码和确定性掩码，与使用线性掩码训练的 GUI 适配 LLaDA-V 相比，在步骤成功率（SSR）方面将定位精度提高了高达 6.1 个百分点。对涵盖 Web、桌面和移动界面的四个数据集的评估表明，采用混合掩码的适配扩散模型始终优于线性掩码变体，并且在预训练有限的情况下，其性能与自回归模型具有竞争力。系统的消融研究表明，增加扩散步数、生成长度和块长度可以提高精度，但也会增加延迟，并且精度在超过一定数量的扩散步数后会趋于稳定。通过使用多样化的 GUI 领域来扩展训练数据，可进一步减少约 1.3 秒延迟，并在各个基准测试中平均提高 20 个百分点的定位精度。这些结果表明，离散 DVLMs 是一种有前途的 GUI 定位建模框架，代表着基于扩散的 GUI 代理的重要一步。
tldr: This paper explores the use of discrete diffusion vision-language models (DVLMs) for GUI grounding, demonstrating competitive performance with autoregressive models and introducing a hybrid masking schedule to improve accuracy. The findings suggest DVLMs are a promising framework for building GUI agents.
tldr_zh: 本文探索了使用离散扩散视觉-语言模型（DVLMs）进行GUI接地的应用，展示了与自回归模型的竞争性能，并引入了一种混合掩蔽策略来提高准确性。 研究结果表明DVLMs是构建GUI代理的有前景的框架。

title: FairLLaVA: Fairness-Aware Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Large Vision-Language Assistants
summary: While powerful in image-conditioned generation, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can display uneven performance across demographic groups, highlighting fairness risks. In safety-critical clinical settings, such disparities risk producing unequal diagnostic narratives and eroding trust in AI-assisted decision-making. While fairness has been studied extensively in vision-only and language-only models, its impact on MLLMs remains largely underexplored. To address these biases, we introduce FairLLaVA, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that mitigates group disparities in visual instruction tuning without compromising overall performance. By minimizing the mutual information between target attributes, FairLLaVA regularizes the model's representations to be demographic-invariant. The method can be incorporated as a lightweight plug-in, maintaining efficiency with low-rank adapter fine-tuning, and provides an architecture-agnostic approach to fair visual instruction following. Extensive experiments on large-scale chest radiology report generation and dermoscopy visual question answering benchmarks show that FairLLaVA consistently reduces inter-group disparities while improving both equity-scaled clinical performance and natural language generation quality across diverse medical imaging modalities. Code can be accessed at https://github.com/bhosalems/FairLLaVA.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型 (MLLMs) 在图像条件生成方面表现强大，但在不同人口群体中可能展现出不均衡的性能，突显了公平性风险。在安全性至关重要的临床环境中，这种差异可能导致不平等的诊断叙述，并削弱对人工智能辅助决策的信任。虽然公平性已在纯视觉和纯语言模型中得到广泛研究，但其对 MLLMs 的影响在很大程度上仍未被探索。为了解决这些偏差，我们引入了 FairLLaVA，一种参数高效的微调方法，可在视觉指令调优中缓解群体差异，同时又不影响整体性能。通过最小化目标属性之间的互信息，FairLLaVA 正则化模型表征，使其具有人口统计学不变性。该方法可以作为一个轻量级的插件集成，通过低秩适配器微调保持效率，并为公平的视觉指令遵循提供了一种与架构无关的方法。在大型胸部放射学报告生成和皮肤镜视觉问答基准上的大量实验表明，FairLLaVA 始终如一地减少了群体间的差异，同时提高了跨不同医学影像模态的公平性缩放的临床性能和自然语言生成质量。代码可在 https://github.com/bhosalems/FairLLaVA 访问。
tldr: FairLLaVA is a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for MLLMs that reduces bias across demographic groups in visual instruction tuning, specifically in medical imaging contexts, without sacrificing overall performance.
tldr_zh: FairLLaVA 是一种面向多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）的参数高效微调方法，旨在减少视觉指令调优中不同人群间的偏差，特别是在医学影像领域，且不影响整体性能。

title: Collision-Aware Vision-Language Learning for End-to-End Driving with Multimodal Infraction Datasets
summary: High infraction rates remain the primary bottleneck for end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving, as evidenced by the low driving scores on the CARLA Leaderboard. Despite collision-related infractions being the dominant failure mode in closed-loop evaluations, collision-aware representation learning has received limited attention. To address this gap, we first develop a Video-Language-Augmented Anomaly Detector (VLAAD), leveraging a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) formulation to obtain stable, temporally localized collision signals for proactive prediction. To transition these capabilities into closed-loop simulations, we must overcome the limitations of existing simulator datasets, which lack multimodality and are frequently restricted to simple intersection scenarios. Therefore, we introduce CARLA-Collide, a large-scale multimodal dataset capturing realistic collision events across highly diverse road networks. Trained on this diverse simulator data, VLAAD serves as a collision-aware plug-in module that can be seamlessly integrated into existing E2E driving models. By integrating our module into a pretrained TransFuser++ agent, we demonstrate a 14.12% relative increase in driving score with minimal fine-tuning. Beyond closed-loop evaluation, we further assess the generalization capability of VLAAD in an open-loop setting using real-world driving data. To support this analysis, we introduce Real-Collide, a multimodal dataset of diverse dashcam videos paired with semantically rich annotations for collision detection and prediction. On this benchmark, despite containing only 0.6B parameters, VLAAD outperforms a multi-billion-parameter vision-language model, achieving a 23.3% improvement in AUC.
summary_zh: 高违规率仍然是端到端(E2E)自动驾驶的主要瓶颈，CARLA排行榜上的低驾驶分数就证明了这一点。尽管与碰撞相关的违规是闭环评估中的主要失败模式，但对碰撞感知表征学习的关注仍然有限。为了解决这一问题，我们首先开发了一种视频-语言增强的异常检测器(VLAAD)，利用多实例学习(MIL)公式来获得稳定、时间局部化的碰撞信号，用于主动预测。要将这些能力过渡到闭环仿真中，我们必须克服现有仿真器数据集的局限性，这些数据集缺乏多模态，并且经常仅限于简单的交叉路口场景。因此，我们推出了CARLA-Collide，这是一个大规模多模态数据集，捕捉了高度多样化路网中真实的碰撞事件。VLAAD经过对此多样化仿真器数据的训练，可以作为一个碰撞感知插件模块，无缝集成到现有的E2E驾驶模型中。通过将我们的模块集成到预训练的TransFuser++智能体中，我们展示了在微调幅度极小的情况下驾驶分数相对提高了14.12%。除了闭环评估之外，我们还使用真实世界的驾驶数据在开环环境中进一步评估了VLAAD的泛化能力。为了支持这项分析，我们推出了Real-Collide，这是一个包含多样化行车记录仪视频的多模态数据集，配有用于碰撞检测和预测的语义丰富注释。在这个基准测试中，尽管只包含0.6B个参数，VLAAD优于一个参数量达数十亿的视觉-语言模型，实现了AUC指标23.3%的提升。
tldr: This paper introduces a collision-aware vision-language learning approach for end-to-end autonomous driving, including a novel anomaly detector (VLAAD) and two new multimodal datasets (CARLA-Collide and Real-Collide) to improve collision prediction and avoidance.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于端到端自动驾驶的碰撞感知视觉语言学习方法，包括一种新的异常检测器 (VLAAD) 和两个新的多模态数据集 (CARLA-Collide 和 Real-Collide)，以提高碰撞预测和避免。

title: Reinforcing Structured Chain-of-Thought for Video Understanding
summary: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show promise in video understanding. However, their reasoning often suffers from thinking drift and weak temporal comprehension, even when enhanced by Reinforcement Learning (RL) techniques like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Moreover, existing RL methods usually depend on Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), which requires costly Chain-of-Thought (CoT) annotation and multi-stage training, and enforces fixed reasoning paths, limiting MLLMs' ability to generalize and potentially inducing bias. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Summary-Driven Reinforcement Learning (SDRL), a novel single-stage RL framework that obviates the need for SFT by utilizing a Structured CoT format: Summarize -> Think -> Answer. SDRL introduces two self-supervised mechanisms integrated into the GRPO objective: 1) Consistency of Vision Knowledge (CVK) enforces factual grounding by reducing KL divergence among generated summaries; and 2) Dynamic Variety of Reasoning (DVR) promotes exploration by dynamically modulating thinking diversity based on group accuracy. This novel integration effectively balances alignment and exploration, supervising both the final answer and the reasoning process. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on seven public VideoQA datasets.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型(MLLMs)在视频理解方面展现出潜力。然而，即使通过群体相对策略优化(GRPO)等强化学习(RL)技术增强后，它们的推理仍然常常遭受思维漂移和时间理解薄弱的问题。此外，现有的RL方法通常依赖于监督微调(SFT)，这需要昂贵的思维链(CoT)标注和多阶段训练，并强制执行固定的推理路径，限制了MLLMs的泛化能力，并可能引入偏差。为了克服这些局限，我们引入了一种新型的单阶段RL框架——摘要驱动的强化学习(SDRL)，它通过利用一种结构化的CoT格式：总结->思考->回答，从而避免了对SFT的需求。SDRL引入了两种集成到GRPO目标中的自监督机制：1) 视觉知识一致性(CVK)通过减少生成摘要之间的KL散度来加强事实依据；2) 推理动态多样性(DVR)通过基于群体准确性动态调整思维多样性来促进探索。这种新颖的集成有效地平衡了对齐和探索，从而监督最终答案和推理过程。我们的方法在七个公共VideoQA数据集上实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces Summary-Driven Reinforcement Learning (SDRL), a novel single-stage RL framework for video understanding using MLLMs. It improves reasoning and temporal comprehension by using a structured CoT format and two self-supervised mechanisms to address limitations of existing RL methods that rely on SFT.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Summary-Driven Reinforcement Learning (SDRL)，这是一种用于视频理解的新型单阶段 RL 框架，它使用 MLLM。它通过使用结构化的 CoT 格式和两种自监督机制来改进推理和时间理解，从而解决了现有依赖 SFT 的 RL 方法的局限性。

title: GazeQwen: Lightweight Gaze-Conditioned LLM Modulation for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) cannot effectively utilize eye-gaze information for video understanding, even when gaze cues are supplied via visual overlays or text descriptions. We introduce GazeQwen, a parameter efficient approach that equips an open-source MLLM with gaze awareness through hidden-state modulation. At its core is a compact gaze resampler (~1-5 M trainable parameters) that encodes V-JEPA 2.1 video features together with fixation-derived positional encodings and produces additive residuals injected into selected LLM decoder layers via forward hooks. An optional second training stage adds low-rank adapters (LoRA) to the LLM for tighter integration. Evaluated on all 10 tasks of the StreamGaze benchmark, GazeQwen reaches 63.9% accuracy, a +16.1 point gain over the same Qwen2.5-VL-7B backbone with gaze as visual prompts and +10.5 points over GPT-4o, the highest score among all open-source and proprietary models tested. These results suggest that learning where to inject gaze within an LLM is more effective than scaling model size or engineering better prompts. All code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/phamtrongthang123/gazeqwen .
summary_zh: 当前的多模态大型语言模型 (MLLMs) 即使通过视觉叠加或文本描述提供注视线索，也无法有效地利用眼动追踪信息进行视频理解。我们引入了 GazeQwen，一种参数高效的方法，通过隐藏状态调制赋予开源 MLLM 注视感知能力。其核心是一个紧凑的注视重采样器（约 1-5M 可训练参数），它将 V-JEPA 2.1 视频特征与源自凝视点的位置编码结合起来进行编码，并产生加性残差，通过前向钩子注入到选定的 LLM 解码器层中。一个可选的第二阶段训练将低秩适配器 (LoRA) 添加到 LLM 中，以实现更紧密的集成。在 StreamGaze 基准测试的所有 10 项任务中进行评估时，GazeQwen 达到了 63.9% 的准确率，相比于使用注视作为视觉提示的相同 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 主干网络，提升了 +16.1 个百分点，相比于 GPT-4o，提升了 +10.5 个百分点，这是所有测试的开源和专有模型中的最高分。 这些结果表明，学习在 LLM 中注入注视信息的位置比扩展模型大小或设计更好的提示更有效。所有代码和检查点都可以在 https://github.com/phamtrongthang123/gazeqwen 找到。
tldr: The paper introduces GazeQwen, a parameter-efficient method to incorporate gaze information into MLLMs for improved video understanding, achieving state-of-the-art results on the StreamGaze benchmark.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GazeQwen，一种参数高效的方法，将眼动信息整合到多模态大语言模型中，以提升视频理解能力，并在StreamGaze基准测试中取得了目前最优的结果。

title: The Limits of Learning from Pictures and Text: Vision-Language Models and Embodied Scene Understanding
summary: What information is sufficient to learn the full richness of human scene understanding? The distributional hypothesis holds that the statistical co-occurrence of language and images captures the conceptual knowledge underlying visual cognition. Vision-language models (VLMs) are trained on massive paired text-image corpora but lack embodied experience, making them an ideal test of the distributional hypothesis. We report two experiments comparing descriptions generated by 18 VLMs to those of over 2000 human observers across 15 high-level scene understanding tasks, spanning general knowledge, affordances, sensory experiences, affective responses, and future prediction. Because many tasks lack ground truth answers, we developed a Human-Calibrated Cosine Distance (HCD) metric that measures VLM output similarity to the distribution of human responses, scaled by within-human variability. In Experiment 1, VLMs approached human-level performance on general knowledge tasks, but showed a robust deficit for affordance tasks that resisted prompt engineering and did not improve with newer model releases. In Experiment 2, we tested six mechanistic hypotheses for explaining this affordance gap, finding that the deficit was structural rather than stylistic and was not resolved by providing explicit spatial information. Corpus analyses revealed that image captioning datasets contain sparse agent-addressed affordance language, consistent with Gricean accounts of why embodied knowledge may be systematically underrepresented in language. Together, these findings suggest that distributional learning from images and text is insufficient for affordance-based scene understanding, implying that some dimensions of human visual cognition may require the kind of agent-centered, three-dimensional experience that no photograph or caption can encode.
summary_zh: 哪些信息足以学习人类场景理解的全部丰富性？分布假设认为，语言和图像的统计共现捕捉了视觉认知背后的概念知识。视觉-语言模型(VLMs)在海量配对文本-图像语料库上进行训练，但缺乏具身经验，使其成为检验分布假设的理想选择。我们报告了两项实验，比较了18个VLMs生成的描述与超过2000名人类观察者在15项高阶场景理解任务中的描述，这些任务涵盖一般知识、可供性、感官体验、情感反应和未来预测。由于许多任务缺乏标准答案，我们开发了一种人类校准余弦距离(HCD)度量，用于衡量VLM输出与人类响应分布的相似性，并根据人类内部的变异性进行缩放。在实验1中，VLMs在一般知识任务上接近人类水平，但在可供性任务上表现出明显的不足，这种不足无法通过提示工程来解决，也未随着新模型版本的发布而改善。在实验2中，我们测试了六个用于解释这种可供性差距的机制性假设，发现这种不足是结构性的而非风格性的，并且通过提供明确的空间信息也无法解决。语料库分析表明，图像字幕数据集包含稀疏的、针对代理者的可供性语言，这与格赖斯式解释相一致，即为何具身知识可能会在语言中被系统性地低估。总之，这些发现表明，从图像和文本中进行分布学习不足以进行基于可供性的场景理解，这意味着人类视觉认知的某些维度可能需要代理者为中心的、三维的体验，而这是任何照片或字幕都无法编码的。
tldr: This paper investigates the limitations of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in embodied scene understanding, revealing a performance gap, especially in affordance-related tasks, suggesting that agent-centered experience is vital for comprehensive visual cognition.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了视觉语言模型 (VLM) 在具身场景理解方面的局限性，揭示了模型在任务性能上的差距，尤其是在与可供性相关的任务中，表明以代理为中心的经验对于全面的视觉认知至关重要。

title: OVI-MAP:Open-Vocabulary Instance-Semantic Mapping
summary: Incremental open-vocabulary 3D instance-semantic mapping is essential for autonomous agents operating in complex everyday environments. However, it remains challenging due to the need for robust instance segmentation, real-time processing, and flexible open-set reasoning. Existing methods often rely on the closed-set assumption or dense per-pixel language fusion, which limits scalability and temporal consistency. We introduce OVI-MAP that decouples instance reconstruction from semantic inference. We propose to build a class-agnostic 3D instance map that is incrementally constructed from RGB-D input, while semantic features are extracted only from a small set of automatically selected views using vision-language models. This design enables stable instance tracking and zero-shot semantic labeling throughout online exploration. Our system operates in real time and outperforms state-of-the-art open-vocabulary mapping baselines on standard benchmarks.
summary_zh: 在复杂的日常环境中运行的自主代理需要增量式开放词汇 3D 实例语义地图。然而，由于需要稳健的实例分割、实时处理和灵活的开放集推理，这仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通常依赖于闭集假设或密集的逐像素语言融合，这限制了可扩展性和时间一致性。我们提出了 OVI-MAP，它将实例重建与语义推断分离。我们提出构建一个与类别无关的 3D 实例地图，该地图从 RGB-D 输入以增量方式构建，而语义特征仅从使用视觉-语言模型自动选择的一小部分视图中提取。这种设计能够在在线探索过程中实现稳定的实例跟踪和零样本语义标注。我们的系统实时运行，并在标准基准测试中优于最先进的开放词汇映射基线。
tldr: OVI-MAP introduces a real-time open-vocabulary 3D instance-semantic mapping system that decouples instance reconstruction from semantic inference, enabling robust instance tracking and zero-shot semantic labeling.
tldr_zh: OVI-MAP 提出了一种实时的开放词汇 3D 实例语义建图系统，该系统将实例重建与语义推理分离，从而实现了鲁棒的实例跟踪和零样本语义标注。

title: ClipTTT: CLIP-Guided Test-Time Training Helps LVLMs See Better
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) tend to hallucinate, especially when visual inputs are corrupted at test time. We show that such corruptions act as additional distribution shifts, significantly amplifying hallucination rates in real-world applications. To address this, we propose CLIP-guided Test-Time Training (ClipTTT), a method to adapt LVLMs under degraded conditions on the fly with a single test sample. Specifically, we leverage the image-text alignment strength of a pre-trained CLIP model as a stable guidance signal to identify reliable self-supervision targets, enabling rapid adaptation without altering the base LVLMs. Extensive experiments on standard hallucination benchmarks, with 15 common corruptions, demonstrate that ClipTTT effectively mitigates hallucinations and improves descriptive faithfulness under visual corruptions.
summary_zh: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）倾向于产生幻觉，尤其是在测试时视觉输入受到破坏的情况下。我们发现，这些破坏行为充当了额外的分布偏移，显著放大了现实世界应用中的幻觉率。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种CLIP引导的测试时训练（ClipTTT）方法，以在单一测试样本的基础上，动态地适应退化条件下的LVLMs。具体而言，我们利用预训练CLIP模型的图像-文本对齐强度作为稳定的引导信号，来识别可靠的自监督目标，从而实现快速适应，而无需更改基础LVLMs。在标准幻觉基准上的大量实验，以及15种常见的破坏，表明ClipTTT有效地缓解了幻觉，并提高了视觉破坏下的描述忠实性。
tldr: The paper introduces ClipTTT, a CLIP-guided test-time training method to mitigate hallucinations in LVLMs caused by visual corruptions, adapting models on-the-fly using a single test sample and achieving improved descriptive faithfulness.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为ClipTTT的CLIP引导的测试时训练方法，旨在减轻视觉损坏在LVLMs中引起的幻觉问题。该方法通过单个测试样本即时调整模型，并显著提高了描述的真实性。

title: Dynamic Token Compression for Efficient Video Understanding through Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in video understanding, yet face prohibitive computational costs and performance degradation from ''context rot'' due to massive visual token redundancy. Existing compression strategies typically rely on heuristics or fixed transformations that are often decoupled from the downstream task objectives, limiting their adaptability and effectiveness. To address this, we propose SCORE (Surprise-augmented token COmpression via REinforcement learning), a unified framework that learns an adaptive token compression policy. SCORE introduces a lightweight policy network conditioned on a surprise-augmented state representation that incorporates inter-frame residuals to explicitly capture temporal dynamics and motion saliency. We optimize this policy using a group-wise reinforcement learning scheme with a split-advantage estimator, stabilized by a two-stage curriculum transferring from static pseudo-videos to real dynamic videos. Extensive experiments on diverse video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that SCORE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Notably, SCORE achieves a 16x prefill speedup while preserving 99.5% of original performance at a 10% retention ratio, offering a scalable solution for efficient long-form video understanding.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型在视频理解方面展现出卓越的能力，但由于海量视觉令牌冗余导致的“上下文腐烂”而面临着令人望而却步的计算成本和性能下降。现有的压缩策略通常依赖于启发式方法或固定的转换，这些方法往往与下游任务目标脱钩，从而限制了它们的适应性和有效性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SCORE（基于强化学习的、惊喜增强令牌压缩），一个学习自适应令牌压缩策略的统一框架。SCORE引入了一个轻量级的策略网络，该网络以惊喜增强的状态表示为条件，该状态表示结合了帧间残差来显式地捕获时间动态和运动显著性。 我们使用具有分离优势估计器的分组强化学习方案优化此策略，并通过从静态伪视频到真实动态视频的两阶段课程学习进行稳定。在各种视频理解基准上的大量实验表明，SCORE 显著优于最先进的基线方法。值得注意的是，SCORE 在 10% 的保留率下实现了 16 倍的预填充加速，同时保留了 99.5% 的原始性能，为高效的长视频理解提供了一种可扩展的解决方案。
tldr: This paper introduces SCORE, a reinforcement learning-based method for dynamic video token compression that significantly speeds up video understanding in large language models while preserving performance, addressing the computational cost and context rot issues.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SCORE，一种基于强化学习的动态视频令牌压缩方法，能显著加速大型语言模型中的视频理解，同时保持性能，解决了计算成本和上下文腐烂问题。

title: HandVQA: Diagnosing and Improving Fine-Grained Spatial Reasoning about Hands in Vision-Language Models
summary: Understanding the fine-grained articulation of human hands is critical in high-stakes settings such as robot-assisted surgery, chip manufacturing, and AR/VR-based human-AI interaction. Despite achieving near-human performance on general vision-language benchmarks, current vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with fine-grained spatial reasoning, especially in interpreting complex and articulated hand poses. We introduce HandVQA, a large-scale diagnostic benchmark designed to evaluate VLMs' understanding of detailed hand anatomy through visual question answering. Built upon high-quality 3D hand datasets (FreiHAND, InterHand2.6M, FPHA), our benchmark includes over 1.6M controlled multiple-choice questions that probe spatial relationships between hand joints, such as angles, distances, and relative positions. We evaluate several state-of-the-art VLMs (LLaVA, DeepSeek and Qwen-VL) in both base and fine-tuned settings, using lightweight fine-tuning via LoRA. Our findings reveal systematic limitations in current models, including hallucinated finger parts, incorrect geometric interpretations, and poor generalization. HandVQA not only exposes these critical reasoning gaps but provides a validated path to improvement. We demonstrate that the 3D-grounded spatial knowledge learned from our benchmark transfers in a zero-shot setting, significantly improving accuracy of model on novel downstream tasks like hand gesture recognition (+10.33%) and hand-object interaction (+2.63%).
summary_zh: 理解人手精细的关节运动对于机器人辅助手术、芯片制造以及基于AR/VR的人机交互等高风险环境至关重要。尽管当前的视觉-语言模型(VLMs)在通用视觉-语言基准测试上取得了接近人类的表现，但它们在精细的空间推理方面仍存在困难，尤其是在解释复杂和可动的手部姿势时。我们引入了HandVQA，一个大规模诊断基准，旨在通过视觉问答评估VLMs对手部精细解剖结构的理解。该基准构建于高质量的3D手部数据集（FreiHAND、InterHand2.6M、FPHA）之上，包含超过160万个受控的多项选择题，用于探测手部关节之间的空间关系，如角度、距离和相对位置。我们评估了几种最先进的VLMs（LLaVA、DeepSeek和Qwen-VL），包括基础设置和微调设置，使用LoRA进行轻量级微调。我们的研究结果揭示了当前模型的系统性局限性，包括幻觉的指部部分、不正确的几何解释以及较差的泛化能力。HandVQA不仅暴露了这些关键的推理差距，而且提供了一条经过验证的改进途径。我们证明，从我们的基准学习到的基于3D的空间知识可以在零样本设置中迁移，显著提高模型在新下游任务（如手势识别（+10.33%）和手-物交互（+2.63%））上的准确性。
