tldr: The paper introduces HandVQA, a large-scale diagnostic benchmark, to evaluate and improve vision-language models' fine-grained spatial reasoning about human hands, revealing limitations and demonstrating gains in downstream tasks via fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了HandVQA，一个大规模诊断基准，用于评估和提升视觉-语言模型对手部的细粒度空间推理能力。它揭示了现有模型的局限性，并展示了通过微调在下游任务中的改进。

title: Consistency Beyond Contrast: Enhancing Open-Vocabulary Object Detection Robustness via Contextual Consistency Learning
summary: Recent advances in open-vocabulary object detection focus primarily on two aspects: scaling up datasets and leveraging contrastive learning to align language and vision modalities. However, these approaches often neglect internal consistency within a single modality, particularly when background or environmental changes occur. This lack of consistency leads to a performance drop because the model struggles to detect the same object in different scenes, which reveals a robustness gap. To address this issue, we introduce Contextual Consistency Learning (CCL), a novel framework that integrates two key strategies: Contextual Bootstrapped Data Generation (CBDG) and Contextual Consistency Loss (CCLoss). CBDG functions as a data generation mechanism, producing images that contain the same objects across diverse backgrounds. This is essential because existing datasets alone do not support our CCL framework. The CCLoss further enforces the invariance of object features despite environmental changes, thereby improving the model's robustness in different scenes. These strategies collectively form a unified framework for ensuring contextual consistency within the same modality. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing previous approaches by +16.3 AP on OmniLabel and +14.9 AP on D3. These results demonstrate the importance of enforcing intra-modal consistency, significantly enhancing model generalization in diverse environments. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/bozhao-li/CCL.
summary_zh: 开放词汇目标检测的最新进展主要集中在两个方面：扩大数据集规模和利用对比学习对齐语言和视觉模态。然而，这些方法通常忽略了单一模态内部的一致性，尤其是在背景或环境发生变化时。这种一致性的缺失会导致性能下降，因为模型难以在不同场景中检测到相同的对象，这揭示了一个鲁棒性差距。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了上下文一致性学习（CCL），这是一个集成了两个关键策略的新型框架：上下文引导的数据生成（CBDG）和上下文一致性损失（CCLoss）。CBDG作为一种数据生成机制，生成包含在不同背景下的相同对象的图像。这至关重要，因为现有的数据集本身并不支持我们的CCL框架。CCLoss进一步增强了对象特征在环境变化下的不变性，从而提高了模型在不同场景中的鲁棒性。这些策略共同构成了一个统一的框架，以确保相同模态内的上下文一致性。我们的方法实现了最先进的性能，在OmniLabel上超过之前的方法+16.3 AP，在D3上超过+14.9 AP。这些结果表明了强制执行模态内一致性的重要性，显著增强了模型在不同环境中的泛化能力。我们的代码已在以下地址公开：https://github.com/bozhao-li/CCL。
tldr: This paper introduces Contextual Consistency Learning (CCL), a framework with Contextual Bootstrapped Data Generation (CBDG) and Contextual Consistency Loss (CCLoss) to improve open-vocabulary object detection robustness by enforcing intra-modal consistency, achieving state-of-the-art performance on OmniLabel and D3 datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了上下文一致性学习(CCL)，它包含上下文引导的数据生成(CBDG)和上下文一致性损失(CCLoss)，通过加强模态内的一致性来提高开放词汇目标检测的鲁棒性，并在OmniLabel和D3数据集上取得了领先的性能。

title: Rethinking Token Pruning for Historical Screenshots in GUI Visual Agents: Semantic, Spatial, and Temporal Perspectives
summary: In recent years, GUI visual agents built upon Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong potential in navigation tasks. However, high-resolution GUI screenshots produce a large number of visual tokens, making the direct preservation of complete historical information computationally expensive. In this paper, we conduct an empirical study on token pruning for historical screenshots in GUI scenarios and distill three practical insights that are crucial for designing effective pruning strategies. First, we observe that GUI screenshots exhibit a distinctive foreground-background semantic composition. To probe this property, we apply a simple edge-based separation to partition screenshots into foreground and background regions. Surprisingly, we find that, contrary to the common assumption that background areas have little semantic value, they effectively capture interface-state transitions, thereby providing auxiliary cues for GUI reasoning. Second, compared with carefully designed pruning strategies, random pruning possesses an inherent advantage in preserving spatial structure, enabling better performance under the same computational budget. Finally, we observe that GUI Agents exhibit a recency effect similar to human cognition: by allocating larger token budgets to more recent screenshots and heavily compressing distant ones, we can significantly reduce computational cost while maintaining nearly unchanged performance. These findings offer new insights and practical guidance for the design of efficient GUI visual agents.
summary_zh: 近年来，基于多模态大型语言模型(MLLMs)构建的GUI视觉智能体在导航任务中展现出强大的潜力。然而，高分辨率GUI屏幕截图会产生大量的视觉tokens，使得直接保留完整的历史信息在计算上代价高昂。在本文中，我们对 GUI 场景中历史屏幕截图的 token 剪枝进行了一项实证研究，并提炼出三个对于设计有效剪枝策略至关重要的实践性见解。首先，我们观察到 GUI 屏幕截图呈现出一种独特的前景-背景语义构成。为了探究这一特性，我们应用一种简单的基于边缘的分离方法将屏幕截图分割成前景和背景区域。令人惊讶的是，我们发现，与通常认为背景区域语义价值小的假设相反，它们有效地捕捉了界面状态转换，从而为 GUI 推理提供了辅助线索。其次，与精心设计的剪枝策略相比，随机剪枝在保留空间结构方面具有内在优势，从而在相同的计算预算下实现更好的性能。最后，我们观察到 GUI 智能体表现出类似于人类认知的近因效应：通过为最近的屏幕截图分配更大的token预算，并大量压缩较远的屏幕截图，我们可以在计算成本几乎不变的情况下保持几乎不变的性能。这些发现为高效GUI视觉智能体的设计提供了新的见解和实践指导。
tldr: This paper investigates token pruning strategies for historical GUI screenshots in visual agents, finding that background regions, random pruning, and recency-based token allocation can improve efficiency without significantly impacting performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了视觉代理中历史GUI屏幕截图的令牌修剪策略，发现背景区域、随机修剪和基于新近度的令牌分配可以在不显着影响性能的情况下提高效率。

title: Knowledge is Power: Advancing Few-shot Action Recognition with Multimodal Semantics from MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have propelled the field of few-shot action recognition (FSAR). However, preliminary explorations in this area primarily focus on generating captions to form a suboptimal feature->caption->feature pipeline and adopt metric learning solely within the visual space. In this paper, we propose FSAR-LLaVA, the first end-to-end method to leverage MLLMs (such as Video-LLaVA) as a multimodal knowledge base for directly enhancing FSAR. First, at the feature level, we leverage the MLLM's multimodal decoder to extract spatiotemporally and semantically enriched representations, which are then decoupled and enhanced by our Multimodal Feature-Enhanced Module into distinct visual and textual features that fully exploit their semantic knowledge for FSAR. Next, we leverage the versatility of MLLMs to craft input prompts that flexibly adapt to diverse scenarios, and use their aligned outputs to drive our designed Composite Task-Oriented Prototype Construction, effectively bridging the distribution gap between meta-train and meta-test sets. Finally, to enable multimodal features to guide metric learning jointly, we introduce a training-free Multimodal Prototype Matching Metric that adaptively selects the most decisive cues and efficiently leverages the decoupled feature representations produced by MLLMs. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior performance across various tasks with minimal trainable parameters.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）推动了小样本动作识别（FSAR）领域的发展。然而，该领域的初步探索主要集中在生成字幕以形成次优的特征->字幕->特征的流水线，并且仅在视觉空间内采用度量学习。在本文中，我们提出了FSAR-LLaVA，这是第一个利用MLLM（例如Video-LLaVA）作为多模态知识库来直接增强FSAR的端到端方法。首先，在特征层面上，我们利用MLLM的多模态解码器来提取时空语义增强的表达，然后通过我们的多模态特征增强模块将其解耦并增强为不同的视觉和文本特征，从而充分利用它们的语义知识进行FSAR。接下来，我们利用MLLM的通用性来设计灵活适应各种场景的输入提示，并使用其对齐的输出来驱动我们设计的复合面向任务的原型构建，有效地弥合元训练集和元测试集之间的分布差距。最后，为了使多模态特征能够共同指导度量学习，我们引入了一种无需训练的多模态原型匹配度量，该度量自适应地选择最具决定性的线索，并有效地利用MLLM产生的解耦特征表达。 广泛的实验表明，该方法在各种任务中表现出卓越的性能，且仅需极少的训练参数。
tldr: This paper introduces FSAR-LLaVA, an end-to-end method that leverages MLLMs as a multimodal knowledge base to enhance few-shot action recognition by extracting enriched representations and using a novel prototype construction and matching metric.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了FSAR-LLaVA，一种端到端方法，利用 MLLM 作为多模态知识库来增强少样本动作识别，通过提取丰富的表示并使用新颖的原型构建和匹配指标。

title: Ruka-v2: Tendon Driven Open-Source Dexterous Hand with Wrist and Abduction for Robot Learning
summary: Lack of accessible and dexterous robot hardware has been a significant bottleneck to achieving human-level dexterity in robots. Last year, we released Ruka, a fully open-sourced, tendon-driven humanoid hand with 11 degrees of freedom - 2 per finger and 3 at the thumb - buildable for under $1,300. It was one of the first fully open-sourced humanoid hands, and introduced a novel data-driven approach to finger control that captures tendon dynamics within the control system. Despite these contributions, Ruka lacked two degrees of freedom essential for closely imitating human behavior: wrist mobility and finger adduction/abduction. In this paper, we introduce Ruka-v2: a fully open-sourced, tendon-driven humanoid hand featuring a decoupled 2-DOF parallel wrist and abduction/adduction at the fingers. The parallel wrist adds smooth, independent flexion/extension and radial/ulnar deviation, enabling manipulation in confined environments such as cabinets. Abduction enables motions such as grasping thin objects, in-hand rotation, and calligraphy. We present the design of Ruka-v2 and evaluate it against Ruka through user studies on teleoperated tasks, finding a 51.3% reduction in completion time and a 21.2% increase in success rate. We further demonstrate its full range of applications for robot learning: bimanual and single-arm teleoperation across 13 dexterous tasks, and autonomous policy learning on 3 tasks. All 3D print files, assembly instructions, controller software, and videos are available at https://ruka-hand-v2.github.io/ .
summary_zh: 缺乏易用且灵巧的机器人硬件一直是实现机器人达到人类级别灵巧性的一个重要瓶颈。去年，我们发布了 Ruka，一个完全开源、肌腱驱动的人形手，拥有 11 个自由度——每个手指 2 个，拇指 3 个——构建成本低于 1300 美元。它是首批完全开源的人形手之一，并引入了一种新颖的数据驱动的指尖控制方法，该方法在控制系统中捕获肌腱动力学。尽管做出了这些贡献，Ruka 仍然缺乏两种对于密切模仿人类行为至关重要的自由度：腕部活动性和手指内收/外展。在本文中，我们介绍了 Ruka-v2：一个完全开源、肌腱驱动的人形手，具有解耦的 2 自由度并联腕部和手指上的内收/外展功能。并联腕部增加了平滑、独立的屈伸和桡尺偏，从而能够在橱柜等封闭环境中进行操作。外展功能实现了诸如抓握薄物、手内旋转和书法等运动。我们展示了 Ruka-v2 的设计，并通过对远程操作任务的用户研究评估了其相对于 Ruka 的性能，发现完成时间缩短了 51.3%，成功率提高了 21.2%。我们进一步展示了它在机器人学习方面的全方位应用：在 13 项灵巧任务中进行双臂和单臂远程操作，以及在 3 项任务中进行自主策略学习。所有 3D 打印文件、组装说明、控制器软件和视频均可在 https://ruka-hand-v2.github.io/ 上获取。
tldr: The paper introduces Ruka-v2, an open-source, tendon-driven dexterous hand with added wrist mobility and finger adduction/abduction, demonstrating improved performance in teleoperated tasks and potential for robot learning applications.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Ruka-v2，一个开源的、肌腱驱动的灵巧手，增加了腕部活动性和手指内收/外展功能，展示了在遥操作任务中性能的提升以及在机器人学习应用中的潜力。

title: Partial Motion Imitation for Learning Cart Pushing with Legged Manipulators
summary: Loco-manipulation is a key capability for legged robots to perform practical mobile manipulation tasks, such as transporting and pushing objects, in real-world environments. However, learning robust loco-manipulation skills remains challenging due to the difficulty of maintaining stable locomotion while simultaneously performing precise manipulation behaviors. This work proposes a partial imitation learning approach that transfers the locomotion style learned from a locomotion task to cart loco-manipulation. A robust locomotion policy is first trained with extensive domain and terrain randomization, and a loco-manipulation policy is then learned by imitating only lower-body motions using a partial adversarial motion prior. We conduct experiments demonstrating that the learned policy successfully pushes a cart along diverse trajectories in IsaacLab and transfers effectively to MuJoCo. We also compare our method to several baselines and show that the proposed approach achieves more stable and accurate loco-manipulation behaviors.
summary_zh: 腿部机器人执行实际移动操作任务（例如在真实环境中搬运和推动物体）的关键能力是运动操作结合（Loco-manipulation）。然而，学习稳健的运动操作结合技能仍然具有挑战性，因为需要在保持稳定运动的同时执行精确的操作行为。本工作提出了一种部分模仿学习方法，将从运动任务中学习到的运动风格迁移到推车运动操作结合。首先，通过大量的领域和地形随机化训练一个稳健的运动策略，然后使用部分对抗运动先验通过仅模仿下半身运动来学习运动操作结合策略。我们进行了实验，证明学习到的策略成功地在IsaacLab中沿着不同的轨迹推动推车，并有效地迁移到MuJoCo。我们还将我们的方法与几个基线进行比较，表明所提出的方法实现了更稳定和准确的运动操作结合行为。
tldr: This paper presents a partial imitation learning approach for legged robots to perform cart pushing, transferring robust locomotion policies learned from locomotion tasks to loco-manipulation by imitating only lower-body motions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种部分模仿学习方法，使腿式机器人能够执行推车任务。该方法通过模仿下半身运动，将从运动任务中学到的鲁棒运动策略迁移到移动操作中。

title: Addressing Ambiguity in Imitation Learning through Product of Experts based Negative Feedback
summary: Programming robots to perform complex tasks is often difficult and time consuming, requiring expert knowledge and skills in robot software and sometimes hardware. Imitation learning is a method for training robots to perform tasks by leveraging human expertise through demonstrations. Typically, the assumption is that those demonstrations are performed by a single, highly competent expert. However, in many real-world applications that use user demonstrations for tasks or incorporate both user data and pretrained data, such as home robotics including assistive robots, this is unlikely to be the case. This paper presents research towards a system which can leverage suboptimal demonstrations to solve ambiguous tasks; and particularly learn from its own failures. This is a negative-feedback system which achieves significant improvement over purely positive imitation learning for ambiguous tasks, achieving a 90% improvement in success rate against a system that does not utilise negative feedback, compared to a 50% improvement in success rate when utilised on a real robot, as well as demonstrating higher efficacy, memory efficiency and time efficiency than a comparable negative feedback scheme. The novel scheme presented in this paper is validated through simulated and real-robot experiments.
summary_zh: 对机器人进行编程以执行复杂任务通常困难且耗时，需要机器人软件甚至硬件方面的专业知识和技能。模仿学习是一种利用人类专家的示范来训练机器人执行任务的方法。通常，假设这些示范由单个、高度胜任的专家执行。然而，在许多使用用户示范进行任务或整合用户数据和预训练数据的实际应用中，例如包括辅助机器人在内的家庭机器人，这种情况不太可能存在。本文提出了一项研究，旨在开发一个能够利用次优示范来解决模糊任务的系统，尤其是能够从自身失败中学习。这是一个负反馈系统，对于模糊任务，其性能比纯粹的正向模仿学习有显著提升，成功率比不使用负反馈的系统提高90%，而应用于真实机器人时，成功率提高50%，并且在有效性、内存效率和时间效率方面都高于可比的负反馈方案。本文提出的新型方案通过模拟和真实机器人实验进行了验证。
tldr: This paper introduces a negative-feedback system for imitation learning that uses a product-of-experts approach to handle suboptimal demonstrations and learn from failures, demonstrating significant improvements in success rate and efficiency in simulated and real-robot environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于模仿学习的负反馈系统，该系统采用基于专家乘积的方法来处理次优演示并从失败中学习，在模拟和真实机器人环境中均表现出显着的成功率和效率提升。

title: Line-of-Sight-Constrained Multi-Robot Mapless Navigation via Polygonal Visible Regions
summary: Multi-robot systems rely on underlying connectivity to ensure reliable communication and timely coordination. This paper studies the line-of-sight (LoS) connectivity maintenance problem in multi-robot navigation with unknown obstacles. Prior works typically assume known environment maps to formulate LoS constraints between robots, which hinders their practical deployment. To overcome this limitation, we propose an inherently distributed approach where each robot only constructs an egocentric visible region based on its real-time LiDAR scans, instead of endeavoring to build a global map online. The individual visible regions are shared through distributed communication to establish inter-robot LoS constraints, which are then incorporated into a multi-robot navigation framework to ensure LoS-connectivity. Moreover, we enhance the robustness of connectivity maintenance by proposing a more accurate LoS-distance metric, which further enables flexible topology optimization that eliminates redundant and effort-demanding connections. The proposed framework is evaluated through extensive multi-robot navigation and exploration tasks in both simulation and real-world experiments. Results show that it reliably maintains LoS-connectivity between robots in challenging environments cluttered with obstacles, even under large visible ranges and fragile minimal topologies, where existing methods consistently fail. Ablation studies also reveal that topology optimization boosts navigation efficiency by around $20\%$, demonstrating the framework's potential for efficient navigation under connectivity constraints.
summary_zh: 多机器人系统依赖于底层连通性来确保可靠的通信和及时的协调。本文研究了未知障碍物环境下多机器人导航中的视线（LoS）连通性维护问题。以往的工作通常假设环境地图已知，以此建立机器人之间的视线约束，这阻碍了它们的实际部署。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了一种本质上分布式的方案，其中每个机器人仅基于其实时激光雷达扫描构建以自我为中心的可见区域，而不是努力在线构建全局地图。各个可见区域通过分布式通信共享，以建立机器人间的视线约束，然后将其纳入多机器人导航框架中，以确保视线连通性。此外，我们通过提出一种更精确的视线距离度量来增强连通性维护的鲁棒性，该度量进一步实现了灵活的拓扑优化，从而消除了冗余且耗费精力的连接。所提出的框架通过在模拟和真实世界实验中进行的大量多机器人导航和探索任务进行了评估。结果表明，即使在具有大可见范围和脆弱的最小拓扑结构的情况下，在充满障碍物的具有挑战性的环境中，它也能可靠地维持机器人之间的视线连通性，而现有方法始终无法做到。消融研究还表明，拓扑优化将导航效率提高了约20％，证明了该框架在连通性约束下高效导航的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces a distributed, mapless multi-robot navigation framework that maintains line-of-sight connectivity using LiDAR-based visible regions and topology optimization, outperforming existing methods in challenging environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分布式、无地图的多机器人导航框架，该框架使用基于激光雷达的可见区域和拓扑优化来维持视线连接，并在具有挑战性的环境中优于现有方法。

title: DRUM: Diffusion-based Raydrop-aware Unpaired Mapping for Sim2Real LiDAR Segmentation
summary: LiDAR-based semantic segmentation is a key component for autonomous mobile robots, yet large-scale annotation of LiDAR point clouds is prohibitively expensive and time-consuming. Although simulators can provide labeled synthetic data, models trained on synthetic data often underperform on real-world data due to a data-level domain gap. To address this issue, we propose DRUM, a novel Sim2Real translation framework. We leverage a diffusion model pre-trained on unlabeled real-world data as a generative prior and translate synthetic data by reproducing two key measurement characteristics: reflectance intensity and raydrop noise. To improve sample fidelity, we introduce a raydrop-aware masked guidance mechanism that selectively enforces consistency with the input synthetic data while preserving realistic raydrop noise induced by the diffusion prior. Experimental results demonstrate that DRUM consistently improves Sim2Real performance across multiple representations of LiDAR data. The project page is available at https://miya-tomoya.github.io/drum.
summary_zh: 基于激光雷达的语义分割是自主移动机器人的关键组成部分，然而大规模激光雷达点云的标注成本高昂且耗时。尽管模拟器可以提供带标签的合成数据，但由于数据层面的领域差异，在合成数据上训练的模型在真实世界数据上的表现往往不佳。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的Sim2Real转换框架 DRUM。我们利用在未标记的真实世界数据上预训练的扩散模型作为生成先验，并通过重现两个关键测量特性：反射强度和射束衰减噪声来转换合成数据。为了提高样本的保真度，我们引入了一种射束衰减感知的掩码引导机制，该机制选择性地强制与输入合成数据的一致性，同时保留由扩散先验引起的真实射束衰减噪声。实验结果表明，DRUM 在激光雷达数据的多种表达形式下都能持续提高 Sim2Real 性能。项目主页可在 https://miya-tomoya.github.io/drum 访问。
tldr: The paper introduces DRUM, a Sim2Real translation framework using diffusion models to address the domain gap in LiDAR semantic segmentation by reproducing reflectance intensity and raydrop noise, improving performance when transferring from synthetic to real-world data.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DRUM，一个使用扩散模型的Sim2Real转换框架，通过重现反射强度和激光雷达射线缺失噪声来解决激光雷达语义分割中的领域差距，从而提高从合成数据到真实数据迁移时的性能。

title: SwarmCoDe: A Scalable Co-Design Framework for Heterogeneous Robot Swarms via Dynamic Speciation
summary: Robot swarms offer inherent robustness and the capacity to execute complex, collaborative tasks surpassing the capabilities of single-agent systems. Co-designing these systems is critical, as marginal improvements in individual performance or unit cost compound significantly at scale. However, under traditional frameworks, this scale renders co-design intractable due to exponentially large, non-intuitive design spaces. To address this, we propose SwarmCoDe, a novel Collaborative Co-Evolutionary Algorithm (CCEA) that utilizes dynamic speciation to automatically scale swarm heterogeneity to match task complexity. Inspired by biological signaling mechanisms for inter-species cooperation, the algorithm uses evolved genetic tags and a selectivity gene to facilitate the emergent identification of symbiotically beneficial partners without predefined species boundaries. Additionally, an evolved dominance gene dictates the relative swarm composition, decoupling the physical swarm size from the evolutionary population. We apply SwarmCoDe to simultaneously optimize task planning and hardware morphology under fabrication budgets, successfully evolving specialized swarms of up to 200 agents -- four times the size of the evolutionary population. This framework provides a scalable, computationally viable pathway for the holistic co-design of large-scale, heterogeneous robot swarms.
summary_zh: 机器人集群具有固有的鲁棒性，并具备执行复杂协作任务的能力，超越了单智能体系统的局限。对这些系统进行协同设计至关重要，因为个体性能或单位成本的边际改进在规模化后会显著累积。然而，在传统框架下，这种规模使得协同设计变得难以处理，原因是其设计空间呈指数级增长且难以直观理解。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的协同进化算法（CCEA）——SwarmCoDe，它利用动态物种形成来自动调整集群异构性，以匹配任务的复杂性。受到物种间合作的生物信号机制的启发，该算法采用进化出的基因标签和一个选择性基因，以促进共生受益伙伴的涌现式识别，而无需预定义的物种边界。此外，一个进化出的显性基因控制着集群的相对构成，从而将物理集群规模与进化种群规模分离。我们将SwarmCoDe应用于在制造预算约束下同时优化任务规划和硬件形态，成功进化出多达200个智能体的专业集群——是进化种群规模的四倍。该框架为大规模异构机器人集群的整体协同设计提供了一条可扩展、计算上可行的途径。
tldr: The paper introduces SwarmCoDe, a co-evolutionary algorithm for designing heterogeneous robot swarms that scales to large swarm sizes by using dynamic speciation and evolved genetic tags to identify beneficial partnerships.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为SwarmCoDe的协同进化算法，用于设计异构机器人群，通过动态物种形成和进化基因标签来识别有益的伙伴关系，从而扩展到大型群规模。

title: 4DRaL: Bridging 4D Radar with LiDAR for Place Recognition using Knowledge Distillation
summary: Place recognition is crucial for loop closure detection and global localization in robotics. Although mainstream algorithms typically rely on cameras and LiDAR, these sensors are susceptible to adverse weather conditions. Fortunately, the recently developed 4D millimeter-wave radar (4D radar) offers a promising solution for all-weather place recognition. However, the inherent noise and sparsity in 4D radar data significantly limit its performance. Thus, in this paper, we propose a novel framework called 4DRaL that leverages knowledge distillation (KD) to enhance the place recognition performance of 4D radar. Its core is to adopt a high-performance LiDAR-to-LiDAR (L2L) place recognition model as a teacher to guide the training of a 4D radar-to-4D radar (R2R) place recognition model. 4DRaL comprises three key KD modules: a local image enhancement module to handle the sparsity of raw 4D radar points, a feature distribution distillation module that ensures the student model generates more discriminative features, and a response distillation module to maintain consistency in feature space between the teacher and student models. More importantly, 4DRaL can also be trained for 4D radar-to-LiDAR (R2L) place recognition through different module configurations. Experimental results prove that 4DRaL achieves state-of-the-art performance in both R2R and R2L tasks regardless of normal or adverse weather.
summary_zh: 位姿识别在机器人学中对于闭环检测和全局定位至关重要。尽管主流算法通常依赖于相机和激光雷达，但这些传感器容易受到恶劣天气条件的影响。幸运的是，最近开发的4D毫米波雷达（4D雷达）为全天候位姿识别提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，4D雷达数据固有的噪声和稀疏性显著限制了其性能。因此，本文提出了一种名为4DRaL的新型框架，该框架利用知识蒸馏（KD）来提高4D雷达的位姿识别性能。其核心是采用高性能的激光雷达-激光雷达（L2L）位姿识别模型作为教师，来指导4D雷达-4D雷达（R2R）位姿识别模型的训练。4DRaL包含三个关键的KD模块：一个用于处理原始4D雷达点云稀疏性的局部图像增强模块，一个确保学生模型生成更具判别性特征的特征分布蒸馏模块，以及一个保持教师和学生模型在特征空间中一致性的响应蒸馏模块。更重要的是，通过不同的模块配置，4DRaL也可以训练用于4D雷达-激光雷达（R2L）位姿识别。实验结果证明，无论在正常或恶劣天气下，4DRaL在R2R和R2L任务中均实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: The paper introduces 4DRaL, a knowledge distillation framework that enhances 4D radar-based place recognition by leveraging LiDAR data, achieving state-of-the-art performance in various weather conditions for both radar-to-radar and radar-to-LiDAR tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了4DRaL，一个知识蒸馏框架，通过利用LiDAR数据来增强基于4D雷达的地点识别能力，在各种天气条件下，在雷达到雷达以及雷达到LiDAR的任务中均实现了最先进的性能。

title: CADSmith: Multi-Agent CAD Generation with Programmatic Geometric Validation
summary: Existing methods for text-to-CAD generation either operate in a single pass with no geometric verification or rely on lossy visual feedback that cannot resolve dimensional errors. We present CADSmith, a multi-agent pipeline that generates CadQuery code from natural language. It then undergoes an iterative refinement process through two nested correction loops: an inner loop that resolves execution errors and an outer loop grounded in programmatic geometric validation. The outer loop combines exact measurements from the OpenCASCADE kernel (bounding box dimensions, volume, solid validity) with holistic visual assessment from an independent vision-language model Judge. This provides both the numerical precision and the high-level shape awareness needed to converge on the correct geometry. The system uses retrieval-augmented generation over API documentation rather than fine-tuning, maintaining a current database as the underlying CAD library evolves. We evaluate on a custom benchmark of 100 prompts in three difficulty tiers (T1 through T3) with three ablation configurations. Against a zero-shot baseline, CADSmith achieves a 100% execution rate (up from 95%), improves the median F1 score from 0.9707 to 0.9846, the median IoU from 0.8085 to 0.9629, and reduces the mean Chamfer Distance from 28.37 to 0.74, demonstrating that closed-loop refinement with programmatic geometric feedback substantially improves the quality and reliability of LLM-generated CAD models.
summary_zh: 现有的文本到CAD生成方法要么在单次流程中运行且没有几何验证，要么依赖于有损的视觉反馈，无法解决尺寸误差。我们提出了CADSmith，一个从自然语言生成CadQuery代码的多智能体流水线。然后，它会经过一个通过两个嵌套校正循环进行迭代细化的过程：一个解决执行错误的内循环和一个基于程序化几何验证的外循环。外循环结合了来自OpenCASCADE内核的精确测量（边界框尺寸、体积、实体有效性）和来自独立视觉-语言模型Judge的整体视觉评估。这提供了收敛到正确几何体所需的数值精度和高层形状感知能力。该系统使用基于API文档的检索增强生成，而非微调，从而在底层CAD库演化时维护最新的数据库。我们在一个包含三个难度等级（T1到T3）的100个提示的自定义基准上，使用三种消融配置进行了评估。与零样本基线相比，CADSmith实现了100%的执行率（从95%提升），将F1中位数从0.9707提高到0.9846，将IoU中位数从0.8085提高到0.9629，并将平均Chamfer距离从28.37降低到0.74，这表明，通过程序化几何反馈进行闭环细化能够显著提高LLM生成的CAD模型的质量和可靠性。
tldr: CADSmith is a multi-agent system that leverages LLMs to generate CadQuery code from text, using programmatic geometric validation and visual assessment within nested loops to refine the CAD model and improve accuracy.
tldr_zh: CADSmith是一个多代理系统，利用LLM从文本生成CadQuery代码，并在嵌套循环中使用程序化的几何验证和视觉评估来优化CAD模型并提高精度。

title: Can AI Models Direct Each Other? Organizational Structure as a Probe into Training Limitations
summary: Can an expensive AI model effectively direct a cheap one to solve software engineering tasks? We study this question by introducing ManagerWorker, a two-agent pipeline where an expensive "manager" model (text-only, no code execution) analyzes issues, dispatches exploration tasks, and reviews implementations, while a cheap "worker" model (with full repo access) executes code changes. We evaluate on 200 instances from SWE-bench Lite across five configurations that vary the manager-worker relationship, pipeline complexity, and model pairing. Our findings reveal both the promise and the limits of multi-agent direction: (1) a strong manager directing a weak worker (62%) matches a strong single agent (60%) at a fraction of the strong-model token usage, showing that expensive reasoning can substitute for expensive execution; (2) a weak manager directing a weak worker (42%) performs worse than the weak agent alone (44%), demonstrating that the directing relationship requires a genuine capability gap--structure without substance is pure overhead; (3) the manager's value lies in directing, not merely reviewing--a minimal review-only loop adds just 2pp over the baseline, while structured exploration and planning add 11pp, showing that active direction is what makes the capability gap productive; and (4) these behaviors trace to a single root cause: current models are trained as monolithic agents, and splitting them into director/worker roles fights their training distribution. The pipeline succeeds by designing around this mismatch--keeping each model close to its trained mode (text generation for the manager, tool use for the worker) and externalizing organizational structure to code. This diagnosis points to concrete training gaps: delegation, scoped execution, and mode switching are skills absent from current training data.
summary_zh: 一个昂贵的AI模型能否有效地指导一个廉价的AI模型来解决软件工程任务？我们通过引入ManagerWorker架构来研究这个问题，这是一个双代理流水线，其中一个昂贵的“管理者”模型（纯文本，不执行代码）分析问题、派遣探索任务，并审查实现，而一个廉价的“工作者”模型（完全访问代码库）执行代码变更。我们使用来自SWE-bench Lite的200个实例进行评估，这些实例跨越五种配置，这些配置改变了管理者-工作者的关系、流水线复杂度和模型配对。我们的结果揭示了多代理指导的希望和局限性：（1）一个强大的管理者指导一个弱小的工作者（62%），其表现与一个强大的单代理（60%）相当，但仅消耗强大模型的一小部分token用量，表明昂贵的推理可以替代昂贵的执行；（2）一个弱小的管理者指导一个弱小的工作者（42%），其表现比弱小代理单独工作（44%）更差，这表明指导关系需要真正的能力差距——没有实质内容只有结构纯粹是额外开销；（3）管理者的价值在于指导，而不仅仅是审查——一个最小的仅审查循环仅比基线提高了2个百分点，而结构化的探索和规划提高了11个百分点，表明积极的指导才是使能力差距产生效益的原因；（4）这些行为可以追溯到一个根本原因：当前的模型被训练成单体代理，将它们拆分成指导者/工作者角色会与它们的训练分布相冲突。该流水线通过围绕这种不匹配进行设计而取得成功——保持每个模型接近其训练模式（管理者进行文本生成，工作者使用工具），并将组织结构外化为代码。这种诊断指向了具体的训练差距：委派、范围限定的执行和模式切换是当前训练数据中缺失的技能。
tldr: This paper explores using a large language model to direct a smaller language model in software engineering tasks, finding that a capability gap between the director and worker is crucial for success and that current models struggle with delegation due to monolithic training.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用大型语言模型指导小型语言模型完成软件工程任务，发现指导者和执行者之间的能力差距对于成功至关重要，并且由于目前的模型是单体训练，因此在委派任务方面存在困难。

title: MemCam: Memory-Augmented Camera Control for Consistent Video Generation
summary: Interactive video generation has significant potential for scene simulation and video creation. However, existing methods often struggle with maintaining scene consistency during long video generation under dynamic camera control due to limited contextual information. To address this challenge, we propose MemCam, a memory-augmented interactive video generation approach that treats previously generated frames as external memory and leverages them as contextual conditioning to achieve controllable camera viewpoints with high scene consistency. To enable longer and more relevant context, we design a context compression module that encodes memory frames into compact representations and employs co-visibility-based selection to dynamically retrieve the most relevant historical frames, thereby reducing computational overhead while enriching contextual information. Experiments on interactive video generation tasks show that MemCam significantly outperforms existing baseline methods as well as open-source state-of-the-art approaches in terms of scene consistency, particularly in long video scenarios with large camera rotations.
summary_zh: 交互式视频生成在场景模拟和视频创作方面具有巨大的潜力。然而，由于上下文信息有限，现有方法通常难以在动态相机控制下进行长视频生成时保持场景一致性。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种记忆增强的交互式视频生成方法MemCam，它将先前生成的帧视为外部记忆，并利用它们作为上下文条件，以实现可控的相机视角和高度的场景一致性。为了启用更长且更相关的上下文，我们设计了一个上下文压缩模块，将记忆帧编码成紧凑的表示形式，并采用基于共视性的选择来动态检索最相关的历史帧，从而在减少计算开销的同时丰富上下文信息。在交互式视频生成任务上的实验表明，MemCam在场景一致性方面显著优于现有的基线方法以及开源的最新方法，尤其是在具有大相机旋转的长视频场景中。
tldr: MemCam addresses the problem of maintaining scene consistency in interactive video generation with dynamic camera control by using previous frames as external memory and employing a co-visibility-based frame selection mechanism to enrich contextual information. The method outperforms existing baselines, especially in long videos with significant camera rotations.
tldr_zh: MemCam 旨在解决交互式视频生成中动态相机控制下场景一致性的问题，它利用先前的帧作为外部记忆，并采用基于共视性的帧选择机制来丰富上下文信息。该方法优于现有的基线，尤其是在具有显著相机旋转的长视频中。

title: DiReCT: Disentangled Regularization of Contrastive Trajectories for Physics-Refined Video Generation
summary: Flow-matching video generators produce temporally coherent, high-fidelity outputs yet routinely violate elementary physics because their reconstruction objectives penalize per-frame deviations without distinguishing physically consistent dynamics from impossible ones. Contrastive flow matching offers a principled remedy by pushing apart velocity-field trajectories of differing conditions, but we identify a fundamental obstacle in the text-conditioned video setting: semantic-physics entanglement. Because natural-language prompts couple scene content with physical behavior, naive negative sampling draws conditions whose velocity fields largely overlap with the positive sample's, causing the contrastive gradient to directly oppose the flow-matching objective. We formalize this gradient conflict, deriving a precise alignment condition that reveals when contrastive learning helps versus harms training. Guided by this analysis, we introduce DiReCT (Disentangled Regularization of Contrastive Trajectories), a lightweight post-training framework that decomposes the contrastive signal into two complementary scales: a macro-contrastive term that draws partition-exclusive negatives from semantically distant regions for interference-free global trajectory separation, and a micro-contrastive term that constructs hard negatives sharing full scene semantics with the positive sample but differing along a single, LLM-perturbed axis of physical behavior; spanning kinematics, forces, materials, interactions, and magnitudes. A velocity-space distributional regularizer helps to prevent catastrophic forgetting of pretrained visual quality. When applied to Wan 2.1-1.3B, our method improves the physical commonsense score on VideoPhy by 16.7% and 11.3% compared to the baseline and SFT, respectively, without increasing training time.
summary_zh: 流匹配视频生成器能够生成时间上连贯、高保真的输出，但却经常违反基本的物理定律，因为它们的重构目标会惩罚每帧的偏差，而没有区分物理上一致的动态和不可能的动态。对比流匹配通过推开不同条件下的速度场轨迹提供了一种原则性的补救方法，但我们在文本条件视频设置中发现了根本性的障碍：语义-物理缠结。由于自然语言提示将场景内容与物理行为耦合在一起，朴素的负采样绘制出的条件，其速度场与正样本的速度场大部分重叠，导致对比梯度直接与流匹配目标相反。我们形式化了这种梯度冲突，推导出一个精确的对齐条件，揭示了对比学习何时有助于训练，何时有害于训练。在这一分析的指导下，我们引入了DiReCT（解耦对比轨迹正则化），这是一个轻量级的后训练框架，它将对比信号分解为两个互补的尺度：一个宏观对比项，它从语义上遥远的区域绘制分区互斥的负样本，以实现无干扰的全局轨迹分离；一个微观对比项，它构建硬负样本，这些样本与正样本共享完整的场景语义，但在单一的、由LLM扰动的物理行为轴上存在差异；涵盖运动学、力、材料、交互和大小。速度空间分布正则化器有助于防止预训练的视觉质量发生灾难性遗忘。当应用于Wan 2.1-1.3B时，我们的方法在VideoPhy上将物理常识分数分别比基线和SFT提高了16.7%和11.3%，而没有增加训练时间。
tldr: The paper introduces DiReCT, a post-training framework that disentangles semantic and physics in text-to-video generation by using macro- and micro-contrastive learning with LLM-perturbed negatives, significantly improving physical commonsense without retraining.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DiReCT，一个后训练框架，通过使用宏观和微观对比学习以及LLM扰动负样本，来解耦文本到视频生成中的语义和物理信息，从而显著提高了物理常识，而无需重新训练。

title: On Integrating Resilience and Human Oversight into LLM-Assisted Modeling Workflows for Digital Twins
summary: LLM-assisted modeling holds the potential to rapidly build executable Digital Twins of complex systems from only coarse descriptions and sensor data. However, resilience to LLM hallucination, human oversight, and real-time model adaptability remain challenging and often mutually conflicting requirements. We present three critical design principles for integrating resilience and oversight into such workflows, derived from insights gained through our work on FactoryFlow - an open-source LLM-assisted framework for building simulation-based Digital Twins of manufacturing systems. First, orthogonalize structural modeling and parameter fitting. Structural descriptions (components, interconnections) are LLM-translated from coarse natural language to an intermediate representation with human visualization and validation, which is algorithmically converted to the final model. Parameter inference, in contrast, operates continuously on sensor data streams with expert-tunable controls. Second, restrict the model IR to interconnections of parameterized, pre-validated library components rather than monolithic simulation code, enabling interpretability and error-resilience. Third, and most important, is to use a density-preserving IR. When IR descriptions expand dramatically from compact inputs hallucination errors accumulate proportionally. We present the case for Python as a density-preserving IR : loops express regularity compactly, classes capture hierarchy and composition, and the result remains highly readable while exploiting LLMs strong code generation capabilities. A key contribution is detailed characterization of LLM-induced errors across model descriptions of varying detail and complexity, revealing how IR choice critically impacts error rates. These insights provide actionable guidance for building resilient and transparent LLM-assisted simulation automation workflows.
summary_zh: 大语言模型辅助建模具有从粗略描述和传感器数据快速构建复杂系统可执行数字孪生的潜力。然而，对大语言模型幻觉的抵抗力、人工监督和实时模型适应性仍然是具有挑战性且常常相互冲突的要求。我们提出了在将韧性和监督集成到此类工作流程中的三个关键设计原则，这些原则源于我们在FactoryFlow（一个用于构建基于仿真制造系统数字孪生的开源大语言模型辅助框架）上的工作中所获得的见解。首先，正交化结构建模和参数拟合。结构描述（组件、互连）由大语言模型从粗略的自然语言翻译成具有人工可视化和验证的中间表示，然后算法转换成最终模型。相反，参数推断在具有专家可调控制的传感器数据流上连续运行。其次，将模型中间表示（IR）限制为参数化的、预验证的库组件的互连，而不是单片仿真代码，从而实现可解释性和容错性。第三，也是最重要的，是使用保持密度的中间表示。当中间表示描述从紧凑的输入急剧扩展时，幻觉错误会成比例地累积。我们提出了使用Python作为保持密度的中间表示的理由：循环简洁地表达了规律性，类捕获了层次结构和组合，并且在利用大语言模型强大的代码生成能力的同时，结果仍然具有高度的可读性。一个关键贡献是对跨越不同细节和复杂性的模型描述中的大语言模型诱导错误的详细表征，揭示了中间表示的选择如何关键性地影响错误率。这些见解为构建具有弹性和透明度的大语言模型辅助仿真自动化工作流程提供了可操作的指导。
tldr: This paper presents design principles for building resilient LLM-assisted Digital Twins, focusing on orthogonalizing modeling and parameter fitting, restricting the model IR to pre-validated components, and using density-preserving IRs like Python to mitigate LLM hallucination.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了构建具有弹性的 LLM 辅助数字孪生的设计原则，重点在于正交化建模和参数拟合，将模型 IR 限制为预先验证的组件，并使用像 Python 这样的密度保持 IR 来减轻 LLM 幻觉。

title: GUIDE: A Benchmark for Understanding and Assisting Users in Open-Ended GUI Tasks
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents have the potential to assist users in interacting with complex software (e.g., PowerPoint, Photoshop). While prior research has primarily focused on automating user actions through clicks and keystrokes, this paradigm overlooks human intention, where users value the ability to explore, iterate, and refine their ideas while maintaining agency. To move beyond automation and toward collaboration, GUI agents must understand what users are doing and why. We introduce GUIDE (GUI User Intent Detection Evaluation), a benchmark that evaluates AI models on their ability to perceive user behavior, infer intent, and provide assistance in open-ended GUI tasks. GUIDE consists of 67.5 hours of screen recordings from 120 novice user demonstrations with think-aloud narrations, across 10 software. GUIDE defines three tasks - (i) Behavior State Detection, (ii) Intent Prediction, and (iii) Help Prediction that test a model's ability to recognize behavior state, reason about goals, and decide when and how to help. Evaluations across eight state-of-the-art multimodal models reveal that all models struggled, achieving only 44.6% and 55.0% accuracy on behavior state and help prediction. However, providing user context significantly improved the performance, raising help prediction by up to 50.2pp, highlighting the critical role of structured user understanding in effective assistance. Our dataset is available at https://guide-bench.github.io.
summary_zh: 图形用户界面（GUI）代理具有协助用户与复杂软件（例如，PowerPoint, Photoshop）交互的潜力。虽然先前的研究主要集中于通过点击和按键来自动化用户操作，但这种范式忽略了人类意图，用户在这种意图中重视探索、迭代和完善其想法，同时保持自主性的能力。为了超越自动化并走向协作，GUI 代理必须理解用户正在做什么以及为什么这样做。我们引入了 GUIDE（图形用户界面用户意图检测评估），这是一个基准，用于评估 AI 模型在感知用户行为、推断意图以及在开放式 GUI 任务中提供帮助的能力。GUIDE 包含来自 120 名新手用户演示的 67.5 小时屏幕录像，并附带思考式口述，涵盖 10 个软件。GUIDE 定义了三个任务 - (i) 行为状态检测, (ii) 意图预测, 和 (iii) 帮助预测，旨在测试模型识别行为状态、推理目标以及决定何时和如何提供帮助的能力。对八个最先进的多模态模型进行的评估表明，所有模型都表现不佳，在行为状态和帮助预测方面的准确率分别仅为 44.6% 和 55.0%。 然而，提供用户上下文信息显著提高了性能，将帮助预测提高了多达 50.2 个百分点，突出了结构化用户理解在有效帮助中的关键作用。 我们的数据集可在 https://guide-bench.github.io 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces GUIDE, a new benchmark for evaluating AI agents' ability to understand user intent and provide assistance in GUI tasks, finding that current models struggle despite significant improvement with user context.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GUIDE，一个新的基准，用于评估AI智能体理解用户意图并在GUI任务中提供帮助的能力。研究发现，虽然提供用户上下文可以显著提高性能，但当前的模型仍然表现不佳。

title: Real-Time Branch-to-Tool Distance Estimation for Autonomous UAV Pruning: Benchmarking Five DEFOM-Stereo Variants from Simulation to Jetson Deployment
summary: Autonomous tree pruning with unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is a safety-critical real-world task: the onboard perception system must estimate the metric distance from a cutting tool to thin tree branches in real time so that the UAV can approach, align, and actuate the pruner without collision. We address this problem by training five variants of DEFOM-Stereo - a recent foundation-model-based stereo matcher - on a task-specific synthetic dataset and deploying the checkpoints on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Super 16 GB. The training corpus is built in Unreal Engine 5 with a simulated ZED Mini stereo camera capturing 5,520 stereo pairs across 115 tree instances from three viewpoints at 2m distance; dense EXR depth maps provide exact, spatially complete supervision for thin branches. On the synthetic test set, DEFOM-Stereo ViT-S achieves the best depth-domain accuracy (EPE 1.74 px, D1-all 5.81%, delta-1 95.90%, depth MAE 23.40 cm) but its Jetson inference speed of ~2.2 FPS (~450 ms per frame) remains too slow for responsive closed-loop tool control. A newly introduced balanced variant, DEFOM-PrunePlus (~21M backbone, ~3.3 FPS on Jetson), offers the best deployable accuracy-speed trade-off (EPE 5.87 px, depth MAE 64.26 cm, delta-1 87.59%): its frame rate is sufficient for real-time guidance and its depth accuracy supports safe branch approach planning at the 2m operating range. The lightweight DEFOM-PruneStereo (~6.9 FPS) and DEFOM-PruneNano (~8.5 FPS) run fast but sacrifice substantial accuracy (depth MAE > 57 cm), making estimates too unreliable for safe actuation. Zero-shot inference on real photographs confirms that full-capacity models preserve branch geometry, validating the sim-to-real transfer. We conclude that DEFOM-PrunePlus provides the most practical accuracy-latency balance for onboard distance estimation, while ViT-S serves as the reference for future hardware.
summary_zh: 无人机（UAV）自主树木修剪是一项安全攸关的现实任务：机载感知系统必须实时估计切割工具到细树枝的度量距离，以便无人机能够接近、对齐并启动修剪器而不会发生碰撞。我们通过在特定任务的合成数据集上训练DEFOM-Stereo的五个变体（一种基于最新基础模型的立体匹配器）来解决这个问题，并将检查点部署在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Super 16 GB上。训练语料库在Unreal Engine 5中构建，使用模拟的ZED Mini立体相机捕获5520个立体图像对，这些图像对来自115棵树实例的三个视点，距离为2米；密集的EXR深度图为细树枝提供了精确、空间完整的监督。在合成测试集上，DEFOM-Stereo ViT-S实现了最佳的深度域精度（EPE 1.74像素，D1-all 5.81%，delta-1 95.90%，深度MAE 23.40厘米），但其在Jetson上的推理速度约为2.2 FPS（每帧约450毫秒），对于响应式闭环工具控制来说仍然太慢。新引入的平衡变体DEFOM-PrunePlus（约21M骨干网络，在Jetson上约3.3 FPS）提供了最佳的可部署精度-速度折衷方案（EPE 5.87像素，深度MAE 64.26厘米，delta-1 87.59%）：其帧速率足以进行实时指导，并且其深度精度支持在2米工作范围内进行安全的分支接近规划。轻量级的DEFOM-PruneStereo（约6.9 FPS）和DEFOM-PruneNano（约8.5 FPS）运行速度快，但牺牲了大量的精度（深度MAE > 57厘米），使得估计结果对于安全启动来说过于不可靠。在真实照片上的零样本推理证实了全容量模型保留了分支几何结构，验证了从模拟到真实的迁移。我们得出结论，DEFOM-PrunePlus为机载距离估计提供了最实用的精度-延迟平衡，而ViT-S则可作为未来硬件的参考。
tldr: This paper explores real-time branch-to-tool distance estimation for autonomous UAV pruning using DEFOM-Stereo variants, achieving promising results on a Jetson Orin Super after training on a synthetic dataset, suggesting a practical solution via DEFOM-PrunePlus.
tldr_zh: 本文探索了使用 DEFOM-Stereo 变体进行自主无人机修剪的实时分支到工具距离估计，在 Jetson Orin Super 上训练合成数据集后取得了有希望的结果，表明 DEFOM-PrunePlus 提供了一个实用的解决方案。

title: PAD-Hand: Physics-Aware Diffusion for Hand Motion Recovery
summary: Significant advancements made in reconstructing hands from images have delivered accurate single-frame estimates, yet they often lack physics consistency and provide no notion of how confidently the motion satisfies physics. In this paper, we propose a novel physics-aware conditional diffusion framework that refines noisy pose sequences into physically plausible hand motion while estimating the physics variance in motion estimates. Building on a MeshCNN-Transformer backbone, we formulate Euler-Lagrange dynamics for articulated hands. Unlike prior works that enforce zero residuals, we treat the resulting dynamic residuals as virtual observables to more effectively integrate physics. Through a last-layer Laplace approximation, our method produces per-joint, per-time variances that measure physics consistency and offers interpretable variance maps indicating where physical consistency weakens. Experiments on two well-known hand datasets show consistent gains over strong image-based initializations and competitive video-based methods. Qualitative results confirm that our variance estimations are aligned with the physical plausibility of the motion in image-based estimates.
summary_zh: 从图像重建手部的显著进展已经实现了准确的单帧估计，但它们往往缺乏物理一致性，也没有提供对运动满足物理学的置信程度的概念。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的物理感知条件扩散框架，该框架将噪声姿态序列细化为物理上合理的双手运动，同时估计运动估计中的物理方差。基于 MeshCNN-Transformer 主干，我们为铰接手制定了 Euler-Lagrange 动力学。与强制零残差的先前工作不同，我们将由此产生的动态残差视为虚拟可观测值，以更有效地整合物理学。通过最后一层的拉普拉斯近似，我们的方法产生每个关节、每个时间步的方差，这些方差衡量物理一致性，并提供可解释的方差图，指示物理一致性减弱的位置。在两个著名的手部数据集上的实验表明，相对于强大的基于图像的初始化方法和有竞争力的基于视频的方法，我们的方法都取得了持续的提升。定性结果证实，我们的方差估计与基于图像的估计中运动的物理合理性相符。
tldr: The paper introduces a physics-aware diffusion framework called PAD-Hand to refine hand motion recovery from images, aiming for physically plausible motion sequences with interpretable physics variance maps.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为PAD-Hand的物理感知扩散框架，用于优化图像中的手部运动恢复，旨在获得具有可解释的物理方差图的物理上合理的运动序列。

title: DTP-Attack: A decision-based black-box adversarial attack on trajectory prediction
summary: Trajectory prediction systems are critical for autonomous vehicle safety, yet remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks that can cause catastrophic traffic behavior misinterpretations. Existing attack methods require white-box access with gradient information and rely on rigid physical constraints, limiting real-world applicability. We propose DTP-Attack, a decision-based black-box adversarial attack framework tailored for trajectory prediction systems. Our method operates exclusively on binary decision outputs without requiring model internals or gradients, making it practical for real-world scenarios. DTP-Attack employs a novel boundary walking algorithm that navigates adversarial regions without fixed constraints, naturally maintaining trajectory realism through proximity preservation. Unlike existing approaches, our method supports both intention misclassification attacks and prediction accuracy degradation. Extensive evaluation on nuScenes and Apolloscape datasets across state-of-the-art models including Trajectron++ and Grip++ demonstrates superior performance. DTP-Attack achieves 41 - 81% attack success rates for intention misclassification attacks that manipulate perceived driving maneuvers with perturbations below 0.45 m, and increases prediction errors by 1.9 - 4.2 for accuracy degradation. Our method consistently outperforms existing black-box approaches while maintaining high controllability and reliability across diverse scenarios. These results reveal fundamental vulnerabilities in current trajectory prediction systems, highlighting urgent needs for robust defenses in safety-critical autonomous driving applications.
summary_zh: 轨迹预测系统对于自动驾驶车辆的安全至关重要，但仍然容易受到对抗性攻击，这些攻击可能导致灾难性的交通行为误判。现有的攻击方法需要具有梯度信息的白盒访问，并依赖于严格的物理约束，限制了实际应用。我们提出DTP-Attack，一种针对轨迹预测系统量身定制的基于决策的黑盒对抗性攻击框架。我们的方法仅基于二元决策输出进行操作，无需模型内部信息或梯度，使其适用于实际场景。DTP-Attack采用一种新颖的边界行走算法，在没有固定约束的情况下导航对抗区域，通过邻近性保持自然地维持轨迹的真实性。与现有方法不同，我们的方法支持意图误分类攻击和预测精度退化。在nuScenes和Apolloscape数据集上，针对包括Trajectron++和Grip++在内的最先进模型的广泛评估表明了卓越的性能。DTP-Attack在扰动小于0.45米的情况下，实现了41%到81%的意图误分类攻击成功率，该攻击操纵了感知的驾驶动作，并且使预测误差增加了1.9到4.2，实现了精度退化。我们的方法始终优于现有的黑盒方法，同时在各种场景中保持了高度的可控性和可靠性。这些结果揭示了当前轨迹预测系统中的根本漏洞，突出了在安全关键型自动驾驶应用中对鲁棒防御的迫切需求。
tldr: The paper introduces DTP-Attack, a decision-based black-box adversarial attack on trajectory prediction systems that achieves high success rates in misclassification and accuracy degradation without requiring model internals, demonstrating vulnerabilities in autonomous driving applications.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DTP-Attack，一种基于决策的黑盒对抗攻击方法，针对轨迹预测系统，无需模型内部信息即可实现高攻击成功率，包括错误分类和精度降低，揭示了自动驾驶应用中的潜在漏洞。

title: T-800: An 800 Hz Data Glove for Precise Hand Gesture Tracking
summary: Human dexterity relies on rapid, sub-second motor adjustments, yet capturing these high-frequency dynamics remains an enduring challenge in biomechanics and robotics. Existing motion capture paradigms are compromised by a trade-off between temporal resolution and visual occlusion, failing to record the fine-grained hand motion of fast, contact-rich manipulation. Here we introduce T-800, a high-bandwidth data glove system that achieves synchronized, full-hand motion tracking at 800 Hz. By integrating a novel broadcast-based synchronization mechanism with a mechanical stress isolation architecture, our system maintains sub-frame temporal alignment across 18 distributed inertial measurement units (IMUs) during extended, vigorous movements. We demonstrate that T-800 recovers fine-grained manipulation details previously lost to temporal undersampling. Our analysis reveals that human dexterity exhibits significantly high-frequency motion energy (>100 Hz) that was fundamentally inaccessible due to the Nyquist sampling limit imposed by previous hardware constraints. To validate the system's utility for robotic manipulation, we implement a kinematic retargeting algorithm that maps T-800's high-fidelity human gestures onto dexterous robotic hand models. This demonstrates that the high-frequency motion data can be accurately translated while respecting the kinematic constraints of robotic hands, providing the rich behavioral data necessary for training robust control policies in the future.
summary_zh: 人类的灵活性依赖于快速的亚秒级运动调整，然而捕获这些高频动力学特征仍然是生物力学和机器人学领域一个持久的挑战。现有的运动捕捉范式受限于时间分辨率和视觉遮挡之间的权衡，无法记录快速、接触丰富的操作中精细的手部运动。在此，我们介绍了T-800，一种高带宽数据手套系统，能够以800 Hz的频率实现同步的全手运动跟踪。通过将一种新型的基于广播的同步机制与机械应力隔离架构相结合，我们的系统在长时间、剧烈的运动过程中，保持18个分布式惯性测量单元（IMU）的亚帧时间对齐。我们证明了T-800能够恢复先前因时间欠采样而丢失的精细操作细节。我们的分析表明，人类的灵活性表现出显著的高频运动能量（>100 Hz），由于先前硬件约束所导致的奈奎斯特采样极限，这种高频运动能量在根本上是无法获取的。为了验证该系统在机器人操作中的实用性，我们实现了一种运动学重定向算法，将T-800的高保真人类手势映射到灵巧的机器人手模型上。这证明了高频运动数据能够被准确地转换，同时尊重机器人手的运动学约束，从而为未来训练稳健的控制策略提供必要的丰富的行为数据。
tldr: The paper introduces T-800, a high-bandwidth (800 Hz) data glove system offering synchronized, full-hand motion tracking using IMUs and demonstrates its utility in capturing high-frequency human dexterity and retargeting to robotic hands.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为T-800的高带宽（800 Hz）数据手套系统，该系统使用IMU提供同步的、完整的手部运动跟踪，并演示了其在捕获高频人类灵巧性和重新定位到机器人手方面的效用。

title: GeoReFormer: Geometry-Aware Refinement for Lane Segment Detection and Topology Reasoning
summary: Accurate 3D lane segment detection and topology reasoning are critical for structured online map construction in autonomous driving. Recent transformer-based approaches formulate this task as query-based set prediction, yet largely inherit decoder designs originally developed for compact object detection. However, lane segments are continuous polylines embedded in directed graphs, and generic query initialization and unconstrained refinement do not explicitly encode this geometric and relational structure. We propose GeoReFormer (Geometry-aware Refinement Transformer), a unified query-based architecture that embeds geometry- and topology-aware inductive biases directly within the transformer decoder. GeoReFormer introduces data-driven geometric priors for structured query initialization, bounded coordinate-space refinement for stable polyline deformation, and per-query gated topology propagation to selectively integrate relational context. On the OpenLane-V2 benchmark, GeoReFormer achieves state-of-the-art performance with 34.5% mAP while improving topology consistency over strong transformer baselines, demonstrating the utility of explicit geometric and relational structure encoding.
summary_zh: 准确的3D车道线段检测和拓扑推理对于自动驾驶中结构化在线地图的构建至关重要。 近期基于Transformer的方法将此任务表述为基于查询的集合预测，但很大程度上沿用了最初为紧凑目标检测开发的解码器设计。 然而，车道线段是嵌入在有向图中的连续折线，通用的查询初始化和无约束细化并未明确地编码这种几何和关系结构。 我们提出了GeoReFormer（几何感知细化Transformer），一种统一的、基于查询的架构，它将几何和拓扑感知的归纳偏置直接嵌入到Transformer解码器中。 GeoReFormer引入数据驱动的几何先验用于结构化查询初始化，有界坐标空间细化用于稳定的折线变形，以及每查询的门控拓扑传播以选择性地整合关系上下文。 在OpenLane-V2基准测试中，GeoReFormer取得了最先进的性能，达到34.5%的mAP，同时提高了相对于强Transformer基线的拓扑一致性，证明了显式几何和关系结构编码的效用。
tldr: The paper introduces GeoReFormer, a novel transformer-based architecture for 3D lane segment detection that incorporates geometry and topology awareness to improve performance and consistency compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的基于Transformer的架构GeoReFormer，用于3D车道线段检测，该架构结合了几何和拓扑感知，与现有方法相比，提高了性能和一致性。

title: Think over Trajectories: Leveraging Video Generation to Reconstruct GPS Trajectories from Cellular Signaling
summary: Mobile devices continuously interact with cellular base stations, generating massive volumes of signaling records that provide broad coverage for understanding human mobility. However, such records offer only coarse location cues (e.g., serving-cell identifiers) and therefore limit their direct use in applications that require high-precision GPS trajectories. This paper studies the Sig2GPS problem: reconstructing GPS trajectories from cellular signaling. Inspired by domain experts often lay the signaling trace on the map and sketch the corresponding GPS route, unlike conventional solutions that rely on complex multi-stage engineering pipelines or regress coordinates, Sig2GPS is reframed as an image-to-video generation task that directly operates in the map-visual domain: signaling traces are rendered on a map, and a video generation model is trained to draw a continuous GPS path. To support this paradigm, a paired signaling-to-trajectory video dataset is constructed to fine-tune an open-source video model, and a trajectory-aware reinforcement learning-based optimization method is introduced to improve generation fidelity via rewards. Experiments on large-scale real-world datasets show substantial improvements over strong engineered and learning-based baselines, while additional results on next GPS prediction indicate scalability and cross-city transferability. Overall, these results suggest that map-visual video generation provides a practical interface for trajectory data mining by enabling direct generation and refinement of continuous paths under map constraints.
summary_zh: 移动设备持续与蜂窝基站交互，产生海量的信令记录，为理解人类移动行为提供了广泛的覆盖。然而，此类记录仅提供粗略的位置线索（例如，服务小区标识符），因此限制了它们在需要高精度GPS轨迹的应用中的直接使用。本文研究了Sig2GPS问题：从蜂窝信令中重构GPS轨迹。受领域专家通常将信令轨迹放置在地图上并绘制相应的GPS路线的启发，不同于依赖复杂的多阶段工程流水线或回归坐标的传统解决方案，Sig2GPS被重新定义为图像到视频的生成任务，该任务直接在地图可视域中操作：信令轨迹被渲染在地图上，并训练视频生成模型来绘制连续的GPS路径。为了支持这种范式，构建了一个成对的信令-轨迹视频数据集，用于微调开源视频模型，并引入了一种基于轨迹感知的强化学习的优化方法，通过奖励来提高生成保真度。大规模真实世界数据集上的实验表明，与强大的工程化和基于学习的基线相比，性能有了显著提升，而对下一个GPS预测的额外结果表明了可扩展性和跨城市迁移性。总的来说，这些结果表明，地图可视视频生成为轨迹数据挖掘提供了一个实用的接口，通过支持在地图约束下直接生成和优化连续路径。
tldr: The paper presents Sig2GPS, a method for reconstructing GPS trajectories from cellular signaling data by framing it as an image-to-video generation task, leveraging map visuals and reinforcement learning for improved trajectory fidelity.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了Sig2GPS，一种从蜂窝信号数据重建GPS轨迹的方法，将其转化为图像到视频生成任务，并利用地图视觉和强化学习来提高轨迹的保真度。

title: Generation Is Compression: Zero-Shot Video Coding via Stochastic Rectified Flow
summary: Existing generative video compression methods use generative models only as post-hoc reconstruction modules atop conventional codecs. We propose \emph{Generative Video Codec} (GVC), a zero-shot framework that turns a pretrained video generative model into the codec itself: the transmitted bitstream directly specifies the generative decoding trajectory, with no retraining required. To enable this, we convert the deterministic rectified-flow ODE of modern video foundation models into an equivalent SDE at inference time, unlocking per-step stochastic injection points for codebook-driven compression. Building on this unified backbone, we instantiate three complementary conditioning strategies -- \emph{Image-to-Video} (I2V) with adaptive tail-frame atom allocation, \emph{Text-to-Video} (T2V) operating at near-zero side information as a pure generative prior, and \emph{First-Last-Frame-to-Video} (FLF2V) with boundary-sharing GOP chaining for dual-anchor temporal control. Together, these variants span a principled trade-off space between spatial fidelity, temporal coherence, and compression efficiency. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that GVC achieves high-quality reconstruction below 0.002\,bpp while supporting flexible bitrate control through a single hyperparameter.
summary_zh: 现有的生成式视频压缩方法仅将生成模型用作传统编解码器之上的事后重建模块。我们提出一种零样本框架——\emph{生成式视频编解码器}(GVC)，该框架将预训练的视频生成模型转化为编解码器本身：传输的比特流直接指定生成式解码轨迹，无需重新训练。为此，我们将现代视频基础模型的确定性整流流ODE在推理时转化为等效的SDE，从而为基于码本的压缩解锁每步的随机注入点。基于这一统一的骨干网络，我们实例化了三种互补的条件策略——带有自适应尾帧原子分配的\emph{图像到视频}(I2V)，以接近零侧信息作为纯生成式先验的\emph{文本到视频}(T2V)，以及带有边界共享GOP链的\emph{首尾帧到视频}(FLF2V)，用于双锚时间控制。这些变体共同构成了空间保真度、时间连贯性和压缩效率之间的原则性权衡空间。在标准基准测试上的实验表明，GVC在低于0.002\,bpp的情况下实现了高质量重建，同时支持通过单个超参数进行灵活的比特率控制。
tldr: The paper introduces Generative Video Codec (GVC), a zero-shot video compression framework that leverages pretrained video generative models, converting them into codecs without retraining by using stochastic rectified flow and different conditioning strategies for flexible bitrate control.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为生成视频编解码器（GVC）的零样本视频压缩框架，该框架利用预训练的视频生成模型，通过使用随机校正流和不同的调节策略将它们转换为编解码器，而无需重新训练，从而实现灵活的码率控制。

title: R-PGA: Robust Physical Adversarial Camouflage Generation via Relightable 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Physical adversarial camouflage poses a severe security threat to autonomous driving systems by mapping adversarial textures onto 3D objects. Nevertheless, current methods remain brittle in complex dynamic scenarios, failing to generalize across diverse geometric (e.g., viewing configurations) and radiometric (e.g., dynamic illumination, atmospheric scattering) variations. We attribute this deficiency to two fundamental limitations in simulation and optimization. First, the reliance on coarse, oversimplified simulations (e.g., via CARLA) induces a significant domain gap, confining optimization to a biased feature space. Second, standard strategies targeting average performance result in a rugged loss landscape, leaving the camouflage vulnerable to configuration shifts.To bridge these gaps, we propose the Relightable Physical 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) based Attack framework (R-PGA). Technically, to address the simulation fidelity issue, we leverage 3DGS to ensure photo-realistic reconstruction and augment it with physically disentangled attributes to decouple intrinsic material from lighting. Furthermore, we design a hybrid rendering pipeline that leverages precise Relightable 3DGS for foreground rendering, while employing a pre-trained image translation model to synthesize plausible relighted backgrounds that align with the relighted foreground.To address the optimization robustness issue, we propose the Hard Physical Configuration Mining (HPCM) module, designed to actively mine worst-case physical configurations and suppress their corresponding loss peaks. This strategy not only diminishes the overall loss magnitude but also effectively flattens the rugged loss landscape, ensuring consistent adversarial effectiveness and robustness across varying physical configurations.
summary_zh: 物理对抗伪装通过将对抗纹理映射到3D物体上，对自动驾驶系统构成严重的安全威胁。然而，当前的方法在复杂的动态场景中仍然脆弱，无法泛化到多样的几何（例如，视角配置）和辐射度（例如，动态光照、大气散射）变化。我们将这种缺陷归因于仿真和优化方面的两个根本性限制。首先，对粗糙、过于简化的仿真（例如，通过CARLA）的依赖导致了显著的领域差距，将优化限制在了有偏差的特征空间中。其次，针对平均性能的标准策略会导致崎岖不平的损失面，使得伪装容易受到配置变化的影响。为了弥合这些差距，我们提出了基于可重光物理3D高斯溅射（3DGS）的攻击框架（R-PGA）。在技术上，为了解决仿真保真度问题，我们利用3DGS来确保逼真的重建，并利用物理分离的属性来解耦内在材质与光照。此外，我们设计了一种混合渲染流程，利用精确的可重光3DGS进行前景渲染，同时采用预训练的图像翻译模型来合成合理且重光后的背景，使其与重光后的前景对齐。为了解决优化鲁棒性问题，我们提出了硬物理配置挖掘（HPCM）模块，旨在主动挖掘最坏情况的物理配置并抑制其对应的损失峰值。这种策略不仅降低了整体损失幅度，而且有效地平坦了崎岖不平的损失面，确保了在各种物理配置下一致的对抗有效性和鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces R-PGA, a novel framework using Relightable 3D Gaussian Splatting and Hard Physical Configuration Mining to generate robust physical adversarial camouflage that generalizes across diverse geometric and radiometric variations, addressing limitations of prior methods in autonomous driving systems.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了R-PGA，一种新颖的框架，使用可重光照的3D高斯溅射和硬物理配置挖掘来生成鲁棒的物理对抗迷彩，该迷彩可以在各种几何和辐射变化中泛化，解决了自动驾驶系统中现有方法的局限性。

title: Designing Fatigue-Aware VR Interfaces via Biomechanical Models
summary: Prolonged mid-air interaction in virtual reality (VR) causes arm fatigue and discomfort, negatively affecting user experience. Incorporating ergonomic considerations into VR user interface (UI) design typically requires extensive human-in-the-loop evaluation. Although biomechanical models have been used to simulate human behavior in HCI tasks, their application as surrogate users for ergonomic VR UI design remains underexplored. We propose a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that leverages biomechanical user models to evaluate and optimize VR interfaces for mid-air interaction. A motion agent is trained to perform button-press tasks in VR under sequential conditions, using realistic movement strategies and estimating muscle-level effort via a validated three-compartment control with recovery (3CC-r) fatigue model. The simulated fatigue output serves as feedback for a UI agent that optimizes UI element layout via reinforcement learning (RL) to minimize fatigue. We compare the RL-optimized layout against a manually-designed centered baseline and a Bayesian optimized baseline. Results show that fatigue trends from the biomechanical model align with human user data. Moreover, the RL-optimized layout using simulated fatigue feedback produced significantly lower perceived fatigue in a follow-up human study. We further demonstrate the framework's extensibility via a simulated case study on longer sequential tasks with non-uniform interaction frequencies. To our knowledge, this is the first work using simulated biomechanical muscle fatigue as a direct optimization signal for VR UI layout design. Our findings highlight the potential of biomechanical user models as effective surrogate tools for ergonomic VR interface design, enabling efficient early-stage iteration with less reliance on extensive human participation.
summary_zh: 在虚拟现实（VR）中长时间进行空中交互会导致手臂疲劳和不适，从而对用户体验产生负面影响。将人体工学考虑纳入VR用户界面（UI）设计通常需要进行大量的人在环评估。尽管生物力学模型已被用于模拟人机交互任务中的人体行为，但其作为替代用户用于人体工学VR UI设计的应用仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了一种分层强化学习框架，该框架利用生物力学用户模型来评估和优化VR界面的空中交互。运动智能体在序列条件下训练用于执行VR中的按钮点击任务，采用逼真的运动策略，并通过经过验证的三室控制与恢复（3CC-r）疲劳模型估算肌肉层面的用力。模拟的疲劳输出作为UI智能体的反馈，该智能体通过强化学习（RL）优化UI元素布局以最大限度地减少疲劳。我们将通过RL优化后的布局与手动设计的居中基线以及贝叶斯优化的基线进行比较。结果表明，生物力学模型产生的疲劳趋势与人类用户数据吻合。此外，在使用模拟疲劳反馈的RL优化布局在后续的人体研究中产生了显着较低的感知疲劳。我们进一步通过一个模拟案例研究，展示该框架在具有非均匀交互频率的更长序列任务中的可扩展性。据我们所知，这是第一项使用模拟生物力学肌肉疲劳作为VR UI布局设计的直接优化信号的工作。我们的研究结果突出了生物力学用户模型作为有效替代工具用于人体工学VR界面设计的潜力，从而能够在早期阶段进行高效迭代，并减少对大量人员参与的依赖。
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning framework that uses biomechanical models to optimize VR UI layouts for reduced arm fatigue, showing promising results compared to baseline methods and human studies.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个强化学习框架，利用生物力学模型优化VR用户界面布局，以减少手臂疲劳。实验结果表明，该方法优于基线方法，并与人类研究结果一致。

title: Do Neurons Dream of Primitive Operators? Wake-Sleep Compression Rediscovers Schank's Event Semantics
summary:
We show that they do. Schank's conceptual dependency theory proposed that all events decompose into primitive operations -- ATRANS, PTRANS, MTRANS, and others -- hand-coded from linguistic intuition. Can the same primitives be discovered automatically through compression pressure alone?
  We adapt DreamCoder's wake-sleep library learning to event state transformations. Given events as before/after world state pairs, our system finds operator compositions explaining each event (wake), then extracts recurring patterns as new operators optimized under Minimum Description Length (sleep). Starting from four generic primitives, it discovers operators mapping directly to Schank's: MOVE_PROP_has = ATRANS, CHANGE_location = PTRANS, SET_knows = MTRANS, SET_consumed = INGEST, plus compound operators ("mail" = ATRANS + PTRANS) and novel emotional state operators absent from Schank's taxonomy.
  We validate on synthetic events and real-world commonsense data from the ATOMIC knowledge graph. On synthetic data, discovered operators achieve Bayesian MDL within 4% of Schank's hand-coded primitives while explaining 100% of events vs. Schank's 81%. On ATOMIC, results are more dramatic: Schank's primitives explain only 10% of naturalistic events, while the discovered library explains 100%. Dominant operators are not physical-action primitives but mental and emotional state changes -- CHANGE_wants (20%), CHANGE_feels (18%), CHANGE_is (18%) -- none in Schank's original taxonomy.
  These results provide the first empirical evidence that event primitives can be derived from compression pressure, that Schank's core primitives are information-theoretically justified, and that the complete inventory is substantially richer than proposed -- with mental/emotional operators dominating in naturalistic data.
summary_zh:
我们证明了他们的确可以。Schank的概念依存理论提出，所有事件都可以分解为原始操作——ATRANS、PTRANS、MTRANS等等——这些操作是通过语言直觉手工编码的。是否能仅通过压缩压力自动发现相同的原语？
我们采用DreamCoder的唤醒-睡眠库学习方法来处理事件状态转换的问题。给定事件作为前/后世界状态对，我们的系统找到解释每个事件的算子组合（唤醒），然后提取重复出现的模式作为新的算子，并在最小描述长度（睡眠）下进行优化。从四个通用原语开始，它发现了直接映射到Schank原语的算子：MOVE_PROP_has = ATRANS，CHANGE_location = PTRANS，SET_knows = MTRANS，SET_consumed = INGEST，以及复合算子（“mail”= ATRANS + PTRANS）和Schank分类法中没有的新型情感状态算子。
我们在合成事件和来自ATOMIC知识图谱的真实世界常识数据上进行了验证。在合成数据上，发现的算子在贝叶斯MDL方面达到了Schank手工编码原语的4%以内，同时解释了100%的事件，而Schank的只能解释81%。在ATOMIC上，结果更为显著：Schank的原语仅能解释10%的自然事件，而发现的库却能解释100%。主要算子不是物理动作原语，而是心理和情感状态的改变——CHANGE_wants (20%)，CHANGE_feels (18%)，CHANGE_is (18%)——这些都不在Schank最初的分类法中。
这些结果提供了首个经验证据，证明了事件原语可以从压缩压力中推导出来，Schank的核心原语在信息理论上是合理的，以及完整的事件原语库存比提出的要丰富得多——心理/情感算子在自然数据中占据主导地位。
tldr: This paper demonstrates that Schank's event semantics primitives, along with new emotional state operators, can be automatically discovered through compression of event state transformations using wake-sleep library learning, validated on synthetic and real-world commonsense data. The learned primitives outperform Schank's on real-world data, highlighting the importance of mental and emotional state operators.
tldr_zh: 该论文证明，通过使用wake-sleep库学习对事件状态转换进行压缩，可以自动发现Schank的事件语义原语，以及新的情绪状态操作符。该方法在合成和真实世界常识数据上进行了验证。学习到的原语在真实世界数据上优于Schank的方法，突出了心理和情绪状态操作符的重要性。

title: Detailed Geometry and Appearance from Opportunistic Motion
summary: Reconstructing 3D geometry and appearance from a sparse set of fixed cameras is a foundational task with broad applications, yet it remains fundamentally constrained by the limited viewpoints. We show that this bound can be broken by exploiting opportunistic object motion: as a person manipulates an object~(e.g., moving a chair or lifting a mug), the static cameras effectively ``orbit'' the object in its local coordinate frame, providing additional virtual viewpoints. Harnessing this object motion, however, poses two challenges: the tight coupling of object pose and geometry estimation and the complex appearance variations of a moving object under static illumination. We address these by formulating a joint pose and shape optimization using 2D Gaussian splatting with alternating minimization of 6DoF trajectories and primitive parameters, and by introducing a novel appearance model that factorizes diffuse and specular components with reflected directional probing within the spherical harmonics space. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets with extremely sparse viewpoints demonstrate that our method recovers significantly more accurate geometry and appearance than state-of-the-art baselines.
summary_zh: 从稀疏的固定相机集合中重建3D几何形状和外观是一项基础性任务，具有广泛的应用，但其根本上受到有限视角的约束。我们展示了，通过利用伺机性的物体运动，可以突破这个限制：当一个人操纵一个物体（例如，移动椅子或举起杯子）时，静态相机实际上在其局部坐标系中“围绕”该物体“旋转”，从而提供额外的虚拟视角。然而，利用这种物体运动带来了两个挑战：物体姿态和几何体估计的紧密耦合，以及移动物体在静态光照下复杂的表观变化。我们通过使用2D高斯溅射并采用6自由度轨迹和图元参数的交替最小化，构建联合姿态和形状优化，并引入一种新的外观模型来解决这些问题。该模型分解了漫反射和镜面反射分量，并在球谐空间内进行反射方向探测。在具有极其稀疏视角的合成和真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，与最先进的基线方法相比，我们的方法可以恢复明显更精确的几何形状和外观。
tldr: This paper introduces a method for reconstructing 3D geometry and appearance from sparse camera views by exploiting object motion to create virtual viewpoints and using Gaussian splatting with a novel appearance model to factorize diffuse and specular components. The method demonstrates improved accuracy compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用物体运动创建虚拟视点，并结合高斯溅射和新型外观模型分解漫反射和镜面反射分量，从稀疏相机视图重建3D几何和外观的方法。 实验表明，该方法比现有技术具有更高的精度。

title: HolisticSemGes: Semantic Grounding of Holistic Co-Speech Gesture Generation with Contrastive Flow-Matching
summary: While the field of co-speech gesture generation has seen significant advances, producing holistic, semantically grounded gestures remains a challenge. Existing approaches rely on external semantic retrieval methods, which limit their generalisation capability due to dependency on predefined linguistic rules. Flow-matching-based methods produce promising results; however, the network is optimised using only semantically congruent samples without exposure to negative examples, leading to learning rhythmic gestures rather than sparse motion, such as iconic and metaphoric gestures. Furthermore, by modelling body parts in isolation, the majority of methods fail to maintain crossmodal consistency. We introduce a Contrastive Flow Matching-based co-speech gesture generation model that uses mismatched audio-text conditions as negatives, training the velocity field to follow the correct motion trajectory while repelling semantically incongruent trajectories. Our model ensures cross-modal coherence by embedding text, audio, and holistic motion into a composite latent space via cosine and contrastive objectives. Extensive experiments and a user study demonstrate that our proposed approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods on two datasets, BEAT2 and SHOW.
summary_zh: 共语姿势生成领域已经取得了显著进展，但生成整体的、语义对齐的姿势仍然是一个挑战。现有方法依赖于外部语义检索方法，由于依赖于预定义的语言规则，限制了其泛化能力。基于流匹配的方法产生了令人鼓舞的结果；然而，该网络仅使用语义一致的样本进行优化，而没有接触到负样本，导致学习到有节奏的姿势，而不是稀疏的运动，例如代表性和隐喻性姿势。此外，通过独立地建模身体部位，大多数方法未能保持跨模态一致性。我们引入了一种基于对比流匹配的共语姿势生成模型，该模型使用不匹配的音频-文本条件作为负样本，训练速度场使其遵循正确的运动轨迹，同时排斥语义不一致的轨迹。我们的模型通过余弦和对比目标，将文本、音频和整体运动嵌入到复合潜在空间中，从而确保跨模态一致性。大量的实验和用户研究表明，我们提出的方法在BEAT2和SHOW两个数据集上优于最先进的方法。
tldr: The paper introduces HolisticSemGes, a Contrastive Flow Matching model for co-speech gesture generation that improves semantic grounding and crossmodal consistency by using mismatched audio-text as negatives, outperforming state-of-the-art methods on BEAT2 and SHOW datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了HolisticSemGes，一种基于对比流匹配的口语姿势生成模型，通过使用不匹配的音频-文本作为负例，改善语义基础和跨模态一致性，并在BEAT2和SHOW数据集上优于最先进的方法。

title: AutoWeather4D: Autonomous Driving Video Weather Conversion via G-Buffer Dual-Pass Editing
summary: Generative video models have significantly advanced the photorealistic synthesis of adverse weather for autonomous driving; however, they consistently demand massive datasets to learn rare weather scenarios. While 3D-aware editing methods alleviate these data constraints by augmenting existing video footage, they are fundamentally bottlenecked by costly per-scene optimization and suffer from inherent geometric and illumination entanglement. In this work, we introduce AutoWeather4D, a feed-forward 3D-aware weather editing framework designed to explicitly decouple geometry and illumination. At the core of our approach is a G-buffer Dual-pass Editing mechanism. The Geometry Pass leverages explicit structural foundations to enable surface-anchored physical interactions, while the Light Pass analytically resolves light transport, accumulating the contributions of local illuminants into the global illumination to enable dynamic 3D local relighting. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AutoWeather4D achieves comparable photorealism and structural consistency to generative baselines while enabling fine-grained parametric physical control, serving as a practical data engine for autonomous driving.
summary_zh: 生成式视频模型在自动驾驶的恶劣天气逼真合成方面取得了显著进展；然而，它们始终需要大规模数据集来学习罕见天气场景。虽然3D感知编辑方法通过扩充现有视频素材缓解了这些数据约束，但它们从根本上受到昂贵的逐场景优化以及固有的几何和光照纠缠的限制。在这项工作中，我们提出了AutoWeather4D，一个前馈式3D感知天气编辑框架，旨在显式解耦几何和光照。我们方法的核心是一种G-buffer双通道编辑机制。几何通道利用显式结构基础来实现表面锚定的物理交互，而光照通道分析性地解析光传输，将局部照明贡献累积到全局光照中，以实现动态3D局部重照明。大量实验表明，AutoWeather4D在实现与生成式基线相当的逼真度和结构一致性的同时，实现了精细的参数化物理控制，可作为自动驾驶的实用数据引擎。
tldr: AutoWeather4D offers a novel feed-forward 3D-aware weather editing framework for autonomous driving videos, decoupling geometry and illumination using a G-buffer dual-pass editing mechanism to generate realistic and structurally consistent adverse weather scenarios.
tldr_zh: AutoWeather4D 提出了一种新的前馈 3D 感知天气编辑框架，用于自动驾驶视频，通过使用 G-buffer 双通道编辑机制来解耦几何形状和光照，从而生成逼真且结构一致的恶劣天气场景。

title: SparseCam4D: Spatio-Temporally Consistent 4D Reconstruction from Sparse Cameras
summary: High-quality 4D reconstruction enables photorealistic and immersive rendering of the dynamic real world. However, unlike static scenes that can be fully captured with a single camera, high-quality dynamic scenes typically require dense arrays of tens or even hundreds of synchronized cameras. Dependence on such costly lab setups severely limits practical scalability. The reliance on such costly lab setups severely limits practical scalability. To this end, we propose a sparse-camera dynamic reconstruction framework that exploits abundant yet inconsistent generative observations. Our key innovation is the Spatio-Temporal Distortion Field, which provides a unified mechanism for modeling inconsistencies in generative observations across both spatial and temporal dimensions. Building on this, we develop a complete pipeline that enables 4D reconstruction from sparse and uncalibrated camera inputs. We evaluate our method on multi-camera dynamic scene benchmarks, achieving spatio-temporally consistent high-fidelity renderings and significantly outperforming existing approaches.
summary_zh: 高质量的4D重建能够实现动态真实世界的照片级真实感和沉浸式渲染。然而，与可以通过单个相机完全捕获的静态场景不同，高质量的动态场景通常需要由几十甚至数百个同步相机组成的高密度阵列。对这种昂贵的实验室设置的依赖严重限制了实际的可扩展性。为此，我们提出了一种稀疏相机动态重建框架，该框架利用丰富但非一致性的生成式观测。我们的关键创新是时空扭曲场，它提供了一种统一的机制来建模生成式观测在空间和时间维度上的不一致性。在此基础上，我们开发了一个完整的流程，能够从稀疏和未校准的相机输入中实现4D重建。我们在多相机动态场景基准测试上评估了我们的方法，实现了时空一致的高保真渲染，并显著优于现有方法。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel method, SparseCam4D, for high-quality 4D reconstruction from sparse and uncalibrated camera inputs by modeling spatio-temporal inconsistencies in generative observations using a Spatio-Temporal Distortion Field.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为 SparseCam4D 的新方法，通过使用时空扭曲场对生成观测中的时空不一致性进行建模，从而从稀疏和未校准的相机输入中实现高质量的 4D 重建。

title: Experimental study on surveillance video-based indoor occupancy measurement with occupant-centric control
summary: Accurate occupancy information is essential for closed-loop occupant-centric control (OCC) in smart buildings. However, existing vision-based occupancy measurement methods often struggle to provide stable and accurate measurements in real indoor environments, and their implications for downstream HVAC control remain insufficiently studied. To achieve Net Zero emissions by 2050, this paper presents an experimental study of large language models (LLMs)-enhanced vision-based indoor occupancy measurement and its impact on OCC-enabled HVAC operation. Detection-only, tracking-based, and LLM-based refinement pipelines are compared under identical conditions using real surveillance data collected from a research laboratory in China, with frame-level manual ground-truth annotations. Results show that tracking-based methods improve temporal stability over detection-only measurement, while LLM-based refinement further improves occupancy measurement performance and reduces false unoccupied prediction. The best-performing pipeline, YOLOv8+DeepSeek, achieves an accuracy of 0.8824 and an F1-score of 0.9320. This pipeline is then integrated into an HVAC supervisory model predictive control framework in OpenStudio-EnergyPlus. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework can support more efficient OCC operation, achieving a substantial HVAC energy-saving potential of 17.94%. These findings provide an effective methodology and practical foundation for future research in AI-enhanced smart building operations.
summary_zh: 在智能建筑中，准确的 occupancy 信息对于闭环的以人为中心的控制（OCC）至关重要。然而，现有的基于视觉的 occupancy 测量方法通常难以在真实的室内环境中提供稳定和准确的测量结果，且它们对下游 HVAC 控制的影响尚未得到充分研究。为了实现 2050 年净零排放的目标，本文提出了一项关于大型语言模型（LLM）增强的基于视觉的室内 occupancy 测量及其对 OCC 驱动的 HVAC 运行影响的实验研究。在使用从中国某研究实验室收集的真实监控数据，以及帧级别的手动标注真值的情况下，在相同条件下比较了仅检测、基于追踪和基于 LLM 的优化流程。结果表明，基于追踪的方法比仅检测方法提高了时间稳定性，而基于 LLM 的优化进一步提高了 occupancy 测量性能并减少了错误的无人预测。性能最佳的流程 YOLOv8+DeepSeek 实现了 0.8824 的准确率和 0.9320 的 F1 值。然后，该流程被整合到 OpenStudio-EnergyPlus 的 HVAC 监督模型预测控制框架中。实验结果表明，所提出的框架可以支持更高效的 OCC 运行，实现高达 17.94% 的 HVAC 节能潜力。这些发现为未来人工智能增强的智能建筑运行研究提供了一种有效的方法和实践基础。
tldr: This paper explores the use of LLMs to enhance vision-based indoor occupancy measurement for HVAC control in smart buildings, demonstrating significant energy savings through improved accuracy and reduced false unoccupied predictions.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用大型语言模型（LLM）来增强基于视觉的室内人员占用测量，用于智能建筑中的暖通空调（HVAC）控制，并通过提高准确性和减少误报无人的预测，展示了显著的节能效果。

title: Drive-Through 3D Vehicle Exterior Reconstruction via Dynamic-Scene SfM and Distortion-Aware Gaussian Splatting
summary: High-fidelity 3D reconstruction of vehicle exteriors improves buyer confidence in online automotive marketplaces, but generating these models in cluttered dealership drive-throughs presents severe technical challenges. Unlike static-scene photogrammetry, this setting features a dynamic vehicle moving against heavily cluttered, static backgrounds. This problem is further compounded by wide-angle lens distortion, specular automotive paint, and non-rigid wheel rotations that violate classical epipolar constraints. We propose an end-to-end pipeline utilizing a two-pillar camera rig. First, we resolve dynamic-scene ambiguities by coupling SAM 3 for instance segmentation with motion-gating to cleanly isolate the moving vehicle, explicitly masking out non-rigid wheels to enforce strict epipolar geometry. Second, we extract robust correspondences directly on raw, distorted 4K imagery using the RoMa v2 learned matcher guided by semantic confidence masks. Third, these matches are integrated into a rig-aware SfM optimization that utilizes CAD-derived relative pose priors to eliminate scale drift. Finally, we use a distortion-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting framework (3DGUT) coupled with a stochastic Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) densification strategy to render reflective surfaces. Evaluations on 25 real-world vehicles across 10 dealerships demonstrate that our full pipeline achieves a PSNR of 28.66 dB, an SSIM of 0.89, and an LPIPS of 0.21 on held-out views, representing a 3.85 dB improvement over standard 3D-GS, delivering inspection-grade interactive 3D models without controlled studio infrastructure.
summary_zh: 车辆外观的高保真3D重建能够提高在线汽车交易市场中买家的信心，但在杂乱的经销商试驾环境中生成这些模型则面临着严峻的技术挑战。与静态场景摄影测量不同，此场景的特点是动态车辆在高度杂乱的静态背景下移动。广角镜头畸变、反光的汽车涂料以及违反经典对极约束的非刚性车轮旋转，进一步加剧了这个问题。我们提出了一种使用双支柱相机装置的端到端流程。首先，我们通过将SAM 3 для instance segmentation与运动门控相结合，干净地隔离移动车辆，并明确屏蔽掉非刚性车轮以强制执行严格的对极几何，从而解决动态场景的模糊性。其次，我们使用由语义置信度掩码引导的RoMa v2 学习匹配器，直接在原始的、失真的4K图像上提取鲁棒的对应关系。第三，这些匹配被整合到考虑装置结构的SfM优化中，该优化利用CAD导出的相对姿态先验来消除尺度漂移。最后，我们使用与随机马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛 (MCMC) 密集化策略相结合的 distortion-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGUT) 框架来渲染反射表面。在10家经销商的25辆真实车辆上的评估表明，我们的完整流程在预留视图上实现了28.66 dB的PSNR、0.89的SSIM和0.21的LPIPS，与标准3D-GS相比提升了3.85 dB，在无需受控工作室基础设施的情况下，提供了可用于检查级别的交互式3D模型。
tldr: This paper presents a pipeline for high-fidelity 3D vehicle reconstruction in cluttered environments using dynamic-scene SfM and distortion-aware Gaussian Splatting, achieving robust results without controlled studio conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在高杂波环境下使用动态场景SfM和失真感知高斯溅射进行高保真3D车辆重建的流水线，无需受控演播室环境即可获得稳健的结果。

title: The Multi-AMR Buffer Storage, Retrieval, and Reshuffling Problem: Exact and Heuristic Approaches
summary: Buffer zones are essential in production systems to decouple sequential processes. In dense floor storage environments, such as space-constrained brownfield facilities, manual operation is increasingly challenged by severe labor shortages and rising operational costs. Automating these zones requires solving the Buffer Storage, Retrieval, and Reshuffling Problem (BSRRP). While previous work has addressed scenarios where the focus is limited to reshuffling and retrieving a fixed set of items, real-world manufacturing necessitates an adaptive approach that also incorporates arriving unit loads. This paper introduces the Multi-AMR BSRRP, coordinating a robot fleet to manage concurrent reshuffling, alongside time-windowed storage and retrieval tasks, within a shared floor area. We formulate a Binary Integer Programming (IP) model to obtain exact solutions for benchmarking purposes. As the problem is NP-hard, rendering exact methods computationally intractable for industrial scales, we propose a hierarchical heuristic.
