This approach decomposes the problem into an A* search for task-level sequence planning of unit load placements, and a Constraint Programming (CP) approach for multi-robot coordination and scheduling. Experiments demonstrate orders-of-magnitude computation time reductions compared to the exact formulation. These results confirm the heuristic's viability as responsive control logic for high-density production environments.
summary_zh: 缓冲区在生产系统中至关重要，用于解耦顺序流程。在空间受限的棕地设施等高密度地面存储环境中，人工操作正日益受到严重劳动力短缺和运营成本上升的挑战。实现这些区域的自动化需要解决缓冲区存储、检索和重排问题 (BSRRP)。虽然以前的工作已经解决了重点仅限于重排和检索固定物品集合的场景，但现实世界的制造业需要一种自适应方法，该方法也包括到达的单元负载。本文介绍了多自主移动机器人BSRRP，它协调机器人群组在共享地面区域内同时管理重排，以及有时窗的存储和检索任务。我们建立了一个二元整数规划 (IP) 模型，以获得精确解作为基准。由于该问题是NP-hard问题，使得精确方法在工业规模上计算量太大，因此我们提出了一种分层启发式算法。该方法将问题分解为：用于单元负载放置的任务级序列规划的A*搜索，以及用于多机器人协调和调度的约束规划 (CP) 方法。实验表明，与精确公式相比，计算时间减少了几个数量级。这些结果证实了该启发式算法作为高密度生产环境响应式控制逻辑的可行性。
tldr: This paper proposes a hierarchical heuristic approach for solving the Multi-AMR Buffer Storage, Retrieval, and Reshuffling Problem in automated production systems, demonstrating significant computation time reductions compared to exact solutions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分层启发式方法，用于解决自动化生产系统中的多自主移动机器人 (AMR) 缓冲存储、检索和重排问题，与精确解法相比，计算时间显著缩短。

title: Curvature-aware Expected Free Energy as an Acquisition Function for Bayesian Optimization
summary: We propose an Expected Free Energy-based acquisition function for Bayesian optimization to solve the joint learning and optimization problem, i.e., optimize and learn the underlying function simultaneously. We show that, under specific assumptions, Expected Free Energy reduces to Upper Confidence Bound, Lower Confidence Bound, and Expected Information Gain. We prove that Expected Free Energy has unbiased convergence guarantees for concave functions. Using the results from these derivations, we introduce a curvature-aware update law for Expected Free Energy and show its proof of concept using a system identification problem on a Van der Pol oscillator. Through rigorous simulation experiments, we show that our adaptive Expected Free Energy-based acquisition function outperforms state-of-the-art acquisition functions with the least final simple regret and error in learning the Gaussian process.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种基于期望自由能的采集函数，用于贝叶斯优化，以解决联合学习与优化问题，即同时优化和学习底层函数。我们证明，在特定假设下，期望自由能可简化为上限置信界、下限置信界和期望信息增益。我们证明，对于凹函数，期望自由能具有无偏收敛保证。基于这些推导结果，我们为期望自由能引入了一种曲率感知的更新法则，并使用 Van der Pol 振荡器的系统辨识问题展示了其概念验证。通过严格的仿真实验，我们表明，我们的自适应期望自由能采集函数在学习高斯过程中，以最小的最终简单遗憾和误差，优于最先进的采集函数。
tldr: The paper introduces a curvature-aware Expected Free Energy acquisition function for Bayesian optimization, demonstrating its superior performance compared to existing methods in learning and optimization, with theoretical convergence guarantees.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种曲率感知的期望自由能采集函数，用于贝叶斯优化，证明了其在学习和优化方面优于现有方法，并具有理论收敛保证。

title: Decoding Defensive Coverage Responsibilities in American Football Using Factorized Attention Based Transformer Models
summary: Defensive coverage schemes in the National Football League (NFL) represent complex tactical patterns requiring coordinated assignments among defenders who must react dynamically to the offense's passing concept. This paper presents a factorized attention-based transformer model applied to NFL multi-agent play tracking data to predict individual coverage assignments, receiver-defender matchups, and the targeted defender on every pass play. Unlike previous approaches that focus on post-hoc coverage classification at the team level, our model enables predictive modeling of individual player assignments and matchup dynamics throughout the play. The factorized attention mechanism separates temporal and agent dimensions, allowing independent modeling of player movement patterns and inter-player relationships. Trained on randomly truncated trajectories, the model generates frame-by-frame predictions that capture how defensive responsibilities evolve from pre-snap through pass arrival. Our models achieve approximately 89\%+ accuracy for all tasks, with true accuracy potentially higher given annotation ambiguity in the ground truth labels. These outputs also enable novel derivative metrics, including disguise rate and double coverage rate, which enable enhanced storytelling in TV broadcasts as well as provide actionable insights for team strategy development and player evaluation.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于分解注意力机制Transformer模型，应用于NFL（国家橄榄球联盟）多智能体比赛追踪数据，以预测个人防守覆盖任务、接球手-防守队员对抗以及每次传球进攻中被针对的防守队员。与以往侧重于事后团队层面覆盖分类的方法不同，我们的模型能够对整个比赛过程中个人球员任务和对抗动态进行预测建模。分解注意力机制分离了时间和智能体维度，从而能够独立建模球员的移动模式和球员间的关系。该模型在随机截断的轨迹上训练，生成逐帧预测，捕捉了防守职责从开球前到传球到达的变化。我们的模型在所有任务中均实现了约89%+的准确率，考虑到真实标签中的标注模糊性，真实准确率可能更高。这些输出还能实现新的衍生指标，包括伪装率和双人包夹率，从而增强电视转播中的故事叙述性，并为团队战略制定和球员评估提供可行的见解。
tldr: This paper uses a factorized attention-based transformer to predict individual defensive assignments and matchup dynamics in NFL football, achieving high accuracy and enabling new analytical metrics.
tldr_zh: 本文使用一种基于分解注意力机制的Transformer模型来预测NFL橄榄球比赛中个人防守任务和对抗动态，实现了高精度，并支持新的分析指标。

title: SHANDS: A Multi-View Dataset and Benchmark for Surgical Hand-Gesture and Error Recognition Toward Medical Training
summary: In surgical training for medical students, proficiency development relies on expert-led skill assessment, which is costly, time-limited, difficult to scale, and its expertise remains confined to institutions with available specialists. Automated AI-based assessment offers a viable alternative, but progress is constrained by the lack of datasets containing realistic trainee errors and the multi-view variability needed to train robust computer vision approaches. To address this gap, we present Surgical-Hands (SHands), a large-scale multi-view video dataset for surgical hand-gesture and error recognition for medical training. \textsc{SHands} captures linear incision and suturing using five RGB cameras from complementary viewpoints, performed by 52 participants (20 experts and 32 trainees), each completing three standardized trials per procedure. The videos are annotated at the frame level with 15 gesture primitives and include a validated taxonomy of 8 trainee error types, enabling both gesture recognition and error detection. We further define standardized evaluation protocols for single-view, multi-view, and cross-view generalization, and benchmark state-of-the-art deep learning models on the dataset. SHands is publicly released to support the development of robust and scalable AI systems for surgical training grounded in clinically curated domain knowledge.
summary_zh: 医学学生的外科手术训练中，技能熟练度的提升依赖于专家主导的技能评估，但这成本高昂、时间有限、难以扩展，且其专业知识仍然局限于拥有专家的机构。基于人工智能的自动评估提供了一种可行的替代方案，但进展受到缺乏包含真实受训者错误的数据集以及训练稳健计算机视觉方法所需的多视角变异性的限制。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了Surgical-Hands（SHands），这是一个大规模多视角视频数据集，用于医学培训中的外科手部姿势和错误识别。\textsc{SHands} 使用五个RGB相机从互补视角捕捉直线切口和缝合，由52名参与者（20名专家和32名受训者）执行，每人完成每个流程的三次标准化试验。视频在帧级别上用15种姿势原语进行标注，并包含一个经过验证的8种受训者错误类型分类法，从而能够进行姿势识别和错误检测。我们进一步定义了单视角、多视角和跨视角泛化的标准化评估协议，并在数据集上对最先进的深度学习模型进行了基准测试。SHands已公开发布，旨在支持开发基于临床策划的领域知识、稳健且可扩展的外科手术训练人工智能系统。
tldr: The paper introduces SHANDS, a large-scale multi-view surgical video dataset with gesture and error annotations, designed to facilitate AI-based surgical skill assessment, particularly for trainees.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为SHANDS的大规模多视角手术视频数据集，它带有手势和错误标注，旨在促进基于人工智能的手术技能评估，特别是针对实习医生。

title: GLASS: Geometry-aware Local Alignment and Structure Synchronization Network for 2D-3D Registration
summary: Image-to-point cloud registration methods typically follow a coarse-to-fine pipeline, extracting patch-level correspondences and refining them into dense pixel-to-point matches. However, in scenes with repetitive patterns, images often lack sufficient 3D structural cues and alignment with point clouds, leading to incorrect matches. Moreover, prior methods usually overlook structural consistency, limiting the full exploitation of correspondences. To address these issues, we propose two novel modules: the Local Geometry Enhancement (LGE) module and the Graph Distribution Consistency (GDC) module. LGE enhances both image and point cloud features with normal vectors, injecting geometric structure into image features to reduce mismatches. GDC constructs a graph from matched points to update features and explicitly constrain similarity distributions. Extensive experiments and ablations on two benchmarks, RGB-D Scenes v2 and 7-Scenes, demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance in image-to-point cloud registration.
summary_zh: 图像到点云的配准方法通常遵循由粗到精的流程，提取patch级别的对应关系，并将其细化为密集的像素到点的匹配。然而，在具有重复模式的场景中，图像常常缺乏足够的3D结构线索，并且与点云对齐度不足，导致错误的匹配。此外，先前的方法通常忽略结构一致性，限制了对应关系的充分利用。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了两个新的模块：局部几何增强(LGE)模块和图分布一致性(GDC)模块。LGE利用法向量增强图像和点云特征，将几何结构注入图像特征，从而减少误匹配。GDC从匹配的点构建图，以更新特征并显式地约束相似度分布。在RGB-D Scenes v2和7-Scenes两个基准数据集上的大量实验和消融研究表明，我们的方法在图像到点云配准方面达到了最先进的性能。
tldr: The paper proposes a new method, GLASS, for 2D-3D registration that uses geometry-aware modules to improve matching in scenes with repetitive patterns, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的 2D-3D 配准方法 GLASS，该方法使用几何感知模块来提高重复模式场景中的匹配，并实现了最先进的性能。

title: DUGAE: Unified Geometry and Attribute Enhancement via Spatiotemporal Correlations for G-PCC Compressed Dynamic Point Clouds
summary: Existing post-decoding quality enhancement methods for point clouds are designed for static data and typically process each frame independently. As a result, they cannot effectively exploit the spatiotemporal correlations present in point cloud sequences.We propose a unified geometry and attribute enhancement framework (DUGAE) for G-PCC compressed dynamic point clouds that explicitly exploits inter-frame spatiotemporal correlations in both geometry and attributes. First, a dynamic geometry enhancement network (DGE-Net) based on sparse convolution (SPConv) and feature-domain geometry motion compensation (GMC) aligns and aggregates spatiotemporal information. Then, a detail-aware k-nearest neighbors (DA-KNN) recoloring module maps the original attributes onto the enhanced geometry at the encoder side, improving mapping completeness and preserving attribute details. Finally, a dynamic attribute enhancement network (DAE-Net) with dedicated temporal feature extraction and feature-domain attribute motion compensation (AMC) refines attributes by modeling complex spatiotemporal correlations. On seven dynamic point clouds from the 8iVFB v2, Owlii, and MVUB datasets, DUGAE significantly enhanced the performance of the latest G-PCC geometry-based solid content test model (GeS-TM v10). For geometry (D1), it achieved an average BD-PSNR gain of 11.03 dB and a 93.95% BD-bitrate reduction. For the luma component, it achieved a 4.23 dB BD-PSNR gain with a 66.61% BD-bitrate reduction. DUGAE also improved perceptual quality (as measured by PCQM) and outperformed V-PCC. Our source code will be released on GitHub at: https://github.com/yuanhui0325/DUGAE
summary_zh: 现有的点云后解码质量增强方法是为静态数据设计的，并且通常独立处理每一帧。因此，它们无法有效地利用点云序列中存在的时空相关性。我们提出了一种统一的几何和属性增强框架 (DUGAE)，用于G-PCC压缩的动态点云，该框架显式地利用了几何和属性上的帧间时空相关性。首先，一个基于稀疏卷积 (SPConv) 和特征域几何运动补偿 (GMC) 的动态几何增强网络 (DGE-Net) 对齐和聚合时空信息。然后，一个细节感知的k近邻 (DA-KNN) 重着色模块将原始属性映射到编码器侧增强的几何上，从而提高映射的完整性并保留属性细节。最后，一个具有专用时序特征提取和特征域属性运动补偿 (AMC) 的动态属性增强网络 (DAE-Net) 通过建模复杂的时空相关性来细化属性。在来自 8iVFB v2、Owlii 和 MVUB 数据集的七个动态点云上，DUGAE 显著提高了最新 G-PCC 基于几何的实心内容测试模型 (GeS-TM v10) 的性能。对于几何 (D1)，它实现了平均 11.03 dB 的 BD-PSNR 增益和 93.95% 的 BD-码率降低。对于亮度分量，它实现了 4.23 dB 的 BD-PSNR 增益以及 66.61% 的 BD-码率降低。DUGAE 还改进了感知质量 (如 PCQM 所测量)，并优于 V-PCC。我们的源代码将在 GitHub 上发布，网址为：https://github.com/yuanhui0325/DUGAE
tldr: The paper introduces DUGAE, a spatiotemporal correlation-aware framework for enhancing G-PCC compressed dynamic point clouds, achieving significant improvements in geometry and attribute quality compared to existing methods and V-PCC.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DUGAE，一个利用时空相关性的框架，用于增强G-PCC压缩的动态点云，相比现有方法和V-PCC在几何和属性质量上取得了显著提升。

title: InstaVSR: Taming Diffusion for Efficient and Temporally Consistent Video Super-Resolution
summary: Video super-resolution (VSR) seeks to reconstruct high-resolution frames from low-resolution inputs. While diffusion-based methods have substantially improved perceptual quality, extending them to video remains challenging for two reasons: strong generative priors can introduce temporal instability, and multi-frame diffusion pipelines are often too expensive for practical deployment. To address both challenges simultaneously, we propose InstaVSR, a lightweight diffusion framework for efficient video super-resolution. InstaVSR combines three ingredients: (1) a pruned one-step diffusion backbone that removes several costly components from conventional diffusion-based VSR pipelines, (2) recurrent training with flow-guided temporal regularization to improve frame-to-frame stability, and (3) dual-space adversarial learning in latent and pixel spaces to preserve perceptual quality after backbone simplification. On an NVIDIA RTX 4090, InstaVSR processes a 30-frame video at 2K$\times$2K resolution in under one minute with only 7 GB of memory usage, substantially reducing the computational cost compared to existing diffusion-based methods while maintaining favorable perceptual quality with significantly smoother temporal transitions.
summary_zh: 视频超分辨率（VSR）旨在从低分辨率输入重建高分辨率帧。虽然基于扩散的方法已显著提高了感知质量，但将其扩展到视频仍然面临两个挑战：强大的生成先验可能引入时间不稳定，以及多帧扩散流程通常过于昂贵，不便于实际部署。为了同时解决这两个挑战，我们提出了 InstaVSR，这是一个用于高效视频超分辨率的轻量级扩散框架。InstaVSR 结合了三个要素：（1）经过剪枝的单步扩散骨干网络，它从传统的基于扩散的VSR流程中移除了一些昂贵的组件；（2）通过光流引导的时间正则化进行循环训练，以改善帧与帧之间的稳定性；以及（3）在潜在空间和像素空间中的双重空间对抗学习，以在骨干网络简化后保持感知质量。在 NVIDIA RTX 4090 上，InstaVSR 处理一个 30 帧的 2K$\times$2K分辨率视频，耗时不到一分钟，仅占用 7 GB 的内存，与现有的基于扩散的方法相比，显著降低了计算成本，同时保持了良好的感知质量和显著更平滑的时间过渡。
tldr: The paper introduces InstaVSR, a lightweight diffusion framework for efficient and temporally stable video super-resolution, achieving significant speed and memory improvements compared to existing diffusion-based methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了InstaVSR，一个轻量级的扩散框架，用于高效且时间上稳定的视频超分辨率，与现有的基于扩散的方法相比，实现了显著的速度和内存改进。

title: User Involvement in Robotic Wheelchair Development: A Decade of Limited Progress
summary: Robotic wheelchairs (RWs) offer significant potential to enhance autonomy and participation for people with mobility impairments, yet many systems have failed to achieve sustained real-world adoption. This narrative literature review examined the extent and quality of end-user involvement in RW design, development, and evaluation over the past decade (2015--2025), assessed against core principles shared by major user-involvement approaches (e.g., user-/human-centered design, participatory/co-design, and inclusive design). The findings indicate that user involvement remains limited and is predominantly concentrated in late-stage evaluation rather than in early requirements definition or iterative co-design. Of the 399 records screened, only 23 studies (about 6%) met the inclusion criteria of verifiable end-user involvement, and many relied on small samples, often around ten participants, with limited justification for sample size selection, proxy users, laboratory-based validation, and non-standardized feedback methods. Research teams were largely engineering-dominated (about 89%) and geographically concentrated in high-income countries. Despite strong evidence that sustained user engagement improves usability and adoption in assistive technology, its systematic implementation in RW research remains rare. Advancing the field requires embedding participatory methodologies throughout the design lifecycle and addressing systemic barriers that constrain meaningful user involvement.
summary_zh: 机器人轮椅（RWs）为行动障碍人士增强自主性和参与度提供了巨大的潜力，然而许多系统未能实现可持续的实际应用。本叙述性文献综述考察了过去十年(2015-2025)中，最终用户参与机器人轮椅设计、开发和评估的程度和质量，并对照主要用户参与方法(例如，以用户/人为中心的设计、参与式/协同设计和包容性设计)所共享的核心原则进行了评估。研究结果表明，用户参与仍然有限，并且主要集中在后期评估，而不是在早期的需求定义或迭代协同设计中。在筛选的 399 条记录中，只有 23 项研究（约 6%）符合可验证的最终用户参与的纳入标准，并且许多研究依赖于小样本量，通常约为十名参与者，样本量选择的理由有限，使用代理用户，基于实验室的验证以及非标准化反馈方法。研究团队主要以工程领域为主（约 89%），并且在地理上集中在高收入国家。尽管有强有力的证据表明，持续的用户参与可以提高辅助技术的可用性和采纳率，但其在机器人轮椅研究中的系统性实施仍然罕见。推进该领域需要将参与式方法嵌入到整个设计生命周期中，并解决限制有意义用户参与的系统性障碍。
tldr: This paper reviews a decade of robotic wheelchair development and finds that user involvement is still limited, primarily occurring in late-stage evaluation rather than early design phases, hindering real-world adoption.
tldr_zh: 该论文回顾了过去十年机器人轮椅的发展，发现用户参与仍然有限，主要发生在后期评估阶段，而不是早期设计阶段，这阻碍了现实世界的采用。

title: Optimal Prioritized Dissipation and Closed-Form Damping Limitation under Actuator Constraints for Haptic Interfaces
summary: In haptics, guaranteeing stability is essential to ensure safe interaction with remote or virtual environments. One of the most relevant methods at the state-of-the-art is the Time Domain Passivity Approach (TDPA). However, its high conservatism leads to a significant degradation of transparency. Moreover, the stabilizing action may conflict with the device's physical limitations. State-of-the-art solutions have attempted to address these actuator limits, but they still fail to account simultaneously for the power limits of each actuator while maximizing transparency. This work proposes a new damping limitation method based on prioritized dissipation actions. It prioritizes an optimal dissipation direction that minimizes actuator load, while any excess dissipation is allocated to the orthogonal hyperplane. The solution provides a closed-form formulation and is robust in multi-DoF scenarios, even in the presence of actuator and motion anisotropies. The method is experimentally validated using a parallel haptic interface interacting with a virtual environment and tested under different operating conditions.
summary_zh: 在触觉领域，保证稳定性对于确保与远程或虚拟环境的安全交互至关重要。目前最相关的技术之一是时域无源性方法（TDPA）。然而，其高度保守性会导致透明度显著降低。此外，稳定作用可能与设备的物理限制相冲突。目前最先进的解决方案已尝试解决这些执行器限制，但仍然无法同时兼顾每个执行器的功率限制和最大化透明度。本工作提出了一种基于优先级耗散行为的新型阻尼限制方法。它优先考虑最小化执行器负载的最优耗散方向，同时将任何多余的耗散分配到正交超平面。该解决方案提供了闭式公式，并且在多自由度情况下（即使存在执行器和运动各向异性）也具有鲁棒性。该方法通过一个与虚拟环境交互的并联触觉界面进行了实验验证，并在不同的操作条件下进行了测试。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel damping limitation method for haptic interfaces that prioritizes dissipation to minimize actuator load while maximizing transparency and accounting for actuator constraints, validated experimentally on a parallel haptic interface.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新型触觉界面阻尼限制方法，该方法优先考虑耗散以最小化执行器负载，同时最大化透明度并考虑执行器约束，已在并行触觉界面上进行了实验验证。

title: Channelling, Coordinating, Collaborating: A Three-Layer Framework for Disability-Centered Human-Agent Collaboration
summary: AI accessibility tools have mostly been designed for individual use, helping one person overcome a specific functional barrier. But for many people with disabilities, complex tasks are accomplished through collaboration with others who bring complementary abilities, not solitary effort. We propose a three-layer framework, Channelling, Coordinating, and Co-Creating, that rethinks AI's role in ability-diverse collaboration: establishing shared informational ground across abilities, mediating workflows between collaborators with different abilities, and contributing as a bounded partner toward shared goals. Grounded in the Ability-Diverse Collaboration framework, grounding theory, and Carlile's 3T framework, it extends the ``agents as remote collaborators'' vision by centring the collaborative, interdependent ways people with disabilities already work.
summary_zh: 人工智能辅助工具主要针对个人使用而设计，旨在帮助个人克服特定的功能障碍。然而对于许多残障人士而言，完成复杂任务是通过与他人合作，发挥各自互补的能力，而非单打独斗。我们提出了一个三层框架——通道化（Channelling）、协调（Coordinating）和共创（Co-Creating）——重新思考人工智能在能力多样化协作中的作用：在不同能力的个体之间建立共享的信息基础，调解具有不同能力的合作者之间的工作流程，并作为有限的伙伴为共同目标做出贡献。该框架立足于能力多样化协作框架、基础理论和Carlile的3T框架，通过关注残障人士已有的协作和相互依赖的工作方式，扩展了“代理作为远程合作者”的愿景。
tldr: This paper proposes a three-layer framework for AI to support ability-diverse collaboration, moving beyond individual accessibility tools to facilitate collaborative task completion for people with disabilities.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个三层框架，旨在利用人工智能支持不同能力之间的协作，从而超越了个人辅助工具，促进残疾人协作完成任务。

title: Dynamic LIBRAS Gesture Recognition via CNN over Spatiotemporal Matrix Representation
summary: This paper proposes a method for dynamic hand gesture recognition based on the composition of two models: the MediaPipe Hand Landmarker, responsible for extracting 21 skeletal keypoints of the hand, and a convolutional neural network (CNN) trained to classify gestures from a spatiotemporal matrix representation of dimensions 90 by 21 of those keypoints. The method is applied to the recognition of LIBRAS (Brazilian Sign Language) gestures for device control in a home automation system, covering 11 classes of static and dynamic gestures. For real-time inference, a sliding window with temporal frame triplication is used, enabling continuous recognition without recurrent networks. Tests achieved 95\% accuracy under low-light conditions and 92\% under normal lighting. The results indicate that the approach is effective, although systematic experiments with greater user diversity are needed for a more thorough evaluation of generalization.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于双模型组合的动态手势识别方法：MediaPipe Hand Landmarker负责提取手的21个骨骼关键点，卷积神经网络(CNN)则负责对手势进行分类，该CNN的输入是这些关键点构成的90x21维时空矩阵表示。该方法应用于家庭自动化系统中LIBRAS（巴西手语）手势的识别，涵盖了11类静态和动态手势，用于设备控制。对于实时推理，采用了一种具有时间帧三倍化的滑动窗口，从而实现了无需循环网络的连续识别。测试表明，在低光照条件下准确率达到95%，在正常光照条件下准确率达到92%。结果表明该方法有效，但为了更彻底地评估其泛化能力，需要进行更大用户多样性的系统性实验。
tldr: The paper presents a CNN-based method for dynamic LIBRAS gesture recognition using a spatiotemporal matrix representation of hand keypoints, achieving high accuracy for home automation device control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于CNN的动态LIBRAS手势识别方法，该方法使用手部关键点的时空矩阵表示，为家庭自动化设备控制实现了高精度。

title: Image-based Quantification of Postural Deviations on Patients with Cervical Dystonia: A Machine Learning Approach Using Synthetic Training Data
summary: Cervical dystonia (CD) is the most common form of dystonia, yet current assessment relies on subjective clinical rating scales, such as the Toronto Western Spasmodic Torticollis Rating Scale (TWSTRS), which requires expertise, is subjective and faces low inter-rater reliability some items of the score. To address the lack of established objective tools for monitoring disease severity and treatment response, this study validates an automated image-based head pose and shift estimation system for patients with CD. We developed an assessment tool that combines a pretrained head-pose estimation algorithm for rotational symptoms with a deep learning model trained exclusively on ~16,000 synthetic avatar images to evaluate rare translational symptoms, specifically lateral shift. This synthetic data approach overcomes the scarcity of clinical training examples. The system's performance was validated in a multicenter study by comparing its predicted scores against the consensus ratings of 20 clinical experts using a dataset of 100 real patient images and 100 labeled synthetic avatars. The automated system demonstrated strong agreement with expert clinical ratings for rotational symptoms, achieving high correlations for torticollis (r=0.91), laterocollis (r=0.81), and anteroretrocollis (r=0.78). For lateral shift, the tool achieved a moderate correlation (r=0.55) with clinical ratings and demonstrated higher accuracy than human raters in controlled benchmark tests on avatars. By leveraging synthetic training data to bridge the clinical data gap, this model successfully generalizes to real-world patients, providing a validated, objective tool for CD postural assessment that can enable standardized clinical decision-making and trial evaluation.
summary_zh: 颈椎肌张力障碍 (CD) 是最常见的肌张力障碍形式，但目前的评估依赖于主观的临床评定量表，例如多伦多西部痉挛性斜颈评定量表 (TWSTRS)，它需要专业知识，具有主观性，并且在评分的某些项目上面临较低的评分者间信度。为了解决缺乏用于监测疾病严重程度和治疗反应的已建立的客观工具的问题，本研究验证了一种用于CD患者的基于图像的头部姿势和位移估计自动化系统。我们开发了一种评估工具，该工具将用于旋转症状的预训练头部姿势估计算法与专门训练在约16,000张合成头像图像上的深度学习模型相结合，以评估罕见的平移症状，特别是侧向位移。这种合成数据方法克服了临床训练样本的稀缺性。该系统的性能通过多中心研究进行了验证，方法是将系统预测的分数与20位临床专家的共识评分进行比较，使用的是包含100张真实患者图像和100个标记合成头像的数据集。该自动化系统在旋转症状方面表现出与专家临床评分的高度一致性，斜颈 (r=0.91)、侧颈 (r=0.81) 和前屈后仰 (r=0.78) 均达到高相关性。对于侧向位移，该工具与临床评分达到了中等相关性 (r=0.55)，并且在头像的对照基准测试中表现出比人类评分者更高的准确性。通过利用合成训练数据来弥补临床数据差距，该模型成功地推广到真实世界的患者，为CD姿势评估提供了一种经过验证的客观工具，该工具可以实现标准化的临床决策制定和试验评估。
tldr: This paper presents a machine learning approach using synthetic data to objectively assess postural deviations in cervical dystonia patients from images, achieving strong agreement with expert ratings for rotational symptoms and moderate agreement for translational symptoms.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于图像的机器学习方法，利用合成数据客观评估颈椎肌张力障碍患者的姿势偏差。该方法在旋转症状方面与专家评级高度一致，在平移症状方面也达到中等一致。

title: Uni-World VLA: Interleaved World Modeling and Planning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving requires reasoning about how the environment evolves and planning actions accordingly. Existing world-model-based approaches typically predict future scenes first and plan afterwards, resulting in open-loop imagination that may drift from the actual decision process. In this paper, we present Uni-World VLA, a unified vision-language-action (VLA) model that tightly interleaves future frame prediction and trajectory planning. Instead of generating a full world rollout before planning, our model alternates between predicting future frames and ego actions step by step, allowing planning decisions to be continuously conditioned on the imagined future observations. This interleaved generation forms a closed-loop interaction between world modeling and control, enabling more adaptive decision-making in dynamic traffic scenarios. In addition, we incorporate monocular depth information into frames to provide stronger geometric cues for world modeling, improving long-horizon scene prediction. Experiments on the NAVSIM benchmark show that our approach achieves competitive closed-loop planning performance while producing high-fidelity future frame predictions. These results demonstrate that tightly coupling world prediction and planning is a promising direction for scalable VLA driving systems.
summary_zh: 自主驾驶需要推断环境如何演变并据此规划行动。现有的基于世界模型的方案通常先预测未来场景，然后再进行规划，导致开放循环的想象可能偏离实际的决策过程。本文提出了Uni-World VLA，一个统一的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，它紧密地交织了未来帧预测和轨迹规划。我们的模型并非在规划前生成完整的世界展开，而是逐步交替预测未来帧和自我行动，从而允许规划决策持续地以想象中的未来观测为条件。这种交织生成构成了世界建模和控制之间的闭环交互，从而在动态交通场景中实现更具适应性的决策。此外，我们将单目深度信息融入到帧中，为世界建模提供更强的几何线索，从而改善长时程场景预测。在NAVSIM基准上的实验表明，我们的方法在产生高保真未来帧预测的同时，实现了具有竞争力的闭环规划性能。这些结果表明，紧密耦合世界预测和规划是可扩展VLA驾驶系统的一个有希望的方向。
tldr: This paper introduces Uni-World VLA, a unified vision-language-action model for autonomous driving that interleaves future frame prediction and trajectory planning to improve adaptive decision-making in dynamic traffic scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍Uni-World VLA，一个用于自动驾驶的统一视觉-语言-动作模型，该模型交错进行未来帧预测和轨迹规划，以提高动态交通场景中的自适应决策能力。

title: ROSClaw: An OpenClaw ROS 2 Framework for Agentic Robot Control and Interaction
summary: Foundation models can endow robots with open-ended reasoning, language understanding, and adaptive planning, yet connecting a model to a physical robot today requires bespoke integration that couples perception, actuation, and safety to a single model and platform. We present ROSClaw, a model-agnostic executive layer that integrates the OpenClaw agent runtime with ROS 2, enabling any foundation model to perceive, reason about, and act on any ROS-enabled robot through (i) dynamic capability discovery with standardized affordance injection, (ii) multimodal observation normalization, (iii) pre-execution action validation within a configurable safety envelope, and (iv) structured audit logging. Swapping model backends or robot platforms is a configuration change; tool schemas, safety enforcement, and provenance logging remain invariant. We deploy ROSClaw on three platforms (wheeled, quadruped, humanoid) with four foundation-model backends. Under this controlled substrate, models exhibit up to 4.8 x differences in out-of-policy action proposal rates (3.4 x among frontier models alone) and produce qualitatively distinct physical behaviors from identical commands. A cross-framework parity protocol against ROSA confirms that executive-layer design, not just prompt wording, significantly affects both task completion and safety behavior, establishing ROSClaw as both practical agentic-robot infrastructure and a reproducible measurement instrument for embodied AI.
summary_zh: 基础模型可以赋予机器人开放式的推理、语言理解和自适应规划能力，然而目前将模型连接到物理机器人通常需要定制化的集成，将感知、执行和安全与单一模型和平台耦合。我们提出了ROSClaw，一个模型无关的执行层，它将OpenClaw agent运行时与ROS 2集成，使任何基础模型都能够通过以下方式感知、推理和作用于任何支持ROS的机器人：（i）通过标准化可供性注入实现动态能力发现，（ii）多模态观察归一化，（iii）在可配置的安全范围内进行执行前动作验证，以及（iv）结构化的审计日志记录。更换模型后端或机器人平台仅需配置变更；工具模式、安全执行和来源日志记录保持不变。我们在三个平台（轮式、四足、人形）上部署了ROSClaw，并使用了四个基础模型后端。在这个受控的基底上，模型在越界动作提议率上表现出高达4.8倍的差异（仅在前沿模型中也高达3.4倍），并从相同的命令中产生定性不同的物理行为。针对ROSA的跨框架奇偶校验协议证实，执行层设计，而不仅仅是提示词，显著影响任务完成度和安全行为，这确立了ROSClaw作为实用的自主机器人基础设施以及可复现的具身人工智能测量工具的地位。
tldr: The paper introduces ROSClaw, a ROS 2 framework that integrates OpenClaw agent runtime for connecting foundation models to ROS-enabled robots, enabling model-agnostic control and interaction while prioritizing safety and reproducibility. ROSClaw provides dynamic capability discovery, multimodal observation normalization, pre-execution action validation, and structured audit logging making it easier to connect LLMs to robots.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ROSClaw，一个ROS 2框架，它集成了OpenClaw代理运行时，用于连接基础模型到ROS机器人，实现模型无关的控制和交互，同时重点考虑安全性和可重复性。ROSClaw 提供了动态能力发现、多模态观察规范化、预执行动作验证和结构化审计日志，使得将LLM连接到机器人变得更加容易。

title: D-SPEAR: Dual-Stream Prioritized Experience Adaptive Replay for Stable Reinforcement Learninging Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation remains challenging for reinforcement learning due to contact-rich dynamics, long horizons, and training instability. Although off-policy actor-critic algorithms such as SAC and TD3 perform well in simulation, they often suffer from policy oscillations and performance collapse in realistic settings, partly due to experience replay strategies that ignore the differing data requirements of the actor and the critic. We propose D-SPEAR: Dual-Stream Prioritized Experience Adaptive Replay, a replay framework that decouples actor and critic sampling while maintaining a shared replay buffer. The critic leverages prioritized replay for efficient value learning, whereas the actor is updated using low-error transitions to stabilize policy optimization. An adaptive anchor mechanism balances uniform and prioritized sampling based on the coefficient of variation of TD errors, and a Huber-based critic objective further improves robustness under heterogeneous reward scales. We evaluate D-SPEAR on challenging robotic manipulation tasks from the robosuite benchmark, including Block-Lifting and Door-Opening. Results demonstrate that D-SPEAR consistently outperforms strong off-policy baselines, including SAC, TD3, and DDPG, in both final performance and training stability, with ablation studies confirming the complementary roles of the actorside and critic-side replay streams.
summary_zh:
摘要：
由于富含接触的动力学、长时程以及训练不稳定性，机器人操作对强化学习来说仍然具有挑战性。尽管诸如 SAC 和 TD3 等离线 Actor-Critic 算法在仿真中表现良好，但它们在现实环境中经常遭受策略震荡和性能崩溃，部分原因在于忽略 Actor 和 Critic 不同数据需求的经验回放策略。我们提出了 D-SPEAR：双流优先级经验自适应回放，这是一个解耦 Actor 和 Critic 采样的回放框架，同时保持一个共享的回放缓冲区。 Critic 利用优先级回放进行高效的值函数学习，而 Actor 则使用低误差转移进行更新，以稳定策略优化。一种自适应锚定机制基于 TD 误差的变异系数平衡均匀采样和优先级采样，并且基于 Huber 的 Critic 目标进一步提高了在异构奖励尺度下的鲁棒性。我们在 robosuite 基准测试中具有挑战性的机器人操作任务（包括方块举起和开门）上评估了 D-SPEAR。结果表明，D-SPEAR 在最终性能和训练稳定性方面都始终优于强大的离线策略基线，包括 SAC、TD3 和 DDPG，消融研究证实了 Actor 端和 Critic 端的回放流的互补作用。
tldr: The paper introduces D-SPEAR, a novel dual-stream experience replay framework that decouples actor and critic data sampling in reinforcement learning for robotic manipulation, demonstrating improved stability and performance compared to standard off-policy methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了D-SPEAR，一种新型双流经验回放框架，它解耦了强化学习中机器人操作的actor和critic数据采样，与标准off-policy方法相比，展现出更好的稳定性和性能。

title: Where-to-Learn: Analytical Policy Gradient Directed Exploration for On-Policy Robotic Reinforcement Learning
summary: On-policy reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms have demonstrated great potential in robotic control, where effective exploration is crucial for efficient and high-quality policy learning. However, how to encourage the agent to explore the better trajectories efficiently remains a challenge. Most existing methods incentivize exploration by maximizing the policy entropy or encouraging novel state visiting regardless of the potential state value. We propose a new form of directed exploration that uses analytical policy gradients from a differentiable dynamics model to inject task-aware, physics-guided guidance, thereby steering the agent towards high-reward regions for accelerated and more effective policy learning.
summary_zh: 在线强化学习算法在机器人控制领域展现出巨大潜力，其中，有效的探索对于高效和高质量的策略学习至关重要。然而，如何鼓励智能体有效地探索更好的轨迹仍然是一个挑战。现有的大多数方法通过最大化策略熵或鼓励对新颖状态的访问来激励探索，而忽略了潜在的状态价值。我们提出了一种新的定向探索方法，该方法利用来自可微分动力学模型的解析策略梯度来注入任务相关的、物理引导的指导，从而引导智能体朝向高奖励区域，以加速和更有效地进行策略学习。
tldr: This paper proposes a new directed exploration method for on-policy robotic reinforcement learning that uses analytical policy gradients from a differentiable dynamics model to guide the agent toward high-reward regions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的定向探索方法，用于在策略机器人强化学习中，使用可微动力学模型的解析策略梯度来引导智能体向高回报区域移动。

title: HiFlow: Tokenization-Free Scale-Wise Autoregressive Policy Learning via Flow Matching
summary: Coarse-to-fine autoregressive modeling has recently shown strong promise for visuomotor policy learning, combining the inference efficiency of autoregressive methods with the global trajectory coherence of diffusion-based policies. However, existing approaches rely on discrete action tokenizers that map continuous action sequences to codebook indices, a design inherited from image generation where learned compression is necessary for high-dimensional pixel data. We observe that robot actions are inherently low-dimensional continuous vectors, for which such tokenization introduces unnecessary quantization error and a multi-stage training pipeline. In this work, we propose Hierarchical Flow Policy (HiFlow), a tokenization-free coarse-to-fine autoregressive policy that operates directly on raw continuous actions. HiFlow constructs multi-scale continuous action targets from each action chunk via simple temporal pooling. Specifically, it averages contiguous action windows to produce coarse summaries that are refined at finer temporal resolutions. The entire model is trained end-to-end in a single stage, eliminating the need for a separate tokenizer. Experiments on MimicGen, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world environments demonstrate that HiFlow consistently outperforms existing methods including diffusion-based and tokenization-based autoregressive policies.
summary_zh: 由粗到精的自回归建模最近在视觉运动策略学习中展现出强大的潜力，它兼顾了自回归方法的推理效率以及基于扩散策略的全局轨迹连贯性。然而，现有方法依赖于离散动作标记器，将连续动作序列映射到码本索引，这种设计继承自图像生成，其中学习压缩对于高维像素数据是必要的。我们观察到，机器人动作本质上是低维连续向量，对于这种数据，标记化会引入不必要的量化误差，并导致多阶段训练流程。在这项工作中，我们提出了分层流策略（HiFlow），一种无标记化的由粗到精的自回归策略，它可以直接作用于原始连续动作。HiFlow通过简单的时间池化，从每个动作块构建多尺度连续动作目标。具体来说，它平均连续的动作窗口，以生成粗略的摘要，然后在更精细的时间分辨率上进行细化。整个模型以单阶段端到端的方式训练，消除了对单独标记器的需求。在MimicGen、RoboTwin 2.0和真实世界环境上的实验表明，HiFlow始终优于现有方法，包括基于扩散和基于标记化的自回归策略。
tldr: The paper introduces HiFlow, a tokenization-free coarse-to-fine autoregressive policy for continuous robot actions, outperforming existing methods in visuomotor policy learning tasks by eliminating quantization errors from tokenization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了HiFlow，一种无需tokenization的由粗到精的自回归策略，用于连续机器人动作，在视觉运动策略学习任务中，通过消除tokenization引起的量化误差，优于现有方法。

title: A Comparative Study in Surgical AI: Datasets, Foundation Models, and Barriers to Med-AGI
summary: Recent Artificial Intelligence (AI) models have matched or exceeded human experts in several benchmarks of biomedical task performance, but have lagged behind on surgical image-analysis benchmarks. Since surgery requires integrating disparate tasks -- including multimodal data integration, human interaction, and physical effects -- generally-capable AI models could be particularly attractive as a collaborative tool if performance could be improved. On the one hand, the canonical approach of scaling architecture size and training data is attractive, especially since there are millions of hours of surgical video data generated per year. On the other hand, preparing surgical data for AI training requires significantly higher levels of professional expertise, and training on that data requires expensive computational resources. These trade-offs paint an uncertain picture of whether and to-what-extent modern AI could aid surgical practice. In this paper, we explore this question through a case study of surgical tool detection using state-of-the-art AI methods available in 2026. We demonstrate that even with multi-billion parameter models and extensive training, current Vision Language Models fall short in the seemingly simple task of tool detection in neurosurgery. Additionally, we show scaling experiments indicating that increasing model size and training time only leads to diminishing improvements in relevant performance metrics. Thus, our experiments suggest that current models could still face significant obstacles in surgical use cases. Moreover, some obstacles cannot be simply ``scaled away'' with additional compute and persist across diverse model architectures, raising the question of whether data and label availability are the only limiting factors. We discuss the main contributors to these constraints and advance potential solutions.
summary_zh: 近年来，人工智能（AI）模型在多项生物医学任务性能基准测试中已与人类专家匹敌甚至超越，但在手术图像分析基准测试中则表现落后。由于手术需要整合不同的任务，包括多模态数据整合、人机交互和物理效应，因此，如果能够提高性能，通用人工智能模型作为一种协作工具可能特别具有吸引力。一方面，扩展架构规模和训练数据的标准方法很有吸引力，特别是考虑到每年都会产生数百万小时的手术视频数据。另一方面，为人工智能训练准备手术数据需要更高水平的专业知识，并且在该数据上进行训练需要昂贵的计算资源。这些权衡带来了一幅不确定的前景，即现代人工智能能否在多大程度上辅助手术实践。在本文中，我们通过一项使用2026年可用的最先进人工智能方法进行手术器械检测的案例研究来探讨这个问题。我们证明，即使使用数十亿参数的模型和广泛的训练，当前的视觉语言模型在神经外科器械检测这一看似简单的任务中也表现不足。此外，我们的缩放实验表明，增加模型规模和训练时间只会导致相关性能指标的改进递减。因此，我们的实验表明，当前的模型在手术应用场景中可能仍然面临重大障碍。而且，一些障碍无法简单地通过额外的计算能力“扩展消除”，并且在不同的模型架构中持续存在，从而引发了数据和标签可用性是否是唯一限制因素的问题。我们讨论了这些限制的主要因素，并提出了潜在的解决方案。
tldr: This paper investigates the limitations of current Vision-Language Models in surgical tool detection, finding that scaling model size and training data provides diminishing returns. It highlights the challenges in applying AI to surgery and proposes potential solutions.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了当前视觉-语言模型在外科手术工具检测中的局限性，发现扩大模型尺寸和训练数据带来的收益递减。它强调了人工智能应用于外科手术的挑战，并提出了潜在的解决方案。

title: GUIDE: Guided Updates for In-context Decision Evolution in LLM-Driven Spacecraft Operations
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been proposed as supervisory agents for spacecraft operations, but existing approaches rely on static prompting and do not improve across repeated executions. We introduce \textsc{GUIDE}, a non-parametric policy improvement framework that enables cross-episode adaptation without weight updates by evolving a structured, state-conditioned playbook of natural-language decision rules. A lightweight acting model performs real-time control, while offline reflection updates the playbook from prior trajectories. Evaluated on an adversarial orbital interception task in the Kerbal Space Program Differential Games environment, GUIDE's evolution consistently outperforms static baselines. Results indicate that context evolution in LLM agents functions as policy search over structured decision rules in real-time closed-loop spacecraft interaction.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已被提议作为航天器操作的监督智能体，但现有方法依赖于静态提示，且无法在重复执行中得到改进。我们引入了\textsc{GUIDE}，这是一个非参数策略改进框架，它通过演化一个结构化的、状态条件化的自然语言决策规则剧本，从而实现跨情节自适应，而无需权重更新。一个轻量级的执行模型执行实时控制，而离线反思则会根据先前的轨迹更新剧本。在 Kerbal 太空计划微分博弈环境中的对抗性轨道拦截任务中进行评估，GUIDE 的演化始终优于静态基线。结果表明，LLM 智能体中的情境演化可以作为实时闭环航天器交互中结构化决策规则的策略搜索。
tldr: The paper introduces GUIDE, a framework for improving LLM-based spacecraft operation agents by evolving a playbook of natural-language decision rules based on past experience, without updating the LLM's weights.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为GUIDE的框架，通过进化基于过去经验的自然语言决策规则集来改进基于LLM的航天器操作代理，而无需更新LLM的权重。

title: EpochX: Building the Infrastructure for an Emergent Agent Civilization
summary: General-purpose technologies reshape economies less by improving individual tools than by enabling new ways to organize production and coordination. We believe AI agents are approaching a similar inflection point: as foundation models make broad task execution and tool use increasingly accessible, the binding constraint shifts from raw capability to how work is delegated, verified, and rewarded at scale. We introduce EpochX, a credits-native marketplace infrastructure for human-agent production networks. EpochX treats humans and agents as peer participants who can post tasks or claim them. Claimed tasks can be decomposed into subtasks and executed through an explicit delivery workflow with verification and acceptance. Crucially, EpochX is designed so that each completed transaction can produce reusable ecosystem assets, including skills, workflows, execution traces, and distilled experience. These assets are stored with explicit dependency structure, enabling retrieval, composition, and cumulative improvement over time. EpochX also introduces a native credit mechanism to make participation economically viable under real compute costs. Credits lock task bounties, budget delegation, settle rewards upon acceptance, and compensate creators when verified assets are reused. By formalizing the end-to-end transaction model together with its asset and incentive layers, EpochX reframes agentic AI as an organizational design problem: building infrastructures where verifiable work leaves persistent, reusable artifacts, and where value flows support durable human-agent collaboration.
summary_zh: 通用技术对经济的重塑，并非仅仅通过改进单个工具，而是通过赋能组织生产和协调的新方式。我们认为人工智能代理正接近一个类似的拐点：随着基础模型使得广泛的任务执行和工具使用变得越来越容易，约束瓶颈从原始能力转向了如何在规模上委托、验证和奖励工作。我们引入EpochX，一个以信用为基础的人机生产网络市场基础设施。EpochX将人类和代理视为对等参与者，他们可以发布或认领任务。认领的任务可以被分解为子任务，并通过具有验证和接受环节的显式交付工作流程来执行。至关重要的是，EpochX的设计使得每次完成的交易都能产生可复用的生态系统资产，包括技能、工作流程、执行轨迹和提炼的经验。这些资产被存储的同时带有显式的依赖结构，从而支持检索、组合和随时间的累积改进。EpochX还引入了一种本地信用机制，以使参与在实际计算成本下具有经济可行性。信用锁定任务奖励、预算委托、在验收时结算奖励，并在验证后的资产被复用时补偿创建者。通过正式化端到端的交易模型及其资产和激励层，EpochX将代理式人工智能重新定义为一个组织设计问题：构建基础设施，其中可验证的工作留下持久的、可复用的工件，且价值流动支持持久的人机协作。
tldr: The paper introduces EpochX, a marketplace infrastructure designed for human-agent production networks with reusable assets, a credit system, and verifiable task executions. It aims to formalize human-agent collaboration as an organizational problem with persistent, reusable artifacts and value flows.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 EpochX，一个为人类-智能体生产网络设计的市场基础设施，具有可重用的资产、信用系统和可验证的任务执行。它旨在将人机协作形式化为一个组织问题，该问题具有持久的、可重用的工件和价值流。

title: Diagnosing and Repairing Unsafe Channels in Vision-Language Models via Causal Discovery and Dual-Modal Safety Subspace Projection
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved impressive performance across multimodal understanding and reasoning tasks, yet their internal safety mechanisms remain opaque and poorly controlled. In this work, we present a comprehensive framework for diagnosing and repairing unsafe channels within LVLMs (CARE). We first perform causal mediation analysis to identify neurons and layers that are causally responsible for unsafe behaviors. Based on these findings, we introduce a dual-modal safety subspace projection method that learns generalized safety subspaces for both visual and textual modalities through generalized eigen-decomposition between benign and malicious activations. During inference, activations are dynamically projected toward these safety subspaces via a hybrid fusion mechanism that adaptively balances visual and textual corrections, effectively suppressing unsafe features while preserving semantic fidelity. Extensive experiments on multiple safety benchmarks demonstrate that our causal-subspace repair framework significantly enhances safety robustness without degrading general multimodal capabilities, outperforming prior activation steering and alignment-based baselines. Additionally, our method exhibits good transferability, defending against unseen attacks.
summary_zh: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）在多模态理解和推理任务中取得了令人瞩目的性能，但其内部安全机制仍然不透明且难以控制。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个全面的框架，用于诊断和修复LVLMs中的不安全通道（CARE）。我们首先进行因果中介分析，以识别对不安全行为负有因果责任的神经元和层。基于这些发现，我们引入了一种双模态安全子空间投影方法，该方法通过良性和恶意激活之间的广义特征分解，学习广义视觉和文本模态的安全子空间。在推理过程中，激活通过混合融合机制动态地投影到这些安全子空间，该机制自适应地平衡视觉和文本校正，从而有效地抑制不安全特征，同时保持语义保真度。在多个安全基准上的大量实验表明，我们的因果-子空间修复框架显著增强了安全鲁棒性，而不会降低一般的多模态能力，优于先前的激活引导和基于对齐的基线方法。此外，我们的方法表现出良好的可迁移性，能够防御未见的攻击。
tldr: This paper introduces a framework (CARE) to diagnose and repair unsafe behaviors in LVLMs using causal discovery and safety subspace projection, demonstrating improved safety robustness without sacrificing multimodal capabilities.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了一个名为CARE的框架，通过因果发现和安全子空间投影来诊断和修复LVLM中不安全的行为，展示了在不牺牲多模态能力的前提下，显著提升了安全稳健性。

title: SafetyDrift: Predicting When AI Agents Cross the Line Before They Actually Do
summary: When an LLM agent reads a confidential file, then writes a summary, then emails it externally, no single step is unsafe, but the sequence is a data leak. We call this safety drift: individually safe actions compounding into violations. Prior work has measured this problem; we predict it. SafetyDrift models agent safety trajectories as absorbing Markov chains, computing the probability that a trajectory will reach a violation within a given number of steps via closed form absorption analysis. A consequence of the monotonic state design is that every agent will eventually violate safety if left unsupervised (absorption probability 1.0 from all states), making the practical question not if but when, and motivating our focus on finite horizon prediction. Across 357 traces spanning 40 realistic tasks in four categories, we discover that "points of no return" are sharply task dependent: in communication tasks, agents that reach even a mild risk state have an 85% chance of violating safety within five steps, while in technical tasks the probability stays below 5% from any state. A lightweight monitor built on these models detects 94.7% of violations with 3.7 steps of advance warning at negligible computational cost, outperforming both keyword matching (44.7% detection, 55.9% false positive rate) and per step LLM judges (52.6% detection, 38.2% false positive rate) while running over 60,000x faster.
summary_zh: 当一个LLM智能体读取一份机密文件，然后撰写摘要，再将摘要通过邮件发送给外部，每一步单独来看都是安全的，但整个序列构成了一次数据泄露。我们称之为安全漂移：即单个安全行动累积导致违规。已有研究测量过这个问题；我们则预测它。SafetyDrift将智能体安全轨迹建模为吸收马尔可夫链，通过闭式吸收分析计算在给定步数内轨迹达到违规状态的概率。单调状态设计的一个结果是，如果没有监督，每个智能体最终都会违反安全（从所有状态的吸收概率都为1.0），这使得实际问题不在于“是否”，而在于“何时”，也因此激励我们关注有限范围的预测。在涵盖四个类别中40项实际任务的357条轨迹中，我们发现“不归点”在很大程度上取决于任务：在通信任务中，即使达到轻微风险状态的智能体，也有85%的概率在五个步骤内违反安全，而在技术任务中，从任何状态违反安全的概率都低于5%。一个基于这些模型构建的轻量级监控器能以可忽略不计的计算成本检测到94.7%的违规行为，并提前3.7步发出警告，优于关键词匹配（检测率44.7%，误报率55.9%）和每步LLM判断器（检测率52.6%，误报率38.2%），同时运行速度快超过60000倍。
tldr: The paper introduces SafetyDrift, a method to predict when LLM agents will violate safety protocols by modeling safety trajectories as absorbing Markov chains, demonstrating significant improvements over existing methods in detection rate and speed.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了SafetyDrift，一种通过将LLM代理的安全轨迹建模为马尔可夫吸收链来预测其何时违反安全协议的方法，并在检测率和速度方面显著优于现有方法。

title: Unsupervised Behavioral Compression: Learning Low-Dimensional Policy Manifolds through State-Occupancy Matching
summary: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) is widely recognized as sample-inefficient, a limitation attributable in part to the high dimensionality and substantial functional redundancy inherent to the policy parameter space. A recent framework, which we refer to as Action-based Policy Compression (APC), mitigates this issue by compressing the parameter space $Θ$ into a low-dimensional latent manifold $\mathcal Z$ using a learned generative mapping $g:\mathcal Z \to Θ$. However, its performance is severely constrained by relying on immediate action-matching as a reconstruction loss, a myopic proxy for behavioral similarity that suffers from compounding errors across sequential decisions. To overcome this bottleneck, we introduce Occupancy-based Policy Compression (OPC), which enhances APC by shifting behavior representation from immediate action-matching to long-horizon state-space coverage. Specifically, we propose two principal improvements: (1) we curate the dataset generation with an information-theoretic uniqueness metric that delivers a diverse population of policies; and (2) we propose a fully differentiable compression objective that directly minimizes the divergence between the true and reconstructed mixture occupancy distributions. These modifications force the generative model to organize the latent space around true functional similarity, promoting a latent representation that generalizes over a broad spectrum of behaviors while retaining most of the original parameter space's expressivity. Finally, we empirically validate the advantages of our contributions across multiple continuous control benchmarks.
summary_zh: 深度强化学习（DRL）被广泛认为存在样本效率低下问题，这部分归因于策略参数空间的高维度和大量功能冗余。一种最新的框架，我们称之为基于动作的策略压缩（APC），通过使用学习到的生成映射 $g:\mathcal Z \to Θ$ 将参数空间$Θ$ 压缩到低维潜在流形 $\mathcal Z$ 中来缓解这个问题。然而，它的性能受到严重限制，因为它依赖于即时动作匹配作为重建损失，这是一种近视的行为相似性代理，会因连续决策中的复合误差而受影响。为了克服这个瓶颈，我们引入了基于占有率的策略压缩（OPC），它通过将行为表示从即时动作匹配转移到长时程状态空间覆盖来增强 APC。具体而言，我们提出了两项主要改进：（1）我们使用信息论唯一性度量来管理数据集生成，从而提供多样化的策略群体；（2）我们提出了一个完全可微的压缩目标，该目标直接最小化真实和重建混合占有率分布之间的差异。这些修改迫使生成模型围绕真正的功能相似性组织潜在空间，从而促进一种潜在表示，该表示可以在广泛的行为范围内泛化，同时保留原始参数空间的大部分表达能力。最后，我们在多个连续控制基准测试中实证地验证了我们的贡献的优势。
tldr: The paper introduces Occupancy-based Policy Compression (OPC), an improvement over Action-based Policy Compression (APC) for deep reinforcement learning, which focuses on state-space coverage rather than immediate action-matching to learn low-dimensional policy manifolds, leading to better generalization and expressivity.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了基于占据的策略压缩（OPC），是对基于动作的策略压缩（APC）的改进，用于深度强化学习。OPC侧重于状态空间覆盖而不是即时动作匹配，从而学习低维策略流形，进而实现更好的泛化性和表现力。

title: AutoSiMP: Autonomous Topology Optimization from Natural Language via LLM-Driven Problem Configuration and Adaptive Solver Control
summary: We present AutoSiMP, an autonomous pipeline that transforms a natural-language structural problem description into a validated, binary topology without manual configuration. The pipeline comprises five modules: (1) an LLM-based configurator that parses a plain-English prompt into a validated specification of geometry, supports, loads, passive regions, and mesh parameters; (2) a boundary-condition generator producing solver-ready DOF arrays, force vectors, and passive-element masks; (3) a three-field SIMP solver with Heaviside projection and pluggable continuation control; (4) an eight-check structural evaluator (connectivity, compliance, grayness, volume fraction, convergence, plus three informational quality metrics); and (5) a closed-loop retry mechanism. We evaluate on three axes. Configuration accuracy: across 10 diverse problems the configurator produces valid specifications on all cases with a median compliance penalty of $+0.3\%$ versus expert ground truth. Controller comparison: on 17 benchmarks with six controllers sharing an identical sharpening tail, the LLM controller achieves the lowest median compliance but $76.5\%$ pass rate, while the deterministic schedule achieves $100\%$ pass rate at only $+1.5\%$ higher compliance. End-to-end reliability: with the schedule controller, all LLM-configured problems pass every quality check on the first attempt $-$ no retries needed. Among the systems surveyed in this work (Table 1), AutoSiMP is the first to close the full loop from natural-language problem description to validated structural topology. The complete codebase, all specifications, and an interactive web demo will be released upon journal acceptance.
summary_zh: 我们提出了AutoSiMP，一个自主化流程，能够将自然语言描述的结构问题转化为已验证的二元拓扑，无需手动配置。该流程包含五个模块：（1）一个基于LLM的配置器，将纯英文提示语解析为经过验证的几何、支撑、载荷、被动区域和网格参数规范；（2）一个边界条件生成器，产生可供求解器使用的自由度数组、力向量和被动单元掩码；（3）一个采用Heaviside投影和可插拔连续性控制的三场SIMP求解器；（4）一个八项检查结构评估器（连通性、柔度、灰度、体积分数、收敛性，加上三个信息性质量指标）；以及（5）一个闭环重试机制。我们从三个维度进行评估。配置精度：在10个不同的问题中，配置器在所有情况下都产生有效的规范，相对于专家标准答案，柔度中位数惩罚为+0.3%。控制器比较：在17个基准测试中，六个控制器共享一个相同的锐化尾部，LLM控制器实现了最低的柔度中位数，但通过率为76.5%，而确定性调度实现了100%的通过率，但柔度仅高出+1.5%。端到端可靠性：使用调度控制器，所有LLM配置的问题在第一次尝试时都通过了每一项质量检查——无需重试。在本研究中调查的系统（表1）中，AutoSiMP是第一个完成从自然语言问题描述到已验证结构拓扑的完整闭环。完整的代码库、所有规范和一个交互式网络演示将在期刊接收后发布。
tldr: AutoSiMP is an autonomous pipeline that uses LLMs to convert natural language descriptions of structural problems into validated topology optimizations, demonstrating high configuration accuracy and reliability.
tldr_zh: AutoSiMP是一个自主流程，利用LLM将结构问题的自然语言描述转化为经过验证的拓扑优化，展示了高配置准确率和可靠性。

title: MotionRFT: Unified Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Text-to-Motion Generation
summary: Text-to-motion generation has advanced with diffusion- and flow-based generative models, yet supervised pretraining remains insufficient to align models with high-level objectives such as semantic consistency, realism, and human preference. Existing post-training methods have key limitations: they (1) target a specific motion representation, such as joints, (2) optimize a particular aspect, such as text-motion alignment, and may compromise other factors; and (3) incur substantial computational overhead, data dependence, and coarse-grained optimization. We present a reinforcement fine-tuning framework that comprises a heterogeneous-representation, multi-dimensional reward model, MotionReward, and an efficient, fine-grained fine-tuning method, EasyTune. To obtain a unified semantics representation, MotionReward maps heterogeneous motions into a shared semantic space anchored by text, enabling multidimensional reward learning; Self-refinement Preference Learning further enhances semantics without additional annotations. For efficient and effective fine-tuning, we identify the recursive gradient dependence across denoising steps as the key bottleneck, and propose EasyTune, which optimizes step-wise rather than over the full trajectory, yielding dense, fine-grained, and memory-efficient updates. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our framework, achieving FID 0.132 at 22.10 GB peak memory for MLD model and saving up to 15.22 GB over DRaFT. It reduces FID by 22.9% on joint-based ACMDM, and achieves a 12.6% R-Precision gain and 23.3% FID improvement on rotation-based HY Motion. Our project page with code is publicly available.
summary_zh: 基于文本的运动生成技术已经随着基于扩散和基于流的生成模型的出现而发展，但有监督的预训练仍然不足以使模型与诸如语义一致性、现实主义和人类偏好等高级目标对齐。现有的后训练方法存在关键限制：它们（1）针对特定的运动表征，例如关节；（2）优化某个特定方面，例如文本-运动对齐，并可能损害其他因素；以及（3）产生大量的计算开销、数据依赖性和粗粒度优化。我们提出了一种强化微调框架，该框架包含一个异构表征、多维度奖励模型MotionReward以及一种高效、细粒度的微调方法EasyTune。为了获得统一的语义表征，MotionReward将异构运动映射到一个由文本锚定的共享语义空间，从而实现多维奖励学习；自我精炼偏好学习进一步增强了语义，无需额外的标注。为了实现高效且有效的微调，我们将去噪步骤中的递归梯度依赖性确定为关键瓶颈，并提出了EasyTune，该方法优化步进式过程，而不是优化整个轨迹，从而产生密集、细粒度和内存高效的更新。大量的实验验证了我们框架的有效性，对于MLD模型，在22.10 GB的峰值内存下实现了0.132的 FID，并且相对于DRaFT节省高达15.22 GB的内存。它在基于关节的ACMDM上将FID降低了22.9%，并在基于旋转的HY Motion上实现了12.6%的R-Precision增益和23.3%的FID提升。我们的项目页面包含代码并已公开。
tldr: This paper introduces MotionRFT, a reinforcement fine-tuning framework for text-to-motion generation that uses a novel reward model and fine-tuning method to improve semantic consistency, realism, and computational efficiency, demonstrably outperforming existing approaches. The framework optimizes step-wise rather than over the full trajectory, yielding dense, fine-grained, and memory-efficient updates.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了MotionRFT，一个用于文本到动作生成的强化微调框架，它使用了一个新的奖励模型和微调方法来提高语义一致性、真实性和计算效率，并且表现明显优于现有方法。该框架优化步进式而不是完整轨迹，从而产生密集、细粒度且内存高效的更新。

title: Incentivizing Temporal-Awareness in Egocentric Video Understanding Models
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have recently shown strong performance in visual understanding, yet they often lack temporal awareness, particularly in egocentric settings where reasoning depends on the correct ordering and evolution of events. This deficiency stems in part from training objectives that fail to explicitly reward temporal reasoning and instead rely on frame-level spatial shortcuts. To address this limitation, we propose Temporal Global Policy Optimization (TGPO), a reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) algorithm designed to incentivize temporal awareness in MLLMs. TGPO contrasts model outputs generated from temporally ordered versus shuffled video frames to derive calibrated, globally normalized reward signals that explicitly favor temporally coherent reasoning. Integrated with GRPO and GSPO, TGPO supports cold-start RL training and effectively suppresses spatial shortcut behaviors learned by existing MLLMs. Experiments across five egocentric video benchmarks demonstrate that TGPO consistently improves temporal grounding and causal coherence, outperforming prior RL-based video reasoning approaches. Our results suggest that TGPO offers a simple and scalable pathway toward temporally robust MLLMs for egocentric video understanding.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型(MLLM)近来在视觉理解方面表现出强大的性能，但它们通常缺乏时间感知能力，尤其是在以自我为中心的场景中，在此类场景中，推理依赖于事件的正确排序和演变。这种缺陷部分源于训练目标未能明确奖励时间推理，而是依赖于帧级别的空间捷径。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出时间全局策略优化（TGPO），一种具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）算法，旨在激励 MLLM 中的时间感知能力。TGPO 对比从按时间顺序排列的视频帧与打乱顺序的视频帧生成的模型输出，以推导出经过校准的、全局归一化的奖励信号，从而明确地偏好时间连贯的推理。TGPO 与 GRPO 和 GSPO 相结合，支持冷启动 RL 训练，并有效抑制现有 MLLM 学习到的空间捷径行为。在五个以自我为中心的视频基准上的实验表明，TGPO 能够持续改进时间定位和因果一致性，优于以往的基于 RL 的视频推理方法。我们的结果表明，TGPO 为以自我为中心的视频理解提供了一条简单且可扩展的通向时间鲁棒 MLLM 的途径。
tldr: This paper introduces Temporal Global Policy Optimization (TGPO), a reinforcement learning algorithm designed to improve temporal awareness in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for egocentric video understanding, demonstrating improvements on five benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种名为时间全局策略优化 (TGPO) 的强化学习算法，旨在提高多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM) 在以自我为中心的视频理解中的时间感知能力，并在五个基准测试中取得了改进。

title: Communicating about Space: Language-Mediated Spatial Integration Across Partial Views
summary: Humans build shared spatial understanding by communicating partial, viewpoint-dependent observations. We ask whether Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can do the same, aligning distinct egocentric views through dialogue to form a coherent, allocentric mental model of a shared environment. To study this systematically, we introduce COSMIC, a benchmark for Collaborative Spatial Communication. In this setting, two static MLLM agents observe a 3D indoor environment from different viewpoints and exchange natural-language messages to solve spatial queries. COSMIC contains 899 diverse scenes and 1250 question-answer pairs spanning five tasks. We find a consistent capability hierarchy, MLLMs are most reliable at identifying shared anchor objects across views, perform worse on relational reasoning, and largely fail at building globally consistent maps, performing near chance, even for the frontier models. Moreover, we find thinking capability yields consistent gains in anchor grounding, but is insufficient for higher-level spatial communication. To contextualize model behavior, we additionally collect 250 human-human dialogues. Humans achieve 95% aggregate accuracy, leaving significant room for improvement for even the best performing model Gemini-3-Pro-Thinking which achieves 72% aggregate accuracy. Moreover, human conversations become increasingly specific as partners converge on a shared mental model, whereas model dialogues continue to explore new possibilities rather than converging, consistent with a limited ability to build and maintain a robust shared mental model. Our code and data is available at https://github.com/ankursikarwar/Cosmic
summary_zh: 人类通过交流局部、视角相关的观测信息来构建共享的空间理解。我们探究多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）是否也能做到这一点，通过对话对齐不同的自我中心视角，从而形成连贯的、以场景为中心的共享环境心智模型。为了系统地研究这个问题，我们提出了COSMIC，一个用于协同空间交流的基准测试。在此设定下，两个静态的MLLM智能体从不同的视角观察一个3D室内环境，并交换自然语言消息来解决空间查询。COSMIC包含899个不同的场景和1250个跨越五个任务的问答对。我们发现了一致的能力层级：MLLM在识别跨视角的共享锚定对象方面最可靠，在关系推理方面的表现较差，并且在构建全局一致地图方面基本失败，即使对于前沿模型，其表现也接近于随机水平。此外，我们发现思考能力在锚定对象定位方面产生了持续的提升，但不足以支持更高层次的空间交流。为了对模型的行为进行情境化分析，我们还收集了250个人与人之间的对话。人类实现了95%的总准确率，这为即使是表现最好的模型Gemini-3-Pro-Thinking留下了显著的改进空间，后者实现了72%的总准确率。此外，随着伙伴们趋同于一个共享的心智模型，人类对话变得越来越具体，而模型对话则继续探索新的可能性，而不是趋同，这与构建和维护一个强大的共享心智模型的能力有限相一致。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/ankursikarwar/Cosmic 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces COSMIC, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs' ability to build shared spatial understanding through dialogue, revealing their limitations in relational reasoning and global map construction compared to humans.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了COSMIC，一个用于评估多模态大型语言模型通过对话构建共享空间理解能力的基准。结果表明，与人类相比，这些模型在关系推理和全局地图构建方面存在局限性。

title: Reasoning-Driven Anomaly Detection and Localization with Image-Level Supervision
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have recently demonstrated remarkable reasoning and perceptual abilities for anomaly detection. However, most approaches remain confined to image-level anomaly detection and textual reasoning, while pixel-level localization still relies on external vision modules and dense annotations. In this work, we activate the intrinsic reasoning potential of MLLMs to perform anomaly detection, pixel-level localization, and interpretable reasoning solely from image-level supervision, without any auxiliary components or pixel-wise labels. Specifically, we propose Reasoning-Driven Anomaly Localization (ReAL), which extracts anomaly-related tokens from the autoregressive reasoning process and aggregates their attention responses to produce pixel-level anomaly maps. We further introduce a Consistency-Guided Reasoning Optimization (CGRO) module that leverages reinforcement learning to align reasoning tokens with visual attentions, resulting in more coherent reasoning and accurate anomaly localization. Extensive experiments on four public benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly improves anomaly detection, localization, and interpretability. Remarkably, despite relying solely on image-level supervision, our approach achieves performance competitive with MLLM-based methods trained under dense pixel-level supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/YizhouJin313/ReADL.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型(MLLMs)最近在异常检测方面展现出了卓越的推理和感知能力。然而，大多数方法仍然局限于图像级别的异常检测和文本推理，而像素级别的定位仍然依赖于外部视觉模块和密集的标注。在这项工作中，我们激活了MLLMs的内在推理潜力，仅从图像级别的监督执行异常检测、像素级别的定位和可解释的推理，而无需任何辅助组件或像素级别的标签。具体来说，我们提出了推理驱动的异常定位(ReAL)，它从自回归推理过程中提取与异常相关的tokens，并聚合它们的注意力响应以生成像素级别的异常图。我们进一步引入了一致性引导的推理优化(CGRO)模块，该模块利用强化学习来对齐推理tokens与视觉注意力，从而产生更连贯的推理和更准确的异常定位。在四个公共基准上的大量实验表明，我们的方法显著提高了异常检测，定位和可解释性。值得注意的是，尽管仅依赖于图像级别的监督，我们的方法也能达到与在密集像素级别监督下训练的基于MLLM的方法相媲美的性能。代码可在https://github.com/YizhouJin313/ReADL获取。
tldr: This paper introduces a novel approach, ReAL, for anomaly detection and localization using MLLMs with only image-level supervision, achieving competitive performance compared to methods using dense pixel-level supervision through reasoning token extraction and attention aggregation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为ReAL的新方法，该方法仅使用图像级别的监督，利用多模态大型语言模型进行异常检测和定位。通过提取推理令牌和注意力聚合，ReAL实现了与使用密集像素级监督训练的方法相媲美的性能。

title: VIRST: Video-Instructed Reasoning Assistant for SpatioTemporal Segmentation
summary: Referring Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) aims to segment target objects in videos based on natural language descriptions. However, fixed keyframe-based approaches that couple a vision language model with a separate propagation module often fail to capture rapidly changing spatiotemporal dynamics and to handle queries requiring multi-step reasoning, leading to sharp performance drops on motion-intensive and reasoning-oriented videos beyond static RVOS benchmarks. To address these limitations, we propose VIRST (Video-Instructed Reasoning Assistant for Spatio-Temporal Segmentation), an end-to-end framework that unifies global video reasoning and pixel-level mask prediction within a single model. VIRST bridges semantic and segmentation representations through the Spatio-Temporal Fusion (STF), which fuses segmentation-aware video features into the vision-language backbone, and employs the Temporal Dynamic Anchor Updater to maintain temporally adjacent anchor frames that provide stable temporal cues under large motion, occlusion, and reappearance. This unified design achieves state-of-the-art results across diverse RVOS benchmarks under realistic and challenging conditions, demonstrating strong generalization to both referring and reasoning oriented settings. The code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/AIDASLab/VIRST.
summary_zh: 指称视频物体分割（RVOS）旨在根据自然语言描述分割视频中的目标物体。然而，基于固定关键帧的方法，即将视觉语言模型与单独的传播模块耦合，通常无法捕获快速变化的时空动态，也无法处理需要多步骤推理的查询，导致在动态密集型和推理导向型视频上的性能急剧下降，超出了静态RVOS基准的范围。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了VIRST（时空分割的视频指导推理助手），这是一个端到端框架，可在单个模型中统一全局视频推理和像素级mask预测。VIRST通过时空融合（STF）桥接语义和分割表示，该STF将分割感知的视频特征融合到视觉语言骨干网络中，并采用时间动态锚点更新器来维护时间上相邻的锚帧，以在大运动、遮挡和重现情况下提供稳定的时间线索。这种统一的设计在各种RVOS基准上均取得了最先进的结果，涵盖了现实和具有挑战性的条件，展示了对指称和推理导向型设置的强大泛化能力。代码和检查点可在https://github.com/AIDASLab/VIRST获取。
tldr: The paper introduces VIRST, an end-to-end framework that unifies video reasoning and pixel-level mask prediction for Referring Video Object Segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art results on diverse benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了VIRST，一个端到端的框架，统一了视频推理和像素级掩码预测，用于视频对象指代分割，并在多个基准测试中实现了最先进的结果。

title: From 3D Pose to Prose: Biomechanics-Grounded Vision--Language Coaching
summary: We present BioCoach, a biomechanics-grounded vision--language framework for fitness coaching from streaming video. BioCoach fuses visual appearance and 3D skeletal kinematics, through a novel three-stage pipeline: an exercise-specific degree-of-freedom selector that focuses analysis on salient joints; a structured biomechanical context that pairs individualized morphometrics with cycle and constraint analysis; and a vision--biomechanics conditioned feedback module that applies cross-attention to generate precise, actionable text. Using parameter-efficient training that freezes the vision and language backbones, BioCoach yields transparent, personalized reasoning rather than pattern matching. To enable learning and fair evaluation, we augment QEVD-fit-coach with biomechanics-oriented feedback to create QEVD-bio-fit-coach, and we introduce a biomechanics-aware LLM judge metric. BioCoach delivers clear gains on QEVD-bio-fit-coach across lexical and judgment metrics while maintaining temporal triggering; on the original QEVD-fit-coach, it improves text quality and correctness with near-parity timing, demonstrating that explicit kinematics and constraints are key to accurate, phase-aware coaching.
summary_zh: 我们提出了BioCoach，一个基于生物力学的视觉-语言框架，用于从流媒体视频中进行健身指导。BioCoach通过一种新颖的三阶段流水线融合了视觉外观和3D骨骼运动学：一个针对特定练习的自由度选择器，将分析重点放在显著的关节上；一个结构化的生物力学背景，将个体化的形态测量学与周期和约束分析相结合；以及一个视觉-生物力学条件反馈模块，应用交叉注意力来生成精确的、可操作的文本。通过参数高效的训练，冻结视觉和语言的主干网络，BioCoach产生透明的、个性化的推理，而不是模式匹配。为了支持学习和公平评估，我们使用面向生物力学的反馈增强了QEVD-fit-coach，创建了QEVD-bio-fit-coach，并引入了一个生物力学感知的LLM评判标准。BioCoach在QEVD-bio-fit-coach上，在词汇和判断指标方面都带来了显著提升，同时保持了时间触发；在原始的QEVD-fit-coach上，它提高了文本质量和正确性，并具有近乎对等的计时，表明显式的运动学和约束是准确、阶段感知指导的关键。
tldr: The paper introduces BioCoach, a vision-language framework using biomechanics to provide personalized fitness coaching from video, showing improved performance on fitness coaching datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了BioCoach，一个利用生物力学信息的视觉语言框架，用于从视频中提供个性化的健身指导，并在健身指导数据集上表现出改进的性能。

title: MetaTune: Adjoint-based Meta-tuning via Robotic Differentiable Dynamics
summary: Disturbance observer-based control has shown promise in robustifying robotic systems against uncertainties. However, tuning such systems remains challenging due to the strong coupling between controller gains and observer parameters. In this work, we propose MetaTune, a unified framework for joint auto-tuning of feedback controllers and disturbance observers through differentiable closed-loop meta-learning. MetaTune integrates a portable neural policy with physics-informed gradients derived from differentiable system dynamics, enabling adaptive gain across tasks and operating conditions. We develop an adjoint method that efficiently computes the meta-gradients with respect to adaptive gains backward in time to directly minimize the cost-to-go. Compared to existing forward methods, our approach reduces the computational complexity to be linear in the data horizon. Experimental results on quadrotor control show that MetaTune achieves consistent improvements over state-of-the-art differentiable tuning methods while reducing gradient computation time by more than 50 percent. In high-fidelity PX4-Gazebo hardware-in-the-loop simulation, the learned adaptive policy yields 15-20 percent average tracking error reduction at aggressive flight speeds and up to 40 percent improvement under strong disturbances, while demonstrating zero-shot sim-to-sim transfer without fine-tuning.
summary_zh: 基于扰动观测器的控制在增强机器人系统对不确定性的鲁棒性方面展现了潜力。然而，由于控制器增益和观测器参数之间存在强耦合，此类系统的调参仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了MetaTune，一个用于通过可微分闭环元学习联合自动调参反馈控制器和扰动观测器的统一框架。MetaTune将一个可移植的神经策略与基于可微分系统动力学推导的物理信息梯度相结合，从而实现跨任务和运行条件下的自适应增益。我们开发了一种伴随方法，可以随时间向后高效地计算关于自适应增益的元梯度，以直接最小化剩余成本。与现有的前向方法相比，我们的方法将计算复杂度降低到与数据视界呈线性关系。四旋翼控制的实验结果表明，MetaTune在最先进的可微分调参方法的基础上实现了持续改进，同时将梯度计算时间缩短了50%以上。在高保真度的PX4-Gazebo硬件在环仿真中，学习到的自适应策略在激进的飞行速度下平均跟踪误差降低了15-20%，在强扰动下性能提升高达40%，同时展示了零样本的sim-to-sim迁移，无需微调。
tldr: The paper introduces MetaTune, a meta-learning framework for auto-tuning robotic controllers and disturbance observers using differentiable system dynamics and adjoint methods, achieving superior performance and efficiency compared to existing methods in quadrotor control.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 MetaTune，一个使用可微系统动力学和伴随方法自动调整机器人控制器和扰动观测器的元学习框架，在四旋翼飞行器控制中实现了优于现有方法的性能和效率。

title: Autonomous overtaking trajectory optimization using reinforcement learning and opponent pose estimation
summary: Vehicle overtaking is one of the most complex driving maneuvers for autonomous vehicles. To achieve optimal autonomous overtaking, driving systems rely on multiple sensors that enable safe trajectory optimization and overtaking efficiency. This paper presents a reinforcement learning mechanism for multi-agent autonomous racing environments, enabling overtaking trajectory optimization, based on LiDAR and depth image data. The developed reinforcement learning agent uses pre-generated raceline data and sensor inputs to compute the steering angle and linear velocity for optimal overtaking. The system uses LiDAR with a 2D detection algorithm and a depth camera with YOLO-based object detection to identify the vehicle to be overtaken and its pose. The LiDAR and the depth camera detection data are fused using a UKF for improved opponent pose estimation and trajectory optimization for overtaking in racing scenarios. The results show that the proposed algorithm successfully performs overtaking maneuvers in both simulation and real-world experiments, with pose estimation RMSE of (0.0816, 0.0531) m in (x, y).
summary_zh: 车辆超车是自动驾驶车辆最复杂的驾驶操作之一。为了实现最佳的自主超车，驾驶系统依赖于多个传感器，以实现安全的轨迹优化和超车效率。本文提出了一种用于多智能体自主赛车环境的强化学习机制，能够基于激光雷达（LiDAR）和深度图像数据实现超车轨迹优化。所开发的强化学习智能体使用预生成的赛道线数据和传感器输入来计算转向角和线速度，以实现最佳超车。该系统使用带有二维检测算法的激光雷达和带有基于YOLO的目标检测的深度相机来识别待超车辆及其姿态。激光雷达和深度相机检测数据通过无迹卡尔曼滤波器（UKF）进行融合，以改进对手姿态估计，从而优化赛车场景下的超车轨迹。结果表明，所提出的算法成功地在模拟和真实世界的实验中执行了超车操作，姿态估计的均方根误差（RMSE）在 (x, y) 方向上分别为 (0.0816, 0.0531) 米。
tldr: This paper introduces a reinforcement learning approach for autonomous vehicle overtaking, using LiDAR and depth camera data for opponent pose estimation and trajectory optimization, demonstrating successful overtaking in simulations and real-world scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的自动驾驶车辆超车方法，利用激光雷达和深度相机数据进行对手姿态估计和轨迹优化，并在仿真和实际场景中成功实现了超车。

title: An End-to-end Flight Control Network for High-speed UAV Obstacle Avoidance based on Event-Depth Fusion
summary: Achieving safe, high-speed autonomous flight in complex environments with static, dynamic, or mixed obstacles remains challenging, as a single perception modality is incomplete. Depth cameras are effective for static objects but suffer from motion blur at high speeds. Conversely, event cameras excel at capturing rapid motion but struggle to perceive static scenes. To exploit the complementary strengths of both sensors, we propose an end-to-end flight control network that achieves feature-level fusion of depth images and event data through a bidirectional crossattention module. The end-to-end network is trained via imitation learning, which relies on high-quality supervision. Building on this insight, we design an efficient expert planner using Spherical Principal Search (SPS). This planner reduces computational complexity from $O(n^2)$ to $O(n)$ while generating smoother trajectories, achieving over 80% success rate at 17m/s--nearly 20% higher than traditional planners. Simulation experiments show that our method attains a 70-80% success rate at 17 m/s across varied scenes, surpassing single-modality and unidirectional fusion models by 10-20%. These results demonstrate that bidirectional fusion effectively integrates event and depth information, enabling more reliable obstacle avoidance in complex environments with both static and dynamic objects.
summary_zh: 在存在静态、动态或混合障碍物的复杂环境中实现安全、高速的自主飞行仍然具有挑战性，因为单一感知模态是不完整的。深度相机对于静态物体有效，但在高速下会出现运动模糊。相反，事件相机擅长捕捉快速运动，但难以感知静态场景。为了利用两种传感器的互补优势，我们提出了一种端到端飞行控制网络，该网络通过双向交叉注意力模块实现深度图像和事件数据的特征级融合。该端到端网络通过模仿学习进行训练，模仿学习依赖于高质量的监督。基于此洞察，我们设计了一种使用球面主成分搜索 (SPS) 的高效专家规划器。该规划器将计算复杂度从 $O(n^2)$ 降低到 $O(n)$，同时生成更平滑的轨迹，在 17 米/秒的速度下达到超过 80% 的成功率——比传统规划器高出近 20%。仿真实验表明，我们的方法在各种场景中以 17 米/秒的速度达到 70-80% 的成功率，超过了单模态和单向融合模型 10-20%。这些结果表明，双向融合有效地整合了事件和深度信息，从而在同时存在静态和动态物体的复杂环境中实现更可靠的避障。
tldr: This paper presents an end-to-end flight control network for high-speed UAV obstacle avoidance, utilizing a bidirectional cross-attention module for feature-level fusion of depth and event data, trained via imitation learning with an efficient expert planner.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种端到端的飞行控制网络，用于高速无人机的避障，该网络采用双向交叉注意力模块对深度数据和事件数据进行特征级融合，并通过模仿学习进行训练，并配备高效的专家规划器。

title: Liquid Networks with Mixture Density Heads for Efficient Imitation Learning
summary: We compare liquid neural networks with mixture density heads against diffusion policies on Push-T, RoboMimic Can, and PointMaze under a shared-backbone comparison protocol that isolates policy-head effects under matched inputs, training budgets, and evaluation settings. Across tasks, liquid policies use roughly half the parameters (4.3M vs. 8.6M), achieve 2.4x lower offline prediction error, and run 1.8 faster at inference. In sample-efficiency experiments spanning 1% to 46.42% of training data, liquid models remain consistently more robust, with especially large gains in low-data and medium-data regimes. Closed-loop results on Push-T and PointMaze are directionally consistent with offline rankings but noisier, indicating that strong offline density modeling helps deployment while not fully determining closed-loop success. Overall, liquid recurrent multimodal policies provide a compact and practical alternative to iterative denoising for imitation learning.
summary_zh: 我们在Push-T、RoboMimic Can 和 PointMaze 任务上，通过共享骨干网络的比较协议，比较了具有混合密度输出层的液态神经网络与扩散策略。该协议在匹配的输入、训练预算和评估设置下，隔离了策略头的影响。在所有任务中，液态策略使用的参数大约是一半（430万对860万），离线预测误差降低了2.4倍，并且在推理时运行速度快了1.8倍。在跨越训练数据的1%到46.42%的样本效率实验中，液态模型始终保持更强的鲁棒性，尤其是在低数据和中等数据状态下增益显著。在Push-T和PointMaze上的闭环结果与离线排名在方向上一致但更嘈杂，表明强大的离线密度建模有助于部署，但不能完全决定闭环的成功。总而言之，液态循环多模态策略为模仿学习提供了一种紧凑且实用的替代方案，以替代迭代去噪。
tldr: The paper introduces liquid neural networks with mixture density heads for imitation learning, demonstrating improved efficiency and robustness compared to diffusion policies, especially in low-data regimes.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了用于模仿学习的带有混合密度头的液态神经网络，与扩散策略相比，展示了更高的效率和鲁棒性，尤其是在低数据状态下。

title: UMI-Underwater: Learning Underwater Manipulation without Underwater Teleoperation
summary: Underwater robotic grasping is difficult due to degraded, highly variable imagery and the expense of collecting diverse underwater demonstrations. We introduce a system that (i) autonomously collects successful underwater grasp demonstrations via a self-supervised data collection pipeline and (ii) transfers grasp knowledge from on-land human demonstrations through a depth-based affordance representation that bridges the on-land-to-underwater domain gap and is robust to lighting and color shift. An affordance model trained on on-land handheld demonstrations is deployed underwater zero-shot via geometric alignment, and an affordance-conditioned diffusion policy is then trained on underwater demonstrations to generate control actions. In pool experiments, our approach improves grasping performance and robustness to background shifts, and enables generalization to objects seen only in on-land data, outperforming RGB-only baselines. Code, videos, and additional results are available at https://umi-under-water.github.io.
summary_zh: 水下机器人抓取颇具挑战，原因在于水下图像质量下降且具有高度可变性，以及收集多样化的水下演示数据成本高昂。我们提出了一种系统，该系统能够 (i) 通过自监督数据收集流程自主收集成功的水下抓取演示数据，以及 (ii) 通过基于深度的可供性表示来迁移陆地人类演示的抓取知识，该可供性表示弥合了陆地到水下的领域差距，并且对光照和色彩偏移具有鲁棒性。在陆地手持演示数据上训练的可供性模型通过几何对齐零样本部署到水下，然后，在水下演示数据上训练一个以可供性为条件的扩散策略，以生成控制动作。在水池实验中，我们的方法提高了抓取性能和对背景变化的鲁棒性，并且能够泛化到仅在陆地数据中见过的物体，优于仅使用RGB的基线方法。 代码、视频和更多结果可在 https://umi-under-water.github.io 获取。
tldr: This paper presents a system for underwater robotic grasping that combines self-supervised data collection with transferring knowledge from on-land demonstrations using depth-based affordances, showing improved performance and generalization in pool experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种水下机器人抓取系统，该系统结合了自监督数据收集和使用基于深度的可供性从陆地演示中转移知识的方法。水池实验表明，该系统提高了抓取性能和泛化能力。

title: SCRAMPPI: Efficient Contingency Planning for Mobile Robot Navigation via Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability
summary: Autonomous robots commonly aim to complete a nominal behavior while minimizing a cost; this leaves them vulnerable to failure or unplanned scenarios, where a backup or contingency plan to a safe set is needed to avoid a total mission failure. This is formalized as a trajectory optimization problem over the nominal cost with a safety constraint: from any point along the nominal plan, a feasible trajectory to a designated safe set must exist. Previous methods either relax this hard constraint, or use an expensive sampling-based strategy to optimize for this constraint. Instead, we formalize this requirement as a reach-avoid problem and leverage Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis to certify contingency feasibility. By computing the value function of our safe-set's backward reachable set online as the environment is revealed and integrating it with a sampling based planner (MPPI) via resampling based rollouts, we guarantee satisfaction of the hard constraint while greatly increasing sampling efficiency. Finally, we present simulated and hardware experiments demonstrating our algorithm generating nominal and contingency plans in real time on a mobile robot in an adversarial evasion task.
summary_zh: 自主机器人的常见目标是在完成标称行为的同时最小化成本；这使得它们容易受到故障或未计划场景的影响，此时需要一个备份或应急方案来安全地进入一个安全集，以避免任务完全失败。 这被形式化为一个带有安全约束的、关于标称成本的轨迹优化问题：从标称计划中的任何点出发，都必须存在一个到指定安全集的可行轨迹。之前的方法要么放宽这个硬约束，要么使用代价高昂的基于采样的策略来优化这个约束。相反，我们将这个需求形式化为一个可达-回避问题，并利用 Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) 可达性分析来验证应急可行性。通过在环境被揭示时在线计算安全集的后向可达集的价值函数，并通过基于重采样的rollout将其与基于采样的规划器 (MPPI) 集成，我们保证了硬约束的满足，同时大大提高了采样效率。最后，我们展示了模拟和硬件实验，证明了我们的算法能在对抗性规避任务中实时地在移动机器人上生成标称和应急计划。
tldr: This paper introduces SCRAMPPI, a method for efficient contingency planning in robot navigation using Hamilton-Jacobi reachability to guarantee a safe fallback trajectory when the nominal plan fails, demonstrating real-time performance in simulations and hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了SCRAMPPI，一种使用Hamilton-Jacobi可达性分析来保证机器人导航中高效的应急规划方法，当名义规划失败时，确保安全的回退轨迹，并在模拟和硬件中展示了实时性能。

title: Online Statistical Inference of Constant Sample-averaged Q-Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning algorithms have been widely used for decision-making tasks in various domains. However, the performance of these algorithms can be impacted by high variance and instability, particularly in environments with noise or sparse rewards. In this paper, we propose a framework to perform statistical online inference for a sample-averaged Q-learning approach. We adapt the functional central limit theorem (FCLT) for the modified algorithm under some general conditions and then construct confidence intervals for the Q-values via random scaling. We conduct experiments to perform inference on both the modified approach and its traditional counterpart, Q-learning using random scaling and report their coverage rates and confidence interval widths on two problems: a grid world problem as a simple toy example and a dynamic resource-matching problem as a real-world example for comparison between the two solution approaches.
