summary_zh: 强化学习算法已被广泛应用于各个领域的决策任务。然而，这些算法的性能会受到高方差和不稳定性的影响，尤其是在存在噪声或稀疏奖励的环境中。在本文中，我们提出了一个框架，用于对样本平均Q学习方法进行统计在线推断。我们在一些一般条件下，对修改后的算法采用泛函中心极限定理（FCLT），然后通过随机缩放构建Q值的置信区间。我们进行了实验，对修改后的方法及其传统对应方法，即使用随机缩放的Q学习，进行了推断，并报告了它们在两个问题上的覆盖率和置信区间宽度：一个网格世界问题作为简单的玩具示例，以及一个动态资源匹配问题，作为比较两种解决方案方法的真实世界示例。
tldr: This paper presents a framework for statistical online inference of sample-averaged Q-learning using the functional central limit theorem and random scaling to construct confidence intervals for Q-values, demonstrating its efficacy on grid world and dynamic resource-matching problems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个用于样本平均Q学习的统计在线推断框架，使用泛函中心极限定理和随机缩放来构建Q值的置信区间，并在网格世界和动态资源匹配问题上验证了其有效性。

title: TerraSeg: Self-Supervised Ground Segmentation for Any LiDAR
summary: LiDAR perception is fundamental to robotics, enabling machines to understand their environment in 3D. A crucial task for LiDAR-based scene understanding and navigation is ground segmentation. However, existing methods are either handcrafted for specific sensor configurations or rely on costly per-point manual labels, severely limiting their generalization and scalability. To overcome this, we introduce TerraSeg, the first self-supervised, domain-agnostic model for LiDAR ground segmentation. We train TerraSeg on OmniLiDAR, a unified large-scale dataset that aggregates and standardizes data from 12 major public benchmarks. Spanning almost 22 million raw scans across 15 distinct sensor models, OmniLiDAR provides unprecedented diversity for learning a highly generalizable ground model. To supervise training without human annotations, we propose PseudoLabeler, a novel module that generates high-quality ground and non-ground labels through self-supervised per-scan runtime optimization. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that, despite using no manual labels, TerraSeg achieves state-of-the-art results on nuScenes, SemanticKITTI, and Waymo Perception while delivering real-time performance. Our code and model weights are publicly available.
summary_zh: 激光雷达感知是机器人技术的基础，使机器能够以三维方式理解其环境。基于激光雷达的场景理解和导航的一个关键任务是地面分割。然而，现有的方法要么是针对特定传感器配置手工设计的，要么依赖于昂贵的逐点人工标注，严重限制了它们的泛化性和可扩展性。为了克服这一问题，我们引入了TerraSeg，这是首个用于激光雷达地面分割的自监督、领域无关模型。我们使用OmniLiDAR训练TerraSeg，这是一个统一的大规模数据集，汇总和标准化了来自12个主要公共基准的数据。OmniLiDAR横跨15个不同的传感器模型，拥有近2200万次原始扫描数据，为学习高度通用的地面模型提供了前所未有的多样性。为了在没有人工标注的情况下监督训练，我们提出了PseudoLabeler，这是一个新颖的模块，通过自监督的逐次扫描运行时优化来生成高质量的地面和非地面标签。大量的评估表明，尽管没有使用人工标签，TerraSeg在nuScenes、SemanticKITTI和Waymo Perception上均实现了最先进的结果，同时提供了实时性能。我们的代码和模型权重已公开发布。
tldr: TerraSeg introduces a self-supervised method for LiDAR ground segmentation, trained on a large, diverse dataset (OmniLiDAR) and using a novel PseudoLabeler for automatic label generation, achieving state-of-the-art performance without manual annotation.
tldr_zh: TerraSeg提出了一种自监督的LiDAR地面分割方法，该方法基于大规模多样化的数据集（OmniLiDAR）进行训练，并使用一种新颖的PseudoLabeler自动生成标签，无需人工标注即可实现最先进的性能。

title: An Instance-Centric Panoptic Occupancy Prediction Benchmark for Autonomous Driving
summary: Panoptic occupancy prediction aims to jointly infer voxel-wise semantics and instance identities within a unified 3D scene representation. Nevertheless, progress in this field remains constrained by the absence of high-quality 3D mesh resources, instance-level annotations, and physically consistent occupancy datasets. Existing benchmarks typically provide incomplete and low-resolution geometry without instance-level annotations, limiting the development of models capable of achieving precise geometric reconstruction, reliable occlusion reasoning, and holistic 3D understanding. To address these challenges, this paper presents an instance-centric benchmark for the 3D panoptic occupancy prediction task. Specifically, we introduce ADMesh, the first unified 3D mesh library tailored for autonomous driving, which integrates over 15K high-quality 3D models with diverse textures and rich semantic annotations. Building upon ADMesh, we further construct CarlaOcc, a large-scale, physically consistent panoptic occupancy dataset generated using the CARLA simulator. This dataset contains over 100K frames with fine-grained, instance-level occupancy ground truth at voxel resolutions as fine as 0.05 m. Furthermore, standardized evaluation metrics are introduced to quantify the quality of existing occupancy datasets. Finally, a systematic benchmark of representative models is established on the proposed dataset, which provides a unified platform for fair comparison and reproducible research in the field of 3D panoptic perception. Code and dataset are available at https://mias.group/CarlaOcc.
summary_zh: 全景占据预测旨在统一的3D场景表示内联合推断体素级的语义和实例身份。然而，该领域的进展仍然受到缺乏高质量3D网格资源、实例级别标注和物理一致的占据数据集的限制。现有的基准测试通常提供不完整且低分辨率的几何信息，且缺乏实例级别的标注，从而限制了能够实现精确几何重建、可靠遮挡推理和整体3D理解的模型的开发。为了应对这些挑战，本文提出一个针对3D全景占据预测任务的以实例为中心的基准测试。具体而言，我们引入了ADMesh，这是首个专为自动驾驶定制的统一3D网格库，它集成了超过1.5万个具有多样化纹理和丰富语义标注的高质量3D模型。基于ADMesh，我们进一步构建了CarlaOcc，一个大规模、物理一致的全景占据数据集，使用CARLA模拟器生成。该数据集包含超过10万帧，具有精细的实例级别占据真值，体素分辨率精细至0.05米。此外，我们引入了标准化的评估指标来量化现有占据数据集的质量。最后，我们在提出的数据集上建立了代表性模型的系统基准测试，为3D全景感知领域的公平比较和可重复研究提供了一个统一的平台。代码和数据集可在https://mias.group/CarlaOcc获取。
tldr: The paper introduces ADMesh, a high-quality 3D mesh library, and CarlaOcc, a large-scale panoptic occupancy dataset for autonomous driving, aiming to address the lack of instance-level annotations and physically consistent occupancy data in existing benchmarks and facilitate research in 3D panoptic perception.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ADMesh，一个高质量的3D网格库，以及CarlaOcc，一个大规模的全景占用数据集，用于自动驾驶，旨在解决现有基准测试中缺乏实例级标注和物理一致的占用数据的问题，并促进3D全景感知领域的研究。

title: RiskProp: Collision-Anchored Self-Supervised Risk Propagation for Early Accident Anticipation
summary: Accident anticipation aims to predict impending collisions from dashcam videos and trigger early alerts. Existing methods rely on binary supervision with manually annotated "anomaly onset" frames, which are subjective and inconsistent, leading to inaccurate risk estimation. In contrast, we propose RiskProp, a novel collision-anchored self-supervised risk propagation paradigm for early accident anticipation, which removes the need for anomaly onset annotations and leverages only the reliably annotated collision frame. RiskProp models temporal risk evolution through two observation-driven losses: first, since future frames contain more definitive evidence of an impending accident, we introduce a future-frame regularization loss that uses the model's next-frame prediction as a soft target to supervise the current frame, enabling backward propagation of risk signals; second, inspired by the empirical trend of rising risk before accidents, we design an adaptive monotonic constraint to encourage a non-decreasing progression over time. Experiments on CAP and Nexar demonstrate that RiskProp achieves state-of-the-art performance and produces smoother, more discriminative risk curves, improving both early anticipation and interpretability.
summary_zh: 事故预判旨在从行车记录仪视频中预测即将发生的碰撞并触发早期警报。现有方法依赖于带有手动标注的“异常起始”帧的二元监督，这些标注具有主观性和不一致性，导致风险评估不准确。相比之下，我们提出RiskProp，一种新颖的以碰撞为锚点的自监督风险传播范式，用于早期事故预判，它无需异常起始标注，仅利用可靠标注的碰撞帧。RiskProp通过两种观测驱动的损失来建模时间风险演化：首先，考虑到未来帧包含更多关于即将发生的事故的明确证据，我们引入了未来帧正则化损失，该损失使用模型的下一帧预测作为软目标来监督当前帧，从而实现风险信号的反向传播；其次，受到事故发生前风险上升的经验趋势的启发，我们设计了一种自适应单调约束，以鼓励风险随时间的非递减演变。在CAP和Nexar数据集上的实验表明，RiskProp实现了最先进的性能，并产生了更平滑、更具区分性的风险曲线，从而提高了早期预判和可解释性。
tldr: RiskProp introduces a self-supervised approach for accident anticipation in dashcam videos, using future-frame regularization and monotonic constraints to improve risk estimation and achieve state-of-the-art performance without relying on subjective anomaly onset annotations.
tldr_zh: RiskProp 提出了一种用于行车记录仪视频中事故预测的自监督方法，利用未来帧正则化和单调约束来改进风险估计，并在不依赖主观异常发生标注的情况下实现了最先进的性能。

title: RailVQA: A Benchmark and Framework for Efficient Interpretable Visual Cognition in Automatic Train Operation
summary: Automatic Train Operation (ATO) relies on low-latency, reliable cab-view visual perception and decision-oriented inference to ensure safe operation in complex and dynamic railway environments. However, existing approaches focus primarily on basic perception and often generalize poorly to rare yet safety-critical corner cases. They also lack the high-level reasoning and planning capabilities required for operational decision-making. Although recent Large Multi-modal Models (LMMs) show strong generalization and cognitive capabilities, their use in safety-critical ATO is hindered by high computational cost and hallucination risk. Meanwhile, reliable domain-specific benchmarks for systematically evaluating cognitive capabilities are still lacking. To address these gaps, we introduce RailVQA-bench, the first VQA benchmark for cab-view visual cognition in ATO, comprising 20,000 single-frame and 1,168 video based QA pairs to evaluate cognitive generalization and interpretability in both static and dynamic scenarios. Furthermore, we propose RailVQA-CoM, a collaborative large-small model framework that combines small-model efficiency with large-model cognition via a transparent three-module architecture and adaptive temporal sampling, improving perceptual generalization and enabling efficient reasoning and planning. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach substantially improves performance, enhances interpretability, reduces inference latency, and strengthens cross-domain generalization, while enabling plug-and-play deployment in autonomous driving systems. Code and datasets will be available at https://github.com/Cybereye-bjtu/RailVQA.
summary_zh: 自动列车运行(ATO)依赖于低延迟、可靠的驾驶室视角视觉感知和面向决策的推理，以确保在复杂和动态的铁路环境中安全运行。然而，现有方法主要侧重于基础感知，并且通常难以泛化到罕见但对安全至关重要的极端情况。它们也缺乏运营决策所需的高级推理和规划能力。尽管最近的大型多模态模型(LMMs)显示出强大的泛化能力和认知能力，但因计算成本高昂和幻觉风险，其在安全攸关的ATO中的应用受到阻碍。同时，系统评估认知能力的可靠的领域特定基准仍然缺乏。为了解决这些差距，我们推出了RailVQA-bench，这是第一个用于ATO驾驶室视角视觉认知的VQA基准，包含20,000个单帧和1,168个基于视频的QA对，以评估静态和动态场景中的认知泛化和可解释性。此外，我们提出了RailVQA-CoM，一种协作式大小模型框架，通过透明的三模块架构和自适应时间采样，将小模型的效率与大模型的认知能力相结合，从而提高感知泛化能力，并实现高效的推理和规划。实验表明，所提出的方法显著提高了性能，增强了可解释性，降低了推理延迟，并加强了跨领域泛化，同时实现了在自动驾驶系统中的即插即用部署。代码和数据集将在https://github.com/Cybereye-bjtu/RailVQA上提供。
tldr: The paper introduces RailVQA, a novel VQA benchmark for visual cognition in automatic train operation, and RailVQA-CoM, a collaborative large-small model framework designed to improve performance, interpretability, and efficiency in safety-critical ATO systems.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RailVQA，一种用于自动列车运行中视觉认知的新的VQA基准，以及RailVQA-CoM，一个协作式大小模型框架，旨在提高安全关键的ATO系统中的性能、可解释性和效率。

title: SceneExpander: Expanding 3D Scenes with Free-Form Inserted Views
summary: World building with 3D scene representations is increasingly important for content creation, simulation, and interactive experiences, yet real workflows are inherently iterative: creators must repeatedly extend an existing scene under user control. Motivated by this research gap, we study 3D scene expansion in a user-centric workflow: starting from a real scene captured by multi-view images, we extend its coverage by inserting an additional view synthesized by a generative model. Unlike simple object editing or style transfer in a fixed scene, the inserted view is often 3D-misaligned with the original reconstruction, introducing geometry shifts, hallucinated content, or view-dependent artifacts that break global multi-view consistency. To address the challenge, we propose SceneExpander, which applies test-time adaptation to a parametric feed-forward 3D reconstruction model with two complementary distillation signals: anchor distillation stabilizes the original scene by distilling geometric cues from the captured views, while inserted-view self-distillation preserves observation-supported predictions yet adapts latent geometry and appearance to accommodate the misaligned inserted view. Experiments on ETH scenes and online data demonstrate improved expansion behavior and reconstruction quality under misalignment.
summary_zh: 利用3D场景表示进行世界构建对于内容创作、模拟和交互式体验变得越来越重要，然而实际的工作流程本质上是迭代的：创作者必须在用户控制下反复扩展现有场景。受此研究空白的驱动，我们研究了以用户为中心的3D场景扩展工作流程：从多视图图像捕获的真实场景开始，我们通过插入生成模型合成的额外视角来扩展其覆盖范围。与固定场景中的简单对象编辑或风格迁移不同，插入的视角通常与原始重建存在3D错位，引入几何位移、虚构内容或视角相关的伪影，从而破坏全局多视图一致性。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了SceneExpander，它对参数化前馈3D重建模型应用测试时自适应，并结合两种互补的蒸馏信号：锚点蒸馏通过从捕获的视角中提取几何线索来稳定原始场景，而插入视角自蒸馏保留了受观测支持的预测，同时调整潜在的几何形状和外观以适应错位的插入视角。在ETH场景和在线数据上的实验表明，在存在错位的情况下，扩展行为和重建质量得到了改善。
tldr: SceneExpander introduces a method for expanding existing 3D scenes by inserting synthesized views, addressing misalignment issues through test-time adaptation and distillation techniques to maintain multi-view consistency.
tldr_zh: SceneExpander 提出了一种通过插入合成视图来扩展现有 3D 场景的方法，并通过测试时自适应和蒸馏技术解决对齐问题，以保持多视图一致性。

title: Unified Number-Free Text-to-Motion Generation Via Flow Matching
summary: Generative models excel at motion synthesis for a fixed number of agents but struggle to generalize with variable agents. Based on limited, domain-specific data, existing methods employ autoregressive models to generate motion recursively, which suffer from inefficiency and error accumulation. We propose Unified Motion Flow (UMF), which consists of Pyramid Motion Flow (P-Flow) and Semi-Noise Motion Flow (S-Flow). UMF decomposes the number-free motion generation into a single-pass motion prior generation stage and multi-pass reaction generation stages. Specifically, UMF utilizes a unified latent space to bridge the distribution gap between heterogeneous motion datasets, enabling effective unified training. For motion prior generation, P-Flow operates on hierarchical resolutions conditioned on different noise levels, thereby mitigating computational overheads. For reaction generation, S-Flow learns a joint probabilistic path that adaptively performs reaction transformation and context reconstruction, alleviating error accumulation. Extensive results and user studies demonstrate UMF' s effectiveness as a generalist model for multi-person motion generation from text. Project page: https://githubhgh.github.io/umf/.
summary_zh: 生成模型在固定数量智能体的运动合成方面表现出色，但在变量智能体的泛化方面表现不佳。基于有限的、特定领域的数据，现有方法采用自回归模型递归地生成运动，这会造成效率低下和误差累积。我们提出了统一运动流 (UMF)，它由金字塔运动流 (P-Flow) 和半噪声运动流 (S-Flow) 组成。UMF 将无数量限制的运动生成分解为单通道运动先验生成阶段和多通道反应生成阶段。具体来说，UMF 利用统一的潜在空间来弥合异构运动数据集之间的分布差距，从而实现有效的统一训练。对于运动先验生成，P-Flow 在不同噪声水平下分层分辨率上运行，从而减轻计算开销。对于反应生成，S-Flow 学习一个联合概率路径，该路径自适应地执行反应变换和上下文重建，从而减轻误差累积。大量的实验结果和用户研究表明了 UMF 作为从文本生成多人运动的通用模型的有效性。项目页面：https://githubhgh.github.io/umf/。
tldr: The paper introduces Unified Motion Flow (UMF) for generating multi-person motion from text without being limited by a fixed number of agents, addressing limitations of existing autoregressive methods and using a unified latent space to train on heterogeneous datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Unified Motion Flow (UMF)，用于从文本生成多人运动，不受主体数量限制。它解决了现有自回归方法的局限性，并使用统一的潜在空间来训练异构数据集。

title: FusionAgent: A Multimodal Agent with Dynamic Model Selection for Human Recognition
summary: Model fusion is a key strategy for robust recognition in unconstrained scenarios, as different models provide complementary strengths. This is especially important for whole-body human recognition, where biometric cues such as face, gait, and body shape vary across samples and are typically integrated via score-fusion. However, existing score-fusion strategies are usually static, invoking all models for every test sample regardless of sample quality or modality reliability. To overcome these limitations, we propose \textbf{FusionAgent}, a novel agentic framework that leverages a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to perform dynamic, sample-specific model selection. Each expert model is treated as a tool, and through Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) with a metric-based reward, the agent learns to adaptively determine the optimal model combination for each test input. To address the model score misalignment and embedding heterogeneity, we introduce Anchor-based Confidence Top-k (ACT) score-fusion, which anchors on the most confident model and integrates complementary predictions in a confidence-aware manner. Extensive experiments on multiple whole-body biometric benchmarks demonstrate that FusionAgent significantly outperforms SoTA methods while achieving higher efficiency through fewer model invocations, underscoring the critical role of dynamic, explainable, and robust model fusion in real-world recognition systems. Project page: \href{https://fusionagent.github.io/}{FusionAgent}.
summary_zh: 模型融合是在非受限场景下实现鲁棒识别的关键策略，因为不同的模型提供互补的优势。这对于全身人体识别尤为重要，其中面部、步态和体型等生物特征线索在样本间差异较大，并且通常通过分数融合进行整合。然而，现有的分数融合策略通常是静态的，针对每个测试样本，无论样本质量或模态可靠性如何，都会调用所有模型。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了 \textbf{FusionAgent}，一种新颖的代理框架，它利用多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM) 来执行动态的、特定于样本的模型选择。每个专家模型都被视为一个工具，并通过基于度量的奖励进行强化微调 (RFT)，代理学习自适应地确定每个测试输入的最佳模型组合。为了解决模型分数错位和嵌入异构性问题，我们引入了基于锚点的置信度 Top-k (ACT) 分数融合，它锚定于最自信的模型，并以置信度感知的方式整合互补预测。在多个全身生物特征基准数据集上的大量实验表明，FusionAgent 显著优于最先进的方法，同时通过较少的模型调用实现了更高的效率，突显了动态、可解释和鲁棒的模型融合在真实世界识别系统中的关键作用。项目主页: \href{https://fusionagent.github.io/}{FusionAgent}.
tldr: The paper introduces FusionAgent, a multimodal agent leveraging an MLLM and reinforcement learning for dynamic model selection in whole-body human recognition, achieving SoTA performance and efficiency through adaptive model combination and confidence-aware score fusion.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了FusionAgent，一个利用多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）和强化学习的智能体，用于全身人体识别中的动态模型选择。通过自适应模型组合和置信度感知的得分融合，实现了最先进的性能和效率。

title: Semantic Interaction Information mediates compositional generalization in latent space
summary:
Are there still barriers to generalization once all relevant variables are known? We address this question via a framework that casts compositional generalization as a variational inference problem over latent variables with parametric interactions. To explore this, we develop the Cognitive Gridworld, a stationary Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) where observations are generated jointly by multiple latent variables, yet feedback is provided for only a single goal variable. This setting allows us to define Semantic Interaction Information (SII): a metric measuring the contribution of latent variable interactions to task performance. Using SII, we analyze Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) provided with these interactions, finding that SII explains the accuracy gap between Echo State and Fully Trained networks. Our analysis also uncovers a theoretically predicted failure mode where confidence decouples from accuracy, suggesting that utilizing interactions between relevant variables is a non-trivial capability.
  We then address a harder regime where the interactions must be learned by an embedding model. Learning how latent variables interact requires accurate inference, yet accurate inference depends on knowing those interactions. The Cognitive Gridworld reveals this circular dependence as a core challenge for continual meta-learning. We approach this dilemma via Representation Classification Chains (RCCs), a JEPA-style architecture that disentangles these processes: variable inference and variable embeddings are learned by separate modules through Reinforcement Learning and self-supervised learning, respectively. Lastly, we demonstrate that RCCs facilitate compositional generalization to novel combinations of relevant variables. Together, these results establish a grounded setting for evaluating goal-directed generalist agents.
summary_zh:
一旦所有相关变量已知，泛化仍然存在障碍吗？我们通过一个框架来解决这个问题，该框架将组合泛化视为具有参数化交互的隐变量上的变分推断问题。为了探索这一点，我们开发了认知网格世界，这是一个静态的部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程 (POMDP)，其中观测由多个隐变量共同生成，但仅为单个目标变量提供反馈。这种设置允许我们定义语义交互信息 (SII)：一种衡量隐变量交互对任务性能贡献的指标。 利用 SII，我们分析了具备这些交互的循环神经网络 (RNN)，发现 SII 解释了回声状态网络和完全训练网络之间的准确性差距。 我们的分析还揭示了一种理论预测的失效模式，其中置信度与准确度解耦，这表明利用相关变量之间的交互是一种非平凡的能力。

然后，我们探讨了一个更困难的场景，其中交互必须通过嵌入模型来学习。 学习隐变量如何交互需要准确的推断，但准确的推断取决于了解这些交互。 认知网格世界将这种循环依赖性揭示为持续元学习的核心挑战。 我们通过表示分类链 (RCC) 来解决这一困境，RCC 是一种 JEPA 风格的架构，它将这些过程解耦：变量推断和变量嵌入分别通过强化学习和自监督学习由单独的模块学习。 最后，我们证明了 RCC 促进了对相关变量新颖组合的组合泛化。 总之，这些结果为评估以目标为导向的通用智能体建立了一个基础环境。
tldr: This paper introduces a framework using Semantic Interaction Information (SII) in a Cognitive Gridworld to address compositional generalization in latent spaces, and proposes Representation Classification Chains (RCCs) to facilitate this generalization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个框架，在认知网格世界中使用语义交互信息（SII）来解决潜在空间中的组合泛化问题，并提出了表征分类链（RCCs）来促进这种泛化。

title: On the Reliability Limits of LLM-Based Multi-Agent Planning
summary: This technical note studies the reliability limits of LLM-based multi-agent planning as a delegated decision problem. We model the LLM-based multi-agent architecture as a finite acyclic decision network in which multiple stages process shared model-context information, communicate through language interfaces with limited capacity, and may invoke human review. We show that, without new exogenous signals, any delegated network is decision-theoretically dominated by a centralized Bayes decision maker with access to the same information. In the common-evidence regime, this implies that optimizing over multi-agent directed acyclic graphs under a finite communication budget can be recast as choosing a budget-constrained stochastic experiment on the shared signal. We also characterize the loss induced by communication and information compression. Under proper scoring rules, the gap between the centralized Bayes value and the value after communication admits an expected posterior divergence representation, which reduces to conditional mutual information under logarithmic loss and to expected squared posterior error under the Brier score. These results characterize the fundamental reliability limits of delegated LLM planning. Experiments with LLMs on a controlled problem set further demonstrate these characterizations.
summary_zh: 本技术报告研究了基于LLM的多智能体规划作为委托决策问题的可靠性限度。我们将基于LLM的多智能体架构建模为有限的无环决策网络，其中多个阶段处理共享的模型-上下文信息，通过容量有限的语言接口进行通信，并且可能调用人工审核。我们证明，在没有新的外生信号的情况下，任何委托网络在决策理论上都优于可以访问相同信息的集中式贝叶斯决策者。在共同证据体制下，这意味着在有限的通信预算下优化多智能体有向无环图可以重新表述为选择对于共享信号的预算约束下的随机实验。我们还刻画了由通信和信息压缩引起的损失。在适当的评分规则下，集中式贝叶斯值与通信后的值之间的差距允许使用期望后验散度表示，在使用对数损失时简化为条件互信息，在使用Brier分数时简化为期望平方后验误差。这些结果刻画了委托LLM规划的基本可靠性限度。在受控问题集上进行的LLM实验进一步论证了这些刻画。
tldr: This paper analyzes the reliability limits of LLM-based multi-agent planning, showing that such systems are theoretically dominated by a centralized decision maker and quantifying the loss due to communication constraints. Experiments with LLMs support the theoretical analysis.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了基于LLM的多智能体规划的可靠性限制，表明此类系统在理论上不如集中的决策者，并量化了因通信约束造成的损失。使用LLM的实验支持了理论分析。

title: Robust Global-Local Behavior Arbitration via Continuous Command Fusion Under LiDAR Errors
summary: Modular autonomous driving systems must coordinate global progress objectives with local safety-driven reactions under imperfect sensing and strict real-time constraints. This paper presents a ROS2-native arbitration module that continuously fuses the outputs of two unchanged and interpretable controllers: a global reference-tracking controller based on Pure Pursuit and a reactive LiDAR-based Gap Follow controller. At each control step, both controllers propose Ackermann commands, and a PPO-trained policy predicts a continuous gate from a compact feature observation to produce a single fused drive command, augmented with practical safety checks. For comparison under identical ROS topic inputs and control rate, we implement a lightweight sampling-based predictive baseline. Robustness is evaluated using a ROS2 impairment protocol that injects LiDAR noise, delay, and dropout, and additionally sweeps forward-cone false short-range outliers. In a repeatable close-proximity passing scenario, we report safe success and failure rates together with per-step end-to-end controller runtime as sensing stress increases. The study is intended as a command-level robustness evaluation in a modular ROS2 setting, not as a replacement for planning-level interaction reasoning.
summary_zh: 模块化自动驾驶系统必须在不完善的感知和严格的实时约束下，协调全局进展目标与局部安全驱动的反应。本文提出了一种ROS2原生仲裁模块，该模块持续融合两个未经修改且可解释的控制器的输出：一个基于Pure Pursuit的全局参考轨迹跟踪控制器和一个基于激光雷达的反应式空隙跟踪控制器。在每个控制步骤中，两个控制器都提出阿克曼指令，而一个经过PPO训练的策略从紧凑的特征观测中预测一个连续门控值，以产生单个融合的驱动指令，并辅以实用的安全检查。为了在相同的ROS主题输入和控制速率下进行比较，我们实现了一个轻量级的基于采样的预测基线。 使用ROS2损伤协议评估鲁棒性，该协议注入激光雷达噪声、延迟和丢包，并额外扫描前向锥体内的虚假近距离离群点。 在一个可重复的近距离超车场景中，我们报告了安全成功率和失败率，以及随着感知压力增加的每步端到端控制器运行时间。 该研究旨在作为模块化ROS2环境中命令级别的鲁棒性评估，而不是替代规划级别的交互推理。
tldr: This paper introduces a ROS2-native autonomous driving arbitration module that fuses global and local controllers using a PPO-trained policy, and evaluates its robustness under various LiDAR error conditions in a reproducible close-proximity passing scenario.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个ROS2原生的自动驾驶仲裁模块，该模块使用PPO训练的策略融合全局和局部控制器，并在可重复的近距离超车场景中，评估其在各种激光雷达误差条件下的鲁棒性。

title: Complet4R: Geometric Complete 4D Reconstruction
summary: We introduce Complet4R, a novel end-to-end framework for Geometric Complete 4D Reconstruction, which aims to recover temporally coherent and geometrically complete reconstruction for dynamic scenes. Our method formalizes the task of Geometric Complete 4D Reconstruction as a unified framework of reconstruction and completion, by directly accumulating full contexts onto each frame. Unlike previous approaches that rely on pairwise reconstruction or local motion estimation, Complet4R utilizes a decoder-only transformer to operate all context globally directly from sequential video input, reconstructing a complete geometry for every single timestamp, including occluded regions visible in other frames. Our method demonstrates the state-of-the-art performance on our proposed benchmark for Geometric Complete 4D Reconstruction and the 3D Point Tracking task. Code will be released to support future research.
summary_zh: 我们提出了 Complet4R，一种用于几何完整四维重建的新型端到端框架，旨在恢复动态场景在时间上连贯且几何上完整的重建。我们的方法将几何完整四维重建的任务形式化为一个统一的重建和补全框架，通过直接将完整上下文累积到每个帧上。与以往依赖于成对重建或局部运动估计的方法不同，Complet4R 利用一个仅解码器的 Transformer，直接从序列视频输入全局地处理所有上下文，重建每个时间戳的完整几何体，包括在其他帧中可见的遮挡区域。我们的方法在我们提出的几何完整四维重建及三维点云追踪基准测试上展示了最先进的性能。代码将被发布以支持未来的研究。
tldr: The paper introduces Complet4R, a novel transformer-based framework for geometric complete 4D reconstruction of dynamic scenes, achieving state-of-the-art performance by globally accumulating context from sequential video input.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Complet4R，一个用于动态场景几何完整4D重建的新型基于Transformer的框架，通过从顺序视频输入中全局累积上下文，实现了最先进的性能。

title: Class-Distribution Guided Active Learning for 3D Occupancy Prediction in Autonomous Driving
summary: 3D occupancy prediction provides dense spatial understanding critical for safe autonomous driving. However, this task suffers from a severe class imbalance due to its volumetric representation, where safety-critical objects (bicycles, traffic cones, pedestrians) occupy minimal voxels compared to dominant backgrounds. Additionally, voxel-level annotation is costly, yet dedicating effort to dominant classes is inefficient. To address these challenges, we propose a class-distribution guided active learning framework for selecting training samples to annotate in autonomous driving datasets. Our approach combines three complementary criteria to select the training samples. Inter-sample diversity prioritizes samples whose predicted class distributions differ from those of the labeled set, intra-set diversity prevents redundant sampling within each acquisition cycle, and frequency-weighted uncertainty emphasizes rare classes by reweighting voxel-level entropy with inverse per-sample class proportions. We ensure evaluation validity by using a geographically disjoint train/validation split of Occ3D-nuScenes, which reduces train-validation overlap and mitigates potential map memorization. With only 42.4% labeled data, our framework reaches 26.62 mIoU, comparable to full supervision and outperforming active learning baselines at the same budget. We further validate generality on SemanticKITTI using a different architecture, demonstrating consistent effectiveness across datasets.
summary_zh: 三维占据预测提供密集的空间理解，对安全的自动驾驶至关重要。然而，由于其体素化的表示，这项任务面临严重的类别不平衡问题，其中安全关键物体（自行车、交通锥、行人）与占主导地位的背景相比，仅占据极少的体素。此外，体素级别的标注代价高昂，而将精力投入到占主导地位的类别中效率低下。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种类分布引导的主动学习框架，用于选择自动驾驶数据集中需要标注的训练样本。我们的方法结合了三个互补的标准来选择训练样本：样本间多样性优先考虑预测类分布与已标注集合不同的样本，集合内多样性防止在每个采集周期内进行冗余采样，频率加权的不确定性通过对体素级别熵按照样本的反向类别比例进行加权来强调稀有类别。我们通过使用 Occ3D-nuScenes 的地理上不相交的训练/验证划分来确保评估的有效性，这减少了训练-验证集的重叠并减轻了潜在的地图记忆。仅使用 42.4% 的已标注数据，我们的框架达到了 26.62 mIoU，与全监督相当，并且在相同的预算下优于主动学习基线。我们进一步使用不同的架构在 SemanticKITTI 上验证了泛化性，证明了在不同数据集上的一致有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces a class-distribution guided active learning framework for 3D occupancy prediction in autonomous driving, addressing class imbalance and annotation cost challenges by strategically selecting training samples for annotation, achieving performance comparable to full supervision with significantly less labeled data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种类分布引导的主动学习框架，用于自动驾驶中的3D occupancy预测，通过策略性地选择训练样本进行标注，解决了类别不平衡和标注成本挑战，在大幅减少标注数据的情况下，实现了与完全监督相当的性能。

title: MotiMem: Motion-Aware Approximate Memory for Energy-Efficient Neural Perception in Autonomous Vehicles
summary: High-resolution sensors are critical for robust autonomous perception but impose a severe memory wall on battery-constrained electric vehicles. In these systems, data movement energy often outweighs computation. Traditional image compression is ill-suited as it is semantically blind and optimizes for storage rather than bus switching activity. We propose MotiMem, a hardware-software co-designed interface. Exploiting temporal coherence,MotiMem uses lightweight 2D Motion Propagation to dynamically identify Regions of Interest (RoI). Complementing this, a Hybrid Sparsity-Aware Coding scheme leverages adaptive inversion and truncation to induce bitlevel sparsity. Extensive experiments across nuScenes, Waymo, and KITTI with 16 detection models demonstrate that MotiMem reduces memory-interface dynamic energy by approximately 43 percent while retaining approximately 93 percent of the object detection accuracy, establishing a new Pareto frontier significantly superior to standard codecs like JPEG and WebP.
summary_zh: 高分辨率传感器对于鲁棒的自主感知至关重要，但对电池容量受限的电动汽车而言，会造成严重的内存墙问题。在这些系统中，数据移动能耗通常超过计算能耗。传统的图像压缩方法并不适用，因为它在语义上是盲目的，并且优化的是存储而非总线切换活动。我们提出了一种软硬件协同设计的接口 MotiMem。MotiMem 充分利用时间连贯性，使用轻量级的 2D 运动传播来动态识别感兴趣区域 (RoI)。作为补充，一种混合稀疏感知编码方案利用自适应反转和截断来诱导位级稀疏性。在 nuScenes、Waymo 和 KITTI 数据集上针对 16 种检测模型进行的大量实验表明，MotiMem 可将内存接口动态能耗降低约 43%，同时保持约 93% 的目标检测精度，从而建立了一个明显优于 JPEG 和 WebP 等标准编解码器的新帕累托前沿。
tldr: MotiMem is a hardware-software co-designed system that leverages motion propagation and sparsity-aware coding to reduce memory-interface energy consumption in autonomous vehicles while maintaining high object detection accuracy.
tldr_zh: MotiMem是一个硬件-软件协同设计的系统，利用运动传播和稀疏感知编码来降低自动驾驶车辆中的内存接口能耗，同时保持较高的目标检测精度。

title: YOLO Object Detectors for Robotics -- a Comparative Study
summary: YOLO object detectors recently became a key component of vision systems in many domains. The family of available YOLO models consists of multiple versions, each in various variants. The research reported in this paper aims to validate the applicability of members of this family to detect objects located within the robot workspace. In our experiments, we used our custom dataset and the COCO2017 dataset. To test the robustness of investigated detectors, the images of these datasets were subject to distortions. The results of our experiments, including variations of training/testing configurations and models, may support the choice of the appropriate YOLO version for robotic vision tasks.
summary_zh: YOLO目标检测器最近已成为许多领域视觉系统的关键组成部分。现有的YOLO模型家族包含多个版本，每个版本又包含各种变体。本文旨在验证该家族成员在检测机器人工作空间内物体的适用性。在我们的实验中，我们使用了自定义数据集和COCO2017数据集。为了测试所研究检测器的鲁棒性，这些数据集的图像经过了失真处理。我们的实验结果，包括训练/测试配置和模型的变化，可以为机器人视觉任务选择合适的YOLO版本提供支持。
tldr: This paper benchmarks various YOLO object detectors for robotic vision tasks using custom and COCO datasets with distortions, aiming to guide the selection of appropriate YOLO versions for robotics.
tldr_zh: 本文对各种YOLO目标检测器在机器人视觉任务中的性能进行了基准测试，使用了自定义数据集和COCO数据集，并加入了图像扭曲，旨在为机器人选择合适的YOLO版本提供指导。

title: Improving Automated Wound Assessment Using Joint Boundary Segmentation and Multi-Class Classification Models
summary: Accurate wound classification and boundary segmentation are essential for guiding clinical decisions in both chronic and acute wound management. However, most existing AI models are limited, focusing on a narrow set of wound types or performing only a single task (segmentation or classification), which reduces their clinical applicability. This study presents a deep learning model based on YOLOv11 that simultaneously performs wound boundary segmentation (WBS) and wound classification (WC) across five clinically relevant wound types: burn injury (BI), pressure injury (PI), diabetic foot ulcer (DFU), vascular ulcer (VU), and surgical wound (SW). A wound-type balanced dataset of 2,963 annotated images was created to train the models for both tasks, with stratified five-fold cross-validation ensuring robust and unbiased evaluation. The models trained on the original non-augmented dataset achieved consistent performance across folds, though BI detection accuracy was relatively lower. Therefore, the dataset was augmented using rotation, flipping, and variations in brightness, saturation, and exposure to help the model learn more generalized and invariant features. This augmentation significantly improved model performance, particularly in detecting visually subtle BI cases. Among tested variants, YOLOv11x achieved the highest performance with F1-scores of 0.9341 (WBS) and 0.8736 (WC), while the lightweight YOLOv11n provided comparable accuracy at lower computational cost, making it suitable for resource-constrained deployments. Supported by confusion matrices and visual detection outputs, the results confirm the model's robustness against complex backgrounds and high intra-class variability, demonstrating the potential of YOLOv11-based architectures for accurate, real-time wound analysis in both clinical and remote care settings.
summary_zh: 伤口的精确分类和边界分割对于指导急慢性伤口管理的临床决策至关重要。然而，目前大多数人工智能模型都存在局限性，它们往往只关注一小部分伤口类型，或仅执行单一任务（分割或分类），这降低了它们的临床适用性。本研究提出了一种基于YOLOv11的深度学习模型，该模型能够同时执行伤口边界分割(WBS)和伤口分类(WC)，涵盖五种临床相关的伤口类型：烧伤(BI)、压力性损伤(PI)、糖尿病足溃疡(DFU)、血管性溃疡(VU)和手术伤口(SW)。我们创建了一个包含2,963张带注释图像的、伤口类型平衡的数据集，用于训练模型执行这两项任务，并采用分层五折交叉验证以确保评估的稳健性和无偏性。在原始未增强数据集上训练的模型在各个折叠中均表现出一致的性能，但烧伤(BI)的检测准确率相对较低。因此，我们使用旋转、翻转以及亮度、饱和度和曝光度的变化来增强数据集，以帮助模型学习更具泛化性和不变性的特征。这种增强显著提高了模型的性能，尤其是在检测视觉上不明显的烧伤(BI)病例方面。在测试的变体中，YOLOv11x取得了最高的性能，其伤口边界分割(WBS)和伤口分类(WC)的F1值分别为0.9341和0.8736，而轻量级的YOLOv11n则以较低的计算成本实现了相当的准确率，使其适用于资源受限的部署。结果得到了混淆矩阵和可视化检测输出的支持，证实了该模型在复杂背景和高类内变异性情况下的稳健性，并证明了基于YOLOv11的架构在临床和远程护理环境中进行精确、实时的伤口分析的潜力。
tldr: This paper introduces a YOLOv11-based deep learning model for simultaneous wound boundary segmentation and multi-class wound classification, demonstrating improved performance through data augmentation and achieving high F1-scores for clinical applicability, especially in resource-constrained environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种基于YOLOv11的深度学习模型，用于同时进行伤口边界分割和多类别伤口分类。通过数据增强提高了性能，并实现了高F1分数，具有临床应用价值，尤其是在资源受限的环境中。

title: Beyond Descriptions: A Generative Scene2Audio Framework for Blind and Low-Vision Users to Experience Vista Landscapes
summary: Current scene perception tools for Blind and Low Vision (BLV) individuals rely on spoken descriptions but lack engaging representations of visually pleasing distant environmental landscapes (Vista spaces). Our proposed Scene2Audio framework generates comprehensible and enjoyable nonverbal audio using generative models informed by psychoacoustics, and principles of scene audio composition. Through a user study with 11 BLV participants, we found that combining the Scene2Audio sounds with speech creates a better experience than speech alone, as the sound effects complement the speech making the scene easier to imagine. A mobile app "in-the-wild" study with 7 BLV users for more than a week further showed the potential of Scene2Audio in enhancing outdoor scene experiences. Our work bridges the gap between visual and auditory scene perception by moving beyond purely descriptive aids, addressing the aesthetic needs of BLV users.
summary_zh: 针对盲人和低视力（BLV）人士的现有场景感知工具依赖于语音描述，但缺乏对视觉上令人愉悦的遥远环境景观（远景空间）的引人入胜的表示。我们提出的Scene2Audio框架利用由心理声学和场景音频合成原则指导的生成模型，生成可理解且令人愉悦的非语言音频。通过对11位BLV参与者进行的用户研究，我们发现将Scene2Audio声音与语音结合使用比单独使用语音的效果更好，因为音效补充了语音，更容易想象场景。一项针对7位BLV用户，持续一周以上的“野外”移动应用程序研究进一步表明了Scene2Audio在增强户外场景体验方面的潜力。我们的工作通过超越纯粹的描述性辅助工具，满足BLV用户的审美需求，弥合了视觉和听觉场景感知之间的差距。
tldr: The paper introduces Scene2Audio, a generative scene-to-audio framework for blind and low-vision users to enhance their experience of vista landscapes, demonstrating improved scene understanding and enjoyment when combined with speech descriptions.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Scene2Audio，一个为盲人和低视力用户设计的生成式场景转音频框架，旨在增强他们对风景的体验。研究表明，与语音描述结合使用时，该框架能够改善场景理解和体验乐趣。

title: Bayesian-Symbolic Integration for Uncertainty-Aware Parking Prediction
summary: Accurate parking availability prediction is critical for intelligent transportation systems, but real-world deployments often face data sparsity, noise, and unpredictable changes. Addressing these challenges requires models that are not only accurate but also uncertainty-aware. In this work, we propose a loosely coupled neuro-symbolic framework that integrates Bayesian Neural Networks (BNNs) with symbolic reasoning to enhance robustness in uncertain environments. BNNs quantify predictive uncertainty, while symbolic knowledge extracted via decision trees and encoded using probabilistic logic programming is leveraged in two hybrid strategies: (1) using symbolic reasoning as a fallback when BNN confidence is low, and (2) refining output classes based on symbolic constraints before reapplying the BNN. We evaluate both strategies on real-world parking data under full, sparse, and noisy conditions. Results demonstrate that both hybrid methods outperform symbolic reasoning alone, and the context-refinement strategy consistently exceeds the performance of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks and BNN baselines across all prediction windows. Our findings highlight the potential of modular neuro-symbolic integration in real-world, uncertainty-prone prediction tasks.
summary_zh: 精确的停车位可用性预测对于智能交通系统至关重要，但实际部署常常面临数据稀疏性、噪声和不可预测的变化。解决这些挑战需要模型不仅具有高准确性，还需具备感知不确定性的能力。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种松散耦合的神经-符号框架，该框架集成了贝叶斯神经网络（BNNs）和符号推理，以增强在不确定环境中的鲁棒性。BNNs能够量化预测的不确定性，而通过决策树提取并使用概率逻辑编程编码的符号知识则应用于两种混合策略：（1）当BNN置信度较低时，使用符号推理作为备用方案；（2）在重新应用BNN之前，基于符号约束来细化输出类别。我们针对完整、稀疏和噪声条件下的真实停车数据对这两种策略进行了评估。结果表明，两种混合方法均优于单独使用符号推理，而且上下文细化策略在所有预测窗口中都始终超越了长短期记忆（LSTM）网络和BNN基线的性能。我们的发现突显了模块化神经-符号集成在现实世界中、易受不确定性影响的预测任务中的潜力。
tldr: This paper proposes a neuro-symbolic framework integrating Bayesian Neural Networks and symbolic reasoning for uncertainty-aware parking prediction, demonstrating improved accuracy and robustness compared to LSTM and BNN baselines, especially in sparse and noisy data conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种神经符号框架，将贝叶斯神经网络和符号推理相结合，用于感知不确定性的停车位预测。结果表明，与LSTM和BNN基线相比，该框架在稀疏和嘈杂的数据条件下具有更高的准确性和鲁棒性。

title: Dynamic resource matching in manufacturing using deep reinforcement learning
summary: Matching plays an important role in the logical allocation of resources across a wide range of industries. The benefits of matching have been increasingly recognized in manufacturing industries. In particular, capacity sharing has received much attention recently. In this paper, we consider the problem of dynamically matching demand-capacity types of manufacturing resources. We formulate the multi-period, many-to-many manufacturing resource-matching problem as a sequential decision process. The formulated manufacturing resource-matching problem involves large state and action spaces, and it is not practical to accurately model the joint distribution of various types of demands. To address the curse of dimensionality and the difficulty of explicitly modeling the transition dynamics, we use a model-free deep reinforcement learning approach to find optimal matching policies. Moreover, to tackle the issue of infeasible actions and slow convergence due to initial biased estimates caused by the maximum operator in Q-learning, we introduce two penalties to the traditional Q-learning algorithm: a domain knowledge-based penalty based on a prior policy and an infeasibility penalty that conforms to the demand-supply constraints. We establish theoretical results on the convergence of our domain knowledge-informed Q-learning providing performance guarantee for small-size problems. For large-size problems, we further inject our modified approach into the deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) algorithm, which we refer to as domain knowledge-informed DDPG (DKDDPG). In our computational study, including small- and large-scale experiments, DKDDPG consistently outperformed traditional DDPG and other RL algorithms, yielding higher rewards and demonstrating greater efficiency in time and episodes.
summary_zh: 匹配在广泛行业的资源逻辑分配中起着重要作用。匹配的益处在制造业中日益受到重视，尤其是在近年来，产能共享备受关注。本文考虑了制造资源的需求-产能类型动态匹配问题。我们将多期、多对多的制造资源匹配问题建模为一个序贯决策过程。该制造资源匹配问题涉及庞大的状态空间和动作空间，并且准确建模各种类型需求的联合分布是不切实际的。为了解决维度灾难以及显式建模转移动态的困难，我们采用一种无模型的深度强化学习方法来寻找最优匹配策略。此外，为了解决由于Q-学习中最大算子的初始偏差估计导致不可行动作和收敛速度慢的问题，我们向传统的Q-学习算法引入了两种惩罚：一种基于先验策略的领域知识惩罚，以及一种符合供需约束的不可行性惩罚。我们建立了领域知识驱动的Q-学习算法的收敛性理论结果，为小规模问题提供了性能保证。对于大规模问题，我们将改进后的方法进一步注入到深度确定性策略梯度(DDPG)算法中，并称之为领域知识驱动的DDPG (DKDDPG)。在我们的计算研究中，包括小规模和大规模实验，DKDDPG始终优于传统的DDPG和其他RL算法，产生了更高的回报，并在时间和episode上表现出更高的效率。
tldr: This paper introduces a domain knowledge-informed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DKDDPG) algorithm for dynamic resource matching in manufacturing, outperforming traditional DDPG and other RL algorithms.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于领域知识的深度确定性策略梯度（DKDDPG）算法，用于制造业中的动态资源匹配，其性能优于传统的DDPG和其他强化学习算法。

title: MultiLoc: Multi-view Guided Relative Pose Regression for Fast and Robust Visual Re-Localization
summary: Relative Pose Regression (RPR) generalizes well to unseen environments, but its performance is often limited due to pairwise and local spatial views. To this end, we propose MultiLoc, a novel multi-view guided RPR model trained at scale, equipping relative pose regression with globally consistent spatial and geometric understanding. Specifically, our method jointly fuses multiple reference views and their associated camera poses in a single forward pass, enabling accurate zero-shot pose estimation with real-time efficiency. To reliably supply informative context, we further propose a co-visibility-driven retrieval strategy for geometrically relevant reference view selection. MultiLoc establishes a new benchmark in visual re-localization, consistently outperforming existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) relative pose regression (RPR) methods across diverse datasets, including WaySpots, Cambridge Landmarks, and Indoor6. Furthermore, MultiLoc's pose regressor exhibits SOTA performance in relative pose estimation, surpassing RPR, feature matching and non-regression-based techniques on the MegaDepth-1500, ScanNet-1500, and ACID benchmarks. These results demonstrate robust domain generalization of MultiLoc across indoor, outdoor and natural environments. Code will be made publicly available.
summary_zh: 相对位姿回归(RPR)在未见过的环境中具有良好的泛化能力，但其性能通常受限于成对和局部空间视角。为此，我们提出MultiLoc，一种新颖的多视角引导RPR模型，经过大规模训练，使相对位姿回归具备全局一致的空间和几何理解。具体来说，我们的方法在单个前向传递中联合融合多个参考视角及其相关的相机位姿，从而实现精确的零样本位姿估计，并具有实时效率。为了可靠地提供信息丰富的上下文，我们进一步提出了一种共视性驱动的检索策略，用于几何上相关的参考视角选择。MultiLoc在视觉重定位方面建立了一个新的基准，在包括WaySpots、Cambridge Landmarks和Indoor6等各种数据集上，始终优于现有的最先进(SOTA)相对位姿回归(RPR)方法。此外，MultiLoc的位姿回归器在相对位姿估计方面表现出SOTA性能，在MegaDepth-1500、ScanNet-1500和ACID基准测试中，超越了RPR、特征匹配和非回归技术。这些结果表明MultiLoc在室内、室外和自然环境中具有强大的领域泛化能力。代码将会公开。
tldr: The paper introduces MultiLoc, a multi-view guided relative pose regression model for visual re-localization that outperforms existing methods with real-time efficiency and robust domain generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了MultiLoc，一种多视图引导的相对姿态回归模型，用于视觉重定位，该模型以实时效率和强大的领域泛化能力优于现有方法。

title: Follow Your Heart: Landmark-Guided Transducer Pose Scoring for Point-of-Care Echocardiography
summary: Point-of-care transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) makes it possible to assess a patient's cardiac function in almost any setting. A critical step in the TTE exam is acquisition of the apical 4-chamber (A4CH) view, which is used to evaluate clinically impactful measurements such as left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF). However, optimizing transducer pose for high-quality image acquisition and subsequent measurement is a challenging task, particularly for novice users. In this work, we present a multi-task network that provides feedback cues for A4CH view acquisition and automatically estimates LVEF in high-quality A4CH images. The network cascades a transducer pose scoring module and an uncertainty-aware LV landmark detector with automated LVEF estimation. A strength is that network training and inference do not require cumbersome or costly setups for transducer position tracking. We evaluate performance on point-of-care TTE data acquired with a spatially dense "sweep" protocol around the optimal A4CH view. The results demonstrate the network's ability to determine when the transducer pose is on target, close to target, or far from target based on the images alone, while generating visual landmark cues that guide anatomical interpretation and orientation. In conclusion, we demonstrate a promising strategy to provide guidance for A4CH view acquisition, which may be useful when deploying point-of-care TTE in limited resource settings.
summary_zh: 床旁经胸超声心动图（TTE）使得在几乎任何环境下评估患者心脏功能成为可能。TTE检查的关键步骤是获取心尖四腔（A4CH）切面图，该切面图用于评估具有临床影响的测量指标，如左心室射血分数（LVEF）。然而，优化探头姿态以获得高质量图像并进行后续测量是一项具有挑战性的任务，特别是对于新手用户。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种多任务网络，该网络为A4CH切面图的获取提供反馈提示，并在高质量A4CH图像中自动估计LVEF。该网络级联了一个探头姿态评分模块和一个具有自动LVEF估计功能的、感知不确定性的左心室标志物检测器。一个优点是，网络的训练和推理不需要繁琐或昂贵的探头位置跟踪设置。我们使用围绕最佳A4CH切面图进行空间密集“扫查”协议获取的床旁TTE数据来评估性能。结果表明，该网络能够仅根据图像来确定探头姿态是瞄准、接近目标还是远离目标，同时生成可视化的标志物线索，以指导解剖学解释和方向。总之，我们展示了一种有前景的策略，可以为A4CH切面图的获取提供指导，这可能在资源有限的环境中部署床旁TTE时非常有用。
tldr: The paper presents a deep learning approach to guide novice users in acquiring the apical 4-chamber view in point-of-care echocardiography and automatically estimates left ventricular ejection fraction, which could improve accessibility in limited resource settings.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种深度学习方法，用于指导新手用户在床旁超声心动图中获取心尖四腔心切面，并自动估计左心室射血分数，这可以提高在资源有限环境中的可及性。

title: Online Learning of Kalman Filtering: From Output to State Estimation
summary: In this paper, we study the problem of learning Kalman filtering with unknown system model in partially observed linear dynamical systems. We propose a unified algorithmic framework based on online optimization that can be used to solve both the output estimation and state estimation scenarios. By exploring the properties of the estimation error cost functions, such as conditionally strong convexity, we show that our algorithm achieves a $\log T$-regret in the horizon length $T$ for the output estimation scenario. More importantly, we tackle the more challenging scenario of learning Kalman filtering for state estimation, which is an open problem in the literature. We first characterize a fundamental limitation of the problem, demonstrating the impossibility of any algorithm to achieve sublinear regret in $T$. By further introducing a random query scheme into our algorithm, we show that a $\sqrt{T}$-regret is achievable when rendering the algorithm limited query access to more informative measurements of the system state in practice. Our algorithm and regret readily capture the trade-off between the number of queries and the achieved regret, and shed light on online learning problems with limited observations. We validate the performance of our algorithms using numerical examples.
summary_zh: 本文研究了在部分可观测的线性动态系统中学习具有未知系统模型的卡尔曼滤波问题。我们提出了一种基于在线优化的统一算法框架，该框架可用于解决输出估计和状态估计两种场景。通过探索估计误差代价函数的性质，例如条件强凸性，我们证明了我们的算法在输出估计场景下，对于时间范围$T$可以实现$\log T$的遗憾。更重要的是，我们解决了更具挑战性的状态估计卡尔曼滤波学习问题，这在文献中是一个开放问题。我们首先刻画了该问题的一个根本局限性，证明了任何算法都无法实现亚线性($T$)的遗憾。通过进一步在我们的算法中引入随机查询方案，我们表明，在允许算法有限地访问系统中更具信息量的状态测量值时，可以实现$\sqrt{T}$的遗憾。我们的算法和遗憾很容易捕捉查询数量和所实现的遗憾之间的权衡，并揭示了具有有限观测的在线学习问题。我们使用数值示例验证了我们算法的性能。
tldr: This paper introduces an online learning algorithm for Kalman filtering in partially observed linear dynamical systems, addressing both output and state estimation. It achieves log-T regret for output estimation and explores the limits of state estimation, presenting a sqrt(T) regret algorithm with a random query scheme.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在线学习卡尔曼滤波的算法，用于部分观测线性动态系统，解决了输出和状态估计问题。该算法在输出估计中实现了log-T的遗憾值，并探讨了状态估计的局限性，提出了一种带有随机查询方案的sqrt(T)遗憾值算法。

title: Conformalized Signal Temporal Logic Inference under Covariate Shift
summary: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) inference learns interpretable logical rules for temporal behaviors in dynamical systems. To ensure the correctness of learned STL formulas, recent approaches have incorporated conformal prediction as a statistical tool for uncertainty quantification. However, most existing methods rely on the assumption that calibration and testing data are identically distributed and exchangeable, an assumption that is frequently violated in real-world settings. This paper proposes a conformalized STL inference framework that explicitly addresses covariate shift between training and deployment trajectories dataset. From a technical standpoint, the approach first employs a template-free, differentiable STL inference method to learn an initial model, and subsequently refines it using a limited deployment side dataset to promote distribution alignment. To provide validity guarantees under distribution shift, the framework estimates the likelihood ratio between training and deployment distributions and integrates it into an STL-robustness-based weighted conformal prediction scheme. Experimental results on trajectory datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework preserves the interpretability of STL formulas while significantly improving symbolic learning reliability at deployment time.
summary_zh: 信号时序逻辑 (STL) 推理旨在学习动态系统中可解释的关于时间行为的逻辑规则。为确保学习到的 STL 公式的正确性，最近的研究方法已将共形预测作为一种用于不确定性量化的统计工具。然而，大多数现有方法依赖于校准数据和测试数据是同分布且可交换的假设，而该假设在实际环境中常常不成立。本文提出了一种共形化的 STL 推理框架，该框架显式地解决了训练轨迹数据集和部署轨迹数据集之间的协变量偏移问题。从技术角度出发，该方法首先采用一种无模板的、可微分的 STL 推理方法来学习初始模型，然后使用有限的部署端数据集对其进行细化，以促进分布对齐。为了在分布偏移下提供有效性保证，该框架估计训练分布和部署分布之间的似然比，并将其集成到一种基于 STL 鲁棒性的加权共形预测方案中。在轨迹数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的框架在保持 STL 公式可解释性的同时，显著提高了部署时符号学习的可靠性。
tldr: This paper introduces a conformalized STL inference framework to handle covariate shift between training and deployment data, improving the reliability of learned temporal logic rules in dynamical systems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种保形的STL推理框架，用于处理训练和部署数据之间的协变量偏移，从而提高了动态系统中学习到的时序逻辑规则的可靠性。

title: Beyond Freshness and Semantics: A Coupon-Collector Framework for Effective Status Updates
summary: For status update systems operating over unreliable energy-constrained wireless channels, we address Weaver's long-standing Level-C question: do my packets actually improve the plant's behavior? Each fresh sample carries a stochastic expiration time -- governed by the plant's instability dynamics -- after which the information becomes useless for control. Casting the problem as a coupon-collector variant with expiring coupons, we (i) formulate a two-dimensional average-reward MDP, (ii) prove that the optimal schedule is doubly thresholded in the receiver's freshness timer and the sender's stored lifetime, (iii) derive a closed-form policy for deterministic lifetimes, and (iv) design a Structure-Aware Q-learning algorithm (SAQ) that learns the optimal policy without knowing the channel success probability or lifetime distribution. Simulations validate our theoretical predictions: SAQ matches optimal Value Iteration performance while converging significantly faster than baseline Q-learning, and expiration-aware scheduling achieves up to 50% higher reward than age-based baselines by adapting transmissions to state-dependent urgency -- thereby delivering Level-C effectiveness under tight resource constraints.
summary_zh: 针对在不可靠且能源受限的无线信道上运行的状态更新系统，我们探讨了 Weaver 长期存在的 Level-C 问题：我的数据包是否真正改善了受控对象的行为？每个新鲜样本都带有一个随机的到期时间——由受控对象的不稳定性动态决定——超过此时间，信息对控制而言将变得无用。我们将该问题建模为一种带有过期优惠券的集邮问题变体，我们 (i) 制定了一个二维平均奖励 MDP (马尔可夫决策过程)，(ii) 证明了最优调度方案是双阈值的，其阈值分别对应接收者的新鲜度计时器和发送者的存储生存期，(iii) 推导了针对确定性生存期的闭式策略，以及 (iv) 设计了一种结构感知 Q 学习算法 (SAQ)，该算法可以在不知道信道成功概率或生存期分布的情况下学习最优策略。仿真验证了我们的理论预测：SAQ 匹配了最优值迭代法的性能，同时比基线 Q 学习算法收敛速度显著更快；并且，基于到期时间的调度方案通过使传输适应于状态相关的紧急程度，比基于年龄的基线方法实现了高达 50% 的更高的奖励，从而在严格的资源约束下实现了 Level-C 的有效性。
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning approach (SAQ) for optimizing status updates in energy-constrained wireless channels, considering the expiration time of information to maximize reward in control systems. It outperforms traditional age-based methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种强化学习方法 (SAQ)，用于优化能源受限无线信道中的状态更新，考虑到信息的过期时间，以最大限度地提高控制系统中的奖励。它优于传统的基于年龄的方法。

title: Design of an In-Pipe Robot with Contact-Angle-Guided Kinematic Decoupling for Crosstalk-Suppressed Locomotion
summary: In-pipe inspection robots must traverse confined pipeline networks with elbows and three-dimensional fittings, requiring both reliable axial traction and rapid rolling reorientation for posture correction. In compact V-shaped platforms, these functions often rely on shared contacts or indirect actuation, which introduces strong kinematic coupling and makes performance sensitive to geometry and friction variations. This paper presents a V-shaped in-pipe robot with a joint-axis-and-wheel-separation layout that provides two physically independent actuation channels, with all-wheel-drive propulsion and motorized rolling reorientation while using only two motors. To make the decoupling mechanism explicit and designable, we formulate an actuation transmission matrix and identify the spherical-wheel contact angle as the key geometric variable governing the dominant roll-to-propulsion leakage and roll-channel efficiency. A geometric transmission analysis maps mounting parameters to the contact angle, leakage, and efficiency, yielding a structural guideline for suppressing crosstalk by driving the contact angle toward zero. A static stability model further provides a stability-domain map for selecting torsion-spring stiffness under friction uncertainty to ensure vertical-pipe stability with a margin. Experiments validate the decoupling effect, where during high-dynamic rolling in a vertical pipe, the propulsion torque remains nearly invariant. On a multi-material testbed including out-of-plane double elbows, the robot achieved a 100% success rate in more than 10 independent round-trip trials.
summary_zh: 管道内检测机器人必须能够穿行于包含弯头和三维管件的狭窄管道网络，这要求机器人具有可靠的轴向牵引力以及快速的滚动重新定向能力以进行姿态校正。在紧凑的V型平台中，这些功能通常依赖于共享接触点或间接驱动，这会引入强烈的运动学耦合，并使性能对几何结构和摩擦力的变化非常敏感。本文提出了一种具有关节轴和轮间距分离布局的V型管道内机器人，该布局提供两个物理上独立的驱动通道，拥有全轮驱动推进和电动滚动重新定向功能，同时仅使用两个电机。为了使解耦机制明确且可设计，我们构建了一个驱动传输矩阵，并将球面车轮接触角确定为控制主要滚动到推进泄漏和滚动通道效率的关键几何变量。几何传输分析将安装参数映射到接触角、泄漏和效率，从而为通过驱动接触角接近零来抑制串扰提供了结构指导。静态稳定性模型进一步提供了一个稳定性域图，用于选择摩擦不确定性下的扭力弹簧刚度，以确保垂直管道的稳定性并留有余量。实验验证了解耦效果，其中在垂直管道内进行高动态滚动时，推进扭矩几乎保持不变。在一个包含非平面双弯头的多材料测试平台上，该机器人在超过10次独立的往返试验中实现了100%的成功率。
tldr: This paper presents a novel in-pipe robot design with decoupled actuation channels for improved locomotion and stability in complex pipeline networks, achieving high success rates on a multi-material testbed.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新型管道机器人设计，具有解耦的驱动通道，可在复杂的管道网络中实现更好的运动和稳定性，并在多材料测试平台上实现了较高的成功率。

title: Path-Following Guidance for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle with Bounded Lateral Acceleration
summary: This paper addresses the three-dimensional path-following guidance problem for unmanned aerial vehicles under explicit actuator constraints. Unlike conventional approaches that assume unbounded control inputs or handle saturation heuristically, the proposed method incorporates bounded lateral acceleration directly into the guidance design. A nonlinear guidance framework is developed employing a nested saturation-based control technique. The proposed guidance strategy guarantees bounded control inputs while ensuring exponential convergence of cross-track errors to zero. The formulation is applicable to general smooth paths and is systematically extended from planar to three-dimensional scenarios using a path-tangent coordinate framework. Rigorous stability analysis based on Lyapunov theory establishes convergence and feasibility properties of the closed-loop system. Numerical simulations on representative paths, including straight-line, circular, and sinusoidal paths, demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior tracking performance, reduced control effort, and robustness against disturbances compared to existing guidance laws. The simplicity of the design and its compatibility with practical actuator limits make it suitable for real-world UAV applications.
summary_zh: 本文研究了无人机在存在明确执行器约束条件下的三维路径跟踪制导问题。与假设控制输入无界或通过启发式方法处理饱和的传统方法不同，本文提出的方法将有界的横向加速度直接纳入制导设计中。开发了一种基于嵌套饱和控制技术的非线性制导框架。所提出的制导策略保证了控制输入的有界性，同时确保横向跟踪误差以指数形式收敛至零。该方法适用于一般的平滑路径，并使用路径切线坐标系将其从平面场景系统地扩展到三维场景。基于李雅普诺夫理论的严格稳定性分析建立了闭环系统的收敛性和可行性。在具有代表性的路径（包括直线、圆形和正弦路径）上的数值仿真表明，与现有的制导律相比，所提出的方法具有更优越的跟踪性能、更小的控制量以及对扰动的鲁棒性。该设计的简洁性及其与实际执行器限制的兼容性使其适用于实际的无人机应用。
tldr: This paper presents a novel nonlinear path-following guidance strategy for UAVs that incorporates actuator limits directly into the design, guaranteeing stability and superior tracking performance on various paths.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的无人机非线性路径跟踪指导策略，该策略将执行器限制直接纳入设计中，保证了在各种路径上的稳定性和卓越的跟踪性能。

title: TokenDance: Token-to-Token Music-to-Dance Generation with Bidirectional Mamba
summary:
Music-to-dance generation has broad applications in virtual reality, dance education, and digital character animation. However, the limited coverage of existing 3D dance datasets confines current models to a narrow subset of music styles and choreographic patterns, resulting in poor generalization to real-world music. Consequently, generated dances often become overly simplistic and repetitive, substantially degrading expressiveness and realism.
  To tackle this problem, we present TokenDance, a two-stage music-to-dance generation framework that explicitly addresses this limitation through dual-modality tokenization and efficient token-level generation. In the first stage, we discretize both dance and music using Finite Scalar Quantization, where dance motions are factorized into upper and lower-body components with kinematic-dynamic constraints, and music is decomposed into semantic and acoustic features with dedicated codebooks to capture choreography-specific structures. In the second stage, we introduce a Local-Global-Local token-to-token generator built on a Bidirectional Mamba backbone, enabling coherent motion synthesis, strong music-dance alignment, and efficient non-autoregressive inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TokenDance achieves overall state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in both generation quality and inference speed, highlighting its effectiveness and practical value for real-world music-to-dance applications.
summary_zh:
音乐到舞蹈的生成在虚拟现实、舞蹈教育和数字角色动画中具有广泛的应用。然而，现有3D舞蹈数据集覆盖范围的局限性，将当前模型限制在狭窄的音乐风格和编舞模式子集内，导致对真实世界音乐的泛化能力较差。因此，生成的舞蹈通常变得过于简单和重复，大大降低了表现力和真实感。

为解决这个问题，我们提出了 TokenDance，一个两阶段的音乐到舞蹈生成框架，该框架通过双模态标记化和高效的标记级生成来明确解决这一局限性。在第一阶段，我们使用有限标量量化来离散化舞蹈和音乐，其中舞蹈动作被分解为具有运动学-动力学约束的上半身和下半身分量，而音乐被分解为具有专用码本的语义和声学特征，以捕获特定的编舞结构。在第二阶段，我们引入了一个基于双向Mamba主干的局部-全局-局部标记到标记生成器，从而实现了连贯的动作合成、强大的音乐-舞蹈对齐以及高效的非自回归推理。大量的实验表明，TokenDance 在生成质量和推理速度方面都实现了总体最先进（SOTA）的性能，突出了其有效性和在真实世界音乐到舞蹈应用中的实用价值。
tldr: TokenDance is a two-stage music-to-dance generation framework using bidirectional Mamba and dual-modality tokenization to achieve SOTA performance in generation quality and inference speed, addressing limitations of existing 3D dance datasets and improving realism.
tldr_zh: TokenDance是一个两阶段的音乐到舞蹈生成框架，它使用双向Mamba和双模态标记化，在生成质量和推理速度方面实现了SOTA性能，解决了现有3D舞蹈数据集的局限性，并提高了真实感。

title: Multimodal Deep Learning for Diabetic Foot Ulcer Staging Using Integrated RGB and Thermal Imaging
summary: Diabetic foot ulcers (DFU) are one of the serious complications of diabetes that can lead to amputations and high healthcare costs. Regular monitoring and early diagnosis are critical for reducing the clinical burden and the risk of amputation. The aim of this study is to investigate the impact of using multimodal images on deep learning models for the classification of DFU stages. To this end, we developed a Raspberry Pi-based portable imaging system capable of simultaneously capturing RGB and thermal images. Using this prototype, a dataset consisting of 1,205 samples was collected in a hospital setting. The dataset was labeled by experts into six distinct stages. To evaluate the models performance, we prepared three different training sets: RGB-only, thermal-only, and RGB+Thermal (with the thermal image added as a fourth channel). We trained these training sets on the DenseNet121, EfficientNetV2, InceptionV3, ResNet50, and VGG16 models. The results show that the multimodal training dataset, in which RGB and thermal data are combined across four channels, outperforms single-modal approaches. The highest performance was observed in the VGG16 model trained on the RGB+Thermal dataset. The model achieved an accuracy of 93.25%, an F1-score of 92.53%, and an MCC of 91.03%. Grad-CAM heatmap visualizations demonstrated that the thermal channel helped the model focus on the correct location by highlighting temperature anomalies in the ulcer region, while the RGB channel supported the decision-making process with complementary structural and textural information.
summary_zh: 糖尿病足溃疡(DFU)是糖尿病严重的并发症之一，可能导致截肢和高昂的医疗成本。定期监测和早期诊断对于降低临床负担和截肢风险至关重要。本研究旨在探讨使用多模态图像对深度学习模型进行DFU分期分类的影响。为此，我们开发了一种基于树莓派的便携式成像系统，能够同时捕获RGB图像和热图像。利用该原型，我们在医院环境中收集了一个包含1205个样本的数据集。该数据集由专家标记为六个不同的阶段。为了评估模型的性能，我们准备了三个不同的训练集：仅RGB、仅热图像，以及RGB+热图像（将热图像作为第四个通道添加）。我们使用DenseNet121、EfficientNetV2、InceptionV3、ResNet50和VGG16模型对这些训练集进行了训练。结果表明，在将RGB和热数据跨四个通道组合的多模态训练数据集上，模型的性能优于单模态方法。在RGB+热图像数据集上训练的VGG16模型表现出最高的性能，其准确率达到了93.25%，F1-score为92.53%，MCC为91.03%。Grad-CAM热图可视化结果表明，热图像通道通过突出溃疡区域的温度异常，帮助模型聚焦于正确的位置，而RGB通道则通过补充结构和纹理信息来支持决策过程。
tldr: This paper explores the use of multimodal (RGB and thermal) deep learning models for classifying diabetic foot ulcer stages, achieving improved performance compared to single-modal approaches using a custom Raspberry Pi-based imaging system and a dataset of 1,205 samples.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用多模态（RGB和热成像）深度学习模型对糖尿病足溃疡进行分期分类，与单模态方法相比，使用基于 Raspberry Pi 的定制成像系统和包含 1,205 个样本的数据集实现了改进的性能。

title: On-Device Super Resolution Imaging Using Low-Cost SPAD Array and Embedded Lightweight Deep Learning
summary: This work presents a lightweight super-resolution (LiteSR) neural network for depth and intensity images acquired from a consumer-grade single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) array with a 48x32 spatial resolution. The proposed framework reconstructs high-resolution (HR) images of size 256x256. Both synthetic and real datasets are used for performance evaluation. Extensive quantitative metrics demonstrate high reconstruction fidelity on synthetic datasets, while experiments on real indoor and outdoor measurements further confirm the robustness of the proposed approach. Moreover, the SPAD sensor is interfaced with an Arduino UNO Q microcontroller, which receives low-resolution (LR) depth and intensity images and feeds them into a compressed, pre-trained deep learning (DL) model, enabling real-time SR video streaming. In addition to the 256x256 setting, a range of target HR resolutions is evaluated to determine the maximum achievable upscaling resolution (512x512) with LiteSR, including scenarios with noise-corrupted LR inputs. The proposed LiteSR-embedded system co-design provides a scalable, cost-effective solution to enhance the spatial resolution of current consumer-grade SPAD arrays to meet HR imaging requirements.
summary_zh: 本工作提出了一种轻量级超分辨率（LiteSR）神经网络，用于重建从消费者级单光子雪崩二极管（SPAD）阵列（空间分辨率为48x32）获取的深度和强度图像。 提出的框架能够重建256x256大小的高分辨率（HR）图像。性能评估使用了合成数据集和真实数据集。 广泛的定量指标表明，其在合成数据集上具有高重建保真度，而对真实室内和室外测量的实验进一步证实了该方法的鲁棒性。 此外，SPAD传感器与Arduino UNO Q微控制器连接，该微控制器接收低分辨率（LR）深度和强度图像，并将其输入到压缩的、预训练的深度学习（DL）模型中，从而实现实时SR视频流。 除了256x256设置外，还评估了一系列目标HR分辨率以确定LiteSR可实现的最大上采样分辨率（512x512），包括噪声干扰的LR输入场景。 所提出的LiteSR嵌入式系统协同设计提供了一种可扩展的、经济高效的解决方案，可增强当前消费者级SPAD阵列的空间分辨率，以满足HR成像的需求。
tldr: This paper introduces a lightweight deep learning model (LiteSR) for on-device super-resolution imaging using a low-cost SPAD array, achieving real-time HR video streaming even with noise-corrupted inputs on an Arduino UNO Q.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种轻量级深度学习模型 (LiteSR)，用于使用低成本单光子雪崩二极管 (SPAD) 阵列进行片上超分辨率成像，即使在 Arduino UNO Q 上存在噪声损坏的输入，也能实现实时高清视频流。

title: Neural Approximation of Generalized Voronoi Diagrams
summary: We introduce VoroFields, a hierarchical neural-field framework for approximating generalized Voronoi diagrams of finite geometric site sets in low-dimensional domains under arbitrary evaluable point-to-site distances. Instead of constructing the diagram combinatorially, VoroFields learns a continuous, differentiable surrogate whose maximizer structure induces the partition implicitly. The Voronoi cells correspond to maximizer regions of the field, with boundaries defined by equal responses between competing sites. A hierarchical decomposition reduces the combinatorial complexity by refining only near envelope transition strata. Experiments across site families and metrics demonstrate accurate recovery of cells and boundary geometry without shape-specific constructions.
summary_zh: 我们提出了VoroFields，一个分层神经场框架，用于近似低维域内有限几何站点集合的广义沃罗诺伊图，该方法适用于任意可评估的点到站点距离。VoroFields并非通过组合构造图，而是学习一个连续、可微的替代表示，其极大值结构隐式地诱导了分区。沃罗诺伊单元对应于场的极大值区域，边界由竞争站点之间相等的响应定义。分层分解通过仅细化近包络过渡层来降低组合复杂度。针对不同站点族和度量的实验表明，该方法能够精确地恢复单元和边界几何形状，无需特定于形状的构造。
tldr: The paper introduces VoroFields, a neural-field approach for approximating generalized Voronoi diagrams, offering a continuous and differentiable alternative to combinatorial methods with demonstrated accuracy across various site families and metrics.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 VoroFields，一种使用神经场近似广义 Voron诺伊图的方法。它提供了一种连续可微的替代方案来代替组合方法，并在各种站点族和度量标准中展示了其准确性。

title: LLM-Enabled Low-Altitude UAV Natural Language Navigation via Signal Temporal Logic Specification Translation and Repair
summary: Natural language (NL) navigation for low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) offers an intelligent and convenient solution for low-altitude aerial services by enabling an intuitive interface for non-expert operators. However, deploying this capability in urban environments necessitates the precise grounding of underspecified instructions into safety-critical, dynamically feasible motion plans subject to spatiotemporal constraints. To address this challenge, we propose a unified framework that translates NL instructions into Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications and subsequently synthesizes trajectories via mixed-integer linear programming (MILP). Specifically, to generate executable STL formulas from free-form NL, we develop a reasoning-enhanced large language model (LLM) leveraging chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision and group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), which ensures high syntactic validity and semantic consistency. Furthermore, to resolve infeasibilities induced by stringent logical or spatial requirements, we introduce a specification repair mechanism. This module combines MILP-based diagnosis with LLM-guided semantic reasoning to selectively relax task constraints while strictly enforcing safety guarantees. Extensive simulations and real-world flight experiments demonstrate that the proposed closed-loop framework significantly improves NL-to-STL translation robustness, enabling safe, interpretable, and adaptable UAV navigation in complex scenarios.
summary_zh: 低空无人机自然语言（NL）导航为低空飞行服务提供了一种智能化且便捷的解决方案，它为非专业操作员提供了一个直观的界面。然而，在城市环境中部署此功能需要将未充分指定的指令精确地转化为具有时空约束的、安全攸关的、动态可行的运动规划。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一个统一的框架，该框架将 NL 指令转换为信号时序逻辑（STL）规范，随后通过混合整数线性规划（MILP）合成轨迹。具体而言，为了从自由形式的 NL 生成可执行的 STL 公式，我们开发了一种推理增强的大型语言模型（LLM），该模型利用思维链（CoT）监督和组相对策略优化（GRPO），以确保高度的句法有效性和语义一致性。此外，为了解决由严格的逻辑或空间要求引起的不可行性，我们引入了一种规范修复机制。该模块结合了基于 MILP 的诊断和 LLM 指导的语义推理，以选择性地放宽任务约束，同时严格执行安全保障。大量的仿真和真实飞行实验表明，所提出的闭环框架显著提高了 NL 到 STL 转换的鲁棒性，从而在复杂的场景中实现安全、可解释和可适应的无人机导航。
tldr: This paper presents an LLM-enabled framework for UAV navigation using natural language instructions, translating them into STL specifications, synthesizing trajectories with MILP, and repairing infeasible specifications for robust and safe navigation in complex environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个基于LLM的无人机导航框架，该框架使用自然语言指令，将其转换为STL规范，通过MILP合成轨迹，并修复不可行的规范，以在复杂环境中实现鲁棒和安全的导航。

title: LOME: Learning Human-Object Manipulation with Action-Conditioned Egocentric World Model
summary: Learning human-object manipulation presents significant challenges due to its fine-grained and contact-rich nature of the motions involved. Traditional physics-based animation requires extensive modeling and manual setup, and more importantly, it neither generalizes well across diverse object morphologies nor scales effectively to real-world environment. To address these limitations, we introduce LOME, an egocentric world model that can generate realistic human-object interactions as videos conditioned on an input image, a text prompt, and per-frame human actions, including both body poses and hand gestures. LOME injects strong and precise action guidance into object manipulation by jointly estimating spatial human actions and the environment contexts during training. After finetuning a pretrained video generative model on videos of diverse egocentric human-object interactions, LOME demonstrates not only high action-following accuracy and strong generalization to unseen scenarios, but also realistic physical consequences of hand-object interactions, e.g., liquid flowing from a bottle into a mug after executing a ``pouring'' action. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our video-based framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art image based and video-based action-conditioned methods and Image/Text-to-Video (I/T2V) generative model in terms of both temporal consistency and motion control. LOME paves the way for photorealistic AR/VR experiences and scalable robotic training, without being limited to simulated environments or relying on explicit 3D/4D modeling.
summary_zh: 学习人-物交互操作面临着巨大的挑战，因为其涉及的动作精细且与接触密切相关。传统的基于物理的动画需要大量的建模和手动设置，更重要的是，它既不能很好地推广到不同的物体形态，也不能有效地扩展到真实世界的环境。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了LOME，一个以自我为中心的世界模型，可以生成逼真的人-物交互视频，其条件为输入图像、文本提示以及每帧的人类动作，包括身体姿势和手势。LOME通过在训练期间联合估计空间人类动作和环境上下文，将强大而精确的动作指导注入到物体操作中。在基于多样化的以自我为中心的人-物交互视频对预训练的视频生成模型进行微调后，LOME不仅展示了高动作跟随精度和对未见场景的强大泛化能力，还展示了手-物交互的逼真物理结果，例如，在执行“倾倒”动作后，液体从瓶子流入杯子。大量实验表明，在时间一致性和运动控制方面，我们的基于视频的框架显著优于最先进的基于图像和视频的动作条件方法以及图像/文本到视频(I/T2V)生成模型。LOME为照片级真实感AR/VR体验和可扩展的机器人训练铺平了道路，而不受限于模拟环境或依赖于显式的3D/4D建模。
tldr: LOME introduces an egocentric world model that generates realistic human-object interaction videos conditioned on image, text, and action inputs, achieving high action-following accuracy and generalization. It outperforms existing methods and facilitates photorealistic AR/VR and robotic training.
tldr_zh: LOME 提出了一种以自我为中心的世界模型，该模型可以根据图像、文本和动作输入生成逼真的人与物体交互视频，实现了高动作跟踪准确性和泛化能力。它优于现有方法，并有助于实现逼真的 AR/VR 和机器人训练。

title: FlowRL: A Taxonomy and Modular Framework for Reinforcement Learning with Diffusion Policies
summary: Thanks to their remarkable flexibility, diffusion models and flow models have emerged as promising candidates for policy representation. However, efficient reinforcement learning (RL) upon these policies remains a challenge due to the lack of explicit log-probabilities for vanilla policy gradient estimators. While numerous attempts have been proposed to address this, the field lacks a unified perspective to reconcile these seemingly disparate methods, thus hampering ongoing development. In this paper, we bridge this gap by introducing a comprehensive taxonomy for RL algorithms with diffusion/flow policies. To support reproducibility and agile prototyping, we introduce a modular, JAX-based open-source codebase that leverages JIT-compilation for high-throughput training. Finally, we provide systematic and standardized benchmarks across Gym-Locomotion, DeepMind Control Suite, and IsaacLab, offering a rigorous side-by-side comparison of diffusion-based methods and guidance for practitioners to choose proper algorithms based on the application. Our work establishes a clear foundation for understanding and algorithm design, a high-efficiency toolkit for future research in the field, and an algorithmic guideline for practitioners in generative models and robotics. Our code is available at https://github.com/typoverflow/flow-rl.
summary_zh: 凭借其卓越的灵活性，扩散模型和流模型已成为极具潜力的策略表示候选方案。然而，由于vanilla策略梯度估计器缺乏显式对数概率，因此基于这些策略进行高效强化学习（RL）仍然是一个挑战。尽管已经提出了许多尝试来解决这个问题，但该领域缺乏一个统一的视角来调和这些看似不同的方法，从而阻碍了持续发展。在本文中，我们通过为具有扩散/流策略的RL算法引入全面的分类法来弥合这一差距。为了支持可重复性和敏捷原型设计，我们引入了一个模块化的、基于JAX的开源代码库，该代码库利用JIT编译来实现高吞吐量训练。最后，我们在Gym-Locomotion、DeepMind Control Suite和IsaacLab上提供了系统且标准化的基准测试，从而对基于扩散模型的方法进行了严格的并排比较，并为从业者根据应用选择合适的算法提供了指导。我们的工作为理解和算法设计奠定了清晰的基础，为该领域未来的研究提供了一个高效的工具包，并为生成模型和机器人技术领域的从业者提供了一个算法指南。我们的代码可在https://github.com/typoverflow/flow-rl上找到。
tldr: This paper introduces a taxonomy and modular framework (FlowRL) for reinforcement learning with diffusion policies, offering a standardized comparison, benchmarks, and an open-source codebase for practitioners and researchers.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个用于扩散策略强化学习的分类法和模块化框架 (FlowRL)，为从业者和研究人员提供了一个标准化的比较、基准测试以及一个开源代码库。

title: Heracles: Bridging Precise Tracking and Generative Synthesis for General Humanoid Control
summary: Achieving general-purpose humanoid control requires a delicate balance between the precise execution of commanded motions and the flexible, anthropomorphic adaptability needed to recover from unpredictable environmental perturbations. Current general controllers predominantly formulate motion control as a rigid reference-tracking problem. While effective in nominal conditions, these trackers often exhibit brittle, non-anthropomorphic failure modes under severe disturbances, lacking the generative adaptability inherent to human motor control. To overcome this limitation, we propose Heracles, a novel state-conditioned diffusion middleware that bridges precise motion tracking and generative synthesis. Rather than relying on rigid tracking paradigms or complex explicit mode-switching, Heracles operates as an intermediary layer between high-level reference motions and low-level physics trackers. By conditioning on the robot's real-time state, the diffusion model implicitly adapts its behavior: it approximates an identity map when the state closely aligns with the reference, preserving zero-shot tracking fidelity. Conversely, when encountering significant state deviations, it seamlessly transitions into a generative synthesizer to produce natural, anthropomorphic recovery trajectories. Our framework demonstrates that integrating generative priors into the control loop not only significantly enhances robustness against extreme perturbations but also elevates humanoid control from a rigid tracking paradigm to an open-ended, generative general-purpose architecture.
summary_zh: 实现通用人形机器人控制需要在精确执行指令性运动和灵活、拟人化的自适应性之间取得微妙的平衡，后者用于从不可预测的环境扰动中恢复。目前的通用控制器主要将运动控制构建为刚性参考跟踪问题。虽然在标称条件下有效，但这些跟踪器在严重扰动下通常表现出脆弱、非拟人化的失效模式，缺乏人类运动控制固有的生成性自适应能力。为了克服这一局限性，我们提出 Heracles，一种新型的状态条件扩散中间件，它桥接了精确的运动跟踪和生成式合成。Heracles 并非依赖于刚性跟踪范式或复杂的显式模式切换，而是充当高层参考运动和底层物理跟踪器之间的中间层。通过对机器人的实时状态进行条件化，扩散模型隐式地调整其行为：当状态与参考对齐时，它近似于一个恒等映射，从而保持零样本跟踪的保真度。相反，当遇到显著的状态偏差时，它无缝过渡到生成式合成器，以产生自然的、拟人化的恢复轨迹。我们的框架表明，将生成先验集成到控制回路中不仅显著增强了抵抗极端扰动的鲁棒性，而且还将人形机器人控制从刚性跟踪范式提升为开放式、生成式的通用架构。
tldr: The paper introduces Heracles, a diffusion-model-based middleware that enhances humanoid robot control by bridging precise motion tracking and generative synthesis, enabling robust and anthropomorphic recovery from disturbances.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Heracles，一种基于扩散模型的中间件，通过桥接精确的运动跟踪和生成合成来增强人形机器人控制，从而实现从扰动中鲁棒且拟人化的恢复。

title: ProgressVLA: Progress-Guided Diffusion Policy for Vision-Language Robotic Manipulation
summary: Most existing vision-language-action (VLA) models for robotic manipulation lack progress awareness, typically relying on hand-crafted heuristics for task termination. This limitation is particularly severe in long-horizon tasks involving cascaded sub-goals. In this work, we investigate the estimation and integration of task progress, proposing a novel model named {\textbf \vla}. Our technical contributions are twofold: (1) \emph{robust progress estimation}: We pre-train a progress estimator on large-scale, unsupervised video-text robotic datasets. This estimator achieves a low prediction residual (0.07 on a scale of $[0, 1]$) in simulation and demonstrates zero-shot generalization to unseen real-world samples, and (2) \emph{differentiable progress guidance}: We introduce an inverse dynamics world model that maps predicted action tokens into future latent visual states. These latents are then processed by the progress estimator; by applying a maximal progress regularization, we establish a differentiable pipeline that provides progress-piloted guidance to refine action tokens. Extensive experiments on the CALVIN and LIBERO benchmarks, alongside real-world robot deployment, consistently demonstrate substantial improvements in success rates and generalization over strong baselines.
summary_zh: 针对机器人操作的大多数现有视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型缺乏对进度的感知，通常依赖于手工设计的启发式方法进行任务终止。这种局限性在涉及级联子目标的长期任务中尤为严重。在这项工作中，我们研究了任务进度的估计和集成，并提出了一种名为 {\textbf \vla} 的新型模型。我们的技术贡献体现在两个方面：（1）\emph{鲁棒的进度估计}：我们通过大规模、无监督的视频-文本机器人数据集预训练一个进度估计器。该估计器在模拟中实现了较低的预测残差（在 $[0, 1]$ 范围内为 0.07），并展示了对未见真实世界样本的零样本泛化能力；（2）\emph{可微的进度引导}：我们引入了一个逆动力学世界模型，该模型将预测的动作标记映射到未来的潜在视觉状态。这些潜在状态随后由进度估计器处理；通过应用最大进度正则化，我们建立了一个可微的管道，该管道提供进度引导以改进动作标记。在CALVIN和LIBERO基准测试以及真实世界机器人部署上的大量实验，始终表明我们相对于强大的基线在成功率和泛化方面取得了显著的提升。
tldr: This paper introduces ProgressVLA, a vision-language-action model that incorporates task progress estimation and differentiable progress guidance using an inverse dynamics world model, showing improved performance on robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出ProgressVLA，一个视觉-语言-动作模型，它结合了任务进度估计和可微的进度引导，使用逆动力学世界模型，在机器人操作任务中表现出更好的性能。

title: Structured Observation Language for Efficient and Generalizable Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to navigate complex environments by following natural language instructions, which typically demands tight fusion of visual and language modalities. Existing VLN methods often convert raw images into visual tokens or implicit features, requiring large-scale visual pre-training and suffering from poor generalization under environmental variations (e.g., lighting, texture). To address these issues, we propose SOL-Nav (Structured Observation Language for Navigation), a novel framework that translates egocentric visual observations into compact structured language descriptions for efficient and generalizable navigation. Specifically, we divide RGB-D images into a N*N grid, extract representative semantic, color, and depth information for each grid cell to form structured text, and concatenate this with the language instruction as pure language input to a pre-trained language model (PLM). Experimental results on standard VLN benchmarks (R2R, RxR) and real-world deployments demonstrate that SOL-Nav significantly reduces the model size and training data dependency, fully leverages the reasoning and representation capabilities of PLMs, and achieves strong generalization to unseen environments.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求智能体在复杂环境中遵循自然语言指令进行导航，这通常需要对视觉和语言模态进行紧密融合。现有的VLN方法通常将原始图像转换为视觉标记或隐式特征，这需要大规模的视觉预训练，并且在环境变化（例如，光照、纹理）下泛化性较差。为了解决这些问题，我们提出SOL-Nav（用于导航的结构化观察语言），这是一个新颖的框架，可以将以自我为中心的视觉观察转化为紧凑的结构化语言描述，从而实现高效且可泛化的导航。具体来说，我们将RGB-D图像划分为N*N网格，提取每个网格单元的代表性语义、颜色和深度信息，形成结构化文本，并将其与语言指令连接起来，作为纯语言输入到预训练语言模型（PLM）。在标准VLN基准测试（R2R、RxR）和真实世界部署上的实验结果表明，SOL-Nav显著降低了模型大小和对训练数据的依赖性，充分利用了PLM的推理和表示能力，并且在未见环境中实现了强大的泛化能力。
tldr: The paper introduces SOL-Nav, a VLN framework that converts visual observations into structured language descriptions for more efficient and generalizable navigation by leveraging pre-trained language models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SOL-Nav，一种视觉-语言导航框架，它将视觉观测转化为结构化语言描述，通过利用预训练语言模型来实现更高效和更具泛化性的导航。

title: Agent-Driven Autonomous Reinforcement Learning Research: Iterative Policy Improvement for Quadruped Locomotion
summary: This paper documents a case study in agent-driven autonomous reinforcement learning research for quadruped locomotion. The setting was not a fully self-starting research system.
