tldr: This paper presents a Kalman filter-based framework for AUV navigation, focusing on improving localization accuracy, trajectory prediction, and search-and-recovery during communication loss by fusing acoustic data from multiple buoys.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于卡尔曼滤波的AUV导航框架，重点是通过融合来自多个浮标的声学数据来提高定位精度、轨迹预测和通信丢失期间的搜索和恢复能力。

title: Online Inertia Tensor Identification for Non-Cooperative Spacecraft via Augmented UKF
summary: Autonomous proximity operations, such as active debris removal and on-orbit servicing, require high-fidelity relative navigation solutions that remain robust in the presence of parametric uncertainty. Standard estimation frameworks typically assume that the target spacecraft's mass properties are known a priori; however, for non-cooperative or tumbling targets, these parameters are often unknown or uncertain, leading to rapid divergence in model-based propagators. This paper presents an augmented Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) framework designed to jointly estimate the relative 6-DOF pose and the full inertia tensor of a non-cooperative target spacecraft. The proposed architecture fuses visual measurements from monocular vision-based Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with depth information from LiDAR to constrain the coupled rigid-body dynamics. By augmenting the state vector to include the six independent elements of the inertia tensor, the filter dynamically recovers the target's normalized mass distribution in real-time without requiring ground-based pre-calibration. To ensure numerical stability and physical consistency during the estimation of constant parameters, the filter employs an adaptive process noise formulation that prevents covariance collapse while allowing for the gradual convergence of the inertial parameters. Numerical validation is performed via Monte Carlo simulations, demonstrating that the proposed Augmented UKF enables the simultaneous convergence of kinematic states and inertial parameters, thereby facilitating accurate long-term trajectory prediction and robust guidance in non-cooperative deep-space environments.
summary_zh: 自主接近操作，例如主动碎片清除和在轨服务，需要高保真度的相对导航解决方案，且这些方案能在参数不确定性的影响下保持稳健性。标准估计框架通常假设目标航天器的质量属性是先验已知的；然而，对于非合作或翻滚的目标，这些参数通常未知或不确定，导致基于模型的传播器快速发散。本文提出了一种增强型无迹卡尔曼滤波器 (UKF) 框架，旨在联合估计非合作目标航天器的相对 6-DOF 姿态和完整惯性张量。所提出的架构融合了来自基于单目视觉卷积神经网络 (CNN) 的视觉测量数据与来自激光雷达的深度信息，以约束耦合刚体动力学。通过扩展状态向量，使其包括惯性张量的六个独立元素，该滤波器可动态实时地恢复目标的归一化质量分布，而无需进行地面预校准。为了确保常数参数估计过程中的数值稳定性和物理一致性，该滤波器采用了一种自适应过程噪声公式，该公式可防止协方差崩溃，同时允许惯性参数逐步收敛。通过蒙特卡罗仿真进行了数值验证，结果表明，所提出的增强型 UKF 能够实现运动学状态和惯性参数的同时收敛，从而促进非合作深空环境中准确的长期轨迹预测和稳健的制导。
tldr: This paper presents an augmented Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) that jointly estimates the 6-DOF pose and inertia tensor of non-cooperative spacecraft using visual measurements and LiDAR data for robust navigation in scenarios with uncertain target mass properties.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种增强型无迹卡尔曼滤波器（UKF），它结合视觉测量和激光雷达数据，联合估计非合作航天器的六自由度姿态和惯性张量，从而在目标质量属性不确定的情况下实现鲁棒导航。

title: GIFT: Bootstrapping Image-to-CAD Program Synthesis via Geometric Feedback
summary: Generating executable CAD programs from images requires alignment between visual geometry and symbolic program representations, a capability that current methods fail to learn reliably as design complexity increases. Existing fine-tuning approaches rely on either limited supervised datasets or expensive post-training pipelines, resulting in brittle systems that restrict progress in generative CAD design. We argue that the primary bottleneck lies not in model or algorithmic capacity, but in the scarcity of diverse training examples that align visual geometry with program syntax. This limitation is especially acute because the collection of diverse and verified engineering datasets is both expensive and difficult to scale, constraining the development of robust generative CAD models. We introduce Geometric Inference Feedback Tuning (GIFT), a data augmentation framework that leverages geometric feedback to turn test-time compute into a bootstrapped set of high-quality training samples. GIFT combines two mechanisms: Soft-Rejection Sampling (GIFT-REJECT), which retains diverse high-fidelity programs beyond exact ground-truth matches, and Failure-Driven Augmentation (GIFT-FAIL), which converts near-miss predictions into synthetic training examples that improve robustness on challenging geometries. By amortizing inference-time search into the model parameters, GIFT captures the benefits of test-time scaling while reducing inference compute by 80%. It improves mean IoU by 12% over a strong supervised baseline and remains competitive with more complex multimodal systems, without requiring additional human annotation or specialized architectures.
summary_zh: 从图像生成可执行的CAD程序需要在视觉几何形状和符号程序表示之间进行对齐，而随着设计复杂性的增加，当前方法无法可靠地学习这种能力。现有的微调方法依赖于有限的监督数据集或代价高昂的后训练流程，导致系统脆弱，限制了生成式CAD设计的进展。我们认为，主要的瓶颈不在于模型或算法能力，而在于缺乏将视觉几何形状与程序语法对齐的多样化训练示例。这种局限性尤其突出，因为收集多样化且经过验证的工程数据集既昂贵又难以扩展，从而限制了鲁棒生成式CAD模型的开发。我们提出了一种几何推理反馈调优(GIFT)的数据增强框架，该框架利用几何反馈将测试时的计算转化为一组高质量的自举训练样本。GIFT结合了两种机制：软拒绝抽样(GIFT-REJECT)，该机制保留了超出精确真实匹配的多样化高保真程序；以及失败驱动增强(GIFT-FAIL)，该机制将近似命中的预测转换为合成训练示例，从而提高对具有挑战性几何形状的鲁棒性。通过将推理时搜索摊销到模型参数中，GIFT在将推理计算减少80%的同时，捕捉了测试时缩放的优势。它比强大的监督基线提高了12%的平均IoU，并且在不需要额外的人工标注或专用架构的情况下，仍然与更复杂的多模态系统具有竞争力。
tldr: The paper introduces GIFT, a data augmentation framework that uses geometric feedback to bootstrap high-quality training samples for image-to-CAD program synthesis, achieving improved performance and reduced inference compute.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为GIFT的数据增强框架，它利用几何反馈来引导图像到CAD程序合成的高质量训练样本，从而提高性能并减少推理计算。

title: RHO: Robust Holistic OSM-Based Metric Cross-View Geo-Localization
summary: Metric Cross-View Geo-Localization (MCVGL) aims to estimate the 3-DoF camera pose (position and heading) by matching ground and satellite images. In this work, instead of pinhole and satellite images, we study robust MCVGL using holistic panoramas and OpenStreetMap (OSM). To this end, we establish a large-scale MCVGL benchmark dataset, CV-RHO, with over 2.7M images under different weather and lighting conditions, as well as sensor noise. Furthermore, we propose a model termed RHO with a two-branch Pin-Pan architecture for accurate visual localization. A Split-Undistort-Merge (SUM) module is introduced to address the panoramic distortion, and a Position-Orientation Fusion (POF) mechanism is designed to enhance the localization accuracy. Extensive experiments prove the value of our CV-RHO dataset and the effectiveness of the RHO model, with a significant performance gain up to 20% compared with the state-of-the-art baselines. Project page: https://github.com/InSAI-Lab/RHO.
summary_zh: 公制跨视角地理定位 (MCVGL) 旨在通过匹配地面图像和卫星图像来估计三自由度 (3-DoF) 相机姿态（位置和朝向）。在这项工作中，我们使用整体全景图和 OpenStreetMap (OSM) 研究了鲁棒的 MCVGL，而不是针孔相机图像和卫星图像。为此，我们建立了一个大规模的 MCVGL 基准数据集 CV-RHO，其中包含超过 270 万张在不同天气、光照条件以及传感器噪声下的图像。此外，我们提出了一种名为 RHO 的模型，该模型具有双分支 Pin-Pan 架构，用于实现精确的视觉定位。引入了一种分割-去畸变-合并 (SUM) 模块来解决全景畸变问题，并设计了一种位置-方向融合 (POF) 机制来提高定位精度。大量的实验证明了我们的 CV-RHO 数据集的价值和 RHO 模型的有效性，与最先进的基线相比，性能提升高达 20%。项目页面：https://github.com/InSAI-Lab/RHO。
tldr: The paper introduces a new benchmark dataset (CV-RHO) and a novel model (RHO) for metric cross-view geo-localization using panoramic images and OpenStreetMap data, achieving significant performance gains.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个新的基准数据集(CV-RHO)和一个新的模型(RHO)，用于使用全景图像和OpenStreetMap数据的度量跨视图地理定位，并取得了显著的性能提升。

title: MV-RoMa: From Pairwise Matching into Multi-View Track Reconstruction
summary: Establishing consistent correspondences across images is essential for 3D vision tasks such as structure-from-motion (SfM), yet most existing matchers operate in a pairwise manner, often producing fragmented and geometrically inconsistent tracks when their predictions are chained across views. We propose MV-RoMa, a multi-view dense matching model that jointly estimates dense correspondences from a source image to multiple co-visible targets. Specifically, we design an efficient model architecture which avoids high computational cost of full cross-attention for multi-view feature interaction: (i) multi-view encoder that leverages pair-wise matching results as a geometric prior, and (ii) multi-view matching refiner that refines correspondences using pixel-wise attention. Additionally, we propose a post-processing strategy that integrates our model's consistent multi-view correspondences as high-quality tracks for SfM. Across diverse and challenging benchmarks, MV-RoMa produces more reliable correspondences and substantially denser, more accurate 3D reconstructions than existing sparse and dense matching methods. Project page: https://icetea-cv.github.io/mv-roma/.
summary_zh: 在图像间建立一致的对应关系是如运动恢复结构(SfM)等3D视觉任务的关键，然而，大多数现有的匹配器以成对的方式运行，当它们的预测在视图间链接时，通常会产生碎片化且几何不一致的轨迹。我们提出了MV-RoMa，一个多视图密集匹配模型，它联合估计从源图像到多个共视目标图像的密集对应关系。具体来说，我们设计了一个高效的模型架构，避免了多视图特征交互中完全交叉注意的高计算成本：(i) 多视图编码器，它利用成对匹配结果作为几何先验，以及 (ii) 多视图匹配精炼器，它使用像素级注意力来精炼对应关系。此外，我们提出了一种后处理策略，将我们模型一致的多视图对应关系整合为高质量的SfM轨迹。在各种具有挑战性的基准测试中，MV-RoMa产生了比现有稀疏和密集匹配方法更可靠的对应关系，并显著提高了3D重建的密度和精度。项目主页：https://icetea-cv.github.io/mv-roma/.
tldr: The paper introduces MV-RoMa, a multi-view dense matching model that leverages pairwise matching results as geometric priors to estimate consistent correspondences across multiple images, leading to denser and more accurate 3D reconstructions for SfM.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为MV-RoMa的多视图密集匹配模型，该模型利用成对匹配结果作为几何先验，估计多个图像之间的一致对应关系，从而为SfM提供更密集、更准确的3D重建。

title: BLOSSOM: Block-wise Federated Learning Over Shared and Sparse Observed Modalities
summary: Multimodal federated learning (FL) is essential for real-world applications such as autonomous systems and healthcare, where data is distributed across heterogeneous clients with varying and often missing modalities. However, most existing FL approaches assume uniform modality availability, limiting their applicability in practice. We introduce BLOSSOM, a task-agnostic framework for multimodal FL designed to operate under shared and sparsely observed modality conditions. BLOSSOM supports clients with arbitrary modality subsets and enables flexible sharing of model components. To address client and task heterogeneity, we propose a block-wise aggregation strategy that selectively aggregates shared components while keeping task-specific blocks private, enabling partial personalization. We evaluate BLOSSOM on multiple diverse multimodal datasets and analyse the effects of missing modalities and personalization. Our results show that block-wise personalization significantly improves performance, particularly in settings with severe modality sparsity. In modality-incomplete scenarios, BLOSSOM achieves an average performance gain of 18.7% over full-model aggregation, while in modality-exclusive settings the gain increases to 37.7%, highlighting the importance of block-wise learning for practical multimodal FL systems.
summary_zh: 多模态联邦学习 (FL) 对于自动驾驶系统和医疗保健等实际应用至关重要，在这些应用中，数据分布在具有变化且经常缺失模态的异构客户端上。然而，大多数现有的 FL 方法都假设模态可用性一致，限制了它们在实践中的适用性。我们引入了 BLOSSOM，这是一个任务无关的多模态 FL 框架，旨在在共享的和稀疏观察到的模态条件下运行。BLOSSOM 支持具有任意模态子集的客户端，并支持模型组件的灵活共享。为了解决客户端和任务异质性，我们提出了一种分块聚合策略，该策略选择性地聚合共享组件，同时保持特定于任务的块私有，从而实现部分个性化。我们在多个不同的多模态数据集上评估了 BLOSSOM，并分析了缺失模态和个性化的影响。我们的结果表明，分块个性化显著提高了性能，尤其是在模态稀疏性严重的环境中。在模态不完整的情况下，BLOSSOM 相比于全模型聚合实现了平均 18.7% 的性能提升，而在模态互斥的情况下，性能提升增加到 37.7%，突出了分块学习对于实际多模态FL系统的重要性。
tldr: The paper introduces BLOSSOM, a multimodal federated learning framework designed to handle missing modalities and client heterogeneity by using block-wise aggregation for personalized learning, showing significant performance improvements in modality-incomplete and modality-exclusive scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为BLOSSOM的多模态联邦学习框架，旨在通过分块聚合进行个性化学习，以处理缺失模态和客户端异构性，并在模态不完整和模态排他场景中显示出显著的性能提升。

title: Interpretable Physics Extraction from Data for Linear Dynamical Systems using Lie Generator Networks
summary: When the system is linear, why should learning be nonlinear? Linear dynamical systems, the analytical backbone of control theory, signal processing and circuit analysis, have exact closed-form solutions via the state transition matrix. Yet when system parameters must be inferred from data, recent neural approaches offer flexibility at the cost of physical guarantees: Neural ODEs provide flexible trajectory approximation but may violate physical invariants, while energy preserving architectures do not natively represent dissipation essential to real-world systems. We introduce Lie Generator Networks (LGN), which learn a structured generator A and compute trajectories directly via matrix exponentiation. This shift from integration to exponentiation preserves structure by construction. By parameterizing A = S - D (skew-symmetric minus positive diagonal), stability and dissipation emerge from the underlying architecture and are not introduced during training via the loss function. LGN provides a unified framework for linear conservative, dissipative, and time-varying systems. On a 100-dimensional stable RLC ladder, standard derivative-based least-squares system identification can yield unstable eigenvalues. The unconstrained LGN yields stable but physically incorrect spectra, whereas LGN-SD recovers all 100 eigenvalues with over two orders of magnitude lower mean eigenvalue error than unconstrained alternatives. Critically, these eigenvalues reveal poles, natural frequencies, and damping ratios which are interpretable physics that black-box networks do not provide.
summary_zh: 当系统是线性的时候，为什么学习要是非线性的？线性动力系统是控制理论、信号处理和电路分析的分析支柱，拥有通过状态转移矩阵得到的精确闭式解。然而，当系统参数必须从数据中推断时，最近的神经方法以牺牲物理保证为代价提供了灵活性：神经常微分方程（Neural ODEs）提供了灵活的轨迹近似，但可能违反物理不变量，而能量守恒架构本身并不代表真实世界系统中必不可少的耗散。我们引入了李生成器网络（LGN），它学习一个结构化的生成器A，并直接通过矩阵指数计算轨迹。这种从积分到指数的转变，通过构造保留了结构。通过参数化A = S - D (斜对称减去正对角)，稳定性和耗散从底层架构中产生，而不是在训练期间通过损失函数引入。LGN为线性保守、耗散和时变系统提供了一个统一的框架。在一个100维度的稳定RLC梯形网络上，标准的基于导数的最小二乘系统辨识可能会产生不稳定的特征值。非约束的LGN产生稳定的但物理上不正确的频谱，而LGN-SD恢复所有100个特征值，其平均特征值误差比非约束替代方案低两个数量级以上。至关重要的是，这些特征值揭示了极点、固有频率和阻尼比，这些是可解释的物理量，而黑盒网络无法提供。
tldr: The paper introduces Lie Generator Networks (LGN) for interpretable physics extraction in linear dynamical systems, ensuring stability and dissipation by construction using structured generators and matrix exponentiation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了李生成器网络（LGN），用于线性动力系统中可解释的物理提取，通过使用结构化生成器和矩阵指数运算，从根本上确保了稳定性和耗散性。

title: A Novel Immune Algorithm for Multiparty Multiobjective Optimization
summary: Traditional multiobjective optimization problems (MOPs) are insufficiently equipped for scenarios involving multiple decision makers (DMs), which are prevalent in many practical applications. These scenarios are categorized as multiparty multiobjective optimization problems (MPMOPs). For MPMOPs, the goal is to find a solution set that is as close to the Pareto front of each DM as much as possible. This poses challenges for evolutionary algorithms in terms of searching and selecting. To better solve MPMOPs, this paper proposes a novel approach called the multiparty immune algorithm (MPIA). The MPIA incorporates an inter-party guided crossover strategy based on the individual's non-dominated sorting ranks from different DM perspectives and an adaptive activation strategy based on the proposed multiparty cover metric (MCM). These strategies enable MPIA to activate suitable individuals for the next operations, maintain population diversity from different DM perspectives, and enhance the algorithm's search capability. To evaluate the performance of MPIA, we compare it with ordinary multiobjective evolutionary algorithms (MOEAs) and state-of-the-art multiparty multiobjective optimization evolutionary algorithms (MPMOEAs) by solving synthetic multiparty multiobjective problems and real-world biparty multiobjective unmanned aerial vehicle path planning (BPUAV-PP) problems involving multiple DMs. Experimental results demonstrate that MPIA outperforms other algorithms.
summary_zh: 传统多目标优化问题（MOPs）不足以应对涉及多个决策者（DMs）的场景，而这些场景在许多实际应用中普遍存在。这些场景被归类为多方多目标优化问题（MPMOPs）。对于MPMOPs，目标是找到一个尽可能接近每个DM的帕累托前沿的解集。这给进化算法在搜索和选择方面带来了挑战。为了更好地解决MPMOPs，本文提出了一种新的方法，称为多方免疫算法（MPIA）。MPIA结合了一种基于个体在不同DM视角下的非支配排序等级的跨方引导交叉策略，以及一种基于提出的多方覆盖度量（MCM）的自适应激活策略。这些策略使得MPIA能够激活适合进行后续操作的个体，维持种群在不同DM视角下的多样性，并增强算法的搜索能力。为了评估MPIA的性能，我们通过求解合成多方多目标问题和涉及多个DM的真实双边多目标无人机路径规划（BPUAV-PP）问题，将其与普通多目标进化算法（MOEAs）和最先进的多方多目标进化优化算法（MPMOEAs）进行了比较。实验结果表明，MPIA优于其他算法。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel multiparty immune algorithm (MPIA) for solving multiparty multiobjective optimization problems (MPMOPs), demonstrating its effectiveness in synthetic and real-world UAV path planning through experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新的多方免疫算法 (MPIA)，用于解决多方多目标优化问题 (MPMOPs)，并通过实验证明了其在合成和实际无人机路径规划中的有效性。

title: LiDAR for Crowd Management: Applications, Benefits, and Future Directions
summary: Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) technology offers significant advantages for effective crowd management. This article presents LiDAR technology and highlights its primary advantages over other monitoring technologies, including enhanced privacy, performance in various weather conditions, and precise 3D mapping. We present a general taxonomy of four key tasks in crowd management: crowd detection, counting, tracking, and behavior classification, with illustrative examples of LiDAR applications for each task. We identify challenges and open research directions, including the scarcity of dedicated datasets, sensor fusion requirements, artificial intelligence integration, and processing needs for LiDAR point clouds. This article offers actionable insights for developing crowd management solutions tailored to public safety applications.
summary_zh: 激光雷达（LiDAR）技术为有效的人群管理提供了显著优势。本文介绍了激光雷达技术，并强调了其相对于其他监测技术的主要优点，包括增强的隐私保护、在各种天气条件下的性能表现以及精确的3D绘图。我们提出了人群管理中四个关键任务的通用分类法：人群检测、计数、跟踪和行为分类，并提供了每个任务中激光雷达应用示例。我们指出了挑战和开放的研究方向，包括专用数据集的稀缺性、传感器融合需求、人工智能集成以及激光雷达点云的处理需求。本文为开发针对公共安全应用量身定制的人群管理解决方案提供了可操作的见解。
tldr: This paper reviews the use of LiDAR technology for crowd management, highlighting its advantages, applications, and future research directions. It covers crowd detection, counting, tracking, and behavior classification using LiDAR.
tldr_zh: 本文综述了激光雷达技术在人群管理中的应用，重点介绍了其优势、应用和未来研究方向。它涵盖了使用激光雷达进行人群检测、计数、跟踪和行为分类。

title: Secure Reinforcement Learning: On Model-Free Detection of Man in the Middle Attacks
summary: We consider the problem of learning-based man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacks in cyber-physical systems (CPS), and extend our previously proposed Bellman Deviation Detection (BDD) framework for model-free reinforcement learning (RL). We refine the standard MDP attack model by allowing the reward function to depend on both the current and subsequent states, thereby capturing reward variations induced by errors in the adversary's transition estimate. We also derive an optimal system-identification strategy for the adversary that minimizes detectable value deviations. Further, we prove that the agent's asymptotic learning time required to secure the system scales linearly with the adversary's learning time, and that this matches the optimal lower bound. Hence, the proposed detection scheme is order-optimal in detection efficiency. Finally, we extend the framework to asynchronous and intermittent attack scenarios, where reliable detection is preserved.
summary_zh: 我们考虑在信息物理系统(CPS)中基于学习的中间人(MITM)攻击问题，并扩展了我们先前提出的用于无模型强化学习(RL)的贝尔曼偏差检测(BDD)框架。我们改进了标准MDP攻击模型，允许奖励函数依赖于当前和后续状态，从而捕捉由对手转换估计中的误差引起的奖励变化。我们还为对手推导了一种最优的系统辨识策略，该策略可以最小化可检测的值偏差。此外，我们证明了代理保护系统所需的渐近学习时间与对手的学习时间呈线性关系，并且这与最优下界相匹配。因此，所提出的检测方案在检测效率方面是阶最优的。最后，我们将该框架扩展到异步和间歇性攻击场景，并保持可靠的检测能力。
tldr: This paper proposes a model-free Bellman Deviation Detection (BDD) framework for secure reinforcement learning in cyber-physical systems vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks, with claims of order-optimal detection efficiency and resilience to asynchronous/intermittent attacks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种模型无关的贝尔曼偏差检测（BDD）框架，用于保护易受中间人攻击的网络物理系统中强化学习的安全性，声称具有次序最优的检测效率以及对异步/间歇性攻击的弹性。

title: FocusVLA: Focused Visual Utilization for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models improve action generation by conditioning policies on rich vision-language information. However, current auto-regressive policies are constrained by three bottlenecks: (1) architectural bias drives models to overlook visual details, (2) an excessive number of visual tokens makes attention difficult to focus on the correct regions, and (3) task-irrelevant visual information introduces substantial noise - together severely impairing the quality of action. In this paper, we investigate how to effectively utilize different visual representations for action generation. To this end, we first empirically validate the above issues and show that VLA performance is primarily limited by how visual information is utilized, rather than by the quality of visual representations. Based on these insights, we introduce FocusVLA, a novel paradigm that directs the model's attention to task-relevant visual regions to effectively bridge vision to action. Specifically, we first propose Modality Cascaded Attention to eliminate shortcut pathways, thereby compelling VLA models to rely on task-relevant visual details for action generation. Furthermore, we propose Focus Attention, which dynamically selects task-relevant visual patches to control information quantity while explicitly modulating their influence to suppress task-irrelevant noise. Extensive experiments on both simulated and real-world robotic benchmarks demonstrate that FocusVLA not only effectively leverages visual details to perform dexterous manipulations, but also substantially improves performance and accelerates convergence across a variety of tasks.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型通过将策略建立在丰富的视觉-语言信息之上来改进动作生成。然而，当前自回归策略受限于三个瓶颈：（1）架构偏见驱动模型忽略视觉细节，（2）过多的视觉标记使得注意力难以聚焦到正确的区域，以及（3）与任务无关的视觉信息引入了大量的噪声——这些共同严重损害了动作的质量。在本文中，我们研究如何有效地利用不同的视觉表征进行动作生成。为此，我们首先通过实验验证了上述问题，并表明 VLA 性能主要受视觉信息利用方式的限制，而不是受视觉表征质量的限制。基于这些见解，我们引入了 FocusVLA，这是一种新颖的范例，它将模型的注意力导向与任务相关的视觉区域，从而有效地桥接视觉与动作。具体而言，我们首先提出模态级联注意力 (Modality Cascaded Attention) 以消除捷径路径，从而迫使 VLA 模型依赖于与任务相关的视觉细节进行动作生成。此外，我们提出了焦点注意力 (Focus Attention)，它动态地选择与任务相关的视觉块来控制信息量，同时显式地调节它们的影响以抑制与任务无关的噪声。在模拟和现实世界机器人基准测试上的大量实验表明，FocusVLA 不仅有效地利用视觉细节来执行灵巧操作，而且还显著提高了性能并加速了各种任务的收敛。
tldr: The paper introduces FocusVLA, a novel approach to improve Vision-Language-Action models by focusing attention on task-relevant visual regions using Modality Cascaded Attention and Focus Attention, significantly enhancing performance and convergence speed in robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了FocusVLA，一种通过使用模态级联注意力和焦点注意力将注意力集中于任务相关的视觉区域来改进视觉-语言-动作模型的新方法，从而显着提高了机器人操控任务的性能和收敛速度。

title: SOLE-R1: Video-Language Reasoning as the Sole Reward for On-Robot Reinforcement Learning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown impressive capabilities across diverse tasks, motivating efforts to leverage these models to supervise robot learning. However, when used as evaluators in reinforcement learning (RL), today's strongest models often fail under partial observability and distribution shift, enabling policies to exploit perceptual errors rather than solve the task. To address this limitation, we introduce SOLE-R1 (Self-Observing LEarner), a video-language reasoning model explicitly designed to serve as the sole reward signal for online RL. Given only raw video observations and a natural-language goal, SOLE-R1 performs per-timestep spatiotemporal chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and produces dense estimates of task progress that can be used directly as rewards. To train SOLE-R1, we develop a large-scale video trajectory and reasoning synthesis pipeline that generates temporally grounded CoT traces aligned with continuous progress supervision. This data is combined with foundational spatial and multi-frame temporal reasoning, and used to train the model with a hybrid framework that couples supervised fine-tuning with RL from verifiable rewards. Across four different simulation environments and a real-robot setting, SOLE-R1 enables zero-shot online RL from random initialization: robots learn previously unseen manipulation tasks without ground-truth rewards, success indicators, demonstrations, or task-specific tuning. SOLE-R1 succeeds on 24 unseen tasks and substantially outperforms strong vision-language rewarders, including GPT-5 and Gemini-3-Pro, while exhibiting markedly greater robustness to reward hacking.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在各种任务中展现出了令人印象深刻的能力，这推动了人们利用这些模型来监督机器人学习。然而，当作为强化学习（RL）中的评估器使用时，当前最强大的模型在部分可观察性和分布偏移的情况下经常失效，使得策略能够利用感知错误而不是解决任务。为了解决这个局限性，我们引入了SOLE-R1 (自观察学习者)，这是一个专门设计作为在线RL的唯一奖励信号的视频-语言推理模型。仅仅给定原始视频观察和自然语言目标，SOLE-R1执行逐时间步的时空思维链（CoT）推理，并生成任务进度的密集估计，这些估计可以直接用作奖励。为了训练SOLE-R1，我们开发了一个大规模的视频轨迹和推理合成 pipeline，它生成与连续进度监督对齐的时间上接地的CoT轨迹。该数据与基础的空间和多帧时间推理相结合，并用于以一种混合框架训练该模型，该框架将有监督的微调与来自可验证奖励的RL相结合。在四个不同的仿真环境和一个真实机器人环境中，SOLE-R1实现了从随机初始化的零样本在线RL：机器人无需真实奖励、成功指标、演示或特定于任务的调整，即可学习以前未见过的操作任务。SOLE-R1在24个未见过的任务上成功，并显著优于强大的视觉-语言奖励器，包括GPT-5和Gemini-3-Pro，同时表现出对奖励攻击的明显更大的鲁棒性。
tldr: The paper introduces SOLE-R1, a video-language reasoning model designed to serve as the sole reward signal for on-robot reinforcement learning, enabling robots to learn unseen manipulation tasks zero-shot from raw video and language goals, outperforming other VLMs like GPT-5 and Gemini-3-Pro.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SOLE-R1，一个视频-语言推理模型，旨在作为机器人强化学习的唯一奖励信号，使机器人能够在零样本条件下从原始视频和语言目标中学习未见过的操作任务，并且性能优于其他视觉-语言模型，如GPT-5和Gemini-3-Pro。

title: DRIVE-Nav: Directional Reasoning, Inspection, and Verification for Efficient Open-Vocabulary Navigation
summary: Open-Vocabulary Object Navigation (OVON) requires an embodied agent to locate a language-specified target in unknown environments. Existing zero-shot methods often reason over dense frontier points under incomplete observations, causing unstable route selection, repeated revisits, and unnecessary action overhead. We present DRIVE-Nav, a structured framework that organizes exploration around persistent directions rather than raw frontiers. By inspecting encountered directions more completely and restricting subsequent decisions to still-relevant directions within a forward 240 degree view range, DRIVE-Nav reduces redundant revisits and improves path efficiency. The framework extracts and tracks directional candidates from weighted Fast Marching Method (FMM) paths, maintains representative views for semantic inspection, and combines vision-language-guided prompt enrichment with cross-frame verification to improve grounding reliability. Experiments on HM3D-OVON, HM3Dv2, and MP3D demonstrate strong overall performance and consistent efficiency gains. On HM3D-OVON, DRIVE-Nav achieves 50.2% SR and 32.6% SPL, improving the previous best method by 1.9% SR and 5.6% SPL. It also delivers the best SPL on HM3Dv2 and MP3D and transfers to a physical humanoid robot. Real-world deployment also demonstrates its effectiveness. Project page: https://coolmaoguo.github.io/drive-nav-page/
summary_zh: 开放词汇目标导航(OVON)要求具身智能体在未知环境中定位语言指定的导航目标。现有的零样本方法通常在不完全观测下对密集的前沿点进行推理，导致不稳定的路径选择，重复的重访和不必要的动作开销。我们提出了DRIVE-Nav，一个结构化框架，围绕持久方向而非原始前沿组织探索过程。通过更完整地检查遇到的方向，并将后续决策限制在前进240度视角范围内仍然相关的方向上，DRIVE-Nav减少了冗余的重访并提高了路径效率。该框架从加权快速行进法(FMM)路径中提取并跟踪方向候选，维护代表性视图用于语义检查，并将视觉-语言引导的提示增强与跨帧验证相结合，以提高 grounding 的可靠性。在HM3D-OVON、HM3Dv2和MP3D上的实验表明了强大的总体性能和持续的效率提升。在HM3D-OVON上，DRIVE-Nav实现了50.2%的成功率(SR)和32.6%的成功率加路径长度(SPL)，比之前最好的方法提高了1.9%的SR和5.6%的SPL。它还在HM3Dv2和MP3D上实现了最佳的SPL，并可迁移到物理人形机器人。真实世界的部署也验证了其有效性。项目页面：https://coolmaoguo.github.io/drive-nav-page/
tldr: DRIVE-Nav is a framework for Open-Vocabulary Object Navigation that improves path efficiency by using directional reasoning and inspection of semantic views, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks and demonstrating transfer to a physical robot.
tldr_zh: DRIVE-Nav是一个用于开放词汇目标导航的框架，通过使用方向推理和语义视图检查来提高路径效率，在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的结果，并展示了向物理机器人的迁移。

title: StreamingVLA: Streaming Vision-Language-Action Model with Action Flow Matching and Adaptive Early Observation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated exceptional performance in natural language-driven perception and control. However, the high computational cost of VLA models poses significant efficiency challenges, particularly for resource-constrained edge platforms in real-world deployments. However, since different stages of VLA (observation, action generation and execution) must proceed sequentially, and wait for the completion of the preceding stage, the system suffers from frequent halting and high latency. To address this, We conduct a systematic analysis to identify the challenges for fast and fluent generation, and propose enabling VLAs with the ability to asynchronously parallelize across VLA stages in a "streaming" manner. First, we eliminate the reliance on action chunking and adopt action flow matching, which learns the trajectory of action flows rather than denoising chunk-wise actions. It overlaps the latency of action generation and execution. Second, we design an action saliency-aware adaptive observation mechanism, thereby overlapping the latency of execution and observation. Without sacrificing performance, StreamingVLA achieves substantial speedup and improves the fluency of execution. It achieves a 2.4 $\times$ latency speedup and reduces execution halting by 6.5 $\times$.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在自然语言驱动的感知和控制方面表现出了卓越的性能。然而，VLA模型的高计算成本带来了显著的效率挑战，尤其是在资源受限的边缘平台上的实际部署中。此外，由于VLA的不同阶段（观察、动作生成和执行）必须依次进行，且需要等待前一阶段的完成，系统经常出现停顿和高延迟。为了解决这个问题，我们进行了一项系统分析，以识别快速流畅生成所面临的挑战，并提出使VLA具备以“流式”方式跨VLA阶段异步并行化的能力。首先，我们消除了对动作分块的依赖，并采用动作流匹配，它学习动作流的轨迹，而不是去噪分块式动作。这会重叠动作生成和执行的延迟。其次，我们设计了一种动作显著性感知的自适应观察机制，从而重叠执行和观察的延迟。在不牺牲性能的情况下，StreamingVLA 实现了显著的加速，并提高了执行的流畅性。它实现了2.4倍的延迟加速，并将执行停顿减少了6.5倍。
tldr: The paper introduces StreamingVLA, a Vision-Language-Action model designed for faster and more fluent execution through asynchronous parallelization of VLA stages, achieving significant speedup by action flow matching and adaptive observation. This method reduces latency and execution halting without sacrificing performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了StreamingVLA，一种视觉-语言-动作模型，旨在通过VLA阶段的异步并行化实现更快、更流畅的执行。通过动作流匹配和自适应观察，实现了显著的加速，从而在不牺牲性能的情况下降低了延迟并减少了执行停止。

title: ManipArena: Comprehensive Real-world Evaluation of Reasoning-Oriented Generalist Robot Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and world models have recently emerged as promising paradigms for general-purpose robotic intelligence, yet their progress is hindered by the lack of reliable evaluation protocols that reflect real-world deployment. Existing benchmarks are largely simulator-centric, which provide controllability but fail to capture the reality gap caused by perception noise, complex contact dynamics, hardware constraints, and system latency. Moreover, fragmented real-world evaluations across different robot platforms prevent fair and reproducible comparison. To address these challenges, we introduce ManipArena, a standardized evaluation framework designed to bridge simulation and real-world execution. ManipArena comprises 20 diverse tasks across 10,812 expert trajectories emphasizing reasoning-oriented manipulation tasks requiring semantic and spatial reasoning, supports multi-level generalization through controlled out-of-distribution settings, and incorporates long-horizon mobile manipulation beyond tabletop scenarios. The framework further provides rich sensory diagnostics, including low-level motor signals, and synchronized real-to-sim environments constructed via high-quality 3D scanning. Together, these features enable fair, realistic, and reproducible evaluation for both VLA and world model approaches, providing a scalable foundation for diagnosing and advancing embodied intelligence systems.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和世界模型近来已成为通用机器人智能领域中颇具前景的范式，但其进展受到缺乏反映真实世界部署的可靠评估协议的阻碍。现有基准测试在很大程度上以模拟器为中心，虽然提供了可控性，但未能捕捉到由感知噪声、复杂接触动力学、硬件约束和系统延迟造成的现实差距。此外，跨不同机器人平台的零散真实世界评估阻碍了公平和可复现的比较。为了应对这些挑战，我们推出了ManipArena，这是一个旨在弥合模拟和真实世界执行之间差距的标准化评估框架。ManipArena包含20项不同的任务，涵盖10,812条专家轨迹，强调需要语义和空间推理的面向推理的操纵任务，支持通过受控的分布外设置实现多层次泛化，并融合了超越桌面场景的长程移动操纵。该框架进一步提供了丰富的感知诊断信息，包括低级电机信号，以及通过高质量3D扫描构建的同步真实-模拟环境。总之，这些特性为VLA和世界模型方法实现了公平、逼真且可复现的评估，为诊断和推进具身智能系统提供了可扩展的基础。
tldr: The paper introduces ManipArena, a new standardized real-world evaluation framework for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and world models in robotics, addressing the limitations of simulator-centric benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 ManipArena，一个新的标准化真实世界机器人评估框架，用于视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型和世界模型，解决了以模拟器为中心的基准测试的局限性。

title: RAD-LAD: Rule and Language Grounded Autonomous Driving in Real-Time
summary: We present LAD, a real-time language--action planner with an interruptible architecture that produces a motion plan in a single forward pass (~20 Hz) or generates textual reasoning alongside a motion plan (~10 Hz). LAD is fast enough for real-time closed-loop deployment, achieving ~3x lower latency than prior driving language models while setting a new learning-based state of the art on nuPlan Test14-Hard and InterPlan. We also introduce RAD, a rule-based planner designed to address structural limitations of PDM-Closed. RAD achieves state-of-the-art performance among rule-based planners on nuPlan Test14-Hard and InterPlan. Finally, we show that combining RAD and LAD enables hybrid planning that captures the strengths of both approaches. This hybrid system demonstrates that rules and learning provide complementary capabilities: rules support reliable maneuvering, while language enables adaptive and explainable decision-making.
summary_zh: 我们提出了LAD，一个具有可中断架构的实时语言-动作规划器。它能够在单次前向传播中生成运动规划 (~20 Hz)，或者在生成运动规划的同时输出文本推理 (~10 Hz)。LAD的速度足以支持实时闭环部署，其延迟比先前的驾驶语言模型低约3倍，并在nuPlan Test14-Hard和InterPlan上取得了基于学习的最先进水平。我们还介绍了RAD，一个旨在解决PDM-Closed结构性局限性的基于规则的规划器。RAD在nuPlan Test14-Hard和InterPlan上实现了基于规则的规划器的最先进性能。最后，我们展示了结合RAD和LAD能够实现混合规划，从而兼顾两种方法的优势。这个混合系统表明，规则和学习提供了互补的能力：规则支持可靠的机动，而语言则支持自适应和可解释的决策。
tldr: The paper introduces RAD-LAD, a hybrid rule-based and language-grounded autonomous driving system that achieves state-of-the-art performance and real-time operation by combining the reliability of rule-based planning with the adaptability of language-based decision-making.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了RAD-LAD，一个混合的基于规则和语言的自主驾驶系统，通过结合基于规则的规划的可靠性与基于语言的决策的适应性，实现了最先进的性能和实时操作。

title: $AutoDrive\text{-}P^3$: Unified Chain of Perception-Prediction-Planning Thought via Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being adopted for end-to-end autonomous driving systems due to their exceptional performance in handling long-tail scenarios. However, current VLM-based approaches suffer from two major limitations: 1) Some VLMs directly output planning results without chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, bypassing crucial perception and prediction stages which creates a significant domain gap and compromises decision-making capability; 2) Other VLMs can generate outputs for perception, prediction, and planning tasks but employ a fragmented decision-making approach where these modules operate separately, leading to a significant lack of synergy that undermines true planning performance. To address these limitations, we propose ${AutoDrive\text{-}P^3}$, a novel framework that seamlessly integrates $\textbf{P}$erception, $\textbf{P}$rediction, and $\textbf{P}$lanning through structured reasoning. We introduce the ${P^3\text{-}CoT}$ dataset to facilitate coherent reasoning and propose ${P^3\text{-}GRPO}$, a hierarchical reinforcement learning algorithm that provides progressive supervision across all three tasks. Specifically, ${AutoDrive\text{-}P^3}$ progressively generates CoT reasoning and answers for perception, prediction, and planning, where perception provides essential information for subsequent prediction and planning, while both perception and prediction collectively contribute to the final planning decisions, enabling safer and more interpretable autonomous driving. Additionally, to balance inference efficiency with performance, we introduce dual thinking modes: detailed thinking and fast thinking. Extensive experiments on both open-loop (nuScenes) and closed-loop (NAVSIMv1/v2) benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance in planning tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/haha-yuki-haha/AutoDrive-P3.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)由于其在处理长尾场景方面的出色性能，正越来越多地被应用于端到端自动驾驶系统。然而，目前基于VLM的方法存在两个主要局限性：1) 一些VLMs直接输出规划结果，而缺乏思维链(CoT)推理，绕过了关键的感知和预测阶段，从而造成了显著的领域差距并损害了决策能力；2) 另一些VLMs可以生成感知、预测和规划任务的输出，但采用碎片化的决策方法，这些模块独立运行，导致严重的协同不足，从而削弱了真正的规划性能。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种名为${AutoDrive\text{-}P^3}$的新颖框架，该框架通过结构化推理无缝地整合了$\textbf{P}$感知、$\textbf{P}$预测和$\textbf{P}$规划。我们引入了${P^3\text{-}CoT}$数据集，以促进连贯的推理，并提出了${P^3\text{-}GRPO}$，一种分层强化学习算法，可在所有三个任务中提供渐进式监督。具体来说，${AutoDrive\text{-}P^3}$逐步生成用于感知、预测和规划的CoT推理和答案，其中感知为后续的预测和规划提供必要信息，而感知和预测共同促成最终的规划决策，从而实现更安全、更可解释的自动驾驶。此外，为了平衡推理效率和性能，我们引入了双重思考模式：详细思考和快速思考。在开放循环（nuScenes）和闭环（NAVSIMv1/v2）基准测试上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在规划任务中实现了最先进的性能。代码可在https://github.com/haha-yuki-haha/AutoDrive-P3 上获得。
tldr: The paper introduces AutoDrive-P3, a reinforcement learning framework that unifies perception, prediction, and planning in autonomous driving using vision-language models with chain-of-thought reasoning, achieving SOTA performance on benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AutoDrive-P3，一个强化学习框架，它使用具有思维链推理的视觉语言模型统一了自动驾驶中的感知、预测和规划，并在基准测试中实现了SOTA性能。

title: CARLA-Air: Fly Drones Inside a CARLA World -- A Unified Infrastructure for Air-Ground Embodied Intelligence
summary:
The convergence of low-altitude economies, embodied intelligence, and air-ground cooperative systems creates growing demand for simulation infrastructure capable of jointly modeling aerial and ground agents within a single physically coherent environment. Existing open-source platforms remain domain-segregated: driving simulators lack aerial dynamics, while multirotor simulators lack realistic ground scenes. Bridge-based co-simulation introduces synchronization overhead and cannot guarantee strict spatial-temporal consistency.
  We present CARLA-Air, an open-source infrastructure that unifies high-fidelity urban driving and physics-accurate multirotor flight within a single Unreal Engine process. The platform preserves both CARLA and AirSim native Python APIs and ROS 2 interfaces, enabling zero-modification code reuse. Within a shared physics tick and rendering pipeline, CARLA-Air delivers photorealistic environments with rule-compliant traffic, socially-aware pedestrians, and aerodynamically consistent UAV dynamics, synchronously capturing up to 18 sensor modalities across all platforms at each tick. The platform supports representative air-ground embodied intelligence workloads spanning cooperation, embodied navigation and vision-language action, multi-modal perception and dataset construction, and reinforcement-learning-based policy training. An extensible asset pipeline allows integration of custom robot platforms into the shared world. By inheriting AirSim's aerial capabilities -- whose upstream development has been archived -- CARLA-Air ensures this widely adopted flight stack continues to evolve within a modern infrastructure.
  Released with prebuilt binaries and full source: https://github.com/louiszengCN/CarlaAir
summary_zh:
低空经济、具身智能和空地协同系统的融合，对能够在单一物理一致环境中联合建模空中和地面智能体的仿真基础设施提出了日益增长的需求。现有的开源平台仍然是领域隔离的：驾驶模拟器缺乏空中动力学，而多旋翼飞行器模拟器缺乏真实的地面场景。基于桥接的协同仿真引入了同步开销，并且无法保证严格的时空一致性。

我们提出了 CARLA-Air，一个开源基础设施，它在单一Unreal Engine进程中统一了高保真城市驾驶和物理精确的多旋翼飞行。该平台保留了 CARLA 和 AirSim 原生的 Python API 和 ROS 2 接口，从而能够实现零修改的代码重用。在共享的物理滴答和渲染管线中，CARLA-Air提供了具有规则约束交通、具有社会意识的行人以及符合空气动力学的无人机动力学的逼真环境，并在每个滴答中同步捕获所有平台上多达 18 种传感器模态的数据。该平台支持具有代表性的空地具身智能工作负载，涵盖合作、具身导航和视觉-语言动作、多模态感知和数据集构建，以及基于强化学习的策略训练。可扩展的资产管线允许将自定义机器人平台集成到共享世界中。通过继承 AirSim 的空中能力（其上游开发已被存档），CARLA-Air 确保了这个被广泛采用的飞行堆栈能够在现代基础设施中继续发展。

发布了预构建的二进制文件和完整源代码：https://github.com/louiszengCN/CarlaAir
tldr: CARLA-Air is a new open-source simulation infrastructure unifying high-fidelity urban driving with physics-accurate drone flight, enabling research in air-ground embodied intelligence with synchronized multi-modal sensor data.
tldr_zh: CARLA-Air 是一个新的开源仿真基础设施，将高保真城市驾驶与物理精确的无人机飞行相结合，从而能够进行空中-地面具身智能的研究，并具有同步的多模态传感器数据。

title: Evolutionary Discovery of Reinforcement Learning Algorithms via Large Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning algorithms are defined by their learning update rules, which are typically hand-designed and fixed. We present an evolutionary framework for discovering reinforcement learning algorithms by searching directly over executable update rules that implement complete training procedures. The approach builds on REvolve, an evolutionary system that uses large language models as generative variation operators, and extends it from reward-function discovery to algorithm discovery. To promote the emergence of nonstandard learning rules, the search excludes canonical mechanisms such as actor--critic structures, temporal-difference losses, and value bootstrapping. Because reinforcement learning algorithms are highly sensitive to internal scalar parameters, we introduce a post-evolution refinement stage in which a large language model proposes feasible hyperparameter ranges for each evolved update rule. Evaluated end-to-end by full training runs on multiple Gymnasium benchmarks, the discovered algorithms achieve competitive performance relative to established baselines, including SAC, PPO, DQN, and A2C.
summary_zh: 强化学习算法由其学习更新规则定义，而这些规则通常是手工设计且固定的。我们提出了一种演化框架，通过直接搜索实现完整训练过程的可执行更新规则，来发现强化学习算法。该方法建立在 REvolve 的基础上，这是一个使用大型语言模型作为生成变异算子的演化系统，并将其从奖励函数发现扩展到算法发现。为了促进非标准学习规则的出现，搜索排除了诸如 Actor-Critic 结构、时序差分损失和价值引导等经典机制。由于强化学习算法对内部标量参数高度敏感，我们引入了一个演化后精炼阶段，其中大型语言模型为每个演化的更新规则提出可行的超参数范围。通过在多个 Gymnasium 基准上进行完整训练运行的端到端评估，所发现的算法相对于已建立的基线（包括 SAC、PPO、DQN 和 A2C）实现了有竞争力的性能。
tldr: This paper presents an evolutionary framework using large language models to discover novel reinforcement learning algorithms by directly evolving executable update rules, achieving competitive performance against established baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用大型语言模型的进化框架，通过直接进化可执行的更新规则来发现新的强化学习算法，并实现了与现有基线算法相当的性能。

title: COvolve: Adversarial Co-Evolution of Large-Language-Model-Generated Policies and Environments via Two-Player Zero-Sum Game
summary: A central challenge in building continually improving agents is that training environments are typically static or manually constructed. This restricts continual learning and generalization beyond the training distribution. We address this with COvolve, a co-evolutionary framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to generate both environments and agent policies, expressed as executable Python code. We model the interaction between environment and policy designers as a two-player zero-sum game, ensuring adversarial co-evolution in which environments expose policy weaknesses and policies adapt in response. This process induces an automated curriculum in which environments and policies co-evolve toward increasing complexity. To guarantee robustness and prevent forgetting as the curriculum progresses, we compute the mixed-strategy Nash equilibrium (MSNE) of the zero-sum game, thereby yielding a meta-policy. This MSNE meta-policy ensures that the agent does not forget to solve previously seen environments while learning to solve previously unseen ones. Experiments in urban driving, symbolic maze-solving, and geometric navigation showcase that COvolve produces progressively more complex environments. Our results demonstrate the potential of LLM-driven co-evolution to achieve open-ended learning without predefined task distributions or manual intervention.
summary_zh: 构建持续改进智能体的一个核心挑战在于，训练环境通常是静态的或手动构建的。这限制了持续学习以及超出训练分布的泛化能力。我们通过 COvolve 来解决这个问题，这是一个协同进化框架，利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 生成环境和智能体策略，两者均表示为可执行的 Python 代码。我们将环境和策略设计者之间的交互建模为一个双人零和博弈，确保对抗性协同进化，其中环境暴露策略的弱点，策略则根据环境做出适应。这个过程诱导出一个自动课程，其中环境和策略协同进化，复杂性不断增加。为了保证鲁棒性并防止课程进行过程中的遗忘，我们计算零和博弈的混合策略纳什均衡 (MSNE)，从而产生一个元策略。这个 MSNE 元策略确保智能体在学习解决先前未见的环境的同时，不会忘记解决先前见过的环境。在城市驾驶、符号迷宫求解和几何导航中的实验表明，COvolve 可以生成逐渐更复杂的环境。我们的结果证明了由 LLM 驱动的协同进化在没有预定义任务分布或人工干预的情况下实现开放式学习的潜力。
tldr: COvolve introduces a co-evolutionary framework using LLMs to generate both environments and policies as executable code, achieving open-ended learning through a two-player zero-sum game formulation that progressively increases environment complexity.
tldr_zh: COvolve 提出了一个使用LLM共同进化生成环境与策略的框架，它通过将环境和策略表示为可执行代码，并利用双人零和博弈实现开放式学习，逐步增加环境的复杂性。

title: SHOW3D: Capturing Scenes of 3D Hands and Objects in the Wild
summary: Accurate 3D understanding of human hands and objects during manipulation remains a significant challenge for egocentric computer vision. Existing hand-object interaction datasets are predominantly captured in controlled studio settings, which limits both environmental diversity and the ability of models trained on such data to generalize to real-world scenarios. To address this challenge, we introduce a novel marker-less multi-camera system that allows for nearly unconstrained mobility in genuinely in-the-wild conditions, while still having the ability to generate precise 3D annotations of hands and objects. The capture system consists of a lightweight, back-mounted, multi-camera rig that is synchronized and calibrated with a user-worn VR headset. For 3D ground-truth annotation of hands and objects, we develop an ego-exo tracking pipeline and rigorously evaluate its quality. Finally, we present SHOW3D, the first large-scale dataset with 3D annotations that show hands interacting with objects in diverse real-world environments, including outdoor settings. Our approach significantly reduces the fundamental trade-off between environmental realism and accuracy of 3D annotations, which we validate with experiments on several downstream tasks. show3d-dataset.github.io
summary_zh: 对人手和物体在操作过程中的精确3D理解，仍然是自我中心计算机视觉领域的一项重大挑战。现有的手-物交互数据集主要是在受控的实验室环境中采集，这既限制了环境的多样性，也限制了基于这些数据训练的模型对真实世界场景的泛化能力。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了一种新型的无标记多摄像机系统，该系统允许在真正的“野外”条件下近乎不受约束的移动，同时仍然能够生成精确的手和物体的3D标注。该采集系统由一个轻量级的、背部安装的多摄像机装置组成，该装置与佩戴者使用的VR头显同步并校准。对于手和物体的3D真值标注，我们开发了一种自我-外部跟踪流程，并严格评估其质量。最后，我们推出了SHOW3D，这是第一个大规模的3D标注数据集，展示了在包括室外环境在内的各种真实世界环境中，手与物体交互的过程。我们的方法显著降低了环境真实性与3D标注准确性之间的根本性权衡，我们通过在几个下游任务上的实验验证了这一点。show3d-dataset.github.io
tldr: The paper introduces SHOW3D, a novel large-scale dataset of 3D hand-object interactions captured in diverse, real-world environments using a multi-camera system, aiming to improve the generalizability of models trained on such data.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SHOW3D，这是一个新的大规模3D手部-物体交互数据集，使用多摄像头系统在不同的真实世界环境中捕获，旨在提高在此类数据上训练的模型的泛化能力。

title: Tac2Real: Reliable and GPU Visuotactile Simulation for Online Reinforcement Learning and Zero-Shot Real-World Deployment
summary: Visuotactile sensors are indispensable for contact-rich robotic manipulation tasks. However, policy learning with tactile feedback in simulation, especially for online reinforcement learning (RL), remains a critical challenge, as it demands a delicate balance between physics fidelity and computational efficiency. To address this challenge, we present Tac2Real, a lightweight visuotactile simulation framework designed to enable efficient online RL training. Tac2Real integrates the Preconditioned Nonlinear Conjugate Gradient Incremental Potential Contact (PNCG-IPC) method with a multi-node, multi-GPU high-throughput parallel simulation architecture, which can generate marker displacement fields at interactive rates. Meanwhile, we propose a systematic approach, TacAlign, to narrow both structured and stochastic sources of domain gap, ensuring a reliable zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. We further evaluate Tac2Real on the contact-rich peg insertion task. The zero-shot transfer results achieve a high success rate in the real-world scenario, verifying the effectiveness and robustness of our framework. The project page is: https://ningyurichard.github.io/tac2real-project-page/
summary_zh: 视觉触觉传感器对于富接触的机器人操作任务至关重要。然而，在模拟环境中进行触觉反馈的策略学习，特别是对于在线强化学习(RL)而言，仍然是一个关键挑战，因为它需要在物理保真度和计算效率之间取得微妙的平衡。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了Tac2Real，一个轻量级的视觉触觉模拟框架，旨在实现高效的在线RL训练。Tac2Real集成了预处理非线性共轭梯度增量势接触（PNCG-IPC）方法与多节点、多GPU的高吞吐量并行模拟架构，能够以交互式的速率生成标记位移场。同时，我们提出了一种系统化的方法TacAlign，以缩小结构性和随机性的领域差异来源，确保可靠的零样本模拟到真实世界的迁移。我们进一步在富接触的销钉插入任务上评估了Tac2Real。零样本迁移结果在真实世界场景中实现了很高的成功率，验证了我们框架的有效性和鲁棒性。项目主页是：https://ningyurichard.github.io/tac2real-project-page/
tldr: The paper introduces Tac2Real, a visuotactile simulation framework for efficient online reinforcement learning, and TacAlign, a method for sim-to-real transfer, demonstrated on a peg insertion task with zero-shot real-world success.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Tac2Real，一个用于高效在线强化学习的视觉触觉模拟框架，以及TacAlign，一种用于sim-to-real迁移的方法，并通过在现实世界中零样本成功的插销任务进行了演示。

title: Reducing Mental Workload through On-Demand Human Assistance for Physical Action Failures in LLM-based Multi-Robot Coordination
summary: Multi-robot coordination based on large language models (LLMs) has attracted growing attention, since LLMs enable the direct translation of natural language instructions into robot action plans by decomposing tasks and generating high-level plans. However, recovering from physical execution failures remains difficult, and tasks often stagnate due to the repetition of the same unsuccessful actions. While frameworks for remote robot operation using Mixed Reality were proposed, there have been few attempts to implement remote error resolution specifically for physical failures in multi-robot environments. In this study, we propose REPAIR (Robot Execution with Planned And Interactive Recovery), a human-in-the-loop framework that integrates remote error resolution into LLM-based multi-robot planning. In this method, robots execute tasks autonomously; however, when an irrecoverable failure occurs, the LLM requests assistance from an operator, enabling task continuity through remote intervention. Evaluations using a multi-robot trash collection task in a real-world environment confirmed that REPAIR significantly improves task progress (the number of items cleared within a time limit) compared to fully autonomous methods. Furthermore, for easily collectable items, it achieved task progress equivalent to full remote control. The results also suggested that the mental workload on the operator may differ in terms of physical demand and effort. The project website is https://emergentsystemlabstudent.github.io/REPAIR/.
summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型(LLMs)的多机器人协同吸引了越来越多的关注，因为LLMs能够通过分解任务并生成高级规划，将自然语言指令直接翻译成机器人行动计划。然而，从物理执行失败中恢复仍然很困难，并且任务往往由于重复相同的失败动作而停滞不前。虽然已经提出了使用混合现实进行远程机器人操作的框架，但很少有尝试专门针对多机器人环境中物理故障的远程错误修复。在本研究中，我们提出了REPAIR（具有计划和交互式恢复的机器人执行），这是一个将远程错误修复集成到基于LLM的多机器人规划中的人机协同框架。在该方法中，机器人自主执行任务；然而，当发生不可恢复的故障时，LLM会请求操作员的协助，从而通过远程干预实现任务的连续性。在真实环境中进行的采用多机器人垃圾收集任务的评估证实，与完全自主的方法相比，REPAIR显著提高了任务进度（在时间限制内清理的物品数量）。此外，对于容易收集的物品，它实现了与完全远程控制相当的任务进度。结果还表明，操作员的精神负荷可能在体力需求和努力程度方面有所不同。项目网站为https://emergentsystemlabstudent.github.io/REPAIR/。
tldr: The paper introduces REPAIR, a human-in-the-loop framework for LLM-based multi-robot coordination that leverages remote assistance for physical action failure recovery, showing improved task progress and insights into operator workload.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了REPAIR，一个基于LLM的多机器人协调的人在环框架，它利用远程协助来解决物理动作失败问题，实验表明该方法改进了任务进度并提供了关于操作员工作负载的见解。

title: Which Reconstruction Model Should a Robot Use? Routing Image-to-3D Models for Cost-Aware Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation tasks require 3D mesh reconstructions of varying quality: dexterous manipulation demands fine-grained surface detail, while collision-free planning tolerates coarser representations. Multiple reconstruction methods offer different cost-quality tradeoffs, from Image-to-3D models - whose output quality depends heavily on the input viewpoint - to view-invariant methods such as structured light scanning. Querying all models is computationally prohibitive, motivating per-input model selection. We propose SCOUT, a novel routing framework that decouples reconstruction scores into two components: (1) the relative performance of viewpoint-dependent models, captured by a learned probability distribution, and (2) the overall image difficulty, captured by a scalar partition function estimate. As the learned network operates only over the viewpoint-dependent models, view-invariant pipelines can be added, removed, or reconfigured without retraining. SCOUT also supports arbitrary cost constraints at inference time, accommodating the multi-dimensional cost constraints common in robotics. We evaluate on the Google Scanned Objects, BigBIRD, and YCB datasets under multiple mesh quality metrics, demonstrating consistent improvements over routing baselines adapted from the LLM literature across various cost constraints. We further validate the framework through robotic grasping and dexterous manipulation experiments. We release the code and additional results on our website.
summary_zh: 机器人操作任务需要不同质量的3D网格重建：精巧的操作需要精细的表面细节，而无碰撞规划可以容忍较粗糙的表示。多种重建方法提供了不同的成本-质量权衡，从图像到3D模型——其输出质量严重依赖于输入视点——到诸如结构光扫描之类的视点不变方法。查询所有模型在计算上是禁止的，这促使我们进行按输入模型选择。我们提出了SCOUT，一种新型路由框架，它将重建得分解耦为两个组成部分：（1）视点相关模型的相对性能，由学习的概率分布捕获；（2）整体图像难度，由标量配分函数估计捕获。由于学习的网络仅在视点相关模型上运行，因此可以添加、删除或重新配置视点不变的流水线，而无需重新训练。SCOUT还支持推理时的任意成本约束，满足机器人技术中常见的多元成本约束。我们在Google Scanned Objects、BigBIRD和YCB数据集上，在多种网格质量指标下进行了评估，展示了在各种成本约束下，相对于从LLM文献改编的路由基线的一致改进。我们通过机器人抓取和精巧操作实验进一步验证了该框架。我们在我们的网站上发布了代码和其他结果。
tldr: The paper introduces SCOUT, a novel routing framework for selecting the optimal 3D reconstruction model for robotic manipulation, balancing cost and quality by learning a probability distribution over viewpoint-dependent models and estimating image difficulty. It is validated through simulations and robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为SCOUT的新型路由框架，用于为机器人操作选择最佳的3D重建模型。该框架通过学习视角相关的模型上的概率分布并估计图像难度，从而平衡成本和质量。该框架通过仿真和机器人实验进行了验证。

title: Dynamic Dual-Granularity Skill Bank for Agentic RL
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) can benefit substantially from reusable experience, yet existing skill-based methods mainly extract trajectory-level guidance and often lack principled mechanisms for maintaining an evolving skill memory. We propose D2Skill, a dynamic dual-granularity skill bank for agentic RL that organizes reusable experience into task skills for high-level guidance and step skills for fine-grained decision support and error correction. D2Skill jointly trains the policy and skill bank through paired baseline and skill-injected rollouts under the same policy, using their performance gap to derive hindsight utility signals for both skill updating and policy optimization. Built entirely from training-time experience, the skill bank is continuously expanded through reflection and maintained with utility-aware retrieval and pruning. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 show that D2Skill consistently improves success rates over skill-free baselines by 10-20 points. Further ablations and analyses show that both dual-granularity skill modeling and dynamic skill maintenance are critical to these gains, while the learned skills exhibit higher utility, transfer across evaluation settings, and introduce only modest training overhead.
summary_zh: 能动性强化学习（RL）可以从可复用型经验中获益匪浅，但现有的基于技能的方法主要提取轨迹层面的指导，并且通常缺乏保持演化技能记忆的有效机制。我们提出了D2Skill，一种能动性强化学习的动态双粒度技能库，它将可复用型经验组织成任务技能以提供高层指导，并组织成步骤技能以实现精细决策支持和误差修正。D2Skill在同一策略下通过配对的基线和技能注入式行动展开来联合训练策略和技能库，并使用它们的性能差距来导出后见之明的效用信号，用于技能更新和策略优化。技能库完全由训练时经验构建，通过反思持续扩展，并通过效用感知检索和剪枝进行维护。使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507在ALFWorld和WebShop上的实验表明，D2Skill始终将成功率在无技能基线之上提高了10-20个百分点。进一步的消融实验和分析表明，双粒度技能建模和动态技能维护对于这些收益至关重要，同时学习到的技能表现出更高的效用、跨评估设置的迁移能力，并且仅带来适度的训练开销。
tldr: This paper introduces D2Skill, a dynamic dual-granularity skill bank for agentic RL that improves performance by organizing reusable experiences into task and step skills, demonstrating improvements on ALFWorld and WebShop using Qwen models.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了D2Skill，一种用于Agentic RL的动态双粒度技能库，通过将可重用经验组织成任务和步骤技能来提高性能，并在ALFWorld和WebShop上使用Qwen模型进行了演示。

title: AdaptToken: Entropy-based Adaptive Token Selection for MLLM Long Video Understanding
summary: Long video understanding remains challenging for Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) due to high memory costs and context-length limits. Prior approaches mitigate this by scoring and selecting frames/tokens within short clips, but they lack a principled mechanism to (i) compare relevance across distant video clips and (ii) stop processing once sufficient evidence has been gathered. We propose AdaptToken, a training-free framework that turns an MLLM's self-uncertainty into a global control signal for long-video token selection. AdaptToken splits a video into groups, extracts cross-modal attention to rank tokens within each group, and uses the model's response entropy to estimate each group's prompt relevance. This entropy signal enables a global token budget allocation across groups and further supports early stopping (AdaptToken-Lite), skipping the remaining groups when the model becomes sufficiently certain. Across four long-video benchmarks (VideoMME, LongVideoBench, LVBench, and MLVU) and multiple base MLLMs (7B-72B), AdaptToken consistently improves accuracy (e.g., +6.7 on average over Qwen2.5-VL 7B) and continues to benefit from extremely long inputs (up to 10K frames), while AdaptToken-Lite reduces inference time by about half with comparable performance. Project page: https://haozheqi.github.io/adapt-token
summary_zh: 由于高昂的内存成本和上下文长度限制，多模态大型语言模型(MLLM)在长视频理解方面仍然面临挑战。 先前的研究通常通过对短片段内的帧/标记进行评分和选择来缓解这个问题，但它们缺乏一种有原则的机制来 (i) 比较不同视频片段之间的相关性，以及 (ii) 在收集到足够的证据后停止处理。 我们提出 AdaptToken，这是一个免训练框架，它将 MLLM 的自身不确定性转化为用于长视频标记选择的全局控制信号。 AdaptToken 将视频分成若干组，提取跨模态注意力以对每组内的标记进行排序，并使用模型响应熵来估计每组的提示相关性。 这种熵信号能够实现跨组的全局标记预算分配，并进一步支持提前停止（AdaptToken-Lite），即当模型变得足够确定时，跳过剩余的组。 在四个长视频基准测试 (VideoMME、LongVideoBench、LVBench 和 MLVU) 以及多个基础 MLLM (7B-72B) 上，AdaptToken 都持续提高了准确率（例如，在 Qwen2.5-VL 7B 上平均提高 +6.7），并继续从极长的输入（高达 10K 帧）中受益，同时 AdaptToken-Lite 将推理时间减少约一半，并具有相当的性能。 项目主页：https://haozheqi.github.io/adapt-token
tldr: AdaptToken is a training-free framework for MLLMs that uses self-uncertainty (entropy) to adaptively select video tokens for long video understanding, improving accuracy and inference time on long video benchmarks.
tldr_zh: AdaptToken是一个免训练的框架，用于多模态大型语言模型，它利用模型的不确定性（熵）自适应地选择视频token，从而提高在长视频理解基准测试中的准确性和推理速度。

title: AMIGO: Agentic Multi-Image Grounding Oracle Benchmark
summary: Agentic vision-language models increasingly act through extended interactions, but most evaluations still focus on single-image, single-turn correctness. We introduce AMIGO (Agentic Multi-Image Grounding Oracle Benchmark), a long-horizon benchmark for hidden-target identification over galleries of visually similar images. In AMIGO, the oracle privately selects a target image, and the model must recover it by asking a sequence of attribute-focused Yes/No/Unsure questions under a strict protocol that penalizes invalid actions with Skip. This setting stresses (i) question selection under uncertainty, (ii) consistent constraint tracking across turns, and (iii) fine-grained discrimination as evidence accumulates. AMIGO also supports controlled oracle imperfections to probe robustness and verification behavior under inconsistent feedback. We instantiate AMIGO with Guess My Preferred Dress task and report metrics covering both outcomes and interaction quality, including identification success, evidence verification, efficiency, protocol compliance, noise tolerance, and trajectory-level diagnostics.
summary_zh: 具身视觉语言模型越来越多地通过扩展交互的方式进行行动，但大多数评估仍然侧重于单图像、单轮的正确性。我们引入了AMIGO (具身多图像定位Oracle基准)，这是一个长时程基准，用于在视觉上相似的图像库中进行隐藏目标识别。在AMIGO中，Oracle私下选择一个目标图像，模型必须通过提出一系列以属性为中心的“是/否/不确定”问题来恢复它，且遵循严格的协议，该协议会用“跳过”来惩罚无效操作。此设置强调(i) 不确定性下的问题选择，(ii)跨回合的一致性约束跟踪，以及(iii) 随着证据积累的细粒度区分。AMIGO还支持受控的Oracle缺陷，以探测在不一致反馈下的鲁棒性和验证行为。我们用“猜猜我喜欢的裙子”任务实例化了AMIGO，并报告涵盖结果和交互质量的指标，包括识别成功率、证据验证、效率、协议一致性、噪声容忍度和轨迹级别诊断。
tldr: The paper introduces AMIGO, a new benchmark for evaluating agentic vision-language models in identifying a hidden target image from a gallery through a sequence of attribute-focused questions, stressing question selection, constraint tracking, and fine-grained discrimination.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AMIGO，一个新的基准，用于评估agentic视觉-语言模型，通过一系列以属性为中心的提问，从图库中识别隐藏的目标图像，强调问题选择、约束跟踪和精细判别。

title: Seeing with You: Perception-Reasoning Coevolution for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially enhanced the reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing RLVR approaches typically rely on outcome-driven optimization that updates both perception and reasoning using a shared reward based solely on the final answer. This shared reward blurs credit assignment, frequently improving reasoning patterns while failing to reliably enhance the accuracy of upstream visual evidence extraction. To address this perception bottleneck, we introduce PRCO (Perception-Reasoning Coevolution), a dual-role RLVR framework with a shared policy. PRCO consists of two cooperative roles: an Observer that generates an evidence caption tailored to the question and a Solver that predicts the final answer based on this caption. Crucially, PRCO employs role-specific reward signals: the Solver is optimized using verifiable outcome rewards on the final answer, while the Observer receives a utility reward derived from the Solver's downstream success. Extensive experiments across eight challenging multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that PRCO yields consistent improvements across model scales by over 7 points on average accuracy compared to the base model, outperforming prior open-source RL-tuned baselines.
summary_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已显著增强了多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）的推理能力。然而，现有的RLVR方法通常依赖于结果驱动的优化，该优化使用仅基于最终答案的共享奖励来更新感知和推理。这种共享奖励模糊了信用分配，经常改进推理模式，但无法可靠地提高上游视觉证据提取的准确性。为了解决这个感知瓶颈，我们引入了PRCO（感知-推理协同进化），这是一个具有共享策略的双重角色 RLVR 框架。PRCO 由两个协作角色组成：一个观察者，其生成针对问题的证据描述；以及一个解算器，其基于该描述预测最终答案。至关重要的是，PRCO 采用角色特定的奖励信号：解算器使用最终答案上的可验证结果奖励进行优化，而观察者则获得源自解算器下游成功的效用奖励。在八个具有挑战性的多模态推理基准上的大量实验表明，与基础模型相比，PRCO 在不同模型规模上产生了超过 7 个百分点的平均准确率的一致改进，优于先前的开源 RL 调优基线。
tldr: The paper introduces PRCO, a dual-role RLVR framework for multimodal reasoning that uses role-specific reward signals to improve both visual evidence extraction and reasoning accuracy, resulting in significant performance gains on benchmark datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为PRCO的双角色RLVR框架，用于多模态推理。它使用特定角色的奖励信号来提高视觉证据提取和推理的准确性，从而在基准数据集上获得显著的性能提升。

title: ResAdapt: Adaptive Resolution for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve stronger visual understanding by scaling input fidelity, yet the resulting visual token growth makes jointly sustaining high spatial resolution and long temporal context prohibitive. We argue that the bottleneck lies not in how post-encoding representations are compressed but in the volume of pixels the encoder receives, and address it with ResAdapt, an Input-side adaptation framework that learns how much visual budget each frame should receive before encoding. ResAdapt couples a lightweight Allocator with an unchanged MLLM backbone, so the backbone retains its native visual-token interface while receiving an operator-transformed input. We formulate allocation as a contextual bandit and train the Allocator with Cost-Aware Policy Optimization (CAPO), which converts sparse rollout feedback into a stable accuracy-cost learning signal. Across budget-controlled video QA, temporal grounding, and image reasoning tasks, ResAdapt improves low-budget operating points and often lies on or near the efficiency-accuracy frontier, with the clearest gains on reasoning-intensive benchmarks under aggressive compression. Notably, ResAdapt supports up to 16x more frames at the same visual budget while delivering over 15% performance gain. Code is available at https://github.com/Xnhyacinth/ResAdapt.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型 (MLLMs) 通过扩展输入保真度来实现更强的视觉理解，然而由此产生的视觉令牌增长使得同时维持高空间分辨率和长时序上下文变得难以承担。我们认为瓶颈不在于编码后表征的压缩方式，而在于编码器接收的像素量， 并提出 ResAdapt，一个输入侧自适应框架，它学习每个帧在编码前应接收多少视觉预算。 ResAdapt 将一个轻量级的分配器与一个未修改的 MLLM 主干耦合，从而使主干保留其原生的视觉令牌接口，同时接收一个经过算子转换的输入。 我们将分配建模为一个上下文赌博机，并使用成本感知策略优化 (CAPO) 训练分配器，该方法将稀疏的 roll-out 反馈转换为稳定的准确率-成本学习信号。 在预算受限的视频问答、时间定位和图像推理任务中，ResAdapt 提高了低预算操作点，并通常位于或接近效率-准确性前沿，在激进压缩下的推理密集型基准测试中收益最为明显。 值得注意的是，ResAdapt 支持在相同的视觉预算下处理多达 16 倍的帧数，同时提供超过 15% 的性能提升。 代码可在 https://github.com/Xnhyacinth/ResAdapt 获取。
tldr: The paper introduces ResAdapt, an input-side adaptation framework that intelligently allocates visual budget across frames in MLLMs, achieving better efficiency and accuracy in multimodal reasoning tasks, especially under heavy compression.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ResAdapt，一个输入侧自适应框架，能在多模态大语言模型中智能地分配跨帧的视觉预算，从而在多模态推理任务中实现更好的效率和准确性，尤其是在高压缩率下。

title: CirrusBench: Evaluating LLM-based Agents Beyond Correctness in Real-World Cloud Service Environments
summary: The increasing agentic capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled their deployment in real-world applications, such as cloud services, where customer-assistant interactions exhibit high technical complexity and long-horizon dependencies, making robustness and resolution efficiency critical for customer satisfaction. However, existing benchmarks for LLM-based agents largely rely on synthetic environments that fail to capture the diversity and unpredictability of authentic customer inputs, often ignoring the resolution efficiency essential for real-world deployment. To bridge this gap, we introduce CirrusBench, a novel evaluation framework distinguished by its foundation in real-world data from authentic cloud service tickets. CirrusBench preserves the intricate multi-turn logical chains and realistic tool dependencies inherent to technical service environments. Moving beyond execution correctness, we introduce novel Customer-Centric metrics to define agent success, quantifying service quality through metrics such as the Normalized Efficiency Index and Multi-Turn Latency to explicitly measure resolution efficiency. Experiments utilizing our framework reveal that while state-of-the-art models demonstrate strong reasoning capabilities, they frequently struggle in complex, realistic multi-turn tasks and fail to meet the high-efficiency standards required for customer service, highlighting critical directions for the future development of LLM-based agents in practical technical service applications. CirrusBench evaluation framework is released at: https://github.com/CirrusAI
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）日益增长的自主能力使其能够在实际应用中部署，例如云服务。在云服务中，客户协助互动表现出高度的技术复杂性和长时程依赖性，使得鲁棒性和问题解决效率对客户满意度至关重要。然而，现有的基于LLM的代理的基准测试主要依赖于合成环境，无法捕捉真实客户输入的多样性和不可预测性，并且常常忽略对于实际部署至关重要的问题解决效率。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了CirrusBench，一个以真实云服务工单数据为基础的新型评估框架。CirrusBench保留了技术服务环境中固有的复杂多轮逻辑链和真实的工具依赖关系。除了执行正确性之外，我们还引入了新颖的以客户为中心的指标来定义代理的成功，通过标准化效率指数和多轮延迟等指标量化服务质量，以明确衡量问题解决效率。利用我们的框架进行的实验表明，虽然最先进的模型表现出强大的推理能力，但它们在复杂、真实的多轮任务中经常遇到困难，并且未能达到客户服务所需的高效率标准，突出了基于LLM的代理在实际技术服务应用中未来发展的关键方向。CirrusBench评估框架已发布在：https://github.com/CirrusAI
tldr: This paper introduces CirrusBench, a new benchmark for evaluating LLM-based agents in realistic cloud service environments, emphasizing customer-centric metrics like resolution efficiency and multi-turn latency, revealing deficiencies in current models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CirrusBench，这是一个新的基准测试，用于评估基于LLM的智能体在真实的云服务环境中的表现，强调以客户为中心的指标，如解决效率和多轮延迟，揭示了当前模型的不足。

title: Marco DeepResearch: Unlocking Efficient Deep Research Agents via Verification-Centric Design
summary: Deep research agents autonomously conduct open-ended investigations, integrating complex information retrieval with multi-step reasoning across diverse sources to solve real-world problems. To sustain this capability on long-horizon tasks, reliable verification is critical during both training and inference. A major bottleneck in existing paradigms stems from the lack of explicit verification mechanisms in QA data synthesis, trajectory construction, and test-time scaling. Errors introduced at each stage propagate downstream and degrade the overall agent performance. To address this, we present Marco DeepResearch, a deep research agent optimized with a verification-centric framework design at three levels: \textbf{(1)~QA Data Synthesis:} We introduce verification mechanisms to graph-based and agent-based QA synthesis to control question difficulty while ensuring answers are unique and correct; \textbf{(2)~Trajectory Construction:} We design a verification-driven trajectory synthesis method that injects explicit verification patterns into training trajectories; and \textbf{(3)~Test-time scaling:} We use Marco DeepResearch itself as a verifier at inference time and effectively improve performance on challenging questions. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our proposed Marco DeepResearch agent significantly outperforms 8B-scale deep research agents on most challenging benchmarks, such as BrowseComp and BrowseComp-ZH. Crucially, under a maximum budget of 600 tool calls, Marco DeepResearch even surpasses or approaches several 30B-scale agents, like Tongyi DeepResearch-30B.
summary_zh: 深度研究代理能够自主进行开放式调查，将复杂的信息检索与跨多个来源的多步推理相结合，以解决实际问题。为在长时程任务中维持这种能力，在训练和推理过程中可靠的验证至关重要。现有范式的一个主要瓶颈源于在QA数据合成、轨迹构建和测试时扩展中缺乏显式的验证机制。在每个阶段引入的错误会向下游传播并降低代理的整体性能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Marco DeepResearch，一个在三个层面上通过以验证为中心的框架设计优化的深度研究代理：\textbf{(1) QA数据合成：}我们引入验证机制到基于图和基于代理的QA合成中，以控制问题的难度，同时确保答案是唯一且正确的；\textbf{(2) 轨迹构建：}我们设计了一种验证驱动的轨迹合成方法，该方法将显式的验证模式注入到训练轨迹中；\textbf{(3) 测试时扩展：}我们在推理时使用Marco DeepResearch本身作为验证器，并有效地提高了在具有挑战性的问题上的性能。大量的实验结果表明，我们提出的Marco DeepResearch代理在最具挑战性的基准测试（如BrowseComp和BrowseComp-ZH）上明显优于8B规模的深度研究代理。至关重要的是，在600个工具调用的最大预算下，Marco DeepResearch甚至超过或接近了几个30B规模的代理，如通义DeepResearch-30B。
tldr: The paper introduces Marco DeepResearch, a deep research agent that uses a verification-centric design across data synthesis, trajectory construction, and test-time scaling, achieving superior performance compared to other agents, including significantly larger models, on challenging benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Marco DeepResearch，一种深度研究代理，它采用以验证为中心的设计，涵盖数据合成、轨迹构建和测试时扩展，在具有挑战性的基准测试中，其性能优于其他代理，包括更大的模型。

title: Integrating Multimodal Large Language Model Knowledge into Amodal Completion
summary: With the widespread adoption of autonomous vehicles and robotics, amodal completion, which reconstructs the occluded parts of people and objects in an image, has become increasingly crucial. Just as humans infer hidden regions based on prior experience and common sense, this task inherently requires physical knowledge about real-world entities. However, existing approaches either depend solely on the image generation ability of visual generative models, which lack such knowledge, or leverage it only during the segmentation stage, preventing it from explicitly guiding the completion process. To address this, we propose AmodalCG, a novel framework that harnesses the real-world knowledge of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to guide amodal completion. Our framework first assesses the extent of occlusion to selectively invoke MLLM guidance only when the target object is heavily occluded. If guidance is required, the framework further incorporates MLLMs to reason about both the (1) extent and (2) content of the missing regions. Finally, a visual generative model integrates these guidance and iteratively refines imperfect completions that may arise from inaccurate MLLM guidance. Experimental results on various real-world images show impressive improvements compared to all existing works, suggesting MLLMs as a promising direction for addressing challenging amodal completion.
summary_zh: 随着自动驾驶汽车和机器人的广泛应用，图像中对人物和物体进行非模态补全（即重建被遮挡部分）变得日益重要。正如人类能基于先验经验和常识推断隐藏的区域一样，这项任务本质上需要关于真实世界实体的物理知识。然而，现有的方法要么仅仅依赖于视觉生成模型的图像生成能力，而这类模型缺乏此类知识，要么仅在分割阶段利用这些知识，无法显式地指导补全过程。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 AmodalCG，一种新颖的框架，它利用多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM) 的真实世界知识来指导非模态补全。我们的框架首先评估遮挡程度，以便仅在目标物体被严重遮挡时才选择性地调用 MLLM 指导。如果需要指导，该框架会进一步整合 MLLM 来推理缺失区域的 (1) 范围和 (2) 内容。最后，视觉生成模型整合这些指导，并迭代地改进可能因不准确的 MLLM 指导而产生的不完美的补全结果。在各种真实世界图像上的实验结果表明，与所有现有工作相比，性能有了显著提高，这表明 MLLM 是解决具有挑战性的非模态补全问题的一个有前景的方向。
tldr: The paper proposes AmodalCG, a framework that uses Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to guide amodal completion, particularly when occlusion is significant, improving performance over existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了AmodalCG，一个利用多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）指导不完整物体补全的框架，尤其是在遮挡严重时，相比现有方法提高了性能。

title: DiffAttn: Diffusion-Based Drivers' Visual Attention Prediction with LLM-Enhanced Semantic Reasoning
summary: Drivers' visual attention provides critical cues for anticipating latent hazards and directly shapes decision-making and control maneuvers, where its absence can compromise traffic safety. To emulate drivers' perception patterns and advance visual attention prediction for intelligent vehicles, we propose DiffAttn, a diffusion-based framework that formulates this task as a conditional diffusion-denoising process, enabling more accurate modeling of drivers' attention. To capture both local and global scene features, we adopt Swin Transformer as encoder and design a decoder that combines a Feature Fusion Pyramid for cross-layer interaction with dense, multi-scale conditional diffusion to jointly enhance denoising learning and model fine-grained local and global scene contexts. Additionally, a large language model (LLM) layer is incorporated to enhance top-down semantic reasoning and improve sensitivity to safety-critical cues. Extensive experiments on four public datasets demonstrate that DiffAttn achieves state-of-the-art (SoTA) performance, surpassing most video-based, top-down-feature-driven, and LLM-enhanced baselines. Our framework further supports interpretable driver-centric scene understanding and has the potential to improve in-cabin human-machine interaction, risk perception, and drivers' state measurement in intelligent vehicles.
summary_zh: 驾驶员的视觉注意力为预测潜在危险提供了关键线索，并直接影响决策和控制操作，其缺失可能危及交通安全。为了模拟驾驶员的感知模式并推进智能车辆的视觉注意力预测，我们提出了一种基于扩散的框架DiffAttn，该框架将此任务定义为一种条件扩散-去噪过程，从而更准确地建模驾驶员的注意力。为了捕获局部和全局场景特征，我们采用Swin Transformer作为编码器，并设计了一个解码器，该解码器结合了用于跨层交互的特征融合金字塔与密集的、多尺度的条件扩散，以共同增强去噪学习并建模细粒度的局部和全局场景上下文。此外，我们还引入了一个大型语言模型（LLM）层，以增强自上而下的语义推理，并提高对安全关键线索的敏感性。在四个公共数据集上的大量实验表明，DiffAttn实现了最先进（SoTA）的性能，超越了大多数基于视频、自上而下特征驱动以及LLM增强的基线模型。我们的框架进一步支持可解释的以驾驶员为中心的场景理解，并有潜力改善智能车辆中的车内人机交互、风险感知和驾驶员状态测量。
tldr: The paper introduces DiffAttn, a diffusion-based framework for predicting drivers' visual attention, incorporating LLMs for enhanced semantic reasoning and achieving SOTA performance on multiple datasets. It has potential applications in in-cabin human-machine interaction, risk perception, and driver state measurement.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了DiffAttn，一个基于扩散的框架用于预测司机视觉注意力，结合了大型语言模型以增强语义推理，并在多个数据集上实现了SOTA性能。它在驾驶舱人机交互、风险感知和驾驶员状态测量方面具有潜在应用。

title: ERPO: Token-Level Entropy-Regulated Policy Optimization for Large Reasoning Models
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced the reasoning capabilities of large language models. However, standard Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) typically assigns a uniform, sequence-level advantage to all tokens, thereby overlooking the intrinsic information heterogeneity along reasoning chains. We show that this coarse-grained credit assignment leads to premature entropy collapse and encourages the model to generate redundant, low-quality reasoning paths. Through systematic empirical analysis, we identify Critical Decision Pivots (CDPs): transient high-entropy states where the policy's trajectory is most sensitive to perturbations. These pivots represent the "forks in the road" where effective multi-path exploration is most crucial yet often suppressed by uniform advantage signals. Building on these insights, we propose Entropy-Regulated Policy Optimization (ERPO), which transitions the optimization focus from coarse sequences to fine-grained token dynamics. ERPO introduces three synergistic components: (i) Entropy-aware Gating, which adaptively amplifies exploration at CDPs to facilitate diverse path discovery; (ii) Bucket-based Implicit Normalization, which mitigates difficulty bias by aligning token progress windows; and (iii) Result-anchored Advantage Synthesis, which re-weights token-level signals via outcome-driven anchors. Extensive experiments on competitive mathematical benchmarks (e.g., MATH, AIME) demonstrate that ERPO significantly outperforms GRPO. Notably, ERPO not only boosts reasoning accuracy but also yields significantly more concise and robust derivation paths, establishing a new efficiency-accuracy frontier for large reasoning models.
summary_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）显著提升了大型语言模型的推理能力。然而，标准的群体相对策略优化（GRPO）通常为所有token分配统一的序列级别优势，从而忽略了推理链中固有的信息异质性。我们表明，这种粗粒度的信用分配会导致过早的熵崩溃，并鼓励模型生成冗余、低质量的推理路径。通过系统的经验分析，我们确定了关键决策枢纽点（CDP）：瞬态的高熵状态，在这些状态下，策略的轨迹对扰动最为敏感。这些枢纽点代表了“道路上的岔路口”，有效的多路径探索至关重要，但通常被统一的优势信号所抑制。基于这些洞察，我们提出了熵正则化策略优化（ERPO），它将优化重点从粗粒度序列转移到细粒度token动态。ERPO引入了三个协同组件：（i）熵感知门控，自适应地放大CDP的探索，以促进多样化的路径发现；（ii）基于桶的隐式归一化，通过对齐token的进度窗口来缓解难度偏差；（iii）结果锚定的优势合成，通过结果驱动的锚点来重新加权token级别的信号。在具有竞争力的数学基准（例如，MATH，AIME）上进行的大量实验表明，ERPO显著优于GRPO。值得注意的是，ERPO不仅提高了推理准确性，而且产生了更简洁和鲁棒的推导路径，为大型推理模型建立了新的效率-准确性边界。
tldr: The paper introduces ERPO, a token-level entropy-regulated policy optimization method that outperforms GRPO in reasoning accuracy and efficiency by addressing the issue of uniform advantage assignment in reinforcement learning for large language models.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了ERPO，一种token级别的熵正则化策略优化方法，通过解决大型语言模型强化学习中均匀优势分配的问题，在推理准确性和效率方面优于GRPO。

title: PReD: An LLM-based Foundation Multimodal Model for Electromagnetic Perception, Recognition, and Decision
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models have demonstrated powerful cross-modal understanding and reasoning capabilities in general domains. However, in the electromagnetic (EM) domain, they still face challenges such as data scarcity and insufficient integration of domain knowledge. This paper proposes PReD, the first foundation model for the EM domain that covers the intelligent closed-loop of "perception, recognition, decision-making." We constructed a high-quality multitask EM dataset, PReD-1.3M, and an evaluation benchmark, PReD-Bench. The dataset encompasses multi-perspective representations such as raw time-domain waveform, frequency-domain spectrograms, and constellation diagrams, covering typical features of communication and radar signals. It supports a range of core tasks, including signal detection, modulation recognition, parameter estimation, protocol recognition, radio frequency fingerprint recognition, and anti-jamming decision-making. PReD adopts a multi-stage training strategy that unifies multiple tasks for EM signals. It achieves closed-loop optimization from end-to-end signal understanding to language-driven reasoning and decision-making, significantly enhancing EM domain expertise while maintaining general multimodal capabilities. Experimental results show that PReD achieves state-of-the-art performance on PReD-Bench constructed from both open-source and self-collected signal datasets. These results collectively validate the feasibility and potential of vision-aligned foundation models in advancing the understanding and reasoning of EM signals.
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型已在通用领域展现出强大的跨模态理解和推理能力。然而，在电磁（EM）领域，它们仍然面临数据稀缺和领域知识集成不足等挑战。本文提出了PReD，首个覆盖“感知、识别、决策”智能闭环的电磁领域基础模型。我们构建了一个高质量的多任务电磁数据集PReD-1.3M和一个评估基准PReD-Bench。该数据集包含原始时域波形、频域频谱图和星座图等多视角表示，涵盖通信和雷达信号的典型特征。它支持一系列核心任务，包括信号检测、调制识别、参数估计、协议识别、射频指纹识别和抗干扰决策。PReD采用多阶段训练策略，统一电磁信号的多个任务。它实现了从端到端信号理解到语言驱动的推理和决策的闭环优化，在保持通用多模态能力的同时，显著增强了电磁领域专业知识。实验结果表明，PReD在基于开源和自采集信号数据集构建的PReD-Bench上实现了最先进的性能。这些结果共同验证了视觉对齐的基础模型在推动电磁信号理解和推理方面的可行性和潜力。
tldr: The paper introduces PReD, a multimodal LLM foundation model for electromagnetic perception, recognition, and decision-making, along with a new dataset and benchmark for this domain, demonstrating SOTA performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PReD，一个用于电磁感知、识别和决策的多模态LLM基础模型，以及一个新的数据集和基准测试，展示了SOTA性能。

title: Evaluating Privilege Usage of Agents on Real-World Tools
summary: Equipping LLM agents with real-world tools can substantially improve productivity. However, granting agents autonomy over tool use also transfers the associated privileges to both the agent and the underlying LLM. Improper privilege usage may lead to serious consequences, including information leakage and infrastructure damage. While several benchmarks have been built to study agents' security, they often rely on pre-coded tools and restricted interaction patterns. Such crafted environments differ substantially from the real-world, making it hard to assess agents' security capabilities in critical privilege control and usage.
