Therefore, we propose GrantBox, a security evaluation sandbox for analyzing agent privilege usage. GrantBox automatically integrates real-world tools and allows LLM agents to invoke genuine privileges, enabling the evaluation of privilege usage under prompt injection attacks. Our results indicate that while LLMs exhibit basic security awareness and can block some direct attacks, they remain vulnerable to more sophisticated attacks, resulting in an average attack success rate of 84.80% in carefully crafted scenarios.
summary_zh: 为 LLM 智能体配备真实世界的工具能显著提高生产力。然而，授予智能体工具使用的自主权，也同时将相关权限转移到智能体和底层 LLM。不当的权限使用可能导致严重的后果，包括信息泄露和基础设施损坏。虽然已经构建了一些基准来研究智能体的安全性，但它们通常依赖于预先编码的工具和受限的交互模式。这种精心设计的环境与真实世界差异巨大，难以评估智能体在关键权限控制和使用方面的安全能力。因此，我们提出了 GrantBox，一个用于分析智能体权限使用的安全评估沙箱。GrantBox 自动集成真实世界的工具，并允许 LLM 智能体调用真正的权限，从而能够在提示注入攻击下评估权限使用情况。我们的结果表明，虽然 LLM 表现出一定的基本安全意识，并且可以阻止一些直接攻击，但它们仍然容易受到更复杂攻击的影响，在精心设计的场景中平均攻击成功率达到 84.80%。
tldr: The paper introduces GrantBox, a sandbox to evaluate the privilege usage of LLM agents interacting with real-world tools; experiments show agents are vulnerable to sophisticated attacks leading to improper privilege usage.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为GrantBox的沙盒环境，用于评估LLM智能体在使用真实世界工具时的权限使用情况；实验表明智能体容易受到复杂攻击，导致不当的权限使用。

title: MolmoPoint: Better Pointing for VLMs with Grounding Tokens
summary: Grounding has become a fundamental capability of vision-language models (VLMs). Most existing VLMs point by generating coordinates as part of their text output, which requires learning a complicated coordinate system and results in a high token count. Instead, we propose a more intuitive pointing mechanism that directly selects the visual tokens that contain the target concept. Our model generates a special pointing token that cross-attends to the input image or video tokens and selects the appropriate one. To make this model more fine-grained, we follow these pointing tokens with an additional special token that selects a fine-grained subpatch within the initially selected region, and then a third token that specifies a location within that subpatch. We further show that performance improves by generating points sequentially in a consistent order, encoding the relative position of the previously selected point, and including a special no-more-points class when selecting visual tokens. Using this method, we set a new state-of-the-art on image pointing (70.7% on PointBench), set a new state-of-the-art among fully open models on GUI pointing (61.1% on ScreenSpotPro), and improve video pointing (59.1% human preference win rate vs. a text coordinate baseline) and tracking (+6.3% gain on Molmo2Track). We additionally show that our method achieves much higher sample efficiency and discuss the qualitative differences that emerge from this design change.
summary_zh: 定锚已成为视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的一项基本能力。目前大多数的VLMs通过生成坐标作为文本输出的一部分来进行指点，这需要学习一个复杂的坐标系，并导致较高的token数量。我们提出了一种更直观的指点机制，它直接选择包含目标概念的视觉token。我们的模型生成一个特殊的指点token，它对输入图像或视频token进行交叉注意力，并选择合适的token。为了使这个模型更加精细，我们在这些指点token之后增加了一个额外的特殊token，用于在初始选择的区域内选择一个细粒度的子补丁，然后使用第三个token来指定该子补丁内的位置。我们进一步表明，通过以一致的顺序顺序生成点，编码先前选择点的相对位置，并在选择视觉token时包括一个特殊的“不再有更多点”的类别，可以提高性能。使用这种方法，我们在图像指点上创造了新的最先进水平（PointBench上为70.7%），在GUI指点上创造了全开放模型中的新最先进水平（ScreenSpotPro上为61.1%），并提高了视频指点（对文本坐标基线的59.1%人类偏好胜率）和跟踪（Molmo2Track上+6.3%的提升）的性能。我们还表明，我们的方法实现了更高的样本效率，并讨论了这种设计变更所产生的定性差异。
tldr: The paper introduces MolmoPoint, a novel pointing mechanism for VLMs that selects visual tokens directly instead of generating coordinates, achieving state-of-the-art results on image, GUI, video pointing and tracking with improved sample efficiency.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新的VLM指向机制 MolmoPoint，它直接选择视觉 tokens 而不是生成坐标，在图像、 GUI、视频指向和跟踪方面取得了最先进的结果，并提高了样本效率。

title: SARL: Label-Free Reinforcement Learning by Rewarding Reasoning Topology
summary: Reinforcement learning has become central to improving large reasoning models, but its success still relies heavily on verifiable rewards or labeled supervision. This limits its applicability to open ended domains where correctness is ambiguous and cannot be verified. Moreover, reasoning trajectories remain largely unconstrained, and optimization towards final answer can favor early exploitation over generalization. In this work, we ask whether general reasoning ability can be improved by teaching models how to think (the structure of reasoning) rather than what to produce (the outcome of reasoning) and extend traditional RLVR to open ended settings. We introduce structure aware reinforcement learning (SARL), a label free framework that constructs a per response Reasoning Map from intermediate thinking steps and rewards its small world topology, inspired by complex networks and the functional organization of the human brain. SARL encourages reasoning trajectories that are both locally coherent and globally efficient, shifting supervision from destination to path. Our experiments on Qwen3-4B show SARL surpasses ground truth based RL and prior label free RL baselines, achieving the best average gain of 9.1% under PPO and 11.6% under GRPO on math tasks and 34.6% under PPO and 30.4% under GRPO on open ended tasks. Beyond good performance, SARL also exhibits lower KL divergence, higher policy entropy, indicating a more stable and exploratory training and generalized reasoning ability.
summary_zh: 强化学习已成为提升大型推理模型的关键，但其成功仍然高度依赖于可验证的奖励或带有标签的监督。这限制了它在正确性模糊且无法验证的开放域中的适用性。此外，推理轨迹在很大程度上仍然不受约束，并且针对最终答案的优化可能会偏向于早期利用而非泛化。在这项工作中，我们探讨了是否可以通过教导模型如何思考（推理的结构）而不是产生什么（推理的结果）来提高通用推理能力，并将传统的RLVR扩展到开放域设置。我们引入了结构感知强化学习（SARL），这是一种无标签框架，它从中间思考步骤构建每个响应的推理图，并根据其小世界拓扑结构进行奖励，灵感来源于复杂网络和人脑的功能组织。SARL鼓励局部连贯且全局高效的推理轨迹，将监督从目的地转移到路径。我们在Qwen3-4B上的实验表明，SARL优于基于真值的RL和先前的无标签RL基线，在数学任务中，PPO下实现了9.1%的最佳平均增益，GRPO下实现了11.6%的最佳平均增益；在开放域任务中，PPO下实现了34.6%的最佳平均增益，GRPO下实现了30.4%的最佳平均增益。除了良好的性能外，SARL还表现出较低的KL散度、较高的策略熵，表明训练更加稳定和具有探索性，以及更强的泛化推理能力。
tldr: The paper introduces SARL, a label-free reinforcement learning framework that rewards reasoning topology based on the structure of intermediate thinking steps, improving reasoning ability in large language models, especially in open-ended tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为 SARL 的无标签强化学习框架，该框架通过奖励基于中间思考步骤结构的推理拓扑来提高大型语言模型的推理能力，尤其是在开放式任务中。

title: Gen-Searcher: Reinforcing Agentic Search for Image Generation
summary: Recent image generation models have shown strong capabilities in generating high-fidelity and photorealistic images. However, they are fundamentally constrained by frozen internal knowledge, thus often failing on real-world scenarios that are knowledge-intensive or require up-to-date information. In this paper, we present Gen-Searcher, as the first attempt to train a search-augmented image generation agent, which performs multi-hop reasoning and search to collect the textual knowledge and reference images needed for grounded generation. To achieve this, we construct a tailored data pipeline and curate two high-quality datasets, Gen-Searcher-SFT-10k and Gen-Searcher-RL-6k, containing diverse search-intensive prompts and corresponding ground-truth synthesis images. We further introduce KnowGen, a comprehensive benchmark that explicitly requires search-grounded external knowledge for image generation and evaluates models from multiple dimensions. Based on these resources, we train Gen-Searcher with SFT followed by agentic reinforcement learning with dual reward feedback, which combines text-based and image-based rewards to provide more stable and informative learning signals for GRPO training. Experiments show that Gen-Searcher brings substantial gains, improving Qwen-Image by around 16 points on KnowGen and 15 points on WISE. We hope this work can serve as an open foundation for search agents in image generation, and we fully open-source our data, models, and code.
summary_zh: 近年来，图像生成模型在生成高保真和照片级真实感图像方面表现出强大的能力。然而，它们在根本上受到冻结的内部知识的限制，因此在知识密集型或需要最新信息的真实世界场景中通常会失败。在本文中，我们提出了 Gen-Searcher，这是首次尝试训练一个搜索增强的图像生成代理，该代理执行多跳推理和搜索以收集用于基于常识生成的文本知识和参考图像。为此，我们构建了一个定制的数据管道，并策划了两个高质量的数据集，Gen-Searcher-SFT-10k 和 Gen-Searcher-RL-6k，其中包含各种搜索密集型提示和相应的真实合成图像。我们进一步引入了 KnowGen，这是一个综合基准，明确要求基于搜索的外部知识进行图像生成，并从多个维度评估模型。基于这些资源，我们训练了 Gen-Searcher，首先进行 SFT，然后进行具有双重奖励反馈的智能体强化学习，它结合了基于文本和基于图像的奖励，为 GRPO 训练提供更稳定和信息更丰富的学习信号。实验表明，Gen-Searcher 带来了显著的提升，在 KnowGen 上将 Qwen-Image 提高了约 16 分，在 WISE 上提高了 15 分。我们希望这项工作可以作为图像生成中搜索代理的开放基础，并且我们完全开源我们的数据、模型和代码。
tldr: The paper introduces Gen-Searcher, a search-augmented image generation agent trained with reinforcement learning to improve knowledge-intensive image generation, along with new datasets and a benchmark for evaluation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Gen-Searcher，一种通过强化学习训练的搜索增强图像生成代理，用以提升知识密集型图像生成的能力。同时，论文还提出了新的数据集和一个评估基准。

title: SonoWorld: From One Image to a 3D Audio-Visual Scene
summary: Tremendous progress in visual scene generation now turns a single image into an explorable 3D world, yet immersion remains incomplete without sound. We introduce Image2AVScene, the task of generating a 3D audio-visual scene from a single image, and present SonoWorld, the first framework to tackle this challenge. From one image, our pipeline outpaints a 360° panorama, lifts it into a navigable 3D scene, places language-guided sound anchors, and renders ambisonics for point, areal, and ambient sources, yielding spatial audio aligned with scene geometry and semantics. Quantitative evaluations on a newly curated real-world dataset and a controlled user study confirm the effectiveness of our approach. Beyond free-viewpoint audio-visual rendering, we also demonstrate applications to one-shot acoustic learning and audio-visual spatial source separation. Project website: https://humathe.github.io/sonoworld/
tldr: This paper introduces SonoWorld, a framework that generates explorable 3D audio-visual scenes from a single image, including spatial audio aligned with scene geometry and semantics.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SonoWorld，该框架从单个图像生成可探索的3D视听场景，包括与场景几何和语义对齐的空间音频。

title: VistaGEN: Consistent Driving Video Generation with Fine-Grained Control Using Multiview Visual-Language Reasoning
summary: Driving video generation has achieved much progress in controllability, video resolution, and length, but fails to support fine-grained object-level controllability for diverse driving videos, while preserving the spatiotemporal consistency, especially in long video generation. In this paper, we present a new driving video generation technique, called VistaGEN, which enables fine-grained control of specific entities, including 3D objects, images, and text descriptions, while maintaining spatiotemporal consistency in long video sequences. Our key innovation is the incorporation of multiview visual-language reasoning into the long driving video generation. To this end, we inject visual-language features into a multiview video generator to enable fine-grained controllability. More importantly, we propose a multiview vision-language evaluator (MV-VLM) to intelligently and automatically evaluate spatiotemporal consistency of the generated content, thus formulating a novel generation-evaluation-regeneration closed-loop generation mechanism. This mechanism ensures high-quality, coherent outputs, facilitating the creation of complex and reliable driving scenarios. Besides, within the closed-loop generation, we introduce an object-level refinement module to refine the unsatisfied results evaluated from the MV-VLM and then feed them back to the video generator for regeneration. Extensive evaluation shows that our VistaGEN achieves diverse driving video generation results with fine-grained controllability, especially for long-tail objects, and much better spatiotemporal consistency than previous approaches.
tldr: VistaGEN introduces a novel driving video generation technique using multiview visual-language reasoning and a closed-loop generation mechanism with object-level refinement to achieve fine-grained control and spatiotemporal consistency, especially for long videos.
tldr_zh: VistaGEN 提出了一种新的驾驶视频生成技术，利用多视角的视觉-语言推理和闭环生成机制，结合对象级别的细化，从而实现细粒度的控制和时空一致性，尤其是在长视频方面。

title: GEMS: Agent-Native Multimodal Generation with Memory and Skills
summary: Recent multimodal generation models have achieved remarkable progress on general-purpose generation tasks, yet continue to struggle with complex instructions and specialized downstream tasks. Inspired by the success of advanced agent frameworks such as Claude Code, we propose \textbf{GEMS} (Agent-Native Multimodal \textbf{GE}neration with \textbf{M}emory and \textbf{S}kills), a framework that pushes beyond the inherent limitations of foundational models on both general and downstream tasks. GEMS is built upon three core components. Agent Loop introduces a structured multi-agent framework that iteratively improves generation quality through closed-loop optimization. Agent Memory provides a persistent, trajectory-level memory that hierarchically stores both factual states and compressed experiential summaries, enabling a global view of the optimization process while reducing redundancy. Agent Skill offers an extensible collection of domain-specific expertise with on-demand loading, allowing the system to effectively handle diverse downstream applications. Across five mainstream tasks and four downstream tasks, evaluated on multiple generative backends, GEMS consistently achieves significant performance gains. Most notably, it enables the lightweight 6B model Z-Image-Turbo to surpass the state-of-the-art Nano Banana 2 on GenEval2, demonstrating the effectiveness of agent harness in extending model capabilities beyond their original limits.
tldr: The paper introduces GEMS, an agent-native multimodal generation framework with memory and skills, which achieves significant performance gains on general and downstream tasks by using a multi-agent loop, trajectory-level memory, and domain-specific skills. It even allows a smaller model to outperform a larger SOTA model on a benchmark.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了GEMS，一个具有记忆和技能的Agent-Native多模态生成框架。通过多Agent循环、轨迹级记忆和特定领域技能，GEMS在通用和下游任务上取得了显著的性能提升，甚至使较小模型超越了SOTA模型。

title: Learning Multi-View Spatial Reasoning from Cross-View Relations
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved impressive results on single-view vision tasks, but lack the multi-view spatial reasoning capabilities essential for embodied AI systems to understand 3D environments and manipulate objects across different viewpoints. In this work, we introduce Cross-View Relations (XVR), a large-scale dataset designed to teach VLMs spatial reasoning across multiple views. XVR comprises 100K vision-question-answer samples derived from 18K diverse 3D scenes and 70K robotic manipulation trajectories, spanning three fundamental spatial reasoning tasks: Correspondence (matching objects across views), Verification (validating spatial relationships), and Localization (identifying object positions). VLMs fine-tuned on XVR achieve substantial improvements on established multi-view and robotic spatial reasoning benchmarks (MindCube and RoboSpatial). When integrated as backbones in Vision-Language-Action models, XVR-trained representations improve success rates on RoboCasa. Our results demonstrate that explicit training on cross-view spatial relations significantly enhances multi-view reasoning and transfers effectively to real-world robotic manipulation.
tldr: This paper introduces XVR, a dataset for training vision-language models on multi-view spatial reasoning, and shows its effectiveness in improving performance on spatial reasoning and robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为XVR的数据集，用于训练视觉-语言模型进行多视角空间推理，并展示了它在提升空间推理和机器人操作任务性能方面的有效性。

title: SAGE: Sink-Aware Grounded Decoding for Multimodal Hallucination Mitigation
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) frequently suffer from hallucinations, generating content that is inconsistent with visual inputs. Existing methods typically address this problem through post-hoc filtering, additional training objectives, or external verification, but they do not intervene during the decoding process when hallucinations arise. In this work, we introduce SAGE, a Sink-Aware Grounded Decoding framework that mitigates hallucinations by dynamically modulating self-attention during generation. Hallucinations are strongly correlated with attention sink tokens - punctuation or function tokens that accumulate disproportionate attention despite carrying limited semantic content. SAGE leverages these tokens as anchors to monitor grounding reliability in real time. At each sink trigger, the method extracts semantic concepts from the generated sequence, estimates their visual grounding using both self-attention maps and gradient-based attribution, and measures their spatial agreement. Based on this signal, self-attention distributions are adaptively sharpened or broadened to reinforce grounded regions or suppress unreliable ones. Extensive experiments across diverse hallucination benchmarks demonstrate that SAGE consistently outperforms existing decoding strategies, achieving substantial reductions in hallucination while preserving descriptive coverage, without requiring model retraining or architectural modifications. Our method achieves an average relative improvement of 10.65% on MSCOCO and 7.19% on AMBER across diverse VLM architectures, demonstrating consistent gains in hallucination mitigation.
tldr: The paper introduces SAGE, a novel decoding framework that mitigates hallucinations in VLMs by adaptively modulating self-attention based on sink tokens and visual grounding, achieving significant performance gains without retraining or architectural changes.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为SAGE的新型解码框架，它通过基于sink token和视觉接地的自适应调整自注意力来减轻VLM中的幻觉，无需重新训练或架构修改即可实现显着的性能提升。

title: Wan-R1: Verifiable-Reinforcement Learning for Video Reasoning
summary: Video generation models produce visually coherent content but struggle with tasks requiring spatial reasoning and multi-step planning. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a path to improve generalization, but its effectiveness in video reasoning hinges on reward design -- a challenge that has received little systematic study. We investigate this problem by adapting Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to flow-based video models and training them on maze-solving and robotic navigation tasks. We first show that multimodal reward models fail catastrophically in this setting. To address this, we design verifiable reward functions grounded in objective task metrics. For structured game environments, we introduce a multi-component trajectory reward. For robotic navigation, we propose an embedding-level verifiable reward. Our experiments show that RL fine-tuning with verifiable rewards improves generalization. For example, on complex 3D mazes, our model improves exact match accuracy by 29.1\% over the SFT baseline, and on trap-avoidance tasks by 51.4\%. Our systematic reward analysis reveals that verifiable rewards are critical for stable training, while multimodal reward models could lead to degenerate solutions. These findings establish verifiable reward design as a key enabler for robust video reasoning. Code will be publicly available.
tldr: This paper introduces verifiable reward functions for reinforcement learning to improve video reasoning in tasks like maze-solving and robotic navigation, showing significant accuracy improvements over SFT baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于强化学习的可验证奖励函数，以提高视频推理能力，应用于迷宫求解和机器人导航等任务，与 SFT 基线相比，准确率显著提高。

title: MuSEAgent: A Multimodal Reasoning Agent with Stateful Experiences
summary: Research agents have recently achieved significant progress in information seeking and synthesis across heterogeneous textual and visual sources. In this paper, we introduce MuSEAgent, a multimodal reasoning agent that enhances decision-making by extending the capabilities of research agents to discover and leverage stateful experiences. Rather than relying on trajectory-level retrieval, we propose a stateful experience learning paradigm that abstracts interaction data into atomic decision experiences through hindsight reasoning. These experiences are organized into a quality-filtered experience bank that supports policy-driven experience retrieval at inference time. Specifically, MuSEAgent enables adaptive experience exploitation through complementary wide- and deep-search strategies, allowing the agent to dynamically retrieve multimodal guidance across diverse compositional semantic viewpoints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MuSEAgent consistently outperforms strong trajectory-level experience retrieval baselines on both fine-grained visual perception and complex multimodal reasoning tasks. These results validate the effectiveness of stateful experience modeling in improving multimodal agent reasoning.
tldr: MuSEAgent enhances multimodal reasoning by using stateful experience learning, abstracting interactions into atomic decision experiences and organizing them in a quality-filtered experience bank to dynamically retrieve multimodal guidance, outperforming trajectory-level retrieval baselines.
tldr_zh: MuSEAgent通过使用有状态经验学习来增强多模态推理能力，将交互抽象为原子决策经验，并将其组织在质量过滤的经验库中，以动态检索多模态指导，性能优于轨迹级检索基线。

title: See it to Place it: Evolving Macro Placements with Vision-Language Models
summary: We propose using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for macro placement in chip floorplanning, a complex optimization task that has recently shown promising advancements through machine learning methods. Because human designers rely heavily on spatial reasoning to arrange components on the chip canvas, we hypothesize that VLMs with strong visual reasoning abilities can effectively complement existing learning-based approaches. We introduce VeoPlace (Visual Evolutionary Optimization Placement), a novel framework that uses a VLM, without any fine-tuning, to guide the actions of a base placer by constraining them to subregions of the chip canvas. The VLM proposals are iteratively optimized through an evolutionary search strategy with respect to resulting placement quality. On open-source benchmarks, VeoPlace outperforms the best prior learning-based approach on 9 of 10 benchmarks with peak wirelength reductions exceeding 32%. We further demonstrate that VeoPlace generalizes to analytical placers, improving DREAMPlace performance on all 8 evaluated benchmarks with gains up to 4.3%. Our approach opens new possibilities for electronic design automation tools that leverage foundation models to solve complex physical design problems.
tldr: The paper introduces VeoPlace, a novel framework using Vision-Language Models to guide macro placement in chip floorplanning via evolutionary optimization, outperforming existing learning-based approaches on several benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 VeoPlace，一种新颖的框架，使用视觉-语言模型通过进化优化来指导芯片布局中的宏布局，并在多个基准测试中优于现有的基于学习的方法。

title: LIBERO-Para: A Diagnostic Benchmark and Metrics for Paraphrase Robustness in VLA Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong performance in robotic manipulation by leveraging pre-trained vision-language backbones. However, in downstream robotic settings, they are typically fine-tuned with limited data, leading to overfitting to specific instruction formulations and leaving robustness to paraphrased instructions underexplored. To study this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Para, a controlled benchmark that independently varies action expressions and object references for fine-grained analysis of linguistic generalization. Across seven VLA configurations (0.6B-7.5B), we observe consistent performance degradation of 22-52 pp under paraphrasing. This degradation is primarily driven by object-level lexical variation: even simple synonym substitutions cause large drops, indicating reliance on surface-level matching rather than semantic grounding. Moreover, 80-96% of failures arise from planning-level trajectory divergence rather than execution errors, showing that paraphrasing disrupts task identification. Binary success rate treats all paraphrases equally, obscuring whether models perform consistently across difficulty levels or rely on easier cases. To address this, we propose PRIDE, a metric that quantifies paraphrase difficulty using semantic and syntactic factors. Our benchmark and corresponding code are available at: https://github.com/cau-hai-lab/LIBERO-Para
tldr: The paper introduces LIBERO-Para, a benchmark for evaluating the paraphrase robustness of VLA models in robotic manipulation. Results show significant performance degradation under paraphrasing, highlighting the need for improved semantic grounding.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了LIBERO-Para，一个用于评估VLA模型在机器人操作中释义鲁棒性的基准。结果表明，在释义下性能显著下降，凸显了改进语义基础的必要性。

title: Heddle: A Distributed Orchestration System for Agentic RL Rollout
summary: Agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) enables LLMs to solve complex tasks by alternating between a data-collection rollout phase and a policy training phase. During rollout, the agent generates trajectories, i.e., multi-step interactions between LLMs and external tools. Yet, frequent tool calls induce long-tailed trajectory generation that bottlenecks rollouts. This stems from step-centric designs that ignore trajectory context, triggering three system problems for long-tail trajectory generation: queueing delays, interference overhead, and inflated per-token time. We propose Heddle, a trajectory-centric system to optimize the when, where, and how of agentic rollout execution. Heddle integrates three core mechanisms: trajectory-level scheduling using runtime prediction and progressive priority to minimize cumulative queueing; trajectory-aware placement via presorted dynamic programming and opportunistic migration during idle tool call intervals to minimize interference; and trajectory-adaptive resource manager that dynamically tunes model parallelism to accelerate the per-token time of long-tail trajectories while maintaining high throughput for short trajectories. Evaluations across diverse agentic RL workloads demonstrate that Heddle effectively neutralizes the long-tail bottleneck, achieving up to 2.5$\times$ higher end-to-end rollout throughput compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
tldr: The paper introduces Heddle, a distributed orchestration system that optimizes the rollout phase in Agentic RL by addressing the long-tail trajectory generation bottleneck through trajectory-centric scheduling, placement, and adaptive resource management, achieving significant throughput improvements.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Heddle，一种分布式编排系统，通过以轨迹为中心的调度、放置和自适应资源管理来解决Agentic RL中rollout阶段的长尾轨迹生成瓶颈，从而优化rollout过程，并显著提高吞吐量。

title: Reducing Oracle Feedback with Vision-Language Embeddings for Preference-Based RL
summary: Preference-based reinforcement learning can learn effective reward functions from comparisons, but its scalability is constrained by the high cost of oracle feedback. Lightweight vision-language embedding (VLE) models provide a cheaper alternative, but their noisy outputs limit their effectiveness as standalone reward generators. To address this challenge, we propose ROVED, a hybrid framework that combines VLE-based supervision with targeted oracle feedback. Our method uses the VLE to generate segment-level preferences and defers to an oracle only for samples with high uncertainty, identified through a filtering mechanism. In addition, we introduce a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that adapts the VLE with the obtained oracle feedback in order to improve the model over time in a synergistic fashion. This ensures the retention of the scalability of embeddings and the accuracy of oracles, while avoiding their inefficiencies. Across multiple robotic manipulation tasks, ROVED matches or surpasses prior preference-based methods while reducing oracle queries by up to 80%. Remarkably, the adapted VLE generalizes across tasks, yielding cumulative annotation savings of up to 90%, highlighting the practicality of combining scalable embeddings with precise oracle supervision for preference-based RL.
tldr: This paper introduces ROVED, a hybrid preference-based RL framework that combines lightweight vision-language embeddings (VLE) with targeted oracle feedback to reduce annotation costs, achieving significant savings and generalization across robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了ROVED，一个混合的基于偏好的强化学习框架，它结合了轻量级的视觉-语言嵌入（VLE）和有针对性的专家反馈，以降低标注成本，并在机器人操作任务中实现了显著的节省和泛化。

title: Principal Prototype Analysis on Manifold for Interpretable Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recent years have witnessed the widespread adoption of reinforcement learning (RL), from solving real-time games to fine-tuning large language models using human preference data significantly improving alignment with user expectations. However, as model complexity grows exponentially, the interpretability of these systems becomes increasingly challenging. While numerous explainability methods have been developed for computer vision and natural language processing to elucidate both local and global reasoning patterns, their application to RL remains limited. Direct extensions of these methods often struggle to maintain the delicate balance between interpretability and performance within RL settings. Prototype-Wrapper Networks (PW-Nets) have recently shown promise in bridging this gap by enhancing explainability in RL domains without sacrificing the efficiency of the original black-box models. However, these methods typically require manually defined reference prototypes, which often necessitate expert domain knowledge. In this work, we propose a method that removes this dependency by automatically selecting optimal prototypes from the available data. Preliminary experiments on standard Gym environments demonstrate that our approach matches the performance of existing PW-Nets, while remaining competitive with the original black-box models.
tldr: This paper proposes a method for automatically selecting optimal prototypes for Prototype-Wrapper Networks (PW-Nets) in reinforcement learning, addressing the need for manual definition and expert domain knowledge. Preliminary results show comparable performance to existing PW-Nets and the original black-box models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在强化学习中自动选择Prototype-Wrapper Networks (PW-Nets)最佳原型的方法，解决了手动定义和专家领域知识的需求。初步实验结果表明，该方法与现有的PW-Nets和原始的黑盒模型具有可比的性能。

title: ATLAS-RTC: Closing the Loop on LLM Agent Output with Token-Level Runtime Control
summary: We present ATLAS-RTC, a runtime control system for autoregressive language models that enforces structured output during decoding. ATLAS-RTC monitors generation at each step, detects drift from output contracts using lightweight signals, and applies targeted interventions such as biasing, masking, and rollback. Unlike post-hoc validation or static constrained decoding, it operates in a closed loop, enabling correction before errors materialize. Across structured generation and tool-calling tasks, ATLAS-RTC improves first-attempt success rates by 20 to 37.8 percentage points, with up to 88% latency reduction in failure-dominated settings. Results show that many failures arise from decoding artifacts rather than task misunderstanding, motivating runtime control as a distinct layer in LLM systems.
tldr: ATLAS-RTC is a runtime control system for LLMs that uses lightweight signals to detect and correct errors during decoding, significantly improving success rates and reducing latency in structured generation and tool-calling tasks.
tldr_zh: ATLAS-RTC是一个LLM的运行时控制系统，它使用轻量级信号来检测和纠正在解码过程中的错误，从而显著提高结构化生成和工具调用任务的成功率并降低延迟。

title: Pandora: Articulated 3D Scene Graphs from Egocentric Vision
summary: Robotic mapping systems typically approach building metric-semantic scene representations from the robot's own sensors and cameras. However, these "first person" maps inherit the robot's own limitations due to its embodiment or skillset, which may leave many aspects of the environment unexplored. For example, the robot might not be able to open drawers or access wall cabinets. In this sense, the map representation is not as complete, and requires a more capable robot to fill in the gaps. We narrow these blind spots in current methods by leveraging egocentric data captured as a human naturally explores a scene wearing Project Aria glasses, giving a way to directly transfer knowledge about articulation from the human to any deployable robot. We demonstrate that, by using simple heuristics, we can leverage egocentric data to recover models of articulate object parts, with quality comparable to those of state-of-the-art methods based on other input modalities. We also show how to integrate these models into 3D scene graph representations, leading to a better understanding of object dynamics and object-container relationships. We finally demonstrate that these articulated 3D scene graphs enhance a robot's ability to perform mobile manipulation tasks, showcasing an application where a Boston Dynamics Spot is tasked with retrieving concealed target items, given only the 3D scene graph as input.
summary_zh: 机器人建图系统通常从机器人自身的传感器和摄像头构建度量-语义场景表示。然而，这些“第一人称”地图会继承机器人自身因其形态或技能限制而带来的局限性，这可能导致环境的许多方面未被探索。例如，机器人可能无法打开抽屉或接触到壁柜。从这个意义上讲，地图表示并不完整，需要更强大的机器人来弥补这些空白。我们通过利用人类佩戴 Project Aria 眼镜自然探索场景时捕获的以自我为中心的数据，来缩小当前方法中的这些盲点，从而提供了一种将关于铰接的知识直接从人类传递到任何可部署机器人的方法。我们证明，通过使用简单的启发式方法，我们可以利用以自我为中心的数据来恢复铰接物体部件的模型，其质量与基于其他输入模态的最新方法相当。我们还展示了如何将这些模型集成到 3D 场景图表示中，从而更好地理解物体动态和物体-容器关系。最后，我们证明了这些铰接式的 3D 场景图增强了机器人执行移动操作任务的能力，展示了一个应用，其中 Boston Dynamics Spot 被赋予仅以 3D 场景图作为输入来检索隐藏目标物品的任务。
tldr: The paper introduces Pandora, a method using human egocentric data to build articulated 3D scene graphs, improving robot understanding of object dynamics and aiding mobile manipulation, demonstrated on a Spot robot.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了Pandora，一种利用人类自我中心数据构建铰接的3D场景图的方法，从而提高机器人对物体动态的理解，并辅助移动操作，已在Spot机器人上进行了演示。

title: Serialized Red-Green-Gray: Quicker Heuristic Validation of Edges in Dynamic Roadmap Graphs
summary: Motion planning in dynamic environments, such as robotic warehouses, requires fast adaptation to frequent changes in obstacle poses. Traditional roadmap-based methods struggle in such settings, relying on inefficient reconstruction of a roadmap or expensive collision detection to update the existing roadmap. To address these challenges we introduce the Red-Green-Gray (RGG) framework, a method that builds on SPITE to quickly classify roadmap edges as invalid (red), valid (green), or uncertain (gray) using conservative geometric approximations. Serial RGG provides a high-performance variant leveraging batch serialization and vectorization to enable efficient GPU acceleration. Empirical results demonstrate that while RGG effectively reduces the number of unknown edges requiring full validation, SerRGG achieves a 2-9x speedup compared to the sequential implementation. This combination of geometric precision and computational speed makes SerRGG highly effective for time-critical robotic applications.
summary_zh: 在动态环境中（例如机器人仓库）进行运动规划需要针对障碍物姿态的频繁变化进行快速调整。 传统的基于路标图的方法在此类环境中表现不佳，依赖于路标图的低效重建或昂贵的碰撞检测来更新现有路标图。 为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了红-绿-灰 (RGG) 框架，该方法建立在 SPITE 基础上，利用保守的几何近似快速将路标图的边分类为无效（红）、有效（绿）或不确定（灰）。 串行 RGG 提供了一种高性能变体，利用批量序列化和矢量化来实现高效的 GPU 加速。 实验结果表明，虽然 RGG 有效减少了需要完全验证的未知边数量，但 SerRGG 与顺序实现相比实现了 2-9 倍的加速。 几何精度和计算速度的这种结合使得 SerRGG 非常适用于时间关键型机器人应用。
tldr: The paper introduces Serialized Red-Green-Gray (SerRGG), a GPU-accelerated method for quickly validating edges in dynamic roadmap graphs for motion planning in dynamic environments, achieving significant speedups compared to sequential implementations.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了串行红-绿-灰 (SerRGG) 方法，这是一种 GPU 加速的方法，用于快速验证动态路线图中的边，用于动态环境中的运动规划，与顺序实现相比，实现了显着的加速。

title: Sim-to-Real Fruit Detection Using Synthetic Data: Quantitative Evaluation and Embedded Deployment with Isaac Sim
summary: This study investigates the effectiveness of synthetic data for sim-to-real transfer in object detection under constrained data conditions and embedded deployment requirements. Synthetic datasets were generated in NVIDIA Isaac Sim and combined with limited real-world fruit images to train YOLO-based detection models under real-only, synthetic-only, and hybrid regimes. Performance was evaluated on two test datasets: an in-domain dataset with conditions matching the training data and a domain shift dataset containing real fruit and different background conditions. Results show that models trained exclusively on real data achieve the highest accuracy, while synthetic-only models exhibit reduced performance due to a domain gap. Hybrid training strategies significantly improve performance compared to synthetic-only approaches and achieve results close to real-only training while reducing the need for manual annotation. Under domain shift conditions, all models show performance degradation, with hybrid models providing improved robustness. The trained models were successfully deployed on a Jetson Orin NX using TensorRT optimization, achieving real-time inference performance. The findings highlight that synthetic data is most effective when used in combination with real data and that deployment constraints must be considered alongside detection accuracy.
summary_zh: 本研究调查了在受限数据条件和嵌入式部署需求下，合成数据在目标检测中用于模拟到真实迁移的有效性。 在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中生成了合成数据集，并将其与有限的真实水果图像相结合，以训练基于 YOLO 的检测模型，分别采用纯真实数据、纯合成数据和混合数据的方式。 模型性能在两个测试数据集上进行评估：一个与训练数据条件相匹配的域内数据集，以及一个包含真实水果和不同背景条件的域迁移数据集。结果表明，仅使用真实数据训练的模型实现了最高的精度，而仅使用合成数据的模型由于域差异表现出性能下降。 与纯合成数据方法相比，混合训练策略显著提高了性能，并在减少人工标注需求的同时，实现了接近纯真实数据训练的结果。 在域迁移条件下，所有模型都表现出性能下降，但混合模型提供了更好的鲁棒性。 经过训练的模型成功地使用 TensorRT 优化部署到 Jetson Orin NX 上，实现了实时推理性能。 研究结果表明，合成数据与真实数据结合使用时最为有效，并且在考虑检测精度的同时，必须考虑部署约束。
tldr: This paper explores using synthetic data from Isaac Sim, combined with limited real-world data, to train YOLO object detection models for fruit detection, demonstrating its effectiveness for sim-to-real transfer, especially when handling domain shift and deploying on embedded systems like Jetson Orin NX.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了使用Isaac Sim生成的合成数据与少量真实数据相结合，训练YOLO目标检测模型进行水果检测，展示了其在sim-to-real迁移中的有效性，尤其是在处理领域迁移和部署到Jetson Orin NX等嵌入式系统上时。

title: Dynamic Lookahead Distance via Reinforcement Learning-Based Pure Pursuit for Autonomous Racing
summary: Pure Pursuit (PP) is a widely used path-tracking algorithm in autonomous vehicles due to its simplicity and real-time performance. However, its effectiveness is sensitive to the choice of lookahead distance: shorter values improve cornering but can cause instability on straights, while longer values improve smoothness but reduce accuracy in curves. We propose a hybrid control framework that integrates Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with the classical Pure Pursuit controller to adjust the lookahead distance dynamically during racing. The PPO agent maps vehicle speed and multi-horizon curvature features to an online lookahead command. It is trained using Stable-Baselines3 in the F1TENTH Gym simulator with a KL penalty and learning-rate decay for stability, then deployed in a ROS2 environment to guide the controller. Experiments in simulation compare the proposed method against both fixed-lookahead Pure Pursuit and an adaptive Pure Pursuit baseline. Additional real-car experiments compare the learned controller against a fixed-lookahead Pure Pursuit controller. Results show that the learned policy improves lap-time performance and repeated lap completion on unseen tracks, while also transferring zero-shot to hardware. The learned controller adapts the lookahead by increasing it on straights and reducing it in curves, demonstrating effectiveness in augmenting a classical controller by online adaptation of a single interpretable parameter. On unseen tracks, the proposed method achieved 33.16 s on Montreal and 46.05 s on Yas Marina, while tolerating more aggressive speed-profile scaling than the baselines and achieving the best lap times among the tested settings. Initial real-car experiments further support sim-to-real transfer on a 1:10-scale autonomous racing platform
summary_zh: 纯追踪（PP）算法因其简单和实时性而广泛应用于自动驾驶车辆中。然而，其有效性对前视距离的选择非常敏感：较短的距离可以提高转弯性能，但可能导致在直道上的不稳定；而较长的距离可以提高平滑性，但会降低在弯道中的精度。我们提出了一种混合控制框架，将近端策略优化（PPO）与经典纯追踪控制器相结合，以在竞赛过程中动态调整前视距离。PPO 智能体将车速和多视距曲率特征映射到在线前视指令。它使用 Stable-Baselines3 在 F1TENTH Gym 模拟器中进行训练，采用 KL 惩罚和学习率衰减策略以保证稳定性，然后在 ROS2 环境中部署以引导控制器。仿真实验将所提出的方法与固定前视距离的纯追踪算法和一种自适应纯追踪基线方法进行了比较。额外的真车实验将学习到的控制器与固定前视距离的纯追踪控制器进行了比较。结果表明，学习到的策略提高了在未见赛道上的单圈用时性能和重复圈数完成率，同时实现了零样本迁移到硬件。学习到的控制器通过在直道上增加前视距离和在弯道中减小前视距离来调整前视距离，证明了通过在线自适应单个可解释参数来增强经典控制器的有效性。在未见赛道上，所提出的方法在蒙特利尔赛道上取得了 33.16 秒的成绩，在亚斯码头赛道上取得了 46.05 秒的成绩，同时相比基线方法，能够容忍更激进的速度曲线缩放，并在所有测试设置中取得了最佳单圈时间。初步的真车实验进一步支持了在 1:10 比例自动驾驶赛车平台上的从仿真到真实的迁移。
tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning approach using PPO to dynamically adjust the lookahead distance in a Pure Pursuit controller for autonomous racing, demonstrating improved lap times and sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的方法，使用PPO动态调整Pure Pursuit控制器中的前瞻距离，用于自主赛车，并展示了改进的圈速和从仿真到现实的迁移能力。

title: Detection of Adversarial Attacks in Robotic Perception
summary: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) achieve strong performance in semantic segmentation for robotic perception but remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks, threatening safety-critical applications. While robustness has been studied for image classification, semantic segmentation in robotic contexts requires specialized architectures and detection strategies.
summary_zh: 深度神经网络（DNNs）在机器人感知中的语义分割领域取得了优异的性能，但仍然容易受到对抗攻击的影响，从而威胁到安全攸关的应用。虽然图像分类的鲁棒性已被研究，但机器人环境下的语义分割需要专门的架构和检测策略。
tldr: This paper explores methods to detect adversarial attacks on semantic segmentation in robotics, addressing a vulnerability in safety-critical applications.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了检测机器人语义分割中对抗性攻击的方法，解决安全关键型应用中的漏洞。

title: A Self-Rotating Tri-Rotor UAV for Field of View Expansion and Autonomous Flight
summary: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) perception relies on onboard sensors like cameras and LiDAR, which are limited by the narrow field of view (FoV). We present Self-Perception INertial Navigation Enabled Rotorcraft (SPINNER), a self-rotating tri-rotor UAV for the FoV expansion and autonomous flight. Without adding extra sensors or energy consumption, SPINNER significantly expands the FoV of onboard camera and LiDAR sensors through continuous spin motion, thereby enhancing environmental perception efficiency. SPINNER achieves full 3-dimensional position and roll--pitch attitude control using only three brushless motors, while adjusting the rotation speed via anti-torque plates design. To address the strong coupling, severe nonlinearity, and complex disturbances induced by spinning flight, we develop a disturbance compensation control framework that combines nonlinear model predictive control (MPC) with incremental nonlinear dynamic inversion. Experimental results demonstrate that SPINNER maintains robust flight under wind disturbances up to 4.8 \,m/s and achieves high-precision trajectory tracking at a maximum speed of 2.0\,m/s. Moreover, tests in parking garages and forests show that the rotational perception mechanism substantially improves FoV coverage and enhances perception capability of SPINNER.
summary_zh: 无人机（UAV）感知依赖于机载摄像头和激光雷达等传感器，这些传感器受到窄视野（FoV）的限制。我们提出了一种自旋惯性导航旋翼机（SPINNER），这是一种用于扩展视野和自主飞行的自旋转三旋翼无人机。SPINNER无需增加额外传感器或功耗，通过连续的旋转运动显著扩展机载摄像头和激光雷达传感器的视野，从而提高环境感知效率。SPINNER仅使用三个无刷电机即可实现完整的3维位置和横滚-俯仰姿态控制，并通过反扭矩板设计调整旋转速度。为了解决旋转飞行带来的强耦合、严重非线性和复杂扰动，我们开发了一种扰动补偿控制框架，该框架结合了非线性模型预测控制（MPC）和增量非线性动态逆。实验结果表明，SPINNER在高达4.8米/秒的风扰下仍能保持稳定的飞行，并以最高2.0米/秒的速度实现高精度轨迹跟踪。此外，在停车场和森林中的测试表明，旋转感知机制显著提高了视野覆盖率，增强了SPINNER的感知能力。
tldr: The paper presents a tri-rotor UAV (SPINNER) with a self-rotating mechanism for enhanced field of view and autonomous flight using a disturbance compensation control framework. It demonstrates improvements in perception and robustness in challenging environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种三旋翼无人机（SPINNER），该无人机具有自旋转机制，通过使用扰动补偿控制框架来增强视野和自主飞行能力。 实验结果表明，该无人机在具有挑战性的环境中具有改进的感知能力和鲁棒性。

title: EBuddy: a workflow orchestrator for industrial human-machine collaboration
summary: This paper presents EBuddy, a voice-guided workflow orchestrator for natural human-machine collaboration in industrial environments. EBuddy targets a recurrent bottleneck in tool-intensive workflows: expert know-how is effective but difficult to scale, and execution quality degrades when procedures are reconstructed ad hoc across operators and sessions. EBuddy operationalizes expert practice as a finite state machine (FSM) driven application that provides an interpretable decision frame at runtime (current state and admissible actions), so that spoken requests are interpreted within state-grounded constraints, while the system executes and monitors the corresponding tool interactions. Through modular workflow artifacts, EBuddy coordinates heterogeneous resources, including GUI-driven software and a collaborative robot, leveraging fully voice-based interaction through automatic speech recognition and intent understanding. An industrial pilot on impeller blade inspection and repair preparation for directed energy deposition (DED), realized by human-robot collaboration, shows substantial reductions in end-to-end process duration across onboarding, 3D scanning and processing, and repair program generation, while preserving repeatability and low operator burden.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了EBuddy，一个语音引导的工作流编排器，用于工业环境中自然的人机协作。 EBuddy旨在解决工具密集型工作流中一个反复出现的瓶颈：专家知识有效但难以扩展，并且当操作员和会话间临时重建程序时，执行质量会下降。 EBuddy将专家实践操作化为一个有限状态机（FSM）驱动的应用程序，该应用程序在运行时提供一个可解释的决策框架（当前状态和允许的操作），以便在状态约束范围内解释语音请求，同时系统执行并监控相应的工具交互。 通过模块化的工作流组件，EBuddy协调异构资源，包括GUI驱动的软件和一个协作机器人，利用基于自动语音识别和意图理解的全语音交互。 一个关于叶轮叶片检测和定向能量沉积（DED）修复准备的工业试点项目，通过人机协作实现，表明在启动、3D扫描和处理以及修复程序生成等端到端流程的持续时间上显著减少，同时保持了可重复性和较低的操作员负担。
tldr: EBuddy is a voice-guided workflow orchestrator that uses finite state machines to improve human-machine collaboration in industrial workflows, demonstrating significant process improvements in an impeller blade inspection and repair pilot.
tldr_zh: EBuddy是一个语音引导的工作流编排器，它使用有限状态机来改善工业工作流程中的人机协作。在一个叶轮片检查和修复的试点案例中，它展示了流程的显著改进。

title: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for Cooperative Tactical Deconfliction of Small Unmanned Aerial Systems
summary: The growing deployment of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUASs) in low-altitude airspaces has increased the need for reliable tactical deconfliction under safety-critical constraints. Tactical deconfliction involves short-horizon decision-making in dense, partially observable, and heterogeneous multi-agent environments, where both cooperative separation assurance and operational efficiency must be maintained. While Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, their direct application to air traffic control remains limited by insufficient domain grounding and unpredictable output inconsistency. This paper investigates LLMs as decision-makers in cooperative multi-agent tactical deconfliction using fine-tuning strategies that align model outputs to human operator heuristics. We propose a simulation-to-language data generation pipeline based on the BlueSky air traffic simulator that produces rule-consistent deconfliction datasets reflecting established safety practices. A pretrained Qwen-Math-7B model is fine-tuned using two parameter-efficient strategies: supervised fine-tuning with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and preference-based fine-tuning combining LoRA with Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Experimental results on validation datasets and closed-loop simulations demonstrate that supervised LoRA fine-tuning substantially improves decision accuracy, consistency, and separation performance compared to the pretrained LLM, with significant reductions in near mid-air collisions. GRPO provides additional coordination benefits but exhibits reduced robustness when interacting with heterogeneous agent policies.
summary_zh: 小型无人机系统(sUAS)在低空空域日益增多的部署，增加了对安全关键约束下可靠战术避撞的需求。战术避撞涉及在密集、部分可观测和异构的多智能体环境中进行短时域决策，其中必须同时保持合作性分离保障和运行效率。虽然大型语言模型(LLMs)表现出强大的推理能力，但由于领域基础不足和不可预测的输出不一致性，它们在空中交通管制中的直接应用仍然受到限制。本文研究了LLM作为合作多智能体战术避撞中的决策者，使用微调策略将模型输出与人类操作员的启发式方法对齐。我们提出了一种基于BlueSky空中交通模拟器的模拟到语言的数据生成管道，该管道产生反映既定安全规范的规则一致性避撞数据集。使用两种参数高效策略对一个预训练的Qwen-Math-7B模型进行微调：使用低秩自适应(LoRA)的监督微调和结合LoRA与组相对策略优化(GRPO)的基于偏好的微调。在验证数据集和闭环模拟上的实验结果表明，与预训练的LLM相比，监督LoRA微调显著提高了决策准确性、一致性和间隔性能，并显著减少了空中接近碰撞。GRPO提供了额外的协调优势，但在与异构智能体策略交互时表现出鲁棒性降低。
tldr: This paper fine-tunes a Large Language Model (LLM) for tactical deconfliction of unmanned aerial systems, using simulation-generated data and parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods (LoRA and GRPO) to align the LLM's decision-making with human operator heuristics, and demonstrates improved performance in reducing near mid-air collisions.
tldr_zh: 本文针对无人机战术避撞问题，通过模拟生成数据并利用参数高效的微调方法（LoRA和GRPO）来微调大型语言模型（LLM），使其决策与人类操作员的经验相符。实验结果表明，该方法可以有效减少空中接近碰撞。

title: Feel Robot Feels: Tactile Feedback Array Glove for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Teleoperation is a key approach for collecting high-quality, physically consistent demonstrations for robotic manipulation. However, teleoperation for dexterous manipulation remains constrained by: (i) inaccurate hand-robot motion mapping, which limits teleoperated dexterity, and (ii) limited tactile feedback that forces vision-dominated interaction and hinders perception of contact geometry and force variation. To address these challenges, we present TAG, a low-cost glove system that integrates precise hand motion capture with high-resolution tactile feedback, enabling effective tactile-in-the-loop dexterous teleoperation. For motion capture, TAG employs a non-contact magnetic sensing design that provides drift-free, electromagnetically robust 21-DoF joint tracking with joint angle estimation errors below 1 degree. Meanwhile, to restore tactile sensation, TAG equips each finger with a 32-actuator tactile array within a compact 2 cm^2 module, allowing operators to directly feel physical interactions at the robot end-effector through spatial activation patterns. Through real-world teleoperation experiments and user studies, we show that TAG enables reliable real-time perception of contact geometry and dynamic force, improves success rates in contact-rich teleoperation tasks, and increases the reliability of demonstration data collection for learning-based manipulation.
summary_zh: 遥操作是为机器人灵巧操作收集高质量、物理一致的演示的关键方法。然而，灵巧操作的遥操作仍然受到以下限制：(i) 不精确的手-机器人运动映射，限制了遥操作的灵活性，以及 (ii) 有限的触觉反馈，迫使以视觉为主的交互，并阻碍了对接触几何形状和力变化的感知。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了TAG，一种低成本的手套系统，它集成了精确的手部运动捕捉和高分辨率的触觉反馈，从而实现有效的触觉闭环灵巧遥操作。在运动捕捉方面，TAG采用非接触式磁感应设计，提供无漂移、电磁鲁棒的 21 自由度关节追踪，关节角度估计误差低于 1 度。同时，为了恢复触觉，TAG 在每个手指上配备了一个紧凑的 2 平方厘米模块内的 32 单元触觉阵列，允许操作者通过空间激活模式直接感受到机器人末端执行器上的物理交互。通过真实世界的遥操作实验和用户研究，我们表明 TAG 能够可靠地实时感知接触几何形状和动态力，提高接触密集型遥操作任务的成功率，并提高基于学习的操纵演示数据收集的可靠性。
tldr: The paper introduces TAG, a low-cost glove system with precise hand motion capture and high-resolution tactile feedback, enabling more effective dexterous teleoperation and improved data collection for learning-based manipulation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TAG，一种低成本手套系统，具有精确的手部动作捕捉和高分辨率触觉反馈，从而能实现更有效的灵巧遥操作，并改进用于基于学习的机械臂操作的数据收集。

title: Tele-Catch: Adaptive Teleoperation for Dexterous Dynamic 3D Object Catching
summary: Teleoperation is a key paradigm for transferring human dexterity to robots, yet most prior work targets objects that are initially static, such as grasping or manipulation. Dynamic object catch, where objects move before contact, remains underexplored. Pure teleoperation in this task often fails due to timing, pose, and force errors, highlighting the need for shared autonomy that combines human input with autonomous policies. To this end, we present Tele-Catch, a systematic framework for dexterous hand teleoperation in dynamic object catching. At its core, we design DAIM, a dynamics-aware adaptive integration mechanism that realizes shared autonomy by fusing glove-based teleoperation signals into the diffusion policy denoising process. It adaptively modulates control based on the interaction object state. To improve policy robustness, we introduce DP-U3R, which integrates unsupervised geometric representations from point cloud observations into diffusion policy learning, enabling geometry-aware decision making. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Tele-Catch significantly improves accuracy and robustness in dynamic catching tasks, while also exhibiting consistent gains across distinct dexterous hand embodiments and previously unseen object categories.
summary_zh: 遥操作是将人类灵巧性赋予机器人的关键范例，但以往的大部分工作都针对初始静态的物体，例如抓取或操作。动态物体抓取，即物体在接触前就处于运动状态，仍未被充分探索。纯粹的遥操作在这种任务中往往因时间、姿态和力度误差而失败，突显了结合人类输入与自主策略的共享自主的必要性。为此，我们提出了Tele-Catch，一个在动态物体抓取中实现灵巧手遥操作的系统框架。其核心是我们设计了DAIM（动力学感知自适应融合机制），通过将基于手套的遥操作信号融合到扩散策略去噪过程中来实现共享自主。它根据交互物体的状态自适应地调节控制。为了提高策略的鲁棒性，我们引入了DP-U3R，它将来自点云观测的无监督几何表示集成到扩散策略学习中，从而实现几何感知决策。大量实验表明，Tele-Catch显著提高了动态抓取任务的准确性和鲁棒性，同时在不同的灵巧手实现和以前未见过的物体类别中也表现出一致的提升。
tldr: The paper introduces Tele-Catch, a framework for dexterous robot teleoperation in dynamic object catching, using shared autonomy with a dynamics-aware adaptive integration mechanism and unsupervised geometric representations to improve accuracy and robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Tele-Catch，一个用于灵巧机器人遥操作动态物体捕捉的框架，使用共享自主，通过一种动态感知的自适应集成机制和无监督的几何表示来提高准确性和鲁棒性。

title: Active Stereo-Camera Outperforms Multi-Sensor Setup in ACT Imitation Learning for Humanoid Manipulation
summary: The complexity of teaching humanoid robots new tasks is one of the major reasons hindering their widespread adoption in the industry. While Imitation Learning (IL), particularly Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT), enables rapid task acquisition, there is no consensus yet on the optimal sensory hardware required for manipulation tasks. This paper benchmarks 14 sensor combinations on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot equipped with three-finger hands for two manipulation tasks. We explicitly evaluate the integration of tactile and proprioceptive modalities alongside active vision. Our analysis demonstrates that strategic sensor selection can outperform complex configurations in data-limited regimes while reducing computational overhead. We develop an open-source Unified Ablation Framework that utilizes sensor masking on a comprehensive master dataset. Results indicate that additional modalities often degrade performance for IL with limited data. A minimal active stereo-camera setup outperformed complex multi-sensor configurations, achieving 87.5% success in a spatial generalization task and 94.4% in a structured manipulation task. Conversely, adding pressure sensors to this setup reduced success to 67.3% in the latter task due to a low signal-to-noise ratio. We conclude that in data-limited regimes, active vision offers a superior trade-off between robustness and complexity. While tactile modalities may require larger datasets to be effective, our findings validate that strategic sensor selection is critical for designing an efficient learning process.
summary_zh: 人形机器人学习新任务的复杂性是阻碍其在工业界广泛应用的主要原因之一。虽然模仿学习（IL），尤其是基于Transformer的行为组块（ACT）使得任务能够快速习得，但对于操作任务所需的最优传感硬件尚未达成共识。本文在配备三指手的宇树G1人形机器人上，针对两种操作任务，对14种传感器组合进行了基准测试。我们明确评估了触觉和本体感觉模态与主动视觉的整合。我们的分析表明，在数据受限的情况下，策略性的传感器选择可以胜过复杂的配置，同时降低计算开销。我们开发了一个开源的统一消融框架，该框架利用传感器掩码处理一个全面的主数据集。结果表明，对于数据有限的IL，额外的模态通常会降低性能。一个最小的主动立体视觉相机设置优于复杂的多传感器配置，在一个空间泛化任务中实现了87.5%的成功率，在一个结构化操作任务中实现了94.4%的成功率。相反，由于信噪比低，向该设置添加压力传感器将后一项任务的成功率降低到67.3%。我们得出结论，在数据受限的情况下，主动视觉在鲁棒性和复杂性之间提供了更好的权衡。虽然触觉模态可能需要更大的数据集才能有效，但我们的研究结果验证了策略性的传感器选择对于设计高效的学习过程至关重要。
tldr: This paper demonstrates that for humanoid robot manipulation tasks in data-limited Imitation Learning scenarios, a minimal active stereo-camera setup outperforms more complex multi-sensor configurations, suggesting strategic sensor selection is crucial.
tldr_zh: 该论文证明，在数据受限的模仿学习场景中，对于人形机器人操作任务，最小化的主动立体相机设置优于更复杂的多传感器配置，表明战略性传感器选择至关重要。

title: Critic-Free Deep Reinforcement Learning for Maritime Coverage Path Planning on Irregular Hexagonal Grids
summary: Maritime surveillance missions, such as search and rescue and environmental monitoring, rely on the efficient allocation of sensing assets over vast and geometrically complex areas. Traditional Coverage Path Planning (CPP) approaches depend on decomposition techniques that struggle with irregular coastlines, islands, and exclusion zones, or require computationally expensive re-planning for every instance. We propose a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) framework to solve CPP on hexagonal grid representations of irregular maritime areas. Unlike conventional methods, we formulate the problem as a neural combinatorial optimization task where a Transformer-based pointer policy autoregressively constructs coverage tours. To overcome the instability of value estimation in long-horizon routing problems, we implement a critic-free Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) scheme. This method estimates advantages through within-instance comparisons of sampled trajectories rather than relying on a value function. Experiments on 1,000 unseen synthetic maritime environments demonstrate that a trained policy achieves a 99.0% Hamiltonian success rate, more than double the best heuristic (46.0%), while producing paths 7% shorter and with 24% fewer heading changes than the closest baseline. All three inference modes (greedy, stochastic sampling, and sampling with 2-opt refinement) operate under 50~ms per instance on a laptop GPU, confirming feasibility for real-time on-board deployment.
summary_zh: 海上监视任务，例如搜索救援和环境监测，依赖于在广阔且几何形状复杂的区域上高效地分配传感资产。传统的覆盖路径规划（CPP）方法依赖于分解技术，这些技术难以处理不规则的海岸线、岛屿和禁区，或者需要为每个实例进行计算代价高昂的重新规划。我们提出了一种深度强化学习（DRL）框架，用于解决不规则海域的六边形网格表示上的CPP问题。与传统方法不同，我们将该问题表述为一个神经组合优化任务，其中基于Transformer的指针策略自回归地构建覆盖路线。为了克服长时程路径问题中价值估计的不稳定性，我们实现了一种无批评家的组相对策略优化（GRPO）方案。该方法通过实例内部对采样轨迹的比较来估计优势，而不是依赖于价值函数。对1000个未见过的合成海域环境进行的实验表明，训练后的策略实现了99.0%的哈密顿成功率，是最佳启发式方法（46.0%）的两倍以上，同时产生的路径比最接近的基线短7%，航向变化减少24%。在笔记本电脑GPU上，所有三种推理模式（贪婪、随机采样和带有2-opt优化的采样）的每个实例运行时间均低于50毫秒，证实了实时车载部署的可行性。
tldr: This paper presents a critic-free deep reinforcement learning framework using Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and a Transformer-based pointer policy for maritime coverage path planning on irregular hexagonal grids, achieving superior performance compared to heuristics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于无评论家深度强化学习框架，采用组相对策略优化(GRPO)和基于Transformer的指针策略，用于在不规则六边形网格上进行海上覆盖路径规划，并取得了优于启发式方法的效果。

title: Point of View: How Perspective Affects Perceived Robot Sociability
summary: Ensuring that robot navigation is safe and socially acceptable is crucial for comfortable human-robot interaction in shared environments. However, existing validation methods often rely on a bird's-eye (allocentric) perspective, which fails to capture the subjective first-person experience of pedestrians encountering robots in the real world. In this paper, we address the perceptual gap between allocentric validation and egocentric experience by investigating how different perspectives affect the perceived sociability and disturbance of robot trajectories. Our approach uses an immersive VR environment to evaluate identical robot trajectories across allocentric, egocentric-proximal, and egocentric-distal viewpoints in a user study. We perform this analysis for trajectories generated from two different navigation policies to understand if the observed differences are unique to a single type of trajectory or more generalizable. We further examine whether augmenting a trajectory with a head-nod gesture can bridge the perceptual gap and improve human comfort. Our experiments suggest that trajectories rated as sociable from an allocentric view may be perceived as significantly more disturbing when experienced from a first-person perspective in close proximity. Our results also demonstrate that while passing distance affects perceived disturbance, communicative social signaling, such as a head-nod, can effectively enhance the perceived sociability of the robot's behavior.
summary_zh: 确保机器人导航的安全性及社会可接受性，对于在共享环境中实现舒适的人机交互至关重要。然而，现有的验证方法通常依赖于鸟瞰视角（外中心视角），无法捕捉到行人在现实世界中遇到机器人时的主观第一人称体验。本文旨在解决外中心验证和自我中心体验之间的感知差距，通过研究不同视角如何影响机器人轨迹的感知到的社交性和干扰性。我们的方法使用沉浸式VR环境，通过用户研究评估相同机器人轨迹在外中心视角、自我中心-近距离视角以及自我中心-远距离视角下的表现。我们对两种不同的导航策略生成的轨迹进行此分析，以了解观察到的差异是单个轨迹类型特有的还是更具普遍性。我们还进一步研究了用点头姿势增强轨迹是否可以弥合感知差距并提高人类舒适度。我们的实验表明，以外中心视角评定为具有社交性的轨迹，当在近距离第一人称视角下体验时，可能会被认为具有显著更高的干扰性。我们的结果还表明，虽然通过距离会影响感知到的干扰性，但诸如点头之类的交流性社交信号可以有效地增强机器人行为的感知到的社交性。
tldr: This paper investigates how different perspectives (allocentric vs. egocentric) influence the perceived sociability of robot navigation, finding that allocentric validation may not reflect first-person experiences and that social signaling can improve perceived sociability from a first-person viewpoint.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了不同视角（鸟瞰视角 vs. 自我中心视角）如何影响对机器人导航社交性的感知。研究发现，鸟瞰视角的验证可能无法反映第一人称体验，而社交信号可以提高第一人称视角下的社交性感知。

title: osmAG-Nav: A Hierarchical Semantic Topometric Navigation Stack for Robust Lifelong Indoor Autonomy
summary: The deployment of mobile robots in large-scale, multi-floor environments demands navigation systems that achieve spatial scalability without compromising local kinematic precision. Traditional navigation stacks, reliant on monolithic occupancy grid maps, face severe bottlenecks in storage efficiency, cross-floor reasoning, and long-horizon planning. To address these limitations, this paper presents osmAG-Nav, a complete, open-source ROS2 navigation stack built upon the hierarchical semantic topometric OpenStreetMap Area Graph (osmAG) map standard. The system follows a "System of Systems" architecture that decouples global topological reasoning from local metric execution. A Hierarchical osmAG planner replaces dense grid searches with an LCA-anchored pipeline on a passage-centric graph whose edge costs derive from local raster traversability rather than Euclidean distance, yielding low-millisecond planning on long campus-scale routes. A Rolling Window mechanism rasterizes a fixed-size local metric grid around the robot, keeping the local costmap memory footprint independent of the total mapped area, while a Segmented Execution strategy dispatches intermediate goals to standard ROS2 controllers for smooth handoffs. System robustness is reinforced by a structure-aware LiDAR localization framework that filters dynamic clutter against permanent architectural priors. Extensive experiments on a real-world multi-story indoor-outdoor campus (>11,025 m^2) show that, on the same-floor benchmark subset, osmAG-Nav delivers up to 7816x lower planning latency than a grid-based baseline on long routes while maintaining low path-length overhead and lifelong localization stability. A single-floor long-range robot mission further validates the integrated stack reliability. The full stack is released as modular ROS2 Lifecycle Nodes.
summary_zh:
摘要：
在大型、多楼层环境中部署移动机器人需要导航系统实现空间可扩展性，同时不影响局部运动学精度。依赖于单体占用栅格地图的传统导航堆栈，在存储效率、跨楼层推理和长程规划方面面临严重的瓶颈。为了解决这些局限性，本文提出了 osmAG-Nav，一个完整的、开源的 ROS2 导航堆栈，构建于分层语义拓扑 OpenStreetMap Area Graph (osmAG) 地图标准之上。该系统遵循“系统之系统”架构，将全局拓扑推理与局部度量执行解耦。分层 osmAG 规划器将密集栅格搜索替换为基于最近公共祖先（LCA）锚定的流水线，该流水线在以通道为中心的图上进行，其边成本源于局部栅格可穿越性而非欧几里得距离，从而在长校园规模的路径上实现低毫秒级的规划。滚动窗口机制在机器人周围栅格化固定大小的局部度量栅格，使局部代价地图的内存占用独立于映射的总面积，而分段执行策略则将中间目标分派给标准的 ROS2 控制器，以实现平滑交接。系统鲁棒性通过结构感知的激光雷达定位框架得到加强，该框架根据永久性建筑先验信息过滤动态杂波。在真实的多层室内外校园（>11,025 平方米）上的大量实验表明，在同楼层基准测试子集上，osmAG-Nav 在长路径上提供的规划延迟比基于栅格的基线降低高达 7816 倍，同时保持较低的路径长度开销和终身定位稳定性。一个单楼层长距离机器人任务进一步验证了集成堆栈的可靠性。整个堆栈以模块化的 ROS2 生命周期节点的形式发布。
tldr: The paper introduces osmAG-Nav, a hierarchical navigation stack for indoor robots using OpenStreetMap Area Graphs for efficient long-range planning and localization in large, multi-floor environments, showing significant speed improvements compared to grid-based methods.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了osmAG-Nav，一种用于室内机器人的分层导航堆栈，它使用OpenStreetMap区域图进行高效的远距离规划和定位，并在大型多层环境中显示出比基于网格的方法显著的速度提升。

title: Cost-Matching Model Predictive Control for Efficient Reinforcement Learning in Humanoid Locomotion
summary: In this paper, we propose a cost-matching approach for optimal humanoid locomotion within a Model Predictive Control (MPC)-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework. A parameterized MPC formulation with centroidal dynamics is trained to approximate the action-value function obtained from high-fidelity closed-loop data. Specifically, the MPC cost-to-go is evaluated along recorded state-action trajectories, and the parameters are updated to minimize the discrepancy between MPC-predicted values and measured returns. This formulation enables efficient gradient-based learning while avoiding the computational burden of repeatedly solving the MPC problem during training. The proposed method is validated in simulation using a commercial humanoid platform. Results demonstrate improved locomotion performance and robustness to model mismatch and external disturbances compared with manually tuned baselines.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于成本匹配的方法，用于在基于模型预测控制（MPC）的强化学习（RL）框架内实现最优的人形机器人运动。 训练一种参数化的、基于质心动力学的MPC模型，以逼近从高保真闭环数据中获得的动作-价值函数。 具体而言，沿着记录的状态-动作轨迹评估MPC的剩余成本，并更新参数以最小化MPC预测值与实测回报之间的差异。 这种公式能够在训练期间实现高效的基于梯度的学习，同时避免反复求解MPC问题的计算负担。 该方法在一个商业人形机器人平台上进行了仿真验证。 结果表明，与手动调整的基线相比，该方法在运动性能以及对模型失配和外部扰动的鲁棒性方面均有所提高。
tldr: This paper presents a cost-matching approach to train a parameterized MPC for humanoid locomotion using offline RL, achieving improved performance and robustness compared to manually tuned baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种成本匹配方法，利用离线强化学习训练参数化的MPC（模型预测控制）用于人形机器人运动，与手动调整的基线相比，实现了更好的性能和鲁棒性。

title: A Classification of Heterogeneity in Uncrewed Vehicle Swarms and the Effects of Its Inclusion on Overall Swarm Resilience
summary: Combining different types of agents in uncrewed vehicle (UV) swarms has emerged as an approach to enhance mission resilience and operational capabilities across a wide range of applications. This study offers a systematic framework for grouping different types of swarms based on three main factors: agent nature (behavior and function), hardware structure (physical configuration and sensing capabilities), and operational space (domain of operation). A literature review indicates that strategic heterogeneity significantly improves swarm performance. Operational challenges, including communication architecture constraints, energy-aware coordination strategies, and control system integration, are also discussed. The analysis shows that heterogeneous swarms are more resilient because they can leverage diverse capabilities, adapt roles on the fly, and integrate data from multidimensional sensor feeds. Some important factors to consider when implementing are sim-to-real-world transfer for learned policies, standardized evaluation metrics, and control architectures that can work together. Learning-based coordination, GPS (Global Positioning System)-denied multi-robot SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping), and domain-specific commercial deployments collectively demonstrate that heterogeneous swarm technology is moving closer to readiness for high-value applications. This study offers a single taxonomy and evidence-based observations on methods for designing mission-ready heterogeneous swarms that balance complexity and increased capability.
summary_zh: 在无人载具（UV）集群中结合不同类型的智能体已成为一种增强任务弹性并拓展各类应用领域操作能力的方法。本研究提供了一个系统性框架，用于基于三个主要因素对不同类型的集群进行分组：智能体性质（行为和功能）、硬件结构（物理配置和感知能力）以及操作空间（操作域）。文献综述表明，战略性异构显著提高了集群性能。文中还讨论了包括通信架构约束、节能型协调策略以及控制系统集成等操作挑战。分析表明，异构集群更具弹性，因为它们可以利用多样化的能力，动态调整角色，并整合来自多维度传感器的数据。实施过程中需要考虑的一些重要因素包括：已学习策略的模拟到真实世界迁移、标准化评估指标以及能够协同工作的控制架构。基于学习的协调、GPS（全球定位系统）拒止环境下的多机器人SLAM（同步定位与地图构建）以及特定领域的商业部署共同表明，异构集群技术正日益接近高价值应用的就绪状态。本研究提供了一个单一的分类法，并基于实践证据对设计兼顾复杂性和增强能力的任务就绪型异构集群的方法进行了观察。
tldr: This paper presents a classification framework for heterogeneous uncrewed vehicle swarms, highlighting the resilience benefits and challenges associated with their diverse capabilities and discussing progress towards real-world applications.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个异构无人载具集群的分类框架，强调了其多样化能力带来的弹性和挑战，并讨论了其在高价值应用中的进展。

title: Flip Stunts on Bicycle Robots using Iterative Motion Imitation
summary: This work demonstrates a front-flip on bicycle robots via reinforcement learning, particularly by imitating reference motions that are infeasible and imperfect. To address this, we propose Iterative Motion Imitation(IMI), a method that iteratively imitates trajectories generated by prior policy rollouts. Starting from an initial reference that is kinematically or dynamically infeasible, IMI helps train policies that lead to feasible and agile behaviors. We demonstrate our method on Ultra-Mobility Vehicle (UMV), a bicycle robot that is designed to enable agile behaviors. From a self-colliding table-to-ground flip reference generated by a model-based controller, we are able to train policies that enable ground-to-ground and ground-to-table front-flips. We show that compared to a single-shot motion imitation, IMI results in policies with higher success rates and can transfer robustly to the real world. To our knowledge, this is the first unassisted acrobatic flip behavior on such a platform.
summary_zh: 本文通过强化学习演示了自行车机器人的前空翻，特别是通过模仿不可行且不完善的参考运动。为解决这个问题，我们提出了一种迭代运动模仿(IMI)方法，该方法迭代地模仿先前策略展开产生的轨迹。从运动学或动力学上不可行的初始参考开始，IMI有助于训练能够实现可行且敏捷行为的策略。我们在超机动车辆(UMV)上演示了我们的方法，这是一种旨在实现敏捷行为的自行车机器人。从基于模型的控制器生成的自碰撞的桌面到地面翻转参考中，我们能够训练出能够实现地面到地面和地面到桌面跳跃的策略。我们表明，与单次运动模仿相比，IMI产生了具有更高成功率的策略，并且可以稳健地转移到现实世界中。据我们所知，这是此类平台上首次实现的无辅助特技空翻行为。
tldr: The paper presents Iterative Motion Imitation (IMI), a reinforcement learning method to train bicycle robots to perform front-flips using imperfect reference motions, achieving, to the authors' knowledge, the first unassisted acrobatic flip on such a platform.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种迭代运动模仿（IMI）方法，利用强化学习训练自行车机器人执行前空翻，并声称实现了第一个在此类平台上无需辅助的杂技空翻。

title: MPC as a Copilot: A Predictive Filter Framework with Safety and Stability Guarantees
summary: Ensuring both safety and stability remains a fundamental challenge in learning-based control, where goal-oriented policies often neglect system constraints and closed-loop state convergence. To address this limitation, this paper introduces the Predictive Safety--Stability Filter (PS2F), a unified predictive filter framework that guarantees constraint satisfaction and asymptotic stability within a single architecture. The PS2F framework comprises two cascaded optimal control problems: a nominal model predictive control (MPC) layer that serves solely as a copilot, implicitly defining a Lyapunov function and generating safety- and stability-certified predicted trajectories, and a secondary filtering layer that adjusts external command to remain within a provably safe and stable region. This cascaded structure enables PS2F to inherit the theoretical guarantees of nominal MPC while accommodating goal-oriented external commands. Rigorous analysis establishes recursive feasibility and asymptotic stability of the closed-loop system without introducing additional conservatism beyond that associated with the nominal MPC. Furthermore, a time-varying parameterisation allows PS2F to transition smoothly between safety-prioritised and stability-oriented operation modes, providing a principled mechanism for balancing exploration and exploitation. The effectiveness of the proposed framework is demonstrated through comparative numerical experiments.
summary_zh: 确保安全性和稳定性仍然是基于学习的控制中的一项根本挑战，其中以目标为导向的策略通常会忽略系统约束和闭环状态收敛。为了解决这一局限性，本文介绍了一种预测安全-稳定性滤波器（PS2F），这是一个统一的预测滤波器框架，可在单个架构中保证约束满足和渐近稳定性。PS2F框架包含两个级联的最优控制问题：一个名义模型预测控制（MPC）层，仅用作副驾驶，隐式定义李雅普诺夫函数并生成经过安全性和稳定性认证的预测轨迹；以及一个次级滤波层，用于调整外部命令以保持在可证明安全且稳定的区域内。这种级联结构使PS2F能够在适应以目标为导向的外部命令的同时，继承名义MPC的理论保证。严谨的分析建立了闭环系统的递归可行性和渐近稳定性，而无需引入额外保守性，仅限于与名义MPC相关的保守性。此外，一种时变参数化允许PS2F在安全优先和稳定导向的运行模式之间平滑过渡，为平衡探索和利用提供了一种原则性机制。通过对比数值实验证明了所提出框架的有效性。
tldr: The paper presents a Predictive Safety--Stability Filter (PS2F) framework using cascaded MPC to guarantee safety and stability in learning-based control by filtering external commands.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种预测安全-稳定性滤波器 (PS2F) 框架，通过级联模型预测控制 (MPC) 来保证学习控制的安全性与稳定性，该框架通过过滤外部命令来实现。

title: Spectral Decomposition of Inverse Dynamics for Fast Exploration in Model-Based Manipulation
summary: Planning long duration robotic manipulation sequences is challenging because of the complexity of exploring feasible trajectories through nonlinear contact dynamics and many contact modes. Moreover, this complexity grows with the problem's horizon length. We propose a search tree method that generates trajectories using the spectral decomposition of the inverse dynamics equation. This equation maps actuator displacement to object displacement, and its spectrum is efficient for exploration because its components are orthogonal and they approximate the reachable set of the object while remaining dynamically feasible. These trajectories can be combined with any search based method, such as Rapidly-Exploring Random Trees (RRT), for long-horizon planning. Our method performs similarly to recent work in model-based planning for short-horizon tasks, and differentiates itself with its ability to solve long-horizon tasks: whereas existing methods fail, ours can generate 45 second duration, 10+ contact mode plans using 15 seconds of computation, demonstrating real-time capability in highly complex domains.
summary_zh: 规划长时间机器人灵巧操作序列充满挑战，因为探索通过非线性接触动力学和多种接触模式下的可行轨迹十分复杂。而且，这种复杂性随着问题的时间跨度增加而增长。我们提出了一种搜索树方法，该方法利用逆动力学方程的谱分解来生成轨迹。该方程将执行器位移映射到对象位移，其频谱对于探索是高效的，因为其分量是正交的，并且它们近似于对象的可达集合，同时保持动力学可行性。这些轨迹可以与任何基于搜索的方法结合，例如快速探索随机树（RRT），用于长时域规划。对于短时域任务，我们的方法表现与最近的基于模型的规划工作相似，其区别优势在于解决长时域任务的能力：现有方法失败时，我们的方法可以在15秒的计算时间内生成45秒时长、10+接触模式的规划，展示了在高度复杂领域中的实时能力。
tldr: This paper introduces a search tree method using spectral decomposition of inverse dynamics for efficient long-horizon robotic manipulation planning, achieving real-time performance in complex contact-rich scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种使用逆动力学谱分解的搜索树方法，用于高效的长程机器人操作规划，在复杂的接触场景中实现了实时性能。

title: Stepwise Credit Assignment for GRPO on Flow-Matching Models
summary: Flow-GRPO successfully applies reinforcement learning to flow models, but uses uniform credit assignment across all steps. This ignores the temporal structure of diffusion generation: early steps determine composition and content (low-frequency structure), while late steps resolve details and textures (high-frequency details). Moreover, assigning uniform credit based solely on the final image can inadvertently reward suboptimal intermediate steps, especially when errors are corrected later in the diffusion trajectory. We propose Stepwise-Flow-GRPO, which assigns credit based on each step's reward improvement. By leveraging Tweedie's formula to obtain intermediate reward estimates and introducing gain-based advantages, our method achieves superior sample efficiency and faster convergence. We also introduce a DDIM-inspired SDE that improves reward quality while preserving stochasticity for policy gradients.
summary_zh: Flow-GRPO 成功地将强化学习应用于流模型，但其在所有步骤中采用一致的信用分配机制。这忽略了扩散生成的时间结构：早期步骤决定构图和内容（低频结构），而后期步骤则解决细节和纹理（高频细节）。此外，仅仅基于最终图像分配一致的信用可能会无意中奖励次优的中间步骤，尤其是在错误在扩散轨迹的后期被纠正的情况下。我们提出了 Stepwise-Flow-GRPO，它基于每个步骤的奖励改进来分配信用。通过利用 Tweedie 公式来获取中间奖励估计，并引入基于增益的优势函数，我们的方法实现了更高的样本效率和更快的收敛速度。我们还引入了一种受 DDIM 启发的 SDE，它在保留策略梯度随机性的同时，提高了奖励质量。
tldr: The paper proposes Stepwise-Flow-GRPO, a reinforcement learning method for flow models that improves credit assignment by considering the temporal structure of diffusion generation, leading to enhanced sample efficiency and faster convergence.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了Stepwise-Flow-GRPO，一种用于流模型的强化学习方法，通过考虑扩散生成的时序结构来改进信用分配，从而提高样本效率和更快的收敛速度。

title: Information-Theoretic Limits of Safety Verification for Self-Improving Systems
summary:
Can a safety gate permit unbounded beneficial self-modification while maintaining bounded cumulative risk? We formalize this question through dual conditions -- requiring sum delta_n < infinity (bounded risk) and sum TPR_n = infinity (unbounded utility) -- and establish a theory of their (in)compatibility.
  Classification impossibility (Theorem 1): For power-law risk schedules delta_n = O(n^{-p}) with p > 1, any classifier-based gate under overlapping safe/unsafe distributions satisfies TPR_n <= C_alpha * delta_n^beta via Holder's inequality, forcing sum TPR_n < infinity. This impossibility is exponent-optimal (Theorem 3). A second independent proof via the NP counting method (Theorem 4) yields a 13% tighter bound without Holder's inequality.
  Universal finite-horizon ceiling (Theorem 5): For any summable risk schedule, the exact maximum achievable classifier utility is U*(N, B) = N * TPR_NP(B/N), growing as exp(O(sqrt(log N))) -- subpolynomial. At N = 10^6 with budget B = 1.0, a classifier extracts at most U* ~ 87 versus a verifier's ~500,000.
  Verification escape (Theorem 2): A Lipschitz ball verifier achieves delta = 0 with TPR > 0, escaping the impossibility. Formal Lipschitz bounds for pre-LayerNorm transformers under LoRA enable LLM-scale verification. The separation is strict. We validate on GPT-2 (d_LoRA = 147,456): conditional delta = 0 with TPR = 0.352. Comprehensive empirical validation is in the companion paper [D2].
summary_zh:
安全门能否在保持有界累积风险的同时，允许无限的有益自我修改？我们通过双重条件形式化这个问题——要求 sum delta_n < infinity（有界风险）和 sum TPR_n = infinity（无限效用）——并建立了一套关于它们（不）兼容性的理论。

分类不可行性（定理 1）：对于幂律风险时间表 delta_n = O(n^{-p})，其中 p > 1，任何基于分类器的门在重叠的安全/不安全分布下都会通过 Holder 不等式满足 TPR_n <= C_alpha * delta_n^beta，从而迫使 sum TPR_n < infinity。这种不可行性是指数最优的（定理 3）。通过 NP 计数方法的第二个独立证明（定理 4）在没有 Holder 不等式的情况下产生了紧 13% 的界限。

通用有限视界上限（定理 5）：对于任何可加的总风险时间表，可实现的分类器最大效用是 U*(N, B) = N * TPR_NP(B/N)，增长速度为 exp(O(sqrt(log N)))——亚多项式。当 N = 10^6 且预算 B = 1.0 时，分类器最多提取 U* ~ 87，而验证器提取 ~500,000。

验证逃逸（定理 2）：一个 Lipschitz 球验证器实现了 delta = 0 且 TPR > 0，从而逃逸了不可行性。预 LayerNorm 转换器在 LoRA 下的形式 Lipschitz 界限使得 LLM 规模的验证成为可能。这种分离是严格的。我们在 GPT-2 (d_LoRA = 147,456) 上进行了验证：条件 delta = 0 且 TPR = 0.352。全面的经验验证包含在配套论文 [D2] 中。
tldr: This paper investigates the theoretical limits of safety verification for self-improving systems using information-theoretic tools, finding impossibility results for classifier-based gates under certain conditions, but also identifying verification escape mechanisms using Lipschitz ball verifiers, and provides empirical validation on GPT-2.
tldr_zh: 该论文研究了自改进系统的安全验证在信息论上的理论极限。研究表明，在特定条件下，基于分类器的安全门存在不可行性；但论文也发现了一种使用Lipschitz球验证器实现验证逃逸的机制，并在GPT-2上进行了经验验证。

title: Learning Partial Action Replacement in Offline MARL
summary: Offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) faces a critical challenge: the joint action space grows exponentially with the number of agents, making dataset coverage exponentially sparse and out-of-distribution (OOD) joint actions unavoidable. Partial Action Replacement (PAR) mitigates this by anchoring a subset of agents to dataset actions, but existing approach relies on enumerating multiple subset configurations at high computational cost and cannot adapt to varying states. We introduce PLCQL, a framework that formulates PAR subset selection as a contextual bandit problem and learns a state-dependent PAR policy using Proximal Policy Optimisation with an uncertainty-weighted reward. This adaptive policy dynamically determines how many agents to replace at each update step, balancing policy improvement against conservative value estimation. We prove a value-error bound showing that the estimation error scales linearly with the expected number of deviating agents. Compared with the previous PAR-based method SPaCQL, PLCQL reduces the number of per-iteration Q-function evaluations from n to 1, significantly improving computational efficiency. Empirically, PLCQL achieves the highest normalised scores on 66% of tasks across MPE, MaMuJoCo, and SMAC benchmarks, outperforming SPaCQL on 84% of tasks while substantially reducing computational cost.
summary_zh: 离线多智能体强化学习（MARL）面临一个严峻的挑战：联合动作空间随着智能体数量呈指数增长，导致数据集覆盖率呈指数稀疏，且不可避免地出现分布外（OOD）联合动作。部分动作替换（PAR）通过将一部分智能体的动作锚定到数据集中的动作来缓解这个问题，但现有方法依赖于枚举多个子集配置，计算成本很高，且无法适应不同的状态。我们引入了PLCQL，一个将PAR子集选择构建为上下文bandit问题的框架，并使用带有不确定性加权奖励的近端策略优化来学习一个状态相关的PAR策略。这种自适应策略动态地决定了每次更新步骤中要替换的智能体数量，从而在策略改进和保守值估计之间取得平衡。我们证明了一个值误差界，表明估计误差与偏离的智能体的期望数量呈线性关系。与之前的基于PAR的方法SPaCQL相比，PLCQL将每次迭代的Q函数评估次数从n减少到1，显著提高了计算效率。在MPE、MaMuJoCo和SMAC基准测试中，PLCQL在66%的任务上实现了最高的标准化分数，并在84%的任务上优于SPaCQL，同时大幅降低了计算成本。
tldr: The paper introduces PLCQL, a novel offline MARL framework that learns a state-dependent partial action replacement policy, significantly improving computational efficiency and performance compared to existing methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PLCQL，一种新颖的离线MARL框架，它学习状态相关的部分动作替换策略，与现有方法相比，显着提高了计算效率和性能。

title: CiQi-Agent: Aligning Vision, Tools and Aesthetics in Multimodal Agent for Cultural Reasoning on Chinese Porcelains
